decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - Lists with about two million names identified for the implementation of the Aswesuma Welfare Benefit Payment Scheme have now been published at the Divisional Secretariat and Grama Niladhari Divisional levels for submitting appeals and objections. Accordingly, Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies for making welfare benefit payments for the 3 social groups of Elderly Beneficiaries, Chronic Kidney Patients with unknown etiology (CKDu) and Differently-Abled Persons, stated in the Gazette Notification which has already been published, until such persons who have applied for obtaining welfare benefits are determined based on the most appropriate criteria and guidelines for obtaining such benefits under the said Programme.

description: Preparation of a Master Plan for development of the Hambantota District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - Although, approval of the cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2018‑06‑26 to assign the task of obtaining consultancy services for the preparation of a Greater Hambantota Regional Structure Plan and a Detailed Master Plan for Key Growth Centres to Surbana Jurong (Private) Company, action have not yet been taken as per the said decision. The Government has decided to give priority to the development of the Hambantota district, and it has been identified that it would be more appropriate to assign the task of preparing a master plan for the development of Hambantota district to Surbana Jurong (Private) Company itself, which has been entrusted with the responsibility of preparing master plans for the development of the Colombo city and the Western Province, and the development of the Eastern Province Strategic Tourism Zone. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to assign the said task to  to Surbana Jurong (Private) Company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enrollment of the 07th intake under the Interest Free Student Loan Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meting held on 2023‑04‑24 to enroll the 07th intake under the Interest Free Student Loan Scheme, to follow degree courses in Non-State universities. The Bank of Ceylon and the Peoples' Bank have expressed their concurrence to implement this loan scheme with a minimum interest rate of 13% for the entire loan duration. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to implement the Interest Free Student Loan Scheme for the students who have fulfilled requisite qualifications from among the students selected to follow degree courses upon the GCE(A/L) results in the years of 2019, 2020 and 2021, under the 07th intake, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mid-Year Fiscal Position Report
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - In terms of section 10 of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No.3 of 2003, the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance is required to release the Report of Mid-Year Fiscal Position to the general public by the end of June of each year and thereafter to table the same in Parliament. Accordingly, the Mid-Year Fiscal Position Report up to 2023‑06‑30 has been published on the website of the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to table the said Report in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bill to amend the approved Borrowing Limit for the Financial Year 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meting held on 2023‑06‑28 to amend the approved borrowing limit for the financial year 2023. Accordingly, a Bill has been drafted by the Legal Draftsman to amend the Appropriation Act, No.43 of 2022 and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the same. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette, and thereafter present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Order under subsection (2) of Section 29A of the Judicature Act, No. 2 of 1978
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - Section 29A(2) of the Judicature Act, No. 2 of 1978 indicates the provisions that the monetary value of all actions specified in the Seventh Schedule over which the Small Claims Court will have exclusive original civil jurisdiction, shall be designated by the Minister in-charge of the subject of Justice from time to time. The Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms has published an Order in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2328/16 dated 2023.04.21, which states that the monetary value up to Rs. 1.5 million excluding the interest, which has been fixed to the said courts, shall be Rupees two million or not exceeding Rupees two million, excluding the interest. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to submit the said Order in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority Act No. 51 of 1979
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - The Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023.01.02 to amend the Sri Lanka Ports Authority Act No. 51 of 1979. Accordingly, the clearance of the  Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and then submit it to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Civil Aviation Aeronautical Service Provider (Air Navigation and Aviation	Security) Licensing Regulations No.01 of 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - The Civil Aviation Aeronautical Service Provider (Air Navigation and Aviation Security) Licensing Regulations No. 01 of 2023 has been promulgated through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2326/16 dated 2023.04.03, as per the provisions of the Civil Aviation Act No. 14 of 2010, enabling to ensure the safe aircraft operation within the aerodromes and airspace of Sri Lanka in accordance with the standards and recommended practices contained in the annexes to the Convention on International Civil Aviation. Accordingly, the proposal submitted by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation Services to submit the said Regulations in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restructuring the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - Taking into account the facts that the expected objectives by establishing the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment (Sathosa) have not been fulfilled and that the institution has not contributed effectively to the economy, it has been identified the necessity of restructuring the Sathosa. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce and Food Security to appoint an Operations and Monitoring Committee to carry out the activities related to the restructuring of the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment (Sathosa) and to implement the proposed restructuring process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing a land plot located in IT Park, Malabe for the establishment of	the laboratory of Sri Lanka Standards Institution
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - A 3 acre plot of land in the Information Technology Park in Malabe has been allocated for the construction of the laboratory of the Sri Lanka Standards Institution. The amount spent by the Urban Development Authority to acquire that plot of land has already been paid by the Sri Lanka Standards Institution. Accordingly, taking into account the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing, the Cabinet granted approval to transfer the said plot of land to the Sri Lanka Standards Institution through a freehold deed.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding for obtaining oil spill	monitoring service based on satellite technology
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - As the number of vessels sailing in Sri Lankan territorial waters is increasing with the growth of the marine industry and port development, it has been identified the necessity to establish a system to quickly obtain information about oil spills caused by vessels. By having such a system, it will be possible to take quick steps to prevent marine pollution caused by vessels, to identify the vessels responsible for it and to take relevant legal actions. Accordingly, the Ministry for the Economy and Finance of France has agreed to provide a grant of Euro 601,810 through Collected Localization Satellites, as a pilot project and the draft Memorandum of Understanding proposed to be signed has received the clearance of the Attorney General. The proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to sign the said Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Updated National Physical Planning Policy and Plan - 2048
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2020‑01‑02 has granted approval to update the National Physical Plan in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the 'National Physical Planning Policy and Plan - 2048' has been prepared based on the proposals made  through the Throne Speeches and Budget Speeches presented by the Hon. President, Policy Framework of the Government,  data updated by various institutions and the Report of the Inter-Government Panel on Climate Change - 2021 and as per the instructions of the Technical Advisory Committee established in accordance with the provisions of Town and Country Planning (Amendment) Act, No. 49 of 2000 and with the contribution of all relevant parties. Approval of the Inter-Ministerial Coordinating Committee on  Physical Planning and the National Physical Planning Council has been received for the said plan. Accordingly, The Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence for the implementation of the updated National Physical Planning Policy and Plan - 2048 presented by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing.

description: Providing the land located at Sir James Peiris Mawatha, Colombo 02, which had been leased out to the Board of Governors of Sri Jinarathana Education Institute, as a grant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - During the implementation of the Beira Lake Restoration Project,  a block of land in extent of 45 perches located at Sir James Peiris Mawatha, Colombo 02 has been provided to the Sri Jinarathana Education Institute on 99 year lease basis for education purposes, in lieu of land being utilized by the said Institute. The Patron Thero of the Governing Council of Sri Jinarathana Education Institute has made a request to provide the said land block as a grant in lieu of long-term lease, in order to develop the same enabling to provide educational services more efficiently and to provide more facilities to the students of the institute.  The said request has been approved by the Board of Management of the Urban Development Authority on 06.04.2023. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to provide the said block of land to the Governing Council of the Sri Jinarathana Education Institute by the Urban Development Authority as a grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Water Resources Policy and Management Mechanism of  Implementation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has also now been enlisted in the category of most vulnerable countries  effected by the severe climate change conditions over the last decade. As a result the country has to face unexpected severe droughts and floods due to the gradual decrease in monsoon rainfall in the dry zone areas of the country and the intensified rainfall in the wet zone areas. Optimum management of limited water resources available in this country for drinking, irrigation, energy and service requirements is turning into an extremely complex process under the backdrop of such uncontrollable climate change. Therefore, introduction of more practical Water Resource Policy has become a prime national interest. Accordingly, the Hon. Prime Minister presented the National Water Resources Policy and Management Mechanism of Implementation prepared by the Committee of Experts appointed under the Chairmanship of  Prof. C.M. Madduma Bandara, a former Vice Chancellor of the University of Peradeniya, representing the relevant fields, under the coordination of the Prime Minister's Office and the Cabinet decided to grant approval for the same.

description: Preferential Trade Agreement proposed to be entered into with Indonesia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - Indonesia, the largest economy in the South East Asia, has been identified as a potential trade partner for Sri Lanka to build beneficial trade relationships. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to initiate negotiations to enter into a Preferential Trade Agreement as an initial step towards Free Trade Agreement with that country in the long run, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Joint Declaration of Intent between the Government of India and the Government of Sri Lanka for Cooperation in the field of Animal Husbandry and Dairying
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-10
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Joint Declaration of Intent between the Government of India and the Government of Sri Lanka for Cooperation in the field of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, to work together in order to enhance the quality of milk production in Sri Lanka, achieve self-sufficiency in milk production and increase the income of smallholder farmers. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received to the Joint Declaration drafted for that purpose. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Agriculture  to sign the said Declaration of Intent, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Light Rail Transit (LRT) Project supported by the Government of Japan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. President to develop an appropriate framework to enter into the relevant Agreement by restarting negotiations with the Japanese Diplomatic Missions in Colombo enabling to commence the proposed Light Rail Transit (LRT) Project, was approved by the Government.

description: Submission of the Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969 to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-04
decision_details_body: - The Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 10 of 2023 have been published through the Gazette Notification dated 2023‑06‑14 as per the provisions of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act No. 1 of 1969 in order to replace the licensing methodology for importation of wheat flour by imposing a Special Commodity Levy. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the Contract between the Ceylon Shipping Corporation and M/s. Shreeji Shipping, India on lightering (barging) for discharging of coal from the mother ships to the jetty of the Lakvijaya Power Station for the seasons 2023/24 and 2024/25
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-04
decision_details_body: - The contract for the use of  lightering  (barging) for discharging coal from ships anchored at the port of Puttalam to the jetty of Lakvijaya Power Station during the years of 2021/22 and 2022/23 had been awarded to M/s. Shreeji Shipping, India. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to extend the Agreement on lightering (barging) between M/s. Shreeji Shipping, India and the Ceylon Shipping Corporation by further period of one year, enabling the carrying out of discharging of coal without any hindrance from the Month of September in this year, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Deployment of Ceylon Corporation Ltd owned Dry Bulk Carrier Ships named Mv. Ceylon Breeze and Mv. Ceylon Princess in year 2023 and 2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-04
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited for the selection of a Charterer or a Commercial Manager on the time chartering basis to place these two vessels on international charter market during the period of 2023 and 2024. Nine (09) bids have been received, out of which 06 bids have been submitted on time chartering basis and 03 bids have been submitted under commercial management. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the Contract of deploying the above two vessels to the M/s Coral Energy DMCC, the bidder who has submitted the financially most attractive offer, based on the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of the Health Delivery Service in the Northern Province under 	Financial Assistance of the Netherlands
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-04
decision_details_body: - It has been entered into an Agreement with the ING Bank N.V. of the Netherlands to obtain a loan of Euro 45 million to finance 75% of the project cost for the "Strengthening of the Health Delivery Service in the Northern Province".The remaining 25% of the project cost is financed by the Invest International Public Programmes B.V. of the Government of the Netherlands as a grant. As of now, the physical progress of the project is about 92%. Considering the current economic situation in Sri Lanka, the Government of the Netherlands has decided to reduce the loan amount by 10% and increase the grant for the project to 35%. The Government of Sri Lanka should enter into a Memorandum of Agreement with the Invest International Public Programmes B.V. of the Government of the Netherlands and the ING Bank N.V. of the Netherlands for that purpose by incorporating relevant amendments. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policy to enter into the said agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Civil Procedure Code (Chapter 101)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-04
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2022‑10‑10 to publish the Civil Procedure Code (Amendment) Bill in the Government Gazette and present the same in Parliament. Further, the Civil Law Reforms Sub Committee of the Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms has identified several amendments to be added to the said Bill. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the final draft prepared by the Legal Draftsman also incorporating the said amendments. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of  Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conferment of the Honour of Senior Instructing Attorneys-at-Law Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-07-04
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2023‑01‑30 to draft a Bill to introduce a new legislation to recognize the legacy of high standards maintained by senior Instructing Attorneys in the legal sector. Accordingly, the Conferment of the Honour of Senior Instructing Attorneys‑at‑Law Bill has been drafted by the Legal Draftsman and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bill. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette, and thereafter present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Amendments to the Banking Act No. 30 of 1988
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to amend the Banking Act No. 30 of 1988 taking into consideration the importance of maintaining a dynamic and resilient banking sector that supports sustainable economic growth. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation to amend the Banking Act No. 30 of 1988 incorporating the identified amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accession to the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - The Free Trade Agreement which is jointly implemented by ten (10) member countries of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and five (05) other regional countries viz Australia, China, Japan, South Korea and New Zealand  that have already entered into Agreements with the member countries of the said Association, is known as the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP). Sri Lanka could reap  many economic and other benefits by joining with the said Agreement. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to authorize the Secretary to the President to submit a formal Letter of Intent to join the RCEP, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Gambling Regulatory Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - It has been identified the necessity to establish a regulatory entity called Gambling Regulatory Authority effecting all gambling operators for purposes such as proper collection of expected taxes revenues from gambling, preventing criminal actions related to gambling activities and reducing the negative consequences that may cause to individuals and society due to gambling. Accordingly,  the  proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to establish the Gambling Regulatory Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining support of the World Bank for the implementation of Economic Stabilization and Recovery Programme through the Development Policy Financing Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - Negotiations to seek the support of the World Bank under the Development Policy Financing Programme  for a period of two years from 2023 to 2024 have been held on 2023‑05‑17. Under the said programme, it has been agreed to grant Special Drawing Rights (SDR) 371.2 million equivalent to US$ 500 million in 02 tranches for the year 2023. The clearance of the Attorney General and the concurrence of the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka have been obtained for the proposed financing facility. Accordingly, the  proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to enter into an Agreement with the International Development Association of the World Bank Group in relation to obtaining the said financing facility, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - Regulations to temporarily suspend the importation of certain selected goods have been issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969 in order to ease the increasing pressure on external reserves and the financial market due to the unfavorable economic situation prevailing  in the country . The necessity to remove restrictions on the importation of selected goods which could cause a minimum impact on Balance of Payment has been identified by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and other relevant parties through the relaxation of aforesaid  Regulations. Accordingly, it has been decided to remove 286 HS Codes from the list of 1216 HS Codes in the schedule of temporary suspension of imports.  For the said purpose, the Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations, No. 09 of 2023 has been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2335/26 dated 2023‑06‑09. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the said Regulations to Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka's Chairmanship of Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) 2023 - 	2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - The Chairmanship of Indian Ocean Rim Association which consists of 23 member States bordering the Indian Ocean, is to be handed over to Sri Lanka in October 2023 by Bangladesh, the current Chairman of the organization. Action should be taken to strengthen the regional cooperation for the development of the region and member States during the period of holding the Chairmanship. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and the Minister of Foreign Affairs to establish a National Task Force under the Chairmanship of a Senior Officer of the Presidential Secretariat and comprising of representatives from the relevant Ministries and Institutions, under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and to set up a Secretariat for a period of two years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations made under Convention against Doping in SportsAct, No. 33 of 2013 in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - Anti-Doping (Prohibited List) Regulations No. 08 of 2022 prepared by the Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs under section 34(1) of the Convention Against Doping in Sport Act No. 33 of 2013 published in the Gazette No. 2329/43 dated 2023-04-27. The proposal made by the Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs to present the said Regulations in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Deprivation of religious freedom and distortion of religious facts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - There has arisen the need to introduce legal provisions to protect religious freedom and prevent defamation of religious teachings. Accordingly, taking into consideration a proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs,  approval was granted by the Cabinet to appoint a committee representing religious leaders of major religions of Buddhist, Muslim, Hindu, Catholic and Christian, legal experts, media and civil society activists.

description: Social Security Contribution Levy (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted to introduce several amendments to the Social Security Contribution Levy Act, No. 25 of 2022 and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare an amended Bill for the same, at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023-01-30. Accordingly, the Attorney General's clearance has been received for the Social Security Contribution Levy (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policy, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and then present the same in Parliament for approval, was  approved by the Cabinet.

description: Insolvency Law Reform
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - Provisions relating to Consumer insolvency and Unincorporated small business bankruptcy are contained in the Insolvency Ordinance 1853, and provisions relating to company bankruptcy are contained in the Companies Act No. 7 of 2007. As the existing provisions under the said laws are not sufficient to fulfill the present needs, it is apparent that there is a need to introduce a new law on joint bankruptcy. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reform to authorize the Law Commission to prepare and submit an initial draft within a period of three (03) months in consultation with the relevant parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Lands for Sutech Sugar Industries (Pvt) Ltd (Greenfield 	Sugar	Development Project) in Vavuniya District under long term lease 	basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - Sutech Engineering Company, Thailand has submitted a project proposal for sugarcane cultivation and sugar production in Vavuniya with an investment of US$ 400 million. The proposed project is expected to produce 20% (120,000 metric tons of sugar) of the country's total sugar requirement. A 200 hectare block of land in the Vavuniya North Divisional Secretariat Division, which is covered by a scrub forest belonging to the Department of Forest Conservation, has been identified for the factory premises and associated facilities related to this project, The Department of Forest Conservation has agreed to provide the said block of land for the implementation of the proposed project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotions to take necessary steps to implement the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formation of 'Climate Justice Forum' of Like-minded Climate Vulnerable &	Developing Countries in order to Fast-track Global Climate Action
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - Several critical aspects which will affect developing countries facing climate risks, are being discussed during the global climate discussions,, and although more attention was paid to the establishment of a Loss and Damage Fund in the past discussions on climate change, the establishment of the said Fund has been delayed due to various reasons. Therefore, Sri Lanka has proposed that it would be appropriate establishing a 'Climate Justice Forum' with the objective of accelerating the financing of losses and damages and providing an alternative approach deviating from traditional methods. Also, considering the debt crises faced by those countries, Sri Lanka is of the view that it is appropriate to include 'Debt Justice' as an essential component of the overall solution proposal to be given to climate-vulnerable and developing countries for their mitigation and adaptation interventions. Accordingly, the implementation of the strategic programme submitted by the Minister of Environment as the proponent of the idea of establishing the Climate Justice Forum to make the said effort a success, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bringing back Sri Lankan cultural heritages presently under the possession of foreign countries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Articles 7 and 13 of the Convention on the Means of  Prohibiting and Preventing the Illicit Import, Export and Transfer of Ownership of Cultural Property adopted by UNESCO in 1970, there is a right to demand the returning of any cultural property currently in the possession of a foreign country to the State to which it belongs. Accordingly, the Government of the Netherlands has decided to return the artefacts taken from the colonial countries and currently stored in the state museums of the Netherlands, to the countries that own those artefacts. According to a research project conducted with the participation of the Museum Department and independent researchers regarding 6 such artefacts in the possession of the Netherlands, it has been confirmed that all the said artefacts were brought from Sri Lanka during the colonial period. A diplomatic request has been made by the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to get those artefacts back to Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to appoint an Officials' Committee to take further action in this regard and to prepare an action plan to get back Sri Lankan artefacts currently in the possession of various countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting the Comprehensive Nuclear Test-Ban Treaty Organization (CTBTO) On-site Inspection (OSI) Integrated Field Exercise (IFE)-2025 by Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has signed the Comprehensive Nuclear Test‑Ban Treaty on 1996‑10‑24 and Cabinet approval has been granted on 2023‑06‑12 to ratify the said Treaty. The Comprehensive Nuclear Test‑Ban Treaty Organization, in pursuant to Article IV of the  Comprehensive Nuclear Test‑Ban Treaty has established a verification regime to carry out an On-site Inspection in order to prove whether a country has conducted a nuclear test/explosion. The Integrated Field Exercise programme has been introduced to accomplish the activities and functions assigned thereto and to provide training on testing equipment. As the Sri Lanka's National Technical Focal Point of the Comprehensive Nuclear Test‑Ban Treaty Organization,   the Geological Survey and Mines Bureau has made a request to host the Integrated Field Exercise Programme-2025. According to the eligibility assessment conducted as per the said request, the area adjacent to the Maduru Oya National Park has been identified as suitable for conducting the relevant integrated field exercises. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs for Sri Lanka to take over the hosting of the Joint Field Exercise of On-Site Inspection - 2025, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for partnership and innovative financing to mainstream biodiversity and sustainable land management in wet climatic zones of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - High demand for lands in the wet zone, forest fragmentation, deforestation and land degradation, rapid development processes, spread of invasive alien plants, unsustainable land use and agricultural patterns, changes in rainfall and temperature and drought have caused severe impacts on the bio diversity, catchment degradation, productive capacity of the soil as well as the productivity of annual and perennial crops in the wet zone. Therefore, attention has been focused in taking due measures for the conservation of small forest patches with higher biodiversity located adjacent to tea and rubber lands and sustainable land management. Accordingly, the United Nations Development Programme has agreed to provide a sum of US$ 04 million to implement  the project for partnership and innovative financing to mainstream biodiversity and sustainable land management in wet climatic zones of Sri Lanka that has been prepared together with the Ministry of Environment, Ministry of Plantation Industries and other relevant parties. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Environment and the United Nations Development Programme in order to obtain the relevant grant for the proposed project designed to be implemented under Public-Private Partnership within the six(06) districts of Nuwara Eliya, Ratnapura, Kegalle, Kalutara, Galle and Matara, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the Field of Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - It has been reached to a consensus between the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority and the Legal Entity of Public Law of the Georgian National Tourism Administration to sign a Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the field of Tourism. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Memorandum of Understanding prepared for that purpose. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Lands, to sign the said MoU was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of lands to the Capital Investment LLC of United Arab Emirates on long term lease basis to implement a luxury hotel project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-26
decision_details_body: - The Capital Investment LLC of the United Arab Emirates has submitted a project proposal for obtaining a plot of land bordering the Maussakelle Reservoir currently under the custody of the Ceylon Electricity Board and a small island located within the said reservoir for a project to build and run a hotel complex, having invested a sum of US$ 25 million as a fully direct investment. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to vest the said land plots to the aforementioned Company on long term lease basis in order to implement the said project with the concurrence of the relevant institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Final Budget Position Report - 2022 in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-12
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of section 13 of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act No. 3 of 2003, the Minister in charge of Finance shall release the Final Budget Position Report to the public not later than five (05) months from the end of the relevant financial year, and thereafter, table the said Report in Parliament. Accordingly, the Final Budget Position Report - 2022 has been published in the website of the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to table the said report in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Parliamentary Elections Act, Presidential Elections Act,	Provincial Councils Elections Act and Local Authorities Elections Ordinance 	in consequence to the Regulation of Election Expenditure Act No. 3 of 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-12
decision_details_body: - It has been identified the necessity to make the incidental amendments to the Parliamentary Elections Act, Presidential Elections Act, Provincial Councils Elections Act and Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, with the enactment of the provisions of the Regulation of Election Expenditure Act No. 3 of 2023, and the approval has been granted to make the said amendments at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023-01-23. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman accordingly. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the relevant Bill in the Government Gazette and present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Prevention of Domestic Violence Act, No.34 of 2005
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-12
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 2018‑03‑06 to draft a Bill to amend the Prevention of Domestic Violence Act, No.34 of 2005. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Prevention of Domestic Violence (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman as per the said approval. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minster of Women, Child Affairs and Social Empowerment to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Repealing the Bread Ordinance No.13 of 1864
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-12
decision_details_body: - The Bread Ordinance has been introduced incorporating the provisions to regulate the sale of bread and to prevent the adulteration of bread offered for sale. It has been identified that it is not necessary to implement the said Ordinance further, since there are instances where issues are arisen with the certain provisions of the same when implementing the provisions of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No.9 of 2003. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce and Food Security to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation to repeal the said Ordinance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Order under section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-12
decision_details_body: - The Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies has issued Orders from time to time under the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017  temporarily suspending/limiting outward remittances related to certain capital transactions and current transfers with effect from April 2020, as per the recommendation of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the Order which was last issued on 2022‑12‑22 in that regard is to be expired on 2023‑06‑30. Therefore,  the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to publish an Order under the provisions of section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act No. 12 of 2017, to extend the said Order for a further period of 06 months as per the recommendation of the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Elections (Special Provisions) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-12
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑12‑12 has granted approval to amend the Parliamentary Election Act No. 1 of 1981 to take relevant action in case of violation of the Code of Conduct by political parties/independent groups and candidates contesting for an election and to establish special polling stations for specially identified voters who are unable to vote at the prescribed polling station on the election day. Similarly, Cabinet approval has been granted on 2022‑12‑12 also to amend the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, Presidential Elections (Special Provisions) Act, Parliamentary Elections Act and the Provincial Council Elections Act so as to take legal action in case of violation of Media Guidelines when an election has been declared. Accordingly, Legal Draftsman has initiated the drafting amending legislation for the above purpose. However, it has been found the appropriateness of introducing a new Act in the name of Elections (Special Provisions) Act instead of amending the relevant Election Acts separately by incorporating aforementioned amendments. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to introduce a new Act by incorporating the relevant amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promotion of the Tourism Industry for Economic Revival
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-12
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑08‑30 has decided to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee under the Chairmanship of the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Civil Aviation and with the participation of another six (06) Ministers to identify the existing impediments and opportunities for the promotion of tourism industry for economic revival and submit recommendations to the Cabinet on action be taken to make use of the prevailing opportunities most effectively by removing the said impediments. Accordingly, the Minister of Tourism and Lands brought the Report containing 25 recommendations submitted by the said Cabinet Sub-Committee, to the attention of the Cabinet and the Cabinet granted its concurrence for the implementation of the said recommendations.

description: Reduction in the price of Essential Medicines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-05
decision_details_body: - The National Medicines Regulatory Authority established under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act No. 5 of 2015 acts as the regulator for all the matters related to the pricing of medicines. Taking into account the depreciation of the Rupee against the United States Dollar, the Ministry of Health has granted approval to increase the maximum retail price of medicines up to 97% in several occasions. As a result of the current economic stabilization program followed by the Government, the value of the United States Dollar has decreased in a considerable amount. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to reduce the maximum retail price of 60 types of medicinal products by 16% with effect from 15th June, 2023 and to review the prices of the medicinal products every three months, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for the Repair of Honeywell Auxilliary Power Units 	at SriLankan Airlines (SLA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-05
decision_details_body: - SriLankan Airlines has invited Bids for the repair of Honeywell Auxilliary Power Units following the Limited International Competitive Bidding procedure. Three bids have been received for the purpose and the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the contract for the repair of Honeywell Auxilliary Power Units for a period of 02 years at an estimated cost of USD 15.3 Mn to Honeywell International SARL which has submitted the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bid based on the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Augmentation of Common Wastewater Treatment Plant at Horana Export 	Processing Zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-05
decision_details_body: - The discharge of sewage into the nearby streams due to the insufficient capacity of the Common Waste water Treatment Plant currently operating in the Horana Export Processing Zone, has become a matter at public nuisances. As a result, the Local Government Institutions have also requested the Board of Investments to expedite the construction of the 2000 m³/day under the augmentation of Common Wastewater Treatment Plant at Horana Export Processing Zone. The Board of Directors of the Board of Investments of Sri Lanka has granted its concurrence to implement this project using the funds of that Board. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to implement the augmentation of Common Wastewater Treatment Plant at Horana Export Processing Zone using LKR 1,110 Mn from the funds of the Board of Investments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Contempt of Court, Tribunal or Institution Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-05
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the cabinet meeting held on 2022-06-27 to introduce a new law on "Contempt of Court" consisting of clear and specific provisions on the offense of "Contempt of Court" and defenses, sentencing and the procedure to be followed in mitigating circumstances. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit to the Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rationalization of Value Added Tax (VAT) Exemptions and Repealing the Simplified VAT (SVAT)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-05
decision_details_body: - Two major reforms with regard to Value Added Tax  have to be introduced as per the Extended Fund Facility (EFF) arrangement of the International Monetary Fund (IMF). Under this, it is required to revamp the Value Added Tax System by removing majority exemptions and to abolish the SVAT system. It is possible to increase the tax revenue approximately by 1.2% of the Gross Domestic Product  through the re-rationalization of  existing VAT exemptions. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill to amend the relevant provisions in the Value Added Tax Act, enabling to remove the vast majority of  exemptions of VAT by retaining exemptions on the fields of education, health and agriculture and also exemptions which soften the impact on the low-income households and protect key sectors in economy and to abolish the existing  SVAT system with effect from 2024‑01‑01 by introducing a more proper mechanism for the refund of VAT, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Order published under the provisions of the Measurement Units, Standards and Service Act, No. 35 of 1995
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-05
decision_details_body: - Maintaining national measurement standards in Sri Lanka in conformity with the international measurements standards, providing metrological services for various fields, ensuring justice through regulatory and service activities based on measurements are the main functions of the Department of Measurement Units, Standard and Services. Accordingly,  National Measurement Laboratory has been established under sub‑section 3(b) of the Measurement Units, Standards and Services Act No. 35 of 1995 and an Order has been published through the Gazette Notification No. 2294/54 dated 2022‑08‑26 by the Minister of Trade, Commerce and Food Security as per the provisions of the Act, declaring the Post of Metrology Experimental Officer to be effective from 2022‑06‑16 for the activities of the said Laboratary. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of  Trade, Commerce and Food Security to submit the said Order to Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Updating the Regulations pertaining to the Company Secretaries under the Companies Act No. 07 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-05
decision_details_body: - Since all the services rendered by the Department of Registrar of Companies are provided through online system, it has been identified the necessity to amend the Regulations pertaining to Company Secretaries made by the Minister in charge  under the provisions of the Companies Act No. 17 of 1982 in order to maintain the said activities properly. Accordingly, taking into consideration the views and suggestions of the relevant stakeholders and Advisory Committee, amended Regulations pertaining to Company Secretaries have been published through the Gazette Notification No. 2323/41 dated 2023‑03‑17. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ratification of the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-05
decision_details_body: - The Comprehensive Nuclear‑Test‑Ban Treaty was adopted by the United Nations General Assembly on 1996‑09‑10. By the said Agreement, the Member States have agreed to prohibit “any nuclear weapon test explosion or any other nuclear explosion” anywhere in the world. So far, 186 countries have signed the said treaty whereas 177 countries have ratified the same. Sri Lanka has signed the Comprehensive Nuclear‑Test‑Ban Treaty on 1996‑10‑24. Currently, Sri Lanka cooperates with the Comprehensive Nuclear‑Test‑Ban Treaty Organization in the areas of training, capacity building, data and information sharing. Sri Lanka's ratification of the said Treaty will recognize the diplomatic role of Sri Lanka as an active proponent of international peace and security in a nuclear weapons free world and enable to obtain useful data for civil and scientific purposes benefiting many developing countries including Sri Lanka such as tsunami warning and climate change and earth studies. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to ratify the said Treaty and take necessary action to draft legislation to enforce the provisions of the said Treaty.

description: The National Policy and the Strategic Framework for Prevention and Control of Chronic Non-communicable Diseases in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-05
decision_details_body: - Heart diseases, stroke, cancer, chronic respiratory diseases and diabetic are the leading causes to a large percentage of deaths in Sri Lanka caused by non-communicable diseases accounting to approximately 120,000 deaths in each year. Use of tobacco, harmful use of alcohol, obesity, high blood pressure, raised blood sugar level, raised blood cholesterol level have been found as main factors for such diseases. Therefore, the health system should be strengthened to provide screening services for early detection and timely treatment. The first National Policy for prevention of Non-communicable Diseases was declared in 2009 and the revised new policy has been drafted with the participation of all relevant parties after evaluating and reviewing the said policy. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to implement the National Policy and the Strategic Framework for Prevention and Control of Chronic Non-communicable Diseases in Sri Lanka and publish the same in the Government Gazette, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Independent Regulatory Institution for the advancement of Cinema and Television Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-06-05
decision_details_body: - The State Film Corporation was established by the State Film Corporation Act, No.47 of 1971 for the revival of the advancement of the local film industry and in the year 1980 it was renamed as the 'National Film Corporation of Sri Lanka'. At present, the Film Industry is facing many problems and suffers a severe drawback. Therefore, the need to establish an independent regulatory institution to revive the industry has been identified. Also, it has been found appropriate to have an independent institution to regulate the television industry to provide necessary guidance for the advancement of the said industry. Accordingly, taking into consideration a proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media, Cabinet decided to grant approval to take necessary action to establish an independent regulatory institution enabling to facilitate and provide guidance for the revival of the Cinema and Television Industry.

description: Conducting the 45th Asian Conference on Remote Sensing in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-29
decision_details_body: - Realizing the importance of Remote Sensing Technology in national development activities, countries of the Asian - Pacific Region have formed the Asian Association on Remote Sensing. This Organization in which Sri Lanka is also a founding member is comprised of several member groups such as ordinary members, associate members and sustaining members. It has been proposed to hold the 45th Asian Conference on Remote Sensing throughout 05 days in Colombo during October-November 2024. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Lands, to hold the said conference in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: International Conference on Qualifications Framework and the Recognition of Qualifications and Credentials in Higher Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-29
decision_details_body: - With the increasing internationalization of opportunities for higher education, it has to be entered into Agreements and Conventions which facilitate to mutually recognize the qualifications and credentials awarded according to each country's qualifications framework. Accordingly, the University of Ruhuna and Wayamba University of Sri Lanka in collaboration with the Ministry of Education have initiated several activities through “Regional Cooperation in the field of Recognition among Asian Countries (RecoAsia)” co-funded by the European Union under its “Erasmus+” Programme. Further, Sri Lanka has also engaged with the SARRC qualifications Framework Project under the guidance of the International Labour Organization. Under this backdrop, the Ministry of Education has planned to conduct an International Conference on Qualifications Frameworks and the Recognition of Qualifications and Credentials in Higher Education during the two days of 28th and 29th June 2023 with the financial assistance of the RecoAsia and the International Labour Organization. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to conduct the said Conference, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Truth and Reconciliation Mechanism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-29
decision_details_body: - On the invitation of Minister of International Relations and Cooperation of South Africa, the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms and the Minister of Foreign Affairs have visited South Africa for a preliminary study on their Truth and Reconciliation Commission. During the visit, meetings have been held with a number of heads of the Government of South Africa including the President and the Minister of International Relations and Cooperation. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms and the Minister of Foreign Affairs to establish the Truth and Reconciliation Commission in Sri Lanka, taking into consideration the functioning of the Truth and Reconciliation Commission of South Africa, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the period of validity of the Memorandum of Understanding signed between the Sri Lanka Council for Agricultural Research 	Policy and the Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-29
decision_details_body: - A Memorandum of Understanding has been signed between the Sri Lanka Council for Agricultural Research Policy and the Malaysian Agricultural Research and Development Institute in 2016 for a period of 05 years, with the objective of continuing the scientific cooperation in the field of agriculture between Sri Lanka and Malaysia. The validity period of the said Memorandum of Understanding has now expired and both parties have agreed to extend the said Agreement for another 5 years. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to extend the period of the Memorandum of Understanding for another five (05) years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding on the Field of Health Cooperation between Maldives and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-29
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding on the Field of Health Cooperation between Maldives and Sri Lanka with a view to improving health care services, promoting research and development and enhancing the overall well being between the two countries thereby strengthening and formalizing the health cooperation between the two countries. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the proposed draft Agreement. Accordingly the proposal made by the Minister of Health to sign the said  Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation and Mutual Assistance on Customs Matters between Sri Lanka and Maldives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-29
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation and Mutual Assistance on Customs Matters between Sri Lanka and Maldives with a view to strengthening, promoting and developing cooperation and mutual assistance on matters relating to the customs and strengthening mutual understating and communication.  The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Memorandum of Understanding drafted for that purpose.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Monument for the Commemoration of those who died as a result of the Armed Conflict, Political Unrest or Civil Disturbances in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-22
decision_details_body: - Since independence, Sri Lanka has experienced a history of civil disturbances, political unrest, communal clashes and a long-drawn armed conflict, during which citizens of all ethnicities, religions, professions and other identities were subject to perils and sufferings innumerable times. Bitter experiences of the past have proved that any form of conflict based on ethnicity, religion, political ideology or other reasons is highly detrimental to the well-being of the citizens and hampers the progress of the nation. However, the trend of such incidents continues thereby endangering the peace and security of citizens and disrupting social and economic systems. The Office of Reparations Act, No.34 of 2018 recognizes the provision of collective reparations in the form of memorials and other infrastructure as the right to redress for communities or groups of aggrieved persons. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to erect a monument in an appropriate location in Colombo as a symbol of healing and reconciliation to commemorate all persons including civilians, members of Tri‑forces and the police and ex‑combatants who died as a result of armed conflict, political unrest or civil disturbances in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for the Ground Handling Services for SriLankan Airlines at the Doha International Airport and Cargo Warehouse Handling Services at the Dubai International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-22
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited for Ground Handling Services at the Doha International Airport and Cargo Warehouse Handling Services at Dubai International Airport. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the contract for Ground Handling Services at the Doha International Airport to Qatar Aviation Services W.L.L and to award the contract for Cargo Warehouse Handling Services at the Dubai International Airport to Dnata Company as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding on Carbon Credits between Sri Lanka and Singapore
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-22
decision_details_body: - Article 6 of the Paris Agreement has provided the countries with the opportunity to cooperate for the purpose of reducing greenhouse gas emissions in a more cost‑effective manner under the International carbon trading.  Accordingly, it has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Carbon Credits between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Singapore within the framework referred to in the Paris Agreement. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding Regarding Political Consultations between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-22
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Political Consultations between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is expected to promote bilateral ties while enhancing the positive roles of other international organizations and regional and global affairs, political developments and topics of mutual interests. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taking steps to name “Kompanna Veediya” Grama Niladhari Division of	Colombo Divisional Secretariat Division in the same manner in all three	languages
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-22
decision_details_body: - “Kompanna Veediya” Grama Niladhari Division of Colombo Divisional Secretariat Division has been declared as "කොම්පඤ්ඤ වීදිය" in Sinhala, "ஸ்லேவ்ஐலன்ட்" in Tamil and "Slave Island" in English. It has been suggested that it would be more appropriate to name the Grama Niladhari Division as “Kompanna Veediya” in all three languages. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government to declare “Kompanna Veediya” as it is in all three languages through a fresh Gazette Notification revising the respective Gazette Extraordinary notification No.743/5 dated 1992‑12‑01, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Western Region Megapolis Master Plan 2048 in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-22
decision_details_body: - The approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023-05-08 to award the review of the Western Region Megapolis Master Plan prepared by the Urban Development Authority in 2015 to M/s Surbana Jurong (Pvt) Ltd in Singapore. Accordingly, the said plan will be reviewed and the "Western Region Megapolis Master Plan - 2048" will be prepared enabling to implement projects that have been identified so far under the original Master Plan, on priority basis. The joint proposal made by Hon. President; Hon. Prime Minister; and the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to appoint a Ministerial Committee under the chairmanship of the Hon. Prime Minister to provide necessary guidance and coordinate the facilities to implement the said plan prepared as such, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Ayurveda Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-22
decision_details_body: - The approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022‑10‑31 for the amendment of the Ayurveda Act, No.31 of 1961, in order to achieve the sustainable development goals and meet the current needs. The Attorney General's clearance has been received for the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman accordingly. The proposal made by the Minister of Health to publish the said draft Bill in the Government Gazette and present the same in Parliament thereafter, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: "Venturing into New Frontiers" - First International Mining and Mineral	Conference, 	Investor Forum and Exhibition
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-22
decision_details_body: - With the aim of providing a platform to all stakeholders involved in the current and future mineral industry in Sri Lanka, the International Mining and Mineral Conference, Investor Forum and Exhibition named "Venturing into New Frontiers" has been planned to be held at the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall. Through that it is expected to build global brand value for the Sri Lankan mineral industry and create large-scale investment and economic opportunities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to conduct the proposed International Mining and Mineral Conference, Investor Forum and Exhibition in October 2023, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting exemptions and incentives in relation to Businesses of Strategic Importance under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-22
decision_details_body: - The Colombo Port City was established as a Special Economic Zone by the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021. In order to achieve the objectives of modernizing Sri Lanka, creating economic stability and transforming the country into a leader in the export of services, it has been identified the necessity of developing the Port City of Colombo to create a business enabling environment that is internationally competitive. According to the provisions of the Act, the Commission in consultation with the President or the Minister in‑charge of the Colombo Port City may identify the businesses designated as Businesses of Strategic Importance and recommend the granting of exemptions or incentives for the same. Two categories have been identified as Primary Businesses of Strategic Importance and Secondary Businesses of Strategic Importance for granting the relevant exemptions and incentives. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to grant the said exemptions and incentives, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulation of a Policy Framework for Logistics Service Development including the Shipping Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-22
decision_details_body: - Competitiveness of the logistics service industry including Shipping industry is a key factor of the economic development of any country and considering the experiences gained by countries like Singapore and Hong Kong, it is more relevant for an island economy like Sri Lanka. However, it is observed that the existing policy and regulatory framework related to the logistics service industry including the Shipping Industry in Sri Lanka is more protective and not sufficient either to attract investments for development of the said industry or to create a conducive environment to supply competitive/cost efficient logistic services to the users of such services. Considering this situation, the need to prepare a policy framework on logistics service industry was also proposed through the Budget 2023. Accordingly, Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to appoint a committee consisting of the representatives of other relevant institutions under the chairmanship of the Secretary to the Treasury to study the existing policies and regulations related to logistics services including the shipping industry and prepare a Logistic Development Programme covering the period of 2023-2027 in accordance with international best practices.

description: Green Bond Framework
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-22
decision_details_body: - The Government's intention to move towards green financing was stated in the Budget 2023. The proceeds of such bond issuances may be utilized in the areas such as Renewable Energy, Energy Efficiency, Green Buildings, Clean Transportation, Sustainable Water and Wastewater Management, Pollution Prevention, Control and Circular Economy, Climate Change Adaptation, Biodiversity Conservation and Sustainable Management of Natural Resources and Land Use. The United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (UNESCAP), United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) have expressed their consent to assist the Government in establishing an internationally accepted framework to access financing through Green/Blue and Sustainable instruments and accordingly a Green Bond Framework has been drafted at present. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to obtain a Second Party Opinion  enabling to validate the presently drafted Green Bond Framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National Development Committee for the appraisal of new development projects/programmes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-22
decision_details_body: - Owing to the commencement of development projects/programmes without proper identification and systematic appraisal, it appears that some of the projects implemented during the past have failed to achieve desired results. As such, a proposal for the establishment of a National Development Committee for the methodical appraisal of new development projects/programmes was made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance through the Budget Speech for the year 2023. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to appoint a Committee headed by Mr. Daya Liyanage, a former Deputy Secretary to the Treasury in order to submit its recommendations on the projects/programmes with the estimated cost  considered by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committees or higher than that, to the Cabinet, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Foreign Affairs Office of the	People's Government of Yunnan Province of the People's Republic of 	China	and the Department of External Resources of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-15
decision_details_body: - During the visit of Mr. Wang Yubo, Governor of Yunnan Province of the People's Republic of China, to Sri Lanka, from 16 to 20 May, 2023, it is proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Foreign Affairs Office of the People's Government of Yunnan Province of the People's Republic of China and the Department of Foreign Resources of Sri Lanka. The Memorandum of Understanding is expected to provide support to Sri Lanka in the fields of mutual travel, economy, trade and commerce, education, tourism, agriculture, people-to-people and cultural exchange, people's livelihood and health. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policy to sign the said Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Scheme for granting permits to import fully electric vehicles for Sri Lankans  	employed abroad
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-15
decision_details_body: - With the view of encouraging migrant workers to remit income earned abroad to Sri Lanka through legal channels, the Cabinet has previously approved the scheme of granting permits for the importation of fully electric vehicles to Sri Lankans employed abroad.  Accordingly, the import of an electric vehicle will be based on the amount of foreign exchange remitted by the migrant workers to Sri Lanka during the period from 2022-05-01 to 2022-12-31. However, it is apparent that the amount of foreign exchange remitted during that period does not make space for them to import the desired electric vehicles. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment to extend the period in which the amount of foreign currency remitted to Sri Lanka is considered in obtaining a vehicle import permit under the scheme up to 09-15-2023, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hiring a Maintenance and Emergency Response Vessel (MERV) for the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-15
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑11‑21 has granted approval to obtain a Maintenance and Emergency Response Vessel for the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation on hiring basis following the International Competitive Bidding Procedure. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to award the contract for operating a Maintenance and Emergency Response Vessel (MERV) to M/s Sri Lanka Shipping Company Limited on hiring basis for a period of two years from 2023‑06‑01 as per the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of Urea Fertilizer for paddy cultivation in the Yala Season 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-15
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that 25,000 MT of Urea fertilizer should be further imported  for the Yala Season 2023 when taking into consideration the available quantity of fertilizer with the two Government fertilizer companies and the private sector and those remaining in the Agrarian Services Centres. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to import the said quantity of fertilizer as 60% by the Ceylon Fertilizer Company and 40% by Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of National Industry Day
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-15
