decision_details_body: - Necessary Plans have been prepared to increase the contribution of the industrial sector to the Gross Domestic Product which is 28% at present, up to 30% and to increase the contribution of the manufacturing industry to the Gross National Product which is 15% at present, up to 25%, by the year 2030. Further, it is expected to increase the percentage of entrepreneurs up to 10% which is currently 2.8% and to increase the contribution of micro, small and medium-scale industries to the Gross National Product from 52% to 70% , by the year 2030. In order to meet the said goals, 06 industry sectors have been identified and the Ministry of Industries has taken action to ensure a unified approach to provide the infrastructure and other facilities required for the said sectors. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Industries, the Cabinet granted approval to conduct an Industry Exhibition Week annually in order to encourage and uplift the promotion of domestic industries and attract foreign investors and industrialists and to conduct the said Exhibition from 22nd to 25th June of this year as the initial step of the same.

description: State-Owned Enterprises Restructuring Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-15
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022‑09‑05 to establish the State-Owned Enterprises Restructuring Unit under the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies in order to provide guidance and assist pertaining to the restructuring of State-Owned Enterprises. Accordingly, the  State-Owned Enterprises Restructuring Policy has been prepared aiming to improve the quality, price and accessibility of goods and services provided by the state owned Enterprises, eliminate the fiscal burden caused to the General Treasury by the said enterprises and create a competitive and market based business environment to attract private investments. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and national Policies to take future action on the restructuring of State‑Owned enterprises based on the said policy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making the song “Danno Budunge Sri Dharmaskanda” a National Heritage
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-15
decision_details_body: - The song “Danno Budunge Sri Dharmaskanda” which contains in the drama 'Sirisangabo' was written by the veteran Mr. John de Silva in 1903 and its music was composed by Mr. Vishwanath Laugi. It has been identified as appropriate to declare that song which is about 120 years old as a national heritage. There are evidences that the said song has been used giving it the same vale that has been given for the National Anthem in festivals and other occasions until the National Anthem of this country came into use.  Considering that the song has continuously influenced the Nation's aesthetic feelings for more than a century, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government to declare the song "Danno Budunge Sri Dharmaskanda" as a national heritage, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National University of Nursing, Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-08
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023‑03‑01 has decided to appoint an Officials' Committee to examine the proposal submitted pertaining to converting the Colleges of Nursing currently administered under the Ministry of Health to a University and submit a Report to the Cabinet. Taking into consideration the recommendations submitted by the said Officials' Committee, the Joint proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways in his capacity as the acting Minister of Education, and the Minister of Health to grant approval in principal to establish the National University of Nursing, Sri Lanka and prepare a Bill for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for Supplying of Aviation Fuel required for SriLankan Airlines at 16 Locations (Airports) worldwide
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-08
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited under the Limited International Bidding procedure to obtain aviation fuel for SriLankan Airlines at 17 Airports worldwide. For that, 52 bids have been received from 12 companies and 49 bids have met the basic qualifications. The bid of the only bidder that submitted bids to the Shanghai Pudong, China has been rejected.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the relevant Contracts for the supply of Aviation Fuel at 16 Airports to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidders, as per the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for the Repair of CFM Leap - 1A Aircraft Engines at Srilankan Airlines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-08
decision_details_body: - Comprehensive proposals have been invited from the qualified service providers under the Limited International Competitive Bidding procedure for the repair of 03 CFM Leap - 1A Aircraft Engines of Srilankan Airlines and three proposals have been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the contract for the Repair of 03 CFM Leap - 1A Aircraft Engines, to Lufthansa Technik AG as per the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Maintenance of adequate Tug Fleet in all Ports under the Sri Lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-08
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑06‑13 has granted approval to obtain Time Charter 04 Tugs of more than 70 T capacity for a period of 05 years following Competitive Bidding Procedure. Accordingly, International Competitive Bids have been invited to obtain Tug vessels and two bids have been received. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the procurement for hiring 04 tugs for a period of 05 years to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, M/s Sri Lanka Shipping Company Limited, as per the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for the Ground Handling Services at Sydney International Airport, Australia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-08
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited from all licensed ground handling service providers currently providing ground handling services at the Sydney Airport, Australia, for the provision of ground handling services at that Airport, under the Limited International Competitive Bidding procedure, and two bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the relevant contract to Menzies Aviation (Australia) Pty Ltd for a period of three years as per the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Standing Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Tea, Rubber and Coconut Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-08
decision_details_body: - The Hon. President presented a proposal in the Budget 2023 to amend the existing legal provisions by imposing restrictions, enabling the fragmentation of coconut lands only of one acre or less. The proposal made by the Minister of Plantation Industries to take necessary action to amend the Tea, Rubber and Coconut Estates (Control of Fragmentation) Act in order to provide provisions accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introducing a new Fiscal Management Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-08
decision_details_body: - The fiscal operations are governed under the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No.3 of 2003 and subsequent amendments to the Act. Although the act has made provisions for not being complied with the said fiscal rules only with the approval of the parliament under exceptional circumstances, the act does not include the provisions for deviation from the said rules. Also, the action to be taken in case of the targets set as per the provisions of the Act cannot be met, are not specified clearly in the Act. Taking these facts into account, the Government has agreed to enact a new Fiscal Management Act under the International Monetary Fund's Extended Fund Facility arrangement. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to take necessary action to enact a new Fiscal Management Act enabling to establish a new fiscal rules framework that will be effective with the Budget of year 2025 and simultaneously to repeal the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No.3 of 2003, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introducing Paying Ward Facilities in Government Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies through the budget for the year 2023 pertaining to the expansion of paying ward facilities in the Government hospitals islandwide, was moved in Parliament. At present, the National Health Insurance Trust Fund has provided health insurance coverage (Agrahara) for Government employees and pensioners and a significant number of some citizens are covered by other health insurance schemes. There are some citizens who are willing to pay personally for extra facilities available within the Government health care system. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to take necessary action to provide paying ward facilities for Sri Lankan Citizens as well as foreigners in Government hospitals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Social Protection Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-08
decision_details_body: - Taking necessary measures to implement a stronger social safety net to protect the most vulnerable groups of the society has been identified as a priority component among the proposed activities of the International Monetary Fund's Extended Fund Facility Programme. The World Bank has agreed to grant US $ 200 million of loan to assist the said Social Protection Project. The proposed project will be implemented under the three (03) components of providing financial benefits to targeted families, pilot programme to enhance the opportunities for poor and vulnerable groups and strengthening the Social Protection System. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to implement the said project and conduct negotiations with the World Bank in order to secure funds for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Current Status of Negotiations on the proposed Sri Lanka - Thailand Free Trade Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-08
decision_details_body: - The forth round of negotiations of the proposed Sri Lanka - Thailand Free Trade Agreement have been conducted in Colombo from 27th to 29th March 2023 and the Hon. President submitted the progress of those negotiations to the attention of the Cabinet. Cabinet noted that the two parties have agreed to complete the negotiations by the first quarter of the year 2024 and make ready the relevant agreement to be signed by the two parties and conduct the next session of negotiations in Colombo on 27th and 28th March 2023.

description: Banking (Special Provisions) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-02
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑11‑21 has granted approval to draft the Banking (Special Provisions) Bill. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received to the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. As such the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same, thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Authorized Treasury Bill Issuance Limit
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-02
decision_details_body: - Authorized Treasury Bill Issuance Limit approved by Parliament in November 2022 is Rs. 5,000 billion. The total outstanding Treasury Bill stock as at the end of March 2023 amounts to Rs. 4,636 billion. The approval of Parliament has been received for a gross borrowing limit of Rs. 4,979 billion. It has been estimated to raise Rs. 3,526 billion from  local sources and  Rs. 1,453 billion from foreign sources. The domestic borrowings are mainly fulfilled by the issuance of Treasury Bills and Treasury Bonds. Accordingly, it has been identified the necessity to amend the maximum limit of issuing Treasury Bills. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to increase the Authorized Treasury Bill Issuance Limit up to Rs. 6,000 billion and move a Resolution to Parliament in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Management of Mahinda Rajapaksha National Tele Cinema Park under the Public-Private Partnership Methodology
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal submitted by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs pertaining to managing the Mahinda Rajapaksha National Tele Cinema Park under the Public-Private Partnership Methodology was taken up for consideration at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023‑02‑27. In the instance, it was decided to refer the said proposal to the National Agency for Public-Private Partnership to examine matters in that regard and submit a Report to the Cabinet. Accordingly, the Cabinet having considered the Report submitted by the said Agency, granted approval for taking necessary action to manage Mahinda Rajapaksha National Tele Cinema Park under the Public Private Partnership Methodology based on the recommendations stated in the said Report.

description: Asean Regional Forum
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-02
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka, a member of Asean Regional Forum holds the Co-Chair of the Inter- Sessional Meeting on Nuclear Proliferation and Disarmament of the said Forum for the period of 2022-2024. The 14th Inter-Sessional Meeting of Asean Regional Forum has been scheduled to be conducted for the members of the Asean Regional Forum on 16th  and 17th  of May, 2023. The measures taken by his Ministry to host the Inter- Sessional Meeting were brought to the notice of the Cabinet by the Minister of Foreign Affairs and it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet for the same.

description: Submission of the Annual Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2022 to the Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-02
decision_details_body: - The 73rd Annual Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2022 hasbeen submitted to the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance,	Economic Stabilization and National Policies by the Monetary Board of the	Central Bank of Sri Lanka on 2023-04-27. In terms of the provisions in the	Monetary Law Act, the Annual Report should be submitted by the Minister in‑charge  of Finance	to the Parliament within 14 days of receiving of the said	report. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as	the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to 	submit the Annual Report of Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2022 to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief to the public officers who are entitled to the political rights 	and had submitted the nominations for the Local Authorities Election
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of 	Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local 	Government, taking into consideration the observations submitted by the Election 	Commission regarding the measures that should be taken in relation to public 	officers who are candidates for the Local Authorities Election 2023 until the 	election is held, to provide the opportunity for such candidates, if they are serving 	in a Government/Semi-Government Institution located within the Local Authority 	Area in which they contest as candidates at the said Election, to report for duty by 	transferring them to Government/Semi-Government Institutions located outside 	the relevant Local Authority Area, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No.9 of 2003
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-02
decision_details_body: - It has been identified the necessity of amending the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No.9 of 2003 so as suit to the present day requirements. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade, Commerce and Food Security to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation, based on the preliminary draft prepared, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Bilateral Consultations between the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Grand Duchy of the Luxembourg and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-02
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding on Bilateral Consultations between the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Luxembourg and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Through the said Agreement it is expected to promote, strengthen and expand bilateral relations including political, economic, commercial, scientific, technical and cultural aspects of bilateral cooperation between the two countries. The proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to sign the aforesaid Memorandum of Understanding at the level of Foreign Ministers of both countries to mark the 50th anniversary year of the establishment of diplomatic relations between Sri Lanka and Luxembourg, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Australian Border Force and Sri Lanka Customs in the Field of Mutual Assistance on Customs Matters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-05-02
decision_details_body: - A compromise has been reached to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Customs and the Australian Border Force with a view to creating assistance between the two parties pertaining to Customs Operations. Accordingly, the objectives of the proposed Memorandum of Understanding are to strengthen, promote and develop cooperation and mutual assistance on customs matters, subject to the laws, regulations, procedures and policies which are in force in each country. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Memorandum of Understanding. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to sign the said Memorandum of Understanding was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Parliamentary Budget Office Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-24
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022‑12‑05 to draft legislation for the establishment of the Parliamentary Budget Office. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Hon. President to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and present the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of a new National Education Policy Framework
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-24
decision_details_body: - The Government has identified the education sector as a key sector that requires expeditious reforms during the process of achieving economic stability in the country. Accordingly a new National Education Policy Framework has to be formulated and implemented, in collaboration with all relevant parties. As such, the proposal made by the the Hon. President to appoint a Cabinet Sub‑Committee comprising of 10 members presided over by the President and participated by the Prime Minister and the Minister of Education in order to provide instructions and required guidance to present the National Education Policy Framework for the next 25 years and all relevant reform proposals in Parliament, and implement the same on priority basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Gazette Notifications for approval in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-24

description: Obtaining a special policy based lending from the Asian Development 	Bank	for the Economic Stabilization program
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-24
decision_details_body: - In parallel with the Extended Fund Facility approved by the International Monetary Fund, the Asian Development Bank has agreed to provide a US$ 350 million Special Policy Based Lending Facility and a technical assistance of US$ 1.5 million to strengthen the stability and governance of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to authorize the Secretary of the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to proceed with the relevant loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing World Bank Funding for Financial Sector Safety Net Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-24
decision_details_body: - Discussions have been held with the World Bank regarding the lending facility from the World Bank in favour of the Sri Lanka Deposit Insurance and Liquidity Support Fund under the Sri Lanka Financial Sector Safety Net Project. The proposed loan amount is expected to be used to strengthen the financial and institutional capacity of the Sri Lankan Financial Sector Safety Net focusing the Deposit Insurance Scheme with the aim of increasing the resilience and efficiency of the financial sector in order to safeguard stability and resume a healthy financial intermediation. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, it was decided to grant approval of the Cabinet in principle to take further steps to obtain a loan of US$ 150 million from the World Bank as an Investment Project Financing.

description: Obtaining support from the Development Policy Financing Program of World	Bank for the Economic Stabilization and Recovery Program in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-24
decision_details_body: - In line with the International Monetary Fund's Extended Fund Facility Programme,the Government of Sri Lanka has implemented a comprehensive economic stabilization and recovery programme with necessary reforms in order to address the  macroeconomic challenges. The World Bank has agreed to support the said programme 	through its Development Policy Financing programme. Accordingly, the World Bank will extend its support based on three focus areas of Transforming Economic Governance, Enhancing Growth and Competitiveness and Protecting the Poor and Vulnerable. The Proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to handle the overall coordination process of the proposed programme by the Presidential Secretariat, to authorize the Department of External Resources to conduct negotiations with the World Bank in relation to securing the relevant funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment Act No. 21 of 1985
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-24
decision_details_body: - It has been identified the necessity to amend the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment Act, No. 21 of 1985 to be suited with the present day needs. Accordingly, it is expected through the proposed amendments to introduce new amendments enabling to take legal action against parties who have entered into the foreign employment business illegally, to regulate the recruitment process for foreign employment through intermediaries, and to reduce mass scale irregularities and corruption jeopardizing the industry of foreign employment and migrant employees. Accordingly the proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment to amend the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment Act No. 21 of 1985 and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Immunities and Privileges extended to the International Centre for Research in Agroforestry and Global Green Growth Institute by the Government of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-24
decision_details_body: - According to the provisions of the Diplomatic Privileges Act, No. 9 of 1996, the privileges and immunities extended to international organizations operating in this country should be published in the Government Gazette and thereafter submitted to Parliament. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to publish the relevant privileges and immunities in the Government Gazette and to submit such information to Parliament as per the provisions of the Agreements signed between the International Centre for Research in Agroforestry and the Global Green Growth Institute,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-24
decision_details_body:
- The proposals made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the following Regulations imposed under the provisions of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969 to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	The Imports Control Regulations on Payment Terms No. 07 of 2023 published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2326/40 dated 2023‑04‑06.

*	The Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.08 of 2023 published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2326/41dated 2023‑04‑06.

description: Preparation of the Nuwara Eliya Tourism Development Master Plan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-24
decision_details_body: - The beauty of Nuwara Eliya city is gradually diminishing due to haphazard development being carried out in Nuwara Eliya area, which has resulted a severe impact on tourism industry. Therefore, the need to prepare a comprehensive Tourism Development Master Plan has arisen so as to create a necessary environment for the growth of tourism industry in the area. Accordingly, the proposals made by the Hon. President to prepare the Nuwara Eliya Tourism Development Master Plan under the coordination of the Presidential Secretariat by involving all relevant parties, to appoint a Task Force headed by the Hon. Governor of the Central Province to regulate the construction of new buildings and to impose Regulations in accordance with the provisions of the Urban Development Authority Act, restricting the construction of new buildings of more than 4 storeys in the Nuwara Eliya District with effect from 2023‑05‑01, were approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Order made as per the provisions of the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No.18 of 2011 to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-17
decision_details_body: - The President in his capacity as Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies has proposed through the Budget 2023 to gradually remove para-tariffs such as the Ports and Airports Development Levy and Commodity Export Subsidy Scheme Levy (CESS) in order to promote the manufacturing industry, remove the existing barriers to international trade and provide the necessary incentives and facilities for the local industries and projects including agriculture. By taking action as such, it is expected to balance the impact caused to the Government revenue through the Customs Import Duty. This programme has been identified as a prior-action to be fulfilled as a part of the Development Policy Financing Programme of the World Bank. Accordingly, as the initial step, an Order has been issued under the provisions of the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No.18 of 2011 to exempt 1,631 selected tariff items from the Ports and Airports Development Levy on the basis of incurring minimum revenue losses to the Government. Accordingly, the proposal made by the President in his capacity as Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the said Order to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation and implementation of a Welfare Benefit Payment Scheme in terms of the provisions of the Welfare Benefits Act, No.24 of 2002
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-17
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the provisions of the Welfare Benefits Act, No.24 of 2002, matters such as period applicable to the payment of welfare benefits, total number of beneficiaries under the scheme, date of commencement of implementation and the cost for implementing the scheme should be specifically mentioned and after obtaining the the approval of the Cabinet for the same, it should be published in the Gazette and approval of Parliament should be obtained prior to the payment of relevant benefits. As such, the Secretary to the President has appointed a Technical Committee consisting of experts in the relevant field to obtain guidelines to prepare a Welfare Benefit Payment Scheme to be implemented accordingly. Taking also into consideration the matters stated in the Report presented by the said Technical Committee, it has been planned to implement a Welfare Benefit Scheme for the transitional, vulnerable, poor and extremely poor social groups based on the poverty gap. Similarly, it has been planned to identify differently abled persons, kidney patients due to undiagnosed causes and elderly persons who are currently receiving benefits and implement separate benefit schemes as well for such people. Accordingly, the proposed Welfare Benefit Schemes are expected to be operated from 01/07/2023, and the total cost is estimated to be Rs. 206 billion per year. Accordingly, the proposal made by the President in his capacity as Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to implement the proposed Welfare Benefit Payment Schemes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the approval of Parliament for the Extended Fund Facility Arrangement of the International Monetary Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-17
decision_details_body: - The Executive Board of the International Monetary Fund has approved a 48 - month Extended Fund Facility arrangement for Sri Lanka with an amount of SDR 2.29 billion (approximately US$ 03 billion) on 2023‑03‑22 and the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies has issued a Promissory Note in that regard. The said Fund Facility and other relevant documents have been tabled in Parliament on 2023‑03‑22 and the approval of Parliament have to be obtained to ascertain the stance of Members of Parliament regarding the said Facility and to incorporate the key policy actions pertaining to the said fund Facility into legislation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the President in his capacity as Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to obtain the approval of Parliament for the Extended Fund Facility arrangement of the International Monetary Fund, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Sri Lankan Institute of Architects (SLIA) Law No.1 of 1976
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-17
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lankan Institute of Architects incorporated by the Act No.1 of 1976 functions relating to the profession of Architecture of Sri Lanka, its practice and education of Architecture. It has been found necessary to amend sections of practice of the architecture, membership and use of titles relevant to in the Sri Lankan Institute of Architects Law, to be suited with the present day needs of the profession of Architecture. Accordingly, a Committee has been appointed comprising of representatives of the relevant professional bodies to examine and submit recommendations in that regard. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to amend the relevant sections of the Sri Lankan Institute of Architects Law No.1 of 1976 based on the recommendations of the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Kandyan Law Declaration and Amendment Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-17
decision_details_body: - There have been requests from the Kandyan community from a considerable period	of time to provide provisions to entitle the same rights of inheritance which apply to widows under the general law to the widows married under Kandyan Law enabling the rectification of the disadvantaged position of the widows married under Kandyan Law. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to amend the Kandyan Law Declaration and Amendment Ordinance and instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft the Amending legislation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of an order imposed under Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No.40 of 1979, for the approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to submit the order prepared under section 14 of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No.40 of 1979 and published through the Gazette Extraordinary No.2325/06 dated 2023-03-28 for approval of Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969, for the approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit Imports and Exports (Control) regulations No.06 of 2023 prepared under the provisions of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 and published through the Gazette Extraordinary No.2324/45 dated 2023‑03‑24 for approval of Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Orders imposed under provisions of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-17
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the following orders issued	under sections 2 and 5 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 for	approval of Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	Order under section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.2308/17 dated 2022‑11‑30.

*	Order under section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.2313/34 dated 2023‑01‑04.

*	Order under section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.2316/28 dated 2023‑01‑25.

*	Order under sections 2 and 5 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007	published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.2320/04 dated 2023‑02‑20.

*	Order under section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.2321/76 dated 2023‑03‑04.

*	Order under section 2 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.2322/20 dated 2023‑03‑07.

*	Order under section 5 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.2322/21 dated 2023-03-07.

*	Order under sections 2 and 5 of the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007	published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.2323/40 dated 2023‑03‑17.

description: Procurement of printing and supplying of Lottery tickets drawn by the	Development Lotteries Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-17
decision_details_body:
- Bids have been invited following the National competitive bidding procedure based	on each brand of lottery for the procurement of printing and supplying of computerized draw lottery tickets; Lagna wasanawa, Ada Kotipathi, Shanida, Super Ball, Development Fortune, Jayoda, Kapruka and Sasiri for the Development	Lotteries Board for a period of one year from May 2023. Six (06) bidders have	submitted bids for the same. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to award the procurement to print and supply the relevant lottery tickets as follows upon recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	Awarding the Procurement to print and supply the lottery tickets Lagna wasanawa, Ada Kotipathi, Super Ball and Kapruka to Grand Export (Pvt.) Ltd.

*	Awarding the Procurement to print and supply the lottery tickets Shanida, Jayoda, Development Fortune and Sasiri to Printcare Secure Ltd.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding for the establishment of a Maldives Cultural Center in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-17
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to establish a cultural center of the Republic of Maldives in Sri Lanka for the purposes of providing training opportunities for cultural and artistic activities and facilitation for the sports, exhibitions, concerts, seminars, public addresses, films and other audiovisual productions. Both parties have agreed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding for the purpose and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft MoU. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Tree Planting Programme - “Ratata Husma Dena Nakatha”
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-17
decision_details_body: - An auspicious time has been added to the auspicious time list (Nekath Seettuwa) of the Sinhalese and Tamil New Year for tree planting in coincide with the National Tree Planting Programme, in the year 2020. Accordingly a tree planting programme named “Nakathata Pelayak - Ratata Husma Dena Nakatha” has been implemented in that year and under the said programme 1.1 million trees have been planted islandwide. As per the Nekath Seettuwa of this Sinhala and Hindu New Year, the auspicious time for tree planting falls on 2023‑04‑20 at 6.38 am and the Ministry of Agriculture has made arrangements to implement a tree planting programme based on that auspicious time. Accordingly, the Minister of Agriculture informed the Cabinet on the measures taken to pant a perennial crop that will bear fruits this year and to get the total number of families of 52 lacks participated in the said programme, and the Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence for the same.

description: Allocating the Galle Face Green for the General Public only to spend their leisure time
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-17
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Ports Authority has undertaken the task of developing the Galle Face Green as a Corporate Social Responsibility Project and the said authority has incurred around Rs.220 million for the development activities so far carried out. An amount of Rs.6.6 million has been spent to repair the damages caused during the recent struggle period. Although this premises should be maintained so that public can freely spend their leisure time, the premises is constantly damaged and maintaining beauty and the scenic nature thereof has become difficult owing to allocating the same for musical shows and other activities where public gather largely. Therefore, Cabinet decided not to grant permission with effect from 2023‑04‑20, to utilize the Galle Face Green for musical shows, political meetings or any other activity which damage or could damage the scenic beauty of its premises, except for religious activities.

description: Amending the existing Air Transport Agreement between Sri Lanka and Israel
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-17
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka and Israel have entered into an Air Transport Agreement on 2003‑08‑24 and the two party has reached to a consensus to amend the said agreement at the International Civil Air Services Negotiations Conference held on 2016‑12‑06 in Nassau, Bahamas. Although, approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously at its meeting held on 2021‑01‑11 to sign the Protocol for the purpose, it has not yet been signed. The clearance of the Attorney General and the concurrence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs have been received for the relevant draft Protocol. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to sign the Protocol for amending the Air Transport Agreement that has already been signed between Sri Lanka and Israel and to authorize Ambassador of Sri Lanka to Israel to sign the said Protocol on behalf of the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Implementation of Dehiwala Smart Metering Project of Ceylon Electricity	Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-03
decision_details_body: - Initiatives have been taken to implement a Smart Metering System targeting a customer base of 50,000 initially in Dehiwala area and its' estimated cost is LKR1,000    million.    Bids    have    been   invited   under   the international   competitive 	bidding procedure for the design, supply, install, testing and commissioning    of    its'	infrastructure  and  5  bids   have   been   received. The proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to award the respective procurement to M/s Yantai Dongfang Wisdom Electric Co. Ltd in China, the substantially responsive bidder as per the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Approved Procurement Committee at the total amount of LKR 937.91 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the procurement for the provisioning of a computer software	solution for revenue optimization at Srilankan Airlines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-03
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the international competitive bidding procedure	for the provisioning of a computer software solution for revenue optimization   at Srilankan  Airlines, accordingly, 04 bids have been received. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to  award  the  respective  procurement to PROS, Inc  in  United  States of America,  the  lowest  evaluated   substantially	responsive bidder as per the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Approved Procurement	Committee for a period of 5 years at the total amount of USD 3,243,600, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National competitive bidding for the operation of a restaurant of	international food chain and/or a shop for international branded apparel	and accessories in the Departure/Transit area at Bandaranaike  	International Airport, Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-03
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited under national competitive bidding procedure for the operation of a restaurant of international food chain and/or a shop for international	branded apparel and accessories in the departure/transit area at Bandaranaike International  Airport,  Katunayake  and  3  bids  have been submitted. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the respective contract to M/s.Flemingo Duty Free (Pvt) Ltd, the substantially responsive highest evaluated bidder as per the recommendation of the Standing	Cabinet Approved Procurement Committee for a period of 3 years at the total	amount of USD 2,502,624.00, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of fertilizer subsidy for paddy cultivation in Yala Season of 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-03
decision_details_body: - Providing a financial subsidy to the farmers for maximum of two hectares as Rs.20,000/- per hectare to purchase fertilizers, taking into consideration a proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture related to supply of fertilizer for paddy	cultivation in Yala Season on 2023, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Truth and Reconciliation Mechanism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-03
decision_details_body: - An Advisory Committee has been appointed in terms of the Cabinet decision dated 2023‑01‑16 to prepare a preliminary draft to use as a basis for making legislation on Truth and Reconciliation Commission. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms and the Minister of Foreign Affairs to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill based on the preliminary draft submitted by the said Advisory Committee, was approved  by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of surgical gauze from local suppliers required for the Medical Supply Division for the year 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2012‑12‑05 has granted approval to purchase the essential quantity of surgical gauze for clinical and surgical activities of Government hospitals under a regular quota scheme. Accordingly, the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has selected 348 surgical gauze suppliers out of 405 suppliers who have registered in the Medical Supply Division, to purchase 30 million meters of gauze required for the year 2023. The Pricing Committee has approved the fixed price of a meter of surgical gauze as LKR 74.96. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the procurement for the purchase of 30 million meters of gauze for the year 2023 to the selected 348 suppliers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Paddy Purchasing Programme of the Government for the Maha Season 2022/23
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023‑01‑16 has granted approval to provide 10kg of rice per month for a family covering 2 million low income families for a period of 2 months. It has been identified that in addition to the aforesaid two million families, there are approximately 850,000 families in the waiting list and the said number of families would be appropriate to include in the proposed programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to provide 10kg of rice per month for 2.85 million families for a period of two months by including the aforesaid 850,000 low income families as well into this programme and to increase budgetary provisions of Rs 10 billion currently approved for this up to Rs 13 billion, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mediation Special Categories of Disputes (Qualifications of Mediators) Regulations No.1 of 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-03
decision_details_body: - Provisions have been made through the Regulation published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2021‑12‑21 by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms under the provisions of the  Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, No. 21 of 2003, in order to operate special Mediation Boards in 06 administrative districts to settle financial disputes arising from financial business transactions. Further, powers to prescribe the qualifications of individuals to be appointed to such a Monetary Board have been vested with the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms as per section 4(2) of the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, No. 21 of 2003. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to submit the Mediation Special Categories of Disputes (Qualifications of Mediators) Regulations No. 1 of 2023 promulgated through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2314/80 dated 2023‑01‑14 to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 75 Ambulances under the Health System Enhancement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-03
decision_details_body: - Health System Enhancement Project is being implemented with funds of US$ 123 million provided by the Asian Development Bank, the Japan Fund for Poverty Reduction and the Counterpart Funds of the Government of Sri Lanka. Under that project, funds have been allocated to purchase 50 ambulances from the funds of the Asian Development Bank and 25 ambulances from the grants of the Japan Fund for Poverty Reduction. Out of that stock, it has been planned to provide 30 ambulances to the Ministry of Health and the remaining 45 ambulances to the Suwaseriya Foundation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to expedite the said procurement process and purchase the ambulances, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Buyback of Shares from the Shareholders of the Tea Shakthi Fund to the Tea Shakthi Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal on the buyback of Shares from the Shareholders of the Tea Shakthi Fund to the Tea Shakthi Fund was taken up for discussion at the Cabinet Meeting held on 2022‑09‑22. In that meeting, it has been decided that the recommendations of the Committee appointed to make decisions on the matters related to the Tea Shakthi Fund should be obtained in the first instance. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation Industries to transfer the relevant share ownership to the Tea Shakthi Fund by paying back  the nominal value of Rs.10  per share and utilize the earned funds of the Tea Shakthi Fund for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of the basic salary for the Public Officers who have submitted nominations for the Local Authorities Election
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-04-03
decision_details_body: - Around 3,000 public officers have submitted nominations as candidates for the Local Authorities Elections and they have been granted no pay leave in terms of the provisions of the Establishments Code. However, since the Local Authorities Elections has been currently postponed, those officers have encountered economic difficulties owing to the extension of their no pay leave period. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government for the payment of the basic salary of such officers for the period from 2023‑03‑09 to 2023‑04‑25, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Selection of Companies for Importation, Storage, Distribution and Sale of 	Petroleum Products in Sri Lanka, on Long-Term Contracts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑06‑27 has granted approval to call for Expression of Interest for importation, storage, distribution and sale of petroleum products on long term contracts. Accordingly, 26 companies have made their proposals and the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Cabinet Appointed Special Committee have recommended 13 companies with qualifications to submit Request for Proposals. As such, 07 companies have submitted detailed proposals. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to enter into Agreements with the following companies for importation, storage, distribution and sale of petroleum products in Sri Lanka as per the provisions of the Petroleum Products (Special Provisions) (Amended) Act, No.33 of 2022, based on the recommendations submitted by the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Cabinet Appointed Special Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board on the said proposals, was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	M/S Sinopec Fuel Oil Lanka (Private) Limited
*	M/S United Petroleum Pty Ltd.
*	M/S RM Parks of USA

description: Establishment of a Solar Power Plant at Sampur, Trincomalee by a Joint Venture Company of the Ceylon Electricity Board and the National Thermal Power Corporation of India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - An agreement has been reached by the National Thermal Power Corporation of India and the Ceylon Electricity Board to implement a Solar Power Plant of 135 MW jointly in two phases at the same location where the Coal Power Plant at Sampur was scheduled to be constructed. Under phase 01 of this Project, it is expected to develop a 50 MW Solar Power Plant project with a total investment of US$ 42.5 million and to construct a 220 kV transmission line of 40 km length from Sampur to Kappalthurai at an estimated cost of US$ 23.6 million. This phase is scheduled to be completed in 2 years from 2024 to 2025. In phase 02 of the Project, a Solar Power Plant with an additional capacity of 85 MW will be constructed at a total investment of US$ 72 million. Further, it has been planned to construct a transmission line of 76 km length transmission line with a capacity of 220 KW from Kappalthurai to New Habarana at an estimated cost of US$ 42 million to distribute the electricity generated under phase 02. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to take the necessary steps to implement the said Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Coal required for the Norachcholai Lakvijaya Coal Power Plant for the Season of 2023/2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - It has been estimated that 2.25 million MT of coal is required for the Norachcholai Lakvijaya Coal Power Plant for the season of 2023/2024. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister Power and Energy to implement the relevant procurement process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding for the Corporation in the Field of	Renewable Energy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - Obtaining a 70% of the total electricity requirement from the renewable energy sources by the year 2030, being energy independent and achieving carbon neutrality by 2050 have declared as a policy by the Government. Aiming to achieve that stability, the Government of the Republic of India has agreed to promote and strengthen corporation in the field of renewable energy by jointly undertaking and /or facilitation power generation projects utilizing solar energy, wind energy including off shore wind, power generation projects relating to Bio mass and dedicated transmission infrastructure at mutually agreed locations in Sri Lanka including locations in the Northern and Eastern provinces jointly by private and public sector enterprises of India and Sri Lanka. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding for the Corporation in the Field of Renewable Energy, between the Republic of India and the Government Of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Holding the State Vesak Festival of the year 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to hold the State Vesak Festival of 2023 (Sri Buddha Year 2567) at Kebellewala Sri Rathanasiri Pirivena Temple, Madampe, Chillaw in Puttlam District jointly by the Ministry of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government; Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs and the Department of Buddhist Affairs, with the recommendations of the Most Venerable Mahamayake Theros of Tri‑Nikaya and the Samastha Lanka Sasanarakshaka Mandalaya. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to declare from 2023‑05‑02 to 2023‑05‑08 as the Vesak Week and simultaneously carry out different religious and social programmes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Orders made under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act,	No.40 of 1979, for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to present the Orders made under section 14 of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No.40 of 1979 and published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2312/76 dated 2023‑01‑01, for approval in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Programme to Commemorate the International Day of Zero Waste
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - The United Nations General Assembly, under the initiative of the Republic of Turkiye, made the proclamation that 30th March of each year as the International Day of Zero Waste, on 2022‑12‑14. The objective of declaring this day is to promote zero waste initiatives to advance the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to conduct a national programme to commemorate the International Day Zero Waste on 2023‑03‑30 with the participation of the Ministry of Environment and other stakeholder institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Determination of Deputy Inspector General Divisional Boundaries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - In the Policy Statement presented at the opening of the 04th Session of the 09th Parliament, Hon. President pointed out that, since the existing Deputy Inspector General divisional boundaries do not coincide with the existing provincial boundaries, it is necessary to determine the Deputy Inspector General divisional boundaries according to the provinces in order to avoid practical difficulties and issues in administration. Accordingly, it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet regarding the measures taken by the Hon. President to appoint an	Officials' Committee under the Chairmanship of Secretary to the Ministry of Public Security to determine the Deputy Inspector General divisional boundaries.

description: Incorporation of Sri Lanka Institute of Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - It is essential to take an integrated approach pertaining to various sectors such as food crops, plantation crops, exports agricultural crops, horticultural crops, animal	husbandry, environment and forest conservation for the agricultural development	in Sri Lanka and for what it has been observed that it is appropriate to establish a	structure to make agriculture experts highly skilled on relevant subjects serving in different institutions for technological capacity building. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to incorporate Sri Lanka Institute of	Agriculture which holds the membership of more than 1000 agricultural professionals at present, ensuring the quality of service and ethics of the agricultural professionals enabling to acquire their service widely, efficiently and effectively and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill, was approved	by the Cabinet.

description: To obtain the approval for the establishment of Quality Assurance and 	Accreditation Commission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 2019‑04‑02 to publish the Higher Education (Quality Assurance Accreditation) Bill in the Government Gazette and to present in the Parliament but could not be presented to the Parliament for approval at that occasion. After examining some of the amendments proposed by the Attorney General to move at the Committee Stage of the said Bill and the observations and proposals submitted by various parties subsequently, it has been identified that it is appropriate to further amend the Higher Education (Quality Assurance Accreditation) Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman incorporating the new provisions. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to Section 6 (3) (e) of the Civil Aviation Act No.14 of 2010
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that, opening up the sectors of aeronautical services for public‑private participation and investment promotion by private entities in these	sectors will contribute for the rapid development of such sectors and for the betterment of the Aviation industry as a whole. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Port, Shipping and Aviation to instruct the Legal Draftsman to	amend the Civil Aviation Act, No.14 of 2010 enabling one or more persons to be appointed as service providers for providing the aeronautical services, was	approved by	the Cabinet.

description: Procedure related to Areca Nut Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - The proposals on export of locally produced Areca Nuts and importation of	dried	Areca Nuts and re‑exportation after value addition have been deliberated	at the	Cabinet meeting held on 2023‑03‑13 and an Officials Committee has	been	appointed under the Chairmanship of Senior Economic Advisor to the	President to submit a report with recommendations to the Cabinet after	examining the matters thereon.  Accordingly, as recommended by the said 	Committee, it was decided to grant approval to the procedure for export of 	locally produced Areca Nuts and the import of Areca Nuts for value added 	exports re-exportation after value addition.

description: Hosting the Fifth Session of the Forum of Ministers of Environment and 	Environment Authorities of Asia Pacific
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - The fifth session of the Forum of Ministers of Environment and Environment Authorities of Asia Pacific has been scheduled to be held in the fourth quarter of year 2023 in Sri Lanka in order to provide opinions and proposals on the Regional Environmental Agenda at the 6th session of the United Nations Environment	Assembly scheduled to be held in February 2024 in Nairobi, Kenya. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to host the fifth session of the said	Forum, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Sigiriya as a Sustainable Tourist Destination
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - Sigiriya, a world heritage and one of the major reputed archaeological sites in Sri Lanka is a tourist destination with the highest tourist attraction among local and foreign tourists. Further, it is also the highest income generating tourist destination from among the tourist destinations in this country. However, considering the issues arising when managing Sigiriya as a tourist destination, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Lands and the Minister of Buddhasasana, Cultural and Religious Affairs to prepare a Master Plan to develop Sigiriya as a sustainable tourist destination, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Road Maintenance Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - The Hon. President presenting the budget for the year 2023 proposed to establish a fund for road maintenance and he further proposed to allocate an initial provision of Rs.100 million for the purpose.  The responsibility of formulating a suitable mechanism to establish and maintain the fund has been vested with the Ministry of Transport and Highways. Accordingly, taking into account a proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways, Cabinet granted its approval for the establishment of the proposed Fund by an Act of Parliament.

description: Conversion of National School of Business Management Limited (NSBM) to 	a Company Limited by Guarantee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - National School of Business Management Limited has been established as a subsidiary of the National Institute of Business Management established under the provisions of the National Institute of Business Management Law No.23 of 1976. The said institute which has been established as a state-of-the-art University in Homagama, presently functions as an institute which offer Degrees and Post Graduate Degrees. Currently, more than 11,500 students have been given the opportunity to study more than 50 degree courses under 05 faculties in that institution. It has been found that by adopting a model equivalent to the models that of the world‑renowned educational institutions in the world, it will be possible to maintain the functions of the NSBM in a more effective manner and in accordance with international standards. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to take future measures required to convert the registration status of the National School of Business Management into a company Limited by Guarantee in terms of section 32 of the Companies Act, No.07 of 2007, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing facilities to pursue Degree Programmes in Non-State Higher	Education Institutes under the Interest-Free Student Loan Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2017‑04‑04 to implement a project for the provision of interest free loans for the students who do not meet the cut‑off marks to enter into State Universities, to pursue Degree Courses in accredited Non‑State Degree awarding institutes.  At present, five (05) batches of students have been benefited under the said scheme and the qualified students to the 06th batch have been identified. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to further continue that Interest‑Free Student Loan Scheme as per the procedure so far followed and to facilitate for 5000 students as the 7th batch of students under the said programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading the Siddha Medicine Units of the University of Jaffna and the 	Trincomalee Campus of the Eastern University, Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - Having discussed at the Cabinet Meeting held on 2023‑02‑06 on the upgrading of the existing Siddha Medicine Units of the University of Jaffna and the Trincomalee Campus of the Eastern University, Sri Lanka as faculties, it had been decided to obtain a Report from the University Grants Commission on whether there are sufficient academic and staff facilities for the purpose. Accordingly, it has been confirmed by the University Grants Commission that there are sufficient human and physical resources to transform the said Siddha Medical Units into Faculties. Taking into account the facts presented by the Minister of Education, the approval of the Cabinet was granted to take the necessary action to upgrade the relevant Siddha Medicine units as faculties in those universities.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding for the implementation of the Korea's Saemaul Undong Projects in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-27
decision_details_body: - The Saemaul Undong Programme which was implemented since 1970 by the Republic of Korea has been instrumental to transform the traditional agrarian economy prevailed in the rural areas of Korea into an industrialized and export‑oriented economy by improving infrastructure facilities, livelihood, welfare and education. In 2015, the Saemaul programme has also been started in Sri Lanka by the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council after entering into a Memorandum of Understanding with the Saemaul Foundation, which was established in the year 2013 by the Republic of Korea with a view to expanding the Saemaul concept to the other countries as well. The duration of the said MoU has expired by now. It has been proposed to sign a new Memorandum of Understanding enabling to implement projects under the Saemaul Undong concept covering all the provinces of Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government to sign a Tripartite Memorandum of Understanding among the Ministry of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government; the Department of External Resources and the Saemaul Foundation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing the Extended Fund Facility Arrangement during 2023 - 2026 from the International Monetary Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-20
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has entered into a Staff Level Agreement on 2022‑09‑01 to obtain a loan facility of US$ equivalent 2.3 billion of SDR for a 48 months arrangement under the Extended Fund Facility to support Sri Lanka's economic policies with a view to ensuring the macroeconomic stability and debt sustainability, safeguarding financial stability, protecting the vulnerable communities, stepping up structural reforms, curbing corruption, and unlocking Sri Lanka's growth potentialities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to enter into the relevant Agreements to obtain the said Extended Fund Facility of the International Monetary Fund for budget financing during 2023‑2026, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Betting and Gaming Levy (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-20
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑07‑04 has granted approval to amend the
	Betting and Gaming Levy Act No. 40 of 1988. The clearance of the Attorney 	General has been received to the Bill prepared accordingly by the Legal 	Draftsman. As such, 	the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as 	the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to 	publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same 	thereafter, 	to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control)Act, No.1 of 1969, for Approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-20
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the following regulations enacted under the provisions of Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969, for Approval of Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	Imports Control Regulations on Payment Terms No.04 of 2023, published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.2320/46 dated 2023‑02‑22.

*	Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.05 of 2023, published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.2320/47 dated 2023‑02‑22.

description: Submission of the Order in terms of section 2 of the Extradition Law No.8 of 1977 for the approval of the Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-20
decision_details_body: - Extradition Law No.8 of 1977 has been enacted to make provision for the extradition of fugitive persons to and from Commonwealth countries and foreign states, to regulate the treatment of persons accused or convicted of offenses committed in	Sri Lanka who are extradited from Commonwealth countries and foreign states, and to provide for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. The Minister of Defence has the authority to promulgate through an Order published in the Gazette on Commonwealth countries to which the provisions of the section 2 of the said Act apply. Accordingly, an amended Order including 56 countries, in terms of the section 2	of Extradition Law No.8 of 1977, was published through Gazette Extraordinary No.2319/30 dated 2023‑02‑14. The proposal made by the President in his capacity as the	Minister of Defense to submit the said Order for the approval of the Parliament, was	approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accession to the Agreement on Privileges and Immunities of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-20
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has been a founding Member State of the International Atomic Energy Agency since 1957 and it receives technical assistance for the fields such as Medicine, Industry, Safety, Food and Agriculture, Environment and Energy Planning under the Technical Cooperation Programme of the said Institute. Sri Lanka has not yet signed the Agreements to grant immunities and privileges to the experts and other officials who visit Sri Lanka to provide such technical assistance. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs and the Minister of Power and Energy to accede the Agreement on Privileges and Immunities of the International Atomic Energy Agency as agreed by the Attorney General's Department, the Ministry of Power and Energy, the Sri Lanka Atomic Energy Board and the Sri Lanka Atomic Energy Regulatory Council and thereafter table the same in terms of the provisions of the Diplomatic Privileges Act, No.9 of 1996, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Distribution of land plots from the land called Hineford Estate of Pasbage Korale, Nawalapitiya vested with the Land Reform Commission for those who were affected by floods and landslides
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-20
decision_details_body: - The land called Hineford Estate in extent of 566 acres situated in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Pasbage Korale of the Kandy district has been vested with the Land Reform Commission. Taking into consideration a proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Lands, Cabinet granted its approval to distribute about 200 acres of lands from the said land among those affected by floods and landslides and the families residing in high risk prone areas and likely to be affected by such disasters.

description: Entering into an Agreement between the Human Resources Development Service of Korea and the Vocational Training Authority of Sri Lanka to Strengthen Technical Vocational Education and Training Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-20
decision_details_body: - The Human Resources Development Service of Korea under the purview of the Ministry of Employment and Labour of the Republic of Korea has expressed its willingness to provide a grant of 2.15 billion of Korean Won for upgrading and capacity building of the National Vocational Training Institute at Niyagama operating under the Vocational Training Authority of Sri Lanka. The proposed project has been planned to be implemented for a period of two years commencing from the year 2023 and for the purpose it has been proposed to enter into an Agreement between the Human Resources Development Service of Korea and the Vocational Training Authority of Sri Lanka. The clearance of the Attorney General and the concurrence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Department of External Resources have been received for the draft Agreement. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to sign the proposed Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Anti-Corruption Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-13
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑07‑18 has granted approval to prepare the Anti‑Corruption Bill. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received to the said Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Anti-Corruption Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter in Parliament for Approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Carriage by Air Act, No.29 of 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-13
decision_details_body:
