- The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑08‑22 has granted approval to amend the
	Carriage by Air Act, No.29 of 2018 to modify the legal framework pertaining to the protection of domestic aviation, to ensure the passenger safety and to identify the liability limits for the domestic aviation. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received to the Carriage by Air Bill prepared accordingly by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter in Parliament for Approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rights of  Persons with Disabilities Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-13
decision_details_body: - The United Nations Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities was signed by Sri Lanka in the year 2016. As per the Article 4 of the Convention, State 	Parties should undertake to ensure and promote the full realization of all human	rights and fundamental freedom for all persons with disabilities without discrimination of any kind on the basis of disability and a committee consisting of Honorable Ministers of Parliament has been appointed to prepare a preliminary draft in this regard. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Women, Child Affairs and Social Empowerment and the Minister of Justice, Prisons Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, to	introduce a new Act repealing the existing Protection of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, No.28 of 1996 and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill for the said purpose, based on the preliminary draft submitted by the above committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Imposition of Regulations under the provisions of the Employees' Trust Fund 	Act No.46 of 1980
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-13
decision_details_body: - Regulations made amending the the Employees' Trust Fund Regulations which had been made under the Employees' Trust Fund Act, No.46 of 1980 and promulgated in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.125 dated 1980‑01‑23, have been published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2311/39 dated 2022‑12‑22. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance,Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the said amended regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Pilot Project for the installation of Floating Solar power projects on the	surface of Chandrika Wewa and Kiri Ibban Wewa in Rathnapura District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-13
decision_details_body: - Under the Framework Agreement on Grant Aid signed between the Republic of Korea and Sri Lanka in 2009, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy of Korea has agreed to provide a grant of 6.83 billion Korean Won in order to implement a pilot project for the installation of Floating Solar power panels of 1 MW capacity on Chandrika Wewa in Rathnapura District and Kiri Ibban Wewa in Monaragala District. The Korea Institute for Advancement of Technology functions as the executing agency for this project on behalf of the Republic of Korea. Accordingly, as agreed, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to sign the Record of Discussion among the Korea Institute for Advancement of Technology, the Ministry of Power and Energy and the Department of External Resources in order to commence and execute this pilot project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transferring of the management of the Ridiyagama Rehabilitation Centre	to the Central Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-13
decision_details_body: - Ridiyagama Rehabilitation Centre located in Ambalanthota which was established under the Department of Social Services in 1975, has been transferred to the Social Affairs Division of the Southern Provincial Council in 1990. Although this centre has been built for the detention of around 450 inmates, currently 576 inmates have been detained there causing them to face a difficult and oppressive living condition. Taking into account the aforesaid situation and the detention of inmates in this centre from different parts of the country based on the Orders given by Courts, it has been found more appropriate that this centre be administering under the Central Government as a national level centre instead of managing the same by the Southern Provincial Council. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Women, Child Affairs and Social Empowerment; and the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to transfer the Ridiyagama Rehabilitation Centre to the Department of Social Services, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Review of Sri Lanka's 6th Periodic Report under the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-07
decision_details_body: - The Review of Sri Lanka's 6th Interim Report under the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights is scheduled to be held in Geneva on March 8 and 9, 2023.	The matters presented by the Minister of Foreign Affairs regarding the steps taken so far by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the said review, was taken into consideration by the Cabinet.

description: Establishing a Financial Sector Crisis Management Committee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-07
decision_details_body: - It is very important to avoiding a financial crisis that can be originated due to the impact on the financial sector owing to fiscal, debt and balance of payment issues and  minimizing the cost of such a financial crisis. Accordingly, critical crisis management and timely decision-making are essential in the face of the economic crisis that Sri Lanka is currently encountered. Therefore, the proposal submitted by 	the Hon. President	in his capacity as the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to establish the Financial Sector Crisis Management Committee	and the Technical Committee on Financial Sector Crisis 	Management to coordinate	between the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the Ministry in charge of the subject of Finance in the preparation and management of a crisis in the financial sector, as well as their respective roles and to include the necessary provisions in the Banking (Special Provisions)Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health Act,	No.38 of 2009
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-07
decision_details_body: - 	The National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health Act,	No.38 of 2009 has been enacted aiming to establish an institute on national occupational safety and health for the purpose of formulating a national policy to frame standards for occupational safety and health and to create an occupational safety environment that ensures the safety of both the employers and employees. It has been identified that this Act should be amended so as to suit to the timely requirements. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation to amend the  National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Contribution of Sri Lanka for the "Commonwealth of Learning" 	Organization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-07
decision_details_body: - The "Commonwealth of Learning" is an international organization established by the Heads of States to strengthen the capacity of member countries to develop human resources required for their economic and social development. The contribution of Sri Lanka as a member country to the "Commonwealth of Learning", which is the education sector of the Commonwealth Organization, has been given for the education sector of the Memorandum of Understanding for the Commonwealth Fund signed with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to pay the relevant contribution amount and continue the membership of the "Commonwealth of Learning" organization, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Water Treatment Plant at Horana Export Processing Zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-07
decision_details_body: - Water is supplied to the Horana Export Processing Zone and the Wagawatta Industrial Zone through a water supply scheme implemented by the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka and its production capacity is 3,000 m3 per day.  However, since the daily water demand of investors in Horana and Wagawata zones is about 4,350 m3, the National Water Supply and Drainage Board has prepared plans for the construction of a new water treatment plant with a capacity of 2,000 m3 per day to meet the said water demand. The Board of Directors of the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka has agreed to make necessary provisions for that. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to construct and operate the said new water treatment plant in the Horana Export Processing Zone by utilizing the allocations of the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Identification of the Limits of the Continental Shelf of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-03-07
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has presented its technical and scientific data and other material to the United Nations Commission on the Limits of the Continental Shelf to establish the outer limits of  the Continental Shelf beyond 200 nautical miles Exclusive Economic Zone under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea. Accordingly, the said Commission has appointed a Sub-Commission to consider the Sri Lanka's claim. The National Ocean Affairs Committee has been appointed under the Ministry of Foreign Affairs as per the approval of the Cabinet to work with the above Sub Commission to identify the  limits of the Continental Shelf for which claims are preferred by Sri Lanka. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to call for Expression of Interest to reconstitute the said National Ocean Affairs Committee with a view to identifying the outer limits of the continental shelf with supporting evidence to establish the shelf, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Anti-Terrorism Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-27
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has previously granted approval for the introduction of a new Act to replace the existing Prevention of Terrorism (Temporary Provisions) Act No.48 of 1979. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman.As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of the Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-27
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑03‑08 has granted approval to introduce a new Act incorporating the most suitable provisions to replace Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Actcurrently in force, so that the internationally accepted best standards and practices can be followed. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Exemption of the purchase of paddy, production and sale of rice from the Social Security Levy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-27
decision_details_body: - Approval ofthe Cabinet has been granted to implement a programme toprovide rice to the low income earners free of charge by purchasing Nadu paddy by the Governmentat Rs 100/-per kg in view of giving a reasonable price to the paddy farmer. The rice producers has pointed out that an additional cost has to be incurred for the water, electricity, storage and transportationetc. until one kg of rice is produced and delivered to the consumer in the process of rice production in addition to the amount of money paid to the farmer for 01kg of paddy and apart from that approximatelyRs.6.00/7.00 for 01kg of rice has to be spent as social security contribution levy. They have further pointed out that if any relief can be given to reduce the said cost, there is a possibility of giving a higher price to the farmers. Taking into consideration the said matters, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to amend the Social Security Contribution Levy Act, No.25 of 2022 to exempt the purchase of paddy, production and sale of rice from the social security levy so as to provide farmers with a price higher than Rs.100/- per kg of Nadu paddy by maintaining the current price of paddy in the market as it is, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Order enacted under the provisions of the Export	Developmet Act, No.40 of 1979 to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-27
decision_details_body: - Taking into account the impact of depreciation ofrupee and the global market price/ cost and CIF value, the specific unit rates of the CESS levy on selected goods under HS Code 677 has been revised, and for that the Order imposed under section 14 of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act No.40 of 1979 has been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2022‑11‑14. Such Order imposed as per the provisions of the said Act should be submitted to Parliament for approval within 04 months from the date of its promulgation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to submit the said Order which has been published through Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2022‑11‑14, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of National Contributory Pension Fund Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-27
decision_details_body: - It has been recognized that it would be appropriate to establish a fund called the National Contributory Pension Fund to provide a pension with some benefit to the pensioners of the Public service for their retirement life and to ensure a suitable environment for the pensioner to spend his retirement life without being a burden to the country. Accordingly, after joining the public service, 8% of the basic salary as a Government employee and 12%as the employer's contribution should be credited to the proposed fund monthly. An independent body governed by the Board of Management will be set up to manage the proposed Contributory Pension Fund and a Fund Manager with special qualifications will be appointed to manage the funds. The proposed National Contributory Pension Scheme will be applicable to the Government employees who will be recruited in future. Further, since the provisions to the effect that employees recruited to the public service after January, 2016 should be subject to a Pension Scheme determined by the Government, are included in their Letters of Appointment, they are also able to join the proposed National Contributory Pension Scheme at their discretion. Accordingly, theproposal made by the Hon. President to instruct a Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill, enabling to make the necessary provisions, was approved by the Cabient.

description: Expanding market opportunities for supply of Jet A-1 fuel being used for 	aircrafts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-27
decision_details_body: - Jet A-1 fuel used for airplanes is currently supplied by the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation. Since it has become unable to ensure the supply of Jet A-1 fuel required for cargo and passenger air service, due to disruption of operations of the Sapugaskanda Oil Refinery, where Jet A-1 fuel is produced and becoming the import of Jet A-1 fuel a challenging task for the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation as a result of the current foreign exchange crisis facing by the country, attention has to be drawn on alternative methods to secure Jet A-1 fuel for the aircrafts that reach airports in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, it has been observed appropriate to provide the opportunity for the parties supplying Jet A-1 fuel to airlines in other countries under maximum supply limits, without hindering the supply of Jet A-1 fuel processed at Sapugaskanda Refinery of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy for the provision of market opportunities for the supply of Jet A-1 fuel to the other parties, who are capable of supplying Jet A-1 fuel , was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Pilot Project to deploy buses charged with batteries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-27
decision_details_body: - In the face of the international energy crisis, as a measure to minimize the cost incurred for the importation of fossil fuels, it has been found appropriate to introduce buses that can be run on solar power, which is a renewable energy source. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways on the implementation of a public-private partnership project for the deployment of electric buses for the Sri Lanka Transport Board covering the Western Province, centered on Colombo Commercial City and Gampaha District, Cabinet granted its approval to implement a pilot project based on a formal feasibility study, in the first instance.

description: Sri Lanka becoming a Party to Two Major International Conventions on	Nuclear Liability
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-27
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to consider nuclear Power as an option to meet Sri Lanka's future energy needs. In keeping with the said decision, a Steering Committee and 09 Working Groups have been appointed to study the matters related to generating electricity using nuclear power. According to the recommendations given by the International Atomic Energy Agency regarding the Self Evaluation Report prepared by the said Working Groups, Sri Lanka has the ability to continue the Project of generating electricity from nuclear power. As such, it has been recognized that being a party to the Vienna Convention on Civil Liability for Nuclear Damage and the Convention on Supplementary Compensation for Nuclear Damage would be appropriate to enable taking necessary measures. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs and the Minister of Power and Energy to take future action to become a party to those conventions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into an Agreement between the 'Sight for All' Company of 	Australia and the Ministry of Health
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-27
decision_details_body: - The 'Sight for All', Community Project Institute of Australia has extended its willingness to donate medical and surgical eye equipment to the eye units of the selected hospitals in Sri Lanka and provide a grant to enhance skills of health staff. Under that, it is expected to secure modern health facilities required for ocular surgeries in Provincial General Hospital Badulla, Teaching hospitals of Ratnapura, Batticaloa and Kalubowila and the Base Hospital of Tangalle and to enhance the skills of Eye Health Workers and to upgrade equipment of the regional eye units. A grant of Rs. 92.44 million will be receivedunder these projects. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to enter into an Agreement between the 'Sight for All', Community Project Institute of Australia and the Ministry of Health to obtain the proposed grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy on Gender Equality and Women Empowerment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-27
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022‑09‑05 for the preparation of a National Policy for Women Empowerment by minimizing gender imbalances. Accordingly, the “National Policy on Gender Equality and Women Empowerment“ has been prepared under 08 key thematic areas with the contribution of all the relevant parties. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Women, Child Affairs and Social Empowerment to implement the said policy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Action Plan on Women, Peace and Security
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-27
decision_details_body: - The United Nations Security Council has adopted a resolution on Women, Peace and Security in the year 2000 and many developed and undeveloped countries in the world have introduced National Action Plans to implement this resolution. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Women, Child Affairs and Social Empowerment to implement the "National Action Plan on Women, Peace and Security - 2023‑2027" which has been drafted with the contribution and concurrence of all the stakeholders, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expediting the investigations and inquiries pertaining to goods detained by the Sri Lanka Customs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-27
decision_details_body:
- It has been observed that a long time is taken to complete the investigation, inquiries and other related processes pertaining to goods including vehicles, detained by the Sri Lanka Customs. As this results in many economic losses including damage and destruction to such goods, it is important to expedite the existing processes followed by the Sri Lanka Customs on such detained goods. Accordingly, the Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence for the measures taken by the Hon. President to appoint a Ministerial Committee consisted with the following composition to study those matters and identify the amendments to be made to the Customs Ordinance if any and to submit recommendations on that regard to the Cabinet.

* 	Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva
	Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation

*	Hon. (Dr.) Ramesh Pathirana
	Minister of Plantation Industries and Minister of Industries

*	Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya 
	State Minister of Finance

*	Hon. Dilum Amunugama
	State Minister of InvestmentPromotion

*	Hon. Shehan Semasinghe 
	State Minister of Finance

description: Proposed Preferential Trade Agreement with Bangladesh
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-27
decision_details_body: - Enhancing market access opportunities for Sri Lankan exporters by removing current trade barriers, attracting investments to address the concerns of the domestic supply and enhancing economic cooperation are the main objectives that are expected to achieve through strengthening connectivity with the main regional trading partners. The Cabinet of Ministers at its meeting held on 2021‑06‑14 granted approval to enter into a Preferential Trade Agreement between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh in parallel. It has been identified bilateral trade can be further enhanced by entering into a Preferential Trade Agreement with Bangladesh can further enhance beyond existing trade agreements. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to expedite the negotiations on the proposed Preferential Trade Agreement with Bangladesh, on the guidance of the International Trade Office, was granted by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of a Development Plan for the development of Kandy City
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-20
decision_details_body: - The Hon. President drew the attention of the Cabinet to the need to develop the Kandy city under a proper plan by reducing the existing congestion in the city. Accordingly, the approval of the Cabinet was granted to appoint a Committee consisting of Ministers in the Kandy district and officials of the relevant institutions to submit appropriate plans and recommendations for the development of Kandy city from Kandy to Kundasale.

description: Financing the Budget for the year 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-20
decision_details_body: - The Appropriation Act, No.43 of 2022 has authorized a gross borrowing limit of Rs.4,979 billion for the year 2023. Accordingly, it should be utilized for the debt repayment, interest payments and financing of development projects in this year. The total gross borrowings of Rs.4,979 billion will be secured from domestic and foreign sources and it has been estimated to obtain Rs.3,526 billion from local sources and Rs.1,453 billion from foreign sources. Necessary borrowings will be secured through Treasury Bills, Treasury Bonds and Foreign Currency Banking Unit Loans and Sri Lanka Development Bonds under the domestic sources. Adhering to the policy declared by the Government of Sri Lanka in April 2022 pertaining to the interim external debt servicing, the total debt service payments to be made in foreign currency within the first six (06) months in the year 2023 has been estimated as US$ 2,609 million. Out of which US$ 2,069 will be for repayment of foreign debt and US$ 540 million will be for the payment of interest. Further, debt service payments made in foreign currencies includes Sri Lanka Development Bonds of US$ 709 and US$ 46 as their interest. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to authorize the Secretary to the Treasury to take necessary action to secure necessary provisions within the approved borrowing limit, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conferment of National Honours
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-20
decision_details_body: - 	Conferring National Honours to evaluate the service rendered through various aspects in Sri Lanka and outside takes place since 1986. As per the Gazette Notification dated 1995‑03‑20, Honours named Sri Lankabhimanya, Desamanya, Desabandu, Vidya Jyothi, Kala Keerthi, Sri Lanka Shikamani, Vidya Nidhi, Kala Shuri, Sri Lanka Thilaka and Veera Prathapa are conferred by the Presidents according to a proper procedure. Further, Sri Lanka Ranjana, Sri Lanka Rathna and Sri Lanka Ramya Honours are conferred to foreigners as per the Gazette Notification dated 1990‑09‑12. Also, in accordance with the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2008‑02‑08, the Sri Lanka Mitra Vibushana Honour is conferred to the Heads of State having cordial relationships with Sri Lanka, in recognition of their cooperation towards the Sri Lankan community. This Honour holds the topmost position in the order of the excellence of the National Honours conferred to non-Sri lankans. At present, there are considerable number of vacancies in those National Honours and the same have to be conferred to the selected individuals following the proper procedure. In addition to said Honours, it has been found appropriate to award Sri Lankans with Vishishta Kaushalyabhimani in order to evaluate the service rendered to the advancement of the fields of art, literature, science and technology and the Vishishta Janaraja Abhimani for the dedication made to the nation and also to grant the topmost rank in the order of excellence of the above mentioned National Honours. Accordingly, the Cabinet concurred with the proposals made by the Hon. President  to select honourees calling applications in keeping with the procedures set out in the relevant Gazette Notifications and to have a Parliament Act passed by making provisions to prevent conferring the National Honours irregularly by other institutions.

description: Issuing of Treasury Bonds in Settlement of Outstanding Bills
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-20
decision_details_body: - A Committee has been appointed by the Secretary to the Treasury as instructed by the Hon. President, to resolve the issues relating to due payments/unpaid bills of the Ministries and Government Institutions. The Committee Report has recommended issuing Treasury Bonds in place of the settlement of dues in Rupee terms to the Suppliers/Contractors to comfort both the market as well as the Treasury's cash flow operations. Accordingly, the proposal submitted by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to take necessary actions in this matter, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bill to establish the National Security Council
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-20
decision_details_body: - The National Security Council of Sri Lanka has been functioning as the primary executive body since 1999 advising the President on matters related to national security as well as coordinating domestic, foreign, economic and military policies. The decision of the Supreme Court given on 2023‑01‑12 has recommended the need to place the National Security Council on a statutory footing and its composition with clarity. Accordingly, the proposal submitted by the Hon. President to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to legalize the National Security Council through an Act, of Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulations imposed for revision of Fees Charged by the Department for Registration of Persons for Providing Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-20
decision_details_body: - Approval has been given in a previous Cabinet meeting to revise the fees charged by the Department for Registration of Persons. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security to present the Draft regulation prepared by amending the Registration of Persons Regulations No.01 of 2017 to Parliament for approval and then to publish the said Regulation in the Government Gazette, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulations Promulgated under the Merchant Shipping Act, No.52 of 1971 and the Licensing of Shipping Agent Act, No.10 of 1972
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to present in Parliament for approval the Regulations imposed by 13 Gazette Notifications in accordance with the provisions of the Merchant Shipping Act, No.52 of 1971 by the Merchant Shipping Secretariat under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Aviation and the Regulations imposed in accordance with the provisions of the Shipping Agents Licensing Act, No.10 of 1972, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Approval to table the Surcharge Orders in Parliament (the Customs Ordinance)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-20
decision_details_body: - Two orders have been published in the Government Gazettes dated 2022‑11‑30	and 2023‑01‑04 levying a Surcharge as a percentage on the Customs Import	Duties on selected goods under section 10(a) of the Customs Ordinance. The	proposal submitted by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Ministry of	Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to table the said Orders	in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revising the terms of the Memorandum of Understanding of Interest Free Loan 	Scheme provided to students to follow degree programmes at Non-State Higher Education Institutes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-20
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Cabinet decision dated 2022‑08‑22 taken in this regard, discussions have been conducted by the Bank of Ceylon, the General Treasury and the Ministry of Education regarding the continuous implementation of the Interest Free Student Loan Scheme provided to students to follow degree courses in the Non-State Higher Education Institutes. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Education to amend the Memorandum of Understanding entered into at present between the relevant parties, so that the course fees can be paid in installments within 8 years after completing the relevant course and to pay the prescribed interest at the monthly rate of 1% added to the prevailing Average Weighted Lending Rate (AWPLR+1%) of the coming year after completion of the course, as agreed upon by the relevant parties during the ensued discussions.

description: Declaring the area around the Narangala Mountain Range as a Wildlife Sanctuary
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-20
decision_details_body: - The Narangala Mountain Range is located in an area with a height of 1450 meters above sea level which belongs to the Dikpitiya Grama Niladhari Division of Soranathota Divisional Secretariat division, bordering Kandaketiya Divisional Secretariat Division of the Badulla District. The said mountain range is a very important water catchment area and it consists of more than 100 springs. Gama Oya, Moragolla Oya and Ambaganga Oya are nourished by the springs in the Narangalla Mountain Range, in particular. The water requirements of majority of villages located below the said mountain range are fulfilled through said rivers. Further, this mountain range is an area of rich in biodiversity. Taking the above facts into account, the proposal made by the Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation to declare the area of 239.276 hectares where the mountain range is located as Narangala Sanctuary and to acquire the lands belonging to the private and Janata Estate Development Board in that area to the government and thereafter declare the entire area as a National Wildlife Reserve.

description: Progress of Mega Scale Development Projects as at the end of Fourth Quarter of the year 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-20
decision_details_body: - Cabinet considered the Report submitted by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies on the progress of 261 mega scale development projects as at the end of the fourth quarter 2022. The progress of the majority of projects is at a very low level due to the suspension of foreign financing pertaining to certain projects and the difficulty of securing funds in the face of the existing economic situation in the country. It has also been identified that there is a risk on the sustainability of certain projects of which all the activities have been completed owing to the fact that the facilities, authority and technical services required to continue such projects have not been included in the objectives and the scope of the Ministry which implemented the said project or in the scope of functions of other relevant Institutions. Taking those matters into consideration, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to prepare and implement an Organizational Results Framework and Inter Organizational Investment Result Framework for each line Ministry including key performance indicators for development investments so that the responsibility of implementation and continuation of development projects is vested with the Line Ministries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Grant provided under Japanese, Economic and Social Development Programme to enhance health care delivery system while ensuring essential services and transport facilities of the Health Sector in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-13
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the current economic crisis prevailing in Sri Lanka, the Government of Japan has agreed to provide a grant of Japanese Yen 05 billion (approximately 38 US$ million) for the supply of fuel (mainly diesel) to ensure the continuance of essential and emergency health services without any hindrance under the Japanese, Economic and Social Development Programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to enter into the relevant Agreements to obtain the said grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of New Excise Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-13
decision_details_body: - It has been found appropriate to amend the Excise Ordinance to be suited with present day needs, which was introduced in the year 1912 for the regulating the use of liquor and tobacco, related business and issuance of relevant licenses and imposing taxes and the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies has submitted a proposal to Parliament through the Interim Budget 2022 pertaining to introduction of a new Excise Act in lieu of Excise Ordinance and the Tobacco Tax Act. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka Water Aerodromes Regulation No. 1 of 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-13
decision_details_body: - Float Plane Operations have been initiated in Sri Lanka in the early 2000 as an attractive venture in view of developing the tourism sector. At present, only one private company is engaged in the said float plane operations and it has been found that another several institutions will come forward to attend to such activities in future. Therefore, the necessity of regulating the float plane operations has arisen in order to ensure the safety of such activities. As such, the Sri Lanka Water Aerodromes Regulations No. 1 of 2022 have been published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2022‑08‑09 as per the provisions of the Civil Aviation Act No. 14 of 2010, adhering to the obligations of the International Civil Aviation Convention. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to submit the said Regulations to Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-13
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑12‑19 has granted approval to prepare the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Bill by the Legal Draftsman. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received to the drafted Central Bank of Sri Lanka Bill. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same, thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Control of single-use plastic/ polythene waste
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-13
decision_details_body:
- Proposals regarding the import, production, sale and domestic use of 07 single-use plastic/polythene products were discussed in the Cabinet meeting held on 30-08-2021 and accordingly, it was decided to appoint an Expert Committee to examine the said proposals and submit a report with recommendations. The proposal submitted by the Minister of Environment to ban the import, production, sale and domestic use of the following plastic products with effect from 01-06-2023 as recommended by the report presented by the said Expert Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

    • Single-use plastic drinking straws and stirrers
    • Single-use plates, cups (except yogurt cups), spoons, forks and knives, including yogurt spoons made of plastic
    • Plastic garlands
    • Plastic string hopper trays.

description: Grant project on capacity development for the evidence-based improvement 	of strategies and policies on air quality management in Colombo Megapolis 	Area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-13
decision_details_body: - The French Development Agency has agreed to provide a grant to implement a project on capacity development for the evidence-based improvement of strategies and policies on air quality management in Colombo Megapolis Area. Accordingly, the non-profit organization "Airpariff" as the technical partner of the project, will provide the total project cost of Euro 300,000. The Attorney General's clearance has been received for the draft Agreement of the Project. The proposal submitted by the Minister of Environment to sign a three-party fexte partnership agreement among the French Development Agency , ''AirPariff '' and the Ministry of Environment to implement the proposed project and to appoint a Steering Committee chaired by the Secretary to the Ministry of Environment to oversee the project implementation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on the Establishment of a Political 	Consultations Mechanism Between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Sri 	Lanka and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates of the 	Government of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-13
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to 		establish Political Consultations Mechanism between the Ministry of Foreign 		Affairs of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates of the 		Government of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan. It is expected to promote, 		strengthen and expand bilateral relations between the two countries including 		political, economic, consular, technical and scientific and cultural cooperation. 		The approval of the Attorney General has been received for the proposed draft 		Agreement. Accordingly, the proposal submitted by the Minister of Foreign 		Affairs to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding for the Establishment of the Bangladesh - 	Sri Lanka Joint Consultative Commission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-13
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding to establish the Bangladesh - Sri Lanka Joint Consultative Commission with the aim of promoting, strengthening and expanding bilateral relations including political, economic, technological & scientific, consular and cultural cooperation between the two countries. The proposed Consultative commission would function as a mechanism of reviewing and evaluating all areas of ongoing bilateral cooperation at the Foreign Ministers level of both countries and exploring new areas of cooperation. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the proposed draft MoU. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to sign the said MoU was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the National Search and 	Rescue Agency of the Republic of Indonesia and the Civil Aviation 	Authority of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-13
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka, as a signatory state to the Chicago Convention of International Civil Aviation Organization, is obliged and responsible to provide Air Navigation Services/Air Traffic Services, Flight Information Services and Alerting Services for all aircraft flying across the airspace of this country. Sri Lanka and Indonesia are neighboring states that share the south-eastern boundary of the Colombo Flight Information Region. The responsibilities of search and rescue operations in that region have been vested with Sri Lanka. According to the Chicago Convention of International Civil Aviation Organization, in order to strengthen the cooperation and coordination of search and rescue activities, it is necessary for adjacent States to enter into agreements with neighboring countries setting forth the conditions for entry of search and rescue units into their respective territories. As such, a Memorandum of Understanding has been signed for a period of 05 years between the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka and the National Search and Rescue Agency of the Republic of Indonesia in the year 2018 and the said period has now become ended. The proposal made by the Minister Ports, Shipping and Aviation to extend the period of said MoU for a further period of 05 years with effect from 2023‑01‑23, in order to continue the corporation between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Third Round of Negotiations of the Sri Lanka - Thailand Free Trade 	Agreement held in Colombo during 09th and 10th January 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-13
decision_details_body: - Preliminary work has been started in the year 2016 to embark a Free Trade Agreement between Sri Lanka and Thailand with the expectation of increasing the existing bilateral trade value of US$ 550 million to US$ 1.5 billion through strengthening the economic corporation of two parties in number of sectors thereby recognizing the economic potentials and complementary economic structures which can be further improved. Accordingly, approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2018‑07‑03 to commence negotiations of the proposed Sri Lanka Thailand Free Trade Agreement covering Goods, Rules of Origin, Services, Investment, Economic Cooperation, Trade Remedy, Custom Procedures and Trade Facilitation and Intellectual Property. The first round of negotiations was held in July 2018 in Sri Lanka and the second round of negotiations has been held in September 2018 in Bangkok, Thailand. Its third round of negotiations has been held in 09th and 10th January, 2023 at Colombo and the information furnished by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies on the progress of those negotiations was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Rationalization of Government Expenditure through a Systematic Review
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-06
decision_details_body:
- The Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies has proposed through the Budget 2023 to introduce the Zero Based Budgeting in view of rationalization of Government expenditure. Duplication in expenditure programmes, wasters, low priority activities and efficient and effective methods of utilizing existing allocations will be identified through a systematic review under the Zero-Based Budgeting approach. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to appoint 10 Officials' Committees under the Chairmanship of a Deputy Secretary to the Treasury or a Senior Officer of the Treasury to carry out a systematic review on the following Ministries for which a higher portion of provisions is allocated through the Annual Budgetary Estimates, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	Ministry of Transport and Highways
*	Ministry of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government
*	Ministry of Education
*	Ministry of Health
*	Ministry of Agriculture
*	Ministry of Plantation Industries
*	Ministry of Defence
*	Ministry of Public Security
*	Ministry of Irrigation
*	Ministry of Urban Development and Housing

description: Maintaining essential Public Services in the most difficult financial circumstances
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-06
decision_details_body: - The Government revenue has dropped down to a value of 8.3% of the Gross Domestic Product due to the prevailing economic crisis. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to instruct the Secretary to the Treasury to take necessary action to release imprest only for the most essential recurrent expenditure to be incurred to maintain public services until the condition returns to normalcy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Finance (Special Provisions) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-06
decision_details_body: - The requirement of introducing a Bill in view of proper management of funds available in the State institutions was submitted to Parliament through a proposal in Interim Budget 2022 by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of  Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to systematically monitor the statutory funds maintained by Ministries, Departments, and other State Institutions and implement a programme for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-06
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to present the Imports Control Regulations on Payment Terms No.03 of 2023 published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2023‑01‑19 under the Imports and Exports  (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Partition Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-06
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑10‑05 has granted approval to prepare a Bill to amend the Partition Act incorporating provisions that suit with present day needs. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received to the drafted Bill. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same, thereafter in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act No.2 of 1996
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-06
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2020‑12‑21 has granted approval to prepare a Bill to amend the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No.2 of 1996 incorporating provisions relating to increase the penalties for obstructions caused to the authorized officers when implementing provisions in the said Act and regulating the illegal activities. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received to the drafted Bill. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same, thereafter in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations made under the Welfare Benefits Act, No.24 of 2002 and the Electronic Transactions Act, No.19 of 2006 for the process of payment of welfare benefits for the approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-06
decision_details_body: - As per provisions of Section 27 of Welfare Benefits Act, No.24 of 2002, the Welfare Benefit Payment Payment(Selection of Persons Eligible to Receive Payments) Regulations No.01 of 2022 have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2022‑10‑20.Also enabling the preparation of electronic documents, electronic records and the maintenance of a related information system in order to carry out the functions and duties of the Welfare Benefits Act, No.24 of 2002, the Integrated Welfare Management System Regulations No.02 of 2002 under the Electronic Transactions Act, No.19 of 2006, have been published in the Gazette Extraordinary dated 2022‑11‑29. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit the said regulations to the Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introducing amendments to the Employees' Trust Fund Act, No.46 of 1980
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-06
decision_details_body: - A proposal to provide Health Insurance similar to Agrahara Health Insurance to 	private sector employees too, was presented by the Hon. President to the	Parliament through the Budget Speech 2023. The proposal made by Hon.	President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic	Stabilization and National	Policies to prepare a Bill to amend the Employees'	Trust Fund Act No.46 of 1980, enabling the implementation of the said	Proposal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations imposed under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021, to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-06
decision_details_body: - Colombo Port City (Registration of Offshore Companies) Regulations No.01 of 2022 made under Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021, have published in the Extraordinary Gazette No.2306/54 dated 2022‑11‑17. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to submit the said regulations to Parliament to approval of the Cabinet, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for CulturalCooperation between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and 	the Republic of Maldives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-06
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for Cultural Cooperation between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Maldives. The Draft Agreement prepared for this purpose has received the clearance of the Attorney General and the concurrence of Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of  Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to sign the said Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Combined Agreement of Cooperation between the Sri Lanka 	Rupavahini Corporation and the Turkish Radio Television Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-06
decision_details_body: - During the second session of the Combined Committee on Sri Lanka Turkey Economic and Technical Cooperation 2021, It has been proposed to enter into an Agreement of Cooperation between the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Cooperation and the Turkish Radio Television Cooperation with the aim of further strengthening trade, economic and technical cooperation between the two parties. The draft Agreement prepared accordingly has been received the clearance of the Attorney General and the concurrence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media to sign the said Agreement on Cooperation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement between the Takamol of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the	Tertiary and Vocational Education Commission of Sri Lanka for the Skills	Verification Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-06
decision_details_body: - The Tertiary and Vocational Education Commission coming under the Ministry of Education and the Sri Lanka Foreign Employment Bureau with co-ordination of the relevant stakeholders and liaising with Qualification Verification Authorities in Foreign Countries implement a programme to equalize the qualifications of Sri Lankan skilled workers with foreign countries. It will pave the way for migrant workers to join overseas jobs with higher value, respect and greater economic benefits. Accordingly, it has been proposed to enter into an Agreement between Takamol for Business Services, Government owned company under the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the Tertiary and Vocational Education Commission. Clearance of the Attorney General and the concurrence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs have been received for the draft Agreement. As such the proposal made by the Minister of Education to sign the relevant Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rebasing the National Consumer Price Index of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-06
decision_details_body:
- The National Consumer Price Index is a major determinant of the GDP deflator and a more comprehensive indicator in the overall inflation in the country and the index reference year 2013 was the first series of the National Consumer Price Index. In order to reflect the current consumption expenditure by Sri Lankan households, the weights and representative basket of goods and services have to be updated. Accordingly, the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies presented the following measures taken by the Department of Census and Statistics to the attention of the Cabinet and the Cabinet granted its concurrence for the same.

*	Updating the National Consumer Price Index which was Base 2013=100 as Base 2021=100.

* 	Compilation and publishing of the new National Consumer Price Index and the inflation rate at national level monthly with the time lag of 	21 days from the month of January 2023.

* 	weighting for the updated National Consumer Price Index based on the consumer expenditure of the year 2019.

* 	Preparation and publication of the inflation rate for the urban areas of the Colombo District by updating the Colombo Consumer Price Index for the new base 2021=100, covering the urban areas of the Colombo District from January 2023.

description: Report of the Committee to Review Project Offices and Project	Management Units
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-02-06
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the fact that a considerable cost is incurred for the Project Offices and Project Management Units established for various purposes and a significant number of staff has been recruited, the Hon. President during his Interim Budget Speech 2022, proposed that the activities related to such Offices and Units have to be reviewed. As such a Committee has been appointed under the Chairmanship of Mr. H.T. Kamal Pathmasiri, a former Ministry Secretary to review whether anticipated objectives of such Project Offices and Project Management Units have been accomplished and whether it is necessary to continue such entities and submit recommendations. The said Committee has recommended that it is appropriate to close down 55 Project Management Units presently in operation, to suspend further 32 Project Management Units and maintain 46 project management units with a minimum staff. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to implement the recommendations stated in the Committee Report, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Social Security Contribution Levy Act, No. 25 of 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-30
decision_details_body: - Social Security Contribution Levy (SSCL) is imposed under the Social Security Contribution Levy Act, No. 25 of 2022 at the rate of 2.5% on the liable turnover of taxable persons whose turnover exceeds Rs. 120 million per annum and exemptions from the said levy have been indicated under the First Schedule to the Act. Motor vehicles liable to Excise Duty under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act No. 13 of 1989 and the equipment used by differently-abled  persons have been exempted from the Social Security Contribution Levy by the Budget proposals for the year 2023. Further, few more amendments to be incorporated to the said Act have been identified at present. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to amend the said Bill and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Honours (2023) - Conferring the Sri Lankabhimanya Award to Hon. Deshabandu Karu Jayasuriya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-30
decision_details_body: - It has been a tradition since 1986 to confer a once-in-a-lifetime national award to Sri lankan citizens and non-Sri lankans who have rendered exceptionally outstanding and distinguished service to the nation in the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the “Sri Lankabhimanya” Award is the highest award conferred in this country. As such, the Cabinet concurred with the action taken by the Hon. President to confer the  “Sri Lankabhimanya” award to Deshabandu Karu Jayasuriya on 3rd February 2023 in recognition of the service rendered by him.

description: Introducing Provisions to Manage and Dispose Court Productions	through a Parliament Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-30
decision_details_body: - Due to the lack of legal provisions on management and disposal of court productions, certain materials that need to be disposed of quickly have to be retained causing economic loss and also issues have arisen due to becoming such items unusable. Therefore, a committee has been appointed to recommend a new policy and legal framework including relevant legal provisions and procedures to dispose the court productions before the end of trial. Based on the recommendations of the said committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to enact an Act to manage and dispose of Court Productions and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill for that purpose, was granted approval by the Cabinet.

description: Accession to the Protocol to amend the Convention on Offenses and	Certain Other Acts Committed on Board Aircraft (Montreal Protocol	2014)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-30
decision_details_body: - The Proposals made by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to accede to the Protocol on ''Amend the Convention on Offenses and Certain Other Acts Committed on Board Aircraft'' (Montreal Protocol-2014) and to take necessary actions to enact legislation for implementation of the provisions of the said Protocol in Sri Lanka, was granted approval by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations for Approval of Parliament issued under the	Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-30
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit following regulations issued under Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.01 of 1969 to be presented at the Parliament, was granted approval by the Cabinet:

    • Special Import License Regulations No.01 of 2023, published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.2312/77 dated 2023-01-01.
      
    • Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations, No.02 of 2023, published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.2312/78 dated 2023-01-01.

description: Establishment of an Energy Storage System in Hambantota district to	store electricity to ensure uninterrupted power supply in case of	emergency and  in the peak time
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-30
decision_details_body: - Under the Framework Agreement on Grant Aid signed between the Republic of Korea and the Government of Sri Lanka,  Republic of Korea has agreed to provide 14.3 billion Korean won (approximately US$ 11.9 million) grant to establish 5MW capacity and 8 MWh Energy Storage System in Hambantota Grid Substation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to sign the Record of Discussion between respective parties to commence and implement the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: BIMSTEC Charter and Memorandum of Association for the Establishment of the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) Technology Transfer Facility
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-30
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has signed the BIMSTEC Charter and Memorandum of Association for the Establishment of the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi‑Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) Technology Transfer Facility on 2022‑03‑30. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to ratify the aforesaid agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into an Agreement for the Provision of Research Services between the Industrial Technology Institute and the University of Sydney, 	Australia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-30
decision_details_body: - The International Food Policy Research Institute located at Washington DC of the United States of America together with the University of Sydney, Australia have entered into an agreement with the Consortium of International Agricultural Research Centres System Organization to conduct research on the Fruits and Vegetables for Sustainable Healthy Diets Initiative in collaboration with Benin, Philippines and Tanzania and Sri Lanka. Under the said research programme, the Industrial Technology Institute has been selected  by the University of Sydney to conduct several research services on the current status of post harvest management and food safety in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to sign for a Sub‑Contract Agreement between the Industrial Technology Institute and the University of Sydney, Australia in order to secure funds amounting to AUD 11,250, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquisition of a land for the construction of District/ Magistrate's Court 	Complex, Pelmadulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-30
decision_details_body: - The Court in Pelmadulla has been functioning as a Magistrate Court as well as a District Court and currently 8,385 cases are pending before this court. Since, the court house does not have sufficient space, the general public, attorneys-at-law and the court staff have encountered  severe inconveniences. As such, the need to construct a new courts complex equipped with required facilities has been emerged.  It has been found appropriate to have allocated a plot of land of 3 acres from the land called Pelmadulla estate which is governed under the Land Reform Commission, for the purpose. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to get transferred the said land to the Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resolving issues pertaining to the forests coming under the purview of the	Department of Forest Conservation and the Department of Wildlife	Conservation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-23
decision_details_body: - Issues of people who have been living for a long period in the forests coming under the purview of the Department of Forest Conservation and the 	Department of Wildlife Conservation or those who are engaged in 	agricultural activities in such forests have been discussed for many years, but permanent solutions have not yet been given in that regard. A programme has been prepared with due time frame as per the instructions of the Hon. President with a view to providing expeditious solutions for the said 	issues. Such issues generally affect almost all districts in Sri Lanka and as the initial phase, it is expected to implement the said programme in the heavily 	forested and 	war-torn districts such as Jaffna, Vavuniya, Mullaitivu, Kilinochchi, Mannar, Trincomalee, Batticaloa, Ampara, Anuradapura, Polonnaruwa and Moneragala. Accordingly, the Cabinet concurred with the said programme presented by the Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation.

description: Convention between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Tax Evasion in respect of Taxes on Income
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-23
decision_details_body: - It has been agreed at official level to the Convention between Sri Lanka and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Tax Evasion in respect of Taxes on Income. The Legal Draftsman has confirmed that the said Convention is in order as per the section 75(3) of the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017 and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has agreed to sign the relevant Convention. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to sign the aforesaid Convention at the government level and to submit the same to Parliament for approval in terms of the provisions of section 75(1) of the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introducing an Act for the administration and discharge of functions of the Office for the National Unity and Reconciliation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-23
decision_details_body: - The Office for National Unity & Reconciliation (ONUR) has been established with a view to providing each person with equal opportunities in the economic, social, cultural, and political sectors, safeguarding the identity, creating a society where diversity will be respected and celebrated and building a society in which all communities will co-exit in harmony and unity. In considering the powers vested with the said office, it has been identified that it would be appropriate to widen its operational activities as well as to establish the said office as a permanent office through an Act. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for Supply of 800,000 Prefilled Syringe of Enoxaparin Sodium 	Injection, 4,000 IU in 0.4 ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-23
decision_details_body: - Bids were invited from Indian manufacturers and suppliers through Limited International bids to purchase 800,000 Enoxaparin Sodium Injections to be used for treatment of patients with heart diseases. Accordingly, on the recommendations of PAB and SCAPC, the proposal directed by the Minister of Health to award the aforesaid procurement to M/s. Brawn Laboratories Ltd. was granted approval by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of En-Route Navigation Charges levied on International Flights	Overflying Colombo Flight Information Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-23
decision_details_body: - Collection of En-route Navigation charges on International Flights Overflying Colombo Flight Information Region comes under the purview of Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) Limited and the charges have not been revised since year 1985. Therefore, the proposal directed by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to revise the charges for Overflying aircraft for the use of Air Navigation Services from 2023‑02‑01 with immediate effect, was granted approval by the Cabinet.

description: Proclaiming a Day on Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime	and Witnesses
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-23
decision_details_body: - Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crimes and Witnesses Act, No.4 of 2015 has been introduced to create a proper mechanism to identify and promote rights and entitlements of victims and witnesses. Accordingly, National Authority for the Victims of Crime and Witnesses was established. Considering the number of persons particularly the women and children victimized as a result of rise in crimes in Sri Lanka, it has been identified that it is appropriate to proclaim a day on assistance to and protection of victims of crime and witnesses with the purpose of making the society aware of protection of victims of crime and witnesses as well as sensitizing Public Institutions and public officials. Accordingly, the proposal directed by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to proclaim 07th of March, the day on which Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crimes and Witnesses Act, No.4 of 2015 was enacted as the Day on Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crimes and Witnesses, was granted approval by the Cabinet.

description: South Asia Commercial and Logistics Hub Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-23
decision_details_body: - The Port of Colombo which is the largest Port in Sri Lanka, is also the main hub Port in the South Asian Region. Converting the Port of Colombo into a Logistics Hub is one of the basic strategic goals of the National Port Master Plan of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority. The service supply areas of Battenberg area and Bloemendhal area of the Colombo South Port have been identified to be developed under Public-private Partnership. As such a proposal made by the Colombo International Container Terminal (CICT) to implement the first phase of the proposed project with an investment of US $ 150 million, has been evaluated by a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee.  Accordingly, based on the recommendations made by the said Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to implement the proposed project as a public-private partnership project between China Merchant Port Company (CM Port), Colombo International Container Terminals (CICT) Company and the Sri Lanka Port Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of an e-License System for the Department of Imports	and Exports Control
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-23
decision_details_body: - Generally, the Department of Imports and Exports Control issues around 17,000 licenses in a year and that process functions with a minimal technical support and a very high intervention. It has been found the necessity of introducing information technology methodologies in order to implement the said license issuance process more efficiently and with a minimal human intervention. As such, it has been planned to enhance the transparency and efficiency of the said process by automating the aforementioned process with the participation of Regulatory Authorities relevant with the licensing process such as the Sri Lanka Customs, Department of Excise, Department of Motor Traffic as well as the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka, National Medicines Regulatory Authority and the Sri Lanka Standard Institute. For the purpose, the Bureau of the Export Control and Related Border Security Programme (EXBS) operated under the Embassy of the United States of America has extended its willingness to grant the STRATLINK information technology programme worth of US$ 280,000 with the complete source code to the Department of Imports and Exports Control as a donation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to implement the e-License programme of the Department of Imports and Exports Control, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief for low income families
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-16
decision_details_body: - Attention of the Government has been drawn on the speedy initiation of a new  Scheme to pay welfare benefits and a survey to identify beneficiaries using latest qualifications and criteria has now been commenced and is being implemented island-wide. Necessary provisions have been allocated through the Budget 2023 to provide financial concessions within the first four (4) months of the year 2023 to prevent any difficulties that may encountered by the vulnerable families in the face of economic crisis prevailing at present. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National policies to provide necessary provisions to extend the  financial relief proposed through the Budget 2023 for vulnerable families of the society including Samurdhi beneficiaries, by another period of 5 months from May to September, 2023 until the completion of the ongoing Survey and introducing of new proposed scheme for the payment of welfare benefits, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Freezing 6% of the Recurrent Provisions in the Government 	Expenditure Estimates approved for the year 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-16
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2023‑01‑09 decided to freeze 5% of recurrent provisions in the Government Expenditure Estimates approved for year 2023 enabling to control the Government expenditure within the limited fiscal space and to ensure adequate financial provisions  for essential and key functions. In order to implement this decision, the strategies expected to be taken by the General Treasury were submitted to the Cabinet by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance,Economic Stabilization and National policies.
