decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2021‑04‑19 to draft a Bill to establish a Bureau of Rehabilitation in order to carry out treatments, rehabilitation, aftercare and related duties connected thereto for drug dependents, ex-combatants, members of violent extremist groups and any other groups of persons. Accordingly, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revising the tasks assigned to the State Timber Corporation  Act according 	to the needs of the time
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - The State Timber Corporation has been established by the Gazette Notification dated 1968‑04‑04 under the provisions of the Government Industrial Corporation Act, No.49 of 1957. The need to amend the functions of the said Corporation to cater to the present day requirements has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation to amend the present scope of the State Timber Corporation, to cater to the present day requirements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Carriage by Air Act, No.29 of 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - International civil aviation limits of liability adopted under the Montreal Convention for the International Carriage by Air, was declared by the Gazette Notification dated 2021‑01‑22 and the high limits of liability stated therein, seem to have been appeared a hindrance for the development of the Aviation Industry of Sri Lanka. As such, a committee has been appointed to review the relevant limits of liability of the Carriage by Air Act, No.29 of 2018 so as to be able to consider exemption of the Aviation industry from such limits of liability. The said Committee has recommended that it would be appropriate to introduce amendments to the sections 2, 5 and 8 of the  Carriage by Air Act, No.29 of 2018. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to take necessary action to amend the relevant sections of the said Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding for Cooperation in the Field of 	Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding  between the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries Wealth and Water Resources of the Government of the Sultanate of Oman and the Ministry of Agriculture of Sri Lanka on Cooperation in the Field of Agriculture. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the proposed draft agreement for that purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to sign the relevant Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of the Annual Budget for the year 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - The fiscal imbalance caused by decline of Government revenue and escalation of public expenditure in the long run, has turned into a severe economic crisis at present. Amidsts the economic challenges related thereto, the budget for the year 2023 has to be prepared within the medium term budgetary framework, through a more prudent and strategic approach and measures have to be taken to prevent the present economic crisis from being worsened and lay the foundation for future sustainability. Accordingly, based on the Public Finance targets expected to be achieved within the medium term budgetary framework 2023-2025, it is envisaged by the Budget for the year 2023 to accomplish the task of escalating the Government revenue from present 9%  to 11.3% to reduce Government expenditure from present 18.9% to 18.1%, the Primary budget balance from  - 4% to -1% and the budget gap from -9.9% to -6.8% of the GDP. Further, it has been planned to prepare the budget estimates for the year 2023 on Zero-Based Budgeting method. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies pertaining to the preparation of budget estimates for the year 2023, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Information and Cyber Security Policy for Government Organizations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-22
decision_details_body: - Although, there is an increased tendancy for the Government Institutions to work on digital systems, the information and information technology systems of such organizations are at a severe risk, owing to the inadequate attention payed on information and cyber security, use of obsolete technologies and the shortage of skilled carder to manage cyber security in the Public Sector. In order to control the said situation, the Sri Lanka Computer Emergency Readiness Team has drafted the Information and Cyber Security Policy for Government Institutions, adhering to the Information and Cyber Security Strategy 2019-2023 and in compliance with the recognized international information security standards. It is compulsory to implement this policy by all Government institutions defined as “Public Authorities” in the Right to Information Act, No. 12 of 2016. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Technology, to implement the proposed Information and Cyber Security Policy  for the Government institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Eye Bank Trust of Sri lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-15
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2013‑08‑29 has granted approval to establish the  National Eye Bank Trust of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the National Eye Bank Trust of Sri Lanka Bill has been prepared by the Legal Draftsman and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to publish the said draft Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting a Bill to establish the Chartered Institute of Media Professionals - Sri Lanka - Sri lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-15
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑10‑05 has granted approval to establish  the “Sri Lanka Chartered Institute of Journalists” with a view to enhancing the professionalism of the journalists engaged in the field of mass media. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media to prepare a Bill by the Department of Legal Draftsman based on the draft prepared by the Steering Committee appointed by the Secretary to the Ministry of Mass Media pertaining to the establishment of the said institute and to revise the name of the proposed institution as “ Chartered Institute of Media Professionals - Sri Lanka” in place of  “Sri Lanka Chartered Institute of Journalists”, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Combined Issuance of stamps by the post authorities of Sri Lanka and India for the commemoration of the 75th Independence Day of India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-15
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to issue 2 commemoration stamps each by the Department of Posts in Sri Lanka and the Department of Posts of India depicting “Parliaments” of both countries based on the theme of “Democracy” in parallel with the commemoration of 75th Independence Day of India falling on 15th August 2022. Further, it is anticipated to exchange each of 3000 stamps, 5000 memorial cards and 2000 first day covers out of stamps issued by both countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between Departments of Posts between two countries for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a block of land belonging to the Department of Sri Lanka Railways to the Nawalapitiya Al-Safa Primary School
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-15
decision_details_body: - Nawalapitiya Al-Safa Primary School has been built in the year 2013 under the 1000 secondary school re-establishment programme and the building space required for that have been fulfilled by a warehouse belonging to the Nawalapitiya Railway Station. It has been identified the necessity of constructing permanent buildings since the space available in the said building is not adequate with the increase of number of students. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education and the Minister of Transport and Highways to legally allocate a block of land in extent of 02 acres located in Karahandungala in Godamuduna, Nawalapitiya belonging to the the Department of Sri Lanka Railways to the said school, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the	Fields of Science, Technology and Innovation between the Government of 	Sri Lanka and the Government of Nepal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-15
decision_details_body: - Although approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2021‑06‑21 for the then Ministry of Skills Development, Vocational Education, Research and Innovation to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the 	Fields of Science, Technology and Innovation between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Nepal, the said agreement has not yet been signed. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to sign the MoU as per the concurrence entered into by both parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of National Guidelines and Minimum Standards for Child 	Development Centres in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-15
decision_details_body: - Child development services operate island wide under the supervision of the Department of Probation and Child Care Services in order to ensure the protection, care and physical and mental well‑being of children who have become orphaned, helpless, abandoned, abused and faced legal problems. Although, Guidelines and Charters designed in relation to the child development centres are being operated in provincial level but national level accepted guidelines are not in operation. Accordingly, the “National Guidelines and Minimum Standards for Child Development Centres in Sri Lanka” submitted by the Hon. President in his capacity as Minister of Women, Child Affairs and Social Empowerment and designed under the supervision and guidance of experts in the relevant field representing all stakeholders related to the childcare sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of One Time Visa to the Tourists visiting Sri Lanka for a period of one year
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - In terms of the existing provisions, a tourist who visits Sri Lanka can be issued a Single Entry visa enabling him to be stayed in Sri Lanka for a period of 270 days from the date of his arrival to this country. Further, under the existing Visa Fee System, a tourist must pay an amount of US$ 685 in obtaining a visa to stay in this country for a period of one year. Taking those matters also into consideration, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Investment Promotion to take necessary action for the issuance of One Time Visa for tourists for a period of one year under Multiple Entry with the permission of Electronic Travel Authorization, subject to the maximum number of days that can stay in the country at one time is 90 days and for the purpose to charge an amount of US$ 200 for a period of one year as charged for Business and Resident Visas, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Petroleum Products (Special Provisions) Act, No 33 of 2002
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022‑04‑25 to amend the Petroleum Products (Special Provisions) Act No. 33 of 2002  so that more competitive parties can be granted licenses for the importation of petroleum, in order to ensure the continuous supply of  petroleum products due to the acute shortage of foreign exchange existing in the country. Accordingly, the relevant Bill has been drafted by the Legal Draftsman and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the same. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Activation of a Revised Price Formula for Domestic Type Liquefied Petroleum	Gas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to activate a cost depicted pricing formula immediately and to revise the price of domestic gas on the 5th day of every month based on that price formula, with the aim of ensuring continuous domestic gas supply.

description: Implementation of the Food Security and Livelihood Recovery Emergency Assistance Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - A project has been planned to implement by the name of “Food Security and Livelihood Recovery Emergency Assistance Project” anticipating to ensure the food security and livelihood of poor and vulnerable. Surplus funds available in several ongoing projects funded by the Asian Development Bank is expected to be re-purposed and utilized  for the said project. In addition, the Japan Fund for Prosperous and Resilient Asia and Pacific has extended its willingness to grant a US$ 3 million through the Asian Development Bank for the purpose of financing the project activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to conduct negotiations with the Asian Development Bank to secure funds for the project and to enter into relevant agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Cabinet Sub-Committee on Cost of Living and 	Establishment of the Food Security Committee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. President to establish the Cabinet Sub‑Committee on Cost of Living under the chairmanship of the Hon. President to recommend necessary policy and pragmatic solutions to the Cabinet of Ministers for maintaining the stability of the cost of living, whilst ensuring that food and other essential materials are supplied to the market without shortage in the face of the current economic situation in the country and to establish the Food Security Council to assist the said committee, under the chairmanship of the Minister of Trade, Commerce and Food Security.

description: Establishment of Cabinet Sub-Committees
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - It has been found appropriate to establish Cabinet  Sub‑Committees, enabling to devote more time at the Meetings of the Cabinet of Ministers to take policy decisions and to submit recommendations on Cabinet Memoranda forwarded in relation to the fields where decisions have to be taken after an in‑depth study pertaining to legal and other issues contained therein. Accordingly, Cabinet approved the proposals made by the Hon. President to establish the Cabinet Sub‑Committee on Public Expenditure Management under the chairmanship of the Hon. President to submit policy recommendations regarding public expenditure proposals such as commencement of new projects and procurement activities to the Cabinet and to establish the Cabinet Sub‑Committee on Establishment Matters under the chairmanship of the Hon. Prime Minister to submit policy recommendations to the Cabinet having studied on the proposals submitted  regarding the establishment matters such as appointments, promotions, transfers and disciplinary actions in the public service.

description: Amending the Shop and Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act No.19 of 1954
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - At present, a host of businesses such as Knowledge Process Outsourcing Institutions, Business  Process Outsourcing Institutions, Back Offices which handle accounts, administrative and technical activities of institutions located in other countries and Businesses Institutions enabling Information Communication Technology services have been established in major cities of the country. Owing to the nature of such businesses, the employees employed therein have to work according to the time of those countries. However, according to the  Shop and Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act No.19 of 1954, only limited number of employments are allowed for female employees to work after 6.00 pm. Under this backdrop, existing restrictive legal provisions regarding the employment of women at night have found to be amended. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment for taking necessary action to amend the  Shop and Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act No.19 of 1954, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Motor Traffic Act to make provisions for the registration of electric motor tricycles
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - Various parties have requested to provide opportunities to use  electric motor tricycles in Sri Lanka to popularize electric vehicles without the use of fossil fuel. Nevertheless, the Motor Traffic Act has to be amended, since no provisions are available in the said Act for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways to take necessary action to amend the Motor Traffic Act incorporating the relevant provisions so as to register the electric motor tricycles, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the published Gazette Notifications to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit a Gazette Notification including Regulations published under the Value Added tax Act, No. 14 of 2002, two Gazette Notifications including Notifications published under the Excise Ordinance (Chapter 52) and a Gazette Notification including an Regulation published under the Finance Act, No. 25 of 2003, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing provisions for the next Tranches of iROAD 1 and iROAD 2 projects implemented under the Asian Development Bank Financed Integrated Road Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - A total of 140 civil work contracts have been awarded for improving and maintaining around 6250 km rural roads and 750 km national roads under the iROAD 1 and iROAD 2 projects implemented under the Asian Development Bank Financed Integrated Road Investment Programme.  Around 4800 km of rural roads and 300 km of national roads have been completed at present. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways to conduct negotiations with the Asian Development Bank pertaining to obtaining US$ 243 for the stage 5 of the iROAD 1 programme and US$ 200 for the stage 4 of the iROAD 2 programme and take future action enabling to implement the activities of the said projects without any hindrance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding contract for the Aviation Insurance to Sri Lankan Airlines Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - Sri Lankan Airlines obtains insurance services under 04 categories for its aircraft. Limited National Competitive Bidding have been invited from general Insurance Companies which have registered  under Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka for the said four categories. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the relevant contract to the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Standing Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commencing the provision of Japanese Language Proficiency at the school level
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - Sri Lankans are eligible to apply for employment in 14 fields under the Specified Skilled Workers Programme as technical interns as per the Memorandum of Understanding signed between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Japan. Proficiency in Japan language is an essential qualification for that and the relevant qualifications should be obtained from the examinations conducted at several levels. It has been planned to recruit around 345,000 workers for the employment in Japan under the Specified Skilled Workers Programme during the next five years and the Japan has entered into agreements with 7 countries including Sri Lanka for this purpose. Taking into consideration the said matters, the proposal made by the Minister Labour and Foreign Employment to commence the teaching of Japan and English languages under the technical subject scheme implemented in Schools at present and to develop soft skills in the fields of nursing, hospitality, building cleaning, agricultural works motor mechanism or electrical or electronics aiming the employment in Japan,was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of blocks of land from the Infrastructure Developed Regional Industrial Estates to set up Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - ''Regional Industrial Estates Development Programme'' is implemented by the Ministry of Industries with a view to promoting industries at regional levels. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to allocate land blocks from 13 Industrial Zones for 25 investors selected under the said programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of Cost Reflective Tariff
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - It has been found necessary to make tariff revision in order to ensure the financial stability of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board and to provide  a continues and uninterrupted water supply to the public. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Water Supply to revise the current water and drainage tariff enabling to cover the recurrent operational cost and capital debt servicing liabilities of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding on Academic Cooperation between the International Centre for Higher Education Innovation and the Ministry of Education of the Government of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-08
decision_details_body: - The International Centre for Higher Education Innovation functioning under the auspices of UNESCO has agreed to provide online training to enhance the capacity of staff of the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Institutes of the Public sector. Under that, it has been agreed to provide a platform to access to the fields of Artificial Intelligence, Robots, Data Analysis, Machine Vision, Machine Learning, Digital Image processing and Digital Business. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the two parties to implement the said programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Kandyan Marriages and Divorce Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-01
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑10‑26 has granted approval to draft legislation to repeal the part II of the Kandyan Marriages and Divorce Act that requires parental consent for the marriage of a minor and remove the inconsistencies therein. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said draft Bill in the Government Gazette and present the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Legalization of the Constitution of the Sri Lanka National Commission for UNESCO (SLNCU)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-01
decision_details_body: - It has been identified the necessity of establishing the Sri Lanka National Commission for UNESCO legally by formalizing and strengthening the same with sufficient authority. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft prepared by the Legal Draftsman as per the approval granted by the Cabinet meeting held on 2021‑06‑14 to draft necessary legislation to establish the Sri lanka National Commission for UNESCO. As such the proposal made by the Minister of Education to publish the said draft Bill in the Government Gazette and present the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting incentives to Migrant employees for sending remittances through legal channels
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-01
decision_details_body: - A Committee has been appointed as per the Cabinet decision dated 2022‑06‑27 to examine matters pertaining to the concessions and incentives to be provided to increase the remittances granted by migrant employees as a remedy to the existing foreign exchange crisis in the country and submit recommendations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment to grant an allowance of additional duty concession when arriving the relevant migrant employees to the country based on the foreign exchange remitted to the country through legal channels and facilitate them to buy a electric vehicle, as per the recommendations submitted through the above Official's Committee Report, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting Tariff Concessions on the importation of necessary accessories for 	local textile production
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-01
decision_details_body: - Despite the Covid-19 pandemic situation, Textile Industry has become one of the leading foreign exchange earning sectors in Sri Lanka. However, due to the rise in the price of raw materials and the adverse economic condition existing in the country, local garment manufacturers have to face many challenges in importing  accessories required for garment production, which are not produced locally. As a remedy, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to provide tariff concessions for accessories/items which are not locally produced, under 19 HS code numbers, was approved by the Cabinet approved.

description: Expenditure Management of Public Corporations, Statutory Boards and Government Owned Companies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-01
decision_details_body: - The operational efficiency and the financial discipline of the Government Owned Enterprises have to be strictly ensured enabling to cope with the challenging  environment prevailed in the country. Accordingly, approval of the Cabinet was granted for the proposal made by H.E the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, to issue circular instructions to ensure expenditure management and business stability of the Public Corporations, Statutory Boards and Government Owned Companies in parallel with the National Budget Circular No.03/2022 dated 2022‑04‑26 issued pertaining to the public expenditure management.

description: Encouraging Agriculture and Farming
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-08-01
decision_details_body: - Owing to the fact that the existing scarcity of fuel has resulted in causing a problem for the public servants to secure their transport facilities and also as a remedy for the forthcoming food crisis, approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022‑06‑13 to close down the Government Offices on Fridays for the purpose of facilitating the government officers to engage in agricultural activities. As per the said instructions, Public Administration Circular No.15/2022 dated 2022‑06‑15 has been issued to be valid for a period of 03 months. However, considering the fact that the public transportation is being restored and a sufficient period of time was granted for the initial agricultural activities, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government to cancel the said circular with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Writing off the non-performing loans obtained by paddy farmers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - The economic crisis which was mainly caused by the Easter Sunday attack and the subsequent COVID - 19 pandemic situation is further worsening and severely affecting every sector directly and indirectly. Even the farmer community which is approximately 30% out of the total population has been enable to deal with it and  they had to face more hardships due to the decision of moving to organic fertilizer instead of chemical fertilizer. Under the circumstance, farmers have been unable to settle the loans obtained by them for paddy cultivation and those loans have been classified as non-performing loans by banks. It has become essential to provide relief to farmers with the intervention of the Government since the most of farmers could be disqualified to obtain loans for paddy cultivation in the next Maha season due to that reason. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to write off principal amount of loans obtained from the Government banks for paddy cultivation in the blocks of land in extent of two hectares or less and has become difficult to repay as of now, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Appropriation (Amendment) Bill 2022 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - Owing to the depreciation of exchange rate, rise of inflation and as well as the shortage of essential commodities such as fuel, gas and electricity, people's life has become very uncomfortable severely affecting the sustenance of the normal livelihood of people and the maintenance of normal livelihoods as well as the sectors of agriculture, transportation, industries and export. Under this circumstance, approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022‑06‑06 to present a new budget for the year 2022. Further, Cabinet approval has also been granted to implement tax reforms with a view to increasing revenue for economic stability. Accordingly, taking into account all the relevant facts, Cabinet granted its approval for the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to amend the budgetary estimates which were passed by the Appropriation Act No,30 of 2021, and publish the draft bill  prepared by the Legal Draftsman and cleared by the Attorney General, in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval.

description: Amending the High Court of Provinces (Special Provisions) Act, No 19 of 1990
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2021‑09‑27 to amend the section 5A of the High Court of Provinces (Special Provisions) Act, No.19 of 1990 by the insertion of the word “Small Claims Court”. Accordingly, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Judicature (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2021‑06‑14 to amend the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978 for the establishment of Small Claims Courts with a separate law, introducing a special procedure for those Courts. Accordingly, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Small Claims Courts' Procedure Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2021‑06‑14 to introduce a separate special procedure law for the Small Claims Court. Accordingly, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Civil Procedure Code (Chapter 101) (Revoking Chapter LXVI)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2021‑09‑27 to revoke Chapter LXVI of the Civil Procedure Code containing procedural provisions on Small Claims Courts, taking into account the drafting of a separate law introducing a special procedure for Small Claims Courts and the amendments added to the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978 for the establishment of Small Claims Courts. Accordingly, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No.2 of 1996
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - It has been recognized that the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act presently in force should be amended, enabling to give effect to Agreements to which Sri Lanka is bounded regionally and internationally and introducing provisions for the sustainable management and conservation of fisheries resources. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation to amend the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No.2 of 1996, so as to suit to the present day requirements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Streamlining the Casino Industry in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - The Casino Business (Regulation) Act, No.17 of 2010 and the the Betting and Gaming Levy Act, No.40 of 1988 have laid down the provisions to regulate  the Casino Industry in Sri Lanka. Even though, licenses should be issued for the operation of Casino industries in Sri Lanka under the Casino Business (Regulation) Act, No.17 of 2010, no licenses have been issued for any casino businesses under the said Act up to now, since regulations to enforce the provisions of the said Act have not been issued so far. Under this circumstance, it has been difficult to collect relevant taxes properly from the institutions currently engaged in casino business. Therefore, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to take necessary action to issue regulations under the Casino Business (Regulation) Act, No.17 of 2010 and introduce appropriate amendments to the Betting and Gaming Levy Act, No.40 of 1988, with a view to regulating the establishments engaged in the Casino business and collecting the due taxes to be received to the Government.

description: Agricultural Crop Cultivation Programmes launched by the Department 	of Prisons and the Bureau of the Commissioner General of 	Rehabilitation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body:
- The Department of Prisons has planned to implement a crop cultivation programme named “Sarusara - From Prisons to Farm”, with a view to deriving the labour contribution of the prison inmates for the agricultural development of the country, considering them as a part of nation's human resource, instead of retaining them in prison cells. It is envisaged from this programme to cultivate high yield crops in the open prison camps and working prison camps under the guidance of the Department of Agriculture and utilize the harvest so yielded for the consumption needs of the inmates.

In addition to that, Agricultural Development Programmes have been initiated under 03 rehabilitation centres which is maintained by the Bureau of Commissioner General of Rehabilitation to rehabilitate drug addicts and in order to expand further the said agricultural activities, it has been planned to obtain 1000 Acres of uncultivated lands situated at Kandakadu and Nawasenapura areas in the Eastern Province, which belong to the Mahaweli  Authority of Sri Lanka and the National Livestock Development Board and cultivate maize in an area of 500 acres and cultivate grains, vegetables and fruits endemic to the area in the remaining portion of land utilizing the labour of those who are being rehabilitated. Cabinet took into notice the information submitted by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional reforms on the said programmes.

description: International day to commemorate air crash victims and their families - Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - The Council of the International Civil Aviation Organization at its 5th meeting of the 224th Session has decided to declare 20th February of each year as the International day to commemorate air crash victims and their families. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to declare 20th February of each year in Sri Lanka also as the Day to commemorate air crash victims and their families, adhering to the above decision, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Flight Training Institute at the Batticaloa Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - Although the Sri Lanka Air Force and the Road Development Authority have developed the Batticaloa Airport as a domestic flight destination in the year 2018, the said Airport does not generate any income since it has been exempted from the landing and parking charges. Taking into consideration this situation, it has been found that it would be appropriate to use the space of the said Airport for any other productive purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to invite Requests for Proposals to establish a Flight Training Institute at that Airport, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Constituency Office under the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to facilitate the Board Director of Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - The Board of Directors of Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank consists of non‑resident Directors and they represent 12 Constituencies comprising one or more member countries. Sri Lanka as a founding member of the said Bank represents its 11th Constituency. Indonesia is the major shareholder of that constituency. Sri Lanka, Cambodia, Myanmar, Laos and Timor-Leste are the other  member countries. According to the Memorandum of Understanding signed among those Constituency members in the year 2016, the Director and the Alternate Director positions relating to that Constituency are exchanged according to a rotation scheme. Accordingly, Sri Lanka has got the opportunity to lead that constituency and hold the Director position during the period of 2022 - 2024 and a Deputy Secretary to the Treasury has been nominated for the same. It is more important for Sri Lanka to get that position in this instance and it is required to provide necessary facilities for the Board level tasks since that Board of Directors functions as a non-resident Board. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to establish a Constituency Office of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank under the Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resources Development Scholarship Prgramme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan has introduced the Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resources Development Scholarship Prgramme in the year 2010 to provide opportunities to the executive grade officers in the Public Sector to follow Postgraduate degree courses in the recognized Universities in Japan. 195 opportunities to follow Postgraduate degree courses and 10 opportunities to follow PhDs have been granted under the said programme so far. It has been agreed to provide a grant of Japan Yen 282 million (Approximately Rs. 761 million) for the year 2022 under this programme. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to sign the Exchange of Notes for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Treaty on Extradition between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the United Arab Emirates
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - The Treaty on Extradition has been signed in the year 2014 between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the United Arab Emirates with the intention of strengthening judicial corporation in the field of extradition.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to rectify the said Treaty on Extradition by re-amending the Provisions of section 5(1) of the said Treaty to suit with the legal system of both countries and to submit the same thereafter to Parliament as per the provisions of the Extradition Law No.8 of 1978, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing a Letter of Intent for Developing Defence Cooperation between the Ministry of Defence of the Republic of Indonesia and the Ministry of Defence of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - An inter-institutional cooperation has been proposed to be established to develop the Defence cooperation between the Ministry of Defence of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Defence of the Republic of Indonesia. The Government of Indonesia has proposed to sign a Letter of Intent to initiate negotiations between two countries for the said purpose and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Letter of Intent. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to sign the said Letter of Intent, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Alternative options to avoid the shortage of Ammonium Nitrate explosives used for various Industries in the country
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body: - The monopoly for import/storage and distribution of Ammonium Nitrate explosives used for Cement/Water gel/Emulsion manufacturing industries and granite blasting industries has been vested with Sri Lanka State Trading (General) Corporation Ltd. There is a shortage of Ammonium Nitrate explosives in the country due to the current foreign exchange deficit in the country and inability of suppliers who supplied the said explosives to  Sri Lanka State Trading (General) Corporation Ltd for a long period to supply the same. This has severely affected to the activities of industries using the said explosives. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to take necessary action expeditiously to import Ammonium Nitrate explosives to the country with the intervention of the Ministry of Defence for short period as a solution to the above issue, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-constitution of the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Cost of Living and the Appointment of the Food Security Committee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-07-04
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by H.E the President to re-establish the Cabinet Sub‑Committee on Cost of Living to make recommendations to the Cabinet on policy and practical solutions required for maintaining the stability of the cost of living, was approved by the Cabinet. Accordingly, the composition of the  Cabinet Sub-Committee on Cost of Living is as follows.

*	H.E the President - (Chairman)

* 	Hon. Prime Minister

*	Hon. Minister of Fisheries

*	Hon. Minister of Transport and Highways

*	Hon. Minister of Agriculture

*	Hon. Minister of Plantation Industries

*	Hon. Minister of Power and Energy

*	Hon. Minister of Trade, Commerce and Food Security

Further, the Cabinet also granted approval to appoint a Food Security Committee chaired by the Minister of Trade, Commerce and Food Security and with the participation of the relevant Ministry Secretaries to assist the activities of the above Cabinet Sub-Committee on Cost of Living.

description: Identification of new suppliers to ensure the continues supply of Jet A-1 Aviation fuel
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - Daily requirement of aviation fuel for aircraft in and outside Sri Lanka is approximately 1.2 million litres and under the current situation in the country, the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation has been unable to provide at least the minimum quantity of fuel required to sustain the operations of domestic and foreign airlines as well. Under this circumstance, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation and the Minister of Power and Energy to grant permission for the Bunkers registered under the Sri Lanka Ports Authority to import, supply and sell Jet A-1 aviation fuel in order to continue the airline services without any hindrance, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Obtaining fuel from the companies established in the petroleum producing countries based on long-term Agreements
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation contributes about 90% of the total fuel supply of the country and the Indian Oil Company supplies the rest of 10%. Due to the prevailing foreign exchange crisis in the country, ensuring an uninterrupted fuel supply in the country has become a major challenge. In this context, it has been observed that it would be appropriate to provide opportunities to the fuel companies established in the fuel producing countries to import and sell fuel with long term agreements with such companies, using the funds of those companies without any pressure to the foreign exchange issue in the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to provide the opportunity to the fuel companies selected using the formal procedure to import, distribute and sell fuel to Sri lanka with long-term Agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Twenty Second Amendment to the Constitution
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - The policy approval has been received at the Cabinet meeting held on 2022‑06‑20 for the preliminary draft on the Twenty Second Amendment to the Constitution. Accordingly, the Legal Draftsman has prepared the draft Bill on Twenty Second Amendment to the Constitution and the Attorney General has assured that the said draft Bill is not inconsistent with the Constitution. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the draft Bill on the Twenty Second Amendment to the Constitution in the Government Gazette and submit the same, thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Registration of Documents Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑07‑19 has granted approval to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislations to amend the Registration of Documents Ordinance for introducing new provisions to prevent irregularities and frauds in respect of lands. Accordingly, the draft prepared by the Legal Draftsman has been received the clearance of the Attorney General. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said draft Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same, thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Notaries Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑07‑19 has granted approval to amend the  Notaries Ordinance for introducing new provisions with a view to preventing unlawful activities pertaining to the land frauds. Accordingly, the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman based on the preliminary draft prepared by the Notarial Advisory Committee while obtaining the views of the Registrar General has been received the clearance of the Attorney General. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said draft Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same, thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a New Law on Contempt of Court
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - Due to the absence of a definition on the offense of contempt of court in Sri Lanka, there is no clear and uniform procedure for hearing and determining such cases at present. Therefore, it has been found difficult to understand limits of interference for the administration of justice and the limits under freedom of expression. Further, in considering the cases on contempt of court which have been severely criticized in the recent past, it has appeared that it is appropriate to reassess the relevant law. Accordingly, the Law Commission of Sri Lanka having studied the matters, has prepared a preliminary draft with a view to introducing appropriate laws. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a draft Bill to enact a new Law based on the preliminary draft, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Powers of Attorney Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑07‑19 has granted approval to introduce amendments to the Powers of Attorney Ordinance with a view to minimizing the fraudulent activities carried out using the forged and illegal powers of attorney. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said draft Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - Taking into account the necessity of making certain consequential amendments to the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance in line with the amendments recommended to be made to the Notaries Ordinance and the Wills Ordinance, the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑10‑18 decided to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a draft for that purpose. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney general has been received for the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to publish the said draft Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of new laws on Child Protection and Justice
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2015‑02‑18 to draft the Children (Judicial Protection) Bill so that Courts can be established to exercise jurisdiction and other forms of jurisdiction over children to hear cases relating to children in need of care and protection or to prosecute a child who violates the law. Accordingly, the preliminary draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman has been studied by two committees of experts and further proposals have been submitted. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare the final draft Bill incorporating the proposals of the said committees also in the preliminary draft Bill that has already been prepared, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Children and Young Persons Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - A person under the age of 18 has been defined as a child by the Convention on the Rights of the Child. Accordingly, approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2020‑09‑16 to amend the Children and Young Persons Ordinance, incorporating relevant provisions while adhering to the said convention. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman as per the said decision. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Eliminate the need for a Family Background Report for female migrant 	workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - Several international reports published on the protection of womens' rights have pointed out that making mandatory the submission of a 'Family Background Report' in view of ensuring that the children of female migrant workers who go abroad for domestic work are not less than 05 years of age, has adversely impacted on womens' rights. Also, it has been reported that women who are anticipating to go abroad are inconvenienced by certain officers, by delaying the reports on several grounds, in spite that women have duly qualified to be issued that report. It has further been reported that some women who are not qualified to submit the said report have gone abroad through other illegal ways without any supervision and faced various problems. Taking into consideration the matters submitted to the Cabinet by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment in this regard, the Cabinet decided to exempt women who have children of two (02) years of age or above from the compulsory requirement to submit a Family Background Report when going abroad for employment.

description: 'Ekwa Wawamu-Rata Dinawamu' - The Crop Production National Drive - 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - As an expedite solution to the crisis emerged in the country on food security, it has been planned to implement an accelerated food production drive island wide under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture in collaboration with the other ministries including the Ministry of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government and the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs. The entire programme is to be carried out under the coordination of the Ministry of Agriculture under the technical contribution of the Department of Agriculture and the Provincial Departments of Agriculture. Accordingly, Cabinet approved the joint proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government; the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to implement the said programme called 'Ekwa Wawamu-Rata Dinawamu'- The Crop Production National Drive utilizing the lands approximately in extent of 250,000 hectares belonging to Buddhist temples and places of worship, Christian churches, Mosques and Hindu Kovils.

description: Revision of Railway Transport Fares
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - The Department of Sri Lanka Railways adopts a concessionary fare scheme for passenger transport in line with the Government policies. However, with the rapid hike of fuel prices, the recurrent loss of the Department of Railways is escalating and therefore it has been essential to raise the income generated by the Department so that a satisfactory railway service could be maintained. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport and Highways to revise the railway passenger transport fare which has not been revised for more than five (05) years and the railway charges for providing wagons for freight transport, mail transport and other goods which have not been increased for nearly 14 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resumption of International Operations of Jaffna International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - Even though, the international operations of the Jaffna International Airport were commenced on 2019‑11‑11 after certifying the initial international regulatory requirements, its operations have been temporarily suspended from 2020‑03‑15 due to Covid-19 pandemic situation. Internationally and locally established airlines have requested at present to operate charter flights and scheduled flights to South Indian destinations from the Jaffna International Airport. Accordingly, Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence for the measures taken by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to resume the international operations of the Jaffna International Airport from 2022‑07‑01.

description: “A Democratic, Prosperous, and Resilient Sri Lanka Programme”
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-27
decision_details_body: - Two Agreements have been signed between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of the United States of America in 2011, to secure funds for  the programmes of “strengthened partnership for Democratic Governance and Social Cohesion” and “Sustained and Inclusive Economic Growth” and the said two programmes have been implemented accordingly. A proposal has been made to enter into a new agreement for securing a grant of US$ 57 million awarded by the United State Agency for International Development (USAID), in order to implement a new programme with the name of “Democratic, Prosperous, and Resilient Sri Lanka” to be effective until 2026, mainly focusing attention on the areas of effective democratic governance, inclusive, market driven growth and resilience of resources to shocks and stresses. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to conduct negotiations for securing the said grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 22nd Amendment to the Constitution
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-20
decision_details_body: - Requests have been made to reintroduce the constructive factors of the 19th Amendment to the Constitution in view of the sensational situation arisen in the country due to the powers vested with the Executive Presidential system by the 20th Amendment to the Constitution. Under this backdrop, taking into consideration the existing crisis situation the country is faced with, it has been identified that  the Constitution has to be amended by vesting a certain power in the Cabinet of Ministers which is collectively responsible to Parliament and the Public and the Constitutional Council thereby creating a certain balance of power on the Executive President and the Parliament. Accordingly, the preliminary draft submitted by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Mixed Development Project within the Anuradhapura 	Post Office Premises
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-20
decision_details_body: - The Urban Settlement Development Authority has planned to implement a mixed development project in the land in extent of 99 perches where the Anuradhapura post office is located. The Postal Department has extended its willingness to release the said land, subject to obtaining a new office premises for the said Department to suit to the present value of the land.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to acquire the said land to the Urban Settlement Development Authority as a free grant, in terms of the section 6(1) of the State Land Ordinance  and  implement the said project as a Public-Private Partnership project having selected a suitable investor by calling for Expression of Interest under national or international competitive bidding procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Installation of a Modern Surveillance System for the Securities and 	Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-20
decision_details_body: - The  existing Surveillance System used by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka was installed in the year 2008 and, the need has been found to modernize the said system so as to suit to the present day requirements. It is possible to secure funds required for the purpose under the World Bank funded Financial Sector Modernization Project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to call for a proposal as a direct procurement from the Millennium IT  Software (Pvt) Ltd., a member of the London Stock Exchange Group Technology, which installed the existing  Surveillance System and take necessary action to modernize the said system, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for obtaining security services to the National Savings Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-20
decision_details_body: - Bids have been called to obtain security services for the head office of the National Savings Bank and its branches  located island wide, following the National Competitive Bidding procedure. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to award the relevant contracts to the security services providing agencies qualified under each category, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revise the minimum age policy for Sri Lankan women for domestic and 	domestic related work abroad
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-20
decision_details_body: - The current minimum age limit for Sri Lankan women to engage in domestic and domestic related work abroad is 25 years for Saudi Arabia, 23 years for other Middle Eastern countries and 21 years for other countries.  The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑06‑06 decided to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee headed by the Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms to study on the revision of age limits, in view of a proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment, and submit the recommendations to the Cabinet. Accordingly, considering the recommendations made by the said Sub-Committee, Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence to revise the minimum age limit for Sri Lankan women to engage in domestic and domestic related work abroad is 21 years.

description: Approval of the National Environment Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-20
decision_details_body: - “The National Environmental Policy and Strategy” which was declared in the year 2003 by the then Ministry of Environment and Natural Resources, has been the existing key policy document that guided to take decisions on the environmental issues in Sri Lanka. During the previous years, several considerable changes which affected nationally and globally to the environment have emerged. Further, the economic, social and cultural factors which contribute to the climatic change and the scientific knowledge on environment have considerably changed. Taking those circumstances into consideration, the Ministry of Environment has taken measures to update the “The National Environmental Policy and Strategy” which was declared in the year 2003, so as to suit to the present day requirements, having obtained the consultations of the experts and stakeholders in the field of environment as well as the views of general public. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to implement the National Environment Policy formulated accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting a block of land in extent of 10 acre located at Muthurajawela to the Ceylon Electricity Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-20
decision_details_body: - The Director Board of the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation has granted approval to provide a block of land in extent of 10 acre located adjacent to the Yugadanavi Power Plant at Muthurajawela to the Ceylon Electricity Board for the construction of a 300MW LNG Power Plant and approval of the Director Board of the Ceylon Electricity Board  has also been received to purchase the said land block. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to transfer the said block of land to the Ceylon Electricity Board by levying the market value of the said land block estimated by the Chief Government Valuer, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Railway reservations on temporary basis for cultivation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-20
decision_details_body: - The total railway reservations belonging to the Sri Lanka Railway is approximately 14,000 acres in extent, out of which about 10% lands has been provided for various purposes on lease basis. It has been identified as suitable to provide the  lands which are not urgently required for the development activities of the  Department of Railways and those suitable for cultivation which are allotted as railway reserves in the vicinity of railway tracks and stations, from the rest of reserves for the use of cultivation on temporary lease basis. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport & Highways to take necessary action to provide those lands, on lease basis for a period of one year, giving priority to the farmers already engaged in the cultivation of the relevant areas and residents near by  railway tracks and low income families, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Export Oriented Sea Cucumber Production Villages in the Shallow Seas of the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-20
decision_details_body: - A significant amount of foreign exchange has been able to earn through the export of sea cucumber harvested from natural marine environment. Based on the experienced gained through that, the National Aquaculture Development Authority of Sri Lanka has initiated a commercial sea cucumber farming project with a view to building sea cucumber breeding centres, expanding sea cucumber farming areas, establishing export oriented sea cucumber production villagers as a commercial farming thereby increasing foreign exchange earnings and enhancing the livelihood of the fishing community. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries to establish sea cucumber production and export villagers consisting of 100 acres by identifying 5000 acres from Jaffna, Mannar, Kilinochchi and Batticaloa Districts and establish sea cucumber production farms with 1 acre each thereby further expanding the relevant project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Annual Report (Final Budget Position Report) of the  Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization & National Policies for the year 2021 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-20
decision_details_body: - Annual Report (Final Budget Position Report) of the  Ministry of Finance, Economic Stabilization & National Policies should be issued prior to the expiry of 05 months at the end of relevant Financial year in terms of the provisions of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 03 of 2003. Accordingly, the said Annual Report for the year 2021 has been published in the official website of the Ministry. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization & National Policies to table the said Report in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the “National Single Window Project” to facilitate international trade
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-20
decision_details_body: - The Trade Facilitation Agreement of the World Trade Organization is in operation since February, 2017 and Sri Lanka is also a party to the Agreement. According  to the said Trade Agreement, Sri lanka is obliged to initiate and maintain a single place (Single Window) to submit documents and data requirements by traders on their border trade flows (importation, exportation and transshipment) to the participatory border trade regulating authorities. A formal plan relating to the project has been developed in the year 2018 under the financial assistance of the World Bank. The estimated cost of this project to be implemented under three stages as per the said plan is approximately US$ 15 million and it is expected to secure the funds required for the purpose from the World bank and other development stakeholders. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization & National Policies to implement the proposed “National Single Window Project”, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Encouraging public officials to engage in Agricultural and Farming Activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-13
decision_details_body: - Public transportation has been disrupted due to the prevailing fuel shortage which has made it difficult for public officials to access their transport facilities. In this context, it seems appropriate to grant leave for public officials for one working day of the week and provide them with the necessary facilities to engage in agricultural activities in their home garden or elsewhere as a solution to food shortage which could arise in the near future. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government to close Public institutions on Fridays for the period of next three months other than those providing essential services such as Water, Electricity, Health, Defence Services, Education, Transport, Ports and Airport, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting No Pay Leaves to employ or to engage in any other Productive Economic Activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-13
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the existing provisions, a public officer is entitled to no pay leave for a maximum period of 05 years during their service period for academic and foreign employment. Nevertheless, Public servants are less interested in obtaining such leaves due to the non consideration of that period in the calculation of pension, impact caused to the seniority and other conditions. Taking into account the current economic situation in the country, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils and Local Government to issue the relevant Circular instructions revising the existing provisions, enabling the public officials to obtain no pay foreign leaves for a period of five (05) years without any prejudice to their seniority and pension to employ in abroad or to engage in any other productive activity, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conservation and Promotion of Angam Martial Art
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-13
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs has taken action to promote Angam Martial Arts which is significant as a traditional sport in the country, a Martial Art as well as a cultural heritage. Even though, approval of the Cabinet has been granted in the year 2019 to lift the ban imposed on the Angampora Martial Art, the relevant Gazette Notification has not yet been published. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs to publish the removal of ban imposed by the English Colonial rulers, through a Gazette Notification in view of conserving and protecting Angampora Martial Art, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Social Security Contribution Levy Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal for the introduction of a Social Security Fund through Budget Proposals - 2022 was passed by Parliament. Accordingly, it has been decided to introduce the Social Security Contribution Levy as a new Levy under a rate of 2.5% for Importers, Manufacturers, Service providers, Wholesalers and Retailers whose turnover exceeds Rs. 120 million per year. The draft prepared by the Legal Draftsman for the purpose has been received the clearance of the Attorney General. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to publish the said bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same, thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of a new Order under Section 22 of Foreign Exchange Act, No.22 of 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-13
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2021‑12‑06 for issuance of an Order under Section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017 to impose restrictions for a period of 06 months relating to certain capital transactions which outflow foreign exchange. The validity period of the Order imposed by the Gazette Notification issued accordingly is to be expired on 2022‑07‑01. The Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka has recommended that issuance of a new Order would be appropriate to further continue the restrictions imposed by such Order. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to issue a new Order under Section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017 and thereafter submit the said Order for approval in Parliament, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Submission of Orders published in the Gazette, for approval in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon.
