Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to submit two (02) Gazette Notifications containing Orders issued under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No.40 of 1979, six (06) Gazette Notifications issued under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 imposing Orders and a Gazette Notification issued under Revenue Protection Act, No.19 of 1962 imposing Revenue Protection Order No.02/2022, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Admission of School children into Grade One of Schools - 2023
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-13
decision_details_body: - Considering the matters submitted by the principals, the Circular Revision Committee, the Investigation Unit of the Ministry, the Commission to Investigate Bribery or Corruption and the Election Commission relating to the issues which have arisen during the implementation of the Circular issued previously for admission of school children into Grade One of schools and the Court Orders granted in that regard, the Ministry of Education has prepared a new revised circular. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to make applicable the provisions in the said revised circular for admission of school children into Grade One of schools, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Appropriation Act for the Year 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-06
decision_details_body: - The Government has decided to submit an amended Appropriation Bill to Parliament in lieu of the Appropriation Act No. 30 of 2021 due to the fact that expenses had to be borne for the other essential activities apart from the functions for which allocations had been made under Appropriation Act from the middle of the first quarter of 2022 in view of prevailing worst economic situation and that the structure of Ministries that existed at the time of passing the Appropriation Bill for the year 2022 has changed significantly at present. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a draft to amend the Appropriation Bill No. 30 of 2021, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining US$ 55 Million Credit Line from Indian EXIM Bank for the Procurement of Urea fertilizer
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-06
decision_details_body: - The Government of India is in agreement to provide US$ 55 Million Credit Line through Indian EXIM Bank for the procurement of Urea fertilizer required for Maha Season 2022/23. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to sign the relevant Agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding for the implementation of the Volunteer Cooperation Programme 2020 - 2027 with the World University Service of Canada
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-06
decision_details_body: - The World University Service of Canada implements a Volunteer Cooperation Programme to create opportunities for education, employment and empowerment for underprivileged youth and women worldwide. The said Programme has been implemented in Sri lanka for about 30 years and under an MoU signed between two parties, Programme has been implemented under the same during the period from the year 2015 to 2020 as well. The said Programme has not been implemented in Sri Lanka within last two years due to the travel restrictions imposed pertaining to the COVID-19 pandemic and it has been proposed to sign an MoU to re-implement the said Programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by  Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies to sign a Memorandum of Understanding to implement the relevant Programme through a Grant of CAD 2.76 million under 10 Government and Non-Government Organizations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Chemical and Organic Fertilizer required for the Paddy Cultivation of Maha Season 2022/23
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-06
decision_details_body: - It is expected to cultivate 800,000 hectares of paddy in the Maha Season 2022/23 and action needs to be taken to provide fertilizer for that purpose. It has been estimated that 150,000 MT of Urea, 45,000 MT of Muriate of Potash and 36,000 MT of Triple Super Phosphate are required for the paddy cultivation in Maha Season 2022/23. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to import the required stock of fertilizer through Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited and Colombo Commercial Fertilizers Limited and distribute to the same to farmers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the section 46 of the Industrial Disputes Act, No, 43 of 1950
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-06
decision_details_body: - Labour tribunals since the inception have granted opportunities to representatives of trade unions and representatives who are not attorneys at law to appear in labour tribunals, on an equal basis as lawyers, representing their parties. However, during the recent times, several issues have been emerged in the instances where representatives who are not attorneys-at-law appear in labour tribunals. In order to prevent the occurrence of such incidents, approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2017 02 21 to amend the Industrial Disputes Act, No.43 of 1950, so that a representative conferred by relevant parties could appear before the Commissioner of Labour or any authorized officer, arbitrator, industrial court or labour tribunal. Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending to the Rubber Control Act, No.11 of 1956 and the Rubber 	Replanting Subsidy Act, No.36 of 1953
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-06
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Public Administration Circular No.423, instructions have been given to the effect that necessary laws be amended to liquidate the dormant statutory funds. Accordingly, measures have been taken to liquidate the Rubber Control Fund established under the Rubber Control Act, No.11of 1956 and the Rubber Replanting Fund established under the Rubber Replanting Subsidy Act, No.36 of 1953. Since the provisions relating to the Rubber Control Fund and the Rubber Replanting Fund incorporated in the said two Acts are no longer required, it is necessary to amend those Acts. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation Industries to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation to amend the Rubber Control Act, No.11of 1956 and the Rubber Replanting Subsidy Act, No.36 of 1953, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation Act, No.06 of 1982
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-06-06
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2021 01 04 to amend the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation Act, No.06 of 1982, incorporating the provisions enabling to appoint a representative of the General Treasury and the Secretary, in charge of the subject or his representative to the Board of Directors of the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media to publish the said bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calculation of Gross Domestic Product (GDP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-30
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the matters such as ascertaining the real structure of the economy accurately, calculating the economic growth of the country more accurately and adhering to the new recommendations and methodologies imposed by the international agencies who are responsible for national Accounts Statistics, the Department of Census and Statistics update the base year of making National Accounts Estimates once in every five years. Accordingly, it has been decided to apply the year 2015 as the base year in lieu of 2010 which is currently being used in preparation of National Accounts. The Department of Census and Statistics has prepared Quarterly and Annual National Accounts Estimates from the year 2015 to 2021 utilizing the year 2015 as the base year. Accordingly, the Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence to the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization & National Policies to publish the said Reports and to issue National Accounts Estimates from the first quarter 2022 onwards under the new base year of 2015.

description: Revenue Mobilization for Economic Stabilization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-30
decision_details_body:
- The decision made by the Government to reduce tax rates of Value Added Tax, Personnel Income Tax and Corporate Income Tax by introducing a low tax regime in late 2019 and to narrow tax bases of Value Added Tax and Personnel Income Tax has resulted in a significant loss in the Government revenue. Further, the said decision has led to an increase in the budget deficit and public debt as a percentage of the Gross Domestic Product. Under the circumstance, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization & National Policies to instruct the Legal Draftsman to amend the following Acts with a view to increasing the Government revenue, was approved by the Cabinet.

    • Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017
    • Value Added Tax Act, No. 14 of 2022
    • Telecommunication Levy Act, No. 21 of 2011
    • Betting and Gaming Levy Act, No. 40 of 1988
    • Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 3 of 2003

description: Submission of a Supplementary Estimate to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-30
decision_details_body: - 	At the beginning of the year 2022, the Government introduced a relief package for Samurdhi beneficiaries, Estate community, Pensioners and Public Servants to minimize as far as possible, the hardships faced by the people due to the adverse economic condition in the country. It has been decided to submit a Supplementary Estimate to Parliament to secure funds required to incur the expenditure for the same and to continue the essential public services without hindrance. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization & National Policies to submit a Supplementary Estimate to Parliament to secure an allocation of Rs 695 billion under the “ Supplementary Support Services and Contingent Liabilities Project of the Department of National Budget, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969 in Parliament for Approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-30
decision_details_body: - The Central Bank of Sri lanka has proposed to introduce limitations on selected certain payment terms with a view to curbing the expansion of grey foreign exchange market operations and avoiding under -invoicing of importation at the point of Customs clearance. Accordingly, the Gazette Notification dated 2022‑05‑06 has been issued imposing 'Import Control Regulations on Payment Terms No. 07 of 2022' under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act No. 1 of 1969 enabling to limit the Open Account Payment terms, Consignment Account Payment terms, Documents against payment term and Documents against Acceptance payment term. Such regulation promulgated under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act shall be submitted for approval of Parliament with the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers within one month from the date of its publication. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization & National Policies to submit the Import Control Regulations on Payment Terms No. 07 of 2022, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Termination of Employment of workmen (Special Provisions) Act, No.45 of 1971 and The Industrial Disputes Act, No.43 of 1950
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-30
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2021‑03‑08 to amend the Termination of Employment of workmen (Special Provisions) Act, No.45 of 1971 and The Industrial Disputes Act, No.43 of 1950 so that relevant provisions could be imposed to the effect that a security could be furnished in case where appeals, revisions and writ applications can be filled against the awards and decrees granted under those Acts. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the bills drafted by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment to publish the said bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter submit the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making Payments to the Suppliers who have submitted bids for the supply of Laboratory Equipments, consumables and reagents
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-30
decision_details_body: - Taking into account the sudden increase in the exchange rates due to the prevailing economic situation in the country, approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022‑04‑25 to make payments as per the exchange rates prevailing to the date of clearance of pharmaceuticals and surgical instruments for which Letters of Credit have already been opened. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved proposal made by the Minister of Health to make payments also for the suppliers who have opened Letters of credit for the import of laboratory equipment, consumables and reagents, following the said system and to make payments for the other relevant suppliers including the procurement of which quotations have been invited and for which bids have been opened by the State Pharmaceutical Corporation, based on the foreign exchange rate prevailing to the date on which relevant payments are made to the Letters of credit.

description: Deployment of Dry - Bulk Carrier Ships of the Ceylon Shipping Corporation during South – West Monsoon Period in 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-30
decision_details_body: - Expression of Interest (EOI) has been called for the deployment of the two vessels; Mv. Ceylon Breeze and Mv. Ceylon Princess belonging to the Ceylon Shipping Corporation in the service of the international charter market during the South-West Monsoon Period in 2022. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation to award the contract for the deployment of the said two vessels in service during the prescribed period under the Commercial Management System, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee to M/s Wallem Shipping Pte Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Global Fund – Framework Agreement for the period 2022-2024
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-30
decision_details_body: - The “Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria” has been established in the year 2002 in order to combat against 3 infectious diseases namely AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria. Since 2003, the said Global Fund has entered into 24 agreements for securing an amount of US $ 114 million to Sri Lanka. Of the said, the Ministry of Health has signed 15 Agreements where as other Agreements have been signed by the Sri Lanka Jathika Sarvodaya Sangamaya, the Tropical and environmental Diseases and Health Associates and the Sri Lanka Family Planning Association. The Ministry of Health has entered into Agreements to obtain grants amounting to US $ 88.3 million. Of such grant, around US $ 71 million has already been disbursed by 2021‑10‑31. The Global Fund has extended its willingness to make an another grant of US$ 9.4 million for the period from 2022-2024. Accordingly, the Minister of Health informed the Cabinet on the measures already taken with regard to the entering into the Agreements to secure that grant and the Cabinet granted its concurrence for the same.

description: Nomination of Cabinet Spokesmen
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-23
decision_details_body:
It was decided to appoint the following Members of the Cabinet to function as Co-Cabinet Spokesmen.
	
	*	Hon. (Dr.) Bandula Gunawardena
		Minister of Transport and Highways
		Minister of Mass Media

	*	Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera
		Minister of Agriculture
			Minister of Wildlife & Forest Resources Conservation

	*	Hon. Kanchana Wijesekera
		Minister of Power and Energy

	*	Hon. Manusha Nanayakkara
		Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment

description: Procurement of Services of an International Financial Advisor and International Legal Advisor for External Debt Restructuring of Government of Sri lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-23
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has previously been granted to procure the Services of an International Financial Advisor and an International Legal Advisor for External Debt Restructuring of the Government of Sri Lanka. 28 proposals to obtain the service of a Financial Advisor and 23 proposals to obtain the service of an international Legal Advisor have been received as per the Request for Proposals made to that effect. Accordingly, the proposals made by H.E. the President to award the relevant procurement as mentioned below based on the recommendations of the Cabinet Appointed Steering Committees appointed pertaining to the relevant procurement, was approved by the Cabinet.

•	to award the procurement for the Service of an International Financial Advisor to M/s Lazard, France.

•	to award the procurement for the Service of an International Legal Advisor to M/s Clifford Chance LLP.

description: Extension of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on the Sending and Receiving of Workers to the Republic of Korea under the Employment Permit System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-23
decision_details_body: - Both countries have signed a Memorandum of Understanding on the Sending and Receiving of Workers to the Republic of Korea under the Employment Permit System. Sri Lankans receive job opportunities in South Korea for a period of 4 years and 10 months as per the said agreement,  and  it is possible to extend that duration further, depending on their performance. The said MoU should be biannually renewed and accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour and Foreign Employment to sign a new MoU for a further period of 2 years under the same terms and conditions of the previously signed MoU or for a period of time agreed by the Republic of Korea, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a Fuel Price Mechanism to decide the selling price of the petroleum products
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-23
decision_details_body: - It has been identified the necessity of having a mechanism to determine the selling price of petroleum based on a scientific methodology which is transparent and reflects all the cost components in order to decide the local selling prices of petroleum products. Such a mechanism would create a positive impact on building up the customer confidence as well as on recovering from the financial difficulties encountered by the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation. Accordingly, approval of the Cabinet was granted for the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to appoint a committee headed by the Ministry of Power and Energy and comprising of the representatives of the other relevant institutions  to submit appropriate recommendations enabling the prices of the petroleum products be  determined monthly giving due attention to six(06) major cost components and to revise petroleum prices monthly based on the mechanism formulated on the said recommendations.

description: Obtaining a Short Term Credit Line under the assistance of the Indian Export-Import Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-23
decision_details_body: - Actions have already been taken to obtain a short term credit facility of US$ 500 million with the assistance of the Export-Import Bank of the India and a credit facility of US$ 200 million under the assistance of the State Bank of India for the purchase of petroleum products that the country needs under the prevailing economic condition in the country. The proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to obtain another short term line of credit of US$ 500 million with the assistance of the Export-Import Bank of India, to purchase petroleum products, by covering the existing foreign exchange deficit, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Report of the Committee of Experts appointed to draft a new Constitution
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-02
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2020 09 09 has decided to appoint a Committee chaired by Mr. Romesh De Silva, President's Counsel, comprising of legal experts to draft a new Constitution. Accordingly, preliminary Report of the said Committee has been handed over to H.E the President on 2022 04 25. As such, the Cabinet has decided to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee comprising of the following Ministers to study the matters containing in the said Report and submit appropriate recommendations to the Cabinet.

*	Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris
	Minister of Foreign Affairs - (Chairman)

*	Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena
	Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs,
	Provincial Councils and Local Government

*	Hon. Douglas Devananda
	Minister of Fisheries

*	Hon. (Dr.) Ramesh Pathirana
	Minister of Education and Minister of Plantation

*	Hon. Ali Sabry
	Minister of Finance and Minister of Justice

description: Identifying Rapid Investment Opportunities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-02
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet decided to appoint a Committee comprising of the following Ministers to identify investment opportunities that could attract foreign investments expeditiously as a solution to the prevailing foreign exchange crisis in the country.

*	Hon. 	(Dr.) Nalaka Godahewa
Minister of Mass Media - (Chairman)

*	Hon. 	Dilum Amunugama
	Minister of Transport and Minister of Industries

*	Hon. 	Kanchana Wijesekera
	Minister of Energy and Minister of Power

*	Hon.	Pramitha Bandara Thennakoon
	Minister of Ports & Shipping

*	Hon. Lohan Rathwatthe
	State Minister of Urban Development

description: Appointment of the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Cost of Living
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-02
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet decided to appoint the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Cost of Living chaired by H.E the President with the participation of the Hon. Prime Minister and other relevant Ministers and State Ministers in view of providing policy and practical solutions required to maintain the cost of living stable.

description: Contract Awarding for the purchase of Refined Petroleum Products
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-02
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited for 04 Procurements to purchase Petrol and Gas Oil under Short Term Indian Credit Line of US$ 200 million received with the assistance of Export-Import Bank of India. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy pertaining to awarding the said procurements to the M/s Indian Oil Corporation Ltd. as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief to the low income families affected due to the economic crisis prevailing in the country
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-02
decision_details_body: - Since the low income families receiving Samurdhi, elder, kidney and disable allowances have been severely affected due to the prevailing economic crisis in the country, the Government has identified the necessity of providing concessions expeditiously for such families and those who are in waiting lists to receive such allowances. Concurrence has been granted to provide necessary provisions for the same through the Contingent Emergency Response Components of Projects implemented under the World Bank funds. Accordingly, the proposals made by the Minister of Finance and the Minister of Samurdhi Development to take necessary action to pay a special cash allowance in order to provide the relevant concessions for the identified beneficiary families from May to July, were approved by the Cabinet.

description: Gazette Notification published under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-02
decision_details_body: - A set of new HS National Sub Divisions have been created to facilitate the international compliance related goods, taking into consideration the proposals presented by various institutions. The HS Codes so created have been published in the Government Gazette dated 2022 01 11 as per the provisions of the Revenue Protection Act, No.19 of 1962. Thereafter, the said HS National Sub Divisions have been promulgated as an Order by the Minister of Trade, under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act No.40 of 1979 with the concurrence of the Minister of Finance. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade to present the said Order published in the Government Gazette dated 2022 01 11, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Annual Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2021 in Parliament, for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-02
decision_details_body: - The Annual Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2021 has been submitted to the Minister of Finance on 2022 04 29 by the Monetary Board of the said Bank. If the Parliament sessions are held, in terms of the provisions of the Monetary Law Act, the said annual report should be laid before Parliament by the Minister of Finance within 14 days on receipt of the said report. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to present the Annual Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, in Parliament for approval for the year 2021, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Law, No.2 of 1974
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-02
decision_details_body: - The need to amend the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Law No. 2 of 1974 has been identified so as to address the present and future challenges in the field of water supply.  Accordingly, approval of the Cabinet was granted at its meeting held on 2021 07 12 to appoint a committee headed by the Secretary, Ministry of Water Supply to prepare a preliminary draft for the purpose. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Water Supply to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation, based on the preliminary draft prepared by the said committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations issued under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969 for approval in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-02
decision_details_body: - Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.06 of 2022 have been promulgated and published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2274/42 dated 2022 04 09, under Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No.1 of 1969, with effect from 2022 03 10 in order to restrict the import of selected non-essential and non-urgent goods. The proposal made by the Minister of Finance to submit the said Regulations for approval in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Creation of a Digital Channel for departing passengers in Terminal - 1 of the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA), Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-02
decision_details_body: - Airport & Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Limited (AASL) has planned to implement several multi-dimensional improvements to enhance the efficiency of the operations of the Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake. Accordingly, a proposal has been made to implement a pilot project for introduction of a digital channel for the passengers departing from Terminal-1, based on the concept “IATA One ID” of the International Air Transport Association. As such, by installing e-gates/Face pods at the entrance to the departure terminal and verifying that they are with possession of a valid e-ticket to confirm their identity, it will be convenient to complete the check-in process of the passengers. Therefore, the Cabinet decided to grant its approval to implement a pilot project for the purpose as proposed by the Minister of Tourism.

description: Declaration of the Tusker “Nadungamuwa Raja” as a National Treasure
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-05-02
decision_details_body: - The Tusker “Nadungamuwa Raja” that paid its contribution in carrying the Sacred Relic Casket of the Temple of sacred Tooth Relic for 13 times since 2005 to 2021 and participated in the processions of several leading Buddhist temples in the country, passed away on 7th March 2022. At the moment, measures are being taken to preserve the body of this tusker. Taking into consideration the contribution it had rendered for the cultural festivals in the country, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to declare “Nadungamuwa Raja” as a national treasure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making the general public aware on the actual circumstances related to the ongoing political, economic and social crisis situation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-04-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media to implement a programme by the Department of Government Information together with the participation of the relevant Ministries in order to make aware the general public on the actual situation of the political, economical and social crisis emerged in the country at present, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending of the Petroleum Products (Special Provisions) Act, No.33 of 2002
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-04-25
decision_details_body: - Since fuel is essential for all the economic activities of the country, it has been found appropriate to issue licenses to selected special industries to import fuel required for their businesses individually. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation to amend the Petroleum Products (Special Provisions) Act No.33 of 2002, so that parties formally identified could be granted licenses to import petroleum, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of Visa Period Free of Charge for the Russian and Ukrainian Tourists Stranding in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-04-25
decision_details_body: - Approval of the cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2022‑02‑28 for the extension of visa of Russian and Ukrainian Tourists stranding in Sri Lanka for a period of two (02) months free of charge, due to the crisis situation emerged between Russia and Ukraine. Since the ongoing crisis between the two countries has not reconciled yet, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism to extend the visa period of both Russian and Ukrainian tourists enabling them to further stay in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introducing amendments to the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No.20 of 2009
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-04-25
decision_details_body: - Clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman to amend the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No.20 of 2009 as amended by the Sri Lanka Electricity (Amendment) Act, No.31 of 2013. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting the Twenty First Amendment to the Constitution based on the Nineteenth and Twentieth Amendments to the Constitution
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-04-25
decision_details_body:
- Several parties representing different strata of politics, profession and society have emphasized that it would be appropriate to introduce proper amendments to the Constitution in view of establishing political, economic and social stability to find solutions for the current economic crisis that has emerged within the prevailing atmosphere in the country. The Cabinet, having taken into consideration this situation, reached the following decisions as per a proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister: 

*	to appoint a Cabinet Sub‑Committee to provide necessary guidance to the Legal Draftsman to prepare a preliminary draft Bill expeditiously, based on the constructive matters      in the Nineteenth and Twentieth Amendments to the Constitution to introduce the Twenty First Amendment, conferring more powers to Parliament while further strengthening democracy.

*	to authorize the Hon. Prime Minister to move a resolution in Parliament to appoint a Parliamentary Select Committee to discuss the Preliminary draft Bill to be prepared as above and the proposals on Amendments to the Constitution that have already been submitted to Parliament and prepare a draft on a reached consensus.

description: Establishment of a mechanism to appraise financial proposals related to foreign exchange and energy supply presented by various parties
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-04-25
decision_details_body: - Various friendly countries, international suppliers and local private sector offer various types of bilateral concessional loans, proposals pertaining to the energy supply and the energy sectors as remedies for the foreign exchange crisis prevailing in the country. Although, it was observed that certain proposals so submitted are effective to overcome the foreign exchange crisis experienced by country at present, there is no room in the existing procedures in order to approach further action on such proposals. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to appoint a Committee chaired by the Secretary to the Prime Minister and with participation of four (04) Ministry Secretaries to analyze those proposals considering the timely importance of the same and submit recommendations on action be taken, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding Research Grants from the Eurasia Foundation in Japan to 	General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-04-25
decision_details_body: - Measures have been taken by the  Eurasia Foundation in Japan to provide a Grant of US$ 42,000 as a Research grant to General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University for the conducting a course under the title of 'Cultural Linkages towards an Asian Ideology'. As such, the proposal made by H.E the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to recruit 200 students under the said Grant and conduct the relevant Course, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of Long Term Residence Visa for Foreign Investors
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-04-25
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑03‑07 has granted approval to introduce a new methodology for the issuance of long term Residence Visa in lieu of the previously implemented methodology. Accordingly, the proposals pertaining to the issuance of long term Residence Visa under the said methodology submitted by H.E the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence as follows, were approved by the Cabinet.

*	Issuance of long term Residence Visa for 5 to 10 years for foreigners and Directors of Foreign Companies together with their spouses and dependents, who invest at least US$ 75,000 or more in Condominium property, depending on the amount of US dollars so invested.

*	Implementing a programme called “Golden Paradise Visa Programme” enabling to issue Visa for expatriates for a period of 10 years who deposit at least US$ 100,000 in a Commercial Bank recognized by the Central Bank of Sri lanka.

description: Submission of the 2021 Article IV Report of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-28
decision_details_body: - The 2021 Article IV Report of the International Monetary Fund pertaining to Sri Lanka  has been published on 2022‑03‑25. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to submit the said Report in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations imposed under the provisions of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017 to facilitate investments in the Colombo Port City in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-28
decision_details_body: - The Colombo Port City Economic Commission has been authorized to determine and grant exemption or incentive from prevailing laws in the country including the Foreign Exchange Act in terms of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021. The Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka has approved the request made by the Colombo Port City Economic Commission to issue necessary Regulations and Directions in terms of the Foreign Exchange Act introducing a separate mechanism to facilitate investments in the area of authority of the said Commission until necessary Rules and Regulations are issued/promulgated by the Commission. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to  promulgate regulations under section 7(1) of the Foreign Exchange Act No.12 of 2017 and to submit the said regulations for approval in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding Procurements for the supply of Dental Consumables
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-28
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been called for the procurement for the supply of dental consumables used for dental surgeries of the patients and accordingly, 09 bids have been received for the said procurement. The Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has recommended to award the said procurements to substantially responsive lowest bidders as per the recommendation of the Technical Evaluation Committee. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the relevant procurements as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Email and Collaboration Platform for the Digital Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-28
decision_details_body: - Creation of a Technology Based Society (Smart Nation) is one of the key objectives of the National Policy Framework of the Government. Under this, setting up of a Citizen Centric Digital Government and digitally empowered economy have been identified as strategies for achieving the vision of the Government. As such, it has been identified the necessity of creating a secured Communication Platform of which the capacity is scalable and suits with the present needs for the use of Government offices. Under this, it has been planned to implement a comprehensive E‑mail and Collaboration Solution Platform which is centrally governed and specially employed for the use of the Government. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Technology to start 100,000 E‑mail and Collaborative Solution User Accounts for the Government Institutions under this arrangement and take necessary action to start 30,000 User Accounts expeditiously as its first phase, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief to the house owners affected by the water leakage of the Uma Oya Multi-purpose Development Project and alternative lands for the acquired lands
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-28
decision_details_body: - All construction activities of the Uma Oya Multi‑purpose Development Project are nearing completion and it has also been planned to finalize the provision of relief to the parties affected due to the project within the next six (06) months period. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Irrigation to award free grants under the State Lands Ordinance for the alternative blocks of land provided to the house owners who were affected by the water leakage occurred due to the excavation of the tunnel of this Multi‑purpose Development Project, pay compensation expeditiously for the houses which have been recommended for removal by the National Building and Research Organization (NBRO) owing to the landslide risk and are entitled to be paid with the full compensation and to provide the opportunity for cultivation under specific conditions, on the original residential lands of the house owners to be resettled, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Agreements for Research Collaborations granted for Women Scientists of Developing Countries under the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-28
decision_details_body: - Research Projects of five (05) Sri Lankan Women Scientists have been selected for providing research grants considering those as suitable Research Projects for the Early Career Followship Programme implemented by the 'Organization for Women in Science for the Developing World' operating under the UNESCO. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to enter into Memoranda of Understanding between the Universities in which the relevant  Scientists serve and the UNESCO  for obtaining the relevant grants and enter into Grant Agreements between the said women scientists and the UNESCO, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Cooperation with the Ehime Prefecture, Japan for promoting Employment and Training Opportunities in the Agricultural and other Fields
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-28
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2021‑07‑26 has granted approval to pursue action as per the proposal presented by the Ehime Prefecture, Japan for providing   opportunities for Sri lankan technical interns to be engaged in employments available in the field of agriculture and other fields including food processing in the relevant area and in the Citrus cultivation in particular which is popular in the said area. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to enter into a  Memorandum of Cooperation between the State Ministry of Foreign Employment Promotion and Market Diversification and the Ehime Prefecture, Japan with a view to securing the relevant employment and training opportunities for the Sri Lankans with special skills, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Government of India for the development of fishery harbours in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - The Government of India has concurred to provide assistance for the development of fishery harbours in the mutually agreed locations. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the two countries to seek the co‑operation of the Government of India for the development of fishery harbours in Point Pedro, Pesalai, Gurunagar, Balapitiya and other mutually agreed locations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for Financial Grant Facilitation from the Government of India for the implementation of the Sri Lanka Unique Digital Identity (SL-UDI) Framework
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - The Government of India has expressed its willingness to award a grant of Rs.300 million for the implementation of the Sri Lanka Unique Digital Identity (SL-UDI) Framework. It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the two parties to obtain the said grant and clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Memorandum of Understanding. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Technology to sign the said Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Maritime Rescue Coordination Centre (MRCC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - The Government of India has expressed its willingness to award a grant of US$ 6 million for the establishment of a Maritime Rescue Centre in Sri Lanka. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of India pertaining to the said grant and sign the Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and M/s Bharat Electronics Limited of India regarding the establishment of the said Centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Revocation of Irrevocable Deeds of Gift on the Ground of Gross Ingratitude Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - The necessity of enacting provisions has been identified to provide for legal redresses to donors where donees force out the donors who gift their properties irrevocably, from the said properties and the donees transfer the relevant property to another third party fraudulently. Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to introduce amendments to the Revocation of Irrevocable Deeds of Gift on the Ground of Gross Ingratitude Act, No.5 of 2017. As such, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to publish the said draft Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Marriage Registration Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to introduce new legislation on registration of foreign divorces and acceptance of annulments or judicial separations and as such, a draft Bill is being prepared by the Legal Draftsman for the purpose. The Marriage Registration Ordinance should include the terms to be met for the registration of marriages and since the said Ordinance does not include provisions for registration of foreign divorces and annulments or judicial separations, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to amend the Marriage Registration Ordinance and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a draft Bill for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Wills Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to amend the Wills Ordinance and accordingly, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to publish the said draft Bill in the Government Gazette and present the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Dangerous Animals Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet was granted previously to introduce amendments to the Dangerous Animals Ordinance. As such, the Legal Draftsman has prepared a draft Bill and clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said draft Bill. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to publish the Dangerous Animals (Amendment) Ordinance in the Government Gazette and present the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the industrial Disputes (Special Provisions) Bill in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - A plethora of cases including violations of provisions in the Labour legislation by the employers and recovery of statutory entitlements of employees which may be resolved within a shorter span, has been filed in the Magistrate's Courts and it appears that it takes a longer period to deliver verdicts in respect of those cases. Taking into consideration these matters, approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to introduce an Industrial Dispute (Special Provisions) Act to delegate concurrent judicial powers to the Magistrate's Courts and Labour Tribunals for adjudicating the cases filed under Labour legislation expeditiously. Accordingly, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the said Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and present the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the Procurement for the purchase of surgical gauze required for the Other Health Institutions including the Government Hospitals for the year 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - It is a must to continuously purchase surgical gauze which is an essential surgical consumable for clinical work and surgery in Government hospitals, every year. Accordingly, the Medical Supplies Division is estimated to have a requirement of 30 million meters of surgical gauze for the year 2022. The Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has recommended to purchase surgical gauze from 407 registered local suppliers at Rs.30.55 per meter. As per the said recommendation, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award he said procurement to the recommended suppliers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a “Rental Purchase” Housing Scheme for tenants living 	with less facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - The State Ministry of Rural Housing and Construction & Building Material Industries Promotion has designed to implement a housing scheme called “Rental Purchase” with a view to finding solutions for the housing issue of tenants living with less facilities due to non-availability of lands and houses. Under the said project, it has been planned to construct 04 storied flats and 09 housing complexes with 464 housing units will be constructed at provincial level as its first stage. Since, the selected beneficiaries are not given chance to make a down payment, a monthly rent of Rs. 15,000/ - could be charged for 31 years and therefore the proposed project has been designed enabling to enter into an agreement with the beneficiaries so that the ownership of the house can be transferred to the second or third generation of the beneficiary and the house cannot be sold for any ground. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to implement the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement for the Transfer of Sentenced Persons between the Democratic 	Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Italian Republic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - The Transfer of Offenders Act, No.5 of 1995 contains provisions to enable a citizen of  another specified country convicted and sentenced to imprisonment by a court in Sri Lanka to serve his/her sentence in the country of which he claims to be a citizen. Similarly, the said Act contains also the provisions to enable a Sri Lankan citizen who is imprisoned in another country to be transferred back to Sri Lanka to serve his/her balance period of imprisonment. In order to act accordingly, it is essential that an agreement be reached between Sri Lanka and the respective country to exchange the sentenced persons between two parties. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to sign an agreement  between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Italy for the transfer and receipt of sentenced persons, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Air Services Agreement Between Sri Lanka and the Netherlands
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - Although approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2019‑07‑30 to sign a Bilateral Air Services Agreement between Sri Lanka and the Netherlands, said agreement has not yet been signed. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism to sign the said Air Services Agreement, with a view to further strengthening the relationship in the field of aviation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of the Memorandum of Understanding between Chinese Academy of  Agricultural Mechanization Sciences (CAAMS) and the Department of Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - A Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the Field of Agricultural Mechanization has been entered into between the Chinese Academy of  Agricultural Mechanization Sciences and the Department of Agriculture in the year 2017. The period of the said agreement has expired by now and therefore, it has been proposed to enter into a new Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the two parties. Under the proposed MoU, the two parties are expected to work together related to the fields of the establishment of model villages of agri-machinary and equipment, exchange of experts on agri-machinary and equipment, conducting training programmes, establishment of model Agricultural Mechanization Centres and conducting joint researches on agricultural mechanization. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to sign the relevant Memorandum of Understanding between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of the proposed Agreement between the Government of Australia and the Government of Sri Lanka to implement the second phase of the “Skills for Inclusive Growth (S4IG)” Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - As per an agreement entered into with the Government of Australia in 2017, Skills for Inclusive Growth Project has been implemented in the districts of Trincomallee, Baticaloa, Ampara, Polonnaruwa, Anuradhapura and Matale during a period of four years, with a grant assistance of Australian Dollar 15 million, aiming to enhance the entrepreneurship in the tourism sector to upgrade the value chains in the tourism sector in the country. The first Phase of the project has now been completed and the Government of Australia has agreed to  provide  a grant of Australian Dollar 12 million to implement its second phase. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to enter into an agreement with the Government of Australia to implement the said project up to 2024 including Anuradhapura and Matale Districts also for the second phase of the project, in addition to the  04 districts in which the first phase of the project was implemented, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of Innovation Systems
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - With the assistance of the United Nations Development Programme, the “Citra” Institute was established in 2018 as the first Social Innovation Research Institute in South Asia. The Citra Innovation Research Institute has played a significant role in the past collaborating with the Government, Non-Government and Private partners. Accordingly, based on the experiences gained in the past, it has been planned to implement the activities of the second phase of the Citra Social Innovation Research Institute in collaboration with the United Nations Development Programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, to continue Citra Social Innovation Research Institute as a project supported by the United Nations Development Programme under the direct guidance and coordination of the Prime Minister's Office, as in other countries of the world and to establish a project Management Board functioning under the guidance of the Secretary to the Prime Minister and the Permanent Representative to the United Nations Development Programme in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of the Ministerial Committee on Investment Promotion
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E the President to appoint the “Ministerial Committee on Investment Promotion” under the chairmanship of H.E the President and with the participation of relevant Ministers and State Ministers including the Hon. Prime Minister, with the objective of achieving the development goals focusing on national priority areas and providing necessary policy and practical solutions required to identify and promote investment opportunities in related sectors and to appoint an Officials Committee under the chairmanship of the Secretary to the President and comprising of the Secretaries to relevant Ministries and State Ministries and other relevant officials, to assist the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Finance has identified a few provisions which require amendments to improve the clarity of the provisions in the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017 and remove ambiguities. Further, it has been decided to introduce several amendments to the Inland Revenue Act, based on the proposals submitted by various parties relating to improvement of tax compliance and easing of tax payments, while encouraging investments and exports by granting reliefs to the thriving sectors of the economy. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to amend the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017 incorporating the amendments so identified and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a draft Bill for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: General Direction to accept Bona-Fide Investment of the Non-Resident Companies by the Resident Companies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - In view of promotion and regulation of Foreign Exchange in Sri Lanka, the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka has made a recommendation to the Minister of Finance to issue a direction to permit the Companies incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act, No.07 of 2007, allowing the said Companies to issue shares to the non‑resident investor for the remittances directly made to the resident Company's account with no attention or knowledge, without making remittances via Inward Investment Account (IIA) of the investor for the purpose of acquiring shares of a resident Company by a non‑resident investor. Accordingly, Cabinet decided to grant its concurrence for the measures taken by the Minister of Finance to issue the relevant directions under section 7(10) of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017.

description: Term contract for the importation of Murban Crude Oil for the period of Seven (07) months from 2022-06-01 to 2022-12-31
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited to award the term contract for the procurement of Murban Crude Oil for a period of seven (07) months from 2022‑06‑01 to 2022‑12‑31. The Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has recommended to award the relevant procurement to M/s. Coral Energy DMCC, U.A.E. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the relevant contract to the said Company as per the said recommendation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Code of Criminal Procedure Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet of Ministers has been granted previously to amend section 281 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, to comply with the United Nations Standard Minimum Rules for Administration of Juvenile Justice, which prohibits sentencing of a person to death if he was under 18 at the time of committing the crime. As such, clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to publish the said draft Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introducing amendments to the Civil Procedure Code (Chapter 101)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - With a view to strengthening the process of administration of justice and facilitating the functions of courthouses and prisons, it has been decided to conduct virtual court sessions as and when required. Accordingly, the Digitalization and Court Automation Law Committee and the Civil Law Reforms Sub‑Committee appointed by the Minister of Justice to look into these matters have recommended that it would be appropriate to amend the Civil Procedure Code by inserting new sections 167(A) to 167(N), with a view to incorporating provisions pertaining to oral testimony provided by a witness in an open court. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to amend the Civil Procedure Code based on the said recommendations and instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Joint Promotion Campaign with Airlines, Online Travel Agents and Key International Tour Operators
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - In view of bringing more tourists to the country, the Sri Lanka Tourism Promotion Bureau has planned to implement a Joint Promotion Campaign, which will draw more attention towards meetings between Business to Consumer (B2C). Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism to call for proposals by the Sri Lanka Tourism Promotion Bureau from major Airlines, selected Online Travel Agents, key International Tour Operators and the internationally reputed Advertising Agencies, Print and Electronic Media institutions for the implementation of the said Promotion Campaign, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Eco-friendly Locally Manufactured Fertilizer for Paddy Cultivation in Yala Season 2022
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - The Total estimated land extent to be cultivated for the Yala Season is approximately 600,000 hectares. The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2022‑01‑10 has granted approval to purchase  eco-friendly locally manufactured fertilizer for the same. Accordingly, bids have been invited following the National Competitive Bidding and 46 bidders have been identified for the award of bids on the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed procurement Committee. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to award the contracts for the supply of  eco-friendly locally manufactured fertilizer for paddy cultivation in Yala Season 2022 to the said bidders, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 360,000 Bottles of Human Albumin Solution BP/Ph Eur, 20% in 50ml Bottles
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - This drug is used for the treatment of patients with various medical conditions and International Competitive Bids have been invited for the purchase of the same. The Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has recommended the award of the relevant procurement to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, M/s Baxalta GmbH, Switzerland as per the recommendation of the Technical Evaluation Committee.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the relevant procurement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of  3,000,000 Particulate Filtering Face Masks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the purchase of these Face Masks which are used to prevent respiratory tract infections. Taking into account the recommendation of the Technical Evaluation Committee,  the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has recommended the award of the relevant procurement to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, Lucky Industries (Pvt.) Limited. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the relevant procurement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for Supply of 1,900,000 vials of Biphasic Isophane Insulin Injection BP, 30/70, 1000IU/10ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the purchase of this Injection which is used for the treatment of diabetic patients. The Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has recommended the award of the bid to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, Wockhardt Limited, India. The said recommendation has been confirmed by the Procurement Appeal Board. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the contract for supplying only 1.5 million doses  of the relevant drug to Wockhardt Limited, India, and to purchase the rest in future depending on the actual consumption in the year 2022, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Awarding the Term Contract for the Import of Diesel
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited from the registered suppliers to award the term contract for  importing Diesel (0.05% M.S.) for a period of 08 months from 2022‑03‑01 to 2022‑10‑31. Awarding the relevant procurement to the Coral Energy DMCC has been recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the relevant procurement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Augmentation of Nadukuda, Chunnakam and Aniyakanda Grid Substations under an Asian Development Bank Loan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the International Competitive Bidding to select a suitable contractor to implement this Project. The Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee has recommended to award the relevant contract to the Joint Venture of TBEA Shenyang Transformer Group and Ceylex Engineering Ltd. Concurrence of the Asian Development Bank has been received for the said recommendation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power to award the relevant contract, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the construction of 408 Housing Units at Millagahawatta, Wattala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the National Competitive Bidding to implement the Project for Designing  and Construction of  408 Housing Units at Millagahawatta, Wattala. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to award the relevant contract to International Construction Consortium (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making a lump sum payment for the revival of families of missing persons
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - Policies have been formulated to rebuild and restore the lives of persons who aggrieved from grievances under various circumstances, in terms of policies and guidelines on reparations. Accordingly, the relevant families should be provided with donations in keeping with the already prepared policies, enabling to promote the reconciliation for wellbeing and protection of all Sri Lankans including future generations. In terms of the Office on Missing Persons Act, No.14 of 2016, issuance of Certificate of Death or a Certificate of Absence is recommended to the Registrar General after conducting a proper investigation on missing persons. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to make a lump sum payment of Rs.100,000/- to the next of kin of the missing person holding a Certificate of Absence issued by the Registrar General  based on the matters uncovered by the Office on Missing Persons, for the revival of the family, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Leasing out of two blocks of land located adjacent to the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport (MRIA), to establish 02 Airport Hotels and operate the same
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - Although Hambantota area where  the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport is located is a famous tourist destination, only few hotels are being operated in that area. It has been identified that construction of 02 hotels of 4 star category in the close proximity of the airport would attract tourists and it may create a more favorable environment.  For the purpose, two land lots each in extent of 15 hectares located on the right side of the Terminal Building of the Airport have been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism to Request for Proposals from the investors for the establishment of the proposed 02 hotels, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The project to establish an Enhanced Transparency Framework for Agriculture, Forestry and other Land Use Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka functions as a party of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) since 1993, and has ratified the Paris Agreement  in 2016. The Ministry of Environment acts as the national focal point of the UNFCCC. In terms of the provisions of the said agreement, Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) of Sri Lanka have been submitted to the  UNFCCC on 2021‑07‑30 and under that Agriculture and Forestry have been identified as 02 key sectors.  According to the section 13 of the Paris Agreement, the partners shall report the progress of the climate change related activities in a transparent manner. Therefore, a project has been designed in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations under the consultation of the Ministry of Environment with a grant of the Global Environment Facility (GEF) in order to formulate the framework with enhanced transparency for the sectors of agriculture, forestry and other land use. The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations has expressed its willingness to provide a grant of US$ 863,242 under the Global Environment Facility to implement the said project.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, to implement the said project and to sign an agreement with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations in order to obtain the relevant grant for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting the Tunnel Muck removed during the excavation of the tunnel connecting Kaluganga - Moragahakanda which is implemented under the North Central Province Maha Ela Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - Tunnel Muck removed during the excavation of the tunnel connecting Kaluganga - Moragahakanda, a component of the North Central Province Maha Ela Project, which is being implemented under the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Programme with the Asian Development Bank funding, is temporarily accumulated in the reserved lands owned by the Department of Forest Conservation. This muck is comprised of gravel, which cannot be directly used for construction purposes. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Irrigation to utilize that tunnel muck so as to produce Aggregate Base Course (ABC) required for the rehabilitation and 9.3 km long road from Illukkumbura to Laggala which has to be rehabilitated and developed due to the constructions of the aforesaid tunnel way and also for the construction of 100,000 km road project, implemented by the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing a block of land from Narahenpita area to the Sri Lanka Air Force to construct a hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - A land lot with an extent of 7 acres and 39.9 perches has been vested with the Urban Development Authority to carry out urban development projects. The Sri Lanka Air Force has requested the Urban Development Authority to provide them a land lot in extent of 03 acres of the said land to construct a hospital. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing, to vest a land lot of 03 acres from the said land with the Sri Lanka Air Force, as a free grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing a housing unit to Mr. Herath Mudiyanselage Dinesh Priyantha Herath, the gold medalist in the Javelin Throw event at the 2020 Paralympic Games
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - Mr. Herath Mudiyanselage Dinesh Priyantha Herath was competent enough to win a gold medal by making a world record in the Javelin Throw event at the 2020 Paralympic Games, held in Tokyo, Japan, bringing Sri Lanka a glory. As an appreciation to the commitment rendered by him in bringing that glory to the country, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to grant Mr. Dinesh Priyantha Herath a housing unit worth of Rs.14.2 million as a free grant from the Metro Homes Housing Project, Slave Island, implemented by the Urban Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University (KDU) and the UFA State Aviation Technical University (USATU) of the Russian Federation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-14
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University (KDU) and the UFA State Aviation Technical University (USATU) of the Russian Federation with the objectives of further strengthening the good relationship between the two countries, enhancing the Academic and Research Cooperation in the field of Aviation and Aeronautical Engineering, exchange of scholars and scientists for conducting research in the areas of mutual interest as well as the exchange of information, academic materials and publications in the aforesaid areas. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of an Incentive Scheme based on Progress of the Exports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-07
decision_details_body: - It has been planed to implement a scheme to encourage exporters with a view to minimizing difficulties encountered by the them such as high inflation, severe  foreign exchange deficit, restrictions on imports of raw materials and high operating cost and encouraging exporters to make progress in this year beyond the export performance achieved in the last year. It is anticipated to earn an additional income of US$ 5,500 million in the year 2022 through the implementation of the proposed scheme than the export income in the year 2021.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade to pay an incentive of Rs 30/- per dollar earned in excess to the corresponding quarter of the previous year, to the institutions which have achieved at least 10% export growth compared to the previous corresponding quarter, under the proposed scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting incentives for the Promotion of Remittances from Migrant Workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2022-03-07
decision_details_body: - Approximately US$ 7-8 billion is remitted annually to the country through the foreign employment sector which is a main source from where Sri Lanka is receiving  foreign exchange.
