Public Administration Circular No. 02/2018 dated 2018‑01‑24, emphasizes the need of preparing a Human Resource Development Plan by every State Institution. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Services, Provincial Councils and Local Government to formulate a long term "Human Resource Development Plan" with the participation of all relevant parties to enhance the efficiency and productivity of the public service, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing the number of National Schools to 1000
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-12-07
decision_details_body: - Policy approval has been granted by the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2019‑12‑10 to implement an appropriate program to establish 1000 new National Schools covering all Divisional Secretariat Divisions. Accordingly, the program is planned to be implemented in three phases and the proposal made by the Minister of Education to implement the relevant programme to develop one selected Provincial Council School as a National School in each of the 123 Divisional Secretariat Divisions in which there are no National Schools as the first phase, to upgrade 673 schools selected on the basis of identified criteria as National Schools under the second phase and to further develop the existing 373 National Schools under the third phase,was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Institutional Name of the Children's Secretariat as the 'National Secretariat for Early Childhood Development'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-12-07
decision_details_body: - The "Children's Secretariat" which has been established in the year 1979, functions as the central institution that executes the National Policy on Early Childhood Care and Development. Though the institute also plays a special role in the field of early childhood education, it seems that, the current institutional name of the said Secretariat does not imply that role. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to amend the institutional name of “Children's Secretariat” as “National Secretariat for Early Childhood Development”, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the method of payment of four housing projects implemented with the Indian Government Aid
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-12-07
decision_details_body: - The Government of India has granted an award of Rs.300 million each for implementing 04 projects for the construction of houses for low – income families and the relevant projects are being implemented by the National Housing Development Authority. Steps will be taken to release applicable funds followed by a progress report submitted to the Indian High Commission by National Housing Development Authority upon the completion of the relevant construction by the beneficiaries with their cost. However, since the house owners do not have sufficient funds to complete the construction as supposed that the progress of the project lies at a lower level. Therefore the Indian High Commission has agreed to release the initial payment required for the construction at the inauguration of work and continue to release the rest of the instalments on the progress of the construction. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development & Housing for taking necessary action to implement the said projects,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation Act, No.15 of 1968
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-12-07
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2015‑12‑02 for further amendment of the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation Act, No. 15 of 1968 (Amended) as amended by the Acts, No. 27 of 1976, No. 52 of 1982, No. 35 of 2006 and No. 11 of 2019. Accordingly, clearance from the Attorney General has been received for the draft bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development & Housing to publish the said draft bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Performing essential renovation and rehabilitation activities of the Mahinda Rajapaksa National Tele Cinema Park
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-12-07
decision_details_body: - Mahinda Rajapaksha National Tele Cinema Park has been established for earmarking a renaissance in the local cinema and tele creations sector by providing studios and scenic background facilities as well as accommodation and other facilities for artists of the said field, on a concessionary basis. 13 local films, 18 tele dramas and 08 songs for advertisements have been produced up to date since the year 2010. Since this park has not been properly maintained for the past four years, most of the physical resources of the institution are being deteriorated. Therefore, it has been identified that prompt actions should be taken to carry out essential renovations of the tele cinema park and accordingly, the the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs for allocating funds from the General Treasury during the years 2021 and 2022 for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining provisions for the working capital requirements of the Central Cultural Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-12-07
decision_details_body: - The income of the Central Cultural Fund has been declined due to the complete collapsing down of the tourism industry with the expansion of the global Corona pandemic. Although, actions have been taken previously to obtain a loan of Rs.135 million for the activities of the said fund having obtained the Cabinet approval, it has been observed that, the amount obtained is not sufficient for maintaining the institutional activities. Therefore, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of  Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs for obtaining Rs.50 million from the General Treasury for settling the bills relevant to the conservation and construction activities presently being performed by the institution, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the published Gazette Notifications for approval in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-12-07
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance for the submission of the following Gazette Notifications in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

(i) 	Gazette Notifications issued under the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No. 18 of 2011;

*	 Gazette Notification No. 2191/25 dated 2020-09-02 

*	  Gazette Notification No. 2198/57 dated 2020-10-23

*	 Gazette Notification No. 2199/2 dated 2020-10-26

*	 Gazette Notification No. 2203/37 dated 2020-11-28

(ii) 	Gazette Notifications issued under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act No. 13 of 1989;

*	Gazette Notification No. 2189/47 dated 2020-08-21

*	 Gazette Notification No. 2197/3 dated 2020-10-12

(iii) 	the Gazette Notification No. 2194/6 dated 2020-09-21 published under the Finance Act No. 25 of 2003

(iv)	Gazette Notifications under the Strategic Development Projects Act No. 14 of 2008

*	 Gazette Notification No. 2201/6 dated 2020-11-10

*	 Gazette Notification No. 2202/3 dated 2020-11-16

*	 Gazette Notification No. 2203/16 dated 2020-11-24.

description: Project to manufacture semi steel radial tyres and all steel radial tyres for export market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-12-07
decision_details_body: - Shandong Haohua Tire Co. Limited of China has submitted a project proposal to the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka with an investment of US$ 300 million for the establishment of a project within the premises of Hambantota International Port for manufacturing semi - steel radial tyres and total steel radial tyres for the export market. The board of investment of Sri Lanka has given its consent for the implementation of this project as a strategic development project under the Strategic Development Act (Amended) No. 14 of 2008. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, to grant the relevant tax concessions as per the provisions furnished by the Strategic Development Act, subject to inauguration of the project within a period of 36 months and export at least 80% of the total production, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of Construction Contract of 27.7km long Tunnel Section in 95.86km long North Central Main Canal Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct a 27.7 km tunnel from Koduruwawa to Namalpura via the protected forests and sanctuaries in Minneriya, Girithale and Hurulu as a package of the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Programme which is implemented under the funds of the Asian Development Bank. For the purpose, international competitive bids have been invited to select a suitable contractor. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Irrigation to award the relevant contract to the China State Construction Engineering Corporation Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Committee to look into the irregularities that occurred in the Grand Hyatt Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - The Grand Hyatt Hotel Project is implemented by the Sino Lanka (Pvt) Ltd, which possesses the ownership of the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation, Employees’ Provident Fund and Litro Gas Lanka Ltd. The hotel was scheduled to open in business activities during the first quarter of 2016 afterwards the completion of construction. Provided that, most of the agreements signed by the previous Government were terminated by the new board of directors of the Sino Lanka (Pvt) Ltd. which was appointed following the 2015 presidential election without any justifiable reason and has been entered into agreements with new contractors for aforementioned work phases. Therefore, some companies have initiated legal proceedings and it has been decided that the Sino Lanka (Pvt) Ltd shall pay approximately a sum of Rs.1.8 billion as compensation. The current cost of the the project, which was originally planned to be completed at an estimated cost of Rs.30 billion , has been re-estimated to be around Rs.60 billion. Therefore, approval has been granted by the Cabinet for proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to appoint a committee to investigate whether the Government has incurred a financial loss as it appears that the situation has arisen due to the irregularities committed by the previous management of the Sino Lanka (Pvt) Ltd.

description: Construction of the new Court Complex, Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - Kaluthara Court Complex which is already being operated within a land and buildings with an archaeological value and the Ministry of Justice has been endowed a plot of land in extent of 1.064 hectares to build a New Court Complex under the Kaluthara Urban Development Project. Therefore the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to award the consultancy service for the construction of the new Court Complex to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the term contract for the import of Gasoline for a period of eight months from 2020-12-01 to 2021-07-31
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - Bids have been called from the registered suppliers of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation to import 1,564,500 Bbls +10/-5% of Gasoline (92 Unl) & 535,500 Bbls +10/-5% of Gasoline (95 Unl) during the period of eight months from 2020‑12‑01 to 2021‑07‑31. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the relevant procurement to M/s BB Energy (Asia) pte. Ltd., Singapore, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of the contract for the supply and distribution of Arial Bundled Conductor Alu. (ABC) 230/400V 3x70+54.6+16 sqmm - 2000km
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - Competitive bids have been called for the supply of Arial Bundled Conductors for distribution zone 2 of the Ceylon Electricity Board. Accordingly, the proposal made by Minister of power to award the contract for the supply and distribution of Arial Bundled Conductor Alu. (ABC) 230/400V 3x70+54.6+16 sqmm - 2000km of the Ceylon Electricity Board to M/s ACL Cables PLC as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Suraksha Student Insurance Coverage 2020/2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - Proposals have been invited from Government-owned insurance companies for “Suraksha” student insurance. In response to the invitation, only the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation has submitted a proposal. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to award the Procurement for the securing of Suraksha Student Insurance Scheme to the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, following the negotiations conducted with the said Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development and Conservation of the National Art Gallery
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been received on several occasions for the renovation of the National Art Gallery. Although the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2018‑08‑21 has granted approval to allocate Rs. 42 million for the purpose, relevant renovations have not been carried out. Main building of the Art Gallery is in a dilapidated condition due to water leaking from the main rain water pipe that was installed to drain the rainwater and it needs to be repaired immediately. Accordingly, the proposal presented by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to obtain the services of the Sri Lanka Navy and carry out the relevant repairs of the National Art Gallery, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Livestock Development Projects for the year 2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement “Saubhagya” Diary Development Programme and the "Dairy Development Centres" project in the year 2021 to increase local milk production under the State Ministry of Livestock, Farm Promotion and Dairy & Egg Related Industries. Activities such as improving efficiency of animal breeding, animal nutrition, animal health conditions and creating eco‑friendly farms through animal waste management are planned under the “Sauubhagya” Dairy Development Programme. The Dairy Development Centres Establishment Project aims to develop the milk value chain process by upgrading artificial insemination Centres, providing the necessary inputs and training, and networking Veterinary Surgeon's offices. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to secure provisions within the 2021-2023 Medium Term Budget Framework for the implementation of these projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of Postal Stamps in Commemoration of 50 years of Sri Lanka-Singapore Diplomatic Relations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - The Department of Posts of Sri Lanka and Singapore Post Limited have agreed to issue two stamps each in commemoration of 50 years of Sri Lanka-Singapore diplomatic relations. Accordingly, it is planned to create stamps under a common theme "Oceanic Bio Conservation" for both parties and to exchange each 4000 stamps and 1000 commemorative leaflets between the two parties. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media to sign a Memorandum of Understanding for the purpose between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Facilitating the issuance of vehicle number plates and driving licenses to the client public through the speed post courier service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - The vehicle registration certificate, vehicle number plates and a sticker are issued when registering a vehicle. Under the existing system, one has to come to the Department of Motor Traffic spending considerable time and expense in order to obtain them. Further, there seems to be some delay in sending new driver's licenses by registered mail to clients. As a remedy for the issue, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport to implement a suitable programme in collaboration with the Postal Department enabling to deliver them to the client's home under the express courier service implemented by the Postal Department, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National Policy to Collect Sex-and Age- Disaggregated Data and Information
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - The difficulty in obtaining information on gender and age disaggregated data with the exception of a limited number of census and surveys by the Department of Census and Statistics and the surveys of the health sector has become an issue in the policy and planning process. This information is essential for identifying Government-prioritized needs, especially in the field of child and women's development, and for understanding their trends and determining plans and strategies for addressing them. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to make it compulsory to collect information based on gender and age group in all census, surveys and studies conducted by Ministries, Departments and Statutory Institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing number of sports schools, development of infrastructure facilities in sports schools and increasing nutrition allowances and other allowances for the sports scholarship holders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body:
- Measures have been taken in the year 1989 to inaugurate sports schools in all the districts, having one sports school in each district in the island. A programme has been planned collectively by the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Youth & Sports in order to implement the said concept more productively. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the following joint proposals made by the Minister of Education and the Minister of Youth & Sports.

*	Development of infrastructure facilities in 26 existing sports schools.

*	 Development of the following schools as special sports schools.

i. 	Inauguration and development of a new bi - lingual National School by the name of ‘Cricket Sports School’ within the premises of Sooriyawewa International Cricket Stadium and enrol students to the grade six (6) from the year 2021.

ii.	Development of Pelwatte Navodya School as a sports school for athletics/ Volleyball.

iii. Development of Mahinda Rajapaksha Vidyalaya, Pitipana for athletics.

iv. Development of Murunkan Maha Vidyalaya, Mannar for football / athletics.

*	Construction of new school hostels in the sport schools where there are no hostels and development of the existing hostels.

*	 Increase of sports scholarships and other allowances to suit the current requirements.

description: Providing relief to those who have been affected due to Weras Ganga Storm water Drainage and Environment Improvement project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body:
- Construction work of the Weras Ganga Storm water Drainage and Environment Improvement project has been inaugurated in 2013 with the objective of flood control in Colombo and suburbs, improvement of environmental systems, conservation of wetlands, conservation of sanctuaries as well as expanding the cannel system. Actions have been taken to compensate 80% of the value recommended by the Department of Valuation for the buildings and other constructions which will be affected by the said project and to pay a housing rental for obtaining temporary housing facilities for a period of 06 months for the people whose residences are totally evacuated under the project. The lands required for the project have been acquired by now and the construction work is scheduled to be concluded by the year 2020.

The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development & Housing for further payment of housing rental paid for residing in temporary houses for an additional period until compensation is paid at a time the payment of statutory compensation decided for them is delayed more than 06 months due to unavoidable reasons and to pay 100% of the total estimated amount recommended by the Department of Valuation for the construction houses and buildings that are totally evacuated.

description: Construction of the Administrative Complex-Polonnaruwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2016‑10‑18 for the construction of the administrative complex of Polonnaruwa. The building has been constructed under the supervision of the Urban Development Authority having spent Rs.1,018 million. It has been planned to accommodate 19 Government and Semi – Government institutions in this building complex. Another Rs.265 million has been estimated to be spent for completion of its construction activities comprised of affixing air conditioning system, installation of electricity generators, completion of remaining work of the auditorium as well as landscaping. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development & Housing to secure required allocations to the State Ministry of Urban Development, Coast Conservation, Waste Disposal and Community Cleanliness for completion of construction work of the said building, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquiring the 48 Waththa land where the Sinhapura Housing Complex has been built to the Urban Settlement Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - Under two phases of the Sinhapura Housing Scheme Project, housing facilities have been provided to 120 low - income families living amidst minimum facilities within the Colombo Municipal Council area within a block of land in extent of 0.4423 hectares belonging to Wanathamulla of Divisional Secretariat Division, Thimbirigasyaya. The said housing programme has been implemented by an establishment called Real Estate Exchange (Pvt.) Limited which was fallen under the then Ministry which was vested with the subject of Housing, and has spent Rs. 174.15 million of budgetary allocations from the General Treasury for the purpose. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development & Housing for transferring the relevant plot of land to the Urban Development Authority as a free grant, enabling to issue deeds for those low – income families who have been granted houses, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the published Gazette Extraordinary Notifications to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to submit six Gazette Extraordinary Notifications published under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007, one Gazette Extraordinary Notification published under the Revenue Protection Act, No.19 of 1962 and one Gazette Extraordinary Notification issued in respect of imposing Surcharge on customs import duty for imported fuel in terms of the provisions of Customs Ordinance, to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extending the validity period of the Order issued under section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act No. 12 of 2017 on restriction of Foreign Exchange Outflows
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2020‑06‑24 granted approval to issue an Order valid for a period of 06 months under section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act No. 12 of 2017 to impose restrictions relating to outward foreign exchange capital transactions. Accordingly, the said Order has been imposed by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2020‑07‑02 and its validity period will expire on 2021‑01‑01. It has been found that it would be appropriate to extend the period of the same for another 06 months. The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to take necessary action accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extending the term of the Committee established to make recommendations to regularize and make efficient the State Banking System to strengthen the National Economy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-30
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2020‑07‑22 granted approval to establish a Committee to submit appropriate recommendations within 03 months to regularize and make efficient the state banking system to strengthen the National economy. However, due to the prevailing situation in the country, the work of the committee could not be completed as expected. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to extend the term of the Committee for a period of three months with effect from 2020‑11‑18, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Programme for the Budget Debate - 2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - Programme for the Budget Debate for the Financial Year 2021 prepared by the Office of the Leader of the House of Parliament and the Committee Stage Programme prepared by the Office of the Leader of the Opposition of Parliament, were submitted by the Hon. Prime Minister for the attention of the Cabinet. Accordingly, the Cabinet noted that it has been scheduled to conduct the Budget Speech on 2020‑11‑17, the Second Reading of the Budget from 2020‑11‑18 to 21, and that 16 days have been allocated for the Committee Stage from 2020‑11‑23 to 2020‑12‑10 and that the Third Reading Vote will take place on 2020.12.10.

description: Purchasing a Maintenance andEmergency Response Vessel (MERV) 	for The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - The fact that hiring a Maintenance and Emergency Response Vessel for the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation was discussed at the Cabinet meeting held on 2020‑07‑22 and it was decided at that Cabinet meeting to explore the possibility of providing relevant services by purchasing a Maintenance andEmergency Response Vessel by the Sri Lanka Navy.Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to purchase a new Maintenance and Emergency Response Vessel by the Sri Lanka Navy thereby connecting ships to two Single Point Buoy Moorings of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation, to provide tanker discharging operations and other necessary services and to purchase the said vessel from the Colombo Dockyard Company as agreed during the deliberations with the participation of the Ministry of Energy, Ministry of Defence and officials concerned, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Eppawala, Rajanganaya, Nochchiyagama & Giribawa Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - A detailed financial proposal has been called from a Swiss Company to implement the Eppawala, Rajanganaya, Nochchiyagama and Giribawa Water Supply Project on the recommendation of the then Cabinet Sub Committee on Economic Management. The cost of the project presented by the said company was found to be very high. Therefore, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Water Supply, the Cabinet granted its approval to implement the said project under the local funds within the Medium‑Term Budgetary Framework pursuant to the plans prepared by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board by revising the scope of the said project.

description: The proposed Voluntary Retirement Scheme of Sri Lankan Airlines Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - It has been decided to implement a Voluntary Retirement Scheme due to the financial crisis of the Sri Lankan Airlines Ltd. and a Three – Member Committee headed by the Secretary to the State Ministry of Aviation and Export Zones Development has been appointed to examine this matter. The said Committee has recommended to implement the proposed Voluntary Retirement Scheme without any hindrance to the operations of the Company for the next three years. It is expected that approximately 560 employees will be retired under this scheme andit has been estimated that Rs1.46 billion would be the cost on it. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism to implement the aforesaid Retirement Scheme, was approved by the Cabinet of Ministers.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka and Council of Scientific and Industrial Research Institute of Himalayan Bio-Resource Technology, India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - The Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka has been awarded a grant to conduct a two year research project under the Indo – Sri Lanka Joint Research Programme on “High throughput genotyping to expedite the genetic characterization and dissection of important agronomic traits of tea”. The main objective of this research is to develop the molecular biology techniques required to accelerate the tea breeding programmes by reducing the time taken for cultivar development. Accordingly,the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Tea Research institute of Sri Lanka and the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research Institute of Himalayan Bio Resource Technology, India, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing production relief for six (06) selected crops under the Saubhagya 	Food 	Production 	National Program
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has been granted to provide guaranteed price for 16 crops and to provide seeds with the intervention of the Government with a view to encouraging local farmers. It seems appropriate to provide government assistance to farmers for obtaining seeds to meet the annual consumption requirement of Maize, Chillie, Big Onion, Red Onion, Potato and Black Gram locally, which are currently restricted to import. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, the Cabinet granted approvalto provide a 50% subsidy for the cost incurred on obtaining seeds up to one (1) acre of Maize and up to 1/2 acre of Chilli, Big Onion, Red Onion, Potato and Black Gram for the Maha season 2020/2021.

description: Transfer of Ownership of the Fertilizer Testing Laboratory of Ceylon Fertilizer Company to the National Fertilizer Secretariat
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - Fertilizer Testing Laboratory of Ceylon Fertilizer Company issues certificates to the relevant institutions after testing fertilizer samples. Since the Ceylon Fertilizer Company is a commercial institute engaged in the fertilizer supply process, it seems inappropriate to engage in the regulatory function of testing samples. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture to transfer the ownership of the Fertilizer Testing Laboratory with its all movable and immovable assets to National Fertilizer Secretariat, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Use of environmentally-friendly materials to cover the roofs of Schools and Pre-Schools in place of Asbestos roofing sheets
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - It has been identified through the studies of the World Health Organization (WHO)that all types of asbestos cause various diseases such as lung cancer and laryngeal cancer at present. Therefore, the use of environmentally-friendlysubstitutes for roofs in buildings of schools and Pre-Schools instead of asbestos enables to prevent school and Pre-School children being exposed to asbestos and it would be an important step that could be taken for the safety of their health. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to use locally manufactured roofing tiles and other environmentally-friendly substitutes forroofs in schools and Pre-Schools to be built in future instead of asbestosroofing sheets considering adverse effects that could be caused by asbestos to the future generation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Centre of Excellence in Robotics Application - CERA
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2016‑08‑09 forthe establishment of Centre of Excellence in Robotics Application. With the establishment of the said Centre, it was expected to function as a technology transfer agency for the design, development and conduct of research with respect to robotic systems and vehicles for Government and industrial customers. Through the applications of this Centre, it is possible to provide services required by many local industries and to raise funds needed for the existence of the Institution. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to establish the Centre of Excellence in Robotics Application as a limited company under the Companies Act No. 7 of 2007 and maintenance of its activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Changing the name of Manthai Salt Limited as 'National Salt Company' and transferring the ownership of all government owned Salterns in the Northern Province to the National Salt Company
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - The Ceylon Salt Company was established by privatizing the Sri Lanka Salt Corporation in 1990 and all Salterns except the Salterns located in Northern Province were brought under the purview of the said Company. Subsequently, in the year 2001, a State-owned public company called Manthai Salt Ltd. was established and the administrativeand the operational activities of the Salterns located in the Northern Province were brought under the said Company. In accordance with the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No. 2196/27 dated 2020‑10‑06, the Manthai Salt Ltd. and the Elephant Pass Saltern have been incorporated as two public enterprises under the purview of the Ministry of Industries. Further, it has been found that maintenance of all Salterns located in the Northern Province under a single administrative structure would be economically and administratively more advantageous other than maintaining those as separate limited companies. Accordingly, taking into account the present needs, the proposal made by the the Minister of Industries to change the company name of Manthai Salt Ltd. functioning as a fully State-owned company under the Ministry of Industries, as “National Salt Company” and to transfer the ownership, administrative activities and operational activities of the Elephant Pass Saltern located in the Northern Province to the National Salt Company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the proposed Gin-Nilwala Diversion project for the optimal use of water from the Gin and Nilwala rivers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - The rivers Gin and Nilwala carry 2000 and 1200 cubic meters of water to the ocean, respectively. The Gin -Nilwala project has been proposed to implement for the purpose of diverting the excess water of the said two rivers in order to avoid shortage of drinking and irrigation water in the Hambantota District and also to control the floods in these rivers and studies in this regard are nearing its completion. Taking into consideration the proposals made by the Minister of Irrigation and the need to expedite the project, the Cabinet approval was granted to implement the project in phased out manner, utilizing local funds.

description: Entering into an Agreement between Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation (SLBC) and the Encompass Digital Media Services Limited - London for the transmission of overseas programmmes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - The services of the TrincomaleeBroadcasting Station commenced as per the Agreement entered into between the Government of Sri Lanka and Deutsche Welle, the overseas broadcasting service of the Federal Republic of Germanin 1980 andthe operational activities of the said station have been entrusted with the Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation in the year 2012. Subsequently, programmes were transmitted through the said station along with foreign media institutions. The Encompass Digital Media Services Limited - London, operating its business activities from Londonhas submitted a business proposal to transmit overseas programmes via short wave and medium wave and accordingly, foreign exchange of US$ 49,000 and US$ 16,000 can be earned respectively by the Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation per month by providing its air time to the said Company. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Mass Mediato enter into aBroadcasting Agreement between the Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation and the Encompass Digital Media Services Limited - London for the transmission of overseas programmes using TrincomaleeBroadcasting Station of the Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of an Arbitration System to settle the disputes of the Employees in the Public Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - It is apparent that there are also instances where protests, demonstrations, strikes etc. conducted by certain employees in the public sector at present,resulting impediments to achieve theNational development goals. Although it is possible to take action to minimize disputes and strikes in the private sector in terms of the provisions of the Labour Dispute Act No.43 of 1950, the Government sector possesses no such methodology. Through the Government's Policy Framework of ‘Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour’, it has been pointed out that a mechanism similar to the arbitration system adopted by the private sector to solve the employee disputes at present would be introduced to solve the employee disputes in the public sector as well. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Services, Provincial Councils and Local Government, to appoint a committee comprising of relevant Secretaries to ministries and relevant trade union representatives, in order to introduce amechanism fortified with four aspects; dialogue,consultation, mediation and arbitration which can be agreed by all in order to avoid and settle disputes in the public sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting an appropriate methodology for determining and identifying 	the National Heritage of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - Issues have arisen in identifying the Nation Heritages of Sri Lanka due to the absence of specific criteria or mechanism for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to appoint a Committee comprising of Experts /Scholars in the relevant fields to prepare a methodology in consultation with the views of the general public for the identification of tangible and intangible national heritages which ensures Sri Lankan cultural identity, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Training Multi-purpose Development Assistants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body:
- Activities pertaining to the recruitment of 100,000 Multi-purpose Development Assistants by the Department of Multi-purpose Development Task Force are being conducted by now. It has been planned to subject all those who recruited accordingly to a training under 25 fields and award them NVQ 3 certificate. As such, the Cabinet approved the the proposal made by H.E the President for entrusting the National Apprentice and Industrial Training Authority (NAITA)
to conduct the said training simultaneously in 332 Divisional Secretariat Divisions island wide for a period of 5 ½ months.

description: Acquiring a block of land for the Divisional Secretariat, Ratmalana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct a new building complex for the Divisional Secretariat, Ratmalana enabling to render an optimum public service to the general public in the area, since space of the current building which is situated in a block of land of 26 perches is inadequate. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Irrigation and State Minister of Internal Security, Home Affairs and Disaster Management and the Minister of Transport to allocate a block of land in extent of 100 perches belonging to the Department of Sri Lanka Railways identified for the construction of the Divisional Secretariat, Ratmalana, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Regulations related to the process of charging visa fees of the Department of Immigration and Emigration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2018‑01‑09 has granted approval to amend the regulations issued in 1956 pertaining to the 	Immigration and Emigration Act No. 20 of 1948 so as to suit with present. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of 	Irrigation and State Minister of Internal Security, Home Affairs and 	Disaster Management to present the amended Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman for the purpose in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Museum of Weapons
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that it would be appropriate to implement a proper programme to collect and preserve, maintain and protect ancient weapons including stone tools found in archaeological excavations, the traditional weapons used in the past which are now subject to extinct and modern weapons. Accordingly, considering the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister, approval was granted for the establishment of a separate unit for preservation of weapons within one of the most appropriate museums which is presently under the purview of the Department of National Museum.

description: Implementing Digital Strategies and empowering the Information and Communication Technology Agency of Sri Lanka (ICTA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body:
- The Information and Communication Technology Agency of Sri Lanka has been entrusted the responsibility of recommending a National Digital Policy and Strategy to be implemented during the period 2020-2025 under the Government's new policy framework. Accordingly, the said Institution has prepared a National Digital Policy and Implementation Strategies for Sri Lanka. It has been recommended to initiate 03 new programme units by the said programme as follows.

i.	Digital Government - This unit will carry out programmes for digital transformation process of Government institutions and empowerment of citizens of Sri Lanka.

ii.	Digital Economy - This unit will facilitate innovations, entrepreneurship and starting up new companies by capacity building, introducing new technology and expansion of the industry by creating an environment for foreign direct investment .

iii.	Digital Services - This unit will establish, mange and maintain IT infrastructure required for government services and provide consultancy services to initiate and manage the digital transformation process. 
As such, the proposal made by H.E the President to restructure the Information and Communication Technology Agency of Sri Lanka enabling to fulfill the aforesaid duties and responsibilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Unique Digital Identity (SL-UDI) Framework and e-NIC Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-16
decision_details_body:
- The Government adopts an Unique Digital Identity Framework and a strategy to facilitate the said framework in order to achieve the goal 'Smart Nation' which is one of the ten key goals of the national policy framework 'Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour'.  Further the said programme has been given priority as a national level programme. The Unique Digital Identity Framework for Sri Lanka has been prepared together with the Information and Communication Technology Agency of Sri Lanka and the Department for the Registration of Persons and implementation of the e-NIC project has been identified as one of the components to be implemented under the said Project. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E the President to implement the following proposals was approved by the Cabinet.

*	Granting approval to the Unique Digital Identity Framework for Sri Lanka finalized 	by the Programme Preparation Committee.

*	Appointment of a Presidential Task Force to provide the necessary guidance to establish the Unique Digital Identity Framework for Sri Lanka.

*	Vesting the responsibility of implementation of the Unique Digital Identity Framework Project for Sri Lanka with the Information and Communication Technology Agency of Sri Lanka.

*	Implementation of the e-NIC Project together with the Information 	and Communication Technology Agency of Sri Lanka and the Department for the Registration of Persons.


*	Making required amendments to the Registration of Persons Act No.32 	of 1968 to facilitate the implementation of Unique Digital Identity Framework for Sri Lanka and the e-NIC Project.

*	Completion of the said project by 2022‑12‑31.

description: Selling of paddy stocks in the possession of the District Secretaries/Government Agents and the paddy stocks belonging to the Paddy Marketing Board through Sathosa outlets by threshing them into rice
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - Considering the facts that the current rice shortage in the market and the reluctance shown by the owners of rice mills to supply sufficient rice stocks under the controlled price, the Cabinet of Ministers granted approval to take necessary measures to sell paddy stocks in the possession of the District Secretaries/Government Agents and the paddy stocks belonging to the Paddy Marketing Board through Sathosa outlets to consumers under the controlled price, after threshing them into rice.

description: COVID-19 (Temporary Provisions) Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - It has emerged the need of taking a certain temporary measure to provide legal protection to all relevant parties and persons in dispensation of justice on pending court cases due to the COVID - 19 pandemic. Particularly, as per the COVID- 19 pandemic condition, it has become appropriate to make provisions for such measures to be taken deviating to the ordered time limit, when certain persons are ordered to take certain measures within specified time limits. Accordingly, the Cabinet of Ministers approved the proposal submitted by the Minister of Justice to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft the COVID -19 Bill (Temporary Provisions) to impose relevant provisions including such identified matters.

description: Awarding the long term contracts for the importation of Petrol and Diesel for the period of eight months from 2020/11/01 to 2020/06/30
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet approved the proposals submitted by the Minister of Energy to award the following long term contracts for the importation of Petrol and Diesel for the period of eight months from 2020‑11‑01 to 2020‑06‑30, as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee. 
* 	Awarding the procument to M/s ES Energy DMCC,U.A.E to supply 1,800,000 barrels of Petrol (92 Unl) 
*	 Awarding the procument to M/s Swiss Singapore Overseas Enterprises Pte. Ltd., in Singapore to supply 1,680,000 barrels of Diesel that contain maximum sulphur percentage 0.05.

description: The contract for supplying and laying of water distribution systems in the Jaffna city area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approved the proposal submitted by the Minister of Water Supply, to award the contract for the supplying and laying of water distribution system in the Jaffna city area, which is one of the components of Jaffna – Kilinochchi Water Supply and Sanitation Project, to M/s NCC Company to a sum of Rs.3,160.20 Million (with VAT) as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee.

description: Construction of New Bridge Across the Rajagiriya Nawala Canal connecting Angampitiya Road at Ethulkotte and School Lane at Nawala, Rajagiriya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - Limited competitive bids were called to award the contract for the construction of a new bridge across Rajagiriya – Nawala canal connecting Angampitiya Road at Ethulkotte and School Lane, Rajagiriya at Nawala. Accordingly, the proposal submitted by the Minister of Highways to award the relevant contract to the State Development and Construction Corporation for a sum of Rs.1,698.55 million (without VAT), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for Construction of Gandara Fishery Harbour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2019‑07‑07 to implement the project for the construction of the Gandara Fishery Harbor in the Devinuwara Divisional Secretariat Division in the Matara District. Accordingly, competitive bids have been called for this purpose and the Cabinet approved the proposal submitted by the Minister of Fisheries to award this contract to RR SENOK JV to a sum of Rs. 5,367.69 million (without VAT), as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee.

description: Awarding Contract for the Construction of the Technology Faculty Building of the Sabaragamuwa Universityof Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - International competitive bidding procedure has been followed to select a suitable contractor for the construction of the Technology Faculty Building of the Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka under the Asian Development Bank funded Science and Technology Human Resources Development Project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to award the above contract to M/s International Constructions Consortium (Pvt) Ltd, to a sum of US$ 3.01 million and Rs 1,507.24 million (without VAT), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of Contract for the Construction of the Faculty of Allied Health Sciences Building - Phase 1 of the University of Ruhuna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2018‑09‑11 to implement the Phase I of the project for the Construction of the Faculty of Allied Health Sciences Building of the University of Ruhuna. Accordingly, National Competitive Biding Procedure has been followed to select a suitable contractor for the purpose. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to award the said contract to M/s Sathuta Builders (Pvt.) Ltd., to a sum of Rs. 1,501.73 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of Contract for selection of an Engineering Consultancy Service Firm for the construction of the Medical Faculty of the Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka has signed an agreement with the Saudi Development Fund to obtain a loan of 187.5 million Saudi Riyals to establish the Medical Faculty of the Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, competitive bids have been invited for the selection of a consultancy firm for the establishment of the said Medical Faculty. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to award the the relevant consultancy service contract to M/s DAR Engineering of Saudi Arabia, to a sum of 5.37 million Saudi Riyals, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Ragama-Peralanda Wetland Recreational Park
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - The Urban Development Authority has planned to implement a Recreational Park project in the vicinity of Peralanda Wetlands located within the Ragama-Peralanda residential area. Accordingly the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to award the relevant contract as a direct contract to the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation and to provide the necessary consultancy services by the Urban Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body:
- The Special Committee appointed to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure Act and the Penal Code has recommended the appointment of "Recorder Judges to the High Court" and the conducting of pre-trial conference in High Courts. 

Accordingly, the draft bill for amending the Code of Criminal Procedure Act No 15 of 1979 is being drafted at present, for the purpose of introducing the procedure for pre-trial conference.

Although it is possible to appoint a Recorder Judge to the Court to deal with all the pre-trial and post-trial matters, in terms of the provisions of the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978, no appointments have been made so far, due to some technical issues in existence. Since the conduct of pre-trial and post-trial hearings is a judicial function, the relevant appointments should be made by the Judicial Service Commission from among the Judges presently serving. Further, it has been identified that it is appropriate to change the designation “ Recorder” in the Judicature Act as “Recorder Judge”. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, to amend the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978, incorporating the said provisions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief to tea smallholders for the affected tea plantations due to excessive heat and drought condition
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at its meeting held on 2020‑06‑03 to implement a program to provide tea plants to tea smallholders free of charge to restore tea plantations damaged due to excessive heat and and drought condition. Accordingly, the Cabinet considered the information submitted by the Minister of Plantation that 3.5 million tea plants worth Rs. 105 million had been distributed by the Tea Smallholdings Development Authority and another 2.5 million tea plants worth Rs. 75 million are planned to be distributed within this year.

description: Granting State Lands to Landless War Heroes for Residential Purposes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - With the introduction of a new methodology for disposition of state lands to war heroes, having revised the previous policy existed, at the Cabinet meeting held on 2016‑07‑18, the some war heroes who have been granted lands under the previous policy are reported to have faced numerous hardships. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Lands to introduce a new methodology to eliminate these inequalities that have occurred in providing relief to the war heroes belonging to the same category, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of necessary scrap metal for the Local Small Scale Industrialists
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body:
- Issues relating to the metal industry had been discussed by the “Inter-Ministerial Task Force on Industry and Enterprise” and the “Presidential Task Force on Economic Revival and Poverty Alleviation” at their meetings. As determined at those discussions, steps have been taken to stop the export of Copper, Aluminium, Stainless Steel, High Carbon Steel, Brass, Cast Iron, Aluminium Ingots and Zinc Ingots with immediate effect, with a view to providing sufficient raw materials for the local metal industrialists. According to a research conducted by the Sri Lanka Industrial Development Board and the University of Moratuwa, it has been proved that there is a high demand for scrap Iron, Cast Iron, Aluminium, Copper and Brass by the local industrialists and the demand for Zinc, Manganese, High Carbon Steel and Stainless Steel is also being increased. 

The demand for Scrap Metal is expected to be increased further in line with policies of the Government pertaining to the promotion of local industries. Therefore, it has been found that it is appropriate to reconsider the current permission that has been given for the export of Copper Wire and to suspend the export of Copper Wire in order to encourage production of more value added products.

Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to use the scrap metal of Iron, Copper, Aluminium, Stainless Steel, High Carbon Steel, Brass , Cast Iron and Aluminium Ingots and Zinc Ingots and Copper Wire only for the local industries and to permit to export the unusable Scrap Metal only on the recommendation of the Sri Lanka Industrial Development Board and the other relevant institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing opportunity for sale of products of the Government Institutions in the showroom of the Sri Lanka State Trading (General) Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body:
- It is been planned to expand the showroom of the Sri Lanka State Trading (General) Corporation which is currently operating at the Narahenpita Dedicated Economic Center and establish a sales center called “Rajawasa” in order to facilitate the customers to obtain the products manufactured and sold in the following Government Institutions under one roof at a reasonable price.
*	 Sri Lanka State Trading (General) Corporation
*	Ceylon Fisheries Corporation
*	Educational Publications Department 
*	 Sri Lanka Tea Board
*	 State Pharmaceuticals Corporation 
*	 B.B.C. Lanka Limited 
*	 Cooperative Development Department 
*	 Lanka Sathosa Limited
*	 Ceylon Cashew Corporation
*	 Mantai Salt Company
*	 Litro Gas Limited
*	 State Timber Corporation
*	 Colombo Commercial Fertilizers Limited
*	Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited
*	 Milco (Pvt.) Ltd
*	 Coconut Development Authority
*	 State Printing Corporation 

Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade to modernize the premises where the showroom of the Sri Lanka State Trading (General) Corporation presently located and to establish the proposed “Rajawasa” Sales Center, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief for continuing inter-provincial bus operations in the face of the COVID-19 pandemic situation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body:
- It has been decided to waive off the following charges from the bus operators with effect from March 2020 for continuing inter-provincial bus operations amidst the COVID - 19 pandemic situation. 

*	Permit renewal fees 
*	Late fees 
*	Tender fees 
*	Log fees 
*	Entrance fees 
*	Expressway temporary permit fees

However, it has been identified that the bus operators need to be provided with relief enabling them to provide quality and efficient passenger transport service, since they have confronted with numerous constrains due to re-emergence of the pandemic situation. Accordingly, considering a proposal made by the Minister of Transport, the Cabinet granted approval for further providing the said concessions to the bus operators until the end of this year.

description: Establishment of a Dedicated Pharmaceutical Zone at Arabokka Estate, Hambantota
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - The Presidential Task Force for Economic Revival and Poverty Alleviation has identified the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry as one of the potential industries that could attract foreign direct investments as well as earn foreign exchange. Therefore, it has been planned to establish a special pharmaceutical manufacturing zone with modern facilities within an area in extent of 400 acres of the Arabokka estate in Hambantota enabling to attract the world renowned pharmaceutical manufacturing companies. It is expected to declare the said project as a Strategic Development Project and grant concessions and incentives for the investors who invest in the said pharmaceutical manufacturing zone. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health for the establishment of 20 pharmaceutical manufacturing companies in 200 acres as phase I of this Project and another 20 pharmaceutical manufacturing companies in 200 more acres as its phase II and to furnish necessary infrastructure facilities by the Board of Investments of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Paediatric Surgical Ward at the Teaching Hospital, Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - Teaching Hospital, Ratnapura is the largest tertiary care hospital in the Sabaragamuwa province thus providing services to a large number of patients from other provinces as well. Adhering to the need of a surgical ward with proper facilities for the pediatric ward complex consisted of 116 beds, it has been planned to construct a paediatric surgical ward in the second storey of the relevant paediatric ward building. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Health for the construction of the proposed paediatric surgical ward with the funding of the donors and to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Health and the relevant donors for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reservation of Borrow Area for Offshore Sand Mining
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - The requirement of long-term reserving of a borrow area for offshore sand mining has been arisen for mining sand for the construction industry and as well as for the projects implemented by Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation. The institution has satisfied its sand requirement since the year 1994 by mining sand within an offshore area of 61 square kilometers, having obtained exploration license periodically. Considering the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing, the Cabinet decided to grant approval to permit the the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation for offshore sand mining from the said borrow area of 61 square kilo meters for a period of 10 years, subject to carrying out an Environmental Impact Assessment.

description: Model Memorandum of Understanding on Police Cooperation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-09
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that entering into bilateral memoranda of understanding with the foreign police organizations who perform their duties in a highly efficient manner with the help of modern technology, will enable our police officers to share their experience, knowledge, skills and internationally recognized practices and standards on modern police duties. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Irrigation and State Minister of Internal Security, Home Affairs and Disaster Management to enter into Memoranda of Understanding between the Ministry under which the subject of police falls and the foreign police organizations under the guidance of the Foreign Ministry to establish police cooperation under 17 fields such as terrorist activities, terrorist financing, drug related crimes, human trafficking and smuggling, money laundering, cybercrime etc, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of security services to hospitals and other institutions under the Ministry of Health for the year 2020/2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-02
decision_details_body: - The contract has to be awarded for the supply of security services to hospitals and other institutions under the Ministry of Health for the year 2020/2021. Accordingly the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the supply of security services for 35 hospitals and institutions in the Western Province to Rakna Arakshaka Lanka Limited and to award the supply of security services for 26 hospitals and institutions located outside the Western Province to LRDC Services (Pvt) Ltd, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing locally manufactured sarees as uniforms for Dhamma School teachers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-02
decision_details_body: - Granting of uniforms to the Dhamma School teachers serving in the Buddhist Dhamma Schools throughout the island is being implemented since the year 2004 and accordingly, 76,000 sarees are required for the year 2020 to be awarded as uniforms to Buddhist Dhamma School teachers .  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to purchase 76000 sarees made by local textile manufacturers at Rs. 2,400/- per each, to a sum of Rs. 182.4 million from Lanka Salusala Limited, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-establishment of the Spices and Allied Products Marketing Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-02
decision_details_body: - Spices and Allied Products Marketing Board has been established under the provisions of section 2 of the State Agricultural Corporations Act No 11 of 1972. At its meeting held on 2008‑07‑16, the Cabinet decided that the functions of the said Board be vested with the Department of Export Agriculture and the institution be closed with effect from 2008‑07‑27. However, the Spices and Allied Products Marketing Board currently falls under the purview of the State Ministry of Development of Minor Crops including Sugarcane, Maize, Cashew, Pepper, Cinnamon, Cloves, Betel Related Industries and Export Promotion. Since the necessity of having a formal mechanism to implement the programmes and projects identified by the said State Ministry, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation to reactivate the Spices and allied products Marketing Board and continue its activities, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Establishment of a New Refinery of 100,000 barrels per day (bblspd) at Sapugaskanda for the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-02
decision_details_body:
- As the existing capacity of the refinery located at Sapugaskanda belonging to the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation is only 40,000 (bblspd), the Corporation refinery meets only 25 % of the local demand for refined petroleum products. The remaining 75% has to be imported, relying much on the foreign exchange. Although a feasibility study had been conducted in 2010 for the renovation and expansion of the refinery to increase that capacity up to 100,000 (bblspd), the subsequent technological changes that have taken place in that field have made it impossible to proceed on the results of the feasibility study.

Accordingly the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to take necessary action to initiate a new feasibility study by the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation to determine the scope, technical, operational and financial feasibility of the project which is to be implemented with a focus on several alternative proposals to enhance the existing refinery capacity of petroleum products, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Streamlining the Fertilizer Production and Distribution System in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-02
decision_details_body: - Production, supply and application of fertilizer should be scientifically handled in order to ensure a sustainable soil quality to produce quality crops for a healthy food production process. Therefore, a proper Fertilizer Supply Chain Management System with appropriate technological procedures that do not lead to fertilizer wastage, scarcity and deviation from standards, should be followed. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, to take necessary action to provide infrastructure facilities with scientific standards and components based on an automated centralized methodology upon instructions of the Information and Communication Technology Agency of Sri Lanka, including the completion of National Fertilizer Secretariat with modern technologies, upgrading existing laboratories and strengthening the district level operating and evaluation system including a field inspection mechanism to be established in collaboration with the Sri Lanka Institute of Nanotechnology, to its scope, was approved by the Cabinet .

description: Obtaining used empty bullet Casings and disposed Armor Plates as raw materials for the industries of traditional artisans
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-02
decision_details_body: - Attention has been drawn to solve the issues confronted by the traditional craft industries and rural industries in order to empower the industrialists who involved in those sectors, since such industries can have a huge impact on the economy of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, it has been planned to supply the manufactures the raw materials at a concessionary basis, enabling them to price such goods in order to compete with the imported goods in the market. For the purpose, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to obtain the empty bullet casings (Brass) and disposed armour plates used by the Sri Lanka Army, the Sri Lanka Air Force and the Sri Lanka Navy to the National Crafts Council, deviating from procurement procedure and subject to the pricing formula  approved by the Cabinet in the year 2017 and also to purchase copper, brass and aluminum etc disposed by the Sri Lanka Telecom, the Department of Sri Lanka Railways, the Ceylon Electricity Board and the National Water Supply and Drainage Board at a concessionary price to the National Crafts Council, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining discarded rails of the Department of Sri Lanka Railways for the construction of electric fences and protective fences to minimize the elephant-human conflict
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-02
decision_details_body:
- At present, Elephant - human conflicts are reported in 133 Divisional Secretariat Divisions in 19 Districts in Sri Lanka. Construction of protective fences and electric fences are the key measures from among the measures taken by the Department of Wild Life Conservation to control this situation. Approximately 4,500 km of electric fences have already been erected by now in the aforementioned 133 Divisional Secretariat Divisions while approximately 1,500 km of electric fences, and elephant retention centres with protective fences have been planned to be constructed. Although, timber posts are being used to construct these fences at present those are frequently subject to fall down by elephants. Using of concrete posts too is beyond practical approach due to difficulties found in renovating them.

Therefore, it has been proposed to utilize discarded rails as an alternative solution for the purpose. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Wildlife and Forest Conservation and the Minister of Transport to obtain the discarded rails by the Department of Sri Lanka Railways to the Department of Wild Life Conservation, on free of charge, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Programme for the Establishment of Export Production Villages
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-02
decision_details_body: - It has been designed to implement an Export Production Villages Programme enabling to develop rural products within a formal business model and connect them with the export supply chain as well as to upgrading local manufacturing industries to produce import substitutions. This programme aims to mobilize homogeneous producers scattered in a particular area as an Export Production Village Company and provide with them opportunity to produce their productions to the export market and also to address the issues having minimized the challenges to be faced by them. Further, it is expected to establish Export Production Villages covering the sectors of Agriculture, Fisheries, Industry and Services and to enter into future trade agreements with leading export companies thereby ensuring the sustainability of the said Export Production Villages. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade, to implement the said proposed programme by the Sri Lanka Export Development Board utilizing the necessary provisions, under the guidance of the Ministry of Trade, was approved in principle, by the Cabinet.

description: Performing teaching activities by means of television and radio services under the Distance education system
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-11-02
decision_details_body: - Considering the difficulties erupted for the continuation of teaching activities in the schools due to the COVID - 19 pandemic situation, approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to use both “Eye Channel” and “Nethra Channel” to perform teaching activities by means of television and radio services under the distance education system. With the re-emergence of COVID - 19 pandemic in the country, it has been perceived that optimal alternative distance educational methodologies are essential to be applied for the continuation of educational activities, since re-opening of schools as scheduled seems to be not practical at present. Therefore, it has been planned to prepare and telecast television educational programmes from grades 3 to 13 in all the three languages; Sinhala, Tamil and English. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education, to implement a series of Educational prorammes with the assistance of the State and private television and radio channels in collaboration with the National Institute of Education and the State Ministry of Education Reforms, Open Universities & Distance Learning Promotion, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extending the grace period agreed on the payment of the salaries to the private sector employees in the wake of the crisis caused by the Covid-19 pandemic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body:
- A Task Force has been appointed representing Employers, Trade Unions, the National Labour Advisory Council, the Ministry of Labour and the Department of Labour has been appointed to look into the payment of salaries to the private sector employees in the wake of the crisis caused by the Covid-19 pandemic. The said Task Force has agreed to take action as follows from May to September, 2020.
    • Retaining the jobs of employees of institutions which suspended operations due to the Covid 19 pandemic. 
    • to make arrangements to deploy employees on a roster basis or any other suitable method enabling them to serve proportionately where the institution that can't deploy all their workers in the duty due to the requirement of maintaining social distancing.

    • to pay either 50% of the basic salary of the relevant month in which employee last received his full salary or Rs.14,500, whichever is more remunerative to the employee, in respect of employees of the institutions which had a requirement to retain their workers at home due to the absence of work. 
    • to pay contributions to the Employees’ Provident Fund and the Employees Trust Fund by the employer for the salaries so paid.

The Cabinet noted that the matters submitted by the Minister of Labour to the effect that the said Task Force is in agreement to take action as mentioned above up to December of this year as the spread of Covid-19 pandemic further continuing in the country.

description: Procurement for the supply of 2,000,000 Vials of Biphasic Isophane Insulin Injection BP, 30/70, 1000 IU/10 ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
