decision_details_body: - International competitive bids were invited for the procurement of Biphasic Isophane Insulin Injection which is used to treat for the diabetic patients. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the procurement for the supply of 2,000,000 vials of Biphasic Isophane Insulin Injection BP, 30/70, 1000 IU/10 ml to M/s Wokhardt Limited at a total C&F price of US$ 3 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for construction of the Faculty Building Complex (Phase I) for the Faculty of Agricultural Sciences of the Sabaragamuwa University, Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body: - National competitive bidding procedure has been followed for the construction of the Faculty Building Complex (Phase 1) for the Faculty of Agricultural Sciences of the Sabaragamuwa University, Sri Lanka. Accordingly the proposal made by the Minister of Education, to award the said contract to Sathuta Builders Pvt. Ltd, Kurunegala to a sum of Rs.797.81 million (without VAT) as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of houses for 14 selected devotees affected by the Easter Sunday attack at St. Sebastian's Church, Katuwapitiya, Negombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approval was granted on 2019‑09‑17 to implement a housing project for the families affected by the bomb explosion that took place at St. Sebastian's Church, Katuwapitiya, Negombo on 2020‑09‑21. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to award the contract for the construction houses for 14 selected families at a cost of Rs. 3.24 million per each under the above programme to the State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of the “Swashakthi Loan Scheme” to provide loan facilities towards developing Small and Medium Scale Business Sector and generating employments
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body:
- In the year 2017, the “Swasakthi Loan Scheme” has been launched jointly by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the Small Business Development Division of the Ministry vested with the subject of Youth Affairs with an investment of Rs. 3500 million. Said loan scheme has been implemented through commercial banks and it provides loans to start a business based on a successful project plan. At present, under the said loan scheme, 13890 entrepreneurs have been provided with Rs. 3064 million. Accordingly, taking into consideration the nature of the project and the compliance with the current needs, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth and Sports, to provide loans to young entrepreneurs within the age of 18 and 40, subject to a maximum of one million rupees, for the implementation of new small and medium scale projects in the following business sectors, was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	IT and computer related projects. 
*	Agricultural, dairy and animal husbandry projects. 
*	Projects related to tourism promotion. 
*	 Projects related to innovations and innovative machinery and plants. 
*	 Food processing products and related projects.

description: Handing over Raigam Korale Tea Shakthi Tea Factory to Raigam Tea Small 	Holdings Development Society
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body: - Due to the cease of the tea production activities of the Raigam Korale  Shakthi Tea Factory from April 2019 by the the Dikhena Tea Small Holder Development Society which had taken over the said tea factory on lease basis, tea smallholders who supplied their production to the said factory are faced with severe difficulties. Approximately Rs. 42 million had to be paid to the tea smallholders who supplied tea to the said factory, broker companies and other external parties by the the Dikhena Tea Small Holder Development Society. Taking into account the request made by the tea smallholders to restart the activities of the said factory, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation to hand over the said factory on lease basis to Raigam Tea Small Holdings Development Society, which has the financial strength and 1,800 members to carry out production activities of the Factory, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed dedicated zone for textile manufacturing and related industries at Punnaikudah of Eravur-Pattu Divisional Secretariat Division in Batticaloa District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body: - The establishment of an apparel industrial Zone in Eravur by the Board of Investment in collaboration with the Land Reforms Commission has been identified as a significant priority project of the Ministry of Industries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industries to declare the apparel industrial zone proposed to be established at Punnaikudah of Eravur-Pattu Divisional Secretariat Division in Batticaloa District as a strategic Development Project as a 'Dedicated Zone for Textile Manufacturing and Related Industries', to vest 275 acres of land identified for the purpose and belonging to the Land Reforms Commission with the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka, to secure provisions required for the said project and to provide investment incentives for the investors those who are investing in that industrial zone, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Republic of India for obtaining Indian Grant Assistance to implement the High Impact Community Development Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body: - The Government of India has extended their grant financing assistance to Sri Lanka since 2005 to implement small scale development projects in view of strengthening the bilateral relationship and development partnership between two countries. Under this grant financing programme, a large number of projects pertaining to the development of infrastructure in the fields such as education, health and community development have been implemented through the Government institutions, Local Authorities and Non Government Organizations. Under the same, the Government of India is in an agreement to provide financial assistance to Sri Lanka in order to implement high impact community development projects for a period of five years from 2020 to 2025. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to enter into a new MoU for the purpose with the Government of India, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Wind Farm Projects in Mannar Island
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body: - Construction work of 100 MW Wind Power Plant in Mannar Island is now underway with an investment of US$ 200 million of the Asian Development Bank (ADB). The physical progress of the project is 73% and the construction is expected to be completed by early 2021. Of the US$ 200 million obtained for the project, a balance of US$ 47 million remains and it has been found that another 06 wind turbines could be installed using the said balance thereby increasing the power generation capacity of the said Plant by 20 MW. The Asian Development Bank has granted approval in principle for the capacity enhancing proposal and accordingly the proposal made by the Minister of Power to take action accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a mechanism to utilize non-forest lands among the residual lands except conservation and reserved forests which are vested with the Conservator General of Forests for productive economic purposes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body: - A decision had been taken in 2006, to transfer the powers vested with the Divisional Secretaries to authorize the use of the remaining non-forest lands of residual lands for activities such as chena cultivation, other farming and temporary economic activities to an Inter-Ministerial Committee. At its meeting held on 2020‑07‑01, Cabinet decided that it would be appropriate to introduce a simplified mechanism of granting permission to engage in such economic activities to minimize the hardships faced by those temporarily engaged in chena farming and other economic activities in such lands. Accordingly, having studied the issues, the officers of the Ministry of Wildlife and Forest Conservation, Ministry of Environment and the Ministry of Lands have formulated a new mechanism. As such, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Wildlife and Forest Conservation, the Minister of Environment and the Minister of Lands to implement the said mechanism, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Sri Lankan Embassies in Romania and Spain
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body: - Diplomatic relations between Romania and Sri Lanka commenced in the year 1957 and so far, very good bilateral relations have been established between the two countries. Further, Diplomatic relations between Spain and Sri Lanka commenced in 1955. Accordingly the proposal made by the Foreign Minister to establish Sri Lankan Embassies in the said two countries with a view to further developing the existing relations with those countries with Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Modernizing the process of conducting Examinations in the Department of Examinations of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body: - The Department of Examinations of Sri Lanka conducts mainly 4 National Examinations related to school education and about 325 Institutional Examinations annually. The departmental staff carries out most of the work related to conducting those examinations following the usual office procedures and the necessity of digitalizing the examination process has been identified to maintain the accuracy and reliability of the examinations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to purchase new technical equipment including internet facilities required to modernize the examination management process of the Department of Examinations, to train the respective staff to utilize the said devices and to establish Examination Evaluation Centres at provincial level to facilitate the exam evaluation process, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Re-allocating the Regidale Watte land at Kahapola, Piliyandala to the National Zoological Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval in the year 2016 to acquire the Regidale Watte land at Kahapola, Piliyandala which was under the National Zoological Department to the then Ministry in charge of the subject of Buddhashasana and vest the same with the institution called “Light of Asia Foundation” under a Memorandum of Understanding for its project for the Erection of the Theme Park of Sakya Kingdom of Kapilawasthu in India. The said project had been scheduled to commence in the year 2017 and complete in March 2020, however its progress is still less than 5%. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhashasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to cancel the Agreement entered into with the “Light of Asia Foundation” and acquire the said land back to the Ministry of Buddhashasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to re-transfer the said land to the National Zoological Department, retaining 5 acres of the land under the Ministry for its future development activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Additional Financial assistance from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) for the Small and Medium Sized Enterprises Line of Credit Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body:
- The Asian Development Bank has given its consent to grant a loan amounting to US$ 165 million including an Emergency Response Component of US$ 100 miilion for the measures to be taken to provide solutions to mitigate the circumstances erupted and the negative impact confronted by the Small and Medium Scale Entrepreneurs due to the COVID -19 pandemic. In addition to the above loan, it has also been agreed to award a grant of US$ 1.25 million under the Japan Fund for Poverty Reduction. 
Further, it has been agreed to grant a concessionary loan amount of US$ 400 million for the Secondary Education Sector Improvement Project under the Results Based Lending financial modality of the Asian Development Bank.

Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to enter into the respective agreements with the Asian Development Bank to obtain the said loan amounts and the grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Capacity Expansion Project of the Colombo International Container Terminal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body:
- The Project for the development of the South Container Terminal of Colombo Port was implemented under an investment of US$ 500 million and its construction was completed on 2016‑12‑01 and is in commercial operation at present. An Agreement has been entered into by the Colombo International Container Terminal Limited with the Sri Lanka Board of Investment to implement the aforesaid Project. Taking into account the present demand for the activities of the said Terminal and the prospective business opportunities, it has been decided to expand the said project enhancing the capacity of the Terminal without commencing new constructions. 
	Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to introduce new equipment to upgrade and moderate the existing equipment investing US$ 90 million, and thereby implement the productivity enhancing project of the Terminal and to publish the relevant tax relief in accordance with the provisions of the Strategic Development Projects Act in the Government Gazette, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka Bill 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation to introduce a new Act, in place of the existing Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka Act No.36 of 1987, incorporating the provisions required to regulate the stock market of Sri Lanka in keeping with current international best practices, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Delimitation Committee to establish new Divisional Secretariat Divisions, to gazette the already established Divisional Secretariat Divisions and to establish and reconstitute of Grama Niladhari Divisions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-26
decision_details_body: - Based on the administration and development requirements of the Government as well as the requirements of the public, many requests have been made by people's representatives as well as people's organizations for the establishment of new divisional secretariat divisions in certain areas of the country, reconstitution of some divisional secretariat divisions, delimitation and then gazette the already established divisions yet to be gazetted, establishment of new Grama Niladhari divisions and reconstitute of the existing Grama Niladhari divisions. Although, a Delimitation Committee has to be appointed for the purpose, every 05 years, the report of the last committee appointed in the year 2012, has not been published in the Government Gazette and accepted officially due to the technical deficiencies in the Report. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Irrigation and State Minister of Internal Security, Home Affairs and Disaster Management, to appoint a new Delimitation Committee for the purpose of carrying out the relevant functions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Twentieth Amendment to the Constitution to be 	moved at the Committee Stage in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-19
decision_details_body:
-The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2020‑09‑ 02 has granted approval to publish the draft Bill on the Twentieth Amendment to the Constitution in the Government Gazette and to submit the same thereafter in Parliament for approval. Accordingly, taking into consideration the determination of the Supreme Court on the said draft Bill, the amendments to be moved at the Committee Stage of the said Bill in Parliament were submitted to the Cabinet by the Minister of Justice and the Cabinet granted approval for the same proposals. 

Further, it was decided at this Cabinet meeting that the provisions relating to following matters too should be moved at the Committee Stage of the Bill of the Twentieth Amendment to the Constitution.

    • Provisions to increase of number of the Supreme Court Judges and the Court of Appeal Judges , taking into account the large number of cases pending in such courts.

    • Provisions to submit only the Bills relating to matters arising in connection with the national security and disaster situations in Parliament, treating those as Urgent Bills.
      
    • Provisions for authorizing the Auditor General to audit the accounts of a Public Corporation or a Company in which the Government or a Public Corporation holds 50% or more of the shares.

    • Incorporate provisions relating to the number of Ministers of the Cabinet of Ministers, Ministers who are not members of the Cabinet of Ministers and Deputy Ministers as provided in the Nineteenth Amendment to the Constitution in the Twentieth Amendment to the Constitution without change.

description: Awarding the contract for the supply of Aviation Fuel for SriLankan Airlines Ltd. at the Melbourne (MEL)Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-19
decision_details_body: -Limited international bidding procedure has been followed in purchasing aviation fuel for SriLankan Airlines Ltd, at the Melbourne Airport, Australia. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism, to award the contract for the supply of fuel for the Aeroplanes of the SriLankan Airlines Ltd at Melbourne Airport, Australia, to Vitol Aviation BV, to a total estimated cost of US$ 18.47 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Bail Act, No 30 of 1997
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-19
decision_details_body: -The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2019‑09‑10 granted approval to amend the Bail Act, No 30 of 1997, as the fines laid down in the said Act is not in keeping with the needs of the contemporary context. The Attorney General has granted his concurrence to the amended draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Complete Re-organization of the Colombo Flight Information Region of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-19
decision_details_body:
-The Colombo Flight Information Region is nearly 25 times of the total land area of Sri Lanka. The Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) Limited is responsible for providing quality air navigational services within the Flight Information Region. Accordingly, Sri Lanka will have to maintain the services required to meet the projected capacity demands in the Asia-Pacific Region, as well as to maintain the air traffic services, aviation procedures and related infrastructure facilities in line with the standards set forth by the International Civil Aviation Organization, in the future. 

Therefore, the existing air route structure within the Colombo Flight Information Region needs to be restructured immediately so as to suit to the present day requirements and it should be formulated in line with the "Seamless Air Navigational Services Concept" of the International Civil Aviation Organization. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism, to fully reorganize the Colombo Flight Information Region subsequent to a study conducted in that regard, enabling to completely reorganize the Flight Information Region of Sri Lanka and to obtain the services of an integrated specialist consultancy service for the said study, was approved by the Cabinet .

description: Re-determination of the interest rate for all loan schemes of the Smallholder Agribusiness Partnership Programme (SAPP) and expansion of relief for partner/promoter companies of Agricultural Value Chain Project Development - Smallholder Agribusiness Partnerships Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-19
decision_details_body:
-The Cabinet noted the following matters submitted by the Minister of Agriculture to implement the Smallholder Agribusiness Partnership Programme, operating under the funds of the International Fund for Agriculture Development (IFAD) and the Government of Sri Lanka, in the manner stated below by further expanding the loan facilities granted at present under the programme in terms of the decision taken by the National Steering Committee of the aforesaid Programme.

    • To revise the annual interest rate for all loans granted under the Smallholder 	Agribusiness Partnership Programme to 6.5% with immediate effect.
      
    • To provide adjustment credit facility for partner/promoter companies of Agricultural Value Chain Project Development subject to a maximum of US$ 	100,000 under the annual interest rate of 6.5%.
      
    • To increase the adjustment credit amount granted to partner/promoter companies of Agricultural Value Chain Project Development from US$ 50,000 to US$100,000.

description: Single Use Plastic and Polythene Waste Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-19
decision_details_body:
-Regulations such as banning the production of polythene of 20 microns or below, banning the manufacture of polythene food wrappers, and banning the open burning of polythene in the open environment have been promulgated with effect from 2017‑09‑01, in order to minimize the environmental damage caused by polythene and plastics within Sri Lanka and steps have also been taken by the Central Environmental Authority, to promote other alternatives instead of the banned polythene while the said regulations are in force.
	
	In accordance with the consensus arrived at the discussions held with the relevant stakeholder institutions on Polythene and Plastic Management, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment, to ban the following Polythene and Plastic products in order to minimize single use Polythene and Plastic products with effect from 2021‑01‑01 and introduce other alternatives instead, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	Prohibition of wrapping of chemicals or insecticides in Poly Ethylene Terephthalate (PET) and Poly Vinyl Chloride (PVC) containers and to use containers made of glass or other raw materials as an alternative.

*	Prohibition of sachets made of polythene and plastic less than 20 ml / 20 g (other than for the use of packing food and medicine) and use containers of 100 ml/ 100 g or bigger as an alternative.

*	Prohibition of various inflatable toys made out of plastic (excluding balloons, balls and water floating toys) and use the toys made of Eco-friendly and hygienic raw material as an alternative.
*	Prohibition of plastic cotton buds (excluding materials used for medical treatments) and use cotton buds made from biodegradable materials, as an alternative.

*	Mandating to indicate the 1-7 Codes for identification of internationally prescribed plastic to promote the recycling of all plastic products.

description: National policy and strategies on traditional knowledge and practices related to biodiversity
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-19
decision_details_body:
-Sri Lanka has signed the Biodiversity Convention in 1992,with the objective of conserving biodiversity, sustainable use and equitable sharing of its benefits. According to the provisions of the said Convention, the Government is committed to take action to deal with the cultural diversity related to biodiversity, the indigenous people and their knowledge, its products and practices and to take measures to preserve them.

Accordingly, the National Policy and Strategies on Traditional Knowledge and Practices related to Biodiversity prepared by obtaining the comments and suggestions from the public with the contribution of all relevant stakeholders and under the guidance of the National Experts Committee on Indigenous Knowledge and Practices established under the Ministry of Environment was submitted to the Cabinet by the Minister of Environment and the Cabinet granted approval for the same.

description: Promotion of the Business activities of Lanka Salusala Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-19
decision_details_body: -Lanka Salusala Limited has formulated a strategic “Five Year Project Plan” in line with the Industry and the Trade Policy of the Government and further, a new business approach is planned while networking with the local textile manufacturers by carrying out a study on the demand for textiles in public sector institutions and to for adopting such. Accordingly, the Cabinet having taken into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Industries, relating to the sales promotion activities of Lanka Salusala Limited, granted approval to provide a 15% preference when the Public Institutions or Government Owned Institutions purchase textiles from Lanka Salusala Limited, under the Competitive Procurement Procedure.

description: Establishment of the Selacine Television Institute as a Limited Liability 	Company
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-19
decision_details_body: -According to the decision arrived by the Cabinet at its meeting held on 09th September 2020, approval had been granted to attach the Selacine Television Institute to the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation to function as a separate Commercial Unit of the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation. 	However, Since the commercial objectives of the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation and Selacine Television Institute are different to each other, taking into consideration the further clarifications made by the Minister of Mass Media, the Cabinet granted approval to incorporate the Selacine Television Institute as a Limited Liability Company.

description: Construction of the New Building Complex and the National Medicines Quality Assurance Laboratory of the National Medicines Regulatory Authority and acquisition of the proposed land
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-19
decision_details_body: -Although National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency successfully performs the regulatory activities of Medicines, Medicinal Devices and Borderline Products so far, the lack of a Laboratory with adequate facilities and modern technology to conduct quality testing is identified as an obstacle to perform its regulatory activities more effectively. Further, with the expansion of the functions of the Authority, recruiting of new staff is taking place and since existing space is in-sufficient, it is necessary to expand the present space urgently. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health for the acquisition of 03 acres from the land in extent of 13 acres belonging to Milco Private Limited at the Kirula Grama Niladhari division of the Thimbirigasyaya Divisional Secretariat division for the National Medicines Regulatory Authority and to construct the proposed new building complex and the National Medicines Quality Assurance Laboratory for the National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency within the said premises, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the 	University of Moratuwa and the Aalto University, Finland for the 	incorporation of Education and Research
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-19
decision_details_body: -The University of Moratuwa and the University of Aalto in Finland has agreed to enter into a MoU between the two parties. It is expected to achieve the objectives of initiating and facilitating of corporation between the institutional staff, the departments and the research institutions of both parties and conducting joint research seminars and other activities by the said MoU. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education for an MoU to be entered into between the University of Moratuwa and the University of Aalto in Finland, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting/Acquisition of State and Private Lands with the Urban Development Authority for the proposed Urban Development Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-19
decision_details_body: -The Urban Development Authority has planned to implement a number of urban development projects centered on major cities including the city of Colombo. Preliminary activities pertaining to these projects have already been initiated while the Urban Development Authority has to acquire both State owned as well as private owned plots of land already identified for this project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing, to vest with the Urban Development Authority 39 plots of State owned land in terms of section 6(1) of the State Land Ordinance as a free grant and another 05 plots of private lands under the Land Acquisition Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Request for Proposals (RFP) to select investors for the development of 	lands belonging to the Urban Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-19
decision_details_body:
-Taking into consideration the time taken in selecting suitable investors for the development of lands belonging to the Urban Development Authority in terms of the existing procedure adopted in this regard, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to follow the procedure stated below for the same, was approved by the Cabinet. 

    • To authorize the Urban Development Authority to call for Requests for Proposals to alienate lands belonging to the said Authority for the development activities according to the proposed development plans with the full participation of the private sector as well as the Public-Private Partnership in terms of the Government Procurement Guidelines.
      
    • To invite proposals from the interested prospective investors through the Competitive Bidding Process for the development of lands belonging to the Urban Development Authority identified for the projects to be implemented with the Public-Private Partnership.

    • To appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee to evaluate the said proposals and Project Committees based on the nature of each project. 
    • In determining the value of the lands to base it on the the valuation of the Government Chief Valuer.
    • to alienate the relevant blocks of land to the selected investors on lease basis based on the recommendation of Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee and subject to the approval of the Cabinet.

description: Regulations under the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No.43 of 2000
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-19
decision_details_body:
-Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No.43 of 2000 has been introduced replacing the previous Act No.25 of 1962, to establish the Insurance Board of Sri Lanka currently known as the Insurance Regulatory Commission making provision for the development, supervision and regulation of the insurance industry of Sri Lanka with the objective and responsibility of protecting the rights of the policyholders and potential policyholders by ensuring the conduct of the insurance business in Sri Lanka is carried out in professional manner with integrity and prudence.
	
	The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, to present the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2118/1 dated 2019‑04‑08 issued by virtue of the powers vested with the Minister of Finance, under section 112(3) to be read with section 16 of the new Act, for the purpose of amending the regulations under the previous Act issued through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 610/4 dated 1990‑05‑15, in Parliament.

description: Implementation of the recommendations made by the Presidential Commission pertaining to Edirisinghe Trust Investment Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-12
decision_details_body:
-A Presidential Commission under the chairmanship of retired Supreme Court Judge, K.T.Chithrasiri was appointed by H.E the President on 2020.01.09 to investigate, examine and report on the alleged wrongdoings, irregularities and malpractices which are said to have taken place relating to Edirisinghe Trust Investments Limited. The said Commission submitted the report containing its observations and recommendations to H.E the President on 2020‑10‑06. The aforesaid Commission, by its observations and recommendations has pointed out that many offenses have been committed under the Companies Act, the Finance Companies Act, Prevention of Money Laundering Act, Financial Reporting Act, the Legal Framework for the transfer of lands to foreigners as well as the Penal Code. Moreover, it has also been pointed out by the above Report of Presidential Commission, the need of fully re-organize the Department of Supervision of Non-Bank Financial Institutions of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, bringing the aforesaid matters to the notice of the Cabinet, the following proposals made by H.E the President, were approved by the Cabinet. 

    • to direct the Attorney General to take legal actions expeditiously to implement the recommendations of the above Report of Presidential Commission pertaining to the irregularities of the financial and property transactions of Edirisinghe Trust Investment Limited.
      
    • to inform the Ministry of Finance to formulate a new institutional structure to regulate Financial Companies by fully re‑organizing the Department of Supervision of Non‑Bank Financial Institutions of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka.
      
    • to submit the said Report of the Commission and the measures to be taken accordingly in Parliament, through the Minister of Justice.

description: Simplifying Systems and Processes to fast track the implementation of development activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-12
decision_details_body:
-The following issues have been identified as some of the impediments to fast track the implementation of development Activities:

*	Ministries have to take action to obtain the approval from several institutions and finally the Cabinet of Ministers for general matters which are not required as matters of policy or the regulatory requirements.

*	Delays in payments to be done to private contractors cause delays in development projects and the cost escalation of projects.

Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to pursue action as follows to fast track the development activities in order to minimize the delays caused as far as possible:

*	To submit a report to the Cabinet of Ministers once in three months on the development projects which could be implemented with the approval of the Secretary to the Treasury and the other relevant Authorities, after fulfilling the same expeditiously.

*	To introduce a new mechanism to ensure a continuous cash flow for the key development projects by issuing Treasury Guarantee or Facilitation Letters to their banks, enabling to pay the Contractors for their work completed, without delay.

description: Greater Colombo Water and Wastewater Management Improvement Investment Programme - Phase 3 - Design, Build and Operate of Wellawatte Wastewater Treatment Plant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-12
decision_details_body: -International Competitive bids have been invited from qualified institutions for the procurement to Design, Build and Operate of the Wastewater Treatment Plant at Wellawatta under Phase 3 of the Greater Colombo Water and Wastewater Management Improvement Investment Programme which is implemented with the funds from the Asian Development Bank and the Government of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Services, Provincial Councils and Local Government, to award the said contract to the Joint Venture of Power China Zhongnan Engineering Corporation Ltd. with Beijing Enterprises Water Group Ltd., to a sum of US$ 20.96 million and Rs. 4.36 billion (without VAT), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 6,875 Vials of Trastuzumab Injection 	440mg vials 	with Solvent in 20ml Vial
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-12
decision_details_body: -International competitive bids have been called for the procurement of the drug called Trastuzumab used to treat certain types of Cancers. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the procurement for the supply of 6,875 Trastuzumab Injection 440mg vials with solvent in 20ml vial to M/s Transfarma Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi, Turkey at a total C&F price of EUR 1.62 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 11,250 Vials of Bevacizumab Injection 	100mg/4ml 	Vial
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-12
decision_details_body: -International competitive bids have been called for the procurement of the drug called Bevacizumab used to treat certain types of Cancers. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the procurement for the supply of 11,250 Vials of Bevacizumab Injection 100mg/4ml Vial to M/s Medmart Pharma (Pvt) Ltd, at a total cost of Rs.196.88 million as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Solving issues related to the supply of special Bamboo sticks used as raw 	material for manufacturing incense sticks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-12
decision_details_body:
-The proposal made by the Minister of Industries, to take actions in the following order to solve the issues that have arisen in supplying special Bamboo sticks used as raw material for manufacturing incense sticks,was approved by the Cabinet.

    • To import required Bamboo sticks from abroad for the manufacturing until the required quantity of the special Bamboo sticks used as raw material for manufacturing incense stick are produced locally to the required standard. 
    • To grant a tax concession for the Bamboo sticks so imported. 
    • To take necessary action to identify the areas where the special Bamboo plants are available (ගල් බම්බු-Bambusa aspera) and identify suitable lands and to cultivate these plants by the Department of Forest Conservation, Department of Agrarian Development and Sri Lanka Mahaweli Authority. 
    • To obtain the assistance of the Industrial Development Board to introduce upgraded technical devices for manufacturing incense sticks.

description: Greater Colombo Water and Wastewater Management Improvement Investment Programme - Tranche 3
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-12
decision_details_body:
-Rehabilitation and expansion of the Water Supply Systems in the North East and South West parts of the city of Colombo and non revenue water reduction, the rehabilitation and the expansion of the wastewater management system in the southern Catchment area of the city of Colombo are being carried out under the Greater Colombo Water and Wastewater Management Improvement Investment Programme. The projects under this programme are planned to be carried out during the period from 2012 to 2022‑10‑24. 

	Under Tranche - 3 of the said Programme, 02 loan facilities are provided and the following projects will be implemented accordingly:
 
*	Providing new gravity sewers, force mains and pump stations for the Kirulapone Catchment area 
*	Construction of the Wellawatte Wastewater Treatment Plant 
*	Rehabilitation and expansion of the Water Supply System in the North East and South East parts of the city of Colombo and non revenue water reduction. 
*	Procurement of vehicles and office equipment and conducting training workshops to assist the Project Management Unit of the Colombo Municipal Council.

The current loan facility under Tranche 3 of this programme is to be expired on 2020‑12‑31 and accordingly the proposal made by the Minister of Public Services, Provincial Councils and Local Government to extend the said loan facility up to 2022‑10‑24, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importing Basmathi Rice under the Pakistan - Sri Lanka Trade 	Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-12
decision_details_body: -In accordance with the provisions of the Pakistan-Sri Lanka Free Trade Agreement, it is possible to import 6000 Metric tons of Basmati rice annually under duty free concession. In recent times, the private sector also had been granted permission to import Basmathi rice under this facility. However, complaints have been received with regard to various irregularities being committed by importing rice not belonging to the specified varieties. Taking into consideration these matters, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade to import Basmathi rice only through the Sri Lanka State Trading Corporation and the Co-operative Wholesale Establishment/ Lanka Sathosa ltd., under this facility, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Intellectual Property Act No.36 of 2003
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-12
decision_details_body: -There are a number of local products that can be promoted as geographical indication and such products have to face a severe competition due to counterfeits both in the local and foreign markets. Therefore, it has been identified that it is appropriate to register such products in Sri Lanka as geographical indications. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Trade to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a bill to amend the Intellectual Property Act No.36 of 2003 enabling to establish a comprehensive and specific legal framework to register geographical indications in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taking actions regarding the railway employees who reside in the railway reserved lands belonging to the Department of Sri Lanka Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-12
decision_details_body:
-The Department of Sri Lanka Railways has about 14,000 acres of reserved lands and about 10% of them have been given on lease to various parties. Further, various persons are in unauthorized possession of about 80% of the remaining lands and officers presently serving in the Department as well as the officers who retired from the departmental service are from among them. These lands are being used for unauthorized purposes such as construction of houses and business premises and cultivation. Some railway employees who have illegally acquired those lands have been evicted from those places by legal proceedings. There have also been instances of disciplinary action been taken against them having to forego their right to pension. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Transport to appoint a Ministerial Committee consisting of the following to study the matters with regard to the said issue and submit recommendations to the Cabinet. 

* 	Hon. Gamini Lokuge,
	Minister of Transport - (Chairman);

* 	Hon.Janaka Bandara Tennakoon,
	Minister of Public Services, Provincial Councils & 
	Local Government;

*	Hon. S.M. Chandrasena,
Minister of Lands; and 

*	Hon. Ajith Nivard Cabraal, 
State Minister of Money & Capital Market and 	State 	Enterprise Reforms.

description: Allocation of a Plot of Land for the Uva Wellassa University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-12
decision_details_body: -Considering the demand for higher education existing at present, it is essential to improve the infrastructure facilities of the State Universities in order to implement the Government's policy on expanding opportunities for more students to enter into State Universities. Taking into consideration, a proposal made by the Minister of Education, the Cabinet approved to vest a plot of 02 acres from the land located at Kalugalpitiya, Badulla, which is under the purview of the Badulla District Secretary, enabling the Uva Wellassa University to commence degree courses further required in the most appropriate field in addition to the degree courses presently available in the University.

description: Construction of multi-storied car parks together with the implementation of mixed development projects in the city of Colombo and other selected cities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-12
decision_details_body:
-A programme has been designed to construct and maintain car parks through selected investors by following the open competitive bidding procedure for the purpose of minimizing the traffic congestion caused by the vehicles reaching Colombo and suburbs daily and the vehicles parked on the sides of the roads. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to implement the said project under the following two (02) methods, was approved by the Cabinet.

* 	Request for proposals from Private Sector investors for the construction of multi-storied car parks constructed under general conditions and multi-storied mechanical vehicle parks at 08 locations in the city of Colombo and in Battaramulla, Anuradhapura and Kandy, as a Public-Private Partnership Project.

* 	Request for proposals to construct multi-storied car parks under general conditions and mechanical car parks including housing units and office spaces and other appropriate projects at Narahenpita, Telecom Parking Land at Pettah, car Park at the land where Otter Sports Club Colombo 07 is located, Kinsey Avenue at Colombo 07, enabling the cost incurred for the project to be generated within the project itself ,on pre-sale basis.

description: Bringing the Vidyalankara International Buddhist Conference Hall to 	service providing status
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-12
decision_details_body: -Government has spent approximately Rs. 1,200 million for the construction of the Vidyalankara International Buddhist Conference Hall and the Cabinet, having considered the magnitude of the investment and enabling to properly maintain the high efficiency technical equipment installed in the said Conference hall, granted approval to appoint a Board of Trustees on 2019‑11‑11. Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received in respect of the Deed of Trust prepared in this regard and the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs informed the Cabinet that the Secretary to the Ministry in charge of the subject of Buddhasasana is to sign on behalf of the Government as the First Party of the said Deed of Trust and the Cabinet has given their consent to that.

description: Establishment of the Expressway Investment Company
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-12
decision_details_body:
- The Statement at National Policy enunciated in 'Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour' has clearly identified the necessity of having an interconnected roadnetwork as a key aspect of the economic growth strategy. Accordingly, 100,000km Rural Road Project is now in progress and the Government has given priority to complete the work of the Central Expressway and to initiate the construction of the Ruwanpura Expressway and to complete the work of the Elevated Expressway from Kelaniya to Athurugiriya.

It has been observed that an investment of 0.5% - 1% of the Gross Domestic Production has to be borne by the National Budget for financing Expressways currently under construction and those are to be constructed. As such, the proposal made by the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to incorporate a Company with Secretary to the Treasury as the sole shareholder, bringing all the Expressways under one Company enabling the said Company to raise funds required to construct the Expressways through the funds received as the revenue earned by the toll charged from the users of the Expressways as well as the other sources of income of Expressways , was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Temporary cancellation of diving permits issued for the collection of sea creatures such as Sea-Cucumber and Conch Shells
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-05
decision_details_body:
-	The Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources issues special diving permits for the collection of sea creatures such as Sea Cucumber and Conch Shells in the western coast of the Jaffna peninsula. Accordingly, the diving teams engaged in such activities attend to same while residing temporarily on the coast of that area.

It has been reported that some of the divers who have obtained permits for this purpose are abusing these permits and engaging in illegal activities with the Indian fishermen who engage in fishing by trawlers in that maritime boarder. It has been observed that in view of the above, there is a severe threat of the spread of COVID- 19 pandemic among the people of Jaffna peninsula. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, to  temporarily suspend the diving permits issued for the collection of sea creatures such as Sea Cucumber and Conch Shells, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Minimum number of students in a classroom in a school
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-05
decision_details_body:
-The Principals follow the circular instructions issued by the Ministry of Education for the admission of students to Grade 1. Similarly, admission of students to Grade 6 of the National and Provincial Schools based on the merits of the Scholarship Examination and admission of students to the Advanced Level classes based on qualifications of the Ordinary Level Examination are conducted by the relevant Principals.
In addition, as per the Circulars: No.37/2008 and 33/2019, students are enrolled to intermediate classes with the recommendations of the school Principals. The students who qualify to be enrolled into intermediate classes include the groups on the basis of change of residence due to transfers, arrive from abroad, elected to Parliament, Judges in Judicial Service, Government Specialist Medical Officers , Government Medical Officers, employees of schools,  Ministry of Education and in affiliated departments thereof, University Lecturers and Executive Officers, Officers in Sri Lanka Education Administrative Service and Sri Lanka Teacher Educators Service. 
Moreover, students who were subjected to injustice in the admission process and subsequently being found as qualified at the investigations conducted in this regard, students with special needs and children in social welfare centers are groups eligible to enter  to  intermediate classes.
Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to revise the existing procedure for admission of students and introduce a more transparent mechanism enabling to increase the number of students that could be admitted to a class, taking into consideration the high demand for admission of students to the schools, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of School Uniform Materials – 2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-05
decision_details_body:
-The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2020‑09‑28 has decided to purchase the required school uniform materials for the year 2021 from the local textile manufacturers and to expedite the procurement process already commenced accordingly.
As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Education to award the contract for manufacturing sorting, packing and distribution of the school uniform materials to the Divisional Education Offices in accordance with the relevant specifications as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee to institutes; Vanguard Industries (Pvt) Company, Dankotuwa Weaving Mills, Prabha Tex Industries and Creative Textile Mills (Pvt) Company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Appropriation Bill for the Financial year 2021 in 	Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-05
decision_details_body: -The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2020.09.16 granted approval to draft the Appropriation Bill for the financial year 2021. Accordingly, the estimated recurrent expenditure and the capital expenditure for the financial year 2021 is Rs. 2,690 billion and Rs. 2,216 billion respectively. Further, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Appropriation Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to publish the Appropriation Bill for the financial year 2021 in the Government Gazette and present the same thereafter in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Appropriation Bill for the Financial year 2020 in 	Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-05
decision_details_body:
-The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2020.08.19 granted approval to draft the Appropriation Bill for the financial year 2020. Accordingly, the total recurrent expenditure and the capital expenditure for the financial year 2020 have been estimated as Rs. 2692 billion and Rs.1846 billion respectively. Those estimated provisions also include the following allocation :
	
    • Provisions allocated by the two Votes on Accounts approved by Parliament before.
    • Provisions for estimated expenditure for the year 2020 approved by  H.E. the President in terms of paragraph (3) of Article 150 of the Constitution.
    • Provisions for accounting for a sum of Rs. 211 billion incurred in the year 2019 but which has not been accounted.
Accordingly, the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the Appropriation Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman for the financial year 2020. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance to publish the said draft bill in the Government Gazette and present the same thereafter in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Import Cargo Terminal Building at the Bandaranaiake International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-05
decision_details_body: -The Cabinet had granted approval at its meeting held on 2019‑05‑07 to commence the procurement process for the construction of the Stage 1 of the Import Cargo Terminal Building at the Bandaranaike International Airport. Accordingly, competitive bids have been called. The proposal made by the Minister of Tourism to award the said contract to M/s Nawaloka Construction Company (Pvt.) Ltd at a sum of Rs.2.37 billion, taking into consideration the recommendation made by the of Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 160,000 Pre-filled Syringes of Enoxaparin 	Sodium Injection, 4,000 IU in  0.4ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-05
decision_details_body:
-The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2020‑01‑08 granted approval to award the contract for the procurement of Pre-filled Syringes of Enoxaparin Sodium Injection used for the treatment of patients with heart diseases to M/s ABC Pharma Services (Pvt) Ltd. Accordingly, the relevant order has been issued to the supplier on 2020‑02‑24.

	However, it was later confirmed that there is a need for another 160,000 	syringes of the same drug. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of 	Health to award the procurement for the supply of 160,000 Pre-filled Syringes 	of Enoxaparin Sodium Injection 4,000 IU in 0.4ml to the same supplier, M/s 	ABC Pharna Services (Pvt) Ltd. as a repeat order at a sum of Rs. 126.96 	million as recommended by the  Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement 	Committee, 	was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Supply of Concentrated Monoclonal Purified and Detergent Treated Dried Factor VIII Fraction 200 IU - 350 IU Vials
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-05
decision_details_body: -The proposal made by the Minister of Health to award the procurement for the purchase of  85,000 vials of Concentrated Monoclonal Purified and Detergent Treated Dried Factor VIII Fraction 200 IU - 350 IU which is being used to treat Haemophilia patients for the year 2021, to  M/s Baxalta GmbH, Switzerland at a sum of  US$ 5.185 million with the total cost and freight, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed  Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Public Library Building Complex, Batticaloa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-05
decision_details_body: -The Cabinet has granted approval on 2018‑09‑11 to complete the ground floor work of the Public Library building belonging to the Batticaloa Municipal Council. Accordingly, National Competitive Bids have been called for the said construction.  The proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development and Housing to award the relevant contract to M/s Focus Marketing and Engineering Company (Pvt) Ltd. at a sum of Rs. 214.07 million (without VAT) as recommended by the  Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the relief measures granted in support of the Tourism Industry after COVID-19 Pandemic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-10-05
decision_details_body:
-In terms of the Cabinet approval granted, Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority has taken measures to allocate a provision of Rs. 186 million  for granting relief to the Tourist Guides and Tourist Drivers registered under the said Authority and have lost their livelihood due to COVID - 19 pandemic and  measures have been taken to grant relief for the Tourist Guides and Tourist Drivers from that amount. 

The proposal made by the Minister of Tourism, to grant the said relief measures also to the following groups engaged in the tourism sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

*  	Make a  one - off payment of Rs. 15,000 to each of the Tourist Drivers / Tourist Bus Drivers and Assistants / Tuk -Tuk (three wheelers) drivers and Safari vehicle drivers who were trained either under the supervision of the Sri Lanka Tourist Development Authority or any other Tourism Associations and applied for relief as at 2020‑08‑31.

* 	Make a one - Off payment of Rs. 20,000/- to each  Tourist Guide trained by the Provincial Councils and registered under Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority.
