Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Power & Energy for transferring the alternative lands provided for the construction of alternative residencies and buildings and for cultivation purposes for the displaced parties due to the construction of Upper Kotmale Hydro Power Plant, to the relevant beneficiaries through free grants, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the Project Completion Date of the Moragolla Hydropower Project and Extension of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) Loan Closing Date
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-22
decision_details_body: - The Moragolla Hydropower Project is being implemented under the Phase I of the Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme implemented by Asian Development Funds and due to delays in the implementation of the project, the loan closing date has been extended up to 2021‑03‑31. However, due to delays in the relevant procurement process, the project completion date and the loan closing date have to be revised further. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power & Energy to extend the project completion date of the Moragolla Hydropower Project up to 2023‑10‑31 and the loan closing date up to 2024‑07‑31, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulation of a mechanism to pay the Depositors who lost their money due to the irregularities of East Hewagam Korale Multipurpose Co operative Society Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-22
decision_details_body: - Since 2015, on five occasions, the Board of Directors of the East Hewagam Korale Multipurpose Co‑operative Society has invested Rs.507.59 million in Treasury Bills through a certain institution, which has been introduced as a primary buying company registered under the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. However, it has been revealed that the said institution is not a primary buyer company approved by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the depositors have been subjected to a severe injustice due to the inability to recover the relevant money up to date. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Internal Trade, Food Security and Consumer Welfare to appoint a committee comprising of the representatives of the relevant institutions to specifically identify the responsible parties for this incident and to recommend actions to be taken to bring justice to the depositors, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief measures to house holders affected by the water leaks of the Main Tunnel of the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-22
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development relating to the payment of the housing rent recommended by the Provincial Assessor further from 2019‑05‑31 up to 2020‑09‑30 for 46 families still living in rented houses out of the house owners affected by the water leakage in the main tunnel of the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project and to construct 118 new houses at another suitable location as a special project with the intervention of the Ministry in charge of the subject of Disaster Management for the families recommended to be evacuated due to the risk of landslides.

description: Rural Bridges Project - Extending the Project Period
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-22
decision_details_body: - 'The Rural Bridges Project' for the construction of 1,210 rural bridges has been implemented since 2013 under 03 Phases and under that, construction of 1318 bridges have been completed by July 2019. Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to extend the duration of the project until 2020‑08‑31, enabling to construct another 250 Rural Bridges under Phase II and another 230 Rural Bridges under Phase III of the project. However, the relevant contracts coming into full force and the implementation of the same have been delayed. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils & Local Government to extend the period of the contract agreements already signed for projects under Phase II and Phase III up to 2021‑05‑10 and 2021‑03‑05 respectively, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promotion of Biofilm Bio-fertilizer Island wide
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-22
decision_details_body: - A pilot project on the use of Biofilm Bio-fertilizer has been launched in the year 2018 under the directions of the National Institute of Fundamental Studies. Under the project, the said fertilizer has been introduced for the paddy cultivation in 3500 acres in Hambantota, Polonnaruwa, Kurunegala, Ampara and Mahiyanganaya. It has been expanded up to 4000 acres in the year 2019 and based on the successful results achieved through that, the fertilizer has been applied for of 15000 acres during the Yala season 2020 especially in the Kurunegala and Ampara districts. By next year, it is planned to increase the area under cultivation using this fertilizer up to 120,000 acres. Considering the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation, the Cabinet approval was granted to further expand and implement the program with a suitable mechanism in collaboration with the Department of Agriculture.

description: Manufacturing and marketing of innovative products developed by the Industrial Technology Institute (ITI) designed as an effort to prevent the COVID-19 Pandemic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-22
decision_details_body: - At the Cabinet meeting held on 2020‑04‑20, it was decided to explore the possibility of the Sri Lanka Ayurvedic Drugs Corporation to manufacture the innovative products developed by Industrial Technology Institute (ITI) and the ability to distribute such products through the sales outlets of the Co‑operative Wholesale Establishment and other appropriate Government Agencies as an effort to prevent the COVID-19 Pandemic. As such, the Cabinet noted the information submitted by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation that, the Institute of Industrial Technology has entered into an Agreement with the Sri Lanka Ayurvedic Corporation and agreed to provide the required raw materials for the manufacture of Alchohol based Herbal Gel Hand Sanitizer and Alcohol based Liquid Hand Sanitizer and its manufacturing methodology to the Sri Lanka Ayurvedic Corporation and the Co‑operative Wholesale Establishment has agreed to distribute the products through its sales outlets.

description: Further extension of benefits under the Agrahara Insurance Scheme operated for retired Public Officers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-22
decision_details_body:
- The officers who retired from the public service after 2016‑01‑01, have been provided an opportunity to join the Agrahara Insurance Scheme and enjoy its benefits. However, the majority of the retired officers have retired from the public service prior to 2016‑01‑01 and the unions of the said retired officers have made requests to grant them also an opportunity to join the Agrahara Insurance Scheme. Accordingly the approval was granted by the Cabinet to the joint proposal made by the Minister of Skills Development, Employment and Labour Relations and the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils & Local Government with regard to the extending of Agrahara benefits which is presently entitled to the public servants retired after 2016‑01‑01 also to the public servants retired prior to 2016‑01‑01, taking into consideration the concurrence given by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development.

	Further, the Cabinet granted approval for taking action, considering the proposals submitted by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development - 

* 	to prepare a suitable mechanism to maintain a separate ward in every leading Government hospital covering all the districts, for all public servants and the retired public servants enabling them to obtain high quality health care facilities under the Agrahara Insurance Scheme.
	
* 	to request the National Pay Commission to submit appropriate recommendations to rectify the pension anomalies since it has been observed that pension anomalies still exist among the officers who have retired from the public service.

description: Modernization and refurbishment of the Lumbini Theatre at Colombo 05
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-22
decision_details_body: - The existing facilities of the Lumbini Theatre, built in 1952, are not adequate and the sound control system, seating capacity and sanitation facilities of the theater have not been updated in a timely manner. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities to implement the project designed for the modernization and refurbishment of the Lumbini Theatre through the Urban Development Authority and to select a suitable contractor on Design and Build basis by following the National Competitive Procurement procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of City Beautification and Landscape Development Projects in Colombo and Sri Jayawardenapura Kotte
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-22
decision_details_body:
- The Urban Development Authority (UDA) has planed to implement the following City Beautification and Landscape Development Projects in Colombo and Sri Jayawardenapura Kotte with a view to improving the green environment of the area and providing environmentally and socially pleasing infrastructure facilities for tourists and general public.
			
i.	Galle Face surrounding Green Infrastructure Network Plan.

ii. 	Pedestrian Facility Center at Baladaksha Mawatha, Colombo 01.

iii. 	Urban Agricultural park at Kimbulawala, Talapathpitiya.

The proposal made by the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Housing Facilities regarding the implementation of the said projects through the Urban Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the period of the agreement of payment of salaries to private sector employees in the wake of COVID 19 pandemic situation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-15
decision_details_body: - As per the agreement entered into between the Employers, Employee Trade Unions and the Officers of the Ministry of Skills Development, Employment and Labour Relations, measures have been taken to pay either a 50% of the total salary obtained or an amount of Rs.14,500/- which is the advantageous amount for the employees of the establishments who had been asked to stay at home in the months of May and June 2020 due to the lack of work caused by the COVID 19 pandemic. The Minister of Skills Development, Employment and Labour Relations drew the attention of the Cabinet on the agreement entered into among the relevant parties for the continuation of the same procedure also for the period from July to September 2020 with regard to the payment of employee salaries.

description: Decade of Skills Development 2021-2030
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-15
decision_details_body: - It is imperative to obtain the participation of the youth as the active pioneers in the endeavour towards the sustainable development efforts for creating a peaceful and a just society and enhance their knowledge, skills and capabilities. For the purpose, the focus on the next generation youth skills development is given foremost attention in the national development agenda; ‘Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour’. Accordingly, the Cabinet concurred for the proposal submitted by H.E. the President for declaring the period from 2021 – 2030 as the ‘ Decade of Skills Development’ of Sri Lanka, expecting to transform the General Education, Higher Education and Professional Education and Vocational Education sectors in order to reduce the population of the unskilled labour to 10% thereby making Sri Lanka the epicentre for human resource development in Asia and with future-fit citizenry who will drive the development agenda of the country.

description: Media Reports published pertaining to the extraction of high quality Ilmenite in the coastal belt in Mannar
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-15
decision_details_body: - The Minister of Industries and Supply Chain Management drew the attention of the Cabinet to a report published in a daily English newspaper indicating that explorations are being conducted pertaining to a project for extracting Illmenite in the coastal belt of the Mannar island in terms to an Agreement entered into between an Australian Company and a local company and such activities are to be expanded in future and also regarding a project report being circulated in the web in this regard. The Minister further stated that the institutions responsible for granting permission for any type of exploration have not given such permission for this purpose. The Cabinet having considered these facts, decided to appoint an Officials' Committee, to study relating to this matter and submit a comprehensive report on the measures to be taken.

description: Sri Lanka Biotechnology Innovation Park (SLBIP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-15
decision_details_body:
- The project for the establishment of the Sri Lanka Bio Technology Innovation Park and the Sri Lanka Bio Technology Institute, with the objective of promoting high-tech exports and encouraging the substitute productions of such imports has been designed to implement in stages. The objective of this project is to facilitate the creation of a favourable environment required to work collectively for the biotech companies and biotech researchers to convert their ideas into commercial products. The International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB) an affiliated entity of the United Nations' Organization has selected Sri Lanka as the Regional Research Centre for South Asia to work in collaboration with the proposed Sri Lanka Bio Technology Institute. Under this, the Organization has given its consent to transfer the technology for the manufacture of 10 biologics including insulin and the growth hormones immediately creating favourable grounds for Sri Lanka.

Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the joint proposal submitted by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development and the Minister of Higher Education, technology and Innovation, for the establishment of a Biotechnology Innovation park and to construct the 'BiotechnoPlex' building in a land in extent of 13.2 acres situated in Aramawatte, Pitipana, Homagama and to appoint a Monitoring Committee co-chaired by the Secretary to the Treasury and the Secretary to the Ministry of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation and a Technical Committee comprising of the experts of the relevant field to take the future steps relating to same and to allocate provisions required for the said project.

description: Conducting feasibility studies for the establishment of High-Tech Universities targeting job market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-15
decision_details_body: - The Asian Development Bank has extended their concurrence to grant assistance to conduct the feasibility studies applicable to establish 10 District High - Tech Universities targeting the expansion of Information Technology, Engineering Technology and Bio Technology opportunities as indicated in the Vistas of Prosperity Development Approach. Accordingly, the Cabinet considered the information submitted by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation that necessary actions have been taken by the University Grants Commission for the commencement of the initial feasibility study process in relation to the 10 districts of Nuwara-Eliya, Kalutara, Hambantota, Matale, Puttalam, Mannar, Mullaitivu, Galle, Polonnaruwa and Kegalle.

description: Paddy Purchasing Programme for Yala 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-15
decision_details_body: - A programme has been planned for the purchase of paddy through the Paddy Marketing Board with the participation of the District Secretaries / Government Agents, Divisional Secretaries and other Government officials at regional and rural level since the harvesting for the Yala season 2020 is scheduled to commence from the second week of July. Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the proposal submitted by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development to implement the proposed programme to purchase paddy under a certified price of Rs.50/- per kg for quality paddy of Samba, Naadu and Kiri Samba categories while a certified price of Rs.42/- per kg for wet paddy, subject to a maximum of 5,000kg of paddy from a farmer according to the extent of land been cultivated by him.

description: Amending the procurement guidelines to support Domestic Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-15
decision_details_body:
- It has been observed that, although provisions are included for domestic preference in the Government Procurement Guidelines, the possibility to achieve benefits for the domestic suppliers and companies from those provisions is limited. Under the COVID-19 pandemic situation, domestic companies and entrepreneurs seek more assistance from the Government to carry out their business activities. Taking this matter also into consideration, it has been found that the following domestic preferences are suitable to be provided to the sectors such as furniture and allied appliances, software and hardware and constructions which have been identified as domestic industries that can create more value addition with employment generation. Accordingly, the Cabinet of Ministers approved the following proposals submitted by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development to define the companies with at least 51% of its ownership with Sri Lankan citizens as domestic companies when procuring goods and services for Government Institutions and provide opportunities for domestic preference for a period of 05 years.
(i) 	Procurement of the required office furniture and allied appliances only through domestic producers, where the value addition will be at least 50%.

(ii) 	Procurement of all the software requirement only from domestic companies and in case of failure to do so, such procurement to be carried out from non local companies, only with the approval of the Information and Communication Technology Agency of Sri Lanka and the General Treasury.

(iii) 	Specifications pertaining to the hardware required for the Government institutions will be formulated by the Information and Communication Technology Agency of Sri Lanka and if any institution is able to provide 25% value addition, such institution will be provided a selection of 30% preference in the procurement evaluation process.

(iv) 	All constructions including housing, roads, irrigation, water supply and sewage systems should be undertaken by the domestic contractors and if sub contracts are to be given for foreign contractors, such contracts should not be more than 10% of the contract price excluding provisional funds.

(v) 	To pursue action as above mentioned, to issue the amended procurement guidelines in consultations with the National Procurement Commission.

description: Entering into a Host Country Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the International Council for Agroforestry (ICRAF)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-15
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Minister of Environment and Wildlife Resources to enter into a Host Country Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the International Council for Agroforestry (ICRAF) to obtain the international scientific, technical and financial support required to empower Sri Lanka, to face the adverse effects of climate change,was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief to electricity consumers for the payment of electricity bills during the period from March to May 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-15
decision_details_body:
- The report of the Committee, appointed by the Minister of Power & Energy to submit recommendations on the relief measures that can be provided to the consumers for electricity bills relating to the period from March to May, 2020 due to the Covid-19 pandemic situation, was taken up for discussion at the Cabinet meeting held on the 2020 07 08. The Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development was requested to further study the recommendations of the Committee by the officials of the General Treasury and submit proposals on possible relief measures that can be given to the electricity consumers.

Accordingly, the Cabinet approved the following proposals submitted by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development.

(i)	To charge an amount equivalent to the electricity bill of the month of February for each month of March, April and May, if the amount of each bill for the month of March, April and May is higher than that of the month of February and grant a period of 2 months to settle such bills.

(ii) 	To take action by the Ceylon Electricity Board to set-off the overpaid amount to the customers who have already paid their bills for the months of March, April and May when issuing bills for them in future.
 
(iii) 	To temporally suspend electricity disconnection due to the delays in settling the electricity bills.

description: The Contract for the Supply and Delivery of 1,500 km Arial Bundle Conductor Alu
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-15
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Power & Energy, to award the contract for the Supply and Delivery of 1,500km Arial Bundle Conductor for 02 distribution divisions of the Ceylon Electricity Board, to M/s Sierra Cables PLC, Sri Lanka, to a sum of Rs.900.50 million (excluding VAT), as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of additional 50% of cargo quantity of the on-going Gasoline   (92 Unl) term contract
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-15
decision_details_body: - The term contract for the purchase of 1,800,000 barrels of Gasoline (92 Unl) for a period of 09 months from 2020 01 15 to 2020 10 14 has been awarded to the M/s Vitol Asia Pte. Ltd., Singapore. The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Power & Energy, to purchase a stock equivalent to 50% of the ongoing contract under the same terms and conditions, as a repeat order in terms of the provisions of 3.6 of the procurement guidelines, as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee.

description: Procurement for the Supply of Balloon Dilatation Catheter
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-15
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical Services to award the procurement for the supply of 40 types of Balloon Dilatation Catheters, which are used for the treatment of heart patients, to M/s Ceegeez Associates, to a total cost of Rs.207.74 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief for the payment of electricity bills of the electricity consumers for the period from March to May 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-08
decision_details_body: - The income of those employed in various sectors had collapsed since the people of the country had to stay at home for the period from March to May 2020 due to the Covid-19 pandemic situation. Considering this situation, the Minister of Power and Energy has appointed a Committee to submit recommendations including proposals pertaining to the concessions to be granted on the electricity bills. Accordingly, the report submitted by the said Committee was presented to the Cabinet by the Minister of Power and Energy. The Cabinet decided to request the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development to submit his proposals to the next Cabinet meeting on the concessions that can be granted to the general public after a further study by the Officials of the General Treasury on the recommendations of the said report .

description: Procurement of Chemical Fertilizer - 2020 - Maha Season (August Delivery)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-08
decision_details_body:
- International competitive bids have been invited for the procurement of fertilizer for the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Ltd (Lak Pohora) and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Ltd (Commercial Fertilizer) for the requirement of fertilizer during the month of August 2020. The Cabinet having considered the recommendation made by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee with regard to the said prices, the covering approval was granted to the proposal made by Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development for awarding the procurement for the supply of fertilizer as follows:
*	To procure 60,000 + 5% metric tons of Urea (Granular) from Midgulf International Ltd for a sum of US $ 241.90 per metric ton.

*	To procure 15,000 + 5% metric tons of Triple Super Phosphate from Swiss Singapore Overseas Enterprises pte. Ltd for a sum of US $ 239.00 per metric ton.

description: Rural Bridges Project - Construction of Rural Bridges - Phase II (618 Bridges) and Phase III (490 Bridges)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-08
decision_details_body: - It has been scheduled to construct 537 bridges with the funds from the United Kingdom under Phase II of the Rural Bridges Project, and 463 bridges with the funds 	from Netherlands under Phase III of the project. However, action has been taken to build another 81and 27 bridges including rural bridges affected by the floods in the 	year 2017 at the same rates. Accordingly, taking into consideration the contract 	variations caused by the essential repairs in the flood affected areas, the proposal 	made by the Minister of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils & 	Local Government to revise the agreed contract value of Great Britain Pound (GBP) 100 million of Phase II of Rural Bridges Project to GBP 114.19 million and the agreed contract value of Euro 105 million of Phase III of the same to Euro 105.25 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for the establishment of 	Education and Research between the University of Ruhuna and the Guizhou Academy of Sciences, China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-08
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into an MoU on education and research activities between the University of Ruhuna and Guizhou Academy of Science in China. By this proposed MoU it is anticipated to share information identified between the two parties, to collaborate in earning research funding and to initiate activities for the joint undergraduate/postgraduate courses. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation to sign the said MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Hostel, Work Shop and a Canteen for the University of Vocational Technology (UNIVOTEC), Rathmalana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-08
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2017.01.03 has granted approval for the construction of three separate buildings for a hostel, workshop and a canteen for the University of Vocational Technology, Rathmalana under an estimated cost of Rs.927.34 million. Nevertheless, taking into consideration the facts that the proposed 	land for the construction of the buildings is a marshy land very close to the Weressa river, the necessity of utilizing the land effectively for future needs and the need to pile separately for the three buildings, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation to build a 06 storied building instead of 03 buildings within the same estimated financial limits, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of contract for the construction of the proposed building complex (Stage 2) for the Faculty of Technology, Wayamba University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation to award the contract for the construction of the proposed building complex (Stage2) for the Faculty of Technology, Wayamba University of Sri Lanka to M/s Sathuta Builders (Pvt.) Ltd. located in Kurunegala at a sum of Rs. 1560.36 million (without VAT), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading the Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute into a full-fledge University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-08
decision_details_body: - The Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute, currently functioning as an institute of higher education affiliated to the University of Kelaniya under the purview of University Grants Commission offers Bachelor degrees and Postgraduate degrees in Ayurveda and allied sciences. Under the policy frame work “Vistas of Prosperity” the said institute has been identified to be upgraded into a full-fledge university. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation to upgrade the Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute as a university giving priority on the study of traditional indigenous medicine of the country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 6,000 vials of Rituximab Injection 100mg/10ml vial and 6, 500 vials of Rituximab Injection 500mg/50ml vial
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-08
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Healthcare and Indigenous Medical Services to award the procurement for the purchase of 6,000 vials of Rituximab Injection 100mg/10ml Vial and 6,500 vials of Rituximab Injection 500mg/50ml vial, the vaccines used to treat for certain types of cancers, to M/s Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited, at a total sum of US $ 739,720.00, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee.

description: Proposed agreement between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan on transferring Sentenced Persons
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-08
decision_details_body: - The Transfer of Offenders Act No.5 of 1995 contains provisions to enable a citizen of a foreign country who is convicted and sentenced to imprisonment by a court in Sri Lanka to serve his sentence in the country of which he claims to be a citizen and a Sri Lankan who is subjected to such a punishment in a foreign country to be transferred back to Sri Lanka to serve the period of imprisonment in this country. In order to give effect to these provisions, Sri Lanka should enter into an agreement with the relevant country. Accordingly, the Cabinet of Ministers approved the proposal presented by the Minister of Justice, Human Rights and Law Reforms to sign an agreement between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan so as to transfer of sentenced persons other than those who are accused and convicted for terrorist activities and drug trafficking.

description: Disposal of Beedie Leaves Forfeited by the Sri Lanka Customs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-08
decision_details_body: - Previously, the stocks of beedie leaves brought to Sri Lanka without formal approval were forfeited by the Sri Lanka Customs and were sold by public auction having followed the customs procedure. However, considering the adverse health impact caused to those who consume beedie manufactured by using such beedie leaves, the Cabinet decided to destroy the stock of beedie leaves forfeited by Sri Lanka Customs, in future.

description: Providing training opportunities for Foreign Officers in the Defence Services Command and Staff College
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-08
decision_details_body: - Since the year 2009, opportunities are also provided for the Foreign Military Officers to follow the courses on gratis basis and payment basis, in the Defence Services Command and Staff College, which provides training courses to the Middle Grade Officers in the Tri-Forces and Sri Lanka Police as well as Executive Officers in Government Institutions. Accordingly, 12 training opportunities on payment basis and 30 training opportunities on gratis basis have already been given for the officers representing the Asian, Middle East, European and African countries. As such, the proposal made by H.E the President to grant one training opportunity on gratis basis and one training opportunity on payment basis to Singapore as well from 2021 onward, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The necessity of transferring lands considered as 'other State forests' to the District Secretaries/Divisional Secretaries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-01
decision_details_body: - The administration of the lands identified as 'other State forests' and not being managed by the Department of Forests or the Department of Wildlife Conservation, but being managed by the Divisional Secretaries has been brought under the purview of the Department of Forests in terms of the provisions of the Circular No.05/2001 dated 2001 08 10 issued by the Secretary to the then Ministry of Wildlife and Environment. Farmers engaged in chena cultivation in the said 'other State forests' have encountered severe hardships since a lengthy procedure has to be followed when using such lands for other purposes in accordance with the provisions of the said Circular which has resulted in an impediment to the use of such lands for economically productive purposes. This matter was taken up for consideration by the Cabinet and it was decided to request the Minister of Environment and Wildlife Resources to look into this matter and submit a suitable mechanism to the Cabinet to transfer the powers for the purpose to the District Secretaries/ Divisional Secretaries enabling to use of the 'other State forests' temporarily for any other purposes while retaining the ownership of the said lands further with the Government, without causing harm to the forest environment and wildlife activities.

description: Ruwanpura Expressway
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-01
decision_details_body: - The present Government's policy statement 'Vistas of Prosperity' has proposed the construction of 	Ruwanpura Expressway linking the Southern Expresswayfrom 	Kahathuduwa - Ingiriya- Ratnapura - Pelmadulla. Although the project is planned to be implemented with foreign funds, it has been found that the	implementation of the project under the 	local funds to be more beneficial to the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Roads and	Highways, to take appropriate measures for the construction of the Expressway utilizing the funds of local banks and with the services of local construction	companies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Final Report of the Committee Appointed to Review the Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC) Compact Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-01
decision_details_body: - The Committee headed by Prof. Lalithasiri Gunaruwan appointed to review and submit recommendations on proposed Agreement to be signed with the Millennium	Challenge Corporation has submitted its final report. Accordingly, Hon. Prime	Minister presented the same to the Cabinet and it was decided to seek the views of	all members of the Cabinet on the recommendations of the said Report.

description: Aviation insurance renewal and placement for the period 2020/2021 of SriLankan Airlines Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-01
decision_details_body: - Aviation insurance is a mandatory requirement for airline operations and in the year 2018 with the Cabinet approval, SriLankan Airlines Limited has obtained the insurance coverage from the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Limited. The insurance cover has to be renewed annually and the Standard Technical Evaluation Committee of the SriLankan Airlines has recommended that the insurance coverage for the year 2020/2021 be obtained from the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation itself. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Civil Aviation to obtain the relevant insurance coverage from Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation for a sum of US$ 4.05 million was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the Consultancy Service Contract with the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) on Consultancy Services for the construction of the Broadlands Hydropower Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-01
decision_details_body: - The Consultancy Services Contract for the construction of the Broadlands Hydropower Project has been assigned to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau. Although, the project was scheduled to be completed on 2017 07 14, it could not be completed as expected due to public protests, delays in releasing the land, change of the equipment manufacturer and delay in executing the loan agreement. Therefore, the contract period of the existing Consultancy Service Contract with the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau is required to be extended. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Power & Energy to extend the said Consultancy Service Contract up to 2020 07 31 as recommended by the Standing Cabinet 	Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reopening Project of Production Processes of the Oddusudan Factory under Restructuring of the Ceylon Ceramics Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-01
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet was granted on 2020 02 05 to make necessary arrangements for reopening the production process of the Brick and Tile Factory of Oddusudan coming under the purview of the Ceylon Ceramics Corporation together with Sampson Rajarata Tiles (Pvt.) Ltd. Nevertheless, the Ceylon Ceramics Corporation has already renovated the said factory with a view to reopening the same and further, it has been planned to commence its production process without the participation of any private entity in the future. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Small & Medium Business and Enterprise Development and Minister of Industries and Supply Chain Management to carry out its production activities by the Ceylon Ceramics Corporation itself without the participation of a private investor, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the period of the loan pertaining to the Asian Development Bank funded Northern Road Connectivity Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-01
decision_details_body: - Renovation of National Highways and Provincial Roads and newly construction of new selected bridges of the Northern and North Central Provinces are being carried out under the Asian Development Bank funded Northern Road Connectivity Project. For this purpose funds up to US$ 98 million are provided by the Asian Development Bank. Two (02) additional contract packages of the Medavachchiya - Horowpathatna road have been awarded in the month of March 2019 out of the savings of the loan. Although it has been scheduled to complete the construction activities of the said project before the 2020 06 30 which was the loan closing date it has not been possible to complete the same. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Roads and Highways to extend the period of the relevant loan up to 2020 12 31, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing an opportunity to buy chemical fertilizer used for paddy, for other agricultural activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-01
decision_details_body: - Under the fertilizer subsidized programme implemented at present, fertilizer is issued for paddy cultivations up to 05 acres while the fertilizer required for the lands exceeding the said extent should be purchased from the open market. Under these circumstances, a shortage of fertilizer used for other crops has been created in the open market since the demand for fertilizer has been increased due to the escalation of the extent of land under cultivation especially as a result of COVID 19 pandemic situation. Therefore, the Cabinet of Ministers noted the information furnished by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development on the action taken for purchasing stocks of remaining fertilizer with the state fertilizer companies imported under the fertilizer subsidized programme for paddy cultivation, by the Agrarian Development Centres and selling a bag of fertilizer of 50kg to a sum of Rs.1000/- to the farmers so that the farmers can purchase the fertilizer stocks required without creating any issues to the government.

description: Establishment of the Ministry of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development in the 'Govijana Mandiraya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-01
decision_details_body: - Necessary actions have been taken by now to re establish the Ministry of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development in the 'Govijana Mandiraya' in terms of the approval granted by the Cabinet of Ministers on 2019 12 18. However, the layout of the building should be re arranged to and the electricity supply system should be renovated to establish the Ministry and carry out its functions. Therefore, the Cabinet of Ministers approved the proposal submitted by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development for the direct awarding of the contract for the consultancy services relevant to the said renovation activities to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) and the contract for the construction activities to the Central Engineering Services (Pvt) Limited since the relevant activities should be attended urgently.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer - 2020 (for the month of July)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-01
decision_details_body:
- International competitive bids have been invited for the procurement of fertilizer for the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Ltd (Lak Pohora) and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Ltd. (Commercial Fertilizer) for the requirement of fertilizer during the month of July 2020. The Cabinet having considered the recommendation made by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee with regard to the said prices, the covering approval was granted to the proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development for awarding the procurement of fertilizer supply as mentioned follows:

*	To procure 9,000 + 5% metric tons of Urea (Granular) from Agri Commodities & Finance FZE for a sum of US$ 260.00 per metric ton.

*	To procure 6,000 + 5% metric tons of Triple Super Phosphate from Aries Fertilizer Group Pvt. Ltd., for a sum of US$ 249.07 per metric ton.

description: Purchase of Food Items to the Department of Prisons for the year 2019/2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-01
decision_details_body: - Although the contract to procure food items to the Department of Prisons for the year 2019 / 2020 is due to be expired on 2020 07 31, it has not been able to carry out the procurement procedure for the selection of new suppliers as a result of the COVID 19 pandemic condition. Therefore, considering the present situation experienced by the country as well as the current market conditions, the Cabinet of Ministers approved the proposal furnished by the Minister of Justice, Human Rights and Legal Reforms for awarding the contract for the purchase of food items required by the Department of Prisons to the current supplier itself from 2020 08 01 to 2021 01 31, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee.

description: Obtaining Provisions for the payment of salaries to the employees of the Central Cultural Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-01
decision_details_body: - The Central Cultural Fund has encountered a grave financial crisis by now and it has led to difficulties in bearing the salaries of the employees and other expenditure. Therefore, the request made by the said Fund for obtaining a provision of Rs.135 million monthly under the prevailing circumstances was brought into the notice of the Cabinet by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddhasasana, Cultural and Religious Affairs. Accordingly, the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers was granted to facilitate in obtaining a Short Term Loan grant from a local bank with the intervention of the General Treasury as a remedy to the issues confronted by the aforementioned Fund and to make necessary arrangement for the settlement of the said loan increasing the income of the Central Cultural Fund once tourism is restored in the country in the time to come.

description: Loans, Grants and material assistance received by the Government of Sri Lanka (GOSL) in support of COVID 19 response initiatives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-07-01
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet of Ministers considered the information furnished by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development in relation to the contributions received during the period up to 2020 06 12 as loans, grants and material assistance by the Government of Sri Lanka from several countries and international organizations for the initial steps to be taken in relation to the control of the global pandemic conditions of COVID 19.

Accordingly, the World Bank has agreed to provide US$ 128.6 million for the Sri Lanka COVID 19 Emergency Response and Health Systems Preparedness Project while another US$ 45 million to be provided under the Social Security Network Project.

It was brought to the attention of the Cabinet of Ministers that US$ 57.5 million out of the agreed amount under the Sri Lanka COVID 19 Emergency Response and Health Systems Preparedness Project as well as the total amount of provision of US$ 45 million agreed under the Social Security Network Project have been received to the country by now.

In addition to that, the Cabinet of Ministers noted that the donations to the value of approximately US$ 75 million and another stock of material assistance to the value of about US$ 8 million too have been received by the Government up to the above mentioned date.

description: Approval for the restriction of foreign exchange outflows from the country and to issue orders on the foreign exchange deposit account
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-24
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet of Ministers at its meeting held on 01st April 2020 granted approval to temporally suspend certain outward remittances for a period of three (03) months, and accordingly, the relevant Order was issued by the Gazette Notification dated 02nd April 2020 as per the provisions of the section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act.

Further, approval of the Cabinet of Ministers was granted at the meeting held on 22nd April 2020 for taking necessary measures to encourage the remittance of foreign currency to the country through Special Deposit Accounts.

In terms of the said Cabinet decisions, relevant Regulations were issued under sections 22 and 29 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017 by the Gazette Notifications 02.04.2020 and 08.04.2020 respectively. 

Furthermore, the Cabinet of Ministers approved the following proposals submitted by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development for taking measures applicable to the said Orders.

* 	Extending the period of the Gazette Notification relating to the Orders applicable to the restrictions of the outward remittances by another six (06) months from 02nd July 2020.



*	Issuance of a new Gazette Notification amending the existing Gazette Notification dated 08.04.2020 relating to the Regulations made under section 29 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No.12 of 2017 in order to address constrains prevailing due to the provisions in the laws applicable to Foreign Exchange Act and Anti-Money laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism when implementing the methodologies introduced for encouraging the remittance of foreign exchange into the country through the Special Deposit Account.

description: Tax Relief Measures to Facilitate Post COVID 19 Economic Recovery
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-24
decision_details_body:
- A simple, transparent and efficient tax system was introduced to all stakeholders in the economy including Small and Medium Entrepreneurs by the Cabinet decision dated 26th of November 2019 on the Note to the Cabinet on 'Economic Revival Initiatives' submitted by His Excellency the President. Since the economy is facing a drastic challenge consequent to the COVID-19 pandemic, it has been an essential factor to implement tax administrative measures by giving sufficient space to commence the business operations of especially the Small and Medium Scale Entrepreneurs to ease their tax burden.

Accordingly, Cabinet approval was granted by its decision dated 2020-06-03 to exempt the penalty relating to all type of taxes during the COVID-19 lockdown period and to re‑commence the collection of the penalty for late payments from July 2020. 

Apart from that the Cabinet of Ministers approved the proposal submitted by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic and Policy Development in regard to providing the following relief measures also to the Small and Medium Scale Entrepreneurs, to amend the legal provisions accordingly and to implement the proposed relief measures with immediate effect until such time the legal provisions are operative. 

*	If the Commissioner General of Inland Revenue is satisfied that no willful evasion of the payment of tax has been taken place, to waive off the income tax in arrears payable on the assessment issued up to the assessment year 2018 / 2019.

*	Non‑issuance of additional assessments for the assessment year 2019 / 2020 in regard to the Small and Medium Scale Entrepreneurs who paid tax by submitting income tax reports. 
*	Extension of the period provided for the submission of the bank guarantee or the non‑refundable cash payment required to be made when submitting an appeal to the Tax Appeals Commission.
*	Granting a grace period to settle the taxes that have already been agreed upon with the Department of Inland Revenue in arrears / default. 
*	Suspending the implementation of the seizure notices issued to the banks until 30th April 2021.
*	Enable the payment or / obtaining of tax reports of a particular tax applicable for the period of 01st March 2020 to 30th June 2020, on the 31st December 2020 or prior to that, and to treat that the relevant payment of tax / submission the report was done on the due date.

description: Extension of Contract between the Ceylon Shipping Corporation (CSC) and M/s United Shippers Limited on Lightering (Barging) for Discharging of Coal from ships to the jetty of the Lakvijaya Coal Power Plant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-24
decision_details_body: - The contract agreement between the Ceylon Shipping Corporation and the M/s United Shippers Ltd of India for disembarkation of coal from barges from the ships to Lakwijaya Coal Power Plant has expired from April 2020. Therefore, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping and the Minister of Power and Energy to extend the said contract agreement for a further period of one year until 2020/2021, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of an arrangement for the proper distribution of chemical fertilizer among farmers required for other crops excluding paddy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-24
decision_details_body:
- The Ministry of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development has implemented several programmes namely ‘Sawbagye Gewaththa’ and the programme for cultivation of 16 identified field crops within 88,000 hectares so as to avoid the possible inconveniences with regard to the food security due to the restrictive factors imposed on the imports and exports consequent to the COVID - 19 global pandemic situation. Therefore in this context, having informed of the programme expected to be implemented along with the following by the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development for the distribution of chemical fertilizer through a rational arrangement without any shortage to the cultivators of other crops except paddy, the Cabinet of Ministers noted the said contents. 

* 	Encouraging to use organic fertilizer for the small scale agricultural cultivations including ‘Sawbagye Gewaththa’ while providing an opportunity to buy less than 10 kilograms of chemical fertilizer from the market only if required.

*	Providing 50% of the required amount of fertilizer ration approved for non‑ paddy crops from the open market while the remaining 50% to be issued through the Agrarian Development Centres.

* 	Providing the chemical fertilizer subsidy required for the vegetable, fruit, and other agricultural cultivations implemented under the supervision of the Department of Agriculture, Provincial Agriculture Departments and the Sri Lanka Mahaweli Authority through the Agrarian Development Centres.
 * Preparation of a methodology to obtain the fertilizer required for the cultivators from the open market based on a receipt issued by the Agricultural Research and Production Assistant when there are no required stocks of fertilizer at the Agrarian Development Centres or when it is apparent to have delays in the required stocks.

description: Awarding the contract for the construction of buildings and infrastructure facilities of the Faculty of Computing and Technology of the University of Kelaniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation to award the contract for the construction of the buildings and infrastructure facilities of the Faculty of Computing and Technology of the University of Kelaniya under the 'Science and Technology Human Resources Development Project' implemented through funds of the Asian Development Bank (ADB), to a sum of Rs 3,032.70 million (without VAT), to M/s Maga - ICC Joint Venture, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relief measures taken by the Ministry of Foreign Relations and the Sri Lanka Missions abroad to address the issues related to vulnerable segments of Overseas Sri Lankans amidst the COVID-19 Global Pandemic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-24
decision_details_body:
- Minister of Foreign Affairs presented the following measures taken by the Ministry of Foreign Relations and the Sri Lanka Missions abroad to address the issues related to the vulnerable segments of overseas Sri Lankans amidst the COVID-19 Global Pandemic to the attention of the Cabinet.

* 52,401 Sri Lankans in 117 countries have made requests to be repatriated to Sri Lanka by June 16, 2020. 

* The Presidential Secretariat together with the COVID Task Force by now, have facilitated in repatriating to Sri Lanka more than 9,580 Sri Lankans from 38 countries.

*	Further, Ten flights have been scheduled from 24th June to 7th July to repatriate Sri Lankans from 10 other countries.

*	Over Rs. 42.6 million have been disbursed to the Sri Lanka Missions abroad for providing dry rations, basic medicines, protective gears and safe transportation to vulnerable segments in the Middle East and other locations.

*	Steps have been taken to dispatch 5,000 packs worth Rs. 15.5 million containing dry rations and medicines to Maldives, UAE and Qatar where there is a shortage of goods and difficulty in purchasing dry rations.

* 	Diplomatic representations are made by the Sri Lanka Missions on behalf of the Sri Lankans overseas pertaining to their needs and maintain continuous contact with the said Sri Lankans.

*	Necessary measures have been taken to provide the required services from the nearest Sri Lankan Diplomatic Missions to the Sri Lankans living in countries where the Sri Lankan Missions are not functioning. 


*	Measures are being taken by the Sri Lankan Diplomatic Missions to identify new markets and increase the demand in existing markets in order to mitigate the economic impact to Sri Lanka of the global pandemic and to revive the economy.

description: Further increase of the Financing Assistance from the International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank Group (WBG) agreed to be made for COVID-19 Emergency Response
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-24
decision_details_body:
- The International Development Association of the World Bank Group has agreed for the use of US$ 60 million of uncommitted funds, of the following projects funded by the International Development Association (IDA) to fund for the programs targeted at COVID-19 affected social segments.

* 	Transport Connectivity and Asset Management Project
* 	Ecosystem conservation and management Project
*	Climate Smart Irrigated Agriculture Project

	Further, The International Development Association (IDA) has agreed to provide US$ 05 million from the Transitional Support Facility of the International Development Association and US$ 1.72 million grant from the Pandemic Emergency Financing Facility. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development to obtain the said funds was approved by the Cabinet of Ministers on June 3, 2020.

	Subsequently, the International Development Association (IDA) has agreed to provide an additional US$ 22.24 million under the Transitional Support Credit Facility. Accordingly, the Cabinet of Ministers approved the proposal presented by Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economy and Policy Development to increase the total amount of funds to be obtained up to US$ 87.24 million and to utilize these funds for social security measures targeting the adversely affected segments of the society due to the COVID‑19 outbreak.

description: Financing the projects implemented by the Road Development Authority and the National Water Supply and Drainage Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-24
decision_details_body: - Construction activities of Section II of the Central Expressway Project are being carried out at present while measures have been taken to initiate the construction works of the section I of the same. Further, the project activities for the rehabilitation of roads in extent of 100,000km has commenced and are being carried out at present. Accordingly, the Road Development Authority has to secure an amount of Rs. 50 billion in order to make payments relating to the projects carried out by the said Authority. In addition to that, an amount of Rs. 30 billion is also required to settle the essential financial commitments pertaining to the projects undertaken by the National Water supply and Drainage Board. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic and Policy Development to authorize the relevant authorities of the two institutions to obtain funds from the local banks including Bank of Ceylon, People's Bank and National Savings Bank and to issue the Treasury Guarantees for the purpose was approved by the Cabinet .

description: Granting the Strategic Project Development Status and incentives for the proposed investment in Colombo Port City by CHEC Port City Colombo (Private) Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-17
decision_details_body: - A Tri-Partite agreement has been signed in August 2016 between the Government of Sri Lanka, the Urban Development Authority and the locally incorporated CHEC Port City Colombo (Pvt.) Ltd. and accordingly actions have been taken to reclaim 440 hectares of land under the said project. In terms of the provisions of the relevant agreement, an extent of 116 hectares of land from the said extent has to be leased to the Project Company CHEC Port City Colombo (Pvt.) Ltd. Accordingly, the said Company has submitted a proposal to the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka to implement a mixed development project comprising of 05 pillars / buildings in an area of 6.8 hectares out of the extent of land proposed to be given on lease. The project with an investment of US$ 01 billion is proposed to be implemented in two phases comprised of first phase for US$ 400 million and the second phase for US$ 600 million. Considering the strategic importance and the magnitude of the project, the Cabinet of Ministers approved the proposal submitted by the Minister of Industrial Exports and Investment Promotion for the publication of relevant Gazette Notifications under the Strategic Development Projects Act, enabling to provide incentive allowances relevant for the said investments in terms of the provisions of the Strategic Development Projects (Amendment) Act, No.14 of 2008 and the Sri Lanka Board of Investment (Amendment) Act, No.4 of 1978.

description: Temporary suspension of the Tea Promotion and Marketing Levy imposed on the tea exports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-17
decision_details_body: Continuous maintenance of the operational activities of tea factories, relative decline of the procurement power of most of the countries that import tea, supply chain management issues as well as continuous maintenance of quality in the products are the major issues that were faced by the tea industry amidst the COVID 19 pandemic conditions, prevailing within the country at present. Therefore, the Cabinet of Ministers has approved the proposal forwarded by the Minister of Plantation Industries and Export Agriculture to temporarily suspend the tea promotion and marketing tax of  Rs.3.50 already charged on each kilogram of tea exported from the registered exporters, for a period of 06 months as a financial relief granted to stabilize the tea industry amidst the said difficulties.

description: Procurement for the supply of Full Cream Milk Powder to the Sri Lanka Thriposha Limited for the Production of Thriposha for the year 2020/2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-17
decision_details_body: - With the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers, Milco (Pvt.) Ltd. has been awarded the contract for  supplying milk powder required for the manufacturing of Thriposha from the year 2014 to 2019 with the objective of strengthening the economy of the local dairy farmers. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal submitted by the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medical Services for the procurement of 720 metric tons of full cream milk powder required for the production of Thriposha for the year 2020 / 2021 for Sri Lanka Thriposha Ltd., the Cabinet granted approval to procure the said quantity of milk powder from Milco (Pvt.) Ltd. itself.

description: Japanese Yen 800 million Non project Japanese Grant Aid of for supplying medical equipment required for COVID 19 pandemic prevention activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-17
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan has agreed to provide Japanese Yen 800 million (approximately Rs. 1,360 million) under the Japanese non‑project grant scheme for the supply of medical equipment required for strengthening the activities pertaining to the prevention of COVID-19 pandemic situation within Sri Lanka. Medical equipment such as MRI Scanner, CT Scanner, Bedside X‑Ray Systems, Central Monitors, Bedside Monitors and Defibrillators etc. can be supplied under that. Accordingly, the proposal made by the the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic and Policy Development to obtain the said grant aid as well as to sign the relevant agreements in this regard was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the period of contract awarded to the State Printing Corporation for printing and supplying new Lottery "Daru Diri Sampatha" drawn by the National Lotteries Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-17
decision_details_body: The agreement period of the contract awarded to the State Printing Corporation for the printing of the "Daru Diri Sampatha" lottery ticket by the National Lotteries Board with the objective of raising funds for the "Save the children National Trust Fund" has expired on 12.05.2020. However, the procurement procedure commenced for selecting a suitable printer after the said contract period has not yet been completed due to Corona pandemic. Therefore, the proposal made by  the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic and Policy Development to extend the contract awarded to the State Printing Corporation for the printing of lottery tickets, for a further period of 06 months from 2020.05.13 to 2020.11.12, so as to get the work done by the State Printing Corporation itself under the previously agreed  specifications and price, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resources Development Scholarship Programme - 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-17
decision_details_body: - The Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resources Development Scholarship Programme is being implemented since the year of 2010 for providing opportunities for the executive level public sector officers to undergo postgraduate courses in the recognized Universities in Japan and under the grant the Government of Japan has given their consent to grant an amount of Japanese Yen 269 million (approximately Rs. 457 million) to facilitate the government officials who are to commence their studies from September 2020.  Accordingly, the Cabinet of Ministers approved the proposal submitted by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic and Policy Development for accepting the aforementioned grant and signing the agreements relating to the same.

description: Utilizing the funds allocated under the Contingent Emergency Response Components of the World Bank Group financed investment projects  for the projects to be implemented on priority basis, due to the COVID 19 pandemic situation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-17
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that it is necessary to provide financial assistance for the  uplifting the agricultural sector, implementing the e-education platform, establishment of an online platform for home-based work , disaster management as well as the prevention of spreading the disease while using public transport sectors,  immediately, since the country is facing a wide range of impacts other than the health sector due to COVID-19 pandemic situation. Therefore, the Cabinet of Ministers has approved the proposal submitted by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Economic and Policy Development for taking necessary measures to enable to utilize  US$ 56 million that has been included under the Contingent Emergency Response Components of (04) investment projects funded by the World Bank Group in the projects to be immediately implemented in the sectors mentioned above.

description: Granting relief for the tourist industry during the post COVID-19 pandemic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body:
As a redress to minimizing the impact on the tourist industry due to the COVID 19 pandemic conditions and normalizing the industry; approval of the Cabinet of Ministers was granted for implementing a relief programme for institutions and individuals engaged in the tourist industry as follows.

- 	Providing loan facilities on the basis of paying back within a period of 05 years with a 2 year grace period under an interest of 4% for payment of salaries of Rs.20,000/- per head for a period of six months for the staffs of tourist hotels, tour management companies/travel agents registered under the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority.

-	Providing loan facilities for the payment of Rs.15,000/- each for a period of six months serving in the other institutions related to tourism including restaurants, cafeterias, spa and wellness centres registered under the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority.

-	One-off payment of Rs.20,000/- per tour guide registered under the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority to be dispensed by the by Sri Lanka Tourist Development Authority.

-	One-off payment of Rs.15,000/- per tourist driver registered under the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority to be dispensed by the Sri Lanka Tourist Development Authority.

-	Providing facilities to pay the electricity and water bills payable from 01st March 2020 to 31st August from 01st September 2020 in 12 equal installments and not to disconnect power or water supply during that period.

-	Extending the grace period of 06 months given for payment of vehicle leasing installments related to the tourism industry up to 12 months without any delayed charges.

description: Allocation of land near the Mirisawetiya Maha Viharaya, Anuradhapura to the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Cultural and Religious Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - The Circuit Bungalow of the Forest Department is located in a 2 Acre 22.6 perch land plot adjoining the Mirisawetiya MahaViharaya. The Department of Archaeology has informed that no new constructions should be done there since this land is situated within the Anuradhapura sacred city and it is an area with archaeological ruins. The Chief Incumbent of the Mirisavatiya Viharaya has requested this land for the Miriswetiya Viharaya for the ease of carrying out religious and social activities of the temple in the future as the relevant land plot is situated adjoining the Mirisawetiya Maha Viharaya. Accordingly, the Cabinet approval was given to allocate this land to the Ministry of Buddhasasana, Cultural and Religious Affairs to be transferred to the Mirisawetiya Maha Viharaya upon the approval of the Sacred Area Development Committee in future when formally declaring the boundaries of the said sacred area.

description: Release of Pine Plantations belonging to the Department of Forest Conservation and the Land Reforms Commission for Oleoresin extraction on the basis of a charge
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval was granted to take necessary action for the selection of suitable institutions following the competitive bidding procedure, for Oleoresin extraction in the Pine Plantations belonging to the Department of Forest Conservation and the Land Reforms Commission in extent of 6,200 hectares.

description: Implementation of Solar Power Projects under the Indian Lines of Credit
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - The Government of India has extended its consensus to grant USD 100 million under Indian Lines of Credit through the EXIM Bank of India in order to accomplish the targets of integrating renewable energy to the energy sector in the Country through implementing solar power projects, in line with 'Vistas of Prosperity and Splendour' policy framework. Accordingly, Cabinet approval was granted to implement the relevant projects by giving the priority for provision of electricity to the government buildings by installation of solar power generation systems on roofs of those buildings and to selected low income families in the Mannar, Trincomalee, Moneragala, Anuradhapura and Hambantota districts and meet their power requirements by provision of solar power generation systems to their housing units.

description: Obtaining additional provisions for forming infrastructure facilities essential for the e-motoring Project of the Department of the Motor Traffic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - The contract to implement the e-Motoring Project, which has been planned to transform the departmental services to public centric nature, has been awarded to Metropolitan Advanced Technologies Pvt Limited and agreement thereof has been signed in July 2018. Even though, the Head Office premises at Narahenpita and the District Office premises of the Department have to be appropriately organized in order to implement to the Project, nonreceipt of allocations needed for such infrastructure facilities has resulted in the delay in implementing the same. Therefore, Cabinet approval was granted to provide the necessary allocations through the forthcoming Budget to accomplish the essential and urgent tasks in order to implement the Project as planned.

description: Tax exemptions for execution of the Railway Track Rehabilitation Project from Maho to Omanthai under the Indian Line of Credit
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval was granted to implement the Railway Track Rehabilitation Project from Maho to Omanthai under the Indian Line of Credit, at the meeting held on 2019 04 02. Now, it has been decided by the Cabinet to declare this Project as a special project to allow exemptions from the payment of the relevant taxes.

description: Introduction of minimum specifications for buses used for public passenger transportation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body:
- Nearly, 26,985 buses are presently being used by the Sri Lanka Transport Board and the Private Sector for passenger transportation and almost all of them are made on truck chassis meant for transportation of goods. It has been observed that passengers are jolted and made uncomfortable when brakes are applied as those are made for transportation of goods. Therefore, Cabinet approval was granted to appoint a Cabinet Sub Committee comprising of the following Ministers in order to further consider the matters mentioned in the report submitted by the Committee appointed to prepare the technical specifications and criteria in order to enable the passengers to travel in comfort, to be considered when importing buses to the country in the future, with the participation of the relevant officials and to submit its recommendations to the Cabinet.

*	Minister of Transport Service Management

*	Minister of Industries and Supply Chain Management

*	Minister of Education

description: Construction of a new interchange on the Southern Expressway at Bedigama for the Tangalle - Weeraketiya Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - It has been found that, there is a possibility of attracting more expressway users by constructing a new interchange at Bedigama, for the road section of Tangalle - Weeraketiya. As such, approval of the Cabinet has been granted to construct the proposed new interchange and to utilize the balance of the amount used for the construction of the Section II of the Southern Expressway.

description: Purchase of School Uniform Materials - 2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body:
- The Ministry of Education has been continuously providing free school uniform materials to the students of the Government schools and Government aided schools and also to the student bhikkus and lay students of Government approved pirivenas, since 1993. Instead of providing uniform materials, a system of providing gift vouchers has been implemented for this purpose during the period from 2015-2020.

Due to the COVID 19 pandemic prevailing in the country, the export income has been reduced and therefore, it has been found appropriate to produce school uniforms locally by encouraging local textile manufacturers, taking into consideration that the cost of foreign exchange to be incurred for the purpose is also very high. Accordingly, Cabinet approval was granted to provide uniform materials in future instead of granting vouchers and to obtain required stock of uniform materials from the local textile manufactures that are registered under the Ministry of Industry and Supply Chain Management.

description: Purchasing three (03) official houses for the Department of Examinations of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2020-06-10
decision_details_body: - The Department of Examinations of Sri Lanka annually conducts more than 350 examinations for Government, Semi-Government, Corporations and Boards. The officers serving in the said department have to work until mid night resulting in officers who come from distant places encountering difficulties.
