decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - The Petroleum Resources Development Secretariat has to price the newly obtained petroleum data in the M2 Block of Mannar Basin and re-price other old data available in the Mannar, Cauvery and Lanka Basins to carry out future licensing rounds. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development for pricing and re-pricing the data available in the Petroleum Resources Development Secretariat as per the recommendations of the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 180,000 vials of Anti Rabies (TC) Vaccine
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to award the procurement for the supply of 180,000 vials of Anti Rabies (TC) Vaccine (Human Use) (0.5 ml/1 ml) which is used to prevent the rabies disease, to M/s ABC Pharma Services (Pvt) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the contract for the supply of catering from Narita International Airport Japan, for SriLankan Airline flights from 15th November 2019 for a 02 year contract period
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Finance to award the contract for the supply of Catering Uplift at Narita International Airport, Japan, for a period of 02 years commencing from 15th of November, 2019, at a total contract value of Japanese Yen 307,695,073 for covering 520 SriLankan Airline flights, to M/s Gate Gourmet Japan Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Dry Ration Packets to the Sri Lanka Army - Supply Year 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Defence, to award the contract for the procurement of 200,000 Dry Ration Packets for the Sri Lanka Army for the year 2019, for a sum of Rs.175,704,347.83 (without VAT), to M/s Rodesha Enterprise (Pvt.) Ltd., the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the approval of the Cabinet for the submission of the draft Bill on Prevention of Offences relating to Sports, in Parliament of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - In terms of the decision arrived by the Cabinet at one of its previous meetings, the Attorney General has been instructed to prepare the Bill on Prevention of Offences Relating to Sports. The clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the draft bill so prepared and therefore,the proposal made by the Minister of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment and Sports to publish the draft bill prepared incorporating the amendments proposed by the  Attorney General in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Coordination Task Force for the Detection of Proceeds of Crime
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - All law enforcement agencies have pointed out that the lack of a formal coordination mechanism is the major obstacle in combating and mitigating, if not eliminating, organized criminality, money laundering and terrorist financing. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to establish a Coordination Task Force to recover the resources acquired unlawfully under the Chairmanship of the Director of the Financial Intelligence Unit of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and comprising of 10 other members in order the establish an effective coordination mechanism with operational level personnel, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the Court Complex at Hulftsdorp in Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - The Court Complex at Hulftsdorp in Colombo is a building complex with archaeological values which is nearly 200 years old. Within this complex, 7 Magistrate Courts, 9 District Courts and 7 High Courts, 3 Commercial High Courts and the respective offices of the said Courts are housed and no extensive renovation has been carried out over the years in an appropriate manner. As such, the proposal made by  Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms  to initially erect a pre-built structure and make renovations pertaining to the building complex  by shifting court buildings in stages into same and to set apart the estimated provisions required for the purpose by way of annual provisions to be provided for the Ministry of Justice & Prison Reforms and to assign the said renovation activities to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) on design and built basis, subject to the approval of the Standing Technological Committee established in the Ministry of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Grant of Cabotage Right to Foreign Airlines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - Up to date, by the Air Services Agreements that Sri Lanka has negotiated with other States, the Airlines of the Bilateral Partner States have not been granted rights to operate flights in Sri Lanka under cabotage rights.  However, with the aim of having a renaissance in the local aviation sector, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to authorize the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka to accord cabotage rights to interested foreign airlines to operate commercial air services only among the Internal Airports in Sri Lanka (Batticaloa International Airport, Jaffna International Airport, Colombo International Airport, Ratmalana International Airport and Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport) under a Temporary Operating Permit with one year validity period, issued under the existing Air Services Agreements between Sri Lanka and the respective States of the Airlines which are interested to operate flights between the said International Airports with cabotage rights,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Updating the regulations made for the preservation of artifacts in Sri Lanka to bestow to our posterity
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - The Antiquities Ordinance No.9 of 1940 has been enacted with the objective of better preservation of the artifacts and the archaeological sites and monuments which hold historical and archaeological significance in Sri Lanka. In terms of the provisions provided for in section 47 of the said Ordinance, the regulations published in the Gazette Notification No.8698 of 23rd December 1940 have to be updated to suit the present trends. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs to amend the regulations made under section 47 of the Antiquities Ordinance No.9 of 1940 and implement the amendments after presenting them in Parliament for approval and subsequently, to publish in the Government Gazette, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Pre Cast Disaster Resilient Houses for the People Residing in the Disaster Prone Areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to construct 400 houses in the Kalutara and Ratnapura Districts under Phase 01 of the Project on constructing Pre‑Cast Disaster Resilient Houses for the people residing in disaster prone areas. By now, lands have been identified to resettle 500 families in the Badulla District and 50 families in the Moneragala District in close proximity to the District boundary of the Badulla District.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Disaster Management and Livestock Development to construct the first 100 houses in the Badulla and Moneragala districts with the objective of resettling of the said 550 families under  Phase 01 of the project,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lease of a Land at Buthgamuwa Road in Rajagiriya to M/s Baili Investment Lanka (Pvt) Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to lease a plot of land in extent of 2 Acres and 3 Roods facing Rajagiriya, Buthgamuwa Road and Parliament Road for a 99 year period, to M/s Baili Investment Lanka (Pvt) Ltd., for a Mixed Development Project according to the recommendations made by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Delimitation Committee for the establishment of the New Divisional Secretariat Divisions, Gazetting of the currently established Divisional Secretariat Divisions and the establishment and Revision of the  Grama Niladhari Divisions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - A Delimitation Committee for the establishment of the New Divisional Secretariat Divisions, Gazetting of the currently established Divisional Secretariat Divisions and the establishment and Revision of the Grama Niladhari Divisions has to be appointed once in every five years. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government, to appoint the new Delimitation Committee comprising of eleven Members under the Chairmanship of a retired Secretary to a Ministry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the dialysis treatment programme for patients with Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) and Chronic Kidney Disease of uncertain etiology (CKDu)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to appoint a Technical Evaluation Committee and a Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee to evaluate and to make recommendations on the project proposal made by the Hospinorm Project GmbH, Frankfurter Str, 92, Eschborn, to provide 643 dialysis machines throughout the country inclusive of the supply of 33 new dialysis units and expansion of 50 dialysis units with  improved facilities and also to secure the provisions required for the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Amendments to Section 3 of the Protection of Government Revenue (Special Provisions) Act, No.1 of 2006
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - Complications have arisen due to the fact that in terms of Section 3 of the Protection of Government Revenue (Special Provisions) Act, No.1 of 2006, the date of import (and export) shall be the date of delivery of the Customs Declaration, whereas in terms of Section 16 of the Customs Ordinance, the time of import shall be the time at which the ship importing such goods had actually come within the limits of the Port (and time of export shall be the time at which the goods had been shipped on board).  As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to amend Section 3 of the Protection of Government Revenue (Special Provisions) Act, No.1 of 2006 to enable to keep the consistency between the provisions of the two Acts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Land (Restrictions on Alienation) (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Finance to publish the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman to amend the Land (Restrictions on Alienation) Act, No.38 of 2014 incorporating the necessary legal provisions to exclude the companies listed in the Colombo Stock Exchange from the application of prohibition on purchasing of lands in Sri Lanka, in the Government Gazette and present it in Parliament for approval,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of houses for the landless protracted IDPs of the Jaffna District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs to construct 250 housing units each with 600 sq ft. as two storey twin compartment housing complex in the land purchased by a donor in a private land called Rasalikulankarai in extent of 7.5 acres situated in the New Moor Street of the Grama Niladhari Division, No.88 of the Jaffna Divisional Secretariat Division and given as a gift to resettle 250 families out of the 535 families of the protracted IDPs of the Jaffna District and registered as landless, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Rural Agri Business Value Chains and Improvement of Related Common Facilities - Smallholder Agribusiness Partnership Programme (SAPP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-10-01
decision_details_body: - The Smallholder Agribusiness Partnership Programme is jointly implemented to facilitate smallholder farmers through agriculture value chain partnerships created by Public, Private and Production Participation (4P) by the Government of Sri Lanka, International Fund for Agriculture Development (IFAD), Private Sector, Participatory Financial Institutes (PFIs) and the beneficiaries through an investment of US$ 105 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President to authorize the Smallholder Agribusiness Partnerships Programme (SSAP) to provide in kind or financial grants to Farmers'/Producers' Organizations who are engaged in the said 4P projects, not exceeding the value of Rs.5 million per value chain project, for development of ‘off farm’ and common facilities/services which has been identified as essential to ensure the smooth operation of Public Private Producer Partnership (4P) projects, accordingly to improve the income level of farmers and minimize their risk in market, and to be implemented in collaboration with the Ministry in charge of the subject of Agriculture and the other relevant ministries was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Additional Ship to Shore (STS) Crane for the Sri lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to award the contract for the supply, installation and commissioning of 03 Ships to Shore Cranes at the Jaya Container Terminals Stage(V) Container quay to M/s Shanghai Zhenhua Heavy Industries Co., Ltd,. Accordingly,  the proposal made by the Minister of  Ports & Shipping and  Southern Development to award the contract for the procurement of an additional Ship to Shore Crane to  M/s Shanghai Zhenhua Heavy Industries on the same terms and conditions and payment method of the above contract, following the Repeat Order Procurement Method of the Government Procurement Guidelines 2006, as recommended by the Ca

description: Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Explosive Detection Systems for the Cabin Baggage (EDSCB) at the  Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - X-Ray Cabin Baggage Screening Machines utilized to inspect the cabin baggage  in the boarding gates at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) have been installed there since 2004 and breakdown of any of the said machines could lead to flight delays. Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to commence the relevant purchasing to replace the the existing old Cabin Baggage X-ray machines with state of art X- ray machines of Computer Tomography for explosive detection and related security requirements, to ensure the aviation security standards,  under the provisions of the emergency procurement utilizing the funds available for Airport & Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) Limited, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Reconstruction of 25 Bridges Project' funded by the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development (KFAED) - Procurement of a Contractor for Civil Works
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to reconstruct 09 dilapidated and narrow bridges in the national road network of the Sabaragamuwa Province under the package 02 of the 'Reconstruction of 25 Bridges Project' funded by the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development (KFAED). As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to award the contract for the reconstruction of 05 bridges in the Dehiowita - Deraniyagala road, 02 bridges in the Galigamuwa - Ruwanwella road and 01 bridge each in the Kegalle - Bulathkohupitiya road and Mawanella - Hemmathagama road, to M/s ELS Construction (Pvt).,Ltd,  to a sum of Rs 1289.76 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Landslide Countermeasures at six road sites in the Sabaragamuwa and Uva Provinces for the Landslide Disaster Protection Project - Package 02
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development to revise the original contract price of Landslide Countermeasures at six road sites in the Sabaragamuwa and Uva Provinces under the Road Disaster Management Package 02 and to award the contract for the construction of Landslide Countermeasures in the identified locations at Ambepussa, Haputhale, Bandarawela, Uduwara and Ella to the current contractor, RR- Soltec Joint Venture, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer 2019 - (October)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to obtain covering approval to procure 2,000 MTs of Urea at US$ 299.50 per MT from M/s Agri Commodities & Finance and 8,500 MTs of Muriate of Potash at US$ 349.43 per MT from M/s Agricultural Resources & Investment Pte. Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee in order to fulfill the fertilizer requirement of the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Limited for the month of October, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Sangilipalama Rural Water Supply Scheme in the Nuwara Eliya District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - The objective of the Water Supply and Sanitation Improvement Project (2015 2020) is to improve the supply of pipe born water and sanitation facilities focusing on 540	Grama Niladhari Divisions in the selected 07 districts of Mullaitivu, Kilinochchi, Badulla, Moneragala, Ratnapura, Kegalle and Nuwara Eliya which do not have safe drinking water facilities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education to award the contract for the construction of the Sangilipalama Rural Water Supply Scheme which is implemented, as a part of the project to provide safe drinking water to 14 Grama Niladhari Divisions and to benefit 3050 households by 2039 in the Kotmale Divisional Secretariat Division in the Nuwara Eliya Dirtrict to M/s Q SJV (Qingdao Savinda JV) as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting of the Regulations made by the Minister of Sports under section 41 of the Sports Act, No.25 of 1973 in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - The Gazette (Extraordinary) Notification No.2137/86 dated 2019 08 23 and the Gazette (Extraordinary) Notification No.2137/85  dated 2019 08 23 have been issued to achieve the objective of hearing the appeals related to the elections pertaining to National Sports Associations, in a convenient and formal manner and appointing disciplined and more suitable persons for sports administration. Accordingly, 	the proposal made by the Minister of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment and Sports, to present the above two Gazette Notifications in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Developing the Galle Face Green
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Ports Authority has undertaken certain development work at the Galle Face Green with Corporate and Social Responsibility (CSR) Funds with the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers in 2007 along with its own funds and the funds of the National Budget. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of  Ports & Shipping and  Southern Development, to set apart a sum of Rs.300 million, being the total estimated cost under the proposed Corporate and Social Responsibility (CSR) Budget for the year 2019/2021 and to complete the development activities by stages within a period of nearly 18 months, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting the new Education Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - The legal basis of the present education system is the Education Ordinance No.31 of 1939 and the subsequent amendments made to the said Ordinance and the Special Acts. Since, most of the provisions included in these Acts are now obsolete, with a view to updating the Acts, the proposed draft framework the Ministry of Education, has submitted, having considered the written and oral suggestions made by the stakeholders in the education sector and various other fields to be taken into consideration for the preparation of the new Education Bill. As such, it was decided by the Cabinet to appoint a Committee of Experts comprising of the representatives of the Ministry of Education,  the Ministry of Women & Child Affairs and Dry Zone Development, the Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs, University Grants Commission, Department of National Planning, National Education Commission, the National Institute of Education and private sector educational institutes, to review the new Education Bill and to make recommendations.

description: Payment of a special allowance to the Executive Officers of the Public Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - A Cabinet Sub-Committee was appointed by the Cabinet at its meeting held on  26th of March 2019, under the Chairmanship of the Minister of Public Administration, Disaster Management and Livestock Development and the membership of the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development and the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to study the recommendations made by the National Salaries and Cadres Commission relating to the payment of a special allowance to the Executive Officers of the Public Sector and to submit a Report to the Cabinet. The recommendations submitted by the said Sub Committee were taken into consideration by the Cabinet. Further, the Cabinet took into consideration that the Cabinet has granted approval to implement 50% out of the increase of salaries in the Public Service recommended by the Report of the Special Commission on reviewing the salaries of the Public Sector appointed by H.E. the President, with effect from 01st of July 2020 and the balance 50 % increase with effect from 01st of January 2021, at its meeting held on the 10th of September 2019. Accordingly, with a view to providing relief to the entire Public Service, the Cabinet approved to grant 50% out of the salary increase recommended by the Special Commission on reviewing the salaries of the Public Sector with effect from 01st of January 2020.

description: Establishment of the Regional Integrated Multi-Hazard Early Warning System Regional Hub for the South Asian Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously, to establish the Regional Integrated Multi-Hazard Early Warning System Regional Hub for the South Asian Region in the premises of the Department of Meteorology. However, the matters submitted by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development  and the Minister of Public Administration, Disaster Management and Rural Economic Affairs to the effect that it has been planned to establish the  proposed regional hub in the Irrigation Department premises due to space and financial constraints, was noted by the Cabinet

description: Construction of a new building to establish the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to construct a storey building in the land called 'Ambalangodella' belonging to the said Ministry, in extent of approximately 6 acres adjacent to the Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,  to house the offices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development situated in Colombo including the Department of Agrarian Development under one roof as 'Govijana Mandiraya', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting an identical Act for the Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to draft a new Parliamentary Act identical to the Ceylon Fishing Harbour Corporation by the Legal Draftsman with a view to converting the said corporation to enhance the generation of income sufficient for self existence and to be profitable by strengthening the same legally and increasing the income generation capability, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion of the Norochcholai Coal Power Plant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - Considering the fact that the construction of a new power plant as an extension of the Norochcholai Coal Power Plant is in conformity with the policy of the future electricity generation mix of Sri Lanka and the Long Term Generation Expansion Plan approved for 2018-2037 by the Public Utility Commission of Sri Lanka, which was approved by the Cabinet previously, the proposal made by the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to build the 04th power plant unit with a capacity of 300 MW as an extension of the Norochcholai Coal Power Plant within the same premises, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of the Sri Jayewardenepura National School of Nursing with the Faculty of Nursing of the University of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - A Faculty of Nursing affiliated to the University of Colombo has been commenced in the year 2018, utilizing the buildings of the Sri Jayewardenepura National School of Nursing with a view to enhancing the quality of nursing education up to a degree level and creating nursing professionals with high competency at a globally competitive level. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to vest the buildings and the assets belonging to the said nurses training school, its staff administered by the Ministry of  Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine and the land where the relevant buildings are situated and belonging to the Sri Jayewardenepura Hospital, with the University of Colombo through the Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, for the use of the Faculty of Nursing of the University of Colombo, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the National Gem and Jewellery Authority Act, No.50 of 1993
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation to amend several sections of the National Gem and Jewellery Authority Act, No.50 of 1993, to arrive at policy decisions in principle to address the legal and institutional issues which have arisen at present and expected to  arisen in future and also with a view to achieving the objectives of the Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Salary and Allowances paid to the Members of the Tri-forces and the Police who died or became disabled directly due to Terrorist activities or activities done for the prevention of same, while on duty, in operational areas or in areas not nominated as operational areas, during the conflict period, until the completion of 55 years of age and to the dependents of the deceased members for their lifetime and to the disabled member for his lifetime
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Defence, in  accordance with the recommendations made by the Officials' Committee under the Chairmanship of an Additional Secretary to the Ministry in charge of the subject of Public Administration and appointed by the Cabinet to study the relevant matter and make recommendations,  to provide further relief in addition to the benefits already received by the members of the Tri forces and the Police who died or became disabled directly due to terrorist activities or activities done for the prevention of same, while on duty, in operational areas or in areas not nominated as operational areas, during the conflict period, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of the Operational Affairs of National Security
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - Consequent to the series of terrorist attacks by the religious extremists on the 21st of April, 2019, the necessity of further strengthening the existing institutional structure to ensure security operations strictly to meet the challenges posed to national security has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation, to establish the  National Security Council, instituted in 1999 under  the Public Security Ordinance and the newly proposed National Security Advisory Committee, the National Security Council Secretariat and the Experts Committees on National Security (Economic, International Affairs, Social and Religious, Research and Analysis, Scientific and Technological and Strategic Management) to be established by an Act of Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the National Minimum Wage of Workers Act, No.3 of 2016 enabling to increase the existing Minimum National Wage
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-24
decision_details_body: - In terms of the National Minimum Wage of Workers Act, No.3 of 2016, The National minimum monthly salary of Rs.10,000/- (Rs.400x25) and the national minimum daily wage of Rs. 400/- (Rs.50x8) had been stipulated with effect from the 01st of January 2016.  Considering the increasing cost of living, the approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to amend section 3 of the said Act enabling to increase the existing national minimum wage of Rs. 10,000/- by Rs. 2,500/- up to Rs.12,500/- and the national minimum daily wage of Rs. 400/- by Rs.100/- up to Rs.500/-. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President at the request of the Non Cabinet Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations to publish the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman amending section 3 of the  National Minimum Wage of Workers Act, No.3 of 2016 in the Government Gazette and subsequently, to present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting ownership of 101 'Shelter for All' new model villages with the housing beneficiaries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - One of the key development initiatives of the 'Shelter for All' national housing drive which commenced from the year 2015 is the model village programme.  Under the said programme, the number of model villages vested with the  housing beneficiaries with all the required amenities of a settlement is 286 and the submission made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs that the ownership of 101 model villages out of the said number will be vested with the beneficiaries awaiting the ownership of a house of their own, during the two week period from 23rd September to 07th October, preceding the World Habitat Day which falls on 07th October, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Introducing an effective legal framework to counter terrorism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - New laws are required in respect of areas such as temporary restriction orders, prohibition on encouragement of terrorism in various ways and control of being in designated foreign areas and the collection of biometric data etc in order to deal with the new dimensions of terrorism. Accordingly, The joint proposal made by the Prime Minister and the Minister of Foreign Affairs to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation for the existing legislation  or to draft appropriate new legislation as per the proposals submitted by the Ministerial Committee appointed by the Cabinet for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of an additional Pilot Launch for Sri Lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - 	Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to award the contract for the supply of 02 Pilot Launches for Sri Lanka Ports Authority to Colombo Dockyard PLC, Sri Lanka. Since Sri Lanka Ports Authority  has identified the necessity of having another Pilot Launch in addition to the said two Pilot Launches in view of delivering efficient navigational services within the operational ports, the proposal made by the Minister of  Ports & Shipping and  Southern Development  to award the contract for the procurement of an additional Pilot Launch for Sri Lanka Ports Authority to M/s Colombo Dockyard PLC, Sri Lanka on the same terms and conditions of the above contract under the provisions of Repeat Order Procurement Method of the Procurement Guideline 2006  as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation and Improvements to Road Sections of the Orugodawatta - Ambatale Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development,  to award the contract for the rehabilitation and improvements (Stage II) to the first 2.9 km road section and the road sections from 4.2 km to 5.44 km of the Orugodawatta - Ambatale Road, (B -435) to M/s Tudawe Brothers (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Term Contract for the importation of Gasoline from 2019 10 01 to 2020 05 31
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to award the contract for the importation of  900,000 Bbls of Gasoline during the period of eight months from 2019 10 01 to 2020 05 31, to M/s Vitol Asia Pte. Ltd., of Singapore, as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Term Contract for the importation of Gas Oil and Jet A-1 from 2019 10 01 to 2020 05 31
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to award the contract for the importation of 1.04 million Bbls of Gas Oil and 1.28 million Bbls of Jet A-1 during the period of eight months from 2019 10 01 to 2020 05 31, to M/s Mena Energy DMCC of the United Arab Emirates, as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Coal required for the Coal Power Plant in Puttalam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to grant covering approval for awarding the contract for the purchase of 300,000 MT of coal required for the Coal Power Plant in Puttalam, to M/s Swiss Singapore Overseas Enterprises Pte. Ltd, 65, Chulia Street # 48-05, OCBC Centre, Singapore, as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of Uniforms and other clothing material required for the Three Forces, the Department of Civil Security, the National Cadet Corps,  the Sri Lanka Police and the Special Task Force for the year 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted in the year 2005, to fulfill the textile requirements of the Tri Forces and the other Public Institutions coming under the purview of the Ministry of Defence from the local textile manufacturers.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Defence, to purchase textile material from the selected local textile manufacturers through the Domestic Textile Allocation Committee, on the quotations called to fulfill  the textile material requirement of the Sri Lanka Army, the Sri Lanka Navy, the Sri Lanka Air Force, the Department of Civil Security, the National Cadet Corps, the Sri Lanka Police and the Special Task Force, for the year 2019,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia and the Government of Sri Lanka on Exemption of Visa requirement for holders of Diplomatic, Special, Official and Service Passports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia and the Government of Sri Lanka on Exemption of Visa requirement for holders of Diplomatic, Official and Service Passports, with a view to promoting further, the friendly ties between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Jaffna and the University of Bristol in the United Kingdom
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the University of Jaffna and the University of Bristol in the United Kingdom, with a view to promoting educational corporation within the higher education sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Support to the Food Safety and Quality in Sri Lanka Project and Sri Lanka's Nationally Determined Contributions in the Industry Sector Project, proposed to be financed under the European Union grant assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - 	The 'Multiannual Indicative Programme of 2014 - 2020 for Sri Lanka' is due to be implemented under the European Union grant assistance with a view to supporting Integrated Rural Development and Democratic Governance and Reconciliation in Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, to enter into financing agreements with the European Union to obtain a grant of Euro 11 million and Euro 7.81 million, respectively, for 'Support to Foot Safety and Quality in Sri Lanka Project' and for 'Sri Lanka's Nationally Determined Contributions in the Industry Sector Project', out of the Euro 110 million set apart under the 'Integrated Rural Development in Sri Lanka', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Viability Gap Funding Agreements (VGF) with Domestic Air Services Companies to undertake scheduled domestic air services to selected destinations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has already been granted to select domestic aviation companies applicable only to operate scheduled domestic flights to selected destinations, which do not exceed a maximum charge of US$ 100 - 150 for one way travel and to finalize a viability gap funding mechanism to settle any shortfall on expenditure and  income that would occur, as an inducement to the tourism industry.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs, for the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority to enter into Viability Gap Funding Agreements with the said domestic aviation companies, subject to presenting the detailed operating statistics and the business plan for the next one year to the National Agency for Public-Private Partnership (NAPPP), on the format prepared by NAPPP, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Liquidation of Natural Resources Management Services (Pvt.) Ltd., Mahaweli Venture Capital Company (Pvt.) Ltd., and Mahaweli Engineering Services (Pvt.) Ltd., companies incorporated under Section 13(18) of the Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to liquidate the Natural Resources Management Services (Pvt.) Ltd., Mahaweli Venture Capital Company (Pvt.) Ltd., and Mahaweli Engineering Services (Pvt.) Ltd., companies incorporated under section 13(18) of Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka Act, which can not be maintained as of now, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting Permanent Appointments to the employees recruited on Temporary, Casual (on Daily wages), Substitute, Contract or Relief Basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - The joint proposal made by the Prime Minister, the Minister of Finance and the Minister of Public Administration, Disaster Management and Rural Economic Affairs, to enforce the provisions of the following circulars, to grant permanent and pensionable appointments to those who have failed to get permanency due to the inability  to fulfill the requirements stipulated in the Public Administration Circular No.25/2014 and 25/2014(I), at the time of their issuance and also for the employees recruited on temporary, casual (on daily wages), substitute, contract or relief basis to primary grades in the public institutions on exigencies of service and who have completed a period of service exceeding 180 days, subject to fulfilling the required qualifications of the said posts as at 2019 09 01, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of the 'Information Month' to coincide with the International Right to Know Day
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - The Right to Information Act No.12 of 2016 which was passed in Parliament of Sri Lanka on the 4th of August 2016, has now been ranked as the fourth best Act in the world and the Ministry of Mass Media which has been entrusted with the prime responsibility of implementing the said Act, is taking appropriate measures to effectively implement the same. Therefore, the proposal made by H.E the President as per the request of the Non-Cabinet Minister of Mass media to declare the period from 15th of September 2019 to 15th of October 2019 as the 'Information Month' to coincide with the 'International Right to Know Day' which falls on 28th of September 2019, to issue a Circular to instruct all the State Institutions to engage in activities related to this Act, to organize awareness programmes for citizens so as to cover all the divisional secretariat divisions of the country to coincide with this event, to implement RTI mobile services under the theme of 'Right to Information to the Village' in 05 selected districts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Multi Sector Action Plan for Nutrition 2018 - 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-17
decision_details_body: - In terms of the National Nutrition Policy declared in the year 2010, it is essential to accomplish the major objectives such as ensuring the involvement and contribution of both health and non-health sectors as well as the Government and Non-Governmental stakeholders in the nutrition improvement process, achieving the sustainable development goals by 2030 including the eradication of all forms of malnutrition and also making contribution to achieve global efforts of ending malnutrition by the year 2025, as agreed at the World Health Assembly held in 2012. As such, the proposal made by H.E the President to obtain approval, in principle to implement the Multi Sector Action Plan for Nutrition 2018 - 2025 (Phase II) which has been prepared with the participation of multi - stakeholders including all the relevant ministries, provincial councils, district and divisional administrative authorities, development partners, donors, agencies, acedemia, business community, civil society organizations and non governmental organizations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project proposal to manage Colombo East Teaching Hospital (CETH) as a Public-Private Mixed Care Model on Free and Paid basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to implement the  Colombo East Teaching Hospital (CETH) as a Public-Private Mixed Care Model on Free and Paid basis and as a Semi-Government entity and to continue its activities pertaining to medical education, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Dry Zone Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Women & Child Affairs and Dry Zone Development to implement the Anuradhapura District the Dry Zone Development Project as the first step of Dry Zone Development Programme in the District of Anuradhapura in the year 2019 incurring an expenditure of Rs.331 million and to carry out the  activities of development of agricultural wells, reconstruction of  agricultural roads, distribution of the agricultural implements to the beneficiaries, construction of community centres by utilizing a provision of Rs.204 million and to carry out activities of supplying clean potable water, development and improvement of the domestic/small scale industries, training and making awareness and promotion of agricultural productivity by utilizing a provision of Rs. 127 million, under the said programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of the three contracts under 'Sukithapurawara Township Development Programme' to the Central Engineering Services (Pvt.) Limited (CESL), which is a Subsidiary Company under Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), without following the National Procurement Procedures
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to award the contracts for the projects of laying carpet for a road section of 1.85 km on Eluwakkulama - Aruwakkaru road up to (Y) junction and the construction of a two storey library building for Kadawalai school and a two storied class room building for Bharatha school at Pudukudiyiruppu, to the Central Engineering Services (Pvt.) Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Jaffna Town Hall
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to award the contract for the development of the Jaffna Town Hall, to the Central Engineering Services (Pvt.) Limited, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for Consultancy Services for Design, Tender Assistance, Supervision and Training to improve facilities and equipment for the diagnosis and treatment mainly of Cardiovascular Diseases in Tertiary Care Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to award the consultancy services contract of the Health & Medical Service Improvement Project implemented under the loan facility of the Japan International Corporation Agency to the Joint Venture of Koei Research & Consultancy (Koei Research & Consultancy Incorporation, Binko International Ltd, Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau and Philkoei International Incorporation), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the Contract for the A330-200 Aircraft Landing Gear Overhaul programme of SriLankan Airlines for the period from 1st August 2019 to 31st July 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Finance, to award the contract for the   Aircraft Landing Gear Overhaul programme of six A330-200  aircrafts of the SriLankan Airlines, for the period from 1st August 2019 to 31st July 2020, to M/s Safran Landing Systems Services Singapore, who is the lowest responsive bidder at the open competitive bidding procedure followed for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The establishment of  an Agricultural and Vocational Training Centre at Weerawila and Embilipitiya Thunkama and a Training Centre for women inmates associated with the Mahara Prison
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to establish an Agricultural and Vocational Centre with all  the facilities for rehabilitation of drug addicted persons imprisoned in the two open prison camps belonging to the Department of Prisons at Weerawila and Embilipitiya Thunkama, instead of establishing two Kibbutz model farms at Ambepussa and Weerawila prisons, in accordance with the budget proposals 2019, to set up a Training Centre for the women inmates, in the vacant land belonging to the Mahara Prison instead of establishing such a centre in the Dompe area, as has been proposed by the Budget Proposals 2019 and to provide the necessary financial provisions to the Department of Prisons by the General Treasury for the said 02 projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increase of  fines (Bail Act, No.30 of 1997)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - Since the fines imposed in respect of violating the provisions in certain Acts and Ordinances are totally inadequate to prevent such violations, a Committee was appointed by the then Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to study this situation and where appropriate to make  recommendations  for the increase of the said fines. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation for the increase of fines in the Bail Act in accordance with the recommendations of the said Committee report, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously, to draft legislation on hate speech, as an amendment to the Penal Code and  the Code of Criminal Procedure. The draft Bill prepared accordingly, has been presented to the Sectoral Oversight Committee in Parliament and the proposal made by the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to publish the new draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman in accordance with the recommendations of the said Committee, in the Gazette and subsequently, present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The Draft (Amendment) Bill to the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979 has been published in the Gazette of 14th June 2019. Subsequently, the Sectoral Oversight Committee which had met to consider the draft Bill has proposed several amendments and the Legal Draftsman has drafted these amendments as Committee Stage Amendments. In view of the decision given by the Cabinet previously, the Committee Stage Amendments which affect the core of a Bill should be submitted to the Cabinet for approval prior to tabling the same in Parliament. Accordingly, the said Committee Stage Amendments and the draft Bill published in the Gazette of 14th June 2019 submitted to the Cabinet by the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the 'National Council for Road Safety' in the name of the 'Commission for National Transport Safety
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The need for the National Council for Road Safety established by the Motor Traffic (Amendment) Act, No.5 of 1998 as a 'Council' comprising of 17 member institutes, to be established as a powerful and legal entity has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to establish the National Council for Road Safety by the name of the 'Commission for National Transport Safety', as a powerful institute within a formal legal framework and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft appropriate legislation to establish the said Commission, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocating the plots of land in the Ratnapura New Town for the construction of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Health Training Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to release the two plots of land in extent of 3 Roods 1.5 perches in the Ratnapura New Town belonging to the Urban Development Authority to the Land Commissioner General enabling to allocate the lands for the Provincial Health Department of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council, to construct the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Health Training Centre subject to the payment of Rs.30 million being the valuation of the Government Valuer, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Development Projects utilizing the Treasury funds allocated to the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development for the year 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development for the implementation of the five (05) projects in which the total estimated cost exceeds Rs.20 million, namely, 'Seruwavila Development - Stage II', 'Jaffna Town Development - Bustand - Stage II', 'Improvement of Welikanda Town' - 'Eluwankulama - Aruwakadu Road Improvement' and 'Aththidiya Childrens' Orphanage - Stage II', utilizing the Treasury funds allocated for the year 2019, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Building for the Accident and Emergency Care Unit of the District General Hospital in Ampara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - Considering the urgent need for providing facilities for accident and emergency care services at the District General Hospital in Ampara, the proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to award the contract for the construction of a two storey building for the Accident and Emergency Care Unit of the said hospital, to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau on Turn-Key (Design and Build) Basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Out Patients Department (OPD) building of the District General Hospital in Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the accommodation facilities available in the existing Out Patient Department building of the District General Hospital in Kalutara are inadequate, due to the increase in the demand for Out Patients treatment services during the past years.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to construct the Out Patients Department (OPD) building of the said hospital, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the approval for Rs.121 million to be set apart for the development of the Nuwarawela Stadium and Shopping Complex in Kandy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Public Enterprise, Kandyan Heritage and Kandy Development to construct the Nuwarawela Stadium and the Shopping Complex within the Kandy Municipal Council area under the supervision of the Kandy Municipal Council, utilizing a sum of Rs.121 million from the provisions of the consolidated fund, for the enhancement of the living standard of the community specially of the Kandy Municipal Council area and the Gangawata Korale Pradeshiya Sabha, minimizing of the traffic congestion in the Kandy city, increasing the income status of the Kandy Municipal Council, providing a good market price for agro based products and the other products of the people in the area and making better marketing facilities for the consumers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial assistance from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) for the  implementation of the 2nd Integrated Road Investment Program
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka has entered into a Framework Financing Agreement with the Asian Development Bank to obtain multi-tranche financial facilities up to an aggregate of US$ 900 million to finance the Second Integrated Road Investment Programme to rehabilitate about 3,400 km of rural access roads and around 340 km of national roads in the Northern, Eastern, Uva and Western Provinces and for improving the capacity of road agencies pertaining to rehabilitation, maintenance, safeguards, road safety, research and road design and construction. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to enter into a loan Agreement with the said bank to obtain a US$ 150 million from the Regular Ordinary Capital Resources of the Asian Development Bank, for the 02nd tranche of the programme with a total  investment cost of US$ 171.8 million and  is expected to be completed by the year 2023,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of Transformation, Reconciliation and Inclusive Democratic Engagement (STRIDE) Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - A project known as ''Strengthening of Transformation, Reconciliation and Complete Democratic Intervention'' is to be implemented with the indirect management of the World Bank, the United Nations Development Programme and the British Council with the overall objective of Strengthening the  execution of decentralized functions in the Northern, Eastern, North Central and Uva Provinces and the dialogue between the people and the Government, thereby contributing to the resolution of critical underline causes of disputes and the prevention of escalation of local disputes. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to enter into a Grant Agreement with the European Union to obtain a grant of Euro 40 million for financing the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recruitment and Training of Graduate Trainees
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the approval granted by the Cabinet previously, the intimation made by the Hon. Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs, to the effect, that graduates from the year 2012 will be recruited for training on chronological order for the remaining 4,667 posts of Graduate Trainees, in September, 2019, giving priority to the external and internal degree holders who are on the threshold of the age limit of 45 years, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of allowances as a compensation in addition to the valuation of the lands acquired from land owners affected due to Moragahakanda - Kaluganga Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The approval of Cabinet has been granted previously to pay an additional compensation of  50% of the assessed compensation for the persons affected due to Moragahakanda - Kaluganga Project, who were permanently residing in the Naula and Laggala Divisional Secretariat Areas, taking into consideration the demands made by them indicating that valuation of the acquired properties for the project has been lessened due to the lack of development of infrastructure facilities of the area compared to the nearby areas and also due to properties of the residents in the area not being renovated by them consequent to the long time delay in commencing the construction after the declaration of the project and the uncertainty that prevailed in the implementation of same.  The proposal made by the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment to pay the said 50% additional compensation to the families of the Medirigiriya Divisional Secretariat Division who have not been included in the relevant Review Committee Report but subsequently determined as project affected, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of a National Policy and Strategy on Sustainable Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - Considering the importance of achieving Sustainable Development Goals for the development of the country, our commitment towards the global efforts to create a sustainably developed world and the need for every government organization to  act as an arm of one government, the proposal made by H.E. the President, that every Ministry to have a common vision of a 'Sustainably Developed Sri Lanka', that every Provincial Council to have a vision of a 'Sustainably Developed  ............... (relevant name of the province) Province for a Sustainably Developed Sri Lanka', for every Government Institution to prepare its public service delivery strategies giving priority to sustainable development goals, that every government institution to propose programmes and projects under the strategies so identified and for the Sustainable Development Council established by the Sustainable Development Act to formulate a National Policy and Strategies on Sustainable Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Sustainable Development Vision of Sri Lanka 2030
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-10
decision_details_body: - The Report compiled by a Committee of 41 experts appointed by H.E. the President with the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers as  'Sustainable Sri Lanka 2030 Vision and Strategic Path' and handed over to the Sustainable Development Council, will in future, serve as the strategic guidance for the preparation of the National Policy and Strategy on Sustainable Development.  Accordingly, the recommendation made by H.E. the President that until such time, that the National Policy and Strategy is formulated in conformity with the sustainable development goals and targets, it is appropriate to present  proposals for projects and programmes for the budget 2020, taking cognizance of the sectoral priorities, new initiatives and options described in the 'Sustainable Sri Lanka 2030 Vision and Strategic Path', was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 190,000 Bottles of Human Albumin Solution BP/PH EUR, 20% in 50ml Bottle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine
	to award the procurement for the supply of 190,000 Bottles of Human Albumin Solution BP/PH EUR, 20% in 50ml Bottle to M/s. Baxalta GmbH of Switzerland as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agriculture Sector Modernization Project - Contract for the consultancy services to design, establish, operate, manage Agriculture Technology Demonstration Parks and transfer to the Farmer Producer Organizations supported by the Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development to award the contract for the consultancy services to design, establish, operate, manage  Agriculture Technology Demonstration Parks and transfer to the Farmer Producer Organizations under the Agriculture Sector Modernization Project implemented with the World Bank Financing to the Joint Venture of M/s FCG ANZDEC Ltd, New Zealand and FCG Swedish Development AB, Sweden, was approved  by the Cabinet.

description: Reinsurance covering activities for Maha season 2019/20 and Yala Season of 2020 for compulsory crop cultivation insurance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: Measures have been taken in the year 2018 to enter into a reinsurance coverage to mitigate the financial risk to be born by the Government and the Agricultural and Agrarian Insurance Board in the payment of compensation for loss/damage reimbursement at a natural disaster. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to carry out the reinsurance activities for the compulsory crops for Maha season 2019/2020 and Yala season 2020 under the proper procurement procedures, in order to implement the compulsory cultivation insurance more productively, and to expand the crop insurance coverage subject to charging a suitable insurance premium from the farmers for the damages caused by diseases, pests and wild animals and to include the same to the reinsurance coverage as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of the Contract for Supply and Delivery of 35km of 240sqmm 3 Core 11kv XLPE Insulated under ground Copper Cables
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to award the contract for the procurement of 35 km of 240 sq mm 3 Core 11kv XLPE Insulated under ground Copper Cables for the Distribution Division 1 of the Ceylon Electricity Board, to M/s Phelps Dodge International (Thailand) Limited of No.159, MOO 10, Theparak Road, Bangpla, Bangplee District, Samutprakarn, 10540, Thailand, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Transmission Distribution Network Development and Efficiency Improvement Project (NTDN & EIP)- Package 1: Award of Contract for construction of 400kv, 220kv and 132 kv Transmission Lines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the  construction of 400kv, 220kv and 132 kv transmission lines of the National Transmission Distribution Network Development and Efficiency Improvement Project, Package 1 to the joint venture of Mitsubishi Corporation, Sumitomo Electric Industries Ltd. and Ceylex Engineering (pvt.) Ltd., 3-1, Marumouchi, 2 - chome, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo 100-8086, Japan, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Dankotuwa Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - Dankotuwa Water Supply Project has been designed by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board to upgrade the drinking water supply in the areas such as Wennappuwa, Dankotuwa and Naththandiya which have been identified as a rapid developing townships in the Puttalam District. As such, the proposal made by  the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education to award the relevant contract for the pupose to M/s. BESIX. S.A. of Belgium at a sum of EUR 28 million and Rs. 5,004 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Token Contribution towards Emergency Flood Relief in Bangladesh
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration of the heavy flooding in Bangladesh due to torrential rains experienced from the month of July this year, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to make a donation  of US$ 50,000 to the Government of the People's Republic of the Bangladesh as an emergency flood relief measure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the United Nations Security Council Resolution 1540 in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - According to the Resolution 1540 of the United Nations Security Council, all member states should refrain from providing any form of support to non-state actors that attempt to acquire, to keep the weapons in their possession and to provide, transport and the use of such devices. As such, since it is a timely need to enact appropriate laws and regulations pertaining to the exportation and re exportation, transition, transshipment and also traveling and transit of the persons engaged in activities related to proliferation and Weapons of Mass Destruction from or via this country and also to adapt to such requirements, the proposal made by the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade to use the European Union Military List and the European Union Dual-Use Control List and make changes as appropriate to Sri Lanka and to prepare a National Control List within one year and also to draft amending legislation to change the Acts and Laws in terms of the provisions of the Gazette (Extraordinary) Notification No.2039/31 of 6th October, 2017, for the implementation of Resolution 1540, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting an Interim Relief to the recipients of Certificate of Absence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The joint proposal made by the Minister of Finance and the Minister of National Integration, Official Languages, Social Progress and Hindu Religious Affairs to grant a monthly interim relief of Rs.6000 to the recipients of Certificate of Absence by way of a direct credit deposit on the 10th day of each month with effect from 10th October 2019 and to direct to the Department of Registrar General to issue Certificates of Absence for the applications submitted by the affected families taking into account the interim report of the Office of  Missing Persons, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Producing 10 Documentaries on 10 Ethnic Groups selected from the book titled 'People of Sri Lanka'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to continue the task of reviewing the scripts of documentaries on ethnic groups which are to be produced by the Veteran Filmmaker, Mr Bertram Nihal based on the book titled 'People of Sri Lanka', subject to obtaining the prior approval for same by a formal Committee.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of National Integration, Official Languages, Social Progress and Hindu Religious Affairs to obtain the assistance of a Committee comprising of 05 experts as resource persons, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal to invest in equity of the Sri Lanka Telecom PLC (SLT) through the State Owned Enterprises and Captive Funds enabling SLT to comply with the Minimum Public Float Requirement of 10% imposed by the Colombo Stock Exchange thereby strengthening the Government of Sri Lanka's stake in SLT
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Telecom (PLC) is the leading telecommunication services provider in the country, with the Government of Sri Lanka controlling 52.92% of the shareholding where 2.1% is held by the general public. According to a new rule introduced in the year 2013 by the Sri Lanka Securities and Exchange Commission for the listed companies to enable the Sri Lanka Telecom to fulfill the requirement of  maintaining 'public free float' of minimum of 10% of their share capital by the Sri Lanka Telecom, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Finance and the Minister of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment and Sports, to instruct the State owned enterprises such as the Employees' Provident Fund, the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Ltd., the National Savings Bank, the Bank of Ceylon, Employees' Trust Fund and the Peoples' Bank to invest in the Sri Lanka Telecom share capital subject to the approval of the respective Boards of Director,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Grade 5 selection process of Scholarship holders in order to increase the facilities of Secondary Education to a grater number of Students of the Low-income Families
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - At present, 15,000 students of the low-income families who become eligible at the Grade 5 Scholarship Examination are awarded scholarships amounting to Rs.625/- million annually. Accordingly, the Note to the Cabinet presented by the  Minister of Education to inform the Cabinet that action will be taken to implement the proposals of increasing the aforesaid number of students up to 20,000 from the year 2019 onwards, the increasing of the monthly bursary from Rs.500/- up to Rs.750/-, for them, to revise the monthly income limit of the families of the students being eligible for scholarship bursaries as Rs.15,000/- from the year 2019 and the allocation of scholarships bursaries to children with special needs as recommended by the Department of Examination, so as not to exceed the total number of students receiving bursaries of 20,000, was noted  by the Cabinet.

description: The Governing Council and the Executive Committee Meeting - 2019 of the Centre for Integrated Rural Development in the Asia and Pacific Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The Executive Committee Meeting of the Centre for Integrated Rural Development in the Asia and Pacific Region is scheduled to be held on the 08th and 09th of October 2019 while the Governing Council Meeting is to be held on the 11th of October 2019 in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the estimated cost  pertaining to the said Meetings presented by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Development Projects utilizing the General Treasury Funds allocated by the National Budget to the Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development under the 'Haritha Udyana' Budget Line
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously to implement the development projects by utilizing the provisions set apart under the 'Haritha Udyana'  budget line. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to award the new projects of Puttalam and Balangoda and the balance scope of work of 19 projects namely the supply and installation of children's play equipment and gymnasium equipment, landscaping to the Central Engineering Services Limited. within the existing budgetary limits, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a Land at the Ratnapura New Town to the Ratnapura Tamil School
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-09-03
