decision_details_body: - The Asian Development Bank has provided a loan of US$ 75 million to meet the cost of the Southern Road Connectivity Project for the improvement of five national highways linking to three interchanges of the Southern Expressway. When the work intended to be completed under the said loan, it has been calculated that a balance sum of approximately US$ 4,300 million will be available in the loan. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to rehabilitate and improve additional road sections following the formal procedure and  utilizing the said balance money, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Awarding of contracts for buildings to be constructed at the Sri Lanka Buddhist and Pali University and the Rajarata University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Acting Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to award the contract for the construction of a five storeyed building complex for the Colombo Office of the Buddhist and Pali University of Sri Lanka to M/s KSJ Construction (Pvt.) Ltd. at No.32, Kandy Road, Kalagedihena, for a sum of Rs.252 million and the proposed Para Clinical building for the Faculty of Medicine and Allied Sciences of the Rajarata University of Sri Lanka to M/s Sunken Construction (Pvt.) Ltd. at No.295, Madampitiya Road, Colombo, for a sum of Rs.767 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the building for the proposed Help Zone of the University of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education to award the contract for the construction of the building for the proposed Help Zone of the University of Colombo, to M/s Kandy Construction at No.264/2, Koswatta, Battaramulla, for a sum of Rs.520 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Consolidation of Core Legislation - Amendments to the Penal Code
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - Certain words and expressions in the Penal Code enacted during the colonial times and revised at several instances do not have any relevance to the present context, after the adoption of the Republican Constitution of 1972. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to publish the draft (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman to substitute such obsolete words and expressions with words and expressions suited to present trends in the Government Gazette and subsequently present it in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting of Commonwealth Law Ministers' Meeting (CLMM) - 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously, to hold the Commonwealth Law Ministers' Meeting in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to organize and hold the said meeting under the theme 'Equal Access to Justice and the Rule of Law', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Air Services Agreement between Sri Lanka and Netherlands
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - At the International Civil Aviation Negotiation Conference held in Nairobi, Kenya in the year 2018, Sri Lanka and Netherlands reached consensus regarding the relevant steps necessary for the air services arrangement between the two countries and the text of an Air Service Agreement was initialed. In accordance with the same, the KLM Royal Dutch Airline and the Sri Lankan Airlines have been designated to operate to and from Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to enter into the said Air Services Agreement, which had been agreed upon at the official level in the preliminary discussions, and to take appropriate steps for the effective implementation of the said Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Opening of Domestic Airports for the Operation of the Regional Commercial Flights
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - During the Past several years, the Government has taken a series of measures to improve the domestic aviation. Consequently, action has been taken to develop the Batticaloa Airport and to enhance civil aviation facilities at Ratmalana Airport while steps are being taken to improve the Palali Airport. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to instruct the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka to perform certification of aerodromes for the commencement of Regional Air Service operations in conformity with the applicable standards to foreign destinations and to prepare the border control formalities to discharge their legitimate functions at such Airports, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaring 21st of March as the Surveyors' Day
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to declare 02nd of August as the Surveyors' Day and the International Federation of Surveyors, in turn, has declared 21st March as the Surveyors' Day. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms, to declare 21st of March every year as the Surveyors' Day, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment and re-establishment of Irrigation reservations for Irrigation schemes, structures and water bodies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - Focus has been made to launch a sustainable programme to identify the requirements for the protection of irrigation reservations in order to maintain irrigation schemes properly and presently, the suitable boundaries for future needs have been identified by reviewing the existing irrigation reservations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and to declare the boundaries of reservations and conservation lands for irrigation schemes, structures and water bodies through a gazette notification as the orders relevant to the present Irrigation Ordinance with the concurrence of the Attorney General and subsequently, table the said regulations in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining approval for a Memorandum of Understanding by the National Aquatic Resources Research and Development Agency (NARA) with the United Kingdom Hydrographic Office (UKHO)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has entered into a bilateral agreement with the United Kingdom Hydrographic Office in the year 2002 to provide updated navigational and safety information for the mariners sailing across the Sri Lankan waters and the only one in force at the moment is the amendment made to such agreement in the year 2005. Further, in the year 2013 the NARA has granted the UKHO the authority to produce and distribute Electronic Navigation Charts in the form of an agreement. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to amend the agreement made to produce and distribute Standard Nautical Charts and Electronic Nautical Charts reviewing the said agreement enabling Sri Lanka to gain authority for the production and distribution of Standard Nautical Charts and Electronic Nautical Charts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of 'Sugarcane crop' as a major plantation crop to increase the sugar production in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - The annual sugar consumption of Sri Lanka is 670,000 metric tons and 91% of this requirement is fulfilled by importation. The amount of expenditure annually incurred for this purpose is around US$ 350 million. By the year 2020, it is expected that the domestic sugar requirement will be increased up to 700,000 metric tons and lands in extent of about 104,000 hectares have been identified in the districts of Moneragala, Batticaloa, Kilinochchi, Anuradhapura, Trincomalee, Ampara, Badulla and Polonnaruwa, enabling to meet this requirement. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation Industries, to declare Sugarcane crop also as a major plantation crop in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of plots of lands to the Department of Measurement Units, Standards & Service, Department of Educational Publications, Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment and Sri Lanka Telecom
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - The Urban Development Authority has acquired an extent of 34.0 hectares of land from Mahenawatta situated at Pitipana in Homagama for the development of activities associated with science and technology and to establish the related institutes. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to allocate plots of lands to the Department of Measurement Units, Standards & Service to establish a National Laboratory of Measurement, to the Department of Educational Publications to construct a Store Complex for the text books, to the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment to construct a Training Centre and to the Sri Lanka Telecom to establish a Data Centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Cooperative Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to seek the public opinion with regard to proposed National Cooperative Policy. As such, the proposal made by Acting Minister of Industry & Commerce, Resettlement of Protracted Displaced Persons, Co operative Development and Vocational Training & Skills Development to implement the amended National Cooperative Policy prepared incorporating the views and suggestions submitted in this respect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 02 silos for the storage of base raw materials for Thriposha productions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Thriposha Limited possesses only a small silo with a capacity of 1200 metric tons at present for the purpose of storing raw materials necessary for Thriposha production. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to construct two silos with the capacity of 4000 metric tons each by utilizing the funds of Sri Lanka Thriposha Limited with a view to obtaining necessary storage facilities so as to store maize and soya beans when there is a surplus of same to maintain Thriposha and Suposha production continuously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the National Zoological Gardens Act, No.41 of 1982
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the National Zoological Gardens Act, No.41 of 1982 should be amended to suit the present functions of the Department of National Zoological Gardens and its institutional structure. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs to refer the National Zoological Gardens Act, No.41 of 1982 to the Legal Draftsman to amend it as appropriate to the present and the proposed new activities of the Department of National Zoological Gardens, removing the existing legal restrictions in carrying out ex situ conservation of animals (outside the natural habitat) and the animal breading programmes experimentally, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of Mihintale as a National Heritage
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that the Government requires to make a higher contribution compared to the present state patronage being given in order to minimize the difficulties when conducting the Poson Festival as a National Festival with the special rituals and customs attached to it. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to take the necessary steps to declare Mihintale as a National Heritage, the Poson Week and Mihintale perahara as National ceremonies and to set apart provisions annually for the Mihintale Poson Festival through the Ministry of Buddhasasana & Wayamba Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of new vehicles for the Election Commission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - The Election Commission is in the process of fulfilling the necessary tasks to conduct national level elections scheduled in the year 2019 and 2020. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to purchase 14 New Cabs and a Van for the Election Commission to enable it to accomplish the elections to be held in the days to come, efficiently and productively, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Gratis Visas for tourists visiting Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-23
decision_details_body:
- The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to implement a pilot project to grant Gratis Visas for tourists visiting Sri Lanka, from Thailand, European Union, United Kingdom, the USA, Japan, Australia, South Korea, Canada, Singapore, New Zealand, Malaysia, Switzerland, Cambodia with a view to attracting a more number of tourists to Sri Lanka. Nevertheless, the Cabinet decided to suspend the introduction of Gratis Visas temporarily taking into consideration the security concerns of the country that arose due to the Easter Sunday terrorist attack.

	Since, the situation of the country is back to normalcy, by now, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs to conduct the pilot project for granting Gratis Visas for tourists of the said countries including Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland, Iceland, Phillippines, Russia, China, India and England, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Ship to Shore Cranes and Gantry Cranes for the East Container Terminal for the Development of the Colombo South Port in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-23
decision_details_body: - In terms of the approval granted by the Cabinet, a Memorandum of Cooperation (MoC) has been signed by Sri Lanka, India and Japan to extend Cooperation for the development of the East Container Terminal of the Colombo South Port. Purchasing and installation of 06 ship cranes and 18 Electric Rubber Tyred Gantry Cranes is necessary for the operation of the East Container Terminal. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports & Shipping and Southern Development, to purchase the said container handling equipment in accordance with the provisions made in the Memorandum of Cooperation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of the contract for the consultancy services for the project implementation of the Northern Province (PIC 04) under the Asian Development Bank funded Second Integrated Road Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development to award the consultancy services contract for the project implementation including construction and supervision, contract management and other implementation activities in the Northern Province under the Asian Development Bank funded Second Integrated Road Investment Programme, to M/s MG Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd. (Sri Lanka) in joint venture with Engineering Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd. (Sri Lanka), for a sum of US$ 2.37 million and Rs.791.5 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer - 2019 (August)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development to obtain the covering approval of the Cabinet to procure the fertilizer requirement of 5,500 MT of Urea (Prilled), at the rate of US$ 322.74 per MT, 60,000MT of Urea (Granular) at the rate of US$ 312.99 and 5,900MT of Muriate of Potash (Red/Pinksh) at the rate of US$ 355.49 from the M/s Valency International Trading (Pvt.) Ltd., and 15,800MT Triple Super Phosphate at the rate of US$ 302.50 from M/s Golden Barley International (Pvt.) Ltd., to fulfill the fertilizer need of the month of August of the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Limited, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Integrated Treasury Management Information System (ITMIS) in the Government Ministries and Departments
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-23
decision_details_body:
- On the success of the 02 pilot projects implemented, it has been planned to establish the Integrated Treasury Management Information System (ITMIS) in all the Ministries, Departments, District Secretariats and Special Spending Agencies in place of the existing CIGAS system.

A software developed by the FreeBalance Inc. Company has been used in this system and any further enhancements and configuration changes that are needed during the use of this software could only be done through the said Company. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC) and a Technical Evaluation Committee in order to establish the ITMIS system for every public institutions and to procure the said services from the FreeBalance Inc. Company, in accordance with the recommendations of the said Committees, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing a new salary structure for the Department of Posts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-23
decision_details_body:
- A new salary structure prepared for the Department of Posts had been submitted to the Cabinet prior to this and the Cabinet has referred it for the recommendations of the Special Commission on Reviewing the Salaries of the Public Sector appointed by H.E. the President to make recommendations with regard to the salary anomalies of the entire Public Service including the Railway, Health, Education and Postal Services. The Report submitted by the Commission, includes the recommendations to remove the salary anomalies existing in the Department of Posts, as well as the recommendations with regard to other services and a number of Government Institutions.

As such, at its meeting held on 2019 02 12, the Cabinet has appointed a Cabinet Sub Committee under the Chairmanship of the Minister of Finance and an Officials' Committee to assist the Sub Committee in order to submit recommendations on the implementation of the recommendations of the said Commission Report, after a technical and financial review in that regard. The said Report is due to be submitted to the Cabinet shortly.

Accordingly, the matters presented by the Minister of Postal Services & Muslim Religious Affairs with regard to the urgent necessity of preparing a new salary structure for the Department of Posts was considered by the Cabinet and since the recommendations of the Special Commission to review the salary structure of the Public Service have been submitted with regard to other services and a number of State institutions as well, the implementation of its recommendations in respect of only the Department of Posts at this juncture is not proper, the Cabinet decided to consider implementation of the recommendations made by the said Commission, pertaining to the Department of Posts on a priority basis, as soon as the recommendations of the Cabinet Sub Committee under the Chairmanship of the Minister of Finance are received pertaining to all recommendations made by the Special Salary Commission.

description: Nation Building Tax (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Finance, to publish the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman to amend the Nation Building Tax Act, No.9 of 2009 incorporating the necessary legal provisions for construction, tourism services, gem and jewellery industry and providing tax concessions relating to certain processing industries, inclusive of bringing cigarette manufacturing under the Nation Building Tax, to give effect to the amendments proposed in the Budget 2019, in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Value Added Tax (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-23
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet had been granted to amend the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002 to give effect to certain amendments indicated in the Budget proposals for the year 2019 on the VAT and to encourage the local construction industry as well as certain local industries using locally available materials. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to publish the Value Added Tax (Amendment) Bill drafted by the Legal draftsman as per the prior approval, in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Palmyrah Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-23
decision_details_body: - A provision of Rs.15.25 billion had been allocated to strengthen the reconciliation process in Sri Lanka by the Budget 2019. In the instance, the approved proposals include the establishment of an independent fund called 'Palmyrah Fund' with a view to ensuring that war-affected communities in Northern and Eastern Provinces reap the benefits of the development. Assisting in the consultancy and support programmes initiated by the civil society towards the matters pertaining to alcoholism, drug abuse, and eradication of youth unemployment is also the objective of this fund. A sum of Rs. 5 billion had been allocated to spend within a period of two years for the said purpose and it is anticipated to allocate provisions for the development of Northern and Eastern Provinces through this fund. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft necessary legislation for the establishment of an independent entity called 'Palmyrah Fund', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Sri Lanka National Youth Voluntary Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-23
decision_details_body: -The encouragement of the youth towards social activities and community development activities and also the inculcation of the team spirit through their leadership and personality development has become a timely necessity. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs, to establish the Sri Lanka National Youth Voluntary Service aimed at building a disciplined and skill filled Sri Lankan community of youth, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recruitment and training of unemployed Graduates as Graduate Trainees
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-23
decision_details_body: - Under the project for the Recruitment of unemployed Graduates, the approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously, to recruit 5,000 unemployed graduates who have completed their degrees as internal students of the State Universities, in Stage 1 and, also for the recruitment of 15,000 graduates for training, in Stage 2. However, 1,800 vacancies out of those recruited under Stage 1 and 15,000 vacancies in Stage 2 still remain. Accordingly, the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs brought to the notice of the Cabinet that action will be taken expeditiously to fill the 16,800 vacancies that remain by initially recruiting the graduates of the year 2012 and subsequently from those of the year 2013 to 2016 respectively as trainees.

description: Introduction of an effective Legal Framework to Counter Terrorism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-23
decision_details_body: - Since the introduction of new legal measures to prevent the rise of terrorist groups in future is a timely need, aimed at preventing people becoming terrorists, a proposal has been submitted to the Cabinet by the Hon. Prime Minister focusing attention in the areas on temporary restriction orders, prohibition on encouragement of terrorism and control of being in a designated foreign area and bio metric data etc. After having a discussion in this regard, approval was granted by the Cabinet to appoint a Ministerial Committee under the Chairmanship of the Minister of Foreign Affairs in order to submit the facts to the Cabinet with regard to this, after making a study of the laws pertaining to the matter available in the UK and other countries

description: Construction of Solar PV Power Plants for the 02 Grid Substations in Ampara and Habarana under the 'Soorya Bala Sangramaya Phase II' Program
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to award the Investors, the 07 Solar Power Projects of 1MW expected to be connected to the 07 projects of the Ampara Grid Substation and the 07 Solar Power Projects of 1MW expected to be connected to the Habarana Grid Substation under the Soorya Bala Sangramaya Phase II and to authorize the Ceylon Electricity Board to enter into Agreements pertaining to the purchase of electricity in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 10,000,000 bottles of 500ml Sodium Chloride Intravenous Infusion BP 0.9% w/v or Sodium Chloride Injection USP, 0.9% w/v
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to award the procurement for the supply of 10,000,000 bottles of 500ml Sodium Chloride Intravenous Infusion BP 0.9% w/v or Sodium Chloride Injection USP, 0.9% w/v, to M/s Aculife Healthcare (Pvt.) Ltd. of India for a sum of US$ 2.6 million, being the total cost inclusive of the freight charges, as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 45,000 vials of 5g - 6g of Human Immunoglobulin required for Intravenous use
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to award the procurement for the supply of 45,000 vials of 5g - 6g of Human Immunoglobulin required for Intravenous use, to M/s Reliance Life Science (Pvt.) Ltd. of India for a sum of US$ 4.8 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of two spare engines required for the maintenance of the Aircraft fleet of SriLankan Airlines Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Finance to purchase 02 Leap Spare Engines for the maintenance of the Aircraft fleet of SriLankan Airlines Limited from the CFM International Institute, in terms of the Agreement signed between the SriLankan Airlines Limited and the CFM Institute, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining approval for the Ruhunu Economic Development Corporation Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - It has been decided to establish the Ruhunu Economic Development Corporation to implement the development activities in the southern region expeditiously with special emphasis on the establishment of export oriented special economic zones in the said region. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports & Shipping and Southern Development to publish the Ruhunu Economic Development Corporation Act prepared by the Legal Draftsman in the Government (Extraordinary) Gazette and subsequently, to present same in the Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Hajj Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approval has been granted previously, to draft the National Hajj Act and submit it to the Legal Draftsman. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Postal Services & Muslim Religious Affairs, to include the provisions to regulate Umrah Pilgrimage as well in the draft and to amend the name of the proposed Act to read as Hajj and Umrah Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an integrity platform for Women Helpline
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - A platform for Women Helpline has been established operative through the telephone number 1938, with a view to providing assistance and relief for complaints of women related to all forms of discrimination against women, defilement of the rights of women, harassments and all types of abusive incidents. It has been planned to improve this help line to provide immediate and emergency response to women across the country throughout the 24 hours. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women & Child Affairs and Dry Zone Development, to establish a mobile based online platform to report violence and harassment to the relevant authorities in a safe and secure manner, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Air Services Agreement between Sri Lanka and Tanzania
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously, to sign the Air Services Agreement between Sri Lanka and the United Republic of Tanzania. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to amend and implement the Agreement based on the matters agreed upon at the consultation between the Aeronautical Authorities of both the countries held in Kenya in December 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Central Expressway Project II - Construction of a new access road to link  Ambepussa - Kurunegala-Trincomalee A006 road and Kurunegala Interchange
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to construct a New Link Road of 1.1 kilometre in length in order to provide connectivity between the Expressway at Kurunegala Interchange and A006  Ambepussa, Kurunegala Trincomalee Road,  as a way to provide an opportunity for the general public using Part II of the  Central Expressway from Meerigama to Kurunegala, to enter and exit from A006 road and to avoid the main town of Kurunegala for the purpose of minimizing traffic congestion, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the Livelihood Enhancement of the Small Scale Farmers in the SAARC Region countries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: It has been proposed to implement the Small Scale Agro Business focusing on the value chain development of the Livelihood Enhancement of the Small Scale Farmers of the SAARC Region countries, with a view to enhancing the  livelihood level of the small scale farmers. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to implement the project on the contribution of the SAARC Development Fund and the Local Funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Regulation of Fertilizer Act, No.68 of 1988
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - The Regulation of Fertilizer Act, No.68 has been adopted for formalizing the importation, manufacture, formulation and distribution of fertilizer and to make provisions for matters connected thereto and the need for the amendment of its provisions to suit the present day needs has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to draft legislation by the Legal Draftsman, based on the procedure relating to matters such as the analyzing of fertilizer, obtaining laboratory assistance for same, fertilizer standardization and certification, revision of fines and the fields in respect of which regulations may be enforced, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Lower Malwathu Oya Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to expedite the implementation of the Lower Malwathu Oya Project by using the Government Consolidated Fund. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to secure the financial provisions so as to enable to commence the programme this year itself, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Smallholder Tea and Rubber Revitalization Project - Implementation of the Rural Finance Component and obtaining the interest subsidy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - Agreements have been made by now, for the implementation of the Smallholder Tea and Rubber Revitalization Project on the contribution of the International Fund for Agricultural Development and the Local Funds. The two main components of this project are the tea replanting and the rubber new planting. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation Industries to include a 'Rural Finance Component' in the project and implement it, as a source of self employment or a short term income generating activity to cover the lost income of the planters until such time tea plucking is done in the new replanted tea plantation as an old tea plantation where tea is plucked has to be removed for tea replanting and to generate certain income until such time that tapping is done in a new rubber plantation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of the Tea Promotion and Marketing Levy on Export of Tea
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of the Sri Lanka Tea Board Law No.14 of 1975, a levy of Rs.3.50 is made on every kilogram of exported tea from the registered exporters. As a result of the direct and indirect levies and the economic service charges made by now, the cost of production charges will further increase and as such, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation Industries, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to make legislation to revise the tea promotion and marketing levy as Rs.3/- per kilogram and publish same in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of land at Kandawalawatta, Ratmalana to the National Housing Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to grant a block of land of 37.16 perches of the land in extent of 80 perches belonging to the Urban Development Authority to the National Housing Development Authority as a free grant, enabling to issue Deeds of Transfer to the occupants who have been already settled there, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: A new Bill for the Repeal and Replacement of the Uniforms Ordinance No.6 of 1895
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - The Uniforms Ordinance No.6 of 1895 has been enacted to confine and regulate wearing of uniforms by all the civilians. However, a trend of instances for the possession of uniforms similar to the uniforms of the Armed Forces and the use of garments similar to the colour of camouflage uniforms  worn by the Armed Forces, as a fashionable style, has been observed. As this situation adversely affects the National Security very seriously, an urgent necessity has arisen to prepare the laws for the prevention of such activities, to suit the present needs. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to Repeal and replace the Uniforms Ordinance No.6 of 1895, to introduce legal provisions to meet the present challenges and to draft a new Bill for the Uniforms Ordinance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulations made under the Factories Ordinance (Chapter 128)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - The main function under the Factories Ordinance is the inspection of factories by the Department of Labour so as to maintain the occupational safety and health as well as the welfare of the workers. Although, the provisions in the Ordinance have been in operation for well over 65 years, a few regulations only have been made therein up to date. Accordingly, considering the necessity of the effective enforcement of the law, the proposal made by H.E. the President, at the request of the Non Cabinet Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, to present the regulations pertaining to Registration of Factories and Approval of Factory Buildings; Registration of Steam Boilers; Issue of certificates for examination of Steam Boilers and other Pressure Vessels; Protection of workers from Excessive Noise and General Standards of Lighting, in Parliament for approval and on receipt of such approval, to publish them in the Government gazette, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revising of the Regulations of the Hazardous list of Occupations gazetted under the Employment of Women, Young Persons and Children Act, No.47 of 1956
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - Fifty one instances of work that are hazardous to the young persons under 18 years of age have been identified by the regulations made in the year 2010, under the Employment of Women, Young Persons and Children Act, No.47 of 1956. Nevertheless, the nature of employment, as of now, has changed significantly and as such, 77 various forms of employment have been identified where work can be hazardous to the children and hinder their physical, mental and moral development. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, at the request of the Non Cabinet Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, to present the proposed hazardous employment regulations of the year 2019 in Parliament and on receipt of such approval to publish them in the Government gazette, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Registration of Electors Act, No.44 of 1980
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President to publish the draft Bill pertaining to the amendment of the Registration of Electors Act, No.44 of 1980, in the Government Gazette in the three languages in order to provide opportunities for the youth who attain 18 years of age and satisfy other required qualifications during the period till the revision of the next register of electors is started, commencing from the certification of register of electors in the process of the annual revision of the register of electors to exercise their voting rights, and subsequently, to present the said Bill in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Research Collaboration Agreement between Sao Paulo Research Foundation of Brazil and the National Science Foundation of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - The National Science Foundation of Sri Lanka and the Sao Paulo Research Foundation of Brazil are leading science funding agencies of both countries and with a view to implementing scientific and technological cooperation among the researches of these two institutions, the proposal made by H.E. the President at the request of the Non Cabinet Minister of Science, Technology & Research to enter into a Research Collaboration Agreement between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Scientific Cooperation between the Russian Foundation for Basic Research and the National Science Foundation of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President at the request of the Non-Cabinet Minister of Science, Technology & Research to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding on Scientific Cooperation between the Russian Foundation for Basic Research and the National Science Foundation of Sri lanka with a view to providing additional opportunities to exchange ideas, information and skills in science, technology and innovation between Sri Lanka and Russia and establishing a cooperative relationship between the two parties to support the cooperative activities of the researchers of both countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revival of  the Tourism Sector - 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - The tourism sector has contributed more than 4.5% to the Gross Domestic Production of Sri Lanka during the last few years of the recent past.  Nevertheless,  the industry was severely affected by the Easter Sunday attacks.  Continuation of airline operations into Sri Lanka and taking promotional measures to attract more tourists into the country enabling the airlines to sustain their operations, are of paramount importance to revive the industry. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs, to instruct the Sri Lankan Airlines to reduce the charges for fuel and lubricant oil supplied to the airlines in Sri Lanka and  the charges levied for other services such as Ground Handling Charges in order to attract airlines to the country, to instruct the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation to reduce the aviation fuel price to match with the aviation fuel price at Chennai Airport and to suspend the implementation of the Budget proposal for the increase of the Embarkation Levy by US$ 10, for a period of 06 months was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mid - Year Fiscal Position Report - 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Finance to table the  Mid - Year Fiscal Position Report - 2019 prepared, explaining the macroeconomic management of Sri Lanka in a difficult local and global environment and the Government revenue, expenditure and cash flow management, including the updated information on the fiscal status of Sri Lanka  during the first four (04) months of 2019, in terms of the provisions of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No.03 of 2003, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the contract for the consultancy services for Western Province Project (PIC 07) of the the Second Integrated Road Investment Programme funded by the Asian Development Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development to award the contract for providing  consultancy services for project Implementation including construction supervision, contract management, and other activities pertinent to the implementation, in the Western Province (PIC 07) project   under the Asian Development Bank funded Second Integrated Road Investment Programme to M/s SMEC International (Pvt.) Ltd., (Australia), Sub-consultant with Resources Development Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd., (Sri Lanka) and Master Hellie's Engineering Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd., Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of the contract for the Supply, Delivery,Installation and Commissioning of 3 Transformers for the Kotugoda Grid Substation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the supply, delivery, installation and commissioning of 3 transformers to enhance the capacity of  the Kotugoda Grid Substation to M/s TBEA Shenyang Transformer Group co. Ltd, of China, for a sum of US $ 2.6 million and Rs.2.5 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of the Services to Conduct a Forensic Audit/Investigation on Selected Entities Regulated and Supervised by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to obtain the services of a firm with a global practice and international experience to conduct a Forensic Audit/Investigation on selected entities regulated and supervised by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, due to the huge gap between the quotations of the bids which had been submitted for the purpose, the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee has recommended that it would be appropriate to recall bids. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, to revise the cost estimate for the forensic audit and to recall bids for selecting a suitable entity for the proposed task and also to obtain the services of the Consultants Procurement Committee previously appointed by the Cabinet for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between the National Institute of Social Development and the University Colleges Leuven - Limburg (UCLL) Belgium
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of  Primary Industries and Social Empowerment to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the National Institute of Social Development and the University Colleges Leuven  Limburg (UCLL) Belgium with a view to obtaining professional expertise for the promotion of academic studies of the National Institute of Social Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Convention on International Settlement Agreements Resulting from Mediation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - Mediation is an important form of  dispute resolution which has the ability to achieve mutually acceptable solutions and preserve commercial relationships while saving time and cost. The United Nations General Assembly, in the year 2018, adopted the United Nations Convention on International Settlement Agreements Resulting from Mediation (“the Convention”) and accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to sign the Convention, on behalf of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Prison Intelligence Unit with a Legal Framework under the Prison Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to establish a Prison Intelligence Unit to facilitate an effective administration and discipline in the prisons, subject to the general powers and control of the Commissioner General of Prison, contemplated under the Prisons Ordinance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recommendation of Additional Amendments to the Construction Industry Development Act, No.33 of 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously, to amend the Construction Industry Development Act, No.33 of 2014 to suit the present trends. Accordingly, the Legal Draftsman has prepared a preliminary draft and the Construction Industry Development Authority as well as the Chamber of Construction Industry including several stakeholder institutions in the construction industry have pointed out the need for the provisions to be further included in the draft Act, to prevent the malpractices and under performances existing in the industry, at present. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs, to amend the said Bill incorporating the above additional amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No.2 of 1996 in order to regulate illegal activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - The number of complaints made by the foreign countries with regard to illegal fishing activities in their Exclusive Economic Zones by the registered Sri Lankan fishing boats are on the increase. At the same time, the trend in abusing fishing boats for drug trafficking, human trafficking as well as illegal transportation of goods outside the fishing industry, has also increased rapidly and in the cases filed against such offences, very often the owners of the boats have to pay the fine imposed on the offence or at times, have to get imprisoned. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to amend the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, incorporating the amendment, so as to penalize the boat owner or the boat operator (skipper) or the master or the persons on board or abetting in such offences, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of financial provision for the construction of the Gandara Fishery Harbour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - In relevance to the construction of the Gandara and Gurunagar Fishery Habours, although the decision taken by the Cabinet at a meeting held previously, was for the project proposer company Bouygues Trvaux Publics to submit a Voluntary Feasibility Assessment and a Domestic Engineer Estimate, the said company failed to submit a comprehensive project proposal before the due date and accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Finance and the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to terminate the procurement procedure implemented in respect of the company and also to construct the Gandara Fishery Harbour by utilizing local funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting a Regional Workshop on the Underutilized Fish and Marine Genetic Resources and their Amelioration in collaboration with the Asia - Pacific Association of the Agricultural Research Institutions (APAARI)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - Although a great concern has been made by many Asiatic Countries on aquaculture and the under utilizing of fish and marine genetic resources and acquired a sound knowledge and skills in that regard, Sri Lanka has not grasped an adequate amount of knowledge or information in the field.  As such, the Sri Lanka Council of Agriculture Research Policy has planned to conduct a regional conference on underutilized fish and marine genetic resources and have a discussion on the matter with the other countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to conduct a regional workshop on Underutilized Fish and Marine Genetic Resources and their amelioration from 10th to 12th of July 2019 in Sri Lanka, in collaboration with the Asia - Pacific Association of Agricultural Research Institution, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Minimizing the problems associated with the damages caused to  cultivation by wild animals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - A Committee was established with the representation of the relevant Government Institutions to formulate a sustainable programme for minimizing the damages caused to cultivation of agricultural crops by wild animals. The Committee has prepared an Action Plan to minimize the damages caused by the wild animals. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to secure the necessary funds for the implementation of the said plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Meethotamulle Redevelopment Project (MRDP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously, to appoint an Officials' Committee to examine the proposals for the implementation of the Meethotamulle Redevelopment Project and make recommendations.  Accordingly, the Officials' Committee has submitted the Report inclusive of its recommendations and the proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Development to implement the Meethotamulle Redevelopment Project subject to the said recommendations , was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taking necessary action for the deportation of the detainees at the Mirihana Detention Camp
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - The foreigners who have violated the Immigrants and Emigrants Act, No.20 of 1948 until the relevant Courts or Institutional proceedings are concluded and those delaying their return to their own countries after concluding their proceedings, are detained in the detention camp situated in the Mirihana Police Station.  Although, adequate facilities have been provided in the camp for only 36 detainees, presently, there are 166 detainees are of various nationalities detained in the camp. As a result of these detainees being detained under minimum facilities, various issues have cropped up among them. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government, to take necessary action, for the deportation of the detainees so detained in the camp of the Mirihana Police Station to their own countries within a short period, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the “Scholarship for Educational Excellence - SEE Fund”
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - Presently, around 160,000 students, out of the 250,000 students who sit for the G.C.E. Advanced Level Examination gain eligibility for admission to University Education. With the objective of supporting personal growth on educational excellence and carrier development the Government wishes to provide scholarships to the highest performers of those students in the fields of Physical Science, Biological Science, Technology, Commerce and Arts to pursue their undergraduate studies at the world renowned Universities such as Harvard, MIT, Oxford and Cambridge, etc. As such, it has been proposed to adopt an Act in Parliament for the establishment of the 'Scholarship for Educational Excellence - SEE Fund' through the Budget 2019. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Finance, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Drug Dependent Persons (Treatment and Rehabilitation) Act, No.54 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - The Drug Dependent Persons (Treatment and Rehabilitation) Act, No.54 of 2007 has been enacted for the regulation of the activities of the treatment and rehabilitation centres for persons addicted to drugs. However, the need for  the amendment of the said Act has been identified to suit the present needs in order to more formalize the process pertaining to the treatment and rehabilitation of persons addicted to drugs and stimulants. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, to amend the Drug Dependent Persons (Treatment and Rehabilitation) Act, No.54 of 2007 incorporating the facts such as regularizing the unctions and the appointment of the Director in‑charge of the treatment centre, regularizing the issuance, renewal and cancellation of licenses issued to private treatment centres, obtaining the services of the officers of the Department of Health Services and inclusion of the compulsory period of rehabilitation etc., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making the Women's Chamber for Digital an active contributor in the acceleration of Sri Lanka's Digital Economy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-07
decision_details_body: - The Women's Chamber for Digital has been established by the Women who empowered the field of information and communication technology, with a view to providing an integrated approach in the acceleration of the Digital Economy of Sri Lanka. It has been observed that the objectives of the Women's Chamber for Digital are aligned with the women entrepreneurship and leadership promotional programmes as well as the Government policies and strategies on substantial promotion of anticipated benefits through digitization. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President,  at the request of the Non‑Cabinet Minister of Digital Infrastructure and Information Technology, to join the Women's Chamber for Digital as an active participant in the programmes of Women's entrepreneurship associated with information technology executed by the public institutes and to provide the necessary facilities for that Chamber, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of the Policy Framework of the Government Fiscal Rules
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - The Government Fiscal activities of Sri Lanka are handled under a Fiscal Management Responsibility Framework introduced by the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No.3 of 2003 enacted for public debt sustainability and the management of fiscal risks. However, the objectives envisaged in the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, have continuously been failed to achieve since  2006 due to the macro economic and fiscal challenges which had to be faced since its introduction, the Tsunami devastation and the prolonged internal conflict. As such, certain above said government fiscal targets have been revised in the year 2013 and 2016. Accordingly, the  proposal made by the Minister of Finance, to amend the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No.3 of 2003 with a view to strengthening the responsible fiscal management, revising the existing Fiscal Regulation Framework inclusive of the Debt Rules, a Medium Term Fiscal Framework, Operational Targets, an Automatic Correction Mechanism, Flexibility, Transparency, Accountability and Oversight or to include the relevant amendments in the Fiscal Management Act, now being drafted, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer - 2019 (July)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to purchase 30,000 MT of Urea (Granular) at the rate of US$ 318.25 per MT from Agri Commodities & Finance, 3000 MT of Muriate of Potash at the rate of US$ 342.2 per MT from M/s Agricultural Resources & Investment PTE. Ltd. and 15,500 MT of Triple Super Phosphate at the rate of US$ 324 per MT from M/s Golden Barley International PTE. Ltd., for the purpose of fulfilling the fertilizer requirements of the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Limited for the month of July, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Container Boxes for the Transportation of Solid waste from Kelaniya to Aruwakkalu
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to award the contract for the supply of Container Boxes necessary for the  transportation of solid waste from Kelaniya to Aruwakkalu to M/s Dongfang Electric International Corporation, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, for the purpose of activating the municipal solid waste sanitary landfill disposal solution at Aruwakkalu with the objective of solving the municipal solid waste issue, which has emerged as a national issue, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Supply of 6,000 MT of Soya Beans to the Sri Lanka Thriposha Limited for the production of Thriposha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to award the procurement  for the purchase of 6000 MT of Soya Beans used for the manufacturing of Thriposha, which is a nutritious food supplement distributed freely to the children with malnutrition, the pregnant mothers with nutrition problems and the lactating mothers, to M/s S.D.K United Agri Ventures (Pvt) Limited, for a sum of Rs 840 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing facilities for the Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) Patients to carry out the Dialysis System  at home
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to implement a pilot project for the use of automated peritoneal dialysis in home setting for the patients of the Chronic Kidney Disease of unknown origin and the Chronic Kidney Disease patients. A sum of Rs.500 million has been set apart by the Budget of 2019 for the implementation of this project. It has been observed that this activity has contributed to prolonging the life span of the kidney patients and   bestowing a better outcome of their lives. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to enter into an Agreement with M/s Lucenxia Healthcare (Pvt.) Ltd. for the implementation of the project ,for a period of 08 years at the rate of Rs.103,740/- per patient per month, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Report of the Sectoral Oversight Committee on Education and Human Resources Development on the Observations regarding the Batticaloa Campus (Pvt.) Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - The observation report of the Chairman of the Sectoral Oversight Committee on Education and Human Resources Development, on the Batticaloa Campus (Pvt.) Limited, which has been presented to the Parliament was submitted to focus the attention of the Cabinet and the Cabinet decided to appoint a Ministerial Sub-Committee comprising of the Ministers of Finance, City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, National Integration, Official Languages, Social Progress and Hindu Religious Affairs and Development Strategies and International Trade, to study the recommendations made by the said Sectoral Oversight Committee and report to the Cabinet.

description: Improving the learning environment of the schools in the Killinochchi District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - The Government has taken steps for implementing various projects to conduct the educational activities of the Kilinochchi area in a high qualitative  standard, which has slumped in to a backward position owing to the conflict situation that prevailed there for three decades. Accordingly, a project for the development of the infrastructure in the schools of the Kilinochchi District was implemented since 2011, with a grant of US$ 2 million by the  Korea International Cooperation Agency  and the facts submitted by the Minister of Education to the effect that an extension to the project will be implemented with a grant of US$ 7.5 million to upgrade the educational activities of selected 13 schools in the Kilinochchi District during the period from 2018 to 2022, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Pre-cast Disaster Resilient Houses in the high risk landslide prone areas of the Ratnapura and Kalutara Districts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - An account named, 'the Secretary, Ministry of Disaster Management' has been opened for the donors to credit money for providing relief assistance to the people affected due to emergency disaster situations and as at 2019‑03‑31 a balance of Rs.294.72 million has been reported in the account. The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to the proposal made by an active operational institution of China to construct 10,000 Pre‑cast Disaster Resilient Houses for the families who live in disaster prone areas and who should be resettled due to landslides and flood disasters island‑wide.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Disaster Management and Rural Economic Affairs, to construct 230 houses out of the 400 houses due to be constructed in the Ratnapura and Kalutara districts as a pilot project by utilizing the funds in the said account, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Launching a Cable Car Project for the promotion of the Tourism Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - Nuwara Eliya situated at the apex point in Sri Lanka which inherits a splendorous environment with  a star attraction of local and foreign tourists and as a further step towards enhancing its glamour, a project proposal has been submitted by the Outdoor Engineering Lanka (Pvt.) Ltd. and its foreign partner Doppelmayr Cable Car to initiate a Cable Car Project from Nanu Oya to Single Tree and Gregory Lake. The project which is proposed to be implemented with an investment of US$ 50 million, proposes to construct 21 towers connecting Nanu Oya Railway Station, Race Course and Single Tree hill in Nuwara Eliya consisting of 86 cabins where 10 people could travel in each cabin and out of which 43 cabins will be installed under its first phase. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation Industries to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding, to implement the project as a project of the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Forming of an Apex Committee as the Task Force to facilitate the implementation of the Pettah Multimodal Transport Hub Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to establish the Pettah Multimodal Transport Hub and to call for Expression of Interest (EOI) from suitable investors who would undertake the activities pertaining to the implementation of the project from the private sector financial assistance. In order to complete the plan of this project, there are several complex problems to be resolved. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to finalize the technological and financial feasible studies pertaining to the project and to appoint a steering committee to act as the task force of the Pettah Multimodal Transport Hub to intervene in the said problems and take decisions , was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of the mental health services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - The impact of the population structure and the diseases of the country is in a changing process and in order to face such situations the health care  delivery system has to be restructured. It has been identified that, at present, around 10% of the total population in the country suffer from any sort of mental illness and only a 40% out of them resort to treatment and it has been assumed that the problems related to mental illness will tend to increase in the future. Considering these facts, the attention of the Government has been drawn to promote mental health services with a view to generating a healthy population. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to construct the new Psychiatric Treatment Unit Complex at the Teaching Hospital in Kandy with an investment of  Rs.503 million and the Psychiatric Treatment Unit at the District Base Hospital in Chillaw with an investment of Rs.213.8 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulations pertaining to the International Telecommunication Operators' Levy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Finance to remove the levy payable on Outgoing Local Access Charge with effect from 2019‑06‑01, to extend the validity period of levy payable on Incoming International Calls, Incoming International Calls on Specific Telephone Numbers Charge, Rate of Disbursement of Levy as Incoming Calls, Access Charge, the Rate of Disbursement of Levy as Telecommunication Development Charge and Outgoing Local Access Charge as proposed in the Budget 2019 and to present the Gazette Notification No.2123/19 dated 2019‑05‑14 in Parliament for approval in terms of the Finance Act, No.11 of 2004, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the National Environment Act, No.47 of 1980
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-02
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to amend the National Environment Act, No.47 of 1980 enacted to suit the present trends, with a view to providing a wide Legal Framework required to coordinate all sectors involved in the environment of Sri Lanka at national level. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to amend the National Environment Act, No.47 of 1980 to incorporate further amendments such as the comprehensive responsibility of the manufacturer in respect of the items which generate hazardous waste material, making domestic laws to empower multi‑faceted environmental Agreements, focusing attention on environmental conditions at the preliminary environmental test and evaluation of environmental effects, prevention of environmental pollution by activities which do not require environmental protection permits,  obtaining the authority to take into custody any implement prohibited by the existing Act and its destruction and the increase of the Members of the Environmental Committee etc., when making this amendment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Public Officers' Dress
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - A Circular has been issued on 2019‑05‑29 regarding the Public Officers' Dress by the Secretary to the Ministry in‑charge of the subject of Public Administration by virtue of the powers vested in him by the Establishments Code. However, considering the various representations made to the Minister in‑charge of the subject of Public Administration pertaining to the implementation of the said Circular, it has been proposed to revise the above Circular. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration, Disaster Management and Rural Economic Affairs to issue circular instructions inclusive of the provisions such as that when coming to their office premises during the duty hours, the male officers should wear Trouser and Shirt or the National Dress and the female officers to wear Saree, Osari or a suitable dignified attire to preserve the dignity of the Public Service and such dress should always keep the face of a lady officer open while it should be a dress which do not obstruct the provisions laid down for public security, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Term Contract for the import of Diesel and Petrol within a period of the next eight months
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development to award the term contact for the import of the required 420,000 barrels of diesel (0.001% Max Sulphur), 1,040,000 barrels of diesel (0.05% Max Sulphur) and 1,084,000 barrels of petrol (92UNL) for the period of 08 months from 2019‑07‑15 to 2020‑03‑14 to M/s Vitol Asia Pte. Ltd. of Singapore, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Special Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of 845.83 km length of Roads in the Eastern Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - With the objective of developing the access routes between the Rural Areas and the Socio-Economic Centres, it is due to develop and maintain 408.62 km length of rural roads in the Ampara District with 05 project packages, 221.28 km length of roads in the Batticaloa District with 03 project packages and 215.93 km length of roads in the Trincomalee District under the Second Integrated Road Investment Programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to award the contract package 01 and 02 to NEM Construction (Pvt.) Ltd., the contract for package No.03 to the joint venture of AMSK - CHEC, to award the contract for package No.04 to the Maga Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., to award the contract for package No.05 to Nawloka Construction Company (Pvt.) Ltd., to award the contract for package No.01 and 02 in the Batticaloa District to the joint venture of Chongqing International Corporation (China) and Sun Constructions, to award the contract for package No.03 to the Nawaloka Construction Company (Pvt.) Ltd., to award the contract No.01 and 03 in the Trincomalee District to Edward & Christie and package No.02 to Maga Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accreditation and Strengthening of the Non-State Higher Educational Institutes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - Although, a number exceeding 150,000 students gain eligibility for admission to the state universities, about more than 125,000 students fail to get the opportunity of admission to the said network due to the limited facilities available at the State Universities. As a solution to the problem, various incentive programmes are being implemented by the Government to encourage the students to get their Degrees from the Non‑State Higher Educational Institutes. In this respect, the attention of the Government has been focused to provide the necessary facilities to the Accredited Non-State Higher Educational Institutes, utilizing the savings of the project on 'Accelerating Higher Education Expansion and Development Operation (AHEAD)'. Through this, it is expected to expand the higher educational opportunities of the Advanced Level students who do not qualify to gain admission to the state university network. Taking these matters into consideration, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs and Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to provide financial assistance to the Accredited Non-State Higher Educational Institutes utilizing the savings of the Accelerating Higher Education Expansion and Development Operation under the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' Programme and to appoint an Officials' Committee to monitor the programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuation of the 'Sukithapurawara'Township Development Programme and Appointment of consultants for Consultation Services of the new projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-06-25
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously for the continuation of the projects commenced under the Sukithapurawara Township Development Programme but which have not been completed as yet. As such, the proposal made by Hon.
