Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Disaster Management for the implementation of a programme aimed at water management, industry promotion, infrastructure facility development, rehabilitation of sacred places, the upliftment of the agri-farms and rural industries etc. and thereby the implementation of the livelihood programmes pertaining to women and the youth community, by utilizing a sum of Rs.400 million allocated to the Ministry of Public Administration & Disaster Management for the year 2019, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of compensation for the damages caused as a result of the conflict situation which occurred recently in several places of the Island
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, for the payment of compensation in regard to the rehabilitation of the damages caused to the Mosques, as a result of the conflict situation which occurred recently in several places of the Island, adopting the same methodology for making payments for the damages caused by the bomb explosions that occurred at the Easter Sunday, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Recommendations made by the Ministerial Committee appointed to ensure an uninterrupted supply of electricity
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet prior to this, had decided to appoint a Ministerial Committee under the Chairmanship of the Hon. Prime Minister, comprising of the Ministers of Finance; Power, Energy and Business Development, Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development; and Ports & Shipping and  Southern Development to make recommendations pertaining to short term, medium term and long term strategies to solve the power crisis which has cropped up at present. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to purchase 200MW powership to be connected at Kerawalapitiy by June 2019 for a period of 06 months at the rate of Rs.26.20 per power unit, and another 200MW powership to be connected at Galle in September 2019 for a period of 09 months at the rate of Rs.26.20, since recommendations have been made by the said Committee to that effect, to maintain an uninterrupted power supply in the country as an urgent need has arisen to purchase power supplies due to the situation prevailing in the field of power supply at present, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaring an Official Languages Day and a Week Concurrent for same
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - In terms of the present Official Languages Policy, Sinhala and Tamil are used as official languages while English is used as a link language.  In order to ensure the language right of all Sri Lankans and further highlight the anticipated benefits it has been proposed as appropriate to declare an Official Languages Day along with a language week concurrent for same and commemorate it annually. By this, it is anticipated that the bilingual service opportunities in the Government Institutions could be enhanced, the equal rights of all communities could be safeguarded while discarding disparities and by which a society which would value peace and reconciliation could be created.  Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. Mano Ganesan, Minister of National Integration, Official Languages, Social Progress and Hindu Religious Affairs, to declare the 03rd of June as the Official Languages Day with the objective of carrying out programmes for the effective implementation of the Official Languages Policy with the full contribution of the Public and Private Sectors for a whole week commencing from the said date, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: A donation of 08 Kidney Disease Mobile Screening Ambulances
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that there is a possibility of a considerable number of people of 13 Districts being affected as a result of the Chronic Kidney Disease of Unknown Etiology which has become a major health hazard in rural Sri Lanka. It has been observed that the people affected by the disease usually get hospitalized only after 60% of the failure of their kidney functions. Nevertheless, by the early detection of the disease, there is a possibility of extending the life span of the patients by preventing the spread of the disease and the requirement for dialysis and renal transplant used as a treatment for the disease. The recommended method of treatment for the chronic kidney disease is screening for its early detection and presenting the results at that juncture itself to seek onsite treatment. In order to provide the necessary facilities for same, the Government of China has agreed to donate 08 ambulances consisting of the necessary equipment for the detection of kidney diseases. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to enter into an Agreement with the Government of China to obtain the said donation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Postponement of the 18th Meeting of the Conference of the Parties of Convention on International Trade on the Endangered Species of Fauna and Flora (CITES) which was scheduled to be held in Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - The postponement of the 18th Meeting of the Conference of the Parties of Convention on International Trade on the Endangered Species of Fauna and Flora (CITES) which was scheduled to be held in the months of May and June of 2019 at the Bandaranaika Memorial International Conference Hall, to enable it to be held on another future date, was brought to the notice of the Cabinet by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs.

description: Proclamation of the Proscribed Organizations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, notified the Cabinet that steps have been taken to proscribe the organizations namely, the National Thowheed Jama'ath Organization, the Jama'athe Milla'athe Ibrahim and Willayath As Seylani, in order to ensure the National Security due to the threat caused to the country's security as a result of the recent terror attacks and that the Gazette (Extraordinary) Notification No.2123/2 of 2019-05-13 has been published in respect of same, by virtue of the powers vested with the President.

description: The designing and the construction of Flyovers at Kohuwala and Getambe
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to construct the flyovers associated with the Kohuwala and Getambe junctions as a remedial measure for the heavy traffic congestion found there. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development, to enter into the necessary loan Agreements to secure the required funds from the Government of Hungary and to award the contract for the designing and construction of flyovers at Kohuwala and Getambe to Betonutepito Plc of Hungary for a sum of Euro 52 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the distribution network of the Ceylon Electricity Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - A project for the purchase of accessories required for the improvement of the distribution network of the Ceylon Electricity Board will be implemented with the financial aid of the Asian Development Bank. The purchase of the necessary equipment in respect of this project has been planned to be carried out under 09 packages. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the purchase of items under Package 5 Lot 5 to M/s Leader Cable Industry Berhad for a sum of US$ 3.17 million and Rs.9.43 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of MRI machine for Teaching Hospital, Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to award the procurement for the purchase of MRI machine for the Teaching Hospital, Jaffna used to obtain magnetic resonance  imaging MRI) for identification of various conditions in the brain and central nervous system and for the breast and cardiac diseases to M/s Dimo (Pvt) Ltd. at a sum of US$ 1.65 and Rs.44.85 million as recommended by the  the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board and enter into a service and maintenance contract with the same entity at a cost of US$ 269,231 for a period of 5 years subsequent to its warranty period of 2 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of 29 Phacoemulsification Machines used for cataract surgeries for implanting artificial eye lenses
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to award the procurement for the purchase of  29 Phacoemulsification machines used for cataract surgeries for implanting artificial eye lenses to M/s. Delmage Forsyth & Co. Ltd at a sum of US$ 1.18 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board and enter into a service and maintenance contract with the same entity at a cost of Rs.937,850 for each equipment for a period of 5 years subsequent to its warranty period of 2 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Trastuzumab Injection 440 mg with solvent in 20 ml vial
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to award the contract for the procurement of 1,875 vials of Trastuzumab Injection 440 mg with solvent in 20 ml vial, which is used as a medication for cancer to M/s Medmart Pharma (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.89.7 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 02 Nos. of Digital Fluroscopy Machines used to investigate Diseases in Blood Vessels
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to award the contract for the procurement of 02 Digital Fluroscopy Machines used in taking Digital Subtraction Angiography (DSA) images in the investigations carried out to diagnose diseases in blood vessels in the various body organs including the brain and the heart  to M/s Dimo (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of US$ 1.1 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board and to award service and maintenance contract of those machines for a sum of Rs 35.8 million, for a further period of 05 years after the expiry of a two year warranty period, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kalu Ganga Water Supply Expansion Project - Awarding of the Consultancy Services Contract of Phase I
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to obtain a credit facility of Japanese Yen 31,810 million for the Phase I of the Kalu Ganga Water Supply Expansion Project and to enter into a loan agreement for the purpose with the Japan International Corporation Agency. Through this project, it is anticipated to increase the water supply efficiency in the Southern Area of Western Province, supply of safe drinking water and to improve the water supply networks in Dehiwala and Moratuwa. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education to award the above contract for the supply of consultancy services to  M/s Nihon Studio Consultants Co. Ltd, the joint venture of M/s TEC International Co. Ltd, of Japan, M/s Ceywater Consultants (pvt) Ltd., of Sri Lanka and M/s Resources Development Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd, of Sri Lanka for a sum of Japanese Yen 558.32 million and Rs.773.19 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Official Languages Commission Act, No.18 of 1991
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - The Official Languages Commission has been established under the Official Languages Commission Act, No.18 of 1991 to monitor and supervise the implementation of the Official Languages Policy in the Government Institutions. It has been observed that the amendments to this Act, is deemed essential to reorganize its administrative affairs, to empower the Commission with the necessary powers to monitor and supervise the implementation of the Official Languages Policy in the Government Institutions and for the effective investigation of public complaints regarding the violation of language rights. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.	 Mano Ganesan, the Minister of National Integration, Official Languages, Social Progress and Hindu Religious Affairs to make amendments to the Official Languages Commission Act, No.18 of 1991, mindful of the said aim, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the time period given to conduct a feasibility study on the  proposed Cocoa Development Project at Ranminithanna in Hambantota
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously for the Sri Lanka Molstar Corp Company to conduct a feasibility study on the Cocoa Development Project at Ranminithanna in Hambantota in collaboration with Bean & Company in Israel which is a Global Cocoa Production Company. Due to the practical delays which caused in obtaining approval for the purpose, it has not been able to complete the activities of the said feasibility study up to date. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayaka, Minister of Ports & Shipping and Southern Development, to extend the period of the feasibility study on this project by a further period of six months, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restoration of the Kudawilachchiya tank and the Dematagala tank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made for the restoration of the presently abandoned  Kudawilachchiya tank situated adjacent to the Wilpattu National Park to augment the supply of water to fulfill the drinking, domestic and the water demand  for agricultural purposes of the people of the Mahawilachchiya area. Through this, around 25,000 people living in 12 Grama Niladhari Divisions of the Mahawilachchiya area will reap benefits while it is also expected to augment the irrigation water supply to 320 hectares of land which could be brought under cultivation. This will also help to provide water for the wildlife found in the area around the Wilpattu National Park and also the elephants roaming for water to be confined to the forest area thus anticipating the mitigation of the human-elephant conflict as well. It is also planned to implement a project to restore the presently abandoned Dematagala Tank and to construct a feeder canal and an anicut across the Hevan Ella Oya to supply additional water to  around 32 village tanks found in the area for the fulfillment of the water needs of the people around the Palagala area who constantly face difficulties owing to the scarcity of water. Through this, irrigation water will be provided for around 520 hectares of land  and will benefit around 1,250 farmer families. The wildlife will also be assured of water during the dry season through the proposed canal  constructed  across the Kahalla forest. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development to restore the Kudawilachchiya tank, within a period of 03 years with an investment of Rs.1,000 million and to carryout the restoration of the Dematagala tank and the improvement of the Hevan Ella anicut and the feeder canal under two (02) stages, with an investment of Rs.924 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuation of the Urban Regeneration Project in the City of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - The Urban Regeneration programme has been implemented with an investment of Rs. 190 billion, with the objective of enhancing of the life standard of about 50,000 low income families living in the areas of Colombo. With the completion of this housing programme, it is anticipated that a land area of 400 acres could be released for commercial purposes. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to construct 2,272 houses under the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank loan scheme in the land at Maligawatta belonging to the Department of Railways, Applewatta of Kettarama, Kimbula Ela of Bluemendhal and the Ratmalana Irrigation Land in addition to the projects planned to be constructed under the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ruwanwella Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to implement the Ruwanwella Water Supply Project so as to cover 03 Grama Niladhari Divisions of the Yatiyantota Divisional Secretary Division and 12 Grama Niladhari Divisions of the Ruwanwella Divisional Secretary Division.  This project consists of an inlet in the Kelani River with a capacity of 4,400 cu.mt. per day, a water treatment plant with a capacity of 4,000 cu.mt., pumping of 3,000 mt. of untreated water, the construction 4 water treatment plants in the areas of Panapitiya, Mahalla, Kannanthota and Imbulana and the compressor of 20.5 km. in length and the distribution line of 100 km. in length. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs and Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education for the implementation of the project from the year 2019 by obtaining funds from the General Treasury for the estimates on further activities pertaining to the construction of 03 reservoirs, a part of the compressor and the distribution system and providing other facilities required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Second and the Third Stage of the  Project for the Construction of the Medical Faculty of Sabaragamuwa University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - Although around 25,000 students following the Advanced Level of the Bio-Science Stream gain eligibility for the University entrance annually, opportunities are available only for 1,484 students to study medicine in accordance with the facilities available at the State Universities of this country. When converting Sri Lanka as a upper middle income country, her health status should be enhanced concurrently and as such, the ratio of 89.5 doctors for 100,000 of population existing at present, has to be further increased. Therefore, the focus of the Government has been drawn to establish new medical faculties within the State Universities of this country, for the purpose of achieving the targets.  As a first step towards this end, a medical faculty was established in the Sabaragamuwa University. Under the second Stage of this construction project, it has been planned to establish an administrative building, a library, a pre-clinical building, student hostels, quarters and a professional unit,  to purchase other infrastructure facilities,  medical, laboratory and office equipment and machines and also to carry out training for the staff. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education for the implementation of the second stage of this project, by a loan obtained from the Saudi Fund for Development within the time frame of 2020 - 2021, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Polonnaruwa and Batticaloa Waste Water Collection, 	Treatment and Disposal Systems
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to get the feasibility studies, for the projects on Waste Water Collection, Treatment and Disposal Systems proposed to be implemented for providing facilities for the people living in 16 Grama Niladhari Divisions, in Thamankaduwa Divisional Secretariat Division of the Polonnaruwa District and for the people living in 26 Grama Niladhari Divisions in the Manmunai North Divisional Secretariat Division of the Batticaloa District , was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Converting the Vavuniya Campus of the University of Jaffna as Vavuniya University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - Faculties of Business Studies and Applied Science of the University of Jaffna have been established in the Vavuniya Campus. Further, the Department of Finance & Accounting and the Department of Economics and Management Studies have been established in the Faculty of Business Studies while the Department of Physical Sciences and the Department of Biological Science have been established in the Faculty of Applied Sciences. As such, the proposal made by Hon.Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education to establish  the Vavuniya Campus of the University of Jaffna as Vavuniya University with a view to enhancing the quality of the courses of the University and enabling to conduct those degree courses in English medium, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial Cooperation granted by Germany for strengthening the National Natural Disaster Insurance Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - The National Insurance Trust Fund has initiated a Natural Disaster Insurance Scheme to cover all uninsured householders in Sri Lanka. The German Development Bank (KfW)  and the Insurance Development Forum of Germany have agreed to provide technical assistance worth of Euro 2.5 million for enhancing the sustainability of this National Natural Disaster Insurance Scheme. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to enter into relevant Agreements to receive the aforesaid  financial cooperation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Virusara Privilege Card - Implementation of the Second Phase
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - A privilege card by the name of 'Virusara' has been issued enabling to obtain benefits for the War Heroes of Tri-Forces, the Police and the Department of Civil Security who became disabled and for the dependents of those who scarified their lives and had gone missing while in operational duties, for the sake of protecting the sovereignty and restoring peace in Sri Lanka. By  using the said Privilege Card they can enjoy special benefits in  purchasing consumer goods and also obtaining services of about 70 public and private institutions which provide services in the areas of Health, Education, Banking, Insurance and Leasing. The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to issue Virusara Cards for the the war heroes who have served in Tri-Forces, the Police and the Department of Civil Security during the war period from 1983 to 2009 and has retired now and war heroes who have served in that period and are still serving  and also for the dependents of the civil officers who died while serving under the said institutions and for such civil officers who became disabled in addition to the present beneficiaries of the said privilege card, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Timeline of the Second National Action Plan of the Open Government Partnership
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-21
decision_details_body: - The Open Government Partnership is a multi-party initiative aimed at ensuring great dedication displayed by the Governments for the promotion of transparency, empowerment of citizens, fight against corruption and  the usage of new technologies for the efficient performance of the Public Administration.  The motive expected in this regard, is to prepare a 02-year Annual National Action Plan inclusive of the Bondages prepared independently by all the participant countries of the Open Government Partnership.  The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously for the implementation of the first 02 year Open Annual National Action Plan of the Government of Sri Lanka (2016 - 2018). The approval of the Cabinet has also been granted for the implementation of the second Action Plan scheduled to be implemented from the year 2018 onwards during the period from 2018-10-31 to 2020-09-30 with the collaboration of the relevant Government Institutions.  As the time period to commence the implementation had lapsed by then, H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, brought to the notice of the Cabinet that the implementation time line of the said Action Plan has been revised to be operative from 2019-03-01 to 2021-08-31 in order to be in line with the next time cycle.

description: “Relief Package” for strengthening the Tourism Industry affected by the Easter Sunday Terrorist Attacks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The tourism industry was the leading force for the increase of the GDP growth of Sri Lanka in the last decade. The number of tourist arrivals which was  less than 500,000 in the year 2009 rose up to 2.3 million by the year 2018 due to the end of the civil war. Accordingly, the tourism industry had assumed the third largest and fastest- growing source of foreign exchange earnings by 2018, next to the foreign remittances and apparel exports. Due to the  threat caused to the future certainty and sustainability of the tourism industry by the recent terrorist attacks, a Cabinet Sub‑Committee chaired by the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs was established to submit the recommendations to the Government on short term and long term measures to be taken to rebuild the said industry. The Government, taking into consideration of the recommendations of the said Committee has decided to grant relief to build confidence among the investors of the tourism sector and the tourists. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Eran Wickremaratna, the Acting Minister of Finance for granting a concessionary period for the recovery of  loans obtained by the industries and persons engaged in the tourism field, to re‑schedule the loans, provide a Working Capital (W/C) loan under “Enterprise Sri Lanka Programme” with a repayment period of 2 years with a 75% interest subsidy granted by the Government, exempt the taxes on importation of security equipment to ensure the security of private establishments, to reduce the Value Added Tax (VAT) up to 5% on registered hotels and tour operators during the period of April 01, 2019 to March 31, 2020, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Import Cargo Terminal Building at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - In the year 2018, the Bandaranaike International Airport has recorded over 280 million Metric Tons of of cargo and during the last 5 years the average annual growth rate of cargo handling at the BIA is noted as 8 %. Since the Airport does not have the adequate capacity comparatively, there is a heavy congestion at the cargo premises. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to initiate the procurement activities to construct a building for additional Import Cargo Terminal at BIA, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of 02 Air Conditioned - Diesel Multiple Unit (DMU) Sets for the Northern Line Train Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The Northern Line Train Service commenced in the year 2013, utilizing the then existing locomotive and rolling stock fleet. Subsequently, the new intercity train between Mount Lavinia and Kankesanthurai had commenced with the Air conditioned Diesel Multiple Unit Sets formed with 50ft long coaches that were imported for the upcountry service. Considering the high demand for this train service and the attraction of the general public, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to procure 02 new S13 Diesel Multiple Unit Air conditioned Coaches  from M/s RITES LTD to be used in the Northern Line, in addition to the previous agreement made for the  procurement of a Diesel Multiple Unit Air conditioned Coach of 65ft in length and to deploy the Diesel Multiple Unit Air conditioned coach of 50ft in length used in the Northern Line for service in the upcountry line which has  the high attraction and the increasing demand of tourists, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of luxary buses for the Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the purchase of 53 buses (33 seater) for the Sri Lanka Transport Board under lease basis to be paid back in five years, so as to provide a more qualitative, comfortable and secure service to the General public, to M/s Ashok Leyland Ltd. for a sum of Rs.444 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of high back seater buses for the Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the purchase of 272 high back 50 seater buses for the Sri Lanka Transport Board under lease basis to be paid back in five years, so as to provide a more qualitative, comfortable and secure service to the General public, to M/s Ashok Leyland Ltd. for a sum of Rs.3,264 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Puechase of Rituximab vials which is a treatment for cancer patients
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the purchase of 1750 vials of Rituximab injection 100 mg/10 ml and 2000 vials of said  injection 500 mg/50 ml which are used for the treatment of certain types of cancers, to M/s Transfarma Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi, Turkey  as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 4,000,000 vials of antibiotics used for bacterial infections
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the procurement of 4,000,000 vials of Cefuroxime Sodium for injection BP, 750 mg or Cefuroxime for injection USP, 750 mg used as antibiotics for bacterial infections, to M/s Inject Care Parenterals (pvt) Ltd. of India, for a sum of Rs 197.89 million (US $ 1.24 million), as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Coronary Stents used in the treatment of patients with Coronary Heart Diseases
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the procurement of Coronary Stents and Drug Eluting Coronary Stents of various sizes for the procedure of percutaneous Coronary Intervention in the treatment of patients with coronary heart diseases, to the suppliers selected as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, for a sum of Rs 446.39 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the infrastructure facilities at the Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - In concurrence with the increase in the intake of students to Universities and taking into consideration the essential facilities necessary to be provided for the students, it has been proposed to implement 13 projects to develop the infrastructure facilities of the Universities of Sri Jayawardenapura, Peradeniya and Kelaniya under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework of 2020-2023.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.	 Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to provide the facilities necessary for the construction of lecture halls for the English Language Training Unit of the Wayamba University, completion of the balance work of the 4th and 5th floors of the existing 5 storey building of the Siddha Medicine Unit of the University of Jaffna, construction of the buildings and the other related structures for the faculty of business studies in the Vavuniya Campus,  construction of an administrative building, construction of a 3 storey  residence block for the academic and executive staff and the construction of a 2 storey building for the nonacademic staff of the said University, construction of a building in the Kilinochchi vicinity of the University of Jaffna for Engineering Technology and Bio‑System Technology, extension of the proposed building for the faculty of Medicine at the University of Sri Jayawardenapura, construction of a new canteen for the University of Peradeniya and the extension of the building established in the Engineering Faculty and the construction of a 10 storey building for the faculty of Commerce and Management studies at the University of Kelaniya, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extending the loan facilities for the development of Cinemas under the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the intervention of the Government is absolutely  necessary for the re‑development of the film industry with a high quality and taste which at present, is subject to some dwindling draw back. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs to provide concessionary loans under the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' programme, in order to feed new technology in to the cinemas presently in operation and to improve the necessary infrastructure facilities required to produce a high standard cinema industry, to re‑establish the closed cinema halls with qualitative vigour suited to the new cinema industry and to motivate the cinema owners to initiate new cinema halls, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of new Divisional Secretary Divisions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - In order to avoid the difficulties faced when providing public services to the General Public due to the existence of a high population density and a large area of extent to cover, the difficulties found in gaining access etc. and also on the basis of the recommendations of the Delimitation Committee 2012, the proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government,  to upgrade the Hikkaduwa Divisional Secretary Division as the Hikkaduwa, Ratgama and Madampagama Divisional Secretary Division, the Baddegama Divisional Secretary Division as the Baddegama and Wanduramba Divisional Secretary Division, the Balangoda Divisional Secretary Division as the Balangoda and Kaltota Divisional Secretary Division and also to establish new Divisional Secretary Divisions as Mathurata, Nildandahinna, Talawakale, Kotmale West, Kotmale East and Norwood in the Nuwara Eliya District and Omanthe in the Vavuniya District, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a New Trilingual Mixed National School in the Peradeniya area in Kandy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that with the Kandy Town and the adjacent suburban towns becoming populous, the competition for admission of children to schools situated in the Kandy Educational Zone has become intense. As such, the attention of the Government has been focused to widen the scope of the opportunities for education of the children, living in that area, with the opening of a mixed school close to the town with a view to providing them with a qualitative education.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to initiate a new Trilingual Mixed National School, with 6 parallel classes for each grade, in a 10 acre block of land situated in the Peradeniya area with an investment of Rs.1,141.46 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the relevant Acts dispensing with the requirement of personal attendance of  suspects/accused persons in court  where necessary
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - Due to the fact that the legal requirement of producing detainees before the Court once in a fortnight in order to extend the order relating to the committal to remand custody and thereby placing the said prisoners, prison staff and the public is considerably a risky situation,  the approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No. 15 of 1979 to dispense with the aforesaid legal requirement under special circumstances. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to publish the draft bill prepared for dispensing with the requirement of personal attendance of suspects/ accused persons in Court, under identified circumstances, in the Government Gazette and present the same thereafter, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Air Services Agreements to be entered into with Guyana and Portugal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to enter into the Air Services Agreements agreed upon and implement them productively for the promotion of Bilateral Corporation between Sri Lanka and  Guyana and Sri Lanka and Portugal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing facilities for the Field Officers in Charge of the subject of Culture dealing with field duties at the District/Divisional Level
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The Department of Cultural Affairs which performs its mission as the fore runner of the culture of Sri Lanka with the preservation of arts components associated with the culture to bequeath them to the future generation and to showcase our own identity to the world, renders its services through the field officers in‑charge of the subject of culture attached to the District and Divisional level offices of the Department. Programmes pertaining to preservation, promotion and propagation of the cultural heritage are organized by the said officers who are in‑charge of the subject of culture at District level while also making their contribution towards the 'Dolosmahe Programme' and other programmes related thereto.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs seeking provisions to provide the officers further with the necessary facilities for them to promote the qualitative aspect of their service, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conservation and Restoration of the Dutch Museum in Pettah
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The Dutch Museum situated at Prince Street in Pettah had been constructed during the colonial period of around 350 years ago which had been used as the Official Residence of the Dutch Governor of the day. As of now, this building which is located in a populous area is a place which is subject to constant focus and attention of the local and foreign tourists.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs, to carry out the identified conservation and restoration of this museum at an investment of Rs.97.26 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementing of the Horana Urban Housing Project as a 'Shelter for All' project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The Horana Urban Housing Project has been initiated in the year 2017 by the Urban Settlement Development Authority but had not been possible to implement same due to the problems that cropped up since the land selected for the construction of the proposed houses was situated a distance away from the town limits. Therefore, it has been proposed to implement the proposed  project as a 'Shelter for All' project implemented by the National Housing Development Authority under the approval and provisions obtained for same. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs to implement this project with a facility of a housing loan of Rs.600,000/- granted for each beneficiary at an interest rate of 6% on basis of repaying in monthly installments within 15 years and providing material assistance to the value of Rs.150,000/- under the community participation basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Discontinuation of the issuance of Recommendation Letters for Liquor licenses in the Cinema Theatres by the National Film Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - Although the National Film Corporation, since its inception, had not intervened in setting up liquor shops in cinema theatres, with the passage of time, the Department of Excise has expected a letter with recommendations of the said corporation for the continuation of liquor shops in the cinema theatres. Setting up of liquor shops within the premises of cinema theaters expected to raise the number of viewers arriving at cinemas, it has been observed that, consumption of liquor and smoke by certain persons within cinema theaters, have caused inconveniences to the viewers, resulting in a drastic reduction of the  number of viewers arriving at cinema theaters. Therefore, as a step taken to create a qualitative cinema culture, and also with a view to contributing to the national programme for creating a drug free country, the facts presented by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs, to the effect that, the issuance of recommendation letters for liquor licenses in Cinema Theatres by the National Film Corporation would be suspended hereafter, were noted by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to be entered into between the Ministry of Plantation Industries and the Foreign Affairs Office in the Hainan Province of China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - Discussions were made by the delegations of the Hainan Province of China with Sri Lanka on  promoting co‑operation between Sri Lanka and China pertaining to investments to be made in the plantation sector and the activities of the plantation sector and during such discussions, the possible fields where co‑operation between Sri Lanka and Hainan Province of China could be promoted were identified.  As such, a proposal has been made to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and the Hainan Province of China for promoting co‑operation in the field of plantation. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to enter into a Memorandum on 'Co‑operation' in the Development of Tropical Agriculture and Value Addition in Plantation Tree Crops, drafted for this purpose was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulations framed under the Public Contracts Act, No.03 of 1987
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry & Commerce, Resettlement of Protracted Displaced Persons, Co‑operative Development and Vocational Training & Skills Development, to present the regulations published in the Government (Extraordinary) Gazette 2055/18 of  24th  of January 2018, prescribing the fees to be levied in respect of the  services rendered by the Department of the registrar of Companies under the Public Contracts Act, No.03 of 1987, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding to be entered into between Sri Lanka and Ruwanda  on Visa Exemption for Holders of Diplomatic and Official  Passports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government, to enter into Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Ruwanda on Visa Exemption for Holders of Diplomatic, Special and Official Passports, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding  to be entered into between Sri Lanka and Bahrain  on Visa Exemption for Holders of Diplomatic, Special and Official  Passports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government, to enter into Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Bahrain on Visa Exemption for Holders of Diplomatic, Special and Official Passports, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the University of Colombo and the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA) of the United Kingdom
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into an MoU  between the University of Colombo and the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA), the  United Kingdom with a view to developing educational cooperation in the higher education sector. Entering into this Agreement will enable to facilitate the students of the University of Colombo for pursuing courses at  the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants, improve the quality of the  Management Accounting Courses of the  University of Colombo and enhance the cooperation between the University of Colombo and the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants. Accordingly, 	the proposal made by Hon.	Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education to enter into an MoU  between the University of Colombo and the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA) of the United Kingdom, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improving the Educational, Health and Nutrition level of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body:
- According to the social, health and educational indicators, although Sri Lanka has achieved a higher level in such outcomes, it has been observed that there is still a considerable number of children subject to malnutrition among the school children.  As such, programmes like the school meal programme, the school milk programme, the triposha programme, the nutritional programmes of pre‑school students and nutritional programmes for pregnant and lacatation mothers etc. are implemented through the various Line Ministries.

In addition, the Department of Agriculture in the United States, has expressed its willingness to donate a grant of US$ 26 million under the 'Save the Children', the Project for Promoting Autonomy, Literacy and Attentiveness through Market Alliances. During a period of 05 years of the implementation of the proposed programme, an investment is to be made for the supply of 4,220 MT of high quality food substances valued at US$ 8.8 million and the Government sponsored 13 projects for the improvement of  nutrition, health, literacy sectors etc. Further more, a focus is made to provide food supplements approximately for 887 schools where around 108,940 students receive their education, across 7 districts namely Kilinochchi, Mullaitivu, Trincomalee, Nuwara Eliya, Badulla, Moneragala and Ratnapura where malnutrition is prevalent at a high level to address their nutritional deficiency.  Accordingly, the joint  proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs and Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to enter into the Memoranda of Understanding required for the implementation of this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Railway Efficiency Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement a Railway Efficiency Improvement Project to cater to the increasing demand on railway sector by modernizing the railway network with a view to improving the operational efficiency of the Department of Sri Lanka Railways, strengthening of the maintenance capacity, improving railway safety, upgrading the technology training centres and strengthening of the project implementation capacity. This project will contribute to improve the passenger attractiveness for railway transport, the market share of railway transport, easing the impact on road congestion and support the development competitive services, industries and  supply chains of the urban areas. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance, to conduct negotiations for obtaining financial assistance from the Asian Development Bank and enter into a loan agreement with the said bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding to be entered into between Sri Lanka and 	Japan on Defence Co operation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Japan on developing Defence Cooperation and exchanges in the field of Defence, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Wages Boards Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously to amend section 59A   of the  Wages Boards Ordinance to prevent any harm or disadvantages that may cause to the permanent employees of a certain business enterprise by the   employment of contract workers for manufacturing or service activities in the said institution and protect their rights. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, at the request of the Non‑Cabinet Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations to publish the draft bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman in the Government Gazette and present the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Innovation Agency (NIA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - Although the recent economic performance of Sri Lanka stands on a considerable level, to be a middle income country, the entrepreneur sector of Sri Lanka should generate better employment opportunities and contribute to the overall economic development of the country by adopting innovative technology, enhancing productivity and gaining access to the global value addition process and the new markets. As such, it has been proposed to establish the National Innovation Agency (NIA) to maintain the required coordination for the innovative, research and entrepreneurship development. This institute will review, coordinate and monitor the activities carried out by the stakeholders in regard to innovation. Taking into consideration the contribution to be made by this institute to the national economy, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to establish the said institute by a Parliamentary Act and to adopt the 'Innovation and Entrepreneurship Strategy for Sri Lanka (2018-2022) as the Road Map and Guiding Framework of the NIA, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Report of the Expert Committee appointed by H.E. the President on Restructuring SriLankan Airlines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-05-07
decision_details_body: - An Expert Committee was appointed by H.E. the President with the Chairmanship of Hon. Eran Wickremaratna, the State Minister of Finance for obtaining recommendations for the restructuring of the SriLankan Airlines and the said Committee has submitted a Report containing policy recommendations in that regard. The Committee has made recommendations in respect of the financial restructuring of the SriLankan Airlines, corporate restructuring, preparation of an effective Strategical Plan and  Operating Business Model,  human resource restructuring, ensuring of an independent procurement process, and exploiting Synergies in Brand Promotion. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, for the expeditious implementation  of the proposed recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling for proposals for the up-liftment of the Tourist Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - It was decided by the Cabinet to establish a Committee under the Chairmanship of the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs comprising of a further five relevant Ministers, to make a study of the measures to be taken to overcome the situation faced by the tourist industry due to the tragic incident that took place on the last Easter Sunday.

description: Ensuring the Security of Air Passengers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The attention of the Government has been focused towards taking prompt action to ensure the security of the air passengers using the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) for traveling purposes, with a view to avoiding the recurrence of terrorist activities such as the terrorist attacks which took place recently. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to purchase modern technological machines to screen the baggage and goods and install the same at BIA as one of such measures, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting of the Annual Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2018 in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The Annual Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka has been prepared by the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka in terms of the provisions of the Monetary Law Act incorporating status of the Sri lankan economy and Central Bank of Sri Lanka and information pertaining to the financial policies and measures adopted in the year, at issue. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Eran Wickremaratna, the Acting Minister of Finance to present this report in Parliament which is forwarded to the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance as per the provisions of the Monetary Law Act, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancement of the Minimum Wage of the Employees of the Private Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - Under the National Minimum Wage of Workers Act, No.3 of 2016, the minimum monthly wage of the workers of the private sector has been fixed as Rs.10,000/- and the daily wage as Rs.400/- to be effective from the 01st of January 2016. The National Labour Advisory Council has recommended that the monthly wage of the workers of the private sector should be Rs.12,500/- and the daily wage should be Rs.500/- to suit the existing cost of living at present. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, at the request of the Non‑Cabinet Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, to amend the National Minimum Wage of Workers Act, No.3 of 2016 to increase the minimum wage of the employees of the private sector, taking into consideration the said recommendation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enactment of a new Act to Eradicate Bribery or Corruption
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to amend the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption Act and the Acts incidental thereto. Accordingly, section 20 of the Bribery Act has already been amended and enacted as Bribery (Amendment) Act, No.22 of 2018 and the Commissions of Inquiry Act has been amended and enacted as the Commissions of Inquiry (Amendment) Act, No.3 of 2019. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to draft one Consolidated Act, including the Act to Eradicate Bribery or Corruption, the new Act to Investigate Allegation of Bribery or Corruption and the Amendment Act related to the Declaration of Assets and Liabilities Act, instead of the new Act to be drafted, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of consultancy services for the Thalpitigala Reservoir Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously to implement the Thalpitigala Reservoir Project as an alternative to the water scarcity which would occur in the Minipe Left Bank Canal Scheme associated with the Bathmadilla anicut found in the Lower Valley as a result of the implementation of the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development to award the Consultancy Contract of this Project for a sum of Rs.333 million to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau and to provide other facilities in that respect, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee (CACPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Five-Storey Building for the Ja-Ela District Secretariat
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to construct a new office building for Ja-Ela District Secretariat which provides services for more than 218,000 people living in 57 Grama Niladhari divisions, at a total cost of Rs 167.9 million. However, the proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government to raise the total cost estimate of the project up to Rs 190.7 million owing to the non-inclusion of the essential constructions identified while the  construction was in progress in the first cost estimate and also due to the fluctuation of prices and to secure other facilities as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the construction work of the new building constructed for the District Secretariat in Kegalle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - Construction activities of the new building for the Kegalle District Secretariat have been initiated as per the approval granted by the Cabinet previously and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government, to carry out the further construction activities and to have other accessories fixed by the State Engineering Corporation for the completion of the necessary construction activities, to make the said building practicably usable, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of infrastructure facilities at the Advanced Technological Institutes of Mannar and Nawalapitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - In the Advanced Technological Institute in Nawalapitiya, 119 students are engaged in following 03 courses while in the Advanced Technological Institute in Mannar 601 students are engaged in fallowing 04 courses. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education to secure provision amounting to Rs.1208 million for the implementation of the projects proposed for the development of a more qualitative educational environment and to provide adequate infrastructure facilities for the said students, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the student facilities of the Uva Wellassa University of Sri Lanka and the Sri Lanka University of Ruhuna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to award the contract for the construction of the library building of the Uva Wellassa University under Phase II of the project for the development of infrastructure facilities of the Uva Wellassa University to M/s Darinton Construction (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.384.2 million, to award the contract for the construction of the Three Storey Lecture Hall building with furniture for the Faculty of Technology of the University of Ruhuna to M/s Central Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.337.8 million and to award the contract for the construction of the South Center for Naval Studies and Shipping with equipment of the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Ruhuna to M/s Central Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.436.3 million, in accordance with the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Temperature Controlled Warehouse complex in Dambulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously to establish a six chamber 5,000 MT capacity Temperature Controlled Warehouse Complex in Dambulla where fresh agri produce could be stored. The Government of India will grant financial assistance amounting to Rs.300 million to cover the cost of the project. The contract for the constructions from the said finances has been awarded to the Joint Venture formed by M/s SAW Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd. and LQ Import Export (Pvt.) Ltd. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, at the request of the Non‑Cabinet Minister of Economic Reforms and Public Distribution, to get the balance work of the warehouse complex completed through the said contractor for a sum of Rs.225 million and also to secure the other facilities necessary in this respect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Computer facilities for schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - According to a budget proposal it has been proposed to implement a project for the provision of computer facilities in schools with a view to developing the learning and teaching process in the school educational system. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to secure the funds required for the purchase of 160,000 laptop computers in order to fulfill the requirement of computers in schools with secondary grades, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a new Tri-lingual Mixed National School in the Mirigama Area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to establish a new fully fledged National School in an extent of 20 acres of the land called Dansele Watta located in the Minuwangoda area with a view to providing qualitative educational opportunities for the children living in the areas adjustment to Gampaha which is developing rapidly. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to establish the proposed new school consisting of six parallel classes for each grade as a school where tri-lingual education could be had, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting of legislation to provide a definition for "child and youthful person"
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the various issues due to the varied definitions found in several Acts of Sri Lanka with regard to the definition of 'Child and Youthful person, the proposal made by Hon.(Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to amend the Children and Young Persons Ordinance to define a person less than 18 years of age as a child and to amend the Youthful Offenders (Training Schools) Ordinance to define a person between the ages of 18 and 22 as a youthful person, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting of the 'Chamber of Construction Industry of Sri Lanka Bill' in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The Chamber of Construction Industry of Sri Lanka has been established in the year 2001 and subsequently, it has been incorporated as a company limited by guarantee. Presently, 12 professional institutes and associations are institutional members of this Chamber and nearly 300 private companies join this Chamber directly. The Chamber of Construction Industry of Sri Lanka (Incorporation) Bill has been presented to Parliament as a Private Members Bill and accordingly the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs, to present the same subsequently taking into consideration the relevant stakeholders associated with the industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of a National Building Code
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - In recent times, there has been an increasing trend in Sri Lanka for incidents of building collapses, fire and damages of buildings as a result of natural disasters.  It has been found that most of these incidents have been the result of adoption of non-engineering practices and deploying of non-competent persons in the constructions. Further, attention has also been focused on the non-availability of a proper regulatory system in Sri Lanka to identify the unsafe buildings and to evaluate the conditions of such buildings. As such, the Government has recognized the necessity of preparing a series of regulation of design manuals, construction, deviation and maintenance activities in the form of a National Building Code. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs and Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Disaster Management, to prepare a National Building Code for the Building Construction Sector of Sri Lanka with the participation of relevant stakeholders, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of muti-storey houses in the developed area adjoining the Beira Lake (TRCSL)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to convert the area adjoining the Beira Lake into a commercial city and to generate job opportunities in the area and develop  the houses, vehicle parks and shopping complexes in a proper way so as to attract the tourists. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs to acquire the lands required to carry out a project for the construction of a muti‑storey housing project within the land in extent of 83 perches identified near the Beira Lake from the National Housing Development Authority, as its first phase, and to secure the other facilities necessary, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Climate Resilience Improvement Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement a project called Sri Lanka Climate Resilience Multi-Phased Programme under the assistance of the World Bank, in order to mitigate the risks from extreme weather conditions. As such, the joint proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Disaster Management, to implement the proposed project through the Department of Irrigation at an estimated cost of US $ 790 million, within a period of 8-10 years under 03 stages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the total cost estimate of the Thalpitigala Reservoir Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously to construct the Thalpitigala Reservoir Project by the China Sino Hydro Corporation Ltd., under the funds of the China EXIM Bank, at a total estimated cost of US$ 174 million. It has been assessed that a further sum of Rs.7,227 million has to be set apart as estimated earlier for the project for the relevant expenditure on taxes, environmental development, land acquisition, payment of compensation, resettlement and for the provision of infrastructure facilities.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to amend the total cost estimate with the inclusion of the said additional sum as well, as US$ 174 million and the local estimate as Rs.7,227 million and to set apart additional financial provision from the General Treasury within the period of 2019 to 2023, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka and the Michigan State University of the United State of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign an MOU between the Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka and the Michigan State University of the United State of America with a view to studying the social and economic conditions of the labourers in the tea sector in various angles, averting the labour shortage and implementing projects for enhancing the labour efficiency. This will provide the necessary facilities to facilitate and enhance the teaching, research and extension  activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries to enter into the said MOU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Lender Direct Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka (GOSL), CHEC Port City Colombo (Private) Limited and the China Development Bank in respect of the Colombo Port City Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - A tripartite Lender Direct Agreement has been signed between the Government of Sri Lanka (GOSL), CHEC Port City Colombo (Private) Limited and the China Development Bank in respect of the Colombo Port City Development Project. In accordance with the provisions of the said agreement, the Government of Sri Lanka should provide the necessary assistance for the CHEC Port City Colombo (Private) Limited to enter into an agreement with  the debtors. The CHEC Port City Colombo (Private) Limited has planned to obtain a long term loan facility from the China Development Bank for the development activities of the project. Accordingly, the proposal made by              Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to sign the loan agreement to be entered into with the said Bank,  the Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development and the Project Company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Maintaining the Colombo Port City Land as a special zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The Port City has been created by the reclamation of land using sea sand with the objective of attracting foreign investment of a high value for the purpose of  escalating the development of the national economy. Under this, a land extent of 269 hectares will be added to the land area of Sri Lanka and a sea coast of 2 km in length within an extent of 91 hectares consisting of roads and common vicinities, a central park, a sea belt suitable for swimming and water sports at any time of the year and a water way 70 m wide running across the town will be established within an extent of 91 hectares consisting of roads and common vicinities. This area will also consist of a holiday harbour with facilities for hotels and recreations, a recreation park, a conference hall for international educational and international health services. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to establish a Property Management Company with the necessary authority for the management of this area inclusive of the implementation of the other activities and to publish the Colombo Port City as a state land situated in the Colombo District of the Western Province, in the Government Gazette, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restructuring the Measurement Units, Standards and Services Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the administration activities, scheme of recruitment, procurement process and the duties related to weight and measures of the Measurement Units, Standard and Services Department which carries out duties under the subject areas of Scientific, Industrial and Legal measurement have to be restructured in order to render its services more effectively and efficiently. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry & Commerce, Resettlement of Protracted Displaced Persons, Co‑operative Development and Vocational Training & Skills Development to appoint an Experts' Committee to make a study in that regard and submit the necessary recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the District General Hospital in Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - The need has been identified for the expeditious refurbishment of most of the buildings in the District General Hospital in Kalutara which are nearly 50 years old, which provides patient care services to a large number of patients in the adjacent districts of Ratnapura and Galle as well.  As such, it has been planned to develop the General Hospital in the Kalutara District with the construction of a building for Common Amenities, a building for the Out-Patient Department, a building complex for Diagnostic activities, a Laundry, a building complex for Surgical Wards and Quarters for the staff with a view to providing a better quality patient care service. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to implement the proposed development programmes with an investment of Rs.6,221 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Multi sectoral Action Plan on the Prevention of Non Communicable Diseases  2016  2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-04-30
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that 70% itself of the diseases which affect the people of Sri Lanka are non-communicable diseases such as Heart attacks, Diabetics, High Blood Pressure, Strokes and Cancers and the development of this trend has also been shown in the surveys conducted recently. In order to control this situation to the minimum, an Action Plan has been prepared with the participation of all the relevant stakeholders to be implemented during the period of 2016 - 2020. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.
