Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to procure the service of a suitable entity with international experience for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Holding of the Third Meeting of the Asia-Europe Political Forum in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to hold the 3rd Meeting of the Asia-Europe Political Forum in Colombo from 5th to 8th of April, 2019, under the theme 'The Challenges of Social Security and Employment for increasing aged population in the developing countries'. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Primary Industries and Social Empowerment, for hosting the event and providing other facilities necessary related thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Education Inspection Service Institution
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education for the establishment of an affiliated institution to the Ministry of Education, named as 'Education Inspection Service' to ensure the accountability and responsibility of all stakeholders who deal with education for making a novel inspection and evaluation culture aimed at promoting the qualitative development in the school education system, suited to the present day needs, to establish the same at sub‑institutional level in all provinces and to establish an independent 'Education Accreditation Board' to make appropriate recommendations by analyzing the findings made by the Education Inspection Service, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancement of facilities of Courts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - Focus of the Government has been made on enhancing the facilities in the courts, due to the increase in the flow of court cases and the lack of adequate space and other facilities in the buildings used for the purpose. In this respect, it has been planned for the construction of the Walapane District and Magistrate's Court Building, the expansion of the Circuit Court Building in Narammala, the construction of the Vakare and Helboda Circuit Court Buildings, the construction of the production rooms and the record rooms of the District and Magistrate's Courts of Akkaraipattu and Pothuwil and the Magistrate's Courts of Kuliyapitiya and the construction of Official Residences for the District Judge and the Magistrate of Chillaw. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to carry out these development activities within the Medium Term Budgetary Framework of 2020 - 2022 with an investment of Rs.592.86 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the remaining construction work of the New Court Complex in Matara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has granted its approval for the construction of the new court complex in Matara and presently, its construction work is in progress. It has been planned to complete the said construction work by May 2019 and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.	(Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to secure the funds needed for carrying out further improvements necessary and providing of facilities in order to use the courts complex for the proper commencement of court functions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Policy on Early Childhood Care and Development - 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - The need has arisen to update the National Policy on Early Childhood Care and Development introduced in the year 2004, considering the local and the global trends and the sphere of changes that had since taken place. Accordingly, when the National Policy on Early Childhood Care and Development - 2018 was presented to the Cabinet at an earlier occasion, instructions have been given to further update it, taking into consideration the observations made so as to represent the various fields in that regard. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women & Child Affairs and Dry Zone Development, to implement the National Policy on Early Childhood Care and Development amended accordingly, under a proper strategic plan, at National, Provincial, District, Divisional and Rural levels, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of clean drinking water to the people of the Districts affected by the Chronic Kidney Disease
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has granted its approval previously, to implement the project for upgrading the water treatment plant in Lunugamwehera and Kirindi Oya by utilizing the funds amounting to Rs.298 million under the programme for the provision of clean drinking water to the people of the districts affected by the chronic kidney disease. As such, the joint proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education and Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs, to implement the project for the laying of pipe line necessary for the distribution of water by the Kirindi Oya water treatment plant so upgraded, to the 217 housing units constructed at the Hon. Narendra Modi Model Village in the Thissamaharamaya Divisional Secretariat Division by using the funds set apart for the National Housing Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a 100 MW of Floating Solar Power Plant in the Maduru Oya Reservoir
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has granted its approval previously, to implement the construct of a 100 MW of floating solar power plant as an integrated project joint venture of the Sri Lanka Mahaweli Authority, the Ceylon Electricity Board and the Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment and Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to establish a joint venture with the Canadian Solar Institute to implement the project as a storage project to store solar energy with the use of solar panels in accordance with the proposal made by the Canadian Government and to appoint a joint Working Committee to conduct negotiations in that regard,was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation activities further necessary at the Seven-storey building complex of the Negambo District General Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has granted its approval previously, to award the contract for the renovation of the seven-storey building complex of the Negambo District General Hospital to the State Development and Construction Corporation at an estimated cost of Rs.500 million.	While the renovation activities are being carried out, the hospital authority has proposed several more renovation activities necessary to be done at the building complex. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to amend the total cost estimate of the project from Rs.500 million to Rs.692.43 million, to make enable the essential activities such as, the improvements to be made to the theatre and the installation of the waste water drainage system, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Monetary Law Act, No. 58 of 1949
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has granted its approval previously to draft legislative reforms to update the law relating to Central Banking so as to comply with the developed international best practices. Accordingly, proposed amendments to be made to the Monetary Law Act No.58 of 1949 which is in force at present for the functions of the Central Bank have been taken up for discussion with the Monetary Board and all relevant stake holders. This includes amendments for introducing new flexible inflation targeting the monetary policy framework, enhancing the governance standards in management structure of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, introducing several disclosure requirements and recognizing the Central Bank of Sri Lanka as the macro prudential authority of the country. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to repeal and replace the Monetary Law Act No. 58 of 1949 with the new law, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting the State Vesak Festival of 2563rd year of Sri Buddhist Era
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - It has been scheduled to conduct the State Vesak Festival of 2563rd year of Sri Buddhist Era on 17th May 2019 and the Vesak Full Moon Poya Day Programme on 18th May 2019 at Thotagamu Ancient Rathpath Rajamaha Viharaya at Thelwatta, Hikkaduwa in Galle with the State patronage. It has been proposed to conduct a programme for the physical development of the temples located in Galle District, spiritual programmes for creating a society of free of drugs enriched with spiritual development and programmes for making a sound economy and an awakening in literature and arts nurtured by Buddhism, to coincide with this ceremony. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana & Wayamba Development to conduct the State Vesak Festival - 2019 at the Thotagamu Ancient Rathpath Rajamaha Viharaya at Thelwatta, Hikkaduwa in Galle District, to declare the week from 15 May 2019 to 21st May 2019 as the Vesak Week and to implement the other said programmes to be conducted in line with that, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of Members to the Wildlife Conservation Advisory Committee in terms of the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance (FFPO)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body:
- The Department of Wildlife Conservation which comes under the ambit of the Ministry of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs, has been assigned with the tasks such as ensuring the protection of the endangered wild animals living in the conservation areas as well as outside those, implementation of the National Wildlife Policy and the law, implementation of the wildlife protection environmental policy, conservation of the wildlife resources and taking measures for minimizing the human-elephant conflict. The Department of Botanical Gardens which comes under the purview of this Ministry is entrusted with the management and development of several botanical gardens including the Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens. In addition, the Department of National Zoological Gardens of this Ministry undertakes the management of the Deheiwala Zoological Gardens, the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, the Pinnawala New Zoological Gardens and the Hambantota Safari Park.

	Accordingly, 	the proposal made by Hon.	 John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs, to appoint an Advisory Committee comprising of experts in the relevant field, for the purpose of advising the Minister on the said functions, in terms of section 70(I) of the Flora and Fauna Protection Ordinance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recruitment of 7,500 Trainee Project Assistants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - Close monitoring and supervision of the development projects have become an essential factor for the effective implementation of the said projects. It has been proposed to make the unemployed youths who have studied up to the GCE (A/L) as partners in the national development process by making them involved in the said process. Accordingly, it has been planned to recruit 7,500 Trainee Project Assistants to the Ministry of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development and Youth Affairs, to appoint the candidates so selected to the posts of Trainee Project Assistants for a period of one year on contract basis and pay them each a monthly allowance of Rs.15,000/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Facilities at the Institute of Peace Support Operations Training in Sri Lanka (IPSOTSL)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - The Training Centre functioning at the Office Complex of the Kukuleganga Hydro power project provides necessary training for the Army troops who attend for the Peace Keeping Missions under the United Nations Organization. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to upgrade the facilities of the training school at an investment of Rs. 811.71 million so as to carry out the said training sessions more qualitatively and up to the standards of the United Nations Organization, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Incorporating the Convention on Cluster Munitions (OSLO Convention) into the Domestic Legislation in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka will be able to gain reputation as a state which stands for the humanitarian disarmament by acceding to the Convention on the Eradication of Cluster Munitions, embodied in the multiple explosive sub-munitions which cause major destruction. Taking into consideration the contribution to be made for the peace and security of the region as well as in the world, the attention of the Government has been focused to incorporate the Convention on Cluster Munitions or the OSLO Convention into the domestic Legislation in Sri Lanka. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to draft the necessary legislation for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of protected foot bridges for the convenience of transportation of the people living in the remote areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct 1000 protected foot bridges developed by the National Engineering Research and Development Centre, at the identified locations in the remote areas at the Divisional Secretariat Division level where unprotected trunk bridges, suspension bridges or any such locations where safety measures are not used for transportation. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President, at the request of the Hon. Non‑Cabinet Minister of Science, Technology & Research to implement the said programme, securing the funds necessary within the 2020 - 2022 Medium Term Budgetary Framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Empowering the economy by the development of the Mechatronics Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet of Ministers has granted its approval previously to the proposal for granting the Long Term Loan Facility under the “Enterprise Sri lanka Programme” proposed to be implemented as one of the components of the Mechatronics Enabled Economic Development Initiative. 

	Accordingly, taking into consideration the benefits that could be accrued through the proposed project, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, at the request of the Non‑Cabinet Minister of Science, Technology & Research to implement the proposed project including the Standards Training, Prototyping and Test Facility identified as another component thereto, through the financial allocations provided under the Non-Cabinet Minister of Science, Technology & Research, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulations for the royalty payment to the rights holders of songs or musical works
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003 amended by the Intellectual Property (Amendment) Act, No.7 of 2018, the rights holders of songs or musical works or the collective societies in which such rights owners hold the membership should be paid the due royalty, for the copyright and the related rights of such creations. However, it has been identified that the royalty payments are still not paid to the right holders of these songs or musical works by those who use them for commercial purposes. Therefore, it has been found that it would be more effective to issue the regulations under the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003 by repealing the Intellectual Property Regulation, No.01 of 2011 published in the Gazette Notification No.1687/28 dated 2011‑01‑05 which stipulates the specific minimum fees as royalty payments to regularize the royalty payment mechanism. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, as per the request made by the Non‑Cabinet Minister of Science,Technology & Research, to publish the regulations made by the Legal Draftsman in this regard in the Gazette and thereafter, to present the same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Shilpa Sena Exposition - Sri Lanka's Technological Revolution
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - Arrangements are being made to conduct a district level Exposition called the 'Shilpa Sena - the Sri Lanka's Technological Revolution' with the prime objective of creating a platform for research commercialization inclusive of the new inventions introduced by the various local Government Institutions and facilitating the development of technology transfer. By this, it is intended to introduce the low‑cost and high‑end technologies already developed by the Government Research Institutes, to the local industrialists and entrepreneurs. It is proposed to conduct the exposition in all the districts and the contribution of the Government Institutions including the Export Development Board, Technology Development Board, Government Research Institutes and the Universities, are sought for this purpose. Accordingly, at the request of the Non‑Cabinet Minister of Science, Technology & Research, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to conduct the 'Shilpa Sena' Exposition also to coincide with the similar expositions and programmes to be conducted by the various public and private sector institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Special Programme on Empowering the Differently Abled and the Elderly Community
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body:
- It has been revealed that, presently, the differently abled and the elderly community in Sri Lanka exceeds 15% of the total population. As such, the necessity of developing a programme has arisen to accord the due dignity to the Differently Abled and the Elderly and thereby making them to contribute to the development of the country without being dependent on another by providing the required facilities for them to meet their needs while minimizing inequalities they are subject to. Paying attention to the same, it has been proposed to implement a special programme for Empowering the Differently Abled and the Elderly Community.

Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to secure the funds necessary for the implementation of the special programme by the Presidential Secretariat to empower the Differently Abled and the Elderly Community, in collaboration and coordination with all stakeholders, focusing attention on ensuring equality in the usage of common amenities and facilities and the development of infrastructure facilities necessary, making the community aware of empowering them in the context of economic and social conditions without treating them differently within the entire community and in the fields of survey, research and policy formulation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the National Drug Prevention Programme: 'A Drug Free Country'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-19
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers had granted its approval previously for the establishment of a National Authority for the rehabilitation of persons addicted to drugs and for importing and making use of the modern equipment for the identification of injurious drugs in order to further extend the activities pertaining to the creation of a drug free country. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to appoint an Advisory Committee for the expeditious implementation of the said programme, until such Authority is established, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Let's Protect Children - National Trust Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - Persons and Organizations come forward voluntarily to provide the necessary assistance to children who have fallen into misery due to numerous social problems,  in‑born injuries and those sustained subsequently, diseases and negligence and unawareness of parents and as such, it has become a timely need for setting up of an institutional structure which could accept their donations in a responsible and a legally acceptable manner.  As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to establish 'Let's Protect Children - National Trust Fund' under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the President, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 03 STS Cranes to increase the Deep Berth Capacity of the Jaya Container Terminal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - A project has been planned to be implemented by the Sri Lanka Ports Authority to increase the capacity of the Deep Berth Capacity of the Jaya Container Terminal (JCT) to enhance the advantage of handling the larger container vessels arriving at the Port of Colombo. As a component of the said project, approval was granted by the Cabinet to award the contract for the purchase of 3 cranes of Ship to Shore to M/s Shanghai Zhenhua Heavy Industries Co. Ltd., in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Appointed Procurement Committee.  According to the said approval, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayaka, the Minister of Ports & Shipping and Southern Development, to proceed with the future activities of the procurement procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the engineering procurement and construction contract of the  Basnagoda Reservoir Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body:
- It has been proposed to implement the Basnagoda Reservoir Project as a part of the Gampaha, Attanagalla, Minuwangoda integrated water supply project implemented under the National Water Supply & Drainage Board, for the supply of drinking water and industrial water required for the areas of Gampaha, Attanagalla, Minuwangoda and Mirigama.

	It has been planned to construct the Basnagoda reservoir by constructing a dam across the Basnagoda Oya which is a tributary of the Attanagalu Oya. It is designed to be constructed with a concrete dam of 2.5 m in height and 130 m in length for the storage of a water capacity of 3.5 million Cubic meters (MCM). Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to award the Engineering Procurement and Construction contract to the Sinohydro Corporation Ltd. for a sum of Rs.2,347.4 million, in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Consultancy Services for the Light Rail Transit Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to award the contract for Design, Procurement Assistance, Construction, Supervision and Project Management of the proposed Light Rail Transit from Malabe to Fort, to the Joint Venture comprising of the Oriental Consultants Global Co., Ltd., Japan International Consultants for Transportation Co., Ltd., Chodai Co., Ltd, Nippon Koei Co., Ltd of Japan and Consulting Engineers & Architects Associated (Pvt.) Ltd. of Sri Lanka as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee (CPCC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the consultancy contract of the project for the improvement of Potable Water Supply Schemes for the Rural Community
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - The Rural Infrastructure Development Project in the Emerging Regions is implemented aimed at the development of the Northern, Eastern, North Central and the Uva Provinces. Under this programme, it is expected to raise the living standards of the people and to develop their livelihood through the improvement of the basic infrastructure facilities such as rural roads, medium and small scale irrigation canals and the supply of portable water. It is also aimed at implementing programmes contributing to the development of the rural economy, reduction of the regional disparities, and alleviation of poverty. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government, to award the consultancy services of the project for the improvement of portable water supply schemes for the rural community to M/s Ceywater Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd. in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee (CACPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Aerial Bundled Conductor of 3000km for the Ceylon Electricity Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to award the contract for the supply and delivery of 3000km  of Aerial Bundled Conductor for the distribution regions of the Ceylon Electricity Board to M/s ACL Cables PLC for a sum of Rs.1780.6 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of 28 Solar Power Projects in Anuradhapura, Vavunathive, Maho, Pannala and Valachchanai
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - The Government has planned to convert approximately 60% of the power sector into renewable energy by 2030. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development for the purchase of 1 Kilowatt hour (kWh) at a rate between Rs.12.84 to Rs.15.93 from 28 investors as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee for the development of 28 Solar Power Plants of 1 MV in Anuradhapura, Vavunathive, Maho, Pannala, and Valachchanai under the “Sooryabala Sangramaya”, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of 10,000 Tenecteplase Injections given for the persons suffering from Heart-attacks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to award the procurement for the supply of  10,000 Tenecteplase Injections 40 mg. used for the prevention of the death of persons suffering from heart-attacks, to M/s Boehringer Ingelheim India (Pvt.) Ltd. of India for a sum of US$ 4,250,000, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of drugs required for the treatment of diabetic patients
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to award the procurement for the supply of  850,000 Vials of Biphasic Isophane Insulin 10 ml Injection used for the treatment of diabetic patients, to M/s Gulf Pharmaceutical Industries of the Kingdom of the United Arab Emirates for a sum of US$ 1,317,500, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of drugs required for the treatment of Haemophilia patients
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to award the procurement for the supply of 52,000 Vials of Concentrated Monoclonal Purified and Detergent Treated Dried Factor required for the treatment of haemophilia patients, to M/s Baxalta GmbH of Switzerland for a sum of US$ 3,172,000, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of Regulations including the Anti-Doping prohibited list against doping in sports in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, Minister of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment and Sports to present the Regulations No.4 of 2018 published in the Government Gazette (Extraordinary) No.2110/2 of 11 February, 2019 including the Anti-Doping (prohibited list) while engaging in sports under section 34(I) of the Convention against Doping in Sports Act, No.33 of 2013, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the National Institute of Education Act, No.28 of 1985, in order to restructure the Administrative and Management structure of the National Institute of Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - The National Institute of Education has been established to advise the Minister in-charge of the subject for the qualitative development in the field of education, curriculum development, the professional development of professionals in the field of education and offering them with the relevant post graduate degrees and  conducting of research and studies in the field of education etc.  A Council has been established for the administration of this institute and it has been observed that a necessity has arisen to restructure the administrative activities of the institute considering the timely and the future needs. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, Minister of Education to make amendments to the National Institute of Education Act, No.28 of 1985, enablling to appoint the Chairman of the Academic Affairs Board of the National Institute of Education as an ex-officio member of the Administrative 'Council' of the Institution, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The proposed price formula on imported milk powder
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - A Committee appointed with the aim of finding a suitable solution to the price of imported milk powder, has proposed a price formula on imported milk powder, taking into consideration the prices prevailing in the international market and the fluctuations in the exchange rate, so as to be beneficial to the Government as well and to those engaged in the milk powder industry. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development to implement the said price formula through the Consumer Affairs Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Proposed Yaka Bendi Ela Anicut
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - Since the Old Yaka Bendi Ela Anicut which was used for the supply of water for irrigational purposes for the farmers in the areas of Makandura, Kandepola Koswatta and Yakdessawa had been abandoned, the farmers in those areas are faced with a severe shortage of water in both Yala and Maha seasons. As a remedy for the severe shortage of water, the new Yaka Bendi Ela Anicut Development Scheme has been designed to divert the water of Maha Oya into Ratmal Oya Basin by constructing the anicut in a new place. Simultaneously, it has been designed to construct an anicut across the Maha Oya at a length of 76.8 meters, to construct an Intake Structure across the main canal, an inter-basin canal at a length of 14.8, a tributary and distribution canals, a storage tank in Anukkampitiya across Kandepola Aru, the upper level flood protection bund at the proposed diversion anicut and to improve structures situated over the cultivation area.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to conduct the feasibility study and the environmental assessment necessary for the implementation of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Tea Research Board Act, No.52 of 1993
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has granted approval previously, to amend the Tea Research Board Act, No.52 of 1993, incorporating the amendments such as, taking environmental safety measures in regard to the tea plantation, issuing of research findings of the Tea Board to various stakeholders, making provisions to prevent the inconsistencies between the Tea Research Board Act, and the other related laws and the re‑structuring of the composition of the Director Board of the Tea Research Board. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries to present the draft Bill prepared accordingly, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Sukithapurawara Development Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - The 'Sukithapurawara Township Development Programme' is being implemented by the Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development, from the year 2016 aimed at the Development of public facilities and the infrastructure facilities of various towns of the Island. Under this programme, an investment of around Rs.12,894 million has been made by now. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to undertake the programmes identified to be implemented during the year 2019, such as wholesale markets, bus stands, parks, vehicle parks, walk ways, weekly fairs, fish markets, town halls, commercial complexes, town centres, children parks, beach parks, road development activities etc. covering all Provinces, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Short Title to the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation as Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - The Colombo District (Low-Lying Areas) Reclamation and Development Board was established under the Colombo District (Low-Lying Areas) Reclamation and Development Act No. 15 of 1968, and its Short Title was amended as Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation incorporating an amendment thereto, under the Act No.52 of 1982. Subsequently, taking into account of the contribution of this institution towards national development, approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to amend its Short Title as Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to present the draft bill published in the Gazette, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuing of Fitness Certificate of Electrical Safety for Elevators and Escalators
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - There are certain factors to the effect that electrical failures lead to most of the accidents which take place in Elevators and Escalators installed in the buildings of Sri Lanka. In order to avoid the recurrence of such incidents, it has been proposed to introduce a methodology to issue a fitness Certificate of electrical safety of those elevators and escalators, with the concurrence of the relevant parties. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to make it necessary to have a fitness Certificate on electrical safety for each of the elevators and escalators installed in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Removal of the legal barriers for the development of Renewable Energy Projects in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - Although, it has been planned to generate 60% of the electricity from the renewable energy sources by the year 2030, due to the legal and policy differences existing between the Ceylon Electricity Board and the Public Utilities Commission over the development of electricity power stations, it has been observed that various problems will have to be encountered when such major electricity development projects are carried out. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development to amend the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No.20 of 2009 and the Sri Lanka Electricity (Amendment) Act, No.31 of 2013 in order to adopt a more flexible method when electricity is purchased from Non‑Conventional Renewable Energy sources equal to or less than 10 MW capacity, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Banning of using and selling betel quid, tobacco, arecanut associated products in the premises of the Public Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - Considering the risk factors for oral cancers, due to the use of betel quid, tobacco and arecanut associated products, it has been proposed to prevent the staff of the  Public Institutions and the people coming over to such institutions from using betel quid, tobacco and arecanut associated products. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to issue a Public Administration Circular to make provision for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing of Mahapola Scholarship Installment granted to the students of the Sri Lanka Institute of Advanced Technological Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka Institute of Advanced Technological Education is one of the prime institutes established in Sri Lanka for awarding the Higher National Diploma in Technological Education and over 20,000 students presently study at 19 regional centres. The Mahapola and Bursary granted to the students who follow higher education have been increased in the year 2015 and currently a Rs.5000/- monthly installment of Mahapola and a Rs.4000/- monthly installment of Bursary are paid for University students and Rs.1500/- monthly installment of Mahapola is being paid to each student of the Sri Lanka Institute of Advanced Technological Education. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to increase the monthly installment of Rs.1500/- being paid to the students of the Sri Lanka Institute of Advanced Technological Education up to Rs.2500/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the required Acts to facilitate the signing of Bilateral Social Security Agreements between Sri Lanka and India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-12
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the existing Labour Law in Sri Lanka, all foreign workers  employed in Sri Lanka are covered by the Employees' Provident Fund Act, No.15 of 1958 (EPF) and are entitled to claim the total contribution made to the EPF with interest for the period of employment in Sri Lanka on account of cessation of the employment and return to their countries. Nevertheless, according to the existing Labour Law in India, a Sri Lankan worker working in India needs to contribute to the Indian Social Security System and is not entitled to withdraw his contribution until he attains the age of 58 years. In order to resolve this issue, it has been proposed to enter into a Bilateral Social Security Agreement between Sri Lanka and India to provide relief to the Sri Lankan expatriate workers working in India. In terms of this agreement, the Sri Lankan workers who work in India and contribute to the EPF in Sri Lanka will not be required to contribute to the Indian Social Security Fund.  Further, the Sri Lankan workers in India who contribute to the Indian Social Security agreement without contributing to the EPF in Sri Lanka will have the ability to make an application to claim their contribution when they cease their employment in India. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to amend the Employees' Provident Fund Act, No.15 of 1958 enabling Sri Lanka and India to enter into a Social Security Agreement as per the request of the Non‑Cabinet Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taking expeditious measures for the preservation of Archaeological Antiquities and the prevention of their destruction, theft and illicit trafficking
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The Antiquities Ordinance No.9 of 1940 was amended for the last time in the year 1998 and the Government has drawn its attention on the importance of updating the legal provision to confront the present challenges in respect of the preservation of antiquities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs to amend the relevant Acts, to take measures in regard to the destruction of Archaeological Antiquities, expeditious action to prevent theft and illicit exportation and to create public awareness on the crimes committed against Archaeological Antiquities and to induce the public to provide information in this regard and also to increase the penalties charged for inflicting damages to archaeological antiquities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of the Thripitaka as a World Heritage
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - On 05th January 2019, The Thripitaka containing its Commentaries (attakatha) transcribed in Pali and Sinhala languages was declared as a National Heritage by H.E the President at the historical Aluwiharaya in Matale and a Gazette Notification dated 07th February 2019 has been issued to that effect. It has been scheduled to hand over the proposal for the declaration of the Thripitaka as a World Heritage to the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) on 23rd March 2019 which has already been approved by the Cabinet of Ministers. Accordingly, with a view to making this event a success, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to conduct a countrywide programme named “Thripitakabhivandana” with the participation of the public during the period from 16th March to 23rd March, to conduct the National Ceremony related to the declaration of the Thripitaka as a World Heritage in the premises of the Maha Maluwa (Great Terrace) of the Tempe of the Sacred Tooth Relic in Kandy and to make the necessary arrangements in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entry into a Long Term Contract for the procurement of Crude Oil
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development to award the contract for the procurement of Murban Crude oil for a period of 8 months during the year 2019, to M/s Swiss Singapore Overseas Enterprise Pte. Ltd., in accordance with recommendation of the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SSCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer required for the month of April 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to obtain approval for the procurement of 27,400 MT of Urea (Granular) for a price of US$ 318.75 per MT from M/s Agri Commodities and Fiance and 3,000 MT of Muriate of Potash for a price of US$ 352.85 per MT from M/s Valancy  International Trading (Pte.) Ltd., required for the month of April for the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Ltd. and the Colombo Commercial Company Ltd., and also for the procurement of 10,000 MT of Triple Super Phosphate for a price of US$ 317.00 per MT from the Golden Barley International (Pte.) Ltd., in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC)  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Services of Firm/s with International Experience for Forensic activities of the  Central Bank of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has granted approval previously to procure the services of firms with a global practice and international experience for the forensic audit activities of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to award the relevant contract to M/s BDO India LLP and M/s KPMG Sri Lanka selected on the results of the evaluation carried out in terms of the above approval of the technical proposal and the financial proposal and in accordance with the recommendations of the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promoting of the Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - It is observed that nearly 60,000 youth enter into the workforce annually, devoid of adequate vocational and technical skills and remain either unemployed or engaged in less paid jobs. It is also felt that there is a difficulty in attracting the youth for the Technical and Vocational Education and the Training Sectors. As such, an expeditious programme is necessary to be implemented to attract the youth with skills and talents required to create a labour market. In this respect, a special programme has been planned to be implemented and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister and the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to set apart funds for this purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Petroleum Refinery in Hambantota for exports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been submitted to set up a Petroleum Refinery with the capacity of 10 million metric tons per annum in Hambantota for exports as a Joint Venture between Silver Park International (Pvt) Ltd., Singapore and the Ministry of Oil & Gas of Sultanate of Oman. Accordingly, taking into consideration the significance of the relevant investment proposal, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade to allocate 400 acres of land to the investor on lease basis for the establishment of the proposed industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Rural Roads in Pasgoda, Kotapola and Pitabeddara Divisional Secretariat Divisions in Matara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - Even though, Cabinet approval has been granted previously to develop the rural roads in Pasgoda, Kotapola, and Pitabeddara Divisional Secretariat Divisions in Matara District, those projects could not be initiated expeditiously due to the delay caused  in  obtaining required resources. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayaka, Minister of  Ports & Shipping and  Southern Development to secure provisions required to develop the roads in Katawala, Horagala, Rajawatta, Kakunahena, Isuru Uyana, Udhadheniya, Nishshankapura, Siyabalagoda East Youth Service Road and Siyabalagoda, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of a Chiller for the Central Air Conditioning System of the  Superior Courts Complex Building
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to purchase a new chiller for the Central Air Conditioning System installed in the  Superior Courts Complex, with a view to enhancing the air conditioning facilities of the building in which the judicial activities of the Superior Court and the Court of Appeal are being carried out, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introducing an Alternative Care Policy for Children in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body:
- Alternative care methods such as retaining the children at risk of leaving their families due to various problems within their natural family itself by supporting such families, handing over the children leaving from their families into the custody of a relative, keeping them under the protection of a suitable person, giving for adoption and institutionalizing of children are being implemented within Sri Lanka, at present.

     Therefore, in order to introduce the Alternative Care Policy for the effective implementation of the said Alternative Care methods, the  proposal made by Hon.(Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, Minister of Women & Child Affairs and Dry Zone Development on the Policy prepared focusing the major aspects, such as reasons for providing alternative care for children, identification of risk prone children, identification of appropriate alternative care systems in Sri Lanka, legal background of alternative care referral, identification of techniques to prevent children from institutionalization, identification of service providers for children, measures to be taken for the children brought before law, social integration of children and implementation of alternative care policies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Policy on Civil Aviation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously to review the draft Bill submitted for the amendment of the National Policy on Aviation and to re-submit the same. Accordingly, action has been taken to further amend the draft Bill of the policy after discussions had with the relevant parties. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation, to implement the final amended draft within Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preservation and Promotion of 'Angam Shilpa'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The contribution had from the Angampora Shilpa, an indigenous Martial Art Technique and such performers were of immense importance to achieve success at the foreign invasions directed against the Sri Lankan nation. The attention of the Government has been drawn to preserve the Angampora Martial Art Techniques for the future generations as a unique art technique which could place the history of Sri Lanka in the face of the World. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs, for the issuance of a new Gazette Notification by annulling the Gazette Notification of 1817 published by the British Colonial Government on banning the practice of the  Angampora Martial Arts and to declare the said Martial Art and the Art Techniques Associated with it as a National Heritage, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the drought risk reduction activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The District Secretary of Jaffna has submitted an estimate for the programme to be implemented at the Divisional Secretariat Division level on the short term and long term measures for the provision of water required for the household and agricultural purposes in a bid to solve the water problem which has cropped up in the area.    Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.	Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Disaster Management, to construct water storage tanks in  Allaipeddy and Nunavil West, to rehabilitate the saline water prevention scheme of the Vertharadaipu Kulam, Sampalodai, Punkuduthevu East and Madathuveli and to renovate the Melinchimunai Kulam tank at a cost of Rs.54.2 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the fishery harbours in Beruwala, Galle, Puranawella/ Kudawella
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that although there are 20 fishery harbours in Sri Lanka none of them except the Dikowita Fishery Harbour has the adequate facilities that are required in mooring the fishing vessels of 55ft or more than 55ft in length. In a study made by the National Aquatic Resources Research and Development Agency (NARA), it has been found that a considerable loss of post‑harvest fish occur due to the non‑availability of proper facilities for taking the fish‑catch over to the sea-shore and adequate facilities for the storage of fish and proper storage facilities in the currently used small vessels. As such, adequate facilities have to be provided for, to minimize the post‑harvest loss and to develop the qualitative aspect of the fish harvest. Taking these matters into consideration, it has been planned to develop the fishery harbours in Beruwala, Galle, Puranawella / Kudawella with the donor funds of the French Development Institute under the concept of the Green Harbours to meet the International standards. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to get the environmental and the sociological study for the development of these harbours done by the NARA, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of the Medical Supplies Facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously to upgrade the facilities of the Drug Stores of the 134 hospitals of the Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine and the 26 Regional Medical Supplies Divisions coming under the purview of the Medical Supplies Division. However, considering the rapid advancement and the development activities of the Health Institutions, the facilities available in the Medical  Supplies Divisions spread over the Island should be expanded. Accordingly, the matters presented by  Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, on upgrading the stores facilities of 430 Divisional Hospitals and 276 Primary Health‑Care Units, in addition to the 160 institutions for which approval has been granted earlier, at a cost of Rs.3,988.6 million within the Medium Term Budgetary Framework of 2020-2022, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: The progress of the establishment of the Joint Ventures by Potential Investors with the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation (SPMC) for the manufacture of  Pharmaceuticals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The development of the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry of Sri Lanka will pave the way for saving the foreign exchange spent on the import of pharmaceuticals and also for keeping the prices of the pharmaceuticals stable. As such, the Cabinet of Ministers has previously granted approval to identify the potential investors for providing the necessary fresh and high quality medicinal ingredients to the hospitals uninterruptedly and for the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation to establish joint ventures with them. The matters presented, in this regard, for the information of the Cabinet by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to the effect that on such approval, 17 institutions have established joint ventures with the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation and that their projects are in progress, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a five-storey Cardiac Care Complex at the Teaching Hospital in Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has previously granted approval to upgrade the Provincial General Hospital in Ratnapura as a Teaching Hospital with a view to providing the necessary facilities to facilitate clinical training for the medical students of the newly established medical faculty of the Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka. As there is no adequate accommodation presently for Cardiology services at the hospital, it has been proposed to construct a five storey building in a land  of 5,000 sq.m. By this it is intended to provide facilities for Cardiology Wards with 80 beds, Cardiology Thoracic Ward with 40 beds, Cardiac Catheterization Laboratory, Excise ECG Room, ECG Unit with Halter Monitoring facilities, 02 Eco Cardiography rooms, Intensive care Units with 10 beds, Theater rooms, Clinic rooms and the required medical equipment and services. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to construct the Five storey Cardiac Care Complex at the Teaching Hospital in Ratnapura at a cost of  Rs.1,325.9 million within the Medium Term Budgetary Framework of 2020 - 2022, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship Trust Fund Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to amend sections 3(2) and 15 of the Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship Trust Fund Act No.66 of 1981 in order to update certain administrative issues which emerge in implementing the said Act by changing its name into Lalith Athulathmudali Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship Trust Fund Act. In addition, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, on the draft bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman amending sections 3(2), 15 and 19 of the said Act by incorporating the amendments such as vesting powers of the said Act, entrusted to the Ministry in charge of Trade to be vested with the Ministry in charge of Higher Education, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Report on the Public Sector Cadre for the Third Quarter of the Year 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: -  The Report on the Public Sector Cadre for the Third Quarter of the Year 2018 has been submitted for the attention of the Cabinet. As such, it has been calculated that the approved cadre of the Public Sector as at 30th September 2018 is 1,587,803 and that the existing cadre at present, is 1,373,338. The report has pointed out the necessity of enforcing proper methodologies, laws and regulations to prevent the recruitment made by certain institutions in the Public Sector ignoring the service requirement, as several issues have emerged in obtaining optimum service from such officers and therefore, it is appropriate to make new recruitment  having obtained the concurrence of the Management Services Department only after carrying out a work study. Accordingly, the facts submitted by Hon.Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance on the data of the Report on the Public Sector Cadre for the Third Quarter of the Year 2018, were noted by the Cabinet.

description: Securing of funds for the 'Smallholder Agribusiness Partnership Program
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The 'Smallholder Agribusiness Partnership Program' of the period from 2017 - 2023 is a programme being implemented under an investment of US$ 105 million, to assist around 57,500 low income recipient families for the sustainable development of their income and their livelihood. The International Fund for Agriculture Development (IFAD) has agreed to provide a loan facility of US$ 54.4 for the implementation of this project and out of this US$ 39.88 million has already been used. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to secure a further US$ 14.52 million required for the continued implementation of this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No.15 of 1995
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the provisions of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No.15 of 1995, the functions have been carried out for more than a period of 20 years, up to the present day and as of now the necessity of amending same to suite the present trends has been observed. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to instruct the Legal Draftsman to amend the Act by incorporating the necessary provisions to make  regulations for a proper regulatory system for certifying the public sector accounting standards, safeguarding the qualitative aspect of the operation of the audit firms, and for strengthening of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Monitoring Board etc., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presidential Media Awards Ceremony
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has previously granted approval to conduct a Presidential Media Awards Ceremony annually, for the encouragement of journalists. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance to award a cash price as well, for the prospective  award recipients to be felicitated and the life time award winners, and to admire and award an honorarium to the journalists experts working in the Editorial Board and the journalist who produce academic write-ups and critiques, as a matter of appreciation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of lands for the accelarated implementation of the Kankesanthurai Harbour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - An Agreement has been entered into, for securing of the necessary funds with the collaboration of the Government of India for the development of the  Kankesanthurai Harbour and hence, it is necessary to transfer lands for the implementation of the said project expeditiously. As such, it has been found that it is appropriate to transfer the lands in extent of 15 acres belonging to the Sri Lanka Cement Corporation over to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to transfer the said 15 acres to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reimbursement of the loss incurred by the Super Markets engaged in the Government Programme to make available food commodities at the landed cost
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The Government has obtained the cooperation of the Supper Markets and the Lanka Sathosa Limited to sell essential food items such as, rice, sugar, potatoes, onions, lentils, sprats and mackerel at landed cost as a relief measure to the consumers for a period of four months commencing from 14 December 2017 to 15 April 2018. The Government has agreed to meet the loss so incurred for selling of these essential food items to the consumers by the said institutions as computed by an external auditor on his recommendations. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to settle the loss amounting to 203 million incurred by Cargils (Ceylon) PLC and the Lanka Sathosa Limited, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Proposals for the Development of the operational activities of the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport (MRIA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has previously granted approval to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee and a Project Committee to assist in its task to examine the proposal made by the  Airports Authority of India in respect of the operational activities of the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport and make recommendations. Accordingly, the Joint Proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Transport & Civil Aviation to pursue future action in accordance with the Report prepared by the said Committee containing its recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Approval for the ratification of the International Labour Organization (ILO) Protocol relevant to the Forced Labour Convention
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has ratified the Forced Labour Convention No.29 of 1930 of the International Labour Organization (ILO) in the year 1950, and the Abolition of the Forced Labour Convention No.105 of 1957 in the year 2003. Considering the trends in regard to the use of forced labour for sexual exploitation, child labour, modern slavery and human trafficking, the Protocol No.29 has been adopted as an additional device to the Forced Labour Convention of 2014. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in accordance with the request of the Non‑Cabinet Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, to ratify the Protocol No.29 of 2014 pertaining to the Forced Labour Convention of 1930 to be on par with the provisions provided therein, for the existing legal framework in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the National Integrity Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - In terms of the United Nations Convention Against Corruption (UNCAC) which was ratified by the Government of Sri Lanka it is obligatory to create an adequate legal background and administrative parameters within the country to act against corruption.  Accordingly, the Cabinet of Ministers has granted its approval previously to formulate a National Action Plan to take measures against corruption. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena,  to implement the National Integrity Plan and Actions in colloboration with the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption with a view to fulfilling the objectives of creating a public service characterized by honesty, transparency, responsibility and accountability, raising awareness among the public sector employees on bribery and prevention methods, encouraging the society and the public officers to provide evidence and information, mobilizing citizens as whistle blowers on corruption and defending and appearing on behalf of witnesses, informants and whistle blowers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Digital Economy Strategy for Sri Lanka: 2018-2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-03-06
decision_details_body: - Digital Economy Strategy for Sri Lanka has been designed in collaboration with the international level consultants and the representatives of the relevant institutions. In order to accelerate the economic growth based on the digital technology, this strategy includes a three-part framework with digitization of priority sectors in the economy, accelerating growth and improvement of digital sectors and building the required digital infrastructure. Under, this strategy, three Flagship Programmes of Digitally Enabled Export Promotion Zone and “Logistic Villages”, Centralized Agriculture Nerve Center and Data Exchange Platform are expected to be implemented. Further, it has also been scheduled for 10 priority projects including the digitalized projects to be completed within 03 years. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, on the request made by the Non‑Cabinet Ministry of Digital Infrastructure and Information Technology, for the proposed digital strategy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Furnishing of information related to Cabinet decisions under the provisions of the Right to Information Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body:
- In terms of the provisions of the Right to Information Act, No.12 of 2016, a request made by a citizen for information related to Cabinet decisions was hitherto addressed by the Office of the Cabinet of Ministers. Nevertheless, the recommendation made by the Cabinet Sub‑Committee on Legislation to authorize the Secretaries to Ministries, to provide the citizens directly with the information requested by the Line Ministry itself, with a view to providing the Cabinet decisions and the related information in a more efficient and effective manner, was approved by the Cabinet.

	Accordingly, the Cabinet decided to authorize the Secretaries to Ministries and the Secretaries to Non‑Cabinet Ministries to provide the citizens the Cabinet decisions and related documents pertaining to the subject matter within the purview of each Ministry directly, having considered the request made by a citizen in terms of the Right to Information Act, subject to restrictions stipulated therein and the Office of the Cabinet of Ministers to provide only the information not relevant to a particular Cabinet Memorandum or falling within the purview of a Ministry and on which the Cabinet has made a decision under 'Any Other Business'.

description: Tentative Programme for the Budget Debate for the Financial Year 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The Budget Speech 	containing the Budget proposals for the year 2019 (the second reading of the Budget) is scheduled to be presented in Parliament on the 5th of March 2019. Accordingly, it is scheduled for the second reading of the Budget debate to be had from 2019‑03‑06 to 2019‑03‑12, the Committee Stage debate to be had from 2019‑03‑13 to 2019‑04‑05 and the Voting on the Budget to be conducted on 2019‑04‑05. The facts presented by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister pertaining to the said Budget programme, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the contract for the water supply extension to Dambulla and Kandalama through the Greater Dambulla Water Scheme in the Central Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government to award the contract for the water supply extension to Dambulla and Kandalama through the Greater Dambulla Water Scheme in the Central Province implemented as a sub - project of the Local Government Enhancement Sector Project, to M/s Squire Mech Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.565.39 million as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The contract for the installation of 100Mvar Breaker Switched Capacitor Banks at the Pannipitiya Grid Substation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the installation of 100Mvar Breaker Switched Capacitor Banks at the Pannipitiya Grid Substation under the Supporting Electricity Supply Reliability Improvement Project, to M/s Seimens Ltd. in India, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Coal required for the Coal Power Plant in Puttalam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the purchase of MT 360,000 of coal required for the Coal Power Plant in Puttalam to M/s Trafigura Pte. Ltd. in Singapore at a price of US$ 91.40 per Metric Ton, as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The contract for obtaining expertise manpower services for the maintenance of the Boiler, Turbine and Auxiliaries of Unit 03 of the Lakvijaya Power Plant in Puttalam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The 'Technical Cooperation Agreement for Overhaul Support' between the China Machinery Engineering Corporation, the main contractor for the construction of the Puttalam Coal Power Plant and the Sri Lanka Electricity Board is valid till the end of September 2019. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Power, Energy and Business Development, to award the contract for the maintenance of the Boiler, Turbine and Auxiliaries of Unit 03 of the Lakvijaya Power Plant in Puttalam to the China Machinery Engineering Corporation, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Mannar Fort
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - With a view to attracting the foreign tourists, it was proposed by the budget proposals in 2018, to develop 06 old Forts situated in Matara, Hambantota, Batticaloa, Trincomalee, Mannar and Kalpitiya with the collaboration of the Department of Archaeology and the Private Sector. Accordingly, the Department of Archaeology has prepared a project proposal for the development of the Mannar Fort. The dredging of the moat around the Fort has been identified as the main task in the proposal. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs, for the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation which has shown competency in such activities to carryout the process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Attracting the 'Multi National Players engaged in the Electrical and Electronic Machinery Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body:
- The Electrical and Electronic Machinery Industry is the process of stepping into the Global Electronic Value Added Supply Chain and according to the Economic Cooperation and Development Classification of Manufacturing Industries, the field of Electronic and Electric Machinery Industry in the country falls under the category of the medium‑high technology and high technology industries. Accordingly, this includes the Automobile, Telecommunication, Consumer Electronics, Industrial Automation, Internet of Things (IoT) and many other verticals. The industrialists of this country in this field, have received the ISO certificate and carry on their activities subject to the required labour rules and the regulations. 

The start‑up companies in research and development prototyping in the country are engaged in innovation and generating new products and in this context, it has become essential for the small and middle scale enterprises to integrate with the large companies. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to provide facilities for this type of enterprises to attract the multi‑national companies to integrate with them, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the Code of Regulations for the formalization of the involvements of the Sports Associations in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-02-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon.
