Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to allocate Rs.335 million required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing facilities to improve the productivity of the Tea and Coconut Smallholder Sectors
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that the contribution made by the Tea and Coconut smallholder Sectors to the total tea and coconut production towards the sectors is being increased during the past few years and it has also been identified that there is a tendency for further increasing the said contribution. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries to allocate the funds required to increase the productivity of Tea and Coconut smallholder Sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of Compensation to the persons affected by the construction of the Kandy Multimodal Transport Terminal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The project for the construction of the Kandy Multimodal Transport Terminal has been identified for implementation under the Strategic Cities Development Project. The project which is to be implemented at an investment of Rs.11,700 million, is expected to contribute towards the establishment of an environmental friendly transport system that enhances the quality of life of the people in the Kandy City and its cultural heritage. However, it has been found that implementation of this project would deprive the livelihood of 820 persons including businessmen engaged in different entrepreneurial activities in the area. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to pay compensation as recommended by the Entitlement Assessment Committee appointed to determine the exact compensation amounts to be paid to the persons affected by the said Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Palaly (Kankesanthurai) Airport for the operation of Regional Commercial Flights
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The need to develop the Palaly Airport has been recognized for the operation of internal commercial flights with a view to promoting the tourism industry. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to make use of the Palaly Airport for the operation of internal commercial passenger flights according to a schedule and to carry out the development activities required for the Palaly Airport expeditiously by the Sri Lanka Air Force at an investment of Rs.1,950 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Adopting the concept of Managing for Development Results (MfDR) as a planning and management technique at the Public institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The developed as well as the developing countries adopt the concept of Managing for Development Results (MfDR) as a modern planning and management technqiue in their public sector management cycle. Through this cycle, the Public management activities are conducted aiming at Key Performance Indicators (KPI) targeted towards the National Sustainable Development. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to institutionalize the process of Managing for Development Results (MfDR) as an initiative in 05 Ministries and 02 Provincial Councils in the form of a pilot project andadopting this concept covering all Public institutions based on its success, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accelerated implementation of the resettlement activities in the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - The Government has focused its attention to carry out the resettlement activities expeditiously in the Northern and Eastern Provinces affected due to conflicts by establishing permanent shelter, sanitation facilities, water supply and economic infrastructure facilities such as roads and electricity connections and educational and health facilities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to construct 4,750 housing units under the owner driven housing programme, to improve the essential economic and social infrastructure facilities in such areas and to upgrade the Thickkam Distilleries for the revival of palmyrah related industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Forest plantation for timber production
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - Since the timber requirement in Sri Lanka increases on an annual basis and in order to coincide with this, it has been proposed to increase the productivity of the forest plantation presently carried out for timber and establish new forest plantation. Lands in extent of 500 hectares have been identified in the Districts of Vavuniya, Kilinochchi, Mullaitivu and Mannar for the establishment of the new forest plantation. Through the implementation of this project, it is expected to generate employment opportunities at divisional level and contribute for the control of global warming by upgrading the forest layer, in addition to meeting the demand for timber. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to secure the funds required for the implementation of this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Controlling of the quantum of waste accumulated in the coast and the ocean through waterways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-29
decision_details_body: - It has been revealed that 90% of the waste accumulated in the coast and the ocean is generated on account of human activities and industries carried out on land and as a result of which, many social, economic and environmental issues have emerged. Action is being taken to obtain the 'Blue Flag' Certificate issued by the Foundation for Environmental Education of Denmark pertaining to the coastal line of Sri Lanka which is treated as an international standard for the assurance of the quality of the coastal line. In addition, it is also necessary to maintain a clean coastal line and ocean for achieving the goal of attracting 4 million of tourists to Sri Lanka by the year 2020 as the coastal and ocean related areas provide around 70% of the contribution to the in‑bound tourism industry while safeguarding the place secured by Sri Lanka as the world's best tourism destination. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement the programmes at District level for the maintenance of waterways free of waste, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of drinking water for model villages and reawakened 	settlements 	in Chronic Kidney Disease of Unknown Etiology (CKDU) 	affected areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously to utilize the funds allocated to the model village and reawakened settlements project to provide drinking water to the said villages in the CKDU affected areas. In this respect, the joint proposal made by Hon.Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Wate Supply and Higher Education and Hon.Sajith Premadasa, the	Minister of Housing,  Construction  and  Cultural  Affairs,  to  implement  the	project for improving the Kirindi Oya water treatment plant, enabling to	provide drinking water for 703 families in 18 model villages located   in Lunugamwehera and Thissamaharama Divisional Secretariat Divisions in the Hambantota District, with an investment of Rs. 298 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kalu Ganga Development Project for the prevention of flood and restraining  Salinity intrusion and  for the Supply of Drinking Water to the Hambantota District by diverting Kalu Ganga
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - A feasibility study has been carried out to implement the Kalu Ganga  development project at an investment of Rs 123 billion, with the main objective of preventing the damages caused in the Ratnapura and Kalutara districts due to the overflowing of the Kalu Ganga during the rainy season, restraining salinity intrusion in the supply of drinking water caused by the flowing of salinity up to 18 km upstream from the river mouth and providing drinking water to the Hambantota district, by diverting Kuda Ganga, which is a tributary of the Kalu Ganga. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development to call for proposals for Expression of Interest from the International Construction Companies which can implement the project with foreign investment, to call for project proposals from eligible construction companies and to appoint Cabinet Appointed Committees to evaluate them, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Supply of 12,000 MT of Maize required for Thriposha Production
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine to award the contract for the purchase of 12,000 MT of Maize, which is one of the main ingredients used for manufacturing Thriposha for Sri Lanka Thriposha Limited, to M/s KST Evergreen (Pvt)Ltd., for a sum of Rs 670.8 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Vehicle and Powertrain Laboratory at the Department of Mechanical Engineering of the Faculty of Engineering, University of Moratuwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to construct a Vehicle and Powertrain Laboratory at the Department of Mechanical Engineering of the Faculty of Engineering, University of Moratuwa, with a view to facilitating the emerging needs of the local automobile industry, establishing a state of the art and automotive laboratory, producing engineers well equipped with modern knowledge and conducting the research, survey and development capabilities related to the automotive environmental issues. The Raiffeisen Bank International AG of Austria has given its concurrence to provide concessional financing for this project under a soft loan scheme. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to obtain a detailed project proposal from M/s AVL List GmbH who is the sole Austrian Manufacturer and supplier operative in this field, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Plant and Design Build Contract for the Civil, Machinery and Electricity 	(M&E) Work of the Valachchenai Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to award the Plant and Design Build contract for the civil, machinery and electrical work of the Valachchenai Water Supply Project to be implemented covering the 06 Divisional Secretariat Divisions of Koralaipattu, Koralaipattu West, Koralaipattu Central, Koralaipattu South, Koralaipattu North and Eravurpattu to M/s China Geo Engineering Company Limited & M/s China National Aero Technology International Engineering Corporation ‑ JV, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee (CANC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Simplifying the Scheme for Registration of Exporters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - It is observed that a long procedure has to be followed for the registration of Exporters under the registration process currently adopted by the Sri Lanka Export Development Board which has been introduced in 1985 for the registration of Exporters since it has be to operated by collaborating with 06 different agencies and that a period from 01 to 03 weeks is taken for the registration of exporters.  At the same time, studies have shown that a further period of 02 weeks to 04 weeks is required in addition to the period given above for enterprises which need permits or licenses for the Export activities.  In order to make the registration process convenient, the Sri Lanka Export Development Board has already taken steps to prepare a mechanism in collaboration with the institutions such as the Sri Lanka Customs and the  Department of Inland Revenue which operate similar databases with exporter details. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to revoke the registration scheme presently adopted by the Sri Lanka Export Development Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reimbursement of the cultivation losses caused by the 'Fall Armyworm' Pest under the Compulsory Cultivation Insurance Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - Due to the Fall Armyworm menace which is rapidly spreading in the major agricultural areas of Sri Lanka from recent times, the farmers have to face an unexpected economic loss. Under the present Compulsory Insurance Scheme, an Insurance Cover is not available for cultivation losses caused by this kind of  pest calamity and therefore, the farmers have to obtain the Insurance Cover under an additional cover through the payment of a small premium. However, it is observed that, a majority of farmers who have commenced cultivation in the Maha Season of 2018/19 have not obtained this additional Insurance Cover and as such, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to reimburse the cultivation losses caused by the Fall Armyworm Pest under the Compulsory Cultivation Insurance Scheme and to secure the additional provision required for the purpose from the Treasury, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Paddy Purchasing Programme for Maha Season 2018/2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - Harvesting of paddy for Maha Season 2018/2019 is due to be commenced and  it has been planned to implement the Paddy Purchasing Programme in 18 districts during this season in order to maintain a price stability for paddy and to ensure a reasonable price for the paddy farmers. As such paddy is to be purchased under a guaranteed price of Rs 41.00 per kg of Samba paddy varieties and  Rs 38.00 per kg of Nadu paddy variety. Accordingly, the proposal  made by Hon.P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to secure funds required for the Paddy Marketing Board to implement the Paddy Purchasing Programme for the Maha Season, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining approval of Parliament for the Gazette Notifications published 	under the Revenue Protection Act, No 19 of 1962
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - The Gazette 	Notifications issued under the Revenue Protection Act, No 19 	of 1962, revising the import duty should be presented in Parliament for 	approval. As such, the proposal made by Hon.	Mangala Samaraweera, the 	Minister of Finance & Mass Media to present the Gazette Notifications No. 	2079/32, 2092/8 and 2097/36 issued for introducing new H.S code 	and duty 	enabling to receive concessions to the local manufactures in 	levying import 	duty and revising the import duty on petrol for the adjustment of the fuel price 	in the 	country relatively to the decrease in fuel price in the international 	market, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002 for the provision of tax reliefs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - Value Added Tax (VAT) exemption that was applicable on certain goods and services including importation of air crafts and accessories, sawn timber and fabrics and sale of condominium housing units has been removed under the Value Added Tax (Amendment) Act, No.25 of 2018. However, considering the requests made by the relevant stakeholders in these fields, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to amend the Value Added Tax (VAT) Act enabling to re-introduce the tax exemptions imposed on importation of air crafts and accessories, sawn timber and fabrics and locally manufactured Rice Bran oil and with a view to protecting the Government revenue and enable the Minister to determine and prescribe by regulation the basis for the imposition of VAT on certain goods,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Further extending of the financial facilities provided under the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that there is a great demand for the loan schemes implemented under the Enterprise Sri Lanka programme due to the  concessionary terms and conditions of such loan schemes. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to implement this programme covering the groups such as migrant workers with the anticipation of concessionary housing loans, private bus owners with the expectation of deploying luxury city buses instead of normal buses, investors who are looking forward to constructing and improving elderly care centres and three-wheeler owners willing to change over to the taxi service that have not so far been covered by the loan schemes implemented under this programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the three storey building where the Ahangama Police 	Station is housed
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - The Ahangama Police Station, which extends its services to the people living in 35 Grama Niladhari Divisions, encounters difficulties while providingservices due to the dilapidated condition and non renovation for a long period of the three storey building in which the police station is housed. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to allocate Rs.33.4 million for the renovations and improvements required to be carried out in the said building, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Police Reforms
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body: - A Police Reforms Committee comprising of the experts was appointed to make recommendations for reforming the Sri Lanka Police, in order to update the present police methodologies and performance to cater to the present trends, relatively to the public demand for an efficient and accountable professional police service. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to implement the Police Reforms Action Plan containing the recommendations made by the said Committee in the areas of improving  professionalism and standards of the Sri Lanka Police, enhancing accountability and transparency, practicing and upholding human rights, preventing and controlling crime and reducing fear of crime and increasing the public trust and confidence in the Police, was approved in principle by the Cabinet.

description: Second National Action Plan of the Open Government Partnership (2018 - 2020)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-22
decision_details_body:
- The Open Government Partnership is a multilateral initiative that is aimed at securing a concrete commitment from the Governments on policies to promote transparency, empower  citizens, fight corruption and harness new technologies to strengthen governance. Under the Open Government Partnership (OGP), all  the participating countries are obliged to develop an Action Plan inclusive of their voluntary commitments spanning for 02 years. Approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously for the implementation of the First 02 year Action Plan of the OGP (2016-2018) of the Government of Sri Lanka.  

The Second National Action Plan has been prepared consisting of 14 transformative commitments and 61 milestones ranging from enhancing the rights of the disabled community, promoting accountability through asset declarations and provision of improved services for disaster management. With the implementation of the Second National Action Plan, it is anticipated that it will enhance the citizens participation in the governance processes and transparency and thereby increasing the accountability of the Government towards its citizenry. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to implement the Second National Action Plan (2018-2020) in collaboration with the relevant Government Institutions and to appoint an Inter Ministerial Steering Committee to monitor the progress and to provide guidance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of the Tripitaka as a World Heritage
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet of Ministers had been granted previously to declare the Tripitaka which includes all preachings of Buddha as a National Heritage of Sri Lanka and to officially declare the same by the Government and reprint the Tripitaka and other related work under the supervision of the Ministry of Buddhasasana. Accordingly, on 05th January 2019, the Tripitaka was declared as a National Heritage at the Matale Alu Viharaya. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to move a resolution in Parliament to confirm  the declaration so made and the necessity to take appropriate action to declare the Tripitaka as a World Heritage, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Piling Work for the Construction of the Faculty of Nursing at Sri Jayawardenapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously to award the contract to the State Engineering Corporation for the construction of the Faculty of Nursing at Sri Jayawardenapura consisting of 22 storyes. Since piling work for 248 places has to be carried out, it was decided to grant sub‑contracts under 03 Packages. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, Minister of Housing, Construction and Cultural Affairs, to award the Package 01 and Package 02 of the above project to M/s Nawaloka Piling (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs 124.8 million and Rs 137.5 million respectively and Package 03 of the said project to M/s D.P Jayasinghe Piling Co.(Pvt.)Ltd., for a sum of Rs 126 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mixed Development project at the Battaramulla Junction of the  Kaduwela Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to vest a land belonging to the Urban Development Authority, in extent of 415 perches situated at the Battaramulla Junction of the Kaduwela Road with M/s Essar Projects Limited on lease basis, to establish a Mixed Development Project, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Carrying out development activities of the ten Urban Parks in the Jaffna City and the Neighbourhood
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body: - The Parks namely, the Pannai Urban Market Place, Lagoon Front Park, Sangiliyan Park, Oddumadam Lagoon Park, Fort Surrounding Park and Rasavinthoddum Square, Russell Square, Passiyoor Pocket Park and Kurunagar Beach Road Square situated in the Jaffna District have been identified for development and improvement. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to award the contract for consultancy in regard to concept and detail designs, preparation of bidding documents and construction supervision pertaining to the appropriate urban development interventions, to the Urban Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sale of Mineral Sands manufactured by the Lanka Mineral Sands Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry & Commerce, Resettlement of Protracted Displaced Persons and Co‑operative Development, to award the tenders for the sale of mineral sand manufactured at the Government owned Lanka Mineral Sands Limited, 40,000 MT of Non‑Magnetic Heavy Mineral Concentrate at US$ 283.91 per MT, 13,000 MT of Low Grade Zircon Crude at US$ 25.11 per MT and 250 MT of Zircon at US$ 1,403 per MT to M/s Alchemy Heavy Metals (Pvt.) Ltd. and 800 MT of Rutile at US$ 1,113 per MT to M/s Sell & Parker Pty Ltd. and 2,000 MT of Hi‑Ti Ilmenite at US$ 136.86 per MT to M/s Project Prospects (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Tender Committee and the Technical Evaluation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an Auditorium for the District Secretariat in Galle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body: - The Galle Secretariat and most of the Public Institutions in the Southern Province hold State functions, Conferences, Seminars and Public Discussions in a Hall at the Hall de Galle which is a high tourist attraction vicinity situated in the sea belt of the Galle City. This premises which is of a very high commercial value situated in the area of the Galle Fort is proposed to be released for planned tourist development activities and for design and construction of a new auditorium with a seating capacity of 2,000 for the use of the Galle District Secretariat.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Wajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government, to award the contract to M/s Sanken Construction (Pvt.) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.2,656.87 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Main Building (Phase - I) at the Base Hospital in Beruwala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the construction of  
the Pile Foundation of the nine storey main building (Phase - I) at the Base Hospital in Beruwala to M/s Access Engineering PLC for a sum of Rs.355 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Setting up of a Picture Archival and Communication System (PACS) and a Radiology Information System (RIS) for 20 Government Hospitals in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for setting up of a Picture Archival and Communication System (PACS) and a Radiology Information System (RIS) for 20 Government Hospitals in Sri Lanka to conserve and store all information of the patients and helpful for accurate diagnosis for providing treatments enabling to magnify the digital ragiological images while spending less time and money, to M/s REDtone MEX sdn Bhd institution in Malaysia, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Construction of a Water Tower with the capacity of 1500m3, laying of water pipes and for fittings for the transmission and distribution mains in the Belummahara Area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body: - The contract for the implementation of the Gampaha, Attanagalla and Minuwangoda Integrated Water Supply Scheme has been awarded to M/s China Machinery Engineering Corporation and an agreement has been reached for sub‑contracts of 08 projects pertaining to the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to award the contract for the construction of a water tower with a capacity of 1,500m3, laying of water pipes and for fittings for the transmission and distribution mains in the Belummahara area which is a sub‑contract of the same, to M/s Sanken Construction (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for laying of pipes and fittings for the Transmission and Water Distribution Mains in the Attanagalla Area under the Gampaha, Attanagalla and Minuwangoda Integrated Water Supply Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body: - The contract of the Gampaha, Attanagalla and Minuwangoda Integrated Water Supply Scheme has been awarded to M/s China Machinery Engineering Corporation and certain activities pertaining to it are scheduled to be sub‑contracted.  In accordance with the above, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, to award the contract for the construction of a water tower with a capacity of 1,500m3 and laying of the necessary water pipes and fittings for transmission and distribution mains in the Attanagalla area, to the Joint Venture established by  M/s Sierra Construction Limited and KDA Weerasinghe Co. (Pvt.) Limited, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Modernization of the Vocational Training Centres in Colombo and	Gampaha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body: - Construction work pertaining to the establishment of the Colombo Vocational Training Centre and upgrading of the Gampaha Technical College are nearing completion. Since the courses of these Technical Colleges have been upgraded from NVQ level 4 to NVQ level 5 and 6, taking into consideration the modern technical changes and the modernization of the equipment, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation,Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to amend the list of equipment originally proposed to comply with the requirement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Uniforms and other Clothing Materials for the Tri Forces, the Department of Civil Security, the National Cadet Corps, the Sri Lanka Police and the Special Task Force
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to procure  uniforms and other clothing materials  for the Tri‑Forces, the Department of Civil Security, the National Cadet Corps, the Sri Lanka Police and the Special Task Force from local textile manufactures for a sum of Rs.1,596.4 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of  the Town Hall of Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body: - The  activities of the Jaffna Municipal Council are carried out at a building belonging to the Nallur Kovil at present instead of the Town Hall of the Jaffna Municipal Council which is not in use due to the damages caused to the building. It has been observed that people face difficulties since many sections which render much services  to the public on a daily basis are scattered in different locations. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to construct the Jaffna Town Hall within the period of 2019 to 2023 at a cost of Rs.2,350 million,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Haldummulla Herbal Garden
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body: - Haldummulla Herbal Garden located in the Badulla District expands over an area in extent of  65 acres and it contains 700 plant species including endangered species, hereditary as well as rare plants. Provision of herbal plants and technical instructions to set up herbal gardens, selling publications related to herbal plants and conducting awareness programmes are also carried out through this herbal garden. Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous  Medicine, to implement a project with an investment of Rs.33.4 million to expand its activities further, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Ayurvedic Hospital at Polwatta in Ambalangoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body:
- The Ayurvedic hospital at Polwatta in Ambalangoda conducts its residential treatment services with 02 wards consisting of 18 beds. Although around 3000 patients attend to hospital seeking treatment, it has found difficult to provide them with the required residential treatment facilities due to the insufficient residential facilities.

   	Considering the contribution that could be made for preventing and controlling diseases such as cancer, heart ailments, diabetes, blood pressure etc. by the hospital and the proposed Yoga Treatment Unit, it has been planned to implement a project in 04 stages to upgrade the hospital. Construction activities of its first stage is nearing completion and development activities of its first and second storyes will be carried out under its Second and Third Stage and the development activities of its Third storey will be carried out under its Fourth stage. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine for securing the  provisions required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project for introducing Home Dialysis System using the Automated Peritoneal Dialysis for Kidney Patients
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body:
- A proposal had been previously submitted to the Cabinet on the implementation of the project for introducing Home Dialysis System using the Automated Peritoneal Dialysis for Kidney Patients and the Cabinet had decided to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee to study the said proposal and submit its recommendations. 

	Accordingly, the said Sub-Committee has recommended to appoint a Technical Evaluation Committee and a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee to evaluate the proposed project and conduct negotiations and to implement it as a pilot project for 500 patients in the identified districts and thereafter to implement same countrywide. As such, the report incorporating the said recommendations submitted by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading the Healthcare facilities in the District General Hospitals of Kilinochchi and Vavuniya and the Base Hospitals of Point-Pedro and Mankulam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to upgrade the healthcare facilities in the District General Hospitals of Kilinochchi and Vavuniya and the Base Hospitals of Point-Pedro and Mankulam for improving the health facilities and services of the Northern Province. The estimated cost to be incurred for the project is Euro 54.45 million and out of which 75% of the said investment will be granted by the ING Bank N.V of Netherlands as an ECA Backed Term Loan and the balance 25% will be financed by a grant extended by the Government of Netherlands. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to implement this project by the Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine in collaboration with the Provincial Council of the Northern Province, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into 06 Memoranda of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Philippines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet was granted to the proposals submitted for the purpose of entering into 06 Memoranda of Understanding specified below in view of the Bilateral Friendship, Cooperation and Development during the visit of         H. E. the President in Philippines. 

	Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Cooperation in the field of Tourism ‑ The proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs, to enter into a bi­lateral Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) in the field of tourism between Sri Lanka and Philippines on improvement of the cooperation in Research & Development, Education and Training, tourism promotion programmes, investments and the other sectors as determined by both parties. 


Improvement of the cooperation in the field of foreign employment ‑ The proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, Minister of Telecommunication, Foreign Employment and Sports, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Philippines and Sri Lanka for the improvement of the co‑operation in the fields of welfare and protection of rights of workers, enhancement of productivity, working standards and professional health and security, providing training for migrant workers and certification and legal aid for safeguarding the workers rights between both countries. 	

Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Cooperation in the Field of Higher Education ‑ The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Wate Supply and Higher Education, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Commission on Higher Education of the Republic of the Philippines and the Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education of Sri Lanka with a view to strengthening the cooperation in the field of Higher Education between the two countries. 
	
Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) covering agriculture and the related fields ‑ 
The proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Philippines and Sri Lanka for the improvement of the cooperation in the fields of crop cultivation, fisheries industry, livestock control and poultry farming, agri‑processing and value addition, distribution and marketing of products.
 
Providing facilities for the Researchers of the National Agricultural Research System (NARS) to follow foreign Postgraduate Degree Courses ‑ The proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Economic Affairs, Livestock Development, Irrigation and Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Los Banos University of the Philippines, to provide for the researchers of the NARS with facilities to follow foreign postgraduate degrees. 

Enhancement of cooperation between the two countries in the field of defence ‑ The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and Philippines on the enhancement of cooperation in the fields of defence, military education and training, exchange of defence delegations, joint exercises, goodwill visits and conference

description: High Priority Economic and Social Empowerment and Infrastructure Development Projects in the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-14
decision_details_body:
- Due to the lapses in the development in the Northern and Eastern provinces for a period of more than three decades, a special project has been proposed to be implemented to accelerate the development in those areas by improving the economic and social infrastructure facilities and facilitating the livelihood development. Accordingly, the programmes will be implemented in such sectors paying special attention towards agricultural, industrial, fisheries and service sectors. It has also been scheduled to provide facilities related to livelihood under this project such as rural roads, anchorages and landing sites, jetties, accesses between islands and main islands, agricultural equipment, agro wells, fishing boats and engines, self‑employment related equipment and technology, market facilities, storage and related infrastructure facilities.

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies, Economic Affairs, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, Northern Province Development, Vocational Training & Skills Development and Youth Affairs, to secure a sum of Rs.2,000 million for the expeditious implementation of this project through the 04 sectors of economic infrastructure facilities, social infrastructure facilities, livelihood and self‑employment and small industries and enterprises, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting of relief to the people in the Northern Province affected by the floods
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - Due to the inclement weather conditions which affected the Island by the activation of the North East monsoon during the past days, 123,862 persons of 39,895 families in 13 Divisional Secretary's Divisions including Kilinochchi, Mullaitivu and Jaffna in the Northern Province have been affected and 474 houses have been completely destroyed while 4,522 houses have been partially damaged in the Kilinochchi and Mullaitivu Districts. The required funds and materials have been released to the District Secretaries to grant an advance of Rs.10,000/- for the house owners to do the necessary renovations and cleaning required to be done urgently, until the completion of the payment of the due compensation after a proper assessment. Similarly, action is also being taken to provide a dry ration for a period of two weeks for the affected families until their lives are brought back to normal. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Disaster Management, to secure the funds necessary to provide further relief for those affected due to the said disaster situation, to carry out the renovations of the damaged infrastructure facilities and common buildings and also for the damages caused to agricultural crops and livestock, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re presentation of the Appropriation Bill for the Financial Year 2019 in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body:
Approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held last week for the preparation of the Annual Budget for the year 2019, with a view to strengthening the Government Fiscal Consolidation Programme which is being carried out presently and to enable to achieve the mid term Government fiscal targets planned to be attained by the year 2021. As such, it has been planned to re‑present a new Appropriation Bill incorporating the Government expenditure as well scheduled to be incurred under the Vote on Accounts during the first 04 months of the Financial Year 2019.

In accordance with the Appropriation Bill so drafted, the expenditure to be incurred for general services amounts to Rs.2,312 billion comprising of Rs.1,436 billion for recurrent expenditure and Rs.876 billion for capital expenditure. In addition, Rs.2,232 billion has been set apart for the expenses already authorized to be charged on the Consolidated Fund such as Public Debt Servicing and Widows and Orphans Pensions. Similarly, inclusive of a provision of Rs.06 billion for the Government Advance Account, the total expenditure anticipated to be incurred for the year 2019 is Rs.4,550 billion. According to the prevailing tax rates structure, the Government revenue and the foreign grants for the year 2019 will be around Rs.2,390 billion. Further, the total borrowing requirement from both foreign and domestic sources will be Rs.2,160 billion. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to present the draft Appropriation Bill for the year 2019 in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting of the Gazette Notification published in accordance with the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No.18 of 2011 in Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - According to the budget proposals of 2017, it was proposed to grant a 75% waiver of payable Ports and Airports Development Levy on the identified high tech and automated machinery under the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, with a view to enhancing the productivity of the domestic industries manufacturing process, by the Gazette Extraordinary No.2079/34 of 11.07.2018 published under Section 3(3) of the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No.18 of 2011. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to present the relevant Gazette Notification in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the approval of Parliament for the Gazette Notifications published under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - Approval of Parliament should be obtained by moving a resolution for the Gazette Notifications published from time to time under the Special Commodity Levy Act No.48 of 2007. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to re-submit 08 Gazette Notifications published under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 having obtained the Cabinet approval but not tabled up to date in Parliament for approval and also another 07 Gazette Notifications published under the same Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 with a view to providing concessions to the consumers and the local farmers, in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting of the Gazette Notifications in Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - Seven Gazette Notifications have been issued under the provisions of the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No.13 of 1989 and the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002 in order to implement several policy decisions with regard to fiscal revenue. The approval of Parliament should be obtained within the time period stipulated in the Acts in respect of any Order issued under the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to submit the Gazette Notification No.2080/31 of 17th July 2018 for the removal of conditions to release motor vehicles from the Sri Lanka Customs before 2018‑04‑03, the Gazette Notification No.2082/11 of 31st July 2018 for the revision of Excise duty on cigarettes, the Gazette No.2082/10 of 31st July 2018 for revision of Excise duty on motor vehicles with engine capacity more than 1000 CC, the Gazette Notification No.2083/2 of 06th August 2018 for the limitation of concessionary terms for importation of motor vehicles, based on the LCs established on or before 2018‑08‑01, the Gazette Notification No.2088/2 of 10th September 2018 for the introduction of Tourist VAT Refund Scheme (TVRS), the Gazette Notification No.2088/25 of 11th September 2018 for the Prescribed minimum refundable value under TVRS and the Gazette Notification No.2089/20 of 18th September 2018 for the Reduced VAT rate applicable on importation of sugar, in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the contract for the Consultancy Services for the St. Sebastian South Pumping Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to award the contract of the consultancy services for design review, contract management and construction supervision of the works contract of the Plant Design, Supply and Installation of the St. Sebastian South Pumping Station designed under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project (MCUDP), to EPTISA Servicios de Ingenieria of Spain, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee (CACPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Development (Widening) of Kirimandala Mawatha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - The Kirimandala Mawatha is one of the four roads identified to be developed within the Colombo Municipal limits under the new township development project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to award the contract of same to M/s AMSK - GC Joint Venture for a sum of Rs.358.9 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Designing and Building of the St. Sebastian South Pumping Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to award the contract for Designing and Building of the St. Sebastian South Pumping Station proposed to be implemented under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project (MCUDP), to M/s China Geo Engineering Corporation, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kolonnawa Canal Diversion Scheme- Stage IV
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - The last section of the Kiththampahuwa canal is scheduled to be rehabilitated under Stage IV of the Kolonnawa Canal Diversion Scheme to be implemented under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project. Under this stage it is expected to remove the bottlenecks to the canal flow,	construct gabion wall, protect the bank by using permanent sheet pile, construct O&M roads with side drain, dredge, reconstruct the bridge and construct gate structure and mechanical works of the Gate. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to award the contract for the construction of Kolonnawa Canal Diversion Scheme- Stage IV Project to M/s E&C- RR Joint Venture for a sum of Rs.1,431.68 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kolonnawa Canal Diversion Scheme - Stage I
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement the Kolonnawa Canal Diversion Scheme 4.8km in length, under 04 sub sections as Stage I,II, III, and IV for the purpose of controlling floods in the Colombo area and out of which the Contracts under Stage II and Stage III have already been awarded. Stage I of this project, has been scheduled to rehabilitate the initial section of the Kiththampahuwa Canal which includes removing of the bottlenecks to the canal flow, construction of gabion wall for the protection of the bank and O&M roads with side drain and construction of conduit structure with steel gates. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to award the contract for the said purpose to M/s E&C-RR JV for a sum of Rs.859.5 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Flushing Gates for controlling of floods in the Colombo Area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development to award the contract for the construction of Flushing Gates in canals to be developed under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project to M/s DGES -RR- INDOEAST JV for a sum of Rs.609.6 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the new access road from Kottawa to Mahenwatta from High Level Road near Walawwatta to Diyagama Road Near Katuwana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to award the contract for the construction of the new access road from Kottawa to Mahenwatta from High-Level road near Walawwatta to Diyagama road near Katuwana to M/s Hoveal Construction (Pvt) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.713 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of 4km road section from Pitipana Junction to Data	Centre at Dampe road on Pitipana - Thalagala Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - Five key road development projects have been identified as priority projects for upgrading the transportation links between the key town centers of Malabe,Kaduwela, Athurugiriya and Homagama with other regions to be developed under the Western Region Tech City Development Project. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development, to award the contract for the improvement of 4km road section from Pitipana Junction to Data Centre at Dampe road on Pitipana - Thalagala road to M/s Finite Lanka (Pvt) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the remaining construction activities of the proposed five storey building for the District Secretariat Matale
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously for the construction of a five storey building for the District Secretariat, Matale and its construction activities are nearing completion. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government to award the contract for the additional work to be carried out for the utilization of the building such as supply of electricity, installation of communication system and fire safety systems and internal partitioning to the original contractor, M/s Micro Constructions (Pvt) Ltd, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the Panadura Base Hospital and Procurement of Medical Equipment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the construction of a six storied building for the Base Hospital of Panadura, construction of staff quarters and construction of a waste water treatment plant and the supply of medical and other equipment required for the hospital, to M/s GITEC-IGIP GmbH of Germany at a sum of Euro 106.49 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of Law as a subject under the Sub-Unit of Citizenship Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - The necessity to provide the knowledge of Law to school children required to cater to the needs of daily life has been identified in order to create a law abiding future generation equipped with a higher standard of discipline. Accordingly, attention has been drawn to incorporate the basic laws that citizens should be familiar with such as traffic laws, child protection laws, laws relating to fundamental rights, environmental and public property laws, basic penal laws, human trafficking laws, minor sexual abuse laws, flora and fauna conservation laws, in the school curriculum from Grade 6 up to GCE (O/L) in the subject of Citizenship Education. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.(Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to appoint a committee comprising of the experts in the fields of education, judiciary and law to study the proposal and report on same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of Polduwa by pass Road from Suhurupaya to Kanatta Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - Concurrent to the relocation activities of all the administrative and Office buildings located within the city of Colombo being done in the administrative Capital of Sri Jayawardenapura Kotte, the development activities of the area also have to be carried out. In order to facilitate such activities, a proposal has been made to construct a road connecting Dematagoda to the Outer Circular Highway and presently, a part of the activities of the above project has commenced from Polduwa junction to Koswatta. Under Stage I of the said project, development activities from Polduwa junction to Suhurupaya have already been completed and the development activities from Suhurupaya to Kanatta road under its Stage II are under way. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis & Western Development to secure the provisions of Rs.328.63 million required to complete the said development activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the requests made by different parties, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media to amend the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017, to exempt the Withholding Tax imposed on the Interest Income of the children's savings, Earnings from the Government Securities, Interest on loans of non residents, Royalty, Leasing of Air crafts and to reduce the tax percentage on Withholding Tax on rent, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting of the Gazette Notification issued under the Excise Ordinance in Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of the Excise Ordinance, the Excise Notifications issued under the said Ordinance have to be presented in Parliament, for approval. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media to present the Excise Notification published in the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No.2091/50 dated 2018‑10‑03 issued in accordance with section 22(3) of the Excise Ordinance, with a view to granting an exemption from the payment of Excise duty on non‑potable spirit imported for manufacturing activities by the Board of Investment (BOI) approved manufacturing industries which produce 100% of their production solely for export purposes, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting the 18th Conference of the Parties of the Convention on International Trade on Endangered Species of Fauna and Flora (CITES)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-07
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is vested with the responsibility of hosting the 18th Conference of the Parties of the Convention on International Trade on Endangered Species of Fauna and Flora (CITES) and the said Conference is scheduled to be held from 23rd May to 03rd June, 2019. It has been estimated that around 4,000 including the delegates from 183 countries, will participate in this event. This Conference is planned to be held at the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall (BMICH) premises. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs, to make a payment of Rs.230.37 million for securing the BMICH, the other buildings and other related services for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of the Budget for the Year 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-02
decision_details_body:
- The Appropriation Bill for the year 2019 was presented in Parliament on the 09th of October 2018 and as Parliament was prorogued the approval of Parliament could not be obtained for the said Bill. In terms of the statutory provisions, a Vote on Account was presented in Parliament on the 21st of December, 2018 for covering the Government expenditure for the first four months of the year 2019 until the re-submission of a new Appropriation Bill and obtaining the approval for same and it was passed on the same day. As such, a fresh Appropriation Bill incorporating the expenditure for the first four months of the year 2019 covered by the Vote on Account has to be presented in Parliament for approval.

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.	Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to prepare the National Budget 2019 with a view to strengthening the ongoing fiscal consolidation programmes and to achieve the following Medium Term Fiscal Targets expected to be achieved by the year 2021, was approved by the Cabinet.

(i)	The Government revenue to be increased to exceed 17 percent of the Gross Domestic Production (GDP)	
(ii)	The Government recurrent expenditure to be limited to 15 percent of the GDP 
(iii)	The Government Public Investment to be maintained at 5.5 percent of the GDP 
(iv)	The Budget Deficit to be limited to 3.5 percent of the GDP 
(v)	The outstanding Government debt to be maintained below 70 percent of the GDP

description: The Project for the Development of A 17 Road Corridor from Deniyaya to Rakwana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-02
decision_details_body: - The Galle-Deniyaya-Madampe Road traverses through the major towns of Morawaka, Deniyaya, Suriyakanda and Rakwana and it is linked with three 'A' Class Roads and ten 'B' Class Roads. Out of this, it has been proposed to develop a road extent of 53 km from Deniyaya to Rakwana.  This has been phased out to be constructed in 2 stages with an investment of US$ 51.75 million and it is expected to develop a road section of 18 km from Suriyakanda to Rakwana as its first stage and a road section of 35 km from Deniyaya to Suriyakanda as its second stage. The OPEC Fund for International Development (OFID) has expressed its willingness to provide the required funds of US$ 40 million for the implementation of this project and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to conduct loan negotiations in this regard and enter into a loan agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Urban Regeneration Project in Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-02
decision_details_body:
- With a view to transforming the Colombo city into a city with a clean and pleasing environment, it has been planned to carry out the Colombo Urban Regeneration Project at an investment of United States Dollars 287 million for the resettlement of people living in slums, in new housing schemes and for more optimal utilization of urban lands. Through this programme, around 50,000 low-income and lower-middle-income residents living in underserved settlements will be benefited with houses of proper standards.

	Accordingly, this project is to be implemented under 03 major components of housing construction, land re-development and technical support and project management and it has been planned to obtain funds for this purpose from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB), the Government of Sri Lanka and the private sector. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to conduct loan negotiations and to enter into a loan agreement for obtaining the funds to be secured as agreed by the AIIB, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the Establishment of a Light Rail Transit System in Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-02
decision_details_body:
The Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) has agreed to provide financial and technical assistance to establish a Light Rail Transit (LRT) System in Colombo in order to minimize the heavy traffic congestion existing in Colombo and its suburbs. This LRT System has been designed to establish the connectivity between the major Administrative Hubs with commercial corridors and the densely populated residential areas situated adjacent to Colombo. This LRT System will also be developed so as to provide easy access to the Expressway Network and Multi-Model Transport Hubs.

       	Under the LRT System project, it has been planned to construct a LRT System 17 km in length with 16 Stations from the Multi-Model Transport Hub in Colombo Fort to Malabe Depot with an investment of JPY 246,641 million from Japan. The Japan International Cooperation Agency has extended its willingness to grant  JPY 200,415 million out of the total expenditure anticipated for the project and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media to conduct loan Negotiations and to enter into a loan agreement for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuous implementation of the 'Gamperaliya' Rapid Rural Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-02
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has set apart a provision worth of Rs.20 billion in respect of the year 2018 for the implementation of projects for the rehabilitation of village tanks, modernization of the rural roads, providing sanitary facilities in schools, construction of school playgrounds, 'Sathi Pola' and 'Haritha Uyana', providing electricity, renovation of religious places, housing development and issuing deeds for lands under the 'Gamperaliya' programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, for an allocation of Rs.48 billion in respect of the year 2019 to continue the development activities further by providing Rs.300 million for each electorate, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Hubs for the improvement of the Secondary Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-01-02
decision_details_body: With the objective of strengthening the Computer Assisted Teaching for Secondary Education, it has been planned to implement a project under the Ministry of Education for enhancing teaching and learning information and communication technology, for enhancing the information technology education level of the teachers and for providing equal opportunity of education to every student including those living in rural areas. Under this programme, a fully equipped e-learning National Contents - - Development Centre (NCDC) in the North Western Province and another 02 Provincial Information Communication Technology Education Centres (PICTEC) centering the Southern and Eastern Provinces are due to be established. The Economic Development Cooperation Fund (EDCF) of the Export and Import (KEXIM) Bank of South Korea has agreed to provide funds for the purpose and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance & Mass Media, to enter into an Agreement to secure the required funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of professionals with competency and experience as Chairmen and Members of the Boards of Directors of Statutory Boards
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-27
decision_details_body: - The Government has emphasized the need for the appointment of professionals with competency and experience as Chairmen and Members of the Boards of Directors when appointments are made as Chairmen and Members of the Boards of Directors in the Public Corporations, Statutory Boards inclusive of  State Owned Enterprises, to enable to achieve the set objectives and targets of the said Enterprises. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to appoint a Committee under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the President to make the necessary recommendations to enable the Ministers in‑charge of the relevant subjects to appoint graduates of a recognized University of Sri Lanka or a foreign University or persons with recognized professional qualifications and long term professional experience in the relevant field, based on the criteria approved previously by the Cabinet, except in the case of Ex-Officio Members, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vote on Account - 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-27
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously, to present a Vote on Account to secure the provision necessary for the first 04 months of the year, 2019.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Rajapaksa, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs, to present a resolution in Parliament (Vote on Account) to incur a total  expenditure of Rs.1,735 billion made up of Rs.760 billion to maintain the Public Services of the Government, Rs.970 billion for providing services already authorized by various laws and Rs.5 billion for the Advanced Account Activities until an Appropriation Bill for the year 2019 is submitted, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Parallel Roads for access to the houses situated on either side of the Matara - Beliatte Railway Track
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-27
decision_details_body: - The construction activities of the Matara - Beliatte railway project is nearing completion and it is expected to commence train operations from the year 2019 covering the entire coastal railway track from Colombo to Beliatte. The need for the construction of parallel roads has been identified considering the necessity of providing access to the houses of the people living in the area  being situated on either side of the Matara - Beliatte railway track. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to get the construction activities of 54 roads with a total length of 12.95 km done under the supervision of the Road Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Incurring the Government expenditure for the first four months of the 	year 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-21
decision_details_body: - Since there is inadequate time to present the Budget for the year 2019 due to the recent shuffles in the composition of the Ministries, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Rajapaksa, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs, to secure the budgetary provisions required to maintain the Government services uninterruptedly for the first four months of the year 2019 through a Vote on Account in compliance with the precedence followed in similar situations, until the Budget for the year 2019 is passed and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft the resolution in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The ongoing Government Procurements to be carried out without any delay
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Rajapaksa, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs, to provide the necessary instructions to the Line Ministries to carry out the ongoing Government Procurement without any delay in accordance with the recent changes in the Ministerial portfolios, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuous implementation of the project on Education for Social Cohesion
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-21
decision_details_body: - The project of Education for Social Cohesion has been implemented successfully from the year 2005 under the technical grant assistance of the Government of Germany. This project is being implemented with the objective of enabling the children, the youth, their families and communities to live together harmoniously and peacefully in a multi-lingual society. The Government of the Federal Republic of Germany has provided a grant assistance of Euro 15.8 million for this project and has agreed to provide another Euro grant of 250,000 for the further implementation of the project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Rajapaksa, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs, to sign Exchange of Notes to obtain the said grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the new building with seven storeys for the Faculty of Arts of the University of Peradeniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Education & Higher Education, to award the contract for the construction of a building with seven storeys for the Faculty of Arts of the University of Peradeniya to M/s Sathuta Builders (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.397.3 million in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the civil work contract of the Project for enhancing the Deep Berth Capacity of the Jaya Container Terminal (JCT) of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-21
decision_details_body: - In order to coincide with the development activities carried out to gain competitive opportunities for handling larger container vessels arriving at the Port of Colombo, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to award the contract for the civil work component of the project for the enhancement of the deep berth capacity of the Jaya Container Terminal (JCT) of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority, implemented by utilizing the funds of the said Authority to M/s China Harbour Engineering Company Ltd., as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Container Handling Equipment for the Jaya Container Terminal of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to award the contract for purchasing 03 cranes required for container handling from ships to the shore for (JCT) - V under the modernization of  the Jaya Container Terminal (JCT) - V of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority by utilizing the funds of the said Authority to M/s. Shanghai Zhenhua Heavy Industries Co. Ltd. for a sum of US$ 25.7 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Agreements / Memoranda of Understanding (MoU) between the Local Authorities of Sri Lanka and the Provincial Entities of Foreign Countries under the Friendship City Concept
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-21
decision_details_body: - Various Local Authorities have implemented several programmes in collaboration with the different provincial entities of foreign countries under the Friendship City Concept. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils, Local Government and Sports, to appoint an Officials' Committee representing all the relevant Ministries and Institutions to evaluate the proposals made in respect of such Programmes or Agreements and take necessary future course of action accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improving the efficiency of the Dairy Farms
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-21
