decision_details_body: - Dairy cattle of around 5,000 belonging to the European Breeds and their crosses have been imported from Australia and New Zealend and distributed among the dairy farms scattered all over the Island in order to enhance the dairy production in Sri Lanka.  Although, the average production potential of these cattle is 20 to 25 Liters per day due to various reasons such as poor management standards and the environmental effects, a very low milk production of about 10 to 15 Liters per day is reported. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Rural Economic Affairs, to implement the projects planned for the improvement of the productivity of the farms and the enhancement of their efficiency and to appoint an Experts' Committee comprising of the representatives of the Department of Animal Production and Health and the National Livestock Development Board and to study the strategies needed in this respect and make recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Facilities to increase Domestic Maize Production
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-21
decision_details_body: - Maize has been imported over the past few years as the domestic maize production was not sufficient to meet the market requirements due to adverse weather and several other issues. With the increase of domestic maize production, the importation of maize can be minimized thereby reducing the foreign exchange spent, as well as increasing the income of the local maize producers. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Agriculture, to provide loan facilities required to increase the domestic maize production under the loan schemes presently being implemented at concessionary interest rates, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act, No.2 of 1990
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-21
decision_details_body: - The Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act, No.2 of 1990 has been introduced with the objective of introducing an expeditious procedure for the recovery of debts. However, since the said Act covers only the lending institutions that were in existence, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Rajapaksa, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs, to amend section 30 of the said Act to make legal provision required to include the Licensed Specialized Banks established subsequently for the purposes of this Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 02 Wave Rider Inshore Patrol Crafts for the Coast Guard of the Republic of Seychelles
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-21
decision_details_body: - During a state visit by H.E. the President in the Republic of Seychelles, H.E.  had acceded to a request made to construct two Wave Rider Inshore Patrol Crafts for the coast guard of the Republic of Seychelles. Accordingly, with a view to strengthening the diplomatic relations between the two countries, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to carry out the construction activities of the Wave Rider Inshore Patrol Crafts by the Sri Lanka Navy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Empowering local potato farmers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-21
decision_details_body: - The Government, with the increase of supply of potato in the market due to the bountiful harvest of potato in Welimada and suburban areas, has taken measures to purchase the potato harvest from the farmers with a view to ensuring a reasonable price for the products. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to secure provisions to settle the payments of the farmers for the potato stock purchased by the Consumer Co-operative Societies Federation Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting post procurement reviews and detailed investigations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-21
decision_details_body: - The Government has focused its attention to ensure that the state funds spent  on public procurement made for various requirements of the government, are value for money and to ascertain that such procurement is made in terms of the Government Procurement Guidelines.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to implement the proposals for post procurement reviews and detailed investigations on all public procurement made by the government institutions avoiding duplication with the programmes of other Ministries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting the Forthcoming Provincial Councils Election
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-13
decision_details_body: Provisions have to be made expeditiously to hold the Provincial Councils Election since the official tenure of 06 provincial councils out of 09 have been expired by now. The delimitation of electorates required to hold elections under the Mixed Member Proportionate System presently being implemented to elect members for provincial councils which was introduced by the Provincial Councils Elections Act, No.2 of 1988 as amended by the Provincial Councils Elections (Amendment) Act, No.17 of 2017 has not yet been completed. As such, considering the exigency of holding the Provincial Council Election, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils, Local Government and Sports, to draft legislation to hold the Provincial Council Elections under the previous proportional representative system, and to ensure 25% women candidates at the said election, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of a seed paddy subsidy for paddy cultivation damaged by Plant Hoppers and Stem Borers during the Yala Season - 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-13
decision_details_body: A vast damage has been caused to the paddy cultivation due to the rapid spread of brown plant hopper and yellow stem borer during the Yala season of 2018 in the Polonnaruwa and Ampara districts. Accordingly, it has been estimated that damages have been caused to 34,759 acres of paddy land owned by 18,280 farmers in the Polonnaruwa district and 7,402 acres of paddy land owned by 3,676 farmers in the Ampara district. Therefore, it has been found difficult for the farmers to obtain seed paddy for the Maha season of 2018/19. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, and Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to grant a compensation of Rs.1,500 to Rs.3,000 per acre relative to the damages caused for the farmers who were affected due to the pest damages to purchase seed paddy for the Maha season of 2018/19, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme for Economic Revival
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-13
decision_details_body: Action is being taken by the Government to revive the economy by strengthening the local entrepreneurs and industries through relaxation of excessive taxes, empowering the agricultural sector and providing reliefs to the consumers through reduction of prices of the essential commodities. Under this, it has been proposed to provide various reliefs such as reduction of prices of fuel and the essential commodities, provision of debt reliefs to farmers,  small scale mill owners and the women living in drought affected areas, providing chemical fertilizer at concessionary price, lowering the high tax burden, providing tax concessions to local agriculture, constructions, small scale businessmen, those who are engaged in foreign employment, professionals and small and medium scale entrepreneurs, and uplifting the livelihood of the Samurdhi beneficiaries. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Rajapaksa, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs, to make amendments to the relevant Acts for obtaining the legal sanction required for the implementation of the proposals made by the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs on 2018‑11‑01, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of water to the areas of Inamaluwa, Kitulhitiyawa, Sigiriya, Habarana, Galewela and Thiththawelgolla under the Local Government Enhancement Sector Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-13
decision_details_body: It has been planned to implement water supply schemes to cater to the water supply needs of the people living in the areas of Inamaluwa, Kitulhitiyawa, Sigiriya, Habarana, Galewela and Thiththawelgolla under the Grater Dambulla Water Scheme of the Local Government Enhancement Sector Project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils, Local Government and Sports to award the contracts for the water supply extension to Inamaluwa and  Kitulhitiyawa areas, for a sum of Rs.491.9 million and the water supply extension to Sigiriya and Habarana areas, for a sum of Rs.415.3 million  to M/s PND, E&C Joint Venture, and the water supply extension to Galawela and Thiththawelgolla areas to M/s Squire Mech Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.660.6 million, in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of School Uniform Material for the year 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-13
decision_details_body: The Government, through out a period of 25 years from the year 1993 up to now, has been engaged in supplying school uniform material to the school children of about 45 million in order to ensure the equality of educational opportunities to the children receiving free education. It has been found that it is financially profitable to supply uniform material obtained from the local cloth manufactures, as was done earlier, relative to the 'gift voucher method' adopted in recent times. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Education & Higher Education, to provide the school children with uniform material for the year 2019, considering the saving of about Rs.50/- per meter of cloth and also the saving of the foreign exchange by obtaining cloth material from the local manufactures, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Nomination of  Cabinet Spokesmen
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-05
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers decided to nominate Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe,  Minister of Ports and Shipping and Hon. Keheliya Rambukwella, State Minister of Mass Media and Digital Infrastructure to function as the Cabinet Spokesmen.

description: Awarding of the contract for the construction of a building for the Faculty of Applied Sciences of the Sabaragamuwa University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Education & Higher Education, to award the contract for the construction of laboratories and lecture halls specified to be constructed as Stage II ‑ Phase I of the new building complex proposed for the Faculty of Applied Sciences of the Sabaragamuwa University, to M/s Sathuta Builders (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.452.4 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project on 'Biomass Energy 2022' for Fueling the Economy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-05
decision_details_body: - The importance of promoting the use of domestic energy resources has been identified with a view to minimizing the foreign exchange spent for the importation of fuels such as petroleum and coal for the energy needs of Sri Lanka, As such, a project named 'Biomass Energy 2022' has been planned  to develop 1000 entrepreneurs for growing of biomass energy and processing of agricultural waste as biomass energy through the establishment of 50 biomass energy collection and processing centres across the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to implement this programme with the financial support of the public, private, as well as the foreign sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Sri Lanka National Freedom from Hunger Campaign Board Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-05
decision_details_body: - The necessity has arisen to amend the Sri Lanka National Freedom from Hunger Campaign Board Act in keeping with the present economical and global trends. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to draft legislation to change the title of the Sri Lanka National Freedom from Hunger Campaign Board to read as the 'Sri Lanka Food Promotion and Agri Marketing Board' to revise the general objectives of the said Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of an Accelerated Agriculture Development Programme, “North East Agricultural Revival (Krushi Navodaya)”
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-05
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the challenges such as low productivity, scarcity of seeds, land use issues, climate changes, inefficient post harvest management, problems associated with marketing and value addition, difficulties in water supply, problems relating to agricultural roads and rehabilitation of tanks, scarcity of infrastructure facilities and the dearth of officers to be engaged in the field have to be overcome to further improve the agricultural harvest of the Northern and Eastern Provinces. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Agriculture, to implement an accelerated Agricultural Development Programme, “North East Agricultural Revival (Krushi Navodaya)” in order to further increase the contribution made by the Northern and Eastern provinces to the national economy and to uplift the living standard of the people in those areas, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the Abandoned Rural Tanks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-05
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the database of the minor irrigation system and primary water sources of the Department of Agrarian Development, 14,421 tanks are in a state of operation at present and it has been identified that 1958 rural tanks have been abandoned  on the grounds of internal conflicts and the spread of infectious diseases. It is anticipated that around a  new cultivable extent of 97,900 acres can be cultivated by renovating these tanks. Further, taking also into consideration the benefits they provide for the nourishment of the ground water resources and to improve the forest cover and the wild life in the waste lands, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to renovate the tanks which are technically confirmed as suitable for renovation,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improving the facilities of the Sri Lanka Schools of Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-05
decision_details_body: - In order to attract the the younger generation to the field of agriculture, 05 Sri Lanka Schools of Agriculture established in Kundasale, Pelwehera, Angunakolapelessa, Karapincha and Vavuniya produce Agricultural Diploma Holders of NVQ Level 6 providing them with the education pertaining to the new technology. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to increase the number of students recruited to the Schools of Agriculture and to provide them with a quality education and thereby enhancing the agricultural production of the country quantitatively and qualitatively with the cooperation of the Ministry of Skills Development and Vocational Training, as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of the Crop Forecast Information System (CFIS) to minimize the gluts and scarcities of food crops
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-05
decision_details_body: - Crop Forecast Reports which include the data on the island-wide information on the prevailing crop situation,anticipated production in respect of the different seasons, crop damages and harvesting schedules are issued by the Department of Agriculture and such data can be considered the most reliable data base presently being used for making timely decisions including decisions regarding the importation of food crops. The said data base is presently being used through the software named 'Crop Forecast Information System (CFIS)'. Accordingly, with the objective of further utilizing the said information system efficiently and productively, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to upgrade the said Information System utilizing the resources available in the Agrarian Service Centres and the Deputy Director of Agriculture Offices established throughout the country, and the Mahaweli Zonal Offices, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tariffs Revision for the Services provided by the Sri Lanka Ports Authority and  the Jaya Bahalu Container Terminal (Pvt.) Ltd
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to revise the tariff charges for the services provided by the Sri Lanka Ports Authority and  the Jaya Bahalu Container Terminal (Pvt.) Ltd in keeping with the present market trends and enabling to provide a more qualitative service and to introduce a uniform method of  tariff rates among the harbours, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Headquarters building of the Sri Lanka Coast Guard Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-05
decision_details_body: - It has been decided to establish the Headquarters of the Sri Lanka Coast Guard Department with all facilities in close proximity with the Colombo city in order to maintain a proper coordination with the Government Institutions, to conduct meetings, seminars and bi‑lateral discussions and to supervise the coast guard operations and administrative functions enabling more efficient and effective performance of the duties of the Department which is entrusted with the safety of the Sri Lankan maritime zone and the protection of lives and property within the zone. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to construct an eleven storey building for the Headquarters of the said Department within the premises of the Wellawatta area where another office of the same Department has already been established, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Climate Change Mitigation Action Support Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-11-05
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to implement the Climate Change Mitigation Action Support Project for the mitigation of the greenhouse gas emission, under the World Bank assistance. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to establish a Project Management Unit comprising of the officials of the Ministry of Mahaweli Development and Environment and the persons with expertise knowledge in the relevant fields, for the proper management of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Gazette Notifications published under the Value Added Tax Act in Parliament for Approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of  the Value Added Tax Act, No. 14 of 2002, any Order published in a Gazette Notification should be presented in Parliament for approval. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to submit the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2088/2 dated 10th September, 2018 declaring the date of implementation of the Tourist VAT Refund Scheme (TVRS) to refund the VAT paid on goods purchased by the tourists, Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2088/25 dated 11th September, 2018 specifying the goods on which the VAT is refundable under the aforesaid scheme, the minimum value of such goods and the scheme of refund, Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2089/13 dated 17th September, 2018 reducing the rate of VAT applicable on the import of fabric up to 5% considering the impact on small scale manufactures due to the importation of fabric being made liable for VAT and the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2089/20 dated 18th September, 2018 reducing the VAT rate applicable on import or import and supply of sugar from 15% to 0%, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reinsurance Cover for the National Natural Disaster Insurance Scheme (NNDIS)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - An Insurance Scheme was introduced in the year 2016 to protect the entire Island from the natural disasters. The said insurance scheme has been activated by the National Insurance Trust Fund under which the insurance cover amounts to about Rs.15 billion by now. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Youth Affairs, Project Management and Southern Development, to obtain a reinsurance cover from the reputed International Reinsurance Companies in order to minimize possible risk to the financial status of the National Insurance Trust Fund, due to the damages caused by the natural disasters, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the Contract for Piling work for the construction of the Faculty of Nursing at Sri Jayawardenapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet had granted approval previously to construct the Faculty of Nursing at Sri Jayawardenapura consisting of 22 floors.  It has been identified that 248 piles have to be cast to carry out the construction work of this building and a decision was taken to procure the piles as 03 packages.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to award the contract for 02 packages, out of the above, to M/s Nawaloka Piling (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.124.8 million and a sum of Rs.137.5 million and the other package to M/s D.P. Jayasinghe Piling Co. (Pvt.) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.126 million, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the infrastructure facilities at the Kelaniya, Sri Jayawardenepura and Sabaragamuwa Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - With a view of improving the facilities in the National University System, it has been planned to construct a four storey hostel building at the University of Kelaniya, 03 storeys in the seven storey Multi Purpose building at the University of Sri Jayawardenepura and the Faculty building complex for the Faculty of Agriculture of the Sabaragamuwa University. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, to carry out those construction works, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the storage capacity of the Paddy Marketing Board (PMB)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - With a view to purchasing and storing the paddy harvest in the Yala Season 2018, it has been planned to construct 02 new paddy stores with the capacity of 2,000 MT at Beliatta and Meegahajadura and to repair 39 existing paddy stores. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to obtain the engineering consultancy services required for conducting those activities with scientific and modern technology, selection of contractors and supervision of work through the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of a Dredger for excavation of sand in the deep sea
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - Due to the scarcity of river sand utilized for constructions, there is a higher demand for the offshore sand as an alternative. As a solution to this, the Land Reclamation and Development Corporation prepares and supplies offshore sand enabling to be used for construction activities. This satisfies about 10% of the total sand requirement in the construction industry. In order to address the higher demand arising for sand in future along with the growth of the construction industry, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to purchase a Dredger for excavation of sand in the deep sea, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvements of a distance of 4 km in the Pitipana - Thalagala Road from the Pitipana Junction up to the Data Centre at the Dampe Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - Five main transport development projects have been identified on a priority basis, in order to improve the transport connectivity with Malambe, Kaduwela, Athurugiriya and Homagama Towns and other areas expected to be developed under the Western Region Tech City Development Project.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the contract for the improvement of the distance of 4 km, in the Pitipana - Thalagala Road from the Pitipana Junction up to the Data Centre at the Dampe Road to M/s Finite Lanka (Pvt.) Ltd., in accordance with the recommendation of the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the NAVIS Terminal Management System at the Jaya Container Terminal (JCT) and the Unity Container Terminal (UCT) at the Sri Lanka Ports Authority.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to award the contract for the improvement of the NAVIS Terminal Management System at the Jaya Container Terminal (JCT) and the Unity Container Terminal (UCT) at the Sri Lanka Ports Authority to ACCESS NAVIS Joint Venture in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Panadura Base Hospital and provision of medical equipment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the procurement for the development of the Panadura Base Hospital and provision of medical equipment which provides medical services to the people living in the areas of Beruwala, Kalutara, Bandragama, Ratnapura, Moratuwa and Ratmalana for a sum of Euro million 106.4 to M/s GITEC IGIP Consultant GmbH of Germany, in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the contracts for the construction under the Gampaha, Attanagalla, Minuwangoda Integrated Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The contract for the Gampaha, Attanagalla, Minuwangoda Integrated Water Supply Project has been been awarded to M/s China Machinery Engineering Corporation (CMEC). Under this project, the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, has planned to carry out 08 major constructions as sub contracts. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for the laying of fittings and DI/PVC Pipes for the Transmission and Distribution Mains in Attanagalla out of those sub contracts, to the Joint Venture of M/s Sierra Construction Limited and K D A Weerasinghe Co. (Pvt.) Limited, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of parallel roads for the houses on one side of the Matara-Beliatta Railway.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The construction activities of the Matara-Beliatta Railway Project are nearing completion and it is expected to implement the railway operations from Colombo to Beliatta from the year 2019 covering the entire coastal line. Since the houses of the people living in the area are on one side of the Matara-Beliatta railway line, it has been found necessary to construct roads parallel to the said railway line in order to provide access to those houses. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to have the construction activities of 54 roads of 12.95 km in total length carried out under the supervision of the Road Development Authority (RDA), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Oil and Lubricants for the Sri Lanka Transport Board Buses.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the procurement of Oil and Lubricants for the buses of the Sri Lanka Transport Board to M/s Lanka IOC PLC, M/s Chevron Lubricant Lanka PLC and M/s McLarens Lubricant Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Road Development Projects in the Northern and Eastern Provinces.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to award 05 Contract packages for the rehabilitation and improvement of the roads in the Northern and Eastern Provinces identified to be developed expeditiously by the District Development Committees of the said Provinces, to the recognized road construction companies as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee/ Project Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Tamil Medium National School in Kelaniya Education Zone.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mano Ganesan, the Minister of National Integration, Reconciliation and Official Languages, to establish a Tamil medium Hindu School named Arun Manickavasagam Hindu College, in Kelaniya Educational Zone to uplift the educational standards of the children studying in the Tamil medium in the Gampaha and the Wattala area, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion of the facilities at the Vocational Training Centre,  Anamaduwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to expand the facilities of the Vocational Training Centre at Anamaduwa with a view to conducting courses targeting the present job market. This will enable to conduct the courses such as Cookery, Bakery and Related Products, Computer Graphic Designing and Human Resource Management belonging to National Vocational Qualifications (NVQ) Level 4 (equivalent to G.C.E. A/L) which have a great demand in the job market. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Youth Affairs, Project Management and Southern Development, to secure Rs. 100 million for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presentation of the Extraordinary Gazette Notification that includes the list of prohibited substances in Parliament.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - A list that includes prohibited substances and methods which are banned to be used by athletes is published by the World Anti-Doping Agency annually. At the same time, in terms of section 34 of the Convention against Doping in Sports Act, No.33 of 2013, the list of such substances declaring the prohibition of such substances in sports has been published in the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No.2083/32. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils, Local Government and Sports, to present the said Gazette Notification, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of a Chiller for the Central Air Conditioning System of the Superior Courts Complex Building.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to secure funds amounting to Rs 50 million to purchase a Chiller for the Central Air Conditioning System of the Superior Courts Complex, in order to supply the air conditioning facilities necessary to carry out the functions of the Supreme Court and the Court of Appeal, uninterruptedly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the outputs of the Fishery Infrastructure Facilities and Aquaculture Development of the Northern Province Sustainable Fisheries Development Project.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement the Northern Province Sustainable Fisheries Development Project comprising of the 03 outputs of construction and development of fisheries harbour, anchorages and ferry,  aquaculture development and livelihood development with the financial assistance of US $ 174 million to be granted by the Asian Development Bank during the period from 2018 - 2024. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Rural Economic Affairs, to establish a Project Implementation Unit(PIU) for the implementation of the project outputs of fisheries infrastructure facilities and  aquaculture, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Science & Technology Human Resources Development Project.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: -With the introduction of the 'Technology Stream' for the G.C.E. Advanced Level, the University Grants Commission has recognized 10 State Universities to award degrees for the new technology subjects.  As such, it has been planned to establish 03 Technological Faculties in the University of Kelaniya, Rajarata University and the Sabaragamuwa University and an Engineering Faculty in the University of Sri Jayawardhanapura.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, to secure Rs.26,400 million necessary for the Universities to  develop  their physical and human resources for the commencement of the said degree  programmes within the time frame from 2018-2023, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The restoration of the Kudawilachchiya and the Dematagala Tanks.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The water collected in the Mahawilachchiya Reservoir situated adjacent to the Wilpattu National Park is the only available source of water for drinking as well as agricultural purposes of the people of the area.  As the water collected in the said reservoir is not adequate for the needs of the people, the restoration of the Kudawilachchiya tank which is a large abandoned tank situated in the Wilpattu National Park has been proposed. Also as the rural tanks situated close to the Palagala area experience shortages of water frequently, it has been identified that a project could be implemented by the restoration of the abandoned Dematagala Tank with a feeder canal to supply additional water to the rural tanks by constructing an anicut across the Heven Ella Oya, as a remedial measure. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources & Disaster Management, for the restoration of the Kudawilachchiya tank and the Dematagala tank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Carrying out Geotechnical Investigations necessary for the Engineering Designs of the Kelani Flood Embankment.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to construct a flood embankment along the Kelani river from Hanwella up to the river mouth to mitigate the damage caused around the Kelani River Basin by floods. The said activities are planned to be carried out under 03 sub-projects.  A Geotechnical Investigation has to be carried out prior to the construction of the proposed flood embankments and as such, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources & Disaster Management, to get the necessary activities done by the National Building Research Institute, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Exhibition, forum and award ceremony on Innovation in Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - As a step towards modernization of the Agricultural sector in Sri Lanka, arrangements have been made to conduct an exhibition on Innovation in Agriculture, the Forum for Modernization of Agriculture and an Awards Ceremony for Stakeholders engaged in the Agriculture sector from 11th - 16th December, 2018 at the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall (BMICH) in Colombo. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to conduct the said programme in association with all sectors engaged in the agricultural activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Modernization of the Seed and Planting Material Supply System of the Department of Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - Due to the limitations prevailing in the essential facilities to be deployed for the production activities carried out in the seed farms of the Department of Agriculture, it has been difficult to produce seeds at the required quantities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to secure the funds required for the mechanization of seed processing, establishment of a combined drying and processing complex at Maha Illuppallama, Ampara and Aluttarama, purchasing the necessary equipment for the Palwehera and Bataatha farms, construction of 04 seed stores in Rahangala, Seethaeliya, Bataatha and Ampara farms and the development of seeds and other supply facilities, through the Medium Term Budgetary Framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National Level Analytical Laboratory.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The need for the establishment of a high level analytical laboratory to regulate the inputs of the chemical and organic fertilizer and the pesticides and to regulate the excessive usage and the residue levels contained in the locally produced food has been identified. With the establishment of such high level laboratory facilities it would be possible to provide low cost as well as more reliable analytical services to all stakeholders. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Agriculture, to establish a national level analytical laboratory with an investment of Rs.286 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the quality of seeds and planting material.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Seed Act, No.22 of 2003, the Department of Agriculture is vested with the legal authority and responsibility of controlling the quality of all planting material such as food crops, plantation crops, export agricultural crops, ornamental flowers and foliage, forest plants and medicinal herbal crops. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to provide the infrastructure facilities further needed for the seed testing laboratories that operate under the seed certification service of the Department of Agriculture to carry out the procedure presently being adopted in a more proper and an efficient manner, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Food safety enhancement.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The Centre for Excellence on Organic Agriculture (CEOA) at Makandura conducts research and technology transfer on Organic Agriculture and organic fertilizer while the Regional Agriculture Research and Development Centre (RARDC) conducts research in various other disciplines such as crop improvement soil and plant nutrition. It has been identified that there is a possibility for establishing a new centre for the development of Sustainable Agriculture by combining these two institutions. The combination of these two institutes will result in the creation of a premier institute which could hold the responsibility for providing training on eco-friendly agriculture and project activities Island wide productively, motivating promotion and research in organic agriculture and organic fertilizer and also as the premier institute for local organic certification and the National Reference Unit for soil micro biology. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to combine the said two institutes and establish the Centre for Sustainable Agriculture and to provide the necessary facilities for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of Polduwa by-pass Road from Suhurupaya to Kanatta Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - Action is being taken to relocate the government administrative offices in the Administrative City of Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte and the development activities of the area have to be carried out parallelly. Under this, it was proposed to construct a road from Dematagoda to Outer Circular Highway (OCH) and the construction activities from Polduwa Junction to Koswatta has been commenced by now. The Stage I  of this project from Polduwa Junction to Suhurupaya has been completed and the Stage II from Suhurupaya to Kanatta Road is under construction. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to secure the provisions of Rs.328.63 million required for the completion of the said construction activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the sanitation facilities in the Kataragama Sacred City.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has previously granted approval to implement the Development Project at Kataragama Sacred city. In addition to this project, considering the inadequate sanitation facilities and solid waste disposal mechanism for the general public visiting the sacred city, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to construct the required sanitation blocks in the Kataragama and Kebiliththa areas, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Building Complex for the Anuradhapura District Secretariat.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the space limitations prevailing in the building where the Anuradhapura District Secretariat is being maintained and with a view to providing more qualitative public service, the proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, to construct a building complex of 150,000 sq.ft. with 07 floors with an investment of Rs.1,731.3 million, in place of the building being used to maintain the Anuradhapura District Secretariat and around 30 other offices of different Government Institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Removal of sand dunes accumulated at the Harbour Mouth of the Oluvil Port.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - Difficulty in entering the fishing boats into the harbor due to the accumulation of sand dunes in the harbour mouth of the Oluvil Port has caused disruptions for the livelihood of the fishermen in the said area. As such, the information bought to the notice of the Cabinet of Ministers by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, that measures are being taken to remove sand dunes accumulated in the harbour mouth of the port using dredgers enabling to use the Port without interrupting the fishing activities, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading of the existing Analogue X-Ray System to Digital X-Ray System in the Government Hospitals.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - Digital X-Ray images have been identified as the best effective technological  method for a successful early diagnosis of a disease.  As such, a proposal has been made to use digital X-Ray systems instead of  the analogue X-Ray systems already used in the Government Hospitals. Under the said project, it has been planned to retrofit 50  analogue X-Ray machines already existing in the hospitals with Digital Radiology panels and obtain 25 Digital Mobile X-Ray systems. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to procure a quality technological Advanced digital radiography system, utilizing the funds to be received through the concessionary financing of 'FINEXPO' from the Kingdom of Belguim, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project of Introducing Home Dialysis System using the Automated Peritoneal Dialysis, for Kidney Disease patients.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been submitted to the Cabinet previously on the implementation of a project of introducing a Home Dialysis System using the Automated Peritoneal Dialysis, for Kidney Disease patients and accordingly it was decided to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee to examine the said proposal and submit its recommendations to the Cabinet. As such, considering the recommendations made by the said Sub-Committee, Hon. Mohomed Casim Mohomed Faizal, the Acting Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, submitted  the proposals to be implemented for the  notice of the Cabinet.

description: Payment of Compensation for the lands acquired for the construction of Demodara Reskuru Reservoir.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to pay compensation of Rs 61.37 million to the land owners of the acquired lands from Ella and Hali Ela divisional secretaries for the construction of Demodara Reskuru Reservoir of the Badulla Hali Ela, Ella Integrated Water Supply Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the University of Vocational Technology (UNIVOTEC) of Sri Lanka and the Seychelles Institute of Technology (SIT) of Seychelles.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Science, Technology, Research, Skills Development & Vocational Training and Kandyan Heritage on the Memorandum of Understanding entered into between the University of Vocational Technology of Sri Lanka and the Seychelles Institute of Technology of Seychelles in the fields such as academic research training, departmental exchange, capacity building and joint student activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement between Sri Lanka and the Republic of Belarus on Science, Technology and Innovation Cooperation.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Science, Technology, Research, Skills Development & Vocational Training and Kandyan Heritage to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on strengthening and expansion of the Scientific and Technological Cooperation between the Republic of Belarus and the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into an Agreement between Sri Lanka and Saudi Arabia for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to  enter into an Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Saudi Arabia for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting the Public Financial Management Act.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has recommended previously to appoint a Committee  comprising of expertise in the relevant field to examine and submit recommendations on the Public Financial Management Bill scheduled to be introduced to form a legal framework on transparency, accountability, productivity, efficiency and frugality of the activities related to public financial management. The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to draft the  Public Financial Management Bill with the inclusion of the recommendations made by the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Palaly Airport to operate Domestic Commercial Flights.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - For the promotion of the tourism industry,the necessity of developing of the Palaly Airport to operate domestic commercial flights has been identified. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policie and Economic Affairs, Hon. John Amaratunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs and Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation,to use the Palaly Airport for scheduled domestic commercial passenger operations and to carry out the developments activities of the said Airport expeditiously by the Sri Lanka Air Force with an investment of Rs.1,965 million for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an International Buddhist Organization for the promotion of the Buddhist Philosophy.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to establish an International Buddhist Organization to promote Buddhist philosophy locally and internationally. Accordingly, it is expected to make Sri Lanka as the center for promoting and disseminating the Buddhist philosophy and  to take necessary measures to protect and conserve Buddhist monuments and places all over the world. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to draft necessary legislation to establish the proposed International Buddhist Organization, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining financial assistance to strengthen the local authorities and to develop the provincial infrastructure facilities.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has granted its approval previously to implement the project for strengthening the local authorities and developing the provincial infrastructure facilities covering 134 local authorities of Northern, Eastern, North Central and Uva Provinces.  The International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank has agreed to provide a financial assistance of (USD) 70 million for this project. Accordingly, the proposal 	made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct loan negotiations to secure funds and enter into relevant loan agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the financial assistance to implement the Climate Smart Irrigated 	Agriculture Project.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - 	The Cabinet of Ministers has granted approval previously to implement  the Climate Smart Irrigated Agriculture Project. The International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank has agreed to provide financial assistance amounting to USD125 million to implement this project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct loan negotiation for the said purpose and enter into relevant agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for strengthening the Regional Development Bank - (RDB)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has agreed to provide financial assistance amounting to  (USD) 50 million for the Project on strengthening the Regiona Development Bank and in addition to providing USD 01 million through the Japan Fund for Poverty Reduction (JFPR) to strengthen the operational capacity of the bank. As such the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Harsha De Silva, the Acting Minister, National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct the loan negotiation for the said purpose and enter into relevant agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Augmentation of the National Kidney Fund for treatment, prevention and welfare of kidney patients.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-23
decision_details_body: - 	“The National Kidney Fund” was established to provide more appropriate treatments, prevention and welfare services for the patients from low income families suffering from Chronic Kidney Disease of uncertain etiology. Utilizing  the said fund, activities such as awareness programmes, programmes to Pre identify kidney patients, development of infrastructure in health sector required for treatments of patients and providing pure drinking water are carried out. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to appoint a Supervisory Board chaired by the Secretary to the President to carry out its functions effectively and to form a scheme to grant its benefits, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improving infrastructure facilities in new settlements
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to secure funds required to improve access road facilities for the ease of the beneficiaries living in new settlements including model villages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing of Houses for the Resettled Families of the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct 65,000 houses under the project for providing houses for the displaced persons in the Northern and Eastern Provinces.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Resettlement, Rehabilitation, Northern Development & Hindu Religious Affairs, to award the contract to the consortium of ND Enterprises (India), Yapka Developers (Pvt.) Ltd. (Sri Lanka) and Archedium (Pvt.) Ltd. (Sri Lanka) for the construction of 28,000 housing units, as Phase I, subject to a cost of Rs.1,280,000/- per housing unit, in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee (CANC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka Tourism Promotion
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously to implement a wide advertising programme to promote Sri Lanka as an attractive tourist destination.  In this context, 06 commercial advertising firms have submitted their Expressions of Interest for the implementation of this programme.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amaratunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to award the contract for the implementation of this programme to M/s J. Walter Thompson, for a sum of Rs.314 million in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Appropriation Act, No.30 of 2017 in line with the new Cabinet reshuffle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - In view of the Cabinet reshuffles which took place on several occasions in the year 2018, the number of Ministries has now been reduced up to 43. The necessity has arisen to amend the Appropriation Act passed in Parliament, last December for the year 2018 by distributing the provisions therein among the new Ministries to comply with the scope of such Ministries. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to amend the Appropriation Act without making any changes in the total expenditure and the maximum borrowing limits imposed by the said Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Teldeniya, Pugoda and Welimada Court Complexes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to carry out the construction activities by the Government owned construction institutions, with a view to providing facilities required to carry out the functions of the courts efficiently and productively, taking into consideration the need for the construction of new buildings for the Court Complexes in Teldeniya, Pugoda and Welimada, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Pesalai Fishery Harbour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct the Pesalai Fishery Harbour under the Northern Province Sustainable Fisheries Development Project implementing with a view 	to developing further fisheries infrastructure in Northern Province, aquaculture development and livelihood development. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Rural Economic Affairs, to appoint a Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and a Technical Evaluation Committee in order to select a construction firm for the said project and to 	implement this project with an investment of Rs.5,267 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a steel sheet pile hood protection wall on the left bank of 	the Kelani River which has eroded
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that nearly 200 families have been affected due to banks	of Kelani river have severely eroded in the Kolonnawa, Halmulla areas. As a	remedial measure, it has been proposed to construct a steel sheet pile hood	protection wall along the river bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by	Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources & 	Disaster Management, to carry out the said constructions with an investment of 	Rs.604 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of contract for the construction of 100 MW Wind Farm
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of	Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for the construction of	100MW Wind Farm in the Southern coastal strip of the Mannar Island with the	financial assistance of the Asian Development Bank, to M/s Vestas Asia Pacific 	A/S - Denmark and enter into the agreements as recommended by the Cabinet	Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of Two Pilot Launches for the Sri Lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to award the procurement for the purchase of two pilot launches necessary to provide an efficient navigation service in the Port of Colombo for the Sri Lanka Ports Authority for a sum of US$ 3.12 million to M/s Colombo Dockyard PLC, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading the Healthcare Service Facilities of the National Hospital associated with the Throat, Ear and Nose (ENT)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - M/s VAMED Engineering Deutschland GmbH of Germany has presented a comprehensive project proposal for the development of facilities found for the prevention, identification and the treatment of impairments associated with the Throat, Ear and Nose (ENT) and for the improvement of the capacity of the National Hospital, Teaching Hospitals, Provincial General Hospitals, District General Hospitals and the Base Hospitals. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to conduct the necessary negotiations in regard to the evaluation and the implementation of the said proposal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Infilling of the Distribution System in the adjacent areas of Ampara and Batticaloa Districts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to refer the project proposal presented by M/s Sunpower Constructions (Pvt.) Ltd. for the implementation of the Infilling Distribution System in the adjacent areas of Ampara and Batticaloa Districts with a view to providing water supply facilities expeditiously to the areas where there is a scarcity of water, to the Standing Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee (SCANC) for evaluation and to make recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Katupota - Bamunakotuwa - Panduwasnuwara Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to refer the proposal made by M/s Kolon Global Corporation pertaining to the implementation of the Katupota - Bamunakotuwa - Panduwasnuwara Water Supply Project, with a view to supplying  drinking water to about 133,000 people living in the Kurunegala District, to the Standing Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee and the Project Committee, for evaluation and recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Shrama Vasana Fund Act, No.12 of 1998
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravindra Samaraweera, the Minister of Labour & Trade Union Relations, to publish the draft bill drafted to amend the Shrama Vasana Fund Act, No.12 of 1998 so as to make provisions for further promotion of the Shrama Vasana Lottery which contributes to the Shrama Vasana Fund that provides diverse relief to the employees of Sri Lanka, in the Government Gazette and present the same thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Setting up a Business Centre in Jaffna for empowering new entrepreneurs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to bring about a sustainable development in the Northern area by creating entrepreneurs equipped with information technology and generating new employment opportunities and income sources. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to set up a centre in Jaffna with the financial assistance of the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of India to empower the new entrepreneurs to provide required services, enabling the professional services, enterprises and entrepreneurs to easily and cost effectively set up their offices, so as to have quick access to the export market, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the National Information Technology initiative for export development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The Budget of 2018 had proposed to provide the necessary facilities for the Export Managers of the Information Technologies/Exporters in the Business Process Management, by the implementation of an export growth initiative as a promotional strategy for the development of exports within a period of 03 years from the year 2018 to 2020. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to implement the Information Technology Initiative Programme so designed, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy for the Senior Citizens of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - Out of the total population of Sri Lanka 12.4% or 2.6 million people are in the age category of senior citizens over 60 years and by the year 2020, it is anticipated that the population will increase to about 16.3%. The government has adopted various measures for the welfare and the protection of the elderly population. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Social Welfare and Primary Industries, to implement the National Policy prepared for the livelihood  development and the protection of the rights of the elderly people in collaboration with the relevant institutions to develop the situation further, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Information and Cyber Security Strategy of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The Government has planned to implement the Cyber Security Strategy over a period of 05 years from 2019 - 2023. This strategy aims at creating a resilient Cyber Security Eco System that will enable the Citizens of Sri Lanka and other parties to improve their livelihoods by deriving the benefits of digital technologies.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication, Digital Infrastructure and Foreign Employment, to implement the Cyber Security Strategy designed with the participation of the experts in the field, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The development project in the Kataragama Sacred Area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - It is identified that vehicle parking facilities, sanitary facilities, drainage facilities, solid waste disposal facilities and lodging facilities in the Kataragama town should be further improved, for the convenience of the local and as well as foreign pilgrims who visit the sacred area of Kataragama to pay their homage. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Youth Affairs, Project Management and Southern Development, to implement the development project in the Kataragama sacred area providing with facilities such as common amenities, police posts, vehicle parks, protective walls, rest rooms and improved road networks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Release of land in the Northern and Eastern Provinces for resettlement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - Action is being taken to release the private lands to the owners of such lands taken into custody of the Tri‑Forces during the period of conflict in the Northern and Eastern Provinces. In terms of the above, it has been planned to release a block of land 23 acres in extent in Mullikulam, Mannar, a block of land 53 acres in extent in Mullivaikal, Mullaitivu held in the custody of the Sri Lanka Navy and a block of land 03 acres in extent in Thoppur, Trincomalee where the 224 Brigade Headquarters of the Sri Lanka Army has been established, to their original owners. Also, in order to enable the people to be resettled in those areas to maintain sustainable livelihood activities, 03 small tanks so identified are to be renovated while developing the infrastructure facilities in such areas and handing them over to the original owners. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Resettlement, Rehabilitation, Northern Development & Hindu Religious Affairs, to re‑establish such facilities enabling to release the lands being occupied by the Tri‑Forces and to secure the funds required for the development of infrastructure facilities in the areas, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Stabilization of the land prone to landslide risk where the Kegalle Court Complex is located
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The land where the Kegalle Court Complex is located comprising of buildings of more than 80 years seems at risk of landslide. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to secure funds for the stabilization of the land preventing such risk, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the Courts Complexes and the Official Residences
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The Colombo Commercial High Court building and the building of the Judicial Services Commission are maintained in old building complexes of historical value and the immediate renovation has been identified in view of their antiquity. The judicial official residences in Colombo as well as the buildings belonging to the District/Magistrate's Courts in Chilaw have also been identified as buildings which require immediate renovation. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to have such construction activities carried out by the government construction institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978 for the appointment of Justices of the Peace for Administrative Districts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to publish the draft Bill prepared by amending the section 45 of the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978 by incorporating provisions to enable the Justices of the Peace to be appointed for the Administrative Districts instead of the Judicial Zones, Districts and Divisions which was adopted in making such appointments, in the Government Gazette and to present the same thereafter in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Social Integration of the Export Village Programme through the Model Village Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - It has been found that the persons living in the Model Villages can reach the economic and environmental development through the Export Village Programme implemented by the Government. The livelihood development facilities can be provided to the beneficiaries by providing planting material, knowledge and other technical assistance to those living in such Model Villages, required for the collective cultivation of selected export crops or the assistance required in the commencement of a manufacturing industry. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to implement the Export Village Programme in the Model Villages, in association with the Ministry of Social Welfare and Primary Industries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extending the beneficiary base of the 'Sonduru Piyasa' Concessionary Loan Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and	Construction, in order to extend the beneficiary base by increasing the	existing floor area of the house to be eligible under 'Sonduru Piyasa'	Concessionary Loan Scheme from 1000sq.ft. to 1500sq.ft., was approved by 	the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of 'I, H and N' buildings of the Anderson Flats
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - A total of 144 housing units of 'I,H and N' buildings consisting of 48 housing	units in each building are used as official quarters of the Inspectors of Police	and the junior grade officers. These houses are nearly 50 years old and	accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the	Minister of Public Administration & Management and Law & Order, to secure	required funds for immediate renovation of these buildings, was approved by	the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of Feeder Tanks under Giant's tank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - Giant's Tank in the Mannar District which has 162 feeder tanks expands over an area of 3,800 hectares. For almost 03 decades, maintenance and rehabilitation works in feeder tanks of the Giant's tank have not been properly carried out due to the conflict situation which prevailed in the past.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources & Disaster Management, to secure required funds for the rehabilitation of 40 feeder tanks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulating a methodology for the frugal consumption of electricity
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - Electricity access in Sri Lanka has been developed up to 100% and  required measures have been taken by the Government to provide electricity during the 24 hours uninterruptedly. However,  the cost incurred for generating electricity can be minimized with the frugal consumption of electricity and thereby reducing the fuel consumption incurred annually. As such, the Joint Proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy and Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to appoint an Officials' Committee with the Chairmanship of the Secretary, Ministry of Power and Renewable Energy to propose a practical mechanism for the frugal consumption of electricity, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Cooperation between Sri Lanka and China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka and China entered into a mutual cooperation for the betterment of the plantation industry of both countries. The proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding to develop tea, rubber and coconut in the plantation sector as the first step of the said cooperation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the proposed Multipurpose Building adjoining the Beach Park at 'Crow Island', Mattakkuliya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - With a view to providing space to persons living in the Crow Island area of Mattakkuliya for their public activities, it has been proposed to construct a Multipurpose building adjacent to the Beach Park constructed therein, with the assistance of the World Bank. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Lasantha Alagiyawanna, the Acting Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to construct the Multipurpose building with a floor area of 14,500 sq.ft. in a land of 65 perches in extent, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Palliative Care Centre in Anuradhapura to provide care for the Patients with Kidney Disease and Cancer
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The 'Shanthi Foundation' in Australia has agreed to construct a Palliative Care Centre in the Anuradhapura town as a donation for the terminally ill patients with Chronic Kidney Disease and Cancer. Under the proposed Centre, it has been planned to construct a Palliative Care Unit for the indoor patients, Out Door Patient Clinics, a Home based Palliative Care Unit and a Training and Research Unit. In this context, a Memorandum of Understanding has been signed between the 'Shanthi Foundation' in Australia and the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine for the establishment and the maintenance of the proposed Palliative Care Centre. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.
