(Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, for the establishment and maintenance of the said Palliative Care Centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a new Bill to substitute the Sri Lanka Code for the Protection, Promotion and Support of Breastfeeding and marketing the designated products
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - It has been ensured that breastfeeding contributes strongly for the achievement of optimum physical health, nutrition and the cognitive development in children and to reduce malnutrition as well as the prevention of non‑communicable diseases in later life. Sri Lanka is also one of the first countries of the world that adopted the International Code on Breast Milk substitutes according to the World Health Convention in 1981 and has gained the first place in  breast feeding status according to the Report of the World  Breastfeeding Trend Initiative. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Bill with a strong legal frame, to address the issues caused by the milk food industry for the infants and children, the promotion of commercial complementary foods and also for the prevention of the spread of unhealthy food habits, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Loan scheme for the installation of the Rooftop Solar Power Generation Systems under the Solar Power Generation Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The proposed loan scheme will be operated for supporting the 'Sooryabala Sangrama Programme' implemented with the objective of supplying 200MW by the year 2020 and 1000 MW by the year 2025 to the national grid through the installation of the Solar Power generation systems on every household and commercial / factory buildings. As such, it has been proposed to provide financial assistance under this programme for the installation of Solar Power generation in households and commercial / factory buildings. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to secure the necessary funds for the implementation of this project and to enter into sub loan agreements with the participatory financial institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Approval for the submission of the Gazette Notifications under the Excise 	(Special Provisions) Act, No.13 of 1989
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No.13 of 1989, any Notification issued by the Gazette Notifications issued under the said Act, should be presented in Parliament within 04 months from the date of publication of such Notification. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to present the Gazette Notification No.2079/58 to revise the Excise duty imposed on the amount of sugar added in some sweetened beverages, the Gazette Notification No.2080/31 for removing the condition to release motor vehicles from the Sri Lanka Customs on or before 30th April 2018, the Gazette Notification No.2082/11 for the revision of Excise duty on Cigarettes and the Gazette Notification Nos.2082/10 and 2083/2 for the revision of Excise Tax on motor vehicles with an engine capacity below 1000 CC, which have been issued by now, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Gazette Notifications published under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007, for the approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to present the Eight (08) Gazette Notifications issued during the period from 31st May 2018 to 07th September 2018, to amend the Special Commodity Levy ratio  in order to keep stable the market price of essential food items, provide goods to the consumer without a shortage, protecting the local farmers, facilitating the consumers to pay a consolidated levy instead of various types of taxes and to extend the period for Special Commodity Levy at the same rates, for approval in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining approval for the Gazette Notifications published under the Revenue Protection Act, No.19 of 1962
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to present the Gazette Notification No.2079/32 published to revise the customs duty imposed on the importation of Beedi Leaves, to create new National Sub Division Customs Codes to identify the foods with artificial sugar and the Gazette Notification No.2080/42 published to grant duty free concessions under the Free Trade Agreement in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Report on Public Sector Cadre for the Second Quarter of the year 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The Report on public sector cadre for the second quarter of the year 2018 submitted by  Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, was presented for the attention of the Cabinet. In terms of the information contained in the said Report, the Cabinet noted that 1,370,885 persons are employed in the public sector comprising of Ministries, Departments, Provincial Councils, Public Corporations, Statutory Boards and Government owned Companies by the second quarter of the year 2018,  that officers in the cadre of certain Public Corporations and Boards are engaged in projects for  more than 05 years without formal approval and that the attention of the Government should be focused when taking decisions on creating additional posts in the education and the health sectors in the public sector in a situation where the contribution of the private sector in the education and the health sectors has rapidly increased.

description: Improvement of call connectivity of mobile phone calls and efficiencies in data transfers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - Mobile Operators are faced with the challenge of supplying a more qualitative service to their customers due to lack of antenna coverage for the mobile phones in Colombo and other areas. Accordingly, as a solution for the issue, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to formulate a mechanism to install roof top antennas in strategic locations of Colombo and the suburbs with the approval of the Telecommunication Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Census of Population and Housing - 2021
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The Department of Census and Statistics has planned to conduct the next census of population held once in 10 years, in the year 2021. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct the listing stage of the census of population and housing in the year 2020 and the enumeration and data dissemination stages in the year 2021, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Rural Bridges
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The Government has identified the need to construct 4,000 rural bridges in order to improve the economic development of the rural areas and to minimize the disparities existing in the Divisional development between Provinces.  In this context, 1,000 bridges have been constructed by now under the Rural Bridges Construction Project with foreign financial assistance. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into Agreements to secure the additional funds necessary for the construction of a further 250 rural bridges under the original project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promotion for the establishment of  network of Temperature Controlled Warehouses/ Cold Storages
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his	capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to launch a	project for the promotion of private investments for the establishment of a	network of Temperature Controlled Warehouses/Cold Storages in crop	producing and fishing areas as a remedial measure to the severe issues faced by 	those who cultivate fruit and vegetable as well as fishermen and other	small and medium scale producers in post production operations in view of	minimizing the fluctuation of prices of such production, was approved by the	Cabinet.

description: Minimizing the damages caused to the Environmental systems due to the                   fragmentation of lands
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - Several issues have emerged in fragmentation of lands for housing constructions; other purposes and commencing housing projects due to the non adherence of guidelines and the procedure for approval to be followed to minimize the adverse impacts caused to the environment, even though such procedures are in existence. Therefore, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, on the measures to be taken for the optimum utilization of state and private lands by minimizing the said issues, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Parliament (Powers and Privileges) Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to amend the Parliament (Powers and Privileges) Act, to declare and define the privileges, immunities and powers of Parliament and its Members, to secure the freedom of speech and debate or proceedings in Parliament, to provide for the punishment for the breaches of Parliamentary privileges and to provide protection to persons employed in the publication of Papers, Minutes, Votes or Proceedings of Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening the functioning of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-16
decision_details_body: - The Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption plays a vital role in maintaining and improving the fiscal discipline in the Public sector. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to implement the Training Programme formulated to provide specialized   training to the Officers of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption with a view to strengthening the state economy by further improving the fiscal discipline, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of rural bridges for the benefit of the beneficiaries in model 	villages in the Hambanthota District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to implement 06 projects, pertaining to the  construction of the bridge across Kirama Oya in Katuwana, Batagassa, Youth Service Bridge across Kirama Ara in Handugala, Kammale Ferry Bridge across Urubokka Oya in Katuwana, bridge across Thundoala connecting Kohamporuwa and Siyambalamuraya, bridge across Kirama Oya in Beliatta along the Angulmaduwa - Aranwela road and fly over across Tangalle - Kadurupokuna road under the 'Nagamu Purawara' Programme to facilitate the beneficiaries of the model villages which are to be commenced in the villages with inadequate infrastructure facilities in the Hambantota District, for them to gain easy access to the 	common urban amenities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Parliamentary Programme for the Budget Debate - 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, informed the Cabinet that it has been proposed to present the Budget (Budget speech/the second reading of the Budget) in Parliament on 05th November, 2018 and the Second Reading Debate from 07th to 14th November and the Committee Stage debate (the third reading of the Budget) from 15th November to 08th December, in accordance with the Parliamentary Programme pertaining to the Financial Year 2019.

description: Providing relief to the people affected by severe dry weather conditions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The Government has decided to provide relief measures further required to the people  affected by the severe dry weather conditions, due to  not being able to engage in cultivation activities. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to provide relief measures for total 451,224 families, comprising of the farmer families who cultivate paddy and other crops and could not cultivate the last three seasons consecutively due to dry weather conditions, families who could not engage in inland fishing industry and lost their livelihood due to dry weather conditions and the labour families engaged in agriculture, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Rural Bridges
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - With a view to upgrading the transport connectivities in rural areas, the necessity of constructing about 4,000 bridges in those areas has been identified. For this, the Government has evaluated 02 proposals submitted by the Governments of Belgium and Netherlands. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils, Local Government and Sports, to award the contract for the construction of 60 rural bridges to Janson Bridging Belgium NV, Belgium for a sum of Euro 17.12 million without tax and the contract for the construction of another 200 rural bridges to Janson Bridging International BV, Netherlands for a sum of Euro 50.68 million without tax, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation and improvement to the road section from 53.74km to 58.00km on the Kandy - Jaffna Road (A9) including Naula Town
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development, to award the contract for the rehabilitation and improvement of the road section from 53.74 km to 58.00 km on the Kandy - Jaffna (A9) Road  including the Naula Town under the Project for the Rehabilitation and Improvement of 144 km of the National Highways Network of Sri Lanka, to M/s Consulting Engineers & Contractors (Pvt.) Ltd. for a sum of Rupees 590.62 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Aerial Bundled Conductors (ABC) for the transmission of electricity
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the procurement for the purchase of 750km of Aerial Bundled Conductors required for the 02 distribution zones of the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) to M/s Sierra Cable PLC, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract  for replacing 04  old turbochargers with new  04 turbochargers at the Sapugaskanda Power Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the procurement for the installation of new  04 turbochargers in place of the 04 old turbochargers at the Sapugaskanda Power Station to M/s MAN Diesel & Turbo SE of Germany as per the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of necessary materials to improve the distribution network for the supply of electricity of the Ceylon Electricity Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contracts for the purchase of 25,000 Distribution Substation Meters and Modems and 75,000 Transformers to improve the distribution network of the Ceylon Electricity Board to M/s Shenzeng Kaifa Technology Co.Ltd and M/s Shenzhen Chuangyin Co. Ltd. respectively, as per the recommendation of Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of Request for Proposals (RFPs) for the implementation of the Western Region Light Rail Transit (WRLRT) Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct three (03) Light Rail Transit lines, namely, the 'Red Line' 33km in length through Ragama - Kadawatha - Colombo Fort upto Kirulapone, the 'Green Line' 28.3km in length through Kelaniya - Borella - Nugegoda - Piliyandala upto Moratuwa, the 'Blue Line' 22.3km in length through Hunupitiya - Angoda - Koswatta upto Kottawa, with a view to establishing a more comfortable and safe transport service. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, for the Issuance of Requests for Proposals for the implementation of the said projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing facilities for immediate clearance of containers and cargo transported by ships
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to construct and operate a Customs Bonded Warehouse as a Public-Private joint venture with the Ceylon Shipping Corporation Ltd. (CSC) so as to clear expeditiously the containers and cargo transported by ships utilizing the modern technology. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to issue Request for Proposals to submit bids with a feasibility study from the parties who have responded to the Expression of Interest for same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Modernization of the Lunawa Hospital, Moratuwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - Lunawa Hospital, Moratuwa provides an immense service in providing health care services to the people in Moratuwa area. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the construction of  an Out Patient Department and a building for clinics under the renovation of the Hospital expeditiously to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) and Engineering Service (Pvt) Ltd. at a sum of Rs.1,035 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Aviation Fuel for SriLankan Airlines worldwide
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Public Enterprise & Kandy City Development, to award the procurement for the supply of aviation fuel for the air crafts belonging to the SriLankan Airlines at 24 airports to 11 suppliers, for a sum of US$ 190.2 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement to the passenger terminal capacity of the Bandaranaike International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement a project to improve the passenger terminal capacity of the Bandaranaike International Airport, enabling to provide facilities for 15 million passengers per annum. A proposal has been made to construct an interim terminal building for providing facilities to the passengers, until the completion of the said project. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the construction of the said interim terminal building to M/s China State Construction Engineering Corporation Ltd., as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Creation of Documentaries on Ethnic Groups of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - A book titled 'People of Sri Lanka' was launched incorporating the findings of a survey conducted recently by the Ministry of National Integration, Reconciliation and Official Languages, on the Ethnic Groups living in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mano Ganesan, the Minister of National Integration, Reconciliation and Official Languages, to secure the necessary funds for the preparation of a programme on documentaries incorporating the information revealed in the said Book pertaining to the Ethnic Groups in the three languages namely Sinhala, Tamil and English, with a view to creating  a nation where peace reigns, by promoting reconciliation and mutual understanding among the nationalities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Vocational Training Centre of the National Youth Services Council at Pitabeddara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to establish a Vocational Training Centre inclusive of the necessary infrastructure facilities with an investment of Rs.200 million at  Pitabeddara to enable to conduct study courses pertaining to Cookery, Bakery and Related Products, Automobile Technology and Beauty Culture at the qualification Level to NVQ - 4 [equivalent to  the G.C.E. (A/L)]. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Youth Affairs, Project Management and Southern Development, to secure the funds necessary for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Act for the Establishment of the Ruhunu Economic Development Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to establish the Ruhunu Economic Development Corporation for the implementation of the development activities of the Southern Region with special emphasis on the establishment of export oriented special economic zones in the Southern Region. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Youth Affairs, Project Management and Southern Development, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill necessary for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the 'Local Development Support Project' in Northern, Eastern, North Central and Uva Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The World Bank had agreed to provide the funds of US$ 50 million under the 'Local Development Support Project' for the development activities of the Local Authorities inclusive of strengthening its infrastructure facilities and institutional capabilities, covering all Local Authorities in the Northern, Eastern, North Central and Uva Provinces. However, with a view to securing the funds necessary for the further development activities of 134 Local Authorities in the said areas, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils, Local Government and Sports, to increase the contribution of the World Bank for the project up to US$ 70 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National Level University to provide the officers of   the Sri  Lanka Police with Higher Educational Facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - A concept paper has been drafted with the recommendations of an expertise committee in the relevant field on the establishment of a national level university to provide the officers of the Sri Lanka Police with higher educational facilities. As such, the Joint Proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister and Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Management and Law & Order, to draft a Bill to establish the proposed university, taking into consideration the said concept paper as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Liquefied Natural Gas Fired Power Plant in Hambantota
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been previously granted to establish a Liquefied Natural Gas Fired Power Plant of 400 MW as an integrated project between the Government of China and the Government of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to implement the said project by a Joint Venture established between the Hambantota Power Private Limited incorporated in Singapore and the Ceylon Electricity Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Guaranteed Price Formula of Paddy for Yala Season 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The Joint Proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Agriculture and Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to purchase paddy from each farmer upto a maximum of 5,000kg  at this Yala season, with the objective of granting relief to farmers and consumers by maintaining a reasonable market price for paddy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a block of land to the Kumara Vidyalaya - Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest a block of land, located at Ratnapura, New Town with Kumara Vidyalaya-Ratnapura identified to be necessary for further development activities of the school, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Visa Exemption between Ukraine and Sri Lanka for the holders of Diplomatic, Service and Official Passports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of  Internal Affairs & Wayamba Development, to enter into an agreement between Sri Lanka and Ukraine to exempt from obtaining visa for the citizens of the two countries holding diplomatic, service and official passports while traveling between those two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to be signed with the Chinese Academy of Sciences of the People's Republic of China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and China on  mutual cooperation on scientific and technological research activities in the areas of Life, Marine, Earth, Environment and other sciences. As such, taking into consideration the facilities to be provided for the promotion of scientific research and technological development between the two countries, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Science, Technology, Research, Skills Development & Vocational Training and Kandyan Heritage to enter into the proposed Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of the Financial Statements of the Government on Accrual Basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - Instead of the method of preparation of the Financial Statements on the modified cash basis, it has been planned to convert the same to the accrual basis gradually in stages. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to prepare the Financial Statements of Sri Lanka on accrual basis to comply with the internationally acclaimed accounting standards, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Matara Nilwala Eliya District Development Project: 2018 - 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to secure the provision for the proposed Nilwala Eliya project for the improvement of infrastructure facilities such as Education, Health, Highways, Irrigation and  Common Amenities found as essential to be effected in the areas specially outside the major towns of the Matara District, within the period from 2018-2020,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expression of the co-operation of the Government of Sri Lanka for the General and Selective Capital Increases of the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) and International Finance Corporation (IFC) of the World Bank Group (WBG)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The World Bank Group has identified the restructure to be made in the Group, in order to achieve its Development Objectives more successfully and in a sustainable manner. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to express the co-operation of the Government and make the required payments for increasing the General and Selective Capital increases and converting its retained revenue into shares of the institutions set up under the said Establishment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Concessionary Loan Scheme for the Product Design Engineering Companies under the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka Programme'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted by the Cabinet previously to explore the possibility of providing long term loan facilities with concessionary terms for the Product Design Engineering Companies (PDEC) to design the products locally and internationally, prototyping and commercializing through the loan schemes which are being implemented under the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka Programme' and to pursue action accordingly. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to implement a new loan scheme to provide concessions for the Companies which initiate Mechatronics enabled Economic Development , was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extending the concessionary loan facilities under the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to extend the benefits of the concessionary loan schemes under the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' Programme to enable those who are engaged in the technical field, the professionals who hold the certificate of National Vocational Qualification (NVQ) level 5,6 and 7, those who are engaged in small scale animal husbandry sector, those who manufacture packing material using bio degradable items and to those who seek investments to set up Day Care Centres, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting of a new Bill on the Suppression of unlawful acts relating to International Civil Aviation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Bill in lieu of   the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation Act, No.31 of 1996 in force, to enable the implementation of the International Conventions namely the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation previously signed in Montreal and the Protocol for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts of Violence at Airports serving International Civil Aviation by further updating and strengthening same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Payments in foreign currencies for the services rendered by the Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to amend certain restrictions prevailing in  Exchange Control, was approved by the Cabinet, considering the advantages to be achieved through granting permission to obtain the payments in foreign currencies for the services rendered by the Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) Limited for their customers, instead of the payments being made in Sri Lankan Rupees.

description: Streamlining the Public Investment Formulation Process
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-10-02
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the public investments should be made effectively on a priority basis towards the government's effort for creating an economically enriched modern society by the year 2025. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to identify, select and plan the projects by the Government institutions and issue a set of guidelines to the government institutions to be followed in obtaining the required approval for the said projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Compact between the Millennium Challenge Corporation, USA and the Government of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The Joint Proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs and Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to set up a Company named as 'Millennium Challenge Account (Guarantee Company) Sri Lanka' for the implementation of the projects in the fields of transport and lands which have been identified to be implemented under the Millennium Challenge Account and to provide the other facilities required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a 500MW Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Power Plant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to sign the Joint Venture and Shareholders Agreement for the construction of the 500MW Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Power Plant   to be constructed jointly by the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) and NTPC Limited, a Company owned by the Government of India, in Kerawalapitiya, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appropriation Bill for the Financial Year 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - It has been scheduled to present the Appropriation Bill for the Financial year 2019 in the second week of October, in Parliament. These estimates have been prepared within the Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2019 – 2021, based on the policy priorities of the formulation of National Budget 2019 and taking into consideration the existing resources. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to present the Appropriation Bill in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of the Tripitaka as a National Heritage
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The Joint Proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena; Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana; and  Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, to name the Tripitaka containing the preaching of Sri Gauthama Buddha as a National Heritage, for the Government to officially declare the same, and for the re-printing and other activities related to the Tripitaka to be carried out under the supervision of the Ministry of Buddhasasana, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a programme to eradicate Bribery and Corruption
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - A programme has been scheduled to launch a preventive system through open government partnership to eradicate bribery and corruption according to the concept paper titled “Corruption Prevention through Awareness Raising” and thereby changing attitudes of the people. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to implement the said programme during the years 2019 to 2021 and to secure funds required for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of uniform  material for the Sri lanka Police
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Management and Law & Order, to purchase 400,000 meters of uniform materials from Vanguard Industries Ltd and 100,000 meters from Creative Textile Mill (Pvt) Ltd at Rs. 346/- per each  for the uniform requirement of  officers of  the Sri Lanka Police, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitating and improving Medawachchiya-Horowupathana Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development, to rehabilitate and improve 27.8 km long road section from 10 km to 37.8 km on  Medawachchiya-Horowupathana Road by using the balance funds after the completion of project activities scheduled to be implemented under the Northern Road Connectivity Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitating and improving roads under the Southern Road Connectivity  Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to rehabilitate and improve 04 road sections i.e. a 1.90 km long road section from Homagama to Panagoda on Colombo - Ratnapura road, a 2.16 km long road section from Panagoda to Godagama junction on Colombo - Ratnapura road, a 0.58km long road section  from W.A De Silva Mawatha to Pamankada on Pamankada-Horana road and a 2.95 km long road section in Piliyandala town on Pamankada-Horana Road by using the balance funds  after the completion of projects scheduled to be implemented under the  Southern Road Connectivity  Project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development, to implement the above mentioned projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of flyovers in Kohuwala, Gatambe and Heerassagala.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road 	Development, to construct 03 flyovers in Kohuwala, Gatambe and	Heerassagala and to award the contract for the said purpose to the Betonutepito 	Plc recommended by the Government of Hungary with an investment of 	Euro 58.68 million and with the financial assistance of the Government of 	Hungary, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Pre-Cast Disaster Resilient Houses for the people residing in Disaster Prone Areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources & Disaster Management, to enter into agreements for the implementation of the project for the construction of 10,000 Pre-cast Disaster  Resilient houses for the resettlement of families residing in disaster prone areas in terms of the proposal submitted by M/s China Railway Beijing Engineering Group Co. Ltd. and Yapka Construction (Pvt.) Ltd. for the purpose and to construct 1,170 houses in Ratnapura and Kalutara and other districts with an investment of Rs.2,530.5 million at its first phase, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lease of land at Mudalige Mawatha, Union Place, Colombo 02 to M/s Access Realties (Pvt.) Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest a block of land in extent of 114.56 perches belonging to the Urban Development Autrhority (UDA), located at Mudalige Mawatha, Union Place, Colombo 02 to be utilized for a development project, to M/s Access Realties (Pvt.) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.1,117.20 million, for a period of 99 years on lease basis, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC) appointed for the relevant procurement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Infrastructure Development under the Jaffna Kilinochchi Water Supply and Sanitation Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for supplying and laying distribution networks and improving and developing other relevant infrastructure facilities in Nallur, Kattudai, Vaddukkodai, Pungudutivu, Karainagar,  Nawatkuli, Puttur, Poonakary, Meesalai, Kodikamam, Palai, Karaveddy,  Poonery, Pokkani and Velanai areas under the Jaffna Kilinochchi Water Supply and Sanitation Project, to M/s Sierra Construction (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National Vocational Training Institute at Hingurakgoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to establish a  National Vocational Training Institute at Hingurakgoda with a view to providing employable skills to the rural youth. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Science, Technology, Research, Skills Development & Vocational Training and Kandyan Heritage to award the said contract to M/s Gemco International BV, the Netherlands at a sum of Euro 35 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Electronic Immigration Gate System (e-Gate System) at Bandaranayake International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that the installation of the e-Gate System as an alternative to the services being provided by the Immigration and Emigration Officers at the Airport will regulate the arrival and departure immigration clearance process. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation and Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of  Internal Affairs & Wayamba Development to install the e-Gate System consisting of  10 units at the Bandaranaike Interantional Airport with an investment of Rs.260 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Productive Use of Stand - by Generators in Government Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - It has been found that the  Stand - by Generator of Government Institutions used in emergency situations can generate about 200 MW of power. Accordingly, it has been observed that, it would be a profitable alternative, if  the above Stand-by generators could be used to feed the National Grid, rather than generating power through diesel power plants. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to grant permission to the Ceylon Electricity Board to purchase electricity generated from the Stand-by generators of Government Institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementing the Recommendations submitted by the Office on Missing Persons
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The Office on Missing Persons has made its recommendations by the Interim Report submitted on 5th  August 2018  on the legal reforms to be effected with regard to the steps to be taken in relation to the legal obligations for reparation and to ensure the non-occurrence of such incidents. Further, recommendations have been made on implementing Financial Assistance Programmes, Debt Relief Programmes, Housing Development Programmes, Educational Support Programmes, Vocational Training and Livelihood Development Programmes for the affected parties.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee comprising of another 10 Ministers, under the Chairmanship of Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, to study the said recommendations and propose appropriate future course action and to secure facilities required to implement the  recommendations of the said Sub‑Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the regulations made on the factory conditions in terms of  the Factories Ordinance, in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The Factories Ordinance has been enforced  by the Department of Labour in order to inspect the factories enabling to maintain the occupational safety protect, the health and welfare of the employees. Taking into consideration the need for effective enforcement of the law on the factory conditions, the proposal made by Hon. Ravindra Samaraweera, the Minister of Labour & Trade Union Relations, to present 05 Regulations made in terms of the provisions of  the Factories Ordinance on the Registration of Factories and Approval of Factory Buildings, Registration of Steam Boilers, issuance of Certificates for examination of Steam Boilers  and other Pressure Vessels, protection of workers from excessive noise and General Standard of the lights of the Factories, for approval in Parliament and thereafter publish the same in the Government Gazette, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting National Vocational Qualification Level 3 (NVQ 3) Certificate for 10,000 Cinnamon Peelers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Social Welfare and Primary Industries, to prepare a programme for granting  National Vocational Qualification Level 3 (NVQ 3) certificate for 10,000 Cinnamon Peelers for carrying out the cinnamon peeling process with accurate technical usages and to secure other facilities required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expediting the demining activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - National Demining Programme was initiated in the year 2002 in the conflict affected areas and accordingly a land area of 137 square km has been cleared and handed over for resettlement activities by now. It has been designed to complete the demining activities by 2020, by implementing the said demining programme in an another land area of 28 square km in  Northern, Eastern and the North Central Provinces. As such, the proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Resettlement, Rehabilitation, Northern Development & Hindu Religious Affairs, to secure facilities required for the Demining Unit of the Sri Lanka Army engaged in the said activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of equipment for the Research Unit of the Sri Lanka Anti-Doping Agency
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils, Local Government and Sports, to supply laboratory equipment for the Research Unit of Sri Lanka Anti-Doping Agency, with the objective of preserving the clean and spiritual sport by minimizing the risk of the Sri Lankan Athletes who participate in National and International level tournaments being alleged on the usage of  prohibited substances, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development and Rehabilitation of Fishery Harbours, Anchorages and Landing Sites Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The  Development and Rehabilitation of Fishery Harbours, Anchorages and Landing Sites Project has developed Seven Fishery Harbours, a Boat Yard, two Landing Sites and three Anchorages by now. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Rural Economic Affairs, to secure funds and other facilities to develop the projects including upgrading and developing of Balapitiya, Suduwella, Dodanduwa, Hambantota and Mailady fishery harbours; Negambo Lagoon Development Project and the construction of Welipatanwila, Dehiwala, Rekawa and Mawella anchorages which have been identified to be further carried out under the said project, during the period from 2018 - 2020, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Developing systems for building assessment and condition reporting
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The National Building Research Organization has designed to introduce a 'system for building assessment and condition reporting' to ensure the protection of the occupants of the building and the neighborhood by assessing the structural integrity of the buildings, deterioration of the building elements due to time, repair and retrofitting of buildings and providing suitable technical recommendations. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources & Disaster Management, to secure funds required to promote the said system, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the Railway Bridge in Galle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - It has been found necessary to construct a new railway bridge after demolishing the narrow bridge constructed via Galle - Matara railway bridge crossing the Moda Ela due to the barrier it causes for efficient flood conveyance.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to secure funds required for the construction of a temporary railway bridge and a railway track  for transportation purposes until the proposed bridge is constructed, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Industrial and Technological Development Super Zone at Raigama in Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - With a view to generating new employment opportunities and upgrading the living standards of the rural community, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to establish the Industrial and Technological Development Super Zone with an investment of Rs.346 million in a block of land in extent of 24 acres in the Neuchatel Estate at Horahena in Millaniya, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recommencement of the manufacturing activities of the Paper Mill at Embilipitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - M/s Korean SPA Packaging (Pvt.) Ltd. has submitted a proposal to recommence the manufacturing activities of the Paper Mill at Embilipitya, which is presently defunct, after renovating its plant machinery and infrastructure facilities. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to allocate this Mill to the M/s Korean SPA Packaging (Pvt.) Ltd., on lease basis, for the manufacturing of industrial grade paper required for packaging items, with an investment of Rs.1,200 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Industrial Zone for Small Entrepreneurs by utilizing the land belonging to the Kankesanthurai Cement Factory
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to establish an eco‑friendly Industrial Zone in a land area of 330 acres out of the land where the Kankesanthurai Cement Factory was situated and not being used for production purposes as of now and to develop 100 acres under its first phase in the year 2019. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to select  suitable investors for the development of the relevant infrastructure facilities and to commence industries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on the Establishment of a Bilateral Consultation Mechanism between Sri Lanka and Laos
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding to strengthen the existing bilateral relations between Sri Lanka and Laos and for the mutual co‑operation on regional and international matters, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Madhu Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The Shrine of Our Lady of Madhu with a history of more than 400 years, is a sacred place of devotion not only of the Catholics but persons belonging to other religions as well. In order to provide a regular water purification facility, for the Water Supply system presently used to provide water to the pilgrims arriving to this sacred place, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to implement the Madhu Water Supply Project by using the Madhu reservoir to enable to generate 1,000 cubic meters of water per day, with an investment of Rs.554 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Finance Bill - 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The Finance Bill prepared to facilitate for the implementation of the various proposals submitted through the Budgets of the years of 2016, 2017, and 2018 by the Government, has been presented in Parliament. Taking into consideration the requests made by different parties on the implementation of the said proposals, it has been observed that it would be appropriate to include the  amendments during the Committee Stage of the Bill in Parliament since it  requires some amendments to implement the above proposals effectively. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to amend the Finance Bill by revising various taxes, dates on implementation of certain provisions and other administrative provisions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Air Services Consultation  between Sri Lanka and Luxembourg
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to enter into a bilateral agreement between Sri Lanka and Luxembourg on air services pertaining to transportation of passengers and cargo according to the agreement reached between the relevant parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening Elder Care Facilities in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - It has been projected that the elderly population in Sri Lanka will be doubled from the current level and reach the level of 24.8% of the total population by the year 2041.  However, it has been observed that the access of the elderly people to the formal mechanism of social protection is very limited. Accordingly, as a remedial measure, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs and Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Social Welfare and Primary Industries, to introduce a methodology to establish Day Care Homes for elders with family, permanent stay homes for elders without family and wards in state hospitals under the care of Geriatric Specialists for elders who are severely disabled or bedridden and to implement necessary programmes to train around 10,000 elder care givers to cater the growing demand in the field of elder care and to implement the necessary programme and provide necessary facilities for same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining International Scientific, Technical and Financial Assistance to mitigate Adverse Impacts of Climate Change
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The importance of building relations with international institutions to implement the activities in an integrated manner to mitigate the Adverse Impacts of Climate Change and meet national obligations on the international environmental agreements has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to enter into Host Country Agreements with Green Climate Fund (GCF) and the International Council for Research  in Agroforestry (ICRAF) and communicate the interest in obtaining the membership of Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) and ratify the establishment agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Food Production Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-18
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously to implement the National Food Production Programme with the objective of reducing the foreign exchange spent for the importation of food by producing all food items which can be produced locally of good quality. However, it has been difficult to achieve the expected targets of this programme due to the bad whether condition that prevailed in the country during the recent past. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to extend this programme up to the years 2019 and 2020 which includes renovating tanks  Island wide, promoting new technological methods among farmers, empowering persons engaged in agricultural, fisheries and livestock fields as entrepreneurs, promoting the renewable energy usage in the said fields, uplifting local milk production and encouraging relevant research work in the field of food production, and to provide necessary funds for that purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of rural bridges for the well being of the beneficiaries of the model villages in the Hambantota District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to commence the construction of the 04 projects under the 'Nagamu Purawara' programme namely the Yaya bridge along the Walasmulla - Pallekanda road, the bridge across the Urubokka Oya in Medagoda Kumbukmulla, the bridge connecting Thalunna and Andupelena and the bridge extension of Pahala Beragama to facilitate easy access to the urban facilities for the housing beneficiaries of the model villages implemented in the villages with inadequate infrastructure facilities in the Hambantota District, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Empowering Youth with leadership skills
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - With the objective of empowering youth to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) in Sri Lanka, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to implement a programme namely 'Project for empowering youth with leadership skills to spearhead accountability for achieving the Sustainable Development Goals in Sri Lanka' under 03 major stages through the 'Sustainable Development Division' of the Presidential Secretariat and to secure the required provision for the purpose through the 2019-2021 Medium Term Budgetary Framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Proposed Counter Terrorism Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to publish the draft Bill for the Counter Terrorism in the Government Gazette, which has been drafted with the objective of protecting the people of Sri Lanka from terrorism and the terrorism associated activities after discussions with all relevant stakeholders, and to present it in Parliament and further amendments if any, necessary for the Bill to be considered at the Committee Stage of the Bill in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Facilities to promote women's employment in the field of Technical and Vocational Education and Training
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - The Asian Development Bank has agreed to provide a grant of US$ 3 million for the provision of required facilities to promote self-employment among  female trainees in the field of Technical and Vocational Education and Training, guide women towards the male-dominated employment fields and widen the women's access towards emerging employment opportunities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Science, Technology, Research, Skills Development & Vocational Training and Kandyan Heritage, to enter into an Agreement with the Plan International Australia to implement the relevant  project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation and Improvement of the road section of 27.75km from Tampitiya to Chenkalady under the Badulla-Chenkalady Road Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - The Badulla-Chenkalady Road Improvement Project is implemented under 03 main stages with the financial assistance of the Saudi Fund for Development (SFD). The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development, to award the contract for the rehabilitation and improvement of the road section from 249.8 km to 277.55 km from Tampitiya to Chenkalady in the Badulla-Chenkalady Road as its 3rd stage, at a sum of Rs.2,837.43 million, without VAT, to Maga Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the buildings necessary for the establishment of the Faculty of Medicine of the Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to establish the Faculty of Medicine of the Sabaragamuwa University in a 20 acre land situated in close proximity to the General Hospital  of Ratnapura with an investment of Rs.5,015 million. Considering the urgent need of commencing the activities of this Faculty of Medicine, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, for the construction of the Clinical building for the Medical and the Para Medical Faculty and to secure the funds necessary for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of infrastructure facilities at the Rajarata, Colombo, Ruhuna and Eastern Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - As it has been planned for the gradual increase of the intake of students to the State Universities, the Government has planned to increase the infrastructure facilities at the Rajarata, Colombo, Ruhuna and Eastern Universities in order to provide more qualitative infrastructure facilities for the students of these Universities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, for the development activities such as the construction of a Laboratory complex including Lecture halls for the Faculty of Agriculture of the Rajarata University, the construction of canteens at Mihintale Student Hostel Premises, the construction of  Stage I of the New Arts building of the University of Colombo, the development of infrastructure facilities of the new Faculty of Healthcare Sciences at the Eastern University, the construction of Stage I of the Faculty of Allied Health Science building of the University of Ruhuna and the renovations at the main building premises of same, with an investment of Rs.3,690.42 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Mathugama, Galle, Beliatta, Matara and Pallekele Grid Substations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to establish 90 Solar Power Plants to connect to the central electricity system all over Sri Lanka under the Soorya Bala Sangramaya Programme. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for the construction of 05 Grid substations in Mathugama, Galle, Beliatta, Matara and Pallekele out of the Grid substations to be constructed to be connected to the solar power electricity system, in accordance with the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Hambantota and Nuwara Eliya District General Hospitals under the Financial Assistance of Netherlands
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - Although the projects on construction of the Hambantota and the Nuwara Eliya District General hospitals and the supply of the necessary equipment for those hospitals have commenced from the year 2012 under the financial assistance of  Netherlands, the inability to complete the projects up to date due to various reasons has resulted in escalating the expenditure to be incurred in respect of the required equipment for the hospitals considerably. However, considering the necessity of fulfilling the requirements of the residents of the area expeditiously, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to obtain the necessary approval and secure funds to provide modern equipment according to specification,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Intake Structure of the Bandarawela, Diyathalawa and Haputale Integrated Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - The Bandarawela, Diyathalawa and Haputale Integrated Water Supply Project has been planned to be implemented to address the present and the future water needs of the residents of the 63 Grama Niladhari Divisions affected by the implementation of the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project.  Accordingly, the Dayabara Reservoir which is being constructed under the Uma Oya Project has been identified as the water source of the said  project.  Presently, the construction work of the Dayabara Reservoir is nearing its completion and as the Intake Structure of the Reservoir has to be constructed before filling the Reservoir, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the said contract to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau / Central Engineering Services (Pvt.) Ltd., and also to secure the funds required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulation of the Boat building Industry and providing infrastructure facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - With a view to improving the Boat building industry in Sri Lanka, feasibility study is expected to be carried out to construct the Boat launching pad, slipway, repair facilities and the breakwater in Weligama, Kapparathota for facilitating the preparation of a regulatory framework for the purpose and for providing the necessary infrastructure facilities to the existing boat builders to continue with their industry. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to secure the required provision for the continuation of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Integrated e-Land Registry (e-LR) Project for improving Registering Property Mechanism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - The e-Land Registry has been initiated with the objective of elevating the position of Sri Lanka in the Ease of Doing Business Index by improving the  access to land information by investors when registering a property. The current process of registering a property takes 51 days and consists of 09 steps. Through the implementation of the e-Land Registry project, it is expected to reduce the said duration up to 05 days and 02 steps. The programme has been planned to be implemented in the Western and Southern Provinces in the year 2018. As such, the Joint Proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs and Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to secure the required provision for the future implementation of the said project Island Wide, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enactment of Legislation for the Prevention of Animal Sacrifices
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - Although animal sacrifice which is considered an ancient religious practice, it is still carried out publicly in certain Hindu temples, it has been observed that the majority of the Hindu devotees do not accept that practice. At present, the Government of India has banned the animal sacrifice in the Hindu temples. As such the proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Resettlement, Rehabilitation, Northern Development & Hindu Religious Affairs, to enact legislation to ban animal and bird sacrifices carried out in the Hindu temples or its precincts in Sri Lanka as well and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation based on the draft prepared for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement for the Transfer of Sentenced Persons between Sri Lanka and the Kingdom of Thailand
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to present the Agreement entered into between Sri Lanka and Thailand on the Transfer of Sentenced Persons, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Installation of Solar Power Panels in Model Village Housing Schemes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - With the objective of uplifting the economic well being of the people residing in the model villages implemented Islandwide by the Ministry of Housing and Construction, it has been proposed to implement a project to install Solar Power Panels in the said Model Villages with the participation of private entrepreneurs, under the Soorya Bala Sangramaya project presently being implemented by the Government. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to call for  proposals to select suitable investors for the implementation of the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 1,200 houses in the Northern and Southern Provinces under the Semata Sevana Gramashakthi Model Village Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - The Government of India has extended a financial assistance of Rs 600 million for the construction of 600 housing units in 25 villages of the Northern Province and  600 housing units in 25 villages of the Southern Province  under the Semata Sevana Gramashakthi Model Village Project conducted by the Government Island wide. Accordingly, the construction of the said villages is being carried out at present.  As such, in terms of the concurrence given by the Government of India for financial assistance under the same project in constructing of another 600 housing units in the Northern Province and 600 housing units in the Southern Province, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to implement the said project, to enter into a  Memorandum of Understanding in that regard and to appoint a Steering Committee for the project implementation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting a new Act to give effect to the National Fisheries and 	Aquaculture Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - National Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No.2 of 1996 which is presently in force has been amended at various instances and according to the present economic, social and environmental trends, it has been identified that further amendments should be made to the said Act. As such, 	the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Rural Economic Affairs, to draft a new Act incorporating the provisions to regulate, conserve and develop the fisheries industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Disposal of ash dump accumulated at the ash yard of the Norochcholai Coal Power Plant in an eco-friendly manner
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - Measures have to be taken immediately to dispose the ash dump accumulated as a by product of coal combustion of the Norochcholai Coal Power Plant to prevent the harmful impact caused to the public in surrounding villages and the environment. As a step of this process, it has been decided to provide ash for making eco-friendly products by using them. As such, according to a proposal presented to make bricks by using ash, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to dispose the ash within the ash yard of the Coal Power Plant to carry out productions without disposing them to the environment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Organizing the 71st  National Day Celebration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, to appoint a sub-committee comprising of 13 people's representatives chaired by  the Hon. Prime Minister to prepare the relevant programme and organize and monitor necessary arrangements pertaining to the 71st National Day Ceremony which falls on 04th  February, 2019, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading of the Provincial General Hospital - Ratnapura as a Teaching Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to accommodate the first intake of medical students which consists of 75 undergraduates for the Faculty of Medicine of the Sabaragamuwa University at the end of the year 2018. The need has arisen to upgrade the Ratnapura General Hospital as a Teaching Hospital with a view to providing the said medical students with clinical training. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to upgrade the Provincial General Hospital in Ratnapura as a Teaching Hospital in order to function as the hospital affiliated to the new Faculty of Medicine of the Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National Health Research Council
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft necessary legislation for the establishment of the 'National Health Research Council' at national level for regulation, co‑ordination, monitoring, development and management of Health Researches, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancing the coverage of 'Vasantham TV' Channel
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - The television channel 'Vasantham TV' has been launched by the Independent Television media network for the Tamil speaking community and during its first phase, services were provided to the viewers covering Colombo and suburban areas. Subsequently, it has been extended to Jaffna, Eastern Province and Kokavil area. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to extend the broadcasting facilities with an investment of Rs.304 million enabling the Tamil viewers living in the other parts of the Island as well the facility to watch the programmes in this Channel, was approved by the Cabinet.
