description: Islandwide citizens Awareness Programme on the Right to Information
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka, being one of the countries which have ensured the right to information of the public, possesses the third best Right to Information Act in the world. Accordingly, the Government has focused its attention to declare the period from 21st to 28th September as the Information Week to make aware the public of using the right to information for the public welfare to coincide with the International Day of Right to Information which falls on 28th September while naming the year 2018 as 'Year of Public Awareness'. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to implement the mobile service on Right to Information as 'Right to Information to the Village' under this programme and to make aware the students of the same by conducting various competitions covering all schools Islandwide, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Sri Lanka Transport Board Act, No.27 of 2005 to increase the income level of the Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - It has been found that a considerable amount of daily income receivable to the Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB) is lost due to various malpractices. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft necessary legislation to amend the Sri Lanka Transport Board Act, No.27 of 2005, by incorporating the necessary amendments to increase the level of income through the prevention of such practices, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The re-printing activities of the Buddha Jayanthi Publication Series by the Ministry of Buddhasasana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - The translation activities of the Pali Thripitikaya into Sinhala language commenced to commemorate the 2500 Buddha Jayanthi and by the year 1989 the publication series have been completed. The Ministry of Buddhasasana has made plans to print this publication series in a more formal manner and publicize in future. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to undertake the responsibility of editing and printing of the Tripitaka Publication Series by the Ministry of Buddhasasana, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Sustainable Punyagrama Programme Islandwide towards a Righteous Society
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - The Sustainable Punyagrama Programme with temple as a centre point is being conducted by the Ministry of Buddhasasana, with the objective of implementing the concept of the village and the temple in a more realistic way and creating a village comprising of an economically sound community  empowered with virtues. Through this programme the community life is to be activated based on the village temple being in the forefront and in accordance with the Buddhist values, customs and cultural concepts which prevailed in the past, but which are deteriorating at present. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana, considering the success of the 50 programmes conducted last year to implement this programme in 250 villages covering all the Districts in the Island within the coming year and centering the other religious places as well, making aware the other Ministries to implement the programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the construction work of the Public Library Building in Batticaloa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - Construction work of a new building in place of the 50 year old building where the present Public Library of Batticaloa is located is now underway. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to secure Rs.169.97 million required further to complete the construction work of the said building from the Budget of the  year 2019, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Middle-Income Housing Loan Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to expand the Middle‑Income Housing Loan Scheme enabling the middle income earners of both the public and private sectors who purchase a house for the first time from the middle income housing projects to obtain a concessionary loan from the National Savings Bank.   Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to take into  consideration the age limits generally adopted by the Banks instead of the age limits that prevailed previously to apply for this loan scheme and also to enable to facilitate more beneficiaries to purchase houses from projects implemented by the private sector  as well, was approved by the Cabinet.  Pertaining to this matter, as proposed by H.E. the President, it was also decided to lower the eligibility criteria relating to the monthly income level for this programme.

description: Vesting of Dr. Neville Fernando Hospital with the Sri Lanka Air Force
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - As a solution to the conflict which prevailed for a length of time at the SAITM Medical Faculty, around 900 medical students who were studying at the faculty had been absorbed into the Sir John Kotelawala Defence University.  Considering the proposal presented for vesting Dr. Neville Fernando Hospital  affiliated to the SAITM Medical Faculty with the Sri Lanka Air Force, the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, the Minister of Defence, for the appointment of a Official Committee to conduct negotiations in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, for approval to procure 38,500 MT of Urea (Granular) at the rate of US$ 309.60 per MT from Liven Agrichem Pte. Ltd., 20,000 MT of Muriate of Potash at the rate of US$ 329.50 per MT and 7,500 MT of Triple Super Phosphate at the rate of US$ 317.25 per MT from Agri Commodities and Finance, required by the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Limited for the procurement of Chemical Fertilizer for the month of October, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Housing Project with 450 Housing Units at Cyril C. Perera Mawatha at Bloemendhal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the contract of the Housing Project with 450 Housing Units at Cyril C. Perera Mawatha at Bloemendhal to M/s Access Engineering PLC, for a sum of Rs.2,737.35 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mirigama Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to implement the Mirigama Water Supply Project, with a view to supplying water to Mirigama, Kaleliya, Kandalama and to a section of the proposed Mirigama Industrial Zone. A feasibility study has been conducted by M/s China Aero Technology International Engineering Corporation (CATIC) in this regard, and the said Corporation has submitted a project proposal for implementation. As such, the Joint Proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs and Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to appoint a Committee to evaluate the said proposal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Standing Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committees to accelerate  the implementation of projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to appoint Senior Officials such as Secretaries to the State Ministries, Additional Secretaries, Chief Financial Officers as members of  the Standing Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committees in order to expedite the procurement decision making process, to accelerate the projects inclusive of development projects implemented by the  Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply and delivery of new Tyre Kits for the Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation,	to award the procurement for the purchase of new Tyre Kits in various sizes required for the buses of the Sri Lanka Transport Board to M/s. Ceat Kelani International Tyres (Pvt.) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.1,124.14 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Digital Advertising Campaign for Tourism Promotion
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: -  Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to implement a digital advertising campaign to  promote Sri Lanka as an attractive tourist destination among the tourists in the United Kingdom,Germany, France, India and China. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amaratunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to award the contracts for the implementation of the said digital advertising campaigns for India and China to Havas Media India Private Limited and to M/s Ionic Media  respectively as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tourism Promotion
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - The Government has planned to implement programmes for promoting Sri Lanka as an attractive destination among the tourists in the global level in order to attract tourists of developed countries with a high purchasing power and to retain them for a longer period of time in the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amaratunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to implement the said tourism promotion programmes by the Ministry of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs as recommended by the committees comprising of the representatives of the relevant institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project for the Correction of Drug Addictive Offenders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - A pilot project, has been implemented within the North Western Province to preclude drug addictive offenders from drug addiction through corrective measures and making them engaged in self employment opportunities enabling their economic stability. The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to secure the provisions required to implement the said project in the North Western, Southern, Sabaragamuwa and Eastern Provinces as well, from the year 2019 onwards, based on its success, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a system for the standardization of the Geographical names
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - Sinhalese and Tamil languages,which are the Official Languages of Sri Lanka, comprise of non‑romanized alphabets. Since the correct Sinhalese/Tamil pronunciation is not produced when the geographical names of such as, villages, towns and rivers in Sri Lanka are written using English characters, writing in English characters in accordance with a standardized system to produce the correct pronunciation is known as the Romanization System. This system is already being used to write geographical names in the Tamil language. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms, to propose the use of Romanization System for writing the geographical names in the Sinhalese language to enable the use of such names internationally and to propose the same, at the United Nations Conference on Standardization, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on the establishment of the South Asian Regional Intelligence and Coordination Centre on Transnational Organized Crime (SARICC-TOC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to establish the Co-ordination Centre in Sri Lanka for the project on “Strengthening of law enforcement on Drugs in South Asia” conducted by the South Asian Regional Office of the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Management and Law & Order, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and India, Nepal, Maldives, Bangladesh and Bhutan which are the member countries of the said Centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Convention against the Illicit Traffic of Narcotic drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, No.1 of 2008
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has signed the United Nations Convention of 1988 against the Illicit Traffic of Narcotic drugs and Psychotropic substances and with a view to executing the responsibility bounded by international obligations, the Convention against Illicit Traffic of Narcotic drugs and Psychotropic substances Act, No.1 of 2008 has been enacted. However, prevention of illicit trafficking and use of these substances has become a serious challenge locally and as well as internationally. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Management and Law & Order, to  amend the Convention against Illicit Traffic of Narcotic drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, No.1 of 2008, by establishing a code of laws, which enables to face the situation squarely, locally and internationally, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reduction of the landslide vulnerability through mitigation measures
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement a project to identify the landslide vulnerable    areas and unstable slopes in the hilly areas to minimize the possible disastrous situations due to climatic changes resulting from extreme bad weather conditions. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources & Disaster Management, to implement the said project at an investment of US$ 104 million and secure the funds required for the purpose from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of drinking water to the people in the Jaffna Peninsula
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - The Joint Proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, and Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources & Disaster Management, to implement the drinking water supply project utilizing the water resource in the Vadamarachchi Lagoon, at an investment of Rs.2,000 million, for the supply of safe drinking water to the people in the Jaffna Peninsula, in accordance with the feasibility study made on the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Tea Research Board Act, No.52 of 1993
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to amend the Tea Research  Board Act, No.52 of 1993. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to publish the Bill prepared, incorporating the provisions to widen the functions of the Board on formulating the environmental security measures, specific provision pertaining to the issue of research outcome to various parties, to make provision to prevent the inconsistencies between the Tea Research Board Act and other related law and to reconstitute the composition of the Board of Directors of the Tea Research Board, in the Government Gazette and to present the same thereafter, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing permanent building facilities for the Nuwara Eliya Regional Office of the Tea Small Holdings Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - With a view to providing permanent building facilities in place of the building on lease where the Nuwara Eliya Regional Office of the Tea Small Holdings Development Authority is functioning presently, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to establish the said Office in a building situated in a block of land in extent of 0.0452 hectares in the Kotmale New Town after renovation and to allocate the required funds for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Companies Act, No.7 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - The Government has focused its attention to amend the Companies Act, No.7  of 2007, considering the present trends and the requirements.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to publish the amendments made to sections 5, 9 and 10 of the Act in the Government Gazette enabling the Registrar of Companies to notify the general public on the incorporation of a new Company and to direct a Company to change its name  in order to achieve a higher grading in the Ease of Business Index of the World Bank for Sri Lanka and to present the same, thereafter, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Tharapuram Co-operative Village Programme in the Mannar District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously for the development work carried out under the Tharapuram Co-operative Village Programme in the Mannar District. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to construct a Convention Centre as the next stage of the multipurpose building under construction, utilizing the provision set apart under the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Industrial Zone for the Small Scale Entrepreneurs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to develop small scale industries in the areas utilizing the extent of the land of 100 acres where the Kankesanthurai Cement Factory had been situated. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to develop the said land as an industrial zone for the small scale entrepreneurs, under an investment of around Rs.998 million, with all infrastructure facilities needed for industries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a transit card which could be used in bus and rail transport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - In order to modernize the Public Transport Service of Sri Lanka and for the convenience of the commuters, it has been planned to introduce a transit card system through an electronic payment methodology.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to facilitate the implementation of a Framework for a Standardized common card required in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reconstruction of Sri Lanka Maha Viharaya in Nepal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-04
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Maha Viharaya situated in the vicinity of the Lumbini Sacred Area in Nepal where the birth of the Gautama Buddha took place is a place of worship of the Buddhist pilgrims. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to provide necessary provision for the further reconstruction activities to be carried out in the Sri Lanka Maha Viharaya with a view to developing the said sacred area as a place of worship which demonstrates the flourishing of the Theravada Buddhism, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Naming the year 2018 as the National Food Production year
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena made the Cabinet aware that action will be taken to issue circular instructions for all the relevant Government institutions to focus attention on re‑cultivating the abandoned paddy lands, making use of all other cultivable lands for cultivation purposes and  producing the seeds and planting materials required for the crop cultivation, with a view to giving a fresh start to the agricultural activities which had declined due to adverse weather conditions such as drought and floods that occurred in the past years.

description: Construction of 08 rural bridges for the betterment of the beneficiaries of the model villages in the Hambantota district
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to construct the 08  rural bridges under the 'Nagamu Purawara' programme namely, the bridge across the Rambukwewa Weligatta ara, the bridge across the Muwanwewa Weerawila ara, the Diyabendi bridge across Pannegamuwa and Abhayapura, the bridge across Ambalanthota Liyangastota and Bedigantota, the Malalaara, Ranmuduwewa bridge in the Thanamalwila road, the bridge between Rubberwatta and Uduwila, the Katuwana Keselwatta bridge and the bridge across Lunugamwehera right bank,  for the housing beneficiaries of the model villages being initiated in the underdeveloped villages of the Hambantota district in order to provide easy access to the urban common amenities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kolonnawa Canal Diversion Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement the  Kolonnawa Canal Diversion Scheme with a length of 4.8 km under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project, under four sub sections with an investment of Rs.3,000 million. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the contract to carry out the construction activities to be implemented under its Stage 3, to the E &C - RR Joint Venture, for a sum of Rs 1,004.4 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The project for upgrading the infrastructure facilities at the Industrial Engineering Training Institute (IETI) in Katubedda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - The Industrial Engineering Training Institute (IETI) in Katubedda offers Three year full time courses at National Vocational Qualification (NVQ) Level 4 in the fields of Electrical, Construction, Wood Work and a one year course in the Computer Application. It has been planned to increase the annual intake of students to the institute which offers courses suited to the job market by enhancing its facilities. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Science, Technology, Research, Skills Development & Vocational Training and Kandyan Heritage, to call for a comprehensive project proposal to upgrade the institute with an investment of Rs.2,400 million by obtaining financial assistance from an Austrian Soft Loan Scheme; and to secure foreign donor assistance for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting the Asia-Pacific Region Annual Conference on Express Mail Service (EMS) - 2019 in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. M.H.A. Haleem, the Minister of Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs, to conduct the Asia-Pacific Region Annual Conference on Express Mail Service (EMS) - 2019 in Sri Lanka, in September 2019 with the participation of foreign representatives, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of the Nutrition Allowance of the Scholarship holders of the  Sports Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - The Sport Schools have been established with the objective of producing athletes at national and international level by selecting students who display talents for sports and providing them with proper training. As such,  the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to increase the monthly Nutrition Allowance provided to a student from Rs.2,500/- to Rs.5,000/-, with a view to providing the students who engage in training in these schools with sufficient nutrition, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship Trust Fund Act, No. 66 of 1981
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, to amend the title of Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship Trust Fund Act, No.66 of 1981 which regulates the Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship providing the students in the Government higher education institutions with funds for their education, as Lalith Athulathmudali Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship Trust Fund Act, No.66 of 1981, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formalization of investments of the Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship Trust Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - The objective of the Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship Trust Fund is to create higher education opportunities for underprivileged youth and provide facilities and enhance them in respect of same. The National Wealth Cooperation Limited and the National Wealth Securities Limited established under the full ownership of the Mahapola Fund make investments on strengthening the Mahapola Main Fund. In view of the negative impact caused to the Mahapola Fund due to the activities of the said companies and to regularize the investments of the said Fund,  the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, to liquidate the said companies and invest all the funds belonging to the Mahapola Higher Education Scholarship Trust Fund, only in state banks and Central bank bonds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Systematic diagnostic assessment of the chemical disaster risks in Sri Lanka by the National Building Research Organization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - Through a study conducted by the National Building Research Organization (NBRO) it has been confirmed that most of the accidents related to chemical substances in Sri Lanka occur on account of being unaware of those substances,  the non‑maintenance of the premises using such substances, the lapses on the supervision and the misuse of the technologies. Considering the requirement of preparing a formal disaster management framework as a remedial measure to address this situation, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources & Disaster Management, to conduct a Systematic diagnostic assessment of the chemical disaster risks in Sri Lanka between 2019 - 2020, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: New Projects proposed to be implemented from the year 2019 for the performance of the Plantation Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - Through the export of products associated with tea, rubber and coconut, an income of Rs.457.85 billion could be generated in the year 2017 and it has been found that various research, services and methodologies should be enhanced in order to generate more income. For this purpose, it has been planed to implement projects for the production of hybrid coconut seeds, the production and distribution of the predatory Mites for the control Mite damages and the construction of productive and highly efficient modern smoke houses.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to secure the provision needed for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration Act, No.9 of 1982
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Management and Law & Order, to make amendments to the Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration Act, No.9 of 1982, incorporating the necessary amendments to suit the present needs of the functions and the administrative structure of the Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) Annual Meeting - 2021 in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to communicate the Asian Development Bank; a long time development partner of Sri Lanka, the intention of hosting the Asian Development Bank Annual Meeting - 2021 in Sri Lanka and to appoint a National Monitoring Committee and Sub‑Committees for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Holding the State Christmas Festival - 2018 under the patronage of the  Mannar Diocese
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - Action has been taken to hold the State Christmas Festival,  every year, under the patronage of a Catholic Diocese and the patronage and guidance of the Bishop of the respective diocese. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to hold the State Christmas Festival - 2018 under the patronage of the Mannar Diocese with the theme as 'The Nativity of Jesus and the Splendor of Christmas', with a view to promoting reconciliation and spiritual awakening among the people in Mannar where there is a multi‑national community, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the facilities needed to support the Public - Private Partnerships in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to secure funds amounting to US$ 25 million from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) of the World Bank for the improvement of a structure to assist the Public‑Private Partnerships and for provision of infrastructure financing to support the Public-Private partnerships programme.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct negotiations in that regard and enter into the relevant loan agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Stabilization of the Mt. Lavinia to Angulana Coastal Stretch and the Sand Bar at the Kalu Ganga Outfall which has been subject to erosion
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-28
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted in principle previously to stabilize the Coastal Stretch from Mt. Lavinia to Angulana under the Southern Colombo Sand Catchment Project. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to stabilize the Coastal Stretch from Mt. Lavinia to Angulana using the Sand Engine Methodology and to restore the sand bar at the Kalu Ganga outfall eroded due to the recent floods, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the National Art Gallery
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approved to set apart a provision of Rs.42 million required in respect of the renovation activities in the National Art Gallery identified as needed to be done expeditiously, taking into consideration the matters submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs.

description: Bringing back to normal the reservoirs and the agricultural wells in the North Central Province dried up due to the dry weather conditions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - It has been found that nearly 12,000 cultivation wells and approximately 2,000 reservoirs used to take drinking water in the North Central Province have dried up due to the prevailing dry climatic conditions. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources & Disaster Management, for the construction of common new drinking water wells to be resistant to drought, excavation of the dried up cultivation wells,  excavation of wells in the dried up reservoirs and renovation of the drinking water wells to be carried out by the farmer organizations through the Divisional Secretaries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into an Agreement for the Establishment of a Biotechnology Laboratory
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - A Memorandum of Understanding has been entered into between Sri Lanka and the Science and Technology Ministry of the Government of China previously, for the establishment of a Joint Biotechnology Laboratory in Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Science, Technology, Research, Skills Development & Vocational Training and Kandyan Heritage, to sign the second Agreement including the terms and the conditions agreed upon for the implementation of the project for strengthening of the technical cooperation between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the contract for the construction of the Grid Substation under the National Transmission and Distribution Network Development and Efficiency Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement a project consisting of 04 packages to develop and improve the efficiency of the national electricity transmission and distribution network. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for the construction and improvement of Grid Substations in the areas of Kirindiwela, Battaramulla, Biyagama, Kotmale, Veyangoda, Padukka, Kosgama, Seethawaka, Thulhiriya, Ratmalana, Pannipitiya, Kolonnawa, Athurugiriya, Polpitiya, Ukuwela, and Naula, to the Joint Venture of the  Mitsubishi Corporation and Ceylex Engineering (pvt) Ltd., under its second package, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, for the approval to procure 54,000 MT of Urea (Granular) at the rate of US$ 305 per MT and 6,500 MT of Urea (Prill) at the rate of US$ 325 per MT from Agri Commodities and Finance and 15,000 MT of Triple Super Phosphate at the rate of US$ 334.1 per MT from Swiss Singapore Overseas Enterprises, required by the Ceylon  Fertilizer Company Limited and Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company limited for the production of Chemical Fertilizer for the month of September, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the construction of the Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the Ashroff Memorial Hospital in Kalmunai
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the procurement for the construction of the Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the Ashroff Memorial Hospital in Kalmunai to M/s Link Engineering (Pvt) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.926.5 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the construction of the Renal Care Unit at the General Hospital in Badulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the procurement for the construction of the Renal Care Unit at the General Hospital in Badulla to provide specialized care for the patients suffering from Chronic Kidney Diseases of Unknown Aetiology to M/s Orient Construction Company (Pvt) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.668.2 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Borella Ayurveda Hospital as a Teaching Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - Under the project for the Development of the Borella Ayurveda Hospital as a Teaching Hospital, the construction of a new ward complex is underway. The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, for the supply of electricity, the construction of the Water and Sewage System to initiate healthcare services expeditiously in the said building, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of an Accounting and Treasury Management System to be used for the Employees' Provident Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - Collection of Employees' Provident Fund amounting to around Rs.2,000 billion, maintenance of accounts, payment of benefits, investment of the excess funds and the preparation of financial statements of the funds, are done by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. Since it has been found that it would be appropriate to replace the existing computer system associated with a new system for the accounting and treasury management activities of this fund, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to carry out the procurement activities for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing building facilities for the accommodation of the staff of the Naval Hospital Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - The Navy General Hospital which consists of 684 navel personnel provides medical facilities for about 450 persons per day including  the navel personnel of the Sri Lanka Navy, the retired navel personnel and their family members. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to construct a permanent four storey residential building to facilitate the accommodation of the naval personnel taking into consideration the difficulties faced by them due to the absence of such permanent accommodation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the new two storey hospital buildings for the Southern Naval Hospital of the Sri Lanka Navy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - Naval Hospital of the Southern Naval Command is located at Boossa and the hospital provides medical facilities for about 4,200 Navel personnel attached to the said Command and their family members. Accordingly,  the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to secure the further required funds for the construction of the 02, two storey buildings equipped with modern facilities in place of the old buildings with inadequate facilities in which this hospital is maintained at present, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of 5,000 Export Production Villages
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to establish 5,000 Export Production Villages in the country under 02 stages, with the objective of promoting the primary products of farmers within the integrated process in order to accelerate the value added products of the primary products to suit the export market. The products suited for each village will be chosen based on the abundance of resources in them and it has been planned to provide training in the activities such as, securing funds required for farmers, technology, efficient resource utilization, farm management, harvesting, packaging and transportation and arrangements are made for them to gain access to the domestic and international markets. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Social Welfare and Primary Industries, to implement this programme under the  project for Research, Development and Promotional Programme for export development implemented under the Ministry of Social Welfare and Primary Industries and establish 1,000 Export Production villages within 300 Divisional Secretariat Divisions under its first stage, implement this project within the period of 2018 to 2020 and improve the total number of villages up to 5,000 in stages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a new Trilingual National School in Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to establish a new Trilingual National School in Colombo to provide the female students of all ethnic groups with the education in three languages. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to establish this as a Trilingual National School with an investment of Rs.900 million at the Wellawatta area and to secure the necessary facilities for the school, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a new Trilingual Mixed National School in the Nanuoya area in Nuwara Eliya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - In order to further upgrade the educational facilities available in the Nuwara Eliya District, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to establish a fully fledged new Trilingual Mixed National School, in the Nanuoya area, with an investment of Rs.800 million to conduct classes from Grade 6 to Grade 13 and to secure the facilities required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Debt Conciliation Ordinance, No.39 of 1941
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to amend the Debt Conciliation Ordinance, No.39 of 1941 by increasing the membership of the Debt Conciliation Board and revise the selection criteria of the Chairman, members of the Debt Conciliation Board and the members of each Branch. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to publish the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman in the Government Gazette and present the same thereafter in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing facilities to enhance the productivity of the Tea Small Holdings
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to provide relief measures, to distribute equipment among the tea smallholders and to enhance the connected rural infrastructure facilities to increase the productivity of the Tea Smallholdings. Further, it has been found that, it would be more appropriate to enhance the tea productivity by ensuring the uninterrupted tea production by the Tea Smallholders, adopting agricultural practices such as proper land preparation, pruning, weeding, standard maintenance of tea bushes, proper application of fertilizer, avoiding soil erosion and ample supply of water during dry seasons. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to implement a programme for distributing the equipment required to adopt the proper agricultural mechanisms relating to the tea cultivation among the tea smallholders at an investment of Rs.250 million and to distribute 10,000 water tanks, 3,500 water pumps and 4,500 sprayers among them under the said programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing the necessary facilities to enhance the productivity of the Coconut Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - Of the total extent of the coconut lands in the country 84% has been identified  as small scale coconut lands of less than 20 acres in extent. As such, with a view to converting the coconut industry into more profitable and stable industry through minimizing the production cost by enhancing the productivity of the small scale coconut lands, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, for seeking allocations required to provide coconut tree climbing devices, Mini Tillers used for fertilizer application, Red Weevil pheromone traps, Grass Cutters, Power Sprayers and Mini Choppers for chopping various parts of the coconut tree, to the coconut land owners and the members of the Kapruka Societies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancing the productivity of rubber cultivation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that the productivity of rubber cultivation in Sri Lanka is comparatively lower when compared to the other Asian Countries which are engaged in the same industry. As a long term solution, it has been identified that it would be appropriate to remove the low harvesting old cultivation which has exceeded its life span and re‑cultivate the rubber plants generated from new clones which provide a large harvest. However, taking into consideration the excessive cost to be incurred for the re‑cultivation of rubber, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to increase the concession provided to new rubber cultivation from Rs.150,000/- to Rs.300,000/- per hectare and the concession provided for the re‑cultivation of rubber from Rs.175,000/- to Rs.350,000/- per hectare, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the name of the Institute of Post Harvest Technology (IPHT) as 'the National Institute of Post Harvest Management (NIPHM)'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - The Institute of Post Harvest Technology (IPHT) established in the year 2000, is an institution which carries out the post harvest technical research and development activities from the harvesting stage of the crops to the value addition leading to consumption. As such, with a view to performing the technical, research development and regulate activities on the post harvest of Sri Lanka more efficiently and effectively, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to amend the name of the Institute as 'the National Institute of Post Harvest Management (NIPHM)', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of an Inland Water Transport project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to maintain an Inland Water Transport across the canals from Battaramulla to Wellawatta, from Fort to Union Place via Beira Lake, from Mattakkuliya to Hanwella across Kelani river and other waterways, as a Public‑Private Partnership project. The Minister of Megapolis and Western Development informed the Cabinet that as an initial step before the commencement of the implementation of the said project under a Public‑Private Partnership model, to implement a pilot project from Fort to Union Place via Beira Laka for a period of two (02) years with the assistance of the Sri Lanka Navy and that arrangements have been made to purchase the required vessels and construct jetties, and those contents were noted by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of Sovereign Bonds
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka has been issuing International Sovereign Bonds since the year 2017 to finance the annual budget and the said Bonds issued up to the year 2018 have been United States denominated Dollars. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to appoint an Officials' Committee comprising of the relevant institutions, to study the possibility of gaining access to the International market with denominated Yen, Renminbi and Euro, for export diversification and attracting Foreign Direct Investments (FDI) within the current economic activities in anticipation of managing the budget financing at a low cost, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Health System Enhancement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to implement a project with an investment of US$ 60 million for the enhancement of the primary healthcare, to strengthen healthcare and prevention, formulation of policies in that regard and capacity building in the Uva, Sabaragamuwa, Central and North Central Provinces.  It has also been further proposed to obtain a grant of US$12.5 million and a  concessionary loan of US$37.5 million from the Asian Development Bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into the necessary agreements to secure the relevant funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a temperature controlled Warehouse at Dambulla to store Agricultural Produce
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to establish a Warehouse in close proximity to the  Economic Centre at Dambulla with a temperature controlled facility on an investment of Rs.475 million to enable the small and medium scale farmers engaged specially in the cultivation of fruits and vegetables to store their produce in a state of freshness for a long period.  Since the availability of a continuous market could be guaranteed for the crops harvested seasonally, a stable price could be maintained for such crops by minimizing the price fluctuations of the products.  The Government of India has agreed to grant Rs.300 million out of the said investment. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to secure the funds necessary for the establishment of a temperature controlled Warehouse at Dambulla and to formulate a mechanism for the management of same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new Conference Hall for the Joint Services Language Training Institute at Kotmale
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to construct a new Conference Hall with the State of the Art facilities which could house around 150 trainees at one given time, in place of the old Conference Hall now being used with inadequate facilities at the Joint Services Language Training Institute at Kotmale, which provides training in various languages to the officers of the Tri Forces and the Police,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Imposing orders to stop land reclamation and destruction of wetlands
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body:
- An Officials' Committee has been previously appointed by the Cabinet for obtaining the recommendations necessary to impose a temporary prohibitory order to immediately stop land reclamation and destruction of wetlands in the Colombo Metropolitan Region and to take appropriate measures to declare wetlands as protected zones and the preservation of same.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement the following recommendations made by the said Officials' Committee, was approved by the Cabinet. 
i	to impose a prohibitory order preventing all types of land reclamation and constructions in the Colombo Metropolitan Region for any other purpose other than the constructions necessary to be done which are of  national importance and the constructions identified under the Transit Railway Line Network.

ii	to direct the Director General of Wildlife to declare the wetlands, other than the areas recognized adjacent to Kimbulaela and Diyawanna oya in which the development activities have already been initiated, as protected areas.

description: Climate Change Mitigation Action Support Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is bound to contribute to the global effort for mitigating the emission of Greenhouse gases which has been the cause for climate changes with the ratification of the Paris Agreement by Sri Lanka in the year 2016 under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) for  mitigation of the emission of Greenhouse gases.  For this purpose, approval of the Cabinet has been granted to submit a series of extensive activities which may mitigate the emission of Greenhouse gases in the 05 major sectors namely  energy, transport, industry, waste and forests to be the local contribution. In order to achieve these goals so determined locally, it is required to identify the quantity of the Greenhouse gases emitted from each of the above sectors. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to obtain the Grants due to Sri Lanka in order to implement the relevant project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Forest Conservation Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-21
decision_details_body: - Focusing special attention on the bio-diversity, soil, water, cultural, religious, historical and aesthetic value, it has been found necessary to amend the Forest Conservation Ordinance presently in force for the achievement of the objectives of forest conservation for the betterment of the future generation, preserving the mineral resources in the forest reserves, further strengthening of the powers assigned to the Forest Conservation Officers, promoting the productivity of the forests and strengthening of the contribution provided by the forests for the welfare of the rural community. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to draft a Bill to amend the Forest Conservation Ordinance incorporating the relevant amendments so as to effectively and productively implement the Forest Conservation Legal Framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointing a Special Commission to review the Salaries of the Public Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - It has been found that, it is a timely need to take measures to settle the problems pertaining to the salaries of the entire public sector after having studied the existing salary structures, and taking into consideration the dire difficulties to be faced by the general public and the adverse effects caused to the economy due to various groups in the public sector resorting to trade union action from the recent times to enhance their salaries and payments.  In order to  find immediate solutions, to avert this situation, the Government has focused its attention to appoint a Special Commission comprising of experts with the knowledge and experience in each sector in the Public Service. In this context, the rectification of salary anomalies in the Railways has been identified as a subject matter of the Commission. Accordingly, the Cabinet agreed on the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to request H.E. the President to appoint a Special Commission to review the salary structures in addition to the functions of the  National Salaries and Cadres Commission.

description: Promoting Sri Lanka as an attractive destination among the Tourists
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - A digital advertising campaign has been designed to be implemented to promote Sri Lanka as an attractive destination among the tourists in the countries of United Kingdom, Germany and France. Accordingly, with a view to implementing the digital advertising campaign specific for each country under the government procurement procedure, the proposal made by Hon. John Amaratunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to award the procurement to the Digital Spring Limited of the United Kingdom for a sum of  US$ 703,480, to the Media Consulta International Holdings AG of Germany for a sum of US$ 697,770.92, and to the  Interface Tourism of France for a sum of US$ 706,460, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Sultanate of Oman on Visa Exemption
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of  Internal Affairs & Wayamba Development, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding on Visa Exemption for holders of diplomatic, Special, Service and Official Passports, between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Sultanate of Oman, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing the services of a suitable company for the maintenance and operational activities of the Mehewara Piyasa building
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - The construction process of a 32 storey building named as the “Mehewara Piyasa” for accommodating the Ministry of Labour and all other institutions functioning under its purview, under one roof with a view to rendering a more effective quality service to the clients, has now reached its final phase. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravindra Samaraweera, the Minister of Labour & Trade Union Relations, for securing the services of a competent external institution for the maintenance activities of this building due to the scarcity of trained staff for the proper maintenance of a building of this nature, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into term contracts to purchase Refined Petroleum Products
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - With a view to maintaining the petroleum stocks at an optimal level, it was decided to enter into 02 term contracts for purchasing refined petroleum products within a period of ten (10) months from the 01st of September 2018 up to the 30th of June 2019. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Petroleum Resources Development, to award the procurement contracts for purchasing the petroleum products to M/s Gulf Petrochem FZC of the United Arab Emirates, as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SSCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ambathale Water Supply System Improvement and Energy Saving Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - The Ambathale Water Supply System Improvement and Energy Saving Project has been identified to be implemented under the Greater Colombo Water & Wastewater Management Improvement Investment Programme with financial assistance by the Asian Development Bank (ADB). Through this project, it has been planned to carry out the renovation and re-establishment of the water pipe lines of the Ambathale Water Treatment Plant, installation of the machinery and to introduce an automated system for the water pumping process and to construct a tank of 8,000 m³ in capacity. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for designing and building of the project to M/s Zongnan-SZSG JH JV, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commissioning of the Railway level crossing protection system
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - There are 1,337 Railway level crossings within Sri Lanka and out of those the protection system functions only in 520. In addition, action is being taken to install protection systems in another 400 level crossings. The Hungarian Government has agreed to provide financial assistance for the Supply, Installation and Commissioning of the balance 417 level crossings. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to call for proposals from M/s. Muszer Automatika Ltd. recommended by the Government of Hungaria for the implementation of this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling for bids for the operation of Currency Exchange Counters in the Departure Walkway at Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) in Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to call for bids from the financial institutions approved by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka to increase the currency exchange counters in the Departure Walkway at Bandaranaike International Airport up to 06 and to conduct such services uninterruptedly from the year 2019 for the convenience of the finance and foreign exchange activities of the tourists who use the Bandaranaike International Airport in Katunayake, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Occupational Safety Week 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - During the National Occupational Safety Week which falls from the 01st of October until the 06th of October various activities and awareness  programmes have been planned to be conducted island-wide by the public and private sector institutions. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravindra Samaraweera, the Minister of Labour & Trade Union Relations, to hold the National Occupational Safety and Health  Seminar on the 02nd of October in Colombo and the National Occupational Safety and Health Award of Excellence at the National level, withing the said week was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of compensation for the people and those whose properties were affected due to political victimization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - The joint proposal made by the Ministers of Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara,  Public Administration & Management and Law & Order; Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, Justice & Prison Reforms; Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, Resettlement, Rehabilitation, Northern Development & Hindu Religious Affairs, to secure the necessary provisions for the payment of compensation in accordance with the  recommendations made by a Committee formed for the payment of compensation for the persons who lost their lives, were injured and those whose properties were damaged due to various political reasons, and pay and settle such compensation in the year 2019 itself, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing  a pair of shoes for the school children
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - A programme for providing gift vouchers to 648,151 students of the difficult, the most difficult and the isolated schools in the remote, the most remote and the isolated areas to buy shoes, was successfully conducted in the year 2017. It was found that these children were provided with an opportunity to purchase  a pair of shoes at their choice through this programme and it was a huge economic relief for their parents as well. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to continue to implement this programme for the year 2018 as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Draft Bill for the recovery of damages pertaining to the death of a person
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to publish the Bill to provide for the recovery of damages pertaining to the death of a person caused by a wrongful act, omission, negligence or default of another and for other matters connected thereto, prepared with the clearance of the Attorney General, in the Government Gazette and to submit the said Bill, thereafter, in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Northern Province Sustainable Fisheries Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to implement the Northern Province Sustainable Fisheries Development Programme, which consists of 03 components such as construction and development of a fishery harbour, anchorages and landing sites, aquaculture development and livelihood development, with financial assistance of US$ 174 million to be provided by the Asian Development Bank within the period of 2018 - 2024. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Rural Economic Affairs, to allocate an equal amount of US$ 27.22 million as the Government contribution for this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing new accommodation for the Department of Cultural Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - It has been found that the Department of Cultural Affairs maintained at the Sethsiripaya Building at Battaramulla does not have adequate facilities to accommodate its staff of about 170 and the artistes and  other persons coming from various parts of the Island for the activities pertaining to the 12 institutions affiliated to the said Department. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, to vest the building premises at Kappetipola Mawatha where the Department for Registration of Persons was then located, with the Department of Cultural Affairs to relocate the Department of Cultural Affairs at the said  premises, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of compensation for the vehicles damaged due to the explosion at the Salawa Ammunition Storage
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - The explosion which occurred in the Salawa Ammunition Storage at Kosgama has caused damages to many movable and immovable properties in the area and the Government has taken measures to pay  compensation due for houses, business places, and other various properties so damaged. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources & Disaster Management, to pay  compensation for the vehicles damaged by the said explosion but which have not been provided with the due compensation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of lands with the Police Station in Kottawa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest the block of land in extent of 49.80 perches with the Police Department, to set up the Police Station in Kottawa, which has been vested with the Urban Development Authority (UDA) by the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the construction of the Kandy Multimodal Transport Terminal (KMTT) - Transitional bus operation during the construction of KMTT
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - The construction activities of the Kandy Multimodal Transport Terminal (KMTT) are at the design stage and during its construction period, facilities need to be provided for an uninterrupted bus operation. A time scheduling system has been prepared for the operation of these buses mitigating the traffic congestion in the city and under the 'Sahasara' programme implemented by the  Central Province Passenger Transport Services Authority, it has been planned to upgrade and implement the Information Technology (IT) based bus operating system. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to make use of the proposed Information Technology procedure in the implementation of the above proposals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Lepers Ordinance of 1901
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to enter into an Agreement between Sri Lanka and Oman relating to the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion covering the areas pertaining to interest, royalty and profit motivation on shipping services in anticipation of enhancing economic relations and corporation between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to enter into an Agreement between Sri Lanka and Oman relating to the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion covering the areas pertaining to interest, royalty and profit motivation on shipping services in anticipation of enhancing economic relations and corporation between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet. - (Agenda Item No.26)

During the  Dutch period, leprosy was called as an infectious disease and  due to the unavailability of any treatment for the disease, leprosy patients were segregated from the other people to prevent the spread of the disease. Under the Leapers Ordinance of 1901, segregation of leprosy patients was made compulsory. With the modern treatments, it was found that leprosy could be fully cured and therefore, segregation of patients from the others was suspended from the year 1983.

Even though recovered from the disease, 31 leprosy patients segregated from others under this Ordinance are still residing at the Hendala and Manthivu Leprosy Hospitals. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to amend the Lepers Ordinance of 1901, to provide the necessary facilities enabling the patients to maintain their social relationships, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Agreement between the Government Sri Lanka and the Government of Oman
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to enter into an Agreement between Sri Lanka and Oman relating to the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion covering the areas pertaining to interest, royalty and profit motivation on shipping services in anticipation of enhancing economic relations and corporation between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Temples and Dhamma Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has previously decided to appoint an Officials' Committee to recommend a more appropriate mechanism to be adopted in order to provide facilities for the Temples and Dhamma Schools through out the country, for upgrading their facilities, in a more formal and consistent manner. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to follow the recommendations submitted by the said committee so as to carry out the functions avoiding duplication when the Government provides facilities for the Temples and Dhamma Schools, and also to adopt the same recommendations in facilitating and developing other religious places of worship as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Chemical Weapons Convention Act No.58 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - Since, it has been observed that the implementation of the Chemical Weapons Convention is a subject which is directly related to the National security, the need has arisen to amend the Chemical Weapons Convention Act No.58 of 2007, for the Minister of Defence, to function as the Minister entrusted with the duty of implementing the convention. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to publish the bill drafted to amend the above Act, in the Government Gazette and subsequently to present the same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Security Buildings of the Parliament Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to improve and refurbish the Jayanthipura security building at the main entrance of the Parliament complex and the Pinniyara security building at the rear entrance of the Parliament inclusive of new technological facilities required for the operational activities for the security of  the Parliament complex, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The establishment of 'Haritha Udyana' and a ' Haritha Zone' with jogging tracks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - Under the budget proposals, a sum of Rs.1,500 million has been allocated to establish a 'Haritha Udyana' or a  'Haritha Zone' with a jogging track to cover every Pradeshiya Sabha Division and mainly 54 projects have been identified to be implemented island-wide. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement the 'Haritha Udyana' programme under the supervision of the Urban Development Authority and with the coordination of the relevant Local Authority Institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Impact on accessing medicines due to the price decline on 48 essential medicines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body:
- The National Medicines Regulatory Authority has conducted a data analysis on the market of medicine in the years 2016 and 2017 to investigate the impact caused by the price decline on 48 essential medicines through the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No.1989/61 dated 2016‑10‑21,. Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine brought  the following facts revealed in the said analysis, to the notice of the Cabinet. 

*	that, the patients who have not taken medicines properly as prescribed even on medical advice due to the  increase in the price of the medicines, are now inclined to use medicines in a proper manner and even the use of medicines prescribed especially for the treatment of chronic diseases such as diabetes mellitus and hypertension have increased leading to the augmentation of the overall use of medicines;

*	that, even though it has been predicted that the use of medicines of high quality would decline with the National Medicines Regulatory Authority taking action to regulate the retail price of  around 280 medicinal brand names widely used, the market share of the manufacturers under such brand names has increased considerably and the same under the 'innovator brand' names has increased by around 600% within a period of one year; and
