*	As such, the patients have received the benefits of approximately Rs.4.4 billion up to now, as a result of the relevant regulatory methodology.

description: Construction of the Para Clinical building of the Faculty of Medicine, in the University of Peradeniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The Faculty of Medicine of the University of Peradeniya established in the year 1962 admits around 215 students annually. The construction of a Para Clinical building for the requirement of the students of the faculty has been commenced with an investment of Rs.280 million and by now, the construction work of the  ground floor and the first floor of the building has been completed. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, to add a further 7,200 sq.m. to the building and develop it under the Second Phase of the programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion of the Ashraff Jetty at the port of Trincomalee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The necessity to upgrade the additional berthing space facility of the port of Trincomalee has been found, in order to fulfill the increasing demand for the container facilities of the port concurrent to the industrial development taking place in the Eastern and North Eastern Provinces. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to commence a project, to upgrade the Ashraff Jetty, which is the sole multipurpose  terminal, presently being used for commercial activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Deployment of 1000 Environment Friendly Buses for passenger transport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body:
- Although 7,257 buses should have to be deployed for the daily passenger transportation by the Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB), at present, the SLTB possesses only 6,540 buses. Further, it has also been found that 500 new buses have to be added into the fleet of buses of the SLTB in place of the buses that have to be taken out from the fleet, due to the expiry of their life span or accidents. Measures are being taken presently to procure new 892 buses for the SLTB and it has been found that 1,000 buses have to be immediately purchased to maintain the passenger transportation services uninterruptedly. 

       	The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation,  to enter into an Agreement with the Csepel Holdings Ltd., of Hungary, for the deployment of 250 environment friendly electric buses and 750 Hybrid buses, taking into consideration the proposal submitted for 1,000 electric and hybrid buses to be added to the Sri Lanka Transport Board with the financial assistance of the Government of Hungary and its Export and Import Bank, for the fulfillment of the above requirement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The new programmes proposed for resolving the Elephant-Human Conflict
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - Due to the elephant human conflict, the loss of 375 human lives, 1,177 elephant deaths and 5,800 instances of property damages have been reported during the period of the past 5 years. The attention of the Government has been focused in taking expeditious action to resolve the elephant-human conflict which has become a major problem at present. As such, it has been planned  to erect an electric fence of about 2,651 km in length within the places newly identified as having elephant threats to connect the existing electric fence of about 4,349 km in length at inoperative places, to increase the human resources and the facilities required to formulate a special programme for the safety and the maintenance of the elephant fences and to maintain the newly established electric fence properly. Accordingly, the proposal made by Field Marshal Hon. Sarath Fonseka, the Minister of Sustainable Development, Wildlife and Regional Development, to secure the necessary funds for the purpose to commence the programme in the year 2018 and implement it expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Trade Negotiating Committee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The Government has focused its attention to gain access over to more preferential markets by diversifying the country's exports and to enter into Free Trade Agreements with various countries with the objective of attracting more foreign direct investments.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to establish a National Trade Negotiation Committee comprising of 17 representatives with competency in the relevant subject fields in order to ensure that the most beneficial conditions for the country are incorporated in such Agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka National Youth Voluntary Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - Even though the Voluntary Service activities being prominent in the programmes implemented by the National Youth Services Council, due to the paucity in the proper appreciation for the youth in voluntary services, it has been difficult to avail the participation of the youth in the voluntary programmes any further. As such, it has been proposed to strengthen the youth social movement at the rural, divisional and district level and to train  volunteers, through the International Organizations such as United Nations Volunteers Programme, United Nations Development Programme, Japan International Cooperation Agency, Korean International Cooperation Agency, Red Cross Society.   As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Youth Affairs, Project Management and Southern Development, to appoint a Steering Committee to make policy decisions to formulate a motivating methodology with regard to awarding Gold, Silver and Bronze medals for the volunteer workers who excel in their work and for the volunteers when seeking employment and gaining entrance to universities and other higher educational institutes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of 13 years of Guaranteed Education Programme in the Government Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - Although the primary and secondary level education due to the free education policy has achieved significant improvement in Sri Lanka, it has been observed that approximately, 80,000 students even now leave the school system annually after the results of the G.C.E. (O/L) Examination, deprived of further education or specific vocational skills. As such, the implementation of a programme to secure a certified education continuously for 13 years with the intention of providing a solution to the issue to enable students, regardless of their results at the G.C.E. (O/L) Examination, to continue another two years of school education to gain competency  of at least one subject out of the 26 vocational subjects, has been commenced. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to implement the said programme from the year 2019 in 860 schools island-wide and to secure the necessary facilities for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of the lands of the National Institute of Education and the Aesthetic Education Institute belonging to it established in the land at Meepe in Padukka with the National Institute of Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, to vest the land in extent of 17.53 acres in Maharagama where the National Institute of Education is situated and the land in extent of 16.26 acres where the Aesthetic Education Institute is situated at Meepe in Padukka, formally with the National Institute of Education, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relocation of the Matara Prison in the Kotawilawatta Area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - As the accommodation facilities in the Matara prison are not adequate, it has been planned to relocate the prison at the Kotawilawatta area. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to secure a sum of Rs.2,950 million within the Medium Term Budgetary Framework needed for the construction of the prison complex with basic facilities to accommodate 700 inmates including other facilities such as officers' quarters, barracks, water supply and electricity, CCTV and utilities, sewerage treatment and other facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expediting the completion of the partial houses under the 'Virusumithuru' Housing Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to implement the 'Virusumithuru' Housing Project to construct 1,950 complete houses and 1,700 partial houses within the period from 2017 to 2020 to address the housing needs of the immediate family members of the war heroes who laid their lives and disabled in combat. At this instance, the labour cost for the construction of a complete house was assessed at Rs.4 million and a partial house at Rs.2 million  and it was decided for the three Army Forces, the Police and the Civil Security Department to provide the labour contribution so needed. Although, the labour contribution of the security forces could be obtained for the construction of complete houses, it has been difficult to get such contribution for the construction of partial houses as anticipated. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to provide Government financial contribution to the beneficiaries instead of the labour contribution of the security forces to expedite the completion of partial houses under this programme and to set apart the provision necessary to complete 1,649 of such houses, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the National Land Use Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The existence of a Land Use Policy formulated on a more scientific basis has been identified by the Government for the fulfillment of the daily increasing human requirements within Sri Lanka which has an extent of 6.55 million hectares of limited land, the implementation of the national economic development strategies and to maintain the proper environmental equilibrium. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms, to analyze and amend the existing land use policy approved in the year 2007 to suit the present trends with the contribution of all relevant stakeholders, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a 03 storey barrack at the Gonahena Camp of the Special Task Force
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - A large number of officers of the Special Task Force of the Sri Lanka Police has been deployed for special security tasks in Colombo and its suburbs. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Management and Law & Order, seeking further provision to construct a 03 storey building equipped with modern facilities so as to provide the officers with residential facilities due to the lack of residential facilities for such officers by replacing the dilapidated building in the Gonahena Camp, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of 6 Milk Processing Centers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The Government has focused its attention towards the development of 06 milk processing centers with the objective of promoting the dairy industry. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Rural Economic Affairs, to enter into an agreement with Boccard of France to develop 06 milk processing centers under a loan facility from the French Investment Bank, Netixis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the quality of the Higher Education Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The 05 Universities established by Parliamentary Acts under various Ministries  are functioning in order to provide the Sri Lankan students with higher educational opportunities in addition to the 15 universities regulated by the University Grants Commission. Due to limited facilities prevalent in the Government Higher Educational Institutions, 16 universities in all, with foreign universities which award degrees in collaboration with the said Higher Educational Institutions and the universities including those which have been granted approval to award their degrees are also functioning in Sri Lanka. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, to draft the necessary legislation to establish the Quality Assurance and Accreditation Commission with a view to ensuring the quality and consistency in the Higher Education Sector by assuring the accreditation and quality in all these  Educational Institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing housing facilities for veteran artists and establishing a China- Sri Lanka Museum
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The Government of China has agreed to provide the necessary funds to construct 108 houses to provide housing facilities for veteran artists and to establish a museum to reflect the historical China-Sri Lanka relationship on a request made by Hon. Karu Jayasuriya, the Speaker of Parliament of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement the project under the financial grants provided by the Government of China, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Deploying luxury buses for public transportation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - As a major step towards reducing the huge traffic congestion prevailing in the Western Province at present, it is necessary to attract the passengers using private vehicles for transportation towards public transportation services. Accordingly, the Bus Priority Lanes are functioning successfully at present enabling passengers to minimize their travel time. In order to further improve  this situation, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to grant concessionary loans for the bus owners under the Enterprise Sri Lanka Programme to motivate them to deploy Air Conditioned Low-Floor Luxury and Safety buses in place of the buses used for public transportation at present, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Pilgrims' Facility and Landscape Improvement Project at Sellakatharagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to secure the funds required for the  implementation of a project to improve common amenities for pilgrims visiting Sellakatharagama and Landscape Improvement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Lands required for the Embilipitiya Town Centre Development and Urban Park Development Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The rapid development projects implemented in the Hambantota town, have resulted in a rapid development in the Embilipitiya town which is located at close proximity to Hambantota. Accordingly, the Embilipitiya Town Centre Development plan has been designed to implement the projects required to upgrade the infrastructure facilities of the Embilipitiya town. Through the proposed plan, it is anticipated to develop the Kawanthissa wewa and the surrounding area under the Town Centre Development project and upgrade a Children's park, road development and other infrastructure facilities. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest the lands required to implement the proposed two projects, with the Urban Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme to Grant Houses for the Middle Income Sector for an affordable price
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The Government has focused attention on the supply of houses for the increasing housing demand of  the Middle income community. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement a housing project of 1,900 housing units, in the areas of Kottawa, Orugodawatta, Anuradhapura, Nuwara Eliya, Awissawella and Horana, to meet the housing requirements of the professionals and the Executive Grade Officers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement with the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Morocco on Visa exemption for holders of Diplomatic, Official and Service Passports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of  Internal Affairs & Wayamba Development to enter into an Agreement with the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Morocco on Visa exemption for holders of Diplomatic, Official and Service Passports, for their visits between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading of the Kuliyapitiya Base Hospital into a Teaching Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - Concurrent to the proposal of granting a new medical faculty for the Wayamba University as proposed in the Budget Proposals 2017, it has been planned to upgrade the Kuliyapitiya Base Hospital into a Teaching Hospital, in order to make provision for the required facilities for the clinical training for the students who enter the proposed faculty. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to upgrade the Kuliyapitiya Base Hospital into a fully-fledged Teaching Hospital with all necessary facilities so as to provide a high quality clinical training, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Report on the Government Revenue and Expenditure in the First Quarter of the Financial year 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - Since the year 2017, a trimester report on the actual expenditure and revenue of the Government is submitted to Parliament. Accordingly, Rupees 403 billion has been incurred (except public debt financing) in the first quarter of the financial year 2018 and it is equivalent to 91% of the target expenditure in the quarter. The Government has accumulated the revenue of Rupees 469 billion within the quarter and it consists of Rupees 425 billion from taxes and Rupees 44 billion from non-tax sources which amounts to 90.2% of the anticipated revenue within the quarter. At the same time, 561 projects out of 1,354 operated in the first quarter of the year 2018 have achieved more than 75% of the physical progress against the target of the quarter and it has been reported that the physical progress of 444 projects is less than 25%. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Me6dia, to table these information in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Amendments to the Institute of Valuers of Sri Lanka Law, No.33 of 1975
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to publish the Bill drafted in accordance with the approval of the Cabinet granted to update the Institute of Valuers of Sri Lanka Law, No.33 of 1975 to suit the present socio-economic conditions, in the Government Gazette and subsequently to present the said Bill, thereafter, in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting a feasibility study on the construction of the Civil Airport at Digana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to conduct a feasibility study on the construction of a domestic airport in Maberiyatenna of Digana in the Kandy District for the  operation of medium size aircrafts linking the Kandy City and the other ares of the Island, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Maintenance and Improvement of the Provincial Roads
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to secure funds amounting to US$ 125 million from the International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank for the improvement of the Road Management Capacities of the Road Development Authority and the improvement of selected roads. However, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to make use of US$ 100 million out of the funds allocated for the essential maintenance and improvement to be made in the provincial roads island-wide expeditiously and secure the project management services required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion and improvement of the Daycare Facilities for Children
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The Government has planned to establish 2,000 daycare centres with the objective of providing high standard daycare facilities for children at divisional level, in association with the private sector. With a view to attracting the human resources and investment required for the purpose, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs and Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, to formulate a concessionary loan scheme under the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' for providing the fund assistance and  the other necessary assistance to the investors to expand and improve the daycare facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of Terms of Reference of the Joint Russian - Sri Lankan Working group on Military - Technical Cooperation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to sign the Terms of Reference containing the  functions and conditions of  the Joint Russian - Sri Lankan Working group on Military - Technical Cooperation proposed to be established as per the Agreement  on Military - Technical Cooperation signed between Russian Federation and Sri Lanka in 2004, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prepairing a legal framework on marine security services provided by the Sri Lanka Navy for foreign Merchant Vessels
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - International merchant vessels deploy armed Sea Marshalls to protect the vessels from the attacks of pirates. Ports of Colombo and Galle are used for embarkation of Sea Marshalls in vessels traveling to the high risk areas of threats and for disembarkation of those Sea Marshalls coming in Vessels through such high risk areas. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to regulate the transportation and storage of weaponry and ammunition belonging to the said Private Maritime Security Services upon the operational requirement under the supervision and security of the Sri Lanka Navy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief  for the Householders affected by the water leak at the main tunnel of the Uma Oya Multi Purpose Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval to pay the monthly rental to the Householders affected by the Uma Oya Multi Purpose Development Project subject to a maximum period of 06 months.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to extend the present payment of rent presently paid to the householders until such time these householders are provided with alternative lands to reside, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Consortium Consultancy Services for the Refurbishment of the Parliament Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-08-07
decision_details_body: - 	The Parliament building complex at Sri Jayawardenapura has been constructed in the year 1982 and during the past 35 years, no major refurbishments have been carried out in the building complex. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to obtain the consultancy services for the refurbishment of the Parliament building complex identified to be done expeditiously, through the Urban Development Authority considering the recommendations of the Staff Advisory Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proclamation and development of the Shrine of Our lady of Madu as a sacred area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The Shrine of Our lady of Madu is a historic site of religious worship of the Catholic devotees and where devotees of other religions pay homage as well. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to launch special development projects encompassing this area inclusive of the protection of the religious place, proclamation of this Shrine of Our Lady of Madu as a sacred area, with the provision of necessary facilities for the visitors, developing transport facilities, road access, sanitation, drainage system and provision of special amenities such as accommodation, pilgrim rests for the people from the other areas visiting the Madu Shrine, treating it as a timely need, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling for bids from the competent International Oil Companies for petroleum exploration, development and production of the Mannar and Cauvery basins
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - It has been found that a significant economic benefit can be gained with the use of oil and gas extracted from the local resources as an energy resource and the oil companies and the Geo Scientists have shown great interest and attracted to the areas of Mannar and Cauvery basins believed to possess petroleum.       Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Petroleum Resources Development,  to call for bids from the International Oil Companies for petroleum exploration, development and production activities in the areas where the petroleum reserves are expected to exist, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of 750 Jeeps for the Sri Lanka Police
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Management and Law & Order, to purchase 600 Jeeps for the Sri Lanka Police and 150 of same for the Police Special Task Force from the Indian Line of Credit to further enhance the services provided by the Sri Lanka Police to the General Public, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the contract for providing the consultancy services for the supervision of  the project for the re-construction of 25 bridges
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development, to award the contract for providing consultancy services for  the construction supervision of contract package 02 pertaining to the Project for the Reconstruction of 25 Bridges funded by the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development (KFAED), to Dr. Nabeel Abdul-Raheem Consultants (NARCO) Joint Venture formed with the Resources Development Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Kuwait Dinar 118,440 and Rs.169.2 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee (CPCC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer - 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: -      The state owned Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited (Lak Pohora) and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Limited (Commercial Fertilizer) have taken measures to call for bids by following the International Open Competitive bidding procedure, for procuring chemical fertilizer on the market requirements. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to award the above contract to procure 30,000 MT of Urea of each amounting to US$ 292.38 to the Livan Agrichem International Pvt. Ltd,  3,000 MT of Muriate of Potash of each amounting to  US $ 317.75 to the Agricultural Resources and Investment Pvt. Ltd and 15,000 MT of Triple Super Phosphate of each amounting to US$ 324.30 to the Golden Bali International Pvt. Ltd, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bingiriya-Udubaddawa Water Supply Project - Phase 1
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to implement the Bingiriya-Udubaddawa Water Supply Project for the supply of pipe water for 76 Grama Niladhari Divisions in the Kuliyapitiya East, Udubaddawa, Pannala and Bingiriya Divisional Secretariat Divisions as a remedial measure to the issue of the quality of the  water from the dug up wells in some areas in the Kurunegala District. Under the  Phase 1 of this project, a pump house will be constructed which can pump 36,500 cum of raw water daily and produce 34,500 cum of treated water daily. The people in the Bingiriya Investment Zone and 33 Grama Niladhari Divisions in the Pannala, Makandura, Kuliyapitiya and Udubaddawa will reap the benefits under this project. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to call for requests for proposals from the Budapest Waterworks Zrt and the Hungarian Water Cluster for the implementation of the Phase 1 of this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of materials (Sarees) necessary for granting Uniforms to the female Dhamma School Teachers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The strict attention of the Government has been focused towards enhancing the  qualitative aspect of the Dhamma education in Sri Lanka in order to generate a virtuous generation. The distribution of uniforms among the Dhamma school teachers who voluntarily provide Dhamma education to the Dhamma school children has been carried out uninterruptedly since the year 2004 up to now. A proposal has been made to provide the female teachers serving in Dhamma schools with sarees even for the year 2018. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana,  to procure 64,000 sarees required for this programme from the Department of Textiles for a sum of Rs.103.04 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Supply of 13,000 Vials of Tenecteplase Injection 40mg Vial
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the procurement for the supply of 13,000 Vials of Tenecteplase Injection 40mg Vials used to prevent a person's  death suffering from a heart attack, to Boehringer Ingelheim India Private Limited of India for a sum of US$ 5.525 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of the ownership of the Mahaoya-Aralaganwila Road to the Road Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The Mahaoya-Aralaganwila Road 23km in length used for the transport of passengers and goods between the districts of Ampara and Polonnaruwa, is laid across a land belonging to the Department of Wildlife Conservation and subsequently it has been developed by laying bituminous carpet. Since this road has not been assigned to any Authority for its maintenance, is in a dilapidated condition and the passengers who use this road have to face severe difficulties. Taking into consideration the above and with the objective of maintaining the road in a proper manner, the proposal made by Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Social Welfare and Primary Industries, to vest the land used for the Mahaoya-Aralaganwila Road with the Road Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Training and Research Centre for the promotion of Beekeeping Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka possesses a huge potential in promoting the Beekeeping industry which is regarded as a very profitable industry. However, due to the lack of scientific knowledge on beekeeping, presently it is carried out in an unorganized manner in Sri Lanka. Consequently, the production of honey is at a low ebb and bee honey is imported to meet the local demand. Taking these matters into consideration, it has been planned to establish 200,000 beekeeping units at the first stage, for the revitalization of the beekeeping industry. Under this, around 1,000 farmers have been trained as of now and beekeeping boxes have been distributed among them. With a view to further expanding the beekeeping industry, to generate new employment opportunities and means of income for a group of about 200,000, the proposal for the establishment of a state of the art Training and Research Centre in the Dambetenna Grama Niladhari Division made by Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Social Welfare and Primary Industries to be implemented as a Joint Project in association with the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Social Welfare and Primary Industries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Local Development Support Project (2019 - 2022)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - With a view to uplifting the economic status of 101 Local Authorities belonging to the Northern, Eastern, North Central, North Western and the Uva provinces, 1,214 sub projects had been completed successfully at an investment of US$ 106 million and it has been found that further economic infrastructure facilities have to be provided to these areas for the alleviation of poverty and further expansion of the economy. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils, Local Government and Sports, to implement the Local Development Support Project under the World Bank loan assistance of US$ 50 million and the Grant of Euro 22.5 million by the European Union, covering 34 Local Government Authorities of the Northern Province, 45 Local Government Authorities of the Eastern Province, 27 Local Government Authorities of the North Central Province and 28 Local Government Authorities of the Uva Province, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The project for the establishment of the Bogambara Prison in Pallekale
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The relocation of the Bogambara Prison in Pallekale was carried out in the year 2013 and out of the activities of the Master Plan prepared for the purpose, there are a large number of essential development activities which have either not been completed up to date or  not commenced as yet to be further carried out. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to implement the construction of the essential facilities such as buildings, official quarters, hospitals, sanitary and utility facility systems, internal roads etc., which are included in the Master Plan of the relocation of the Bogambara Prison in Pallekale and which have not been completed, as the second stage of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Remand Prison at Wariyapola
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - In the Remand Prison of Wariyapola where around 500 detainees are detained daily, the suspects and the remand prisoners, awaiting to be produced before the Courts in the Kurunegala District are also detained there and it is found that the  accommodation therein is inadequate for these detainees. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to secure the financial provision required for the improvement of the Wariyapola Remand Prison within the Medium Term Budgetary Framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the training facilities of the Katukurunda Training School of the Special Task Force of the Sri Lanka Police
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The Katukurunda Training School in Kalutara is functioning as the central training school of the Special Task Force of Sri Lanka. Sliding down on a rope or string using the Abseiling Tower and mountain climbing are a part of the challenging training sessions conducted at this school. The Abseiling Tower which is being presently used is about 31 years old and since the strength of same has also been weakened, certain challenging sessions have been stopped  considering the risk of accidents involved during the training activities. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Management and Law & Order, to expeditiously construct an Abseiling Tower with modern facilities for the Katukurunda Training School, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the “Diyawara Neyo” mobile service and accelerated irrigation maintenance programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The Government has focused its attention to provide the required irrigation water adequately for the agricultural activities of the farmers affected due to the drought that prevailed over 03 years in certain areas of the Island and for the success of the Maha Season 2018/2019. Accordingly, a proposal has been made to implement the “Diyawara Neyo” mobile service programme with a view to expanding irrigation facilities by resolving expeditiously the long term issues existing in the irrigation system and rehabilitating the dilapidated canals. This programme is proposed to be implemented with the active contribution of the farmers' community. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources & Disaster Management, to conduct mobile services within the Regional Irrigation Engineer Divisions with the participation of the farmer community and the political authority and to implement the accelerated irrigation maintenance programmes to resolve the issues pertaining to the irrigation networks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Sri Lanka Electricity Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to publish the Bill drafted to amend the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No.20 of 2009 as amended by the Act, No.31 of 2013, with the objective of overcoming the impediments in procuring the electricity generated by the renewable energy resources, in the Government Gazette and to present the same subsequently, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the title of the 'Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation' as 'Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The Colombo District (Low-lying Areas) Reclamation and Development Board was established under the Act No.15 of 1968, with a view to designing plans for developing the low-lying areas of the Colombo District for such areas to be rendered suitable for building purposes and its title was amended as Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation by the amendment Act No.52 of 1982. At present, the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation not only deals with the matters pertaining to the Colombo District but the entire country as well without limiting its activities to land reclamation purposes and makes a tremendous and exceptional contribution to all development activities in the country. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to amend its title as “Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation”, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a state-of-the-art high capacity store building for the Medical Supplies Division
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The Medical Supply Division (MSD) of  the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine is entrusted with the responsibility of supplying of all items inclusive of  pharmaceutical, surgical, laboratory and radioactive items to all Government Healthcare Institutions and further the MSD also supplies  dangerous drugs to all private and Government hospitals including private medical clinics. Even though the MSD at Wellawatta, Colombo possesses 30 large warehouses and 06 distribution units, it has been found that adequate facilities are not available in the said Division for the effective functioning of the medical services. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to construct a building with storage facilities in the premises of the National Hospital for Respiratory Diseases at Welisara within a land area of 04 acres with an investment of  Rs.2,255 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new building for the National Medicines Regulatory Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to allocate a block of land in extent of 27.24 perches located at Thimbirigasyaya area for the construction of the Head Office building and the National Quality Assurance Laboratory of the National Medicines Regulatory Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Fortification of common staple foods with Iron and Folic Acid to reduce Anaemia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The Anaemia condition caused by iron deficiency has been a major health issue in Sri Lanka and the fatigue and lethargy caused by anaemia reduces the performance of an individual. Even now, iron tablets are given to pregnant mothers and school children to prevent anaemia. To address the situation it has been discovered that the anaemia condition can be reduced with the addition of Iron to the commonly consumed foods.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to appoint a committee comprising of the Officials of the relevant Ministries to study and report on the implementation of a programme on the fortification of rice and wheat flour with Iron and Folic Acid and submit a report, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the proposed Centre for Speech and Hearing and the National Cancer Screening Centre by M/s Dialog Axiata PLC - Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to construct a four storey building in Narahenpita for the establishment of a special centre equipped with modern facilities to detect the symptoms of hearing and speech problems of children and elders and treat them and for the National Cancer Screening Centre to prevent cancer and the early detection of  cancer symptoms, at a cost of Rs.146 million, with the funds provided by the Government and the financial sponsorship of the M/s Dialog Axiata PLC, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting relief to small scale Rice millers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - The small and medium scale Rice millers have to encounter financial difficulties since the financial requirements for their  day to day business can not be met from the banks due to their failure to settle the loans obtained earlier. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to provide credit facilities to the small and medium scale Rice millers through the Millers Cooperative Federation who have failed to settle the previous bank loans without taking legal action against them, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Temperature Controlled Warehouse facility in the Dambulla area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct a temperature controlled warehouse facility in the Dambulla area where the farm products could be stored to retain their fresh quality longer preventing the post-harvest losses, so that the consumers could purchase food products at a reasonable price and to maintain the stability in the price of crops, fruits, vegetables and onions etc. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs and Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to establish this storage facility under the grants of the Indian Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Air Force Fire Extinguishing Unit
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-31
decision_details_body: - It has been decided to establish the Sri Lanka Air Force Fire Extinguishing Unit which was located at the D.R Wijewardane Mawatha, Colombo in another location according to the Colombo Megapolis Master Plan and the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to relocate the said unit in a state owned land in extent of 1 acre called Bakeriya Watta situated at Narahenpita, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Debt Relief for Micro Finance Loans Granted for women in Drought Affected Districts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - The Micro Finance Institutions are providing micro finance loans to women adopting a door to door strategy  of interest rate amounting to 40 percent to 220 percent per annum. Due to the unfeasible high risk in Economic activities and loans granted for consumption purposes, the micro finance loan recipients in the rural sector have fallen into a debt-trap and it has become a serious crisis at present. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to implement a debt relief programme to coincide with the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' for the emancipation of women living in the drought affected Districts, of the said indebtedness, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of Compensation to the damaged properties and damaged places of worship due to the disturbances that occurred at Ginthota and Ampara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Resettlement, Rehabilitation, Northern Development & Hindu Religious Affairs, to pay compensation to the damaged properties and damaged places of worship due to the disturbances that occurred at Ginthota in the last year and in Ampara during this year, also taking into consideration, the methodology adopted in granting compensation in similar situations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of Additional Maize Quantity required for the Production of Animal Feed
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - It has been forecasted that approximately 500,000 metric tons of maize would be required for the production of animal feed in the year 2018. However, it has been estimated that, the maize production for the Maha Season of 2018 would be around 150,000 MT while the Yala Season production would be around 30,000 MT. As such, the joint proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, and Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Rural Economic Affairs, to import a 50,000 MT of maize by the National Food Promotion Board to be utilized for the production of animal food and to impose a trade tax of Rs 10/- per 1 kg of maize, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting of the 17th General Conference of the Asia Pacific Institute for Broadcasting Development in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - With a view to creating a vibrant and modern electronic media environment, the Asia Pacific Institute for Broadcasting Development has been established and it also serves as a media consultancy institute for the member countries. The Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation has the full membership of the institute since the year 1982 and derives the benefit of its technological and training opportunities. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to conduct the 17th General Conference of this Institute in Sri Lanka in August, 2018 and for the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation to host the Conference, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Exemption of  cost for the Health Care Services from the Value Added Tax (VAT)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - The Value Added Tax (VAT) was imposed on the provision of Health Care Services such as Consultation fees, hospital room charges, Chanelling fees and payments to the medical professional by the Value Added Tax (Amendment) Act, No.20 of 2016 and it was decided to remove the VAT on other Health Care Services except the hospital room charges with effect from 2018‑07‑02. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to present the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2078/6 dated 2018‑07‑02 issued for the purpose in Parliament, under the provisions of the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Court Complexes in Ratnapura and Killinochchi
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - The attention has been focused on the construction work of the Ratnapura Court Complex to be carried out expeditiously due to the apparent congestion prevalent in the Courts and the dilapidated state of the buildings and the alarming risk of landslides in the area. Similarly, it has been identified that the Killinochchi Court Complex has also to be provided with adequate infrastructure facilities to expand the building. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to award the contract of the construction of both the Ratnapura and the Killinochchi Court Complexes to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Modernization of the electrical cable system of the Government Factory in, Kolonnawa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - The low voltage underground electrical cable system which is presently being used to obtain electricity for the Department of the Government Factory which provides specific mechanical services to various Government institutions has to be modernized. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to implement the proposed project at a cost of Rs.34.6 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for the construction of the Colombo 'B' Grid Substation, installation of the In and Out electricity connection from the cable between the Kolonnawa and the Colombo 'C' Grid Substations and the improvement of the Kolonnawa and Colombo 'C' Grid Substations under the Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme, to M/s Hyosung Corporation for a sum of Rs.1,260.78 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of facilities of the Swami Vipulananda Institute of Aesthetic Studies affiliated to the Eastern University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - Action has been taken to expand the educational activities of the Swami Vipulananda Institute of Aesthetic Studies affiliated to the Eastern University of Sri Lanka enabling the students to follow courses such as Drama and Theatre, Visual and Technological Arts, as well, in addition to the fields of Music and Dance. As such, the need for the improvement of the infrastructure facilities of the institution to suite the present day educational courses and the necessities have been recognized. Therefore, it has been planned to provide infrastructure facilities including the refurbishment of the auditorium, the construction of a building complex with audio and video recording cum editing facilities and other infrastructure facilities necessary for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, to implement this project with the Indian Rs.275 million grant provided by the Government of India as a financial assistance and Rs.60.7 million as a total investment granted by the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 5000 Rails for Railway Network
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the procurement of 5000 EN 45 E1 Rails required for the Railway Network to M/s. Angang Group International Panzhima Co. Ltd., for a sum of US$ 2.13 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply, Installation and Commissioning of a Communication System for the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) and the Ratmalana Airport (RMA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the supply, installation and commissioning of a Communication System to enhance the efficiency of the operations at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) and the Ratmalana Airport (RMA) to M/s SITTI S. P. A, for a sum of Euro 1.7 million and Rupees 6 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Installation of the an Information Technology Application System for the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to commence a new procurement process for the procurement of two insurance systems based on the information technology to be utilized for life insurance and general insurance purposes, with a view to enhancing the efficiency of the business operational activities of the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Limited and providing more qualitative insurance services while maintaining a highly competitive market environment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conservation of the Nilwala River Basin
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - Kotapola and Pitabaddara areas where the highest rain fall in the Matara District received, suffer from frequent floods. In addition to the loss of lives and property resulting in from the flood situation, damages are caused to the Nilwala river basin, the bridges constructed across the river as well as the roads running parallel to the river. In order to minimize these damages, it has been planned to rehabilitate the Nilwala river bank and to develop and conserve the banks by planting trees such as Mee and Kumbuk. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Youth Affairs, Project Management and Southern Development, to conserve the river basin of the Nilwala river from Pitabaddara to Kotapola with an investment of Rs.62 million for the purpose with the assistance also of the Ministry of Irrigation and Water Resources & Disaster Management, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing facilities to the temporary shelters for providing protection to women victims of violence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with the institutes of 'Women in Need' and the 'Jaffna Social Action Centre' for the administration of the temporary shelters established in Jaffna, Mullaitivu, Batticaloa, Colombo and Matara for providing protection to women victims of violence. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, for the Government to provide competent staff and the other necessary facilities for the systematic management of these centres, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Utilization of the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' and the 'Gamperaliya' National Programmes for the livelihood development of the beneficiaries in the Model Villages
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - Through the Model Village Programme implemented under the Ministry of Housing and Construction, various programmes are carried out to build up the future of the low income people in addition to providing the ownership of a house. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to formulate the rural livelihood development plans in such a way to enable the use of the model villages for the livelihood development of the beneficiaries and to launch the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' and the 'Gamperaliya' National Programmes, of such villages and so as to ensure a mode of livelihood for each and every beneficiary in those villages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new building for the Kekirawa Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - Kekirawa Police Station is one which provides services to approximately 62,650 people living in 50  Grama Niladhari Divisions. There are 80 Police Officers serving in this Police Station and the building presently used for this purpose is a very old one with inadequate facilities. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Management and Law & Order, to construct a new state of the art building for the Police Station, in order to bring out a more productive service for the people of the area, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Empowerment of the Rubber Smallholders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - The local natural rubber production has declined due to the drop in the price of natural rubber in the International Market during the past period. Special programmes have to be implemented to protect approximately 130,000 of rubber smallholders and also to further retain them in the Rubber Plantation Sector. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to provide a tool kit along with the equipment tools and accessories manufactured and developed by the Rubber Research Institute of Sri Lanka worth of Rs.5,000/- each to 10,000 members of the 'Thurusaviya' Societies within the two years of 2018 2019, which will assist in enhancing the production productivity, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Brand Promotion Scheme for the pure Ceylon Tea Exports : 2018/2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to implement a brand promotion programme, with a view to further promoting the pure Ceylon Tea with the Lion logo, in accordance with the budget proposal for the year 2015. Accordingly, Agreements have been entered into with 19 Companies pertaining to the matter and in respect of which, about Rs.177 million had been incurred. The Ceylon Tea Board has planned to extend this promotion scheme also to the year 2018/2019. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to set apart a sum of Rs.500 million from the funds of the Ceylon Tea Board, to reimburse an amount of 50% to those Tea Export Companies/Exporters with full local ownership, who meet the relevant qualifications to promote the private brand names concurrent to the Global Tea Promotion programme planned by the Ceylon Tea Board, from the  promotion cost to be incurred by them, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project on Climate Smart Irrigated Agriculture (2018 - 2024)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - A large extent of paddy land is cultivated under small lakes, small irrigation canals consisting of anicuts and streams and a considerable number of families  through these also make their living.  Since these paddy lands are easily vulnerable to climatic changes, 789 small tanks have been identified for rehabilitation under 53 Ellanga Networks spread over 11 Districts of the dry zone have been identified for rehabilitation for resistance to climate changes.  Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to implement a project with a total investment of US$ 140 million within the period of 2018 - 2024 also with the assistance of the World Bank Funds, with the objective of enhancing the productivity of the cultivable lands under the above tanks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Kandy Multimodel Transport Terminal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct the Kandy Multimodel Transport Terminal for the improvement of the qualitative aspect of the Public transportation services in the Kandy city. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to secure a sum of Rs.1,460 million for the construction of a four (04) storey and a seven (07) storey building to relocate the buildings of the Department of the Sri Lanka Railways affected by the implementation of the project and also to construct a vehicle park for the pilgrims coming to the Dalada Maligawa, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Air Services Agreements with Hellenic Republic (Greece) and Italy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-24
decision_details_body: - The proposals made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to sign the initialed Bilateral Air Services Agreements with the Republic of Greece and the Italian Republic by an accredited representative of Sri Lanka and thereafter take appropriate measures for the entry into force of these Agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Creation of awareness among the public  on the massive investments being made in the field of Irrigation Works under the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - The Mahaweli Development Programme largely contributes to the development of the country for a period of three decades and  after the present Government was elected to power, the construction work of the massive irrigation schemes of Moragahakanda and Kalu ganga reservoirs, which were not yet completed under the Mahaweli Development Scheme and small scale reservoirs of Maha Kithula, Maha Kirula, Alikota-Ara, Handapanagala, Dayaraba, and Puhulpola and  the North Central Maha Ela, Wayamba Maha Ela and Minipe Maha Ela, as the largest ever schemes in the 21st  century are nearing completion, under an investment of Rs.200/- million. However, with the construction of Moragahakanda Power Plant, Uma Oya Underground Hydro Power Plant and Solar power plants established at the surface of reservoirs, it has also been planned to generate 1000 MW of power to the national power grid within the next two years. Further, measures are being taken to implement a massive programme which supplies irrigation and drinking water requirements to the villages through 2,400 rural tanks, by rehabilitating thousands of old Ellanga systems which had been constructed for the preservation of rain water. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to create awareness among the public on the massive investment programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mid - Year Fiscal Position Report - 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to present the Mid - Year Fiscal Position Report which contains updated information on the Government's Fiscal Position pertaining to the first four (04) months of 2018 as stipulated in Section 10 of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No.03 of 2003, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of 93,767nos. of Foldable Hydrophobic Intra Ocular Lenses
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the procurement for the purchase    of 93,767 Foldable Hydrophobic Intra Ocular Lenses which are to be implanted in the eye during cataract surgery to M/s Hemas Pharmaceuticals (Pvt.) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.1,062.2 million as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of 120,000 Bottles of Human Albumin Solution - 50ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the procurement for the purchase of 120,000 bottles of  Human Albumin Solution BP/PH EUR, 20% in 50ml, a drug used for the treatment of kidney patients, to M/s Shire Singapore Pte. Ltd. for US$ 2.82 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) and the Procurement Appeal Board (PAB), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Printing of School Textbooks to be distributed free of charge among the 	school children for the year 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to deliver the school textbooks scheduled to be distributed to the schools prior to 2018-11-04 free of charge to the school children for the year 2019.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to award the contract for the printing of 39.7 million copies of school text books  in 419 categories to 27 local printing institutions  for a sum of Rs.3,473.1 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of  the Kokilai Bridge
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: Construction of a new bridge and approaches across Kokilai  Lagoon provides the people living in Trincomalee and its suburbs with an easy access to Jaffna and through which the distance of travel from Mullaitivu to Trincomalee will be reduced by around 80 km.  Accordingly, the Joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, and Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development, to award the Contract for the construction of Kokilai Bridge and approaches across Kokilai Lagoon on Mullaitivu - Kokilai - Pulmudai road, to Bilfinger MCE Slany s.r.o of Czech Republic for a sum of Euro 48.8 million as per the Cabinet decision made in 2014 in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of LED Lamps (Light Emitting Diode Lamps) for a concessionary price to  electricity consumers who consume less electricity
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - Under the National Programme for the Demand Side Energy Management, it has been planned to distribute LED Lamps among the consumers who consume  less electricity on a concessionary basis with a view to encouraging the popular use of the efficient LED Lamps. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the tender for the supply of 10 consignments of 1 million LED Lamps for a sum of Rs.169.6 million per consignment to M/s Rang Dong Light Source & Vacuum Flask Company, in Vietnam, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Ambathale Water Pumping Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - The Ambathale Water Pumping Station Project due to be implemented with a view to providing a qualitative water supply service, is a sub project identified under the Metro Colombo Region Development Project.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the contract for the Design and Building of the Ambathale Water Pumping Station to M/s SALCON ENGINEERING BERHAD of Malaysia for a sum of Rs.1,181.5 million (excluding tax), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Light Rail Transit Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body:
- The introduction of a Light Rail Transit System for the establishment of an effective and productive transport service within the Colombo Megapolis area is one of the major components in the Western Region Megapolis Master Plan.  Under this, it has been planned to construct 07 Light Railway Transit Lines and out of them, the line which links Colombo Fort area with other major cities and the line extended to the area of Battaramulla and Malabe have been identified as priority roads.
	

Due to the high congestion in these areas, the Government of Sri Lanka has requested financial assistance from Japan to construct these lines as two elevated Light Railway Transit Lines. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement a Light Rail Transit Project with 16 stations and a Depot 17km in length, from Malabe to the Multi Model Transport Hub (MMTH) in Colombo Fort, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Ten Storey Building at the Provincial General Hospital in Badulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - The Provincial General Hospital in Badulla equipped with 1,493 beds and 41 wards, is the largest Health Service providing institution in the Uva Province. Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to implement an Accident and Emergency Care Project, and to construct a Cardiac Catheterization Laboratory with Auxiliary Clinical Services at the Hospital. Accordingly, a proposal has been made to construct a new ten‑storey building in the hospital premises to establish surgical/medical ward facilities and cardiac treatment facilities as well as the proposed Accident and Emergency Care Unit. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the construction of the ten‑storey building to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), with an investment of Rs.3,958.2 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Stage II of the Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the Teaching Hospital in Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - As Stage II of the Construction of a five storey building for the Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the Teaching Hospital in Jaffna, the construction activities of the 2nd floor up to the 5th floor of the said building has been planned to be constructed. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the construction work of Stage II of the Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the Teaching Hospital in Jaffna to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau and the Central Engineering Services Private Limited, for a sum of Rs.1,224.6 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Gas Cylinders used by the Litro Gas Lanka Ltd., for the distribution of Gas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Public Enterprise & Kandy City Development to purchase 656,298 of LP Gas Cylinders (of different sizes) with safety valves used by the Litro Gas Lanka Ltd., for distribution purposes, from M/s Mauriya Udyog Ltd., in India for a sum of Rs.2,057.1 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Elephant Retention Centre to retain the two elephants living in the Sinharaja Reserve
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - The damage caused by the two elephants presently remaining in the Sinharaja World Heritage Reserve, to the lives and properties of the villagers living closer to the said reserve is gradually increasing. In this background, the attention of the Government has been focused to take expeditious measures to protect the two elephants and the lives and the properties of the villagers living closer to the Reserve. Accordingly, the proposal made by Field Marshal Hon. Sarath Fonseka, the Minister of Sustainable Development, Wildlife and Regional Development, to reserve and maintain an area of land in extent of 36 hectares situated in the Parugala area of the Dolekanda Grama Niladhary Division in Kalawana with environmental conditions suitable for the retention of the two elephants, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Deniyaya Weekly Fair
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: The proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Youth Affairs, Project Management and Southern Development, to improve and develop the  Deniyaya Weekly Fair which is present in a dilapidated condition as a trade complex with 80 to 120 shops inclusive of a new road net work around the  trade complex and proper sanitary facilities with a view to providing necessary facilities for daily commuters of 25,000 arriving in the Deniyaya town, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Facilitating newly constituted Local Authorities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
