decision_details_body: - Revising the limits, 10 new Local Authorities have been constituted as the previous Ambagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha Authority Area as Ambagamuwa, Maskeliya and Norwood Pradeshiya Sabhas, the Nuwara Eliya Pradeshiya Sabha Authority Area as Nuwara Weediya, Kotapola, Agarapathana Pradeshiya Sabha, the Thamankaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha Authority Area as two   Pollonnaruwa Municiple Council and Pradeshiya Sabha newly, Bandaragama Pradeshiya Sabha Authority Area as two Bandaragama and Millaniya Pradeshiya Sabha newly. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils, Local Government and Sports, to secure a sum of Rs.540 million to provide the new Local Authorities with the essential facilities with a view to providing Public Services expeditiously through the newly constituted Local Authorities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme for the construction of new houses for the displaced families in the Welioya  Area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to implement a special project to address the housing problem of 1,000 displaced families who lived in the villages of Helambawewa, Mayawewa, Sapumaltenna, Gajabapura, Hansawila and Namalpura in the Welioya Divisional Secretary's Division. Under this programme, construction work of 1,084 houses was initiated and out of them 994 housing units have now been completed. The construction work of the balance 90 houses is being completed.  Another 256 families who lived in the area and left due to the conflict situation, having returned to the area, are living in temporarily built houses with in adequate facilities. Having also considered the request made by such families to assist in the construction of houses for them also under the said housing project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to construct houses for them as well under the said project, was approved in principle by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the active contribution of the Tri Forces for Control of Drugs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - The Narcotic Bureau of the Sri Lanka Police and the Divisional Police perform a yeoman service to control the rapidly spreading drug menace within the country which has engulfed the elders as well as youth community with harmful effects  with the assistance of the Special Task Force of the Sri Lanka Police and the Tri‑ Forces as well where necessary.  It has been found that, obtaining of the active contribution of the Tri‑Forces would be appropriate to control the drug menace more successfully. It has been found that, the control of drug trafficking could be made more effective by vesting the officers who engage in drug control operations with more powers. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, and Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Management and Law & Order, to draft the Drugs Control (Special Provisions) Bill, vesting certain powers recommended by the Attorney General with the Tri‑Forces for a determined period of time to control drugs menace more successfully, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining of Technical Consultancy Services for the successful implementation of the Empowerment of Programmes for the Samurdhi Beneficiaries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - An Entrepreneurs Motivation Programme named ''One Country One Product'', ''OTOT- One Tambon One Product'' for selling high standard local products within the country is conducted in Thailand very successfully. As such, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Social Empowerment, to enter into an agreement between the Thailand International Cooperation Agency, in the Ministry of Affairs of the Kingdom of Thailand and the Ministry of Social Empowerment of Sri Lanka for obtaining technical consultancy in the implementation of the empowerment programmes for the promotion of the economic viability of the Samurdhi beneficiaries through the said programme conducted in Thailand, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reserving of lands to Establish the Natural Gas Power Plant at  Kerawalapitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that, establishment of Power Plants that utilize Natural Gas as the fuel, is more appropriate to meet the increasing demand of electricity in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, approval of the Cabinet has been received to establish two Natural Gas Power Plants of each 500 MW, as a joint venture project between India and Japan.  Kerawalapitiya area has been identified as the most suitable area to construct the Natural Gas Power Plants considering the facts such as the close proximity to the Colombo City and Suburban areas, appropriate location to build to receive the important natural gas terminal, availability of cooling water as well as the availability of the open lands to build power plants. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to vest a state land in extent of 110 acres situated at Kerawalapitiya to the Ceylon Electricity Board subsequent to a proper environmental assessment, for the construction of the proposed Natural Power Plant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a Fixed Rate of CESS on Bulk Tea Exports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - CESS calculation on Bulk Tea is being carried out at present and accordingly, the said calculation is computed on a monthly basis, at the rate of Rs.10/- per kg or 2.5% of the Colombo Tea Auction average prices which ever is higher. Presently, CESS paid by the Tea exporters is approximately 20% per kg. of tea and accordingly, the tea exporters have encountered several difficulties such as the difficulty in finalizing the bulk tea prices in advance as the CESS rates is computed on monthly basis and delay in submitting export prices. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to introduce a fixed CESS rate of Rs.10/- per kg for bulk tea exports, as a remedial measure for the issue, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the National Institute of Plantation Management Act, No.45 of 1979
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to amend the National Institute of Plantation Management Act, No.45 of 1979, so as to transform the National Institute of Plantation Management as an institution which creates professionals with high competency required in the field of plantation and awards skills oriented plantation management degrees, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and 	Finland for cooperation in the field of Health
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Social Activities and Health of the Republic of Finland for enhancing the cooperation between the two countries on the matters pertaining to the Health Sector for adopting Digital Technology, Dental Care, development of Medical Equipment and Hospital Infrastructure facilities, Genomics, Blood Plasma Fractionation, Diagnostics, Medical and Health Care Education and Non‑Communicable Diseases, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh for cooperation in the fields of Health and Medical Sciences
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine of Sri Lanka and the Management and Training International Ltd., of Bangladesh for the promotion and cooperation between the two countries on matters pertaining to Health and Medical Science such as public health, nursing education, environmental and occupational health, the Health Policy and administration, community health, rural and urban health management, health tourism industry, adopting  Information and Communication Technology for health services, climate changes and disaster management and the promotion of Human Resource Management in the health sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Macro - Fiscal Framework for the preparation of the Budget - 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to formulate the National Budget 2019 adopting the Performance Based Budgeting approach. In this instance, under the fiscal consolidation programme to be achieved by 2021, the national budget is expected to be prepared in view to achieving the outcomes namely, increasing the Government Revenue to 17 percent of the GDP  curtailing the Government Recurrent Expenditure at a level of 15% of the GDP, maintaining the Public Investments at a level of 5.5% of the GDP, restricting the Budget Deficit to 3.5 percent of GDP, maintaining the outstanding Government debt below 70 percent of the GDP, in the Medium Term Public Finance Framework. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to allocate the provisions, identifying the priority projects of the Government, in the preparation of the National Budget of 2019, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Colombo Train Control Centre (CTCC) and the Railway Operation Headquarters (ROHQ)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct the Colombo Train Control Centre (CTCC) and Railway Operation Headquarters (ROHQ) under the Colombo Suburban Railway Efficiency Improvement Project (CSREIP) funded by the Asian Development Bank and to improve the technical facilities, in order to enhance the efficiency of the railway services in the suburban areas in Colombo. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to allocate a block of land in extent of 01 acre and 02 roods located at Maradana area, identified as being suitable for the purpose to the Sri Lanka Railway Service, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accelerated Programme for the issuance of Land Grants for state lands - (Agenda Item No.11)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - With a view to ensuring the land ownership of the people, the Government has issued more than 1.6 million of Land Permits up to now under the Land Development Ordinance and out of them, 930,082 have been converted into Land Grants. However, the surveys of the plots of land have to be carried out, in order to issue Land Grants for an extent of 700,000 more plots of land to which such permits have been issued as well as for an extent of 436,992 blocks of land for which Jayabhumi Land Grants have been issued. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs and Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms, to implement an expeditious programme for the issuance of Land Grants for 1.1 million of plots of land within the period of 2019‑2020 and to provide facilities for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Grant and Implementation Agreement between the Millennium Challenge Corporation and the Government of Sri Lanka - (Agenda Item No.09)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-10
decision_details_body: - Investment activities of the funds provided under the Millennium Challenge Corporation implemented by the United State of America for alleviating poverty through  economic growth, is carried out by the Policy Development Office of the Prime Minister's Office. Under the coordination of the Policy Development Office, it is scheduled to carry out projects for the development of land administration, transport, agriculture logistic, development of power and energy sector etc., and it is also scheduled to establish a high-tech University and the construction of an elevated highway from Peliyagoda to Malabe.  Accordingly, a Note to the cabinet presented by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to the effect that the total grant of US$ 450-500 million approximately, is expected to be obtained for the improvement of the  transport sector project and  the land administration process inclusive also of the present position in regard to the principle investments of the Millennium Challenge Corporation of United State of America,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Gamperaliya - Rapid Rural Development Programme 2018 - 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body:
- Infrastructure facilities through out the country were damaged due to the weather related disasters in the recent years and the decline in the general economic growth due to various challenges and thereby the  people had to face difficulties with regard to livelihood developments. Therefore, the Government has decided to take necessary action for the livelihood development of people and to accelerate the economic development of the country by enhancing the essential infrastructure facilities. Accordingly, it has been planned to implement a rural development programme called 'Gamperaliya' covering all the districts in the country to develop the areas of work namely, Irrigation, Rural roads, School Sanitary Facilities and playgrounds, Sati Pola, Harita Uyana, Electricity, rehabilitation of religious and Archaeological places, housing development,  issuing land deeds and entrepreneurship.

Accordingly, a programme is proposed to be implemented  within a period of two years commencing from the third quarter of 2018. It is expected to provide Rs.200 million for each Divisional Secretariat Division to carryout the said development activities in the year 2018.  The total investment for the purpose is Rs.65,811 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to expeditiously implement the proposed rural economic development programme 'Gamperaliya', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of Public Health in Batticaloa District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to construct 3,400 sanitary units so as to cover 14 Divisional Secretariat Divisions in the Batticaloa district. The Government of India has agreed to grant Rs.300 million, which is expected to be incurred for the purpose. By implementing the project, it is expected to minimize health issues and poverty level in those areas. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Rural Economic Affairs, to enter into the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) which has been prepared to implement the said project, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Development of Infrastructure facilities at Higher Educational Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, to implement projects amounting to Rs.2,384.7 million, for the development of infrastructure facilities at the University of Ruhuna, Biksu University of Sri Lanka, South Eastern University, University of Sri Jayawardhanapura and Sri Lanaka Institute of Advanced Technological Education, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Polonnaruwa Solar Power Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to construct a Solar Power Plant of 10MW in Polonnaruwa on Build, Own and Operate Basis. However, since it was not possible to locate a suitable land from the area, it was decided to establish this Power Plant in a suitable block of land closer to the Valachchenai Sub‑Grid Station. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the procurement for Building, Owning and Operating the said Power Plant of 10MW to M/s Didul (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.12.49 for 1kw per hour, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of the Contract for the Supply and Delivery of Aerial Bundled Conductors
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the procurement for purchasing 2,500 km of Aerial Bundled Conductors used by the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) for distribution purposes, to M/s ACL Cables PLC for a sum of Rs.1,456.2 million, as recommended by the the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Operating a Container Feeder Service between Port of Colombo and Port 	of Chittagong, Bangladesh
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - A Memorandum of Understanding has been signed between the Shipping Corporations of the two countries of Sri Lanka and Bangladesh with a view to strengthening bilateral relationship in the maritime sector. Due to the limitations in the port facilities and the depth of the Port of Chittagong which is the main port in Bangladesh, the vessels belonging to  Main Line Operators (MLOs) do not call at the Port of Chittagong. Therefore, most of the export and import cargoes of Bangladesh  are feedered via the Port of Singapore, Port of Colombo and Port of Malaysia on Common Carrier Container Feeder Vessels. The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to select a suitable partner under a joint partnership and  reap the benefits by deploying a vessel registered under the Sri Lanka flag since the priority has been given to Ceylon Shipping Corporation for Container Feeder Service  in comparison with other countries in view of the aforesaid Agreement already entered in between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Constructing of 1,500 cum capacity water tower in Minuwangoda Area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for constructing of 1,500 cum capacity water tower and laying transmission and distribution mains scheduled to be constructed in Minuwangoda area as a part of the Gampaha Attanagalla and Minuwangoda Integrated Water Supply Project to M/s Finite Lanka (Pvt.) Ltd. as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing permanent houses for conflict affected  families  in the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approval has been granted previously for the programme of  providing traditional brick and mortar type permanent houses to conflict affected families in the Northern and Eastern Provinces. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to construct 25,000 housing units under Phase I of the project a sum of Rs.1.25 million  per housing unit (without taxes) in the Northern and Eastern Provinces and out of which 15,000 houses to be commenced in 2018 and completed within period of 08 months  and the balance of 10,000 houses to be completed in 2019, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee (CANC) and the Procurement Committee (PC) and to enter into the Agreement with the  UNOPS and UN‑Habitat led Consortium for the construction of such houses, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Developing the Gem Street Demuwawatha, Ratnapura as an International Gem Street and Constructing the Gem Tower
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approval has been granted previously to develop the Gem Street Demuwawatha, Ratnapura as an International Gem Street and to construct a Gem Tower with the objective of constructing a specific centre for  providing all the required services efficiently for the gem and jewelry sector under one roof within the Ratnapura city and to attract buyers for medium scale entrepreneurs. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to construct a four storied building at a land in extent of 22 perches located at Limewatta, Demuwawatha Street, Ratnapura and to establish business places, gem laboratory and banking, export and customs facilities therein, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Strategic Economic Partnership 	between Thailand and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Thailand covering the sectors such as investments, agricultural development, promoting and facilitating the fisheries industry, promoting the tourism industry and expanding and promoting information technology, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparing a National Policy for Primary Industries in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - Measures have been taken to prepare a national policy for primary industries with the objective of the primary industry sector actively contributing in  achieving the government goal of enhancing the export earnings and strengthening livelihood of the people through the promotion of investments. Promotion of competitiveness and productivity in the primary industry sector, research and development, enhancement of entrepreneurial capacity, increase of global market share, entire economic growth through the market diversification and export promotion is expected to be covered by this policy. Accordingly, the National policy for primary industries was submitted by Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Social Welfare and Primary Industries, for information of the Cabinet.

description: Expediting the Digitalization of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - Creating a 'Digital Sri Lanka' which leads the way towards a digital economy has been identified as a priority area in the policy and economic development plan. In this instance, providing the service receivers with broadband connections has been recognized as a vital aspect. Even though, Fibre-To-The Premises has been recognized as an important medium to increase broadband penetration in the areas of service receivers, a high cost have to be incurred in respect of same. However, the development of technology has enabled the broadband to share the same infrastructure with electrical power. Accordingly, mutually sharing the infrastructure by the electricity distribution licensees and the licensees of telecommunication service providers, enables to expand electricity and broadband connections at considerably lower cost with high standard technology. The Joint Proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication, Digital Infrastructure and Foreign Employment, and Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to appoint a Committee comprising of expertise in the field to examine all aspects relating to the subject  and submit proposals in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ensuring the proper functioning of the rental housing market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - An Experts' Committee has been appointed to submit recommendations pertaining to the functioning of rental housing market at an optimum level considering the requirement of providing rental housing at a price affordable to those moving to the city due to the urbanization, employees and young families.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to draft necessary legislation to ensure the proper functioning of rental housing market taking into consideration the matters such as regulation of rental housing market, increase the provision of rental housing and designing such houses at a rate affordable to the women and elders as per the recommendation of said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Cultivating Ayurvedic Medicinal Herbs at the model village level and selling to the Ayurvedic Drugs Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - The model village housing programme which functions under the Ministry of Housing and Constructions addresses the housing problems of beneficiary families and empowers such beneficiaries in view of making them productive partners of the national economy. As such, for a model village comprising 25 housing units, a land extent of two acres in addition to the land allotted for the houses have been reserved for collective cultivation of beneficiaries. Similarly,  Cultivation of ayurvedic medical plants have been initiated in 77 model villages which have already been vested with the beneficiaries and ayurvedic medical plants are expected to be introduced for the proposed 2,500 model village as well. This programme will also minimize the import cost borne by importing ayurvedic drugs and enhance the income level of the beneficiaries. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to establish a Steering Committee for launching the programme of promoting the cultivation of ayurvedic medicinal herbs within the model villages, was approved by the  Cabinet.

description: Restructuring of the Department of Government Factory (DGF)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - The Department of Government Factory (DGF) is a Department which possesses the competency in carrying out the mechanical, engineering work and installation activities with high quality required for the development activities and various Government Institutions for a longer period of time.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to appoint a committee to obtain recommendations to restructure the Department in order to further continue as an independent institution and grant approval for the mechanical, engineering work and installation activities required for the institutions of the Public Sector to be performed by the Department of Government Factory under direct contract method, until the proposed restructuring activities are completed, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the infrastructure facilities in remote villages where Samurdhi beneficiaries are living
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body:
- Even though various programmes have been implemented by the Department of Samurdhi Development for the economic empowerment of the Samurdhi beneficiaries, it has been found that the expected result from these programmes could not be achieved due to inadequate accessibility facilities to bring their products to the market, limitations pertaining to the water supply facility required for cultivation activities, lack of places required for marketing the products and the absence of service centres to seek technical facilities and enhance the quality of products and the insufficient infrastructure facilities.

As a remedial measure, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Social Empowerment, to implement a special programme for improvement of such infrastructure facilities in rural villages situated in the Northern, Eastern and hilly areas as well as in the districts of Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, Moneragala and Hambantota where the poverty exists at its highest level, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing facilities to the private sector engaged in the field of agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - The Government has identified the necessity of obtaining the contribution of the private sector in order to improve the agriculture productivity and enhance the quality of such agricultural products. As such, the proposal  made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Agriculture, to establish an Inter Ministerial Coordinating Committee to facilitate the private sector engaged in the field of agriculture to perform successfully in the global business environment as well as to provide agricultural products of high quality to consumers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation blocks of Land from the Regional Industrial Estates to set up 	Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - 	The Regional Industrial Estates have been established with the objective of promoting the industries at regional level and the selection of investors anticipating to establish industries, will be performed by the Regional Industrial Services Committee and the Project Evaluation Committee of the Ministry. Accordingly, considering the direct employment opportunities to be generated with a total investments exceeding Rs.4 billion from such industries, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to allocate blocks of land from the Industrial estates located in areas of Puttlam, Noorani, Bata Atha, Nalanda, Nalanda Ellawala, Laksha Uyana, Raigampura and Millewa, for a lease period of 35 years, to the investors selected, as per the recommendations of those Committees, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting the Water and Development Congress 2019 of the International Water Association(IWA) and the Exhibition on Sustainable Solution for Water Security in Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - It has been decided to host the Water and Development Congress and  Exhibition organized every two years by the International Water Association, in Colombo in the year 2019. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply,  to host the proposed congress and exhibition in Sri Lanka in September, 2019 considering the benefits to be achieved for the professional development of those interested in this field, Water and Environmental professionals, engineers, chemists, regulators and policy makers, and the service to be provided, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Development of a framework and Infrastructure Financing to Support   Public - Private Partnerships
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - The National Agency for Public-Private Partnership (NAPPP) has been established for the purpose of attracting foreign direct investments and accelerating economic growth through a robust Public-Private Partnership programmes. The said Agency has identified approximately 35 Public-Private Partnership projects for implementation.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to implement a programme with the funds from the Word Bank to support the Public-Private Partnership programmes in Sri Lanka and provide facilities required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for promoting the right to information among the various communities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - The Right to Information Act, No.12 of 2016 is implemented to enable the public to access the information in possession of Public Authorities. The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to implement a project utilizing the funds donated by the Swiss Confederation, to promote the right to information guaranteed by the said Act specially among the people in the conflict and remote areas and the officers serving in the said areas,  to create awareness in the manner in exercising the  right to information and to further enhance the training provided for the officers in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining funds for the implementation of Port Access Elevated Highway Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body:
- The Port Access Elevated Highway Project is proposed to link the Colombo - Katunayake Expressway to the Colombo Fort and the Port via the New Kelani Bridge. This project will help to minimize the traffic congestion prevailing around the port and the city and provide trade logistics as well. Under this project, it is scheduled to construct the 5.3 km Port Access Elevated Highway from New Kelani Bridge to Galle Face with a dedicated ramp to Colombo Port. Further, upgrading the existing port access road to six lanes and installing the electronic troll collection system have also been proposed. In addition, it has also been planned to relocate 49 places of the port affected due to these constructions and to establish a maritime facilitation center.

The total investment of US$ 360.2 million is expected to be made by the Government for this Project out of which US$ 300 million is to be obtained as a foreign loan from the Asian Development Bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to obtain said loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining  funds required for the implementation  of Northern Province  Sustainable Fisheries Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body:
- It has been proposed to implement the Northern Province Sustainable Fisheries Development Project to promote investments and livelihood opportunities in the fisheries sector in the Northern Province and thereby sustainably increasing  the production in the Province. Under this project, it has been planned to construct two fishery harbours at Point Pedro and Pesalai; one anchorage at Mandative in Jaffna District; 23 landing sites in Jaffna, Mannar, Mullativu and Kilinochchi Districts. In addition, for the development of aquaculture, a sea cucumber hatchery, a mud crab hatchery and a sea weed tissue culture have been scheduled to be constructed in Mullativu, Mannar and Jaffna respectively. With a view to expanding this project among the local communities of the area and women, it is expected to develop the infrastructure facilities in selected 141 Grama Niladhari Divisions and provide access to credit for the re‑plantation of Kadolana, create awareness of credit facilities, establish three model enterprises in partnership with the private sector to generate employment opportunities and  provide the communities impacted due to the prolonged conflict with psycho‑social trauma support.

A sum of US$ 201.02 million is scheduled to be invested by the Government with the assistance of foreign loans for this Project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to obtain the foreign loan of US$ 174 million from the Asian Development Bank required for the implementation of this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing funds for the implementation of the Science and Technology Human Resource Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - The Government has decided to focus more on science and technology education to meet the evolving demands of the economy for human resource with knowledge on technology and innovation. For this purpose, the Government has planned to implement the Science and Technology Human Resource Development Project at a total investment of US$ 165 million.  Under this project, 03 technological faculties at the Universities of Kelaniya, Rajarata and Sabaragamuwa as well as an Engineering Faculty at the University of Sri Jayewardenapura will be established. Through this, it is expected to orient graduates with extensive knowledge on modern technology and interest on entrepreneurship and equipped skills to suit the present labour market. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to take appropriate action to obtain the foreign funds of US$ 145 million required for the implementation of the project, from the Asian Development Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Technical Assistance required for the Urban Development Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - By carrying out feasibility studies on Urban Development Projects and preparing detailed designs and strengthening the institutional capacity pertaining to performance and implementation of procurement activities for expediting the project activities, it is expected to strengthen the project preparedness through the proposed urban project preparatory facility. Under this, the start‑up efficiency of the projects for the development of 25 secondary towns implemented under the Ministry of Provincial Councils, Local Government and Sports and the projects for the development of 04 Strategic Cities implemented under the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development, will be enhanced.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to obtain the technical assistance loan of US$ 10 million from the Asian Development Bank for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing Funds for the construction of the Central Expressway section from Pothuhera to Galagedara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to construct the Central Expressway by further expanding the existing Expressway network, in order to link Colombo and Kandy via Pothuhera. Through this, an uninterrupted connectivity will be created from down South of the Island to Kandy, linking the Port, Airport  and Commercial Cities and several provinces of economic importance. Arrangements have been made to construct phase 3 of the Central Expressway, the section from Pothuhera to Galagedara 32.5 km in length under the Japanese Banks financing. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into an Agreement with the MUFG Bank Ltd. of Japan to secure funds amounting to Japanese Yen 100 billion required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Women's wellbeing Survey - 2018/19
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body:
- Provisions pertaining to the safety and empowerment of women have been provided in the Constitution and in many other Acts. Accordingly, programmes pertaining to the empowerment of women are being implemented by the Government jointly  in collaboration with Non-Governmental Organizations.

However,  due to the information pertaining to the lower percentage of women in the labour market in Sri Lanka, gender based violence and domestic violence against women, circulating in the society through unofficial statistics, the need for official statistics has surfaced to understand the real life situation of women. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct a National Level survey on the women's wellbeing by the Department of Census and Statistics, utilizing the donor facility of Rs.26.9 million, to be granted by the United Nations Population Fund(UNFPA) and to publish its report, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the 'Clean Air 2025 Action Plan'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body:
- The Government has implemented several programmes to control the air pollution that existed in the atmosphere  of the Colombo metropolitan area and the suburbs, for a considerable period of  time. Under the guidance of the Air Resources Management Centre which was established to facilitate for the management of the quality of air, The 'Clean Air 2000 Action Plan' has been  implemented uninterruptedly, subject to appropriate amendments.

The 'Clean Air 2025 Action Plan' has been prepared with the objective of  managing the quality of air in Sri Lanka at a optimum level for the next few years. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement the said plan and to appoint a Steering Committee to monitor and regulate the implementation of such plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project to Check the quality of internal water sources of the country
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-07-03
decision_details_body: - Excessive use of pesticides and chemicals in agricultural activities has resulted in the deterioration of the quality of water in the water sources which has adversely affected for the existence of humans and animal lives. Further, information has been received to confirm the speculation that the chronic kidney disease spread presently in certain provinces of the country, is attributed to the deterioration of the quality of water used for drinking purposes. As a solution, it has been found necessary to identify the causes of water pollution by testing the quality of water in the water sources, take measures to avoid that causes and also create awareness among the students and the public on the impact it causes. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement the 'Folllow-up project to check the quality of internal water sources of the country' for a period of 02 years from 2019 to 2020 by the Central Environmental Authority, by incurring a sum of Rs.44.9 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Committee for updating the fuel oil prices
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-26
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously, to introduce a price formula for fuel oils based on the cost and make it effective from 2018‑05‑11 and to update the fuel oil prices from the 5th day of the third month based on the international prices that prevailed in the preceding two months. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to establish an Officials' Committee comprising of the officials of the Treasury and the Ministry of Petroleum Resources Development to implement the price formula in a more transparent manner and to update the  price of Petrol and Diesel used in vehicles, on the 5th day after after every third month,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining of consultancy services for the implementation of the  Northern Province Sustainable Fisheries Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-26
decision_details_body:
- The North and Eastern Regions cover around 2/3 of the coastal belt of Sri Lanka and the fisheries industry has been recognized as an industry which would contribute largely for the development of livelihoods of these areas. As such, the Asian Development Bank (ADB) has agreed to provide financial assistance in a sum of US$ 158 million, for improving the infrastructure facilities essential for the promotion of the fisheries industry in those areas inclusive of the entire infrastructure facilities required. Under this, it has been planned to construct two (02) fishery harbours in Point Pedro and Pesalai and an anchorage at Mandaitivu in Jaffna as well. It has been also identified to improve eight (08) fishery ferries in the Jaffna and Mannar Districts, six (06) fishery landing sites in the Mullaitvu District and three (03) fishery ferries in the Kilinochchi District.

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Rural Economic Affairs, to take necessary action to select consultancy firms needed for the project implemented under three basic components namely, the construction and development of fishery harbours, anchorages and landing sites, and aquaculture and the livelihood development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a 1500cum capacity water tower and the Transmission and Distribution network in the Naiwala area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for the construction of a 1500cum capacity water tower in the Naiwala area under the Gampaha, Attanagalla, Minuwangoda Integrated Water Supply Project and laying of the required water pipes for transmission and distribution activities and the installation of other accessories, to the Joint Venture of M/s Ceylex Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd. and Prathiba Industries Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Wandurapeenu Ella Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-26
decision_details_body: - In a study made by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, it has been revealed that the construction of the Wandurapeenu Ella Reservoir is the most suitable alternative for providing drinking water to the Kurunegala District as well as to make it a better storage for all of the water supply schemes carried out adjacent to the Daduru Oya Basin. M/s Tata Projects Ltd. of India has made an Expression of Intent to make a feasibility study in respect of the construction of the proposed reservoir. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between M/s Tata Projects Ltd. and the National Water Supply & Drainage Board to carry out the said feasibility study, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The procurement for the supply of Inflight Entertainment material and Guide 'Onboard' for Air Flight Passengers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Public Enterprise & Kandy City Development, to award the procurement for the Supply of Inflight Entertainment (IFE) Material and Inflight Entertainment Guide 'Onboard' in the SriLankan Airlines to M/s Inflight Dublin Ltd. for a period of three (03) years effective from 2018‑10‑01 for a sum of US$ 5.92 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an Airport Hotel at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) in Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ashoka Abeysinghe, the Acting Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the procurement for the Establishment and Operation of an Airport Hotel in a land owned by the Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) Ltd. (AASL) at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA), Katunayake to the consortium of M/s Thilanka Hotels (Pvt.) Ltd. and Striders Corporation, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The commencement of the preliminary construction work of the Cardiac and Critical Care Complex of the Lady Ridgeway Hospital for children
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-26
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval to the proposal made by the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to carry out the project for the construction of the Cardiac and Critical Care Complex of the Lady Ridgeway Hospital for children as a Joint Venture with the coordination of the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine and the Ministry of Defence and to deploy the Sri Lanka Navy to undertake its construction work. In accordance with a proposal made by the Minister of Defence subsequently, approval of the Cabinet has been has been granted to carry out certain construction activities through external sources which cannot be handled by the Sri Lanka Navy.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to award the contract for the construction of the Pile Foundation of the Cardiac and Critical Care Complex of the Lady Ridgeway Hospital for children to M/s Nawaloka Piling (Pvt.) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.99.67 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Evaluation Policy (NEP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-26
decision_details_body: - The Government implements around 1,300 diverse development projects through out the country annually and out of such projects, about 1/3 could be considered as large scale projects implemented utilizing an expenditure exceeding Rs.500 million. In addition to these projects, a large number of small and medium scale development activities are also implemented in the country at provincial, district, divisional and local authority levels. However, due to the absence of a formal evaluation process on the outcome of those projects, it has been difficult to assess their productivity and analyze properly the impact caused by  them and their long term effect on the lives of the community. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Youth Affairs, Project Management and Southern Development, to implement the draft National Evaluation Policy prepared with the contribution of the relevant stakeholders and experts, as a remedial measure to overcome the situation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a four storey building with state of the art facilities for the Administrative functions of the Kalutara Police College
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-26
decision_details_body: - The Police College in Kalutara which extends over an area of 209 acres provides facilities to train over a 1000 police officers, at a time, from the post of Police Constable to the rank of Assistant Superintendent of Police.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Management and Law & Order, to construct a four storey building with state of the art facilities in place of the building presently used for the Administrative functions of the said training courses, with inadequate facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the relevant Tax Legislation for providing tax reliefs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to amend the Value Added Tax (VAT), Nation Building Tax (NBT) and the Economic Service Charges (ESC), for the maintenance of a stable Government Revenue. However, taking into consideration the requests made by various stakeholders, it has been found that it would be appropriate to remove certain taxes so imposed. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to amend the relevant legislation to remove the Value Added Tax (VAT) imposed on the Medical Consultation fees, channeling fees and the fees paid to the Medical Practitioners, to relieve the construction services provided under the construction agreements entered into before 01st August 2017 from the Nation Building Tax (NBT) and to release the unrealized foreign exchange benefits of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka from the Economic Service Charges (ESC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Consultancy services for the  review of plans and supervision of constructions of the proposed Thalpitigala Reservoir Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to implement the Thalpitigala Reservoir Project to meet the water scarcity of the Bathmedilla Scheme in Uma Oya lower valley by the construction of the Uma Oya Multi‑Purpose Project. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources & Disaster Management, to obtain the consultancy services for the  review of plans and supervision of constructions of the project from the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Locomotives to transport solid waste from Kelaniya to Aruwakkalu in Puttalam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - The management of the solid waste collected in the urban areas of Sri Lanka has become a major issue and as a solution to the problem, a project for constructing a sanitary landfill has been initiated in Aruwakkalu area in Puttalam for disposing of the urban solid waste. Under this project, waste has to be transported by trains from Kelaniya to Aruwakkalu for which it is necessary to procure 04 railway engines, 34 container carrier wagons and 94 container boxes. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to purchase 04 railway engines required for the purpose, from M/s Dongfang Electric International Corporation of China, for a sum of US$ 8.27 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Cyclotron Plant in Sri Lanka to operate PET CT Scanners in Government Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - Tests are carried out by the PET CT Scanners to reveal the functioning of the tissues and organs of the Human body and for such tests, a radioactive drug  known as FDG 18 is used. A Cyclotron Plant is required to manufacture this radioactive drug. The service of a PET CT Scanner is essential for the purpose of observing the cancer related growth, to assess the response and to provide accurate treatment of cancer patients. As of now, only one such PET CT Scanner is available in a Private Hospital in Sri Lanka and about Rs.150,000/- is charged to obtain an examination report and an exorbitant sum has to be paid for the radioactive drug FDG 18 as well, used for the purpose. A PET CT Scanner has been commissioned at the National Hospital of Sri Lanka and another such scanner will also be commissioned at the Apeksha Cancer Hospital, Maharagama, in future.  The radioactive drug FDG 18 will be needed for those scanners as well in the future. If the PET CT Scanners  are to be used successfully and effectively in the country, it is absolutely essential to have a Cyclotron Plant in Sri Lanka.  As a remedial measure, M/s Access International (Pvt.) Ltd. has submitted a proposal to commission a Cyclotron Plant in Sri Lanka, subject to entering into a purchase agreement within a specific time period. Taking into consideration the importance of the proposal, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee to evaluate the said project proposal and conduct negotiations in respect of same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Institute of Personnel Management Sri Lanka Act, No.24 of 1976
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - The Institute of Personnel Management Sri Lanka representing 1,500 full time members professionally qualified in the field of Human Resources Management, was founded in 1959 and has been incorporated by the Institute of Personnel Management Sri Lanka Act, No.24 of 1976. The Cabinet has granted  approval previously to amend the Institute of Personnel Management Sri Lanka Act, substituting its name as the 'Charted Institute of Personal Management Sri Lanka'. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Ravindra Samaraweera, the Minister of Labour & Trade Union Relations, to publish the Draft (Amendment) Bill prepared in that regard, in the Government Gazette and subsequently present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Action Plan of the Spices and Allied Products Marketing Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - The Action Plan submitted by the Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Social Welfare and Primary Industries, to develop the Spices and Allied Products by the Spices and Allied Products Marketing Board and to promote the services with a view to enhancing the quality, organic products, upgrading the technology and research studies for promoting them locally and internationally, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National HAJ Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - Around 7,000 - 1,0000 applications are made by the Muslim Devotees to the Department	of Muslim Religious and Cultural Affairs per year to take part in the Hajj Pilgrimage. However, since the annual quota received by Sri Lanka to take part in the Hajj Pilgrimage is limited from 2,200 to 3,400, it is found to be an extremely difficult task to choose the pilgrims and tour operators.  Accordingly, a proposal has been made to draft an Act to regulate the activities related to the Hajj Pilgrimage. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. M.H.A Haleem, the Minister of  Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation for this purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Educational Institutions for the Buddhist Dasa Sil Matha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - At present there are approximately 4,000 Dasa Sil Matha residing in Sri Lanka and their educational activities are being carried out by several educational institutions which function at voluntary level without Government assistance. Presently, necessary measures are being taken to amend the Pirivena Education Act, No.64 of 1979, in order to provide the said institutions with the assistance and the sponsorship required thereto by the Government. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, Minister of Education, to register the institutions which provide education to Dasa Sil Matha as “Educational Institutions for Buddhist Dasa Sil Matha” and provide the said institutions with necessary facilities until the amendments are made to the above Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Social Integration of the Gramashakthi Livelihood Development Programme through the Model Village Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - The model villages programme implemented under the Ministry of Housing and Construction could be utilized for the social integration of the Gramashakthi Peoples' Movement carried out under the guidance of His Excellency the President through which the capability of the livelihood  development of the rural people could be gained by empowering them collectively. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to implement the Gramashakthi Peoples' Movement centred at the model villages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Required amendments to the Establishments Code in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Information Act, No.12 of 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: Under the Right to Information Act, No.12 of 2016, providing of information in possession of the public institutions to the people is effective with effect from 03rd February 2017.  It has been identified that when the provisions of the Act is enforced by the public officers, certain provisions found hitherto pertaining to the provision of information to the public in the Establishments Code have to be revised.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Management and Law & Order, to make the required amendments in Volume II of the Establishments Code, taking into consideration the views of the Public Service Commission, provided for by way of Circular instructions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Volley ball and Basket Ball play grounds in the National Police Academy at Katana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - The National Police Academy at Katana has been established with a view to enhancing the knowledge, skills, attitudes and vocational skills of the police officers. Five training courses are conducted daily in this academy and around 300 trainees attend the courses and  out of them, a majority participate in  training being resident in the academy. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration & Management and Law & Order, to construct 02 Volley Ball and Basket Ball play grounds to facilitate the said trainees to be engaged in sports, physical exercises and physical fitness activities in order to spend their leisure time productively, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing  the Production of Local Big Onions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - Even though the big onion cultivation which is very popular among the farmers of the dry zone and had been spread over an area of 7,000 hectares by 2014, it has been reduced up to 2,000 hectares by 2017 due to the price changes that occurred in the market and the climatic conditions. However, the Government has focused its attention on matters such as the inability of marketing the big onion seeds of farmers, the prevention of the farmers refraining from the cultivation of big onion and safeguarding of the local seed producers. Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to purchase 5,000 kgs. of seeds from the seed stocks available with the local big onion seed producers and cultivate newly 1,000 hectares of lands during the Yala season of 2018, for the Government to purchase a further 2,000 kgs. of   big onion seeds and stock them for the seed requirement in the next season, to intervene in securing a price of Rs.70/- to Rs.80/- per kilograms to the local producers and to revise the import taxes accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting the Workshops on 'Innovative Technologies for Increasing the Agricultural Water Productivity' and 'Smart Agriculture Extension Models' in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to conduct  two workshops on 'Innovative Technologies for Increasing Agricultural Water Productivity' and 'Smart Agriculture Extension Models' in Sri Lanka organized jointly by the Asian Productivity Organization and the Ministry of Agriculture with a view to enhancing the productivity in the industrial and agricultural fields of member states. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to conduct a 5 day workshop commencing from 2018‑07‑23 to 2018‑07‑27 on 'Innovative Technologies for Increasing Agricultural Water Productivity' for encouraging towards healthy water resources management and a 5 day workshop commencing from 2018‑09‑17 to 2018‑09‑21 on 'Smart Agriculture Extensions' to make a study of the 'Smart Agriculture Extension Models and Methodologies' which are suited for member states, in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Sri Lanka National Freedom from Hunger Campaign Board Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to amend the title of the Act as National Food Promotion Board Act, with a view to updating the Sri Lanka National Freedom from Hunger Campaign Board Act, No.15 of 1973 to suit the current trends. In this respect, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to draft a Bill incorporating the further amendments necessary to be made in the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman, in order to further strengthen the activities of the agricultural community and the institutions engaged in such activities, to publish same in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present the Bill in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mixed Development Project for the Chalmers Granary Land at Pettah
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to develop the Chalmers Granary Land at Pettah as a Mixed Development Project. Although proposals had been called for the Project accordingly, investors have not submitted proposals even by the due date. Considering the deliberations had with the investors who showed interest in the project when proposals were called for the purpose, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to provide the opportunity of submitting alternative proposals for the payment of the land value when the Chalmers Granary Land at Pettah is used for Mixed Development Projects and  to introduce a process for the evaluation of such proposals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Report on Public Sector Cadre for the First Quarter of the Year 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the decision taken previously by the Cabinet, the changes taking place in the Public Sector cadre due to the recruitment, transfers, vacation of posts, dismissal, retirement, resignation and death of officers in all public institutions should be updated and maintained and such information has to be submitted to the Cabinet, for consideration. In accordance with the Note submitted by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, 9,851 personnel have been newly recruited to the public sector and 7,755 public officers have left office due to retirement, resignation, vacation of post, dismissal or death, during the first quarter of the year 2018. Besides, the Provincial Councils have employed 7,840 persons outside the approved cadre and the necessity for all public sector institutions to adhere to a national policy on salary has also been pinpointed. The above information submitted by the Note to the Cabinet was noted by the Cabinet and  the Cabinet also emphasized the fact that the Heads of the Institutions are held accountable for the recruitment of employees outside the approved cadre without specific approval.

description: Granting of Ports and Airports Development Levy Tax Concessions on High tech Automated Machinery
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to present the Gazette Notification issued under the Ports and Airports Development Levy Act, No.18 of 2011 for granting a 75% tax concession in respect of the High tech Automated Machinery used for the production activities of the domestic production industry, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Consultations between Sri Lanka and Thailand pertaining to Air Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - The Delegations representing Sri Lanka and Thailand Aeronautical Authorities held discussion with regard to the air services plans of the two countries at the Civil Air Services Conference held in December 2017 in Colombo. The 2 parties reached consensus with regard to the  air services agreement scheduled to be signed between the two countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ashoka Abeysinghe the acting Ministers of Transport and Civil Aviation,  to enter into force of this Agreement and to implement it effectively, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promotion of Domestic Air Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Expression of Interest calling of proposals by the National Agency for Public Private Partnership (NAPPP) for the operation of scheduled domestic air services according to a given time table, 05 institutes have submitted their proposals and the said proposals have been evaluated by a Committee comprising of the Director General of Civil Aviation, the Chairman of the National Agency for Public Private Partnership and the Executive Director of the Airport and Aviation (Sri Lanka). Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs and Hon. Ashoka Abeysinghe, the Acting Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to call for applications from the relevant air services institutes for issuing licenses for operational activities, subject to taking action in accordance with the recommendations of the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of 06 Mini Milk Processing Centres in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to secure the funds necessary for the development of 30 milk collecting centres and 06 milk processing centres in the areas of Kaduwela, Attanagalla, Polonnaruwa, Batticaloa, Wariyapola and Wennappuwa with the expectation of enhancing the income level of dairy farmers through the increase of the capability of producing fresh milk in the rural areas, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Draft Bill on 'Secured Transactions'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-19
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously, to repeal the Secured Transactions Act, No.49 of 2009 and to draft a new Bill to enable Small and Medium Entrepreneurs to leverage a large part of their assets as 'surety bonds' in obtaining credit for improving their enterprises. It has also been proposed to amend the Prescription Ordinance, Trust Receipts Ordinance, Mortgage Ordinance, Finance Leasing Act, No.56 of 2000, Inland Trust Receipts Act, No.14 of 1990, Companies Act, No.7 of 2007 and the Registration of Documents Ordinance, along with the proposed draft Bill. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to amend the said Acts and to table the Draft (Amendment) Bills in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Report of the Ministry of Finance - 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body: In terms of the provisions of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No.03 of 2003, the Minister of Finance is required to table a 'Final Budgetary Position Report' in Parliament, for information of the Parliament and the general public. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to table the Annual Report of the Ministry of Finance pertaining to the financial year 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reduction of the Price of Kerosene
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body: Previously, the Government had decided to increase up to a certain extent, the price of kerosene that had been provided at a relatively concessionary rate in comparison with the high prices in the world market. Accordingly, the proposals made by the Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Rural Economic Affairs and the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to reduce the price per litre of kerosene increased up to Rs.101/- down to Rs.70/-, considering the requests made by the small scale mechanized fishing boat owners who use kerosene for their boats and the low income families who use kerosene for lighting, were approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Task Force to direct, coordinate and monitor the development programmes in the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body: Subsequent to the cessation of the conflict which existed in the Northern and Eastern Provinces, several projects have been implemented for Socio Economic Development of the areas. However,  it is observed that the projects have not been sufficiently effective in raising the living standards of the people of the area. As such, the information furnished by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to the Cabinet to the effect that he has taken measures to appoint a Task Force to review, coordinate, operate and monitor the development programmes implemented in the Northern and Eastern Provinces by various Government Institutions, comprising of the Hon. Prime Minister, Provincial Governors, Chief Secretaries of Provinces, Officers of the Armed Forces and the Police in charge of Provinces and all relevant stakeholders under his Chairmanship, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the road sections from Bibile to Chenkalady and  Padiyathalawa to Tampitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body:
The Saudi Fund has provided loan facilities for the rehabilitation and  improvement of the road section from Bibile to Chenkalady, 86.75km in length. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development to award the following 02 contract packages under the project, to M/s Consulting Engineers & Contractors (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.
		
*	Rehabilitation and Improvement of the Bibile to Padiyathalawa road section, 29 km in length, for a sum of Rs.2,389.07 million.
		
*	Rehabilitation and Improvement of the Padiyathalawa to Tampitiya road section, 30 km in length, for a sum of Rs.2,295.63 million.

description: Award of contract for the consultancy services for the implementation of the projects in the Uva Province under the Second Integrated Roads Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body: The Asian Development Bank has expressed its willingness to provide a sum of US$ 900 million as funds for the implementation of the Second Integrated Roads Investment Programme and the Cabinet has granted approval to implement the said programme in the Northern, Eastern, Uva and Western Provinces. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways & Road Development, to award the contract for  consultancy services for the implementation of the projects in the Uva Province inclusive of the construction monitoring and contract management to the joint venture of M/s Pyunghwa Engineering Consultants Institute in Korea and M/s Consulting Engineers and Architects Associated (Pvt.) Company, for a sum of Rs.1,154.8 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee (CACPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sale of Mineral Sands of Lanka Mineral Sands Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body: - Lanka Mineral Sands Limited is a state venture implemented under the supervision of the Ministry of Industry and Commerce, which is mainly engaged in mining, separating and selling of Ilmenite, Rutile, Zircon and Hi-TI Ilmenite. The company has called for prices to sell 25,000 MT of Ilmenite and the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to sell the said stock of Ilmenite at US$ 145.25 per 01MT, to M/s Rescom Mineral Trading FZE established in Dubai in the United Arab Emirates as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Deltota Water Supply Project
