decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to make a request to M/s M-U-T GambH Austria for the issuance of project proposals for the implementation of the Deltota Water Supply Project which is a priority project included in the master plan of investment of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Cost Estimate Review Committee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body:
- When contracts are awarded pertaining to infrastructure development projects by the Government, it has been found that most are awarded for a sum that exceeds the Engineer's Estimate and that during the implementation of the projects, frequent cost increases take place. Therefore, the introduction of a proper mechanism to rectify this situation and the guidance of procurement entities in the preparation of realistic cost estimates, have been recognized as a timely need.
	
	As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to establish a Cost Estimate Review Committee comprised of the relevant officers under the Ministry of National Policies and Economic Affairs to review the total cost estimates and contract price variations of the infrastructure development projects within the authority of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committees, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of 160 Passenger Coaches
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the purchase of 160 Passenger Coaches, under the Indian Line of Credit, with the objective of further improving the passenger services provided by the Sri Lanka Railways, to M/s RITES Ltd., for a sum of US$ 82.63 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of Special Compensation for the properties damaged due to the incidents that took place in the Beruwala, Aluthgama Areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body: - Action has been taken by the Government to grant the maximum compensation payable under the existing regulations for the properties damaged due to the civil commotion that took place in the year 2014 in the Beruwala and Aluthgama areas in the Kalutara District. As such, the proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Resettlement, Rehabilitation, Northern Development & Hindu Religious Affairs, to allocate a sum of Rs.185.9 million to enable the further payments recommended by a Special Valuation Committee appointed by the District Secretary in order to compensate for the damages caused to furniture and other equipment that have not been covered so far, was approved in principle by the Cabinet.

description: Implementing the 'Sampath Piyasa' programme in the model villages
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body: - Action is taken to ensure the entitlement of a land, a housing unit and a settlement to the low income or poverty stricken families who do not possess a plot of land to construct a house, by the model villages programme implemented under the National Housing Programme implemented by the Ministry of Housing and Construction. Accordingly, it has been possible for the beneficiaries of the 75 model villages vested with the community under this programme, to achieve considerable progress in the implementation of drug prevention, health promotion and home gardening programmes. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to establish a 'Sampath Piyasa' unit introduced by the Central Environmental Authority in every Model Village to make it possible for the disposal of non degradable waste collected in the villages in an environment friendly manner, with the support of the Presidential Task Force on Environmental Conservation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Samurdhi Subsidies to 150,000 low income families
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body: - At present, around 1.38 million people are provided with benefits under the Samurdhi Subsidy Programme. However, it has been reported that families who have been resettled in the Northern and Eastern areas and are not presently Samurdhi beneficiaries as well as a large number of low income families living in the other areas of the country, identified as deserving the Samurdhi benefit, do not receive the said subsidy.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Social Empowerment, to expand the Samurdhi subsidy facility for a further  150,000 low income families, with the recommendations of the relevant District Secretaries and Divisional Secretaries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of title deeds to the re-settlers under the Awarakotuwa Relocation Project at Muthurajawela
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body: - Under the Muthurajawela Development Project which was implemented in the year 1994, the squatters who were residing in the marshy area of the land were relocated in a section of the said land subsequent to its development.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to issue title deeds for the families identified after a survey done with regard to granting of title deeds to the occupants of these lands, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing of funds for the purchase of Railway Locomotives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet had been granted previously, to purchase 12 Railway Locomotives for the Sri Lanka Railways with the objective of improving the Upcountry Railway Line operations. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into an Agreement to secure a sum of US$ 48.67 million as funds necessary for the purpose, from  the Standard Chartered Bank with the collaboration of the Export Development Canada, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the National Environmental Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body:
- The National Environmental Act, No.47 of 1980 provides the legal framework for the coordination of all sectors related to the environment of Sri Lanka, at national level and the Central Environmental Authority has been established as the fundamental institution for implementing the functions pertaining to the Act.  Even though, this Act has been amended in several instances to suit the timely needs, the necessity for amending the Act has been recognized in order to find solutions for the present environmental issues as well as those that may arise in future.  
	
	Accordingly, in order to face current and future issues successfully, especially with regard to water pollution caused by factories, urban waste related issues and issues caused by illegal constructions, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft necessary legislation to amend the National Environmental Act, No.47 of 1980, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Office for Reparations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-12
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted to draft legislation to establish an Office for Reparation to identify suitable persons for reparation and to carry out the reparation activities pertaining to the payment of compensation to those who were harmed due to getting caught in conflict situations, political unrest, civil commotion, forcible disappearance and various other causes, in a more formalized and a transparent manner. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to publish the draft Bill for the establishment of the  office for Reparations prepared by the Legal Draftsman in the Government Gazette and   subsequently, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of buildings for the use of the Ceylon Electricity Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct eight housing complexes and a dormitory comprising of 24 rooms, available with all facilities for the Engineers in the Lakvijaya Power Plant in Puttalam. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for the construction, to M/s George Steuart Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., in accordance with the recommendation of the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Container Carrier Wagons and Container Boxes to transport solid waste from Kelaniya to Aruwakkalu
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - he Cabinet has granted approval previously, to construct a Municipal Solid Waste Sanitary Landfill Disposal Facility at the Aruwakkalu area in Puttalam and the contract in that regard has already been awarded. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to commence the procurement procedure to procure  34 container carrier wagons and 94 container boxes to transport the solid waste collected in the selected municipal areas in Colombo up to Aruwakkalu area, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Beira Lake Intervention Area Development Plan and the Bank Protection
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - The Urban Development Authority has planned to develop the area surrounding the Beira Lake as a tourist attraction destination, preserving its natural beauty. Under this programme, the necessity of implementation of projects pertaining to the establishment of a Linear Park around the lake, development of the surrounding lands of the lake and the infrastructure facilities have been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to take necessary action to conserve the lake bank prior to commencing the said development activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Medical Examination Gloves
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the supply of  79,430,000 locally manufactured unsterile Medical Examination Gloves made of Rubber latex (in various sizes), used in medical examinations, to M/s Sisili Project Consortium (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.448.3 million, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Surgical Rubber Gloves
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the supply of 31,041,000 locally manufactured Sterile Surgical Rubber Gloves made of rubber latex (in various sizes) for single use, powdered, in pairs, sterile packed in peel open package for surgeries, to M/s Sisili Project Consortium (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.1,199.9 million, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procuring of 500 New Buses for the Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - Although 7,257 buses are required according to the transportation time table of the Sri Lanka Transport Board, to fulfill the passenger requirements, only 6,000 buses have been operated in service due to the shortage of buses. 1,560 buses of the fleet of  buses of the Sri Lanka Transport Board are more than 15 years old, and since they constantly succumb to technical failures, the Board has not been able to provide a dependable service to fulfill the passenger requirements. Annually about 500 buses have to be removed from the fleet due to expiry of the life span and accidents. Considering these issues, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to procure  400 New Buses with 50-54 High Back Seaters to be deployed  for  passenger services in urban routes and 100 New Buses with 32-35 Seaters to be used for the passenger services in the rural routes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a new Act to make the Sri Lankan labour force the shareholders of the economy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body:
- The Department of Labour, from its inception up to now has enforced 61 Acts related to the Service Conditions, Social Protection and Occupational Hygiene and Safety of Workers and out of them only 27 Acts are being practically implemented, at present. As several discrepancies seem to have been found between certain service conditions in these Acts, it has been proposed to make a single Act pertaining to the conditions of employment without prejudice to the existing labour rights, with a view to averting the discrepancies encountered when implementing them. By this Act, it is expected to introduce flexible service conditions to get the inactive labour population in Sri Lanka to  contribute to the economic development. 
	
       	Accordingly, the  the proposal made by Hon. Ravindra Samaraweera, the Minister of Labour & Trade Union Relations, to introduce a new Act in respect of employment replacing the Wages Boards Ordinance, Shop and Office Employees Act, the Employment of Women, Young Persons and Children Act and the Maternity Benefits Ordinance, without any prejudice to the labour rights enforced by the labour laws already imposed, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Cooperation in the areas of Digitalization between Sri Lanka and Finland
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication, Digital Infrastructure and Foreign Employment, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Cooperation in the fields of Digitalization so as to cover the areas of  Cyber Security, E-Government, Digital Services and Critical Online Communication Methods, between Sri Lanka and  Finland during the official visit of the Deputy Minister of Economic Affairs and Employment of Finland, to Sri Lanka from 10th to 13th June 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of a Master Plan for the Hambantota District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to set up a Special Economic Zone in Hambantota, in collaboration with the Government of China and for this purpose, China Harbour Engineering Corporation has been nominated by the Government of China. Under this, the construction of Sri Lanka - China Logistics and the Industrial Zone in Monaragala and Hambantota Districts are scheduled to be carried out under 03 stages. It has been decided that it would be appropriate to prepare a Master Plan for the Hambantota District, in order to ensure that a well planned urban development is carried out in the area concurrent to the development activities. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Youth Affairs, Project Management and Southern Development, to establish a consultancy service institute for the purpose and to set up a Project Management Unit for the coordination of the said project and also to provide the required facilities for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National Centre of e Content Development for Computer Assisted Teaching
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - A project proposal has been prepared by the Ministry of education to formalize  information technology education and the use of information technology for education in Sri Lankan schools and action will be taken to provide computers and accessories to all provincial Information Technology Resource Centres and to establish two communication technology information centres each at the Nilwala National College of Education premises and the Addalachchenai National College of Education premises and also to establish a National e‑Content Development Centre at the Narangala Estate premises in Kuliyapitiya.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to secure funds amounting to US$ 56.9 million through the Korean EXIM Bank from the Economic Development Cooperation Fund (EDCF) and the Abu Dhabi Fund, for the implementation of this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of a packet of milk to School Children
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - The programme of providing a packet of milk to school children from Grade 1 to Grade 5 of the selected schools in the morning, covering the students in the special educational units as well, is implemented up to date, uninterruptedly from the year 2013. Under this programme, a packet of milk containing 150 ml produced by the Milco Private Limited and purchased by the Government for a market value of Rs.30/-is given over to school children. Through this programme, it is anticipated to create a viable student generation minimizing the nutritional problems of school children. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to continue to conduct this programme further, even under the presently higher market price of a packet of milk, treating the importance of conducting the programme uninterruptedly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka's accession to the Convention on the Prohibition of the Use, Stockpiling, Production and Transfer  of Anti personnel Mines and on their Destruction: (APMBC) Ottawa Convention
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval for Sri Lanka to accede to the Convention on the Prohibition of the Use, stockpiling, production and transfer of Antipersonnel Mines and on their Destruction: (APMBC) Ottawa Convention. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms,  to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft enabling legislation to give effect to the provisions of the APMBC, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Case Management Guidelines to prevent children from all Forms of Violence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body:
- Over two decades have elapsed, since Sri Lanka had signed the convention on the 'Rights of the Child' and the Government has taken a large number of measures to ensure the protection and security of children.  While performing the activities pertaining to the protection of children from all forms of violence, it is imperative that the officers dealing with such activities carry out their services in accordance with the principles of child rights.  As such, guidelines to be adopted in such circumstances have been prepared under the name of  'Case Management Guidelines to Prevent Children from all Forms of Violence' by the Department of Probation and Child Care Services.




Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, to implement these Guidelines as the National Guidelines when taking action with regard to children and to implement, direct and monitor such guidelines by the officers in charge at all administrative levels, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Development activities to be effected within the Central Cultural Fund (CCF) Project Office premises in Polonnaruwa, to coincide with the  ' Re awakening Polonnaruwa ' Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to develop the adjacent region of the sacred city of Polonnaruwa as a world heritage zone under the 'Re‑awakening Polonnaruwa' Project. As such, it has been planned to renovate the 19th Century building  where the project office of the Central Cultural Fund in Polonnaruwa is established, as a Heritage Management Centre, Archaeological Information Centre and a sales and Exhibition Centre for local foods and industrial products, to be attractive to both local and foreign tourists while preserving its cultural identity. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, to construct a two storey market complex expeditiously, consisting of 22 small sales centres to replace the sales centres which have to be removed due to the development of the Colombo - Batticaloa main road running in front of the said building,  concurrent to the development activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the progress of the Programme for Control of Weligama Coconut leaf Wilt and Rot Disease
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - In order to prevent the damage caused to the coconut cultivation, as a result of the Weligama coconut leaf wilt and rot disease prevalent in the Southern Province, the approval of the Cabinet had been granted prior to this to continue to implement the Programme further from 2018 to 2020. Under this programme, steps are taken for the identification of sick trees, marking for removal, spreading awareness of the disease, supply of alternative economic crops and for the development of facilities for the generation of coconut varieties resistant to the disease and for the payment of Rs.3,000 per coconut tree removed, as compensation to land owners. In this context Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries informed the Cabinet that 832 infected coconut trees had been removed during the first quarter of the year 2018 and that a further 819 coconut trees have been identified for removal under this programme.

description: Introducing 'Health' as a Compulsory Subject for GCE (O/L) Examination
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body:
- According to the latest statistics available, around 75% of the deaths that occur in Sri Lanka annually are attributed to non-communicable diseases. Further, it has been revealed that 72.5% of the total population do not consume enough vegetables and fruits and that around 44% of the female population do not engage in sufficient physical exercises. In order to avert this situation and to lead a healthy lifestyle, a proper awareness on health is essential. Nevertheless,  health as a subject is taught in schools only from the year six and the year nine as a compulsory subject and it is not mandatory for the G.C.E. (O/L) examination.
	
Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposals made by the Expertise Committee on Educational Reforms to the effect that the subject of 'Health and Physiology' should be taught in schools as a compulsory subject up to the G.C.E. (O/L) examination from the next revision of the school syllabi, to be made in the year 2023, the Cabinet granted approval to implement the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, after obtaining the recommendations of the National Education Commission which is the authority on policy decisions with regard to the revision of the school syllabi.

description: Provision of the State of the Art Medical Equipment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body:
- Presently, cancer has been identified as the second major cause of death in Sri Lanka owing to diseases. There is a tendency for patients with a sound financial position to seek treatment from centres in foreign countries due to the lack of advanced facilities of modern technology in Sri Lanka to control the disease. If there is a possibility of the early detection of the disease, its development in more than 1/3 of the patients could be prevented but around 70% of all cancer cases in the low and middle income countries are diagnosed after being too far gone and as a result, the deaths of cancer cases have increased. 
	
	Having taken the situation into consideration, it has been proposed to implement a project to procure and install a 3 Tesla MRI Scanner at the National Cancer Hospital, Maharagama for early detection and diagnosis of the disease  and a Gamma Knife Package and a PET/CT Scanner at the Teaching Hospital in Kandy. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to obtain a comprehensive proposal from Odelga Med G.m.b.H, Austria  and to conduct loan negotiations with the UniCredit Bank of Austria to secure the funds required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the Membership of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia (CICA) by Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - This Multinational Forum was established in the year 1992 to enhance cooperation towards promoting peace, security and stability in the Asian region.  As of now, Sri Lanka is working as an observer country of this conference where 26 countries including India, China and Russia have obtained the membership. China which holds the current Chairmanship of the Conference has invited Sri Lanka to obtain the full pledged membership of the conference and thereby, Sri Lanka has got the opportunity to further develop interaction with all member states. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, for Sri Lanka to obtain the membership of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia (CICA), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promotion and Implementation of the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' Interest Subsidy Loan Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body:
- In accordance with the budget proposals of 2017 and 2018, the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' Interest Subsidy Loan Scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Finance and Mass Media in collaboration with the state and private banks, foreign financial cooperation institutes and the other participatory institutes. Through this programme it is expected to build a business paradise in Sri Lanka, using the innate entrepreneur expertise of the Sri Lankans. Under this programme consisting of 11 interest subsidy loan schemes, 3 refinancing loan schemes inclusive of 2 financial and non‑financial schemes, concessions are provided under 16 schemes. Accordingly, funds over Rs.30 billion have been provided by now to entrepreneurs of around 12,405 in number. The Government has set apart Rs.5,250 million for the year 2018 for the payment of interest subsidies alone in respect of the loan schemes, implemented under the programme and the Government expects the generation of 50,000 new employment opportunities, through the creation of a capital of nearly Rs.60,000 million. 
	
 	With a view to popularizing the programme further among the general public, it is expected to implement it as a national level promotional programme, under the theme '2025 vision' along with the other development programmes of the Government once in every three (03) months covering all Provinces of the country in the hope of providing the necessary guidance to expand the products of the entrepreneurs up to the international level. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to establish a Secretariat in the Ministry of Finance and Mass Media to coordinate the activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion and improvement of Daycare facilities for children
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body:
- The need for taking measures for the expansion and improvement of Daycare facilities for children having been drawn to the attention of the Cabinet, prior to this, by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, a Committee comprising of the representatives of the institutions of the relevant field, was appointed by the Cabinet, to make the necessary recommendations in that regard to the Cabinet.     

Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, and Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, to take the necessary steps to implement professional training programmes offering a relevant NVQ level for childcare givers with the consensus of  the relevant stakeholders, to encourage the youth to follow the child care courses through the provision of soft loan facilities under the Government loan schemes and to introduce a concessionary loan scheme up to a sum of Rs.02 million for the youth trained in the process, to establish daycare centres, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing of funds for the implementation of the  Primary Health Care System Strengthening Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-06-05
decision_details_body: - A consensus has been reached with the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) of the World Bank for securing funds in a sum of US$ 200 million required for the implementation of the Primary Health Care System Strengthening Project designed for strengthening the health care protection network of Sri Lanka, with special emphasis on the primary health care services. Accordingly, the Cabinet was informed by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to the effect that it has been agreed to implement this project within a period of 5 ½ years and settle this loan in 33 years with a grace period of 06 years.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer to be distributed under the Fertilizer Subsidy of the Government - 2018 June
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body: Chemical Fertilizer is imported by the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Ltd. and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizers Ltd., to be supplied to the farmers. With a view to distributing the required fertilizer in the month of June 2018 under this programme, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture, to purchase 6,000 MT of Muriate of Potash at US$ 311.74 per 01 MT from M/s Valency International Trading (Pvt.) Ltd. of Singapore, and 18,000 MT of Urea at US$ 280.90 per 01 MT from M/s Agri Commodities & Finance FZE of Abu Dhabi, as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board (PAB), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Emergency Measures necessary for the control of the influenza epidemic spreading in the  Southern Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body: Nearly 2,000 patients of suspected influenza have been admitted to the hospitals of the Southern Province within the past 02 months and it has been reported that 11 patients have died during the period. The Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine has taken numerous measures for the control of the disease, including provision of emergency treatment services and setting up of places for segregating patients. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mohomed Casim Mohomed Faizal, the Acting Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to provide the additional medical equipment, other equipment and facilities without delay, to be supplied to the relevant hospitals expeditiously, for further strengthening the measures taken up for the prevention of  spreading the disease within the Province and the adjacent areas, in accordance with the instructions of H.E. the President, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting of the 18th International Conference of the Parties to the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Fauna and Flora - (CITES)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body:
Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to host the 18th International Conference of the Parties to the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Fauna and Flora (CITES) from 22nd May to 03rd June 2019 in Sri Lanka. Even though, the responsibility of organizing this conference was vested with the then Ministry of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, it has since been entrusted to the Ministry of Buddhasasana by the Gazette Notification No.2064/26 dated 2018‑03‑28.  

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to sign the Memorandum of Understanding on hosting of the conference in Sri Lanka, to be entered into with the CITES Secretariat, on behalf of the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Training of Unemployed Graduates on Staggered Basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body:
- Considering the need to provide employment for unemployed Graduates, measures will be taken to call for all unemployed graduates under 45 years of age who have submitted their applicaions, for an interview. It has been planned to recruit  5,000 graduates in July 2018 and 15,000 in September 2018 for training. During the training period, they will be provided with a monthly allowance of Rs.20,000/-. It has also been planned to train the rest of the graduates in the year 2019 on staggered basis.
	
	As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to implement the programme for training of unemployed graduates and recruit the graduates who will fulfill the qualifications in terms of the Service Minute of the Development Officers, to fill the vacancies of the post of Development Officer, out of those who complete the training, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Productive utilization of the savings of  contingencies allocated for the Rural Bridges Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to construct 35 rural bridges at the same rates indicated in the original contract agreements by utilizing the savings of contingencies allocated for construction of bridges in the rural areas and construction of temporary bridges with a length of 36 meters for each Province. However,  it has been proposed at the National Steering Committee Meeting, that it would be more appropriate to construct 15 additional bridges in the most essential flood affected locations instead of 09 temporary bridges at provincial level as previously proposed.

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils, Local Government and Sports, to construct 15 steel bridges in the most essential flood affected locations, instead of constructing 09 temporary bridges at provincial level, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of services of International Forensic Audit Firm/s for Forensic Audits/Investigations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Report furnished by the Commission of Inquiry appointed by His Excellency the President to investigate into the alleged irregularities said to have been committed in the issuance of the Central Bank Treasury Bonds, after its investigation, has recommended to conduct different Forensic Audits in respect of the matters specified thereto. A proposal has been made to obtain the services of an independent firm/s with a an exellent performance and expertise in the field and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to appoint a Consultancy Procurement Committee to select a suitable audit firm, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Supply, Installation, Testing and Operation of Railway Level Crossing Protection
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body: - The contract for supply, installation, testing and operation of 25 Double Line and 175 Single Line Level Crossing Protection Systems inclusive of the requirement of Training was awarded to a consortium consisting of M/s N‑Able (Pvt.) Ltd. and M/s Uni Consultancy Services of the University of Moratuwa. The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to extend  the duration of the project by a period of 12 months taking into consideration the various issues that have cropped up in the implementation of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the New Villages Development Authority for Plantation Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. U. Palani Digambaram, the Minister of  Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development, to publish the New Villages Development Authority Act, in respect of the Plantation Region, prepared incorporating provisions for the establishment of the New Villages Development Authority, in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Programme for the expeditious grant of deeds to the General Public
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Government Policy of granting all citizens the ownership of land,  a National Programme for the distribution of 1 million Permits / Grants to the people residing in state lands has been initiated. The main programmes under the above have been conducted in the districts of Polonnaruwa, Moneragala, Galle and Anuradhapura.  It has been planned to conduct the main programmes relevant to the remaining 21 districts and 03 programmes in each district at divisional level within the period from May to December of 2018. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms, to allocate additional Funds from the Treasury to the Land Commissioner General's Department for the implementation of this programme, in all districts and at divisional level, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Management of waste within the Harbours in the Coastal Zone of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body: - Approximately, 30% of the total population of Sri Lanka lives associated with the sea coast where several major economic related activities including the fisheries industry and the tourism industry are carried out. As a result of the improper management of the waste generated, sea pollution in the zone has reached a high level and posed a severe threat to the public health.  Accordingly, the joint proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment and the then Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development, to set up a Waste Management Committee with the representation of all institutions engaged in waste management activities in the coastal zone and to provide a mechanism to take action strickly against the persons polluting the coastal zone, under the Dengue Prevention Act, the National Environmental Act and the Marine Environment Protection Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Customs Ordinance to facilitate the 'Single Window' implementation to improve Ease of Doing Business Index
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body:
- It is essential to improve the efficiency and the simplicity of the trading process for the improvement of the Business Climate and the Investment Climate of the Economy of Sri Lanka and as such, it has been proposed to implement the pre‑arrival clearance and paperless customs process prior to the importing process. This will reduce the costs and time of the Traders during the clearance process and Ease of Doing Business Index will improve. 

Therefore, a proposal has been made to amend the Customs Ordinance by incorporating provisions to that effect. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft the proposed amendments to the Customs Ordinance to be included in the (Amendment) Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief to the Beach Seine (Madel) Fishers of Kalametiya who were adversely affected by the construction of the Kalametiya Fishery Harbour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body: - As a result of the construction of Kalametiya Fishery Harbour and the Breakwater, the traditional beach seine fishing industry in the area was hampered and it has adversely affected  28  beach seine fishers and 644 of their dependents. It has been found that a significant loss of annual income has been sustained by the Madel owners. In this regard, a proposal has been made to provide 36ft multiday boats at a cost of Rs. 7.8 million, to the 28 Madel owners, separately instead of monitary compensation. Accordingly, considering the above factors, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to provide 36 ft.  multiday boats to each 28  Madel owners, separately and a 50% of the total cost to be borne by the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resources Development Scholarship Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body:
- The Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resources Development Scholarship Programme was introduced to Sri Lanka in the year 2010, in order to provide opportunities to the public sector officials of the executive grade to undergo Master Degree programmes in prominent universities in Japan. By now, 135 officers have got the opportunity to follow studies under two frameworks in this programme. In response to a request made by the Government of Sri Lanka, the Government of Japan has expressed its willingness to continue this programme for the ensuing 4 years, uninterruptedly. Under this programme, it has been proposed to provide 15 scholarships for Post Graduate Degree courses each year and 02 Scholarships for the Doctorate degree for the next 4 years. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs,  to sign an Agreement with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) to obtain a grant of Japanese Yen 265 million, in order to implement the proposed Human Resources Development Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Budget Proposal of 2018 on the Middle Income Housing Loan Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body:
- In accordance with a proposal in the Budget of 2018, the Middle Income Housing Loan Scheme is implemented with the objective of supporting the first time home buyers to obtain a house from the Middle Income Housing Loan Scheme implemented by the National Housing Development Authority and the Urban Development Authority. It has been found that the demand for housing cannot be fulfilled expeditiously through the housing projects implemented by the Government, as a result of the non‑availability of adequate extents of lands and the time taken for the  completion of the construction activities.

As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to expand this housing loan scheme to make enable the first time home byres of the middle income category to purchase houses from the private sector as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Emergency Pre-Hospital Care Ambulance Service in Sri Lanka '1990 Suwaseriya Foundation' - Implementation of Phase II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-30
decision_details_body: - As of now, action is being taken to establish '1990 Suwaseriya' Pre-Hospital Care Ambulance Service by an Act of Parliament. Under its second Phase, it has been planned to expand the said ambulance service, presently being implemented in Western and Southern Provinces to the other Provinces in the Island as well. The Indian Government has expressed its willingness to grant a credit facility of US $15.02 million for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to bear the relevant tax expenditure to be incurred for the second Phase of the said ambulance service by his Ministry, until the '1990 Suwaseriya Foundation' is established, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of bus fares in keeping with the increase in fuel prices
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body:
- Considering the demand made by the Bus Associations to revise the bus fares in keeping with the increase of fuel prices from 2018‑05‑11, the Cabinet granted approval at its meeting held on 2018‑05‑15 to increase the other bus fares by 6.56% while keeping the minimum fare of Rs.10/- static. However, the Bus Associations made representations to the effect that the increase of bus fare is inadequate and the Government has also agreed that certain value fluctuations in the price mechanism on which the annual bus fare revision is based should be amended to suit the present day values. 

	Considering these factors, the Deputy Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation     and the Deputy Minister of Finance and Mass Media had made discussions with the Bus Associations. According to the agreement reached at the discussion, and taking into consideration the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, the Cabinet granted approval to increase the minimum charge of Rs.10/- up to Rs.12/- and the other bus fares by 12.5% with effect from 2018‑05‑22, subject to the condition that no revision of bus fares will be made during the forthcoming period of two years.

description: Implementation of the 'Suraksha' Health Care Insurance Scheme for School Children during the period 2018/2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body:
- An insurance scheme has been implemented under the 'Suraksha' Health Care Insurance Scheme for all school children between the age of 05 - 19, in accordance with the Budget proposal 2017 and accordingly, a health care insurance certificate valued at Rs.200,000/- will be provided for every child. The Insurance Scheme will grant up to Rs.100,000/- for indoor patients treatments and Rs.10,000/- for outdoor patients treatments. The Insurance Scheme is presently  implemented by the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation and provisions have been allocated to implement the said Insurance Scheme during the year 2018/2019 as well.
Accordingly, taking into consideration, a proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, pertaining to the selection of a suitable insurance institution, to take measures to call for proposals from Government Insurance Institutions and to select an Insurance Institution which will provide more benefits to the school children, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: e Motoring Project of the Department of Motor Traffic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for designing an information technology solution for the e‑Motoring Project of the Department of Motor Traffic under Build, Operate and Transfer basis, to 'Face Technologies & Metropolitan Joint Venture', as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 40,000 permanent houses for the low income families resettled in the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body:
- When providing a permanent solution to the housing problems of the displaced and affected persons due to the conflict which existed in the Northern and Eastern Provinces of Sri Lanka, a large scale housing project has to be implemented with the intervention of the Government. The proposal made prior to this for the construction of 65,000 prefabricated houses for the purpose was not implemented due to the opposition of certain parties. The recommendation made by the National Building Research Organization (NBRO) for the construction of houses using the concrete panel technology, as an alternative has been acclaimed by the people and the Political Representatives of those areas.  

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Resettlement, Rehabilitation, Northern Development & Hindu Religious Affairs, to construct 40,000 permanent houses of 650 sq.ft. for the low income families resettled in the Northern and Eastern areas using the concrete panel technology, within a period of two (02) years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Traditional Brick and Mortar Type Permanent Housing Programme for conflict affected families in the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body:
- The approval of the Cabinet has been granted to construct 50,000 Traditional Brick and Mortar Type Houses to the families affected during the conflict of Northern and Eastern Provinces.  For this purpose, proposals were called for from the contractors and out of such proposals, the proposals presented by the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat), the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS),  Habitat for Humanity Sri Lanka and the Sri Lanka Red Cross Society (SLRCS) led non‑profit oriented humanitarian organizations consortium with 3 options, has been recommended by the Negotiation Committee appointed by the Cabinet as being most advantageous. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to take future action in accordance with the proposal made by the said consortium to construct 25,000 of the said type of houses in the Districts of Jaffna, Kilinochchi, Mannar, Mullaithivu, Trincomalee and Batticaloa under Phase 1 of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Five (5) programmes implemented under the  Presidential Task Forces to be integrated into the society through the 'Model Village' Housing Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body:
- The National Programme initiated for the construction of 2500 new model villages by the year 2020 through the National Housing Development Authority  by the Ministry of Housing and Construction has been implemented. By now, the work of 700 model villages has commenced and out of which 60 houses have already been constructed and handed over to the beneficiaries. It has been found that, by implementing the National Programme for Kidney Disease Prevention, National Programme for Environmental Conservation, National Programmes for Food Production and Drug Prevention National Programme as well as Let's Protect Children' national programme, at the model village level, it would be possible to achieve the desired objectives effectively. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to appoint a National Steering Committee, to coordinate the required resources and relevant institutions to implement the intended programmes through the Model Villages Programme, and report its progress to the Cabinet, once in every 06 months, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a Fertilizer Subsidy Scheme starting with the 2018 Yala cultivation season for paddy farmers using organic farming methods
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body:
- According to the method of granting fertilizer subsidy to the farmers in the form of cash, implemented from the 2016 Yala Season onwards, there was the option of using the subsidy by the farmers for the purchase of chemical fertilizer or organic fertilizer for their cultivation. However, with the granting of chemical fertilizer again to the farmers on a subsidized price from 2018 Yala Season onwards, this programme is now being implemented and this had not provided any relief to the farmers who cultivate using organic fertilizer.  

As such, taking into consideration, the importance of encouraging organic cultivation,  the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Agriculture to identify the farmers who are engaged in the organic farming in each season and the actual extents of land to be cultivated at the Grama Niladhari Division level and credit the relevant financial subsidy in their bank accounts and make the necessary adjustments in each season based on the variations in the price of chemical fertilizer, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and Australia on Recognition of Certificates issued to the Sailors
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body:
- For a Naval Officer with a Certificate of Competence to serve in a vessel registered under the flag of a foreign country, it is mandatory that he obtains  a Certificate of Recognition from the country in which the relevant vessel has been registered, in addition to the Certificate of Competency.  For the issuance of such certificates there should be a convention or Memorandum of Understanding entered into between the relevant states and Sri Lanka has already signed such agreements with 32 foreign countries.

	By entering into such agreements, employment opportunities will be open to a large number of Sri Lankan Naval Officers with Certificate of Competency to serve in foreign vessels. The Government of Australia has expressed its willingness to enter into an agreement with the Government of Sri Lanka on the issuance of these certificates. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding pertaining to the recognition of certificates of maritime proficiency, with the Government of  Australia, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a new Agreement in regard to providing access to the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) to observe the places of detention in the Country
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body:
- The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) has been operating in Sri Lanka since the year 1989 and it conducts excellent relations at professional level with all relevant public institutions. According to a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed with the then representation of the Ministry of Defence, an opportunity has been provided to the Committee to visit the persons detained in Sri Lanka Prisons and the places of detention. The Committee ensures that all detainees are treated humanly and brings to the awareness of the relevant authorities the matters where attention is needed. With the change of environment following the conclusion of the armed conflict, a proposal has been made by the Committee to enter into a new Agreement in regard to carrying out the observation activities and the visits of the Committee to the places of detention conducted in Sri Lanka. 

	When the prison network of Sri Lanka is designed in accordance with the international standards, obtaining the wide international experiences the Red Cross Committee has gained and its expertise, is really important to Sri Lanka  in order to improve the status of the detention places of Sri Lanka and the manner in which the detainees are treated. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to sign the Agreement proposed for cooperation and humanitarian activities in between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on behalf of the Government of Sri Lanka and the International Red Cross Committee to benefit the detainees deprived of their liberty, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting of the Co-operative Conference on Asian Press Councils in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body:
- The Sri Lanka Press Council takes action to conduct awareness workshops and seminars aimed at creating a positive media culture in the country, and to secure the press freedom as well as the rights of the public. In this context, it has been proposed to host the Asia Press Council Cooperative Conference in Sri Lanka, considering the benefits accrued such as the promotion of cooperation among Press Councils and the Media Councils in the countries of the South Asian Region, creating awareness of global trends and expanding the training opportunities for professional journalists and the trainee journalists.

	Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to host the proposed Asian Press Council Cooperative Conference in October 2018  in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Bonded Warehouse facilities for selected Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body:
- In accordance with the Budget proposals of 2018, a proposal has been made for granting of tax relief in the import of capital goods for pharmaceutical manufacturing industry, dairy production industry, solid waste management and renewable energy production enterprises and providing facilities in order to eliminate delays in Custom clearance.

	By this, it is expected to develop said sectors by providing relief to the local investors who are engaged in the importation of capital goods for the establishment or expansion of the said industries. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to introduce  a method of bonded warehouse facilities to provide new investments to expand the industries of the pharmaceutical manufacturing, dairy production, solid waste management and renewable energy production, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increase of the subsidy provided by the Government for the 'Sisu Seriya', 'Gemi Seriya' and 'Nisi Seriya' Bus Passenger Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body:
- The Government has introduced 'Sisu Seriya' and 'Gemi Seriya' projects  respectively, to provide bus passenger transport services to school students and the students of Universities, Technical Institutions and other similar Institutions on concessionary rates and also to provide bus services to the general public living by the non‑profitable rural routes. The 'Nisi Seriya' project is also implemented to ensure the reliability of the night final turn and the dawn first turn. 

	It is essential to further encourage the implementation of these bus passenger services and accordingly, considering the timely cost, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to increase the concessionary cost granted by the Government for these bus passenger services, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining private investment on Public Private Partnership(PPP) Basis for construction of the buildings for the Public Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body:
- The Government has to spend a large sum of money from the annual budgetary allocations for the construction of Government buildings such as schools, universities, hospitals and offices and also consume time and funds to construct and maintain such buildings. As such, focus has been made to find the possibility of obtaining private sector investments for the construction of Government buildings to enable the Government funds to be utilized for other priority activities.  

	A proposal has been made to adopt the Public Private Partnership Model to construct the new Government buildings in the fields of education, higher education, skills development & vocational training and health.  According to this method, the private investor will construct a building for a Government institute and after a lapse of a period of 15 to 20 years, the Government will acquire the building.  During this period the maintenance of the building will be carried out under the Public Private Partnership basis and the Government will pay the guaranteed rental to the private investor.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to take action to call for proposals from private investors under the said system in relevance to the above fields to construct the buildings required by the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and Rwanda on Cooperation in the field of Defence and Security
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to enter into a MoU between Sri Lanka and  Rwanda with a view to encouraging, facilitating and promoting military cooperation and providing a structure for capacity building, cooperation in Defence  and  Security, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Membership of the International Coral Reef Initiative by Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-22
decision_details_body:
- Sri Lanka is unique out of the countries with tropical coral reefs which is an environmental system containing bio diversity. More than 193 species of hard corals are reported from the sea belt around Sri Lanka and it has been estimated that more than 900 species of shore fish diversity exist associated with those coral reefs. These coral reefs provide an economic contribution towards fisheries, tourism and ornamental fish industry while also providing an environmental contribution through the mitigation of sea erosion and acting as a buffer to protect the sea belt from surge water. As of now, there is an imminent danger of the destruction of coral reefs due to human activities as well as natural phenomena such as cyclones and Tsunami. 

	By obtaining the membership of the International Coral Reef Initiative (ICRI) acclaimed as an International Organization which functions with the objective of protecting the coral reef resource, focus is made to derive the further benefits of the international partnerships for the conservation of coral reefs.     Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to obtain the membership of the ICRI,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of bus fares in keeping with the increase in fuel prices
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- Requests have been made by the Bus Associations for the revision of bus fares in keeping with the fuel price increase effective from 2018-05-11. The Official Committee working on the revision of the bus fair policy considering the recommendations made by the National Transport Commission and also that bus fairs are revised in the month of July every year, has made its recommendations  as to the manner in which the bus fairs should be revised.

	Accordingly, the Cabinet granted approval to increase the bus fairs by 6.56% with the minimum charge being Rs.10/- effective from 2018‑05‑16.

description: Scheme for providing the  Kerosene subsidy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet on 2018-05-09 approved the implementation of the 'Pricing Formula System' for the petroleum products and accordingly, instructions were given to the relevant institutions to design a proper scheme to grant a kerosene subsidy to the low income families with no access to electricity and the small scale fishery community using mechanized boats who will be affected due to the increase in fuel price. 

	As such, taking into consideration the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Petroleum Resources Development, approval of the Cabinet has been granted to take necessary action in keeping with the amount of increase in the price of kerosene to provide the subsidy for kerosene,  implemented up to now also in the future.

description: Purchasing of dates  required to be distributed amongst Islamic devotees during the Ramalan festival
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- It is a religious practice amongst Islamic devotees to consume dates at the breaking of the fast during the Ramalan festival. As such, it is usual for the Government of Saudi Arabia to provide the requirement of dates to the Government of Sri Lanka as a donation for the consumption of the Islamic devotees during this period. However, this year the Government of Saudi Arabia has not made any donation of dates to Sri Lanka but has received a stock of 03MT of dates from 03 private donors.

	Therefore, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, and Hon. M.H.A. Haleem, the Minister of Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs, to purchase the additional stock of 250 MT of dates from the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment (CWE) required to be distributed during the Ramalan festival amongst the Islamic devotees through the mosques specially centered around the Muslim families beset with financial difficulties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resolving the educational problems of the students of the Medical Faculty of the South Asian Institute of Technology and Medicine - SAITM
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet granted approval on 2018-03-06 to implement a methodology in accordance with the recommendations made by the Officials' Committee Chaired by the Secretary to the Ministry of Defence pertaining to the absorption of the students of the South Asian Institute of Technology and Medicine engaged in studying medicine to the Institute of General Sir John Kothalawala Defence University. Subsequently, discussions were held on 2018‑05‑09 presided over by H.E. the President and with the participation of the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs on 2018‑05‑10 in regard to the legal and practical problems arisen when implementing the approved methodology. 

	The joint proposals made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena in his capacity as the Minister of Defence; and Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legal provision with regard to the implementation of the following recommendations pertaining to the absorption of the medical students of the SAITM into the Faculty of Medicine of the Kothalawala Defence University, as decided at the said discussions, was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	Out of the students who have registered with the SAITM institute from 15th September, 2009 up to 15th of May 2017 to the course of study in medicine only, the students who have fulfilled the basic qualifications to be admitted to the Medical Faculties in the State Universities to be absorbed into the Faculty of Medicine of the General Sir John Kothalawala Defence University. 

*	Granting authority to the Board of Management of the said University to stipulate the requirements and conditions for the absorption of the said students to the General Sir John Kothalawa Defence University.

*	Out of the students absorbed into the General Sir John Kothalawa Defence University from the SAITM institute, the students who pass the relevant examination of the Sir John Kothalawa Defence University will be awarded the degree of the said University.

description: Construction of Pulathisi  Market Complex and Agro-Economic Centre at Kaduruwela, Polonnaruwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- A proposal has been made to construct a market complex consisting of 58 sales outlets in an area spread over 8 acres under the 'Pibidemu Polonnaruwa' National Programme by the year 2019 to provide facilities for the farmers in Polonnaruwa to sell their agricultural products and to provide facilities for the people of the area to buy such products. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to award the contract for the construction of this market complex with an agro- economic centre, food court, children's park, a vehicle park and other common amenities as well to the Central Engineering  Consultancy Bureau, for a sum of Rs.623.2 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the contract for the construction of Wellamankara Fishery Harbour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- The approval of the Cabinet has been granted earlier to construct the Wellamankara Fishery Harbour with two breakwaters with 4 meters deep and 700 meters long to provide all service facilities for fishery boats of 40 to 60 feet in size engaged in the fishery industry. 

	The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the then Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to award the contract for the construction of the said fishery harbour to M/s R R Construction (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.1,862.25 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), also taking into consideration the concurrence given by the present Hon. Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Rural Economic Affairs, in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Hambantota 220/132kV Grid Substation and Augmentation of the existing  Hambantota Grid Substation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for the construction of the Hambantota 220/132kV Grid Substation and augmentation of the existing  132/33 KV Hambantota Grid Substation, under the Green Power Development & Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme, to M/s Chint Electric Co., Ltd., for a sum of Rs,1866.49 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Mulankavil Water Supply Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body: - Under the Mulankavil Water Supply Scheme, it is expected to provide safe drinking water to nearly ten thousands of people residing in Mulankavil area in the Kilinochchi District. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the above contract for the construction of the said water supply scheme, to the Joint Venture of M/s Ceylex Engineering (Pvt) Ltd., and Prathibha Industries Limited, for a sum of Rs.608.49 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting of permission for the operation of Currency Exchange Counters in the Arrival Terminal of the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA), at Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to avail the permission for maintaining the operation of Currency Exchange Counters in the Arrival Terminal beyond the Customs area at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA), Katunayake, to the Commercial Bank of Ceylon PLC, Sampath Bank PLC, Thomas Cook Lanka (Pvt.) Ltd., Bank of Ceylon and the People's Bank, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Development Programmes in the Mannar District concurrent to the  Meela'd-Un-Nabi Celebration - 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body: - Mannar district has been selected to conduct the major celebrations of the   Meela'd‑Un‑Nabi - 2018 and its major event is scheduled to be conducted at the Muslim National School. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. M.H.A. Haleem, the Minister of Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs, seeking the active co-operation and support of the Central Government, the Northern Provincial Council and the other institutions, in order to implement the development activities proposed to be carried out concurrent to the   Meela'd‑Un‑Nabi Celebration to develop the common amenities and the infrastructure facilities of the Muslim people who have been resettled in their places of origin after being displaced and living in welfare camps for a long period of time, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing sponsorship to 13 Government approved unaided private schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- Due to urbanization and the increase in population there is a tremendous competition for admission of children to national and provincial schools in Sri Lanka and the need to resolve this social problem with Government mediation through expanding the educational opportunities, has been identified. It would enable to ensure a high quality standard of education by facilitating those Government approved private schools where the national syllabus is implemented under the supervision of the Ministry of Education, thereby providing a reliable alternative solution for the national issue for the parents when admitting a child  to a school. 

	Presently, there are 80 Government approved private schools registered under the Ministry of Education and the Government provides all such schools with benefits such as school uniforms and text books free of charge.  Out of which the Government provides aid to 36 schools for the payment of teacher salaries. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to expand this sponsorship further and grant aid for 13 selected private schools which do not receive Government aid with ability to provide the children with qualitative and competitive education to be treated as Government sponsored schools based on the criteria of the Ministry of Education, was approved y the Cabinet.

description: Alienation of lands vested in the Land Reform Commission to outsiders and institutions on Lease Basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- In terms of the provisions of the Land Reform Act No.01 of 1992 the alienation of lands vested in the Land Reform Commission for commercial and agricultural purposes should be done with the approval of the subject Minister. However, it has been decided in the year 2011 that the approval of the Cabinet should be obtained for the purpose, in all instances except in exceptional situations.
 
	The Cabinet decided that the Minister in-charge to whom the subject of Land Reform Commission is assigned may select the beneficiaries for the alienation of land up to a maximum of 05 acres, subject to a mechanism being used to select the suitable persons in a more transparent manner based on the recommendations of a Senior Officials' Committee.

description: Revision of the name of the National Institute of Social Development as the 'Sri Lanka School of Social Work'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- The National Institute of Social Development is the only State Institute in Sri Lanka which provides education pertaining to social work. The institute which commenced in 1952 as the 'Institute of Social Work' has subsequently been named as the 'Sri Lanka School of Social Work'. Under Act No.41 of 1992 this institute has been established as a Higher Educational Institute by the name of National Institute of Social Development. Accordingly, the institute conducts higher educational courses pertaining to various subjects related to Social Work and also Counseling, Child Care, Elder Care, Community based Correction, Conflict Management, Leadership, Communication Skills and Project Management.
