	The proposal made by the experts who represent the Universities and most of those engaged in various professional fields pertaining to social work, is that when the programmes conducted by this institute is introduced to Government and Non-Governmental Institutes and also to the community at large, the name denoted by 'Sri Lanka School of Social Work' has a better professional recognition than the name of 'National Institute of Social Development'. Considering these facts, the Cabinet granted approval to change the name of  'National Institute of Social Development' and rename the institute as 'Sri Lanka School of Social Work'.

description: Construction of an auditorium for the Sri Lanka Social Security Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Social Security Board is implemented with the objective of granting pensions and social security benefits to all state sector employees who are not entitled to pension rights. When the promotional activities of this institute are carried out, the need for an auditorium to conduct training of divisional officers, to hold seminars etc. has been felt. For this purpose, the Cabinet granted approval to provide the funds to upgrade the upper floor of the Head Office of the Sri Lanka Social Security Board as an auditorium.

description: Hosting of the 5th International Conference of the International Association of Theravada Buddhist Universities (IATBU)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- The International Association of Theravada Buddhist Universities (IATBU) implemented globally for the enhancement of the Buddhist education, has become a global network that coordinates the higher educational institutions which provides the student community in understanding and following Buddhism documented in Pali Texts. Its 5th international conference has been scheduled to be held on the three days of 27th 28th and 29th of November 2018 centering Colombo and Anuradhapura. 

	As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, to host this conference in Sri Lanka under the patronage of the Sri Lanka Buddhist and Pali University in collaboration with the Sri Lanka Bhiksu University, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Sri Lanka Bhikku University Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Bhikku University, established with the objective of imparting the Buddhist monks with knowledge required for the furtherance of Buddhism, is presently carrying out a significant mission in the higher education sector in Sri Lanka.  A proposal has now been made to amend the Bhikku University Act, No.26 of 1996 incorporating provision to provide opportunities for the laymen as well to follow post graduate degree courses in view of the great keenness shown not only among the Bhikkus but also the laymen relating to the Buddhist education, also inclusive of several   amendments important in the current context,  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the then Minister of Higher Education and Highways to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation for the purpose also taking into consideration the concurrence given by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the present Minister of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs, in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The project for the construction of the Wind Power Plant in Mannar
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- In the present context, global focus has been diverted for alternate sources of electricity and the generation of electricity by using renewable energy has become a costly and environmentally uncongenial process. As a result, electricity generation with wind power and solar power is spreading globally. Being an Island in the Indian ocean and situated in a region where there is  wind blowing, there is ample wind power available in Sri Lanka for the generation of electricity.

	Cabinet has granted approval for implementing large scale wind power plants   to develop them as Wind Power Parks and as a first step of the venture, the preliminary activities necessary have been taken, by now, for the construction of a 100MW wind park in the Mannar Island.  The funds required  for the purpose is due to be granted by the Asian Development Bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to implement the construction of 100MW wind park in the Mannar Island along with the other infrastructure facilities necessary, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Use of the  'Soranawatta' Land at Horana for a middle class housing project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body: - Although, it was planned to use Soranawatta' Land at Horana to relocate the Welikada prison and the relevant institutions, the arrangements pertaining to the relocation process has been suspended due to the demands made by the local community and the political leaders of the area. As such, action is being taken to identify another plot of land suitable for the relocation of the prison. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to make use of the Soranawatta' Land at Horana to construct a housing project for the middle income earners and improve the related facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003 to introduce  exemptions in respect of Copy Right provisions by reproducing and distribution of published printed material to enable the visually impaired or otherwise print disabled people to use the print media
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- The Marrakesh Treaty administered by the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) has provided guidance to the member states to introduce a series of exceptions to relax the limits imposed on copy right provisions for facilitating access in regard to the reproduction and distribution of the published printed works to enable the persons with disability for using the printed material.

	The Cabinet has granted approval in the year 2016 to amend the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003 prior to ratifying the Marrakesh Treaty incorporating a series of exemptions in regard to the existing copy right provisions. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to publish the draft (Amendment) Bill to the Intellectual Property Act,  No.36 of 2003 in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present it in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and Korea for the development in the field of Navigation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to sign a MoU between the Ministry of Ports and Shipping of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries of the Republic of Korea with a view to exchanging  technological information between the two countries for the development of the field of navigation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the Implementation of an Emergency Air and Technical Rescue System for Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to establish an Emergency Air and Technical Rescue System for Sri Lanka which responds expeditiously to transport the affected persons by air to the closest hospital for treatment from the scene of the accident when a sudden accident occurs. According to the project proposal, presented by a non‑profit organization in Germany known as Bijorn Steiger Stiftung, it has been planned to provide the services of an emergency rescue system with 8 helicopters and 25 technical rescue vehicles during an emergency. The estimated cost of this project is Rs.190 million and the sum will be provided as a long term soft loan.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to appoint a Project Committee and a Negotiation Committee to make a feasibility study on the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Survey for identification of Risk factors of the non-communicable diseases in stages
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body: - The National Survey STEPS is conducted for identifying the data in stages on risk factors that contribute to the non-communicable diseases with the objective of collecting the data necessary to determine the spread of non-communicable diseases and for the preparation of plans for deciding the prevalence and the prevention and control of the non‑communicable diseases. Since the year 2003, this National Survey is conducted once in every 05 years and preparations are underway to conduct it once again in the year 2018.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to conduct the National Survey STEPS Island-wide at an estimated cost of Rs.50 million, in the month of August in the year 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading the Health facilities in the Estate Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- There are more than 220,000 families living in the Estate Sector of the country.  90% of the labour force in the Estate Sector constitute of women and the nutrition status of the children and the pregnant mothers living in those areas are at a low ebb when compared with the rest of the areas in the Island. As such, the necessity of giving priority to upgrade the health facilities in the Estate Sector has been identified. Presently, there are about 450 Estate Dispensaries under the estate management and a proposal has been made to enhance the health status of the estate sector by upgrading of the said Dispensaries.  

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to integrate the Estate Health Network with that of the Government to enable the people of the Estate Sector to obtain the health services conveniently in the manner the services as   provided by the Government to the people of the other Rural and Urban Areas and to vest all the Estate Health Institutes now implemented under the Estate Management with the Government in Phases, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting of loans at a concessionary interest rate for the damaged business properties in the Kandy Administrative District as a result of the conflicts that occurred
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet on 2018‑03‑20 granted approval to grant loans at a concessionary interest rate to revive the damaged businesses as a result of the conflicts that occurred in the Kandy administrative district in the first week of March 2018 at a concessionary rate of 2% interest, subject to the relevant conditions and the stipulations of the 'Athwela Loan Scheme'. However, the maximum loan amount granted by the loan scheme is around Rs.500,000/-. When considering the extent of damages caused to the business places the maximum loan amount appears to be inadequate. 


Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Public Enterprise & Kandy City Development, to increase the maximum loan amount up to Rs.1 million granted under the 'Athwela Loan Scheme' at a concessionary rate of 2% interest for the business places so damaged, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of new members to the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) National Coordinating Committee (NCC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- The Financial Intelligence Unit  (FIU) in Sri Lanka was established in 2006 under the Ministry of Finance and with the introduction of the National Anti‑Money Laundering (AML) and Countering the Financing of Terrorism   Policy, it was renamed as the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism National Coordinating Committee (NCC). 
 
	With the development of technology, the financial crimes becoming complex from day to day and the coordination with various Government institutions has become an essential factor in order to face them successfully. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to expand the composition of the National Coordinating Committee of the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism, for the inclusion of the Commissioner General of Inland Revenue, the Commissioner General of the Department of Excise, Director General of Commission to Investigate Allegation of  Bribery or Corruption and the representatives of the   Ministry of Defence and the Ministry of National Policies and Economic Affairs, as well,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Amaradeva Aesthetic and Research Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval to establish an institute by the name of 'Amaradeva Aesthetic and Research Centre' by an Act of Parliament, to preserve the musical culture introduced by the late Dr. Pandith W.D. Amaradeva known as the legendary music icon of Sri Lanka for the future generations, treating same as national heritage in gratitude to him.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to publish the draft Bill of the Amaradeva Aesthetic and Research Centre prepared by the Legal Draftsman, in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present it in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 300 Low Cost Housing Units adjacent to the  the Madhu Church in Mannar
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- Out of the Sacred places in Sri Lanka the Madhu Church is a destination held in high esteem and it is a place for worship and honour of local, foreign Catholic devotees and as well as other devotees. 
		Considering the inadequacy of the accommodation facilities available during the festive seasons,  a proposal has been made to construct 300 housing units for the use of the tourists and the devotees who visit the Madhu Church.  The Government of India has agreed to grant a financial sponsorship of Rs.300 million for the implementation of this housing project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amaratunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Sri Lanka and India to obtain the financial aid, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing of Funds for the implementation of the Primary Health Care System Strengthening Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- Owing to the high quality and the efficiency of the health care system, it has been possible for Sri Lanka, to achieve satisfactory standards in various health care indicators. However, a new trend has emerged in the increase of the number of deaths caused by non‑communicable diseases and as well as infectious diseases. The need also has arisen for the provision of health facilities for the gradual increase of the aging population.  Therefore, the strengthening of the primary Medical Care System in Sri Lanka has become an essential factor.  

	Accordingly, the Cabinet has already granted approval to implement a project for strengthening of the primary heath care system.  The International Bank for re-construction which is an institute affiliated to the World Bank has agreed to provide the US$ 200.0 million required for the purpose. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into a financial agreement with the World Bank to obtain the loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing of funds for the supply of Medical Equipment required for the Medical Faculties of Rajarata and Eastern Universities and the Faculty of Allied Health Science of the University of Peradeniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body: - The standard of the health care status of Sri Lanka is higher in comparison to the other countries of the region. The free education system and the free health services prevalent in Sri Lanka have greatly impacted towards this situation and the aim of the Government is to provide a higher quality free health and education. In this contest, a proposal has been made to provide the medical equipment required for the Medical Faculties of Rajarata and the Eastern Universities and the Faculty of Allide Health Science of the University of Peradeniya. The UniCredit Bank of Austria, A.G. has agreed to provide a loan of Euro 4.9 million to meet the expenditure required for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into the relevant loan agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of Firefighting Vehicles / Equipment for the Colombo Municipal Council
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-15
decision_details_body:
- Owing to the increase in population and the limited land space available building complexes with multi‑storyes are being constructed in the city of Colombo and its suburbs. In order to ensure the safety of these properties and the occupants of these buildings it has been proposed to supply fire fighting equipment and vehicles with the objective of increasing the capacity of the fire fighting unit of the Colombo Municipal Council. 

	The UniCredit Bank of Austria, A.G. has agreed to provide an interest free loan of Euro 10.5 million for securing the funds necessary for the purpose.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct negotiations to obtain the loan and enter into the loan Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of an Expert Committee on the Impact of the use of Glyphosate
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body: The Cabinet appointed an Officials' Committee comprising of experts, to make a study to confine the use of Glyphosate only in respect of the Plantation Sector subject to restrictions, taking into consideration the adverse effects caused on the Plantation Sector of the country due to the decision taken by the Government to impose a prohibition on the use of Glyphosate as a pesticide.  As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to permit the use of Glyphosate only for tea and rubber cultivation for a period of 36 months, under strict control, subject to the establishment of a proper monitoring mechanism for over use and misuse of Glyphosate and prevention of leakage of Glyphosate to water sources, as recommended by the Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Release of Lands in the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body:
Private and Government lands in extent of 4,992.84 acres in the Northern and Eastern Provinces used by the three forces during the conflict situation and which are not further needed, have already been released to their original owners with the consent of the Ministry of Defence.  The Sri Lanka Army has agreed to further release 522 acres of private lands in the Northern and Eastern Provinces to resettle the displaced community presently living in the welfare centres or in the residences of their friends and relatives, amidst much difficulties. 

Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, and Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Resettlement, Rehabilitation, Northern Development & Hindu Religious Affairs, to allocate the funds of a sum of of Rs. 866.71 million, required for the purpose of relocating the army camps presently existing in the private lands when releasing such private lands, to the Sri Lanka Army, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Old Kelaniya Railway Bridge
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body: The Government has identified the need for developing the railway infrastructure facilities in keeping with the increasing number of passengers traveling by train and the need for increasing the speed of the trains.  As such, the Government has launched a project to reconstruct the Old Kelaniya Railway Bridge, constructed in the year 1881, to suit the present trends. It has been estimated that Euro 9 million will have to be incurred for the project. The UniCredit Bank of Austria AG has expressed its willingness to grant an interest free loan to cover the entire cost of the project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct loan negotiations with the UniCredit Bank of Austria AG to obtain the said credit facility and to enter into the relevant loan agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Public Sector Efficiency Project (PSEP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body: The European Union (EU) has agreed to provide a grant of Euro 10 million, to strengthen the Government Institutions functioning in respect of the Public Finance Management and its capacity building and approval of the Cabinet has been granted to pursue future action with regard to obtaining those funds. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to enter into the relevant Grant Agreement and to authorize the Secretary, Ministry of Finance and Mass Media to sign the same on behalf of the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presentation in Parliament of the Annual Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the Year 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body:
The Annual Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL) is formulated in accordance with the provisions contained in the Monetary Law Act incorporating the information on the economic status of Sri Lanka, the status of the CBSL and the monetary policies and measures adopted by the Monetary Board within the year. 

	According to the 2017 Annual Report of the Central Bank, even though the economic growth has reduced up to 3.1% in the year 2017 in the midst of adverse climatic conditions and the other effects caused in that regard, the unemployment ratio has further declined up to 4.2%. Sri Lanka has succeeded in reporting a surplus in the overall Balance of Payments (BoP) amounting to US$ 2.1 billion in the year 2017 and the Gross Official Foreign Reserves have increased up to US$ 8 billion. The increase of the Tax revenue of the Government as a percentage of the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is a considerable victory. By the year 2017, the per capita income of the country has reached US$ 4,065. The Annual Report of the CBSL for the year 2017 has pointed out the importance of formulating policies aiming at the progress of the general public and the sustainable implementation of the reforms with a long term vision, in achieving the economic and development challenges of the country. As such, Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media submitted the Report to the Cabinet and the same was approved by the Cabinet for its presentation in Parliament.

description: Implementation of 03 Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Power Plants as Joint Venture Projects with the Governments of Japan, India and China and the Government of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body: China, Japan and India have expressed their willingness to sponsor to establish 03 Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Power Plants in Sri Lanka on Government to Government basis. Taking into consideration the increase in demand for  Renewable Energy after the year 2021 and the recommendation of the National Economic Council, the proposal made by the Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to take future measures necessary for the construction of a 400 MW LNG power plant in the Hambantota area, with the collaboration of the Government of China, a 500 MW LNG power plant with the collaboration of the Government of Japan and a 500 MW LNG power plant with the collaboration of the Government of India, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of a Multi Beam Echo Sounder to carry out Hydrographic Surveys for mapping out the ocean belt of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body:
The drawing of Nautical Charts for Sri Lanka from the Colonial times up to date is done by the United Kingdom and since the Charts thus prepared are owned by them, they derive a colossal sum of money out of the sale of such charts. It is imperative that every ship which sails across the shipping route of Sri Lanka should use the printed and electronic nautical charts of the ocean belt of Sri Lanka and when considering the large number of commercial ships which sail across the shipping route of Sri Lanka, annually, the country can derive a huge income.

	Although, there are trained human resources available, the constraint for mapping out of the ocean belt of Sri Lanka is the non-availability of modern technological equipment with the Sri Lanka Navy Hydrographic Division. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the then Minister of  Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to purchase a Multi Beam Echo Sounder for the country's only institute available for designing of Nautical Charts established in the National Aquatic Resources Research Development Agency, with a view to mapping out the ocean belt of Sri Lanka with an updated network of hydrographic surveys and to call for international bids for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet, taking into consideration the concurrence given by  Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the present Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Rural Economic Affairs.

description: Design, Construction and Financing of the Super Structure Work of the Housing Project at Kimbula Ela Watta, Madampitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body: The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the contract for Design, Construction and Financing of the Super Structure Work of the Housing Project at Kimbula Ela Watta, Madampitiya, which comprises of 472 low income category housing units, to M/s CML-MTD Construction (Pvt.) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.2,247 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of drugs required for the treatment of diabetic patients
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body: The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the supply of 1,350,000 vials of Biphasic Isophane Insulin injections, a medicine used for treating the diabetes patients, to M/s Novo Nordisk A/S, Denmark, for a sum of US$ 2.55 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Colombo Suburban Railway Efficiency Improvement Project (CSREIP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09

description: Supply of a Air Traffic Management System, for the Bandaranaike International Airport at Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body: The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the supply and Commissioning of a Air Traffic Management System for the Bandaranaike International Airport at Katunayake to M/s Thales Air Systems S.A.S., France, as recommended by the  Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Single Window Investment Facilitation Taskforce (SWIFT) for providing investment services in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body: At present, the investors who envisage to commence their operational activities in Sri Lanka, are supposed to obtain around 14 approvals/permits provided by various Government Institutions. The lengthy period taken for the purpose results in discouraging the investors. Even though the Board of Investment (BOI) of Sri Lanka functions as the Coordinating institution, constraints have come up in making the process efficient, due to various obstacles found in the other relevant Government Institutions. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to establish a Single Window Investment Facilitation Task Force with proper coordination and a mechanism for follow‑up action and regulation as a remedial measure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of the National Equipment and Machinery Organization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body: The  National Equipment and Machinery Organization was established in the year 1992 as a remedial measure taken to address the dearth that existed in machineries required for the construction sector to implement the regional development projects expeditiously. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to obtain a loan facility on a Treasury Guarantee, in order to secure the working capital required to expand the entrepreneurial affairs of the Organization, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act, No.25 of 2002
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body: The Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act, No.25 of 2002 provides for combating trans‑national  crimes and strengthening the prevention of crimes or internal investigation and confiscating the crimes proceeds. Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to amend the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act, No.25 of 2002, for identifying the offences relating to Money Laundering and the necessity of criminalizing the offences related to bribery outlined in Article 16 of the Convention of the United Nations against Bribery and Corruption and the recent developments  pertaining to computer systems and data related criminal offences, reflecting the international obligations of Sri Lanka in the present context. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to publish the Amendment Bill so formulated in the Government Gazette and to present the same, subsequently, in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting of the Regional Symposium on Sustainable Development Goal  -'Life below Water' (Blue SDG) on 21st and 22nd June 2018 in Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body:
It has been found that, the fisheries industry is able to contribute a great deal in achieving the goals coming under the Sustainable Development Goals of the United Nations such as eradication of poverty etc. As such, the importance of being prepared collectively in facing challenges and achieving the Life below Water or Blue Sustainable Development Goals has been emphasized. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the then Minister of  Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development also taking into consideration the concurrence given by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the present Minister of Fisheries & Aquatic Resources Development and Rural Economic Affairs, to host a Regional Symposium on  Blue Sustainable Development Goals with the participation of the representatives of the coastal nations of the region on 21st and 22nd of June 2018 in Sri Lanka and to obtain the donor award of Rs 3.48 million granted by the Government of Norway, in order to cover the expenditure incurred for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the 'Women Entrepreneurship Finance Initiative
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body:
Taking into consideration the importance of motivating women entrepreneurs, a proposal has been made to implement a loan scheme known as 'Women Entrepreneurship Finance Initiative Grant Programme'. It has been planned to implement the loan scheme under the second phase of the Small and Medium-sized Enterprises Line of Credit Scheme presently in force, utilizing the financial assistance of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) has agreed to provide. Loans will be provided to the women entrepreneurs who satisfy the following conditions and an amount of 20% - 30% of the loan will be given as a non‑repayable grant:


I.	the requested loan should be Rs.750,000/- or more and 51% or more of the relevant business institution should be owned by women; or
	
II.	the loan for which the request is made should be Rs.750,000/- or more and the following three conditions must be fulfilled;

- 	the minimum of 20% of the institution must be owned by women.

- 	the Chief Executive Officer or the Chief Operations Officer should be a woman.

- 	the women representation where the Director Boards exist, must be a minimum of 30%.

Accordingly, giving priority to the less developed areas such as Uva, Sabaragamuwa, North and East, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to implement the loan scheme through 10 financial institutions island‑wide, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Three-storey Rehabilitation Centre and providing it with equipment and the implementation of a three-year Training Programme in the Teaching Hospital, Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body:
Teaching Hospital, Jaffna is a major tertiary Health Service Centre in Sri Lanka and provides the clinical training required to the undergraduates at the Faculty of Medicine of the University of Jaffna. In the year 2017, 39,390 surgeries have been performed at the hospital and out of those, around 12,486 are orthopedic surgeries requiring post‑operative rehabilitation care. It has been identified that the infrastructure facilities and staff training at the hospital should be improved, in order to provide quality rehabilitation care services.

It has therefore been proposed to construct a three-storey rehabilitation centre at the Teaching Hospital, Jaffna, to provide it with equipment and to implement a three year training programme to enhance the skills of the relevant staff. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to implement the  proposed project at a cost of Rs.605 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Joint Ventures by the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation (SPMC) of Sri Lanka with investors to promote the manufacturing of pharmaceuticals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body:
With the uplifting of the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry in Sri Lanka, a considerable amount of foreign exchange incurred for the import of pharmaceuticals, could be saved. Hence, approval of the Cabinet has been granted to identify the investors with the potential of supplying  pharmaceuticals of high quality to the Government Hospitals in an efficient manner and to establish Joint Ventures between the investors and the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation of Sri Lanka.

With a view to granting legal authority to the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation of Sri Lanka, to enter into the Joint Ventures, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to amend the orders issued under the State Industrial Corporations Act, No.49 of 1957, published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.456/21 dated 1987‑07‑04, as recommended by the Attorney General, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The proposed Health System Enhancement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body: It has been planned to enhance the health system of the North Central, Central, Sabaragamuwa and the Uva Provinces under the proposed health system enhancement project to be implemented  under the  Asian Development Bank (ADB) Assistance and funds of the Sri Lanka Government. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to establish Project Management Units under the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine and the  relevant provincial level, for the implementation of the project and to recruit the necessary staff for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Cooperation in the field of Tourism between Sri Lanka and Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body: The proposal made by Hon. John Amaratunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to promote Cooperation in  the field of Tourism between Sri Lanka and Pakistan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulating the Registration of International Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body:
As a result of the non-formulation of laws and regulations pertaining to the registration, accreditation and regulation of international schools, there is a tendency of establishing an unlimited number of international schools below standards island‑wide along various informal methods of registration. Since the children who receive the education from these schools form more than 95% of the Sri Lankan nationals, it should be ensured that they receive a quality education to suit the needs of the country. When requesting the Sri Lankan community living abroad to return to Sri Lanka to contribute to the development process of the country and attracting the foreign investors into the country, the availability of standardized international schools is an essential factor and an absolute necessity.

	Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, the Cabinet granted approval to resume the registration of international schools under the Companies Act, on the recommendations of the Ministry of Education until such time that a formal legal framework is formulated. The Cabinet further decided to appoint a Cabinet Sub‑Committee to study and make necessary recommendations and establish legal provision for the registration, accreditation, regulation, quality assurance and monitoring and making it mandatory for the training of the teachers of those schools and for teaching of the subjects of Sinhala, Tamil, Religion and History for the Sri Lankan students receiving their education in the international schools.

description: Grant and Implementation Agreement between the Millennium Challenge Corporation, USA and the Government of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body: The Cabinet has granted approval to obtain a US$ Grant of 7.4 million to be awarded to Sri Lanka by the Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC) which is a foreign grant aid agency of the United States of America for the development of several important sectors towards the advancement of the  economic growth of Sri Lanka within the forthcoming period of five years, and also to sign the Agreement pertaining to it. Subsequently, the said corporation has also agreed to award Sri Lanka an additional grant of US$ 2.6 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to obtain the additional grant and to sign the Agreement made between the Millennium Challenge Corporation and the Government of Sri Lanka in respect of the implementation of the programmes under same with a revised total grant of US$ 10 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting of a new Immigrants and Emigrants Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-05-09
decision_details_body:
Cabinet has granted approval to enact a new Act reviewing the Sri Lanka Immigrants and Emigrants Act No.20 of 1948, taking into consideration, the timely needs. As such, a Committee comprising of Experts conversant with the subject has been appointed to study the subject specific matters. The Department of Immigration and Emigration has prepared a Report, pertaining to the provisions to be included in the new Immigrants and Emigrants Act  based on the recommendations of the said Committee. 

Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister and Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of  Internal Affairs and Wayamba Development, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Immigration and Emigration Bill incorporating the provisions proposed in the said Report, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Three (03) Term Contracts to Purchase Refined Petroleum Products
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body: The proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Petroleum Resources Development, to enter into Three (03) Term Contracts with the relevant suppliers to purchase 4,650,000 Gas Oil (Diesel) Barrels, 2,080,000 Jet A‑1 Gas Oil Barrels and 1,275,000 Gasoline (Petrol) Barrels required for a period of eight (08) months from the 15th of March 2018, as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SSCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of the machinery required for enhancing the performance of the Department of Government Factory
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body:
The Department of Government Factory is a pioneering institution which supplies Mechanical Engineering Services to the public and private sector and especially, its Heavy Fabrication and Mechanical Workshop provides large structures and the necessary engineering products and services required for the irrigation sector. With the development of the country's irrigation industry, the demand for the construction, fixing and refurbishing of irrigation water management sluice gates is in the increase and to meet the demand it has been identified that the production capacity of the workshop has to be enhanced. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to purchase a Plano Miller and a Computer Numerical Control (CNC) Machine which could be operated by computer required for the Heavy Structural Machinery Division, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction and augmentation of the Biyagama 220/33 kV Grid Substation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body: The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for the construction and augmentation of the Biyagama 220/33 kV Grid Substation implemented under the Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme, to M/s ABB India Limited for a sum of Rs.1,434.11 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a long term Contract for the purchase of 7,000,000 barrels of Crude Oil
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body: It has been decided to purchase crude oil necessary under the term contracts, to ensure the uninterrupted supply to the Sapugaskanda Oil Refinery of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation for its continuous operation. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Petroleum Resources Development to award the contract to M/s Swiss Singapore Overseas Enterprises Pte. Ltd. for the purchase of 7,000,000 Barrels of Murban Crude Oil required for a period of 8 months from the 01st of April 2018 for a premium value of US$ 1.69 per crude oil barrel, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sale of Mineral Products of the Lanka Mineral Sands Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body: The Lanka Mineral Sands Ltd. sells its main mineral products such as Ilmenite, Rutile, Zircon, Hi Ti Ilmenite etc. through the International Competitive Bidding Procedure. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to sell 17,800 metric tons of mineral sands of different types to the highest bidders who have submitted their quotations, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of Consultancy Service Agencies for the Construction of the new buildings of the Sri Lanka Police
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body: A sum exceeding Rs.1,000 million is allocated annually to the Sri Lanka Police, for the construction of new buildings and for the improvement and renovations pertaining to the existing buildings. Taking into consideration a proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration and Management and  the Minister of Law & Order, to select a consultancy service agency for the new building construction projects of the Sri Lanka Police during the period from 2018 to 2020, approval of the Cabinet was granted to obtain the  services intended from the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), State Engineering Corporation and  the Department of National Buildings.

description: Allocation of lands for 'Semata Sevana' and 'Grama Shakthi' Model Villages
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body:
When strengthening of the low income communities through socio‑economic empowerment, the Government by the implementation of the 'Semata Sevana' and 'Grama Shakthi' Model Villages programmes has taken measures to resolve their issues with regard to their basic need of housing. In order to achieve the target under the programme for the construction of 2,500 model villages by the year 2020, it is imperative that around 650 model villages are constructed  annually. 

For this purpose, the allocation of lands Island-wide has to be done expeditiously. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to establish an Officials' Committee under the Co‑Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Ministry of Housing and Construction and the Secretary to the Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms and comprising of the representatives of the relevant Ministries and institutions  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of means of livelihood associated with Model Villages
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body:
Under the model village programme implemented by the Ministry of Housing and Construction, the impoverished and low income families who have neither a house of their own nor a suitable plot of land for the construction of a house, is provided with a state land and a loan facility up to a maximum of Rs.500,000/- to construct a house. Under this programme, the work pertaining to 596 model villages have commenced from the year 2015 up to now and out of which 54 model villages have already been vested with the beneficiaries.  

For the sustainable upliftment of this community, in addition to providing houses, it is essential to develop their income as well as their livelihood. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to appoint a Steering Committee comprising of the officers of the relevant institutions for the introduction of home gardening, small scale animal husbandry, domestic industries and self employment activities in the model villages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of an Agreement on the Exchange of Sugarcane Breeding Material between Sri Lanka and Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body:
Under a collaboration undertaken between 3 Agricultural Research Institutes in Pakistan and the Sugarcane Research Institute of Sri Lanka in the year 2010, the exchange of commercial varieties of sugarcane breeding material for sugarcane plant improvement through modern breeding technologies and training of young agricultural scientists have been carried out.

	Considering its success, a proposal has been made to have a new Memorandum of Understanding on the exchange of sugarcane breeding material between the Sugarcane Research Institute of Sri Lanka and the Sugarcane Research and Development Board and the Sugarcane Research Institute in Faisalabad, Pakistan. Under this programme, an opportunity is created to obtain new sugarcane varieties to Sri Lanka and to engage in joint research activities with the Agricultural Scientists of Pakistan.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding between the relevant institutes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of plots of Land from the Regional Industrial Estates to set up Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body:
The 'Regional Industrial Services Committee' and the 'Project Evaluation Committee' of the Ministry select the suitable investors for the Regional Industrial Estates Development Programme implemented for promoting the industries at regional level.

	Accordingly, newspaper advertisements have been published calling for proposals for the selection of suitable investors for vacant plots of land available in the industrial estates at Karandeniya, Bata-atha, Noorani, Puttalam, Laksha Uyana and Batticaloa. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to allocate plots of land on a 35 year lease basis in respect of 8 project proposals out of same, as recommended by the Regional Industrial Services Committee and the Project Evaluation Committee of the Ministry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting of a feasibility study on the Proposed Flood Prevention and Development Project in the Galle District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body: The pre-feasibility study on the Proposed Flood Prevention and Development Project in the Galle District has now commenced and presently is in the process of collecting data from the Ministry of Irrigation and Water Resources Management and other Government Institutions. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, for the issuance of an Official Letter to the MCC International Limited mandated to carry out the pre‑feasibility study in order to obtain the required data officially from the relevant institutions, and to conduct matters relating to such study in coordination with the relevant Ministries and Institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Motor Vehicle Fleet owned by the Government

The Cabinet took note of the following information of the motor vehicles belonging to the Provincial Councils, collected as per the Assets Management Circular No.01/2017 issued by the Comptroller General's Office established with the objective of managing the assets and expenditure of the Government, presented to the Cabinet by  Hon. description: Upgrading the functions of the Institute of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology (IFMT)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body: The Institute of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology (IFMT) of the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, performs a significant role in  conducting autopsies. A proposal has been made to implement a programme with the collaboration of the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) with a view to enhancing the quality of the operations of the said Institute through standardization and centralization of  autopsy associated operations and training of non‑medical staff. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to sign a Letter of Agreement between the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine and the International Committee of the Red Cross in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Primary Healthcare System Strengthening Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body:
Even though the management of child and maternity health services and communicable diseases has achieved its success on account of the free health service, further challenges such as the growth of the aged population and the spreading of non‑communicable diseases due to unwholesome foods and bad health practices, have to be dealt with. At the Primary Healthcare level, more attention has to be focused on communicable diseases such as Dengue fever, Tuberculosis and H.I.V./AIDS, in addition to non‑communicable diseases. Due to this reason, it has become a timely requirement to develop the Primary Healthcare service facilities in Sri Lanka and accordingly, approval of the Cabinet has been granted to implement the 'Policy providing Healthcare services aimed at Universal Health Coverage', formulated in that regard.

	Under this, it has been designed to implement a Five Year Project for the empowerment of the Primary Healthcare System identifying the deficiencies in the Primary Healthcare system prevailing in the country to enable to provide a comprehensive and qualitative health treatment service. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to implement the proposed project by the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine in collaboration with the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government, utilizing the funds of US$ 200 million as agreed to by the World Bank to provide under concessionary terms, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing of Funds for the proposed Technical Education Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body:
The Government has found the need to upgrade the work force in Sri Lanka  to suit the changing demand for emerging technologies and skills in the country. Therefore, considerable changes have been made to the education system in Sri Lanka during the recent past, focusing on vocational skills.  In this respect, the technology subject stream was introduced for the G.C.E. (A/L) from the year 2013 and action should essentially be taken for providing the required modern infrastructure facilities for the practical activities and training of teachers.  For this purpose, it has been planned to implement the proposed Technical Education Development Programme at a cost of US $ 60.7million.

The OPEC Fund for International Development (OFID) has agreed to grant a loan facility of US $ 50 million for the implementation of the project and the balance sum of US $ 10.7 million will be borne by the Government of Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into a loan agreement with the OPEC Fund for International Development (OFID), to obtain a loan of US$50 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enactment of the '1990 Suwaseriya Foundation' Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body: Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to expand the pre-hospital care ambulance service presently being operated in the Western and Southern Provinces under the grant facility of the Government of India, to the other Provinces as well and to establish the '1990 Suwaseriya Foundation' for the administration of the said service. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to publish the '1990 Suwaseriya Foundation' Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman, incorporating the provisions required for the purpose in the Government Gazette and to present it subsequently, in  Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Sri Lanka Integrated Border Management (IBM) Strategy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-24
decision_details_body:
The border protection and management is highly important, in order to maintain the national security and safety of the country effectively.  This has become a matter of paramount importance especially with the increase in the cross border movement of both people and goods. As such, the National Border Management Committee has been established in the year 2016 to act as the principal coordinating body within the Government for border management.
	
	The Committee has prepared a formal Integrated Border Management (IBM) Strategy and Action Plan, identifying the responsibilities and functions of the various inter‑agencies engaged in boarder protection, to establish an effective border management in the country, in accordance with the international standards.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to implement the Strategy and the Action Plan under the grant aid provided by the Government of Australia through the International Organization for Migration (IOM), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting relief to the affected persons due to the civil unrest occurred in the first week of March in Teldeniya, Digana and the suburban areas in the Kandy District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement and Hindu Religious Affairs, to grant a compensation of  Rs.500,00/- for each of the next- of-kin in respect of the three persons deceased and a compensation subject to a maximum of Rs.250,000/-for each injured person, in the civil unrest that occurred in the first week of March 2018, in Teldeniya, Digana and suburban areas in the Kandy District, depending on the medical reports, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining of lands from the Government Estates administrated by the Companies for improving the Plantation Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-10
decision_details_body:
- Schools 843  in number have been established for educational purposes of the children of the plantation community. Although, a specific land area has not been fixed for these schools, the Government has agreed in principle to reserve a plot of land in extent of 2 acres for each school. However, since the estates which were in the possession of the  Government had been transferred again to the private companies on lease basis, the maximum of 2 acres of land reserved for plantation schools have to be obtained from the private companies for the development activities of the schools. 

Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Public Enterprise and Kandy Development, Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of  Plantation Industries and Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to acquire a maximum of 2 acres of  lands each for the 354 plantation schools situated in 7 Districts which are presently being conducted in a limited space, from the relevant companies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for Issuing of Vehicle Emission Test Certificates
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation,  to award the contract for the Issuing of Vehicle Emission Test Certificates to the three companies namely M/s Laughs Eco Sri (Pvt.) Ltd., M/s Cleanco Lanka (Pvt.) Ltd. and M/s Auto Test Lanka (Pvt.) Ltd.,  as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee (CANC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Action Plan for the Expeditious Exploration and Production of Petroleum in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-10
decision_details_body:
- Even though, the petroleum exploration activities in Sri Lanka have been moving forward at a slow pace during the past three years due to the negative   growth trends of the global petroleum and natural gas excavation industry, Sri Lanka has been able to conduct off-shore exploration activities uninterruptedly with much vigour to achieve the local market needs. The Petroleum Resources Development Secretariat has taken action to initiate the awareness activities, paying attention to call for small scale bids for the development of natural gas deposits discovered, at present and call for formal bids for the implementation of exploration activities. 

	The bid round to explore the additional deposits in the natural gas deposit discovered from the block of land called M2 in the Mannar basin, is due to be announced in May 2018. It has been planned to enter into Agreements with selected companies for the petroleum exploration activities in the Eastern coastal line and the shallow sea area in Sri Lanka and it is also expected to focus on petroleum exploration in the land area of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the above information pertaining to action and plans for expediting the  exploration and production activities of Petroleum in Sri Lanka was presented to the Cabinet by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Petroleum Resources Development.

description: The Draft Bill on Apartment Ownership (Special Provisions)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-10
decision_details_body:
- The Legal Draftsman has prepared the relevant 'Draft Bill' in accordance with the approval granted by the Cabinet to enact the Draft Apartment Ownership (Special Provisions) Act, considering the timely needs. By this, it is expected to provide remedies to the provisions contained in the existing Draft Apartment Ownership (Special Provisions) Act which has been an impediment to vest the title of the condominium houses constructed by the National Housing Development Authority and the other State Institutions prior to 2009, with the residents living in such houses. It also expects to provide provisions for the safety of the state owned condominium properties. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to publish the Draft Apartment Ownership (Special Provisions) Bill in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present it in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Construction Industry Development  Act, No.33 of 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-10
decision_details_body: - The Construction Industry Development  Act No.33 of 2014 has been enacted with the objective of  providing provisions for the development of the construction industry in Sri Lanka by regulating, formalizing and standardizing the activities of the construction industry. Since it does not cover the whole spectrum of activities in the construction industry in Sri Lanka, requests have been made by all stakeholders and professionals connected to the construction industry that the Act should be amended so as to cover all sections of the industry and the stakeholders.  As such, draft amendments to the Act have been made to amend the Act after consulting all relevant stakeholders and after an intensive dialogue. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation to amend the  Construction Industry Development  Act No.33 of 2014, based on the said draft amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: State Vesak Festival - 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-10
decision_details_body: - 	Arrangements have been made to conduct the State Vesak Festival of 2562nd year of Sri Buddhist Era, under the theme of 'Demunu Sitha Suwa Gena De' at the historical Bingiriya Devagiri Rajamaha Viharaya in the Kurunegala District, under the auspices of His Excellency the President. As such, the information submitted by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana, that a programme has also been arranged to be implemented during the vesak week from 26th April to 02nd May, 2018, giving prominence to  the practice of Buddhist principles and that several programmes are to be implemented to coincide with the State Vesak Festival with a view to creating a sustainable society blessed with spiritual development, were noted by the Cabinet.

description: Agri-Irrigated project adaptable to Climate Changes (2018 - 2024)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-10
decision_details_body: - Around 470,000 acres of paddy lands are cultivated under the small tanks, anicuts and irrigational channels situated in the dry and intermediate zones of the Island which is about 25% of the total cultivated paddy lands of the country. This provides livelihood means to about 384,000 farmer families. Since these paddy lands are prone to climatic changes easily 1,493 small tanks scattered in 87 cascades located in 09 dry zone districts have been identified for rehabilitation to resist the adverse effects of the climate changes. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to implement a project under the World Bank Aid during the period from 2018 to 2024, with a view to enhancing the productivity of the cultivated lands falling under the said tanks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increase of aquaculture production through conservation and development of the aquatic ecosystems associated with lagoons and inland waters of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-10
decision_details_body:
- There is a high probability for the sustainable utilization of the natural lagoon system, estuary related areas and the small and medium scale internal waters in the wet zone with surplus of water which is not used for temperate grasslands and agricultural purposes the fishery industry in the country. Therefore, the Budget - 2018 has allocated Rs.1,000 million to implement a project to improve the fish production through conservation and development of the aquatic ecosystems associated with lagoons and inland waters of Sri Lanka. 

	The objectives of the project are to improve the fish production, generate new employment opportunities, promote tourism related industries, enhance the rural economy by implementing the fish product processing and value addition projects and to increase the foreign currency earnings.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to implement the project to cover 18 lagoons and 300 inland tanks in the wet zone, giving priority to the lagoons of Puttalam, Nayaru, Arugambay, Panama and Rekawa, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a New National Policy pertaining to the Fisheries and Aquaculture Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-10
decision_details_body:
- The draft on the New National Policy pertaining to the Fisheries and Aquaculture Sector has been prepared by the Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, having sought the views of all stakeholders including the fishermen, aquaculture farmers and exporters and academics and the general public, in accordance with the approval granted by the Cabinet to formulate such a policy. 

	The new policy has focused on the sustainable management of the fisheries industry and aquaculture farming with equitable distribution of benefits. The policy provides provisions for engagement in the fisheries industry in accordance with the International Standards, elimination of illegal fishing, introduction of appropriate new technology, minimizing of the post harvest  losses, increasing of the national fish consumption, promotion of fish product exports and enhancing the socio-economic status of the fisher community. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to present the proposed new National Fisheries and Aquaculture Policy in Parliament, to seek the views of all Members of Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of  the Primary Healthcare Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-10

description: Introduction of the standardized (plain) packaging for tobacco products
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-10
decision_details_body:
- As a result of the direct and indirect harm caused by the use of tobacco, it has been estimated that the death toll in Sri Lanka annually exceeds 25,000. The programmes implemented for the prevention of the use of tobacco and alcohol throughout the past have resulted in reducing the use of tobacco among the adult males in Sri Lanka from 29% in 2011 up to 24% by 2015. The expectation of the Government is to reduce the tobacco usage up to 15% in the next 4 years to prevent the 6,000 deaths. In this respect, as one of the strategies adopted for discouraging of smoking, a proposal has been made to introduce 'Standardized Packaging' to minimize the attractiveness of packaging of all tobacco products. 
	In this, only two colours or black and white can be used for tobacco products packaging and anything other than the information specified or mandated by the Government such as trade name, product name, quantity of the product and health warning or any symbol will not be permitted to be exhibited on these packaging. It has been a proven experience in other countries that this strategy has helped in minimizing the sale of tobacco to a considerable level. As such, with a view to providing legal provisions to introduce 'Standardized Packaging' for all tobacco products placed for sale in the country, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to amend the National Authority on Tobacco and Alcohol Act, No.27 of 2006 or to prepare draft legislation to enact regulations under the Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Popularizing the Sustainable Development Goals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-10
decision_details_body: - In the year 2015, Sri Lanka has committed  to implementing the United Nations Agenda 2030 designed to achieve Sustainable Development Goals by 2030. In this connection, the Sri Lanka Sustainable Development Act, No.19 of 2017 comprising of the relevant provisions is in force with effect from 2017‑10‑03. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravindra Samaraweera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to request all State Institutions to incorporate the National Strategies to be adopted by State Institutions in their institutional plans in achieving the Sustainable Development Goals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading health facilities in the identified hospitals of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-10
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to implement a project for the construction of buildings for the identified hospitals and to provide them with medical equipment with a view to enhancing the facilities of health services in Sri Lanka. As previously planed, it has not been able to obtain loan assistance from the EXIM Bank of China. 

However, considering the need to implement this project expeditiously, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into loan agreements in order to secure US$ 72.25 million which covers 85% of the total project cost from the Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited in Hongkong and the balance sum of US $ 12.75 million which covers the remaining 15% of the cost from the People's Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expediting the payment of compensation for those who were affected due to the unfortunate incidents that took place mainly around Kandy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet decided to instruct the relevant authorities to expedite the payment of compensation to the persons who were affected and the properties damaged due to the unfortunate incidents that took place mainly around Kandy in the first half of the month of March.

description: Enforcement of the law against those who disseminate false information and publish defamative statements
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet decided to intimate to the Institutions such as, the Ministry of Finance and Mass Media, Law & Order and Telecommunication, Digital Infrastructure and Foreign Employment and Telecommunication Regulatory Commission to make recommendations to the Cabinet regarding the measures that could be taken within the existing legal framework against the persons utilizing the Social Media networks, various websites including electronic media and electronic & print media who disseminate false information and publish defamative statements.

description: Construction of Rain Water Drainage Tunnels in the New Mutwal and Torrington Areas under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct a drainage tunnel system in Mutwal and Torrington areas under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project, for the  control of floods. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the contract to M/s China Petroleum Pipeline Engineering Co. Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Pilot Project for the creation of Young Agrarian Entrepreneurs in the districts of Kurunegala and Puttalam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to implement a project under the 'Food Production National Programme' to create entrepreneurs who will be able to involve in agriculture at commercial level, with a view to improving the local food production.  As a pilot project, it has been planned for 100 selected young entrepreneurs in the Kurunegala District, to be provided with concessionary loan facilities to procure resources including modern technology in agricultural equipment. Taking into consideration the prevailing weather condition in the Kurunegala District and the interest already shown by the agricultural entrepreneurs in this regard, in the Puttalam district, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to implement the pilot project including the district of Puttalam as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into an Agreement between Sri Lanka and Russia on Military Cooperation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to enter into an Agreement on Military Cooperation, between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Russian Federation, with a view to enhancing the bilateral military cooperation for strengthening mutual trust and international security, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resolving of the current issues of the Oluvil Port for the immediate commencement of its operational activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body:
-  Although the Oluvil port developed at a cost of euro 45 million, was opened in the year 2013, it has not been possible to commence its commercial operations, due to the siltation of of the harbour basin.
