Furthermore, the sea erosion of coastal area to the north of Oluvil Port has progressively advanced and it has adversely affected the livelihood of the fishermen in the area. The need to take action for the immediate commencement of the commercial operations of the Oluvil Port by resolving the issues concerned has been identified. The proposed solution is dredging the coastal area south to the Oluvil harbour and   sand nourishment of the coastal area north to the harbour and it has been estimated that it would incur an expenditure of US $ 15 million. 

        	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to carry out the relevant dredging activities by securing Foreign Aid and to purchase a suitable dredger for such purpose under the Government Procurement Procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading the Fishing Fleet to increase fish production and to enhance the quality of fish landings
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - Cabinet has granted approval for the implementation of a project for  upgrading the Fishing Fleet to increase fish production and to enhance the quality of fish landings. The budget of 2018 has allocated a sum of Rs.400 million for this project. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, for the production of 23 fishing boats on the basis of the beneficiary making a contribution of 50%, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Locomotives to Transport Solid Waste from Kelaniya to Aruwakkalu
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body:
- Cabinet approval has been granted to implement the project for the disposal of Municipal Solid Waste collected in the Colombo City region limits to a Sanitary Landfill constructed in the Aruwakkalu Area in Puttalam. For this purpose, 04 railway engines and carrier wagons have to be procured to transport Solid Waste from the Kelaniya railway Transfer Station to the Aruwakkalu area. 

Securing locomotives for this purpose through a new procurement process will take a considerable length of time. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to couple the requirement of 04 railway locomotives for the purpose, with the ongoing procurement process commenced by the Department of Sri Lanka Railways for securing railway engines for the Department, with a view to implementing the project expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the small Boutique Hotel  associated with the Waters Edge Hotel
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - The Waters Edge Hotel Ltd. has been successful in securing a profit of Rs.240 million in the year 2017 and as such, focus has been made to further improve the operational activities and the physical infrastructure facilities of the hotel. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to construct a small Urban Boutique Hotel for the Waters Edge Ltd. consisting of 48 rooms, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Infrastructure Facilities in the Ruhuna and the Wayamba Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - The Government has given priority to increase the accommodation and infrastructure facilities in the State Universities.  Under this programme, it has been planned to develop the infrastructure facilities in the Ruhuna and the Wayamba Universities using the provision set apart by the budget of 2018.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to construct a building for the Medical Faculty and the construction of the Nautical Study Centre Building at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Ruhuna and to construct the technological faculty building at the University of Wayamba, 	was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the  Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration (SLIDA) and the   Institute of Public Enterprises of (IPE) India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body:
- The Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration responsible for promoting the skills  and the capacity building of the officers of the All Island Services of the Public Sector is in the process of expanding its relations with the recognized Foreign Educational Institutes, with a view to improving the learning and development capacity. Under this programme, a proposal has been made to enter into a MoU with the Institute of Public Enterprises of India which is a recognized Educational Institute in India.  

The Agreement will cover the areas such as joint training programmes, exchange of expertise, student, academic activities, management consultancy activities and joint research. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration and Management, to enter into the proposed MoU, with the objective of providing public services more efficiency through the development of the capacity building of the public sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Technical Collaboration in the field of Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to enter into an Agreement to foster Cooperation in Education and Research for Long-term Technical Collaboration between  the Sri Lanka Council for Agricultural Research Policy functioning under the purview of the Ministry of  Agriculture and the Michigan State University (MSU) of the United States of America, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enforcement of the Additional Protocol to Sri Lanka's Safeguards Agreement with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body:
- Sri Lanka placed her signature to the Treaty on Non‑Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT) in the year 1970 and in terms of the binding effect of the Treaty, Sri Lanka has entered into an Agreement with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) on the 06th of August 1984 on application of safeguards. The main objective of this initiative is to ensure through a verification mechanism, non‑diversion of Nuclear material and technology from peaceful use to Nuclear weaponization.  With a view to further strengthening of the safeguard system for collecting information of the Nuclear Fuel Cycle and its supporting elements, a proposal to sign an Additional Protocol between the member states of the relevant Agreement and the International Atomic Energy Agency has been adopted in the year 1997 and by May 2017, 129 countries have singed the protocol.  

Demonstrating the dedication by Sri Lanka for utilizing the Nuclear Materials and Technology only for peaceful purposes, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to take necessary action to implement the provisions in the protocol within Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Productivity of the Tea Smallholders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body:
- Around 64% of the Tea Smallholdings accounts for the total extent of tea lands in Sri Lanka and it provides more than 76% of contribution for the total tea production of the country. As a strategy for further improving the Tea Smallholding Sector, the Budget 2018 has allocated Rs.250 million for the improvement of the productivity of the Tea Smallholders. Under this, it has been designed to implement 3 major projects namely, the introduction of modern machines for the effective application of fertilizer for tea cultivation, provision of equipment required for encouraging the adoption of correct agricultural practices and the rehabilitation of the rural access roads to supply the infrastructure facilities for the sale of qualitative green leaves. 

As such, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of  Plantation Industries, to provide fertilizer applicator each to 1,456 Tea Smallholder Development Societies in each tea cultivating areas, to provide  equipment such as Spray Machines, Pruning Machines and Forks needed for cultivation and to rehabilitate the rural access roads to facilitate transportation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Bloemendhal Area for Port related logistics
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body:
- It has been identified that the Bloemendhal area in Colombo needs to be developed for the Colombo Port related logistics and the commercial and residential development purposes with the expectation to improve the cargo operation activities of the Port of Colombo and to improve its efficiency and it will enable to make the local import and export activities effective. Through this initiative, action will be taken to ensure a more protective environment devoid of health hazards to the community living around Bloemendhal in under facility houses.  

	Further, it has been planned to carry out the construction of such work as the the expansion of the Authentication Centre at the Sri Lanka Customs, Urban Recreational Garden and the Kimbula Ela Water Retention area as well as the improvement of additional railway line facilities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to carry out these development activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments proposed to the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No.9 of 2003
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - The Consumer Affairs Authority has been established under the provisions of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No.9 of 2003. The main objective of this is to provide the consumers with the proper protection through the regulation of trade and the prices of goods and services and to protect traders and manufactures against unfair trade practices and the restrictive trade practices. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to amend the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, eliminating the short comings identified in the implementation of the Act for the last fifteen years commencing from 2003 and also while complying with the laws and regulations adopted in the developed and developing countries to protect the consumer and the trade competition in accordance with the new global marketing trends, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Companies Act, No.7 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - It has been found that certain amendments have to be made to the existing Companies Act, No.7 of 2007 to maintain the Business Index of Sri Lanka on a high level with a view to promoting the investment activities of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to amend sections 5, 9 and 10 of the Companies Act No.7 of 2007 to enable the Registrar of companies to notify the general public regarding the incorporation of a new company providing certain information of the relevant company and to eliminate publishing a public notice regarding the incorporation of a new company, and to empower the Registrar of companies to make order for any company to change the name of the company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Vehicles  for the Government Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval for procuring of vehicles for the use of  Government Institutions under the methods of Outright Purchase, Operational Leasing and Financial Leasing. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to issue Circular Instructions indicating the criteria to be adopted when procuring of vehicles adopting each method, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Public Sector Efficiency Enhancement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - The World Bank has agreed to provide Sri Lanka with a loan facility of US$ 60 million while the European Union has agreed to provide with a grant approximately US$ 10 million for institutional strengthening and the capacity  building of the public sector institutions pertaining to the public financial management. Focusing on the following, with the utilization of these funds it has been planned to implement the Public Sector Efficiency Project (PSEP), strengthening the efficiency of the public investment and debt management improving the operational efficiency of the budget execution and the procurement process, strengthening the Governance transparency and the  efficiency of the public services, and the sustainable public sector skill development and capacity building and public participation. Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to provide the facilities necessary for the implementation of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of a land for the construction of  a Playground and a Community Centre at Badanagoda in Beruwala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine,to vest a portion of land in extent of 127.6 perches from the land called Pallegodawaththa managed by the Namunukula State Plantation Company for the construction of a playground and a community centre at Badanagoda in Beruwala for the use of the people living in the area around Grama Niladhari Divisions of Galpoththawila and Punsalamulla belonging to the Divisional Secretariat Divisions of Beruwala and Dodangoda, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening the Corporation in Science and Technology among the countries associated with the Bay of Bengal  Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - In the second summit of the BIMSTEC held in India in the year 2008, it was decided to establish a Technology Transfer Facility in Sri Lanka for the member states of the BIMSTEC. Through this facility it is proposed to exchange experiences among the member states in regard to biotechnology, nanotechnology, information and communications technology and space technology and to strengthen the corporation among member states for capacity building. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to sign the Memorandum of Association and securing the funds required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Maternity Benefits Ordinance, No.32 of 1939 and the Shop and the Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act, No.9 of 1954
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body: - The need to take corrective measures to remove the discrepancies in the  Maternity Benefits Ordinance, No.32 of 1939 relevant to the payment of maternity benefits to a female worker during her confinement and the Shop and the Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act, No.9 of 1954 has been recognized. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, the Minister of Labour, Trade Union Relations and Sabaragamu Development, to publish the two draft amendment Bills prepared by the Legal Draftsman in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present them in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing a monthly allowance to the Senior Citizens of over 100 years of age
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body:
- The existence of an elderly population of over  100 years of age, in a country is considered a benchmark which reflects a country's development in the health sector. It is identified that, presently, there are approximately 350 elders in Sri Lanka over 100 years of age. 


	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, the Minister of Social Empowerment, Welfare and Kandyan Heritage, to pay a monthly allowance of Rs.5,000/- to all citizens over 100 years of age, with a view to ensuring security and welfare of their lives, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Amendments to the Law relating to Central Banking in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body:
- The need has been identified to amend the Monitory Law Act relating to the establishment of the Central Bank and the other relevant laws and regulations for improving the Governance of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka in order to strengthen the independence of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. Through these amendments it is expected to take appropriate measures to facilitate the adoption of a Flexible Inflation Targeting on the monitory policy framework to ensure sustainable price stability in Sri Lanka and to strengthen the financial sector oversight. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to update the laws relating to the functions of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of Chemical Weapons Convention Act, No.58 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-04-03
decision_details_body:
- Chemical Weapons Convention Act, No.58 of 2007 has been enacted in order to implement the provisions of the Convention relating to the prohibition of the development, production, stockpiling and the use of chemical weapons and their destruction in Sri Lanka. In terms of the provisions of the Act, the relevant subject matter Minister named for the implementation of the provisions of the Act, is the Minister of Industry and Commerce. 

Since the National Chemical Weapons Convention is a subject matter directly relevant to the National Security, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to amend the Chemical Weapons Convention Act No.58 of 2007 incorporating the Minister of Defence as the Minister in‑charge of  the subject, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Naming a different day for the May Day Commemoration activities falling within the 'Vesak Sathiya' of 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body:
The Vesak Poya of 2018 has fallen on the 29th of April and the week succeeding the said date has been named as the 'Vesak Sathiya' and preparations have been made to conduct religious programmes Islandwide to commemorate the Three Noble Events associated with the Vesak Poya Day. Since 1st of May being the International Labour Day, also falls within the said 'Vesak Sathiya', a proposal has been made by the Most Venerable Chief Prelates of the Three Nikayas to make alternative arrangements to commemorate the May Day enabling the General Public to participate in the programmes scheduled for the 'Vesak Sathiya' without any obstructions.

	Accordingly, a request is made to all Trade Unions and the Political Parties to make arrangements to hold their ceremonies and programmes pertaining to the May Day on the 7th of May. As such, the Cabinet decided to cancel the holiday which falls on the 1st of May and instead declare 7th of May as a holiday.

description: Presenting the Draft Bill of the General Sir John Kotelawala National Defence University to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The General Sir John Kotelawala Defence Academy established  in terms of the Sir John Kotelawala Defence Academy Act, No.68 of 1981, as amended by Sir John Kotelawala Defence Academy (Amendment) Act, No.27 of 1988, General Sir John Kotelawala Defence Academy (Amendment) Act, No.30 of 1990 and Sir John Kotelawala Defence Academy (Amendment) Act, No.50 of 2007, functions as a Defence University which provides Academically, Professionally qualified Military Officers to the Tri Forces and higher education opportunities to local and foreign students. Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to repeal the above Acts and to enact a new Act namely, the General Sir John Kotelawala National Defence University, to further expand the academic activities of the University and to enhance its functions and the mission as a National Defence University. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to publish the Draft Bill so formulated in the Government Gazette and to present same subsequently, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Fertilizer Subsidy Policy to be effective from the Yala Season
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body:
The Fertilizer Subsidy Programme, which provided fertilizer to the farmers, with effect from the Yala Season in the year 2016 was determined to be in the form of a cash grant and the same is being implemented during 4 seasons consecutively, since the Yala Season, 2016 up to now. Under the programme, measures were taken to remit to the bank accounts of the farmers a sum of Rs.25,000/- for two hectares of paddy cultivation in one season and a sum of Rs.10,000/- once a year, for one hectare of selected other field crops such as potatoes, onions, capsicum, corn and soya.

	Considering the matters which arose while reviewing the Cash Grant Policy for the purchase of fertilizer, the Government has focused its attention on making arrangements to purchase the direct fertilizer such as Urea, T. S. P. , M. O. P. and Ammonia Sulfate as required by the farmers for a concessionary price determined in the open market, based on the recommendations to be applied in respect of each crop, covering all crops in lieu of the Cash Grant Programme.

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to provide a bag of 50 kg of direct fertilizer such as Urea, T. S. P. and M. O. P. at a concessionary price of Rs.500/-, to the paddy cultivators for one season subject to a maximum of 5 acres through the Department of Agrarian Development, to formulate a mechanism to enable to purchase a bag of fertilizer of 50kg required by the farmers who cultivate other crops at a concessionary price of Rs.1,500/- from the open market, to contribute  Rs.675/- per season by the Government, to an Insurance Scheme on behalf of a farmer, providing a compensation of Rs.40,000/- per acre for the loss of crops such as paddy, potatoes, corn, soya and onions due to natural causes, as proposed by the Budget 2018, and to implement these proposals with effect from the Yala Season 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Augmentation of Kotugoda, Kolonnawa, Padukka, Horana Dehiwala and Madampe Grid Substations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: Taking into consideration the recommendations made by the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Procurement Committee, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contracts to M/s ABB India Ltd., for a sum of Rs. 2,214.16 million, to upgrade the Kotugoda, Kolonnawa, Padukka, Horana, Dehiwala and Madampe Grid Substations under the Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Additional Financing for Rural Bridges Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body:
The need to construct approximately 400 bridges to upgrade the economic development in the rural areas and to reduce the provincial disparities has been identified. The currently ongoing project implemented to construction 1,210 bridges is in the final stages of completion, with over 1000 bridges completed and about 200 more to be completed.

         	Considering the requests received from the different Provinces for the immediate completion of the bridges to improve the rural connectivity, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to extend the  periods of the relevant loan agreements to obtain the additional provisions required for the construction of 250 more bridges from the same agencies that funded for the original projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Carrying out the Rehabilitation activities of the Kankesanthurai Harbour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: In accordance with the development policy framework of the Government, the rehabilitation of the Kankesanthurai Harbour for commercial purposes as a self sustainable Commercial Port has been identified to be one of the major projects under the North East Economic Corridor Concept. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to undertake the rehabilitation of the existing brake water and the construction of the new Jetty  of the Kankesanthurai Harbour by the Sri Lanka Ports Authority utilizing the funds of the Line of Credit provided by the Government of India, and to appoint the Procurement and Technical Evaluation Committees for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Feasibility Study on the North Port Development Project of the Port of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: Considering the need to perform a feasibility study for the development of the Port of Colombo towards the Northern side by the Government of Sri Lanka for the development activities of the transport sector, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to call for  Expression of Interest (EOI) and Request for Proposal (RFP) to select and appoint an appropriate consultancy agency for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a Re insurance Cover for Agricultural Crop Insurance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: Measures have been taken by the Agricultural and Agrarian Insurance Board to implement an agricultural crop insurance scheme proposed in the Budget Proposals of 2018. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to award the re insurance scheme to cover the said insurance scheme to Renaisance Re Lloyds Syndicate Company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Moragolla Hydro Power Plant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: Under the Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme, the procurement activities of the construction of the  Moragolla Hydro Power Plant with a capacity of 30.2 Megawatts are implemented in three Lots. Out of this, under the first Lot, civil works consisting of road construction, office construction, irrigation system and quarters for employees are due to be constructed and a sum of US$ 5.21 has been set apart for the purpose. Accordingly, the 7 bids have been received from the bids called for this procurement, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract to the bidder V V Karunaratne & Company, the lowest bidder for a sum of Rs.1,109.4 million, (without VAT) as recommended by the  Procurement Appeal Board (PAB) and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Extension of the agreements of the Private Plants from which the Ceylon Electricity Board currently purchases power
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The total installed capacity, of the the Ceylon Electricity Board currently, is 4086 Megawatts. The hydro power plants that have been generating 1,391 Megawatts of power have been limited due to the drought experienced during the last two years. Since the power plants constructed presently, are due to be completed during the period between 2019 and 2022, the need has arisen to make a temporary programme to get electricity until the year 2020.  Accordingly, considering the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee (CANC), the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to extend the power purchase Agreements entered into in 2018 and due to expire in the near future to be extended to enable to purchase electricity further from the power plants belonging to ACE Power from Matara, Embilipitiya and Sapugaskanda for a further period of three (03) years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of new components for the Gas Turbine at the Kelanitissa Combined Cycle Power Station (KCCPS)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to procure the essential components required to be re installed in the Gas Turbine at the Kelanitissa Combined Cycle Power Station after operating a specific period of time, from GE BHEL-GE Gas Turbine Services (Pvt.) Ltd. in India, the local agent of the General Electric Company, the original equipment manufacturer, for a sum of Rs.582 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sanitation and Hygiene Initiative for Towns (SHIFT) Project for the Southern and Western Provinces of Sri Lanka - Design and Supervision Consultancy Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: Sanitation and Hygiene Initiative for the Towns in the Southern and Western Provinces of Sri Lanka will be implemented with the funds of the French Agency for Development and the Government of Sri Lanka. Improvement of the management capacity of the large scale sewerage system of the Water Supply and Drainage Board and the implementation of the Galle Unawatuna and Kelaniya Peliyagoda sewerage systems will be undertaken by this project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for Designing and providing consultancy services to the Joint Project established by the M/s Cabinet D'ETUDES MARC MERLIN and SWECO Denmark A/S Green Tech Consultants (Pvt) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Ambathale Water Treatment Plant Expansion Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: It is expected that the daily water demand of the Colombo district will increase up to 863,602 m³ of water by the year 2020.  Therefore, it has been planned to increase the water purification capacity of the Ambathale Water Treatment Plant by 50,000 m³ of water per day. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to implement the Ambathale Water Treatment Plant Expansion Project treating it as a priority project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the rural roads in the Uva Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award 15 contracts for the improvement of rural roads of a length of 557.31 KM in the District of Badulla in the Uva Province and 488.78 KM in length in the Monaragala District under the second Integrated Road Investment Programme funded by the Asia Development Bank as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Development of the Kandy Suburban Railway (KSR) as a solution to minimize the traffic congestion in the Kandy Metropolitan Region (KMR)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27

description: Construction of the Main Canal from Nebadagahawatta to Mahakithula Reservoir Inlet Tunnel of the North Western Province Canal Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to award the contract for the construction of the Main Canal from Nebadagahawatta to Mahakithula Reservoir Inlet Tunnel of the North Western Province Canal Project under the Mahaweli Water Securities Investment Programme to China State Construction Engineering Corporation Limited, for a sum of Rs.5,505.28 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presentation of Regulations made by the Minister of Sports under section 34(1) of the Convention against Doping in Sports Act, in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to present the Gazette Notification issued, incorporating the Anti-Doping Regulations (Prohibited List) No.3 of 2017 made by the Minister of Sports in terms of section 34(1) of the Convention against Doping in Sports Act, No.33 of 2013, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Formulation of a Joint-Programme for the Administration of Provincial and District Sports Complexes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body:
A project is being implemented by the Government to construct 09 Provincial Sports Complexes and 16 District Sports Complexes, covering the entire Island with a view to creating rural athletes who will excel in international events through the establishment of sports infrastructure facilities. Under this project, 04 Provincial Sports Complexes constructed in areas such as Anuradhapura, Badulla, Trincomalee and Kandy as well as 05 District Sports Complexes constructed in areas such as Kalutara, Matara, Polonnaruwa, Batticaloa and Jaffna, have been vested with the public.  It is anticipated to finalize the construction of the other Sports Complexes also, within this year.

	As such, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of                              Sports, to formulate a proper mechanism for the formal administration of these Sports  Complexes, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Implementation of the Small Scale Infrastructure Development Projects at Local Level
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: In accordance with the Local Government Elections held under the new Electoral System there is an elected representative for each ward of a Local Authority and therefore, it is important to provide him / her also as representatives with an opportunity to take part in the identification of the infrastructural needs of the respective ward. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to develop an appropriate mechanism to avoid issues that would crop up in the implementation and duplication of work, giving priority to the proposals so identified, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Technical Education Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The technology subject stream for the G.C.E.(Advanced Level) was introduced in the year 2013 and in the first phase of the project, the teaching of the subject stream commenced in 251 schools. With a view to further expanding the opportunities for learning the technology subjects, it has been planned to introduce the technology subject stream in 1,500 schools by the year 2019. Since this stream is inclined towards practical activities the schools where this stream is to be taught should essentially be equipped with modern technology and training of teachers for teaching the subjects should essentially be done. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to implement the Technical Education Development Programme with the assistance of the OPEC Funds for International Development (OFID) to achieve the said objectives, was approved by the Cabinet

description: General Education Modernization Project (funded by the World Bank)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: Along with the globalization and the rapid progress in the technology, it has been recognized that the General Education will lay the foundation for producing the human resource of a country to suit the economic and social activities. Accordingly, in order to suit the future requirements of Sri Lanka, the World Bank has given its concurrence to grant a concessionary loan of US$ 100 million for the implementation of a General Education Modernization Project, for modernizing and enhancing the quality of General Education. As such, to befits needs of the present labour market, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to implement the proposed project with a view to developing human capital with skills and training, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Re establishment of the Sri Lanka National Book Development Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The Sri Lanka National Book Development Board, having established in the year 1972, on a recommendation made by the UNESCO to achieve the objectives of formulating and implementing a National Policy pertaining to the functions inclusive of improving and encouraging the habit of reading and referring books among public, writing and producing books, was abolished in the year 2012 and its functions were taken over by the National Library and Documentation Services Board. However, taking into consideration the necessity of having a separate entity to achieve the objectives and carry out the  functions in a more effective manner, which were expected to be performed by the Sri Lanka National Book Development Board, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to re establish the Sri Lanka National Book Development Board which was abolished in the year 2012, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Protection of Human Dignity and Social Harmony Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body:
Presently, it has become imperative to device measures to  suppress the surreptitious efforts emerging and the incident of harassment, revenge, intimidation and threat through electronic media to create social unrest and   the religious and communal disharmony among the general public, damaging the human dignity and social harmony.

	As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice, to formulate legislation to enable to take action against the efforts made to violate the privacy of each individual and to create religious, racial or communal disharmony among the general public treating them as offences, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Establishment of a Divisional Office in Kurunegala for the Department of Buddhist Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: Taking into consideration the special religious activities and the significance of the places of worship, two divisional offices of the Department of Buddhist Affairs have been established in the districts of Kandy and Rathnapura. Important places of worship are located in the North, North Central and North Western Provinces. In the above Provinces, 54 places of worship where the  administrative activities are being directly carried out by the Department of Buddhist Affairs and a total of 2,364 temples are located. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to establish a divisional office of the Department of Buddhist Affairs in the Kurunegala District, in order to fulfill the official duties and related services to the places of worship and temples, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Supply of electricity to the State Vesak Festival of 2562nd  Year of Buddhist Era
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The approval of the Cabinet has been granted to conduct the State Vesak Festival this year at the historical Bingiriya Rajamaha Viharaya in the Kurunegala District. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to secure the funds further required for the supply of electricity to the Bingiriya Rajamaha Viharaya, where the main function will be conducted and the surrounding areas, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Replacement of the Plantation Management Monitoring Division with the Plantation Regulatory and Compliance Agency
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The lands acquired by the Land Reform Commission in terms of the Land Reform Laws, were vested with the Janatha Estates Development Board and Sri Lanka State Plantation Corporation and later they were leased out to 23 Regional Plantation Companies for a period of 53 years with effect from 1992. Monitoring activities of the ownership rights of the Government in such companies were carried out by the Plantation Management Monitoring Division of the Ministry of Plantation Industries. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of  Plantation Industries, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation for the establishment of a Plantation Regulatory and Compliance Agency with sufficient monitoring powers to safeguard the interests of the Government for the remainder of the lease period of 28 years in place of the existing Plantation Management Monitoring Division, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Establishment of Development Review Committees for the implementation of the Sacred Areas Development Plans
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The need for the improvement of facilities available for the pilgrims and the visitors who visit the sacred areas around the Island has been identified. In this respect, it is important to develop the sacred areas in a formal manner with a proper administrative mechanism and guidance. Accordingly, with a view to developing the sacred areas according to a well prepared plan, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to establish Development Review Committees in Anuradhapura, Kataragama, Seruwavila, Matale Aluviharaya, Mahiyanganaya, Kelaniya, Kotte, Devinuwara, Muthiyanganaya and Tissamaharamaya with  the authority delegated for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet

description: The draft Bill of the Sri Lanka Light Rail Transit System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body:
Action is being taken by the Government to implement a project on Light Rail Transit System (LRT) to establish an efficient and effective passenger transport system in the Colombo Megapolis area. Under this 7 LRT lines have been planned to be constructed and in this respect priority has been given to the LRT line running within Colombo and the LRT line extending towards Malabe from Boralle via Battaramulla. It is expected to commence the operation of the Colombo Light Rail (CLR) system by the year 2025.

	In accordance with the agreement with the Japan International Corporation Agency (JICA) which provides funds for the construction of the proposed 2 roads the regulatory frame work relating to the above has to be drawn up before commencing the construction of the said 2 roads. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to establish a legal entity for the regulation on management of the proposed LRT, to provide for relevant legal provision and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare the Sri Lanka Light Rail Transit System Bill, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Nation Building Tax (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27

description: Amending the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017 to provide for Transitional Provisions and to avoid the practical impediments in the implementation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017 will be in force from April, 2018. Under this, the transitional provisions necessary to be provided to the tax payers such as claiming the unexpired losses, capital allowances, tax holidays etc., which had been granted by the previous Inland Revenue Act, have to be issued by way of Regulations. Further, in order to avoid the practical impediments which may arise in the implementation of the new Act certain provisions in the Act require amendments. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to amend the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017 for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Holding of a Presidential Media Award Ceremony for Media Personnel
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The necessity of identifying the multiple talents and skills of the media personnel and while appreciating their skills, evaluate and guide them in the  appropriate way to create professional media personnel and motivate them and to empower the entire media sector in order to build a just society and to induce the media personnel to create a progressive media culture, has been recognized. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media,  to hold a  Presidential Media Award Ceremony annually from 2018 onwards to appreciate the mission and the contribution made by Sri Lankan Media Personnel, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Adoption of Innovators to Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body:
The Budget of 2018 proposed to provide the opportunity for new inventors to enter into industries and the objective was to absorb the University Graduates and NVQ Certificate Holders with a registered Patent or a viable business idea.  The industry will adopt the innovators and to support this cause, the Government will bear 50% of their monthly salary subject to a Rs.50,000/- per month up to a maximum of 24 months and in addition the cost of Patent in Sri Lanka and counseling on Patenting.      
    
Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to implement the project inclusive of the determination of criteria to select the candidates and partner companies, to appoint a Steering Committee to take necessary measures to implement the Project and to take measures to ensure success of the initiatives including the  selection of candidates, the entities, matching the candidate to the entity and other activities of the proposal and also to appoint a Technical Committee to assist the Steering Committee, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Introduction to Sri Lanka a methodology for the transplantation of the organs of the persons diagnosed for brain-death
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body:
Presently, the transplantation of the organs of the persons diagnosed for brain death is a surgical operation conducted globally, for a period of time. The organs of the brain dead persons connected to a ventilator in an intensive care unit can be so transplanted. There is the possibility of transplanting specially, the kidneys, heart, liver, lungs, pancreas, parts of the digestive system as well as parts of the eye, skin, veins, heart valves, ligaments and bones.

	Approximately,  750 - 1,000 are buried without retrieving organs as a result of not having an opportunity to give their consent for donating organs before their death. It is the responsibility of the Government to provide for opportunities for the people willing to donate their organs after death. Australia, France and Lebanon carry out this activity using their national data network and the countries like the United Kingdom have provided several opportunities of registration of their data network for the donation of organs through the internet, telephones, short messages etc.

	Motor traffic accidents has become a major cause for brain death and it is estimated that, approximately, more than 2,500 people die of road traffic accidents every year. Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to design and implement a national programme for within Sri Lanka transplanting organs after death and to prepare an organ donor registration data network inclusive of future course of action, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Vesting of a plot of land to establish the office of  Payagala Medical Officer of Health (MOH)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body:
Considering the number of hospitals and the offices of the MOH situated in the area of the National Institute of Health Sciences in Kalutara, the establishment of a MOH office in Wadugoda, Payagala has been identified as essential for the purpose of according due attention to child and maternal health and implementing programmes to take follow-up action to prevent the non communicable diseases such as diabetes, heart diseases, high-blood pressure as well as dengue prevention in the area.  It is considered that the premises where the Wadugoda Primary School was situated which remains closed since the year 2004 is highly appropriate for this purpose.

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to vest the said land with the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to establish the Payagala MOH Office, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Value Enhancement of Sri Lankan Timber Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body:
When analyzing  the development of the other various industries in Sri Lanka, the Timber and the Timber Based Industry indicates a comparative downward trend or slow progress in comparison with other industries. The need for the sustainable development of the Timber and the Timber Based Industry of Sri Lanka a fair balance between the protective and productive capacity of the forest has been recognized. For this purpose, obtaining of membership by Sri Lanka of the International Tropical Timber Organization (ITTO) for Forest Conservation which promote conservation and sustainable management and the  use and trade of tropical forest resources and marketing, and the establishment of a Timber Innovation and Design Centre in Moratuwa where there are a large number of wood based manufacturing producers, has been planned.    

       	The proposed  Timber Innovation and Design Centre would pave the way for the timber manufactures to develop first class timber and to develop Moratuwa area as one of the magnificent design centres with the assistance of the State Timber Corporation and the design groups of the University of Moratuwa. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Science, Technology and Research and the relevant institutions and the Universities, to implement the said proposals, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Establishment of the 'National Railway Museum of Sri Lanka' at the historical site of the Colombo Terminus Station at Maradana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body:
Several attempts have been made to establish a railway museum of international standards in Sri Lanka to attract the general public, the students and the railway enthusiasts. However, due to inadequate resources and proper methodologies, the two(02) railway museums which have been established presently in Maradana and Kadugannawa do not function properly.  Therefore, it has been planned to establish a railway museum by rehabilitating the buildings of the Colombo Terminus Station and the buildings close by, in Maradana under a new railway museum project.

It has been found that more than hundreds of small and large railway related artifacts with historical value are available in proper condition for exhibition and by attracting local and foreign tourists to the new museum, the Department of Railways can also earn a considerable amount of revenue. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to establish 'Sri Lanka National Railway Museum', was approved by the Cabinet

description: Securing of loan facilities for the implementation of the Thalpitigala Reservoir Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The total estimated cost of the Thalpitigala Reservoir construction project is US$ 174 million and the Cabinet has granted approval to obtain a loan from the EXIM Bank of China to cover 85% of same. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to obtain a loan of US$ 26.1 million from the People's Bank to cover 15% of the balance project cost and to enter into a loan agreement in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Securing of Additional financing for the Kaluganga Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: Construction work of the Kaluganga Reservoir has commenced in the year 2014 and the work is expected to be completed by December 2018. Due to the unforeseen geological conditions identified in the Bund, the necessary revisions of the design done accordingly have led to an increase of the cost of the contract by US$ 50.5 million. Out of the shortfall of funds, the Saudi Fund for Development has agreed to provide an additional loan of approximately US$ 16 million to cover the shortfall.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct negotiations to obtain the said loan and to enter into the relevant agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Association of Accounting Technicians (AAT) of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-27
decision_details_body: The Association of Accounting Technicians of Sri Lanka which was established in the year 1987 has been registered as a company limited by guarantee under the Companies Act and at present, it has become one of the prominent accountancy and training institutes in Sri Lanka. A proposal has been made to incorporate the said Institution by an Act of Parliament, in order to produce the required competent Accounting Technicians for the Small and Medium Enterprise sector by further expanding the activities carried out by the Institution. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting loans at concessional interest rate for the damaged businesses  due to conflicts  in the Kandy District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to provide relief to rebuild the damaged businesses in the Kandy Administrative District which occurred due to the conflicts that took place in the first week of March 2018.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Public Enterprise and Kandy Development, to grant loans at 2% concessionary interest rate under the 'Athwela Loan Scheme' to re-build such damaged businesses in the Kandy District, subject to the relevant terms and conditions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Institute of National Security Studies of Sri Lanka (INSSSL) and the Institute of  Strategic Studies Islamabad (ISSI) of Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Institute of National Security Studies of Sri Lanka (INSSSL) and the Institute of  Strategic Studies Islamabad (ISSI) of Pakistan with the objective of promoting cooperation between Sri Lanka and Pakistan on the activities relating to National Security Study. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to enter into the proposed MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of Chemical Fertilizer for paddy cultivation of Yala Season 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to procure the chemical fertilizer required for distribution for paddy cultivation in the Yala Season 2018, by the Ceylon Fertilizer Company (Lak Pohora) and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizers Ltd., (Commercial Fertilizer) under the Ministry of Agriculture. Bids have been called from the International Suppliers for this purpose. 

	As such, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to purchase 24,000 MT of Granular Urea at US$ 307.18 per 01 MT from M/s Ameropa Asia (Pvt.) Ltd., 18,000 MT of Triple Super Phosphate at US$ 333.5 per 01 MT from M/s Agri Commodities & Finance FZE and 18,000 MT of Muriate of Potash at US$ 315.85 per 01 MT from M/s Agricultural Resources and Investment (Pte) Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Companies Act, No.7 of 2007 incorporating the provisions to eliminate money laundering and countering the financing of terrorism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body:
- 'Financial Action Task Force' (FATF) has taken action to grade Sri Lanka as a country with strategic deficiencies pertaining to the prevention of money laundering and countering of financing of terrorism. The European Union (EU) has accordingly, blacklisted Sri Lanka in this regard in February 2018. Taking into consideration the serious negative consequences which may be caused to the economy and the financial system of the country, the necessity of making further legal provisions for the prevention of money laundering and countering financing of terrorism has been identified. 

	One of the important provisions to be incorporated will be the necessity of maintaining a register providing for information of the persons who own a share entitlement of 25% or more the ownership of their own Company, and all the other Companies except a Public Limited Company (PLC) or on the beneficiaries who exercise effective control over the operations of such a Company. Further, provisions have to be made to provide such information to the Registrar of Companies and other relevant authorities as well. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. A.D. Champika Premadasa, the Acting Minister of Industry and Commerce, to make the necessary amendments to the Companies Act, No.7 of 2007 and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration (SLIDA) and the National School of Public Policy of the Government of Pakistan (NSPP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration (SLIDA) which holds the responsibility of  the capacity building of the officers in the  public sector in Sri Lanka  and the National School of Public Policy of the Government of Pakistan. The MoU will cover the areas such as conducting of integrated training programmes, exchange of expertise, students and academic activities, management consultancy activities and integrated research activities. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration and Management, to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding, with the objective of making the public service more efficient through the capacity building of the public sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Industrial Technology Institute of Sri Lanka and the International Center for Chemical and Biological Sciences (ICCBS) of Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Industrial Technology Institute of Sri Lanka and the International Center for Chemical and Biological Sciences (ICCBS) of Pakistan, with the objective of securing cooperation between Sri Lanka and Pakistan in the fields of chemical and Biological Sciences. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to sign the proposed  Memorandum of Understanding during the scheduled state visit of H.E the President to Pakistan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Bandaranaike International Diplomatic Training Institute (BIDTI) of Sri Lanka and the Foreign Service Academy (FSA) of Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to  sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Bandaranaike International Diplomatic Training Institute (BIDTI) of Sri Lanka and the Foreign Service Academy (FSA) of Pakistan, with a view to promoting the cooperation between the officers of the diplomatic services of Pakistan and Sri Lanka on training and professional development. This will generate the opportunity for improving the interaction between the foreign service officers of the two countries and for exchanging information between the foreign service officers of the two countries in the fields of Foreign Policies, International Relations, International Law and diplomatic relations. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to enter into the proposed MoU during the scheduled state visit of H.E. the President to Pakistan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing of funds required for the Supply of Garbage Collecting Compactors to Local Authorities of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body:
- The management of solid waste disposal in the urban areas has become a challenging issue due to the absence of a proper solid waste management and disposal system with necessary equipment and technology. Therefore, it has been planned to provide 190 garbage collecting compactors to the local authorities with the objective of improving the capacity of garbage collection and transportation of 84 local authorities. 


Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into the relevant loan Agreements to obtain a loan of not exceeding US$ 14 million from the Economic Development Corporation Fund of the Export - Import (EXIM) Bank  of Korea,  to cover the expenditure incurred in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting of the 70th World Health Day Celebrations in Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body:
- Arrangements have been made to celebrate the 70th Anniversary of the World Health Organization (WHO) which falls in the year 2018, under the theme of 'Universal Health Coverage: for everyone, everywhere'. It has been found that it would be appropriate to conduct the Anniversary Celebrations this year in Sri Lanka as a country  with  Health Indices on par with the Developed countries. The representatives of the WHO, Ministers of Health in 12 countries, Agents from 11 member states and high profile officers representing the field of health are scheduled to participate in this event.  

	As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to host the 70th World Health Day, inauguration ceremony  on the 07th of April 2018, in Colombo, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the University of Peradeniya and the University College of Southeast Norway of the Kingdom of Norway on Cooperation in the field of Higher Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to enter into a MoU between the University of Peradeniya and the University College of Southeast Norway of the Kingdom of Norway with the objective of strengthening a cordial co-operation in the field of Higher Education. The proposed MoU covers the activities such as conducting of Joint Research and Academic Programmes, exchange of the academic staff and the students, curriculum development etc,.  Accordingly,   the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the then Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to sign the relevant MoU between the two universities, considering also the concurrence given by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister in-charge of the subject of Higher Education and Highways, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a Management Information System for the Technical and                             Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body: - Seven Institutions which provide Vocational Training and Technical Education are implemented under the Ministry of Skills Development and Vocational Training and the Tertiary and Vocational Educational Commission ensures the standard of the syllabuses of the Institutions. It has been proposed to introduce a modern information management system for the institutions, with a view to ensuring an effective coordination among the said institutions and the training institutions of the private sector and to introduce training programmes to address the present day needs. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Chandima Weerakkody, the Minister of  Skills Development and Vocational Training, to commence the said activity in the year 2018 and to implement it expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Hydrophobic Intra Ocular Lenses used for Eye Surgeries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the purchase of 18,600 Hydrophobic Intra Ocular Lenses implanted into the eye during cataract surgery, to M/s Vision 2000 (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.322.84 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mullaitivu Water Supply Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body: - The Mullaitivu Water Supply Scheme has been designed covering 09 Grama Niladhari Divisions of the Maritimepattu Divisional Secretariat Division in the Mullaitivu District with the objective of providing  safe drinking water for around a population of  7,430  living in the town of Mullaitivu and the suburban areas (around 1,500 families). Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for the construction of the Mullaitivu Water Supply Scheme to the Joint Venture of M/s Ceylex Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd. and Prathibha Industries Ltd.,  India, for a sum of Rs.894.74 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Alternative Sources of Financing - 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body: - As proposed by the Budget 2018, the maximum borrowing limit of the Government for the year 2018 is Rs.1,895 billion. It is estimated that within the first quarter of the year, around US$732 million will be required for foreign loan debt servicing and repayments. In the context of the existing global conditions and the difficulties that would emerge in future, in securing funds at a lower cost, it has been observed that it would be beneficial to pay and release the Sri Lanka Development Bonds which are to be matured in the year 2018, with a relatively higher cost by securing funds expeditiously, under the prevailing Fixed Interest Ratios. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Eran Wickramaratna, the Acting Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to secure funds for the purpose, up to a maximum of US$ 300 million, from the Bank of Ceylon and the People's Bank through their Foreign Exchange Banking Units or the Offshore Banking Units, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Implementation of a Health Assessment Programme for migrants who visit Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body:
- The National Migration Health Policy was declared by Sri Lanka in the year 2013 and accordingly, appropriate measures have to be taken to prevent the threat posed on  public health with the diseases that could enter the country due to migration. Sri Lanka receives around 40,000 long-stay or resident visa applications annually and it is identified that around 60% of them are from migrant workers arriving from the countries with a higher risk level relative to the public health in Sri Lanka. Currently, there is no process to assess their health level status of these migrants and no incentive programmes is also in place for them to obtain a health insurance cover during their stay in the country to cover their health expenditure.  

Therefore, it has become necessary to take some expeditious measures in this regard. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine representing Sri Lanka and the International Organization for Migration (IOM), to establish and implement a Health Assessment Programme for Residence Visa Applicants, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the establishment of the Neonatal and Obstetrics Reference Centre for the De-Zoysa Maternity Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet approval has been granted for the establishment of the Neonatal and Obstetrics Reference Centre for enhancing the qualitative aspect of the Neonatal treatment services provided by the De Zoysa Maternity Hospital and for securing funds for the purpose. Negotiations have been conducted to secure funds from the Government of France for this purpose and considering the obstacles and the delay in obtaining the said funds, a decision has been made to consider the alternative sources of loans. 
	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to secure a loan of EURO 17.99 million from the Standard Chartered Bank and EURO 8.45 million from the Sampath Bank and to sign the relevant agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Execution of the Strategic Plan relevant to Sri Lanka in the United Nations World Food Programme (WFP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-20

description: Resolving the Academic Issues of the Medical Students of the South Asian Institute of Technology and Medicine (SAITM)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- A Committee under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Ministry of the Defence, has been appointed to introduce a suitable methodology for the admission of  the medical students of the SAITM to the Medical Faculty of the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University, with a view  to resolving the issue that cropped up relating to the admission of medical students to SAITM and awarding medical degrees to them. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to implement the following recommendations in the report made by the said committee, having examined the issue and  conducted negotiations with  the relevant parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	Admission of only the students who are currently studying at the Faculty of Medicine of the SAITM to the  Faculty of the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University and awarding of the MBBS Degree for those who successfully complete their degree programme.

*	The Government to provide the capital and recurrent expenditure required for the maintenance of academic study programmes of the said students and the Recurrent expenditure required for the maintenance of hospital services of the Kotelawala Defence University.

description: Implementation of the Paddy Purchasing Programme of the Government (PPPG) in 2017/2018 Maha Season
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to obtain Rs. 500 million from the General Treasury, to implement the Paddy Purchasing Programme of the Government, through the Paddy Marketing Board in the districts where paddy harvest has been received in excess of consumption requirements of the 2017/2018 Maha Season, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Office for Reparations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- Pursuant to the policy decisions as approved by the Cabinet from time to time where gross violation of Human Rights or Humanitarian Law which occurred, in the following instances, the necessity of having an independent institution  has been recognized for the purpose of providing reparations for the same:

(i)	In the course of the conflict which took place in the Northern and Eastern Provinces in the past or its aftermath; or

(ii)	In connection with political or civil disturbances; or

(iii)	In the course of systematic violations of the rights of individuals, groups or communities of the people of Sri Lanka; or

(iv)	Due to enforced disappearances as defined in the 'International Convention on Protection of All Persons from Enforced Disappearances'.
Therefore, a proposal has been made to establish an 'Office for Reparations' by law to which requests for reparations can be submitted by Sri Lankans belonging to all ethnic and religious groups including the civilians in the adjoining villages who were amidst those conflicts and affected by such incidents and including the families of the Police and the Security Forces. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill necessary for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enactment of a New Act in respect of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been granted, in principle, to amend the laws pertaining to Bribery or Corruption and pursuant to the said Cabinet approval, action is being taken to amend the Bribery Act, No.11 of 1954.  The power of instituting prosecutions in respect of the offences under the Bribery Act and the Declaration of Assets and Liabilities Law, No.1 of 1975 has been vested with the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption, established by the Act, No.19 of 1994. 

	In terms of Article 156A(1) of the Constitution as amended by the 19th Amendment to the Constitution, provisions should be made to vest the CIABOC with the power to conduct investigations on its own motion or on a complaint made to the Commission by another individual pertaining to an allegation of  bribery or corruption and to institute prosecutions  on the same and to implement the International Conventions relating to the prevention of corruption to which Sri Lanka is a party.     

	For this purpose, it has become apparent that it would be more appropriate to introduce a new Act for the establishment of CIABOC as an independent entity by further strengthening the same instead of amending the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption Act, No.19 of 1994.
