As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Bill for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Faculty of Medicine in the Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- The University of Sabaragamuwa established as a National University in the year 1996, is presently, a University comprising of 7 Faculties. In accordance with the policy of the Government to expand the medical education, a sum of Rs.1,250 million has been set apart from the Budget of 2018 to commence the Medical Faculties of the Universities of Wayamba, Moratuwa and Sabaragamuwa. Under this programme, it has been planned to commence the Medical Faculty of the  University of Sabaragamuwa in 2018 with the admission of 75 Medical Students. The construction of a building for the Medical Faculty has been planned in the year 2019 and until then building accommodation facilities have to be sorted out.  

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the then Minister of Higher Education and Highways with the concurrence of the present Minister as well, to vest the land and the building complex located close to Batuhena school in Ratnapura - Colombo main road belonging to the Auditor General's Department formally with the Ministry of Higher Education and Highways with a view to conducting the activities of the Faculty, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of 100 Waste Transport Vehicles (Compactors) for formalizing of the transportation of waste by the Local Authorities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- It has been identified that 341 additional waste transport vehicles are required for the Local Authorities to carry out the waste disposal efficiently and effectively.  Out of this number, action is in progress to obtain 190 waste transport vehicles under the Korean Loan Aid facility.  A further number of 100  waste transport vehicles are proposed to be purchased expeditiously with domestic funds and for this purpose bids have been called.

	Considering the recommendations of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC) and the Procurement Appeal Board, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to award the contract for the supply of 100 waste transport vehicles (Compactors)  with a capacity of 6 cubic meters, to M/s ZXY Hong Kong Co. Limited of China, for a sum of Rs.622.13 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Vavunathivu Solar Power Plant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- Since the Solar Power Plant with a 10MW capacity proposed to be built in Valachchanai area is to be connected with the Vavunathivu grid sub‑station, it will be named as the 'Vavunathivu Solar Power Plant'.  Bids have been called for, for the construction of the said Solar Power Plant and 17 institutions have submitted their bids in this regard. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract to Build, Own and Operate the 'Vavunathivu Solar Power Plant' to M/s Ex-Pack Corrugated Cartons (Pvt.) Ltd., which has submitted the minimum cost at the rate of Rs.11.86 per KW hour, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 100MW of Supplementary Power to ensure uninterrupted power supply in the County
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- Due to the inadequate rain fall that prevails, the fall of water level of the reservoirs could be expected within the next 06 months and it has been identified that this could be an obstruction for an uninterrupted supply of power. As such, the approval of the Cabinet has been granted to purchase supplementary power of 100MW through a short term power purchase agreement and in the meantime, bids have been called adopting the International competitive bidding for the purpose.

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy,  to purchase a 56MW power supply from M/s Aggreko International Projects Limited at the rate of Rs.28.063 per KW hour and to purchase a 44 MW power supply from M/s Hayleys Aventura (Pvt.) Limited & SES Smart Energy Solutions Fzco at the rate of Rs.28.367 per KW hour for a period of 06 months, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of public institutions utilizing the cost effective NERD technology
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- The National Engineering Research and Development Centre of Sri Lanka (NERDC) is carrying out research activities pertaining to cost effective  technologies of construction of buildings and also take measures to spread the outcome of such research among the public. Presently, school buildings, laboratories for hospitals, buildings or clinics and stores residential buildings for the forces and various types of houses have been constructed in various parts of the Island utilizing these cost effective technologies. If this method is adopted from the planning stage, at least a minimum of 20%- 25% of a financial saving could be had from the total cost of construction and also there is the possibility of minimizing the use of timber, sand and metal. The use of this technology for the construction of buildings has also been recommended by the Construction Industries Development Authority.  

	Taking into consideration, the above and making provision for the use of the cost effective method for the construction of buildings required for public institutions, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to award  the consultancy services, designing and construction of such buildings directly to the National Engineering Research and Development Centre of Sri Lanka (NERDC), subject to a maximum of Rs.50 million, deviating from the procurement procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Catering Services for Passenger Lounges of the Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body: - The Airport & Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) Limited operates  four (04) Passenger Lounges at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA), Katunayake and one (01) Passenger Lounge at the Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport (MRIA) for the passengers of the Business Class, First Class and Special Categories. It is essential to provide high quality catering services to the local as well as the foreign air passengers receiving the services of these Lounges. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract to M/s Sri Lankan Catering Limited affiliated to the Srilankan Airlines, which has the potential for the purpose, for a forthcoming period of 03 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Kaluganga - Moragahakanda Transfer Canal (KMTC) under the Upper Elahera Canal Construction Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body: - The Design and Build Contract for the Transfer Canal comprising of two tunnels 8km in length from the Kalu Ganga Tank to Moragahakanda Tank, open canal way, aqueducts and the associated structures, which fall under the purview of the Upper Elahera Canal Project is implemented under the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Programme. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to award the construction contract to Sinohydro Corporation Limited of China, for a sum of Rs.6,111.91 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining suitable lands to Local Authorities for Solid Waste Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- The Local Authorities are faced with the difficulty of obtaining suitable lands  in disposing of solid waste for Solid Waste Management adopting environmentally friendly methods. Even though lands have been released to some Local Government Authorities for disposing of waste, the development of those lands as sanitary landfills has been barred due to non-awarding of the legal ownership of those lands.

Therefore, as agreed to by at the discussion held on this matter with the participation of all relevant stakeholders, the joint proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms and Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government to formally vest the lands already set apart to the relevant Local Government Authorities for disposing of waste and to acquire the land lots belonging to the Land Reform Commission and the State Plantation Corporation and those possessed by the Regional Plantation Companies on long term lease basis under the Land Acquisition Act, which has been found as suitable for the disposal of waste by developing them as sanitary land fills and to allocate the same over to the Local Government Authorities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Prevention of Domestic Violence Act, No.34 of 2005
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- The need for amending the Prevention of Domestic Violence Act, No.34 of 2005 introduced with a view to eliminating domestic violence has now arisen, when considering the problems observed during the implementation of the Act during the last 12 years. The Committee comprising of all stakeholders appointed to examine the matter after obtaining the views of the General Public as well, has submitted its recommendations for amending the Act.  

	Accordingly, proposed amendments include the increase of the categories of persons who can institute legal action on behalf of an adult person or children, subject to domestic violence, simplifying the process of filing an application, removing of the requirement of mandatory counseling in order to ensure the protection of an aggrieved party, amending the existing method of followup action, implementation of temporary protection orders effectively. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, to amend the  prevention of Domestic Violence Act, No.34 of 2005 incorporating the said amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Controlling of the floods in the Colombo and Kolonnawa areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- The Kolonnawa Canal Diversion Scheme (KCD) has been identified as a major development activities under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project, carried out aimed at mitigating of floods. Under this project, it is expected to widen the existing canals to flow down the storm water in the Colombo area during the periods of low water levels in the Kelani River and also to make arrangements to mitigate the flood condition occurring in the Kolonnawa area during the periods of high water level in the Kelani River.

	As such, it has been planned to reconstruct the flood gate structure across the Kiththampahuwa Canal closer to the outfall on Sedawaththa - Ambathale Road  and to remove the bottlenecks to the canal flow and to conduct the gabion bank conservation activities. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement the project with the assistance of the Officers of the Department of Irrigation and the Climate Resilience Improvement Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lease of 2 land lots in the Muthurajawela sand filled area for the Logistics related activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- The Muthurajawela area in Wattala has been identified as a part of the Logistics Zone being constructed under the Megapolis Plan of the Western Province. The land in extent of 400 acres developed in the area by the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation (SLLR&DC) through sand nourishment, has been alienated for various projects.

	Applications have been called by way of publishing paper advertisements to lease out two remaining land lots for logistic purposes. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to lease out the said two land lots to John Keells Logistics (Pvt.) Ltd., the highest bidder for the purpose, for a period of 30 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the Polduwa by-pass road from 'Suhurupaya' to 'Koswatta Junction'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- The traffic congestion in the Kaduwela-Colombo road has become intense due to the rapid development taking place in the Battaramulla area and as a solution to the problem, it has been identified as necessary to construct a by pass road from the Polduwa Junction to Koswatta Junction circumventing the Battaramulla town.  The construction activities of the access road from the Polduwa Junction to 'Suhurupaya' has already been completed and the Cabinet approval has also been granted to extend this road up to  Udumulla Junction as a 2 lane road.
	Considering the increasing traffic congestion in the Battaramulla area, it is proposed to extend this road up to the Koswatta junction. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to develop the Polduwa by-pass road about 4 km in length as a 4 lane road up to the Koswatta junction, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Small and Medium Scale Enterprises Loan Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body: - The programme implemented by the Government with the objective of securing funds for the capital and as well as the working capital requirements of the small and medium scale entrepreneurs, provides funds subject to a maximum Rs.50 million with a 10 year repayment period. Under this loan scheme, loan facilities are provided for business start up or the expansion of the existing businesses. Ten public and as well as the private sector banking institutions participate in this loan assistance programme and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to enter into the relevant loan Agreements with those participatory financial institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Labour Laws for the protection of the rights of domestic workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- Even though there are no statistics available pertaining to the domestic workers employed in Sri Lanka, it is clear that a large group of such workers are so employed. Since the prevailing labour laws are insufficient for the protection of the rights of such domestic workers, it is found that the worker community is faced with disadvantageous situations like employment for lower salaries, inability to obtain  leave and the non availability of social security. Since the domestic workers are excluded from the application of the Industrial Disputes Act, the Employees' Provident Fund Act and the other Labour Acts, the Department of Labour is unable to intervene to protect the rights of such workers.

	Through the “National Action Plan for Human Rights of 2017 - 2021” the need for the protection of the rights of the domestic workers has also been identified.  As such, considering a proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, the Minister of Labour, Trade Union Relations and Sabaragamu Development, the Cabinet granted approval in principle for enacting legislation required to protect the rights of the domestic workers.

description: Installation of the Railway Level Crossing Protection Systems and formation of  Project Management Units to expedite the rehabilitation of the Northern Railway Line
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- The length of the Sri Lanka Railway Network is 1,450 km and there are all together 1,337 railway cross roads. Out of the above, 520 have already been protected, pursuant to the provisions set apart from the Budget 2018 and measures are being taken to install Railway Level Crossing Protection Systems for another 400 railway cross roads.  Further, a proposal has been made to implement a project to construct railway cross roads so as to cover all the remaining railway cross roads under the financial assistance of the Government of Hungary.  

	Further, action has been initiated to rehabilitate the railway track from Maho Junction to Omanthai, and to construct a double track and installation of signaling system from Polgahawela to Kurunegala under the financial assistance of India with the objective of operating trains at 120 km per hour in the Northern railway line so as to reduce the time taken to reach from Jaffna to Colombo by 40 minutes. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, for the establishment of Project Management Units to implement the projects expeditiously and to implement the installation of Level Crossing Protection Systems under the financial assistance of the Hungarian Export and Import (EXIM) Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Raising Funds for the construction of the Multi-model Center in Makumbura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- Construction activities of the Makumbura Multi-model Centre is in progress at present. It is expected to provide a more efficient and cost effective public transport facilities through the transport center constructed with the amalgamation of  the transport modes from railway to long distance and local bus services.

It has been estimated that, Rs.306.79 million will be incurred  to prepare an operational mechanism required for transport management, operation and maintenance  of the Multi-model Transport Centre and providing necessary information for the commuters. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, for the proposed construction of the Makumbura Multi-model centre by utilizing the remaining unused balance of the credit facility obtained from the Japan International Corporation Agency,  for the  activities of Phase 2 of the Outer Circular Highway Development Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Listing of Census Units
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- The Department of Census and Statistics (DCS) conducts the listing of Census Units such as, housing units, collective living quarters and non-housing units island-wide based on the census of population and housing. The List is taken  as the Sampling Frame, in respect of all surveys conducted by the Department. From the year 2012 in which the last census of population and housing was conducted, the Sampling Frame has been considerably changed up to now due to the reasons such as disasters which took place during the period and the new settlements. Since these data are used for disaster management and achieving the Sustainable Development Goals in addition to duly carrying out the surveys of population and housing, it is essential to have updated information.

	Accordingly, the proposals made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct the listing of Census Units in the year 2018 covering the entire island and  subsequently, at two year intervals, thereafter, with the collaboration of the district and divisional administrative mechanisms as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing of funds for the implementation of the Giridara Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-03-06
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet has granted approval for the implementation of the Giridara Water Supply Project which has been identified as a priority project by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWS&DB), which has been designed with the objective of  addressing the drinking water issues in the Dompe Divisional Secretariat Division covering 18 Grama Niladhari Divisions, at a cost of Rs.513.28 million.

	Proposals have been called from local banks to secure the funds necessary for the project and in this respect, it has been decided to obtain the required loan from the People's Bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to authorize the National Water Supply and Drainage Board to enter into a Loan Agreement with the People's Bank to secure the necessary funds, amounting to Rs.513.28 million for the implementation of the Giridara Water Supply Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of Chemical Fertilizer for Paddy Cultivation in the Yala Season - 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body: - The supply of fertilizer is necessary from the oncoming first week of the month of April for around 500,000 hectares of paddy expected to be cultivated during the Yala season of 2018. Since, it is difficult to import and distribute fertilizer prior to the said time period following the normal procurement procedure for purchasing fertilizer, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to adopt an expeditious procurement procedure and select a suitable supplier by calling for competitive bids and to issue Treasury Guarantees to the two state owned Fertilizer Companies namely, the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Limited for purchasing fertilizer, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Health and Medical Service Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
- In the recent past, a significant increase is shown in the non‑communicable diseases such as the cardiovascular and strokes among the people of the country. Of the deaths caused, 75% are due to non‑communicable diseases and the major cause for about 40% is heart diseases. As such, the focus of the Government has been directed to improve the health and medical service facilities needed specially for the prevention of  heart diseases, and  providing treatments in that regard. 

	Under this programme it has been proposed to implement a project with the objective of improving such treatment services in the General Hospitals of Anuradhapura, Kandy, Kurunegala, Badulla and Trincomalee and the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) has agreed to provide funds for this purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct loan negotiations with JICA to obtain a loan of  Japanese Yen 10,639 million for the implementation of the project and to enter into the relevant loan Agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Audit Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
- When the National Audit Bill was taken up for discussion at the Cabinet meeting held on 20‑02‑2018,  the proposed Bill was referred to the Committee appointed under the Chairmanship of Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Special Assignments, to examine the observations submitted by the Minister of Finance and Mass Media and the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, and to make recommendations, if any further amendments are necessary for the proposed Bill. 

	Accordingly, the Cabinet having noted the recommendations made by the said Cabinet  Sub‑Committee, decided to grant approval to the National Audit Bill subject to including the amendments proposed in the recommendations.

description: Measures to be taken to face challenges for the Cyber Security successfully
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
- The increase in cyber crimes and cyber threats have affected the information and communication technology and the promotion of the internet negatively. Sri Lanka has already focused her attention to this problem and has taken action to establish the Sri Lanka Computer Emergency Readiness Team - Sri Lanka CERT/CC, as the national centre which takes action in regard to cyber security. The Sri Lanka Computer Emergency Readiness Team established in the year 2005 is an Administrative Institute belonging to the Sri Lanka Information and Communication Technology Agency(ICTA). Acting closely with the International Computer Emergency Readiness Teams and the other institutes dealing with the cyber security, the institution performs a national level service to provide the security relevant to information and communication technology for the public institutions of Sri Lanka, law enforcement Institutions, the Justice, Defence, Banks and Financial Services Sectors and the private sector. 

	The importance of the functions and the activities of the Computer Emergency Readiness Team of Sri Lanka is visible, in view of the the demand of the public institutions and the general public is increasing with regard to the cyber security.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to vest the said Team with the Ministry of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure with the objective of ensuing continued operations and improving its activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Aerial Bundled Conductor required for the Distribution Region 2 of the Ceylon Electricity Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body: - The maintenance activities and the purchase of equipment required to supply new electricity connections of the Ceylon Electricity Board are being conducted separately according to each distribution region. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for the supply and distribution of  Aerial Bundled Conductors (ABC) 3x70+54.6+16 sqmm - 1500km to M/s Sierra Cables PLC, for a sum of Rs.872.96 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Polptitya - Hambantota 220 kV Transmission Line
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy,  to award the contract for the construction of the 220kv transmission line at a length of 150 km from Polpitiya to Hambantota, which is implemented under the Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme, to M/s China National Cable Engineering Corporation, for a sum of Rs.5,794.32 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Trincomalee Industrial Estate - Stage III
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body: - Stage I and II of the Trincomalee Industrial Estate have been initiated by now and  the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to commence its infrastructure facilities development activities to establish the stage III of the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing 250 Ambulances for use in the Government Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body: - Considering the requirement of supplying adequate number of ambulances for the Government hospitals, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to procure 250  ambulances, under several stages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining office space for the office of the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
- Due to the limited space available in the building where the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine is located, a section of the National Medicinal Regulatory Authority (NMRA), Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) Prevention Programme and Investigations, Procurement, Internal Audit and Indigenous Medicine Units, under the purview of the Ministry are located  in a building obtained on lease rental basis. The validity of the relevant lease agreement is due to expire shortly and as such, until the construction of a new building is completed, it has become necessary to further obtain office space on lease rental basis.  

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to obtain the building belonging to the Medi House (Pvt.) Ltd. with a floor space of 55,0000 sq.ft. situated at No.26, of Sri Sangharaja Mawatha in Colombo 10, on a monthly rental of Rs.9.07 million, for a period of two (02) years , as recommended by the Procurement Committee of the Ministry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Injections required for treating the patients with immune deficiency
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for purchasing  33,000 vials of Human Immunoglobulin for Intravenous use BP 5-6g vial for treating the patients with immunity deficiency, to M/s Reliance Life Science (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of US$ 3.06 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Anti-biotics required for the treatment of infections
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for purchasing 750,000  Vials of Meropenem Injection 1g Vial which is an anti-biotic used for treating severe infections, to M/s Scott Edil-Advance Research Laboratories & Education Ltd. of India, for a sum of US$ 1.08 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The construction of a Stroke Treatment Unit at the Teaching Hospital in Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body: - The Stroke is the fourth major cause for deaths in the hospitals of Sri Lanka. As such, action is being taken by the Government to establish state-of- the art treatment facilities for Stroke in all major hospitals of the Island. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the construction of a Stroke Treatment Unit at the Teaching Hospital in Jaffna to M/s Link Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.633.97 million, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting a Feasibility Study for the implementation of the Section of the Highway from Rajagiriya to Athurugiriya under the project for the construction of an Elevated  Highway from the New Kelani Bridge up to Athurugiriya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet approval has been granted to implement the construction of a Four lane Elevated Expressway project from the New Kelani Bridge to Athurugiriya  with connectivity to Battaramulla, Malabe, Athurugiriya areas and the Outer Circular Highway.  

Accordingly, taking into consideration the concurrence of Hon. Kabir Hashim, the present Minister in-charge of the subject, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the then Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract to conduct a feasibility study on the section from Rajagiriya to Athurugiriya in Phase II of the project to M/s Resource Development Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd. and M/s SMEC International Pty Ltd. for a sum of Rs.98.73 million, in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement  Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting of sponsorship for research purposes at the Museum of the University of Peradeniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Special Assignments, to grant Rs.10 million from the funds already allocated to the Ministry for the year 2018 to carry out research and exploration activities of the Museum project implemented with the objective of collecting and preserving the art pieces and creativework belonging to the history of the  University of Peradeniya  to make enable the future generation, to make use of them to coincide with the 75th anniversary of the University of Peradeniya, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Tripartite Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lankan, Indian and Japanese Entities for the establishment of a Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Terminal - Floating Storage Regasification Unit (FSRU)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
- The Government of Sri Lanka, with the collaboration of the Government of India and the Government of Japan has signed a Memorandum of Understanding for the establishment of a Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Terminal - Floating Storage Regasification Unit (FSRU) in the Kerawalapitiya area in Colombo and a Natural Gas Terminal for the distribution of infrastructure facilities for electricity power generation. In the joint venture established for the implementation of the project, it is proposed to award 15% equity of the joint venture with the State owned Sri Lanka Gas Terminal Company Ltd., to vest 47.5% equity with Petronet LNG Limited nominated by the Government of India and  to vest 37.5% of equity with Sojitz Corporation and Mitsubishi Corporation nominated by the Government of Japan. 

	Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade and Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to sign a MoU with the relevant parties with the objective of making a basic feasibility study and to vest authority with the Sri Lanka Gas Terminal Company Ltd., to enter into Agreements with the Indian and Japanese parties to establish the proposed joint venture, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Accommodation facilities, the Mess and the Car Park for the Police Inspectors in Slave Island
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
- Non‑availability of adequate accommodation, mess and vehicle parking facilities for the Police Officers in the Inspector Grade who come over or called to Colombo from various areas of the Island for special duties, has become a problem. As such, a proposal has been made to construct a 06 storeyed building in the Slave Island in Colombo, as a solution to the problem. 



Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the then Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to implement the construction activities of the said project at an estimated cost of Rs.468.27 million, during the period from 2018-2020, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Residential Building and the Administrative Building of the National Police Academy in Katana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body: - Under the improvement of the infrastructure facilities a proposal has been made to construct the residential building and the administrative building of the National Police Academy in Katana, established for the purpose of enhancing the knowledge, skills and attitudes of the Officers of the Sri Lanka Police,  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the then Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to implement the said project for the construction of the said buildings, at an estimated cost of Rs.836.28 million,  during the period from 2018-2020, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 10,000 houses for the Plantation Community under the Grant Programme of the Indian Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
- The Government of India has already granted funds to construct 4,000 houses for the Plantation Community living in the Districts of Nuwara Eliya and Badulla and out of those, the construction work of 1,136 houses are nearing completion. The construction work of the rest of the 2,836 houses has  commenced in the month of January, 2018. During the visit by the Indian Prime Minister to Sri Lanka in May, 2017, he has agreed to provide funds for the construction of 10,000 more houses for the Plantation Community. 

In order to commence the implementation of the project, the identification of suitable lands for the purpose is expected to commence in March, 2018, giving priority to the families affected in the landslide disasters. As such, the proposal made by Hon. U. Palani Digambaram, the Minister of  Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Government of India, to implement the project for the construction of 10,000 houses for the Plantation Community at a cost of Rs.10 Lakhs per house, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting of import duty concessions for the import of Squid and Wekkaya the bait for Long Line Fishing used by multiday fishermen
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body: - In the Long Line Fishing used by multiday fishermen in harvesting Tuna fish, Squid, Wekkaya, Sardinella and Black Fish are used as fishing baits. Although around 7000 metric tons of bait fish are required annually for the purpose, the local supply could provide only 3000 Metric Tons out of the total requirement.  As such, bait fish such as Squid and Wekkaya are imported and distributed among fishery associations and since these types of fish being used for human consumption, duty concessions granted on the import of normal bait fish are not granted when importing such fish. The Tuna fishing industry in Sri Lanka is adversely affected due to the exorbitant prices of the imported bait fish. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to grant a import duty concession for the types of bait fish, Squid and Wekkaya imported only for the purpose of distributing among fishery associations in accordance with the recommendation of the Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development and to take necessary measures to prevent the release of such imported bait fish for local consumption,was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The construction and the management of warehouse complexes in the Polonnaruwa, Kilinochchi and Ratnapura Districts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body: - The stores complexes constructed in the Districts of Anuradhapura, Moneragala and Mannar with the objective of storing the crop harvest of the farmers of the dry zone are operated presently, under the supervision of the District Secretaries in such Districts. In the stores complexes in the Polonnaruwa, Kilinochchi and Ratnapura where completion is nearing at present, the operational activities of the stores complexes are expected to be implemented in the year 2018 and to vest authority with the relevant District Secretaries to enter into management agreements with the Regionas Development Banks to carry out the operational activities of the stores complexes and to vest the regulation and supervision of the said activities with the relevant District Secretaries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Paddy Purchase Programme of the Government (PPPG) for 2017/2018 Maha Season
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
- After reviewing the paddy purchasing programmes implemented by the Government previously and taking into consideration the matters raised by the District Secretaries and the other relevant officers at the meetings conducted recently, attention has been drawn to implement the oncoming paddy purchasing programme more effectively.   

Accordingly, considering the proposal made by Hon. Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, and Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy in this regard, approval of the Cabinet was granted to purchase per kg of Nadu Paddy for Rs.38/-, per kg and Samba/Keeri Samba Paddy for Rs.41/- by the intervention of the Paddy Marketing Board and the relevant District Secretaries in the districts where the government intervention is needed to ensure the guaranteed purchasing price of paddy.

description: Establishment of the Regional Integrated Multi-Hazard Early Warning System (RIMES) Sub-Regional Hub in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
- A proposal has been made to establish the Sub-Regional Hub of the  Regional Integrated Multi-Hazard Early Warning System (RIMES) of the South East Asian Region in Sri Lanka, which is an international institution working for the capacity building of the member countries in generating and utilizing user-relevant science based information for early warning of risks from natural hazards. 

Considering the contribution that could be made to strengthen the  technological capability and the capacity, of the Department of Meteorology of Sri Lanka by this manoevure,  the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, to construct a two storeyed building in the premises of the Department of Meteorology to establish the said sub‑regional centre in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making a Feasibility Study and an Environmental Impact Assessment on the Construction of  Wandurapeenu Ella Reservoir
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body: - When supplying drinking water to the Kurunegala town and its suburban areas the considerable fall of the water flow of the Deduru Oya, which is the major water source,  during the dry spells has become a major obstacle. As a solution to the problem, it has been identified that a reservoir has to be constructed upstream of the Daduru Oya basin. As such, a proposal has been made to construct Wandurapeenu Ella reservoir with a 3.6 MCM capacity and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to make a feasibility study and an environmental impact assessment in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Central Expressway connectivity of roads in Kandy and its suburbs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
- Presently, the construction work of Section 1 and Section 2 of the Central Expressway from Kadawatha to Kurunegala has already commenced.  Section 3 of the Expressway from Pothuhera to Galagedara is due to be constructed and by which the Kandy Town and the other towns in the Central Province will be connected to the Expressway via Galagedara Interchange.  As a result of this, it is anticipated that traffic movement in the section of the highway from Galagedara to Kandy will be increased.  As such, it is proposed to improve the road section from Katugastota to Galagedara as a 4 lane road and to construct a new 4 lane sub‑road in the Katugastota Town.  
 

The EXIM Bank of India has consented to provide the necessary funds for the purpose.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the then Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to appoint RITES Ltd. of India to provide consultancy services to make a Comprehensive Project Report in regard to the development of the said road activities, taking into consideration the concurrence of the present Minister Hon. Kabir Hashim, in‑charge of the subject, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining exotic animals to the Department of National Zoological Gardens
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
-  The Dehiwala National Zoological Gardens is being presently modernized by adopting the provisions of proper animal welfare and therefore, it is essential to obtain animals for exhibition purposes. Obtaining animals through animal exchange programmes conducted by the different worldwide Zoological gardens and obtaining excess animals donated by Foreign Zoological gardens are the main strategies adopted for the purpose. Further, focus had been made to ascertain the possibility of purchasing animals from the parties  and institutions that import animals to Sri Lanka to raise them. 

      	Accordingly, the proposal which had been made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the then Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to authorize the Director General of National Zoological Gardens to obtain animals through animal exchange and animal donation programmes and to purchase foreign birds and domestic animals from the parties and institutions that import to Sri Lanka. by following the proper procurement procedures, until the provisions in the National Zoological Gardens Act, No.41 of 1982 pertaining to the implementation of the animal exchange programme are amended, taking into consideration the concurrence of  Hon. Ravindra Samaraweera the present Minister, in-charge of the subject  as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Effective Management of Water Resources in the face of the challenges of Climate Change
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
- Sri Lanka has an annual rainfall of more than 2,000 mm which feed nearly 103 rivers that flow into the ocean covering all areas of the country. However, due to the spatial and area changes that occur during  the periods of rainfall, 65% of the land area in the Island is known as the dry zone and this zone is subject to scarcity of water and droughts frequently.  The risk of Sri Lanka being prone to adverse effects of climatic changes have increased and it has been observed that the changes in the rainfall pattern which occur continuously within a short period of time as well, increasing the annual dry weather days during a year have also been observed. 

As a result of the adverse effects of these extreme weather conditions, severe unpredictable disaster situations like floods, landslides and drought affect the agriculture and food security of the country, irrigated water supply, supply of safe drinking water, generation of hydro electricity power and the livelihood of the people, severely.  In order to overcome these challenges, the necessity has arisen for formulating a wide and integrated management framework for the development, conservation and management of water resources. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment to establish a Presidential Task Force with the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the President inclusive of all relevant institutions, to make recommendations within three (03) months, to establish a comprehensive integrated management mechanism for the proper management of water resources, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Explosives Ordinance, No.21 of 1956
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body: - The importation of explosives and its regulation activates are carried out under the Explosives Ordinance. Considering the timely requirements, it has been proposed to amend the Ordinance. As such, focus has been made to amend the Explosives Ordinance, No.21 of 1956 incorporating the amendments for granting approval for the foreign ships or air crafts carrying either explosives or related cargo to travel across sea area or air zone of Sri Lanka, indicating the post of 'Controller of Explosives' as 'Controller General of Explosives' in the Act and incorporating better methodologies in the Act to suit the present needs. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to appoint an Officials' Committee representing the relevant institutions to seek proposals for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka's accession to the Convention on Cluster Munitions (Oslo Convention)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
- Even though some parties have made allegations that Sri Lanka had utilized cluster munitions, during the period of the armed conflict, there is no evidence at all to the effect that such cluster munitions have ever been used by the Security Forces of Sri Lanka and the stand taken up by Sri Lanka is that Sri Lanka has never used cluster munitions nor will Sri Lanka use such munitions  in future. 

	Demonstrating the dedication of the Government of Sri Lanka and its commitment  towards the non‑usage of cluster munitions, towards ataining sustainable peace and stability through Humanitarian Disarmament making emphasis on the International Community and the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to express the consent of Sri Lanka by acceding to the Convention on Cluster Munitions (Oslo Convention) which has already been ratified by 102 states, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting the authority with the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery Or Corruption (CIABOC) to file cases based on the facts revealed by the Commissions of Inquiry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-27
decision_details_body:
- The necessity has arisen to provide legal provisions to enable to vest the authority with the Director General of the CIABOC for instituting cases under the Bribery Act or the Assets and Liabilities Law, based on the facts revealed by such Commissions of Inquiry established under the Commissions of Inquiry Act, No.17 of 1948. 

	The Legal Draftsman has drafted the relevant amendments for the purpose, to amend the Commissions of Inquiry Act, No.17 of 1948. The Attorney General has advised that the said draft would have to be passed by a special majority of not less than two thirds of Parliament. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to publish the Commissions of Inquiry (Amendment) Bill in the Government Gazette and to present the same subsequently, in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing of funds from the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) for the implementation of the Sri Lanka Emergency Solid Waste Management Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body:
- 	The Sri Lanka Emergency Solid Waste Management Project has been planned, with the objective of providing sustainable solutions to the problem of solid waste disposal and the construction of a solid waste disposal facility at the Aruwakkalu area in Puttalam. The estimated cost of the said project implemented by the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development and the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government is US$ 274 million. 

Out of the cost, a sum of US$ 115 million, is to be obtained from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development of the World Bank and the Asian Infrastructure Development Bank has also agreed to provide US$ 115 million.  The balance of US$ 44 million will be borne by the Government of Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct loan negotiations with the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank to obtain the loan amount of US$ 115 million agreed to be provided by the said Bank was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting Lease Concessions for the lands alienated on Long Term Lease for Agricultural Purposes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body:
- Under the  State Land Ordinance, No.8 of 1947, lease concessions have been granted when alienating lands on lease basis for the purpose of constructing houses and for commercial activities. However, since the general procedure for the alienation of lands on commercial basis is not followed, in respect of the alienation of state lands for agricultural purposes on commercial basis under the said Ordinance, the release of state lands has been limited for the large scale agricultural development activities.   

Accordingly, targeting the development goals in the agriculture sector of the country, the proposal made by Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms, to grant the following lease concessions in alienating lands for agricultural purposes on long term lease basis under the State Land Ordinance, in future, was approved by the Cabinet:

(i)	Refrain from changing a once and for all premium equal to thrice of the annual lease which is so recovered;

(ii)	Revision of the lease rental by the addition of an amount of 20% to the lease rental which was applicable to the year previous to the year in which the revision is to be made effective, instead of the revision of the lease rental by a 50%  increase once in every 05 years;  and

(iii)	The addition of 20% to the lease rental recovered at the end of the initial lease period to be treated as the commencement value in the second lease period, when extending the lease period subsequent to the expiry of the initial lease period.

description: Awarding of the relevant contracts for the Development of the infrastructure facilities at the Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20

description: Supply of the Firefighting Vehicles / Equipment for the Colombo Municipal Council
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body: - It is essential to strengthen the Fire Service Department in the Colombo Municipal Council in ensuring the protection of the lives and property of the residents especially in multy storied buildings, concurrent to the development activities carried out in the city of Colombo and the suburbs. Accordingly, it has been proposed to supply new fire fighting vehicles and equipment to the fleet of fire fighting vehicle pool of the Department which is maintained at an exorbitant cost. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to award the contract to M/s Rosenbauer International AG in Austria for a sum of Euro 10.3 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Grid Sub-station under the  Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Program
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to develop the Pannala Grid Sub-station, to purchase two (02) power transformers, for the  Pannipitiya and Veyangoda Grid Sub‑stations, to purchase five 36 KV GIS Adopter Panels for the Kalutara, Kesbewa, Old Anuradhapura, Kappalturai and Kerawalapitiya Grid Sub‑stations, by utilizing the balance funds available in the 'Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme' implemented under the Asian Development Bank loan aid, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing facilities for the disposal of waste water in the premises of the Colombo Port City
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body:
- The responsibility of ensuring the utility infrastructure facilities required for the Colombo Port City which is presently in progress, is entrusted to the Government of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, it has been planned to lay a 900 mm diameter waste water force main from the Colombo Port City to the Madampitiya pump station to a total length of 5.50 km. Since  a limited space is available in the section that crosses the Maccalum canal (Beirra Outfall) where the proposed waste water pipelines have to be laid, it has been planned to lay a common pipe line  in place of the 02 waste water pipe lines found there.   

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the piling work to M/s ELS Construction (Pvt.) Ltd., already mobilized in the same location for the Ceylon Electricity Board Micro Piling, for a sum of Rs.48 million, was approved by the Cabinet in principle.

description: Awarding of the contract for the construction of the Central Expressway Section 3
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body: - The Bank of Tokyo Mitsubishi, Japan has agreed to grant a credit facility of Japanese Yen 100 billion for the construction of the road section in extent of 32.5 km from Pothuhera to Galagedara via Rambukkana which is the Section 3 of the Central Expressway. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to award the construction contract to M/s Taisei Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Stabilizing the coastline from Mount Lavinia to Angulana under the Colombo South Sand Nourishment Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to implement a project for stabilizing  the coastline by way of the Sand Engine Methodology in the coastline from Colpetty to Mount Lavinia, covering the coastlines of Mount Lavinia, Dehiwala, Ratmalana Wedikanda and Moratuwa which have been identified as places subjected to sea erosion in the West coastline. 

	It has been planned to stabilize the coastline from Mount Lavinia to Angulana about 5.5 km in length through sand nourishment, utilizing the provision of Rs.800 million allocated by the Budget 2018 for the Southern Colombo Sand Nourishment Project implemented for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to select a suitable contractor for the implementation of the Project under the International Competitive Bidding Procedure, was approved by the Cabinet in principle.

description: Amending the Voluntary Social Service Organizations (Registration and Supervision) Act, No.31 of 1980
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body:
- Taking into consideration the timely requirements, it has been proposed to amend the Voluntary Social Service Organizations (Registration and Supervision) Act, No.31 of 1980. Accordingly, the Voluntary Social Service Organizations (Registration and Supervision) Amendment Bill has been prepared, taking into consideration the recommendations made by the Parliamentary Select Committee which studied the operation of the Non‑Governmental Organizations and its impact as well as the views of the relevant stakeholders including the Financial Intelligence Unit of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka. 

	The objectives of making the proposed amendment are to provide for the registration of all the Non‑Governmental Organizations, to establish the National Secretariat for Non‑Governmental Organizations as a Statutory Body which is the authorized institution for the regulation and supervision of the Non‑Governmental Organizations, to promote the mutual co‑operation between the State and Non‑Governmental Organizations, to recognize the Non‑Governmental Organizations in the effort to fulfill the common development requirements of the country, to strengthen and empower the civil society, to facilitate the effective operation of the Non‑Governmental Organizations and to ensure the transparency and accountability on its Finance, Policies and Management. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mano Ganesan, the Minister of National Co‑existence, Dialogue and Official Languages, to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and to present same thereafter in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the South Asian Regional Intelligence and the Coordination Centre on Organized Crimes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to establish the South Asian Regional Intelligence and the Coordination Centre (SARICC) in Sri Lanka to coordinate and to exchange intelligence information among the countries in the region, with a view to eliminating organized crimes and the drug menace in the South Asian Region. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to establish the said centre in Sri Lanka and to accommodate it  temporarily in the premises of the National Dangerous Drugs Control Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Secretariat Building Complex for the Offices of the Parliament, Offices of the National Commissions and the Office of the Cabinet of Ministers and any compatible Government Offices
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to construct a Secretariat on a land in close proximity to the Japan - Sri Lanka friendship road for offices related to  Parliamentary Affairs, the offices of the National Constitutional Commissions established under the Constitution, the office of the Cabinet of Ministers and any other compatible Government Offices. The construction of the proposed Secretariat will have a built up office floor area of 35,000 m2, 15,000 m2 for common spaces, adequate vehicle parking slots with other infrastructure facilities and it is planned to be constructed within a period of three (03) years. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to carry out the activities relevant to the project, was approved by the Cabinet in principle.

description: Implementation of the Sustainable Urban Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body:
- Under the Strategic Cities Development Programme implemented by the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development, 13 cities namely Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, Trincomalee, Batticaloa, Badulla, Ratnapura, Matara, Kurunegala, Nuwara Eliya and Dambulla have been identified to be developed  as Strategic cities. The sustainable urban development project implemented under the said Strategic Cities development programme, the urban city centres out side Colombo with high growth potential in economic corridors  spread across the country will be developed. 

	In this respect, through the development of basic service improvements, focus will be made on minimizing the gaps existing in large scale infrastructure facilities, enhancing mobility and connectivity between the urban centres, improvement of urban facilities, heritage conservation, improvement of sanitation activities related to environmental conservation and livelihood improvements in the towns. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement the proposed Sustainable Urban Development Project and to secure the funds necessary for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Middle Income Housing Loan Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body:
- The Budget of 2018 has proposed to provide loan facilities at a subsidized rate of interest to the middle income earning community who purchase a house for the first time from the National Housing Development Projects implemented by the National Housing Authority and the Urban Development Authority.  

Accordingly, it is planned to grant loan facilities with a maximum period of re‑payment for 25 years up to Rs.5 million through the National Savings Bank.  In this respect, it is proposed to release the loans under a subsidy interest rate of 7 % for the first 5 years. The 5% balance interest to be levied to the bank will be born by the Government.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to enter into the relevant agreements with the National Savings Bank, to implement the said loan scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promotion in the Cooperation on Scientific and Research Studies between Sri Lanka and Germany
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the National Science Foundation of Sri Lanka and the German Academic Exchange Service for exchanging German Scientists to further promote Cooperation on Scientific and Research Studies between Sri Lanka and Germany, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting  an allowance of Rs.50,000/- for the owners of the houses who were evacuated due to the landslide that occurred at the Meethotamulla Solid Waste Dump
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body:
- The Government has already taken appropriate measures to grant rental allowances to the families, whose houses were damaged or evacuated from the risk areas due to the landslide at the Meethotamulla solid waste dump, until such time that they were provided with alternative houses or compensation for their houses. Accordingly, the Cabinet has granted approval to take over the lands which were situated within the risk zone where the houses were located and the houses damaged due to such landslides and the Government to pay compensation for the private lands situated in the landslide area.  

It has been observed that the rental allowance need to be further granted to persons affected by the landslide and who have not accepted the alternative houses or in respect of private landowners within the risk zone and the owners of such houses have not been paid the valuation compensation as yet, in respect of houses until the valuation process of such lands is completed. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, to continue to pay the monthly rental of Rs.50,000/- each further for  the 60 families so identified, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Draft Bill on Carriage By Air
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body:
- The objective of 'the Convention on the Unification of certain Rules for International Carriage By Air' is to grant the unification and  predictability required for the rules pertaining to international carriage of passengers, luggage and cargo by air. Sri Lanka is a party to the Convention which has been entered into in Montreal in the year 1988. 

A draft Bill has been submitted to the Cabinet in a previous occasion for giving effect to the said Convention in Sri Lanka and the Cabinet had referred the matter to the Cabinet Sub‑Committee on Constitutional Affairs. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to publish the draft Bill on Carriage By Air formulated by the Legal Draftsman incorporating the recommendations of the said Sub‑Committee in the Government Gazette and thereafter to present same in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing the funds required for the General Education Modernization (GEM) Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body:
- Even though there is a considerable progress in the field of education in Sri Lanka in the recent decade, in terms of learning outcomes in key subjects, the country shows regional variations. It has also been identified that further attention is required in better orienting the General Education System  to enhance the socio‑emotional skills such as problem solving and reaching targets, regulation, confidence, teamwork and improving ethics and productivity that are important for students to become good and productive citizens in the modern global economy. 
 
	As such, it has been planned to implement a new project named 'General Education Modernization Project' to further strengthen the education sector based on the experiences and knowledge gained from 'Transforming School Education Centered on the Foundation of a Knowledge Hub Project'  and with the educational system of the developed countries.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct loan negotiations for securing funds for a sum of US$ 100 million from the International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank and to enter into the relevant loan agreements for the implementation of the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Rural Bridges
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body:
- The Government has planned to construct 4,000 bridges with the objective of increasing access to markets, education and health facilities through the building of transport connectivity for the people living in the far away remote villages.  It has been identified that the Direct Lending Facility of the United Kingdom is a favourable source of loan to secure funds for this project.  

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to vest authority with the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government to call for proposals from the construction institutions of the United Kingdom for the implementation of a Rural Bridge Project at a cost of  Pounds (UK) 50 million and to vest authority with the relevant Technical Evaluation Committee and the Procurement Committee to evaluate the bids and the proposals submitted thereby and make recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Augmentation of the Water Pipelines along with the Orugodawatta - Ambatale Road Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body:
- The activities pertaining to the widening of the Orugodawatta - Ambatale Road have commenced presently. Since the main water transmission line to the Colombo City which is more than hundred years old is also laid along the said Road, the re‑laying of the water pipe line network also has to be commenced  to coincide with the said Road Development Work.  

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into loan agreements with the UniCredit Bank Austria AG and the People's Bank as per the approval granted by the Cabinet, with the objective of securing the funds necessary to implement the water pipe laying project expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Ape Suwaya - Rate Saviya' (Our Health is the Country's Strength) National Health Promotion Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-20
decision_details_body: - 	It has been proposed to implement a National Programme called 'Ape Suwaya - Rate Saviya' (Our Health is the Country's Strength), with a view to relieving the people of Sri Lanka from the unfortunate situation they have fallen into due to the prevailing non‑communicable diseases and making them healthy and thereby creating a country with a strong economy through the commencement of community health development programmes, at rural level, for the prevention of communicable diseases.  As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to implement this programme by the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine in collaboration with the relevant Ministries and other Institutions under the purview of a special operational unit to be setup in the Presidential Secretariat  and to commence same as a pilot project in the Districts of Polonnaruwa, Kalutara, Moneragala, Badulla, Batticaloa and Kilinochchi  effective from the month of February of this year, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prevention of the current misuse of Kerosene
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- Since most of the low income communities in Sri Lanka use kerosene for the requirements such as lighting houses etc, the Government provides a large subsidy in respect of the same. The consumption of kerosene by the rural community has declined since electricity is provided for the rural areas to a great extent. Nevertheless, the consumption of local kerosene during the past couple of months has greatly increased and it is found that the instant increase in consumption of kerosene has been caused due to modifying engines and mixing kerosene with petrol illegally by some parties to enable to drive long distance buses and lorries by using kerosene instead of diesel for the reason of the concessionary price of kerosene. It has also come to light that the mixing takes place through hired bowsers while transporting of fuel from the depots to the respective dealer filling stations. 

	Taking into consideration the necessity of taking expeditious action to prevent this situation, the joint proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena and Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Petroleum Resources Development, to take necessary action to revoke the dealership of the fuel filling stations who are engaged in illegally mixing of fuel or in other illegal activities relating to kerosene or assisting in such activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing the Assistance of the United States Programme of the Peace Corps for the improvement of the English Language Education in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- The Programme of the Peace Corps of the United States of America was operative in Sri Lanka from time to time from the year 1962 and especially, during the Tsunami disaster which occurred in 2004, it provided significant assistance for the relief activities and as well as for rebuilding efforts. The programme is not operative in Sri Lanka after the year 2006. The  United States has decided to re-establish the programme for teaching of English based on a request made by the Government of Sri Lanka. 

	As such, the  assistance of the programme will be provided for the capacity building of the English language teachers of Sri Lanka and action will be taken  to place the volunteers in the Secondary Schools, Regional English Support Centres and in the Vocational Training Centres. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs,  to enter into an Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of the United States of America in regard to the re-establishment of the Programme of the Peace Corps in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing of funds for the implementation of the Sri Lanka Emergency Solid Waste Management Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- The Sri Lanka Emergency Solid Waste Management Project has been designed with a view to providing sustainable solutions to the problem with regard to the disposal of solid waste. This project also includes the construction of a waste disposal yard at Aluwkkaru area in Puttalam, for the disposal of waste generated within the Metro Colombo Region, expanding the existing composting facility at Muturajawela and the stabilization and development of the existing open dump sites not in use at present.  

	The total estimated cost of this project implemented by the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development and the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government is US$ 274 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct loan negotiations with the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) of the World Bank in regard to obtaining a sum of US$ 115 million out of the cost estimate, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading of the Railway track from Maho to Omanthai
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
