decision_details_body:
- Cabinet approval has been granted for the rehabilitation of the section of the  railway track from Maho to Omanthai under the Indian Line of Credit. The pre-qualification process to identify the engineering, procurement and construction contractors for the project has commenced and bid documents have been issued to 03 selected companies which have fulfilled the pre-qualifications, taking into consideration the observations of the EXIM Bank of India. 




	Accordingly, the Cabinet noted, the information submitted by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to the effect that the road development activities of the Maho - Anuradhapura section and Anuradhapura - Vavunia section have been planned separately in order to  complete the activities expeditiously.

description: Purchase of 75,000 pairs of Boots (High Leg) required for the Sri Lanka Army
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to award the contract for the purchase of 75,000 pairs of Boots (High Leg Black) for the members of the Sri Lanka Army, to M/s Irosha International (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.232 million, as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The construction of a Stroke Treatment Unit at the District General Hospital in Ampara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body: - 'Stroke' is a leading cause of adult disabilities. Therefore, it has been decided to construct a Stroke Treatment Unit at the Ampara District General Hospital for the improvement of treatment facilities needed for stroke patients.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the construction of the Treatment Unit to M/s Link Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.213.9 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the infrastructure facilities in the Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- Budgetary provision has been set apart from the year 2018, to improve the infrastructure facilities in the Universities to suit the academic courses of the students creating space for their educational activities who enter the Universities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to implement the following infrastructure development projects utilizing the allocated provision, was approved in principle by the Cabinet. 

*	Construction of 02, three storey buildings for the Library and the Information Technology Centre of the Vavunia Campus of the University of Jaffna. 

*	Construction of a three storey building for the Lecture Hall of the Faculty of Technology of the University of  Ruhuna.

*	Construction of Quarters for the staff of the Bhiksu University of Sri Lanka in Anuradhapura.

*	Construction of a four storey building for the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies of the University of Kelaniya.

description: Procurement of 12 Railway Locomotives for operation in the Upcountry Railway Line
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the procurement of 12 railway locomotives for the Department of Sri Lanka Railways for operation in the up country railway line to M/s General Electric Company of USA, for a sum of US$ 4.056 million each, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of Principal Ordinances and Acts related to the Local Authorities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- The necessity to amend the three principal Ordinances and Acts being the  Municipal Councils Ordinance, Urban Councils Ordinance and the Pradeshiya Sabha Act relating to the Local Authorities to suit the timely requirements has been identified. As such, the Hon. Minister of  Provincial Councils and Local Government, has appointed a Committee headed by a President's Counsel to propose the amendments necessary, considering the matters emphasized by the Local Authorities, Provincial Councils, Political Parties and the Civil Society Organizations from time to time and the recommendations of the Commission on Local Government Reforms published in the Parliament Session Report No.1 of 1999. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare legislation to amend the related legislation inclusive of the proposed amendments in order to ensure a more People Friendly Democratic Governance within the Local Authorities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Development Programme in the Moneragala District to coincide with the 200th Anniversary of the Uva Wellassa freedom struggle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- When the British conquered  Sri Lanka completely in the year 1815, the people of Uva Wellassa launched a struggle in the year 1818 against the suppression and it was the first freedom struggle against the British. In order to suppress the struggle, the Britishers severely destroyed the properties such as lakes and anicuts, lands and paddy fields, temples and religious places and the human lives around the area resulting in a severe socio-economic deterioration.  

	At present, the District which indicates the minimum development is  the Moneragala District which includes the areas which were subject to the suppression.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration and Management, to implement a programme in the Moneragala District, aimed at renovation of  the reservoirs and anicuts, the development of roads and infrastructure facilities, renovation of religious places, improvement of agricultural farms and cottage industries  to coincide with the commemoration in the year 2018 which marks the completion of 200 years from the freedom struggle of 1818, was approved by the Cabinet. It was further decided by the Cabinet that priority be given to implement the above programmes by utilizing the provisions already allocated under the Budget 2018 to the relevant Line Ministries.

description: Enhancing the pension allowance granted by the National Film Corporation Trust for the Film Artists and Technicians
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- A programme for granting a monthly pension allowance for the Film Artists and Technicians who have completed 60 years of age has been established by an Act, of Parliament  No.3 of 1986 and it is being implemented by the 'National Film Corporation Trust' since the year 1987. Under this programme 57 Film Artist and Technician pensioneers are presently granted a monthly allowance of Rs.2,000/- each and a further 106 eligible applicants are there in anticipation of the allowance. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration and Management, to enhance this monthly pension allowance up to Rs.5,000/- considering the present situation and to seek a Treasury grant of Rs.10 million for the National Film Corporation Trust to enable the Trust to pay the said allowance for 163 Film Artist and Technician pensioners, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a pilot project for the issuance of Electronic Phytosanitary Certificates
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- The issuance of Phytosanitary Certificates which is an essential certificate for ensuring the quality of plants and plant materials exported by Sri Lanka, by the    Plant Quarantine Unit of the Department of Agriculture of Sri Lanka is carried out in the print form. The International Plant Protection Convention of the United Nations has emphasized the necessity of issuing the Electronic Phytosanitary Certificates as a safe and efficient methodology of exchanging documents among countries. Accordingly, Sri Lanka has been selected for the pilot project to be implemented in the Asia Pacific Region to experiment on the programme of issuing Electronic Phytosanitary Certificates. In view of this programme, new commercial and marketing opportunities will be created for Sri Lanka with the enhancement of the efficiency and security of the exchange of plants and plant material at international level. 

	The Agriculture and Water Resources Department of Australia under the guidance of the International Plant Protection Convention of the United Nations will provide the sponsorship for the implementation of this pilot project. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, and to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Department of Agriculture of Sri Lanka and the Department of Agriculture and Water Resources of Australia to implement the pilot project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting of an alternative land for the plot of land to be obtained by the Ceylon Electricity Board for the expansion of the Panadura Divisional Secretariat
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- Since the existing office space of the Panadura Divisional Secretariat is inadequate, an Agreement has been reached to obtain the adjoining land in extent of 80 perches owned by the Ceylon Electricity Board, for the purpose of making the District Secretariat most spacious and to give an alternative plot of land to the Ceylon Electricity Board in lieu of same. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to allocate a land in extent of 120 perches at the Modarawila Industrial Zone belonging to the Urban Development Authority (UDA) to be granted as an alternative land for the CEB and to vest a land in extent of 124 perches located at Pattiya North, Panadura, with the Urban Development Authority instead, as a free grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the concessionary loan schemes under the 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' Programme proposed in the Budget 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- The 'Enterprise Sri Lanka' Programme was proposed in the Budget 2018 with the objective of upgrading the Per Capita income up to  US$ 5,000, creation of 1 million new employment opportunities, doubling of the value of exports and sustaining an economic growth of over 5% to reach the Government's midterm development goals by the year 2020. Under this, it is scheduled to provide 15 loan schemes inclusive of financial and non‑financial facilities aimed at small scale and medium scale to entrepreneurs, youth and women entrepreneurs and the self employed identified as the driving force of the economic development. For this purpose, a sum of Rs.20,230 million has been set apart for the year 2018.  

	Under the concessionary loan scheme 'Green Loan' proposed in the Budget 2018, financial facilities are due to be provided to induce local entrepreneurs to manufacture packing material by using the biodegradable raw material instead of using polythene, small scale hotel owners who provide services to tourists and the house owners registered in the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority under the 'Homestay' programme.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to implement the said loan scheme through the public and private banks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a new Indigenous Medical Council Bill to regularize the functions of the Ayurveda Medical Council
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- The ancient Ayurveda system of medicine which is older than 3,000 years, performs a significant role in the medical sector in Sri Lanka operating along side the traditional system of medicine in the country and concurrently the  Siddha system of medicine as well as the Unani System of medicine also is operating in the system of Indigenous Medicine. The Ayurveda Medical Council established under the Ayurveda Act, No.31 of 1961 is presently engaged in the registration of Ayurvedic doctors serving in the Ayurveda Medical System, regulating them and dealing with their  ethical aspects. Presently, the Ayurveda Mediccal System, by now is popular among Sri Lankans as well as foreigners, and therefore, it has been found that it is appropriate to expand the functions of the Ayurveda Medical Council as suited to the current requirements. 

Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to present a new Indigenous Medical Council Act, for the betterment of the system of Indigenous Medicine by segregating the Ayurveda Medical Council from the Ayurveda Act, No.31 of 1961 and to regulate the functions of the Ayurveda Medical Council, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Collaborative Research Agreement with the International Agency for Research on Cancer
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- The crude incidence rate of cancer patients in Sri Lanka in the year 1985 shows 31.6 for per population of 100,000 and it has risen up to 82.1 for per population of 100,000 by the year 2010. When taking measures for controlling cancer, the proper maintenance of population based cancer registers on all types of cancers is highly important. In Sri Lanka, a cancer register at the national level is maintained since 1985 and a population based cancer register has also been established for the Colombo district since 2012. 

The International Agency for Research on Cancer has recommended that, the cancer registers in Sri Lanka can be further expanded, based on the population. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to enter into a Collaborative Research Agreement between the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine and the International Agency for Research on Cancer, with a view to obtaining the required technical assistance for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979 pertaining to the increase of the minimum age of Criminal Responsibility
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- In terms of the law prevailing in Sri Lanka, a child below the age of 08 years is not vested with the criminal responsibility. Yet, in the opinion of the psychiatrists and the experts in the relevant fields, this age limit is  comparatively a tender age. As such, approval of the Cabinet has been granted to amend the Penal Code to increase this age limit up to 12 years and in case of  a child above 12 years but below 14 years, to confer the discretion to the Magistrate to determine in a case where a child is accused of a crime whether such child has attained sufficient maturity to understand the gravity of the offence with which he has been charged. 

As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice, to publish the Bill formulated to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979 providing provision in such circumstances to direct such a child to be examined by a Government Medical Officer, to enable a Magistrate to obtain expert guidance to assist in forming the relevant opinion on a scientific basis, in the Government Gazette and subsequently, to present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Office of the 'Delegation of German Industry and Commerce' in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- The policy of the Government is to obtain the maximum economic benefits through the integration into the global economy and therefore, a key strategy under the said policy is the establishment of effective partnerships in countries with advanced economies. As such, it has been proposed to establish an office of the 'Delegation of German Industry and Commerce' in Colombo with a view to promoting co-operation and partnership among the trading companies, organizations and persons engaged in the commercial field in Germany as well as in Sri Lanka. 

	By the establishment of such an office in Sri Lanka, it would create greater assistance for facilitating the promotion of commercial activities between the two countries covering specially, the small and medium size industries, thereby opening up new opportunities for the investors of both countries. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to provide facilities for the establishment of an office of the Delegation of German Industry and Commerce in Colombo, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishing a Regional Consular Office in Polonnaruwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- More than 600 persons are travelling daily from various districts of the country, to visit the Colombo Office of the Consular Division of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to obtain the services rendered by the said Consular Division. Action is being taken to establish Regional Consular Offices to enable the general public to obtain these services easily.  Accordingly, action has already been taken to establish a Regional Consular Office in Jaffna for the general public of the Northern Province and presently, appropriate action has been initiated to open such  a Regional Consular Office in Matara as well. 

It has been proposed to set up a Regional Consular Office in Polonnaruwa as well, with a view to providing such services easily to the public living in the Districts of Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, Trincomalee, Batticaloa, Kurunegala, Ampara and Matale. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to establish the said Regional Consular Office in a building located close to the Divisional Secretariat, Thamankaduwa of Polonnaruwa, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Master Plan for the Development of the Ratmalana Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- The Ratmalana Airport, being the first international airport in Sri Lanka  was operating as the major international airport up to the year 1969. The airport which has been located very close to the major commercial city in Colombo, with easy access to all the main roads, presently operates around 70 domestic aircraft movements per day, the airport serves domestic aviation needs including commercial passenger flights, Aviation Training, International Commercial Aircrafts and the arrangement of VIP and VVIP movements,   humanitarian missions during national crisis situations and conducts the Sri Lanka Air Force (SLAF) operational activities, as well. The number of flight operations conducted are rapidly increasing and to suit the situation, considering the Colombo centered development projects, the existing capacity of the airport is required to be improved.  

As such, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to implement the Master Development Plan of the  'Way to 2030' incorporating the strategic plans to be implemented from 2018 to 2030, prepared for the improvement of the Ratmalana Airport as an Airport providing efficient domestic and international flight services, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Co-operation in the field of Tourism between Sri Lanka and Estonia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. John Amaratunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Communications of the  Republic of Estonia  on co-operation in the field of Tourism, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing of Funds for the implementation of the Greater Ratnapura Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- Under the Greater Ratnapura Water Supply Project, it is anticipated to provide around 3,500 new pipe born water connections covering 29 Grama Niladhari Divisions. The contract for installing the other accessories required for the distribution system, the DI Valves and the supply and laying of pipes has by now been awarded in accordance with the Cabinet approval and the Bank of Ceylon has agreed to grant a loan of Rs.1,528.9 million to secure the required funds to cover its cost. 


Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to vest the authority with the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWS&DB) to enter into an Agreement with the Bank of Ceylon to obtain the loan facility, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing of Funds for the implementation of the Hasalaka Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body:
- The Hasalaka Water Supply Project has been designed to address the drinking water issue in the Hasalaka area and plans are underway to provide clean water for about 49,370 people covering 33 Grama Niladhari Divisions. Presently, the contract for the implementation of the project has been awarded in accordance with the approval of the Cabinet and the People's Bank has agreed to grant a loan of Rs.6,235 million to secure the required funds to cover its cost.  

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to vest the authority with the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWS&DB) to enter into an Agreement with the People's Bank to obtain the loan facility, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the National Defence Fund Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-02-14
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approval has been granted to amend the National Defence Fund Act, No.9 of 1985 by which the National Defence Fund has been established with a view to further expanding the services rendered by such fund for the  welfare of the families of the War-heroes who have died or become disabled, and streamlining its administrative functions. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to publish the amended Bill so formulated in the Government Gazette and subsequently, to present it in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Special High Court to inquire into cases pertaining to allegations of bribery and corruption and extremely complex financial crimes, expeditiously
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body:
-	Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to amend the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978 for the purpose of establishing a dedicated three Bench High Court to inquire into cases expeditiously pertaining to allegations of bribery and corruption and extremely complex financial crimes. Accordingly, in terms of the Draft Bill prepared, the Attorney General or the Director General of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) will file indictment in respect of the specified offences therein, in the proposed three Bench High Court. The particulars such as the nature of the relevant offences, the gravity, the complexity, the effect on the State or the victims, the national interest etc., incidental thereto, as the case may be, will be taken in to consideration subject to a formal methodology. 

The Cabinet noted the matters submitted by Hon. Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice, to publish the Draft Bill prepared to amend the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978, providing for the establishment of the three Bench High Court, in the Government Gazette and subsequently, to present it in Parliament, for approval.

description: Granting of further relief to the farmers affected by the drought
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body:
-	It has been identified that 291,945 farmer families have been affected by the drought caused by the dry climatic condition which prevailed in the country recently. An Officials' Committee comprising of the Secretaries to the Ministries of Finance and Mass Media; Disaster Management; Home Affairs; and Agriculture has been appointed by the Cabinet to submit proposals for providing further relief in addition to the relief already provided for by the Government to those farmer families.  

As such, the  joint proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, and Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to extend the monthly dry ration provided to the farmer families who have not cultivated continuously during 03 seasons namely Maha Season of 2016/17, Yala Season of 2017 and Maha Season of 2017/18 due to the drought situation, further for the period from January 2018 to April 2018 as well, as recommended by the Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of legislation for the Demutualization of the Colombo Stock Exchange
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body:
-	The Colombo Stock Exchange  has been established in the year 1985 as a non for profit 'company limited by guarantee' and it is the only major Stock Exchange operated in South Asia as a 'Shareholder Owned Company'. Demutualization is the process through which, exchanges operating as 'not for profit' member controlled organizations are converted into 'for profit' shareholder owned companies.  

It is essential that, the Colombo Stock Exchange is established as a  Demutualized Stock Exchange, to ensure proper management and to promote the ownership of diversified shares. As such, Cabinet approval has been granted to convert the Colombo Stock Exchange into a Demutualized Stock Exchange limited by shares and to make the legislative amendments necessary for the purpose. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to publish the Draft Bill prepared for 'the Demutualization of the Colombo Stock Exchange', in the Gazette and subsequently, to present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Additional Loan Assistance from the Asian Development Bank for the implementation of the Skills Sector Enhancement Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body: -	'The Skills Sector Development Programme', which has been planned by the Government within the period from 2014 to 2020, with a view to creating an efficient Skills Development Methodology to meet the labour market demand, is implemented under the Loan Assistance obtained from the Asian Development Bank, for the purpose of assisting the 'Skills Sector Development Programme'. Through this programme, it is anticipated to achieve the goals such as improved quality of Provision of Tertiary Vocational Education and Training, (TVET), enhanced industry partnership for TVET, policy and the implementation of Institutional and Operational Reforms. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct negotiations to obtain US$ 100 million from the Asian Development Bank and to enter into the relevant loan agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Bribery Act to eliminate Bribery and Corruption
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body:
-	The approval of the Cabinet has been granted to amend to the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption Act and the Laws incidental thereto, having identified the necessity of the amendments required to be made to suit the present requirements, for the elimination of bribery and corruption prevalent in Sri Lanka. Presently, action is also being taken to amend the Judicature Act to establish a three Member Bench High Court to expedite the conducting of financial crimes and corruption trials. 

Concurrently, section 70 of the Bribery Act, No.11 of 1954 has also to be amended to enable the corruption charges apart from bribery charges to be conducted not only by the Magistrate's Court but also by the High Court.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena to publish the Draft Bill prepared for the purpose in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an Officer Quarters Complex at Kalapaluwawa for Officers of the Special Task Force
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body: -	Approval of the Cabinet has been granted for the construction of an Officer Quarters Complex, at Kalapaluwawa  for married officers of Special Task Force in the ranks of  Police Constable, Police Sergeant, Sub Inspector of Police and Inspector of Police. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to award the said contract to M/s Construction Managers and Planners (Pvt) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.289.59 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the construction of a Stroke Treatment Unit at the Teaching Hospital in Kurunegala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body:
-	Stroke is a leading cause of adult disabilities and it has become the 4th leading cause of deaths in the hospital system in Sri Lanka. Except for the rehabilitation hospital in Ragama a properly developed stroke unit is not available in any hospital, in the country, at present.  As such, the approval of the Cabinet has been granted for the construction of a stroke unit at the teaching hospital in Kurunegala. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the construction of the stroke unit to M/s Link Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.230.57 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Selecting a Contractor for the expansion of the Nanotechnology and Science Park at Mahenwatte, Pitipana in Homagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body: -	The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to award the contract for the expansion of the Nanotechnology and Science Park at Mahenwatte, Pitipana in Homagama under Phase 1B, to M/s Access Engineering PLC, for a sum of Rs.3,088 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an additional lane each at the Entry and Exit Ramps at the Ja-Ela Interchange on Colombo - Katunayake Expressway
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body:
-	There are two lanes for the Entry and Exit ramps for vehicles at the Ja-Ela Interchange on Colombo - Katunayake Expressway. At the outset, the Manual Toll Collection (MTC) took place in all these lanes and subsequent to the introduction of the Electronic Toll Collection (ETC) separate lanes were allocated for the purpose. Since most of the daily users of the expressway are still not attracted to the ETC method, the number of vehicles moving on the MTC lane has increased. 




	Also, the number of vehicles which use the Ja-Ela Interchange has gone up unprecedentedly, due to the rapid development of the residential areas in Ja-Ela and associated areas as well and this has caused a huge traffic congestion in the MTC lane at the Interchange at peak hours. 

	As such, taking into account the long term advantages in the ETC method, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to further maintain the lane set apart and to construct an additional MTC lane each in the entry and exit ramp at the Ja-Ela Interchange as a remedial measure for the above said traffic congestion, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Consultancy Services for the Construction Supervision of the Western Province Road Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body: -	The Western Province Road Development Project is implemented with the funds provided by the OPEC Fund for International Development (OFID). Under this project, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for the provision of consultancy services for the supervision of the construction in the roads namely, Kaduwela-Athurugiriya, Walgama-Athurugiriya, Wadduwa-  Moronthuduwa, Bellana-Moragala,  to M/s Green Tech Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.150.75 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and Turkmenistan  on Bilateral Consultations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body: -	The proposal made by Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Turkmenistan on Bilateral Consultations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Disposal of Documents pertaining to Vehicles that are not in use
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body:
-	With the increase of the per capita income of the country during the past decade, the annual import of vehicles have also increased gradually. The information related to the tabulated increase in several types of vehicles registered in the Department of Motor Traffic during the period from the year 2008 up to the month of October in 2017 is given below.
