Consequent to the annual increase of the number of registered motor vehicles, the number of vehicle files in the Department of Motor Traffic also have been increased.  A four storey building is being constructed presently, for storing these files, but the maximum number of documents that can also be stored in the record room under construction is estimated to be around 3.5 million. 

	As such, a proposal has been made to provide accommodation to store new files by the formal disposal of all files pertaining to the vehicles presently not in use. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to dispose of the files of vehicles systematically, for which no revenue licenses have been obtained continuously during the last five years, treating them as vehicles not in use, under the supervision of a group of officials of the Department of Motor Traffic, was approved by the Cabinet.  It was also decided that the files relevant to vehicles where the legal proceedings have not been completed as yet, should not be disposed under this programme.

description: Establishment of the Secretariat for the Operations at Sea on Piracy off the Coast of Somalia (CGPCS)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body:
-	In the Indian Ocean zone close to Somalia, a series of incidents of hijacking of commercial ships were reported since the year 2005 and  the year 2010 was the peak year where the most number of such incidents were reported. This made a severe effect on the free passage of maritime trade and the global economy. The responses made by deploying of armed guards on board the commercial vessels and deploying navies in the seas close to Somalia have, by now, resulted, in the reduction of incidents of piracy. However,  as a deterrent measure considered essential for enhancing the efforts to combat piracy and increasing coordination among the countries of the region. 

	The Contact Group on combating Piracy off the Coast of Somalia was established in the year 2009 as an international mechanism for the purpose and Sri Lanka has been a founder member in the Group. Sri Lanka has gained an opportunity to function as the Secretariat for the Working Group on operations at sea and the Sri Lanka Navy has both the ability and the experience to deal with the activity. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to make a formal request to the Contact Group on piracy off the Coast of Somalia, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration (SLIDA) Act, No.9 of 1982
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30

description: Establishment of a 'Think Tank Forum' for the promotion of the Fisheries Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body:
-	The importance of making group decisions has been identified for the purposes  of formulation of policies pertaining to the management and sustainable utilization of the marine resources of Sri Lanka, modernization of the Fisheries and Marine Tourism Sector, inclusive of the realization of aspirations, with a view to achieving economic development. In this regard, it has been proposed to establish a Think Tank Forum to enable to take decisions, taking into account the views and proposals of the experts and research data. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to establish a Think Tank Forum comprising of the economic experts, environmentalists, legal experts, marine engineers, naval and guided wave technicians, sociologists, representatives of the fisheries and tourism sectors and fishermen, under the Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the 04th Round of Duty Concessions under the Asia Pacific Trade Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body:
- The Asia Pacific Trade Agreement (APTA) which is a Regional Co-operation Agreement comprising of 06 member countries namely, Bangladesh, China, India, Laos, South Korea and Sri Lanka (previously known as the Bangkok Agreement), is the only operational trade agreement in which China and India, the two of the fastest growing markets in the world, are members. Under this trade agreement, the 03 rounds of duty concessions on selected trade items are implemented from 1990 up to now and accordingly, Sri Lanka has granted duty concessions on 442 items. 

	Under the 04th round of the agreement, Sri Lanka has agreed to grant duty concessions for a further 143 items so as not to cause any adverse effect on the state revenue and the local industries. All member countries have agreed to implement the duty concessions effective from January 2018 at the 4th round of duty concessions. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to implement the duty concessions of the said 143 items agreed upon by Sri Lanka effective from January 2018 and for this purpose to issue an Order under the Revenue Protection Act, No.19 of 1962 and present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renaming the Institute of Personnel Management (IPM), Sri Lanka as the 'Chartered Institute of Personnel Management, Sri Lanka'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body:
- 'The Institute of Personnel Management, Sri Lanka' was founded in the year 1959, with a view to creating competent professionals in the field of human resources and utilizing same to elevate the productivity of the country to a higher level, recognizing the uniqueness of professions relating to the subject of human resource management. Subsequently, the Institute has been incorporated by the Act, No.24 of 1976. 

	The Institute of Personnel Management, Sri Lanka which is regarded as the pioneering institute which provides the knowledge and training required for the public and private institutions in regard to human resource management, represents approximately 1,500 full time members who have fulfilled the professional qualifications.  A proposal has been made to amend its name to read as the 'Chartered Institute of Personnel Management, Sri Lanka' in order to formalize the function of the institute, to enhance its standardized  professionalism, recognition and the reputation. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, the Minister of Labour, Trade Union Relations and Sabaragamu Development, to amend the Institute of Personnel Management, Sri Lanka Act, No.24 of 1976 making provisions for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taking action in respect of the encroachments in the Railway reservations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body:
- The total extent of the railway reserved lands belonging to the Sri Lanka Railways is about 14,000 acres. Out of which, around 10% of lands has been provided to various stakeholders on lease basis and the rest of 80% of the said  lands are encroachments. The majority of these encroachers is the general public and among them, there are a few officers presently serving and as well as few retired officers in the Sri Lanka Railways. It is an unhealthy precedent to allow the railway employees themselves to occupy the lands   belonging to the Sri Lanka Railways unlawfully and thereby causing a loss of tax revenue to the Government.


As such, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to appoint a Cabinet Sub Committee headed by himself, comprising of the following Ministers as members to examine the possibility of adopting a fair and concessionary measure in respect of these railway employees and to submit a report to the Cabinet, within three (03) months, was approved by the Cabinet. 

	*	Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, 
		Minister of Finance and Mass Media; 

	*	Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, 
		Minister of Public Administration and Management; and
		
	*	Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, 
		Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.

description: Directions to prevent the use of the property belonging to the State  during the period of election for the purpose of promoting political activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-30
decision_details_body: - With a view to preventing the use of any movable or immovable property belonging to the State or any Public Corporation during the period of election, for the purposes of promoting political parties, groups and candidates or causing injustice or obstructing the conduct of a free and fair election, the Direction, No.2048/2 made by the Election Commission under sub paragraph (a) of paragraph(4) of Article 104(B) of the Constitution, has been published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification dated 2017-12-04. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to present the Gazette Notification, incorporating the said provisions in Parliament by the adoption of a resolution, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Special High Court to inquire into legal proceedings expeditiously with regard to allegations of Bribery and Corruption and extremely complex charges on financial crimes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to establish a High Court comprising of three judges specially designated to inquire into the legal proceedings expeditiously with regard to allegations of Bribery and Corruption and extremely complex charges on Financial Crimes. An amendment to the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978, for this purpose, has been drafted by the Legal Draftsman. 

Accordingly, taking into account, the objective criteria such as, the nature, gravity and the complexity of the offence, the impact of the crime on the victim or the state, the national interest etc., as the case may be, the crimes specifically mentioned in the Act, could be referred by the Attorney General or the Director General of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption, to the proposed High Court. The draft Bill has now been referred to the Attorney General for clearance.  The above mentioned matters presented to the Cabinet by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice, were noted by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and Vietnam in the field of Information and Communication
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Vietnam pertaining to Information and Communication, with a view to strengthening the friendly relations between the two countries for the promotion of bilateral cooperation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of the Sri Lanka - Singapore Free Trade Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- Experts in both countries have made deliberations and reached consensus regarding the provisions incorporated in the Free Trade Agreement proposed to be signed between Sri Lanka and Singapore.  Provisions relating to the fields of trade in goods, trade in services, liberalization of  services, investment, government procurement, competition etc. are included in the proposed Free Trade Agreement. Action has been taken to incorporate appropriate amendments  as well considering the observations made by several Ministers in regard to the draft Agreement. By the incorporation of the said amendments, a more favourable environment would be created for investments and as such, the foreign direct  investments from Singapore to Sri Lanka will be enhanced.   

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to sign the Sri Lanka - Singapore Free Trade Agreement on behalf of Sri Lanka, subject to clearance of the final draft Agreement by the Attorney General, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Active Liability Management Draft Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- The maintenance of Public Debt of Sri Lanka on a sustainable level has received focus at national level. Appropriate systems of reforms have to be adopted to prevent any risk that may occur in this regard. Therefore, the Cabinet has granted approval to draft legislation to adopt the liability management as a strategy for active public debt management. 

As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to publish the Active Liability Management Draft Bill prepared accordingly, in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present it in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Host Country Agreement  with regard to the CITES CoP, 18th Summit which Sri Lanka will host in 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- Sri Lanka has been a party to the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora - CITES from the year 1976. The Cabinet has granted approval to host the 18th Summit of the parties of this Convention in Sri Lanka in the year 2019. 

Accordingly, it is due to hold the said Convention from 22nd of May 2019 to 03rd of June 2019 in Sri Lanka and as such, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to sign a host county agreement pertaining to the Convention which Sri Lanka will host in 2019, between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Secretariat to the above mentioned International Convention, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of New Court Buildings
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- Most of the buildings where the Courts are housed in Sri Lanka are very old and, therefore, a large amount of money has to be spent for their maintenance.  Since the legal proceedings are ever increasing the space available in the buildings are also inadequate. Further, the Court Complexes in Welimada and Ratnapura which are situated in landslide risk prone areas are required to be relocated.   
Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice, to construct new buildings for the Court Complexes situated in the areas of Welimada, Ratnapura, Theldeniya, Pugoda, Kantale and Kilinochchi by utilizing the financial provisions set apart from the budget for the year 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project - Phase 1
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- The Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project - Phase 1 is implemented with the objective of providing safe drinking water to the people living in the Rambewa and Medawachchiya Divisional Secretary Divisions who depend on unsafe ground water which causes Chronic Kidney Diseases and Dental and Skeletal Fluorosis. 

As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for the construction of the Intake Facility, the Water Treatment Plant, the Water Storage Structures and the Mechanical, Electrical and Building Works, under Phase 1 of the project, to M/s Access Engineering PLC for a sum equivalent to a total of US$ 6.17 million received from the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) and a sum of Rs.2,349 million of domestic funds , as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Phase III of the Medirigiriya Water Supply Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- The  Medirigiriya Water Supply Scheme is implemented with the objective of providing safe drinking water to the people in the Medirigiriya Divisional Secretariat division, which has  been identified as an area which lacks safe drinking water resources and where the chronic kidney disease prevails. Owing to the resettlement of families in the same area, displaced due to the Moragahakanda reservoir project, the demand for safe drinking water is increasing and the Phase III of the Medirigiriya Water Supply Scheme has been decided to be implemented so as to supply water to cover  the demand. 
Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the Design and Build contract for the distribution system under Phase III of the said project to M/s Squire Mech Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.1,230 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Infrastructure facilities of the Uva Wellassa University - Phase 2
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- The Uva Wellassa University conducts 13 degree courses relevant to the industrial sector and currently about 2,200 students are engaged in educational activities. The intake of students to the university is being gradually increased and accordingly to coincide with it, the infrastructure facilities too have to be upgraded. 

As such, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to commence the construction activities of the library building, auditorium, staff learning unit, the alternative water supply system, students' welfare centre of the Uva Wellassa University and the activities related to the development of the main entrance of the University, in the year 2018 and to call for bids to select suitable contractors for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procuring of 50 Electric Buses for the Sri Lanka Transport Board to upgrade the urban public transport service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- Most of the people use their private vehicles for their day today transport needs due to the lack of comfortable, dependable and efficient public transport service and it contributes to a heavy traffic congestion on city roads and  air pollution.  

The Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB) possesses 6,300 buses in running condition and out of which 2,467 are more than 10 years old. Since such buses are subject to frequent wayside breakdowns, it causes problems to provide the public with a more reliable and efficient bus service. Further, the total number of buses required for the Transport Board is 7,257 to operate in accordance with a time table. At present, the fleet of buses of the SLTB consists 100% of diesel buses, which is a contributory factor for air pollution. 

Accordingly, the proposals made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to install an environment friendly Bus Rapid Transit System (BRT) within the city of Colombo, so that the elderly and the disabled passengers also can travel easily, and to purchase 50 electronic low floor air conditioned buses to the Sri Lanka Transport Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Installation of an Aeronautical Information Management System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body: - Bids have been called for the Supply, Installation and Commissioning of  an Aeronautical Information Management System for Sri Lanka and accordingly, a French and a Canadian company have presented their bids for the purpose. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the above contract to M/s Thales Air Systems S.A.S., France, for a sum equivalent to the total of Euro 3.3 million and Rs.65 million, as recommended by the Technical Evaluation Committee which evaluated the bids and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Installation of the main water supply system in the Defence Headquarters Complex (DHQC) at Akuregoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to award the contract for Design, Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of the Water Mains for the Defence Headquarters Complex (DHQC) Project at Akuregoda, to M/s Frigi Engineering Services (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.494.48 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvements to the Grand Oriental Hotel, Colombo through  Public-Private Partnership
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- It has been planned to develop the Grand Oriental Hotel in Colombo, under the Public-Private Partnership process while protecting its heritage and to transform it into a luxurious hotel brand. The HPL Hotels and Resorts of Singapore  has submitted a proposal to conduct a feasibility study in this regard.  

	As such, the joint proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media; Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Public Enterprise Development; and Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to appoint a Project Committee for the evaluation of the said proposal and to pursue action in this regard, subject to the relevant guidelines of the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Vietnamese People's Police Academy and the National Police Academy of Sri Lanka on Cooperation in Police Training and Scientific Research
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body: - Vietnam and Sri Lanka have agreed to enhance bilateral cooperation between the two countries for the prevention of crimes. As such, with a view to strengthening the cooperation through the exchange of updated information on Police Training and Scientific Research, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Vietnamese People's Police Academy and the National Police Academy of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing the Free Postal Facilities granted to the Hon. Members of Parliament and the Members of the Provincial Councils
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- The free postal facilities granted to the Hon. Members of Parliament and the Members of the Provincial Councils have not been revised since the year 2007 and now, requests have been made to revise the existing postal charges to coincide with the revision of the postal charges made from time to time. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. M.H.A. Haleem, the Minister of Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs, to increase the limit of the free annual postal facilities offered presently to the Hon. Members of Parliament from Rs.175,000/- up to Rs.350,000/- and to increase the limit of the free annual postal facilities offered presently to the Hon. Members of the Provincial Councils from Rs.24,000/- up to Rs.48,000/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979 to dispense with the requirement of producing of a suspect/accused in person to court at identified specific instances
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- Every suspect taken into custody should be produced before a Magistrate within 24 hours and where such suspect is committed to remand custody without granting bail, such detainee should be produced in the Magistrate's Court  for the extension of the order generally once in two (02) weeks.  Further, even in circumstances in which the Magistrate does not have the jurisdiction to grant bail, the suspect/accused person should be produced before the Magistrate from time to time.   

	Taking into consideration the delays in the judicial process and especially the unfortunate incidents that occurred while transporting the detainees to the Court, the life threats against the detainees and the opportunities for them to flee away from custody, focus has been drawn for limiting the instances of taking the suspects/accused before Court. As such, in accordance with the recommendations of the Special Committee appointed for the above amendments to the Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, while further maintaining the requirement of monitoring the welfare of the detainee, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice, to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979, to introduce a procedure which does not require  a suspect or an accused  person to be produced in person before the Magistrate under identified specific instances for the purpose of extending the order relating to the committal to remand custody, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Technical Assistance for improving the production of the major fruit crops and fruit value chains in Sri Lanka and commercialization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- The South-South Cooperation of the People's Republic of China has agreed to provide technical assistance for a project implemented with the objective of increasing the production of fruits in Sri Lanka and enhancing the business activities to suit the local and export markets by promoting an effective agro-business sector. Under this project, it has been planned to raise the production, quality and effectiveness targeting fruits such as, banana, mango and pineapple, to enhance the value chains and to promote the Public-Private Partnership process to attract the interest of investments for fruit orchards and processing centres.  

	The value chain activities of banana will be carried out mainly based in the Districts of Monaragala and Kalutara, and the value chain activities of mango will be carried out based on the Districts of Anuradhapura and Kilinochchi and the same of Pineapple based on the Districts of Gampaha, Kurunegala and Monaragala. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to enter into a Tripartite Agreement among the Government of Sri Lanka, the Government of China and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) for the implementation of the above project, which will be beneficial for the development of the agricultural sector in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Agricultural Cooperation between Sri Lanka and  Turkey
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Agricultural Cooperation, for the exchange of knowledge, technology and techniques relating to agricultural activities between Sri Lanka and Turkey, was approved by the Cabinet. The Cabinet also took note of the fact that it has been planned to enter into a special Agreement pertaining to the increase of the quantity of tea to be exported to the Republic of Turkey from Sri Lanka.

description: Import of Bristle Fiber for export with Value Addition
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- A quantity between 8,000 MT to 15,000 MT of Bristle Fiber, which is a coconut related product, is exported annually from our country to around 20 countries and a considerable amount of foreign exchange is received by such export process. Even though, there is a possibility of deriving more foreign exchange by exporting bristle fiber brushes and brooms as Value Added products, the process has been interrupted due to the difficulties in obtaining bristle fiber locally.  

	As such, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to permit the importation of Bristle fiber from India for value addition and exportation, subject to strict plant quarantine rules and regulations, the recommendations of the Coconut Research Institute and the relevant conditions, until the local coconut harvest becomes stable, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement between Turkmenistan and Sri Lanka on Mutual Visa Exemption for Holders of Diplomatic and Official Passports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of  Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs, to enter into an Agreement  between Sri Lanka and Turkmenistan on Mutual Visa Exemption for citizens who are Holders of Diplomatic and Official Passports when traveling between the two countries, with the objective of furthering friendly relations between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Land Surveys and Socio-Economic Surveys of all lands belonging to the Sri Lanka Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- Sri Lanka Railways owns a considerable extent of lands set apart by the Government of Sri Lanka, considering the present and future needs. Encroachment on railway lands and utilizing them due to various socio- economic and political reasons have resulted in a number of problems with regard to clear demarcation of boundaries and this has become a hindrance for the improvement of railway operations and its modernization activities. The Sri Lanka Railways has given around 7,000 plots of land on lease basis with a view to generating revenue and the management of such lands and the collection of outstanding lease payments are not carried out satisfactorily.   
	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to conduct surveys covering all lands belonging to the Sri Lanka Railways, in order to define the boundaries of the railway lands, to map out them accurately and as well as to conduct socio-economic surveys covering  encroachment of all railway lands to resettle the encroachers residing on them and to formalize the management of railway lands given on lease basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Smallholder Agribusiness Partnership (SAP) Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-16
decision_details_body:
- The 'Smallholder Agribusiness Partnership Programme' is implemented under the financial assistance of the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) with a view to enhancing their competitive abilities while assisting in broadening the livelihood avenues of rural small scale agri producers. This project which is implemented Island wide giving priority to low income generating districts provides benefits to around 57,500 low income rural families. 

	A major component of this project is the provision of the necessary financial facilities for the young agri-entrepreneurs for the development of their farms and to strengthen their enterprises at commercial level. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to provide credit facilities with an annual interest rate of 6.5% for the producer groups, farmer groups, and the young agri-entrepreneurs, under this programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting Relief Measures to Media Persons who were subject to various harassments and oppressions during the period from 2005 - 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body:
- By the publication of press notifications, opportunities were afforded to the media persons who were subject to various harassments and oppressions during the period from 2005 - 2015 to submit their appeals, with a view to granting relief to them. A Cabinet Sub-Committee was appointed under the Chairmanship of the Ex-Minister of Foreign Affairs to make recommendations to the Cabinet, with regard to such appeals. Subsequently, the period of time for appeals was then extended up to 01st May 2017 and in response to which 14 more applications have been received. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to appoint a fresh Cabinet Sub-Committee comprising of the following Ministers to examine the appeals and make recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

	*	Hon. Mangala Samaraweera,
		Minister of Finance and Mass Media - (Chairman);

	*	Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, 
		Minister of Disaster Management; and

	*	Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, 
		Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.

description: Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project - Phase - II - Consultancy Contract for Detailed Design and Bidding Assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for the Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project - Phase - II - Consultancy Contract for Detailed Design and Bidding Assistance to M/s NJS Concultants Co. Ltd. of Japan in association with M/s Ceywater Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd. and M/s EML Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd. of Sri Lanka, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee (SCACPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Uniforms and other Clothing Material for the Sri Lanka Police and the Special Task Force
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body: - The uniforms required for the Sri Lanka Police and the Special Task Force are purchased from the local textile manufacturers registered under the Ministry of Industry and Commerce by calling for quotations.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to purchase the uniforms required for the Sri Lanka Police and the Special Task Force from the local textile manufacturers recommended by the Local Textile Allocation Committee, for a sum of Rs.257.3 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Construction of a Wind Barrier around the Coal Yard and the Ash Yard at Lakvijaya Power Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body:
- The annual coal requirement for the electricity generation of the Lakvijaya Power Station is around 2.4 million MT. Dust generates while transporting the coal unloaded from the ships to the jetty and also during the storage of burned coal ash.  It poses much inconvenience to the residence living close to the vicinity.  Although, a wind barrier of the length of 450m and height of 15m has already been constructed in the coastal limits of the coal storage yard, it has been found that it is insufficient to cover the entire area during the periods of stormy winds.  It has also been found the necessity of expanding this wind barrier to cover the ash yard as well.  



As such, bids have been called for, to select a contractor to expand the existing wind barrier of the Lakvijaya Power Station around both the Coal Yard and the Ash Yard so as to cover the yards completely. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract to Laugfs Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd. and Sanken Construction (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.723.7 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of the Underground Storm Water Drainage System in Kandy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to rehabilitate the underground storm water drainage system in Kandy to coincide with the Kandy City Development activities taking place under the Strategic Cities Development Project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the civil contract to the Joint Venture of Ludwig Pfeiffer (Germany) - Gypsum Structural India (Pvt) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.1,016.3 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the  Pile Foundation  of the Multi-Office Complex proposed to be constructed in the Sethsiripaya Premises
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body:
- The Urban Development Authority has planned to construct a multi-office complex to cater to the increased demand for office space within the Administrative City of Sri Jayawardenapura - Kotte. The proposed building to be constructed in the premises of Sethsiripaya will consist of 25 storeys and a floor area of 123,902 m2.  The building which has been designed in line with the green building concept will comprise of modern office facilities and it is anticipated to complete the construction within a period of 3 ½ years. The estimated cost of the project is Rs.15.6 billion.
Presently, bids have been called for the construction of the pile foundation of the proposed building and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the contract to M/s San Piling (Pvt.) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.1,155 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mining and Pumping of Offshore Sand for Reclamation of land and Stockpiling at Muthurajawela and Kerawalapitiya  areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body:
- Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation is engaged in purifying sea sand obtained from offshore sand mining and supplying such sand for construction activities as a solution to reduce the detrimental impacts of river sand mining caused on environment.  For this purpose, it is necessary to secure fresh sea sand for stockpiling maintained at Muthurajawela area.  Similarly, it is necessary to supply sea sand for the proposed land reclamation taking place at Kerawalapitiya in accordance with the development plans.

In this respect, international bids have been called for, to select a suitable contractor for mining and pumping offshore sand and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the contract to M/s Rohde Nielsen A/S of Denmark for a sum of US$19.97 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the contract for the construction of the new Vocational Training Centre at Horana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body: - Under the 'Skills Sector Development Programme' implemented with the objective of expanding the Network of the Vocational Training Centres in the country, approval of the Cabinet has been granted to construct the new Vocational Training Centre at Horana.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Chandima Weerakkody, the Minister of  Skills Development and Vocational Training, to award the contract for the construction of the Vocational Training Centre, to M/s Asiri Constructions, for a sum of Rs.141 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Consultancy Services for the supervision of the Badulla - Chenkalady Road Improvement Project (86.75 km)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body: - The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) has provided a loan amounting to US$ 60 million to the Government of Sri Lanka for the rehabilitation and improvement of the road section from Bibile to Chenkalady, 86.75 km in length of the Badulla - Chenkalady Road.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for the provision of consultancy services for the supervision of the construction of the said road section, to Resources Development Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.258.3 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee (CPCC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promoting the performance of the National Sports Team Pools aiming at International events/tournaments
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body:
- There are only a few number of professional athletes in Sri Lanka and most of them are engaged in their professional and other activities in their day to day life while involving in sports activities during their free time. With a view to improving the performance of the athletes aiming at international competitions, it is important to enroll them into the training pools and to provide them with technical training, food and beverages, medical consultations and medicines etc; under proper guidance. Sports Training Pools for athletics, weight lifting, Wushu, Hockey, Rugger and Karate and Paralympic games are being conducted by the Ministry of Sports and under the training programmes, 159 athletes are being trained. Each athlete in the athletic pool is paid an allowance from Rs.10,000/- to Rs.80,000/-.

It is necessary to improve the performance of these training pools, targeting achievements at international competition(s),  As most of these athletes are engaged in sports while being employed at the institutions such as the Public Service, Tri-Forces and Sri Lanka Police, it is necessary to take action to have them released from the professional environment for the training activities on a full time basis.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to obtain the services of the national and international coaches for each training pool, to provide facilities to those athletes who join the training pools and to motivate the athletes with optimal talents in sports by providing permanent appointments in the State Institutions when the relevant qualifications are achieved for recruitment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of Compensation to the Victims of the incident that took place in  Beruwala and Aluthgama in the Kalutara District on 2014-06-15 and 2014-06-16
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body:
- Some unknown persons had destroyed the properties belonging to 273 families during an unfortunate incident that took place in Beruwala and Aluthgama in the Kulatara District  on the 15th and 16th of June 2014 and the Sri Lanka Army renovated those damaged buildings.  However, a compensation was not paid to the victims to restore the damaged furniture and their livelihood.  
The Officials' Committee appointed to examine the relevant damages has recommended the payment of compensation for other properties and furniture  lost due to the incident.  As such, taking into consideration a proposal submitted by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement and Hindu Religious Affairs, approval of the Cabinet was granted to pay compensation subject to the existing provisions.

description: Preparation of a General Accounting System for the Local Authorities in accordance with the Public Accounting Standards
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body: - A project has been implemented under the World bank funds, with the objective of introducing a new accounting network in accordance with the internationally accepted  accounting standards having rectified the existing deficiencies found in the accounting system which is implemented at present in the Local Authorities.  The new  accounting system prepared accordingly is due to be introduced in all the Local Authorities in the country from the year 2018. In this respect, awareness programmes will also be carried out for the officers of the Local Authorities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to implement the new accounting system in all the Local Authorities effective from the financial year 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the main building of the Department of National Archives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body:
- A large number of valuable archives which confirm to the uniqueness of Sri Lanka and the Sri Lanka's rules, regulations and legislation since 1885 have been deposited in the  Department of National Archives. The main building of this Department which has been constructed with its own architectural design comprises of 07 storeys and it is around 40 years old.

As such, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to renovate the main building to create the ideal environment necessary to preserve the invaluable archives deposited in the Department in accordance with the proper  standards and to provide the public with a high  archival service,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the New Villages Development Authority for the Plantation Regions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been granted for the  Establishment of the 'New Villages Development Authority' for the Plantation Regions, in order to empower the plantation community living in those areas economically and socially with a view to making them contribute to the national development process through the Socio-economic, Cultural and Infrastructure Development in the plantation sector of Sri Lanka.

The Agreements reached after discussion on the provisions incorporated in the Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman for the purpose, were submitted to the Cabinet by  Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of  Plantation Industries and Hon. U. Palani Digambaram, the Minister of  Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development and the approval of the Cabinet was granted to proceed with the process.

description: Granting of relief for the families who are affected due to the Land acquisition for the construction of Ella Wewa Reservoir
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body: - It has been designed to provide irrigation water for 1,800 acres of lands located in the areas of Panamura, Walalgoda, Hulanda Oya by the Ella Wewa Reservoir proposed to be constructed in the Embilipitiya Divisional Secretary's Division of the Ratnapura District. As identified, 20 families will be displaced due to the acquisition of lands for the construction of this reservoir. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to make arrangements for granting alternative lands for these displaced families to construct houses and granting them a reasonable compensation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing a plot of land for the construction of a Service Centre relating to the Caged Fish Farming Project in the open sea
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet has granted approval to implement a project under two stages in farming high demand species such as Modha, Pompanu (Watchchalaya) and Kossa with the use of caged fish farming technology in the open sea on a commercial basis adopting environmental conservation methods  and using modern technology.  For this purpose, the Cabinet has also granted approval to provide a plot of land in Koddiyar area in the Trincomalee District of the coastal belt belonging to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority, in extent of 150 hectares on lease basis for a 30 year period  to the Global Ceylon Sea Food (Private) Limited.

	Under the said project, the estimated annual fish production is expected to be at 2,000 MT and a pre-processing service centre is needed to be constructed to provide services relating to activities before presenting fish to the market.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development,  to provide a land in extent of 01 acre situated at the Muttur Divisional Secretary's Division on a lease basis, for a period of 30 years to the Global Ceylon Sea Food (Private) Limited, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Streamlining and updating of the existing Visa issue system
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09

description: Implementation of the 'Good Governance for Growth' Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body:
- One of the basic principles of the concept of Good Governance is the responsibility of the Government to meet the needs of the public as opposed to any selected group of the society. In support of the Government's efforts made in regard to Good Governance,  the Government of Australia has agreed to provide a grant of AUD 31 million to contribute towards the improvement in the public service delivery. Under this programme is has been planned to implement a programme for 'Good Governance for Growth' by utilizing these funds.
	Under this programme, it is expected to cover the matters like enhancing economic growth and the spread of such development benefits to the society to minimize the poverty and income disparities prevalent in the country, to assist in providing effective and accountable public services and to assist in the joint research programmes in respect of economic decision making and enhancing the qualitative aspect of public services. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to implement the proposed programme within the next five (05) years and to enter into a Subsidiary Agreement with the Government of Australia.

description: Establishment of comprehensive 'Sub-fertility' Management Service Centres
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body:
- 'Sub-fertility' and the 'Inability to achieve pregnancy' is a problem faced by more than 15% among the Sri Lankan married couples. This has caused negative social consequences which include  marital instability, social isolation, lack of domestic support, exclusion from inheritance of property. 

Accordingly, the need to improve the services provided by the public health services at present, for treatment provided for sub-fertility has been identified.  Under this programme, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to initially establish a comprehensive sub-fertility treatment centre  with modern services such as in-vitro fertilization (IVF) and egg/embryo freezing  as well, in the Castle Street Hospital for Women in Colombo, a second such centre in the New Maternity Hospital at Karapitya in Galle and to develop one such centre each in all the remaining Provinces under Phase III of the programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a  pilot project to control the Dengue mosquitoes through the introduction of  the 'Wolbachia' bacteria with the assistance of the Government of Australia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body:
- Dengue has emerged as one of the key public health challenges in Sri Lanka and during the last two decades, it has reached epidemic proportions. Although several preventive measures were taken, the disease  has cost more than 400 human lives in Sri Lanka in the year 2017. The necessity to prevent and control dengue by the use of more efficient and an environmental friendly bio-control strategy has been identified due to the existing deficiencies in the prevention of Dengue which is transmitted by 'Aedes aegypti' through traditional methods.
	
	The University of Monash in Australia has successfully experimented the possibility of using 'Wolbachia' bacterium in order to prevent the transmission of the dengue virus. The bacterium prevents the dengue virus growing inside the body of the dengue mosquito to a level which would transmit the disease. The system has already been successfully implemented in Australia, Vietnam, Indonesia, Brazil and Colombia. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to implement a project for using 'Wolbachia Bacterium' as a long term dengue preventive measure in Sri Lanka, in the selected areas of Colombo district as a pilot project, under the Australian grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Public Debt Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-09
decision_details_body:
- The Government has planned to make a deceleration of the public debt accumulation through the increase of Government revenue and a Government financial consolidation process to bring down the Public Debt Ratio up to 70% of the Gross Domestic Product (GDP), by the end of year 2020. The Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL), on the request of the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management (CCEM) has submitted the available alternatives and different proposals have also been submitted by the  Investment Houses for a more favourable public debt management. Some of  such proposals are given below:

(i)  	Gradual increase of  public revenue as a percentage of the GDP as set out in the Medium-term fiscal projections.

(ii) 	Public investments for immediate beneficial activities selected through cost - benefit analysis.

(iii)	Reducing the borrowing for public investments by the attraction of local private sector or foreign investors for public investments.

(iv)	Improving of the financial and the operational status of the major state- owned business enterprises and thereby reducing the impact on public expenses.

(v) 	Careful articulation of domestic debt issuance.

(vi) 	Set off the loans taken at a high interest rate from the loans taken in instances where loans can be obtained relatively at a lower interest.

Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, submitted these alternatives and proposals and the challenges to be faced while implementing the Liability Management Process to the Cabinet and the Cabinet took note of the facts.

description: Further payment of house rental provided to the families who were displaced from their dwelling places due to the water leakages of the Main Tunnel of the Uma Oya Multi Purpose Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet granted approval on the 29th of August, 2017 for the payment of a monthly rental for a period of 06 months for the householders adversely affected due to the water leakage which occurred in the Main Tunnel of the Uma Oya Multi Purpose Development Project and evacuated from their permanent dwelling places, until they are provided with suitable alternative residential lands by the Government. The National Building Research Organization has reported that several plots of lands identified for re‑settlement of the families, situated in the Bandarawela area are not quite safe for residential purposes. Accordingly, a land belonging to the Department of Forest Conservation has been identified as suitable for the purpose and the future activities related to the purpose are in progress. 

	As such, in accordance with the recommendation made by the Cabinet Sub‑Committee appointed to examine and provide relief to the persons affected due to the leakage of the  main tunnel of the Uma Oya Multi Purpose Development Project, the Cabinet granted approval to provide the monthly house rental now being paid for the families who were evacuated due to the disaster situation, for a further period of 06 months.

description: Issuance of International Sovereign Bonds under the Government Borrowing Programme - 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to take further action to raise funds up to a sum of US$ 2,000 million through the issuance of International Sovereign Bonds within the approved Government borrowing limits for the year 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of Sri Lanka Development Bonds under the Government Borrowing Programme of 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body:
- In terms of the Appropriation Act, No.30 of 2017, the estimated maximum borrowing limit is a sum amounting to Rs.1,893 billion for the year 2018. Out of this sum, it is anticipated to utilize Rs.1,150 billion for re-payment of loans and Rs.743 billion for development projects and other related expenditure. Of this sum of loans, amounting to Rs.1,893 billion, it is expected to raise Rs.1,313 billion from domestic sources and Rs.580 billion from foreign sources. The loans proposed to be obtained from domestic sources will consist of the issuance of Treasury Bonds and Sri Lanka Development Bonds (SLDB).
   	Accordingly, during the year 2018, it has been planned to raise funds up to a sum of US$ 3,000 million (approximately Rs.456 billion) through the issuance of SLDBs.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to make the issuance of the said bonds under the supervision of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing of relief to 4,000 farmer families of the Kaudulla Irrigation Scheme who had to abandon their cultivation of the Maha Season of 2017/2018 due to the inability to provide irrigation water duly for want of  the structural investigations of the Moragahakanda Reservoir
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body:
- In accordance with the decisions of the Water  Management Committee, it was due to release water to Elehera, Giritale, Minneriya and Kaudulla irrigation schemes from 10th November, 2017 for the 2017/2018 Maha Season. But since the water collection was needed to be done for the completion of the structural investigations of the Moragahakanda reservoir, it has not been possible to release water this time, for about 4,000 farmers of the upper canal of Kaudulla reservoir who are provided with irrigation water facilities.  

	For this reason, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to provide a special compensation of Rs.10,000/- per month in addition to the dry ration of Rs.5,000/- already provided for, to the 4,000 farmer families of the Kaudulla irrigation scheme, who had to abandon their cultivation of the Maha season of 2017/2018, for the forthcoming period of 03 months as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Ratmalana / Moratuwa Waste Water Disposal Project - Stage 1- Phase II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body:
- The Ratmalana / Moratuwa Waste Water Disposal Project Stage 1- Phase I has been implemented successfully under the financial assistance of the Swedish International Development Agency (SIDA) during the period from 2008 - 2015. Under Phase II of the project, it is envisaged to construct 7 new pumping stations, a 95 Km long sewege collection network, to improve  equipment at the Moratuwa Treatment Plant etc. that will facilitate to provide 11,000 household connections and about 580 commercial  and industrial connections to dispose of waste water.   

In order to implement Phase II of the project an expenditure of Euro 105.5 million will have to be incurred and out of which the French Development Agency (AFD) has agreed to provide Euro 75 million.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into a loan agreement with the French Development Agency to obtain the said funds,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of Work at the Kilinochchi Sports Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body: - The construction work of the Kilinochchi Sports Complex constructed with the objective of providing for the promotion of the sporting skills of the sportsmen and sportswomen of the Northern Province has presently been abandoned half way.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to get the balance construction work of the Sports Complex completed by the Sri Lanka Army at an estimated cost of Rs.141.9 million with a view to constructing it expeditiously and vesting it with the people, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Pilot Project for providing an opportunity to the school children to learn and experiment upon Digital Technology
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet has granted approval to implement a project for providing basic IoT (Internet of Things) training kits to 100 schools, with a view to providing an opportunity to school children between 11 and 12 years of age to learn and experiment upon the digital technology. Under this project, 100 selected schools will be provided with 20 training kits each, including 04 BBC micro:bit equipment, few sensors, a charger and a Raspberry Pi3 computer. 

As such, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to award the contract for providing the essential hardware and training required for the project, to Orel Corporation, as a direct contract, for a sum of Rs.99.21 million, as recommended by the Procurement Committee of the Ministry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the balance work of the low income housing project at Kalinga Mawatha in Colombo 05
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body: - Bids have been called for, to select a suitable contractor for completing the balance work of the low income housing project being constructed at Kalinga Mawatha in Colombo 05, comprising of 528 housing units and securing funds necessary for the same.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the contract to M/s Maga Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.1,898.7 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Housing Project at Sri Jayawardenapura Hospital Road at Thalawathugoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body: - Bids have been called for, to select a suitable contractor for designing, constructing and securing funds for a housing project at the Sri Jayawardenapura Hospital Road at Thalawathugoda, comprising of 400 middle income housing units.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the contract to M/s Yanjian Group Co. Ltd., for a sum of Rs.6,997 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Export Processing Zone at Millaniya in the Kalutara District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body:
- Rs.2.5 billion has been set apart by the budget 2018 to identify suitable lands to establish Export Processing zones along the expressway corridors and to provide facilities required for the purpose. It has become essential to establish new investment zones, since 12 Export Processing zones/ Industrial parks within the Western, Southern, Central and North Western Provinces under the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka are functioning at their maximum capacity at present. 

A proposal has been made by a Thailand and Japanese Joint Venture to establish an industrial park in Sri Lanka, to enable to attract foreign investments and as such, several plots of suitable lands situated at Millaniya in the Kalutara District, have been identified for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to vest the plots of lands identified to be suitable for establishing the proposed Export Processing Zone at Millaniya  with the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka under two stages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between India and Sri Lanka on Co-operation in the Field of Information Technology and Electronics
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to sign a Memorandum of Understanding for the establishment of co-operation pertaining to Information Technology and Electronics between India and Sri Lanka and thereby promote inter-institutional co-operation and relations of the relevant institutions of the two countries. By this, it paves the way for Sri Lanka to exchange the experiences gained by India in the use of Information Technology and Electronics, in governance and public service delivery to the citizens. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing Loan Facilities to obtain the Technical Assistance for the   Secondary Town Sustainable Development Project (STSDP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body: - The Secondary Town Sustainable Development Project has been designed under the sponsorship of the financial assistance of the Asian Development Bank, to carry out capacity building, rehabilitation and infrastructure development of 25 towns selected to be developed as economic hubs that contribute to the entire development of the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, for the  procurement of consultancy services to design the sub projects, obtain the necessary technical assistance, to identify initial procurement and formal administrative systmes under the said project and to obtain a loan facility of US$ 05 million from the Asian Development Bank for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improving the Educational Institutions of the Dasa Sil Mathavos
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body:
- The necessity has arisen to prepare a programme of a high level to provide Dhamma discipline training required for the Dasa Sil Mathavos who have entered the Sasana and the Dasa Sil Mathavos who are to enter the Sasana in the future. Four Dasa Sil Matha Educational Institutions have already commenced and to provide the necessary Dhamma based knowledge, training on rituals pertaining to the Sasana and basic Pirivena education essential for the Dasa Sil Mathavos and it is of importance to provide sponsorship to manage these institutions duly. 

	As such, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to design a formal institutional structure for the educational institutions dedicated for Dasa Sil Mathavos, to introduce a formal study course and to appoint an Advisory Board to formalize the administration of such institutions and to provide the maintenance expenditure by the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sustainable Management of Ground Water
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body:
- Due to various development activities taking place along with the increase of the population, the utilization of ground water in Sri Lanka has increased rapidly. Apart from domestic consumption, ground water is largely used for agriculture, bottling of water, tourist hotels, vehicle service stations and various industries etc. Since the over utilization of ground water causes diverse environmental issues, the owners of the tube well drilling machines have been registered under the Water Resources Board and taken measures to regulate the extraction of ground water. The procedure to be followed by the tube well drilling operators has been stipulated by the Regulations published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2010/23 dated 2017‑03‑16. 

As such, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to increase the fine imposed under the provisions of the Water Resources Board Act, on tube well drilling operators who act in contravention of the Regulations and to establish a standard among the tube well drilling operators by levying an annual registration fee for tube well drilling machines, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Releasing the lands belonging to the Co-operative Wholesale Establishment (CWE) for the development of the Beira Lake Intervention Area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body:
- The Urban Development Authority (UDA) has prepared an Action Plan to open the Beira Lake Intervention area to the public and under this project, the lands located between the Beira Lake and the D. R. Wijewardane Road are to be utilized for development activities. The lands presently being possessed by the CWE, have been allocated for the Hotels and Tourist Zones, in accordance with the Beira Lake Intervention Development Plan. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Ministry of Industry and Commerce, to release the said lands to enable the effective utilization of the same for development activities and to call for proposals to implement the integrated development projects so as to be beneficial to the CWE as well, based on the Government valuation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expanding the beneficiary base of the Concessionary Loan Scheme 'Sonduru Piyasa'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body:
- The Concessionary Loan Scheme 'Sonduru Piyasa' was proposed by the Budget‑2017, to provide funds up to Rs.200,000 to the low income beneficiaries who make efforts to expand the houses below 750 square feet and to complete them but find it difficult to do so due to financial constraints . It has been planned to provide benefits to 100,000 loan recipients by the year 2020 and the number of loan recipients  registered under this Loan Scheme by 2017‑12‑14 is 3,354. 

The Ministry of Housing and Construction has pointed out that since the floor area of the houses belonging to most of the persons with low income and old house owners outside the limits of the urban areas exceeds 750 square feet,  they are not qualified to benefit from  the loan scheme.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to raise the floor area of the houses of the persons with low income up to 1,000 square feet, with the objective of increasing the number of beneficiaries entitled to receive loans under the 'Sonduru Piyasa' Loan Scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Motor Vehicle Fleet of the Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body:
A Comptroller General's Office has been established under the Ministry of Finance and Mass Media, with effect from 2017‑03‑07, with a view to monitoring the management of the assets and expenditure of the Government,. The main function  of the Office is to maintain a list of central assets prepared covering all non‑financial assets of the Government. The statistics on the motor vehicle fleet of the Government received by the Office up to 2017-12-14 were submitted by Hon. 			The Cabinet also decided to instruct the relevant officers to take necessary action to dispose of the motor vehicles not in running order expeditiously, which are not in use at present.

description: Payment of Partner Fees for the Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body:
- It has become apparent that the multi-national companies involved in International Transactions are creating opportunities due to the loop holes in the domestic and international tax systems either to mitigate the potential tax exposure or to achieve no tax liability. As such, the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) and G-20 countries have prepared an action plan named 'Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) Project' in order to address this issue. 

Sri Lanka obtained its full membership in the year 2016 and at present, 107 countries have joined the framework. It is beneficial for Sri Lanka to maintain its membership since this framework project provides clear solutions to the states and tax administrators in carrying out the operations pertaining to tax evasions. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to pay a membership fee of Euro 30,000 to the OECD to retain membership in the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a National Accreditation Scheme for Medical/Clinical Laboratories and Healthcare Service Providers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body: - The function of the Sri Lanka Accreditation Board is to grant accreditation, after an assessment that the Medical/Clinical Laboratories functioning in Sri Lanka are in accordance with the accepted international standards. A proposal has been made to commence a new accreditation process for the institutions that provide the services for hospitals and health care services, considering the demand for accreditation related to the field. Under this programme, it is due to cover the customer care, the patient's rights and education, medication management, infection control, safety of facilities, training etc., pertaining to a hospital and improve the accreditation criteria and procedures in line with the national and international standards. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to implement a national accreditation scheme jointly with the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, with the objective of enhancing the standards of the Medical/Clinical Laboratories (Public and Private) and the registered private medical institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulation of the Finance Commission Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-01-02
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enact legislation to vest the powers required further with the Finance Commission in order to discharge the functions assigned to the Finance Commission in terms of the Constitution more effectively. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill incorporating the powers required by the Finance Commission to perform its assigned functions taking also into consideration the proposals of the Sub-Committee appointed by the Finance Commission to make a study in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The manufacture of asbestos, the usage and the import of raw material required for the manufacture of asbestos.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-12-19
decision_details_body:
- The industrialists engaged in the production of asbestos as well as the experts on the subject have made various representations and submissions pertaining to the policy decision taken by the Government on 2016-09-06, imposing restrictions on the manufacture and use of asbestos in Sri Lanka and the import of the raw materials required for the manufacture of asbestos, to be effective from 01st January 2018.

	80% of the asbestos imported to Sri Lanka is used for the manufacture of roofing sheets and several members of the Cabinet has brought to the notice of the Cabinet the difficulties faced by the housing constructors due to these restrictions. At this meeting, the difficulties in creating opportunities to purchase suitable alternative products in the market at a fair price, as well, due to the restrictions imposed on the use of asbestos in the country within a short span of time was extensively discussed.

	As such, the Cabinet decided to suspend the said decision, until a further study is carried out and a final decision is taken, on the restrictions to be imposed pertaining to the manufacture and use of asbestos in Sri Lanka and the import of raw  material required for the manufacture of asbestos which was to be implemented, with effect from 2018-01-01.

description: Suspension of Sri Lanka Tea Imports by the Russian Federation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-12-19
decision_details_body:
