A survey is being conducted on the socio-economic effects when releasing lands required for the project and the activities of the survey from Maradana to Homagama has by now been completed. As revealed in the survey, the 2,100 families who reside in the railway reservations on either side of the railway line should be resettled in other places before commencing the construction work of the project.  

In this respect, the preferred and the most practicable solution available at present for addressing this issue is to utilize the Housing Units of the Housing Projects constructed by the Urban Development Authority (UDA) under the 'Urban Regeneration Project'. The Authority has consented to set apart 2,036 houses with a capacity of 400 to 500 sq. feet for the purpose for a value of Rs.4 to Rs.5 million each, from the houses expected to be completed from such projects, within the period from 2017 to 2019.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to secure the funds necessary to reserve such houses, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on the Conservation of Migratory Sharks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-17
decision_details_body:
- Sri Lanka being a party to the Convention on the Conservation of Migratory Species of Wild Animals, since 1993 is bound to ensure the protection of the migratory wild animals listed in this Convention within the territorial waters of the country. This Convention favours the signing of International and Regional Level MoUs between the Governments covering the migratory animal species or groups.   

	As such, a proposal has been made to sign a MoU regarding the conservation of the migratory sharks at the stakeholders Convention scheduled to be held in Philippines from 22nd to 28th of October 2017. The said MoU will be helpful in providing opportunities for sources of financial and technical assistance for the conservation of migratory sharks. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to sign the MoU on behalf of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion and Improvement of Daycare Facilities for Children
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-17
decision_details_body:
- Presently, the women labour force participation in the national labour force is only 36% and the constraint for increasing it further due to women resigning from their jobs and their lack of interest on being employed because of the  responsibility of childcare placed on them has been identified as the lack of adequate facilities for childcare. Since, a considerable number of women with a higher level of education could be harnessed in obtaining their contributions to the economy of the country, the Government has identified that priority should be accorded further for the enhancement of this sector through the development of affordable and high quality daycare facilities in the country.   

According to a survey carried out by the Ministry of Women and Child Affairs, it has been revealed that around 24,000 children are taken care of, in 1,200 daycare centres managed by both the Government and the private sector in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to appoint a Committee comprising of the representatives of the Government, the Provincial Councils and the Private Sector to study the further expansion and enhancement of the child daycare facilities in Sri Lanka, identifying the problems pertaining to the field, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and Nepal on Youth Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and Nepal focusing attention on the areas where priority has to be given in  the area of co-operation on youth development, such as implementation of programmes for sharing the knowledge and experience, leadership and personality development, as well as skills development, youth  cultural programmes, encouraging the youth entrepreneurs in both countries, exchange programmes between the two countries to facilitate for the youth volunteer groups etc., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making provisions for the control of election expenses
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-17
decision_details_body:
- For the proper exercise of the universal suffrage which is an integral part of the peoples sovereignty, conducting of free and fair elections is an absolute necessity.  If an election is to be held in a free and fair manner, it is necessary to have the true reflection of the opinion of the people in exercising their vote without any influence and if any political party, a group or a candidate spends money lavishly with no control it will cause a considerable effect on the choice of the people. 

	Many countries including India have introduced legislation to control election expenses to ensure the true reflection of the peoples' opinion and it has been found that such kind of a control on the election expenses will also help to reduce illegal acts, violent incidents as well as corruptions. In the elections held in Sri Lanka prior to 1977 there were laws in force to obtain Reports of expenses borne by the candidates but under the present system of elections such provisions have not been enshrined. The Election Commission has reported that a basic consensus has been reached in this regard, after a discussion with the Secretaries and representatives of the recognized political parties and the legal fraternity. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to amend the existing election laws and also to enact new laws to enable to obtain the Reports of election expenses incurred by political parties, groups and the candidates and to impose a ceiling on such expenditure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Audit Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet at its meeting held on 15-08-2017 decided to appoint a Ministerial Sub-Committee under the Chairmanship of  Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Special Assignments, to recommend appropriate amendments relating to the Draft National Audit Bill focusing attention on various opinions expressed in regard to the said Bill and the relevant legal position relating to this subject prevalent in other countries. 

Accordingly, being compatible with the recommendations of the Ministerial Sub-Committee and the other observations, approval was granted by the Cabinet to pursue further action to amend the Draft National Audit Bill and to incorporate the proposed amendments to vest the authority with the Secretary to relevant Ministry within whose purview the institution in which the officer is serving belongs, to surcharge from the relevant officer any loss caused to the Government due to the negligence, misappropriation, fraud or corruption of  the officer when reported by the Audit Services Commission and to widen the representation of the Surcharge Appeal Committee to be established by the inclusion of two persons representing the fields of Public Administration and Engineering to inquire into the appeals made by a public officer subject to such surcharge.

description: Provision of infrastructure facilities to Model villages of  'Semata Sevana' and 'Grama Shakthi'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- In accordance with the Island wide survey conducted in the year 2016 in respect of the housing needs, it has been identified that there are 216,197 low income families living without a house of their own. In order to provide them with housing ownership, the Ministry of Housing and Construction has commenced the implementation of 'Semata Sevana' and 'Grama Shakthi' Model Village programmes, treating it as high priority development programmes with a target of constructing 2,500 model villages by the year 2020.


It is highly essential to allocate lands for the construction of new settlements, develop access roads, provide for drinking water facilities as well as electricity for the successful implementation of these programmes.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to accord priority within the ongoing and the new development of the 2500 model villages anticipated for construction, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of India 	and the Government of Sri Lanka on the Grama Shakthi Model Village 	Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- The Ministry of Housing and Construction as of now is implementing an extensive programme called the 'Grama Shakthi Model Village' for resolving the housing problems of the poverty stricken people.  The Government of India has already provided a financial grant of Rs.300 million for the construction of 600 houses in 25 model villages throughout the island.  With the evaluation of the progress of the project, the Government of India has expressed her willingness  to provide a further award of Rs.300 million for the construction of another 600 houses. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to implement a programme to provide houses for another 600 families of abject poverty under the Grama Shakthi Model Village Programme by utilizing the Indian Government grant of Rs.300 million and to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of India, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Declaration of Assets and Liabilities Law
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- The persons dealing with the needs of the general public should adhere to the tenets of honesty, integrity and transparency. In terms of the    Declaration of Assets Law, No.1 of 1975, such persons should periodically declare his/her assets and liabilities within Sri Lanka or outside the country, and the law also provides for investigations to be conducted upon complaints made against a person to whom the law applies.

Accordingly, where a person fails to make a declaration on his/her assets and liabilities which he is required to make, or makes false information in such declaration and fails to give additional information when necessary and in such situations, such person is found guilty and is liable only to a fine of not exceeding Rs.1,000/- or/and to an imprisonment for a term not exceeding one year.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation to increase the fine up to Rs.100,000/- taking into consideration the present day needs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Import of Rice by the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment (CWE)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body: - The anticipated production of rice in the Yala Season of 2017 has been reduced by about 50%.  As such, it has been decided to import 500,000 MT of rice through the CWE to meet the requirement of rice in the market up to the month of December 2017.  Out of the above, 100,000 MT of rice have been ordered from India. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources and Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Development Strategies and International Trade, to appoint a Special Committee presided over by the Secretary to the Treasury to take necessary action to import the balance requirement of 400,000MT of rice expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Crew Cabs necessary for the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract to purchase 50 Short Wheel Crew Cabs necessary for the Distribution Division 2 of the CEB for a sum of Rs.185.6 million to M/s. Sathosa Motors PLC and the contract to purchase 15 Long Wheel Crew Cabs for a sum of Rs.56.5 million to the M/s. United Motors Lanka PLC as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Medical Examination Gloves and Surgical Rubber Gloves
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the procurement of 92 million pairs of medium and large size rubber gloves for a sum of Rs.482 million and 31 million pairs of  Surgical Rubber Gloves for a sum of Rs.1,196 million, to M/s. Sisili Project Consortium (Pvt) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 400,000 Nucleic Acid Testing Reagents used for Blood Tests
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the procurement of 400,000 Nucleic Acid Testing Reagents used for ensuring that the Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) and the Hepatitis B & C Viruses are not present in the blood donated by the blood donors to the National Blood Transfusion Service, to M/s. Apcot Marketing (Pvt) Ltd., for a sum of US$ 5.94 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Medical Ward Complex in the General Hospital, Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- The General Hospital, Kalutara, which is the major hospital in the Kalutara District provides a great service in providing health care services for the people living in Agalawatta, Bulathsinghala, Horana, Bandaragama, Kalutara, Mathugama, Panadura and Beruwala. It has been proposed to construct a new 07 storey building for the medical ward complex with the objective of providing with more accommodation facilities for in-door patients.

As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the  construction of this complex to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau and the Engineering Services (Pvt.) Company for a sum of Rs.2,817 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Towns East of Polonnaruwa Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to implement a new water supply project so as to cover the towns east of Polonnaruwa which is being developed under the 'Rajarata Navodaya - Let's Awaken Polonnaruwa'. Through this project, it is expected to supply safe drinking water to a population of about 262,481 residing in Welikanda, Dimbulagala, Thamankaduwa, Lankapura, Hingurakkdoda and Elahera Divisional Secretariat Divisions.
 
Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for the implementation of the  project to M/s China Harbor Engineering Company Ltd. for a sum of US$ 354 million, as recommended by the standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Greater Polonnaruwa Township Water Supply Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to implement 09 water supply projects under the 'Rajarata Nawodaya - Pibidemu Polonnaruwa' development programme. Under one of the sub projects of the Greater Polonnaruwa Township Development Project, additional water supply required for the proposed Heritage City, Commercial City, Administrative City and the proposed Renal Care Hospital is provided by transmitting water from the existing Water Treatment Plant at Gallella.

Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract of supply, installation, testing and commissioning of mechanical and electronic equipment required for this water supply project to M/s K. P. Projects International (Pvt.) Ltd., at a cost of Rs.154 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of contracts for buildings to be constructed at Universities of Colombo and Ruhuna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract of establishment of the faculty of Technology at the University of Colombo for a sum of Rs 1,801 million to M/s International Construction Consortium (Pvt.) Ltd., and the contract of constructing of a twelve storey building with an examination centre, Clinical excellence center, health education center and a family health centre at the Medical Faculty of the University of Ruhuna for a sum of Rs. 850 million, to M/s Link Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the Sabaragamuwa Saman Devalaya, Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body: - In a survey carried out by  the Department of Archaeology and some institutions, it has been revealed that the parts decayed in the roofs and the other buildings of the Ratnapura Maha Saman Devalaya where a large number of pilgrims visit daily need to be renovated expeditiously. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to finance the renovation process of the Devalaya safeguarding its  authenticity, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Youth Software Competition 2017 - 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- With a view to empowering the youth community for the purpose of creating innovative solutions to provide the benefits of the information and communication technology to everyone in the society, it has been proposed to conduct a Software Competition among youth. This project will be implemented by the National Youth Services Council (NYSC) in collaboration with the Information and Communication Technology Agency of Sri Lanka (ICTA) and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).

Under this, three(03) competitions are scheduled to be held at provincial level to create software which could be used as solutions for the development challenges and the winners selected will be provided with the sponsorship to commence the relevant enterprises and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to hold the proposed Youth Software Competition during the period of 2017-2019, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Police Information & Communication System (PICS) Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has been granted for the establishment of a Police Information & Communication System (PICS) for the Sri Lanka Police. The project has been designed to be implemented from the year 2018 with the use of modern technology and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, for the first phase to be implemented as a pilot project to cover the Western Province and based on its success the second phase of it covering the whole country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Achieving victory through Dope Free Sports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body: - Due to the high level of competition and commercialization, it is observed that  athletes, presently, have a tendency to make use of nutritional supplements containing drugs with or without their knowledge. Since the adverse effects of these are likely to surface during the up coming international competitions, the necessary measures should be taken to prevent such situation. Therefore, it is appropriate to make aware of the athletes of National and School level, their parents, coaches and the Sports Managers as well of the prohibited substances and the preventive methods. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to implement an awareness programme to promote a dope free sport protecting the lively spirit of sports and to allocate  funds required for the provision of facilities to carry out the dope control programmes in Sri Lanka creating awareness of prohibited substances and preventive methods, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining consultancy services for the development of the Ministry of Sports and the institutions coming under the Ministry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- Presently, the Ministry of Sports and other institutions coming under it obtains consultancy services for various development work of the Ministry and the institutions coming under the Ministry from the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB). However, it has been observed that it is desirable to obtain the services of other public institutions as well, in order to carry out the projects and the development work of the Ministry more efficiently.

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to obtain the Consultancy Services required for construction and development activities of the Ministry and the institutions coming under the Ministry for development work, from the Government/Semi Government institutions such as the State Engineering Corporation, the Urban Development Authority, the Buildings Department, the Government Universities, the State Development & Construction Corporation, the Land Reclamation and Development Corporation of Sri Lanka and the Tri Forces inclusive of the CECB, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulation of a methodology to regulate, license fees and other fees levied by the local authorities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- Complaints have been received to the effect that the General Public has to face various difficulties in situations when the Local Authority Institutions levy the Assessment Tax fees pertaining to the lands and buildings located within their respective areas of authority and providing certain services, due to the absence of a common policy on determining the rates of charges.  It has been observed that the application fees for the purposes of amending the names given in the Assessment Register, for submitting Building Plot Development Plans, for the issuance of  Compliance Certificates, for the charges made for Telecommunication Towers, the fees charged for licensing of business premises and assessment tax in certain instances are determined without any justifiable basis.
Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to appoint an Officials' Committee chaired by the Secretary to his Ministry, to make a review on various taxes and fees levied by the Local Authorities at national level, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Diagnosis of poultry and fish disease at the Veterinary Investigation Centres (VIC) and upgrading the surveillance facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- There has been a higher growth in the poultry, shrimp and ornamental fish  industries during the past few years and the shrimp and ornamental fish industries have become the significant sectors generating foreign exchange. It has become a timely need to control the outbreak of various diseases in these fields, to diagnose the diseases and to establish facilities for responding to same expeditiously.

As such, with a view to contributing to the development of those industries, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to enhance the laboratory facilities at the Veterinary Investigation Centres (VIC) at Wariyapola, Chilaw and Welisara, to diagnose the diseases and for surveillance, in accordance with the international standards, was approved by the Cabinet.  It was further decided to prepare a programme with the collaboration of the Ministry of  Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to provide specialized training in the curative process of the diseases for the veterinary surgeons serving in the centres.

description: Sale of Houses of the Multi Storey Housing Complex constructed newly at Angoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- A Condominium Apartment Complex with 500 housing units is being constructed in a block of land 05 acres in extent, for the purpose of resettling the low income families in the city of Colombo under the 'Urban Regeneration Project (URP)' and its construction work is nearing completion.  However, due to various reasons, practical difficulties have cropped up in resettling of the low income families residing in the city of Colombo, in the areas outside the Colombo city limits.  

	Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to call for applications by way of paper advertisements and sell these housing units valued at an amount between Rs.4-5 million each, to the groups of lower middle income public officers and the Members of the Tri Forces, Artists, Small and Medium Scale Entrepreneurs and Civil Activists, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Excise Ordinance to prevent the production of artificial toddy including other illicit productions of toddy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- Provision had been incorporated in the Excise Ordinance, for the requirement of a valid license to tap a toddy producing tree or to draw toddy from any toddy producing tree. However, with the amendments made subsequently to the said Ordinance, tapping or drawing toddy from Kithul, Palmyrah and Coconut trees have been exempted from the requirement of obtaining a license. It has resulted in  problems related to monitoring the volume of toddy received by Distilleries, toddy taverns, bottled toddy manufactories and viniger manufactories and also a reason for the increase of other illicit toddy productions including artificial toddy.

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to amend the Excise Ordinance declaring it mandatory  to obtain a license to tap or draw toddy from any other type of tree other than Kithul in order to regulate supervision of toddy production and to publish the draft Excise (Amendment) Bill, prepared accordingly, in the government Gazette and to present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commemorating the 'National Science Day' and the 'National Science Week' in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- The 'World Science Day' is celebrated every year on the 10th of November in order to highlight the importance of science for the society and the role of science in peace and development. Attention has been drawn to celebrate the 'National Science Day' and the 'National Science Week' in Sri Lanka as well to coincide with the event.

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to declare 10th of November 2017 every year as the 'National Science Day', prioritizing different programmes aimed at promoting science and technology, inclusive of the creation of public awareness and empowerment, on the role of science for a sustainable society in relation to achieving Sustainable Development Goals and to declare the week commencing from that date as the 'National Science Week', was approved by the cabinet.

description: Appropriate Technology Development and Intellectual Property (IP) sharing project (2017) in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- Appropriate Technology categorized in a place in between high and low levels of technology is an efficient cost effective solution for the developing countries for the upliftment of the living standards of the people and to liberate them from poverty.  A project on the appropriate technology development for the improvement of the living standards of the people of the developing countries on intellectual property sharing is implemented by the Intellectual Property Office of the Republic of South Korea (KIPO) and the Korean Innovative Promotional Association (KIPA).

	Under this project, a  proposal has been made to produce a Coconut Oil Extractor suitable to the country with the use of coconut residue and to implement a project to improve the brands related to the industry. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding for the implementation of the Appropriate Technology Project between the relevant institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Empowerment of the economy through Mechatronics enabled Development Initiative (MEDI)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- Mechatronic Engineering has a promising place within the economy of the developed as well as the developing countries. Experiences in other countries have revealed that returns on investment in the Mechatronic Sector is  more than 15 times of the other investments. With the development of this field in Sri Lanka benefits such as, enhancing higher technological exports, minimizing the expenditure on importation by creating high techno equipment which could be used in the production industry in Sri Lanka and generating high paying job opportunities for the well trained youth of Sri Lanka could be accrued.

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to establish a  Product Design Engineering and Manufacturing Park for the Companies dealing with Mechatronics within the premises of the Sri Lanka Institute of  Nanotechnology in Pitipana, Homagama and to vest its managerial functions with the National Engineering Research and Development Centre (NERDC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Integrated Solid Waste Management Project to be implemented in the Gampaha District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- Providing adequate facilities and a proper mechanism to the local authority institutions for solid waste management has become a timely need.  It has been identified that it is appropriate to provide solutions for the purpose through a proper system implemented at District level. In this connection, a proposal has been made to construct a sanitary land fill for the Gampaha District where more urbanized solid waste is collected due to the dense population and the rapid industrialization taking place. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement a project for the establishment of a sanitary land fill and a carbonic fertilizer production yard by the Central Environmental Authority at a cost of Rs.989 million for the formal management of the solid waste collected by all local authorities of the Gampaha District, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Compliance with the Kigali Amendment made to the Montreal Protocol by Sri Lanka for the gradual Phase down of the Hydroflurocarbons (HFC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-10
decision_details_body:
- The Montreal Protocol was formed by the world community in the year 1987 for the purpose of regulating the use of chemicals which cause damages to the Orzone Layer and the gradual phase down of the same. Sri Lanka is a party to the Protocol and has demonstrated commitment to the amendments made to the protocol from time to time. The last amendment to the Montreal Protocol was made in Kigali, Rwanda, on the 15th of October, 2016 and by this amendment all parties have agreed to control the global warming by the gradual phase down of the use of refrigerants like Hydroflurocarbons which contribute to global warming, by the year 2050.

	Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to ratify the Kigali Amendment by Sri Lanka considering the fact that Sri Lanka has already commenced the necessary activities and awareness to limit the use of Hydroflurocarbons in a manner avoiding an impact on the industrial sector and the economy of Sri Lanka and to present it in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Title/Tenure Regularization and Cadastral Registry Modernization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- Surveying and mapping of around 2.5 million allotments of lands alienated to the public by the government for residential, agricultural and other purposes without formal survey plans and the issuance of title certificates with clear survey plans for private blocks of lands islandwide have become a timely need.   In this context, the process of surveying and issuing title certificates needs to be modernized by adopting the technical and professional methodologies used by the developed countries. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms, to authorize the Department of External Resources to negotiate the matters in the project proposal presented by the Trimble Inc. of the United States of America to carry out the said modernization process and to commence a pilot project to examine the technical feasibility prior to initiating the main project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Operation of Indo-Lanka Ferry Service between Colombo and Tuticorin
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - By initiating the Ferry Services between Sri Lanka and India, it will be possible to establish a close relationship between the people of the two countries, uplift cultural and economic relations and promote trade, tourism and new employment opportunities. Even though the Expressions of Interest (EoI) were accordingly called to operate the project for the passenger ferry service between Colombo and Tuticorin, sufficient responses have not been received for this purpose.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to cancel the existing procurement procedure pertaining to this project, re-tender and select a suitable investor, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer required for the Government Fertilizer Companies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to purchase the required 18,000 MT of Urea and 3,000 MT of Triple Super Phosphate (TSP) by Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited (Lak Pohora) and Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Company Limited (Commercial Fertilizer) operating under the Ministry of Agriculture, from M/s. Quantum Fertilizers Ltd. and M/s. Haiyork Holding Ltd., as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 100 MW of supplementary power to ensure uninterrupted 	power supply in the Island
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - Due to the decline of anticipated rain during the monsoons of  last year and this year, the water level in the reservoirs associated with hydro power stations has gone down. In this context, it has been decided to add 100 MW of supplementary supply of power for the period of next 06 months from October 2017, to the National Grid. The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to select a suitable supplier to purchase electricity generators on lease basis, by calling for  International competitive bids through a short term purchase agreement,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Technical Assistance for implementation of the Sanitation and Hygiene Initiative for Towns (SHIFT) 	Project in the Southern and Western Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - Sanitation and Hygiene Initiative for Towns (SHIFT) Project is implemented in the Southern and Western Provinces in Sri Lanka, with the objective of enhancing sewerage services in Negambo, Galle and Kelaniya areas and upgrading the capacity for the management of large scale sewerage systems operated by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board. The proposal made  by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for granting the relevant technical assistance to the Project Management Unit of the said project, to M/s. Egis Eau for a sum of Euro 01 million and Rs5.8 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of contract for Phase 1 of the Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - The Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project is being implemented considering the necessity of providing safe drinking water to the people living in the Anuradhapura District and specially to the areas where the kidney disease is prevalent.  The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for the supply of pipes and the required equipment necessary for Phase 1 of the Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project to the Joint Venture of M/s. Nagarjuna Construction Company Ltd., and M/s. Sierra Construction (Pvt) Ltd., for a sum of Yen 1,197.46 million and LKR 1,275.75 million, without VAT,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Oil and Lubricant for the Sri Lanka Transport Board buses
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the procurement of Oil and Lubricant for the Sri Lanka Transport Board buses to the M/s. Lanka IOC PLC and M/s. Chevron Lubricant Lanka PLC, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relocation of the Emigration area at the Passenger Terminal Building of the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) in Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - With a view to providing a more efficient service to the air passengers, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the relocation of the Emigration Area at the Passenger Terminal Building of the BIA in Katunayake to M/s. R.N. Constructions (Pvt) Ltd. for a sum of Rs. 472.5 million, without VAT, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kandy Mahaiyawa Urban Housing Project (KMUHP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- Around 1,220 families reside in the Mahaiyawa settlement, scattered in an area of around 12 acres within the Kandy Municipal Council limits. The 'Kandy Mahaiyawa Urban Housing Project' has been planned to be implemented, with a view to providing housing solutions and enhancing the living standards of those families living amidst social, economic and health issues due to unplanned irregular constructions.  

Accordingly, it has been proposed to construct 1,220 condominium apartments as a Joint Project with the Kandy City Development Programme, under two phases. As such, the joint proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Special Assignments, Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction and Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to vest the lands required for the purpose with the Urban Development Authority (UDA) and to provide the title deeds of the housing units to be constructed under this project on gratis basis to the beneficiaries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement on Economic Cooperation between Sri Lanka and Hungary
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- Hungary, as a Central European country, has succeeded in showing significant performance in its foreign trade during the past decade and Sri Lanka will be able to expand its market to the countries of the European Union (EU) by strengthening its economic cooperation with Hungary.  
As such, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, with a view to increasing investments and enhancing the economic and technical cooperation, to enter into an Agreement on Economic Cooperation between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Digitizing the Economy: 2016-2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - Under the project of 'digitizing the economy' the Government has focused its attention on the rapid development of the digital infrastructure and connectivity and this will improve the quality of the supply of public services.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to implement 27 projects within the budgetary provisions of the year 2017, in compliance with the development strategies implemented by the Information and Communication Technology Agency (ICTA) of Sri Lanka, during the period of 2016 - 2019, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Community based Sports Development for the control of the spreading of Non Communicable Diseases in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- The risk of contacting non‑communicable diseases has increased considerably due to unhealthy food practices, use of tobacco and alcohol and physical inactivity. Especially, the individuals who do not engage in physical exercises have become highly prone to heart diseases. Surveys have revealed that  diseases such as diabetes and cancer can be prevented by engaging more in  physical exercises and getting accustomed to healthy foods. 

By promoting sports among the general public, it would be possible to provide them with more opportunities to engage in physical activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to implement a project for the community based sports development, with a view to increasing the ratio of the community engaged in physical activities by 10% within the next three years, was approved in principle by the Cabinet.

description: Sports Re-engineering Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- The sports re-engineering project was implemented during the period from 2013 - 2017 with the intention of offering a systematic training for the sportsmen and sportswomen focusing on international competitions and offering scientific training from foreign specialized coaches to the local sports coaches in Sri Lanka. This has immensely helped to enhance the skills of the sportsmen and sportswomen in all the Provinces and the knowledge of the trainers by obtaining the services of foreign coaches. 
	The Commonwealth Games and the Asian Games are scheduled to be held in the year 2018 and the South Asian Games and the Olympic Games in the year 2020. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to extend the period of the sports re-engineering project for a further period of 05 years from the year 2018 up to the year 2022 with view to providing the formal training necessary for the junior level sportsmen and women of the country for these competitions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and Poland for the promotion of sports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and Poland for the development and promotion of sports with a view to strengthening the cooperation between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding  (MoU) on Migrant Labour Cooperation to be signed between Sri Lanka and the United Arab Emirates
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - New laws have been formulated by the United Arab Emirates pertaining to the exchange of information on the domestic migrant workers using modern technology when recruiting such workers for employment and the conduct of recruitments in a clear and transparent manner. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice, to enter into a new Memorandum of Understanding on Migrant Labour Cooperation between Sri lanka and the United Arab Emirates, to deploy   Sri Lankan Migrant workers in compliance with the said law and to provide protection to the Sri Lankan Migrant workers from human trafficking and human smuggling, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Importation of 100 Boer Goats to the Department of Animal Production and Health
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - Concurrent with the decline of beef consumption in the country, the demand for mutton consumption has gone up due to the promotion of tourism as well as various social reasons. However, the mutton production in the country is not sufficient to meet the local demand. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to import 100 Boer Goats including 90 females and 10 males by the Department of Animal Production and Health for the purpose of crossbreeding goats and supply of Boer stud goats to commercial farms, with a view to increasing the mutton production, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of New Court Buildings
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- The necessary measures are being taken by the Government to make the administration of Justice expeditious and efficient. With a view to providing a better service to the general public, it has been planned to improve the infrastructure facilities in the court houses which are presently maintained in old buildings with inadequate facilities. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice, to implement a project for providing new building facilities to the Circuit Magistrate's Courts in Kahatagasdigiliya and Medawachchiya, District/Magistrate's Court in Walasmulla, High Court in Matale and the Civil Appellate High Court in Kalmunai, at an estimated cost of Rs.491 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Trust Ordinance,
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval to expand the scope of the Trust Ordinance by amending same, in order to comply with the international standards for the minimization of money laundering and reduction of the risk of terrorist financing.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice, to publish the Trust (Amendment) Bill prepared for the purpose, in the Government Gazette and present the same subsequently in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Commercial Mediation Centre of Sri Lanka Act, No.44 of 2000
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- The Commercial Mediation Centre of Sri Lanka Act, No.44 of 2000 provides for the establishment of a Commercial Mediation Centre in Sri Lanka.  There is a Board of Management for the administration and management of the affairs of the said Commercial Mediation Centre and the members are appointed to the Board to represent the relevant fields. 

It has been proposed to amend the composition of the Commercial Mediation Centre of Sri Lanka, in order to enhance its performance by strengthening the coordination with the Line Agencies and representatives.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice, to publish the Commercial Mediation Centre of Sri Lanka (Amendment) Bill which has been prepared to make provisions for the purpose, in the Government Gazette and submit the same subsequently, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the religious places damaged due to the earthquake in Nepal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- Sri Lanka provides its sponsorship for the renovation work of the Ananda Kuti Maha Viharaya in Swayamboonath and the Ratho Machchindranath Hindu Kovil damaged due to the earthquake that occurred in Nepal in the year 2015 and the construction work is being carried out at the moment. 

The cost of Rs.345 million for the renovation activities has increased due to the amendments subsequently made to the preliminary plan pertaining to such activities.  As such, the joint proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena and Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to allocate the additional allocation of Rs.105 million to cover the additional cost, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Irrigation Development Plan for the Lanka Sugar Company in Pelwatta
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- The Pelwatta Sugar Company, which is a company affiliated to the Government, performs a very important function in the economy of the Uva Province producing around 10% of the total sugar requirement of the country. Most of the lands where sugar cane is cultivated for the purpose of sugar production of the Company fall within the rain fed areas and due to the low sugar cane yield as a result of the scarcity of water, the production activities of the company have been adversely affected. 

As such, a proposal has been made for the implementation of an irrigational development project, covering the sugar cane planting areas related to the Pelawatta sugar company, with the financial inputs of the Government and the Company to enhance sugar production while also promoting the yield of the sugar cane planting lands. Under this project, it is due to renovate 13 small tanks and the existing streams and plans have been designed to construct new supply canals, rainwater harvesting ponds and tube wells. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to implement this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Fisheries (Regulation of Foreign Fishing Boats) Act, No.59 of 1979
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- The Fisheries (Regulation of Foreign Fishing Boats) Act, No.59 of 1979 provides for the regulation, control and management of fishing and related activities by foreign boats in  Sri Lankan waters. Taking into consideration the changes that had taken place pertaining to this field internationally and regionally during the past  3 decades, the Cabinet has granted approval to make the necessary amendments to the Act. 



	As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development to publish Fisheries (Regulation of Foreign Fishing Boats) (Amendment) Bill in the Government Gazette prepared accordingly and subsequently, present the same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The development of the Tangalle Fishery Harbour as a Multipurpose Fishery Harbour Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to develop the Tangalle Fishery Harbour as a Multipurpose Fishery Harbour Complex	used for fishery, tourism and commercial purposes. The HAE CHUN Co. LTD of the Republic of South Korea has agreed to prepare the relevant feasibility report and the design free of charge. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with the said company for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting the fishery anchorages with the Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- About 48 anchorages are operating in the coastal stretch in this country and  these anchorages, provide facilities for approximately 27,000 fishing boats engaged in coastal fishing. These anchorages need to be improved with advanced facilities for unloading and auctioning fish and the capacity of utilizing the post harvest technology, in order to create new economic opportunities, encourage investments and enhance the productivity of coastal fishing. A proper management structure needs to be established in respect of the anchorages under the supervision of the Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources, for the purpose. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to vest the responsibility of management, regulation, maintenance and development of the anchorages, with the Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation which is equipped with sufficient physical and human resources for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocating a plot of land at Perahera Mawatha, Colombo-03 to Dharmakeerthi Aramaya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to allocate a plot of land in extent of 19.7 perches, belonging to the Urban Development Authority, located at Perahera Mawatha, Colombo 03, to the Dayaka Sabhawa of Dharmakeerthi Aramaya as a free grant to construct an access road to the temple, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining sea sand for the Colombo Port City Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- It has been observed that the remaining sand in the pit reserved for the completion of reclamation activities of the Colombo Port City Development Project, is not sufficient to complete the said task. A further 40 million m3 cubes of sand is required for the purpose and it is possible for the said quantum to be obtained from the sea sand pit reserved for the purposes of the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation. 

According to the Tripartite Agreement related to the project, the Government of Sri Lanka is committed to supplying the sand required for the project free of charge. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to supply the required quantum of sand, subject to US$ 2 million being paid as a lump-sum as  administrative and other costs to the the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation by the Colombo Port City Project Company,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of 18 additional Urban Development Projects in the year 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval for 39 projects exceeding the value of Rs.20 million which have been planned to be carried out by the Urban Development Authority (UDA) utilizing the provisions allocated by the General Treasury to the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development under Budget 2017.  18 other projects have been identified to be implemented by the UDA in the year 2017 itself by utilizing the balance provisions available and the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement those projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the Gazette Notification on Reduction of Excise Duty on Mini Trucks, Single Cabs and Motor Bicycles, in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- The Government has taken measures to reduce the Excise Duty on the import of Mini Trucks and Single Cabs by Rs.300,000/- per vehicle, in order to support the small and medium scale business enterprises and to create market opportunities for motor bicycles of high quality by removing the ad-valorem rate on motor bicycles with an engine capacity less than 150 cc, to be effective from 2017.08.18.  

Accordingly, in order to make provision for same, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to present the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No. 2032/31 of 2017‑08‑17, published under section 3 of the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No.13 of 1989, in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Creating public awareness regarding the Economic Development Process   of the Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - The Eight (08)  Subsidy Loan Schemes called 'Ran Aswenna', 'Gowi Navoda', 'Riya Shakthi', 'Riwi Bala Sawi', 'Diri Sawiya', 'Jaya Isuru', 'Madya Aruna' and 'Sonduru Piyasa' introduced under the 2017 budget proposals, focusing on farmers, entrepreneurs, small and medium scale industrialists and self‑employed persons, are being successfully implemented at present. The Cabinet took note of the information submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media to the effect that the loan facilities amounting to Rs.6,517 million have been disbursed among 1,266 beneficiaries through the Government and the Private Banks by 2017.09.15 under these loan schemes,

description: Introduction of Statement of Corporate Intent (SCI) for State Owned Enterprises
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- Approximately 400 State Owned Enterprises (SOE) engaged in both 'Commercial' and 'Non‑Commercial' activities are operating in the country. Out of these, 55 State Owned Enterprises that generate income by engaging in commercial activities have been categorized as 'State Owned Business Enterprises - SOBEs' considering their importance. Therefore,  it has been decided to introduce a Statement of Corporate Intent (SCI) as a management tool to improve the annual performance of the SOEs. Accordingly, having selected five (5) extremely important SOE's required to operate with high efficiency in the economy, Statements of Corporate Intent (SCI) have already been signed with the said institutions. 

It is necessary to Introduce the  SCI for other SOE's as well, with a view to improving the contribution made by the SOE's for the growth of the economy and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to enter into SCI with another 10 SOE's, effective from the year 2018,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading of the Sewerage Systems in the Base Hospital, Kantale and the Base Hospital, Kalmunai North
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- Concurrent to the upgrading of Patient care services, it is essential to upgrade the Utility services in the hospitals as well. Disposal of waste water from hospitals to the environment without a proper management results in creating grave environmental issues. Taking the above into consideration, the Government is taking action to upgrade the sewerage systems in hospitals.

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to establish a sewerage system for the Base Hospital, Kanthale at an estimated cost of Rs.103.5 million and to construct a sewerage treatment plant in the Base Hospital, Kalmunai North at an estimated cost of Rs.95 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Streamlining of the disaster relief services and the Build Back Process
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- The special attention of the Government has been drawn with regard to prior preparedness and the enhancement of the capability for emergency response in view of the unpredictable whether conditions, continuous natural disasters and the increase in the number of people affected as a result.  


	For this purpose, it is essential to formulate a disaster relief management procedure with a well coordinated and a collaborative approach,  minimizing the existing shortcomings in the present relief management mechanism. As such, Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, apprised the Cabinet that the task of preparing the guidelines for the purpose with the collaboration of the Food Programme of the United Nations and the Development Programme of the United Nations is being carried out by the Ministry of Disaster Management.

description: Presenting the National Emergency Operation Plan for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- The necessity for a systematic approach has been identified for search, rescue and relief operations in disaster situations to avoid duplication of relief efforts and streamline the collection and distribution of food and essential items by public and private sector organizations, non‑governmental organizations and  mass media organizations. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, to implement the National Emergency Operation Plan to counter any National Emergency Disaster Situation and ensure the safety of lives, with the proper coordination of all government, private sector and mass media institutions,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Action Plan  for the implementation of the related programmes for disaster risk reduction
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- The objective of the Government is to ensure the safety of Sri Lanka by the implementation of more extensive disaster management programmes to reduce  the disaster risks and impacts on the people, properties and the economy. For this purpose, action is being taken by the Government to prepare disaster reduction strategies by targeting the priority actions of understanding disaster risk, disaster risk governance, investing in disaster risk reduction and disaster preparedness and the use of build back better concepts in preparedness and  rehabilitation programmes. 

	Accordingly, Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, presented to the Cabinet, the National Action Plan for the implementation of the programmes for disaster risk reduction, and the Cabinet took note of same.

description: Improvement of the Kelani Valley Railway Line and the Main Railway Line
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- The pre-feasibility study of the proposed Colombo Suburban Railway Project to be implemented to improve the existing railway network, to cater to the demand for railway services by the year 2035 has by now been completed. Through this, plans have been designed for the implementation of a number of development activities pertaining to the Main, Kelani Vally, the Coastal and the Puttalam Railway Lines. 

In this regard, it has been decided to take action in accordance with the  accepted policies of social security with regard to the persons affected due to the railway  reservations being used for these development purposes. Towards this end, action is being taken to conduct social economic surveys and by now the socio economic survey pertaining to the section from Maradana to Homagama in the Kelani Velly line has been completed. With a view to implementing this project expeditiously, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to conduct the socio-economic survey in respect of the section from Homagama to Avissawella in the Kelani Velly line and from Maradana to Rambukkana in the Main Line with the assistance of the  UN Habitat programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Emergency pre-hospital care ambulance service in Sri Lanka and the '1990 Suwaseriya Foundation'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body:
- The validity period of the Memorandum of  Understanding between the GVK EMRI Lanka (Pvt) Ltd. and the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine relating to the implementation of the '1990 Suwaseriya Emergency Pre-hospital Care Ambulance Service' which is successfully established in the Western and the Southern Provinces, is due to expire on the 31st of December, 2017. It has been proposed to implement this Ambulance Service to cover all the Provinces in Sri Lanka. 

	As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to establish a Foundation known as the '1990 Suwaseriya Foundation'  fully owned by the Government of Sri Lanka, by an Act of Parliament to ensure its uninterrupted operational and administrative functions, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Action Plan 2017 - 2021 on National Human Rights
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-10-03
decision_details_body: - The formulation of the National Human Rights Action Plan 2017 - 2021 has been finalized as per the specific guidelines under the guidance of the Cabinet of Ministers. The Cabinet took note of the National Action Plan submitted by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, and noted that an Officials' Committee will be established for reporting its progress periodically and that an Inter‑Ministerial meeting will be convened to review the progress of its implementation.

description: National Food Production Drive
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- National Food Production programme initiated with the major objectives of   limiting the  import foods having made maximizing the food production in the country and thereby achieving self-sufficiency in food requirement has  received set-backs due to the adverse weather condition prevailed during the last few cultivation seasons. In order to overcome the situation a speed programme named 'National Food Production Drive' has been planned to commence the food production for the 'Maha' Season 2017 - 2018 with a new outlook in collaboration with all Governmental and Non-Governmental Organizations, Farmers community  and Public sector. 

H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, briefed the Cabinet of Ministers of the Circular instructions issued by the Secretary to the President outlining that special activities  to be  launched  island wide from 06th to 12th October 2017 which is the inaugural week of the Food Production programme, enabling  the participation and the attention of all stakeholders in order to ensure the success of the programme.

description: Rectifying the shortcomings in the Report of the Local Authorities Delimitation Appeals Review Committee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- The Election Commission has pointed out the printing errors in the names and numbers of some Grama Niladhari Divisions, the number of members in the Wards of Local Authorities, issues relative to boundaries, printing and spelling mistakes pertaining certain Local Authorities as shortcomings, in the Gazette Notifications published in accordance with the recommendations of the National Committee on Delimitation. 

	As such, it is essential to rectify the shortcomings pertaining to boundary issues and publish an amended Gazette Notification in order to hold the Elections of Local Authorities expeditiously. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to appoint an Officials' Committee in terms of the provisions of the Local Authority Elections Ordinance to examine this matter and submit recommendations within two (02) weeks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-calling of Nominations of the Pudukuduirippu and the Maritimepattu Pradeshiya Sabas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - The Local Authority Elections to be held in respect of the Pudukuduirippu and Maritimepattu Pradeshiya Sabas of the Mullaitivu District, in the Northern Province on 17‑03‑2011 had to be postponed due to various reasons and as such, legislative provisions have to be made, to enable the cancellation of  the nominations which had been called for, calling fresh nominations and for holding fresh elections under the new electoral system. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to publish the Draft Bill on Local Authorities (Special Provisions) in the Government Gazette  and subsequently present it in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Integrated Road Investment Programme - (Phase 4)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - A sum of US$ 168 million will be expended for the implementation of Phase 4 of the Integrated Road Investment Programme initiated and now being implemented with the objective of providing a better connectivity between the rural communities and the Socio‑Economic Centres. Out of this sum, a US$ 150 million is due to be obtained from the Regular Ordinary Capital Resources Fund of the Asian Development Bank. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to authorize the Ministry of Finance and Mass Media to conduct negotiations and enter into a loan Agreement regarding the relevant loan assistance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing  Training on Modern Dairy Farming practices for Veterinary Surgeons engaged in the Livestock Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - During the past years, the local dairy farming has achieved a significant progress and along with it, the demand for trained expertise knowledge in this sector has also increased. As such, it has been proposed to provide special training on modern dairy farming practices and technical and research  methods required for the veterinary surgeons engaged in the livestock sector in the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Belarusian State Agrarian Technical University and the Government of Sri Lanka, to provide training for 10 veterinary surgeons engaged in the dairy extension services in the said University, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the proposed Police Mess and Barracks building at Mirihana in Nugegoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - The initial construction work up to the 3rd floor of the six storey building  proposed to be constructed for the Police Mess and Barracks in the Mirihana area in Nugegoda has been completed in the year 2008. Bids have been called to select a suitable contractor to complete the balance construction work of the building and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to award the contract to M/s. Sripalie Contractors (Pvt) Ltd., the lowest substantially responsive bidder for a sum of Rs.340.6 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project of the Hambantota LPG Filling Plant of Litro Gas Lanka Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - The Litro Gas Lanka Ltd. has planned to install a  LPG Cylinder Filling Plant facility at the Gas Stores Terminal with the objective of granting cost benefits to the customers in the Districts of Hambantota, Ampara, Moneragala, Batticaloa, Badulla, Matara and Ratnapura. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Public Enterprise Development, to award the contract for the construction of the  plant to M/s. Dockyard General Engineering Services (Pvt) Ltd., the lowest substantially responsive bidder for a sum of Rs.647.2 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of the contract for the supply and distribution of the Aerial Bundle Conductors
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - The Ceylon Electricity Board procures the required items separately for the distribution regions for the maintenance activities pertaining to the distribution and new electricity connections. Accordingly, competitive bids have been called for, for the supply and distribution of aerial bundle conductors to a length of  (ABC) 3x70+54.6 sqmm (4 core)- 700 km for the four (04) distribution regions. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for the said supply and distribution to M/s. Sierra Cables PLC         Ltd., the lowest substantially responsive bidder for a sum of Rs.363.7 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of access roads, drains and street lights of the housing complex in the Victoria Estate, Norochcholai, Puttalam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for the construction of the access roads, drains and street lights of the housing complex in the Victoria Estate, Norochcholai, Puttalam under Phase II of the Lakvijaya Power Station to M/s. Sierra Construction (Pvt) Ltd., the lowest substantially responsive bidder for a sum of Rs.332.7 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Construction of a Student Hostel, a Canteen and a Workshop for the University of Vocational Technology  (UNIVOTEC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval to construct a Student Hostel, a Canteen and a Workshop for the University of Vocational Technology. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Chandima Weerakkody, the Minister of  Skills Development and Vocational Training, to award the contract for the consultancy services required for the construction to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Ayurveda Research Hospital on Non?Communicable Diseases at Ninthavur in the Ampara District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the construction of the proposed  Ayurveda Research Hospital on Non‑Communicable Diseases at Ninthavur in the Ampara District to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Faculty of Nursing
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - It has been decided to commence a special Faculty of Nursing to train a greater number of nursing officers and assign them over to the health services as graduates to provide an optimal service by improving the qualitative aspect of the services of the nursing officers of Sri Lanka.
