The plans necessary for the purpose have been designed with the concurrence of the Ministry of Higher Education and Highways and the University Grants Commission.  Accordingly, it has been planned to construct the proposed Faculty of Nursing at the premises of the Sri Jayawardenapura Nursing School and the main student hostal building complex at the premises of the Colombo East Base Hospital situated at Mulleriyawa. As such, 	the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contracts of the relevant construction to the State Engineering Corporation and the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The New Bridge Construction Project over the Kelani river -  Award of the contract for the construction of the Steel bridge section
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - Bids have been called from the local and international contractors for the construction of the Steel Bridge Section to be constructed under Package I of the New Bridge Construction Project over the Kelani river.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for the construction of the said steel bridge section to the JMT Joint Venture of Japan comprising of M/s. JFE Engineering Corporation, Mitsui Engineering & Shipbuilding Co. Ltd. and M/s. TODA Corporation for a sum of Rs.31,539 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the  Kaduwela - Athurugiriya Road and the Walgama - Athurugiriya Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to improve and rehabilitate the road section from  starting point to 9.5 km on the Kaduwela - Athurugiriya (B 174) and the  road section from starting point to 1.2 km (B 451) on the Walgama - Athurugiriya, utilizing a part of the loan received from the OPEC Fund for International Development (OFID) for the Western Province Road Development Project.  Accordingly, Bids have been called for the said construction work and  the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for the improvement and rehabilitation of the said road sections to M/s. Hovael Construction (Pvt) Ltd., the lowest substantially responsive bidder, for a sum of Rs.1,065 million, in accordance with the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeals Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the consultancy services for Designing of Bridges and Railway Lines from the Maradana Railway Station up to Maligawatte
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - 'The Colombo - Suburban Railway Project' will be implemented to cater to the demand of railway services by the year 2035 focusing attention on the development associated with Colombo and Suburban area of the railway network of Sri Lanka. The pre-feasibility  study of the project has been completed by now and is planned to construct of four (04) new railway lines from Maradana to Maligawatta has been recommended as a short term development proposal. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to obtain the consultancy services required to lay the new rail line, to widen the bridge at the school lane at Maligawatta and the pedestrian bridge at Maradana from the Road Development Authority along with the assistance of the experts of the Department of Railways, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Eviction of encroachers in the land of the Kandy Hospital by providing housing facilities for the  Development of the General Hospital of Kandy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - The Kandy Teaching Hospital with 2,402 beds is the second largest hospital in Sri Lanka.  The limitation of space has become a major obstacle for the future development activities of this hospital which provides treatment to around 1,600,000 patients annually. Although the extent of land belonging to the hospital is 58.4 acres and as a result of an extent of 23.7 acres being occupied by the encroachers, the development of facilities within the premises have been hampered. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Special Assignments,Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, the Minister of Social Empowerment, Welfare and Kandyan Heritage, Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, for reacquisition of the said land required to carry out the development activities to be conducted under the Kandy Teaching Hospital development plan  and to construct a housing complex comprising of 66 houses in a separate area within hospital  land for the low income earning unauthorized settlers affected by the decision to evict such settlers and  allocate houses to  them, utilizing the provisions to be allocated to the Ministry for the year 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the 2nd Phase of the new building of the National Sports Museum
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- Activities pertaining to the establishment of the 'National Sports Museum' is in progress at the Independence Square in Colombo 07 with a view to conserving and exhibiting the sports related information and memorabilia of historic value.  This Museum will be provided with the galleries necessary to include the history of National Sports Associations, a data base of sports, records, live size vax statues of elite sportsmen/women who gained success at the international competitions. 

This museum is scheduled to be opened in December 2017 and as such, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to obtain Treasury Allocations for the construction activities pertaining to its  2nd phase, for fixing interior decor and electronic equipment etc. and to obtain the past information related to sports like, films, TV programmes, photographs and documents from the relevant government institutions, to be preserved in the museum,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Construction of the Human Performance Laboratory
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- For the purpose of achieving international success in sports, inherent talents and traditional training methods alone will not suffice but the use of modern technology and correct and updated training methods and dynamics are also essential.  In the international sports arena, the developed countries use the facilities of 'Human Performance Laboratories' which analyze the human motion and the structural shortcomings in order to keep the skills of the sportsmen/women at an optimal level by preventing sports injuries.  

The construction of such a Human Performance Laboratory has commenced in Sri Lanka as well and the activities pertaining to it will be completed this year.  This laboratory will provide immense assistance to keep the skills of the  sportsmen/women at an optimal level.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to purchase the high tech  equipment needed for the laboratory and to commence activities to secure the  consultancy services of experts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Pradeshiya Sabhas Act for the provision of welfare facilities to the Plantation Community
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval to make amendments to the relevant provisions of the Pradeshiya Sabhas Act, No.15 of 1987 to enable the use of funds of the Pradeshiya Sabhas for the supply of the common amenities necessary for the plantation community. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government to publish the draft Bill (Amendment) prepared accordingly in the Government Gazette, to seek the views of the Provincial Councils in respect of  the said draft Bill and subsequently, present it in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of two new National Schools within the Municipal limits of Kurunegala and in the Wariyapola Town
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
-  There are 09 National Sinhala Medium Schools within the Municipal limits of Kurunegala and although 5,228 application had been received in the year 2016 for admission of children to year 01, it is only a number of 1,425 students who could be admitted to them. Similarly, there is only 01 National School in the Wariyapola town and out of the 503 applications received for the year 2016 for admission of children to year 01, only 240 applicants could be provided with the opportunity. 



	Taking these circumstances into consideration, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to establish  02 new National mixed Schools for girls and boys in the Kurunegala  and Wariyapola electorates, consisting all facilities was approved by the Cabinet. Further, the Cabinet also decided that a National Policy should be formulated on the establishment of National Schools.

description: Increasing of the daily food allowance paid to the student teachers undergoing training at the National Colleges of Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - There are 19 National Colleges of Education in the country for the purpose of training teachers required for schools and at present there are 12,558 resident student teachers undergoing training. These student teachers during the period of their residential training are paid a monthly allowance of Rs.3,500/- and it would be appropriate to increase the said allowance to meet  the present day trends. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to increase the monthly allowance up to Rs.5,000/-  and to grant this allowance to  the entire training period of 03 years including the internship as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No.2 of 2013 (Rights of Detainees - Access to Legal Counsel)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- Approval of the Cabinet was granted previously to publish the draft Bill submitted to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No.2 of 2013 to ensure the right of a detainee in custody to access the services of a Legal Counsel   in the Government Gazette and to present it in Parliament for approval. Further, approval was also granted to present the amendments proposed in respect of the draft Bill at the Committee Stage in Parliament.  

	Prior to resubmitting the Revised Draft Bill in Parliament a series of discussions had been held with the Attorney General's Department, Sri Lanka Police, the Bar Association of Sri Lanka and the relevant stakeholders, and  the Revised Draft Bill, has been unanimously accepted. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice, to publish the said Revised Draft Bill initially to be operative for four (04) years, in the Government Gazette, to be implemented and subsequently, to present it in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of identified infrastructure facilities associated with minor irrigation systems
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- Considering the magnitude of the  drought and the flood situations that occurred recently, it has been found that measures should be taken to minimize impacts of the climate change on the agriculture sector and to adopt to the situation. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to implement a project to develop farm access roads, enabling the  use of modern technology on the lands of small farmers in remote areas of the dry zone and to renovate the existing agro wells and encourage farmers towards water conserving farming, as recommended by the Inter Ministerial Committee of Experts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementing a formal Agricultural Insurance Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the difficulties faced by the farming community in recovering the damages caused to the agricultural crops due to the natural disasters, a proposal was made by the budget 2017 to implement a methodology for providing an insurance cover of Rs.40,000/- per acre initially for the 6 of crops of paddy, maize, soya, big onions, potatoes and chilli. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to put forward a suitable  mechanism in collaboration with the  National Insurance Trust Fund in order to  to implement the said insurance scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Utilization of abandoned and uncultivated paddy fields for Solar Power Generation Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- The government has launched a programme to improve the contribution of the renewable energy sources for electricity generation in Sri Lanka and the priority has been given for electricity generation by solar power.  Under the 'Sooryabala Sangramaya' project, the opportunity has been given to any customers to generate electricity by solar power and derive an income by supplying the same to the National Electricity Grid. 
 
Even though there is a potential for solar power electricity generation in the Provinces such as Western and Sabaragamuwa where the demand for electricity is high in Sri Lanka, there are difficulties in acquiring the lands required for the purpose. An area of 3 - 5 acres is generally required for a land mounted solar power electricity generation project with the capacity of 1 MW. Accordingly,   the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to utilize the abandoned and uncultivated paddy lands in the Western and Sabaragamuwa Provinces for the solar power electricity generation projects with the concurrence of the Commissioner General of Agrarian Services and the other authorities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: New projects proposed to be implemented from the year 2018 for the performance of the Coconut Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - Around 70% of the Coconut yield in Sri Lanka is used for domestic consumption and the remainder is used for coconut related industries. Sri Lanka has been successful in receiving an export revenue of Rs.84 billion in the year 2016 alone by exporting coconut kernel related products. The Coconut related industries need to be developed while protecting the local consumer as well as the coconut cultivator, due to the limited extent of land available for  coconut cultivation and the challenges due to various climatic factors.     Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of  Plantation Industries, to establish specially in the Northern and Eastern areas model coconut gardens to enhance the performance of coconut cultivation and  to establish a trained work force for the coconut sector from the year 2018, with the objective of increasing the coconut yield and the productivity in the coconut sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of a Recreational Beach Area from Colpetty to Dehiwala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - With the rapid development of the City of Colombo, it has become a necessity to develop a common beach area for the people living in the City of Colombo and the suburbs. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to develop a recreational beach area from Colpetty to Dehiwala for the public recreational activities and consequently, to mitigate the sea erosion and provide space required for the additional railway lines, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a block of land to the Open University of Sri Lanka (OUSL) to establish the Ratnapura Study Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - The Ratnapura Study Centre of the Open University of Sri Lanka has been proposed to be improved under the project 'One Regional Centre of the Open University for each Province'. The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to transfer a block of land of 01Acre 02Roods in extent, belonging to the Urban Development Authority, situated in the Ratnapura New Town, to the Open University of Sri Lanka as a free grant for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of blocks of lands from the Regional Industrial Estates to set up Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - Proposals have been called through paper advertisements to select suitable industrialists in order to invest in the industrial estates, with a view to promoting industries at regional level. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to allocate the blocks of land situated in Laksha Uyana, Trincomalee - Stage 2, Batticaloa, Mathugama, Homagama, Ratmalana, Millewa, Galigamuwa, Nalanda Ellawala, Buttala, Karandeniya, Bata atha, Dankotuwa, Puttalam, Nalanda and Ulapane Regional Industrial Estates, to the selected investors on lease basis as per the  recommendations of the Regional Industrial Services Committees which evaluated the project proposals submitted in this regard and the Ministry Project Evaluation Committee, to establish 26 Industrial Projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancing the provisions allocated for the State Award Ceremonies and other Commemoration Ceremonies organized by the Department of Cultural Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- Fifteen various state award ceremonies and several commemoration ceremonies are annually conducted by the Department of Cultural affairs with a view to preserving, promoting and propagating the cultural heritage of Sri Lanka. Certain state award ceremonies are conducted continuously for more than a half century and this has been greatly helpful in cultural renaissance of high quality and standard. 

The amount of the cash awards presented to the winners at these state award ceremonies has not been enhanced for a long period of time. Further, the organizational cost for these ceremonies too has gone up considerably and additional provisions are also necessary, since a few new state award ceremonies are being organized to be held in respect of major fields of Arts which have not been subject to appreciation up to now, at State level. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs, to enhance the provision of Rs.55 million presently set apart annually by the General Treasury up to Rs.100 million, for the state award ceremonies conducted to facilitate the Artists in different fields, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new building complex for the Gampaha District Secretariat
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- It has been found that the old building where the Gampaha District Secretariat is housed at present is not suitable to provide an efficient and effective service to the general public. The relocation of the Government and Semi-Government institutions, presently scattered in several places, within the District Secretariat premises would also result in minimizing the traffic congestion in the Gampaha town.  

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, to construct a 07 storey building complex with approximately  200,000 square feet, at an estimated cost of Rs 2,960 million for the Gampaha District Secretariat, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of hospitals in the Sabaragamuwa Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - The necessity of upgrading the healthcare facilities in the Sabaragamuwa Province  where around 9% of the total population of Sri Lanka are living  has been identified. As the Provincial General Hospital in Ratnapura and the District General Hospital in Kegalle, the major hospitals in the province are highly congested, it has been identified that it will be essential to develop the Base Hospitals of Mawanella, Karawanella, Balangoda and Kalawana and the  Divisional Hospitals of Rambukkana and Eheliyagoda where people can have easy access and have quality healthcare service. Accordingly, it is expected to establish different new clinics and treatment units and to increase the number of beds by 250 in each hospital. Therefore,  the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to implement the proposed project at an estimated cost of Rs.1,547 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Anuradhapura Regional Office of the Ayurvedic Drugs Corporation of Sri Lanka, the Sales Centre and the Medicine Purchasing  Centre in one and the same building
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - The requirement of establishing the Regional Office of the Ayurvedic Drugs Corporation of Sri Lanka, the Sales Centre and the Medicine Purchasing Centre located at different places in the Anuradhapura town, in one and the same premises, has been identified.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to vest the block of Government land and the abandoned building situated at the Public Stadium Mawatha in Anuradhapura, given on lease to M/s. Lanka Salusala Ltd.,  with the Ayurvedic Drugs Corporation of Sri Lanka, on a long term lease basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Cardiac Catheterization Laboratory with Auxiliary Clinical Services at the Provincial General Hospital in Badulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- At present, there is a significant increase in the risk of the people being subject to heart diseases.  Therefore, it is essential to improve the facilities in the Cardiac Treatment Units of the hospitals.  The Provincial General Hospital in Badulla is the only hospital in the Uva Province, which provides specialized treatment services for heart diseases. Around 10,000 patients arrive in its Cardiology Clinics annually and about 1,500 out of them are admitted to the Cardiac Treatment Unit.  Even though more than 1,000 patients out of them are required to have Catheterization for diagnostic purposes, the facilities available at the hospital at the moment are inadequate for such a number. 

As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to establish a Catheterization Laboratory with the relevant clinical treatment facilities and an Intensive Care Unit at the Provincial General Hospital in Badulla, at the estimated cost of Rs.698 million within the financial assistance of the Japan International Cooperation  Agency (JICA), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improving the Cancer Treatment Unit at the Teaching Hospital,  Karapitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- Cancer has become the second major cause of death in the hospitals of Sri Lanka.  Taking into consideration the recent increase in the number of Cancer patients, the Cancer Treatment Unit at the Teaching Hospital in Karapitiya, the major hospital in the Southern Province, which provides special treatment services to those patients, needs to be improved.   

	As such, a ten storey building with OPD, Iodine Therapy Unit, Clinics, 03 Oncology Units, Onco‑Surgical and Pediatric Oncology Units, a Laboratory and Auditorium Facilities has been planned to be constructed, in order to expand the existing Cancer Treatment Service Facilities at the Hospital. An estimated cost of Rs.2,000 million is to be incurred in respect of same. The Charitable Organization, Colours of Courage Trust (COC) has come forward to provide its contribution for the joint implementation of this project and it is expected to utilize the financial aid collected by the organization by conducting trails throughout the country, for the purpose.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine and the Charitable Organization, Colours of Courage Trust (COC) to carry out the construction work of the proposed ten (10) storeyed building to expand the Cancer treatment facilities at the Teaching Hospital in Karapitiya, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Science and Technology for Society (STS) Forum - 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- The 'Science and Technology for Society (STS) Forum Sri Lanka' was first held in the year 2016 with the objective of achieving the benefits from the progress in the fields of science, technology and research in the developed world and  increasing the contribution of the knowledge on science, technology and research to the national development process and it has been possible to initiate the support of the Sri Lankan Scientists residing in foreign countries, towards the local science and technology projects. 

	Taking into consideration the success of its first forum, it has been proposed to conduct the same for the second time with the participation of approximately 1,000 persons including the representatives of other countries and international organizations working in collaboration with Sri Lanka in this field, eminent Sri Lankan expatriate scientists, Government and Private sector technologists, innovators and university and school students. Identification of emerging technologies enabling economic development, science and technology innovations for Sustainable Development Goals are the themes scheduled to be addressed at the forum. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to conduct the 'Science and Technology for Society (STS) Forum Sri Lanka' in Colombo, in October 2018 for the second time, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Collaboratives  with the European Organization for Nuclear Research (CERN)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- Sri Lanka has entered into a Collaborative with the European Organization for Nuclear Research (CERN), an institution which is engaged in high energy physics and related high tech scientific experiments, in May 2017.  This Collaborative will provide an opportunity for the professors and lecturers of the universities and the scientists of the country to have access to the laboratories of the organization and to liaise with the Organization and the Scientists of around 77 countries linked with the Organization and it will enable to educate the Sri Lankan student population and as well as for the progress of the local industries.   

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to enter into Collaboration Agreements and  to allocate a provision of Rs.250.45 million in the forthcoming 05 years for the activities related to the said Collaboratives, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a State of the Art National Science Centre (NSC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- A science culture for a country is an essential factor to move towards a knowledge based society and economy. Establishment of fully fledged science centres in order to enhance the knowledge an understanding of science, technology and innovations of the general public are measures adopted by many countries around the world. 

As such, it has been proposed to establish a National Science Centre with modern facilities in the country with the objective of providing the knowledge of science especially in school children, for paving the way for activities such as conducting experiments etc.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to construct a National Science Centre in the block of land allocated from the Technocity at Mahenawatta, Pitipana, Homagama, at a cost of Rs.2,550 million and in accordance with the international standards, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of District Offices of the National Building Research Organization (NBRO) in high risk landslide-prone Districts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- The National Building Research Organization is an institution which carries out all related activities of landslide investigations, mapping out disaster prone zones, awareness creation, early warning indication and issuance of Landslide Risk Assessment Certificate prior to all construction and development projects in the landslide-prone areas through its Head Office in Colombo and the district offices located in 09 landslide-prone districts.  

In view of the unprecedented increase of landslides and collapsing of slopes has  been observed, as never before, due to the climate change impacts and changing monsoon patterns that bring any heavy rains and in order to enable to provide services to the public in an efficient manner, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, to construct permanent office buildings with modern laboratory facilities in the most critical two (02) landslide-prone Districts and thereafter as per the necessity, to provide such facilities in the other Districts as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Further payment of house rental allowance to persons whose dwelling houses had been damaged completely or found unsuitable for occupation being subject to the floods and landslides which occurred in May 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- Due to the floods, landslides and storms that occurred in the latter part of last May, a large number of people were subject to distress and in respect of the families who were evacuated due to the complete loss of their dwelling houses or found unsuitable for occupation or landslide high risk areas, the Government decided to provide a housing rental allowance of Rs.7,500/- per month for each family for a period of three (03) months to enable them to reside in rented out houses temporarily. Accordingly, 3,584 families affected in the Districts of Ratnapura, Galle, Matara, Hambantota, Kalutara and Colombo were provided with the housing rental for the months of June, July and August, 2017. 

	The preliminary activities for the resettlement of such families are already underway and as such, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, to extend the payment of the house rental now being paid for such families for a further period of three (03) months up until the completion of such activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing accommodation facilities for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - In order to overcome the difficulties faced due to the insufficient office space in the Republic Building in Colombo 01 where the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is functioning at present, it is necessary to obtain an additional space of approximately 30,000 sqft. The proposal made by Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to have the building adjacent to the Republic Building constructed in the Dutch era and used by the Civil Security Department until recently, renovated by the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the efficiency of the Railway operations through the introduction of the Global Positioning System (GPS) and providing train operation related information to the General Public
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has previously granted approval to improve the efficiency of the train operations by procuring a  train operating information system based on the Global Positioning System (GPS). It has been proposed to further expand the use of the Global Positioning System (GPS) for the improvement of the efficiency of the railway operations to cover a wide scope by connecting Colombo, Anuradhapura and Nawalapitiya control centres of Sri Lanka Railways, preparation of train charts automatically, generating all train operation related reports, analyzing the train delay monitoring system etc; and to provide the general public with the train operation related information. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to obtain the relevant operating system from the Ministry of Defence for a sum of Rs.31.8 million, in accordance with the proposal put forward by the said Ministry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Short term solutions for the unprotected railway level crossings
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body:
- The policy of the Government is to provide systematic protection at every railway level crossing. Presently, action is being taken by the Government to install a Bell and Light protection system at unprotected railway level crossings and until then such activities are completed, it will be necessary to have Railway Barrier Operators to avoid accidents that may occur at such level crossings.  




	Presently, there are 687 railway level crossings throughout the country manned by the barrier operators employed with the intervention of the Sri Lanka Police. For each such crossing, three (03) barrier operators are employed and each person so employed is paid a monthly allowance of Rs.7,500/-. However, in the recent past, a considerable number of barrier operators have left the service due to the inadequacy of the allowance paid to them. 

	Therefore, as a remedial measure, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to hand over the responsibility of handling the barriers throughout the day to be given over specifically to a single Member of the Samurdhi beneficiary family selected for the purpose for the payment of Rs.22,500/- for each barrier to the said Samurdhi beneficiary Family assigned with the task, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Securing of supplementary financial assistance for the completion of the construction work of the Mahamodara Maternity Hospital, Galle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - The Government of Germany has agreed to provide further financial assistance required for the completion of the construction work of the Mahamodara Maternity Hospital, Galle which was damaged by the Tsunami disaster. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to negotiate and enter into a loan Agreement with the KfW (Kerditanstalt Fur Weideraufbau) Bank of Germany to secure the  supplementary loan facility up to Euro 13 million required for the completion of these development activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on co-operation between Sri Lanka and Australia in regard to the prevention of various crimes committed across Borders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-26
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with a view to strengthening and for further promotion of the existing co-operation between Sri Lanka and Australia in regard to the prevention of human smuggling and other Transnational Border Crime. Through this, both parties will reap the  benefits of preventing human smuggling and movement of illicit goods, Border Management, promotion of regional and multilateral engagement related to Transnational Border Crime and the prevention of such other crimes beyond  human smuggling and other Transnational Border Crime by money laundering. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to sign the proposed MoU between the Ministry of Defence of Sri Lanka and the Department of Immigration and Border Protection of the Government of Australia, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Museum of Traditional Technological Heritage and an Information Centre in Polonnaruwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- The establishment of a Heritage Museum and an Information Centre which reflect the pristine traditional technology such as the past towns and garden designing, technological heritage, traditional irrigation and water supply systems, food preservation methods, mode of transport, architecture etc. different to that of a normal museum has been identified as a need of the time.  

	Accordingly, the joint proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena and Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs, to establish a Heritage Museum and an Information Centre in Polonnaruwa which comprises of galleries designed to display the important milestones in the field of traditional technology and the period of governance from the pre-historic era to the present day, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appropriation Bill for the Financial Year 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- Action has been taken to table the Appropriation Bill for the Financial Year 2018 in Parliament at the end of September 2017. The General Treasury has prepared these Budget Estimates, based on the Government policy priorities, taking into consideration the total resources which may be available for the Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2018 - 2020. Attention has also been drawn to the matters surfaced at the budget discussions with the Line Ministries and the Provincial Councils.  

Accordingly, the total expenditure of the Government for the financial year 2018 has been estimated at Rs.3,982 billion. Authority need to be derived through the proposed Appropriation Bill to incur the expenditure amounting to Rs.1,977 billion from the said total amount, other than the expenditure to be incurred under laws passed by Parliament such as for servicing and repayment of public debt and payment of Widows/Widowers and Orphans Pension etc amounting to Rs.2,005.1 billion for the year 2018, from this Recurrent Expenditure is estimated at Rs.1,308.9 billion and the Capital Expenditure is estimated at Rs.668 billion. Further, the total estimated Government Revenue and the Foreign Grants for the year 2018, is estimated at Rs.2,175 billion and accordingly, Rs.1,813 billion has to be obtained as loans by way of domestic and international resources, including Rs.6 billion for the advanced accounts expenditure of the Government. 

The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to present the Appropriation Bill for the financial year 2018 including the draft budgetary estimates, for approval in Parliament having published the same in the Government Gazette, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tentative Programme for the Budget Debate for the Financial Year 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, presented the tentative programme for the Budget Debate for the Financial Year 2018 to the Cabinet and the Cabinet noted same. 

Accordingly, the budget speech for the financial year 2018 will be delivered on 09th November 2017 and  it has been planned to conduct the Parliamentary Debate on the Second Reading of the Appropriation Bill on 10th, 11th, 13th, 14th and 15th November 2017, to commence its Committee Stage Debate on 2017-11-16 and to conduct the vote of the Third Reading of the Appropriation Bill on 2017-12-09.

description: Establishment of the Country Office of the International Fund (IFAD) for Agricultural Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body: - The International Fund for Agricultural Development is a special agency of the United Nations dedicated to alleviate the rural poverty in the developing countries. The said agency which provided support for the implementation of the various projects in Sri Lanka since 1978 continue to provide the necessary support presently too, for the various agricultural development programmes.  In order to strengthen its operational activities carried out in Sri Lanka, the  fund intends to open a country office.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Thilak Marapana, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to sign an Agreement between the International Fund for Agricultural Development and the Government of Sri Lanka, for the establishment of its country office in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Mixed Development Project  in the Land of Charlmers Granaries in Colombo Fort
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body: - The Government has planned to establish a Multi-modal Transport Hub integrating all modes of transport in Colombo Fort and Pettah. As such, it has been decided to make use of the land of the Charlmers Granaries in extent of 9 Acres 3 Roods 27 Perches, belonging to the Urban Development Authority situated in front of the Fort Railway Station to carry out the necessary development activities under the project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to call for competitive bids under the Multi-madel Transport Hub Project to select a suitable investor to develop the land as a 'Gate to the City of Colombo', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply and Delivery of New Tyre Kits to the Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body: - Bids have been called for, under open competitive bidding to select a suitable institution for the supply and delivery of New Tyre Kits to the buses of the Sri Lanka Transport Board and in response 02 bidders have submitted their bids. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract to M/s. Ceat Kelani International Tyres (Pvt) Ltd., for the supply of 33,672 tyre kits of different varieties, for a sum of Rs.1,115 million, as per the recommendation of the  Technical Evaluation Committee appointed to evaluate the prices and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a five storey building at the School of Nursing, Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body: - In providing a high qualitative health care service, the contribution of the Nursing Officers is of paramount importance. The Government has identified that the facilities of the Nurses Training School in Colombo have to be improved to fulfill the need of increasing the number of trained Nursing Officers with high skills and the knowledge of scientific and up to date information. The Nurses Training School in Colombo established in the year 1939 is one of the major Training Schools in the country and the facilities available there, at present, is sufficient only to train 100 Nurses annually. As such, it has been planned to construct a building consisting of five storeys to improve the facilities of the Nurses Training School in Colombo to enable around 600 Nursing Students to be trained annually. Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract to the State Engineering Corporation with a view to implementing the project expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a building complex for the National Institute of Social Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, the Minister of Social Empowerment, Welfare and Kandyan Heritage, to award the contract to construct a building complex on design and build basis for the National Institute of Social Development in the Seeduwa area, to the State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanka, at a cost of Rs.818.63 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancing of the cash flow of contractors of the construction projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- The Government places a high priority on the development of infrastructure facilities. As such, it is essential to complete the infrastructure facility projects within the duration and the cost agreed upon while also maintaining the required qualitative standards. However, it has been found that in the investment of funds, the difficulties faced by the local contractors engaged in certain infrastructure facility projects implemented by the Government due to various reasons has been a constraint to complete the activities taken over by them within the due time period and the qualitative standards.   

	As a remedial measure, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to introduce a suitable mechanism to ease the cash flow situation of contractors, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Liquefied Petroleum Gas required for the Litro Gas Lanka Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body: - The LP Gas required to be distributed by the Litro Gas Lanka Ltd., which is the largest LP Gas supplier of the country with a 80% market share is purchased by the International Competitive Bidding Procedure. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Public Enterprise Development, for the purchase of 300,000 MT of LP Gas required for the said company for the year 2017 - 2018 from M/s. Shell International Eastern Trading Company for the Saudi Aramco Contract Price plus US$ 47.50 per MT of LP Gas, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Middle Income Housing Project for the Professionals at Kulasevana Watta, Kottawa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body: - It has been planned for the implementation of a Middle Income Housing Project for the Professionals at Kulasevana Watta, Kottawa under the 'Urban Regeneration Project' implemented in the City of Colombo. Under this project 300 housing units are scheduled to be constructed and proposals have been called for, from the eligible contractors for the purpose and in response 04 bidders have submitted their proposals. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the relevant contract to M/s. Sathuta Builders (Pvt) Ltd., on design and build basis, for a sum of Rs.3,699 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) which evaluated the proposals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 115 Housing Units at the Torrington Mawatha, Colombo 07, under the 'Urban Regeneration Project'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body: - Bids have been called for, from the eligible contractors for the construction of 115 Housing Units at the Torrington Mawatha, Colombo 07, under the 'Urban Regeneration Project' and in response 05 bidders have submitted their proposals for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the relevant contract to M/s. Subasinghe Contractors and Earth Movers on design and built basis, for a sum of Rs.395 million  as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) which evaluated the bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply and Installation of a Whole Body MRI Scanner for the General Hospital, Sri Jayawardenepura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- It is essential to have the MRI Scans to diagnose the conditions of the brain and the central nerves system and as well as the breast and heart diseases. It has, therefore, been found that the purchasing of a 3.0 Tesla Whole Body MRI Scanner is essential for enhancing the quality of treatment services provided by the General Hospital of Sri Jayawardenepura. 

As such, Open International Bidding has been called for and in response 03 bids have now been submitted for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the relevant contract to M/s. Dimo (Pvt) Ltd., the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, for a sum of Rs.45 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) which evaluated the bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Establishment of Public-Private Joint Ventures for the upliftment of the Pharmaceutical Industry of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- With the upliftment of the Pharmaceutical Industry of Sri Lanka, a considerable amount of foreign exchange used for the import of pharmaceuticals could be saved and it would also pave the way for keeping the prices of pharmaceuticals stable.  Therefore, the Government has planned to identify investors with the possibility of making an uninterrupted supply of fresh and high quality Pharmaceutical items effectively to the Government Hospitals and establish joint ventures between such investors and the State Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Corporation. 

As such, the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee has recommended to accept the 31 proposals out of the 36 proposals submitted by 24 investors who have responded. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to implement the accepted proposals with the selected investors to commence Joint Ventures on the Public-Private-Partnership basis subject to the recommendations of the Officials' Committee appointed headed by the Secretary to the Treasury, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the General Hospital, Chilaw
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- A proposal has been made to establish an Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the General Hospital, Chilaw with the objective of preventing the deaths caused by accidents and disabilities by providing an easy accessible, high standard and quality patient care service. National Competitive Bids have been called  for selecting a suitable contractor to construct this Unit and 09 bidders have submitted their bids in this regard. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract, in accordance with the recommendation of  the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) to M/s. AMSK Construction (Pvt) Ltd., the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, for a sum of Rs.501.2 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the Base Hospital, Kegalle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- A proposal has been made to establish an Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the Base Hospital, Kegalle with the objective of preventing the deaths caused by accidents and disabilities by providing an easy accessible, high standard and quality patient care service. National Competitive Bids have been called  for selecting a suitable contractor to construct this Unit and 10 bidders have submitted their bids in this regard. 
	
	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract, in accordance with the recommendation of  the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) to M/s. Link Engineering (Pvt) Ltd., the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, for a sum of Rs.320.1 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of new Academic Buildings for the University of Colombo and Ruhuna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for the construction of the Information and Learning Centre at the Faculty of Science in the University of Colombo to M/s. Sanken Construction (Pvt) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.516.54 million and the construction of the Second Phase in the Building Complex of the Faculty of Management and Finance in the University of Ruhuna to M/s. MTD Construction (Pvt) Ltd., for a sum of Rs.198.02 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Air Traffic Control Simulator Training System for the Civil Aviation Training Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Air Traffic Control Simulator Training System for the Civil Aviation Training Centre to M/s. Adacel Technologies Limited as decided by the Procurement Appeal Board and  in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) pertaining to the field of migrant labour proposed to be entered into between Sri Lanka and Lebanon
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- A considerable number of Sri Lankan migrant labour is employed in Lebanon and in the year 2017 alone, the number of 1,593 persons registered in the Foreign Employment Bureau have left for employment in Lebanon and 79% out of them have taken up household employment. The two countries have come to an Agreement to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding pertaining to the field of migrant labour with the objective of safeguarding the rights and the welfare of the Sri Lankan migrant labour employed in Lebanon. 
	Through the proposed MoU, positive measures will be taken for the  implementation of a safe service environment and a transparent and low cost recruitment procedure for the Sri Lankan migrant labour. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice and Foreign Employment, to sign the proposed MoU between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Bursaries for the Pirivena Student Monks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- The traditional education system formed in the country for the purpose of  creating a systematic and formal education to the Buddhist Monks is the Pirivena education system.  At present, 758 Pirivenas function throughout the Island in the form of Elementary Pirivena, Maha Pirivena and Vidyathana Pirivena. The budget 2017 proposed to grant a bursary for the Pirivena student monks for the promotion of their educational activities. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to grant a 'Learning Improvement Grant' to the Account of the Head of the Pirivena 'Kruthyadikari' to be used for the welfare activities of the Pirivena student monks for the supply of books and equipment, co-curricular activities, skills development activities, promotion of English language skills and to meet the travelling expenses and to implement the project under the strict supervision of the Ministry of Education, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of the mechanism for the implementation of the Charter on the Child Rights
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- Sri Lanka signed the Child Rights Convention and ratified same in the year 1991. As such, the Government of Sri Lanka is bound to ensure the rights of children to the maximum. The responsibility of giving effect to the commitments under the convention is vested with the Ministry of Women and Child Affairs and measures have been taken to give effect to the commitments  through the Officers of the Department of Probation and Child Care Services, National Child Protection Authority, the Children's Secretariat and the Officers attached to the Divisional Secretary's Offices.  

	Steps had been taken in the year 2000 to establish Operational Committees at the National, District and Divisional Level for follow-up and reporting on the activities under Section 40 of the Convention. Taking into consideration the present requirement, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, to widen the composition and the functions of the Operational Committees, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Crash Programme for the supply of seed paddy for the 'Maha' Season 2017/18
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- Normally paddy is cultivated in 8 lakh hectares of paddy land during the Maha season for which 4 million bushes of seed paddy are being used.  Due to the unfavourable weather conditions which prevailed in certain parts of the Island, it is expected that there will be a shortage in the supply of seed paddy during the Maha season of 2017/2018.  Therefore, a proposal has been made to jointly implement a crash programme for the supply of germination certified seed paddy by the Department of Agriculture in collaboration with the Provincial Departments of Agriculture, Mahaweli Authority and other relevant Institutions. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to purchase 560,000 bushels of high quality seed paddy expeditiously, from the areas where seed paddy cultivation was carried out successfully and from the paddy cultivations done for the purpose of consumption during the Yala season of 2017 and to sell such seed paddy among the farmers in areas where there is a shortage of seed paddy, was approved by the Cabinet.  Further, the Cabinet also granted approval to sell the seed paddy to the farmers in the Districts which were subject to severe drought during the past season and suffered loss of harvest, charging only 50% of the value.

description: Implementation of a project to undertake fish farming in cages
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- The Global Ceylon Sea Food (Pvt) Ltd., the joint venture established in collaboration with the Continental Ceylon Sea Food (Pvt) Ltd., of Sri Lanka and the Continental Ceylon Sea Food A.S. Ltd., of Norway has submitted a proposal to undertake commercial scale fish farming such as the Sea Bass, Pompano and Grouper with high market demand by utilizing the technology of fish farming in cages in the open sea.  It has been proposed to be implemented in two (02) phases, adopting the best environmental conservation practices and modern technology.     

The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to grant a 30 year lease to the Global Ceylon Sea Foods (Pvt.) Ltd. of the sea bed in extent of 150 hectares of the local coastal area in the Koddiyar Bay in the District of Trincomalee belonging to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority, for the implementation of this project identified as a project of high feasibility, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Final Disposal Facility for Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) at Aruwakkalu, Puttalam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- Due to the sudden collapse of the Meethotamulla landfill facility, the disposal of Municipal Solid Waste in the City of Colombo and suburbs has become a crisis.  In this situation, the expeditious implementation of the sanitary landfill in the Puttalam Aruwakkalu area for which approval has already be granted, is essential.   

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to carry out the activities of  the construction of the waste distribution centres relevant to the Solid Waste Management Project, the Sanitary Landfills and the connectivity railway tracks expeditiously and commence the waste disposal activities by the year 2020, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new Auditorium in the town of Galle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- Certain state functions, conferences, seminars, public gatherings and discussions relevant to the District of Galle and the entire Southern Province, are held in places close to the town of Galle. The Hall de Galle belonging to the Ministry of Home Affairs is mostly used for these activities at present and the existing facilities and space available are  not sufficient to carryout such activities. Therefore, a new Auditorium has been proposed to be constructed for the District Secretariat of Galle.  

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, to construct an Auditorium of 2,000 seats with modern facilities, adjacent to the road having access to the Southern Expressway, to be used as a public Auditorium for such events held in the town of Galle, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing of Student Hostel facilities in the Sri Lanka - German Training Institute (SLGTI) in Killinochchi
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- The Sri Lanka-German Training Institute (SLGTI) belonging to the National Apprentice and Industrial Training Authority, situated in Killinochchi was established in the year 2016 and presently, around 200 students follow training courses at NVQ Levels 4,5, and 6. Around 57% of the present number of students are residents of the Districts outside the District of Killinochchi. The hostel facilities need to be improved since the present hostel facilities of this institute are sufficient only for 144 students and is expected to enroll 400 more students to its training courses within this year. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Chandima Weerakkody, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to construct a new hostel building for the Sri Lanka-German Training Institute, Killinochchi, to enable to provide hostel facilities for 400 more students, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Social Innovation Lab
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to establish a Social Innovation Lab as a methodology to examine the effectiveness of the Government Policies, prior to their  implementation. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to implement the proposed Social Innovation Lab as a pilot project at the Ministry of Science, Technology and Research, with the assistance of the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), aimed at formulating effective policies as well as a vibrant and productive public service delivery through stability of policies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of small bridges for the convenient transportation of communities in the remote areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- It has been observed that in the most difficult remote areas in Sri Lanka, there are around 1,500 locations where people commute with the use of extremely unprotected temporarily erected trunk bridges across streams and rivers and in about 500 locations where people commute by crossing rivers and streams with difficulty without any kind of safety measures put in place. Therefore, it is essential to construct small bridges with the objective to providing safe transportation for the people living in such remote areas. In this respect, the National Engineering Research and Development Centre (NERDC) has been successful in designing and experimenting a long term durable special foot bridges at a low cost with the use of advanced technology. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to identify the locations where people commute unsafely by crossing streams, rivers etc. and construct 1,000 bridges within the forthcoming three years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Sri Lankan Graphite to be used in Rechargeable Batteries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- Although Sri Lanka is a high quality graphite producing country, the economic benefit derived by the country takes a low value as a result of it being exported as a raw material without value addition. Therefore, the focus of the Government has been directed in promoting the export after improving the natural graphite as a value added product with the aim of generating a higher income. 
	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to implement a research project by the National Institute of Fundamental Studies (NIFS) for the  improvement of the quality of the natural graphite in the country under appropriate innovative initiatives to enable it to be used in rechargeable batteries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Carrying out a feasibility study on the Greater Vavuniya Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- It has been proposed to implement the Greater Vavuniya Water Supply Project with the main objective of providing safe drinking water to the people living in the Vavuniya Divisional Secretary's Division and the Vavuniya South and Cheddikulam where people have been severely affected with the Chronic Kidney Disease.  

	The information submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply to the effect that a Memorandum of Understanding has been signed between the National Water Supply and Drainage Board and the M/s China National Complete Plant Import and Export Corporation Limited (COMPLANT) to carry out a feasibility study in regard to the implementation of the project was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining blocks of land for the construction of the Ratnapura and Badulla District Labour Office Complexes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- The Labour Offices,  the District Labour Offices and the District Factory Inspecting Engineer's Offices functioning under the Department of Labour coming under the purview of the Ratnapura and Badulla zones are housed in rented out buildings. A large number of people visit these offices daily to obtain services from these offices and as such, it has been proposed to construct permanent buildings for these offices to provide the public with adequate facilities as well as the accommodation facilities necessary for the staff.   

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, the Minister of Labour, Trade Union Relations and Sabaragamuwa Development, to obtain the land required for the establishment of District Labour Office Complexes in Ratnapura and Badulla,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Draft Bill on Sign Language
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- The hearing impaired population living in Sri Lanka is reported to be 389,677.  In terms of the National Policy on Disability, Sign Language has been accepted as the language of communication of the profoundly hearing impaired persons. With the establishment of the Sign Language, as a recognized language it ensures the hearing impaired persons right to education and paves the way for them to have access to  the services provided by the Government without any discrimination.   Affording  equal opportunities in this manner to the hearing impaired persons will enhance their self esteem as well.  



Accordingly, with the objective of making legal provision to establish the Sign Language as a recognized language in Sri Lanka, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, the Minister of Social Empowerment, Welfare and Kandyan Heritage, for drafting the proposed Draft Bill on Sign Language, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The 10th conference on  the Air Services Negotiations of the  International Civil Aviation Organization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body: - The annual International Civil Aviation Negotiation Conference (ICAN) organized by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), provides the opportunity for the World Air Services to enter into bilateral negotiations for the traffic rights between States.  Arrangements are underway to host the said Conference which is held for the 10th time in Sri Lanka from 04th to 08th of December 2017.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to enter into an Agreement between the International Civil Aviation Organization and the Government of Sri Lanka for hosting the event in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of the Ritigala - Yan Oya National Park and the declaration of the revised boundary limits of the Horowpothana National Park
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- The 'Ritigala Elephant Transit Home' in Sri Lanka has been established as the second such Home for taking care of the displaced wild elephants and elephant calves covering the North, the North Central and the North Western Provinces of the Island.  The land extent of 427.8 hectares inclusive also of the forest area adjacent to it has been proposed to be declared as Ritigala - Yan Oya National Park. 

With a view to minimizing the human elephant conflict, it has been proposed to revise the boundary limits of the Horowpothana National Park inclusive of the land area adjacent to  the Elephant Retention Centre in Horowpothana established for the capture and keeping them in captivity of the elephants who often trespass the villages and behave aggressively and also to re-declare it as the Horowpothana National Park.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to declare the Ritigala - Yan Oya National Park and the Horowpathana National Park with revised boundary limits, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Bridges in Rural Areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- The Government has accorded high priority for connectivity improvement within the country with a view to providing the maximum benefits of the National Level Development Project Activities not only to the Urban but to the remote villages as well. Under this activity, it has been planned to construct around 3,500 to 4,000 bridges in rural areas and 02 projects pertaining to the construction of bridges are presently underway with the financial assistance of the United Kingdom and the Netherlands.  

	In the mean time, Governments of Hungaria and Belgium have come forward to provide financial assistance for the projects for constructing bridges in the rural areas. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs,  to authorize the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government to call for proposals for the implementation of the 02 projects for the construction of bridges in rural areas with the financial assistance of the said Governments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Draft Bill on Bio-safety
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-09-12
decision_details_body:
- The sustainability of bio-diversity is affected due to the natural causes and the various human activities. It is an accepted fact that the release of genetically modified organisms created through the development of bio-technology to the environment without safety measures is also a kind of human activity which is a threat to bio-diversity.  Adopting safety measures to minimize the imminent damage caused to the bio-diversity in Sri Lanka is a timely need. 

	As Sri Lanka is a signatory to the Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety the necessary legislative provision have to be provided by Sri Lanka  for the use of the genetically modified organisms, created using bio-technology, for the  promotion, marketing, utilizing in commercial activities, transport, import, export, re-export, transfer, disposal and release in a manner not causing a risk or causing a minimum risk for the human health and the bio-diversity.  As such, 	the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to introduce a new draft Bill on Bio-safety, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief for Temples situated in areas affected as a result of the drought prevailing in the Island
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-29
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Buddhasasana and the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to grant  relief to the Temples situated in areas affected by floods as well similar to the relief granted to the people affected by the severe drought prevailing in some parts of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of a Mechanism to manage the declining Price of Pepper
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-29
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet appointed a Cabinet Sub Committee under the Chairmanship of the Minister of Finance and Mass Media on 09-08-2017 to put forward suitable proposals with the objective of safeguarding the livelihood and the income of the persons engaged in pepper cultivation and who are affected as a result of the declining price of pepper in the international market and as well as in the local market.   

Accordingly, as recommended by the Cabinet Sub-Committee, the proposal made by Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Primary Industries, to maintain a certified price of Rs.900 per kg of dry pepper, to formulate a relief mechanism by the Government, taking into consideration the difference of the proposed certified price and the prevalent market price, to pay an amount subject to a  maximum of Rs.150 per kg and to continue with the relief programme until such time that the market price of a kilogram of dry pepper exceeds Rs.900/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Municipal Councils Ordinance, Urban Councils Ordinance and the Pradeshiya  Sabha Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-29
decision_details_body:
- The Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Amendment) Bill incorporating provisions on the new system of electing Members for the local government authorities, was passed in Parliament recently. Concurrently to the above, in determining the number of Members of Local Authorities to be elected, the existing legal provision has to be amended to provide for returning a further additional number of Members not exceeding 40% of the members due to be elected on ward basis, from the list, at divisional level.  

The proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to amend section 5 of the Municipal Councils Ordinance, section 5 of the Urban Councils Ordinance and section 4 of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act, as amended by the Local Authorities (Special Provisions) Act, No.21 of 2012 providing for same, was approved by the Cabinet.
