- Approximately 500,000 families in 17 districts have been affected by the dry weather conditions prevailing in the country and accordingly, the livelihood of the people in those areas  has also been severely affected. Having considered the   existing situation a relief distribution system should be implemented to  provide relief for the families affected due to the drought as in the case of the disaster situations that occurred in the previous years. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to identify the families who have lost their livelihood due to the severe drought  and to provide them dry rations at a cost of Rs.5000/-, per month effective from August, 2017, on the basis of deploying the members of such families for community work and to expeditiously pay compensation for damaged crops under an insurance cover and to continuously implement the programmes of providing drinking water, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rescheduling of the Provincial Councils Elections
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet granted approval on 25‑07‑2017 to make amendments to the provisions in the Constitution and the relevant provisions in the Provincial Councils Elections Act, No.2 of 1988, enabling the elections for all Provincial Councils to be held on the same date.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to publish the Draft twentieth Amendment to the Constitution and the Provincial Councils Elections (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman and subsequently present the Bill in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Social Values and Psycho-Intellectual Values to be enhanced based on Reconciliation and Equality through Pre-School Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enhance the life skills of school children with a view to creating a future generation endowed with social values which would successfully adapt to the social diversity of nationality, religion and gender.  Accordingly,  the joint proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education and Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to introduce a series of lessons with a half an hour session  once a week, including practical activities in order to equip the Pre‑School children with personal and social values to enhance their life skills, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expediting the Rehabilitation and Reconstruction work in the areas damaged  by Flood and Landslide
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body:
- Due to the floods and landslides that occurred  in May this year, a number of areas including the districts of Matara, Galle, Kalutara, Ratnapura and Hambantota were severely affected.  In order to completely bring back the daily lives of the people there to normalcy, the reconstruction work and the supply of other amenities will have to be carried out expeditiously.  

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to autherize the District Secretaries to award the contracts relevant to the reconstruction work which should be done expeditiously, not exceeding Rs.50 million  based on the engineers' estimates and subject to the approval of the Procurement Committees, to the contractors registered in the Construction Industry Development Authority(CIDA), and the relief activities which should be made on medium term and long term to be implemented through the relevant Ministries and Provincial Councils, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial Assistance for the Implementation of the Wind Power Generation Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - The Asian Development Bank has agreed to provide US$ 200 million out of the sum of US$ 256.7 million required for the implementation of the Wind Power Generation Project with the objective of enhancing clean power generation and reliable power supply on concessionary conditions. The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into the relevant loan agreements to obtain the funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquisition of lands for the Light Rail Transit Project (LRT) and  payment of compensation for the affected parties
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body:
- A project for the construction of a Light Rail Transit System (LRT) has been planned to be implemented to reform the public transportation system, mitigating the traffic congestion in the Colombo Metropolitan Area and the feasibility studies on the construction of the first two Light Rail Transit routes under this project are being carried out. In order to implement the project expeditiously, it is necessary to commence the acquisition of the required lands for the purpose as soon as such lands are identified by the said feasibility study. 

	Accordingly, with the objective of acquiring the required lands without any delay by providing a more reasonable compensation to the parties affected by the project, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to adopt the methodology of the Land Acquisition and Resettlement Committees (LARC) and Land Acquisition and Resettlement Special Committees (Super LARC) for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Narahenpita New Town Development Project - Kirimandala Mawatha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the new Development Plan prepared by the Urban Development Authority, it is envisaged to develop the area in the close proximity of the Kirimandala Mawatha, Narahenpita, Colombo into a sustainable township fully equipped with residential, commercial, recreational and entertainment activities and public utilities.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to utilize the lands occupied by various Government Institutions in the area to implement the said Development Plan and to allocate alternative lands in lieu of the said lands to the relevant institutions from other areas, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Leasing out the Nuwara Eliya Race Course
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - The Nuwera Eliya Race Course managed by the Sugathadasa Sports Complex Authority has been presently leased out to a third party for conducting horse-racing activities and the validity period of the agreement expires on 31-12-2017.  Horse-racing can be promoted as a sport which could bring about investment benefits by attracting local and foreign tourists and as such, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to select a suitable lessee to lease out the race course for the forthcoming ten year period through the open bidding process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Printing of school textbooks to be distributed free of charge for the year 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - Open bids have been called from the local printers for printing of 18.53 million copies from 285 categories of school text books required to be distributed among the school children during the year 2018 free of charge. Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to get the relevant text books printed from the 25 institutions recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, taking into consideration the minimum price, the printing capacity of the bidder and the ability to supply the books within the stipulated period, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restructure of the ownership of the Hilton Hotel
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body:
- The Hilton Hotel in Colombo managed by the Hotel Developers (Lanka) PLC fully owned by the government has been identified by the budget proposal of 2016, as a non‑strategic state owned enterprise which could be considered for private investment with the divestment of  government ownership.  In order to proceed with the necessary investment for the future development of this hotel, the private sector investor involvement could motivate the private sector investments and the funds owned by the government could be utilized for other purposes of social and economic importance. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Public Enterprise Development, to provide the opportunity for the investors selected to present bids at a special board  of the Colombo Share Market, to transfer 51% of the shares of the Hotel Developers (Lanka) PLC to a suitable investor, to set apart 4% of the shares of the company to its employees and the balance shares of 45% to be sold at a fixed price at the Colombo Stock Exchange, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restructure of the ownership of the Hyatt Hotel
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body:
- The policy of the government is to promote rapid, sustainable and inclusive economic development by improving competitiveness and the performance of the state owned enterprises under its control.  Accordingly, the government has planned to restructure the ownership of a several selected non‑strategic state owned enterprises. 

A further substantial investment has to be made, in order to develop it to its full  potential owned by the Grand Hyatt Hotel project constructed by the Canwill holdings (Pvt) Ltd. belonging to the Government Institutions namely the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation, Litro Gas Company and the Employees' Provident Fund. As there are other priority issues, incurring of further funds of the public institutions for a luxury hotel project of this nature which  serves foreign tourists and only a handful of high net worth individuals in Sri Lanka is not appropriate and as such, it has been decided to call for private investment for the project. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Public Enterprise Development, to appoint a Procurement Committee and a Technology Evaluation Committee to select suitable private investors to divest  the government owned shares of the Canwill Holdings (Pvt) Ltd. implementing the Grand Hyatt Hotel Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Balance construction work of the four storey building constructed for the District Secretariat in Polonnaruwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - The construction work of Phase I of the four storey building constructed for the District Secretariat in Polonnaruwa is to be completed before the end of this year and to coincide with same, the construction work of Phase II of the project has to be commenced expeditiously.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs to award the contract for the  construction work of Phase II, taking into consideration the necessity to bring the various divisions of the District Secretariat of Polonnaruwa presently functioning in several locations, under one roof, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Essential Drugs for the treatment of Kidney Patients
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine,  to award the tender for the purchase of  80,000 Bottles of Human Albumin Solution BP/PH Eur 20% in 50ml Bottle, an essential drug used for the treatment of kidney patients for a sum of US$ 2.19 million, in accordance with the recommendations of the Procurement Appeal Board and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Drugs used for the treatment of blood volume replacement of patients
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the tender for the purchase of 8,500,000 Bottles of 500ml Sodium Chloride Intravenous Infusion BP 0.9% w/v or Sodium Chloride Injection USP, 0.9% w/v, used for blood volume replacement of patients for a sum of US$ 2.54 million, in accordance with the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of Vaccine required for Children's Immunization Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the tender for the purchase of 80,000 Vials of Adsorbed Diptheria, Tetanus, Pertussis, Hepatitis B and Haemophilus Influenza Type B Conjugate Liquid Vaccine (Pentavalent), 10 Dose Vial at a cost of US$ 568,800, for the continuation of the Children's Immunization Programme, uninterruptedly as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the purchase of Surgical Items
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contracts for the purchase of essential items and equipment used for Oral and Maxillofacial surgeries in accordance with the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Contract for the Supply and delivery of DI Pipes and Fittings for the Angunakolapelessa Pumping Main of Angunakolapelessa Water Supply Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply to award the contract for the supply and delivery of DI Pipes and Fittings required for the Angunakolapelessa Pumping Main of the Angunakolapelessa Water Supply Scheme which was implemented with the objective of providing safe drinking water to the new prison complex located in Eraminiyaya, Angunakolapelessa and for 2,000 families living in Angunakolapelessa area, at a cost of Rs.166.74 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of Water Bowsers for the Local Authorities of the Eastern    Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - Supply of drinking water through bowsers has been found as a short term solution for supply of safe drinking water to the people resided in remote areas in the dry zone which constantly subject to droughts and which do not come  under a proper water supply system. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply to purchase 23 water bowsers for the Local Authorities in the Eastern Province for the purpose, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of contracts for buildings to be constructed at the University of Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for the construction of a new building for the Engineering Technology and Bio Systems Technology Division of the University of Jaffna and the contract for the construction of an eight (08) storeyed clinical building for the Faculty of Medicine of the same University, at a cost of Rs.424.43 million and Rs.564.67 million respectively, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: New Trade Policy of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body:
- Due to the absence of a Trade Policy prepared with a constructive and formal methodology and a clear vision, the formulation of conflicting laws and regulations from time to time has created adverse effects on the expansion of trade in the country. Therefore, in the backdrop of trade and investment being given high priority, the formulation of a new Trade Policy is essential.  Accordingly, the preliminary draft of the new Trade Policy of Sri Lanka has been prepared by a Committee comprising of the experts in the relevant sectors focusing attention on the main objectives of increasing competitiveness, expanding the market access, providing trade facilitation, the macro economic balance creating policy and institutional coherence, providing facilities required for the small and medium scale entrepreneurs who could be affected, to face the competition and ensuring  the benefits of trade to be enjoyed by all parties. 

	Accordingly, 	the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to adopt the proposed Trade Policy and for ensuring the implementation of the policy measures contained therein, by all relevant institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of land ownership and proper housing facilities for the Plantation Community
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - The programme for granting clear title deeds for a block of land in extent of 07Perches has been initiated in the District of Nuwara Eliya, with the objective of providing better facilities to the Plantation Community presently living in small houses with meagre facilities. The Cabinet noted the Action Plan prepared under this programme for granting clear title deeds for the houses constructed for the Plantation Community under various housing programmes within the period from the year 2010 to the year 2016 in several Districts including the districts of Nuwara Eliya, Badulla and Kegalle under this programme submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. U. Palani Digambaram, the Minister of Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development.

description: Importation of Raw Cashew
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body:
- Although  the annual cashew demand in Sri Lanka is 20,000 MT, the local production of cashew is around 10,000 to 12,000MT.  The scarcity of  cashew prevalent in the local market has adversely affected the livelihood of a large number of families engaged in cashew production.  As such, the following methodology proposed by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Public Enterprise Development and Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Primary Industries jointly to fulfill the need of the cashew in the local market, was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	permission to import 6,000MT of raw cashew annually, for the local market and 15,000MT for re‑export by value addition  under the Temporary Import and Export Programme (TIEP)  annually, in accordance with the regulations under the Plant Protection Act, complying with the quarantine regulations, on a permit issued by the Director General of Agriculture on the recommendations of the Ministry of Public Enterprise Development, to the Ministry of Agriculture.   

*	the raw cashew imported under the TIEP scheme to carryout the value addition process in an identified port or at a place close to the port identified by the Department of Agriculture as appropriate for the purpose and for the Department of Customs to ensure that the entire quantity so imported are re‑exported. 

*	implementation of an accelerated cashew cultivation  programme to achieve self sufficiency in cashew production by 2020.

description: Amendment to the Judicature Act (Increase in the number of High Court Judges)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice to publish the Judicature (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman in the Government Gazette to increase the approved number of High Court Judges from 75 up to 85 with the objective of minimizing the delays in dispensing of cases within the judicial system in the country and carrying out such activities with efficiency and subsequently present the Bill in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Resettlement Policy Framework of the Strategic Cities Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - The social management framework designed to grant relief to the people affected due to the acquisition of their lands for the strategic cities development project implemented under the World Bank financial aid, has been developed paying special attention on the relevant geographical, economic, social and cultural factors.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to make the Resettlement Policy Framework so developed, applicable in granting compensation to the people who will be affected due to the development activities carried out in the areas where the  Strategic Cities Development Project is implemented, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction and issuance of an Electronic Passport (e-Passport) to the citizens of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - With the introduction of bio-metrics into the passport processing system, the Department of Immigration and Emigration has commenced the preliminary activities to coincide with the introduction of an 'Electronic Passport' (e-passport) and it has been identified as an essential component under the National Digitalization programme as well.  In this context, a passport in electronic format will be issued with a protective electronic chip which includes the bio-metrics of the holder of the Passport.  Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of  Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs and Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure to implement the project for the Introduction and issuance of an Electronic Passport under a Public-Private Partnership subsequent to a proper study made on the matter, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Regional Secretariat for the South Asian Conference on Sanitation (SACOSAN) in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - This Conference is held among the SAARC countries by annually, as a platform for the discussion of matters relating to sanitation.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to establish a Regional Secretariat for the South Asian Conference on Sanitation in Sri Lanka, with the objective of providing facilities for the exchange of knowledge and experiences necessary among the South Asian Countries in resolving the problems relating to sanitation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulation of the usage of  pneumatic weapons to ensure the protection of wild animals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body:
- Due to the increase in some wild animal population the crop damages caused by them also have increased in various parts of the island, and the difficulties caused to the daily lives of the people living in such areas have also increased.  On the other hand, complaints have been made to the effect that pneumatic weapons to be used for the crop protection are also used for hunting of wild animals. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to implement the following recommendations made by the Officials' Committee appointed to study the matter, was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	to look into the possibility of producing a pneumatic rifle with low power in place of the 0.22mm pneumatic rifle which is used for driving away of wild animals and to encourage the creation of a new model rifle which could drive away animals, by way of a loud noise.
 
*	regularization of the issuance of  the 0.22mm pneumatic rifles presently used for the protection of the coconut cultivation.

*	pneumatic rifles to be brought under the Firearms Ordinance.

*	conduct of bio‑scientific research with the assistance of the experts to control the high growth of animal population which cause harmful effects on  cultivations.  

*	impose controls in the usage of agro‑chemicals which result in destroying the animals who are considered beneficial to cultivations. 

*	usage of modern scientific methods to minimize the crop damages caused by the wild animals. 

*	improving the traditional methods used in the past  in driving away of animals from cultivable lands without causing harm to them with new technology and apply them to suit the present trends. 
*	minimize the disposal of waste in open grounds which is a cause for wild animals to come over to the villages. 

*	impose limits on the import of raw materials used in the production of 'hakka patas'.

description: The maintenance and expansion of railway network
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - With the increase of the passengers travelling by train, it is essential to upgrade the railway bridges and the proper maintenance of the railway road network to bear the increased axle load and the speed of the trains. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct negotiations and to enter into loan agreements for obtaining the concessionary loans agreed to be provided for the project by the Government of Austria, proposed to be implemented at an estimated cost of Euro 7.6 million for the replacement of 100 year old 7 railway bridges in the Coastal Line, the Northern Line and the Matale Line and the renovation of turn-tables in Maho, Galle and Dematagoda and for the supply of tools and equipment for the maintenance of the railway network, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The implementation of the Second Integrated Road Investment Program
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - The Phase I of the Integrated Road Investment Program initiated in the year 2014 with the objective of building up a bettter connectivity between rural communities and the vital socio‑economic Centres, is being implemented in the Southern, Central, Sabaragamuwa, North Western and North Central Provinces and in the district of Kalutara of the Western Province. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to implement the Phase II of the Integrated Road Investment Program which is to be implemented, with the target of upgrading and maintaining about 3,400 km of rural access roads and around 340 km of national roads in the Northern, Eastern, Uva and Western Provinces, and to conduct loan negotiation to obtain financing to implement the Second integrated road investment programme and to enter into a loan agreement with the Asian Development Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Centre of Excellence for Higher Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-08-01
decision_details_body: - It is observed that there is a need for a professional work force competent with skills in high management and equipped with knowledge on modern  technology for Sri Lanka to remain competitive in the global market.  Therefore, it has been proposed to set up an International Level University primarily comprising of an Engineering School and a Business School as a Public‑Private Partnership. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to establish a not for profit Company Limited by guarantee to solicit the  top Global Universities such as the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and the University of California Berkeley and  for obtaining the Private Sector investment for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-scheduling of the Provincial Councils Elections
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body: - As a result of adopting a staggered system for Provincial Councils Elections during the past, instead of adopting the methodology which prevailed in conducting of the Provincial Council Elections in all Provinces on the same day, an undesirable environment has emerged in the country resulting in a large wastage of  resources such as financial, human and other resources, undue disruption to the State service Delivery System and day to day activities of the general public and the increase of election related violence, malpractices and the abuse of state property. Taking these matters into consideration, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister to amend the relevant provisions contained in the Constitution and the Provincial Councils Elections Act, No. 2 of 1988 to enable to hold all the Provincial Council Elections in all the Provinces on the same day, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Setting up of an Emergency Pre-Hospital Care Ambulance Service in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Agreement signed by the  Government of Sri Lanka and the GVK EMRI Lanka (Private) Limited, an Emergency Pre-Hospital Care Ambulance Service project was launched on 29th of July 2016, to be implemented in the Western and Southern Provinces and to be in force for a period of one year from the date of its commencement. Under this project 88 ambulances have been deployed in the Emergency Pre-Hospital Care Ambulance Service and the Emergency Response Centre has handled 236,000 calls by the end of April 2017 and about 130 - 135 patients have been transported daily by this service with an average response time of 12.52 minutes. Having taken the success of this project into consideration, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister to arrange financial provision to further continue with the service uninterruptedly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Board of Management for the Maintenance of the Services of the Dr. Neville Fernando Teaching Hospital, Malabe
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body:
- In accordance with the approval granted by the Cabinet, necessary steps have been taken to vest Dr. Neville Fernando Teaching Hospital with the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine with effect from 2017‑08‑01. This State of the Art hospital consisting of modern high tech facilities is expected to be maintained as a teaching hospital which provides a high qualitative patient care service and as such, it has to be established similar to the manner adopted in establishing the Sri Jayawardenapura Hospital, by an Act of Parliament. 

	Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to appoint a Board of Management operative from 2017‑08‑01 comprising of experts who represent the medical, administrative, managerial and civil society under the chairmanship of  Dr. U.A. Ajith Mendis, the former Director General of Health Services for the administration and management of the services of the hospital until the hospital is established by an Act of Parliament, and to provide a sum of Rs.200 million per month for the operational cost of the hospital by managing the funds allocated to the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine for the year 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of the required medical equipment for treating Dengue patients and taking expeditious action for controlling the Dengue Outbreak
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet has granted approval to procure some essential medical and laboratory equipment  expeditiously, treating it as an emergency procurement to provide efficient intensive care treatment to Dengue patients, taking into consideration the Memorandum submitted by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, and also the Memorandum submitted by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine on the measures to be taken to control the Dengue epidemic.  Accordingly, it was decided to procure  the equipment expeditiously which can be purchased locally, to take necessary action to purchase the rest of the equipment via the Sri Lankan Diplomatic Missions abroad and to allocate a provision of Rs.300 million to the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine for the purpose. 

In addition, it was decided to grant approval to take the following action to prevent the further spreading of Dengue. 

i.	Strictly enforce the circular instructions issued by the Secretary to the President to the effect that the Heads of Departments are accountable for maintaining Dengue free office premises.  

ii.	The Ministry of Education to carry out the Dengue prevention  programmes in schools with the participation of parents and students. 

iii.	The Western Provincial Council has employed field officers to carry on house to house supervision in order to identify the breeding places of the Dengue mosquito and the same methodology to be followed by the other Provincial Councils. 

iv.	The Ministry of Finance and Mass Media, to produce and broadcast suitable short video programmes/audio programmes to make the general public aware of the importance of preventing Dengue. 

v.	Provide training to 2,000 Sri Lanka Army personnel with the assistance of the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to  make available the required care and services to the Dengue patients. 

vi.	Implement Dengue Prevention Programmes in the respective areas in collaboration with the Medical Officers of Health (MOH), Local Authority Institutions, Divisional Secretariats and Police Stations.

description: Concession Agreement of the Port of Hambantota
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25

description: Renewable Energy Absorption Transmission Development Project - procurement of materials and goods for the construction of the 4 Grid Substations at Nawalapitiya, Ragala, Wewalwatta and Maliboda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body: - It is required to construct 04 grid substations and the related transmission lines in Nawalapitiya, Ragala, Wewalwatta and Maliboda in order to provide inter connections of the upcoming mini hydro power plants to the main electricity transmission system. Bids have already been called for purchasing the materials required for the purpose and the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contracts in respect of each relevant contract package, as recommended by the Technical Evaluation Committee which assessed the bids received and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an Office Complex for the Ceylon Electricity Board in the City of Anuradhapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for the construction of an office complex in the land belonging to the Ceylon Electricity Board, located at  Maithripala Senanayake Mawatha, Anuradhapura, to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder at the cost of Rs.213.4 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Selection of a Consultancy Firm for supervision of the construction of the road section from Pothuhera to Galagedara of the Central Expressway Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for the consultancy services for supervision of the construction of the road section from Pothuhera via Rambukkana up to Galagedara (32.5 km) of the Central Expressway Project, at a cost of a sum of Rs.2,848 million, in accordance with the recommendation of the Consultancy Procurement Committee appointed by the Cabinet, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of equipment required for the Combat Battalion participating in Peace Keeping Operations in Mali
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body: - Limited International Competitive bids have been called to procure the equipment  required for the Combat Battalion to engage in peace keeping duties in Mali on behalf of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to purchase relevant equipment from the three (03) substantially responsive institutions, as recommended by the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Constitution of new Local Government Authorities and Upgrading of the  Existing Local Authorities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body:
- Provisions have not been made with regard to the constitution of  new Local Government Authorities or Upgrading of existing Local Authorities by law and therefore, previously various criterion have been followed for this purpose. As a result, the local authorities constituted are upgraded in an informal manner do not posses a viable economic background for their independent existence and the Government  has to bear  the expenses.  Such Local Authorities have found it difficult to provide the public, the service they expected from such authorities. 

A committee of experts comprising 12 members has been appointed by the Minister of  Provincial Councils and Local Government in order to submit recommendations on introducing a policy on the Constitution and upgrading of Local Government Authorities in terms of the recommendations of the Report of the Commission of Inquiry on Local Government Reforms published in the year 1999. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government  on the Constitution of Local Government Authorities or Upgrading of the existing Local Authorities  based only  on the criterion of  population and population density, number of houses and density, service delivery and level of improvement of infrastructure facilities, spread of commerce and industries, employment and the self-generated revenue within the administrative area of the proposed local authority, as recommended by the said Committee of experts,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Guidelines for Child Day Care Centres in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body:
- With the increase in the employment of women,  the demand for child day care centres too has increased. Presently, day care centres are operated by  several government and private institutions and therefore, the need has arisen to set National Standards for the proper regulation with regard to the functioning of such Centres. 

Accordingly, the 'National Guidelines for Child Day Care Centres in Sri Lanka' have been formulated having obtained the comments and views of all relevant stakeholders and experts. The proposed guidelines introduces provision for the registration process of the Child Day Care Centres, standards to be maintained and the monitoring methodology of the said mechanism. The said guidelines are proposed to be implemented under the Provincial Department of Probation and Child Care. Parallel to the proposed Guidelines,  a child care course has also been introduced for the National Vocational Qualification Level 4. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs for approval of the 'National Guidelines for Child Day Care Centres in Sri Lanka',  and to implement the said guidelines subject to a proper Action Plan, under the supervision of the Ministry of National Policies and Economic Affairs and the Ministry of Women and Child Affairs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Infrastructure facilities of the alternative lands given in respect of the lands acquired for the construction activities of Hambantota Port - Stage II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body: - The residents whose lands have been acquired for the construction activities of the Stage II of the Hambantota Port  have been granted alternative lands. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping to develop the infrastructure facilities such as roads, electricity and water in those areas expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National Credit Guarantee Institute for Small and Medium Scale Entrepreneurs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body: - The small and medium scale entrepreneurs face various difficulties in obtaining funds for new investment needs due to the absence of a national level methodology to provide long term credit guarantees to such entrepreneurs. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to establish the 'National Credit Guarantee Institute' as a limited public company under the provisions of the Companies Act, to provide the credit guarantees required for obtaining loans from the banks for new investments by the small and medium scale entrepreneurs, with a view to providing a sustainable solution to the problem, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining accreditation status for Sri Lanka in the Economic Community of the West African States (ECOWAS)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body:
- The Economic Community of the West African States (ECOWAS) was established in the year 1995 with the objective of enhancing the living standards of the people in the West African countries, maintaining and expanding the economic stability, fostering the relations among member countries and contributing to the progress and development of the African Continent and it has a membership of 15 West African countries. Out of those countries, Sri Lanka maintains diplomatic relations with 12 countries. 

It is important to obtain the accreditation status for Sri Lanka in the above Community as Sri Lanka focuses in developing and expanding its relations with Africa, especially in the field of economic activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to pursue action in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Controlling of undesirable conditions prevailing in the jungles due to the severe drought
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body:
- The severe drought conditions prevailing in the Northern, Eastern, North Central and North Western provinces have resulted in inimical situations like forest fires, in  jungles adjacent to such areas, dying of wild animals, moving of wild animals into villages in search of Water. In order to successfully control the situation the Department of Wildlife Conservation and the Department of Forest Conservation need to get the support of the other public institutions. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife to implement the proposed activities for controlling the adverse effects caused by the drought in areas adjacent to the forests through the Divisional and District Committees comprising of the officers relevant to the task, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Transferring of the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage land to the Department of National Zoological Gardens
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body: - The 'Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage' managed by the Department of National Zoological Gardens is a centre for the conservation and breeding of Asian elephants and it has been successful in focusing the attention of many tourists. With the objective of  further upgrading the Orphanage, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, for transferring the land in extent of 26 Acres and 5.8 Perches  owned by the Land Reform Commission where the Elephant Orphanage is situated, to the Department of National Zoological Gardens permanently, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Raising of funds for purchasing of 09 Nos. Diesel Multiple Units to the Sri Lanka Railway Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-25
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted to procure 12 Locomotives and 09  Diesel Multiple Units to improve the performance of the train service of the upcountry railway line by the Department of Sri Lanka Railways. The cost of the project to procure 09 Diesel Multiple Units has been estimated at US$ 93.86 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into loan agreements with the Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited and the Hatton National Bank, in order to seek funds required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Adoption of expeditious remedial measures to resolve the issues  associated with the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2017‑06‑27 appointed a Ministerial Sub‑Committee under the Chairmanship of Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera the  Minister of  Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development and the State Minister of Mahaweli Development to examine and submit a Report to the Cabinet on the difficulties encountered by the residents of the area as a result of the construction of tunnels of the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Scheme. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of  Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development and the State Minister of Mahaweli Development, to implement the following recommendations expeditiously to provide relief for the difficulties faced by the residents of the area, as a result of the construction of tunnels of the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Scheme, subsequent to a visit to the relevant area and  discussions had with the relevant parties, was approved by the Cabinet: 

*	Having made a comprehensive study, to construct six (06) large deep wells associated with the suitable locations.

*	Implement a special programme to provide water tanks within the next two (02) weeks, to family units, if any, which have not been provided with water tanks so far; 

*	Release twenty (20) tractor bowsers in the possession of the Ministry of Home Affairs, to the District Secretary, Badulla expeditiously, for further strengthening of the water distribution process; 

*	Expedite the process of the payment of compensation for the damaged properties. 

*	Establishment of a special unit by the National Buildings Research Institute for a more efficient service. 

*	Release of a financial provision of Rs.100 million expeditiously to the Provincial Council for the rehabilitation of the Rural Road Network of the affected areas. 

*	Strengthen the 'Secretariat for Relief to Persons' already established to ensure that the relief activities are efficient. 

* 	Review of the progress of the relief measures once in two weeks or monthly. 

*	Allocation of funds necessary for expediting the construction work of the proposed Bandarawela Multi Water Scheme from the Budget 2018. 

*	Release provision of Rs.100 million for the restoration of the affected small reservoirs.   

*	Hand over of the possession of the lands identified to be re‑settled expeditiously to the Divisional Secretary, Bandarawela.  

*	Provide the necessary additional financial provision to renovate the affected schools expeditiously and put them in order.   

*	Provide a 2 year relief period for the affected families for the repayment of installments of housing and cultivation loans obtained by them. 

*	Implement a special alternative livelihood development plan expeditiously in the affected areas. 

*	Action to be taken by the Company in Iran to close the water spill in the tunnel. 

*	Future drilling activities of the project to be considered only on the recommendations of the International Experts and on the recommendations made by a Committee of Local Experts.

description: Obtaining Consultancy Services to implement the Disaster Management Process in Sri Lanka more efficiently and effectively
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body: - The tendency for natural calamities has been increased due to climatic changes and concurrently the man made disasters are also increasing.  Therefore, the need for a long term plan has arisen for the management of these disaster situations efficiently and effectively. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management,  to appoint an Expert Committee comprising of experts in the field, under the Chairmanship of the Minister of Disaster Management to get the necessary advice, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Empowerment of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body:
- The Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption is the  State Institution established in Sri Lanka for eradicating bribery and corruption. Certain investigations to be handled by this Commission are of a very complex nature and as such, it has been identified that providing modern technology support and updating the knowledge and enhancing the skills of the officers are essential for enhancing the efficiency of the Commission, the Bureau for Democracy, Human Rights and Labour Affairs of the State Department of the United States of America has agreed to provide financial support for this purpose. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena to enter into the relevant Memoranda of Understanding to obtain the grant of US$ 235,000 (approximately Rs.35.25 million) agreed to be provided by the above Bureau, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Modernization of the Jaya Container Terminal of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body: - The capacity of the Jaya Container Terminal which is fully owned and operated by the Sri Lanka Port Authority has to be modernized expeditiously in order to accommodate large ships. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to implement the modernization work of Phase V of the terminal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Academic and Administrative Building of the Nurses Training School, Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body: - The has Government has decided to increase the intake of trainees for training in nursing in order to provide a qualitative health service. As such, it has been planned to construct a new academic and an administrative building for the Nurses Training School, Kalutara which functions presently within the National Institute of Health Sciences, amidst great difficulties. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for a sum of Rs.714.2 million (with tax), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The prevention of unauthorized dumping of solid waste in Colombo and the suburban areas and the emergency measures to be taken for controlling of the Dengue Epidemic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet has already granted approval to prepare an operational mechanism  to minimize the issues faced due to haphazard disposal of solid waste informally in Colombo and the suburban areas. Accordingly, an Operational Office has already been set up in the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government,  integrating the Tri‑Armed Forces, and the Police including other Institutions and the said office receives a considerable number of complaints on a daily basis. The complaints reveal that the required  cooperation of the public is not forthcoming for the disposal of waste and  the haphazard disposal of waste takes place specially during the night. Accordingly, the Joint proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government  and Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development to implement the following steps decided upon to be carried out at the meeting held under the Chairmanship of the Prime Minister, was approved by the Cabinet: 

*	installation of CCTV Cameras to observe the common sites where unauthorized waste is disposed of and to adopt a methodology to enable the officers of the Operational Office to monitor the images received from such cameras through mobile phones. 

*  making it compulsory to exhibit name boards containing all information pertaining to the construction sites in Colombo and the suburban areas, the names of the legal owners of such construction sites and the information regarding the contractor with other details. 

*  	instituting legal action against persons in their personal name working in such manner as to make way for mosquito breeding in schools, state institutions and other institutions. 

*  	make regulations under the Public Security Ordinance permitting the entry into premises which are under lock and key to conduct investigations and also to take legal action against such persons.   

*	to attach the required number of officers to the Operational Office to enable it to operate during the entire 24 hours and to provide such facilities in respect of the above.

description: Providing of relief to the People affected by Floods and Landslides Living in the plantation areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body:
- Due to the floods and landslides that occurred in the month of May in 2017, in the Districts of Galle, Ratnapura, Kegalle and Hatton, approximately 872 families living in the plantation areas were severely affected and most of their properties were destroyed. The people so affected are now residing in temporary sheds and common shelters and as such, measures are needed to be taken to relocate and their infrastructure facilities renovated. 



As such, the proposal made by Hon. U. Palani Digambaram, the Minister of  Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development, to identify suitable land to construct new houses for the re-location  of persons so affected at a cost of Rs.500 million, to provide roofing sheets for the houses that were damaged, to construct toilets in affected plantation areas, to implement water supply projects, to provide with water tanks, and to upgrade the Child Development Centres damaged due to the disaster, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body:
- As it has been identified that the appointment of Justices of the Peace for Administrative Districts instead of appointing them for a Judicial Zone, Judicial District or Division is more practicable and appropriate, the Cabinet has granted approval to amend section 45 of the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978, with a view to making provision in that regard.   

In this context, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation for the amendment of Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978 including the necessary provision to state that the Justices of Peace already appointed before the date of operation of this amendment shall be deemed to be appointed for the  relevant Administrative District containing the Divisional Secretary Division, in which their residences were situated at the time of the appointment and with the objective of implementing a code of conduct in respect of the Justices of the Peace to enable the Minister to make regulations for the suspension, cancellation and termination of the appointment of the Justices of the Peace, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting of international level training courses and workshops by the  Irrigation Training Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that there is a possibility of building up an international demand for short term training courses in respect of the development which existed with the system of irrigational civilization of Sri Lanka and the allied subjects.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to provide the necessary facilities and to design an administrative and financial methodology to conduct international level training courses at the Kotmale International Training Institute for Irrigation and Water Management (KTI-IWM)  and the Galgamuwa Irrigation Training Institute with the collaboration of the institutions like the International Irrigation and Water Management Institute and the International Water Centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of land for the Salawa Town Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body:
- Due to the explosion of the Armoury at the Salawa Army Camp premises at Kosgama, last year, damages were caused to a number of public and private properties.  In accordance with the recommendations of the special Committee appointed to make recommendations for the re‑development of the township and the buildings damaged by the explosion, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest a land in extent of 04 Acres, 02 Roods, 24.40 Perches with the Urban Development Authority as a free grant, from the premises of the Salawa Army Camp,  with the concurrence of the Sri Lanka Army, for the expeditious commencement of the following projects, was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	Widening of the main road to form four lanes
*	Allocation of land for the banks
*	Construction of the Community Centre
*	Construction of the Super Market
*	Construction of 35 Nos. of shops
*	Construction of a Children's Park and a Play Ground
*	Construction of food courts

description: Appointment of a Board of Administration for the Ranmihithenna National Tele-Cinema Park
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that it is essential to appoint a Board of Administration for the creative and efficient performance of the functions of the Ranmihithenna National Tele-Cinema Park and also to prevent unnecessary delays in the  decision making process. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to appoint a Board of Administration comprising of experts pertaining to the field and the representatives of the relevant institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Health Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body:
- The existing National Health Policy is one which had been prepared in the year 1996 and as such, the need has arisen for the introduction of a new National Health Policy to address the present emerging problems. 

Accordingly, within a period of three (03) years from 2014 to 2016 a new National Health Policy has been designed with the participation of professional experts of all sectors of the Health Service, Professionals and the Professional Institutions. In this respect, the concept of the 'Universal Health Coverage' was taken into consideration for the introduction of the new Health Policy aimed at ensuring the rights of patients and social justice centered around the patients and the public.

As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine for the approval of the said National Health Policy designed for a period of 10 years from 2016 to 2025 identifying the following major policy directions, was approved by the Cabinet.

*	Strengthening of services delivery for achieving the goals of preventive health. 

*	provision of an appropriate and accessible high quality curative care for all citizens of Sri Lanka.

*	Promotion of equitable access to qualitative rehabilitation care.


*	Establishment of a planned methodology based on the service supply data to strengthen the methodologies of uninterrupted service supplies.

*	Development of new strategies to minimize of out of pocket spending for patients and to reduce of financial risk.

*	Ensure a comprehensive health system through a better re‑structure including human resource management.

*	Development of  a strategic partnership with all health care providers.

description: Manufacture of 100 special boats to salvage the lives of victims in situations of flood disaster
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body: - During flood disasters boats have to be used to salvage the lives of people and to distribute food and other basic amenities to the people caught in the floods.  In this respect, the inability to find the required number of boats and the non‑availability of the basic essential equipment in certain boats, was a major obstacle faced during the past flood situations. As a solution to this problem, the Sri Lanka Navy has manufactured a special boat which could be used during the flood disaster situations. This boat can be made use of during night time for search and salvage operations and also for relief activities and it consists of life saving jackets, flash lights, solar panels, first aid kits and communication equipments and it can accommodate around 10 persons at a time.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management to get such 100 special boats manufactured by the Navy and to identify high risk prone areas of flood disaster and station them in close proximity to such areas, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of a new house as the super prize in 'Sevana' Lottery Draw
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body:
- In addition to the 'Sevana' instant Lottery conducted by the National Lotteries Board, another Lottery draw named 'Sevana' has been released to the market to coincide to the National Housing Day which fell on 2017‑06‑23 and its maiden draw is due to be held on 2017‑07‑27. As the super prize of this draw, it has been proposed to award a new house with all modern facilities from a suburb of Colombo or close to another urban area. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Foreign Affairs to purchase new houses from an institution recommended by the Ministry of Housing and Construction and the National Housing Development Authority to be awarded as prices, and to make the relevant contribution of the sales revenue of this Lottery to the Sevana Trust Fund, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of a Methodology to conduct the practical tests pertaining to issuing of Driving Licenses in a more qualitative and productive manner
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body:
- Public criticisms have been leveled against the malpractices that occur due to the monopoly that exist in conducting the practical tests for issuing Driving Licenses and it has been pointed out that this situation acts as a barrier to producing disciplined drivers. When considering the road accidents that presently occur the negligence of the drivers and their lack of knowledge of the road rules further justifies the above mentioned situation. 

As a solution to this state of affairs, a proposal has been made to identify  suitable parties to conduct these practice tests in addition to the Examiners of Motor Vehicles of the Department of Motor Traffic. Through this process, it is anticipated to conduct the practical tests in a more qualitative manner and through proper regulation to exert accountability. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to appoint an Officials' Committee comprising of the representatives of the relevant institutions to obtain a Report with recommendations for a suitable methodology to be adopted in this process, after a study, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of compensation to the affected persons due to the acquisition of their lands for the Moragahakanda Project, which had been provided to them in lieu of their lands inundated by Wemedilla Reservoir
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body: - The people who were deprived of their lands at the acquisition of lands for the implementation of the Wemedilla Reservoir project covering the Divisional  Secretary's Divisions of Naula, Galewela and Dambulla in the Matale District were provided with lands from the Laggala - Pallegama Divisional Secretary's Division under the Kandepitawala reservoir scheme in the year 2008.  However, action has been taken to acquire the lands so provided once again for the Moragahakanda - Kaluganga development project, and as such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, for the payment of cash as compensation for 53 persons who were so deprived of their lands in lieu of alternative lands, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Phasing-out of Hydrochloroflurocarbon harmful to the Ozone Strata
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body:
- Sri Lanka has been working on minimizing the use of ozone depleting substance known as Hydrochloroflurocarbon, since 1989 and introducing ozone friendly alternative substances, in accordance with the agreements reached and the commitments made with the Vienna Convention and the Montreal Protocol on protection of the Ozone Layer.  Accordingly, the Cabinet at its meeting held on 16‑08‑2016 appointed a Technical Committee to submit short term and long term solutions for imposing limits on the import of  Hydrochloroflurocarbon chemical while also controlling the adverse effects likely to occur on the maintenance and repair of refrigeration and air conditioning systems which necessitate the use of Hydrochloroflurocarbon.  As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, for the implementation of the recommendations of the Committee along with the following recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet: 


*	to impose a ban with immediate effect, on the import of used and reconditioned equipment falling within the category with the ozone depleting substances mentioned in the Montreal Protocol. including Refrigerators, Deep Freezers, Air conditioning Systems and Heat Pump Units, Water Coolers, Ice Machines, Vehicle Deep Freezers or Containers.  

*	to impose a ban with effect from 01‑01‑2018, on the importation to Sri Lanka of equipment or spares manufacturing or assembling in Sri Lanka using the Hydrochloroflurocarbon  exceeding the Global Warming Potential 100, and Ozone Depleting Potential 0.03. 

*	to impose a ban with effect from 01‑01‑2021, on the importation to Sri Lanka, of equipment or spares manufacturing or assembling in Sri Lanka using the Hydrochloroflurocarbon not exceeding the Global Warming Potential 100, and Ozone Depleting Potential 0.03. 

*	to make it mandatory to use Refrigerant Recovery and Recycling Machine with effect 01‑01‑2019 at all work shops which are engaged in  services, maintenance and repair of Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Systems to be incorporated as a condition, when issuing environment protection licenses.

description: Providing of hostel facilities for the Staff of the Defence Services Command and Staff College
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body: - Annually, more than 130 local and foreign officers complete the training given by the Defence Services Command and Staff College established to train the staff officers of the Three Armed Forces and the Public Service to bear the responsibilities of high positions, direct operations and perform the duties entrusted to them efficiently.  Therefore, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Defence, to construct a three storey building and a four storey building to provide  hostel facilities for the Senior Non‑Commissioned Officers of the Three Armed Forces and for the Officers of other ranks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Grant and Implementation Agreement between the Millennium Challenge Corporation and the Government of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body: - The Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC) of the United States of America which is an agency for granting foreign aid operating aimed at long term economic development through the creation of economic growth of selected countries is due to arrange a grant of US$ 7.4 million to the Government of Sri Lanka within the next period of five years for the development of several important sectors conducive to the economic  progress of the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to enter into an agreement between the Millennium Challenge Corporation and the Government of Sri Lanka to obtain the said grant and for the implementation of the programmes under its purview, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Producing of young Agricultural Entrepreneurs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body:
- The absence of a developed young agricultural community in the country to undertake agricultural activities using advanced technology, with entrepreneurial capacity  has been identified as a problem directly affecting the low productivity in the field of agriculture of the country.  Even though a considerable number of young people qualify annually from the Schools of Agriculture and from the Faculties of Agriculture in the Universities, majority of them drift away from the agriculture sector as a vocation, as a result of the field of agriculture being a non-profitable venture when compared to that of other fields and involvement in the agricultural sector is a hardly recognized vocation in the society. 

It has been planned to implement a project to produce young agriculture entrepreneurs who could engage themselves in the commercial agriculture under the National Programme on Food Production, with a view to maintaining the contribution of the agriculture sector towards the country's national production at a high level. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to provide loan facilities to obtain resources inclusive of modern agricultural technological equipment for 100 young entrepreneurs selected from the Kurunegala District under its pilot project and on the basis of the success of the pilot project to implement the project with the participation of 1000 young entrepreneurs from the South Western, North Central and Eastern Provinces and at the next stage, with the participation of 10,000 young men and women agri entrepreneurs from all parts of the island, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing buses to be deployed to ensure the safety of school children while travelling
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-18
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to provide passenger transport buses for the use of the school children of four(04) difficult educational zones in the North Central Province, taking into consideration the need to minimize the difficulties encountered while travelling and to provide safe traveling facilities for school children.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, to purchase four buses at a cost of Rs.12.86 million and deploy them to be used as a pilot project commencing under the 'Let's Protect Children' National Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memoranda of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh on Economic Cooperation and  Investment Cooperation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11

description: Initiating a Public Consultation Process on Media Entitlements and Standards
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet has already granted approval to implement the proposal for  initiating a public consultation process on Media Entitlements and Standards. As such, a public consultation process has been conducted at District level on the concept paper in respect of same enabling the representation of all communities. The then Minister of Parliamentary Reforms and Mass Media has also conducted several consultative sessions with the members of Maha Sangha, Press Council, Press Complaints Commission of Sri Lanka and the Managers of the Private  Media Institutions.  Taking into consideration all relevant views expressed at these sessions, the proposed final draft is in the process of completion. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to appoint a Ministerial Sub‑Committee to pursue action in this regard to enable to make the relevant recommendations to the Cabinet, within two(02) months, and for the Ministry of Finance and Mass Media to proceed with the process which has been initiated at the civil society and semi‑government level, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Information and Broadcasting between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to sign the MoU on Information and Broadcasting between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the People's Republic of Bangladesh, during the forthcoming State Visit of H.E. the President to Bangladesh, with a view to exchanging current news and television programmes as well as successful experiences and technology in the field of media between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh on Collaboration in the Field of Higher Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to sign a MoU between the University Grants Commission of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the University Grants Commission of the Republic of Bangladesh during the forthcoming State Visit of H.E. the President, with a view to strengthening and broadening of the collaboration in the field of higher education in both countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mid-Year Fiscal Position Report
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to table the 'Mid-Year Fiscal Position Report' inclusive of the updated information pertaining to the first four (04) months of the year 2017, in Parliament as stipulated in section 10 of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No.03 of 2003, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recruitment of Graduates to the Public Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body:
- It is essential to obtain the services of the graduates to achieve the anticipated targets of the development programmes launched by the Ministries, Departments and the other governmental institutions and specially in activities such as collection of data and information and compiling of reports. 

As such, the proposal made by Hon.
