Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to recruit graduates on district basis to fill the vacancies identified  after the determination of the required  cadre to be recruited by the Department of Management Services for each Ministry, Department and other government institution, subject to a period of one year training, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Mutual Cooperation in Shipping Business between the Ceylon Shipping Corporation and the Bangladesh National Shipping Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - A Shipping Service Agreement has been signed between the Republic of Bangladesh and the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka in the year 2011 and according to the Agreement the parties of the relevant two countries have agreed to undertake a joint study  on all options of maritime connectivity between the two countries and for that matter to launch a Joint Study Group.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to sign the MoU on Mutual Cooperation in shipping business drafted by the joint group after a series of meetings, during the forthcoming State Visit of H.E. the President to Bangladesh, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Sri Lanka Institute of Textile and Apparel (SLITA) and the Chittagong BGMEA Institute of Fashion and Technology (CBIFT), Bangladesh
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to enter into the MoU between the Sri Lanka Institute of Textile and Apparel (SLITA) and the Chittagong BGMEA Institute of Fashion and Technology (CBIFT), Bangladesh during the forthcoming of state visit of H.E. the President to Bangladesh, with a view to promoting the collaboration in the educational and professional activities of the fashion and technology fields, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of Electronic Identity Registration for Sri Lankans
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - Due to the complexity of the subject matter of the project initiated for the establishment of the  Household Transfer Management (HTM) System for Sri Lankans, it has now been re‑reviewed.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to provide each and every Sri Lankan with a permanent electronic registration number and through this to provide the general public with the relief measures and other benefits granted by the Government expeditiously and effectively, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the  micro:bit Educational Foundation and the  Ministry of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - Having identified the necessity of improving the digital skills of the school children, the Ministry of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure submitted a proposal named  'Providing Awareness of Internet of Things (IoT) through the use of Basic Hardware' and the Cabinet has already granted approval for the implementation of the project.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to sign an MoU between the  micro:bit Educational Foundation and the  Ministry of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure and to purchase the training equipment kits necessary for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Kawashima Compost Plants at Provincial Level
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to purchase Kawashima Compost Plants to establish compost yards in 09 Provinces adopting the Japanese Kawashima Technology, in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, with a view to providing a solution to the major problem being the waste problem faced by the Provincial Councils presently, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of footwear for students in difficult, most difficult and isolated schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The Government continues to implement the annual programme for provision of footwear to the students studying in the difficult, most difficult and the isolated schools.  The procedure adopted at present in respect of the process, takes a considerable amount of time and also is faced with the practical difficulties with regard to the size of the footwear to match that of the measurement of the students.   As such, with a view to providing quality footwear for the students without delay, and as well as enhancing the competition among the producers, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to issue a cash voucher to the students when the programme for provision of footwear to the students for the year 2017 is implemented, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of  the land called 'Sathyawadi' at Kurunegala for a Mixed Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to lease the above mentioned land in extent of  01Acre, 01Rood, 21.15Perches to M/s. Fairway Holdings (Pvt.) Limited for a mixed development project, in accordance with the recommendation of the Ministry Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relocation and improvement of the Technical College at Anamaduwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Chandima Weerakkody, the Minister of  Skills Development and Vocational Training, to award the contract for the relocation and improvement of the Technical College at Anamaduwa to M/s. Antony Builders, the lowest substantive responsive bidder, in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of a PET/CT Scanner for the Apeksha Hospital at Maharagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - As the PET/CT scanner detects cancers very accurately  and conveniently at the early stage itself, there is the possibility of performing prompt treatment. In this regard, the donors being the general public had made lavish contributions to the National Health Development Fund for the purchase of a high quality PET/CT scanner. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to purchase the required scanner making use of these funds, in accordance with the recommendations of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of contracts for the new buildings to be constructed at Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways to award the contracts pertaining to the following construction projects in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet: 

*	construction of a six story building for the Department of Statistical Sciences of the Faculty of Science of the University of Colombo.

*	construction of a building complex for the Lecture Theatre for the Faculty of Science  of the University of Kelaniya.

*	construction of buildings for the Faculty of Technology of the University of Sri  Jayawardenapura.

description: Restructuring of the Kahatagaha Graphite Lanka Limited (KGLL)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, prior to this, had decided to appoint a Ministerial Sub-Committee under the Chairmanship of the Minister of Special Assignments comprising of seven (07) other Cabinet Ministers to examine the present situation of the Kahatagaha Graphite Lanka Limited and make recommendations to make it viable as a profit making institution. Accordingly, in accordance with the recommendations of the Ministerial Sub‑Committee, retaining the mining with the KGLL, and to form a new company for  value addition with a private investment as well and to increase the value addition process of the graphite so as to have a more capital formation for the company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Roadmap for export competitiveness of Sri Lanka through innovation & entrepreneurship
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - Although, the recent economic performance of Sri Lanka has been encourging, the transmission to upper middle-income status requires the enterprise sector to improve its productivity significantly through the adoption of technology entering into a global value chains and new markets, creating  better job opportunities and contributing to overall economic growth of the country. Accordingly, in order to identify the challenges affecting the enhanced competitiveness of Sri Lanka, a comprehensive report has been complied with the participation of relevant stakeholders identifying the specific reforms needed in laws, regulations and institutional arrangements to be done. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies; Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research; and Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce for the creation of a national innovation and  entrepreneurship community, a targeted procedure / a plan proposed for the enhancement of the export competitiveness of Sri Lanka, to appoint three working groups and to establish a Secretariat for Innovation and entrepreneurship under the Ministry of Development Strategies and International Trade, to conduct the operational activities of the overall procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Digital Economy of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body:
- With the result of the growth of the ability to gain access to digitization and the internet connectivity, a great impact has been made on the lives of the people and specially on ways in which the people are engaged such as in work, travel, learning activities, socialization and entertainment. At the same time, as the digital economy has permeated every aspect of the modern economy and as a result of which, progress has been achieved in the fields pertaining to rapid expansion of the market beyond the domestic borders, initiation of innovative methods in regard to business enterprises, provision of the strength needed for the scientific breakthroughs, generating of new employment opportunities and enhancement of labour productivity and economic development. 

	Even though, Sri Lanka has made a significant progress in the promotion of digital infrastructure facilities, the achievement has not been adequate to meet the goal in transforming Sri Lanka into a digital economy. As such, through  the penetration of the digital economy of Sri Lanka, the need for a clear strategy for empowering every one  to reap its benefits has arisen. Accordingly,  the joint proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure; and Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade for the preparation of appropriate strategies for the digitization of the economy and to take appropriate measures for the implementation  of the proposed projects by the Ministry of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure and the Ministry of Development Strategies and International Trade, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of quarters for the officers of the National Police Academy, Katana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - In the National Police Academy of Katana, five training courses are conducted daily with the objective of enhancing the knowledge, skills and attitudes of the Police personnel and around 250 officers take part in them. The officers engaged in the administrative activities of the said training courses have to be provided with  accommodation facilities and therefore, 11 quarters have to be constructed for the purpose. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development to initiate the construction activities of the project for the construction of the said quarters utilizing the provision set apart for the year 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquisition of the land where the Sri Lanka Police College of the Mahiyanganaya Unit is situated to the Sri Lanka Police
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development to vest the land called Madayayawatta situated in Mahiyangana, in extent of Acres 141 Roods 3 and 11.03 Perches where the Sri Lanka Police College of the Mahiyanganaya Unit is established, with the Sri Lanka Police, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Modernization of School Classrooms for creating a qualitative learning environment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - In line with the  socio economic development which had taken place during the past six decades, the field of education too has undergone rapid modernization and along with it several positive changes have been brought about in    development of new curricular, updating practical tests and teaching learning methodologies and enhancing skills through group activities. In order to facilitate such changes, steps have been taken to establish classrooms  with modern facilities, laboratories, computer centres and language labs in schools. Concurrent to this, to make it more convenient for the students seated in one place for long hours being engaged in their educational activities, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education to provide furniture made out of polymer materials (without PVC) to class rooms in all the schools during the four (04) year period, commencing from the year 2017, replacing the wood and iron mixed desk and chairs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of relief to school children affected by the recent disaster situations and rebuilding of the damaged schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - As a result of the floods and landslides that occurred during the month of May last, various damages have been caused to 472 schools constituting of 182 schools in the Southern Province, 177 schools in the Western Province and 112 schools in the Sabaragamuwa Province and 01 school in the Nuwara Eliya District. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education to relocate certain schools out of those damaged in other places and to rehabilitate the furniture, computers, library books, laboratories, sports material, aesthetic equipment etc., back to normal and to provide per child with 03 sets of school uniform and a pair of footwear, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuing of Title Deeds for the houses constructed under the Estate Housing Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The 'New Life Housing Programme' and the 'Green Gold Housing Programme' have been implemented since the year 2010 for the construction of houses for the plantation sector community and 1,122 houses and 1,742 houses have been constructed, respectively up to the year 2016 and given over to the plantation sector community. Initial steps have already been taken to construct a further 2,000 houses under the 'Green Gold Housing Programme' and another 1,134 houses to be constructed under the Indian Grant Housing Programme. Since there is a Cabinet decision to grant a land in extent of 07 perches for the construction of houses with more facilities with a view to enhancing the life standard of the plantation sector community, the proposal made by Hon. U. Palani Digambaram, the Minister of Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development to issue Title Deeds to cover the Estate Houses constructed and given over under the 'New Life Housing Programme' and the 'Green Gold Housing Programme' implemented from 2010 up to 2016, as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Land to construct houses for the labourers residing at the Mahaberiyathenna Farm
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 08th of April 2015 has granted approval as a matter of policy to provide houses together with the ownership of land for the labourers employed in the Estates. There are 210 labourers residing permanently in the Mahaberiyathenna Farm belonging to the National Livestock Development Board (NLDB) and the approval of the Director Board of the NLDB has been given to allocate a land in extent of 12 acres to provide 07 perches each to be distributed among such labourers for the construction of houses. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to allocate the above extent of land, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Prescription (Special Provisions) Act, No.5 of 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body:
- The period of validity for the implementation of the provisions contained in the  Prescription (Special Provisions) Act, No.5 of 2016 passed in Parliament, with a view to enabling the persons who were deprived of their lands including immovable properties to pursue their rights in courts for the recovery of such properties, will end by the 25th day of April 2018.  

Since, a considerable number of persons who were deprived of their properties or had to abandon them within the period from 01st of May 1983 up to the 18th of May 2009 covered by the provisions of this Act,  have not been able to avail themselves of the benefit under this Act, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to amend the Prescription (Special Provisions) Act, No.5 of 2016 by extending the period of the validity of the Act by a further period of two years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of the membership fee for the International Convention on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval to obtain the membership of this convention for Sri Lanka which has a membership of 128 countries. By entering into this convention, Sri Lanka will gain the opportunity for free access to the food production, agricultural research and development process under the convention, free of charge. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, for the payment of the contribution due to the convention for the years 2016 and 2017 on behalf of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of two Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Power Plants in collaboration with the Governments of India and Japan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka has expressed its willingness for the Governments of India and Japan to establish two(02), 500MW capacity Liquefied Natural Gas Power Plants in Sri Lanka on Government to Government basis.  Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy and Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade to issue Letters of Intent to the Governments of India and Japan, to establish two power generation plants was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Further Implementation of the programme for the Control of Weligama Coconut Leaf Wilt and Rot Disease
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The Weligama Coconut Leaf Wilt and Rot Disease caused by a bacteria called Phytoplasma which is harmful to the coconut cultivation has spread in 12 Divisional Secretary's Divisions of the Matara District, 2 Divisional Secretary's Divisions of the Hambantota District and 2 Divisional Secretary's Divisions of the Galle District. After the affliction of this disease the coconut tree will be completely destroyed with the gradual reduction in the crop yield and causing the debility of the tree.  A disease management programme was initiated in the year 2008 and after controlling the disease the necessary measures have been taken to prevent the spread of the disease outside the Zone. By now, the number of trees which have been infected with the disease have decreased and at the end of the year 2016, 290,279 infected trees have been uprooted. In addition,  the activities such as making the land owners aware, payment of compensation, conducting of research on the disease and taking initiatives to plant resistant varieties have been undertaken during the past period.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of  Plantation Industries to further implement the disease control programme during the period of next 03 years until the disease is completely eradicated  from the zone where it has been spread and to make use of provision in a sum of Rs.213.60 million for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The proposed revision of duty on Soya Beans and Soya Poonac
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body:
- Taking into consideration a proposal made to grant import tax relief for the promotion of Soya Bean cultivation and the Soya Bean based food production, the Cabinet granted approval for the implementation of the following recommendations made by the Minister of Finance and Mass Media further to  discussions with the relevant stakeholders, on the request made by the Cabinet: 
	
i.	to continue with the existing duty structure on the importation of the Soya Bean seeds.

ii.	waiver of Customs Import Duty  on the importation of Soya Been seeds for established for Soya Bean Value-added manufacturing purposes or the seedling for cultivation purposes based on the recommendation of the Department of Agriculture.

iii.	to continue with the existing duty structure with the exemption of Customs Import Duty on the importation of Soya Poonac by the  animal feed producers.

iv.	to create a level playing field between the Soya Bean based    Value-added product manufacturers and the animal feed producers and also to provide the relief required for the Soya cultivators.

description: Rehabilitation and reconstruction of the properties damaged by the recent adverse weather conditions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - It has been estimated that a sum between Rs.50 to Rs.60 billion will be  required for the rehabilitation and reconstruction of the properties damaged due to floods, landslides and cyclones caused by the recent adverse weather conditions. This is approximately 0.5% of the Gross Domestic Production and it will be a challenge to further fiscal expansion in that regard.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to utilize the potential savings for the year 2017, and part of the supplementary support services and contingencies available within the existing  budgetary provisions of 2017, for the re-building activities without any further delay, by reviewing the basis of priority on various projects for which provision has been set apart for the year 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No.43 of 2000
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval in the year 2013 for the amendment of the  Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No.43 of 2000, and to make several amendments including the change of the name of the 'Insurance Board of Sri Lanka' to read as the 'Insurance Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka'. The draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman in this regard, has been further amended taking into consideration the recommendations of the Cabinet Sub -Committee on Legislation and the proposals made by the representatives of the Insurance Industry. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to publish the proposed amended Bill in the Government Gazette and present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Agency for Public-Private Partnership
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, for the establishment of the National Agency for public-private partnership as an independent institution with  adequate legal, administrative and financial powers, instead of the public-private partnership  division presently functioning in the Ministry of Finance and Mass Media to select projects based on the public-private partnership collaboration, their implementation and to provide guidance to the Ministries and other Government Institutions in respect of such projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting of the 6th SAARC Health Ministers Conference on the 27th up to 29th of July, 2017 in Colombo, Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The conference of the Health Ministers of the member states of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) is scheduled to be held on the 27th up to 29th of July 2017 in Colombo.  At this conference, it will be possible after discussion on common challenges faced by the countries of the SAARC region to reach consensus on measures to be adopted in this regard. Concurrent to the above conference, the meetings of the Health Secretaries, the Technological Committee and the SAARC Expert Groups will be held on the 27th and 28th of July 2017.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, for Sri Lanka to host the conference, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuation of the activities of the Herbal Farmer Company Ltd. further under the Ministry of Primary Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body:
- The Herbal Farmer Village Project which started in the year 2004 with the objective of producing the raw materials required in the production of Indigenous Medicine, instead of importing them, has been converted into the Herbal Farmer Company Ltd. in the year 2007.  The company is operated to purchase Indigenous Medical products, elevate the status of the herbal farmers, and to supply raw materials for the production of indigenous medicine. Even though, proposals were called for from investors for a joint venture under  a Public-Private Partnership collaboration so that it will not create a financial  burden to the Government, no suitable investor has responded in this connection.  

	As such, with a view to promoting the living standard of the indigenous herbal farmers and providing a significant contribution to the national economy through the production of medicinal plants, the Cabinet granted approval to vest the assets and the resources of the company to the Ministry of Primary Industries for the further continuation of the activities of the company.

description: Bilateral Cooperation with the Russian Federation on Technology and Innovation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body:
- In accordance with the agreements reached during the recent State Visit of H.E. the President to Russia and the collaborative initiatives made with the relevant institutions by the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, it is due to improve further the national capabilities in space technology and the currently on going initiatives for development, between the two countries. 
Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research to conduct short term training programmes for the improvement of human resource capacity development in the fields of Aerospace Technology, Space Technology and Applications, Robotics and Bio‑Medical Engineering and to implement a Post Degree programme with a view to providing opportunities for the Sri Lankan Engineers and Scientists, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Standards Institution and the Bangladesh Standards and Research Institution
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Standards Institution and the Bangaladesh Standards and Research Institution for cooperation, during the state visit of H.E. the President to Bangladesh, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Empowerment of District Secretaries to respond immediately at disaster situations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - Considering the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, the Cabinet decided to grant approval as a matter of National Policy, to empower District Secretaries to secure the support of Divisional Secretaries, other officers attached to other Ministries serving in those offices and other relevant institutions to implement all relief measures more efficiently and effectively including rescue operations for saving the victims of sudden disasters and providing expeditious relief and to incur the required expenditure to carry out the essential activities efficiently and independently.

description: Payment of compensation for persons deceased due to the  landslide that occurred at the  Meethotamulla Solid Waste Dump
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11

description: Acquisition of Government vehicles on Operating Lease Basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Police needs 1,050 vehicles constituting of 800 Motor Cycles and 250 Land cruisers for its use.  According to the existing market prices a sum of Rs.4.5 billion is required for the purpose.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to obtain these vehicles under the operating lease basis instead of the general financing lease basis, taking into consideration the benefit of reducing the risk to be borne by the state and the advantage of the significant reduction in the loan amount to the government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a loan scheme for young graduates for business  initiatives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - In the Budget 2016, it was proposed to provide loan facilities to young graduates subject to a maximum of Rs.1.5 million with a view to encouraging their participation in the economic development process of the country.  The  Bank of Ceylon and the People's Bank have expressed their willingnes to participate in the implementation of this loan scheme. In this regard, applications have been called through paper advertisements and 80 such applications have been received.   Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, for the Bank of Ceylon and the People's Bank to award the loan funds necessary for the implementation of 40 business projects recommended by the Sectoral Evaluation Committee comprising of experts relating to the relevant fields which evaluated the said business projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The study on supply of potable water to the population in Jaffna Peninsula through the development of water resources in the Vadamarachchi Lagoon
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body:
- Although, the National Water Supply and the Drainage Board has implemented 16 various water supply projects in the Jaffna Peninsula, it has been able to provide pipe borne water facilities only to a fraction of 9% out of a total population of 600,000 living in the area.  The scarcity of  potable water resources is the major obstacle for the implementation of drinking water projects in Jaffna.  As a remedial measure, it has already been decided to establish a Desalination Water Plant to purify sea water and provide drinking water.  

In addition, it has been proposed to store the rain water from the rains that occur from the period of October to December of the year in an area of 10 km of the Vadamarachchi lagoon and to implement a potable water supply project out of the water so collected.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs to make a comprehensive feasibility study on this, taking into consideration the data and information collected pertaining to the research already carried out in this regard, with the collaboration of the related Government institutions as well as the Northern Provincial Council, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proper Management of the use of polythene to minimize environmental issues caused by polythene
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11

description: Establishment of a National Mechanism for minimizing the Green House Gas emission in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka, being a party to the 21st conference of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change held in the year 2015 in Paris, is bound to keep Green House emission at a minimum level.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to name the Ministry of Mahaweli Development and Environment as the national focal point for the approval of the related projects and for the successful implementation of the Nationally Appropriate Mitigation Activities (NAMA) on minimizing the Green House Gas emission, to establish the relevant coordinating unit at the Climate Change Secretariat of the said Ministry and to establish the implementing mechanism and the institutional framework needed for the successful implementation of the projects in Sri Lanka, approved by the above Coordinating Unit, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renewal of Acquisition and Cross-servicing Agreement signed between the Ministry of Defence of Sri Lanka and the Department of Defence of the United States of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - An Agreement has been signed between the Defence Department of the United States of America and the Defence Services of Sri Lanka to exchange supplies and services at times of need, to train the service personnel and to provide humanitarian support during disaster situations, on the 05th of March 2007, valid for a period of 10 years and by now the period of validation has elapsed. Negotiations have been conducted in this regard and both the parties have agreed to further renew the Agreement. In this regard, H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, made the Cabinet aware of the fact that the said agreement is scheduled to be signed between the two countries for the purpose of the further validation of the agreement, considering the global security situations, the need for further continuation of the  international relationships positively and to create an opportunity for the promotion of new technological, training and development opportunities,

description: Expert Panel on Impact Management of Natural Disasters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, for setting up of an Expert Panel on Impact Management comprising of the representatives of the related institutions, to study the causes of natural disasters such as floods and landslides and to prevent and mitigate the harmful effects caused by them and to recommend short term and long term remedial measures that could be adopted, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka in the field of Information and Communication Technology and the related Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - Recommendations have been made to sign a MoU between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka with the objective of broadening the development of corporation pertaining to the field of  Information and Communication Technology and the field of Digital Technology.  The two countries have reached consensus on the diplomatic level in this regard and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure to sign the MoU during the forthcoming State visit of H.E. the President to Bangladesh, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of Kotmale Mahaweli Maha Seya sacred site to the Mahaweli Cultural Foundation Trust
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - The Mahaweli Cultural Foundation Trust has been established with a view to taking appropriate measures for the completion of the construction activities of the Kotmale Mahaweli Maha Seya which is underway, to carry out the future maintenance and renovation activities of the Maha Seya and for the stability of Buddhasasana while providing protection for Buddhism as well as the identity of Buddhist culture. H.E. the President made the Cabinet aware of the fact that having obtained the recommendation of the Department of Archaeology, measures will be taken to release the state land in extent of 40 Acres 03 Roods 31.6 Perches situated in the Kotmale Victoria Zone on a free grant to the Trust to achieve its objectives.

description: Signing of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Bandaranaike International Diplomatic Training Institute (BIDTI) of Sri Lanka and the Foreign Service Academy (FSA) of Bangladesh
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Foreign Affairs to sign a MoU between the Bandaranaike International Diplomatic Training Institute (BIDTI) of Sri Lanka and the Foreign Service Academy (FSA) of Bangladesh, with the objective of establishing an appropriate framework to provide information with regard to the training of diplomats of Sri Lanka and Bangladesh, exchanging of expertise knowledge and resources and to extend facilities for the participation in relevant conferences and workshops during the forthcoming State visit of H.E. the President to Bangladesh , was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Lakshman Kadirgamar Institute for International Relations and Strategic Studies of Sri Lanka and the Bangladesh Institute of International & Strategic Studies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Foreign Affairs to sign a MoU, between the Lakshman Kadirgamar Institute for International Relations and Strategic Studies of Sri Lanka and Bangladesh Institute of International & Strategic Studies with the objective of gaining experiences, expertise knowledge and exchange of research publications in the areas of mutual interest, exchanging of  researchers and experts on short term and long term basis and conducting integrated research projects of mutual interest, during the forthcoming State visit of H.E. the President to Bangladesh , was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a Loan of  (USD) 75 million from the International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank for the Financial Sector Modernization Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - On a Cabinet approval granted earlier negotiations have been conducted to initiate a loan negotiation to obtain USD 75 million from the International Development Association of the World Bank for the Financial Sector Modernization Project. Since the interest rate of 3.20% for the 3rd quarter of the 17th Financial Year of the World Bank proposed earlier had been revised to 3.36% by the time the relevant negotiations were conducted, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into a Loan Agreement with the IDA to obtain a Credit of Special Drawing Rights (SDR) of 55.4 million being equivalent to USD 75 million, based on the exchange rate between SDR and USD on the date of the previous month to the month proceeding the loan negotiation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Cardiology Unit at the Teaching Hospital - Batticaloa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - The Batticaloa Teaching Hospital  is one of the premier hospitals in the Eastern Province and it provides tertiary health care  not only for the people of the Batticaloa District but also for the people from the adjacent Districts namely Ampara and Trincomalee. Due to the non‑availability of a Cardiology unit at the hospital the patients have to be transferred to far away hospitals for advanced Cardio vascular treatment and as such it has been identified that it is essential to construct a Cardiology unit for the hospital. National Competitive Bids have been invited to select a suitable contractor for the construction of this unit and in response 13 bidders have presented their bids. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the relevant contract to M/s Ancheneye Constructions (Pvt.) Ltd., the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder in accordance with the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee which evaluated the bids and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the National Stroke Centre at the Colombo East Base Hospital, Mulleriyawa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body:
- Stroke is a leading cause for adult disabilities and it is recoverable withe proper treatment and rehabilitation facilities. At present, it is only at the Ragama Rehabilitation Hospital that modern facilities are available for treatment of strokes. Therefore, it has been proposed to establish the National Stroke Unit at Colombo East Base Hospital, Mulleriyawa for the improvement of treatment facilities of stroke patients.  

	National Competitive Bids have been invited to select a suitable contractor for the construction of this unit and in response 09 bidders have presented their bids. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the relevant contract to M/s R.N. Constructions (Pvt.) Ltd., the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder in accordance with the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee which evaluated the bids and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The ten storey building under construction for the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to be increased to form a 16 storey building
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approval was granted to award the contract to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau to construct a 10 storey building for the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine on design and built basis at an estimated cost of Rs. 3,896.55 million, and the construction work is  presently, underway. As the proposed building is insufficient to accommodate  all the divisions functioning under the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to add 6 more storeys to make it a 16 storey building and thereby to increase the sum of the cost estimate accordingly, from Rs.3,896.55 million up to Rs5,979.29 million and to handover the construction work on the design and built basis as agreed upon earlier, to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Accident & Emergency Treatment Unit at the Teaching Hospital - Kandy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - A recommendation has been made for the construction of the that an Accident & Emergency Treatment Unit at the Teaching Hospital, Kandy under the development of the accident and emergency treatment services in Sri Lanka. National Competitive Bids have been invited to select a suitable contractor for the construction of this unit and in response 11 bidders have presented their bids. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the relevant contract to M/s Link Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd., the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder in accordance with the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee which evaluated the bids and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Accident & Emergency Treatment Unit at the Teaching Hospital - Anuradhapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - A recommendation has been made for the construction of an Accident & Emergency Treatment Unit at the Teaching Hospital, Anuradhapura with a view to providing an easily accessible high quality patient care service for preventing deaths and disabilities caused by accident. National Competitive Bids have been invited to select a suitable contractor for the construction of this unit and in response 09 bidders have presented their bids. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the relevant contract to M/s. Electro Metal Pressings (Pvt.) Ltd., the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder in accordance with the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee which evaluated the bids and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new Nurses' Hostel at the Sri Jayawardenapura General Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - A nursing staff of 750 is engaged at the Sri Jayawrdenapura General Hospital for patients care services and hostel facilities are provided only for 200 nurses out of them. As such, National Competitive Bids have been invited for the construction of a new nurses hostel to provide a further number of about 300 officers with hostel facilities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the relevant contract to M/s Sripalie Contractors (Pvt.) Ltd., the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder in accordance with the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee which evaluated the bids and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Accident & Emergency Treatment Unit and the Accident Wards, Operating Theatres and the Intensive Care Unit at the Base Hospital (Teaching) - Gampola
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - The Base Hospital (Teaching), Gampola  is one of the premier hospitals of the Central Province comprising of around 350 beds and it functions as an affiliated teaching hospital as well, for the medical students of the University of Peradeniya. As such, in order to prevent the deaths and disabilities caused by accidents and to provide high quality care for a large number of patients, the facilities of the Intensive Care Units, Accident Wards and Operating Theatres of the hospitals have to be developed. As such, National Competitive Bids have been invited to select a suitable contractor for the construction of the Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit, Accident Wards, Operating Theatres and the Intensive Care Unit of this hospital. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the relevant contract to M/s Electro Metal Pressings (Pvt.) Ltd., the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder in accordance with the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee which evaluated the bids and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementing the Projects for the development of the Infrastructure facilities of the Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to implement 14 projects for the development of infrastructure facilities at the Universities of Peradeniya, Rajarata, Sri Jayawardenapura, Sabaragamuwa, Jaffna, Wayamba and the Open University,   with a view to enhancing the space and facilities available in the Universities, in order to increase the annual intake of students and providing the necessary facilities to the present students, at an estimated cost of Rs.7,640.23 million to be implemented within the period of 2018 - 2020, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new seventeen storey office building and four workshops in lieu of the affected buildings that belong to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority  due to the Port Access Elevated Highway Project funded by the  Asian Development Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, for the construction of a new seventeen storey office building and four workshops in lieu of the affected buildings that belong to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority  due to the Port Access Elevated Highway Project funded by the  Asian Development Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Augmentation of water pipelines concurrent to the improvement of the Orugodawatta - Ambatale Road Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - The augmentation of water distribution pipelines from Orugodawatta up to Kaduwela are required to be carried out concurrent to the development of the Orugodawatta - Ambatale Road Development Project. The Cabinet has granted approval to award the contract of this project for a sum of Euro 46.21 million at its  meeting held on 2017‑03‑21. While the Uni Credit Bank of Austria has consented to provide 85% of the required funds for the project, the People's Bank has expressed its willing to provide the balance  of 15%.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into the relevant loan Agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Tamil Medium Secondary School in the Matugama town
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body:
- In the Matugama Educational Zone of the Kalutara District  there are 18 estate and other schools which provide Tamil Medium education. These schools are primary schools that conduct classes only from Grade 1 to 5. As such, there are no Tamil Medium schools in the Zone, suitable for the students to seek education for the Advanced Level standards and therefore, the Tamil Medium students have to often attend the schools either in the Kalutara or Horana Educational Zones. As for the students who follow the Advanced Lelvel Classes in Science and Maths subjects, they have to invariably attend to schools situated in the Beruwela or Darga town educational zones.  


Therefore, it has been identified that it is essential to commence a secondary school in the Tamil Medium in close proximity with the Matugama town. 

Accordingly, taking into consideration the joint proposal made by Hon. Mano Ganeshan, the Minister of National Co-existence, Dialogue and Official Languages and Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, the Cabinet granted approval for the establishment of a Tamil Medium Secondary School in close proximity with the Matugama town with the corporation of the Ministry of Education and the Western Provincial Ministry of Education and to set apart a land in extent of about 05 acres for the purpose, from the Matugama Estate managed by the Namunukula Estate Company.

description: Acquisition of a land to the Sri Lanka Police for the construction of the  Bulathsinhala Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to vest a land in extent of 04 acres owned by the Horana Plantation Company situated in the Athura village in the Bulathsinhala Grama Niladhari Division with the Sri Lanka Police to construct a building to house the Bulathsinhala Police Station, presently functioning in a closed down school building, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Release of a block of land for an Integrated Solid Waste Management Project implemented by the Urban Council of Chillaw, Pradeshiya Sabha of Chillaw and Pradeshiya Sabha of Arachchikattuwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body:
- The daily collection of Solid Waste within the limits of the Chillaw Urban Council is around 18 to 20 Mt while within the limits of the Pradeshiya Sabha of Chillaw and Arachchikattuwa the Solid Waste collection daily amounts to around 06 to 05 Mt, respectively. These Solid Waste is disposed of in sites which are not scientifically developed for such dumping and as a result, environmental and societal issues have cropped up. As such, an integrated Waste Management Project has been planned to be implemented by these three (03)  Local Government Institutions for the management of the non‑degradable waste collected within their limits. 

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to vest a plot of land in extent of 05 acres out of the land called Manaweriyawatta, situated in the Karukkuliya Grama Niladhari Division within the Divisional Secretary's Division of Arachchikattuwa  belonging to the Land Reform Commission and presently possessed by the National Livestock Development Board, with the Chillaw Urban Council on a 30 year lease basis in order to implement the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commemoration of the World Post Day 2017 - Polonnaruwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - Arrangements have been made to hold the 143rd Anniversary of the  Commemoration of the World Post Day which falls on the 09th of October 2017 centered around the North Central Province. Accordingly, Hon. M.H.A. Haleem, the Minister of Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs informed the Cabinet that action has been taken to organize activities pertaining to holding of the National Commemoration of the World Post Day on the 09th of October 2017 in Polonnaruwa under the patronage of H.E. the President, and concurrent to the above, to renovate 34 Post Offices and Sub‑Post Offices in the Districts of Polonnaruwa and Anuradhapura with modern facilities, to conduct blood donation campaigns and social service projects at Divisional Level with the contribution and participation of all employees of the Postal Department and to carry out the evaluation programmes of a Postal Staff of 25,000 employees.

description: Providing essential welfare and livelihood development for women and children affected by floods and landslides
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body:
- The Ministry of Women and Child Affairs have been allocated a sum of Rs.75 million by the Ministry of Finance and Mass Media for providing essential relief measures for women and children affected by floods and landslides. Even by now, various public institutions, non-governmental institutions as well as private sector institutions have intervened to fulfill the basic needs of the affected women and children. It has been planned to implement a project utilizing the said funds  with the objective of re-orienting the livelihoods of families whose income sources have been broken and for the future welfare activities of the children of such families.  

Accordingly, taking into consideration a proposal made by Hon. Mrs. Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, the Cabinet granted approval, to design a sustainable mechanism and a methodology for the continued financial assistance in respect of the welfare of the women and children affected by floods and landslide disasters.

description: Importation of Sheep for the National Livestock Development Board to promote Sheep Industry in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - Sheep Farming is mainly confined to the National Livestock Development Board Farms and a few private farms in the Northern and North Western Provinces.  The present stock of breedable animals are not up to the standard level as they have undergone inbreeding for many years and as such, the need for high quality breedable sheep has arisen since, after the first half of the 1980's introduction of new genes to the existing herds have not been made in Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to import 25 breedable male sheep and 100 breedable female sheep for breeding, following the formal procurement procedure and to utilize Rs.10 million set apart for the purpose from the 2017 budgetary provision, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting research to identify effective Bio Control Agents for pest and disease management related to tea cultivation in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries,  to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between Synkromax Biotech (Pvt) Ltd. in India and the Tea Research Institute of Sri Lanka for the isolation, identification, characterization and the development and evaluation of suitable bio control agents for the management of termites, white grubs and root and stem diseases harmful to the tea cultivation in Sri Lanka and to make an analysis of the results of evaluation in regard to the usage of the said methodology with the objective of enhancing the productivity and the profitability of tea lands, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting Incentives for Desiccated Coconut Millers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - In the export industry of coconut kernel based products, the desiccated coconut industry earns the highest amount of Foreign Exchange. The decline in the coconut harvest, as a result of the drought which prevailed from the beginning of the year 2017 and the rise in the price of coconut in the domestic market, the coconut production export has declined by about 25% in the 1st quarter of the year 2017 in comparison to the 1st quarter of the year 2016.  As a result of the increase in the production expenditure concurrent to the price increase in the coconuts, the desiccated coconut millers have fallen into great difficulties and therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to grant relief to the said millers utilizing a sum of Rs.50 million from the Mill Development Fund of the Coconut Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting a study on the environmental effects, for the construction of an Aquaculture Industrial Park in the Mannar District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to establish an Aquaculture Industrial Park in a land area in extent of 1,491 Hectares situated alongside the Vedithalativ sanctuary,  in the District of Mannar, with the objective of enhancing the contribution made to the National Economy by an increased fish production in the country.     Taking into consideration, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development and the recommendation of the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management, the Cabinet decided to instruct the relevant officers to make an assessment in this respect, in the first instance, with regard to the suitability of the land identified for the proposed project and the environmental impacts of the project.

description: Vesting of the 'Ruwanpura' Urban Children's Park situated at the New Town of Ratnapura with the Ratnapura Municipal Council as a Free Grant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest a block of land in extent of 01Acre, 01Rood, 16.30 Perches out of the land acquired for the Urban Development Authority under the Ratnapura New Town Developm Project, with the Ratnapura Municipal Council as a free grant to maintain and continue the 'Ruwanpura Urban Children's Park' constructed by the Urban Authority,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Hotel of the National High Altitude Sports Training Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Sports has initiated the establishment of a  High Altitude Sports Training Centre at the Nuwara Eliya Race Course Ground with the objective of  developing athletics and other sports.  It has been planned to construct a State of the Art Sports Hotel,  concurrently, in close proximity to the training centre to be constructed.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest a block of land in extent of 01Acre, 01Rood, 23.69Perches situated in Badulla Road, Nuwara Eliya belonging to the Urban Development Authority for the construction of the said hotel, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Macro-Fiscal Framework for Preparation of the Budget 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body:
- The Zoro-Based Budgeting approach was adopted in the year 2016 and 2017 to prepare the budgetary programmes gradually moving towards the Performance-Based Budgeting over the Medium Term in an orderly fashion. Appropriate measures are being taken to prepare the National Budget 2018 based on the Performance-Based Budgeting.  

Accordingly, the Ministry of Finance and Mass Media, has formulated the 'Medium Term Macro-Fiscal Framework for 2018 - 2020' and the distinguishing elements that characterise this framework include, rationalization of recurrent expenditure, prioritization of capital expenditure and enhancing government revenue organization.  Accordingly, the major outcomes envisioned along the path of fiscal consolidation are as follows: 

(i)	Increasing the Government revenue up to a 16.5% of GDP 
(ii)	Bringing the Government Recurrent Expenditure to a 14.8% of GDP
(iii)	Bringing the Government Public Investments to a 5.3% of GDP 
(iv)	Reducing the Budget Deficit up to a 3.5% of GDP 
(v)	Reducing the Outstanding government debt up to a 70% of GDP 

By the achievement of the said targets it will provide the way to contain  the rate of inflation at mid single digit levels and the realization of the Medium Economic growth rate at around 6% - 7%.  In this context, since the capacity of the relevant sectors are required to be broadened to a considerable level, more emphasis will be placed to adopt methods such as Build, Operate and Transfer (BOT) and also the Public Private Partnership Enterprises. Meanwhile, when the budgetary provisions are allocated, provision will be set apart for the new projects, taking into consideration the socio-economic needs and the long term targets on a priority basis.  Here, specially the performance will be based on efficient indexes.  

The tax policy structure which has already been declared will be further implemented and appropriate measures will be taken for more effective revenue collection.  

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to prepare the National Budget for the year 2018 based on the Performance Based Budgeting within the Medium Term Budgetary Framework, and to impose the budgetary limits for line Ministries for the year 2018, taking into consideration the government priority programmes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Safety Centres in the 25 Districts to house the people affected with Disaster Situations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body:
- The establishment of safety centres make it possible for temporarily  accommodating the people evacuated from the affected areas for safety as soon as the order of evacuation is given, in a situation of a sudden disaster and providing them with other reliefs effectively. Presently, the religious and school buildings are more commonly used as temporary safety centres and due to the inadequacy of facilities available in them and as the use of school buildings adversely, it affects the school children in their educational activities a proposal has been made to construct common safety centres at district level to be used in any disaster situation. 

Accordingly, taking into consideration, a proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, the Cabinet granted approval to construct 100 safety centres islandwide so as to cover all the 25 districts within the period from 2018 to 2020 which could facilitate 100 to 200 people at disaster situations and to design a method for the constructive use of the said buildings and the resources available at times when the centres are not in use as disaster situation camps.

description: Construction of the Headquarters of the Department of Civil Security
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-07-04
decision_details_body: - The need has been identified for the construction of a suitable building for the Department of Civil Security which is now being housed in a rented out building in the Bambalapitiya area.  A block of land of 01Acre in extent has been obtained for the purpose from the Moratuwa area and as such, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to obtain a Treasury Grant of Rs.42 million to construct the Headquarters of the above department with the use of the Manpower of the Civil Security Cadre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Long Term Solutions for the Management of Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) generated in the Western Region - Project for the Sanitary Waste  Landfill at Aruwakkalu in Puttalam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body:
- As a long term solution for the management of Solid Waste of around 1200 MT collected daily in the Metro Colombo, it has been planned to transport the Solid Waste in 20ft containers with the necessary compaction by rail transportation and safe disposal from Kelaniya to the Aruwakkalu Sanitary Landfill to be constructed using the limestone pits which have been abandoned after excavation. Action is being taken to obtain the preliminary environmental investigation reports of the Central Environmental Authority and the Wayamba Provincial Environmental Authority and it is anticipated that the reports will be released by the end of July.  Subsequently, the operational activities of the project is expected to be commenced within 06 to 08 months. 

The World Bank has agreed to provide the funds necessary for this project.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to call for Limited International Competitive Bids and Limited National Competitive Bids in order to select a suitable contractor in accordance with the National Procurement Guidelines to commence the project expeditiously, to acquire the extent of land required for the proposed project from the land at Aruwakkalu owned by the Sri Lanka Cement Corporation, to empower the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee to conduct negotiations with the Sri Lanka Cement Corporation, Siam City Cement (Lanka) Pvt Ltd. including the public and private sector stakeholders to obtain the other facilities needed in matters related to its operational activities, acquisition of lands and properties necessary for construction, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Handing over of the Dr. Neville Fernando Sri Lanka Russia Friendship Hospital to the Government and the proposal for the Future Management Structure of the South Asian Institute of Technology and Medicine (SAITM)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body:
- Although, the Dr. Nevile Fernando Sri Lanka Rusia Friendship Hospital which was established in 2013 to function as a Private Hospital with 500 beds and room facilities with 100 beds achieved a gradual development providing treatment for around 3000 Outdoor patients per month and about 100 Indoor patients, in the face of the present state of affairs, it has been difficult to attract an adequate number of Indoor patients to the hospital required to provide clinical training for Medical Students.  

Taking into consideration, the availability of only a limited number of institutions which provide tertiary health care in the East Colombo area and it being situated in close proximity to the Expressway,the joint proposal made by Hon. (Dr. Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine and Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways to get the Dr. Nevile Fernando Hospital worth of a government valuation of Rs.3.55 billion vested with the government of Sri Lanka, to transfer its full ownership to the government after the settlement of the loan obtained from the Bank of Ceylon for the establishment of SAITM, to provide free medical health care services to the public and to appoint a Governing Board by the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine for the management of the hospital similar in nature to the Administration Structure prevailing in the University of Jayawardenapura, was approved by the Cabinet.  Further, it was also decided that alternative proposals should be presented in consultation with all the related stakeholders to widen the ownership of the SAITM.

description: Approval of a  Service Minute Unique to the Postal Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - Although, the Postal Department has got 9 Schemes of Recruitments approved for its Staff in accordance with the provisions of the Public Administration Circular No.06/2006, practical difficulties have arisen in the implementation of such Schemes of Recruitments and these difficulties are yet to be resolved.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. M.H.A. Haleem, the Minister of Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs, to appoint a Committee comprising of the representatives of the Ministries of Public Administration and Management, Finance and Mass Media, Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs and the National Salaries and Cadres Commission headed by a Senior Official named by the Secretary to the Prime Minister, to examine the possibility of preparing a Service Minute unique to the Postal Department comprising of Schemes of Recruitment for each Grade which could be easily implemented and make recommendations in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lease of a Land situated at the Hospital Road, Thalapathpitiya for a Mixed Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - Bids have been called for under the Government Procurement Procedure to allocate a part of the land in extent of 6 Acres 0 Roods 9.6 Perches situated at Battaramulla and Sri Jayawardenapura Kotte acquired for the Urban Development Authority under the Sri Lanka, Jayawardenapura Kotte, Parliament Development Project, to select a suitable developer for implementation of a Mixed Development Project.  In response, 3 bidders have tendered there bids and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to lease the land to the Monarch Imperial (Pvt) Ltd., the bidder who has offered the highest bid relatively to the government valuation of Rs.514 million, for a sum of Rs.1,200 million on a 99 year lease basis, subject to the conditions stipulated, as per the recommendations of the Technical Committee appointed by the Cabinet to evaluate the bids and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of the Electronic Procurement System into the Public Procurement in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body:
- The procurement activities pertaining to the Public Sector forms a considerable part of the Sri Lanka's economy, since about 20% to 25% of the total Government spending is for the procurement of Goods and Services of the Public Sector. Under the present procurement process due to the shortcomings, such as persistent delay in the bid evaluation and the lack of transparency and competition, various problems crop up and this situation has a direct negative impact on the economic development of the country.  

At the 4th South Asia Region Public Procurement Conference held in Colombo and Kandy from February 20th to 23rd 2017 under the theme of 'Electronic Government Procurement in South Asia - Achievements, Opportunities and Challenges' where H.E. the President participated, it was revealed that except for Sri Lanka, most of the other South Asian countries use the Electronic Procurement System and have shown a remarkable progress. Since, the use of modern technology could minimize the deficiencies found in the procurement process, it is felt that the procurement process also could be re‑oriented accordingly by introducing an Electronic Procurement System.  

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to implement the Public Electronic Procurement System in the Public Procurement Process and to appoint an Officials' Committee under the Chairmanship of the Director General of the Department of Public Finance comprising of the representatives of other relevant institutions with the concurrence of the National Procurement Commission, with the responsibility for preparation of an Action Plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Administration Building (Phase II) at the General Hospital, Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body:
- The Government has made initiatives to upgrade the Kalutara General Hospital as a premier hospital in the Western Province. As such, as a solution to the lack of space in the existing building for administrative functions, it has been proposed to commence the construction work of the Phase II of the building.   National competitive bids have been invited to select a suitable contractor for the purpose and in response 5 bidders have presented their bids.       

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract to the State Engineering Corporation,  the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder as per the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee which evaluated the bids and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.
