description: Construction of the Accident and Emergency Treatment Unit at the District General Hospital, Trincomalee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body:
- It has been proposed to establish an Accident & Emergency Treatment Unit at the District General Hospital, Trincomalee to prevent disabilities and deaths caused by accidents by providing easily accessible high standards quality care to the patients. National competitive bids have been called for to select a suitable contractor for the construction of this Unit and in response 10 bidders have submitted their bids.  


Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract to M/s. Link Engineering Limited,  the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder as per the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee which evaluated the bids and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an Accident & Emergency Treatment Unit and a Simulation Centre at the Colombo East (Mulleriyawa) Base Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to establish an Accident & Emergency Treatment Unit and a Simulation Centre at the Colombo East (Mulleriyawa) Base Hospital to prevent disabilities and deaths caused by accidents by providing easily accessible high standards quality care. National competitive bids have been called for to select a suitable contractor for the construction of this Unit and in response 13 bidders have presented their bids.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract to M/s. Link Engineering Limited,  the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder as per the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee which evaluated the bids and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Building for National Sexually Transmitted Diseases and the National AIDS Control Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body:
- National Sexually Transmitted Diseases and the National AIDS Control Programme is a public health programme which works as the national focal point in Sri Lanka for the identification, treatment and prevention of Human Immuno-deficiency Virus (HIV), Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome (AIDS) and Sexually Transmitted Diseases (STD). Currently, 23,000 new patients visit the clinic annually for treatment and it has been estimated that around 4,000 undiagnosed HIV patients are there within Sri Lanka. 

The Head Quarters of this programme is presently, situated at De Seram Place, Colombo 10 and several other units of the programme are conducted in a rented out building at Jaya Mawatha. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to construct newly a four storey building in the same place where the Head Quarters of the programme is located, in order to avoid the difficulties arising as a result of conducting the activities of the programme in two different places, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Western Province Road Development Project -  Award of the contract for the Development and rehabilitation of the Wadduwa - Moronthuduwa road (B449) and Bellana - Moragala road (B544)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bidding has been called for, with the objective of finding a suitable contractor for the development and rehabilitation of a road section of 5.3 km in the  Wadduwa - Moronthuduwa road (B449) and a road section of 9.8 km on Bellana - Moragala road (B544) implemented with the funds provided for by the OPEC Fund for International Development and in response, 08 bids have been received.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract to the Maga Engineering (Pvt) Limited, the lowest successful bidder as per the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee which evaluated the bids and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formal vesting of lands to the Postal Department for the construction of the new Postal Complex in Polonnaruwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - The Land in the sacred city of Polonnaruwa where the Post Office, the official bungalow of the Post Office and the office of the Polonnaruwa Divisional Postal Superintendent is situated, are to be vested with the Urban Development Authority, in accordance with the proposed new town development plan under the programme for 'Awakening of Polonnaruwa' and in lieu of Postal Department land and buildings, that are to be vested, it is proposed to establish a new Postal Complex in the Kaduruwela Town (the land in which the old main Post Office is located) and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. M.H.A. Haleem, the Minister of Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs, to get the lands required vested with the Postal Department, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for providing Technical Internship Opportunities in Japan for the Sri Lankan Technical Interns
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs. Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Foreign Employment, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with the International Manpower Development Organization (IM Japan) which is a reputed human resources development organization established in Japan, to provide internship training opportunities in Japanese companies for Sri Lankan technical intern trainees, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Early Childhood Development Standards to be declared as 'National Standards for Early Childhood Development'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - The child, during the period of 3 to 5 years of age while getting accustomed   to the formal pre-school life and in association with the  pre‑school prepares for receiving the fundamentals of education.  Presently, as the pre‑school teachers design their activity plans according to various subject matters, it has become essential to introduce correct standards. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, to declare the Early Childhood Development Standards as 'National Standards for Early Childhood Development' compiled by the Children's Secretariat and reviewed by a Committee which comprised of the relevant Ministries and the representatives of all Provincial Councils and to activate such standards with the collaboration of the Provincial Councils, Local Government Institutions and the District and Divisional Secretariats, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Initiation of a Scientific Collaboration with the Yunnan Academy of Agricultural Sciences and the Yunnan Sugarcane Research Institute of Yunnan Province of China with Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to enter into Agreements for the development of sugarcane research and exchange of sugarcane genetic material with the Yunnan Academy of Agricultural Sciences in the Province of Yunan, situated in Kunmin of the People's Republic of China and the Sugarcane Research Institute of Sri Lanka with regard to the exchange of sugarcane germplasm and utility, evaluation of germplasm, exchange knowledge pertaining to sugarcane cultivation, exchange of information and expertise knowledge, training of young scientists, carrying out a study on subjects of mutual benefit and importance to the two countries and the settlement of common issues with a view to promoting collaboration between Sri Lanka and China, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of  lands required by the Thai Lanka Aqua (Private) Company for Pacific White Marine Shrimp Farming
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - Tiger Shrimp farming is undertaken over an extent of around 10,000 acres of land making the Puttalam District as the centre of Sri Lanka and the annual total production is around 6030 MT.  Out of this production about 2500 MT are exported deriving an annual revenue of US$ 16 million. Due to being subject to the white spot disease resulting in the lack of export quality standards the industry has turned out to be an under‑performing activity and as such, it has been proposed to introduce White Shrimp Farming for a rapid increase of Marine Shrimp to the country which shows resistance to white spot disease and as there is a high demand for same in the Global Market. The project proposal submitted by the Thai Lanka Aqua (Private) Ltd. to implement a White Pacific Shrimp Farming Project alongside the proposed Aquaculture Industrial Park in the Manthai - West Divisional Secretariat Division of the Mannar District has been recommended by the Project Committee of the  Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to give over a land of 250 acres to the Thai Lanka Aqua (Private) Ltd. close to the land identified to develop as an Aqua Industrial Park in the  Manthai - West Divisional Secretariat Division, on lease basis, for a period of 30 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Kottawa-Pinhena road, as the main access Road leading to the Homagama-Pitipana Technological City
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body:
- The technological city under the Megapolis Development Plan is to be built to cover the areas of Malabe, Kottawa, Homagama, Athurugiriya and Kaduwela.  Accordingly, 200 acres of land situated at Pitipana, Homagama has been set a part for the establishment of the Information Technology and other Technological Faculties affiliated to State Sector Universities. Concurrent to the development activities, widening and development of the access road network for providing convenient access to the new zone has been identified as an urgent need. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to develop the Kottawa - Pinhena Road coming under the purview of the Road Development Authority and identified as a road to be developed expeditiously, utilizing the funds set a part for the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of development projects by the Urban Development Authority (UDA) with the Treasury funds
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - The Urban Development Authority has planned to implement 6 major development projects utilizing the funds set a part to the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development by the Budget 2017, under the 6 major projects. In this respect, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement under 3 major projects, exceeding a sum of Rs.20 million, under which 39 sub projects namely, 13 projects under the project component of the Urban Development Authority, 16 projects under the Provincial Urban Development Projects and 10 projects for the Township Development and  Urbanized Waste Management with the Treasury Funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a land to the Sri Lanka Police for the establishment of the Galewela Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest a portion of land in extent of 1½ Acres from the land of about 24 Acres situated in the Galewela Town, acquired by the Urban Development Authority under the Greater Dambulla Development Plan, with the Sri Lanka Police for the construction of the Galewela Police Station, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the Government Revenue Report of the first quarter 2017 in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - The Government revenue of the first quarter of 2017 is Rs.436 billion and of which 95% amounting to Rs.415 billion is the tax revenue collected. The revenue collection of the first quarter is 22% of the annual estimate and 94% of the target of the first quarter. Tax collection from the Value Added Tax and the Nation Building Tax has exceeded the expected targets. However, the targeted revenue has not been achieved from the Income Tax and the Excise Tax.  The attention has been drawn especially, on the low progress from Excise Tax liquor and cigarettes. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to table the report pertaining to the above fact and the summary of Government revenue at the end of each month of the first quarter and the end of the quarter of 2017, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the contribution of Local Government Institutions for minimizing  disaster risk and making disaster response
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body:
- The disaster management policy has recognized that the local government institutions has a significant role to play in the minimization of the risk of facing disaster situations. The approval of the local government institutions has to be obtained for  all development activity planning and the National Disaster Management Policy has made provision to enact by-laws to enable the inclusion of methods for the minimization of disaster risk in the development projects implemented within their local government area of authority. As such, when preparing development plans in the disaster prone areas and carrying out constructions, following the guidelines on the specifications of buildings is really important. 

	Since, the Provincial Councils are vested with the authority of governing and monitoring the local government institutions, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, to assist the Chief Ministers of Provincial Councils in the Development of a disaster management plan in respect of their areas of authority in accordance with the guidelines provided for in the Disaster Management Act., and to get the support of the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government related to coordination, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Creating Awareness among Public Officers on Disaster Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - Disaster management is not an activity for s single institution or an organization but a responsibility which needs the contribution of both the public and private organizations inclusive of the general public. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, to implement an awareness programme on disaster mitigation for officers of the District Secretariats, Divisional Secretariats, Local Government Institutions, Samurdhi Officers, the Schools and the entrepreneurs making use of the resource persons serving in the public and the non-governmental organizations having expertise knowledge in the field of disaster management, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of permanent houses for the people residing in landslide high risk areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - The National Building Research Organization has found that the number of families residing in landslide high risk areas stands at 14,680 in Nine Districts. As there is a risk of these families being subject to disaster during the periods of  heavy rain, the need has arisen for evacuating them expeditiously from the lands they reside and settling them in other suitable places. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, to provide such families with Government financial assistance for them to purchase a land and a house from a safe place, to examine the possibility of giving them houses from the housing projects implemented by the the Ministry of Housing and Construction and to take appropriate measures to prevent the families from settling down in high risk zones once again, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Adoption of the Lease-Back OPEX Module in the construction of the Government Sponsored Buildings
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - With the development of the country's economic activity, the need for the accommodation facilities of the state sector has also increased gradually.  A sum of Rs.21.4 billion in 2016 and a sum of Rs.16.3 billion in 2017 have been incurred for the construction of state buildings and as a result, the possibility of utilizing funds for priority development programmes has been limited. Under the proposed Lease-Back OPEX Module to be adopted as a solution to the problem,   to give over the state owned land to private parties on lease basis for construction of state buildings as per Government specifications, subsequent to the construction, the Government in turn to pay a lease rental to the private parties concerned for the use of the building space for an agreed time period. Since the lease rent payable by the Government for the building could be set off against the rental to be paid by the private parties it would  be beneficial to the Government, and also it would create only a minute affect on the Cash Flow of the Government. Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to adopt the 'Lease-Back Real Estate Development Model'  as the provision of a cash flow funding method through the Public Private Partnership mechanism, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Competent Public Service with an accomplished Environment of Ethical Standards
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - A new Public Service Culture has to be created with characteristics of the principles of good governance, the Citizen Focus Service and High Qualitative Service and Management which could be accountable for results, in order to keep pace with the Modern Day Competition and the rapidly changing complex challenges. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, for the implementation of the Common Competency Framework in respect of the Public Sector Employees of Sri Lanka proposed by the National Human Resources Development Council (NHRDC) of Sri Lanka in collaboration with the Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration (SLIDA), the Department of Management Services, the Ministry of Public Administration and Management, the Public Service Commission and the Management Faculty of the University of Colombo, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the National Adaptation Plan for the adverse Impacts of Climate Change
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - Sri  Lanka being an Island Nation located in the tropical region, it is highly vulnerable to adverse impacts of climate change.  As such, with a view to developing the ability to withstand such changes, the National Climate Change Adaptation Plan for Climate Change Impacts - 2016 - 2025 was prepared in line with the guidelines set forth by the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change with the provision of financial assistance, in collaboration with all the respective governmental and non‑governmental stakeholder participation.  The plan covers the most adversely affected food security and the fields of water resources; coastal and ocean; health; human settlement and infrastructure facilities; eco-systems and bio diversity; tourism and recreation; export agriculture; industry; energy and transportation.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as  the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement the National Climate Change Adaptation Plan within the period from 2016 to 2025 depending on sector based priorities and the Mid Term, priority programmes due to be implemented, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extradition Treaty between Sri Lanka and Vietnam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-27
decision_details_body: - The Extradition Treaty signed between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam with the objective of providing for more effective cooperation between the two countries in the prevention and suppression of crime was presented to the Cabinet by H.E. the President, the Minister of Defence, and approval was granted by the Cabinet for its implementation.

description: Disposal of Garbage in the areas of the Colombo Municipal Council and the adjoining Municipal Councils / Urban Councils
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, for the disposal of garbage in places identified by the relevant Local Government Institutions in accordance with the environmental rules and regulations laid down, with the objective of finding solutions for the health and environmental issues which had cropped up owing to the disposal of garbage not being carried out systematically and properly by the Colombo Municipal Council and the adjoining Municipal Councils / Urban Councils, for obtaining court orders for preventing public objections when disposing of garbage, for issuing orders for the garbage to be disposed of only after proper segregation, for providing the necessary equipment for the Local Government Institutions for garbage management, for creating awareness among the public, for preventing the disposal of garbage in roads, for identifying alternative methods to minimize the disposal of polythene to the environment etc., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Removal of the Simplified Value Added Tax System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The Value Added Tax (Amendment) Bill drafted in accordance with the amendments announced in the Budget Proposal was earlier approved by the Cabinet. One of the proposals contained in the amendments taken in to consideration at that juncture was the removal of the simplified Value Added Tax Scheme as per the recommendation of the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to publish the Value Added Tax (Amendment) Bill which was re-drafted incorporating the effective date of removal of the tax scheme as 1st of January 2018, providing a sufficient period of time to enable the exporters time to adopt the system, in the government gazette and subsequently, present it in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Ministerial Committee to Coordinate the Recommendations of the UN Human Rights Council (UNHRC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka was successful in her bid to get an additional period of two more years at the session of the UNHRC held in March 2017, in order to implement the commitments agreed upon by Sri Lanka at its session held in the year 2015.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to further obtain the necessary technical assistance and other support from the UNHRC as well as the other member countries and to appoint a Committee under the Chairmanship of  Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister comprising of the other relevant Ministers and also to appoint an Officials' Committee to assist the said Committee, with a view to designing a methodology for the coordination of the initiatives of the various Ministries and Institutions working towards this end and the follow-up activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Liability management for the improvement of Public Debt Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The Government Debt Level of Sri Lanka, as of now, amounts to Rs.9,387 billion and it has become a national concern over the debt sustainability due to it being 76% of the Government revenue for the year 2016. Although, the Government of Sri Lanka has never defaulted repayment of debt any time before, it has to adopt appropriate debt reform methods to prevent any potential future risk. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a Bill to make use of liability management as a strategy for active Public Debt Management, and to take other measures necessary for liability management according to the relevant Constitutional provisions , was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of India and the Government of Sri Lanka for the Most Venerable Maduluwawe Sobitha Nahimigama Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - A project for the development of Elapathagama in the Anuradhapura District initiated by the late most Venerable Maduluwawe Sobhitha Thero has been commenced under the patronage of the Hon. Speaker and the Government of India has expressed its willingness to provide a grant of Rs.296.50 million for the purpose. Under this programme, development activities pertaining to the construction of houses for the 153 families living in the village, a multipurpose  building, a Bhikku 'Avasa' and a 'Dana' hall, modernizing of the library, a water supply facility and the construction of a rural reservoir are to be undertaken. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to sign the MoU for the implementation of the said project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief to persons who have lost their passports  in the disaster situation occurred in May 2017  due to the floods
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body:
- In terms of the legal position prevailing if, a passport has been misplaced or damaged prior to the lapse of the period of validity, a surcharge of a sum of Rs,10,000/- should be paid when obtaining a new passport. It is reported that the passports of a considerable number of people have either been damaged or misplaced due to the recent floods and landslides which occurred in most places of the Island. 

	As such, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs, to exempt the relevant person from payment of a surcharge when the person's passport has been misplaced due to floods and landslides on the recommendation made by the  relevant Divisional Secretary, to levy only a concessionary sum of Rs.100/- from a person who has obtained a passport after 1st of January 2017 but has not emigrated up to now when issuing a new passport and to limit this period of relief only up to 30th of August 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulating the method of alienating State Land held by the Government  Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - Lands year marked by the Government for administrative and development purposes could only be alienated for other parties when there are provisions for such alienation in terms of the Act., under which the relevant institution has been established or if only H.E. the President of Sri Lanka has granted approval for same. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, to appoint a Committee under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the President comprising of the Secretaries of the relevant Line Ministries and Officials with the objective of introducing a more formal method to investigate and make recommendations to H.E the President when dealing with the requests for under utilized state lands by the private sector for various development purposes,was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of the Assistance Agreement for Strengthened Partnership for Democratic Reform & Social Integration signed with the United States of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of National Policies and Economic Affairs implements the Assistance Agreement for Strengthened Partnership for Democratic Reform & Social Integration together with the assistance of the United States Agency for International Development. The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs to sign the agreement, with a revision to increase the contribution of US$ 22.70 million agreed upon for the implementation of this programme, in the year 2016 to around US$ 26.30 million by a further contribution of around US$ 3.6 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of the Contract for the Construction of the New Habarana Grid substation and Augmentation of the Veyangoda Grid substation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract  for the Construction of the New Habarana Grid substation and Augmentation of the Veyangoda Grid substation to M/s Siemens Ltd., India, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lease of a land at Sir James Peiris Mawatha, Colombo 02 to M/s Superlative Properties Limited for a Mixed Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - Competitive Bids have been called to select a suitable investor to lease out a land in extent of 03 Rood, 01 Perches, situated in Sir James Periris Mawatha, Colombo 02, owned by the Urban Development Authority and in response bids have been submitted by 05 firms.  The Procurement Committee appointed by the Cabinet has recommended to lease out the relevant potion of land for a value of Rs.1,815 million on a 99 year lease to M/s Superlative Properties Limited, the highest bidder out of the bidders who have responded.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to dispose of the potion of land on lease basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Performance of the Procurement Monitoring as at End of April 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body:
- The Procurement Monitoring Unit was established in the year 2016 as a part of the operational unit of the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management with the objective of ensuring the efficiency of the government procurement procedure.  As at end of 30‑04‑2017 there had been 219 ongoing procurements while 32 procurements had been awarded.  Out of the 219 procurements, 151 procurements were in relevance to 5 Ministries namely, Higher Education and Highways, City Planning and Water Supply, Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, Defence and Transport and Civil Aviation. 
 
The above facts presented by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media were noted by the Cabinet and focused its attention also on the reasons for the delay of the procurement procedure and the proposals submitted in the Report in regard to enhancing its efficiency.

description: Procurement of Anti Rabies Vaccine used for the prevention of Rabies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been called for the purchase of 2,900,000 vials of Anti Rabies (TC) Vaccine (Human Use) (0.5 ml /1ml) used for the prevention of Rabies and in response 03 Bids have been received.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the Tender to the M/s SmithKline Beechan (Pvt.) Ltd., the successful bidder, in accordance with the recommendations of the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Research and Training Complex at the Faculty of Agriculture, University of Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, on the 6th of April 2016 had granted approval to enter into the relevant agreements for obtaining a grant of Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) for the establishment of a  Research and Training Complex at the Faculty of Agriculture, University of Jaffna.  Subsequently, agreements on consultancy services have been entered into with consultancy firms for the implementation of the relevant projects.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to authorize the Secretary to his Ministry to enter into an agreement with the contractor selected by the consultancy firms following the Grant Aid procurement guidelines of the JICA, in accordance with the conditions in the Grant Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Negotiations on New Free Trade Agreements with China, Singapore and India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body:
- Entering into free trade agreements is one of the best ways to open up foreign market exports and to attract foreign investment for priority fields. In accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management, Sri Lanka is presently engaged in negotiations with India, China and Singapore for entering into free trade agreements.  Accordingly, to date, Sri Lanka has concluded 04 rounds of negotiations with India, 06 rounds with China and 05 rounds with Singapore and has planned to conclude the negotiations by the end of this year.  

	The facts included in the Report presented to the Cabinet by Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, on the current progress made with regard to the scope of negotiations on free trade agreements to be entered into with India, China and Singapore covering the sale of goods, services, investments, protective methods for sanitary and phyto sanitary material, customs procedures and trade facilitation, economic collaboration and government procurement procedures (pertaining to negotiations with Singapore) was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an operational Water Intake for the Horana Zone of the Sri Lanka Board of Investment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The Board of Investment of Sri Lanka has established an Industrial Township in the Perth Estate of Horana in a total extent of 1,463 acres of land and in the  3 Industrial Zones implemented therein, there are 20 commercial industries in operation generating 2,500 employment opportunities. In addition to these 3 industrial zones, the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka has given approval to implement a number of other projects within this industrial township. The Horana export processing zone has to be provided with an adequate supply of water but due to technical reasons it has not been possible to augment beyond the 2,500 cubic meters of water supply provided at present to the zone per day. As such, the Board of Investment has prepared a plan to have a water supply scheme for a capacity of 8,000 cubic meters per day for this industrial zone and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrema, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade,  to vest the land in extent of 2 Acres 00 Roods and 5.1 Perches selected for the implementation of the water supply scheme situated at Maguruwela area in Horana with the Board of Investment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Sri Lanka Technological University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Technological University established by the Sri Lanka Telecom PLC by utilizing its funds, with the objective of fulfilling the need of an Industry Academic Partnership, has been awarded the Degree Awarding Status by the Ministry of Higher Education and Highways  in the year 2016. This University has been established in a 36 acre land of the Satellite Station of the Sri Lanka Telecom situated in Padukka. The Cabinet noted the facts presented to the Cabinet by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to the effect that the University is due to introduce a 4 year Engineering Degree Programmes to the students who qualify following the Technological Stream at the Advanced Level Examination from the year 2017, that the the University has entered into student transfer Agreements with the Lancaster University in UK and the Deakin University in Australia and that discussions are underway for similar partnerships with Georgia Tech University and the Texas Tech University in USA and the Lincoln University in New Zeland and that a Post Graduate Research Unit for fostering industry sponsored research  will also be established in the University,

description: Providing a Land to H.V.A. Farms (Private Limited) for an Environment Friendly Organic Fruits and Vegetable Cultivation Project on a Long Term Lease
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms, to provide a plot of land in extent of 69.9 hectares situated in the  Grama Niladhari Division of Ralmaduwa in the Wanathwilluwa Divisional Secretary's Division in the Puttlam District, to H.V.A. Farms (Private Limited) for an Environment Friendly Organic Fruits and Vegetable Cultivation Project on a 30 year long term lease basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Abolition of the Import Control Fee of 1% of CIF value on import of tea for re-export
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The budget proposals of 2017 has proposed to abolish the import control fee of 1% of CIF value on import of tea for re-export. Accordingly, taking into consideration the joint proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries and Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, the Cabinet granted approval to abolish the said import control fee and amend it by removing the Item of Serial No.46 of Schedule 1 in the Regulations published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.1953/28 of 2016-02-11 and decided that a permit charge of Rs.1,000/- be levied for every permit issued, for import of tea for re-export.

description: Establishment of a University College in the Trincomalee District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - Presently, 13 public sector vocational training centres function in the Trincomalee District conducting 54 training courses in diverse fields while around 24 training courses are conducted in the vocational training centres operated by the private sector. Approximately, 2,200 students have undergone training at these public sector training centres. At present, these training centres provide only the vocational training courses of NVQ level 3 and 4 and therefore, to follow the training courses of NVQ level 5 and 6 the students have to attend the University Colleges in either Anuradhapura or Jaffna. Under these circumstances, it has been found that the establishment of a University College in the Trincomalee District is an absolute need. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Chandima Weerakkody, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to establish a University College at Kinya in the Trincomalee District at a cost of Rs.434 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal to establish an Offshore Sri Lankan Rupee (LKR) Bond Programme by the International Finance Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The International Finance Corporation (IFC) affiliated to the World Bank has submitted a proposal to issue offshore Sri Lankan Rupee Bonds and to utilize such proceeds in her own IFC projects implemented  by Sri Lanka. By this the country will benefit since it would signal confidence in the Sri Lanka economy: flow new foreign investors into the country overtime: promote alternative funding sources for the Sri Lanka bond issuers and attract more USD flows into Sri Lanka. The matter has been taken up at the Committee meeting of the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management and the implementation of the proposal has been recommended. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media, to implement the proposal subject to obtaining the formal approval of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the other relevant institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Divi Udana' Programme for Interest Subsidy Loan Schemes - 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The Budget Proposal of 2017 proposed to implement loan schemes at concessionary interest rates with the aim of improving the agriculture sector,  and encouraging the production economy as well as the social welfare of the country. Accordingly, measures have been taken to implement 08 loan schemes at concessionary interest rates.  The Cabinet noted the facts presented to the Cabinet by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media,  to the effect that the whole programme which has been named as the 'Divi Udana' Interest Subsidy Loan Schemes Programme has been implemented since 31st March 2017, that the Ministry of Finance and Mass Media has entered into agreements for the successful implementation of the programme through the Commercial Banks and that measures have been taken to conduct awareness programmes to educate the general public of the subsidy loan schemes programme, through both the printed and electronic media.

description: Conducting a Feasibility study on the construction of Wee Oya Reservoir in the Kelani river basin and the Yatimahana Reservoir in the Ma Oya basin
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body:
- Presently, the National Water Supply & Drainage Board experiences difficulties in the intake of the required quantities of water for water treatment plants operated from the Ma Oya and the Kelani River during the periods of dry weather. This situation will adversely affect the planning and implementation of the water supply schemes anticipated even in the future. 

As a solution to the issue, it has been planned to construct the proposed MCM 19 capacity Wee Oya Reservoir by the Kelani River and the proposed MCM 12.7 capacity Yatimahana Reservoir by the Ma Oya.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for conducting a feasibility study on the proposed upstream reservoir construction to Ms. Mahaweli Consultancy Bureau (Pvt.) Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of Annual Bus Fares - 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body:
- The National Transport Commission has been vested with the authority of the revision of bus fares in consultation with the Bus Operators' Associations and all stakeholders.  The proposals pertaining to the revision of bus fares for the year 2017 has been prepared based on the data published by the Central Bank  and taking into consideration the changes pertaining to the cost variable to the bus operating cost. 

Accordingly, with due consideration to the proposal made by the National Transport Commission, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation to increase the existing bus fares by 6.28% with effect from 01st July 2017 and to revise the present minimum bus fare of Rs.9/- to be Rs.10/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancing and Upgrading of the Institute of Engineering Technology, Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet on 14th March 2017 has granted approval for the award of the contract of the project for Enhancing and Upgrading of the Institute of Engineering Technology, Katunayake.  The Government of Austria has agreed to provide the sum of 9.5 Euro million required for the implementation of the project as an interest free soft loan through a Bank of Austria. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Niroshan Perera, the Acting Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct negotiations with the Raiffeisen International Bank of Austria and subsequently, to enter into loan agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading of Operating Theatres and Intensive Care Units under the Austrian Soft Loan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-20
decision_details_body: - 	A project has been designed to provide Anesthetic Machines, Ventilators for ICU, Blood Gas Analyzers, Endoscopes, Operation Theaters and  Networks of Mobile Lights to the identified government hospitals with the objective of enhancing the health facilities of the people.  The Government of Austria has agreed to provide a soft loan of 9.58 Euro million for the purpose through a Bank of Austria. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Niroshan Perera, the Acting Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into Agreements to obtain the said loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Report 2016 of the Ministry of Finance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- In accordance with section 13 of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No.03 of 2003 the Minister of Finance and Mass Media is required to release the 'Final Budgetary Position Report' at the end of the financial year to Parliament and to the Public. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Finance and Mass Media to table the said Report in Parliament, prepared inclusive of the information regarding the relevant Government Fiscal Activity, containing thirteen (13) Chapters, the Government Financial Statement and the Auditor General's Report on such Statement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of the National Disaster Relief Service Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - Further strengthening of the National Disaster Relief Service Centre (NDRSC) is imperative to respond immediately to situations emerging as a result of natural disasters as well as human activity to be faced continuously and also to carry out efficiently the relief services and re-establishment activities. For this purpose, the Disaster Relief Service Mechanism in the National, District and Divisional Level should be strengthened by taking measures to fill the vacancies in the Head Office, District and Divisional Offices of the NDRSC and to create new posts where necessary. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management to fill the vacancies in the National Disaster Relief Service Centre immediately, to assign a Disaster Relief Officer to every Divisional Secretary's Division and  to create new posts to cover essential services, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of a House Rent Allowance for the families who were deprived of their houses and who had to leave their dwelling houses as a result of floods and landslides that took place in May 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - As a result of floods, landslides and cyclone that occurred in the latter part of last May, a large number of people had to suffer where 3,037 houses had been completely damaged and 25,647 houses partially.  As such, presently, facilities have been provided for in the welfare centres for families whose houses had been completely damaged and those whose houses had been damaged rendering them unsuitable for living and for those families who were removed from their dwelling houses due to the high risk of landslides.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management to make a payment of Rs.7,500/- per family, per month for the month of June, July and August to make enable those families to live in rented out houses temporarily, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting of Scholarships by the Japanese Government for Human Resources Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan introduced the Japanese Grant Aid for Human Resources Development Scholarship Programme  in Sri Lanka in the year 2010 with the objective of providing opportunities to the executive level public sector officers to follow Post Graduate studies in the recognized universities of Japan.  The Government of Japan has agreed to continue the programme which is scheduled to be completed by this year for a further period of four years. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Niroshan Perera, the Acting Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs to authorize the Secretary to the Treasury to sign the Exchange of Notes and the two Grant Agreements with the Japan International Cooperation Agency to obtain a grant of 358 million of Japanese Yen,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of District Level Committees for Religious Reconciliation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The need has arisen for a proper mechanism to be adopted island-wide for the establishment of national integration, reconciliation, co‑existence and sustainable peace. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of National Integration and Reconciliation to appoint District Level Reconciliation Committees  representing inter‑religious leaders, the Superintendent of Police of the area and any others in the area actively engaged in promoting national integration and reconciliation, convened by the District Secretary, to vest such Committees with authority to take appropriate measures to resolve the religious and ethnic tensions peacefully and to appoint a National Level Reconciliation Committee in addition to the District Level Committees, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Office of the Medical Officer of Health (MOH) at Wadugoda, Payagala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration, the MOH Offices presently available in the Kalutara District and the population in the Payagala area, the construction of a MOH Office has become a matter of importance for focusing special attention on the  implementation of specially the programmes pertaining to maternal and child health, non communicable deceases and dengue prevention. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to construct a MOH Office in the Wagugoda area in Payagala, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Nurses Training Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- Presently, there are about 34000 Nursing Officers serving in the Government Hospitals around the island.  The modernization of the Nurses Training Schools is a timely need and it has also been found that the educational and administrative buildings of 14 Nurses Training Schools and in addition, the quarters of  certain Training Schools as well, have to be constructed expeditiously.  

Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to commence the construction work of the educational and administrative buildings of the Nurses Training Schools in Galle, Kandy and Anuradhapura, expeditiously, utilizing the provision of Rs.200 million set apart for the year 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Projects aimed at enhancing digital literacy and infrastructure development and the promotion of Digital Economy and Good Governance and related Policies: 2016 - 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- The Ministry of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure has planned to implement 18 projects within the period from 2016 - 2018 under the programme for digitalization of economy.  



Out of the said projects, the 10 projects which exceeds Rs. 20 million for implementation within the provision set apart for the Ministry for the year 2017 have been identified and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to implement the projects so identified, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Access to lands for Housing and Human Settlement Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- Land is a limited resource and as such, it has to be utilized with frugality and fruitfully. Due to the various limitations prohibiting the use of paddy lands for purposes other than agriculture, the development of human settlements especially in the areas subject to rapid urbanization has caused much concern. As such, the need has arisen for the use of abandoned and barren paddy lands as compatible with the town development plans and without giving way for the emergence of environmental problems for human settlements.  

	Taking note of the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction in this respect, the Cabinet decided to appoint a Committee comprising of the representatives of the relevant Ministries and other Government Institutions to decide on the methodology to be adopted with regard to the under utilized portions of lands and abandoned and barren paddy lands when such lands are given over for construction activities while also retaining the formal safety measures pertaining to environmental protection.

description: Providing safe drinking water in the Model and Reawakened Village areas in the Districts affected by the Chronic Kidney Disease of unknown etiology (CKDUE)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The model and reawakened village development programme launched by the Ministry of Housing and Construction is implemented successfully in all Districts of Sri Lanka and when providing houses under this programme special attention is focused on families affected by the  Chronic Kidney Disease of unknown etiology. However, problems have cropped up due to the absence of safe drinking water and the inadequacy of the available water supply programmes in certain areas  where this programme is implemented. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction to provide drinking water necessary to the housing projects implemented in the 11 Districts affected by the CKDUE expeditiously, with the coordination of the National Community Water Supply Department and the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between Switzerland and Sri Lanka on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice  to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Switzerland and Sri Lanka with the objective of improving the effectiveness of the law enforcement of both parties in matters pertaining to investigation, prosecution and prevention of crime and the confiscation of criminal proceeds and subsequently for ratification of the MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting the Annual Meeting of the International Rubber Study Group for the year 2018 in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The International rubber study group commenced its activities as an Inter-Governmental Organization comprising of rubber producing and consuming stakeholders in the year 1944 and by now, it comprises of 36 member countries including Sri Lanka and 120 industry members. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Disanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries to provide facilities to conduct the next Annual General Meeting of the Inter-Governmental Organization in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New two storey laboratory building for the Coconut Research Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- The need for the development of the laboratory facilities of the Coconut Research Institute to the level of international standards has arisen in order to effectively contribute, to the development of the coconut industry of Sri Lanka.       

	Accordingly, 	the proposal made by Hon. Navin Disanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to construct a two storey building at an estimated cost of Rs.47 million for the establishment of a state of the art laboratory for the Coconut Research Institute of Sri Lanka, and out of which Rs.23 million to be obtained from the Consolidated Fund and the balance of Rs.24 million to be incurred from the earnings of the Sri Lanka Coconut Research Institute, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Disposal of garbage in the Nuwara Eliya District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- The waste collected in the town of Nuwara Eliya and the suburbs is disposed in various places of the Nuwara Eliya District and the absence of a formal methodology for waste management has resulted in various health hazards while  it has also affected the environmental beauty of the Nuwara Eliya area adversely.  

	In order to avert this situation, the need for the implementation of formal waste management programmes have been identified, and 02 Regional Plantation Companies have expressed their willingness to release the blocks of land required for the purpose.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Disanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to implement 02 Waste Management Programmes in such land, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lease of a block of land within the Welipatanwila Fishery Harbour premises for a Yacht construction facility
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- Even though the Fishery Habour Corporation has entered into an Agreement in the year 2014 to provide a block of land in extent of 01 acre and 6.4 perches within the Beruwala Harbour premises to the Building a Future Foundation (BAFF) Company registered under the Board of Investment which has already commenced its business activities in the Koggala Industrial Estate, for the construction of yachts to be used for passenger transport to support the tourist industry and recreational and sports activities, it has not been possible to hand over the land up to date as a result of the inability to get the consent of the fishing community to this arrangement. 
     
	As such, a site called Muththalagahalanda in Ussangoda situated in close proximity to the Welipatanwila Fishery Anchorage in the Ambalantota Divisional Secretary's Division has been selected as an alternative land  suitable for locating this project and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to hand over the land in extent of 01 acre to the company concerned, on lease basis, based on the Government Valuation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lease of the land at Muthurajawela in extent of 2 Acres - 0 Rood - 11 Perches to the Dart Global Logistics (Pvt.) Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body:
- The Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation has developed approximately 400 acres of land in Muthurajawela using sea sand and given it over for various investment projects and state sector projects. Three blocks of land in Muthurajawela have already been given over for logistics related activities and applications have been called for another two blocks of land to be given over for similar projects.  

	Accordingly, 30 applications have been received from interested parties and the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to lease the block of land in extent of 2 Acres - 0 Rood - 11 Perches on a 30 year lease to the Dart Global Logistics (Pvt.) Ltd. the highest bidder for the land, subject to the relevant conditions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Institute of Real Estate and Valuation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The Institute of Real Estate and Valuation (IREV) has been established in the year 2001 with the objective of fostering professionalism in real estate with specific focus on management, marketing, development, investment and valuation and it has been registered under the Companies Act. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development to establish the Institute by a Parliamentary Act in order to carry out its objectives in a more effective manner, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Sri Lanka Environmental Wellness Ayurveda Village and the Research Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - With the underlying concept of establishing a treatment village and a research and educational centre of International and National Standards making use of the Ayurvedic Medical Systems, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to establish a Sri Lanka Environmental Wellness Ayurveda Village and a Research Centre at the Meddewatta area of the Mathugama Divisional Secretary's Division in the Kalutara District where it is considered as suitable to be constructed and to implement the project under Public Private Partnership basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Empowerment and Streamlining the Regulation Mechanism of the Community Based Organizations (CBOs), registered under the Department of National Community Water Supply (DNCWS)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - Around 90% of the population of Sri Lanka has the facilities for having safe drinking water and out of which 46% fulfill their needs through pipe borne supplies. The National Water Supply & Drainage Board undertakes the supply of 35% of the pipe borne water and the balance of 11% is covered by the community based water projects. Taking into consideration, the necessity of state intervention for the regulation and settlement of issues which had arisen as a result of these projects implemented by the community, the Department of National Community Water Supply was established in 2014.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply to register the community projects which supply water for the rural community under the department and to establish 'community based co‑ordinating units' at Divisional and District level for the regulation of such community based organizations, was approved by the Cabinet. The Cabinet also noted the submissions made by the Minister that an awareness programme has been organized from 20th to 23rd of June, 2017 for the representatives of the  community based organizations and the public officers, in this regard.

description: Measures taken to limit the usage of (Hydroflurocarbons - HFC) for the protection of the Ozone Layer
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The Ozone layer acts as a shield preventing the harmful ultra violet rays falling on the earth and ensure protection of all living beings and plants. The global community having considered the urgent necessity of regulating and the gradual phasing out of the use of the chemical substances that damage the Ozone Layer, established the Vienna Convention and subsequently, the Montreal Protocol in 1987.  The last amendment to the Montreal Protocol was carried out on 15th October, 2015 in Kigali, Rwanda and at this Convention all parties expressed their willingness over the gradual phasing out of Hydroflurocarbons - HFC.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, for Sri Lanka to appoint a Committee to plan out the activities for the ratification of the amendment expeditiously and thereafter, to ratify the amendment by Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ratification of the Minamata Convention on Mercury
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - By now, 128 countries including Sri Lanka have signed the Minamata Convention on Mercury to minimize the global harmful effects of its usage     while 53 countries have ratified it. With the ratification of this Convention, Sri Lanka will be afforded with the opportunity of participating as a Party at the conference, making formal representations directly to the Secretariat to the Convention, and work in collaboration with other countries being sensitive to global environmental issues. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment for Sri Lanka to ratify the Minamata Convention, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a three storey building with General Facilities for Defence Services Viru Daru Vidupiyasa, Kurunegala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-13
decision_details_body: - The three storey building constructed by the Sri Lanka Navy with a provision of Rs.215 million allocated by the Ministry of Education for the Defence Services Viru Daru Vidupiyasa, Kurunegala, was declared open for the students  in the month of March. However, as the building does not provide other essential facilities for educational as well as extra curricular activities, such as science labs, libraries, an auditorium, computer labs, etc. the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to construct a three storey building equipped with general facilities so as to avert such shortcomings, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The establishment of a 'Sri Lanka Cultural Centre' in New Delhi
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is a unique country rich in various resonating cultural aspects originating from within the country itself. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Foreign Affairs to conduct discussions with the relevant authorities of India to obtain a sufficient block of land to set up a 'Sri Lanka Cultural Centre' in New Delhi to utilize it as a venue to promote the unique cultural identity of Sri Lanka through Sri Lankan dance performances and Sri Lankan music, inclusive of the Sri Lankan traditional arts and crafts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Present developments in the Gulf Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet noted the information provided by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Foreign Affairs to the Cabinet on the prevailing state of affairs as a result of the breaking of diplomatic ties with the State of Qatar by the countries of Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Egypt, Bahrain and Yemen.

description: Establishment of a Buddhist Stupa in New Delhi
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - The Buddhist Vihara established, presently, in New Delhi is governed by the Mahabodhi Society and the temple is located within a limited space. A Buddhist Stupa or adequate facilities are not found there for the pilgrims who arrive in New Delhi from Sri Lanka and other Buddhist countries.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Foreign Affairs to conduct discussions with the relevant authorities of the Government of India to an adequate block of land to construct a Buddhist Stupa in New Delhi, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Sinhala Language Teaching Unit at the Jawaharlal Nehru University -
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to conduct discussions with the Government of India for the establishment of a Unit for teaching of the Sinhala Language at the School of Language, Literature and Cultural Studies in the Jawaharlal Nehru University, with a view to providing an opportunity for the students of India and the students of other regions inclusive of the SAARCK region interested in studying the Sinhala Language, Literature and the culture of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Disposal of garbage accumulated in certain areas due to the sudden disaster situation which prevailed recently
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - As a result of the torrential rains that fell on certain areas of the Island during the 25th and 26th of May, 2017, lives were lost and damages were caused to several properties due to the floods and landslides. Waste and garbage have been accumulated in large quantities in the disaster affected areas and the health sectors have pointed out the importance of disposing of such waste expeditiously.  As the vehicles and equipment belonging to the institutions of the Provincial Councils are inadequate to dispose of the huge quantities of such accumulated garbage, the joint proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management and Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government to provide an additional provision in a sum of Rs.100 million for the purchase of the vehicles and the equipment necessary for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Sri Lankan Presidential Task Force for the Prevention of Chronic Kidney Disease and the Australian Nuclear Science and Technology Organization to conduct studies and research on the Chronic Kidney Disease of Unknown Etiology
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - It has been found that the Chronic Kidney Disease of Unknown Etiology is now prevalent in 60 Divisional Secretariat Divisions of 11 Districts. The Cabinet noted that during the state visit of H.E. the President to Australia from 24th of May to 26th of May, H.E. the President has signed the MoU between the Sri Lankan Presidential Task Force for the Prevention of Chronic Kidney Disease and the Australian Nuclear Science and Technology Organization to  obtain assistance of Nephrologists in Australia and make use of the Australian Nuclear Science and Technology infrastructure facilities to carry out studies and research pertaining to the disease.

description: Development of the Sugathadasa National Sports Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body:
- The Sugathadasa National Sports Complex provides sports infrastructure facilities for sports competitions at both the National and International level. This is governed by the Sugathadasa National Sports Complex Authority and certain measures have been taken periodically for the renovation of the sports complex which has been constructed about 25 years ago. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports to carry out the implementation of the following programmes to develop the complex more comprehensively, was approved by the Cabinet: 

*	Installation of a Solar Power Generation System;

*	Repairing of the electricity supply wire system and the other equipment of the Flood Light Towers which provides electricity for the out door stadium; and

*	Modification of the Light system and the Sound System in the main stadium.

description: Strengthening of the Capital of the People's Bank by Rs.5.0 Billion
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - A period of about 55 years have been elapsed by now, since the commencement of the People's Bank and the total consolidated assets owned by the Bank as of now has increased up to Rs.1.4 trillion. It has been ranked as the 387th Bank among the Asian Banks and according to domestic grading the Bank is also the second largest Bank in the country. Presently, the Bank has a total of 737 service centres and the total customer accounts are close upon  Rs.18.0 million. Considering the regulations existing in the Field of Banking, supervision and the risks involved, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Public Enterprise Development to increase the Capital of the People's Bank by Rs.5.0 billion under the monitoring of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka to suit the standards set by the Basel III Committee for the regulation of the Capital Assets of the  Banks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Dedicated Economic Centre in the Eastern Province and obtaining Consultancy Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - A financial provision of Rs.300 million has been set apart by the budget proposal of 2017 for the construction of a Dedicated Economic Centre in the Eastern Province and a potion of state owned land located at Kalawanchikudy - Manmunai South Divisional Secretariat Division has been identified as suited for the purpose with the concurrence of the relevant officers and the political authority. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, for the selected land of 02 acres and 03 roods to be vested with the Ministry of Rural Economy and to award the contract for the construction on Design, Construction and Turn Key basis to the well experienced Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) which has already  constructed 10 Economic Centres, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Seed Conservation Division of the Plant Genetic Resource Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is a country endowed with a high biodiversity.  With the aim of  conservation of biodiversity, the Plant Genetic Resource Centre had been established at Gannoruwa with the financial assistance of the Japanese Cooperation Fund in 1989 and by now, 14500 samples of plants have been conserved in the Plant Genetic Resource Bank.  This Genetic Resource Bank provides a high contribution for the upliftment of the national agriculture by providing such conserved crops to the Research Officers and the farmers engaged in traditional agriculture for breeding new high yielding varieties with proven resistance to climatic changes, diseases and pesticides. The Genetic Resource Centre comprises of a conservation Unit with 16 Cool Rooms and the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to obtain the necessary funds from the General Treasury for updating the technology used for functioning of the cooling systems according to the standards set by the International Conventions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of an integrated project by the Department of Agriculture, Sri Lanka and the Lal Teer Seed Ltd., of Bangladesh for  increasing the production of improved varieties of  vegetable seeds
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - Even though, the Department of Agriculture and several Institutions of the private sector are engaged in seed production activities, these institutions have failed to supply the total demand for the improved seed varieties adaptable to the climatic conditions of the country and as such, the demand is met with a large quantity of imported seeds.
