As a solution to the problem, it has been planned to implement an integrated project at the Mahailuppallama Field Crops Research and Development Centre with the Lal Teer Seed Ltd. of Bangaladesh which produces high quality seeds and which has the potential for research and development. The funds necessary for the project will be provided for by the Company and the Department of Agriculture will supply the land needed for the purpose. The technical know-how and the genetic resources available with the two parties will be utilized  in this process. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture to sign the relevant Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), to implement the proposed integrated project  and to empower the Director General of Agriculture to sign the MoU  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of additional space for the Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - Recently, the inadequacy of resources of the Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources has affected the activities of the Department adversely and in order to be in line with the rapid and  positive changes that occurred in the  Fisheries Sector in the recent past, it has become necessary to change the  organizational structure and the present staff composition and moving to a building with adequate space. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to construct a four storey building with a capacity of 432 sq.m. of accommodation by expanding the proposed building to accommodate several divisions of the Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources and to obtain the required financial provision from the Budget Estimate of 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Additional provision required for increasing the financial assistance given  to the needy artistes from Rs.5,000/- to Rs.10,000/-
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - This matter was taken up for discussion at the Cabinet meeting held on 06th December 2016 and the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs, therein, to increase the financial assistance given to the needy artistes from Rs.5,000/- to Rs.10,000/-, to increase the number of artistes who receive the assistance up to 5,000 and  to implement the programme from the year 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy and Strategic Framework on Accident Prevention and Management in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - As a result of injuries that take place in Sri Lanka, more than 1 million people are hospitalized annually and a considerable amount of provisions set apart annually for the health sector, have to be spent on them. It has been identified that the major cause of injuries is 'road traffic accidents' and the findings show that the most who die of such accidents are persons between the age of 15 to 44. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to accept the National Policy and Strategic Framework on Accident Prevention and Management in Sri Lanka formulated in order to address the situation and to get the political and the institutional cooperation desired for the implementation of the  National Policy and the Strategic Framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prevention of obesity among the School Children
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the predominant health problem faced by Sri Lanka is in regard to non-communicable diseases such as heart disease, high blood pressure, diabetics, cancer etc. Recent findings show that in Sri Lanka the non‑communicable diseases account for 59% of the total deaths and the most of those who succumbed are below the age of 60 years. Since there is a trend for obesity even among the adolescents due to not being engaged in physical exercises, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to implement a new programme with the recommendations of the Ministry of Education which would pave the way to encourage the school children to be engaged in physical activities more and more during the school hours, and for them to have more facilities to get the food items which are conducive  to their health, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reformulated 'National Policy on Sanitation'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - The National Policy on Sanitation was submitted to the Cabinet earlier and for the implementation of same more effectively, the policy has been reformulated incorporating the observations of the relevant stakeholders interested in the matter, the experts in the field as well as the Ministers of Finance; Megapolis and Western Development; and Education and also taking into consideration the observations of the National Steering Committee appointed to improve  the content. The policy so reformulated and submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the State Forestry Administration of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Sustainable Development and Wildlife of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-06-06
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between China and Sri Lanka to provide training and educational opportunities for the staff members of the Department of Wildlife Conservation in Sri Lanka. Through this programme a larger number of officers of the Department of Wildlife Conservation will get a valuable opportunity to enhance their knowledge and build up their skills. Further, opportunities will be provided for the training of officers in the relevant field, and also for them to gain experiences of the relevant field with tours arranged in both countries, to implement collaborative research programmes and also for the exchange of animal and plants and therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of  Sustainable Development and Wildlife to sign the above MoU during his scheduled official visit to the People's Republic of China, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Relief to the victims of floods and landslides
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30

description: Reinsurance cover for National Natural Disaster and Emergency Relief Insurance Scheme for the year 2017/18
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - In a Budget Proposal for the year 2016 an insurance scheme has been introduced under the National Insurance Trust Fund to protect the entire country against natural disasters such as Cyclones, Storms, Tempests, Floods, Landslides, Hurricanes, Earthquakes, Tsunami and other similar natural disasters. In this context, a sum of Rs.500 million has been set apart in the Budget of 2017 to develop this Insurance Scheme as a more productive one enhancing the benefits which could be derived from the present insurance scheme. Accordingly, providing of benefits have been more enlarged including insurance coverage for loss of life due to lightning, falling objects on individuals, property damage due to falling of trees caused by heavy winds, collapse of retaining walls caused by heavy rain, permanent disability caused by natural disasters etc. Under this insurance scheme the National Insurance Trust Fund has provided an insurance coverage of Rs.15 billion and therefore, a re-insurance  has to be obtained with the objective of preventing an unusual loss for the fund. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to select a re-insurance company in accordance with the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, to pay the due installments in that regard and to enter into the relevant Agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulation of the import of  Concrete Pump Trucks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The construction sector represents the second largest industrial segment in Sri Lanka and by facilitating the construction industry the country can derive a considerable amount of economic and social benefits. As such, the regulations relevant to the import of concrete pump trucks necessary for construction activities have been amended and in the import of such machines two new combined classification code numbers have been introduced for the Concrete Pump Trucks which are not more than 10 years old and those which are more than 10 years old. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to present the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2019/24 of 2017-05-19 published under the Import and Export Control Act, No.01 of 1969 incorporating the importation of Concrete Pump Trucks which are more than 10 years old in the list of Items for which Import licenses should be obtained, to the Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of an additional bulk of 150 MT of dates from Sathosa to be distributed among the persons of the Islamic faith during the Ramalan season
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - Although, 150 MT of dates have been received as a donation from the Government of Saudi Arabia for the persons of the Islamic faith  to be used during the  Ramalan season, it has been assessed that the quantity will not be sufficient for the consumption such persons during the period. As such, the proposal made by Hon. M.H.A. Haleem, the Minister of Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs for Sathosa to purchase a stock of 150 MT of dates  in addition to the stock of donation received presently and distribute same among the persons of the Islamic faith under the supervision of the Ministry of Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Official Residences for Public Officers - Colombo District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - A large number of Government Institutions are established within the Colombo District and since a considerable number of officers serving in these institutions are residents living outside the Colombo District, they expect official residences for them. Even though, some number of residences owned by the  Ministry of Public Administration and Management have been provided for the executive grade of the public service and other officers due to exigencies of service, providing residences for officers like the Secretaries to Ministries and Heads of Departments has paused a problem due to the dearth of such official residences. As a solution to the problem a project has been planned to construct a 08 story building to house 49 official residences in a portion of land in extent of 0.2840 hectares belonging to the Ministry of Public Administration and Management located at Hector Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Colombo 07 where the office of the  Land Reform Commission was established previously and the project is due to commence this year and complete by the end of 2019. As such the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration and Management, to implement the relevant project and to obtain the funds necessary for the purpose from the General Treasury within the period of 2017 - 2019, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of contract for the construction of 500 houses on design & construction basis for Professionals at Weera Mawatha, Pannipitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development has planned to implement a project for the construction of 500 houses for the Professionals at Weera Mawatha, Pannipitiya. This project has been planned to be implemented with the funds obtained as house value in advance from the selected recipients of the houses. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development,  to implement the project in accordance with the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee and as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of contract for the construction of the Road from Lunugala to Bibila (from 171.80 km to 190.80 km) under the Badulla - Chenkalady Road Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways,  to award the contract for the construction of the Road from Lunugala to Bibila (from 171.80 km to 190.80 km) under the Badulla - Chenkalady Road Improvement Project as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting the Conference of the organizations of Anti - doping in Sports  established in the countries of Asia - Oceania Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: The World Anti-doping Agency has made a request to host the conference of the organizations of Anti - doping in Sports  established in the countries of Asia - Oceania Region scheduled to be held in 2018 in Sri Lanka. 150 members consisting of 120 delegates from the World Anti-doping Agency, Asian Olympic Committee including 30 professionals of Sri Lanka are due to participate in this conference for whom local hosting facilities should be afforded. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to host the said conference in Sri Lanka in the year 2018 under the hospitality of Sri Lanka, to bear an estimated expenditure in a  sum of Rs.20 million and to obtain the necessary funds in the year 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Repealing the Flood Protection Ordinance, No.4 of 1924 and enacting a new Flood Management Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The Minister in charge of the subject is empowered to declare areas that can be affected by floods under the Flood Protection Ordinance, No.4 of 1924 and the  authority to take appropriate measures for the protection of such areas has been vested with the Director of Irrigation. This Ordinance has been subject to  a minor amendment only once. Considering the social, economic, environmental, climatic and institutional changes that had taken place during the past a necessity has now arisen to address the present and future eventualities by enacting a new Flood Management Act incorporating provision to minimize the damages which my be caused to lives, property, environment and the economy from the adverse effects of flood disasters caused by rivers and reservoirs and as well as urban and local storm waters and various other causes.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to draft a new Flood Management Bill repealing the Flood Protection Ordinance, No.4 of 1924, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding entered into between the Sri Lanka Council for Agricultural Research Policy (SLCARP) and the Malaysia Agricultural Research Development Institute (MARDI) for development of human resources of Agricultural Scientists in the National Agricultural Research Systems
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - During the official visit of H.E. the President to Malaysia in the year 2016,  a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) has been entered into between the Sri Lanka Council for Agricultural Research Policy (SLCARP) and the Malaysia Agricultural Research Development Institute (MARDI) for development of human resources of Agricultural Scientists in the National Agricultural Research Systems. In accordance with the MoU an opportunity has been created to enhance the technical corporation between the two parties and also to produce scientists with post graduate degrees. In order to enable the release of  the required provision from the General Treasury for the implementation of the programmes agreed upon, the Cabinet granted covering approval for the signing of the relevant MoU as proposed by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture.

description: Development of pedestrian web in Fort and Pettah in Colombo (Construction of Stage III)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct a pedestrian web linking attractive areas to enable the pedestrians to walk safely, considering the excessive vehicle influx found in Fort and Pettah in Colombo. Stage I of this project extending from D.R. Wijewardena Mawatha to Olcott Mawatha has already been completed and the work pertaining to the Olcott Mawatha and Samudra Mawatha under Stage II is presently nearing completion. As Stage III, it is proposed to develop a pedestrian walk way of 06 meters wide (20 feet) and 1,485 meters long, along the Sebestian Canal from the Technical Junction to the Supreme Courts Complex.    Accordingly, 	the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to obtain the services of the Sri Lanka Navy to carry out the proposed construction work utilizing the provision set apart for the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development, for Stage III of the Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of land blocks from Regional Industrial Estates to set up new Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to lease out 23 blocks of land available in the Industrial Estates of Buttala, Nalanda (Matale), Nalanda Ellawala, Galigamuwa, Kalutara, Millawa, Minuwangoda, Matugama, Dambadeniya, Nurana, Makandura (West), Dankotuwa, Udukawa and Trincomalee to the investors selected on lease term basis on payment of a lease rental determined by the Chief Government Valuer for a period of 35 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a loan facility of US$ 200 million from the Government of Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The Government of Pakistan has agreed to provide a loan facility of US$ 200 million to finance the Priority Development Projects in Sri Lanka.  This loan facility will be utilized for the construction of houses, the import of farm animals necessary for enhancing livestock activities, the import of machinery required for agriculture and dairy industry, and for the development of the Industrial Technology Institute (ITI) etc. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the then Minister of Finance, to enter into the relevant Agreement with the Government of Pakistan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting of the next conference of the International Network for Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education (INQAAHE) in Sri Lanka in the year 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The International Network for Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education has been established with the collaboration of over 200  organizations actively engaged in the task. A biennial conference is held to discuss the more productive programmes undertaken by the members with a view to sharing the best practices adopted by such members. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to host the next conference of the network in  Sri Lanka in the year 2019 where around 1000 local and international stakeholders are due to participate, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recovery of lease arrears from the occupants of the railway reservations of the Department of Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - Even though nearly 1934 acres of lands out of the lands belonging to the Department of Railways have been given over to 6400 occupants on lease basis, most of the lessees have not paid their due lease rent on a regular basis to the department.  As a result, a sum of Rs.1,468 million is due as arrears. At the Cabinet meeting held on 10th of May 2016, approval was granted to lease out the lands occupied for more than 10 years to the relevant occupants for a maximum period of 5 years based on the Government Valuation. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to introduce a formal and concessionary method to levy the arrears of lease from the occupants of the relevant lands, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Measures to be taken to prevent the hanging out of Wild Elephants around Waste Disposal Sites
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - The improper disposal of waste has affected the environment as well as the wild animals, adversely .  It has been identified that there are 54 waste disposal yards especially in the forest zones for the disposal of waste and that over 300 wild elephants are reported roaming around these sites.  The wild elephants getting used to consume waste has resulted in pausing a serious threat to their lives.  As such, the joint proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife and Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to workout an integrated plan giving priority to places where the wild elephants frequent mostly for re-cycling of waste by the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government together with the Ministry of Sustainable Development and Wildlife and to erect electric fences in the proper places to prevent the entry of wild elephants to the waste disposal yards, as a solution to this issue, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extradition Treaty between Sri Lanka and the People’s Republic of China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-30
decision_details_body: - During the official visit of the Hon. Prime Minister to China last year, an extradition treaty has been entered into between Sri Lanka and the People's Republic of China for mutual extradition of persons convicted in a court of law. Accordingly, the reference made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, in relevance to the signing of the extradition treaty, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accident caused due to the collapsing of a Building at Wellawatta
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-23
decision_details_body:
- The attention of the Cabinet was focused on the accident caused by the collapsing of a building which was under construction at Wellawatta area and the Cabinet noted the need to take appropriate measures to ensure that the incidents of this nature would not occur in future.   

The Cabinet noted further, the information provided in this regard by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, that the relevant approval from the authorities concerned has not been obtained in accordance with the norms and standards of building construction for the construction of that building, that formal investigation has been initiated against all officers responsible for allowing to construct the building illegally in such manner, that disciplinary action will be taken against the officers concerned based on the findings of the investigation and that instructions have already been given to the authorities concerned to ensure that no such incidents of this nature occur in future.

description: Incidents hampering the peaceful co-existence among ethnic communities in the country
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-23
decision_details_body:
- The attention of the Cabinet was focused on incidents hampering the peaceful co-existence among the ethnic communities and some provocative behaviour of certain parties which had taken place recently in several places of the country. The Cabinet noted the necessity of taking relevant appropriate measures to ensure that recurrence of  such incidents and behaviour do not occur in the future.  Accordingly, the Cabinet decided as follows: 
(i)	to direct the law enforcement authorities to take legal action in accordance with the legal provision against those who are responsible for incidents hampering the peaceful co-existence among communities; and 

(ii)	to direct the Inspector General of Police to instruct the Officers-In-Charge of all Police Stations to ensure that recurrence of such  incidents do not take place within their area of authority.

description: Increase in the price of rice in the domestic market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-23
decision_details_body: - The attention of the Cabinet was focused on the steep rise in the price of rice in the domestic market and the matter was discussed at length. Accordingly, the Cabinet decided to grant approval to import rice through the private sector importers to enable the consumers to obtain rice at an affordable price without causing an adverse impact on the local paddy farmers.  Cabinet further decided that the quantum of rice to be so imported should be determined by the Cabinet Sub‑Committee on Cost of Living.

description: Financial Assistance for the Construction of the High Altitude Sports Complex in Nuwara Eliya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-23
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Sports has planned to construct a High Altitude Sports Complex in Nuwara Eliya with the objective of earning a considerable amount of foreign exchange by establishing the proposed sports complex in a picturesque location for the enhancement of the competitive skills of the Sri Lankan Sportsmen and women at zonal and international level. The Cabinet at its meeting held on 20th December, 2016 has granted approval to sign an Agreement with the prospective contractor for the implementation of the project. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct loan negotiations and to enter into Agreements with the relevant institutions to obtain loan facilities for providing the necessary funds for the implementation of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Concessional Financial Assistance from Finland
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-23
decision_details_body: - The Government of Finland had provided Concessional Financial Assistance to implement several development projects in Sri Lanka from 1983 to 2006 and has expressed its willingness to provide  Concessional Financial Assistance once again to Sri Lanka under its Public Sector Investment Facility Programme.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to sign an Agreement with the Government of Finland to obtain a loan of up to Euro 30 million to be utilized for financing the development projects in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Joint Communiqué of Leaders' Roundtable of the Belt and Road Forum for International Cooperation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-23
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet noted that the Hon. Prime Minister had participated in the Roundtable Conference of the above Forum held in China on the 15th May of 2017, chaired by H.E. Xi Jinping, the President of the People's Republic of China and also that the leaders of the countries of Russia, Spain, Switzerland, Argentina, Belarus, Chile, Indonesia, Laos, Philippine, Turkey, Vietnam, Cambodia, Fiji, Hungary, Italy , Malaysia, Myanmar, Pakistan and Poland had been present at the Rountable conference.  The Cabinet noted, further, the matters contained in the Joint Communiqué issued by the Heads of States with the objective of enhancing International Cooperation including the Belt and Road initiative and various development strategies, expanding economic growth, promotion of industrial cooperation, scientific and technological innovation and strengthening the regional economic cooperation.

description: The Second Indian Ocean Conference - IOC 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-23
decision_details_body: - The Indian Ocean Conference - (IOC2017) is being organized by the India Foundation with its partners comprising of the Institute of Policy Studies, Sri Lanka; Institute of International and Strategic Studies, Bangladesh and            S. Rajaratnam School of International Studies, Singapore, to be held in Colombo from 31st August to 2nd September, 2017. At this conference, attention will be focused on the security, economic, cultural and environmental matters of the zone where eminent leaders and distinguished delegates of over 30 countries are due to participate   Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to convene the conference in Colombo with the sponsorship of the India Foundation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Reforms to promote the flow of Investment to Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-23
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the various reforms undertaken by the peer countries in their investment climates to move investments to a higher level, Sri Lanka also should adopt reforms required to promote the flow of Investment into the Country by which the competitiveness of Sri Lanka in regard to investment could be moved up the rankings. As such, the necessity to introduce appropriate reforms has been identified to resolve issues relating to the coordination and collaboration in different Line Ministries and Agencies and activate appropriate mechanisms with detailed implementation plans to devolve  accountability and leadership. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to establish a Secretariat in the Ministry of Development Strategies and International Trade, with a group dedicated entirely for the purpose, to establish 10 Technical  Task Forces for coordination with the relevant institutions and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation required for the proposed legal reforms, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of a land to the Sri Lanka Police for the establishment of the Yatawatta Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Hon. Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to vest a land in extent of Acres 02, Rood 01, Perches 35 from the Yatawatta Estate belonging to the Udapussellwa Plantations Limited with the Sri Lanka Police for the establishment of the Yatawatta Police Station, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Alienation of Lands vested in the Land Reform Commission for public purposes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-23
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Hon. Minister of Lands, for the  alienation of the following Lands vested in the Land Reform Commission for public purposes, was approved by the Cabinet.  

*	a plot of land in extent of 07.31 perches situated in the Korathota area in Kaduwela to the Municipal Council Kaduwela for the construction of a Community Centre; and 

*	a plot of land in extent of 05 perches situated in Chilaw to the Multipurpose Co-operative Society Ltd., Chilaw for the construction of a building for a Co-operative Bank.

description: Construction of a 240 MW Wind Power and  800 MW Solar Power Hybrid Energy Park at Pooneryn
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-23
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Government Policy to move towards for renewable energy for generating electricity, several such energy projects have been implemented during the past. In the same manner, a considerable amount of energy is to be further added to the National Energy Network from the renewable energy sources. According to studies made by the Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority, Pooneryn situated in the Northern Province of Sri Lanka has been identified as a suitable area for generating electricity through Wind Power as well as Solar Power. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Minister of  Power and Renewable Energy to construct the 240 MW Wind Power and  800 MW Solar Power Hybrid Energy Park in the  Pooneryn area under three phases, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Consulting Agency for the expansion and renovation of the Police Hospital in Narahenpita
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval to obtain a land in extent of 02 Roods 23.05 Perches from the Urban Development Authority for the expansion and renovation of the Police Hospital in Narahenpita.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayaka, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to obtain the services of the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau which presently provides consultancy services for several ongoing projects in the Sri Lanka Police, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making a Feasibility Study on the Greater Mannar Water Supply Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made for the implementation of the Greater Mannar Water Supply Scheme with the objective of alleviating the difficulty in supplying of drinking water which has become a major problem for the people of the Mannar District. As such, in accordance with the discussion, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply had with the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management with regard to the fulfillment of the future water supply needs of the Manner area and the issues that may crop up while distributing water resources with several water supply projects, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to make a feasibility study and to conduct the study at the expense of the institution which had made the proposal and to adopt the Swiss Challenge Procurement Procedure for the implementation of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Installation of the Signaling, Telecommunication and Level Crossing Protection System in the Matara - Beliatta Section under the  Matara - Kataragama Railway Extension Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body: - The Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) has recommended to award the contract for the installation of Signaling, Telecommunication and Level Crossing Protection System of the Road Section from Matara to Beliatta utilizing the balance provision left in the Matara-Kataragama Railway Extension Project to M/s China National Machinery Import and Export Corporation, the present contractor of the project.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala De Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the relevant contract as recommended by the SCAPC, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body:
- The final draft of the Amendment to the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) has been prepared, taking into consideration the submissions made by the Elections Commission, after a Cabinet Sub‑Committee had studied  the draft prepared by the Legal Draftsman, in accordance with the approval granted by the Cabinet to draft amending legislation to amend the said Ordinance.   

As a result of the Attorney General having pointed out that certain sections of the draft Bill have to be adopted by a special majority in Parliament in terms of sub‑paragraph (a) of Article 75 of the Constitution, the Bill has been re‑drafted to be able to be passed by a simple majority in Parliament, subsequent to a discussion with the officers of the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government, the Attorney General's Department and the officers of the Legal Draftsman's Department.        
     
	Further amendments will be drafted by the Legal Draftsman, taking into consideration the suggestions made by the Elections Commission with regard to the mechanism of presenting candidates for Multi‑Member Wards and such amendments will be incorporated into the draft Bill at the Committee Stage of the Bill in Parliament. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to publish the draft Bill in the Government Gazette and present it in Parliament and to incorporate the further amendments made by the Legal Draftsman based on the suggestions made by the Elections Commission, at the Committee Stage of the Bill in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Programmes by all Ministries pertaining to the National Milad-Un-Nabi Ceremony
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body: - The Department of Muslim Religious and Cultural Affairs is making arrangements to commemorate the birthday of Prophet Muhammad Nabi which falls on the 1st of December, 2017 and this year's ceremony of the commemoration is planned to be held in the Jaffna District.  Concurrent to this, the General Treasury has already set a part a sum of Rs.14 million for the development of Muslim religious activities of the Districts of Kilinochchi and Mullaitivu.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. M.H.A. Haleem, the Minister of Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs, to obtain the cooperation of all Ministers and Ministries for conducting the ceremony and also the cooperation of the District Secretaries and the Divisional Secretaries of the Districts of Jaffna, Kilinochchi and Mullaitivu  towards the specified development activities contemplated in those districts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Light Emitting Diode Lamps (LED Lamps) to the households with less electricity consumption under the National Programme of Demand Side Energy Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body: - The Government has focused greater attention for energy management through the reduction of the demand for electricity consumption and it has been proposed to distribute LED bulbs among the consumers with less electricity consumption at a concessionary loan scheme, as a measure towards making energy efficiency popular among them. Accordingly, it has been proposed to remove the bulbs of high electricity consumption used by the households and to replace them with LED bulbs with less electricity consumption and to recover the cost from the customers in equal monthly installments within 24 months without any interest, along with the monthly electricity bills. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to provide a household  which uses between 1 to 30 units of electricity per month, with 02 LED bulbs, which uses between 30 to 60 units of electricity with 03 LED bulbs and which uses between 60 to 90 units with 04 LED bulbs, under this programme and to purchase 1 million LED bulbs required for the purpose, through international competitive bidding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restoration of the damages caused to the Tea and Rubber planted lands  in the Kegalle District due to torrential rains
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body: - 	Damages were caused to a large number of tea and rubber planted lands in the Kegalle District due to the torrential rains that fell in the two days of 2016-05-16 and 17.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries,  to restore such tea and rubber planted lands to a state where re‑plantation could be done, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Pilot project on implementation of flexible hours in Government Offices around Battaramulla area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body:
- According to a study carried out, taking into consideration the number of vehicles that reach the Government offices in the Battaramulla administrative area within a period of three (03) months from November 2016 up to January 2017, it has been revealed that 58% of the officers who use their private vehicles or official vehicles use such vehicles to reach their offices from 7.00 a.m. to 9.30 a.m. and from 3.00 p.m. up to 5.30 p.m. to leave  their offices at the end of their duty hours.      

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to empower the Secretary, Ministry of Public Administration and Management to issue a Public Administration Circular in that regard, for the implementation of a pilot project with flexible working hours in offices situated around the Battaramulla area enabling to report for work, at any time between 7.30 a.m. up to 9.15 a.m. and to leave those offices at any time between 3.15 p.m. up to 5.00 p.m. after completing the specified duty hours, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Report on the Actual Expenditure at the end of the 1st Quarter of the Financial Year 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the report of the expenditure presented by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, in relevance  to the 1st Quarter of the Financial Year 2017, the Cabinet noted that the Government has incurred a total expenditure of Rs.957,365 million, constituting Rs.482,856 million as recurrent expenditure and Rs.474,509 million as capital expenditure at the end of the 1st Quarter of the Financial Year 2017. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to present the report prepared in relevance to the 1st Quarter of the year 2017, in Parliament, according to the Budget proposal 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting of the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) Ministerial Meeting on Poverty Alleviation in Sri Lanka in 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body: - The BIMSTEC organization which was established in the year 1997 with the collaboration of Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Thailand and Sri Lanka, conducts its functions pertaining to the Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation. This organization carries out a major role in regard to poverty alleviation and it has held two Ministerial Meetings in this regard, one in the year 2008 in the Dhaka City in Bangladesh and the other in the year 2013 at Kathmandu in Nepal. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, the Minister of Social Empowerment and Welfare, to host the third Ministerial Meeting of the BIMSTEC in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of plots of land to construct the Office of the Superintendent of Police and the Divisional Secretariat, Elpitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala De Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to transfer a plot of land in extent of 140 perches from the Elpitiya Depot land owned by the Sri Lanka Transport Board to construct the Office of the Superintendent of Police and a land in extent of 01 acre for the construction of  the Divisional Secretariat, Elpitiya under the proposed Elpitiya Town Development Plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The proposed Air Services Agreement between Sri Lanka and Canada
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body: - Canada is a home to a large number of population of Sri Lanka and at present, an Air Services Agreement does not exist between Sri Lanka and Canada. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala De Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to sign the proposed Air Services Agreement presently initialed at official level providing facilities for the promotion of business and tourism industry with a view to formalizing the Air Services between the two countries and subsequently to take appropriate measures for the effective implementation of the Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing lands for the Promotion of Tourism Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body: - The aim of the Government is to achieve the target of 4.5 million tourist arrivals in Sri Lanka by the year 2020. In this respect, developing a regional level tourism destination and improving the infrastructure facilities related to it, is of great importance.  Kalpitiya area which is endowed with a unique eco-system and a striking sea frontage with diversity marine resources with multiple tourists attractions has become popular among domestic as well as foreign tourists and the area has a vast potential for tourism development. However, the hotels and  other tourism facilities available in the area is inadequate to fulfill the desires of high end tourists. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to vest 05 plots of lands with a land capacity of 56.35 hectares situated in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Kalpitiya with the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority for the development of activities and facilities related to tourism, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a two-storey Headquarters Building for the establishment of the Security Force Headquarters (Central)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body: - The Security Force Headquarters (Central) established at Diyathalawa in the year 2013 provides security to the Central and Uva Provinces and also to a part of the Southern Province.  It also plays a dominant role during urgent disaster situations and also in providing security at times of need. Therefore, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to construct a two storey building at the Security Force Headquarters (Central) premises, to establish the above Headquarters which is now being conducted amidst various inconveniences in the buildings belonging to the training school of the Volunteer Force situated at Diyathalawa, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology (SLIIT) to be conducted as an Independent Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-16
decision_details_body: - 	The Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology (SLIIT) situated in Malabe, initiated under a fund provided by the Mahapola Trust Fund, by now, is a leading educational institute which awards degrees in technological, business and engineering fields. Presently, there are nearly 7,000 students engaged in   educational activities and the institute, over the past, has produced about 9,000 graduates.  The institute needs to be further developed by attracting investors, and getting affiliated with foreign higher educational institutes. Considering the fact that the loan obtained from the Mahapola Trust Fund has been completely settled, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, to make provision required for the institute to continue as an Independent Degree Awarding Higher Educational Institute in the future, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Heda Oya Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - The present water flow of the Heda Oya which is the main water supply source for the supply of safe drinking water for the people residing in Lahugala, Pottuvil, Paanama and Siyambalanduwa and for the tourist zones of Pottuvil and Paanama, is not adequate to meet the demand for drinking water. The Cabinet has already granted approval for the implementation of a project to  construct a reservoir by building a dam across the Heda Oya and the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to select a suitable contractor following the 'Swiss Challenge' procurement procedure to implement the Heda Oya Water Supply Project, concurrently with that project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Agreements between Sri Lanka and China for Investment Promotion and Economic and Technology Cooperation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) has been signed between the Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Development Strategies and International Trade  of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on 2016‑04‑07 with a view to enhancing Investment Promotion and Economic and Technology Cooperation.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to sign the Framework Agreement between Sri Lanka and China and the Outline of the Medium and Long-term Development Plan, based on the priority projects identified under the above MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the Membership of the South Asia Regional Training and Technical Assistance Centre (SARTTAC) of the International Monetary Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - The South Asia Regional Training and Technical Assistance Centre of the International Monetary Fund has been established in New Delhi of India in the year 2016. This Training Centre offers Technical Assistance to the policy makers and the government agencies in 6 neighbouring countries including Sri Lanka in a wide range of macro-economic and fiscal management, fiscal operations, financial sector regulations and supervision and macro-economic statistics. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to enter into relevant Agreements to obtain training opportunities provided by the Centre for Sri Lankan Officers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kandy North - Pathadumbara Integrated Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - The Kandy North -  Pathadumbara Integrated Water Supply Project aims at providing safe pipe born water supply facilities to 6 Divisional Secretariat Divisions of Pathadumabara, Pujapitiya, Akurana, Harispattuwa, Gangawatakorale and Thumpane.  The Cabinet has granted approval to enter into commercial contracts for the implementation of these projects. The EXIM Bank of China has agreed to provide a concessionary loan to cover the entire cost of the project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into a loan Agreement to obtain the loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Doppler Weather Radar Network in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan has agreed to provide a grant assistance of Japanese Yen 2,503 million (Approximately Rs.3,422 million) through the Japan International Cooperation Agency for the establishment of a Doppler Weather Radar Network in Sri Lanka to detect hazardous meteorological phenomena and enable the making of accurate forecasts to the people. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to sign the exchange of notes and to enter into a Grant Agreement with the Government of Japan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Pre-fabricated houses in the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - On the basis of the recommendation of  Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Special Assignments appointed to re-evaluate the project for the  Pre-fabricated houses proposed to be implemented with the objective of providing houses for the war affected displaced families of the Northern and Eastern Provinces, the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management has recommended the construction of 6,000 houses in the first instance, at a cost of Rs.1.5 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement and Hindu Religious Affairs, to construct 6,000 Pre-fabricated houses and to provide the houses built for the purpose in accordance with the requests of the displaced families and on their concurrence, was approved by the Cabinet. It was also decided for the appointment of a high level Officials' Committee to make recommendations for the mode of construction of 59,000 houses proposed to be constructed with the use of bricks and cement for the war affected displaced families of the Northern and Eastern Provinces.

description: Reserving of Official Residences for the Medical Staff of the Teaching Hospital, Karapitiya, from the Nila Sewana Housing Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - Around 120 Medical Specialists and 570 Medical Officers are serving in the Teaching Hospital, Karapitiya and the inadequacy of official residences for them has become a serious problem. Since about 15 of the existing quarters of the Medical Officers have to be removed for the proposed development activities of the hospital immediately, an expeditious programme has also to be implemented in that regard. Considering these facts, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to purchase 10 houses from the Vekunagoda 'Nila Sewana' Housing Scheme in Galle for the Karapitiya Teaching Hospital at a cost of Rs.38.7 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Phase-II of the Accident and Emergency Medical Treatment Unit at the General Hospital, Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - The construction work of the Accident and Emergency Medical Treatment Unit of the General Hospital, Kalutara which is the premier hospital in the Kalutara District had commenced in the year 2015. As of now, the construction work of Phase-I of the building is being carried out and Phase-II which includes the construction work of the third and the fourth floor needs to be commenced expeditiously. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for Phase-II of the project on Design and Built basis to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau and the Engineering Services (Pvt.) Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of essential drugs for the treatment of Cancer
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the tender for the procurement of 2500 vials of Trastuzumab Injection 440mg with solvent in 20ml vials to M/s Pharmace (Pvt.) Ltd., the lowest responsive bidder at a cost of Rs.360.25 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulations made under the Licensing of Shipping Agents, Freight Forwarders, Non-Vessel Operating Common Carriers and Container Operators Act, No. 10 of 1972
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - The regulations made under the Licensing of Shipping Agents, Freight Forwarders, Non‑Vessel Operating Common Carriers and Container Operators Act, No.10 of 1972 has been published in the Government Gazette No.1842/16 of 2013‑12‑27, in order to prohibit the charging of terminal handling and other charges in addition to the internationally recommended freight charges for  shipment, to safeguard importers and exporters and to avoid negative impacts upon the national economy through the evasion of import and export taxes. The Cabinet has granted approval to amend the relevant legislation, taking into consideration the issues pointed out and the proposals made by certain parties with regard to the implementation of these regulations.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to publish the amended legislation prepared in the Government Gazette and subsequently present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Judicature Act (Increase of the number of High Court Judges up to 85)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - Since there is an enormous backlog of cases pending in the courts of  justice of the island, appropriate measures have to be adopted expeditiously to eliminate them.  As at March 2017, the number of cases pending in the Civil Appellate High Courts was 5749, in the Commercial High Courts, it was 5580 and as at March 2017, the number of cases pending in the High Courts was 16,574, and the number of judges serving in the courts at present to resolve these cases is only 75. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to make amendments to the Judicature Act to enable the increase of the present approved cadre of 75 High Court Judges up to 85, to expedite the cases pending at present, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to Section 45 of the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978              (Appointment of Justices of the Peace)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body:
- In accordance with the provision of section 45 of the Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978, the Hon. Minister in charge of the subject of Justice is vested with the authority of appointing Justices of the Peace in any particular zone, district or division of the country. Accordingly, Justices of the Peace are appointed to serve in any particular judicial zone, district or division considering their places of residence to enable them to provide their services with ease. However, the Justices of the Peace have brought to the notice of the Ministry of Justice that due to judicial zones being changed from time to time, it is practically difficult for them to identify their respective judicial zones. 

	Taking these facts into consideration, it has been found that the appointment of Justices of the Peace for administrative districts would be more practicable instead of appointing Justices of the Peace to any particular judicial zone or division. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice to instruct the Legal Draftsman to amend section 45 of the  Judicature Act, No.2 of 1978, with a view to providing such legislation as required, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the work of several irrigation projects now being implemented expeditiously
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - A sum of Rs.600 million has been set apart in the Budget of 2017 for the rehabilitation of the Left Bank of Minipe, Kitul reservoir and Rugam reservoir  projects, Kumbukkan Oya reservoir project and the Mannar Tarapuram Tank projects. Out of these provisions, the General Treasury has already released a sum of Rs.300 million. Since, funds have already been allocated for the rehabilitation of the Left Bank of Minipe by the Mahaweli Road Security Investment Programme under the Asian Development Fund and the Kitul reservoir and the Rugam reservoir projects do not need further funds for this year,  the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to utilize the balance provision of Rs.300 million, to complete the work of the Gonagala Tenna reservoir and the Gurugal Oya reservoir project now under progress, the pilot project for the establishment of the ground water monitoring network and the promotion of the infrastructure facilities of the Monaragala District under the Wellassa Navodaya project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a Land at the New Town of Ratnapura to the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to construct the office of the Medical Officer of Health
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest a plot of land of about 60 perches belonging to the Urban Development Authority situated in the New Town of Ratnapura to the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the construction of  the office of the Medical Officer of Health, Ratnapura, subject to the payment of the Government valuation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a block of land situated in the Centre of the Imaduwa Town to the Ceylon Electricity Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - Several plots of land belonging to the Government and the private sector have been acquired by the Urban Development Authority for the Imaduwa Town Centre Project and the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest a plot of land in extent of 01 rood and 03.20 perches out of those, with the Ceylon Electricity Board, to establish the proposed electrical sub‑station in the Imaduwa Town,  subject to the payment of the Government valuation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Flood Mitigation Projects in the Year 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - After the flood situation which arose due to the heavy rainfall experienced in the city of Colomboy in November 2010, the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation had made a number of attempts to implement flood mitigation projects within the Colombo City and the suburban areas. Accordingly, during the year 2016 a sum of Rs.3,500 million was set apart for flood mitigation projects. In the year 2017, the construction of pumping stations, conservation of wetlands, and studies pertaining to floods under an estimated cost of Rs.3,700 million are to be carried out and some of these project have already been commenced. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to proceed with the flood control projects being implemented presently, was approved by the Cabinet as a matter of principle.

description: Allocation of a block of land in the Centre of the Imaduwa Town to the Sri Lanka Police
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - Several plots of land belonging to the Government and the private sector have been acquired by the Urban Development Authority for the Imaduwa Town Centre Project and the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest a plot of land in extent of 01 rood and 04.10 perches out of those, with the Sri Lanka Police, to construct the Imaduwa Police Station, subject to the payment of the Government valuation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Cooperation (MoC) between the National Science Foundation of Sri Lanka and the Science and Technology Agency of Japan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research to sign a Memorandum of Cooperation between the National Science Foundation of Sri Lanka and the Science and Technology Agency of Japan for the promotion of cooperation in the fields of science and technology, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Netherlands for providing security to merchant vessels flying the flag of the Kingdom of the Netherlands
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-09
decision_details_body: - The Kingdom of Netherlands has made a request for the use of services of the Sri Lanka Navy by the Royal Netherlands Navy Protection Detachment deployed in the Indian Ocean off the cost of Somalia on board merchant vessels flying the flag of the Kingdom of Netherlands on a payment basis. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Defence of the Government of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Defence of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, in accordance with the international laws and the existing laws governing each country to provide the required services, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The New Inland Revenue Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Budget proposal of 2016 measures have been taken to  re-draft the Inland Revenue Act making it simple and compatible with modern trends. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance to publish the New Inland Revenue Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman to publish it in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Annual Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2016 to the Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs submitted the Annual Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka 2016 prepared in accordance with the provisions of the Monetary Law Act which includes the state of the Sri Lankan economy, Accounts of the Central Bank, the administrative measures adopted in the previous year, the important Bills passed and data to the Cabinet and  approval was granted by the Cabinet to present it in Parliament.

description: Purchasing of Mobile Laboratory Equipment sets for schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed by the Budget - 2016 to provide Mobile Laboratory Equipment sets for 3000 schools conducting classes up to G.C.E. (O/L) and which do not have laboratories with the objective of uplifting science education.  In this respect, competitive bids have been called for, to select suitable suppliers. The proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to award the contract for the supply of Mobile Laboratory Equipment sets in accordance with the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Eye Theatre and Wards (Stage II) at the General Hospital, Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - The project for the construction of the Eye Theatre and Wards is implemented in order to minimize the obstructions caused in the provision of Eye Clinic services and Patient Care services due to the lack of adequate space presently available in the General Hospital, Kalutara.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of contracts for buildings to be constructed at Universities of Moratuwa, Uva Wellassa and the University of Visual and Performing Arts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for the construction of a building extension for the Department of Textile and Clothing Technology of the University of Moratuwa, development of infrastructure facilities at the Uva Wellassa University for conducting Degree Programmes under the Technology Stream and construction of a building complex for the Faculty of  Music and Common Amenities of the University of the Visual and Performing Arts, on the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Colombo National Highways Project - contract for the Rehabilitation and Improvement of the Walgama - Diyagama road section (B452)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder for the rehabilitation and improvement of the Walgama - Diyagama road section (B452) under the Colombo National Highways Project funded by the OPEC Fund for International Development (OFID), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Military Logistic Support Vehicles required for Peacekeeping Operations in the Republic of Mali
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been called to procure the military logistic support vehicles for peacekeeping operations of the Republic of Mali and 6 institutions have submitted their bids in that regard. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena to award the relevant bids in accordance with the recommendations made by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee having evaluated the relevant bids submitted separately by each of the institutions item-wise, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of the Import Cess Levy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to present the Gazette Notification No.2011/09 of 21.03.2017 published under section 14/1 of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act No.40 of 1979 to remove the Import Cess Levy on several items with the objective of encouraging local industries, in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Approval of the Convention of the United Nations on Electronic Communications for International Agreements - Amendments to the Electronic Transactions Act, No.19 of 2006
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to publish, the amended  Electronic Transactions Act, No.19 of 2006 drafted by the Legal Draftsman in accordance with the approval granted by the Cabinet, to give effect to the provisions providing for in the United Nations Convention in respect of the use of Electronic Communications in the International Agreements in Sri Lanka, in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present it in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading of the Thondaman Vocational Training Centre at Hatton
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - The Government of India has agreed to provide a grant of Rs.199 million to upgrade the Thondaman Vocational Training Centre at Hatton with a view to improving the skills and vocational capabilities of the youth in the plantation sector. The proposal made by Hon. U. Palani Digambaram, the Minister of Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding, in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Buduputh Mapiya Upahara Housing Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to implement a project named Buduputh Mapiya Upahara Housing Programme to coincide with the United Nations Vesak Celebrations - 2017 to be held in Sri Lanka in order to build houses for the parents and the members of the families of Buddhist Bhikkus who have entered into priesthood. Accordingly, the joint proposals made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction and Hon. Dr. Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to identify the recipient families in accordance with the recommendations of the Department of Buddhist Affairs and the Pradeshiya Shasanarakshaka Bala Mandala, having identified the lands necessary to provide financial aid subject to a maximum of Rs.500,000 per house of  a floor area of 500 sq.ft., to construct 500 houses island-wide for such 500 beneficiary families, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project for provision of Solar Power Systems for Public Institutions under the Programme of 'Sooryabala Sangraamaya'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - A sum of Rs.300 million has been allocated in the Budget proposals of 2017 to transform the buildings where public institutions are housed into green energy sources. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy to install solar panels in selected Government Hospitals in all districts utilizing 75% of the funds and to install solar panels under the cost distribution basis in the selected Government institutions utilizing the balance  25%, under the first phase of this programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting a survey to ensure the accuracy for introduction of an analysis equipment using Japanese technology to instantly analyze the ingredients in Tea
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - The Japanese International Corporation Agency and the Kawasaki Kiko Co, Ltd., of Japan have expressed their willingness to introduce an analysis equipment to Sri Lanka using Japanese technology to instantly analyze the ingredients in Tea. For this purpose, a survey has been planned to be conducted in Sri Lanka to suitably upgrade an analysis equipment which has already been developed to ensure its accuracy. The Sri Lanka Tea Research Institute and the Sri Lanka Tea Board will function as the collaborating institutions of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with the aforesaid institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Long term solutions for the management of Municipal Solid Waste generated in the Western Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body:
- The Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development and the Urban Development Development Authority has been assigned with the task of finding long term solutions for the management of urban solid waste of the Western Region. It has been forecast that an additional 1,300 mt of waste will be collected daily by the year 2013 with the implementation of the Colombo Megapolis Development Plan and the Colombo Port Financial City project. As such, the following proposals made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, for the implementation of the following projects and plans initiated by the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development in respect of the urban solid waste management, was approved by the Cabinet.  

*	to take necessary measures to complete the activities being done in respect of the Meethotamulla land fill within 05 months with the collaboration of the Army and to develop the place as an Urban Forest Park.  

*	to take measures to vest authority on the Central Environment Authority for granting Environmental  approval of all ongoing and future waste processing adopting the initial Environmental Evaluation procedure.  

*	to induce the general public only to segregate the waste  and only such waste to be transported to the centres allocated for such purpose.

*	to direct Local Authorities having more than 50,000 families to take measures to initiate their own waste disposal and processing centres.

*	The Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development in collaboration with the Lanka Transformers Limited, to initiate a Waste to Energy Project.
