*	to request for project proposals from foreign Governments through the foreign embassies in Sri Lanka for the Arukkaru Waste Disposal Project in Puttlam.
      
*	to transfer the plot of land required for the construction of a Transfer Station of Waste in Kelaniya to the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development belonging to the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation.

description: Off-shore Sand Mining & Pumping and Supplying of Sand to the Construction Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - Due to the shortage of river sand used for the construction industry the price of sand has increased steeply and as an alternative for sand, measures are being taken by the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation to implement a project to purify the sea sand from off-shore for marketing and the Corporation has obtained a mining license. Under this project it has been planned in the year 2017 to mine and pump 4 cu.meters of sand about 10 to 16 km in the area of the off-shore from Muturajawela. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to adopt the procurement procedure to select a suitable institution to mine sea sand, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recommendations on Financial Incentives on the Import of High-Tech Automated Machinery and Equipment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - Budget proposal of 2017 has offered a Financial Incentive of 75% waiver on  Port and Aviation Levy (PAL) on import of High-Tech Automated Machinery and Equipment when importing machinery which will enhance the productivity of any enterprise. The approval of the Ministry of Industry and Commerce has to be obtained to be entitled for this incentive granted by the Government.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to appoint an Officials' Committee under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Ministry of Industry and Commerce to scrutinize and recommend the application for the said incentive, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the balance work of the project for improving the College of Technology, Ampara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - The College of Technology Ampara functions under the Department of Technical Educational and Training and presently, the College conducts training programmes for National Vocational Qualification Levels 3, 4, 5, and 6 for which the annual enrollment of students stand at 1000 approximately.  With a view to developing the infrastructure facilities of this college, a few buildings have been constructed under the 'Deyata Kirula' Development Programme held in the year 2013 under which  lecture halls and the hostel had been partially completed. In accordance with the recommendations made by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management in this respect, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to complete the balance work utilizing the provision set a part by the Budget of 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Four Storey Building for the Regional Centre of the Ocean University at Panadura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - There are 08 Regional Centres of the Ocean University of Sri Lanka located at Mattakkuliya, Kalutara, Galle, Tangalle, Batticaloa, Trincomalee, Jaffna and Negambo and these Centres conduct Diploma Courses and Higher Diploma Courses at National Vocational Qualifications (NVQ) Level 5 and 6 which have a great demand in the fishing and the marine fields. Presently, there is also a high demand for skilled man power in the fields of marine communication, diving, under water welding and boat building. However, there is no possibility of expanding the capacity of the training centre conducted at Dediyawala in Kalutara district any further, and as such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to construct a new Regional Training Centre of the Ocean University in a plot of land belonging to the Ministry of  Skills Development and Vocational Training in the Grama Niladhari Division of Uyankale situated in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Panadura and to provide the equipment and infrastructure facilities necessary for the Centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Nation Building Tax (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayaka, the Minister of Finance, to publish the Draft Amendment Bill to the Nation Building Tax Act, N0.9 of 2009 drafted by the Legal Draftsman incorporating the amendments proposed in the Budget of 2017, in the Government Gazette and subsequently, to present same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between  Sri Lanka and India for  Co-operation on Traditional Systems of Medicine and the Homeopathy System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - India has achieved a high standard in the Ayurveda System of Medicine as well as in the Homeopathy System through the modern technology strategies.  Theses medical systems are prevalent in Sri Lanka as well.  By providing facilities for such alternative medical systems, people can be diverted for cheap, safe and side‑effects free treatment methods.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding to share the knowledge and technology pertaining to Ayurveda, Homeopathy and other fields of medicine and also to enhance the bilateral relationship between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of India, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Urological Unit with Surgical Intensive Care Unit (SICU) at the National Hospital of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - The Genito-Urinary Surgery Unit was established at the National Hospital in Sri Lanka in the year 1955 and provides treatment for a variety of surgical conditions including urinary stones, diseases of the prostrate glands, Genito-Urinary cancers, female urethra problems and over fifty other surgical diseases. Prior to the establishment of the kidney transplantation unit at Maligawatta, this unit was engaged in the kidney transplantation as well. Presently, this unit is functioning in a dilapidated building which could no longer be renovated and as such, it should be relocated expeditiously in another building with the necessary facilities. For this purpose, Ms. E.A.M. Maliban Textiles (Pvt.) Ltd. has expressed its willingness to demolish the present building and construct a new three story building at an estimated cost of a sum of Rs.150 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the sponsor  institution and the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine  to  construct a state of the art building inclusive of an Intensive Care unit with a capacity for 80 - 100 beds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulations for the Water Services Industry in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - It is observed that an effective regulation is necessary to protect the interest of consumers and attract more investment into the water services industry. Presently, the Public Utilities Service Commission of Sri Lanka is vested with the economic and technical regulations pertaining to the water services industry and the water survices provided by the Institutions of the Provincial Councils and the community based organizations do not come under the purview of the  Commission. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to formulate a policy framework for the Water Services Industry, in Sri Lanka by empowering the National Water Supply and Drainage Board to be the 'Activator' and the Public Utilities Commission to be the 'Regulator', with the objective of formalizing the water services industry and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft the Water Services Industry Bill aimed at providing such provision, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-location of Bakamoona Bus Stand for a qualitative development of the transport services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - Concurrent to the Government programme of the development of bus stands in the main towns and the suburban towns of the Island for the convenience of passengers, it is proposed to build a new bus stand in the Bakamoona town under the Polonnaruwa district development programme known as  Rajarata Navodaya. The Bakamoona Pradeshiya Sabawa has agreed to provide a plot of land for the purpose and it is proposed to build a bus stand with facilities for parking seven buses at one and the same time. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to construct the Bakamoona bus stand at an estimated cost of a sum of Rs.50 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Road Safety Commission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - Presently, one of the major challenges faced by Sri Lanka, is the minimizing of loss of life and damage to property due to road accidents. The only institution which is available to deal with this situation is the National Road Safety Commission established under the Motor Traffic Act.  However, when focusing the attention on the complex problem of road safety, it is clear that the  establishment of a Commission with due responsibilities and authority is more appropriate as has been manifested with the experiences prevalent in other countries. As such, although approval has been granted in the year 2010 to establish a National Road Safety Commission, no action has yet been taken, to proceed with the necessary action to appoint such Commission.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to establish a “National Road Safety Commission”, a new Government Institution with the authority to activate a mechanism which will minimize the road accidents increasing day by day, to conduct a suitable methodology for qualitative driver services and to share the knowledge with regard to the collection of information required for the purpose and to appoint a Committee comprising of the representatives of the relevant field to prepare a draft Bill with that objective, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of Kankesanthurai Harbour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - It has been considered that the rehabilitation of the Kankesanthurai Harbour is essential for the promotion of the trade activities in the Northern Peninsula.  The Kankesanthurai Harbour is the nearest port for all Eastern Ports of India as well as the countries of Myanmar and Bangladesh.  The Indian Export and Import Bank has expressed its willingness to grant a loan of a sum of US$ 45.27 million for the rehabilitation of the harbour and the Sri Lanka Ports Authority will handle the activities of the project.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to initiate negotiations with the Export and Import Bank of India with regard to the relevant loan conditions and enter into agreements with the bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Pilot Project for the establishment of a Ground Water Monitoring Network in three selected Districts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - As a result of the significant increase in the use of ground water it has become essential for the proper management of the ground water due to the opportunities available for causing the water resources to be endangered  and pouted in Sri Lanka. For this purpose, it is essential to have timely data on the quality and the quantity of the ground water level and in this respect the Cabinet has granted approval for the implementation of a pilot project for the establishment of an effective ground water monitoring network covering three selected districts. Under this pilot project a ground water monitoring system will be established in three river basins covering three selected districts of Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa and Monaragala where the chronic kidney disease is spread due to the ground water contamination. The estimated cost of this project is Euro 20.36 million and the Rabo Bank of the Netherlands has expressed its willingness to provide 85% of  the total estimated sum. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into an Agreement with the Rabo Bank of Netherlands  to obtain the above loan amount was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial Assistance from the French Agency for Development for the implementation of Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme - Tranche 2
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - The French Agency for Development has expressed its willingness to grant Euro 30 million, to meet a part of the total cost of a sum of US$ 250 million needed for the Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency improvement programme - Tranche 2 planned to be implemented under three projects namely Transmission Infrastructure Enhancement, Efficiency Improvement of medium Voltage Network and Demand side management improvement for energy efficiency.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs,  to enter into Agreements with the above agency to obtain the above loan amount was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into an Agreement between Sri Lanka and France concerning the Establishment of an office of the French Agency for Development in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - The French Agency for Development (AFD) has been established for the implementation of the French Government's Economic and Social Development Aid Policy which assists over 60 countries of 4 Continents providing financial assistance through grants and loans. With the establishment of an office of the French Agency for Development in Colombo, affiliated to the Embassy of France of Sri Lanka in the year 2005, several priority development projects such as water supply and sanitation, integrated urban development, fisheries, bio-diversity, green power development, forestry and irrigation sectors have already been implemented in Sri Lanka with the funds provided for by the above agency.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs,  to enter into an agreement between the two countries, to establish a new office in Sri Lanka and to confer privileged status to AFD, with a view to enhancing the bilateral relationship between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Thalpitigala Reservoir Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - It is planned to divert Uma Oya in the upstream of the Bathmedilla Anicut  situated in the Badulla District with the objective of supplying Irrigation Water to the Bathmedilla Scheme.  It is also proposed to provide safe drinking water to Wasanagama, Madulla, Thatilla and Beramada in the Kandaketiya Divisional Secretariat Area and to generate 51GWh of Hydro power annually to feed the National Grid. The Cabinet has granted approval to implement this project at a cost of US$ 174 million. As the Export and Import Bank of China has expressed its willingness to to provide 85% of the estimated total cost, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into an Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Export and Import Bank of China to obtain the loan facility, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy on Reconciliation and Co-existence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - The Government Policy on reconciliation and co-existence to be implemented as the 'National Policy on Reconciliation and Co-existence' has been formulated considering the views of all the relevant stakeholders and providing a guiding framework to  ensure non-recurrence of a conflict of the nature of a protracted armed conflict which was endured for three decades causing untold suffering to all communities and peoples of Sri Lanka, with the objective of an   envisioning a shared future that foster national unity and peaceful co-existence among all the peoples of the country. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by H.E. the President and the Minister of National Integration and Reconciliation Maithripala Sirisena and Hon. Mano Ganeshan, the Minister of National Co‑existence, Dialogue and Official Languages to implement the above policy drawn up as the National Policy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Explosives Act, No.21 of 1956
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-05-02
decision_details_body: - A Committee has been appointed with the representatives of the relevant stakeholders to make recommendations regarding the amendment to the  Explosives Act, No.21 of 1956 to suit the current trends.  The Committee has proposed a number of recommendations including the amendment of the provision to the issue of permits to the suppliers of explosives regarding the period of the validity of the permit for the explosives and the appointment of a 'Additional Controller of Explosives'.  As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity of  the Minister of Defence, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amendments to the Explosives Act, No.21 of 1956 including the said provision, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing facilities to persons and religious institutions with the necessary basic requirements to obtain Elephants from the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and the National Zoological Gardens
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body:
- Presently, 88 Elephants are kept in the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage within a total extent of 30 acres and it has been a difficult task to maintain these animals in such a restricted land area. As such, it has been proposed to give out a certain number out of these animals to persons or religious institutions with the necessary basic requirements. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to give out to persons and institutions with the necessary basic requirements, selected by a Committee appointed by the Cabinet subject to specific conditions and also to issue Orders incorporating the necessary provision, was approved by the Cabinet. 

The Cabinet also granted approved to provide tamed elephants for religious processions from a pool of elephants managed under the National Zoological Department and to issue Orders to regularize the registration of tamed elephants  and to provide them with protection.

description:
Improvement of  the Orugodawatta - Ambatale Road under Stage-1 of the 
Colombo National Highway Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for the improvement of Road Sections from 2.90 km to 4.20 km and from 5.44 km to 7.70 km in the Orugodawatta - Ambatale Road (B435) under Stage-1 of the Colombo National Highway Project funded by the OPEC Fund for International Development (OFID), to M/s. Komuthi-HCM Engineering JV as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Vocational Training Centers at Panadura and Pahalayagoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - The Government, presently, is implementing a Skills Sector Development Programme aimed at building an efficient skills development educational system to cater to the local and foreign labour markets. Under this programme two Vocational Training Centres will be constructed one at a cost of Rs.370 million in the Panadura area and the other at Pahalayagoda at a cost of Rs.170 million.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to obtain the necessary consultancy services from the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No.2 of 2013 (Right of Detainees - Access to Legal Counsel)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the approval granted by the Cabinet of Ministers to publish the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No.02 of 2013 and to present it in Parliament for approval, the Bill, has been published in the Government Gazette of 03rd March 2017. The Cabinet noted that the facts submitted by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Prime Minister to the effect that there is a recommendation made as appropriate to amend the procedure further, more formally, to ensure the right of access of a detainee to a legal counsel and that the proposed amendments will be included in the Bill during the Committee Stage of the Parliament.

description: Providing Relief to the people affected due to the  disaster which occurred at the Meethotamulle Garbage Dump
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the decisions taken at the meetings held in respect of this matter on 16th, 19th and 21st of April 2017, presided over by H.E. the President, with the participation of the relevant Ministers and the Officials, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, for the implementation of a programme to provide houses for the people who were deprived of their houses at Government expense, to pay Rs.50,000/- per month as a rental for a family evacuated from the risk prone areas subject to a maximum period of three (03) months, to grant a transport allowance for the families who go to reside in permanent houses, to provide dry ration and other assistance  for the families who are presently housed in relief centres until they go to reside in permanent houses, to pay a sum subject to a maximum of Rs.250,000/- to purchase furniture for a house affected by disaster, to provide school uniforms, books and stationary for school going children of affected families and to publish a Gazette Notification declaring risk zones in the area, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Compost/Energy Production Project adjacent to the Gohagoda waste disposal yard in Kandy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has granted approval for the implementation of a project for the production of compost fertilizer and generating electricity from solid waste adjacent to the Gohagoda waste disposal yard in Kandy. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, Minister of Agriculture, to pay compensation to the residents living in the nearby area and evacuate them in order to commence the activities of the project and to enter into an Agreement with the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) to purchase electricity generated under this project by the CEB  through a specific method of payment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Task Force and an Operating Office for the conduct of Beautification of the Colombo City and Suburbs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - Considering the problematic situation created by the informal disposal of waste in the Colombo city and of the closest suburbs, by the Local Government  Institutions, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to establish a Task Force and an Operating Office for the management of waste with the collaboration of the state institutions directly linked with the management of solid waste, and to create awareness among the public of the relevant formal methods of waste disposal concurrent to waste management, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Sanitary Landfill for the Colombo Municipal Council for Waste Disposal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - The Government has appointed a Committee comprising of the Secretaries to the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government, Mahaweli Development and Environment and Megapolis and Western Development to take appropriate measures to design a Sanitary Landfill necessary for the disposal of waste collected in the Colombo City. Taking into consideration a proposal made by the Waste Management Research Unit of the University of Peradeniya to establish a Sanitary Landfill in a State owned land of 5 acres in extent at Uswetakeiyawa, in Muthurajawela area of the Divisional Secretary's Division, Wattala, a Sanitary Landfill to be designed for the  management of about 400 MT of waste per day and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to implement this project expeditiously utilizing the allocation set apart for the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government for the year 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Policy and Legal Framework relating to the Proposed Counter Terrorism Act of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Cabinet decision as at 04th April 2017, the Policy and Legal Framework relating to the Counter Terrorism Act of Sri Lanka, amended taking into consideration the observations of the Minister of Defence and the other Ministers was presented to the Cabinet by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister and the Cabinet decided to approve the Policy and Legal Framework so presented and instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft the proposed Counter Terrorism Act of Sri Lanka based on the said Policy and Legal Framework.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between India and Sri Lanka for Co-operation in Economic Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Republic of India and the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka for co-operation in Economic Projects, was approved by the Cabinet.   

The Cabinet also noted that the respective Ministries will submit separate Cabinet Memoranda with regard to the projects to be implemented between the two countries jointly, in consultation with all stakeholders, prior to entering into such formal Agreements.

description: The Buddhist Centre proposed to be constructed at Kahapola in Piliyandala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approval has been granted to implement a project to produce a replication of the Sakya Kingdom similar to the one in India, as a joint venture with the Ministry of Buddhasasana and the Light of Asia Foundation  concurrently with the International Vesak Day Commemoration of 2017.  In this respect, the Light of Asia Foundation will bear a sum of Rs.500 million and it has been planned to complete the project, concurrently with the International Vesak Day Commemoration ceremony.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Buddhasasana to enter into an Agreement between the Light of Asia Foundation and the Ministry of Buddhasasana, for the implementation of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Cultural Program to be conducted concurrently with the Celebration of  the International Day of Vesak declared by the UN
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - The Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minster of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs brought to the notice of the Cabinet that the special cultural event organized this year, concurrently with the International Day of Wesak - 2017 is scheduled to be held in Sri Lanka  at the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall (BMICH) on the 12th of May 2017 and also at the Nelum Pokuna Theatre on the 13th May 2017.

description: Enhancing the limit of issuance of Sri Lanka Development Bonds under the Implementation of the Government Borrowing Programme 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - According to the Appropriation Act, No.24 of 2016 the maximum borrowing limit for the year 2017 is Rs.1,529 billion. Out of which Rs.1,129 billion is planned to be raised from the domestic sources and the balance Rs.450 billion from the foreign sources. Approval has already been granted by the Cabinet to raise funds through international sovereign bonds amounting to US$ 1,500. Meanwhile, the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers has been granted on 2017-10-01 to raise US$ 1,500 to issue Sri Lanka Development Bonds under the domestic borrowings. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, taking into consideration the low liquidity situation in the domestic market and the upward trend on the interest rate of the Treasury Bills and Treasury Bonds to enhance the limit of issuance of the Sri Lanka Development Bonds from US$ 1,500 million to US$ 3,000 million, including the Bonds due to mature this year, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of the required material (Sarees) to provide uniforms for Dhamma School female preceptors - 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - The Government is implementing the provision of uniforms for Dhamma School preceptors who are working voluntarily in the Dhamma Schools in the Island since the year 2004. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to purchase 72,000 hand-loom sarees with blouse material directly from the Department of Textile Industry to be distributed among the Dhamma School female preceptors for the year 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting a Feasibility Study of the Integrated Water Supply and Sewerage Schemes in Hambantota Covering the Harbour and the Proposed Special Industrial Zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - The Government is making plans to set up an industrial zone under the Hambantota port development project and it is anticipated that the demand for water supply will be increased significantly within the next 05 to 20 years time.  Since the water supply infrastructure facilities available in the area, at present, are not adequate to meet the  increasing demand for water, it is necessary to carry out a feasibility study expeditiously to prepare a suitable plan for providing facilities for Water Supply and Sewerage. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply to obtain the technical and financial assistance of M/s China Heavy Machinery Corporation  and follow the Swiss Challenge Procurement Procedure for the implementation of the project based on the results of the feasibility study, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of contracts for buildings to be constructed at the Rajarata University of Sri Lanka and the University of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has been granted to select constructors under the competitive bidding system to construct a building complex for quarters for the academic and non-academic staff of the Rajarata University of Sri Lanka and to complete the balance construction work of the 17 story building complex being constructed for the Faculty of Medicine of the University of Colombo.   Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways to award the contracts as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion and Modernization of the activities pertaining to the Hadabima Authority of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - The Agricultural Diversification and Settlement Authority established under the State Agricultural Cooperation Act, No.11 of 1972 has been named as the 'Central Authority for the Development of Green Lands' (Hadabima Authority) since the year 1980.  Preparation of Agricultural Products and Marketing had been the main functions of the Authority and a special marketing unit had been established and conducted successfully since the year 2002. Accordingly, the proposal made by Field Marshal Sarath Fonseka, the Minister of Regional Development to extend the activities of the Hadabima Authority island-wide by implementing the recommendations made by the expert committee appointed for the study of the possibility of modernization of the activities pertaining to the Hadabima Authority of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of time frame of the Project for the construction of Gokarella Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has been granted on 23rd of December, 2015 for the construction of the Gokarella Police Station under an estimated cost of Rs.95.71 million.  As at, 31st December 2016, 30% of the construction work of the Police Station has been completed. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to obtain the balance provision released for the completion of the above project and to extend the time frame of the project from 2017 to 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Additional provision for the salary revision of the Sri Lanka Police in accordance with the budget proposals of 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the budget proposals of 2016, it has been identified that it is appropriate to pay a special allowance of 40% for Police Officers under 2 Phases, with a view to addressing the salary anomaly of the Sri Lanka Police Service. Accordingly, a provision of Rs.3000 million and Rs.6000 million have been allocated,  for the years 2016 and 2017, respectively. The proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to obtain the additional provision of Rs.1,042 million required, to grant the proposed 40% payment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Village Tank Cascade Systems (Ellangawa)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - Hydrologically inter connected Village Tank Echo-systems in a common water way is locally known as 'Ellangawa'. This irrigation system created by our ancestors has been accepted as the most viable solution to overcome the adverse effects of the climatic changes which we face presently.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to implement a project through the Department of Agrarian Services for the improvement of 21 Ellangawa systems spread over in 9 districts and the 258 rural tanks coming under them within the period of next 5 years, in  collaboration with the relevant agricultural organizations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restoration of the damaged Agro Wells of the Dry Zone to mitigate the effects of the  drought condition
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - The need has arisen to restore the damaged Agro Wells of the dry zone to a suitable standard to conduct agricultural activities successfully even under the drought conditions which may occur. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to implement the programme for the restoration of 14 Agro Wells of the dry zone, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Bus Service for the promotion of Public Transport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25

description: Acquisition of the land situated adjacent to the Rajarata University of Sri Lanka for the expansion of its Faculty of Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - Approximately 150 students are admitted annually to the Faculty of Agriculture of the Rajarata University of Sri Lanka. Concurrent to the Government policy of increasing the intake of the number of students to the Universities by 5% to 10%, it has been identified that the above Faculty of Agriculture needs to be further developed and as such, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways to make available the funds necessary for the development of the land in extent of 3.6 hectares which has already been acquired for the purpose of providing the required facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Lakshman Kadirgamar Institute for International Relations and Strategic Studies  of Sri Lanka and the Nepal Council of World Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Lakshman Kadirgamar Institute for International Relations and Strategic Studies (LKIIRSS) of Sri Lanka and the Nepal Council of World Affairs (NCWA), a non-profit making organization under the patronage of the Head of the Government of the Nepal, with a view to enhancing mutual cooperation, in  sharing knowledge, experience, expertise and information in the areas of mutual interest, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Matara Riverside Park
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - Development project of the Matara Riverside Park is one of the priority projects under the Matara Urban Development Programme.  Under this programme, a Library, Gymnasium, Waterfront Residential Development activities, Office and Institutional Development activities, National Celebration Centres, River Front Recreational activities with a Boat Yard Facility and a parking area for vehicles is due to be constructed. Under Phase I of this programme, development work relevant to the prevention of river bank erosion has already been commenced.  Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs; and Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement the future activities of the project, to transfer the ownership of the lands already acquired for the purpose with the Urban Development Authority, and to handover the  maintenance  of the build up properties to the Matara Urban Council when the project is completed, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of passenger transport permits for deployment of Buses in the Southern Expressway
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala De Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, for the amendment of the relevant sections of the National Transport Commission Act, for the revision of the relevant existing criteria presently in force regarding the issuance of passenger transport permits for deployment of buses in the Southern Expressway,  in accordance with the  advice of the Attorney General and the Order made by the Supreme Court and to call for fresh tenders for the issuance of the Passenger Transport Permits of the Southern Expressway, giving priority to the bus route permit holders operating in the Galle Road, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of relief for the farmer families affected due to the drought in the Maha Season 2016/2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The joint proposal by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management; and  Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to grant a special financial relief of Rs.10,000/- per farmer family for the 2016/2017 Maha Season whose paddy crops were damaged due to the drought and to farmers who could not cultivate their lands due to the drought and who cultivated other crops and whose crops were damaged and to take necessary action, so as to enable granting of the above financial relief however prior to the Sinhala and Hindu New Year, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing of Income Tax relief for the inducement of Investor
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The Policy of the Government is to broaden the income tax base by removing excessive tax incentives and thereby increase the Government revenue. In future, income tax incentives are proposed to be streamlined and will solely be based on the investments made on the capital assets and employment generation and to achieve this purpose the necessary provision will be incorporated in the new Inland Revenue Act, now being drafted. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to incorporate in the proposed Inland Revenue Tax Act the amendments namely the Investment Incentive Scheme proposed  under Schedule‑ii and the incentives proposed under Schedule iv to provide for the investments to be made by the small scale and medium scale investors during the period 2017-2019, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing further relief measures for the persons affected due to Landslides in the Kegalle District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The National Building Research Organization has recommended relocating persons living in 1,682 houses in high risk areas after the landslides in Kegalle which occurred in May 2016 due to heavy rains and the Cabinet approval was granted to provide funds for the resettlement of such families. During the research activities conducted subsequently, the number of houses located in high risk areas have increased up to 1,941.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, to allocate additional funds through the General Treasury for providing lands and houses for the resettlement of 259 families, subsequently identified, in  secure places, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Interest Free Loans to students to follow the Degree Programmes in the  Non-Governmental Degree Awarding Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body:
- In the Budget proposals of 2017, the Ministry of Higher Education and Highways had proposed to initiate an interest free loan facility subject to a maximum of Rs.800,000/- to follow the Degree Programmes offered by the recognized Non-Governmental Degree Awarding Institutions, for the students who fall short of the cut-off marks adequate for entering the universities. This will facilitate the youth with an enhanced opportunity to further their higher education and also to meet the demand in certain sectors of the labour market.                    

Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, as the first step, to select the students for the purpose based on the Z-scores obtained at the A/Level examinations conducted in the year 2014 and 2015 and to implement the first step in collaboration with the National School of Business Management (NSBM) where the necessary infrastructure facilities are adequately available, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Smallholder Agribusiness Partnership Programme (SAPP) to encourage the rural agri-producers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - Having identified the weak linkages within the organizational levels of the Agricultural Production Sector in Sri Lanka and considering the success of the National Agribusiness Development Programme implemented with the objective of strengthening the coordination among the value chain partners, the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) has agreed to provide funds for the implementation of a Smallholder Scale Agribusiness Partnership Programme for strengthening of the smallholder agri‑producers. Under this programme, which is to be implemented giving priority to low income and agricultural districts, 57,500 low income rural households will reap benefits within the stretch of 6 years. The programme activated with a total investment of US $ 105 million will be implemented through the Presidential Secretariat. Accordingly, the proposal made by Maithripala Sirisena, H.E. the President to implement the project and to vest the authority with the Department of External Resources to conduct negotiations with the IFAD on the  terms and conditions of the loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the  'Virusumithuru Housing Project' for the families of the war heroes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The Government has decided to implement the project named Virusumithuru where 3650 housing units are to be constructed within the next four (04) years with a view to providing a solution to the housing problem of the families of heroes of the Three Armed Forces, the Police and the Civil Security Force who scarified their lives and who suffered disabilities. Under this project, it is expected to construct 1950 new housing units and to complete the work of the 1700 housing units which are partially constructed and the beneficiaries concerned will be identified by the Ranaviru Seva Authority. In this context, it is proposed to provide a sum of Rs.1.2 million for a new house and building material valued at Rs.500,000/- for a partially constructed house and the required contribution of labour will be provided by the three Armed Forces and the Police. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Maithripala Sirisena, H.E. the President and Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction for implementation of this project, within the period from 2017 to 2020 as a joint venture of the National Housing Development Authority and the Ranaviri Seva Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of Scope of the Mannar Grid Sub-station Construction
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The contract for the construction of the Mannar Grid Sub-station has been awarded in the year 2014 under the the Clean Energy and Network Efficiency Improvement Project implemented with the loan aid provided by the Asian Development Bank. After commencing its construction it has been identified that the scope of the grid sub-station should be increased from 132 kV to 220 kV and as a result, fresh proposals had to be called for in regard to the revised scope. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to get the present contractor engaged in the construction work to carry out the constructions pertaining to the revised scope, in accordance with the Agreement reached by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), after negotiation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Corporate Office Building Complex for the Distribution Division    No.4 of the Ceylon Electricity Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for the construction of a Corporate Office Building Complex for the Distribution Division No.4 of the Ceylon Electricity Board to M/s. Sripalie Contractors (Pvt.) Limited, the lowest substantial responsive bidder at a cost of Rs.466.66 (valued without VAT) million as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Supply of Anesthetic Machines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - When providing a high standard health care service to patients in the Government hospitals anesthetic machines are of great importance and as such,  the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the supply,  installation and commissioning of 137 Anesthetic Machines with Ventilators to M/s Meditechnology Holdings (Pvt.) Ltd. at a cost of US$ 1.3 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Specialized Paediatric Unit in the Teaching Hospital, Karapitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The Teaching Hospital at Karapitiya in Galle,  is the third largest tertiary care hospital in Sri Lanka.   There are 60 wards and 1,900 beds in the hospital out of which only 250 beds have been allocated for the child patients. To meet the requirements, it is necessary to develop the Paediatric Neuro‑Intensive Care Unit, Paediatric Intensive Care Unit and the Paediatric Surgical Unit of this hospital.  As such, it has been decided to construct a building complex to establish a State of the Art Child Care Unit in the Karapitiya Teaching Hospital with all necessary facilities and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the construction of the building complex, to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau and the Engineering Services (Pvt) Ltd. subject to the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of the Total Cost Estimate of Ruhunupura Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - It is proposed to revise the cost estimate of Rs.8,653.54 million of the Ruhunupura Water Supply Project to Rs.10,029.64 million, for reasons beyond the control of the contractor.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to revise the contract sum concerned in accordance with the Agreement reached after consultation with the Secretary to the Treasury and to proceed with the implementation of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of contract for providing consultancy services for design review and construction supervision for Section-1 of the Central Expressway Project from Kadawatha to Meerigama  (36.59 km)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for providing consultancy services for design review and construction supervision for Section-1 of the Central Expressway Project from Kadawatha to Meerigama (36.59 km), for a sum of Rs. 2,548.91 million to a joint venture of Resources Development Consultants (Pvt.) Ltd. with Green Tech Consultant (Pvt.) Ltd. and Consulting Engineers and Architects Associated (Pvt.) Ltd., as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memoranda  of Understanding by the  Ministry of Primary Industries between the Bank of Agriculture and Agricultural Cooperatives (Thailand) and the Faculty of Agriculture of the Kasetsart University (Thailand)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Primary Industries,  to enter into two Agreements between the Ministry of Primary Industries and the Bank of Agriculture and Agriculture Cooperatives in Thailand  for capacity building and for knowledge and experience sharing in the areas of Agriculture, Micro Finance and Agricultural support and the Ministry of Primary Industries and the Kasetsart University (Thailand) for technology collaboration related to Value Addition of Agricultural products, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Setting up of trilingual Sign Boards in the Public / Semi-government and Public Places, under the Official Languages Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - Trilingual Sign Boards and Direction Boards are of paramount importance in maintaining an office environment that ensures the convenience of citizens seeking services from Public Institutions to reach the desired place without inquiring from any other officer. In accordance with the  Official Languages Policy, from the Main Name Board up to the Direction Boards,  Sign Boards of the Divisions, the Officers' Name Boards etc. should be trilingual and the  Reception Counter is expected to provide bi‑lingual services.  Although, action has been taken to set apart the required provision for the purpose, to Ministries, Departments and other Public Institutions under a separate Object Code, it is observed that the policy is not properly implemented in certain instances. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mano Ganeshan, the Minister of National Co‑existence, Dialogue and Official Languages to provide, any Public Institution which has not prepared the relevant Sign Boards in accordance with the Official Languages Policy, guidance to rectify same to be in compliance with the Official Languages Policy and if necessary, to provide additional provision for such purposes from the provision set apart for the Ministry of National Co-existence, Dialogue and Official Languages,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relief Loan Scheme for the resettled People
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - Pursuant to the decision of the Cabinet taken at its meeting held on 2010‑08‑11, the Rehabilitation of Persons, Properties and Industries Authority (REPPIA) has implemented a relief loan scheme through the Bank of Ceylon to provide relief to the families affected by terrorist activities to facilitate the resumption of a normal and productive life for them.  Under this loan scheme a sum amounting to Rs.770.1 million has been granted to 5,222 beneficiaries by  2016‑12‑31 and out of which Rs.497 million have been recovered from them by the Bank of Ceylon. The said Bank has intimated that the money so recovered, could be utilized to provide loans to the relevant families under a revolving loan scheme and as such, the proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement and Hindu Religious Affairs, to take action accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for Importation of 20,000 Dairy Heifers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The Government has given priority to develop the dairy industry with a view to   enhancing the milk production in Sri Lanka.  Under this project with the objective of establishing large scale and medium scale commercial dairy farms, a project for the importation of 20,000 Heifers will be implemented and the first herd of Heifers is scheduled to reach the country on the 2017‑05‑17. The imported high breed Heifers will be provided at a subsidized rate to the farmers who conduct dairy farms on a commercial level and provide the funds for the purpose through a subsidized loan scheme. The Department of Animal Production and Health is expected to provide training for the beneficiaries with regard to the establishment of modern farms and their operational activities and  assistance of veterinary surgeons.  Presently, the beneficiary farmers have  already been selected for the 1st Phase and the infrastructure facilities of the farms concerned are being developed.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to implement the project under the proposed methodology with the objective of generating employment for at least   two Samurdhi beneficiaries  at a beneficiary farm with a minimum of at least 10 Heifers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act, No.04 of 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice to publish, the draft Bill, to amend the Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act, No.04 of 2015, by incorporating the necessary provisions to record any evidence or statement of any victim of crime or witness from any remote location outside Sri Lanka at the Sri Lankan diplomatic mission in the country from where such victim of crime or witness seeks to testify or make the statements through Contemporaneous Audio Visual Linkage, in the Government Gazette and subsequently present same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme to utilize uncultivated paddy fields for the promotion of freshwater aquaculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - Aquaculture contributes approximately 13% out of the total freshwater fish production of Sri Lanka.  There is a potential for freshwater fish production to be significantly increased through aquaculture. It has been identified that a considerable number of uncultivated paddy lands, which have been abandoned in the wet zone and the dry zone due to the inability to cultivate any type of crop and it has been estimated that they are suitable for aquaculture to enhance the freshwater fish production by about 10,000 MTs and also generate an additional income of about Rs.2500 million.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to obtain the uncultivated paddy fields necessary for the  purpose after a proper feasibility study subject to the approval of the relevant institutions, without causing an obstruction to the water flow for the paddy fields and without permanent erections, to be used for freshwater fish production, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Governments of the Member States of the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) for the promotion of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - At the second conference of the Ministerial Economic and Business Conference of the Member States of the Indian Ocean Rim Association, hosted in Dubai on 11 - 13 April 2016, it has been decided to sign a Memorandum of Understanding among the Member States for the promotion of Small and Medium Enterprises.  The benefits of this MoU is the promotion of corporation among the Small and Medium Enterprises of the Member States,  and widening of the opportunities among them for acquiring appropriate technology and investment. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeena, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to sign the above MoU on behalf of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a new Vocational Training Centre at Panadura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The number of youth dropping out of schools after the G.C.E. (O/L) and G.C.E. (A/L) examinations, in the Kalutara District annually, is approximately 9,000.  However, it has been identified that the student intake capacity of the Vocational Training Centres belonging to the National Vocational Training Authority in the Kalutara District is only 1,785.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to construct a new Vocational Training Centre in Panadura at an estimated cost of Rs.370 million within two (02) years, with a view to increasing the intake of youth of the Kalutara District to Government Vocational Centres, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of a land for the future development activities of the University of Sri Jayawardenapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The University of Sri Jayawardenapura consists of seven (07) faculties and  the total number of students, at present, is around 11,557. Attention has been focused on purchasing of buildings and lands in close proximity to the University to address the needs of the students increasing annually.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to purchase a land in extent of 377.5 perches, situated close to the University belonging to a private party, for a sum of Rs.481.3 million utilizing part of the earnings of the University and as well as Government funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Kandy Tunnel Construction Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to construct a Tunnel of 4.36 km. in length from  Thennekumbura area up to Suduhumpola and a four (04) lane road way 1.2 km. in length, in order to mitigate the heavy traffic congestion existing in the  Kandy City at an estimated cost amounting to US$ 252.30. The Economic Development Cooperation Fund of Korea has agreed to provide necessary financing facility of US$ 199.27 for the project and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to implement the Kandy Tunnel Construction Project and to vest the authority with the Department of External Resources to conduct negotiations on the  terms and conditions of the loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of Twenty (20) National Highways through Local Contractors with funding from Local Banks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The Road Development Authority is vested with the responsibility of maintaining and up-keeping  of the network of National Highways in the country with a total length of 12,210 km. A length of approximately 7,900 km. of the National Highways has already been rehabilitated and nearly 4,300 km. have to be rehabilitated to a satisfactory standard.  Accordingly, the road  sections with 564.53 km. of 20 National Highways in A and B class spread over in the Island have been planned to be rehabilitated at an estimated cost of Rs.58 billion within the next three years. Considering, the enhancement of the capacity of local contractors and the importance of their achieving competency in the field of road construction, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to call for proposals from local entrepreneurs who are keen to adopt the Swiss Challenge Procurement Method, for the construction of the highways, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Colombo City as a  Cultural Hub of South Asia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The objective of the Government is to promote the Tourism Industry whilst ensuring long time environmental and cultural sustainability. The tourism industry in Sri Lanka has shown a great upsurge during the past period and in the year 2016, over 2 million foreigners had toured Sri Lanka. When classifying  the objective of touring Sri Lanka, approximately over 70% of the foreign tourists tour the country for pleasure and another over 25% undertake tours for visiting friends and relatives. Although there is a great potential to attract tourists in the fields of vibrant cultural traditions like indigenous arts, dancing performances, cookery, ceremonies etc. conventional to the country, the number of tourists who visit the country aiming at religious and cultural goals is less than even 1%. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to appoint a Committee comprising of senior public officers representing the relevant fields to develop a Cultural Hub of South Asia in Colombo for the  promotion of international arts and cultural performances and an exhibition focal point of South Asia with a view to creating a platform to perform and showcase and indigenous arts and culture of the country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Expenditure incurred by the Government for the Office of the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body: - The United Nations Development Programme has been working closely with the Government of Sri Lanka, since 1967.  In this connection, the Government of Sri Lanka is paying a voluntary contribution of US$150,000 annually and approximately US$395,000 is provided for as the contribution of the Government of Sri Lanka to meet the expenditure of the Office of the United Nations Development Programme.  Sri Lanka which existed as a lower middle income country, as a result  of it being classified into a middle income status,  an arrears amounting to US$1.182 is required to be settled by the Government of Sri Lanka. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to implement the proposal made by the United Nations Development Fund to utilize the arrears of the fund available to implement the development projects identified on priority basis by the Government instead of settling the arrears, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of Maritime Rescue Coordination Activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-04-04
decision_details_body:
- In accordance with the International Conventions embarked upon by Sri Lanka, the establishment of a Maritime Rescue Coordination Centre (MRCC) is absolutely necessary to respond immediately for the search and rescue services of vessels in distress operating in the region to ensure the safety of the vessels engaged in fishing within the Maritime Zone of Sri Lanka to comply with the Convention for International Civil Aviation, the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea as well as the law of the Sea Convention,  Presently,  the Merchant Shipping Secretariat is vested with the authority to operate the MRCC and the Secretariat in turn has vested the activities with the Sri Lanka Navy. 

It is proposed to implement a project for the improvement of infrastructure facilities that will enable the MRCC of Sri Lanka to communicate directly with  vessels in distress within the Maritime Zone of Sri Lanka and to offer assistance and respond immediately and the project will be implemented with the collaboration of the Merchant Shipping Secretariat, Sri Lanka Air Force and the Department of Sri Lanka Coast Guard as stakeholders. As per the specifications developed it is planned to establish the main operational centre in Colombo, a secondary operational centre in Hambantota and in addition, to establish seven (07) strategically important sub-stations in Galle, Trincomalee, Point Pedro, Mollikulama, Arugambe, Batticaloa and Kal‑arawa.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Maithripala Sirisena, H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to commence this project in the year 2017 and complete same within four (04) years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the Gazette Notification Published for amending the tax imposed on selected imported goods, in Parliament, for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to present 10 Gazette Notifications published amending the Special Commodity Levy imposed on identified essential goods imported to the country under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2007 and the 02 Special Gazette Notifications issued under the Revenue Protection Act, No.19 of 1962, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Grant Aid from the Government of Japan for the improvement of the Port and Nautical Activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan has agreed to provide Grant Assistance under  non-project grant aid scheme, amounting to Japanese Yen 1 million (Approximately 1.3 billion)  for obtaining Japanese products necessary for the improvement of the Port activities and development of the Navigation System in the Trincomalee Port. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs to sign the Exchange of Notes with the Government of Japan to obtain the Grant Aid, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of contract for Consultancy Services for the  Seethawaka Ganga Hydro Power Project)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy,  to award the contract for the consultancy services of the proposed 20 MW Seethawaka Ganga Hydro Power Project to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, to be implemented in the village of Hinguralakanda Gama Niladhari Division of the Dehiowita Divisional Secretary's Division in the Kegalle District  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Deduru Oya Water Supply Project - Consultancy Service Design, Review and Construction Supervision
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka has entered into an agreement with the Economic Development Cooperation Fund  of the EXIM Bank of Korea in the year 2014 to obtain a credit facility of US $ 58.15 million for the implementation of Deduru Oya Water Supply Project. The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply to award the above contract for consultancy services, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee by utilizing the said credit facility, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of infrastructure facilities of the Universities of Kelaniya, Wayamba, Ruhuna, Moratuwa, Rajarata, Colombo, Sri Lanka Bhiksu, Peradeniya, Sabaragamuwa and Eastern
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways to select contractors by following open competitive bidding procedure to implement 13 projects to develop essential infrastructure facilities of the Universities of Kelaniya, Wayamba, Ruhuna, Moratuwa, Rajarata, Colombo, Sri Lanka Bhiksu, Peradeniya, Sabaragamuwa and Eastern at an estimated cost of Rs. 6,960.95 million and to allocate provisions required for the purpose from the Medium Term Budgetary Frame Work 2017-2022, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 09 Nos. Diesel Multiple Units for Upcountry Line operation of Sri Lanka Railways - SRS/F.7336
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval was granted on 2015.12.16 to procure  09 Nos. Diesel Multiple Units for Upcountry Line operation of Sri Lanka Railways. Accordingly, open competitive bids were called and the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala De Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation to   award the above contract of purchasing  09 Nos. Diesel Multiple Units for the Department of Sri Lanka Railways to the M/s Dongfong Electric International Corporation of the Republic of China, the lowest responsive bidder selected from among 04 bidders, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction and Operation of Two Airport Hotels at the Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers considered the rapid growth of passengers who pass through the  Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake, and granted  approval on 2016.05.10 to call for bids and select suitable investors to construct two hotels of star category with a minimum of 100 rooms in two land lots owned by the Airport and Aviation Services of  BIA, Katunayake.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala De Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation to award the above contract for the Construction and Operation of two Air Port hotels on a 40 year lease to E.C.M Libra Financial Group Berhad, Malayasia and T.P Real Estate Holdings (Pvt) Ltd., Singapore as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of a TESLA, MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) Scanner for Sir John Kothalawala Defence University (KDU) Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - International Competitive bids have been called to procure a Tesla MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) Scanner (01) for the Sir John Kothalawala Defence University (KDU) Hospital and accordingly three (03) bids have been received. Therefore, the proposal made by H.E the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to assess those bids and to award the above tender to M/s Technomedics International (Pvt) Ltd at a total cost of Rs.251.78 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Polonnaruwa Postal Complex, Poojapitiya Post Office and Batticaloa Postal Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - Under the Polonnaruwa new town development plan, lands and few buildings belonging to the Postal Department are to be acquired by the Urban Development Authority and in place of same a new postal complex is proposed to be constructed in the Kaduruwela town. Further, it has been found that a new 06 storey building should be constructed for the dilapidated postal complex existing in Batticaloa. Poojapitiya Post Office delivers letters covering an area of 30 square kilometers in extent and fundamental preparatory activities for the construction of a new office building for Poojapitiya has commenced. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. M.H.A Haleem, the Minister of Posts, Postal and Muslim Religious Affairs to obtain provisions to construct new buildings for the Polonnaruwa and Batticaloa postal complexes and to obtain the balance provisions required to proceed with the construction work of the   Poojapitiya Postal Complex from the General Treasury, was approved by the complex.

description: Recovery of Damages on the Death of Minors
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - It is proposed to introduce legislation to ensure that in the case of a death of a child due to the negligence or carelessness of a third party, damages should be recovered from the said third party for the mental pain caused to the parents and the future impacts.   Accordingly, the proposal made by  Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksha, the Minister of Justice to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation giving effect to such provision, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Electricity Grid Interconnection for the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation of the (BIMSTEC) Member States
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon.
