Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy to sign the Memorandum of Understanding for establishment of the Grid Interconnection  for the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation of (BIMSTEC) Member States, recognizing the need of strengthening economic, commercial and technical cooperation in the region on energy cooperation programmes for the implementation of transmission interconnections for the trade in electricity, with a view to promoting a logical and maximum power transition in BIMSTEC states, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Cardio-Thoracic Treatment (Cardiac & Critical Care) Complex at the Lady Ridge Intensive Care Unit way Hospital for Children
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - Lady Ridgeway Hospital is the only national referral centre for Pediatric patients in the country with extensive facilities for treatment of children with heart diseases and the Government has focused its attention to provide it with the necessary resources with a view to increasing its capacity for cardiac surgeries. The Cabinet has granted approval for the construction of a ten storeyed State of the Art Building Complex at the Lady Ridgeway Hospital with space for 4 Cardiac Theaters, 14 Cardiac Intensive Care Unit beds, 33 Medical Intensive Care Unit beds and over 50 beds for the new-born.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to amend the cost of the project as Rs.2,439.7 million in accordance with revised estimate provided by the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, to cover the cost from the Consolidated Fund and the Sri Lanka College of Pediatricians under a special project named 'Little Hearts' and to complete the construction of the project within two (02) years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Accommodation facilities to Tourists in the vicinity of  Railway Stations (Back Packing Tourist Accommodation)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - According to the new concept to be introduced as proposed by the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority, the Railway Department will derive an additional income, by renovating the discarded railway carriages and placing them at selected locations by leasing out the lands unused by the Railway Department to create accommodation facilities for tourists in the Railway Stations such as Colombo Yard, Mahaiyawa Sub Railway, Nanu Oya, Ambewela, Ella and Dodanduwa. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala De Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation; and Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance to implement the proposed project in collaboration with the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Progress of the Projects Implemented through the Capital Budget in the Year 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - The Report, prepared in accordance with the instructions given by the Cabinet of Ministers to the Secretary, Ministry of National Policies and Economic Affairs to submit a Progress Report on the projects implemented by each Ministry and the institutions under such Ministries with local and foreign funds,  during the year 2016, 10 Line Ministries have utilized more than 80% of the Capital allocation set apart for them and 21 Ministries have utilized around 60% to 80%  and that the overall rate of Capital Budget in 2016 is recorded as 62.3% of the total allocation. The Cabinet noted the Report including the above facts, submitted by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs.

description: Elevated Expressway from New Kelani Bridge to Athurugiriya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval for the construction of an Elevated Expressway from the proposed New Kelani Bridge to Rajagiriya, with connections to Battaramulla, Malabe, Athurugiriya and outer circular Highway. Under Phase I of the project, the Section from the New Kelani Bridge to Rajagiriya 6.9km in length and under Phase II the Section from Rajagiriya to Athurugiriya 10.4 km in length are due to be constructed. 14 Expression of Interests on Build‑Operate‑Transfer basis were received for Phase I and 9 for Phase II.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, for the selection of consultants to conduct the feasibility study, to prepare preliminary design and to call for proposals along with bids from the institutions which expressed their willingness, as recommended by the Project Committee appointed in respect of the Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulation of Electric Vehicle Charging Stations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body:
- There is a popular trend in Sri Lanka for  electric motor cars.  The number of electronic cars which had been limited to 90 cars in 2014, has been increased up to around 4,000 by now. Around 50 Electric Vehicle Charging Stations (EVCS) are being operated in the country, centered in the main towns. Although the Electric Vehicle Battery Charging Stations sell electricity, the provisions for regulation of this activity have not been incorporated in the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009. 



	Accordingly, with a view to safeguarding the rights of the electric car users, concerning the matters of sales tariff, safety measures, accuracy of measuring devices, intervention to resolve consumer complaints and disputes, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to amend the Electricity Act No.20 of 2009 by incorporating the relevant provisions to address the above  and to pursue action on the guidance of the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka, with regard to the affairs of the Electric Vehicle Charging Stations until such time the legislation is in place, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Defining the Outcomes and Priorities for the Economic Delivery Programme (EDP) and mandate for the Central Programme Management Unit (CPMU)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body:
- Cabinet has already granted approval to establish a Central Programme Management Unit (CPMU), with a view to making a rapid economic transformation in Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, action is being taken to list out the outcome and priorities, establish a Central Programme Management Unit, while making special focus towards accelerating the delivery of most important economic benefits to Sri Lanka, in the next 3 years. It is expected to achieve development in the following 5 priority fields, under the Economic Delivery Programme implemented strictly with a set target: 

(i)	median income
(ii)	private sector jobs
(iii)	domestic and foreign investments
(iv)	exports
(v)	government revenue

The fields of tourism, agriculture and manufacturing have been selected as the fields which could make a direct impact to achieve the anticipated outcome under this programme. Moreover, investments, digital economy and government revenue have been identified as Enablers to this programme. It has been planned to vest the responsibility of implementing this target programme under the leadership of the relevant Ministers and to review its progress by the Hon. Prime Minister and the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management (CCEM), once in two weeks. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to implement the programme within a prescribed time frame, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mining of Quartz Deposits in Kotikambokka Forest of Wellawaya impacted due to the construction of the Alikota Ara Reservoir
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - It has been estimated that, the Quartz deposit located in a forest area belonging to the Department of Wildlife Conservation in Kotikambokka, Wellawaya, is in extent of approximately 910,000 Cubic Meters. Since the said Kotikambokka, Vein Quartz is located in the boundary of the Alikota Ara Reservoir which is being constructed under the Uma Oya Multi Purpose Development Scheme, it will be impossible to carry out proper mining of the deposit, when the reservoir is filled in with water at the end of year 2018, as stipulated. As such,  the proposal made by Maithripala Sirisena, H. E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to carryout  a formal feasibility study and on the results, to call for proposals  from local and international organizations following a transparent procedure for selecting a suitable organization to conduct scientific mining prior to filling the reservoir with water and to export the produce after value addition with the objective of getting a significant contribution to the National Economy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Capacity Building for Service Excellence - 2017/2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - In terms of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) entered into between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Singapore, 70 mid‑career Public Officers were provided with a special training on Capacity Building at the Civil Service College of Singapore, in the year 2016. The joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister and Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration and Management, to conduct a medium term training programme titled 'Capacity Building for Service Excellence' jointly, by the Civil Service College of Singapore and the Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration (SLIDA), for the years 2017- 2018, to develop further, the specific skills needed for the officers selected, under the Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementing recommendations of the Committee on granting measures of relief to media personnel who were subject to various harassments and oppressions during the period from 2005-2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-28
decision_details_body: - On the directive of H. E. the President, the Secretary to the President has appointed a Special Committee,  to inquire into the harassment and oppression of media personnel during the period from 2005 to 2015. Accordingly, by way of publishing newspaper notices the media personnel who had been so harassed and oppressed were given an opportunity by the Committee to submit their appeals. Taking into consideration the appeals so submitted, the Committee has presented a Report, including its recommendations on provision of relief measures to the relevant media personnel. Accordingly, the proposal made by Maithripala Sirisena, H. E. the President, to appoint a Cabinet Sub‑Committee comprising of the Ministers of Foreign Affairs; Justice; and Parliamentary Reforms and Mass Media, to study the Report further and report the outcome to the Cabinet, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accelerating  Higher Education Expansion and Development (AHEAD)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - A project named  'Accelerating  Higher Education Expansion and Development' has been designed with a view to increasing the enrollment to higher education in priority areas for economic development being  Science,Technology, Engineering and Mathematics, improving the quality of higher education and the promotion of innovative, research and development activities. The project will be implemented during the period 2017 - 2022 and the International Development Association has agreed to grant a credit of Special Drawing Rights being the equivalent to US$ 33 million and  a credit facility of US$ 67 million by the International Bank for Reconstruction  and Development. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs to conduct negotiations to obtain the loan facilities concerned and enter into loan agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National Vocational Training Institute at Hingurakgoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The annual school dropouts in the Polonnaruwa District is around 3,225 and the capacity in the existing public sector training centres available at present, in the district are not adequate to provide them with vocational training. Therefore, the joint proposal made by Maithripala Sirisena, H.E. the President and Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training to establish a National Vocational Training Centre at Hingurakkgoda with the loan assistance provided by the  Government of Netherlands concurrently with the Polonnaruwa Integrated Development Programme to enable the youth to undergo a qualitative technical and vocational education and training leading to productive employment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Concession Agreement of the Port of Hambantota
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The proposed Concession Agreement to be entered into between the Government of Sri Lanka and the China Merchant Port Holdings Company Limited of China on the Port of Hambantota is for the development of port and the port infrastructure of  phase I, phase II which have been completed  and the proposed Phase III,  especially the planning, financing, construction, operation and management and the future expansion. The Cabinet approval was granted to enter into this Concession Agreement cleared by the Attorney General and to appoint a Ministerial Sub-Committee chaired by Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Special Assignments with the participation of other relevant Hon. Ministers to operationalise and monitor the said Agreement.

description: The Foreign Exchange Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his  capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to publish in the Government Gazette the 'Foreign Exchange draft Bill' prepared by the Legal Draftsman  for the management and regulation of  foreign exchange, to encourage the Sri Lankan Citizens living abroad to remit their money over to the country, to repeal the Exchange Control Act which is not appropriate to address the current trends and given clearance by the Attorney General, and subsequently present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting of Voluntary Disclosure Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The main objective of the Voluntary Disclosure Act is to permit the people liable to pay income tax, to regularize past non-compliance in respect of the payment of income tax on the income derived within Sri Lanka and to encourage them to start paying income tax as required by the Inland Revenue Act. By doing so, many countries offer similar Voluntary Disclosure programmes and have been successful in increasing their tax revenue. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Prime Minister to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft the Voluntary Disclosure Bill based on the concept paper, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Accommodation Building and the Administration Building of the National Police Academy, Katana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The 'Police Training School, Katana' established with the objective of enhancing the knowledge, skills and attitudes of the police personnel was subsequently transformed into a 'National Police Academy'. The development of this academy established within a 39 acre land to a standard similar to that of  International Police Academies, is a timely need. Accordingly, it is imperative that accommodation facilities, administrative, lecture halls, library, welfare and recreational facilities are provided in the academy for 450 police personnel  to be trained simultaneously. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayaka, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development to implement the project for the construction of the Accommodation Building and the Administration Building of the National Police Academy, Katana at an estimated cost of Rs.674.26 million within the Medium Term Budgetary Framework of 2017 to 2019 as a preliminary step of the development activity, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Ayurveda Hospitals and the Development of their Infrastructure
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval in the year 2014 for the construction of a    10 storyed building for the Yakkala Ayurveda Hospital, a Siddha Medical Teaching Hospital in Koonespuri of Trincomalee, a Ward Complex for the District Ayurveda Hospital, Manchanthuduwai and a two storyed building for the Kaithadi Ayurveda Hospital in the Jaffna District, for expediting the essential infrastructure facilities for the promotion of  the Indigenous System of Medicine.  In the same way, Cabinet approval has also been received on 2016-07-13 to construct a Traditional Ayurveda Hospital in the Wedagama village in the Gampaha District. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to obtain the consultancy services from the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) in respect of the project which has been unduly delayed to construct it with a minimum cost and a high standard in a more productive manner and to hand over the construction activities of the project to the State Engineering Corporation and commence the work expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Bone Marrow Transplant Centre at the Teaching Hospital, Kandy for Patients afflicted with Thalassaemia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that there are over 3500 Thalassaemia Patients and nearly 500,000  Thalassaemia Carriers in Sri Lanka.  Many countries around the world have now recognized that Bone Marrow Transplantation and the Cord-Blood stem cell transplantation is the permanent cure for this disease but unfortunately the treatment modality is  not available at present, in the government hospitals of Sri Lanka. As such, it has necessitated the establishment of a Unit for Bone Marrow Transplantation for the Thalassaemia patients. It has also been observed that it is appropriate to establish such a Bone Marrow Transplantation  Unit in the Teaching Hospital, Kandy since a greater number of the Thalassaemia Patients have been found from the districts of Kurunegala, Colombo, Gampaha, Anuradhapura, Badulla, Ampara and Kandy. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to handover the construction of the new building complex for the Bone Marrow Transplantation Unit in the Teaching Hospital, Kandy on design and build basis to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau and the Central Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd. at a cost of Rs. 856.9 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Augmentation of Water Pipe Lines concurrent to the Orugodawatta Ambathale Road Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The main objective of this project to be implemented on financial facilities provided by the Uni Credit Bank AG, Austria and the People's Bank is to shift the existing water utility pipe network laid concurrent to the Orugodawatta - Ambathale road section, to the new road proposed to be constructed under the Orugodawatta - Ambathale Road Development Project. Although proposals have been called  from 03 institutions to select a suitable Company to implement the project, on the recommendation of the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management, only Mascinen - Umwelttechink - Transport Anlagen Company (M-U-T) has responded. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the Contract of this project to the Mascinen - Umwelttechink - Transport Anlagen Company (M-U-T), for a total sum of Euro 46.21 million, on the recommendation of the Ministerial Committee appointed by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management to negotiate with the Company and expedite the procurement process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Medirigiriya Water Supply Scheme Phase III - Laying of Pipes and  Fitting of accessories to the Pumping Mains of Bisopura and Kumudupura Water Towers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The Medirigiriya Water Supply Scheme Phase III valued at Rs.3,057 million  is one of the 09 water supply schemes implemented under the 'Rajarata Navodaya' / 'Pibidemu Polonnaruwa' development programme.  Through this project pipe borne water facilities will be provided  to cover 14 Grama Niladhari Divisions of the Medirigiriya Divisional Secretary's Division. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply to award the contract for the  Supply and Laying of Water Pipes and Fittings, and Valves for the Pumping Mains of Bisopura and Kumudupura Water Towers as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee to the lowest substantial responsive bidder M/s Sanken Construction (Pvt.) Ltd. - Vonlan Constructions (Pvt.) Ltd. JV, at a cost of Rs.678.06 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the Contract for Rehabilitation of Stage 3 of Minipe Left Bank Canal under the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - Under the Stage 3 of the Minipe Left Bank Canal of the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Programme, in the Minipe Left Bank Canal of 74km in length, it has been planned to rehabilitate the Canal from 49.82 km upto 63.65 km.  Accordingly, the proposal made by  Maithripala Sirisena, H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to award the relevant contract, to the lowest substantive responsive bidder, for a sum of Rs.625.73 million excluding VAT, to the Nawaloka Construction (Pvt.) Ltd. as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Solution to the Dispute relating to some of the Employees of the Human Capital Solutions (Pvt) Ltd. - a subsidiary of Sri Lanka Telecom PLC
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body:
- The SLT Human Capital Solutions (Pvt) Ltd (HCS), which is a Subsidiary of Sri Lanka Telecom PLC, is an institution established to provide Human Resources to the outside institutions including the Sri Lanka Telecom PLC and its staff consists of 2,650. Out of them, 2,180 are employees attached to of the Sri Lanka Telecom PLC. All of them have been recruited under a Service Agreement of the HCS Company and received salaries and other facilities from the Company. The services of 1,331 employees out of the above have been made permanent in their posts. These employees receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs.30,000/- to Rs.100,000/- including over time, allowances and annual bonus allowances and they enjoy the other facilities in addition to the annual bonus allowances, salary increases and insurance coverage. 

	The demand by one section of these employees of the trade union is to absorb them into the Sri Lanka Telecom PLC, treating them as employees of the same.  After computerizing the consumer affairs under the new investment plan of the Sri Lanka Telecom PLC it has been estimated that there will be a considerable surplus of employees, if the relevant employees are absorbed into the Sri Lanka Telecom PLC according to their request and the company will have to bear an additional expenditure of Rs.1.6 billion. 

	However, taking into consideration the matters submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, regarding the prevailing situation, it was decided by the Cabinet to advise the Board of Directors of the Sri Lanka Telecom PLC to take action to absorb the experienced and professionally qualified employees of the HCS,  under four (04) stages, from the year 2017 up to the year 2020, as a humanitarian gesture.

description: Amendment to Information and Communication Technology Act, No. 27 of 2003
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The legal framework for the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) policies to be adopted by the Cabinet is established through the Information and Communication Technology Act, No.27 of 2003 amended by the Amendment Act, No.33 of 2008.  The Cabinet has granted approval for the Information Communication Technology Agency to provide facilities to implement a Centralized Household Transfer Management project with the  idea of establishing a National Digital Identifier-NDI and a  National Digital Transaction-NDT which could store bio-metric data of citizens inclusive of  data of citizens to provide an efficient public service to the General Public using the Information and Communication Technology and exchange data with other State Institutions.  When considering the importance of the above project it is observed that ensuring the safety of the data inclusive of the personal data is imperative, and that the Information Communication Agency should prepare and National Policy on collection, storage, distribution and the use of citizen's personal data.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft the necessary amendments to be made to the Information and Communication Technology Act, No. 27 of 2003, to enable the Inter-Ministerial Committee to exercise the powers under the Act, to establish appropriate institutional arrangements, governance and operational measures for the formal and effective implementation of the Cabinet approved strategies and programmes on Information and Communication Technology, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the provisions of Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, No.17 of 1929 and Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs (Amendment) Act, No.13 of 1984
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The target of the Government in respect of the drugs issue is to reduce the supply and demand and the usage of drugs to a very low level by the year 2021.  In this connection, it has been observed that it is necessary to amend the existing provisions to strengthen the functioning of the State Institutions and other Agencies acting directly to enforce the laws relating to narcotic drugs inclusive of the Provincial and Divisional Administration and the Agencies.  Cannabis and Heroin have become a severe threat, at present and as a result of these drug dealings the future generation is being exposed to a great disaster. Although, it is observed that there is a decrease in the cultivation of Cannabis due to the constant raids carried out by the Sri Lanka Police and the Department of Excise, the consumption of Kerala Cannabis has been increased.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development to amend the penalties imposed for the sale of dangerous drugs such as, opium, cocaine, heroin and cannabis and the possession, importing and exporting of such drugs including the amendment to the Third Schedule to the Act, and to reduce the time period in custody after arrest,  by amending the Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, No.17 of 1929 and  to amend the  Poisons, Opium and Dangerous Drugs (Amendment) Ordinance, No.13 of 1984  taking into consideration, the proposals submitted by the  Sub-Committee on Legislation of the National Dangerous Drugs Control Board with the contribution of the law enforcement institutions such as the Attorney Generals Department the Police Narcotic Bureau, the Sri Lanka Customs and the Department of Excise, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting in Parliament the Regulations made by the Minister of Sports under Section 41 of the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to present the  Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.1990/23 dated 2016-10-27 including  the Regulations of the National Association of Sports bearing No.01 of 2016 made by the Minister of Sports under section 41 read with section 31 of the Sports Act No.25 of 1973 and the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2006/13 dated 2017-02-13 including the Regulations made amending the Regulations of the National Association of Sports, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rural Bridges Project - Phase II - Construction of additional 63 bridges
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted on 21st February 2014, to obtain a credit facility of Sterling 100 million from the Deutsche Bank AG London Branch, as a commercial facility for the proposed project of constructing 537 bridges. The project duration of 03 years is due to be completed on 08th December 2017 and owing to the fluctuations of the exchange rates, a further surplus is found to be existing on the loan amount.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government to construct additional 63 bridges utilizing the balance saving and also to extend the project period by another 03 months from 08th December 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Registration of Dogs Ordinance No. 25 of 1901
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The general public have to face various difficulties due to the problem of stray dogs and it has been found that there is no adequate legal provision in the Registration of Dogs Ordinance No. 25 of 1901 to address this issue.  Although the Cabinet approval has been granted to repeal both the Registration of Dogs Ordinance and the Rabies Ordinance and draft a new Bill, which would address all these issues, but the matter has not been completed up to date. Therefore, taking into consideration the immediate necessity for the solution of the problem of stray dogs, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government to instruct the Legal Draftsman to amend the Registration of Dogs Ordinance increasing the fine imposed on persons who abandon their dogs up to Rs.25,000/- and also increase the term of imprisonment up to two years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making it compulsory to establish letterboxes in the Ground Floor of the Housing Complexes to be constructed to provide the residents there with postal facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The postmen have to face various practical problems when distributing letters and mail items to the residents of the multi-storey housing complexes and as a result, a situation has arisen where they cannot perform their duties in the best of manner. Accordingly, with  the objective of providing a solution to the issue, the proposal made by Hon. M.H.A. Haleem, the Minister of Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs, to inform the Ministries concerned to provide instructions to the Urban Development Authority and the relevant Provincial Institutions to establish letter boxes separately for each house under the house holders' list number when constructing multi-story housing complexes, to design a separate area newly for letter boxes in the ground floor of the housing complexes already constructed, to hand over the keys of the letter boxes where the number of the particular house is carved to the relevant house owners and take action as proposed above, when issuing permits for the construction of buildings, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the land at Peliyagoda owned by the State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanka owns a land in extent of 14.5 acres, facing the Negombo-Colombo main highway and the access road to the Katunayake-Colombo Expressway and considering its extent and the location, it has been observed that it could be utilized for a large scale development activity. There is a high potential for utilizing the land especially, for a mixed development project with commercial and residential facilities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to identify viable project proposals for productive development to be implemented in the above land through the State Engineering Corporation of Sri Lanka, to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee to monitor the process, to evaluate and consider the proposals and to appoint a Project Committee comprising of the representatives of the relevant institutions to assist the said Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of interest Concession on loans for electricity consumers for installing Rooftop Solar PV Systems
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - A proposal was made in the Budget Proposals - 2017  to introduce a concessionary rate loan scheme to the households with a monthly electricity bill of over Rs.2,000/- to encourage them to transfer over to Solar Energy.    However, since the monthly electricity bills of around 40% of the electricity consumers in the country are below Rs.300/-, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy to provide the interest concession to all household consumers who obtain loans from any government or private bank, without limiting it only to householders with monthly bills of over Rs.2,000/- as planned earlier, and to increase the proposed loan amount from Rs.150,000/- up to Rs.350,000/- for the purpose of implementing the plan more effectively,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuing commemorative tea packs to be distributed among foreign visitors at the Bandaranaike International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - In order to reinforce the identity of Ceylon Tea among tourists and to enhance their impression of Sri Lankan hospitality, it is proposed to gift the passengers of selected Airlines departing to selected destinations, with a high quality pack of tea free of charge with the contribution of several leading tea brand-owners who market Sri Lanka Tea,  In addition, a booklet containing the information on the unique attributes of Ceylon Tea and how to buy Ceylon Tea in their own countries, also will be provided.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries to implement the project utilizing a Rs.100 million from the Tea Promotion and Marketing Fund of the Sri Lanka Tea Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Project Management Unit (PMU) for the implementation of the Light Railway Transit (LRT) Lines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development for conducting a feasibility study for the proposed Light Trail Transit Line (LRT) from Colombo Port to Bambalapitiya and to Maradana via Borella and the proposed LRT from Borella to Malambe due to be constructed with the assistance of the Japan International Corporation Agency (JICA) and for the establishment of a Project Management Unit for designing and implementing the road network, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lease of a land for a Clinical Waste Management Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - With the development of the Government and the private hospitals in Colombo and the suburbs the clinical waste generated in such hospitals have been  increased significantly. It is, therefore, necessary to dispose of the waste in a proper method so that it may not create serious environmental and social issues. The  Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine and the Central Environment Authority together with the Sisili Hanaro Encare (Pvt) Ltd. have planned to implement a clinical waste project to be implemented in the Mulleriyawa hospital. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development to lease out a land in extent of  2A - 1R - 23.99P situated at Muthurajawela, for the purpose, to the Sisili Hanaro Encare (Pvt) Ltd. for a period of 30 years was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting of the new Sri Lanka Immigrants and Emigrants Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - Although the Immigrant and Emigrant Act, No.20 of 1948 had been subject to  amendments in 1955, 1961, 1993, 1998, 2006 and 2015, it requires compliance with the present trends of the international environment. Accordingly, with the objective of establishing a strong Immigrants and Emigrants legal network, identifying the gaps in the existing Immigrant and Emigrant laws, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare the new Sri Lanka Immigrants and Emigrants Act, to address the challenges with regard to illegal migration, trafficking of persons, terrorism, cross border transnational crimes and health, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Economic Service Charge (Amendment) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance to publish the draft Bill, prepared by the Legal Draftsman to amend the Economic Service Charge Act No.13 of 2006 incorporating the changes proposed by the Budget Proposal of the year 2016 and 2017 and given clearance by the Attorney General, in the Government Gazette and subsequently present it in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: New Inland Revenue Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Budget Proposal of 2016 action is being taken to introduce a New Inland Revenue Act, with a view to simplifying and modernizing the existing Inland Revenue Act. By the proposed new Act, it has been planned to   broaden the income tax base by expanding the sources of income rules,    to add new administrative powers to the Inland Revenue Department to enable it to enforce tax control activities efficiently while enhancing the tax payer protection instead of providing wide tax concessions, to address tax base erosion and combat tax avoidance to modernize tax control based on non-complex principles creating a more conducive tax structure and to implement the Capital Gains Tax.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft the New Inland Revenue Act,  based on the  existing concept paper, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Funding the NCD Alliance Lanka to combat the spread of non-communicable Diseases
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - An alliance known as NCD Alliance Lanka has been formed comprising of the Sri Lanka Heart Association, the Sri Lanka Cancer Society, and the Ceylon National Association for the prevention of Chest Diseases, to combat Diabetes Mellitus, Ischeamic Heart Diseases, Cancers, Chronic Chest Diseases and use of Alcohol and Tobacco. This alliance is in Agreement with a five (05) year strategic plan for the prevention and control of the above non-communicable diseases. Accordingly, the proposal made by  Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to provide NCD Alliance Lanka annually with Rs.5 million for five (05) years from the year 2017 from the  provision set apart for the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine by the Government of Sri Lanka to carryout the activities identified in the strategic plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening medical supply facilities in Hospitals and Regional Medical Supply Divisions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The Medical Supplies Division of the Ministry of Health is the central organization responsible for providing all pharmaceuticals, surgical items, laboratory items, radioactive items and printed material. As such, considering the importance of providing qualitative medical supplies to patients in a timely manner, it has been proposed to implement the two (02) projects namely, the  improvement of store facilities for pharmaceuticals in hospitals and the expansion of the Medical Supply Management Information System up to the divisional hospitals.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to implement the project for upgrading of drugs stores in 134 hospitals and 26 Regional Medical Supplies Divisions at an estimated cost of Rs.712 million and the project for expanding the Medical Supply Management Information System up to the divisional hospitals at an estimated cost of Rs.954 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Setting up of a Picture Archival and Communication System (PACS) / Radiology Information System (RIS) for 20 Government Hospitals in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The daily inflow of patients to the entire hospital system of Sri Lanka as well as the indoor patients is very high and various medical reports are necessary for  diagnosing the diseases of the patients. Among these, there are patients afflicted with various complex diseases who need constant diagnosis. For this purpose, it is essential to keep their records so as to be able to make references. Some of the reports are kept in the hospital while some are with the patients. Therefore, storing and conserving the data with the help of advanced technology to be referred to when such information is needed, is a timely need. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to implement a project for establishing a Picture Archival and Communication System and Radiology Information System network in 20 Government Hospitals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National Science Centre (NSC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - A land in extent of 7 acres from the Mahenawatta area at Pitipana in Homagama has already been set apart for the Ministry of Science, Technology and Research for the establishment of a National Science Centre (NSC). The NSC is a new initiative for Sri Lanka and as such, it is vital to carry out its activities in line with international standards with the assistance of competent experts.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee to procure consultancy services for Project Planning & Architectural Designing, Construction and Setting-up and Supervision of the NSC and to obtain the Technical and Financial Assistance from appropriate agencies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the National Zoological Gardens of Sri Lanka and the National Zoological Gardens of Singapore
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The development plans of the Dehiwala Zoological Gardens, the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage  affiliated to it and the Safari Park at Ridiyagama are being implemented and the construction work of the proposed project will continue until the end of 2018, building a sound collaboration with an advanced zoological gardens of international repute for the exchange of technical knowledge and the experiences needed has been identified as vital in regard to the development activities of the zoological gardens.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding to work in close collaboration with the Zoological Gardens of Singapore in regard to the technical and scientific knowledge concerned, the exchange of information and the new trends on animal species, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding in the field of Tourism between the Russian Federation and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on cooperation in the field of tourism between the Ministry of Culture in the Russian Federation and the Ministry of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs of Sri Lanka during the scheduled forthcoming official visit to Russia by Maithripala Sirisena, H.E. the President, with a view to promoting friendly relations between the two countries and for the contribution in the field of economic and tourism development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Investments in the public infrastructure through the Private-Public Partnership (PPP) model
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka's  infrastructure development lags behind, in contrast to other competitor countries in the region, as a result of being dependent on public funding for infrastructure development projects. This situation has created enormous pressure on the Government fiscal operations. In this background, it is vitally important for the country to adopt successful PPP modalties operated in other countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee and a Project Committee for the formulation of a suitable mechanism to attract foreign investment into the country through successful PPP modalties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of the ownership of Condominium and Non Condominium Properties over to the long term residents there
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The Government has planned to construct 500,000 housing units for the lower and middle income families within the year 2017 under private-public partnership and the budget 2017 has proposed to transfer the ownership of the condominium and non-condominium properties over to the residents who had been resident there for over a period of 15 years. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to formulate a methodology for the transfer of ownership to the owners of such properties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Concessional financial assistance from the Netherlands
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The Government of the Netherlands has expressed its willingness to provide financial assistance for several development projects in Sri Lanka inclusive of the construction of rural bridges, the vocational training centre in Polonnaruwa and the water supply scheme in Mirigama.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to proceed with the necessary activities to evaluate the project proposals in that regard submitted by the companies in Netherlands interested in such projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Draft Securities Exchange Act 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The attention of the Government has been focused to introduce a new Act in place of the present Securities and Exchange Commission Act, No.36 of 1987, to meet the challenges faced by the capital market, at present. The draft concept paper has been prepared by taking into consideration the legal concepts and the experiences of other countries like Malaysia, Singapore and Hongkong and further amended based on the recommendations of the experts in the field. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs to draft a new Act named the Securities Exchange Act based on the draft concept paper  with the objective of strengthening the independence of the Securities and Exchange Commission to provide the confidence of both the local and foreign investors as a well regulated and orderly share market inter alia making the capital market more attractive as an alternative way to raise capital in the Sri Lankan Economy, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Development of Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body: - The Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Industry has been identified as one of the potential industries which could contribute to boost the economic growth of the country. As such, the improvement of the capacity of the pharmaceutical producers in the country is imperative to meet the domestic pharmaceutical needs, in order to provide qualitative pharmaceuticals at an affordable price, and to minimize the dependence on imported pharmaceuticals. Presently, 15% of the country's total pharmaceutical needs are produced locally and the expectation of the Government is to increase it up to 80%. Accordingly, with a view to providing the facilities needed, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his  capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, for the modernization and expansion of the local pharmaceutical manufacturing industry, for promoting competitiveness to gain entry into the export market, for exemption of taxes applicable to imports of raw materials, packing materials, equipment and accessories and the machinery used by the pharmaceutical industry and to expedite the establishment of the Bio Medical Zone to attract investment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The introduction of a formal methodology for the supply of Metal, Sand, Soil and Gravel required for the development activities of the Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body:
- A high demand has been created for minerals such as metal, sand, soil and gravel etc; required for the development of infrastructure facilities presently carried out in Sri Lanka. As such, the importance of having a formal methodology for the supply of such minerals for the development activities of the Government with the least possible environmental effects in excavating of these minerals, has been emphasized. 

Accordingly, the proposal made by Maithripala Sirisena, H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, for the introduction of a formal methodology for the excavation of minerals found in the areas administered by the Sri Lanka Mahaweli Authority and the Department of Forest Conservation and for the protection of environment conservation, eliminating corruption, fraud and irregularities for ensuring an effective supply chain after a proper environmental assessment for the expeditious implementation of the development projects at a minimum cost  with a view to achieving sustainable development,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the 'Grama Shakthi Programme' for alleviation of poverty
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-21
decision_details_body:
- The poverty rate of Sri Lanka which was at 26.1% in the year 1990 has been brought down to 6.7% by the year 2011, as a result of numerous security programmes implemented through out the past years.   The year 2017 has been declared as the 'Year of alleviation of poverty in Sri Lanka' and under this programme measures have been adopted to alleviate poverty which still exist at the divisional level. 
	
	Accordingly, in 2017, 700 severely affected Grama Niladhari Divisions will be selected out of the Divisional Secretary's Divisions where the poverty index ranges from 10% to 45% and a People's Company will be formed to be managed by a Director Board selected from out of a general assembly with a participation of 80% of the selected families under the 'Grama Shakthi Programme' which is due to be implemented. The representatives of the People's Companies will be trained and development funds will be granted to the People's Companies so as to enable the representatives to shoulder the task of alleviating poverty of the village by themselves and at the end of the year 2017 this programme will be implemented in such manner as to spend Rs. One Million for the development of every village.  

	In addition to the 700 community-managed villages, 300 Grama Niladhary Divisions situated in various parts of the Island which could be developed as production villages will be selected for providing the needed technical know how to improve production and financial facilities for products suitable for export or materials for local needs and thereby reduce imports and creating  new employment opportunities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Maithripala Sirisena, H.E. the President for the implementation of this programme with public-private participation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project for Upgrading of the Institute of Engineering Technology at Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approval has been granted for the implementation of the project for upgrading the Institute of Engineering Technology at Katunayake with the objective of increasing the annual intake of students from 300 to 500. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to vest the implementation of the project with  M/s KUHN International Project GmbH CoKG of Austria, in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), subject to a maximum of 9.5 million Euro, inclusive of the development of the required infrastructure facilities, supply of equipment and accessories, curriculum development and capacity enhancing activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Paddy Purchasing Programme during the Maha Season - 2016 / 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - During the Maha season 2016/2017 a harvest of 1.32 MT of paddy is expected and out of which the Government has planned to purchase 73,500 MT of paddy covering 17 Districts. In this context, paddy is to be directly purchased from the farmers and it has been planned to get the assistance of the District Secretary / Government Agent, Divisional Secretary and the relevant Village Level Officers to implement the paddy purchasing programme. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to purchase Kiri samba and other samba varieties for Rs.41/- per kg and the Nadu category of paddy for Rs.38/- per kg, cultivated during the seasons from the registered farmers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Long Term Contracts for the purchase of petrol and diesel
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Chandima Weerakkody, the Minister of Petroleum Resources Development to award the long term tender for the import of 4,200,000 barrels of diesel (0.05 percentage of maximum sulphur) and 956,250 barrels of petrol (92 Unl) to M/s Swiss Singapore Overseas Pte. Ltd. of Singapore and M/s Gunvor singapore Pte. Ltd. respectively, for a period of eight (08) months commencing from 2017‑03‑01 to 2017‑10‑31, in accordance with the  recommendations of the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Protocol on Cultural Cooperation between Russia and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs to sign a protocol for the implementation of matters pertaining to the cooperation of the cultural field between Sri Lanka and the Russian Federation on Performing Arts, Cultural Exchange Programmes including the implementation of  activities pertaining to the cultural field, during the scheduled Heads of State visit by H.E. the President to Russia in March 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rural Infrastructure Development Project in Regions where rapid development activities occurred
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan has expressed its willingness to grant a loan of Japanese Yen 12,957 Million (approximately Rs.17,369 Million) through the Japanese International Cooperation Agency to implement this project through the improvement of Rural Roads, medium and small scale irrigation canals and the rural water supply facilities of the Northern, Eastern and Central and Uva Provinces to improve the living standards of the people living in those areas thereby developing the rural economy and minimizing the regional disparities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe,  the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into a loan Agreement with the JICA to obtain the loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kalu Ganga Water Supply Expansion Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The water distribution network which facilitates pipe borne water for the people of Kalutara District is more than 70 years old and to minimize the leakages that occur as a result and also to fulfil the increasing demand of water facilities due to rapid urbanization, the improvement of the Kalu Ganga Water Supply Expansion Project is imperative. The Government of Japan has expressed its willingness to grant a sum of Japanese Yen 31,810 Million through the Japanese International Cooperation Agency (JICA) (approximately Rs.42,240 Million) for the implementation of the Kalu Ganga Water Supply Expansion Project.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into a loan Agreement with JICA, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Financial Assistance from the Saudi Fund (SFD) for the implementation of the Wayamba University Township Development Project and  the Mahaweli Left Bank Lower Basin Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The Saudi Fund for development has expressed its willingness to grant a concessional loan of (SAR) 273.75 Million approximately 73 American Dollors in all constituting SAR 105 million for the implementation of the Wayamba University Township Development Project and SAR 168.75 million for the implementation of the Mahaweli Left Bank Lower Basin Development Project.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to conduct loan negotiations and to enter into  Agreements for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and Russia for the promotion of Combating Crimes and Fostering the Police Assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet had granted approval on 2014‑06‑06 to sign the MoU between Sri Lanka and Russia for the promotion of Combating Crimes and Fostering the Police Assistance, the MoU had not been signed up to date. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to sign the MoU during the scheduled Heads of State visit by H.E. the President to Russia in March 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the National Aquatic Resources Research and Development Agency and the University of Notre Dame of the United States of America (USA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The University of Notre Dame of the United States of America, in collaboration with the National Aquatic Resources Research and Development Agency (NARA) over the past 5 years has developed an oceanographic research programme on the Indian Ocean, especially focussing on the Bay of Bengal.  The above institutions  are embarking on a Multi-year programme commencing from 2017 to carry out the relevant collaborative research activities. With a view to formalizing this collaboration, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to sign the Memorandum of Understanding between the University of  Notre Dame of USA and the NARA of Sri Lanka during the visit of the Hon. Minister to the University of  Notre Dame, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Interest Subsidy Loan Schemes proposed in the Budget 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body:
- The Budget Proposals of 2017 have made provision for the 12 proposed  concessionary loan schemes in several fields inclusive of providing concessions to the farmers dealing with small scale subsistence agriculture and the companies engaged in commercial level agriculture and to fulfil the housing needs of the low income groups. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to implement these loan schemes through the State and Private Sector Banks in the following manner, to be covered under 8 schemes, taking into consideration the executional convenience, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and Russia for Cooperation on Science, Technology and Innovation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Science, Technology and Research of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Education and Science of Russia have agreed to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the two countries with a view to promoting Cooperation on Science, Technology and Innovation. In terms of the MoU it is expected to exchange  specialists and scientific information, organize seminars and symposia, joint research, technological studies and set‑up joint scientific research centers and groups in the relevant fields coming under the  MoU. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to sign the MoU during the scheduled Heads of States visit of H.E. the President to the Russian Federation in March 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-development of the Bambalapitiya Flats
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction to sign a Public‑Private‑Partnership Agreement between the National Housing Development Authority and the Investor concerned for the re‑development of the Bambalapitiya Flats, subject to the condition that within a period of 4 to 6 weeks of signing the Agreement the developer should transmit US$ 10 million to the country as recommended by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of the University of Moratuwa as the Consulting Agency for Construction of the Kelaniya Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - With the objective of to establishing a people friendly police service Islandwide, the Cabinet has already granted approval to implement a project for the construction of model Police Stations in accordance with the approved model plans, giving priority to the convenience of the public and as well as the Police Officers considering the surroundings and the environmental factors of the respective provinces. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development to appoint the University of Moratuwa as the Consultancy Agency for construction of the Kelaniya Police Station, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Greater Colombo Water and Wastewater Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - Asian Development Bank (ADB) has granted US$ 112.83 million to Sri Lanka for the 'Greater Colombo drinking Water and Wastewater Management Improvement Investment Programme - Project 3' for upgrading the Wastewater Services and Management in the Greater Colombo Area to enable the residents of the area to live in a more conducive health surrounding.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government to award the contract for the provision of New Gravity Sewers, Force Mains and Pump Stations for the Kirullapona Wastewater Catchment Area in Colombo Municipal Council Area, to the substantially responsive lowest bidder, M/s. Larsen & Toubro Limited, utilizing a part of the loan, for a total sum of Rs.7,015.91 Million as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee with the concurrence of the Asian Development Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of the National Equipment and Machinery Organization (NEMO)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the recommendations made by the Minister of Housing and Construction and the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management for strengthening of the National Equipment and Machinery Organization (NEMO) the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2016‑08‑09 appointed an Officials' Committee to evaluate the capacity of the Institution.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction for the award of contracts direct to the NEMO without inviting bids and to increase the present limit of Rs.25 million to a limit of Rs.50 million in respect of renting out equipment from the organization by the State Institutions, in accordance with the recommendations of the above Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Setting-up of Cold Stores centered on dedicated economic centers of Dambulla and Keppetipola
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - Rs.2,000 million has been allocated to the Ministry of Rural Economy under the 2016 Budged Proposals for setting-up of cold stores with the main objective of stabilizing prices in the market and minimizing post harvest losses. Accordingly, on the results of a feasibility study made by a Committee comprising of State and Private Sector University Experts, it was decided that setting-up of two cold stores centered on the Dambulla and Keppetipola dedicated economic centers was most appropriate for which the Cabinet has already granted approval.   In order to commence the activities of the projects expeditiously to enable them to be completed by October 2017, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to award the consultancy contract to Design consultants as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee for a sum of Rs.30.1 Million without VAT, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Mannar Nadukuda Transmission Line under the Green Power Development & Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - Asian Development Bank has granted a loan of US$ 166.6 Million under  Tranche II of the  Green Power Development & Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme for strengthening the transmission network of the Ceylon Electricity Board.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for constructing the 30km Transmission Line from Mannar to Nadukuda as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee utilizing the above loan, to the substantially responsive lowest bidder, the KEC International Limited, for a sum of Rs.1,379.9 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between China and Sri Lanka on  'Investment and Production Capacity Promotion
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - During the Hon. Prime Minister's visit to China last year, Sri Lanka entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Government of China on comprehensive implementation of Investment, Economic and Technological Cooperation.  As secondary to the extensive Memorandum of Understanding the National Development and Reform Commission of China has indicated its willingness to enter into a MOU with Sri Lanka on 'Investment and Cooperation on Production Capacity' with the objective of building partnership in more focused strategic areas in terms of product base and strategic infrastructure.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to enter into an Agreement between the National Development and Reform Commission of the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Ministry of Development Strategies and International Trade of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement on   Mutual Cooperation between Sri Lanka and the  Czech Republic in trade matters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to enter into an Agreement between the Ministry of Development Strategies & International Trade of Sri Lanka and the  Ministry of Industry and Trade of the Czech Republic with a view to enhancing trade and economic cooperation between the two countries, providing facilities for bilateral investment promotion and identifying economic and investment opportunities, promotion of close trade and industrial cooperation and  facilitate networking activities in the entrepreneurial institutions in the two countries promoting greater understanding between the private sectors of the two countries regarding trade and economic policies and encouraging the cooperation in their areas of mutual interest, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Rural Infrastructure Facilities and the Livelihood Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Rural Economy has been able to successfully complete 241 infrastructure facility development projects and 145 livelihood development projects, based on the districts of Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa and Batticaloa, within the year 2016 under the Rural Infra-structure Facilities and the Livelihood Development Programme. As such, considering the level of poverty within the entire Island, it has been identified that it is appropriate to implement the above programme, in other districts as well. Under this programme it is expected to develop rural access roads, modernization of small irrigation work, drinking water projects, and development of common amenities like small bridges, culverts etc., implementation of self employment projects for youth, small and medium scale entrepreneurship projects, animal husbandry, fisheries and cultivation projects. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to implement the Rural Infrastructure Facilities and the Livelihood Development Programme through the District Secretaries, Divisional Secretaries and the relevant Government Institutions under the supervision of the Ministry of Rural Economy, in the year 2017 in the districts of Mullativu, Galle, Moneragala, Ratnapura, Kalutara, Puttalam and Matale, in addition to the districts of Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa and Batticaloa and to get the necessary provisions allocated for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Registration of Electors (Special Provisions) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to publish the Registration of Electors (Special Provisions) Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman in the Government Gazette, with a view to providing special legal provisions to ensure and protect the right of voting of the internally displaced persons as well as their children and to enable them to cast their votes further in the electoral districts of their permanent residencies before they were displaced, and present same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement to be signed between Sri Lanka and Russia for Cooperation in the field of Fisheries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to sign an Agreement for  Cooperation in the Field of Fisheries between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of Russian Federation on mutually beneficial conditions which contribute to the development of the fishing industry, during the official visit of H.E. the President, to Russia from 22nd to 25th of March, 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 08.	Entering into Agreements with the Government of Norway for Financial and Technical Assistance for the formulation of a Long - term National Fisheries Policy and Action Plan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to sign two Agreements  between the Ministry of Trade, Industries and Fisheries of the Government of Norway and the Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development in Sri Lanka, with a view to obtaining financial and technical assistance from the Government of Norway for the formulation of a new Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development Policy for Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement between Sri Lanka and Myanmar on Visa Exemption for holders of Diplomatic and Official/Service Passports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet granted covering approval to the proposal presented to the Cabinet by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs, for the Agreement entered into  between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Union of Myanmar, to facilitate the citizens of the two countries holding valid diplomatic or official/service passports to enter, transit and stay in the territory of either party for a period which does not exceed 30 days from the date of entry, with a view to further developing friendly relations between the two countries.

description: Excise Notification No. 994 (Gazette Extraordinary No. 1998/7 of  2016-12-20)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance to present in Parliament, for approval the Gazette Extraordinary No.1998/7 of 2016-12-20 wherein the Excise Notification No.994 was published, containing the order made by him under Section 32 read with Section 25 of the Excise Ordinance, to impose an annual license fee of Rs.100,000/- with effect from 2017‑01‑01, on four types of liquor licenses for foreign liquor shops, rest houses, hotels and restaurants  and for bulk sales of arrack issued free of charge up to the year 2017 by the Department of Excise, in addition to the licenses issued to sell foreign liquor, and also impose an annual license fee of Rs.50,000/- on the sale of bottled toddy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Biotechnology Innovation Park
