decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The National Research and Development Framework has identified that research and industries based on 'biotechnology' which falls within the emerging technologies of the world, have to be promoted within the country.  As such, a provision of Rs.100 Million have been set apart by the Budget proposals of 2017 and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research  for the establishment of a Biotechnology Innovation Park, within the existing Nanotechnology and Science Park situated in Pitipana, Homagama with Public-Private Partnership collaboration, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Census of Population and Housing - Year 2021 - Mapping Out Stage
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka conducts her Census of Population and Housing once in 10 years.  The next Census is scheduled to be conducted in the year 2021 and for this purpose the mapping out operations based on Grama Niladhari Divisions covering the whole island has already commenced. These mapping out operations will go on until April in the year 2020 and as such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to generate funds for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposals regarding the liquidation of Rakna Arakshaka Lanka Limited (RALL)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Attorney General's Advice, the Cabinet has granted approval on 2016-12-13 to liquidate Rakna Arakshaka Lanka Limited (RALL) and handover its ground security matters to the Department of Civil Security and the marine security matters to the Sri Lanka Navy.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to appoint an Officials' Committee to study the issues relating to the financial liabilities and responsibilities of the company and issues in respect of public finance and to attach the ground security personnel serving in the Rakna Arakshaka Lanka Limited to the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Services (Pvt) Ltd., owned by the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation (SLLRDC) for the purpose of  ensuring their job security until steps are taken for the liquidation of the RALL, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Millennium Challenge Corporation Project Unit
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC) is a Foreign Aid Agency of the United States of America which works towards reducing global poverty through economic growth. As a result of the discussions with the Agency, which targets long term economic development of selected countries, with a view to obtaining an opportunity of investment with it, the Agency has agreed to provide Sri Lanka with a sum of US$700 million to invest in the development of priority areas within a period of 05 years.  Under this programme, it has been identified to develop the Policy Instability, Access to Land and Transport as well as infrastructure facilities of water and waste water, electricity and education in a manner suited to promote the economic upliftment of Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to establish a Millennium Challenge Corporation Project Unit in the Office of the Prime Minister under the Policy Development Unit, to proceed with the activities relating to the operation of this programme in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Grama Rajya - Draft Concept Paper and Framework
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-03-14
decision_details_body: - The attention of the Government has been focussed on the implementation of the concept of the  Grama Rajya with the main objectives of forming an institutional framework that would allow the local community to actively and meaningfully contribute to the development of their resident area, of ensuring march towards a complete and sustainable society that gives the foremost place to social justice, and of creating a platform that enables the community and the state to discuss their  concerns and priorities relating to the development of the locality and work with mutual understanding.  The Grama Rajya - Draft Concept Paper and Framework has been prepared by a Committee comprising of the Senior Officials in the relevant field and the Sectoral Oversight Committee on Internal Administration and Public Management in Parliament has made its observations in that regard. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister to publish the  Grama Rajya - Draft Concept Paper and the framework to seek the views of the public on the Draft Concept Paper and the Framework in the website of the Prime Minister's office, in order to  seek the views of the public, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of rice to control the price hike and the shortage in the domestic market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approval was granted on 2016-12-25 to import rice through the private sector to maintain a buffer stock, with the objective of controlling the dearth of rice in the domestic market and increasing the prices of rice.  Accordingly on 2017-02-26, a total quantity of 113,000 MT was imported and the prices appear to have decreased slightly in the market. The proposal made by the Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to import 20,000 MT each month through the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment (CWE), as the stock available in the market as at present is insufficient and to import 100,000 MT as a buffer stock through Government to Government basis and to sell such rice through the CWE and the open market, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Instruments to be signed between Sri Lanka and Indonesia during the State Visit of the H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena to Indonesia on 8th of March 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body:
- His Excellency the President Maithripala Sirisena, is due to undertake a State Visit to Indonesia on 8th March 2017. As such, the proposal made by the Hon.(Dr.) Harsha de Silva, the Acting Minister of Foreign Affairs, to sign the bilateral instruments of the following, was approved by the Cabinet :- 

*	Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries of Indonesia. 

*	Memorandum of Understanding between the Marketing Services Agency for Small and Medium Enterprises and Cooperation (SMESCO) of Indonesia and the National Crafts Council of Sri Lanka in the field of Traditional Industrial Cooperation.

description: Signing of the Concord of the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) to be entered into at the Leaders' Summit
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - A Summit of the Leaders of the Member States is scheduled to be held in Jakarta, Indonesia on 7th March, 2017, concurrent to the commemoration of the 20th Anniversary of the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) which is implemented with the aim of sustainable and balanced development of the States around the Indian Maritime Zone. His Excellency the President Maithripala Sirisena, will represent Sri Lanka at this summit which takes place under the theme 'Strengthening Maritime Corporation for a Peaceful, Stable and Prosperous Indian Ocean'.  Accordingly, the proposal made by  Hon.(Dr.) Harsha de Silva, the Acting Minister of Foreign Affairs, to sign the Memorandum of Understanding to be entered into, anticipating the promotion of consultation and cooperation among the member states of this organization, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Amendment to the Office of Missing Persons (Establishment, Administration and Discharge of Functions) Act, No. 14 of 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - The Office of Missing Persons (Establishment, Administration and Discharge of Functions) Act, No. 14 of 2016 was passed by the Parliament on the 23rd of August 2016.  The Legal Draftsman drafted an amendment to section 11 of the Act by removing paragraph (a) of section 11 which empowered the office to enter into agreements as are necessary to carry out functions with a person or organization.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to publish the Amendment to the Office of Missing Persons (Establishment Administration and Discharge of Functions) Act, in the Government Gazette and present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling for Expressions of Intention and Project proposals in respect of the Heda Oya Reservoir Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - Under the proposed Heda Oya Reservoir Project, a reservoir with a capacity of 147 Million Cubic Metres across the Heda Oya and a diversion weir of 6.4 Km below the reservoir and a 16 Km long Right Bank Stream and a 13.5 Km long Left Bank Stream will be constructed.   According to the feasibility study conducted, this project is expected to supply irrigation water to 5,308 Ha of old and new lands to be cultivated in the lower valleys of Heda Oya, Vila Oya and Karanda Oya and to supply a 5 Million Cubic Metres of water facilities to meet the annual needs of water for drinking and domestic purposes of the people of Pothuwil, Lahugala and Panama areas. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to call for expressions of intention and project proposals with a view to identifying a suitable company which could implement this project utilizing foreign funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling for Expressions of Intention and Project proposals in respect of the Kumbukkan Oya Reservoir Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - Under the Kumbukkan Oya Reservoir Project, a reservoir with a capacity of 48 Million Cubic Meters will be constructed at the meeting point of the Buttala - Moneragala A4 Road and the Kumbukkan Oya. According to the feasibility study conducted, it has been confirmed that this project will supply water to 4,280 Ha. of new lands and 1,255 Ha. of existing lands and generate 16 Giga Watt hours of electricity annually and also provide water for drinking and industrial purposes. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to call for expressions of intention and project proposals with a view to identifying a suitable company which could implement this project utilizing foreign funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Yan Oya Left Bank Main Canal on Design and Built Basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body:
- The Yan Oya Development Project is one of the major water resources development projects implemented in Sri Lanka in the recent years. This project will result in bringing a number of economic benefits to the people of the Districts of Anuradhapura and Trincomalee. This project,  through the Left Bank Main Canal, will provide water to a cultivable area in extent of 4,190 Ha. coming under the Padaviya scheme and the Yan Oya Anicut scheme inclusive also of the lands which at present face a severe scarcity of water. The Left Bank Main Canal of 18Km in length will have to be designed to be concrete lined with a 05Km length Syphon section, according to the geophysical features of the terrain.   

	Although, it has been observed that it is necessary to get the assistance of contractors of renowned international level expertise in technology for the qualitative design and built construction of the Left Bank Main Canal, if the Open International Competitive Bidding Procedure is to be adopted the time consumed for such procedure will delay the supply of water to the people of the area by one year than the time anticipated. As such, obtaining the services of the China CAMC Engineering Institution, the main contractor of the Yan Oya Reservoir design and built construction is considered as technologically and economically more beneficial and feasible for the design and built construction of the Left Bank Main Canal.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to call for technological and financial proposals from the China CAMC Engineering Institution for the design and built construction of the Yan Oya Left Bank Main Canal within a period of 24 months, on a contract basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Rehabilitation/Improvement of the Road section from Rambewa to Medawachchiya on the Kandy - Jaffna (A9) Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka has received a loan of US$98 Million from the Asian Development Bank towards the cost of the Northern Connectivity Project (Additional Financing) for the rehabilitation of national highways and provincial roads and replacement of selected bridges on provincial roads in the Northern and North Central Provinces.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for the rehabilitation and improvement of the road section from Rambewa to Medawachchiya (140.76 km to 150.40 km) on the Kandy-Jaffna Road (A9), utilizing a part of this loan, to the RR Construction (Pvt) Ltd, the lowest substantially responsive bidder, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of the Stimulant Substances and the Methods prohibited to be used while engaged in Sports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to present in Parliament for approval, the Anti Doping (Prohibited List) Regulations No.02 of 2016, 'containing the prohibited substances and the methods while being engaged in sports in terms of the World Anti-Doping Code and the Regulations made by the Minister of Sports, under Section 34(1) of the Convention against Doping in Sport Act, No. 33 of 2013, published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.2006/15 of 14-02-2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Synthetic Running Track for the Bernard Aluwihare Stadium at Matale
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - The Bernard Aluwihare Stadium is presently, the largest Stadium in the Matale District, which is used for the Athletics who come from Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, Jaffna, Batticaloa, Trincomalee, Kandy, Badulla and Kurunegala Districts as well.  Last year, under the auspices of H.E. the President,  the modernization activities of this stadium as a sports complex commenced and it is observed that a synthetic running track for this stadium is a timely need.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to construct a 400 metre Synthetic Running Track newly, for the Matale District Bernard Aluwihare Stadium and to obtain the consultancy services from the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing of facilities for the transport of Aviation Fuel from Muthurajawela to the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - Since it has been assessed that, the need of aviation fuel will be increased in the future with the modernization activities carried out presently in the Bandaranaike International Airport and as such, the establishment of a pipe line exclusively for the transport of aviation fuel from Muthurajawela terminal to the BIA is necessary to enable the Lanka Petroleum Corporation to supply aviation fuel to meet the increasing demand.  Through a feasibility study made in this regard, it has been proposed to construct 04 steel tanks with a total operational capacity of 75,000 Cu.M. exclusively for aviation fuel and a pipe line of  23 Km in length and to carry out the development activities connected with it.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Chandima Weerakkody, the Minister of Petroleum Resources Development, to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and a Technical Evaluation Committee to call for bids following the open International Competitive Bidding Procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of Compensation for the deceased and injured persons in the conflict that occurred in the Welikada Prison on 09th November 2012
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - In the conflict that occurred in the Welikada Prison on 09th November 2012, 27 prisoners died and a Prison Officer along with 20 prisoners sustained injuries.  A 03 Member Committee was appointed to investigate into the incident and make recommendations and the Report of the Committee has now been submitted. According to the recommendations of the Committee, 16 deceased out of the 27 deceased have been recommended for payment of compensation and the Committee has recommended that payment of compensation is not needed for the remaining 11 deceased persons since they had died while attempting to escape from the prison and had also made recommendations for the payment of compensation for the Prison Officer and the 20 prisoners who had sustained injuries in the incident. Taking into consideration, the proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement and Hindu Religious Affairs, the Cabinet decided on the payment of compensation of Rs.2,000,000/- to the next-of-kin of each of the 16 deceased persons and Rs.500,000/- to each injured person in the conflict that occurred in the Welikada Prison on 09-11-2012.

description: Re-cultivation of the abandoned Paddy Lands in the Low Country Wet Zone for Food Security
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - When taken into consideration, the adverse effects on agriculture due to climatic changes that take place frequently in the present day, it has been felt that the focus on long term food security is an essential factor for the creation of a sustainable agro-economy.  In this respect, it is important to develop the abandoned paddy land and re-cultivate them. The Department of Agrarian Development has identified that	 there exist about an extent of 26,122 Ha. of abandoned paddy lands in the Districts of Colombo, Gampaha, Kalutara, Kegalle, Galle and Matara coming under the low country wet zone and as such, the Ministry of Agriculture, the Department of Agriculture, the Provincial Departments of Agriculture, the Department of Agrarian Development and the Department of Irrigation have proposed to implement a project jointly for cultivating paddy, vegetables and roots and tuber crops within the premisses of those institutions during this Yala Season.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to develop 17,000 Ha. of abandoned paddy lands constructing the streams bunds, putting the drainage systems in order etc. and to provide the farmers with financial provision, to induce them to develop the extent of 17,000 Ha. of uncultivated land, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing seed paddy for 2017 Yala Season and 2017/2018 Maha Season
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - Due to delay in the rains and the inadequate rainfall experienced during the Maha Season 2016/2017, the extent of cultivation has been reduced in almost all parts of  the Island.  Accordingly, the reduction in the expected yield and an unfavourable impact on seed production is anticipated.  It is apparent that a shortage of seed paddy may also be experienced during the coming Maha Season of 2017/2018. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to procure the required seed paddy for the 2017 Yala Season and the 2017/2018 Maha Season from the Department of Agriculture and the seed paddy cultivators and distribute same among the farmers at a concessionary rate to ensure the food security of the country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a New Vocational Training Centre at Pahala Yagoda in Gampaha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - The number of students who drop out from schools after G.C.E. (O/L) and G.C.E.(A/L) annually, in the Gampaha District is approximately 17,500 but the maximum number of students who could be accommodated in the Vocational Training Centres existing in the District is around 7,300.  Out of these it is only a number of around 960 students who could be admitted to the Training Centres of the Vocational Training Authority. Taking into consideration the demand for the skilled craftsmen in the labour market, the establishment of a new Vocational Training Centre in the Gampaha District is a felt need.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to establish a new Vocational Training Centre at Pahala Yagoda in Gampaha, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of the concept of Statements of Corporate Intent (SCI) for the strategically important State Owned Business Enterprises (SOBEs)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - The Statements of Corporate Intent (SCI) could be used to contribute positively to enable the State Owned Business Enterprises (SOBEs) towards achieving the economic goals of the country.  In achieving these objectives the strategy would be to encourage and facilitate these SOBEs to be self-sufficient without depending on the General Treasury through improved corporate practices, strong and prudent financial management, exposure to competitiveness and international best practices  and effective human resource management while enhancing public accountability,   Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, for the implementation of the SCI in respect of the strategically important Ceylon Electricity Board, Ceylon Petroleum Corporation, National Water Supply and Drainage Board, Sri Lanka Airport and Aviation Company, and Sri Lanka Ports Authority to be signed by the tri-party including the Secretary, Ministry of Finance, the Secretaries in-charge of the line Ministries of the institutions that come under them and the Chairpersons of the respective institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Training Programme for providing facilities for the Prototype manufacturing of Solar Panels
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - The Government policy is to get 20% of the entire electricity generation of the country out of non traditional renewable energy sources, by the year 2020.  Accordingly,  the Cabinet has granted approval on 06-04-2016 for the implementation of an educational training project on manufacturing Prototype Solar Panels, with a view to assisting in the industries pertaining to Solar Power which is past developing and its initial activities have already been commenced. Through this programme training of youth and the project and other relevant activities will be carried out by the direct intervention of 04 Professors of the 04 Universities of Kelaniya, Jaffna, Ruhuna and Peradeniya and another Professor from the National Institute of Fundamental Studies (NIFS). As such, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to get an additional allocation of Rs.80 Million for providing the necessary equipment, chemicals and consumables for the successful implementation of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Post Disaster Needs Assessment Report pertaining to the Floods and Landslides occurred in May 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - In the month of May 2016, Sri Lanka had the heaviest recorded rainfall in more than 18 years which caused severe floods in 24 Districts and also the gravest landslide ever recorded along with a number of other landslides. It was reported that floods and landslides affected around 493,319 persons, caused 93 deaths and injured 33 and found 117 persons missing. In the aftermath of the disaster, the Ministry of Disaster Management had conducted a Post-Disaster Needs Assessment with the collaboration of the International Stakeholders and the relevant Ministries, the United Nations Organization, the World Bank and the European Union. The assessment had proposed a long term plan to strengthen the pre-preparedness and to minimize the risks liable to be caused due to disasters and climatic conditions.  Accordingly, based on the Post Disaster Management Report, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, for the implementation of an extensive action programme for disaster management in Sri Lanka, within the 5 year period from 2018 to 2023, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a plot of land for the High Commission of Pakistan in Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to allocate a plot of land in extent of 1.5 Acres, located at Barnes Place, Colombo 07, to the High Commission of Pakistan earmarked as suitable to build its Chancery Building, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Leasing out the Railway reserves to State Institutions for public utility services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - Leasing out the lands of the Department of Railways which are not required immediately for the operation and development of the railway to a third party based on Government Valuation for a period not exceeding 05 years without any restrain to get them back when required, is carried out by the Railway Department.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to charge according to the valuation only one nominal value of 1% of the lease rent imposed and the relevant administrative expenses only when leasing out such lands to the State Institutions for public utility services like laying water pipes and activities involved in the electricity projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Enterprise Based Village Development Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - Although, the socio economic standard of the Northern and Eastern Provinces have risen considerably after the end of the conflict, these regions still lag behind other Provinces in important aspects like income equality and poverty.  As such, the Government has focussed its attention to extend the opportunities of the people of the Northern and Eastern Provinces to expand their economic participation, providing support for the upliftment of small entrepreneurs and thereby to raise their standards of living. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of National Integration and Reconciliation, for the implementation of the Enterprise Development Project under the Office for National Unity and Reconciliation (ONUR), with a view to providing a concessionary loan up to a maximum limit of Rs.250,000, for 1,785 small scale entrepreneurs selected representing all 08 Districts of the Northern and Eastern Provinces, with the financial support of the Regional Development Bank and the SANASA Federation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Floating Solar Power Energy Plants in the Mahaweli Reservoirs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval in principle for the establishment of Floating Solar Power Energy Plants in the Reservoirs of the Mahaweli Economic Zones, as a step towards focussing on renewable energy sources for the purpose of reducing thermal energy power generation.  Accordingly, the joint proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research and Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to call for international competitive bidding for the implementation of a Solar Power Energy Plant of 100MW,  covering less than even 4% of the entire surface area of the Maduru Oya Reservoir, which is about 500 Acres in extent, as the first step, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of National Biosafety Framework Project Conforming to the Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - The 'Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety' has been adopted by the global community with a view to minimizing and avoiding the risk that may be caused by the genetically modified plants and organisms on the environment and the human health, of which Sri Lanka is also a partner.  While minimizing the risk which may be caused through biodiversity technology to human health and environment and at the same time deriving maximum benefits out of it to Sri Lanka, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement a National Biosafety Framework Project within the period from 2017 to 2020, utilizing the financial grant of US$2.36 Million, agreed to be provided by the Global Environmental Facility (GEF), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 03 Vessels for the use of the Coast Guard Department of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body: - The Coast Guard Department of Sri Lanka is entrusted with the duty of patrolling in maritime waters covering approximately 517,000 sq.m of the sea area around Sri Lanka to conduct search and rescue operations and as well as to carry out observations necessary to enforce law and order in the coastal areas.  In order to carry out this activity successfully, it is essential for the Department to have the required marine platforms capable of operating in both coastal and high seas, where necessary.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to proceed with the activities related to the construction of 03 offshore observation vessels of 85m in length by the Colombo Dockyard PLC, for the Coast Guard Department of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expediting the Government Procurement Process
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-28
decision_details_body:
- H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, brought to the attention of the Cabinet, the following decisions arrived at the meeting held on 03-02-2017, with the participation of H.E. the President, the Hon. Prime Minister, the Hon. Minister of Finance, the relevant Public Officials, the Members of the Procurement Commission and the Procurement Appeals Board, in regard to expediting the Government Procurement Procedure. 

*	The National Procurement Commission, to take action to gazette the Government Procurement Guidelines adopted at present in compliance with the provisions of the Constitution and the other relevant instructions issued by the Ministry of Finance from time to time. 

*	Integrating the new time frames, to be adopted in the Government Procurement Procedure in the Procurement Guidelines for which the Cabinet has already granted approval.

*	Revision and updating of the present Public Procurement Guidelines suitably, focusing on the new procurement trends like the e-procurement which helps to expedite the process of the Government Procurement Procedure.    

*	Making use of type plans in common use in the public sector constructions with suitable modifications, wherever deemed necessary, with a view to minimizing the delay and the cost of designing. 

*	Provision of  technical skills to the public officers in regard to the Government Procurement Procedure.

description: Paying compensation to persons who died or sustained injuries due to capsizing of a boat close to Katukurunda area in Kalutara on 2017-02-19
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, to pay a compensation of Rs.100,000/- per deceased person and pay Rs.20,000/- for an injured person in the accident which occurred close to Katukurunda, Kalutara due to the capsizing of one of the boats transporting people from Beruwala to Kalutara on 2017-02-19 to participate in a religious activity, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of Moragoda Ela and Temple Bypass
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The International Development Association(IDA) provides a  credit facility of  US$ 147 million for the urban intervention of Galle and Kandy cities. It is intended that part of the proceeds of this credit be applied for the rehabilitation of Moragoda Ela and Temple Bypass in Galle district. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the relevant contract as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee(SCAPC)  to M/s Business Promoters and Partners Engineering (Pvt) Ltd. at the contract price of Rs. 844,907,205.00, excluding VAT, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improving the Infrastructure facilities of the Saraswathy Central College, Pussallawa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The Saraswathy Central College in Pussallawa, which has a strength of around 1,000 students is a Tamil School more than 100 years old situated in the Gampola Educational Zone in the Central Province. This is the Centre School among the school in the area with several feeder schools which could be improved with necessary facilities to provide qualitative education to the children of the Estate Sector.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, for the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of India to have a Memorandum of Understanding, to develop the infrastructure facilities of the school under the sponsorship of the Indian Government, as a special step taken in the direction of implementing the National Policy in providing equal educational opportunities for the children of the nation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Commission on Women
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body:
- The Sri Lanka Women's Bureau and the National Committee on Women although mandated to ensure the protection of the rights of women in Sri Lanka and empower them, these institutions do not possess the authority to engage actively to address incidences of violence and inquire into such incidences and initiate legal proceedings. 

	As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, in consideration of the Constitutional provisions and in terms of the convention, the responsibility vested with the Government in the elimination of all forms of violence against women and for the advancement of women, for the establishment of the National Commission on Women, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Houses for the Plantation Community - Request to increase the allocation per house from Rs.650,000.00 to Rs.1,000,000.00
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - As initiated by the Ministry of Hill country, New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development, new houses are being constructed for the plantation community by the Estate Workers Co-operative Societies through the Plantation Human Development trust on loan and grant basis. The estimate prepared is Rs.650,000/- in 2014,  for a house, consisting of two bed rooms, a dining room, verandah, kitchen and an attached toilet. It is observed that, this amount is inadequate in view of the current prices of building materiel. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Palani Dhigambaran, the Minister of Hill Country, New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development to increase the estimated cost of a house from Rs.650,000/- to Rs.1,000,000/- for a complete house and of which Rs.480,000/- to be given as a grant and Rs.520,000/- as a loan to be paid in a period of 15 years and the full amount to be provided as a grant to the families affected by landslide and who have been asked to vacate their houses, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Statement of Mutual Agreement between the Port of Colombo and the Port and Urban Projects Bureau of Kobe City Government of Japan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Ports Authority has received an invitation to participate in the "International Port Conference" to be held in Kobe, Japan.  This will provide a significant opportunity for Sri Lanka to share information on maritime affairs in the Asian Regions. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to sign a Statement of Mmutual Agreement between the Sri Lanka Ports Authority and the Port and Urban Projects Bureau of Kobe City Government of Japan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of infrastructure of the Construction Equipment Operator Training Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - It is essential for skilled machine operators to operate the construction equipment productively, in order to obtain the maximum productivity in the construction projects. The Construction Equipment Operator Training Centre implemented under the Construction Industry Development Authority established at Galkulama in Anuradhapura, in the year 1982 is one of the prominent institutions which supply the necessary manpower.  The proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to identify the infrastructure facilities necessary for the development of this Construction Equipment Operator Training Centre, on a comprehensive plan, for the sustainable development of the local construction industry and to fulfil the growing need of manpower in the local and foreign construction industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No. 2 of 2013 - (Rights of Detainees - Access to Legal Counsel)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet at its meeting held on 2017- 01-10 has granted approval, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amendments to the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No. 2 of 2013, to enhance further the rights of a suspect in police custody. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to publish the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman and given clearance by the Attorney General, in the Government Gazette and present same in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Programmes for the livelihood development and poverty alleviation of the fisher community
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - A sum of Rs.1,200 Million, has been allocated to the Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, for the year 2017, for the implementation of programmes pertaining to the enhancement of life standards and livelihood development of fisher community living in the hinterland and coastal areas and the construction of houses. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to implement 30 projects identified by the Ministry as a high priority requirement, utilizing this allocation, with the participation of the private sector as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of allotments from the land at Mahenawatta, Pitipana, Homagama to the Ministry of Science, Technology & Research, the University of Sri Jayawardenapura and the University of Moratuwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The Urban Development Authority has taken action to acquire about 34 Hectares of land form Mahenawatta situated at Pitipana in Hamagama for the development of Science and Technology and related activities and the establishment of related institutions. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest approximately 46 Acre of land out of the said land to the Ministry of Science, Technology and Research, the University of Sri Jayawardenapura and the University of Moratuwa, subject to the payment of the value assessed by the Chief Valuer of the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Land at New Town, Ratnapura for the construction of the District Office of the Department of National Community Water Supply
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest a portion of land 01 Rood 29 perches in extent from the Farm Garden Estate at the New Town in Ratnapura, owned by the Urban Development Authority with the the Department of National Community Water Supply for construction of the District Office of the Department, through the Divisional Secretary of Ratnapura, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Land at New Town, Ratnapura for the construction of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial office of the Department of Community Based Corrections
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest a portion of land of 20 perches in extent from the Farm Garden Estate at the New Town in Ratnapura, owned by the Urban Development Authority with the the Department of Community Based Corrections for construction of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial office of the Department, through the Divisional Secretary of Ratnapura, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Land at New Town, Ratnapura for the construction of  the District Cultural Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest a portion of land 1 Acre  in extent from the Farm Garden Estate at the New Town in Ratnapura, owned by the Urban Development Authority with the District Secretary of Ratnapura, for the establishment of the Ratnapura District Cultural Centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a Feed-in Tariff System for purchasing electricity generated by Municipal Solid Waste Processing
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement the Feed-in Tariff System prescribed by the Sri Lanka Public Utility Commission to purchase the electricity generated in the Urban Solid Waste Dumping Yards to be established at Karadiyana and Muthurajawela and such Solid Waste Dumping Yards to be established in future for which the Cabinet approval has already been granted, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulations made under the Companies Act, No. 07 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to present the Regulations made by him pertaining to the "Company Secretaries" under section 527 of the Companies Act, No.07 of 2007, granting permission for the members of the Institute of Certified Management Accountants of Sri Lanka also to be registered as Company Secretaries and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.1998/11 of 2016-12-20,  in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Euro-clearing system of Securities issued by the Government of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - It is essential to increase Treasury Bond Market facilities if more foreign investors are to be attracted. The Euro clearing system is helpful to popularize the Securities issued by the Government among the foreign investors as an open and flexible facility to reduce the complexity of transactions and to minimize the cost.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to establish a legal and regulatory framework to get the facility of Euro clearing system for the Securities of the Government of Sri Lanka, with a view to providing the foreign investors with direct and uninterrupted access to the Government Securities Market, creating a diversified base, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Funding Major Infrastructure Projects through a Government Owned Special Infrastructure Company (SIFCO)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The policy of the Government is to give priority in investing in major infrastructure projects which would accelerate the development of the country by adopting efficient and cost effective mechanisms, to manage the funding in an accountable manner.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to establish the "Special Infrastructure Company (SIFCO)" as a limited liability company owned by the Government of Sri Lanka and the Road Development Authority making way for investment in an optimum efficient manner, in the identified Expressway Projects, to vest the asset base of the Expressway Projects being constructed in the Southern, Outer Circular Road and Colombo - Katunayake Expressways and the future Expressway Projects undertaken in future with the SIFCO to generate the Capital from the investors using the asset base or to construct a new Expressways using such assets as a surety to obtain loans to construct new Expressways, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Draft Bill on Credit Information Service Providers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body:
- The quality of the Credit Portfolio could be improved with the ability to take better decisions based on the judgement of the credit profile of the applicants. In the same manner, it could minimize the likelihood of default as well, thereby reducing the cost of credit the benefit of which can be passed on to the prospective borrowers.     

	Presently, the only authority empowered to access and provide credit information is the Sri Lanka Credit Information Bureau and the Government has identified the  positive contribution the Private Credit Information Providers  could make to a market economy.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to publish the Draft Bill on Credit Information Services which makes provision for the licensing of the Credit Information Service Providers and for regulating and supervising them over collecting and disseminating of  the accurate credit information, in the Gazette and submit it to Parliament, subsequently, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Modern Neonatal Centre at the De Soysa Maternity Hospital in Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body:
- The De Soysa Maternity Hospital situated in the heart of the Colombo City adjoining the Medical Faculty of the University of Colombo, provides medical services including Maternity, Obstetrics and Gynecology, Sub-fertility, Baby Care and Family Planning and Medical Care.  At the same time, it contributes to training medical undergraduates and postgraduates also of the University of Colombo.  Along with the deliveries at the De Soysa Maternity Hospital and the complicated number of transfers of mothers and babies from peripheral hospitals reach a high number, the improvement and expansion of the Premature Baby Unit (PBU) and the Special Care Baby Unit (SCBU) of the hospital is a high priority requirement and the Cabinet has already granted its approval to raise funds for the purpose.   

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to construct a SCBU within the hospital with the funds provided by the Government of France, with a view to improving the qualitative services of the Neonatal and Specialist Baby Care Services of the De Soysa Maternity Hospital, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the National Hospital of Sri Lanka into a State-of- the-Art Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body:
- The development of the National Hospital of Sri Lanka with a bed strength of 3,382 which can be regarded as the centre of excellence in the Sri Lankan Healthcare System, into a State-of-the-Art hospital following a long term development plan, is a timely need.  The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to fulfil the following needs identified to be given priority as a part of the development process, was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	Modernization of the old Victoria Building and the Bandaranaike Building with extensive facilities for the patients as well as the staff.

*	Modernization of the Doctors' Quarters at Barnes Place and the Nurses' Quarters at No.93.

description: Amendment to the Industrial Disputes Act for extending the Right of Representation and Appearance on behalf of parties before the Labour Tribunals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The responsibility of the Labour Tribunals established under the provisions of the Industrial Disputes Act is to settle industrial disputes on a speedy and inexpensive machinery according to the accepted   principles of justice and equity.  Although, the task expected of these were to function as Tribunals accessible to the ordinary worker communities for them to have services with ease, it has now been found that an injustice have been caused to the ordinary workers as a result of some Labour Tribunal Presidents denying non lawyer representatives to appear before them on behalf of the parties, giving a strained interpretation to the law that persons who are non lawyers are disallowed to represent the parties before the Labour Tribunals.  As such, the joint proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, the Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations and Hon.(Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to delete the provisions found in the Act preventing a lawyer to appear during an inquiry conducted before the Commissioner of Labour or an authorized officer and to instruct the Legal Draftsman, to draft amendments vesting of the authority now given to the Commissioner of Labour to the Presidents of Labour Tribunals as well, to take steps to enforce their orders against the employers when they do not carry out an order made by a Labour Tribunal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining the assistance of the Sri Lanka Scouts Movement for the conservation of natural resources and building of human-wildlife co-existence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The joint proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife and Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to conduct a training programme to obtain the assistance of the Sri Lanka Scouts Movement and the Girl Guides, for a 03 year period, at the Randenigala Trainig Centre of the Sri Lanka Wildlife Trust, with the collaboration of the Department of Education, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing of the compensation paid for deaths under the compensation scheme on wild elephant damages
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - As a result of a death of a person, due to a wild elephant attack the dependants of the person finds themselves in a helpless situation. In such a calamity, payment of a justifiable compensation to the dependants of the deceased would provide relief at least to a certain extent. Recently, the Cabinet has granted approval to increase the limits of the compensation paid to persons who die of such incidents and the damages caused to house and property.  Amending the methodology for payment of compensation further, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to increase the compensation paid in the case of a death of a person or permanent disability due to wild elephant attack from Rs.200,000/- to Rs.500,000/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka's Financial Sector development through Financial Sector Project Modernization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body:
- The priority reforms in the financial sector of Sri Lanka has been identified and the Government of Sri Lanka has planned to implement several reforms targeting the financial sector development during the period from 2017 to 2022 through the "Financial Sector Modernization Project". This project will be implemented under the three (03) components by providing financial support for the middle level renovation, strengthening of regulators' institutional capacity and the implementation of the project for modernization of infrastructure facilities in that field and monitoring.    

	Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, for the Ministry of Finance, Central Bank of Sri Lanka, Securities and Exchange Commission and Insurance Board of Sri Lanka  to implement the "Financial Sector Modernization Project", within  the period of 2017 - 2022 and to obtain a loan from the International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank under the Special Drawing Rights (SDR) being the equivalent of United States Dollars 75 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Grant Aid from Japan for Strengthening of Public Security and Counter-terrorism Activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - In order to strengthen the bi-lateral relationship between Japan and Sri Lanka, the Government of Japan provides grant assistance to Sri Lanka annually, under various grant aid schemes.  As such, the Government of Japan has agreed to provide grant assistance under non-project grant aid amounting to Japanese Yen 250 Million (Approximately Rs.327 Million) in the Fiscal Year 2016/2017 for the provision of Japanese products to improve the public security and to strengthen the counter terrorism activities in Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to sign the Exchange of Notes with the Government of Japan to obtain the above grant of Japanese Yen 250 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expediting the additional compensation to be paid to the land owners affected by the Moragahakanda - Kaluganga Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-21
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval to make a 50% of  compensation for the families affected by the Moragahakanda - Kaluganga Development Project, in addition to the assessed value of the lands acquired from them in instalments within a period of 04 years from 2016 to 2019. Having taken into consideration, the submissions made in regard to the difficulties encountered by the land owners whose lands get submerged in the reservoir, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to settle the compensation completely within the two years from 2017 to 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commencing a project for producing Organic Fertilizer, establishment of cold storage facilities and power generation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - A German Company has come forward to implement an integrated project with the collaboration of several companies of Sri Lanka, which would provide solutions to address the high priority challenges, with regard to encouraging the use of organic fertilizer in place of chemical fertilizer in food production, preservation of fruits, waste management and renewable power generation, as a whole. Under this investment programme, it is expected to establish a Unit for the production of organic fertilizer associated with the solid waste management Yard of the Kandy Municipal Council.  The organic fertilizer produced in the first year is intended to be provided free of charge to the Lanka Fertilizer Company Ltd. It is anticipated to add about 6-10 MWs of renewable power to the National Grid and to minimize the quantity of vegetables and fruits getting wasted with the construction of several stores.  The proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to implement this project in accordance with the recommendations made by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procuring 1000 new passenger buses for the Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - In view of the public transport system prevailing at present, is not efficient and dependable, most of the public is more inclined to use private modes of transport instead of the public transport services. This situation has caused in the increase of heavy traffic congestion, accidents and air pollution and high fuel import expenditure. With the creation of an efficient, dependable and a comfortable public transport service, a majority of those who make use of their private mode of transport would be attracted to use the public transport service to come to the city. The public transport service network is also required to be improved as a whole with fixed schedules for integrated train and bus travel services.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to modernize the fleet of buses of the Transport Board and to procure 900, 40-46 high back seater (2x2) new buses and 100 new low floor AC buses for the Sri Lanka Transport Board through the Indian Line of Credit, to maintain an adequate fleet strength to meet the operational needs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procuring specially trained dogs to be deployed at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - The adoption of security measures, to ensure the safety of the air passengers, the staff, the operational staff, the general public including the Civil Aviation industry is a mandate by every State.  The use of trained dogs and the deployment of their handlers as a security measure is very important to detect explosives, weapons, narcotics, money, and potential harmful substances.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to purchase 20 sniffer puppies, train and deploy them at the BIA with a view to enhancing its security measures pertaining to operational activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of IT Infrastructure facilities for the Government Securities Market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval for the procurement of a state-of-the-art electronic trading platform with information technology infrastructure facilities with the objective of expanding of the Government Securities Market, enhancement of the transparency of its activities and to have the benefit of price discovery. Taking into consideration, the complex nature of the procurement, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to call for quotations under the Two Stage Bidding Procedure, in accordance with the Government Procurement Guidelines, as recommended by the  Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Food Items (raw, dry rations and various other items) required for the Three Armed Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to award the contracts for the procurement of food items (raw, dry rations and various other items) required for the Three Armed Services for the year 2017, to 28 suppliers for a total sum of Rs.17,555 Million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC),was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Police Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Police Hospital established in the year 1911 needs to be improved in a manner suited to provide adequate health facilities for the officers of the Sri Lanka Police, the members of their families and as well as the retired Police officers.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayaka, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to vest the land in extent of 02 Roods 23.5 Perches owned by the Urban Development Authority situated opposite to the Police Hospital, with the Sri Lanka Police, for the renovation of the Police Hospital situated at Narahenpita, as a state-of-the-art Hospital, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to Sugathadasa National Sports Complex Authority Act, No. 17 of 1999
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - The Sugathadasa National Sports Complex Authority, provides Sports facilities at the most concessionary rates in all Sports Complexes administered by the Authority.  Although, the revenue derived so, is used for the proper maintenance of the Sports Complexes, the revenue generated from them as at present, is not adequate for the purpose.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to present the draft Bill, prepared to amend the Sugathadasa National Sports Complex Authority Act, No.17 of 1999, incorporating  amendments made to suite the present trends, with a view to using the Sports Complexes for cultural activities, conferences, examinations and activities of similar nature, enabling to earn an income adequate for the maintenance of the Sport Complexes,  when they are not in use for sports functions,  in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Selling of Sri Lanka stamps and the associated items for foreign stamp collectors
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - The Philatelic Bureau of the Department of Posts established in the year 1967, produce and sell the stamps and the associated items for the local and foreign stamp collectors.  Foreign exchange could be earned from selling stamps  specially to the foreign stamp collectors and there is also a tendency for the foreign stamp collectors to visit the country as tourists due to the attraction for the environment of the country, the natural beauty, the archaeological sites, wild animals and the sceneries of birds displayed on the stamps. As such, it is essential to have the agents who introduce the stamps of Sri Lanka to foreigners and therefore, the proposal made by Hon. M.H.A. Haleem, the Minister of Posts, Postal Services and Muslim Religious Affairs, for the appointment of foreign agents and also to enter into Agreements with them, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief for those who have faced various problems due to political reasons
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Public Administration and Management has received 31,666 appeals in terms of the Public Administration Circular No.09/2015 of 17-04-2015 issued with a view to providing relief for the officers of the public sector who were subject to political victimization.  Out of these, the recommendations in respect of 23,093 appeals have already been submitted to the Cabinet under 03 Phases and the Cabinet has granted approval for the implementation of those recommendations.     The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration and Management, to get the recommendations pertaining to 3,440 appeals relevant to six (06) Ministries of the balance of 8,573 appeals submitted as the 04th Phase, implemented by the relevant administrative authorities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Identification of Judicial and Legal Causes for minimizing the overcrowding in Prisons and Prison Reform
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body:
- The first Report of the Inter Institutional Task Force appointed to make proposals for the identification of the Judicial and Legal Causes for minimizing the overcrowding in Prisons and Prison Reform, has submitted the following recommendations:-  

*	The effective use of the Community Based Correction orders as an alternation of imprisonment. 


*	Implementation of the provisions of the Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Act, No.4 of 1995 to it's full potential, which provides an opportunity for payment of the relevant fine in instalments as an alternative to imprisonment when in default of a fine. 

*	Implementation of a Management Information System to prevent the misplacement of case files pertaining to cases where the Magistrate has no jurisdiction but continue to call them until such time that the case is referred to the Attorney General for indictment in the High Court.       

*	Action to be taken to release persons imprisoned without an indictment on a bond and the supervision of the prison through the visits by the Magistrates, once a month, in accordance with the provisions of the Act.   

*	Adoption of the police bail system in the case of bailable offences, in accordance with the provisions of the Bail Act, No.30 of 1997. 

*	Consideration of the possibility of commuting the death sentence into a life sentence. 

*	Construction of new prison buildings and relocation. 

*	Creation of a safe and secure environment for the inmates and the Prison staff. 

	The joint proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice; and Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement and Hindu Religious Affairs, to present the above Report to the Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the Enhancement of Efficiency and Productivity of the Irrigation System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - Increasing the irrigation schemes of the country is an essential factor in the achievement of the country's food security, the upliftment of the rural economy and secure the livelihood of the rural community. As such, under the proposed 'Productivity Enhancement and Irrigation System Efficiency Improvement Project' it is contemplated to renovate 80 major and medium scale irrigation schemes completely, which have not been subject to renovation for the period within the last 25 to 35 years.  With the expansion of the land and improvement of the water consumption efficiency and strengthening of the farmer community, the productivity of the farming lands will be enhanced resulting in the improvement of income of around 98,000 farmer families. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to implement the project at a cost of Rs.18,500 Million within the period of 2017 - 2021, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Controlling of Coconut price fluctuation in the local market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body:
- The Coconut Research Institute has forecasted that there may be a 13.9% drop in the yield during the period from January to August 2017 as against the year 2016 and as a result, it is observed that a further increase in the price of coconuts would occur. As such, short term strategies should be implemented in order to maintain the local coconut price at an optimum level to be favourable for both the coconut growers as well as the coconut based product manufacturers by way of reducing the demand for coconuts available for the local coconut oil production.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to revise the special commodity levy of coconut oil, as given below, to enable the import of only 40,000 MT of crude oil requirement for 04 months, was approved by the Cabinet. 


*	Reducing of the special commodity levy of coconut oil from Rs.150/- to Rs.130/- per kilogram. 

*	Reducing of the special commodity levy of crude palm oil/coconut oil from Rs.130/- to Rs.110/- per kilogram. 

*	Reducing of the special commodity levy of palm kernel and purified palm oil from Rs.150/- to Rs.130/- per kilogram.

description: Increase of financial assistance provided to the elderly and the sick artistes by the Department of Cultural Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval to increase the annual assistance of Rs.5,000/- up to Rs.10,000/- provided under the aid scheme implemented by the Department of Cultural Affairs, presently, with a view to providing relief to the elderly and the sick artists with a low income, who have done a yeoman service dedicating their lives to the field of Arts.  Accordingly,   the methodology presented by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs, for the selection of artists with low income for awarding the financial assistance,  was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Cadre Review of Public Institutions - 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - At present, although the public sector has been widened with the public employee ratio being increased to 1 public servant per every 15 citizens, there is a discontentment about the public service delivery among the people despite the allocations set apart annually, as a result of the slow progress achieved in the expected goals.  There is also a dearth of public servants employed specially in the fields of education and health in the rural and remote areas while the public servants employed in the Government Institutions in the urban and the suburban areas exceed even the approved cadre at institutional level.  Also the number of the staff at the Primary Level is higher in number compared to the number of Senior and the Tertiary Staff. Accordingly, the information submitted by Hon. Ravi Karunanayke, the Minister of Finance, to the effect that a review is undertaken by the Ministry of Finance in collaboration with the Ministry of Public Administration and Management, the National Salaries and Cadre Commission and the Finance Commission, pertaining to the cadre requirements of the public sector and as well as the Provincial Councils and that the cadre requirements of the above institutions will be determined based on the information gathered through the Department of Management Services Circular No.1/2017 of 2017‑01‑11 issued giving instructions on conducting a cadre review, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting a New Bill for the National Lotteries Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - The National Lotteries Board has been established in accordance with the provisions of the Finance Act, No.11 of 1963.  As of now,  the National Lotteries Board conducts 09 passive lotteries and 02 instant lotteries and the turnover recorded from the lotteries for the year 2015 is Rs.7.5 Billion. The Committee on Public Enterprises (COPE) has pointed out the necessity of amending the Act to rectify the shortcomings identified, to suite the present trends and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayke, the Minister of Finance, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Bill for the Lotteries Board including the proposed changes having taken into consideration, the present trends prevailing in the market, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of International Sovereign Bonds by the Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the Appropriation Act for the year 2017, the balance outstanding during the financial year 2017 of the maximum borrowings of the Government stands at Rs.1,579.11 Billion.  It has been estimated that the sum necessary for the settlement of loan instalments and interest payments within the year 2017, amounts to Rs.1,480 Billion.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayke, the Minister of Finance, for the issuance of International Sovereign Bonds within the total debit limit of the Appropriate Act for the year 2017, with a view to raising funds up to US$1,500, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National Air Transport Facilitation Programme and a National Air Transport Facilitation Committee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - 452 Standards and Recommended Practices have been laid down in the International Civil Aviation Convention for adoption to provide provision in the International Airports for the facilitation of the operation of aircraft and the prevention of delays when implementing the laws relating to immigration, quarantine, customs and clearance between the Contracting States and Sri Lanka as a member of the International Civil Aviation Convention is bound to follow the said standards and the recommended practices and to implement them in the country's civil aviation activities.    As such, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to appoint a National Air Transport Facilitating Committee (NATFC) Headed by the Secretary to the Ministry of Transport and Civil Aviation, with the participation of other relevant Heads of Ministries and Institutions and to vest the responsibility of  preparing and implementing a National Air Transport Facilitation Programme (NATFP) with the said committee for maintaining the set standards and the recommended practices in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the grace period given for the Registration of Motor Cycles  illegally imported to Sri Lanka and circulating in the Market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - Approval was granted by the Cabinet to register up to 2017‑01‑31, the motor cycles up to 450cc Engine capacity, that have been illegally imported to the country, subject to charging a surcharge based on the Cubic capacity of such motor cycles, without paying the taxes due to the Government.  During this period 1558 motor cycles have been registered after paying the surcharge and a further number of 2500 motor cycles  have been submitted to be directed for supervision. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to extend the grace period given for the registration of motor cycles from 2017‑01‑31 to 2017‑03‑31 by a further 02 months to  enable the proper completion of the matters pertaining to registration of these motor cycles, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: "Swashakthi" National Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - A Programme known as the "Swashakthi" National Programme will be implemented by the Ministry of National Policies and Economic Affairs in collaboration with the Central Bank of Sri Lanka towards the creation of One million job opportunities.
