The purpose of this programme is to provide credit facilities through the Rural Development Banks and the Commercial Banks for the promotion of creating 25,000 new enterprises with the objective of generating employment in the field of Small and Medium Scale Entrepreneurs. In the process of granting financial facilities subject to a maximum of Rs.250,000/-, having considered the efficacy of the business plans, it is proposed to grant a loan of Rs.200,000/- along with a financial grant of Rs.50,000/- for the new entrepreneurs. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to implement this Loan/Grant Scheme through the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Bibile Sugar Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-14
decision_details_body: - The implementation of a Sugar Development Project has been proposed with a view to enhancing the living standards of the people living in the  Rambakan Oya Special Economic Zone of the Sri Lanka Mahaweli Authority by providing them with cultivable lands to enable them to derive a better income. According to this Project Proposal which is a Public Private Partnership venture with a total foreign investment of US$152.25, it has been planned to produce 80,000 MT of sugar annually and generate around 1,000 direct and 75,000 indirect employment opportunities.  Similarly, the production of by products like animal feed and organic fertilizer and the commencement of a sub-project producing about 20 MWs of power has been planned. The proposal which has been submitted for the implementation of this project inclusive of the Divisional Secretary's Divisions of Bibile and Medagama, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Australia for the upliftment in the field of Sports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Australia, in respect of cooperation in the field of sports, with a view to strengthening the cooperation between the two countries in the fields of sports identified where the two countries have excelled, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Teacher Advisors' Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The post of Teacher Advisor has been effective in the school system of the country since the year 1962 and they perform an admirable service to ensure the qualitative aspect of the school education.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to establish a new service called the 'Sri Lanka Teacher Advisors' Service', with a view to formally harnessing the services of the Teacher Advisors and to take action to absorb the Teachers presently serving as Teacher Advisors into the new service, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of the Special Allowance paid for the Principals of Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The Principals of schools play an important role in the educational management of Sri Lanka and for that matter, the success of any school depends on the efficient and the formal management style adopted by the Principal.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasa, the Minister of Education, having taken into consideration the complex and the responsible nature of functions performed by the Principals in 10,162 National and Provincial Schools scattered all over the Island, to enhance the Special Allowance now being paid to the Principals, with a view to encouraging them, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Warehouse Complex at Medirigiriya in the Polonnaruwa District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval  to construct 03 Warehouse Complexes in the Districts of Kilinochchi, Ratnapura and Polonnaruwa, to provide high quality storage facilities to farmers, to store their agricultural produce during the period of a surplus harvest with the objective of avoiding the reduction in market prices due to a glut situation which tends to prevail in the market in such a situation.  The construction activities of the 02 Warehouse Complexes at Kilinochchi and Ratnapura have already commenced.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, for awarding the contract of the proposed Warehouse Complex of around 28,500 sq.ft, to be constructed at Medirigiriya in the Polonnaruwa District and the other infrastructure facilities, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Waiving off of Special Commodity Levy on Rice
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to present the Gazette Extraordinary No.2003/43 of 2017-01-27 issued under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No.48 of 2017, to reduce the Special Commodity Levy of Rs.15/- Kg on rice imposed so far up to Rs.5/- effective from 2017-01-28, in Parliament for approval, with a view to controlling the price hike in rice in the market and ensuring an adequate supply of rice to the local market, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Framework Agreement on the Tax and Customs Regime Applicable by the Partner Country to Projects Funded by the General Budget of the European Union
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The European Union (EU) has so far extended over US$220 Million worth of grants to the Government of Sri Lanka and in addition, a large amount of grants as humanitarian assistance.  The EU has agreed to provide Euro210 Million (approximately Rs.34 billion) for the period of 2014 to 2020 and of the amount, Euro72 Million has already been set apart for 03 projects.  According to the EU Guidelines its grants cannot be utilized to pay customs duties, taxes and other fiscal levies imposed by the recipient Government.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into a Framework Agreement with the EU on the Tax and Customs Regime applicable to Sri Lanka for the projects funded by the General Budget to the EU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Disaster Recovery Solution (DRS) for Data Centre at the Ceylon Petroleum Storage Terminals Ltd. (CPSTL)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Chandima Weerakkody,  the Minister of Petroleum Resources Development, to award the contract for the implementation of Disaster Recovery Solution (DRS), in order to ensure the implementation of the Data Centre at the Ceylon Petroleum Storage Terminals Ltd. which provides the necessary infrastructure facilities for the storage and distribution of Petroleum without any interruption, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Industrial and Techno Development Super Zone at Raigama, Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval for the Establishment of an Industrial and Techno Development Super Zone at Raigama, in the Kalutara District. With the objective of commencing this project expeditiously, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to award the contract for the development of the infrastructure facilities of the super zone to the Central Engineering Services Company (Pvt) Ltd.(CECL), owned by the Government, deviating from the normal procurement procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Drugs needed to treat Cancers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne,  the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the tender for the procurement of 3,750 vials of Bevacizumab Injection 100mg / 4ml Vial administered for the treatment of certain types of cancer, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Deferasirox Tablets needed for the Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne,  the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the tender for the purchase of 1,250,000, 400 mg Deferasirox Tablets, used for the treatment of iron overload caused by blood transfusions, as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Jaffna - Killinochchi Water Supply and Sanitation Project - Revision of the cost of the Consultancy Contract
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The Jaffna - Killinochchi Water Supply and Sanitation Project commenced in the year 2011, with the funds provided by the Asian Development Bank to achieve the objective of assisting the resettlement in the Northern Province and improving the living standards of the people in the Jaffna Peninsula, provides safe drinking water to around 300,000 people living in those districts.  Considering the variation of the contractual cost beyond the control of the contractor of the project,  the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem,  the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to revise the contractual cost, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of Contract for the Consultancy Services of the Port Access Elevated Highway Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella,  the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for the supply of consultancy services for the Port Access Elevated Highway Project, implemented with the funds provided by the Asian Development Bank, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Phase II of the Bandaranaike International Airport Development Project and construction of the ‘Remote Apron and Taxiways’
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) has handled 9.5 Million air passengers in the year 2016, and as per the passenger forecast, it is anticipated that it will have to handle around 14.5 Million air passengers by the year 2020. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for construction of the ‘Remote Apron and Taxiways’ with a view to increasing the BIA accommodation capacity to 15 Million air passengers per year and developing the infrastructure facilities of the Airport implemented under the Bandaranaike International Airport Development Project (BIADP) - Phase II with the loan grant provided by the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Consultancy Services for the Rehabilitation of the Railway line from Maho to Omanthai
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva,  the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for procurement of consultancy services of the project for the rehabilitation of railway line from Maho to Omanthai, to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Holding of the 08th Meeting of SAARC Law & Order Ministers and the meeting of Secretaries and SAARC Immigration Authorities in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake,  the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to hold and host the 08th Meeting of SAARC Law & Order Ministers preceded by the meeting of the Secretaries to the Ministries of Law & Order and the next meeting of SAARC Immigration Authorities in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet as a matter of policy.

description: Administration of Temporary Shelters Provide Protection to Women Victims of Violence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka is committed to providing legal assistance and counselling and other services to women who face various types of violence and seek relief/protection from such violence and in addition, for conducting relief centres/temporary shelters. Although, the Government has constructed temporary protection shelters for women in need, in Jaffna, Batticaloa, Mullativu and Ratnapura Districts the administrative activities of such shelters have not yet been commenced due to the dearth of resource personnel.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, to maintain the temporary shelters established in Jaffna, Batticaloa, Mullativu and Ratnapura Districts in collaboration with the Non-governmental Organizations which have the experience in such activities and to provide Government sponsorship for the temporary women protection shelters established in Colombo and Matara Districts and administered by a Non-governmental Organization, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Galle Port Yacht Marina Development of Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga,  the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to introduce a suitable developer/investor willing to carry out the development and operation of the Galle Port Yacht Marina and to call for proposals following the 'Swiss Challenge' procedures to operate the related business, in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Economic Management Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Training of Construction Machinery Mechanics
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The assistance of trained construction machinery mechanics armed with knowledge and skill are essential to repair and maintain the construction machinery used to meet the growing needs of the large scale construction projects day by day. There is a high demand for such machinery mechanics in the local as well as foreign job markets and as such the   implementation of a programme of proper standard to train them has become an urgent need. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to conduct a full time 03 year training Course at NVQ 4 Level at the Construction Equipment Training Centre (CETRAC) functioning under the Ministry of Housing and Construction for the training of Construction Machinery Mechanics, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the People’s Bank Act, No. 29 of 1961
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim,  the Minister of Public Enterprise Development, to instruct the Legal Draftsman, to amend  Section 12, 20, 21 and 43 of the People’s Bank Act, No. 29 of 1961, for the inclusion of provision to further strengthen the financial ability and the effectiveness of the operations of the People's Bank, to enable it to  increase its authorized share capital and issue debentures without a Government guarantee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mahaweli Left Bank Lower Basin Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa,  the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, for the implementation of the Mahaweli Left Bank Lower Basin Development Project at an estimated cost of Rs.6,250 Million, with the objective of providing irrigated water during both Yala and Maha seasons for 4,000 acres of land  so as to include Kinniya and Kanthale Divisional Secretary's Divisions in the Trincomalee District and the Medirigiriya Divisional Secretary's Division in the Polonnaruwa District, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of the portion of land at Wedamulla, Kelaniya area where a 'Dasasil Matha Aramaya' is being conducted over to the same Aramaya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - A plot of land belonging to the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation had been given over to the Sudharma Dasasil Aramaya and the adjoining land where a Bo-sapling is planted is also being used by the Aramaya.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, transfer the land of 7.56 Perches in extent to the Sudharma Dasasil Aramaya, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a pilot project in Sri Lanka for washing Hospital Laundry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - In providing a quality healthcare service, a special consideration should be made with regard to the sanitation of the patients.  In this process, it is compulsory to categorize the clothes used of patients, bedsheets, the clothes of patients undergoing surgery and the clothes used by the staff of  the operation theatres, sterilize and to wash and dry them in the proper manner as stipulated.  At present, washing of the hospital laundry is very often carried out by private parties and it has been observed that the activity is not conducted in a satisfactory level. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne,  the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to implement a project for the construction and maintenance of a Washing Plant for the hospital laundry in the hospitals situated within the Western Province, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accelerating the Higher Education Expansion and Development (AHEAD) Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lankan higher education sector has to be developed to address the economy based modern and global knowledge to meet the international standards. When minimizing the under employment prevalent in the graduates, priority has to be accorded to enhance the quality of the educational programmes and to enhance the employability skills of the students to improve the teaching and teaching methods and evaluation methods. The attention has also to be focused on the administration of the higher education field and the governance and management, investment and financing and also the non-governmental higher educational sector.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, for the implementation of an expeditious project for the development of the expansion of the higher educational sector under the World Bank assistance project, for a period of 6 years, with a view to solving the problems existing in these fields, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Empowering the growers to have an enhanced living standard through Floriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The field of Floriculture provides an immense contribution towards the enhancement of the living standards of the rural folk by creating self employment among women and youth.  Sri Lanka has earned an export income of more than US$18 Million in the year 2015 through floriculture and there is a possibility of increasing it further.  The Department of National Botanical Gardens has been engaged for a length of time, in the activities of the floriculture development at district level and it has by now established 173 'Suvahas Mal Societies' in 17 Districts.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera,  the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to empower small and medium scale flower growers targeting specially the women engaged in flower growing with assistance provided to have the infrastructure facilities needed for the floriculture field, technical information, high yielding planting material, cultivation training and marketing, aimed at the implementation of a project for developing the floriculture field also inclusive of the Northern and Eastern Provinces as well in the programme, at a cost of Rs.228.5 Million, within the five period of 2017-2021, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Modernization of the Agriculture Sector and Strengthening the Reconciliation Processes in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The European Union has agreed to provide grant assistance of  Euro 30 Million and Euro 14.5 Million respectively, for the 'Modernization of the Agriculture Sector Programme in Sri Lanka' and 'Strengthening the Reconciliation Processes Programme in Sri Lanka' and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into the relevant financial Agreements with the European Union, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Assistance Agreements Signed with the United States of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The information presented by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs that the amendments related to the relevant Agreements were signed as the Government of the United States of America has agreed to enhance the financial contribution, it had agreed upon, in accordance with the Agreement the Sri Lanka Government entered into  with the United States of America in the year 2011 for the implementation of the programmes of 'Strengthened Partnership for Democratic Reform and Social Integration' and the 'Increased Equitable Economic Growth and Public Financial Management', was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Rural Bridges
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The Government has planned to construct 4,000 bridges for connectivity improvement for transportation, with a view to improving easy access to  market place, education and healthcare facilities for the rural folk in several remote villages situated in the interior.  The Governments of Netherland, Austria and Belgium have agreed to provide funds for this project and the Birtish High Commission in Sri Lanka has intimated that it will provide direct financial facilities up to a value of 85% of the contract value of the project for the contractors of the UK identified for the implementation of the project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to empower the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to call for quotations inclusive of the financing proposals from the bridge building companies of the UK for the implementation of a Bridges Project valued at £50 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: A Project Design Advance Loan for the project preparatory activities of the Northern Province Sustainable Fisheries Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has already been granted for the implementation of the	'Northern Province Sustainable Fisheries Development Project' covering the coastal areas of the Districts of Jaffna, Mulathivu and Kilinochchi, with a view to improving the nutritional status, food security and the fisheries productions to enhance the income of the fisheries community.  This project, will be beneficial for around 40,000 fisheries families of the Northern Province.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into an Agreement with regard to obtaining a Loan Advance of US$1.3 Million from the Asian Development Bank (ADB), for commencing the preparatory activities of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the establishment of a Neonatal and Obstetrics Reference Centre for the De Soysa Maternity Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - With a view to establishing a Neonatal and Obstetrics Reference Centre at the De Soysa Maternity Hospital, it has been planned to provide the essential infrastructure facilities and equipment for the hospital, as well as the facilities needed by the hospital staff. The Centre which is to be established is expected to be converted into a national level centre of excellence of infant healthcare.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into Agreements with the Credit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank of France and the Hatton National Bank of Sri Lanka, to obtain the funds necessary for the implementation of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Office on Missing Persons (Establishment, Administration and Discharge of Functions) Act, No. 14 of 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-02-07
decision_details_body: - The Office on Missing Persons (Establishment, Administration and Discharge of Functions) Act, No. 14 of 2016 was approved by the Parliament on the 23rd August, 2016.  A proposal has been made to remove the paragraph (a) of section 11 which empowers the above Office 'to enter into Agreements with any person or organization' in regard to the performance of its functions.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to amend the Bill accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of financial facilities to the Sri Lanka Road Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-31
decision_details_body: - The Government has identified the Central Expressway as one of the priority projects for the improvement of connectivity and the stimulation of economic activities in the country.   Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to take action to obtain a term loan facility of Rs.23.2 Billion from the National Savings Bank and the Peoples Bank as required by the Road Development Authority (RDA), for the construction of the second phase (II) of the Central Expressway, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of contract for the supply of services for the 02nd Phase of the Lanka Government Network Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-31
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to award the contract to the Sri Lanka Telecom, for the supply of services to the 2nd Phase of the Lanka Government Network (LGN) Project, implemented by the Information and Communication Technology Agency with a view to providing public services to the citizens and the business community without interruption by providing high speed and safe Internet connections to the Government Organizations, in accordance with the recommendations of the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement for the establishment of a Joint Commission on cooperation between Sri Lanka and Ethiopia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-31
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to sign the Agreement for the establishment of a Joint Commission on cooperation between the Government of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia during his official visit to Ethiopia, with a view to promoting and reinforcing the cooperation  between the two countries, on political, economical, technical and cultural based on the principle of equality and mutual advantages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expediting the Programme for providing houses for families of the Low Income Group and the Middle Income Group
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-31
decision_details_body: - It is anticipated to construct 620,000 houses by the year 2019 under the Home Ownership Programme for families of the Low Income Group and the Middle Income Group. Ensuring that the programme will be completed within the stipulated period of time, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to establish a Special Purpose Vehicle (Public Limited Company) under the General Treasury and a 'Land Bank' for all lands allocated to the said unit with a view to providing facilities required by the unit for the expeditious implementation of matters, treating it as a national priority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Equipment for the Special Task Force (STF) troops to be deployed for UN Peacekeeping Operations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-31
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayaka, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, for the procurement of the items and equipment necessary for the Special Task Force (STF) troops to be deployed for UN Peacekeeping Operations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of new buildings for Courts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-31
decision_details_body: - When considering the prevailing situation, the construction of new buildings for court houses has been necessitated in view of the existing court buildings being very old, the increase in legal actions in relation to the increase in population being high and the availability of space in court houses being barely sufficient. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to construct new buildings  for court houses according priority to the construction of court buildings in Gampola, Ruwanwella, Mankulam, Mulathivu, Jaffna, Anuradhapura and Polonnaruwa, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for purchasing of Surgical Consumables for the Operation Theatres in Government Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-31
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the purchase of various surgical consumables essentially required for use in surgical treatment in the Operation Theatres of Government Hospitals, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the Supply of Hypodermic Syringes necessary for the Government Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-31
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the procurement of Hypodermic Syringes of various sizes to inject substances and extract fluids, in accordance with the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeals Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Hasalaka Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-31
decision_details_body: - The Hasalaka Water Supply Project expects to provide 12,500 water supply connections covering 33 Grama Niladhari Divisions which would be beneficial to around 49,370 people. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, for the implementation of the Hasalaka Water Supply Project, in accordance with the recommendations of the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Prevention of Crimes Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-31
decision_details_body: - At present, the finger prints of a certain accused could be obtained only in the case of crimes committed which are included in the Schedule to the Prevention of Crimes Ordinance.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to make amendments to the Schedule to enable to include inter alia the finger prints of those also accused of certain new crimes which have been included in our legislation recently and also to make amendments to the prevention of Crimes Ordinance including provision for a Court of Law to direct a person to be subject to the supervision of the police when a suspended sentence is imposed on a convict of such a crime and in respect of whom a previous conviction has been proved, until such time the expiry of the operational period of such sentence and to publish the Draft Bill in the Government Gazette and subsequently to present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Special Project Proposals for Tea Smallholders in the Up-country region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-31
decision_details_body: - In Sri Lanka, 73% of the total extent of tea lands belong to the Tea Smallholders out of which 17% of the entire Tea Smallholdings are scattered around the up country.  When solutions have to be provided for the social and economic issues faced by the Tea Smallholders of the up country, it is really important to carry out the rehabilitation of rural access roads to facilitate the transport of tea leaves and the implementation of the livelihood development projects connected with tea planting, for the  maintenance of a steady flow of income.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to rehabilitate 200 rural access roads situated within the small tea holdings of the Nuwara Eliya, Kandy and Matale Districts and to implement small greenhouse pilot projects in association with the estates for the cultivation of vegetables, fruits and flower varieties to enable to obtain an additional income and also to implement a small infrastructure development project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuation of Projects under the 'Sukitha Purawara' Township Development Programme within the Year 2017 and the Commencement of new Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-31
decision_details_body: - In the year 2016, 64 construction contracts have been awarded under the 'Sukitha Purawara' Township Development Programme implemented  by the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development, so as to cover the whole Island. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement some of the projects which could not be completed before the end of the financial year 2016, due to various justifiable reasons and also to commence new projects identified to be implemented within the financial year 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Programme on the Exchange of Students and Teachers of the Skilled Technology Field between Sri Lanka and Germany
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-31
decision_details_body: - The College of Technology (BBS III) in Mainz, Germany has expressed its willingness to cooperate with the Department of Technical Education and Training of Sri Lanka functioning under the Ministry of Skills Development and Vocational Training, for the implementation of a Programme on the Exchange of Students and Teachers.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for the Exchange of Students and Teachers between the Department of Technical Education and Training of Sri Lanka and the College of Technology of (BBS III) in Mainz, Germany, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement on the Educational Cooperation between Sri Lanka and Vietnam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-31
decision_details_body: - Agreement on Educational Cooperation between Sri Lanka and Vietnam entered into, with a view to developing the educational cooperation within the higher educational sector, was implemented from the year 2011 up to the year 2015.  The two countries, with the objective of further strengthening the mutual cooperation between their higher educational institutions, have agreed upon the implementation of the said Agreement with the relevant amendments for the period between the year 2016 to 2020.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to sign the new Agreement  on Educational Cooperation between the Ministry of Higher Education and Highways of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Education and Training of Vietnam, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Report on the current situation of the Gin-Nilwala Diversion Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-24
decision_details_body: - A sum of Rs.3,549 Million has been released from the General Treasury during the period from 2015-01-01 to 2015-01-07 for the Gin-Nilwala Diversion Project and the Ministerial Sub-Committee appointed to examine the present situation of the implementation of the project and make recommendations to the Cabinet of Ministers, has observed, that it is unusual for such magnitude of payment to be made at the beginning of a financial year. Accordingly, the recommendation made by the Ministerial Sub-Committee, to hand over the investigation into this matter to the Financial Crime Investigation Division (FCID), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Digital Summit scheduled to be held in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-24
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to hold a Digital Summit on the 23rd and 24th March, 2017, in Sri Lanka, with the objectives of attracting the innovators of the new technologies of the next generation to Asia and Sri Lanka to become a digital hub connecting the countries across South Asia and South East Asia. It is anticipated that experts from the internationally reputed Companies and the Executive Officers in the field such as Facebook, Google, Social Capital, Infosys will grace the occasion.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to initiate necessary activities pertaining to holding this Summit in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Memorandum of Understanding on Diplomatic Consultation between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Harsha de Silva, the Acting Minister of Foreign Affairs, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding on Diplomatic Consultation between the Foreign Ministry of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Foreign Ministry of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia during the forthcoming visit of the Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs to Ethiopia, with a view to strengthening and promoting the traditional relations of friendship and co-operation between the two countries, on the basis of the principles enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sale of the Stocks of Paddy held in the Paddy Marketing Board to avoid the shortage of rice in the market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-24
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet noted that the Ministry of Rural Economy has taken steps to convert 90,958 Metric Tons out of the paddy stocks held in the Paddy Marketing Board, into rice and issue same for sale to the Paddy Mill Owners and the Cooperative Wholesale Establishment (CWE) at district level. The Cabinet further noted that although the CWE has already taken steps to convert the paddy stocks into rice and sell same at Rs.76 per kilogram to the public through Lak Sathosa sale centres, the private paddy mill owners have not released the stocks of rice to the market as anticipated. As such, the Cabinet decided to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee under the Chairmanship of the Minister of Special Assignments, to take action, with regard to the paddy stocks still remaining in the possession of the Paddy Marketing Board to be converted into rice and released to the market in a suitable manner through the CWE and the private paddy mill owners and also to take necessary action against the paddy mill owners who have purchased the paddy stocks and failed to convert such stocks into rice.  

	On the request of H.E. the President, the Government of Indonesia has  donated a stock of 10,000 Metric Tons of rice to Sri Lanka and the Cabinet noted that the above stock of rice is due to reach Sri Lanka within the next few days and also if the price of rice in the market further remains at a high level, the Cabinet focussed its attention to take necessary steps to import rice to the market expeditiously from Indonesia and Vietnam including the other nearby countries, as well.

description: Proposed Re-location of the Manning Market in Pettah at Peliyagoda - Construction of Pile Foundation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-24
decision_details_body: - Under the Western Region Megapolis Development Plan, it has been planned to establish the Manning Market in Pettah at Peliyagoda.  Accordingly, the land development activities for the relocation of the Manning Market at Peliyagoda has been completed and as the next step, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the contract for the construction of pile foundation in accordance with the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of Two Contract Packages for Civil Works under the Landslide Disaster Protection Project of the National Road Network
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contracts for contract Package 01 and 02 under the road disaster management relating to the civil works of the Landslide Disaster Protection Project of the National Road Network and prevention of landslides in 16 places in the Central, Uva and Sabaragamuwa Provinces, to be implemented under the funds provided by the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), in accordance with the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Integrated Road Investment Programme - 2
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-24
decision_details_body: - The Asian Development Bank has agreed to provide funds for the rehabilitation, improvement and maintenance of around 4,000 km. of roads in the North, East, Uva and Western Provinces.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to carry out the remaining activities pertaining to the implementation of Programme - 2 of the proposed Integrated Road Investment Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of the land ownership and suitable houses to the beneficiaries of the Hautiville Housing project under the concept of creating New Villages in the Estate Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-24
decision_details_body: - The Hautiville Housing project in the Nuwara Eliya District has been initiated under the concept of creating New Villages, with a view to providing a better living condition to the Plantation Community.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. U. Palani Digambaram, the Minister of Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development, to issue Title Deeds to 71 of the beneficiaries of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of quality seeds for enhancing the productivity of Local Big Onion production
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-24
decision_details_body: - At present, 65% to 70% of the local big onion seed requirement needed for the consumption in the country is imported annually. Therefore, priority has been accorded to enhance the production of big onion under the Food Production National Programme 2016-2018 and to achieve the purpose, high yielding seed varieties have to be introduced to enhance the yield per unit of land.  Although, the annual requirement of big onion in the country is approximately 40,000 kg., only a half of it is produced locally. The balance is imported by the private sector of which some draw backs have been reported with regard to the quality of such imported big onions.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to import 6,200 kg. of high quality seeds from the 'National Horticultural Research and Development Foundation' which is a Research Institution of the Indian Government and fulfil the local need of the big onions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Sustainable Fisheries Development Project in the Northern Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-24
decision_details_body: - It is a special and a priority need of the government to develop the infrastructure facilities in the Northern Province where the development activities were held up for a long time due to the conflict which prevailed over there. The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has agreed to provide funds for the purpose and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to implement the 'Northern Province Sustainable Fisheries Development Project', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the e-friends Project II of the Revolving Fund Loan Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, for the implementation of the e-Friends II Revolving Fund utilizing the remaining funds out of the sum debited to the Revolving Fund under the Environmentally Friendly Project II Loan Scheme implemented from the year 2004 up to the year 2010 under the financial assistance provided by the Japanese International Cooperation Agency (JICA) and the provision of Rs.1,300 Million, set a part by the General Treasury for the year 2017 for this purpose, for waste minimization, for energy saving and for assisting the industrialists in the environment pollution control and also for formulating a suitable mechanism to ensure that the most suitable beneficiaries identified are provided with loans to achieve the objectives of this loan scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of the Railways Department Stores at Matale to the Municipal Council, Matale, on Lease Basis for constructing a Public Market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to transfer the Stores of the Railways Department at Matale to the Municipal Council, Matale, on lease basis for constructing a public market, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Luxury Tourist Camp Sites adjoining the Yala National Park
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-24
decision_details_body: - In the year 2012, an extent of 07 Acres from the land belonging to the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority (SLTDA) situated in the Palatupana area adjoining the Yala National Park had been allotted to M/s Wild Coast Lodge (Pvt.) Ltd., to construct environmental friendly luxury tourist camp sites, with a view to attracting the tourists of the higher income group. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to give an additional 155 perches of land on lease basis for a period of 50 years, to the above company, in order to carry on the project successfully as planned earlier, to obtain the approval of the  Department of Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management, the recommendation of the Department of Wildlife Conservation and also to direct the company to carry out its activities following the recommendations of the other government institutions as well, when the relevant constructions are underway, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Equipment necessary for the Sri Lanka Army Contingent Deployed for Peace Keeping Operations in Mali
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-24
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka has made a commitment to the United Nations to deploy a contingent of Sri Lanka Army for peace keeping operations in Mali. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into a Loan Agreement with a Bank of Russia known as SBERBANK, to procure the items and equipment necessary for the Sri Lanka Army Contingent, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting the International Forum of the Independent Audit Regulators (IFIAR) Annual Workshop
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - The Independent Audit Regulators in the World over have formed the International Forum of the Independent Audit Regulators to discuss and share information relating to oversight of Audits by its members. Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Monitoring Board has been working as a member of the forum since the year 2007 and it has participated actively in its discussions.  The IFIAR conducts a workshop  every year, attended by the staff of its member organizations and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to host its Annual Workshop for the year 2018, in the month of February in Colombo, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Human Rights Action Plan (2017-2021)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval last year, for the establishment of an Inter Ministerial Committee for Human Rights with the Co-chairmanship comprising of the Ministers of Foreign Affairs; Skills Development and Vocational Training; Justice and Strategic Development and International Trade, for the preparation of 'National Human Rights Action Plan 2017-2021' and to study all facts which should be taken for consideration.  The Cabinet approved, the 'Five Year National Human Rights Action Plan (2017-2021)', crafted with the consultations of the said Inter Ministerial Committee and wide participation of the relevant Stakeholders, presented by Hon. (Dr.) Harsha de Silva, the Acting Minister of Foreign Affairs.

description: Awarding the Contract for the Design and Building of St. Sebestian North Lock Gates and Pumping Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the contract for the Design and Building of St. Sebestian North Lock Gates and Pumping Station implemented under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project financed by the World Bank Loan for controlling floods in the Colombo City, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Pre-fabricated Structured Building for Storing Medical Supplies in the Medical Supplies Division at Welisara Hospital Premises
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - As the storing facilities available in the Medical Supplies Division of the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine are inadequate, a sum of nearly Rs.1 Million per month is incurred as rent for the storage facilities to be obtained from the private sector.  Therefore, considering the long term storage facilities needed, a pre-fabricated structured building has been planned to be constructed at the Welisara Hospital Premises, to ensure uninterrupted medical supplies to the hospital.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senarathe, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the construction of the stores building, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the Contracts for buildings to be constructed at the University of the Visual & Performing Arts and the Sri Lanka Institute of Advanced Technological Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contracts pertaining to the construction of  a building and landscaping for the Faculty of Visual Arts at the University of Visual & Performing Arts and the contract for the construction of academic and administration buildings for the Sri Lanka Institute of Advanced Technological Education located in areas in Galle, Gampaha, Kandy, Kurunegla and Samanthurei, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memoranda of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Ukraine and Denmark on the Recognition of Certificates issued to seafarers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - For a seafarer with a certificate of competency, to serve on ships registered in a foreign country, flying its flag has to obtain a similar certificate of recognition from the country concerned, in addition to his certificate of competency.  For the issuance of such certificates of equal status, their should be a Convention or a Memorandum of Understanding between the relevant countries and Sri Lanka has already entered into such Agreements with 30 foreign countries. Entering into such Agreements, generate job opportunities for a large number of Sri Lankan Seafarers who have obtained the Certificates of Competency to serve in foreign vessels. The Governments of Ukraine and Denmark have expressed their willingness to enter into an Agreement  with Sri Lanka relating to the issue of these certificates and therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to enter into Memoranda of Understanding between the Governments of Ukraine and Denmark relating to the recognition of the Oceanic Certificates of Competency, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulations made under the Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971 to regularize Small Commercial Vessels
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - At present, there is a great interest in Sri Lanka, over the activities carried out by the small commercial vessels. At the same time, with the development of the tourism industry, there is a significant increase in the passenger transportation by ships and as well as in the tourism activities.    As such, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to make regulations for the regularization of small merchant vessels under the Merchant Shipping Act, No. 52 of 1971, with a view to formalizing the registration and regularization of these small merchant vessels, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief to persons adversely affected due to the acquisition of land for the Yan Oya Reservoir Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - By now, 85% of the construction work of the Yan Oya Reservoir Development Project connecting the Anuradhapura and the Trincomalee Districts has been completed.  Around 242 families to be affected due to the impact of the project have to be evacuated from their places of residence expeditiously before commencement of filling the reservoir with water. As such, taking into consideration, the need to provide the families affected with more conducive living facilities, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to provide the above families with relief measures such as granting them financial aid to facilitate them to construct houses with the basic needs resembling their present houses, deviating from the existing provision, paying compensation on a suitable methodology to the encroaches who have developed and are in possession of government lands earmarked to be acquired, awarding compensation for crop damage, for those who could not continue with their seasonal cultivation as a result of the implementation of the project and  evacuating them from their places of residence expeditiously and complete the work of the project within the scheduled time frame, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prohibition of trawl fishing operation using mechanized boats within Sri Lankan waters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to present the Draft Bill for the amendment of the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No. 2 of 1996 in Parliament, making the necessary provisions for the prohibition of trawl fishing operation using engine mounted boats or mechanized boats within Sri Lankan waters, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Economic Empowerment of Women through Apparel Based Mini Factories
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval to provide training for rural women from the Eastern and the Uva Provinces and from the selected districts prioritizing women of displaced families and those who had become widowers as a result of war in sewing under the 'Programme for Economic Empowerment of Rural Women', anticipated to be implemented by the Ministry of Industry and Commerce, and subsequently to establish 150 mini apparel factories. Taking into consideration the great demand in respect of this project, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to expand the number of direct beneficiaries per mini factory from 15 to 20 and to install 5 more additional machines in each factory and to vest the ownership of the sewing machines to the respective cooperative societies that provided the training to the beneficiaries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Quarters/Housing facilities for the Medical Officers,  and the rest of the Health Services Staff in all Government Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Budget proposals of 2016, a proposal has been made to provide the basic accommodation requirements of Doctors and other medical staff serving in rural areas through Public Private Partnership Project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senarathe, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to construct government quarters for the Medical Specialists, the Medical Officers and the Internship Medical Officers and the other Health Services as well, through the Public Private Partnership Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Seeking the consent of drivers to donate organs and tissues for transplantation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - With the advancement of medical science, it is becoming prevalent to successfully transplant an organ of a healthy person who voluntarily donates such organ to be transplanted in place of the damaged organ of another person.  Organs can be donated by persons who are living, by those who have had a brain death or circulatory death, in case the person has given his/her consent prior to death. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senarathe, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to amend the application form when applying for a driving license and renewing it with the inclusion of a statement indicating the consent of the bearer who suffers a brain death or a circulatory death as a result of a road traffic accident, enabling the drivers to donate their organs and tissues, to be transplanted for the benefit of the needy patients and to amend the present driving license so as to display such consent given, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Management of the Water Supply Facilities during the Drought situation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - The drought situation prevailing in the Island, at present, has caused and adverse effect on the small community water systems in the rural areas. Due to the dry climatic conditions, the water supply capacity of the small water supply sources have been reduced with an anticipated  increase in the demand for water. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to expand the water supply activities carried out by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board by deploying water bowsers, to construct 400 hand pump wells and to repair and rehabilitate the existing 1,000 public hand-pump fitted in deep wells located within the drought prone rural areas, to construct 200 hand pump wells in the remote villages and to create awareness among the public of the need to water economically and to facilitate coordination activities with the relevant authorities and the institutions for the purpose of taking expeditious action at instances when the water supply is suddenly hampered, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation  of the National Human Resources and Employment Policy (NHREP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, the Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, for the implementation of the updated National Human Resources and Employment Policy designed, taking into consideration, the views of all stakeholders and paying more emphasis on private sector participation, to achieve a higher rate of economic growth under the economic development plan of the present government and to generate more employment opportunities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading the quality of service of the passenger transportation in the three-wheelers and the student transportation in the school vans
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Budget proposals of 2017, a proposal has been made to establish a Regulatory Authority to upgrade the quality of service of the passenger transportation in the three-wheelers and the student transportation in the school vans.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to appoint a Committee comprising of the Ministry Secretaries, to study and propose a methodology for implementation of the proposal and submit a Report to the Cabinet, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taking over of the Land leased to the US Embassy at Iranawila
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - A block of land at Iranawila situated in the Puttalam District, in extent of 166.038 Hectares had been leased out to the Embassy of the United States in 1991, to establish a radio transmission station 'the Voice of America' in Sri Lanka.  The US Embassy has informed its intention to close down the radio transmission station and handover the land and other assets/properties back to the Government of Sri Lanka before the expiry of the lease period. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, for the government to terminate the relevant Lease Agreement and take over the land and other assets/properties found in the premises, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of an Integrated Municipal Solid Waste Management System  for the Kandy District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - Around 250 Metric Tons of waste is collected within the Municipal Council authority area of the Kandy District and also in other Local authority areas daily and as such a need has arisen for the disposal of such solid waste adopting an environmentally sound integrated mechanism. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement a Waste Management Programme for the Kandy District through a joint venture Company formed between the Municipal Council Kandy and a Private Investor selected through open proposal procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Firearms Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-17
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that amendment of the Firearms Ordinance No.33 of 1916 is a timely need to formalise the usage of firearms to preserve law and order in the country, in the issuance and usage of firearms for the protection of agricultural crops and other property and in prohibiting the usage of firearms in public places.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to instruct the Legal Draftsman, to draft the amending legislation necessary in accordance with the recommendations made by the Officials' Committee appointed in this respect to make a study and report, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Policy and Legal Framework relating to the Counter Terrorism Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to refer the Amended Policy and Legal Framework relating to the Counter Terrorism Act to the Parliamentary Sectoral Oversight Committee on Legal Affairs, including the provisions to be incorporated into a new law to make provision for the protection of Sri Lanka's National Security and the Security of it's people from acts of terrorism and related attacks, the protection of the unity, territorial integrity and the sovereignty of Sri Lanka from acts of terrorism and related attacks, the protection of other countries and areas from the scourge of terrorism, the prevention of the use of Sri Lankan territory and its people for the preparation of terrorism in overseas, the prevention and detection of acts of terrorism and related offences, the identification of acts related to terrorism and the related offences, the identification of person who have committed acts of terrorism which would affect the national security and the security of the people of Sri Lanka, arrests, detention, investigations, prosecution and punishment and to commence drafting of Legislation in accordance with the said Framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No.2 of 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - A Bill was drafted in August 2016, with a view to providing for a suspect arrested by the Police, the right of access to a lawyer immediately after recording his statement, but taking into consideration the representations made by certain parties interested on the matter, the Draft Bill was not tabled in Parliament. Subsequently, a Committee was appointed comprising the representatives of the Sri Lanka Bar Association, the Attorney General's Department and other Stakeholders to evolve a more acceptable draft on the subject as recommended by the Parliamentary Sectoral Oversight Committee on Legal Affairs (Anti Corruption).  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to instruct the Legal Draftsman, to draft necessary Legislation, based on the draft prepared by the said Committee which has made provision to ensure the rights of a suspect arrested and to publish the draft so prepared, in the Government Gazette and present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Government Borrowing Programme for 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, for the issuance of Sri Lanka Development Bonds up to US$1,500 Million, under the supervision of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka to implement the Government Borrowing Programme for 2017, by strengthening the flexibility in domestic borrowing and the reserves of the country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Relief under Emergency Disaster Conditions to House Holders Adversely Affected by the Water Leaks of the Main Tunnel of the Uma Oya Multi Purpose Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The Uma Oya Multi Purpose Development Project is being implemented with the objective of providing water to the Kirindi Oya Basin of the Southern Region which suffers from shortage of water. When the construction work was underway, due to the water ingress in the main tunnel of the Uma Oya, several adverse effects such as drying of domestic wells and development of cracks in the houses occurred in 08 Grama Niladharys' Divisions in the Divisional Secretarys' Divisions of Bandarawela and Ella.  Due to this reason, damages have been caused to the lives and the properties of the people living in those areas while it has also greatly affected the daily livelihoods of the people adversely. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to mitigate the prevailing disastrous conditions and to construct new houses in place of the completely damaged ones, to bring back normalcy to the day to day living conditions of the affected people, providing pipe borne  water connections free of charge etc. and such other reliefs as necessary, expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 60 MW of Supplementary Power for a 06 month period to ensure uninterrupted power supply
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Public Utility Commission has submitted recommendations with regard to the measures to be taken to ensure an uninterrupted power supply to face the likely electricity deficit in a dry weather situation prevailing, presently, in the Island. A major recommendation among other recommendations is to install additional power capacity to the network, expeditiously.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapaitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to purchase a number of generators of 60Mw capacity necessary to generate  power supply for a short period of 06 months by Open International Competitive Bidding Procedure, in accordance with the proposal of the Ceylon Electricity Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the Expired Agreements of Furnace Oil Power Plants by 06 months
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet of Ministers having considered the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapaitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to extend the Power Purchase Agreements made between the Ceylon Electricity Board and the following companies, granted its approval to extend the Agreements up to a period of 06 months, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee, to meet the power need in the likely electricity deficit in the future due to the dry weather conditions, presently, prevailing in the country and for an uninterrupted power supply.  

*	ACE Power Embilipitiya (Pvt) Ltd., 
*	ACE Power Generation Matara (Pvt) Ltd.
*	Heladanavi (Pvt) Ltd.  Puttalam

description: Amendment of the Irrigation Ordinance No. 32 of 1946 to suit the timely needs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - Except for the Mahaweli Authority area, the responsibility of construction, improvement and management of major irrigation canals in all other areas of Sri Lanka is vested with the Department of Irrigation.  Accordingly, in order to enable the Department to carry out its responsibilities, successfully and efficiently, the joint proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management and Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to instruct the Legal Draftsman, to amend the said Ordinance, as recommended by the Expert Committee Appointed to study the Ordinance No.32 of 1946 and make recommendations, to suit the timely national requirements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development and Improvement of Godigamuwa Tank in the Matale District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The Godigamuwa Tank situated in the Naula Divisional Secretary's Division in the Matale District has a capacity of about 45 acre feet and paddy and several other crops are cultivated using its water. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to implement  the project for the development and improvement of the Godigamuwa tank, with a view to ensuring the supply of irrigation water for 162 farmer families living in Dambagalla, Bambaragahawatta and Helambagahawatta in the Naula area, by increasing its capacity from 45 acre feet up to 202 acre feet, at an estimated cost of Rs.165.9 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the projects for Municipal Solid Waste Management, at Karadiyana and Muthurajawela areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to implement two projects at Karadiyana and Muthurajawela areas to generate electricity from waste material with the use of the incineration technology as a remedial measure to solve the problem of waste management in the Districts of Colombo and Gampaha.   It is expected to implement these projects on Public Private Partnership    basis. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the contract to the investors selected following the Government Procurement Procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a land at Denzil Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Battaramulla to the Department of Divineguma Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to release a plot of land belonging to the Urban Development Authority situated at the Denzil Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Battaramulla, to the Department of Divineguma Development  to construct its Head Office, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a land to the National Institute of Business Management (NIBM) for the construction of a new building
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - At present approximately 10,500 students follow the courses conducted in Management, Information Technology and Language Studies by the National Institute of Business Management (NIBM) located at Wijerama Mawatha, Colombo 07 and the demand for such courses is gradually increasing.  However, due to the limited space available at the current premises, it has become difficult to meet the increasing demand and commence new courses. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training and Hon.
