Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to expand the scope of the infrastructure facilities of the National Institute of Business Management with the allocation of a land of about 45 perches belonging to the Department of Agriculture situated adjoining  the NIBM, to construct a new building, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Public Private Partnership Division
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The attention of the government has been focused on the implementation of the projects aligned with the national priority and the economic development agenda under the Public Private Partnerships.  Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance and Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to establish a division in the Ministry of Finance comprised of commercial technical expertise to assist the relevant Ministries in providing assistance advice and facilitating when selecting projects suitable to be implemented under the Public Private Partnership collaboration, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Prevention of Mosquito Breeding Act, No. 11 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - Presently, Dengue fever has become a major health problem in Sri Lanka.  The most effective and successful preventive measure identified currently is the control of mosquito breeding.  The Legislation which provides for  the control of Dengue is the Prevention of Mosquito Breeding Act, No.11 of 2007.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Dr. Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft Legislation with the objective of making the amendments necessary to the Act, to rectify the deficiencies and shortcomings identified in the implementation of this Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increase of the Annual Grant to the Sri Lanka Cancer Society
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Cancer Society inaugurated in 1948, is a voluntary organization committed to serving the patients suffering physically and mentally from cancer. It provides the needy patients suffering from cancer with various needs they deserve and patient care services free of charge for the terminally ill cancer patients operating and maintaining a Hospice - 'Shantha Sevana' and the 'Bandaranaike Memorial Cancer Home'. Therefore, as Government sponsorship for renovation and maintenance activities and considering the services provided by it as a voluntary organization, the proposal made by Hon. Dr. Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to increase the grant of Rs.550,000/- to Rs.2,000,000, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement between Sri Lanka and Iran on Science, Technology and Innovation Cooperation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - Submissions made to the Cabinet by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Iran during his official visit to Iran between 14 to 17 January, 2017, to enhance the cooperation between the two countries in matters related to the  implementation of technology development projects and programmes on Food and Herbal Technology, Bio-technology, Nano Technology and Advanced Material Technology Sectors, Integrated Research and Development, Exchange of Scientific and Technology Personnel and Management of Innovative Projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the United Arab Emirates and Sri Lanka on Cooperation in the field of Higher Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Education - Higher Education Affairs of the United Arab Emirates and the Ministry of Higher Education and Highways of Sri Lanka on cooperation in the field of Higher Education, with a view to further strengthening the mutual cooperation and also to further improve the cooperation between the higher educational sectors of the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Academy of Labour and Social Relations of the Russian Federation and the National Institute of Labour Studies (NILS), Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The National Institute of Labour Studies (NILS) functions with the objective of conducting research and carrying out surveys and provide training to widen  the field of labour studies.  In fulfilling its objectives, it is also expected to work in close collaboration with local as well as the foreign institutions. As such, the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, the Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with the Academy of Labour and Social Relations of the Russian Federation and the National Institute of Labour Studies in Sri Lanka, to exchange information on studies made in the field of socio-labour and to implement joint programmes and projects concerning studies in the field of labour, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a plot of land to the Embassy of the State of Palestine
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to allocate a plot of land located in the Hewa Avenue, Colombo 07, to construct a permanent building for the Embassy of the State of Palestine, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting the 10th Air Services Negotiation Event of the International Civil Aviation Organization in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) was established as an Agency of the United Nations to manage the administration and governance of the Convention on International Civil Aviation (Chicago Convention) signed in the year 1944 and Sri Lanka functions as a member of the organization since June 1948. Providing a Central meeting place for all member states with a view to improving the efficiency  of the negotiating process in regard to the Aviation Services Agreements, the International Civil Aviation Organization holds an Air Services Agreement Convention, annually. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to host the Convention of the year 2017 in the period from 04 to 08 December 2017 in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Puttalam District Integrated Tourism Development Plan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - There is an immense possibility of developing Kalpitiya and Puttalam Lagoon area as Sri Lanka's biggest and the main tourism zone.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, for the implementation of a project under the integrated tourism development plan with collaboration of the Ministry of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs and the Ministry of Sustainable Development and Wildlife within the 2 years from 2017 to 2018, with the objective of transforming this area into a sustainable tourism zone and increasing job opportunities in the tourism field through the enhancement of the biodiversity and the conservation in the area, developing tourist industry with increased employment opportunities and empowering the people in the area, a greater contribution towards the national economy based on the main tourism industries prevalent in the Puttalam District, enhancing the income sources of the people and enhancing the attraction of local and foreign tourists, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Marketing Facility Development Project of the Tourism Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The Australian Government has submitted a proposal for the implementation of Marketing Facility Development Project with an investment of Rs.12 Million Australian Dollars for a period of 04 years, targeting the implementation of a project for stimulating business investment in the tourism industry. The proposed project aims at increasing facilities for international business activities in the fields of digital technology which is growing past in Sri Lanka for the identification of new attractive tourist destinations and activities of a more divers nature of the tourism industry, promotion of tourism investment activities in areas where tourism associated business investment is lagging and attracting international consumers for the highest quality 'Sri Lankan made' products.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to enter into an Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Australia for the implementation of the proposed Marketing Facility Development Project in Sri Lanka with the financial assistance provided by the Government of Australia, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Additional Financing for Kaluganga Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The Kaluganga Development Project is presently implemented with the financial assistance of Saudi Fund for development (SFD), Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development (KFAED) and the OPEC Fund for International Development (OFID). The construction work of this project is scheduled to be completed by December 2018.  The revised cost of contract of this project amounts to US$140.35 and close upon US$89.85 has been provided by the Development Partners.  Accordingly, the funds amounting to US$50.5 have to be obtained additionally and therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into an Agreement with the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development (KFAED) to obtain a sum of US$16.5 out of the above funds under the concessionary terms, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding for Development Cooperation Partnership between the Governments of Sri Lanka and Australia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The development cooperation between Sri Lanka and Australia dates back to more than 60 years and Australia can be regarded as a leading country which provides Sri Lanka with long term scholarships on various subject fields. A Memorandum of Understanding between the two countries was entered into in the year 1998 to ensure the smooth implementation of the Australian assistance within Sri Lanka and the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to sign the reformulated Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of Australia taking into consideration the policy changes which occurred in both countries recently, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of the required facilities for the Medical Faculties of Rajarata and Eastern Universities and the Faculty of Allied Health Sciences of the University of Peradeniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - It has become an urgent need to provide the necessary facilities with the required medical equipment and accessories essential for the faculties of Rajarata and Eastern Universities and the Faculty of Allied Health Sciences of the University of Peradeniya to uplift the quality and teaching and training facilities of the above faculties in par with the other State Universities. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct negotiations to obtain  the necessary funds from a Bank in Australia under concessionary terms and to enter into a loan Agreement in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Creating Awareness on Environment Education of the Teachers in accordance with the New Syllabus introduced
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - The World Leaders and the Environment Organizations have entered into a number of conventions with regard to facing the challenge of climatic changes, successfully adaptation to such conditions and to minimize the damages caused, environment conservation etc. The environment sensitive components have been introduced to the science syllabus when the new syllabus for Grade 6 to Grade 11 were prepared to provide a formal education on such matters to school children with a view to making them aware about the future challenges on climatic and environment changes. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement a project to create awareness for the government teachers in environment education in order to effect an attitudinal change in the school children by providing them with a proper understanding about the environment sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Guidelines for the Construction and Maintenance of State Buildings as widely Environment friendly Green Buildings
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-10
decision_details_body: - In order to achieve sustainable development goals in Sri Lanka it is mandatory to obtain the contribution of the green and environment friendly construction sector.  In this respect, the Cabinet of Ministers have already granted approval for the Guidelines to be followed pertaining to designing, construction and maintenance of state buildings as widely environment friendly green buildings. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to obtain the approval to measure the qualitative status in implementing these Guidelines and the rating systems of the institutional structure in respect of the sectors namely energy efficiency, sustainable landscaping and management, infrastructure used for construction and resource management, qualitative aspects of the environment in-side the buildings, water efficiency, green innovation and their socio-cultural adaptability, in the construction of new state buildings, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Balagathu Sri Lankavak' - the Government Development Plan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - The booklet titled 'Balagathu Sri Lankavak' which provides a snapshot of the proposed economic development plans and the ongoing progress made concerning such plans to provide a better understanding of the development process and progress made so far, to the public officers and the general public was presented by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to the Cabinet.

description: 'Let's Protect Children' National Programme - 2017-2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - The Government has identified the necessity to safeguard the children,  the lifeline of the nation, as a priority need against numerous calamities prevalent in the Society. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to implement the 3 year Activity Plan 'Let's Protect Children' National Programme during the period 2017-2019, encompassing all facets covering, avoid abuse/abduction and ensure child protection, health, nutrition and welfare and personality development, education and life skills, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Siyabalanduwa Water Supply Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - The Siyambalanduwa Water Supply Scheme in the Moneragala District proposed to be implemented under the water supply and sanitation improvement project, has been planned to provide safe drinking water to over 8,450 houses in the Siyambalanduwa and Muthukandiya areas.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for construction of this water supply scheme, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Greater Colombo Water and Wastewater Management Improvement Investment Programme - Project 2
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for the construction of the Gothatuwa Reservoir with a capacity of 15,000 Cu.m, construction of the Gothatuwa Pump Station and the Booster Pump Station, with the Supply and Laying of 1,200 mm DI Pipes under Tranche 2 of the Greater Colombo Water and Wastewater Management Improvement Investment Programme, implemented with funds provided by the Asian Development Bank and the French Agency for Development (Agence Francaise de Development), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of value addition centers in Sri Lanka for Vegetables and Fruits
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - The Government is providing assistance to farmers and entrepreneurs to export vegetables and fruits to suit the needs of the conditions prevailing in foreign countries, targeting the global export market.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Primary Industries, to establish 03 centres for enhancing the value addition under Public Private Partnership associated with the farms with facilities for processing, packaging and storage, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of the Elphinstone Theatre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - The Elphinstone Theatre Hall constructed in 1925 and acquired by the Government in 1988 is presently governed by the Tower Hall Theatre Foundation. The modernization activities of this Theatre with a 600 seating capacity are being presently carried out and it has been planned to reopen it for the public in the 1st quarter of the year 2017.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to generate the additional funds required for the completion of the remaining activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recommendations of the Cabinet Sub-Committee on the proposed Registration of Electors (Special Provisions Bill)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - The implementation of the Registration of Electors (Special Provisions) Act, No.27 of 2013 which made provisions for safeguarding the right to vote of the displaced persons and the members of their families who resided in the temporary shelters and lodgings situated in the other areas of the Island having left their villages and properties in the Northern Province due to the conflict situation which prevailed, ended with effect from the 19th of June, 2015. In accordance with the recommendations of the Cabinet Sub-Committee appointed to examine this matter, it is further necessary to achieve the objectivities of the Act. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, as the Chairman of the Sub-Committee, to publish in the Gazette the Registration of Electors (Special Provisions) Bill drafted with a view to providing an extension of the period of the validity of the provisions in the Act for a further period of 04 years and subsequently, present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Vattarama Sri Arahantha Maliyadewa Raja Maha Vihara sacred area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Buddha Sasana, to generate the additional provision of Rs.35 Million required for the completion of the development activities of the Vattarama Sri Arahantha Maliyadewa Raja Maha Vihara sacred area  situated in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Galigamuwa in the Kegalle District where the State Vesak Festival of 2017 is scheduled to be held, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading of the Sri Lanka Institute of Textile & Apparel as a Degree awarding Institution
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka Institute of Textile and Apparel is engaged in the function of conducting training in the industry of Sri Lanka Textile and Apparel, quality testing and providing consultancy services. At present around 4,500 students follow the short term and long term courses offered by the Institute and currently the institute conducts in a wide range of demand driven courses including Certificate and Diploma Level.  With a view to providing the capability of the students of the institute to face the competition, prevalent in the job market, it is proposed to upgrade this institute as a Degree awarding institution in the Textile and Apparel field affiliated with the Lovely Professional University of Punjab in India.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka Textile and Apparel Institute and the Lovely Professional University of Punjab in India, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - Considering the necessity of incorporating the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute functioning under the Ministry of Skills Development and Vocational Training as a separate legal entity by an Act of Parliament, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to publish the Draft Bill on the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute, in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the infrastructure facilities of the University of Vocational Technology (UNIVOTEC), Ratmalana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - Around 1,600 students take up the Bachelor of Technology Degree in the University of Vocational Technology at Ratmalana and there is a gradual increase of the number of applicants applying for these courses.  Further, a considerable number of these students are residents from remote areas away from Colombo. This University does not have adequate  hostel facilities to provide accommodation facilities for these students and even in the present canteen the space available is highly limited. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to construct a new hostel to cater for 600 students, a canteen with 300 seating capacity at one and the same time and also a vocational training workshop to provide facilities for students, at an estimated cost of Rs.927.34 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Policy on Health Information
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - When providing essential healthcare services and curative and treatment services to the people through the hospital system, diagnosis and treatment of the deceases and the outcome assessment pertaining to administrative decisions, planning and monitoring activities should be carried out properly.  In this respect, availability of an accurate, reliable, relevant and an easily accessible and cost effective information network is of paramount importance to provide health services more effectively. The National Health Information Network of Sri Lanka is mainly comprised of information inputs from the State health service and in future most of the information inputs of the private sector institutions which provide healthcare services will be included in the above information network.  It is also a felt need to improve the paper based system of data capture and transfer same with the use of the modern information and communication technologies.  Accordingly, the 'National Policy on Health Information' formulated in accordance with the objectives of the 'National Health Services Policy' and submitted by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Proposed National Elderly Health Policy of Sri Lanka and the Strategies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - The rapid increase of the ageing population, mainly due to the increase in the life expectancy and the fertility decline is a current problem faced by Sri Lanka.  It is anticipated that the current proportion of 12% of the people aged over 60 years will increase to 16% by 2020 and 29% by 2050. In order to face this situation, it is necessary for the health care  programmes to focus on preventing ill health. Accordingly, the proposal 'National Elderly Health Policy' submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, with a view to providing a wholestic health service for the senior citizens living in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Science Technology and Innovation Coordinating Authority (NASTICA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to establish a 'National Science Technology and Innovation Coordinating Authority' by an Act of  Parliament, to facilitate the proper coordination of the research and development activities of Research Institutions and Research Centres numbering about 80 administered by 21 line Ministries with a view to harnessing maximum results on investments made for Science, Technology and Innovation towards Socio Economic Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of National Parks and New Wildlife Sanctuaries and the Revision of Boundaries of Sanctuaries so declared
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - Priority has to be accorded to safeguard the natural forests, wet lands and wildlife in order to minimize the danger of destruction of the habitats of animals which have been faced with danger due to various unauthorized activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to declare the forest stretch of Kalawewa and Balaluwewa of the Kahalla - Pallekale sanctuary bordering the districts of Kurunegala and Anuradhapura as 'Kalawewa National Park', to name the balance forest stretch falling within the Kurunegala District as 'Kahalla - Pallekale National Park', to declare the marine region around the Pasikuda area in the Trincomalee District as 'Kayankarni Marine Natural Reservation', to declare the forest area around the 'Kotuaththawala wewa' situated in the Nikaweratiya Divisional Secretary's Division of the Kurunegala District as 'Kotuaththawala Wildlife Sanctuary', to declare the 'Akurala Wet Land' situated in the Hikkaduwa Divisional Secretary's Division of the Galle District as 'Akurala Wildlife Sanctuary', the 'Kodigahakanda Forest Stretch' situated in the Horana Divisional Secretary's Division of the Kalutara District as 'Kodigahakanda Wildlife Sanctuary' and the Oceanic Zone where Small Rawana and Great Rawana light houses with coral reef situated off the South East Coast of Sri Lanka as the 'Small Rawana and Great Rawana Marine Sanctuaries' and for the revision of boundaries of the Maadu River Sanctuary situated in the Balapitiya Divisional Secretary's Division of the Galle District, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulation of Tourist Hotels
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to place before Parliament for approval, the Regulations, Orders and Rules published in the Gazette Extraordinary No.1963/28 dated 2016-04-20 by the Minister, made in terms of the Tourism Act, No.38 of 2005, with regard to the minimum capacity and facilities required in tourist hotels for classification under 1  to 5 Star categories, the fees payable for registration, Code of conduct of tourist hotels, registration and licensing of tourist hotels and the  provision of minimum accommodation facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the National Biodiversity Strategic Action Plan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2017-01-03
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is a signatory to the International Convention on Bio-diversity  which was formulated to coincide with the 'Earth Summit' which was held in the year 1992. In accordance with the commitments of the convention, Sri Lanka has carried out a number of programmes from the year 1992 up to 2016 for the conservation of Bio-diversity.  The National Bio-diversity Expert Committee, with the participation of the relevant stakeholders, has also prepared a National Bio-diversity Conservation Action Plan with Bio-diversity Strategies to be implemented during the period 2016 to 2022.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, for the implementation of the National Bio-diversity Conservation  Strategic Action Plan for 2016-2022, with the objective of conserving Bio-diversity in Sri Lanka, sustainable use of Bio-diversity and the equitable sharing of the benefits accrued, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Import of Rice to maintain a buffer stock for the prevention of a price hike in the Domestic Market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body: - Due to the adverse weather conditions prevailing in the island, which has resulted in not having adequate rain, there is a steep decline in the extent of land cultivated in paddy in the Maha Season this year. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, for the private sector to import rice and maintain a buffer stock to prevent any shortage of rice in the market, to store the rice so imported in the bonded warehouses as a buffer stock and to release the rice to the market systematically, so as to enable the control  of price of  rice in the market, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion of the facilities in the Vocational Training Centre, Moneragala of the National Youth Services Council
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body: - The Moneragala Vocational Training Centre of the National Youth Services Council was established in the year 1987 and no proper programme has since been initiated up to now for the expansion of its facilities. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs,  to construct a new building to accommodate lecture halls in the Vocational Training Centre, Moneragala, to conduct 10 courses, with facilities for training of 250 youth, aimed at the job market for motor mechanism, construction and tourist hotel industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding four Contracts for the Development of Roads under the Let's Awaken Polonnaruwa District Development Programme of the Presidential Programme for 'Awakening Rajarata'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the following four contracts implemented under the Let's Awaken Polonnaruwa District Development Programme of the Presidential Programme for 'Awakening Rajarata, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	Development of Manampitiya - Aralaganwila - Maduru Oya Road (from 3.0km up to 33.0km)
*	Rehabilitation and Improvement of the Dehiattakandiaya - Aralaganwila of Road (from 0km up to 21.10km)
*	Improvement of the Minneriya - Galoya Road (from 0km up to 14.54km)
*	Improvement of the Elahera - Giritale Road (from 0km up to 29.0km)

description: Financing the Consultancy Services for Design Review and Construction Supervision of Civil Works for extension of the Southern Expressway Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body: - The construction work of all the 4 Sections of the Southern Expressway from Matara to Hambantota commenced in the latter part of 2015 and as of now the construction work is underway.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to enter into a Framework Agreement with the Government of the Peoples Republic of China, to obtain a loan of Renminbi Yuan 577 Million for the Design Review and the Construction Supervision of Civil Work and also to enter into a Loan Agreement with Exim Bank of China to obtain the above Loan under the concessional loan facilities provided by the Government of China, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Pilot Project for establishment of a Ground Water Monitoring Network covering the Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa and Moneragala Districts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body: - Proper management of ground water usage in Sri Lanka is extremely important and in this context, it is essential to collect timely data on quantity and quality of ground water.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to award the contract for the establishment of a pilot project on the data network on ground water monitoring, covering the river basins of the Malwathu Oya in the Anuradhapura District, the Maduru Oya in the Polonnaruwa District and the Kumbukkan Oya in the Moneragala District, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Building for the Divisional Secretariat,  Homagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, to award the contract for the construction of a new 03 storeyed building for the Divisional Secretariat, Homagama, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Setting up of an Intravenous Solution Manufacturing Plant in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body: - The Government spends a large sum of money annually, for the importation of medicinal drugs and other medical equipment. The Cabinet approval has already been granted to set up an Intravenous Solution Manufacturing Plant in Sri Lanka to save foreign exchange at least to a certain extent and enable the manufacture of essential Intravenous Medicinal Products in their fresh and high quality form and supply in a short supply time to all hospitals in the country uninterruptedly. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract of the project for setting up of the manufacturing plant, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Infrastructure facilities of the Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body: - In order to retain the services of the academic and non-academic staff of the Universities outside Colombo, it is imperative that they are provided with accommodation facilities within the University premises itself.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to implement the projects for the construction of quarters for the staff of the  Rajarata, Ruhuna, Wayamba, Sabaragamuwa, Eastern and Jaffna Universities, to construct a 4 storeyed building for the development of the Jaffna Regional Centre of the Open University and also to renovate the old buildings at the Peradeniya University premises and put them in order, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new rail track from Kurunegala to Habarana via Dambulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body: - An impact assessment has already been made on the construction of a  new rail track from Kurunegala to Habarana via Dambulla.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to obtain the services of the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), to assist the Negotiation Committee Appointed by the Cabinet of Ministers, in the Technological Proposal made by the Project Proposer which is a Chinese Engineering Company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resettlement of the displaced families due to the implementation of the Moragahakanda - Kaluganga Development Project in the Medirigiriya Divisional Secretary's Division
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body: - A section of the displaced families owing to the Moragahakanda - Kaluganga Development Project is re-settled in the Kaluganga Catchment area and 9,000 Ha of productive lands in the Medirigiriya area belonging to the Mahaweli D-Zone have been identified to re-settle the remaining families.  Under this programme the development activities in 4 Grama Niladari Divisions of the Medirigiriya Divisional Secretary's Division is already underway and is scheduled to carry out the human settlement development activities, in order to completely cover the Divisional Secretary's Division. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to expand the irrigational and human settlement development activities in the 9 Grama Niladari Divisions of the Medirigiriya Divisional Secretary's Division which is presently under-developed and also to conduct feasibility studies to expand the development activities of the remaining 32 Grama Niladari Divisions,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Knuckles Information Centre - Forest Conservation Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body: - The construction work of a fully pledged information centre, within the Knuckles Conservation Forest belonging to the World Heritage Site of the Central Highlands commenced in 2014 but the construction of the centre has been suspended for want of necessary funds.  As such,  the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to re-commence the construction work of the information centre, utilizing the Rs.23 Million, from the 'Punarudaya Work Programme of 2016-2018', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Establishment of a Solar Power Park of 100MW in the Siyabalaanduwa Area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body: - At present, an unprecedented attention is being diverted worldwide in the generation of electricity through the eco-friendly renewable energy sources. In this respect, a high priority has been accorded to solar power.  Presently, solar power plants of 11.3Mw have been connected to the Central Electricity Board Network of Sri Lanka and up to now nearly 30Mw is generated under the Net Metering System. By now, several projects are being implemented with the objective of increasing electricity generation in Sri Lanka through solar power and it has also been planned to establish 03 new solar power parks. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to conduct a feasibility study for the construction of a solar power park with a capacity of 100Mw in the Moneragala, Siyambalanduwa area, as a first step, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recreational Facilities Development Project at Kumbichchankulama Lake at Anuradhapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body: - Although, the Anuradhapura town has the basic infrastructure facilities as well as common amenities, to cater to the population there are no recreation and leisure facilities in the town.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to allocate funds for Phase II of the project with the objective of renovating the Kumbichchankulama Lake and developing its surroundings with recreational facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of a National Integration and Reconciliation Week from 8th-14th January 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of National Integration and Reconciliation, to declare, 'the National Integration and Reconciliation Week' every year from 8th-14th January 2017, with a view to laying the foundation for promoting a nation building effort for a united, strong, reconciled and prosperous nation and to implement various programmes focussing on all schools in the island, the media and public and private institutions to co-inside with the Reconciliation Week from the year 2017, highlighting the importance of National Integration, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Programme on Prevention of Chronic Kidney Disease - 2016 to 2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-20
decision_details_body: - The Chronic Kidney Disease of unknown etiology, a major non-contagious disease, which has taken root in Sri Lanka recently has by now become more prevalent in the North Central, Uva, Wayamba, Northern, Central and Eastern Provinces of Sri Lanka, while patients have also been reported, to a certain extent, in the District of Hambantota in the Southern Province. This disease has not only become a major health hazard but also has created several socio economic problems, as well. In order to overcome the health crisis which has arisen due to the disease, it is essential to launch a programme for prevention, screening of patients, treatment of patients, implementation of welfare measures constantly for the families of the patients and the provision of safe drinking water.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to obtain funds necessary for the National Programme on   Prevention of Chronic Kidney Disease implemented by the Presidential Task Force on  Prevention of Kidney Disease during the period from 2016 to 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relocation of two transmission lines to facilitate construction of the proposed New Bridge over the Kelani River
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The preliminary activities for construction of a six-lane bridge over the Kelani River for connecting the existing Colombo - Katunayake Express Way, have now been completed. In this regard, it is necessary to relocate two main power transmission lines of Kolonnawa - Kelanitissa 132kv and the Biyagama - Kelanitissa 420kv, to facilitate the construction of the new bridge. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for relocating the two power transmission lines, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Budget Financing for 2016 and 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - When mobilizing the funds required for the Budget Financing, in addition to accessing the domestic market through Government Securities, the foreign currency financing resources, raising of Foreign Currency Credit facilities through the Foreign Currency Banking Units of the State Banks, provision of the foreign exchange term financing facilities and the issue of International Sovereign Bonds also could be utilized.  According to the alternative diversified borrowing options, the required funds could be mobilized at a reduced cost and an opportunity also will be created for various investors who show interest, to gain access to the Sri Lanka Loan Market.  At the same time, a greater competition will also be created among those investors.  Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wirckremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, and Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to appoint a Steering Committee and a Technical Evaluation Committee comprising of the officials of the General Treasury, the Ministry of National Policies and Economic Affairs and the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, to pursue action to move forward in the provision of foreign exchange term financing facility, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: ‘Awakening Rajarata’ - Presidential Programme - Award of Three Contracts for Road Development under the ‘Let’s Awaken Polonnaruwa’ District Development Programme - 2016-2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contracts for the development of Habarana - Batticaloa Road (B529) in the Urban Area of Polonnaruwa with a 4 lane track up to a distance of 7.5 km, improvement of Dambulla - Bakamuna - Kalagahawela Road (B615) up to a distance of 13.6 km and widening and carpeting 5.06 km of the Maradankadawala - Habarana - Thirikkondiyamadu Road from Polonnaruwa to the New Town, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Colombo National Highways Project - Improvement of the Road section from Kottawa to Moragahahena on the Kottawa - Thalagala Road (B239)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for the improvement of the Road section from Kottawa to Moragahahena on the Kottawa - Thalagala Road (B239) from 1.0 km to 15.48 km under the Colombo National Highways Project funded by the OPEC Fund for International Development (OFID), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Colombo National Highways Project - Improvement of the Road section from Godagama to Bope in the Kotte-Bope Road (B240)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for the improvement of Road section from Godagama to Bope in the Kotte-Bope Road (B240) from 16.740 km to 28.004 km under the Colombo National Highways Project funded by the OPEC Fund for International Development (OFID), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Mulativu Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - Priority has been accorded for the construction of buildings for Police Stations and the improvement of the existing Police Stations under the special programme initiated in order to maintain law and order within the Northern Province. Although, Cabinet approval was granted in 2014, to construct a new building for the Mulativu Police Station instead of the building it occupied on rental basis, the implementation of the project has been delayed.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayaka, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to initiate the construction of the building for the Mulativu Police Station expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Kelani River Flood Protection Bunds
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The Kelani River is one of the major rivers in Sri Lanka and a 2/3 area of its basin consists of low lands including the Colombo City and the suburbs in an around it, which get flooded frequently.  During the floods in May 2016, it was observed that there are weak sections in the bunds erected under the scheme designed for the protection of the Colombo City and the Kelaniya Town, from river flooding.  The major reason for the vulnerability of flood protection trends are public encroachments. With the objective of renovating the existing major bunds, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to implement a project for the development of the flood protection bunds of the Kelani River, at an estimated cost of Rs.1,000 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Multi purpose Fishery Harbours in Udappuwa, Delft, Madhagal and Chalei
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The Government has planned to establish Multi purpose Fishery Harbour Complexes so as to cover all the three fields namely the fishery, commercial and tourism. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding with the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries of the Republic of Korea, to make enable large fishing trawlers to gain access and to construct Multi purpose Fishery Harbours in Udappuwa, Delft, Madhagal and Chalei with cold storage, fish drying, packing facilities and centres for repairing fishing equipment and for the preparation of a feasibility report on constructing the above multi purpose harbours, free of charge, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Millawa Industries Cluster as Phase I of the Proposed Horana Industrial Township Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - It is proposed to establish two large industrial townships in Horana and Meerigama areas under the Western Region Megapolis Plan.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to establish the Millawa Industrial Cluster as Phase-I in the Horana Industrial Township Development Project on a Public Private Partnership basis and for the Urban Development Authority to obtain the required land for the purpose, from the Land Reform Commission, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Building for the Out Patients Department of the National Hospital of Sri Lanka (NHSL)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The National Hospital of Sri Lanka comprising of 3,300 beds and situated in a 32 acre land in Colombo is the largest hospital in the South East Asia. The Out Patients Department of the Hospital maintained in the same building where it was first established in the year 1948 and the infrastructure facilities found are inadequate to provide the necessary facilities for over 5,000 patients coming to the Department daily for treatment. As such, it has been planned to construct a new Out Patients Department Complex at the Sri Lanka National Hospital as an award of the the Republic of China.  Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to enter into an Agreement with the Republic of China to implement the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Safety Center for temporary accommodation of  people affected during a disastrous situation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The National Building and Research Organization has identified that Badulla, as a high risk landslides prone District due to intensive rainfall.  As such, it is obligatory to ensure the safety of the affected community and to construct a safety centre where the people subject to emergency disaster situations could be provided shelter. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, to acquire a land in extent of half an acre belonging to the Balangoda Plantation Company to the Ministry of Disaster Management, for the construction of a safety centre where people could be temporarily accommodated during an emergency disaster situation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Policy on Elimination of Child Labour from Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka made a commitment to eliminate child labour from Sri Lanka at the Global Child Labour Conference, held in the Hague city of the Netherlands, in the year 2010.  According to the Child Activity Survey conducted in the year 2015/2016, the number of Child Labour in Sri Lanka has been reduced by about 50% in comparison to the year 2008/2009.  As such, Sri Lanka has the potential to achieve zero tolerance in the elimination of child labour. Further, implementing a National Child Labour Policy is one of the initiatives in the Action Plan in relation to regaining the European Union's Generalized Scheme of Preferences (GSP) to the country.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, the Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, to recognize the national policy for the total elimination of child labour from Sri Lanka and to  implement same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Sri Lanka and Tajikistan for the development of Sports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of  Sri Lanka and the Government of the Republic of Tajikistan, with the objective of taking necessary measures for the development sports having identified the significant fields of sports that have acquired achievements in both the countries, during the official visit of H.E. Emomali Rahmon, the President of the Republic of Tajikistan, to Sri Lanka, scheduled between 13th to 15th of December 2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Political Consultations between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Tajikistan and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Harsha de Silva, the Acting Minister of Foreign Affairs, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding on Political Consultations between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Tajikistan and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka, with the objective of enhancing bilateral relations and cooperation in the political as well as economic, trade, scientific, technical and cultural fields, during the official visit of H.E. Emomali Rahmon, the President of the Republic of Tajikistan, to Sri Lanka, scheduled between 13th to 15th of December 2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and  Tajikistan on Cooperation in the Field of Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of  Sri Lanka and the Government of the Republic of Tajikistan, on Cooperation in the Field of Tourism, during the official visit of the President of Tajikistan to Sri Lanka, scheduled between 13th to 15th of December 2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Training Programme in Skills Development associated with the Gem & Jewellary Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The objective of the National Gem and Jewellery Research Training Institution, in widening the scope of its research and training activities, is to further enhance the contribution by the industry towards the economic development of Sri Lanka. With the objective of providing foreign employment opportunities for skilled personal in the sector, to convert the National Gem and Jewellery Research Training Institution into a Gem and Jewellery Education Institution of International standard, which could attract foreign students, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement a skilled development project to further the scope of the training opportunities provided by the institution, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Dam Safety & Water Resources Plans which could be utilized for the Future Development Activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The necessity for an updated National Water Resources Development and Management Plan for Sri Lanka, has surfaced, in order to achieve the current targets and objectives of the development of the country. The Mahaweli Master Plan has also not been updated since 1978. The three (03) Water Resource Plans namely; the National Plan of Water Usage, updated Mahaweli Water Resources Development Plan and the Integrated Water Resources Development Plan of the Mundeni Aru Basin have been prepared under the Dam Safety and Water Resources Planning Project commenced in the year 2007. Therefore, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment to treat the above mentioned plans as a National Document containing Guidelines in Water Sector Development in Sri Lanka and to keep the 03 Plans in the custody of the National Planning Department, to be used as Guidelines by any institution engaged in the Water Resources Development Field in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accommodation for the other Rankers of the Sri Lanka Army
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - Insufficient accommodation facilities available in Colombo for the staff of the Army Head Quarters and the Institutions affiliated to it and the other staff of the Army Hospital, stationed in Colombo has become a problem.  As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to construct a new building with accommodation facilities for other rankers as well, at the premises owned by the Sri Lanka Army situated at Manning Town, Narahenpita, at an estimated cost of Rs.239.12 Million, as a remedial measure to overcome the situation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Main Sewerage System in the Panagoda Army Camp
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Army Camp in Panagoda, established in the year 1952 comprises of the Security Force Head Quarters (West), 07 Regimental Centres, a Base Hospital and the quarters of the officers and other Rankers.  The Main Sewerage System in the Camp is found to be in a dilapidated condition and identified as unproductive to carry out repairs.   Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to construct a new Sewerage System in the Panagoda Army Camp, at an estimated cost of Rs.80 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new building for the use of the Army Women’s Corps
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-13
decision_details_body: - The Regiment Head Quarters of Army Women’s Corps is housed in an old building situated in an extent of 92 perches, at Kingsy Road, Borella.  Therefore, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to construct a new building instead of the old building, in the same premises, at an estimated cost of Rs.94 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Realization of a National Sustainable Development Vision of Sri Lanka - 2030
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - Realization of Sustainable Development always depends on achieving the multi sector targets.  Therefore, to achieve such targets, follow up action and evaluation activities become extremely vital. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee comprising of 05 Cabinet Ministers and a Provincial Chief Minister and an Expert Committee to assist in the functions of the Sub-Committee, for the formulation of the National Sustainable Development Vision-2030 inspired by the United Nations' 17 Sustainable Development Goals, identifying development priorities to be achieved by Sri Lanka, drawing up a time frame to achieve the identified goals, identifying the role assigned to the State, Private and Civil Society Organizations in the accomplishment of Sustainable Development Goals - 2030, and to review the progress in the realization of the identified goals and to update the sustainable development goals and the strategies after review, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Joint Cabinet Memorandum of the Ministerial Committee on the Development of Hambantota Port
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - The joint proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade and Hon.(Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Special Assignments, to develop the Hambantota Port in collaboration with the China Merchants Port Holding (CMPort) Company on a Public Private Partnership basis, on the approval given by the Hon. Attorney General in respect of the finalized Framework Agreement in accordance with the provisions of the Framework Agreement, based on the final decisions  of the the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management (CCEM) pertaining to the restructuring of the Hamabantota Port and  to confer authority on the relevant authorities to sign the Framework Agreement with the investing company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Ministerial Sub-Committee to investigate into the implementation of Gin-Nilwala Diversion Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06

description: Bilateral Instruments to be signed between Sri Lanka and Malaysia during the forthcoming official visit of H.E. the President to Malaysia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06

description: Construction of the Nuwara Eliya High Altitude Sports Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - Since, training in a high altitude increases the endurance ability of sports men and women, it is beneficial to conduct outdoor and indoor training in such a background. While emphasizing the need of a high altitude training centre for the Sri Lankan sports men and women, the Government has focused its attention on the construction of a high altitude sports complex in the Nuwara Eliya District situated 1,895 Meters above the mean sea level to meet the needs of the sports men and women of Sri Lanka and to provide high altitude training at international level for the sports men and women of the neighbouring countries as well, with a view to earning foreign exchange.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, for the Government of Sri Lanka to enter into an Agreement, with a French Company selected from the project proposals received to construct the  Nuwara Eliya High Altitude Sports Complex, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of small scale Solar Power Plants under the Soorya Bala Sangramaya - Stage 2
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - In order to cater to the increasing demand in electricity and also to ensure the energy security of the country, diversification of energy generating sources is essential.  Although there is a high demand from investors to establish Solar Power Plants, it is only 60Mw which has been recommended technologically, for absorption to the medium voltage of the National Grid during this year.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to implement a new project called 'Soorya Bala Sangramaya' - Stage 2, and to enable the selection of investors who have come forward to establish solar power plants of 1Mw for the 60Mw solar power capacity, through a competitive bidding process which is fair and transparent, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of Plant & Design - Build Contract of the Deduru Oya Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - The Deduru Oya Water Supply Project is implemented with the objective of providing an adequate supply of safe and reliable drinking water to a population living in 97 Grama Niladari Divisions in the Mahawa and Polpithigama Divisional Secretariat Divisions in the Kurunegala District.  Under this project, it is expected to provide 18,150 house connections and more than 90,800 people will be benefited by it.   Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the Plant and Design Build Contract for Civil and Mechanical and Electrical work, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of Contracts for the Buildings to be Constructed in the Jaffna & Wayamba Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contracts for the construction of a sports and exercise hall in the University of Jaffna, a science laboratory in the Wayamba University and also a building for the Agriculture and Plantation Management Faculty of the same University, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Police Information and Communication System (PICS)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval had been granted in the year 2013, for the implementation of the Police Information and Communication System (PICS).  However, due to the technological advancement of the new inventions in the field, it is observed that the overall purview of the whole system needs to be revised. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayaka, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to appoint a Steering Committee in consultation with the Ministry of Finance for a further revision of the entire compass of the project, to set apart a permanent range of frequency for the Sri Lanka Police Department, to apply 'digital' communication equipment instead of  'analogue' equipment, when the above project is established with the approval of the Telecommunication Regulatory Commission (TRC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Elimination of violence against women within the work places and  empowerment of women
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the International Agreements entered into by Sri Lanka, legal and other measures to protect and safeguard women from various forms of violence caused to them within their work places need to put in place. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, to establish Committees headed by Senior Officials of the Ministries, Departments and the Institutions functioning at the district and divisional level, to eliminate violence against women within the work places, just because of being a woman, with a view to protecting and empowering women, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Land Ownership and Proper Housing for the Plantation Community
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - At present, there are about 256,533 families living in the Estates belonging to the Regional Plantation Companies and 9,025 families in the Estates owned by the Government.  The number of houses constructed presently for these families are around 33,000 and the remaining families live in the line rooms and the temporary sheds.  In accordance with the Government policy of handing over land ownership, the joint proposal made by Hon. U. Palani Digambaram, the Minister of Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development, Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries and Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Lands, to grant transferable deeds for 07 perches of land which could be offered to banks as security to the legal residents in estates and to release the lands identified as not prone to the risk of landslides from the Regional Plantation Companies and other State Institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restoration of Madulla, Bingoda, Kolallawatta Reservoir
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - The people of the area are engaged in their farming activities depending on the Madulla, Bingoda, Kolallawatta reservoir situated in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Madulla in the Moneragla District of the Uva Province have made requests from a long time for the formal  construction of the reservoir.  Accordingly, it has been planned to restore the reservoir and to improve the land and paddy cultivation of the area and to enhance the living standards of the people with the establishment of a sustainable irrigation system.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa, the Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to construct the proposed reservoir across the Kolallawatta Aru which is a branch of the Unachchi Aru after carrying out an assessment study on the environmental impacts, at an estimated cost of Rs.320 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promotion of aquaculture on a commercial scale
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - The expectation of the Government is to derive a target income of US$ 425 Million, the raring of aquaculture of fish varieties on a commercial basis utilising high technology and exporting same by the year 2020.  As such, the Sri Lanka Aquaculture Development Authority is making an effort to attract investors engaged in aquaculture on a commercial basis utilising the latest technologies. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to identify suitable lands for the purpose and suitable waterways in the sea and the fresh water reservoirs and to lease same to suitable investors, as recommended by the Cabinet Sub-Committee appointed for making a study on this matter, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relocation of the Manning Market at Peliyagoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - Under the redevelopment programme of the Colombo City, it has been planned to relocate the Manning Market at Pettah in Peliyagoda and to construct the main building of the Multi-Mode Transport Hub in the land where the Manning Market is presently situated, as proposed under the  Western Region Megapolis Plan.  The construction work necessary for removing around 1,200 traders within the Manning Market at present and relocating them in a land belonging to the State Engineering Corporation is underway. However, since a need has arisen for the commencement of the construction work of the proposed Multi-Mode Transport Hub without any delay, until the completion of the said relocation work, it has become necessary to relocate the traders of the Manning Market expeditiously in another land.  As such, the joint proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development and Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to get an adjoining plot of land of about 06 acres belonging to the State Engineering Corporation situated in the Peliyagoda area, on lease basis, for a period of 03 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Multi-Model Transport Centre at Battaramulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - With the location of all Government administrative Institutions in the areas of Battaramulla and Sri Jayawardhanapura, Kotte under the master plan of the Megapolis and Western Development, it is important to minimize the vehicle congestion that would be created in doing so.  Due to the development activities of the future, it has been proposed to provide multi model transport facilities like Bus and light Rail Transits, elevated highways and inland water transport facilities, in order to address the upcoming transport demand of the said area.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement a mixed development project comprising of a multi model transport centre, office accommodation of 113,000 sq.ft, a 33,000 sq.ft of residential apartments and 60,000 sq.ft of commercial space under the Public and Private Partnership basis, adjoining the Battaramulla 'Suhurupaya' building, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief to the aged and sick artistes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - With a view to providing relief for the aged and sick artistes of low income who had rendered a great service to the advancement of the field of Arts by dedicating their lives for same, a welfare assistance programme implemented by the Department of Cultural Affairs, through which 1,019 artistes of such calibre are given financial aid in an annual sum of Rs.5,000/- per artiste, presently. Considering the present economic situation prevailing in the country, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs, to increase the annual aid of Rs.5,000/- provided for them to Rs.10,000/- in the year 2017 and also to increase the number of artistes of low income receiving such aid up to Rs.5,000/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Five Year Corporate Plan for Wayamba
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs has been vested with the responsibility of establishing the Wayamba Secretariat with the objective of coordinating, the economic and infrastructure facilities of development projects and the formulation and implementation of policies.  Accordingly, the five year corporate plan formulated by the Ministry under the patronage of all parties covering the period of 2017-2021 under the sectors of agriculture and irrigation, livestock, fisheries and aquaculture, tourism, human resource development, investment promotion and development of industries and the development of rural infrastructure facilities, aimed at the development of the economic and infrastructure facilities of the Wayamba Province was submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs.

description: Purchasing of a Land to Construct a Hostel for Male Students of the Institute of Indigenous Medicine, Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - The policy of the Government is to complete the process of providing hostel facilities to all University students who need hostels by the end of the year 2018.
