Although, the hostel issue of all the female students studying in the Institute of Indigenous Medicine, Rajagiriya has been addressed, the problem relating to male students studying there has been addressed through houses provided on rent basis for the time being and the permanent solution, has been identified as purchasing a land and constructing a hostel.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriwella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to purchase a plot of land in extent of 62 perches situated within the Municipal limits of Sri Jayewardhanepura, Kotte, at a cost of Rs.99.5 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Orders for the regulation of maintaining of Sea Turtle Conservation Study Centers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Fauna and Flora Protection Act, all turtle species living in the coastal belt of the Island and those living in the Sea Zones are considered as highly protected reptiles and keeping such animal in one's possession is a punishable offence. The sea turtle conservation centres in the Southern coast maintained by the private sector with the objective of bringing the sea turtle eggs from the coast and protecting them in the artificial nests prepared for the purpose and subsequently releasing the baby sea turtles so born into the sea, have been operative since 1980.  Around 15 such centres are maintained in the Southern Coast and they have become popular tourist and conservation centres. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to formalize these private turtle conservation centres further, to register the centres in the Department of Wild Life Conservation and provide provision to regulate them granting permission to operate under annual permits and to publish the Orders prepared under the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance Act, in a Gazette Notification, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Tunnel of the Upper Elehara Canal under the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Program
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - The objective of Stage I of the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Program is to improve the agro-economic crop production of the area providing Mahaweli water for agricultural activities, drinking water and commercial activities in the North Central and North Western Provinces.  Under this programme, it has been planned to construct a 65.5km long canal from Moragahakanda reservoir to Huruluwewa Reservoir, capable of conveying 974 Million Cu.m. of water per year.  In designing the canal a section in extent of 26 km long has been designed to trace through the Giritale and Minneriya sanctuary and the forest reserves.  The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to construct the said part as a tunnel section, to minimize the damage caused to the environment and wild animals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a New Bill to prevent the infiltration of dangerous and invading plants and animal species and for their destruction
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka holds a premier position among the countries where bio-diversity is rampant.  Hence, it has become essential to protect the natural environment network of the country and also to conserve the plants and animal species inherent to the country.  Studies on invasive alien organisms have revealed that the existing laws are inadequate to control the threats caused to the bio-diversity of Sri Lanka, from invading plants and animal species. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to instruct the Legal Draftsman, to draft a new Act, making provisions to prevent the infiltration of dangerous and invading plants and animal species to Sri Lanka and to destroy such plants and animals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal for Liquidating the Rakna Arakshaka Lanka Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-12-06
decision_details_body: - Due to the state of the national security that prevailed in the Island it was essential to deploy the Army personnel to the duties in respect of law and order, by removing such personnel from the duties assigned at public and private institutions, economical nerve centres and other special institutions. Accordingly, the Rakna Arakshaka Lanka Limited was established as a security service affiliated to the Government for providing protection for the said institutions. However, due to the peaceful environment prevalent at present, it is observed that a state owned private security service is no longer required.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to transfer the Ground Defence activities to the Civil Security Service Department and the Marine Security activities to the Sri Lanka Navy, was approved by the Cabinet in principle.

description: Extension of the concessionary period granted for the registration of transfer at the time of change of possession of motor vehicles subject to a surcharge, up to 2016?12?31
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The concessionary period of 03 months granted by the Cabinet for registration of transfers at the time of change of possession of motor vehicles subject to a surcharge is due to expire on 2016-11-30.  Therefore, due to a large number of persons coming to the department for registration of transfer of these vehicles a great congestion has been created, presently, in the official functions of the department.   As such, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to extend the concessionary period by a further one month up to 2016-12-31, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a building for the Attorney General's Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - Acknowledging that the space available at the Attorney General's Department is in adequate to conduct its affairs without hindrance, approval has been granted by the Cabinet to construct a new building within the Superior Court Complex premises itself. Accordingly, the initial work in the construction of the new building has already been completed. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to award the contract for the construction of the remaining part of the proposed new building as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sand nourishment project in the Marawila Beach (Phase II)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The Phase II of the sand nourishment project implemented for pumping sand to minimize the coastal erosion of the Marawila beach has already commenced.  As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to pump an additional 400,000 Cu.m of sand for the nourishment of an extra area for the long term stability of the Marawila-Thalawila beach line, making use of the balance provision available under this project for 2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of the office allowance for Members of Parliament and enhancement of the Parliament sitting allowance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Parliamentary Reforms and Mass Media, to grant a monthly allowance of Rs.100,000/- to all Hon. Members of Parliament including the Members  appointed under the National List to cover the expenses borne on  maintenance of an office, and to enhance the Parliament sitting allowance from Rs.500 to Rs.2,500/- with effect from January 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Court Complex of Wattala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approval has been granted to award the contract for the construction of Phase I of the Wattala Court Building Complex to the Sri Lanka State Engineering Corporation, at an estimated cost of Rs.156.18 Million. Presently, all Court functions of the Wattala Courts are conducted in a part of the Mahara Court Complex.  In order to provide a better service to all persons access the services of the Wattala Courts it is imperative that the project is completed expeditiously.  Accordingly, The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to award the contract to the Sri Lanka State Engineering Corporation to construct Phase II of the Court Complex at a cost of Rs.148.29 Million, incorporating certain requirements identified as pre-requites to be included in Phase II of the Court Complex, construction of Phase I, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of two Wind Power Plants at the Chunnakam area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The Government has focused its attention to fulfil the greater part of the electricity demand by using renewable energy sources and in this regard, it has been proposed to construct wind power plants.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to construct two wind power plants of 10 Mw each, in the Chunnakam area, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Greater Colombo Transmission and Distribution Loss Reduction Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The Greater Colombo Transmission and Distribution Loss Reduction Project is implemented under the loan facilities of the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), with a view to contributing to the economic development in the region by strengthening the transmission and distribution capacity and enhancing the transmission and distribution network in the Greater Colombo area for increasing the reliability of power supply and reducing transmission losses. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for the supply of specially made vehicles required for the distribution work under Package 3 of the project, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC),  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of partially completed projects in the areas of Tangalle, Angunukolapellessa and Middeniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to complete the partially done construction work of the projects pertaining to Tangalle and Angunukolapellessa Commercial Complex and the Side Walks under Middeniya Town Development through the new contractors selected after a competitive bidding process, at an estimated cost of Rs.60.8 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Badulla-Chenkalady Road - Road sections from Badulla to Passara and Passara to Lunugala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contracts for improving the road sections of 20 km in length from Badulla to Passara and 21 km in length from Passara to Lunugala, under the Badulla-Chenkalady Road development project funded by the OPEC Fund for International Development (OFID), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Research and Training Complex at the Faculty of Agriculture in the University of Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for consultancy services of the above project funded by the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procuring 1,000 new 40-46 seater (2x2) high back, buses for the Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - Bids were invited for repairing 1,000 old buses of the Sri Lanka Transport Board but since the repairing cost of a bus, in accordance with the responses received was almost equal to the cost of procuring a new bus, it was found that repairing is not economically productive.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to suspend the project for the repairing of 1,000 buses and instead to purchase 40-46 seater (2x2) high back, 1,000 new passenger buses, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of 100 Housing Units to the Sri Lanka Police from the ‘Nila Sevana’ Project at Wekunagoda, Galle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - ‘Nila Sevana’ Project at Wekunagoda, Galle is a project jointly carried out under a tripartite Agreement by the Board of Investment, Ministry of Public Administration and Management and the Private Sector. The proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayaka, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, seeking the allocation of Treasury Funds of Rs.333 to the Sri Lanka Police to provide 100 units from the said Project to the Police personnel such as Police Constables, Police Sergeants and Police Officers in the Inspector Grades serving in the Galle area needing housing facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The construction of a New National School with Multi-ethnic and Tri-lingual Education in the Polonnaruwa District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval to commence a new school in the Kaduruwela town starting from Grade 6 including all facilities, since the space available in the Royal College of Polonnaruwa is inadequate to provide an opportunity for all the children of the Polonnaruwa District who get through the Grade 5 scholarship examination, to be admitted to the Grade 6 of the Royal College of Polonnaruwa.  It has been estimated that an approximate sum of Rs.1,200 Million will have to be spent to construct this new Model National College which is expected to be operative with Multi-ethnic and Tri-lingual Education with a view to ensuring national reconciliation.   Out of this sum, about Rs.900 Million will be borne by the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of India has agreed to provide the balance of Rs.300 Million.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with the Republic of India, to obtain the financial aid agreed upon and also to implement the construction work of this school with the coordination of the Ministry of Education, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Memorandum of Understanding for employment of Sri Lankans in Malaysia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval in the year 2015 to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Malaysia to establish a methodology facilitating the recruitment and employment of domestic workers and other workers for employment in Malaysia in such manner as to safeguard the rights of such migrant workers.  The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalata Atukorala, the Minister of Foreign Employment, to sign the Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Human Resources of the Government of Malaysia and the Ministry of Foreign Employment of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, prepared incorporating the subsequent amendments as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Protecting houses of the Sobasiripura Housing Scheme under the threat of Landslide
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The National Building Research Organization has shown that a considerable number of houses in the Sobasiripura Housing Scheme constructed in the Seethawaka Divisional Secretariat Division of the Colombo District under the 'Semata Sevena Model Villages Programme' by the National Housing Development Authority could be subject to the threat of landslide. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to get funds allocated from General Treasury required for taking the preliminary steps to protect the houses of the Sobasiripura Housing Scheme subject to the threat of landslide, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal for Setting up of a Meter Enclosure Manufacturing Factory
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The Ceylon Electricity Board and the Lanka Electricity (Pvt) Company (LECO) require more than 250,000 meter enclosures annually.  These are presently obtained from the open market via a competitive bidding process and due to the scarcity of the items which occur at various instances, it has not be possible to fulfil the customer demand.  As a remedial measure in this regard, the  proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, for the Sri Lanka Energies (Pvt) Ltd. affiliated to the Ceylon Electricity Board to establish a Meter Enclosure Manufacturing Factory in the Galigamuwa industrial zone in the Kegalle District and to provide the Meter Enclosures so produced to the Ceylon Electricity Board and the Lanka Electricity (Pvt) Company, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: A land for the construction of the District Sports Complex at Dadalle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - With the conversion of the public playground in Galle into an International Cricket Stadium, a land in extent of 17 Acres at Dadalla has been identified to be developed as a public playground.  Land filling and  the preliminary construction activities of the playground have been completed and the construction of a 400 meter track and a swimming pool is in progress. Therefore, the joint proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development and Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to obtain a sum of Rs.400 Million from the General Treasury to complete the land acquisition process to enable the expeditious completion of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a land to construct the Head Quarters of the Sri Lanka Amarapura Nikayabhiwurdhi Dayaka Sabhawa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - There are around 3,700 temples connected to the Sri Lanka Amarapura Nikaya spread throughout the country where nearly 12,000 Bikkus reside. Considering the request made by the Sri Lanka Amarapura Nikayabhiwurdhi Dayaka Sabhawa for a plot of land to build its Head Quarters, in order to extend its religious activities in the country as well as internationally, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to release a plot of land in extent 2 Roods and 4.2 perches, situated in the Sri Jayawardhenapura Hospital Road, owned by the Urban Development Authority, to the Sri Lanka Amarapura Nikayabhiwurdhi Dayaka Sabhawa as a free grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the New Utility & Infrastructure facilities needed for the Development of  the Western Region Megapolis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29

description: Construction of a Student Hostel for the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The Ceylon German Technical Training Institute (the German Tech) established under German financial aid, presently conducts 10 full time training courses and around 2,000 students from various parts of the Island are engaged in following them.  Action is being taken to increase the intake of students by a further 200 by the end of year 2017.  It is important to provide hostel facilities to the students to create a proper learning environment necessary for a qualitative education and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to construct a 05 storeyed hostel building for the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute in the Attidiya area of Dehiwala to accommodate around 1,000 students, at an estimated cost of Rs.280 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new Building for the National Lotteries Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The National Lotteries Board contributes a large sum of money to the Consolidated Fund of the Government but its head office is housed in a  building obtained on annual rental basis at a cost of Rs.17.5 Million.  The space available in the building is also inadequate to conduct the operations of the organization. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to construct a new building for the National Lotteries Board in the land owned by the Board in Vauxhall Street, Colombo 02, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Quarantine and Prevention of Diseases Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - It is necessary to establish the legislative framework in the country to facilitate the operation of health strategies to prevent the spread of international diseases in a background where global links are created which generate major population flows along trade, tourism and labour in and out of the country.  In the International Health Regulations (IHR-2005) to which Sri Lanka has become a signatory, provides a public health response to the international spread of diseases in ways that are commensurate with and restricted to public health risks, for the prevention of the spread of international diseases and their control and for the protection from such diseases, and avoid unnecessary interference with international traffic and trade. As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to make the necessary amendments to the Quarantine and Prevention of diseases Ordinance presently in force in Sri Lanka to capture all the relevant articles of the said regulations for the implementation in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Priority Water Supply Projects in the Western Region Megapolis Area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The Government has accorded priority to fulfil the necessary utility services to meet the needs of the growing population of the Western Region Megapolis Area.  97.3% of the population in the Western Region has access to safe water supply and 57.5% of them receive pipe borne water supply services.  The 19 water treatment plants found in this region purify 1,078,520 Cu.m. of water per day. Based on the projected population of 8.7 Million in 2030 the demand for water is expected to grow up to about 2,200,000 Cu.m. per day for which new water supply schemes will have to be implemented.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to implement 05 new water supply schemes to cover Colombo and its immediate suburbs of the Western Region, Industrial Township of Meerigama, the proposed Aero city at Meerigama, Diwulapitiya, Homagama, Horana and the surrounding areas, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prohibition of touting within the Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The touts at the Arrival Lobby and the Porch Area considered as public areas at the Bandaranaike International Airport are engaged in providing unauthorized transport facilities, money changing and baggage loading and illegal activities and this has caused much difficulties to the  passengers as well as the Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) Ltd.  As the existing legislation is inadequate to control the situation, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to amend the Civil Aviation Act, No.14 of 2010 to prevent touting at the premises of the Airport by various persons, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the ‘Ranaviru Resource Centre’ at Hendala which provides vocational training to the disabled war heroes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - The ‘Ranaviru Resource Centre’ situated at Hendala is in operation from the year 2010 as an institution which provides vocational training to the war heroes who had been disabled in the battle grounds, for the purpose of creating the necessary environment for them to lead a dignified life  within the civil society. More than 09 vocational training courses are implemented with the infrastructure facilities provided for in the 1st phase of the institution.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence,  to construct 05 new buildings in the 2nd phase and on completion of the necessary infrastructure facilities to increase the number of training courses up to 15 to elevate the ‘Ranaviru Resource Centre’ as a formal vocational training centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Defence College (NDC), Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - A proposal has been made to establish a National Defence College in Sri Lanka, with the objective of linking Sri Lanka strategically with the global trends, to bring both local and foreign Defence scholars together to share their experiences at a central platform and provide a formal training in strategic level aspects of security to a greater number of officers of the Forces as well as civil officers.  Accordingly, considering the importance of establishing the academy in the vicinity of Colombo, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to establish it in the premises of 'Mumtaz Mahal', the official residence formally used by the Speaker to the Parliament having made suitable renovations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Domestic Airline Service through Public-Private Joint Venture Partnership
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-29
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to establish a Domestic Airline Service for civil passenger transportation through Public-Private Joint Venture Partnership in accordance with the criteria laid down by the International Civil Aviation Authority.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to call for proposals from a larger number of persons from the private sector with adequate financial stability, with a view to selecting a suitable investor to commence a joint venture with the Sri Lanka Air Force, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of a National Insurance Day
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to declare 1st of September of every year as the 'National Insurance Day', with the objective of making the people of Sri Lanka aware of the importance of insurance and encouraging the possession of a basic insurance cover for every family in the case of death, disease and property damages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of Urban Interconnected Roads
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - It is essential to develop the roads that connect urban areas, in order to minimize vehicle congestion in Western Province and develop the regional transport infrastructure facilities. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to carpet and improve 26 interconnected roads of about 30 km in total length where vehicular traffic continues amidst difficulties due to extremely dilapidated conditions, at a cost of Rs.208.5 million, in the areas of Colombo, Moratuwa, Mahara and Avissawella through the Provincial Road Development Authority (Western Province) as recommended by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National Border Management Committee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - Controlling the Borders of a country is of paramount importance for the National Security of that country and reflects the safeguards on sovereignty of a country.  The number of people traveling across the Sri Lankan border and the amount of goods exchanged across are continuously on the rise and  as such,  it is expected that a 10 million of people and over 200 million kg. of goods will move across the border of Sri Lanka  in 2020.  Therefore, the proper management of such activities carried out across the border is really important for the maintenance of national security, social order and economic prosperity of the country. Therefore, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to establish a 'National Border Management Committee' comprising of Senior Government Officials / Policy Makers to perform as the Central State Agency in the assessment of risks, priorities and targets, focusing on all facets of Border Management of Sri Lanka, which is presently carried out by several agencies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of Drugs administered to patients for low blood pressure
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to award the tender for the purchase of 7,200,000 Bottles of 500 ml Sodium Chloride Intravenous Infusion BP 0.95 w/v or Sodium Chloride Injection USP,  0.95 w/v, used in blood volume reduction of patients, as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of 820,000 of Blue Base Dry Imagine Films (35 cm x 43 cm) used for X-Ray Machines in Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to award the tender for the purchase of 820,000 of Blue Base Dry Imagine Films (35 cm x 43 cm) used in Fuji Laser Printers in X-Ray Machines at Government Hospitals as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of Equipment used to Inject Drugs to Patients
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to award the tender for the purchase of I.V. Cannula (with and without Injection Port) in various sizes, used to inject drugs to patients,  as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the Non Revenue Water Management and Construction Supervision Consultancy Contract
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, for awarding the contract for the Non Revenue Water Management and the Construction Supervision Consultancy Contract of  project 1 implemented under the Asian Development Bank assisted  Greater Colombo Water and Wastewater Management Improvement Investment Programme, for reducing pipe-borne water leakages and managing the non revenue water within Colombo and the suburbs, in a more efficient and productive manner, with the objective of improving the water supply services in the areas of  Colombo North and Colombo East, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Contract for System Rehabilitation for the reduction of Non Revenue Water of the Southern Part of the Colombo City
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, for awarding the contract for system rehabilitation of  project 2 implemented under the Asian Development Bank assisted  Greater Colombo Water and Wastewater Management Improvement Investment Programme, for reducing pipe-borne water leakages non revenue water within Colombo and the suburbs, with the objective of improving the water supply services in the areas of  Colombo South and Colombo West, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Equipment required for the Combat Convoy Battalion for peacekeeping operations in Mali
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka expects to post a Combat Convoy Battalion for UN peacekeeping operations in Mali and as such, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to award the contract for the supply of  demining and explosive ordnance disposal equipment, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of Sports Shoes for the Sri Lanka Army
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to award the contract, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee for the purchase of  200,000 pairs of Sports Shoes necessary for the Sri Lanka Army, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of Residential facilities of  the Police Special Task Force Officers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The non‑availability of adequate residential facilities for Officers of the Special Task Force of the Sri Lanka Police deployed for special security services in Colombo and the surrounding areas, has caused a problem.  As a remedial measure for the issue, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to remove a dilapidated barrack situated in the Gonahena Camp Premises and construct a three storeyed building in its place which could facilitate the accommodation of 250 Officers at an estimated cost of Rs.75.9 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Land Subsidence at Achchuveli in the Jaffna District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - A land subsidence incidence in the farming lands of the Achchuveli area has been reported and cracks developing on the ground in the affected location over a prolonged period have also been noticed. Since the land in the area is composed of limestone it is prone to form cavities and caverns.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement and Hindu Religious Affairs, for the National Building Research Organization to make a further study to clarify and confirm the cause of this situation, to enable decision making with regard to the future land use and development taking into consideration the sinking of land would have long-term repercussions on land use practices and  human settlements in future, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Initiating Public Consultation Process on Media Standards and Entitlements
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to establish an Independent Commission to regulate the news content of the print media, broadcast media (Television and Radio) and locally registered Websites, in accordance with internationally recognized professional standards and practices, with the objective of promoting high professional and ethical standards in news media, while ensuring a free, independent and diverse media. Hence, the proposal made by Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Parliamentary Reforms and Mass Media to conduct a comprehensive public consultation process for the implementation of the above proposal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act, No.25 of 2002 provides for the provision of assistance by Sri Lanka to other countries in respect of criminal activities in those countries and vice versa, when combating transnational crime and strengthening of prevention of crime. Considering the recent development standards relevant to this field, concerning identification of money laundering, criminalization of   bribery as a mandatory measure to combat corruption as indicated in Article 16 of the United Nations Convention against Corruption, criminal offences related to computer systems and data, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice to amend the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act reflecting Sri Lanka's international obligations in relation to criminal investigations and confiscation of criminal proceeds, was approved by the  Cabinet.

description: Minimizing of the delays experienced in Court Procedures by Providing for Pre?Trial Procedure
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The Public has to face great difficulties due to the delays caused in Court Procedure.  Although several measures have been adopted from time to time to overcome this situation, a large number of Cases are still piled up   in Courts.  The Cabinet has already given approval to introduce Pre‑Trial Procedure in order to solve this problem.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice to publish the Civil Procedure Code (Amendment) Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman and given clearance by the Attorney General, in the Government Gazette and present it in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Seed and Planting Material Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - It has been scientifically confirmed that the quality of harvesting and productivity could be increased through ensuring the availability of quality seeds and planting material.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture to implement projects to ensure the availability of high quality seed and planting material required for assuring sustainability of agricultural and food security of the country, utilizing the lands belonging to the Department of Agriculture and the Institutions coming under it, which have not been used for any productive purpose, with public‑private partnership participation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of charges for the services rendered by the Department of Registrar of Companies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce to present the Gazette Extraordinary No.1990/12 dated 2016‑10‑25 issued by the Hon. Minister,  revising the fees for the services rendered by the Department of Registrar of Companies under the provisions of the Companies Act, No.07 of 2007 and the Societies Ordinance, No.16 of 1891 as amended by the Act, No.11 of 2005, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Herbal Cultivation Project for the Production of High Standard Ayurveda Medicinal Raw Materials
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - According to data from the Department of Ayurveda,  60% of the annual raw materials used for local and Ayurvedic medicines are met out of importations.  As a remedial measure, the Budget of 2016 proposed to commence a short term herbal plant cultivation to meet the demand for medicinal raw materials.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine to initiate a farmer participatory herbal plant cultivation project for the production of high standard medicinal raw materials centered around the districts of Ratnapura, Kurunegala, Anuradhapura, Moneragala and Galle and for the marketing network of the Sri Lanka Ayurvedic Drugs Corporation to purchase the medicinal raw materials produced in the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Sri Lanka Institute of Digital Health Innovation & Commercialization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - Convergence of the genomic medicine and information and communication technologies are referred to as Digital Health and it is making a paradigm shift in the field of health-care for higher quality delivery of services,  superior outcomes and lower costs. In the recent past, a steep increase in the amount of global investment is shown in the Digital Health Sector and the future of the Health-care Sector will depend on the Digital Health Innovation.  In this context, with a view to reaping maximum benefits to Sri Lanka, the proposal made by Hon.  Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, for the establishment of the 'Sri Lanka Institute of Digital Health Innovation and Commercialization' as a Public‑Private Partnership to make enable to build network with the world recognized commercial and research organizations in order to foster high quality innovations with the use of modern digital and genomic technology, was approved by the Cabinet as a matter of principle.

description: National Quality Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The initial quality policy for improving the quality of goods and services in Sri Lanka was implemented in the year 1998.  Considering the ongoing extensive development activities in Sri Lanka, at present and the objectives of the government, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research for the implementation of the "National Quality Policy" formulated, focusing  on the health, education, highways, transport and trade & commerce  sectors  and taking into consideration the views expressed by the representatives of those sectors and adopting a broad/strong participatory approach, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the International Labour Organization Recommendation 204  in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, the Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations to present the 'Recommendation 204', adopted at the 104th session of the International  Labour Conference, concerning the transition from the informal to the formal economy,  in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of the Global Positioning System for Train Operations with more efficiency and safety
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The necessity for the introduction of Modern Technology for Sri Lanka Railways to bring out improvement in the efficiency and safety of train operations, has been identified.  Accordingly, with a view to accruing benefits to both the Sri Lanka Railways and the General Public, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation to procure Train Operating and Information System (TOIS) based on the Global Positioning System (GPS) from the Ministry of Defence through which the exact locations and speed of trains could be viewed more preciously on global information based maps and combining it with the existing train time indicating system, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing the fine imposed against persons operating buses without valid passenger permits
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - In order to  enhance the quality of the passenger bus services and also to prevent people being subject to dangerous situations, a necessity has arisen to strengthen the existing laws against those who deploy buses without the valid passenger permits.  Therefore,  the Cabinet has granted approval to increase the minimum fine of Rs.10,000/- presently imposed by Magistrate Courts to Rs.200,000/- against those who operate bus services without a valid Passenger Transport Permit issued by the National Transport Commission. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to present the National Transport (Amendment) Act, amending section 40 of the National Transport Commission Act, No.37 of 1991 for this purpose, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ensuring the protection and well-being of the tamed elephants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance provides for owners of domesticated elephants to register such elephants with the Department of Wildlife Conservation and obtain an annual license in order to keep them in their possession. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to publish the Orders in terms of the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance, with the objective of ensuring the protection and well being of the registered elephants and relating to the specifications on the places where such elephants are kept, maintenance of good health conditions, the responsibility of the owners and keepers of such elephants, caring for the calves of the registered she-elephants, harnessing them in work, breeding, using them in processions and decorating them with attire and ornaments etc., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Exploration and Assessment of Gem Deposits in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - Although, it has been assessed that gem deposits are spread over 70% of the total land area of Sri Lanka, gem mining is concentrated only to a limited area of 10%. Therefore, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment to implement the project planned for the Exploration and Assessment of gem deposits in Sri Lanka, with a view to identifying the insitu gem deposits which have not been explored as yet, by developing a gem potential database including maps and introducing an eco‑friendly mining methodologies and preparation of guidelines for sustainable gem mining operations during the period from 2017 to 2021, under three phases, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Third Phase of the Army Hospital Project (Narahenpita)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The construction of the 1st and the 2nd phases of the project for relocation of the Army Hospital at Narahenpita which was located in the Army Headquarters, has been completed. In order to upgrade it as a state‑of‑the art Hospital, plans have been made to continue with the 3rd phase of the Hospital for the construction of three new building complexes, with specialized medical facilities and accommodation facilities for Medical Officers and as well as other Officers, and storage and maintenance facilities.  As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to implement the 3rd phase of the Army Hospital Project at an estimated cost of Rs.7,088.32 Million and to commence its construction work in the year 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuation of the Anti-Corruption Committee Secretariat
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-22
decision_details_body: - The attention of the Government has been drawn for restructuring the Anti‑Corruption Committee structure and it has been proposed to establish a fully‑powered Serious Frauds Office, similar to the Serious Fraud Office of the United Kingdom.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister to continue the operations of the Anti‑Corruption Committee Secretariat (ACCS) established in 2015, to receive complaints regarding serious frauds and corruption and to facilitate the related investigations, until such time that, a new anti‑corruption structure is introduced, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commemoration of the Second Anniversary of the President's Inauguration in Office
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-15
decision_details_body: - H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena informed the Cabinet of Ministers that he has advised all public institutions to commemorate the Second Anniversary of his inauguration in Office which falls on 2017-01-08, without much celebrations but to make arrangements to commence the projects envisaged in the Budget 2017 which could be implemented expeditiously and also to initiate development programmes to coinside with the commemoration which would yield beneficial results to the general public.

description: Entry into three (03) Term Contracts for the Purchase of Refined Petroleum Products
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-15
decision_details_body: - Since the period of the existing long term contracts for the purchase of Refined Petroleum Products have expired, the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation has invited bids from the registered suppliers separately for 03 long term contracts, with a view to procuring all petroleum products through long term tenders. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Chandima Weerakkody, the Minister of Petroleum Resources Development, to award the 03 long term contracts for the period from 2016-12-01 up to 2017-07-31, in accordance with the recommendation of the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SSCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Consultancy Services for the Supervision of the construction of Section 2  from Meerigama to Kurunegala of the Central Expressway Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-15
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for Consultancy Services for the Supervision of Construction of Section 2 from Meerigama to Kurunegala (39.29 km) of the Central Expressway Project, in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Consultant Procurement Committee (CPCC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulation of a long-term National Fisheries Policy and Action Plan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-15
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, for a 03 year project with the technical assistance of the Government of Norway, with a view to formulating a long-term National Fisheries Policy and Action Plan, to implement foreign training programmes for the capacity building of the fisheries officers of Sri Lanka and to promote investment by the Government of Norway in the fisheries and aquatic sector in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The establishment of a Marine Finfish/Shellfish Hatchery Farm for Research
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-15
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to allocate a 05 acre block of land situated at Kandakuliya, Kalpitiya, to the National Aquatic Resources and Development Agency (NARA), to conduct research in the development of technology for breeding high quality and economically important aquatic organisms such as Crab, Sea cucumber, Bivalve, Finfish/Shellfish species, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Joint Ventures of Private Public Partnership initiative for the expansion of the local Pharmaceutical manufacturing industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-15
decision_details_body: - A large quantity of the required pharmaceuticals to the country is imported and the Government has to incur a large amount of foreign exchange in this regard, annually. As a remedial measure to overcome this situation, it has been proposed to initiate Joint Venture projects for the expansion of the local pharmaceutical manufacturing industry. As such, in accordance with the recommendations of the Officials' Committee appointed to examine the matter, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to promote investors, to initiate joint ventures with the State Pharmaceutical Corporation for manufacturing of Pharmaceuticals of good quality at a minimum cost, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Protection of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-15
decision_details_body: - The Protection of the Rights of the Persons with Disabilities Act, No.28 of 1996 is implemented as a legal framework for securing the rights of the persons with disabilities living in Sri Lanka.  On 8 February, 2016 Sri Lanka ratified the 'United Nations Convention of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities'. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, the Minister of Social Empowerment and Welfare, to amend the Act, No.28 of 1996 for the Protection of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities to secure 30 Rights including the general principles stipulated in the above Convention and to establish an Independent Commission in place of the 'National Council' established under the above Act, with a view to providing a greater service for the Persons with Disabilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Making Use of the Mahaweli Economic Zones for the Development of Renewable Energy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-15
decision_details_body: - As a Member State of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climatic Change (UNFCCC), Sri Lanka is committed to minimizing the emission of Green House Gasses. The energy sector plays a major role in  minimizing the emission of Green House Gasses and in this context, the Government has recognized the need to develop wind power, hydro power and solar power energy instead of resorting to thermal power stations of diesel and coal.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to identify the lands, reservoirs and water sources which cannot be utilized for agriculture in the Mahaweli Economic Zones belonging to the Sri Lanka Mahaweli Authority and to grant approval as a matter of policy to establish floating solar power production units, including power stations using all renewable eco-friendly energy sources and also to appoint an Officials' Committee to propose a suitable mechanism in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extradition Treaty between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Belarus
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-15
decision_details_body: - For the purpose of effective cooperation between the two countries in the prevention and suppression of crime and facilitating cooperation between them, in the extradition of accused persons/offenders to the relevant countries, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to enter into an Extradition Treaty between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Belarus, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Policy on Construction
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The construction industry which is a major contributor to the national economy also a major driver of employment creation.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to adopt the national policy for construction and its implementation mechanism, prepared by the National Advisory Council, on construction, under the provision of the Construction Industry Development Act, No.33 of 2014, with the objective of providing strategic leadership for all stakeholders in the construction industry, stimulating sustainable growth, reforms and improvement, promoting energy efficient and environment friendly building materials and systems, appropriate research, dissemination of information on research activities,  formulating standards and codes of conduct and practices and promoting of export of construction services, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of two Regional Consular Offices in Matara and Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval for the establishment of two Regional Consular Offices of the Foreign Ministry in Matara and Vavuniya.  However, having taken into consideration, the matters pointed out by the Political Authority of the Northern Province that it is the people of the Jaffna District who constitute mostly of those who regularly seek consular assistance and with the objective of providing the consular assistance to a larger sector of the people living in the Northern Province, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, for the establishment of the Regional Consular Office in Jaffna instead of Vavuniya, where it was scheduled to be established earlier, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka on the 'Recent Economic Developments': 'Highlights of 2016' and the 'Prospects for 2017'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to present, the Bi-Annual Report, in order to facilitate discussion on the Annual Budget, prepared by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka on the 'Recent Economic Developments': 'Highlights of 2016' and the 'Prospects for 2017' in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new Seven Storeyed Building at the Ananda College, Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - To ensure the safety of the lives of children, the approval of the Cabinet has been granted for the construction of a new Seven Storeyed Building at the Ananda College, Colombo, after removing the five storeyed 'Moor' building which was found to be sinking.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to award the relevant contract as recommended by the Procurement Appeals Board (PAB) and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply and Installation of Operation Theater/ICU Equipment for the Epilepsy Unit at the National Hospital of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - It is essential to provide Operation Theater/ICU Equipment for the Epilepsy Unit newly established at the National Hospital of Sri Lanka in order to provide high quality healthcare services. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the procurement to the relevant bidders, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) and to invite fresh bids for the lots not quoted with offers and with requests to increase the prices after extension of bid security, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the supply of 7,000,000 sets of equipment used for Injecting drugs to patients
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the tender for the supply of 7,000,000 sets of Disposable Intravenous solution giving  for single use for injecting drugs to patients, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the supply of Vials for treatment of patients with immunity deficiencies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the tender for the supply of 30,000 Vials of 5-6g of Human Immunoglobulin, for treatment to the patients with immunity deficiency, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the supply of Anti Biotic Drugs required by the Governmebnt Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the tender for the supply of 19,000,000 Co-Amoxiclav Tablets BP 625mg or Amoxicillian and Clavulanate Pottassium Tablets USP 625 mg, which are widely used antibiotic drugs as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the Cardiology Unit of the National Hospital, Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The Cardiology Unit of the National Hospital of Sri Lanka provides an immense service to cure the heart patients with various types of cardiac complications, coming from all over the island.  Since the building complex where the Cardiology Unit of the National Hospital is housed is in a dilapidated condition, the Cabinet has already granted approval to renovate the building. After the commencement of the renovation activities, considering the new proposals made by the specialists attached to the Cardiac Unit, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, for installing of a Central Air condition Network for the building complex to enable successful surgeries to be performed on patients, carry out other repairs which are absolutely necessary and also to modernize the Cardiac Unit, at a revised estimated cost of Rs.186.32 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Infrastructure Facilities at the State Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The Government has accorded high priority to develop the available space and the infrastructure facilities of the State Universities and to provide the students engaged in studies in these Universities with a qualitative higher education.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to implement the project for the development of infrastructure facilities of the Bhiksu University of Sri Lanka, the Universities of Wayamba & Ruhuna and also the Sri Palee Campus of the University of Colombo and the Trincomalee Campus of the Eastern University, at an estimated cost of Rs.2,670 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding of the contract for the construction of the section from Meerigama to Kurunegala of the Central Expressway Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The Section 2 of of the Central Expressway starts from Meerigama and runs up to Kurunegala, a length of 39.29 km.  Considering the volume of work involved in the section, the contract has been divided into 04 civil work packages. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract of the 04 civil work packages, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee (CANC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of 10 Diesel Electric Locomotives to Sri Lanka Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - With a view to providing a more efficient Railway transport service to the people, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the procurement of 10 Diesel Electric Locomotives to the Sri Lanka Railway Department under the Indian Line of Credit, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee (CANC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion to the Departure Public Concourse at the Bandaranayke International Airport (BIA), Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the expansion of the Departure Public Concourse at BIA, Katunayake, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Arrivals Passenger Terminal Building at the Bandaranayke International Airport (BIA), Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the construction of  the New Immigration Hall and the Electronic Mall, at the Arrivals Passenger Terminal Building at the BIA, Katunayake as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prohibition of Cinnamon imports to Sri Lanka and the Amendment of Re-export Procedures of Spices
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka Cinnamon has been able to acquire a long standing reputation due to its unique quality, aroma, taste, flavour and colour.  However, there has been reports recently of incidents of importing cinnamon to Sri Lanka from various countries and re-exporting same which has adversely affected the reputation of the Sri Lanka Cinnamon (Ceylon Cinnamon) in the global market.  Having taken this situation into consideration, the proposal made by Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Primary Industries, to band the import of cinnamon to Sri Lanka from other countries and taking into consideration, the importance of reviewing the Re-export Procedure through Sri Lanka Ports, to appoint an Officials' Committee, to amend the scheme for Temporary Importation for Exporting Processing (TIEP),  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project for Construction of the Peradeniya Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - Although, it was planned to initiate the development activities in the year 2008 of the Peradeniya Police Station which is housed in an area, where there is a large local as well as foreign population, the construction work has not been carried out so far due to various reasons.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to launch the project for constructing a state-of-the art Police Station at Peradeniya to suit the present day needs, at an estimated cost of Rs.141 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Baddegama, Wanathawilluwa, Meegahathenna and Katupotha Police Stations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - With a view to providing a more efficient service to the general public, a programme for constructing Police Stations with new facilities is being presently implemented. Under this programme, in addition to the renovation of the existing Police Stations, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, for the construction of new buildings for the Baddegama, Wanathawilluwa, Meegahathenna and Katupotha Police Stations housed in rented out buildings or very old buildings, at an estimated cost of Rs.370.3 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resettlement of Landless Internally Displaced (IDP) Families residing in Welfare Centres
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - Measures are being taken by the Government to accelerate the resettlement activities of the IDP families residing in the Welfare Centres.  There are, presently, 971 such families residing in the Welfare Centres in the Jaffna District and measures have been taken to resettle 462 families out of these 682 landless families, in alternative lands and there still have 220 families for whom lands remain to be identified for resettlement.  Since there is a scarcity of state lands in the Jaffna District, it has been proposed  to purchase private lands so as to provide 20 perches of land per family  in order to resettle the 220 families.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement and Hindu Religious Affairs, to allocate a maximum sum of Rs.88 Million, to purchase the private lands required for the purpose, through the District Secretary Jaffna, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-calling of Nominations of the Pudukuduirippu and the Maritimepattu Pradeshiya Sabhas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The elections of the Pudukuduirippu and the Maritimepattu Pradeshiya Sabhas in the Mulativu District was scheduled to be held on 2011-03-17  but due to various reasons, the elections had to be postponed from time to time.  Although, the elections were postponed, the nominations submitted are in force even by now.  Hence, a necessity for re-calling nominations, has arisen due to demise of the candidate who have submitted nominations or the candidate exceeding the age of 35 years who when submitting nominations was below the age of 35 years. Further, the elections of the above local authorities should be held under the proportional representation system that existed then, in accordance with the provisions of the Local Authorities Elections Act.  However, it is observed that holding elections for these two local authorities would be appropriate under the mixed system of elections, since the delimitation activities of the wards of Local Authorities are almost at the final stage. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapaha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation providing for holding of elections for the above two local authorities under the mixed system of elections based on the ward system re-calling nominations and calling for fresh nominations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading the Printing Press in the Department of Examinations, Sri Lanka based on new technology
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The Department of Examinations of Sri Lanka annually conducts over 270 examinations and the Press of the Department prints over 160 Lakhs of question papers including a large number of other documentation.  It has been  identified that the Press needs modernization if it were to print question papers with a high quality finish, devoid of defects and preserving the confidentiality it requires.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasa, the Minister of Education, for the purchase of printing machines of digital technology and equipment necessary for the press of the Department of Examinations of Sri Lanka, at an estimated cost of Rs.530 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Guidelines for the maintenance of temporary shelters to provide protection for women victims of violence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - At present, in addition to legal assistance, counselling and medical services required for the women victims of violence in cases of domestic violence, rape and to sex trafficking, the need to maintain temporary shelters which provide relief for such women victims has also emerged.  The first shelter for women victims of violence  was established by the Government of Sri Lanka in the year 2012 and subsequently, several such centres have been established on a regional level. Further, such temporary shelters are maintained at private premises as well, with the assistance of government hospitals, the Police and Non-Government Organizations. As such, the Cabinet granted its approval for the Guidelines submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, for the maintenance of such shelters to provide protection for women who become victims of violence due to various reasons.

description: Development of 100 Temples situated in the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - Most of the Buddhist temples in the Northern and Eastern Provinces can be identified as un-accesible temples with very low facilities.  Facilities for drinking water and the essential sanitary facilities in these temples are at a minimum level, in view of the limited number of families with the ability to support, the temples do not possess the financial capacities to upgrade these facilities.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Buddha Sasana, to implement a project for improving the sanitary facilities (toilet facilities etc.) in 100 selected temples with inadequate facilities situated in the Northern and Eastern Provinces, utilizing the Rs.20.25 Million donated by Rev. Ming Sheng, the Chairman of the Buddhist Association in the Gwandoon area  of China, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Wijaya Kumaratunga Memorial Hospital at Seeduwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, for implementation of the following two Projects for the Development of the Wijaya Kumaratunga Memorial Hospital at Seeduwa, was approved by the Cabinet. 
*	for expanding and modernizing the building consisting of the Hospital Office and the Clinics, at an estimated cost of Rs.35 Million; and 

*	for constructing a 06 storeyed building consisting of an Accident Ward and an Emergency Treatment Unit, Mdical and Surgical Wards, the 2nd Eye Ward, Diabetic Treatment Centre, Intensive Care Unit, Laboratory and X-ray Department, rooms for Doctors and accommodation facilities for Nurses, at an estimated cost of Rs.1,431 Million.

description: Extension of the Surgical/Medical Units in the Teaching Hospital - Karapitiya, Galle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The Teaching Hospital - Karapitiya, Galle is the major hospital in the Galle District and it provides services to patients from the Districts of Matara and Hambantota of the Southern Province and as well as to patients from other Provinces.  This hospital consists of 60 wards with 1,838 beds and 24 Specialist Units.  The number of patients receiving treatment from this hospital and the number of surgeries done have  increased significantly, over the past several years.
