Therefore, the proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to increase the total number of beds in the hospital by 300 and to construct a 10 storeyed building with an Orthopaedic Ward to enable 130 additional surgeries to be done per week, a Plastic Surgery and Burns Unit, 02 Ear - Nose - Throat (ENT) Units, Gastro Enterology and Genito-Urology Surgery Units, a Rheumatology Unit, a Vitreo-Retinal Surgery Unit, and also a Paediatric Cardiology Unit, Nephrology, Neurology and Opthalmology wards with facilities for the treatment of children, at an estimated cost of Rs.1,401.7 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Bilateral Consultations between Sri Lanka and Sudan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding on Bilateral Consultations between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Sudan (Northern Sudan), with a view to further strengthening the existing friendship and cooperation between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Additional Funds for the Kaluganga Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The construction work carried out in the Moragahakanda Reservoir under the Kaluganga Development Project, is expected to release 100 Cu.M. of irrigable water into the Moragahakanda Reservoir, annually and the development of a new irrigational area of 3,000 Ha, is due to be completed by the end of the year 2018.  Due to the unforeseen geological conditions and the changes in the subject area, the cost of the contract has been revised, accordingly.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into negotiations and a Loan Agreement with the Opec Fund for International Development (OFID), for the provision of a part of the additional funds so required, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Funds for the implementation of the Thambuttegama Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval for the implementation of the Thambuttegama pipe born Water Supply Project covering 42 Garama Niladhari Divisions comprising of Thalawa, Thambuttegama and Galnawa Divisional Secretary's Divisions aimed at providing safe drinking water. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into Loan Agreements with the China Development Bank and the Bank of Ceylon for the provision of funds for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Funds for the implementation of the Katana Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval for the implementation of the Katana Water Supply Project, aimed at providing safe drinking water to a majority of the populace living in the Katana Divisional Secretariat Division.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into Loan Agreements with the China Development Bank and the Bank of Ceylon for the provision of funds for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting a new Act to further strengthen the Coast Guard activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the Department of Coast Guard, established by the Department of Coast Guard Act, No.41 of 2009, finds it difficult to carry out the functions expected of the Department within its existing organizational structure.  Accordingly, having taken into consideration the current needs, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to draft a new Act repealing the Department of Coast Guard Act, 41, of 2009, to further strengthen the Department of Coast Guard, as a law enforcement Institution of the Coast Guard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Creating a Special Unit in the Treasury for the Low Income Group  and the Middle Income Group under the Home Ownership Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-08
decision_details_body: - The Government is expected to construct a total of 620,000 houses  consisting of 120,000 for the Low Income Group and 500,000 for the Middle Income Group by the year 2019, under the Low Income Group  and the Middle Income Group Home Ownership Programme. Treating this as a national priority, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to establish a Special Unit (Special Purpose) in the General Treasury, for obtaining the necessary approval expeditiously for the programme (SPV) allocating the required lands and provision of the necessary facilities to complete the project within the stipulated time frame, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Production Capacity of the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - It is essential to expand the manufacturing capacity of the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation (SPMC), in order to provide good quality drugs in large quantities at lower prices to all hospitals in the country and also in a short period of time and save a considerable amount of foreign exchange. Accordingly, the Cabinet has already granted approval to implement a Project for the construction of new drug manufacturing plants with the necessary infrastructure facilities and modern equipment and in this regard, a loan facility of Japanese Yen 1,244 Million has also been provided.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract, in accordance with the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of 06 Diesel Multiple Units with air conditioned passenger compartments to Sri Lanka Railways under the Indian Line of Credit
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval for the procurement of 06 Diesel Multiple Units with air conditioned passenger compartments to the Sri Lanka Railways under the Indian Line of Credit, with the objective of providing a more efficient and comfortable train transport service to the people. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract, in accordance with the recommendations of the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the North - Western Canal under the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Program
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The North-Western Province Canal Project is implemented under the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Program, with the objective of providing for 12,500 Ha of paddy land.  Under Phase-I of the Project, it is proposed to develop a length of 5.25 km in the Wemadulla Left Bank main canal up to the Nebadagahawatta Reservoir, and to construct a new sluice at Wemadulla and to construct a canal from the sluice 600 meters in length up to the Left Bank main canal.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to award the relevant contract, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Upper Elahera Canal under the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Program
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The Upper Elahera Canal is implemented under the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Program, with the objective of providing water to the North Central Province.  The Upper Elahera Canal is designed to be constructed under Phase-I of the Project.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to award the contract for the construction of the Upper Canal of 6.2 km in length, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), at an estimated cost of Rs.3,254 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recognition of Colombo Port City Development Project (Financial City Project) as a Strategic Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The Colombo Port City Development Project (Financial City Project) has re-commenced since resolving the issues pertaining to approvals and environmental impact assessment. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to recognise same as a Project, under section 3(3) of the Strategic Development Project Act, No.14 of 2008 and to publish the relevant Gazette Notification, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Refurbishment of Nila Sevana Housing Scheme - Habaraduwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The Nila Sevana Housing Project commenced in the year 2003, to provide houses at an affordable and reasonable price with special focus on public sector employees. However, the construction work of the 576 apartments planned to be constructed at Habaraduwa, in the Galle District, under this programme has not been carried out since 2011.  As a result, the premises in extent of 13 acres where the housing units are to be constructed and the 09 buildings therein, remain in a state of severe dis- repair.  Hence, it has been proposed to develop the land and renovate the buildings therein, so as to contain all modern amenities to enhance the value of the premises changing its scope as a mixed project for both residential and tourist objectives.  Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade; and Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration and Management, to sign a supplementary Agreement to the tri‑partite Agreement entered into between the Ministry of Public Administration and Management, the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka and the Project Company, enabling the provision of some of the housing units to be allocated to the public officers on concessionary terms and the rest for accommodation purposes of both the local and foreign tourists, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of Compensation for the Shops affected by the out break of fire at the Kilinochchi Public Market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - Due the out break of fire at the Kilinochchi Public Market on 16.09.2016, 122 shops were damaged. As such, the proposals made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister and Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement and Hindu Religious Affairs, for payment of compensation of Rs.74 Million, for the affected 122 traders and to establish a fire brigade service in the Kilinochchi District at a cost of Rs.97 Million and to construct a permanent market complex at an estimated cost of Rs.150 Million, to re-establish the business establishments affected by fire, as recommended by the Assessment Committee Appointed with the objective of providing relief to the traders affected by the fire, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Disposal of Segregated Waste in the Public Institutions under a formal Waste Management Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The improper disposal of the waste generated by means of human activity to the environment has now become a major problem.  Accordingly, as an initial remedial measure to overcome the present state of affairs, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to set up a mechanism in the public institutions to formally hand over such waste to the relevant Local Government Institutions having segregated such waste as degradable and non-degradable and to obtain the cooperation of the Ministers, in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Pension Scheme for Migrant Workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet Appointed a Committee comprising of the relevant representatives in the year 2015 to propose a pension scheme for the Migrant Workers. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Foreign Employment, to implement the proposed pension scheme prepared by the Committee, to draft appropriate legislation required for the purpose and to amend the Sri Lanka Foreign Employment Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Penal Code  (Amendment) Draft Bill - (Increasing the Minimum Age of Criminal Responsibility)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The Psychiatrists and experts in the relevant fields have expressed the view that the minimum age of 8 years, is a very tender age to attach criminal responsibility. Accordingly, a proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, for amending the Penal Code to increase the age of criminal responsibility of a child from 8 to 12 years, and confer a Magistrate with the discretion to punish a child between 12 years and 14 years only in cases where he finds that such child has attained sufficient maturity of understanding to judge the nature and consequences of his conduct on that occasion, and publish it in the Government Gazette and subsequently, present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Creation of a Charitable Trust for the Sri Lanka Buddhist Pilgrims Rest (SLBPR)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Buddhist Pilgrims Rest in New Delhi which provides accommodation for the pilgrims who visit India, is a property given to the Government of Sri Lanka by Pandith Jawaharal Neru, when he was the Prime Minister of India.  The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Buddha Sasana, to create a Charitable Trust under the Trust Ordinance and to ensure that the pilgrims rest is used for the intended purposes, provides high quality accommodation facilities for pilgrims, proper management to enable the income generated to be utilized for charitable purposes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an International Buddhist Centre to coinside with the International Vesak Commemoration of 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to build an International Buddhist Centre in the land of ‘Rejidelwaththa’ in Kahapola, Piliyandala which belongs to the ‘Samarakoon’ Legacy, to coinside with the International Vesak Commemoration to be held in Sri Lanka, in the year 2017.  It is proposed to recreate the 'Sakya Janapadaya' which happened to be the birth place of the Buddha, in order to provide the opportunity for the public to see and to construct a fully pledged Buddhist Library, a Buddhist Meditation Centre, a Centre for the recreating of stories relevant to the Life of Buddha through Digital Technology, a Training Centre to provide discourses in the medium of Sinhala and English, a vegetative restaurant, rest rooms for both laymen and priests etc..  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Buddha Sasana, to implement this project in collaboration with the 'the Light of Asia Foundation' as a non-profit making charity, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of land at Parliament Road, Battaramulla for the establishment of  the Talangama Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The Talangama Police Station covers 240 Grama Niladhari Divisions and serves a population of 170,000.  It is situated in a small plot of land of 44 perches in extent along a internal road away from the main road.  Due to this reason, the Police Officers serving in the Police Station and as well as the people who come for services to the Police Station have to undergo much difficulties.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to transfer a land of one acre in extent at the Parliament Road, Battaramulla, owned by the Urban Development Authority, to the Ministry of Law & Order and Southern Development for the establishment of the Talangama Police Station, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Multi-Modal Transport Hub - Fort-Pettah
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - Establishment of the Multi-Modal Transport Hub - Fort-Pettah has been incorporated in the Comprehensive Transport Management Plan for the Western Region Megapolis.  Accordingly, with a view to providing a comfortable and an efficient transport system for the general public, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, for the implementation of the proposal for the establishment of Multi-Modal Transport Hub integrating all transport modes, as recommended by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The signing of a Subsidiary Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Australia ‘in respect of Skills for Inclusive Economic Growth’
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - It is proposed to implement a programme by the Ministry of Skills Development and Vocational Training, during the period 2016-2019 to create educational opportunities for qualitative skills development in the field of tourism to provide job opportunities for the youth of the Districts of Ampara, Batticaloa, Trincomalee and Polonnaruwa. The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to enter into a Subsidiary  Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Australia to obtain a financial grant of AUD15 Million as agreed to be provided for by the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) of the Government of Australia for the implementation of this programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Amendments to the Institute of Valuers of Sri Lanka Law No. 33 of 1975
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance,  to instruct the Legal Draftsman, to draft legislation to amend the Institute of Valuers of Sri Lanka Law No.33 of 1975, incorporating timely amendments needed therein, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Matara Water Supply Project - Stage IV
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to enter into an Agreement with the National Development Bank to obtain a loan amounting to US$76.83 Million and  Rs.2,448.81 Million for the implementation of the Matara Water Supply Project - Stage IV, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing Soya Beans for Thriposha Production
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body:
- Taking into consideration the matters submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine and Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, the Cabinet decided - 

*	to supply the 5,000 Mt of Soya Beans purchased by the National Food Promotion Board from the Soya Bean Farmers, directly to the Thriposha Company; and 

*	in the future, to call for quotations from the registered Farmer Societies comprising of Soya Bean Farmers and purchase the required quantity of Soya Beans for the National Thriposha Production Programme.

description: Survey pertaining to Child activities - 2015-2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The Department of Census and Statistics utilizing the financial grants  provided for, by the International Labour Organization (ILO) has conducted a survey on child activities during the period 2015-2016 and had prepared a data file and conducted the review activities.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to utilize the additional fund of Rs.4.35 Million for the  preparation of the final Report of the Survey and to conduct a programme to make the relevant institutions and the general public aware of the information revealed at the survey, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Maternal and Infant Care Unit of the Matara General Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - Matara General Hospital provides health services to around half of the indoor patients in the Matara District. It is situated in the city centre of the Matara town within a small area where expansion is limited and hence, heavily congested.  As such, attention has been focused over making use of the Korea - Sri Lanka Friendship Hospital in Godagama for the purpose for which a proposal has already been drawn up to establish the Maternal and Infant Care Unit of the Matara General Hospital, in the Korea - Sri Lanka Friendship Hospital in Godagama, Matara.  Accordingly, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, made the Cabinet aware of the arrangements made to obtain a grant of US$ 8.5 Million from the Korean International Cooperation Agency for the establishment of a new ward complex for this purpose, at the Korea - Sri Lanka Friendship Hospital in Godagama, Matara.

description: The Responsibility of the Producer/Trader and Consumer for Waste Management in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - Despite several laws being implemented and awareness programmes, conducted the producers, traders and consumers dispose of various non-degradable packages, electric and electronic wastes to the environment in an irresponsible manner.  Presently, 60% (210,000 MT) of the annual total plastic and polythene inflow to the country gets added to the natural environment.  As a solution to the problem, it has been proposed to implement the concept of Polluter Pays Principle where the polluter of the environment should pay the compensation.  According to this concept, a deposit is to be obtained temporarily from the consumer at the time of purchasing the goods, which will be refunded to the consumer when the remaining non-degradable wastes is returned to the trader after the consumption of such goods. In respect of deposits made for electronic and electrical equipment used for longer periods, it is proposed to pay an annual interest, calculated on the duration, to the consumer. Through this process, having collected the waste at designated places,  it will be convenient for waste management in an eco-friendly manner.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to establish an Officials' Committee comprising of the representatives of the relevant institutions to make recommendations to implement the above procedure, ensuring the responsibility of the producer, trader and the consumer and to initiate a pilot project on the recommendations of the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Claim for Compensation in terms of International Convention for damages caused by spills of bunker oil carried by ships
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - With the increase of transport of goods via oceans, the damages caused to ships have been increased and the International Convention on the accountability of Civil Liability for Bunker Oil Pollution Damage came into force in the year 2008, in order to provide adequate and prompt compensation to the parties who suffer from the damages caused by spills of bunker oil and minimizing the damages to marine associated industries.  Presently, 80 States are parties to the convention.  Since around 5,000 ships anchor at the Sri Lankan Ports annually, and a large number of ships traverse daily on the International Naval Route located in the Marine Zone of Sri Lanka, the risk of having bunker oil spills within the Marine Zone of Sri Lanka is very high.  In  order to minimize possible damages caused to the fisheries, tourism and other industries related to the marine environment, it is appropriate to sign this convention in order to obtain the compensation expeditiously. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, and adopt the International Convention on the accountability of Civil Liability for Bunker Oil Pollution Damage to amend the Marine Pollution Prevention Act, No.35 of 2008, to make provision to implement the said Convention, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a two storeyed Building in the 'Ranawiru Sevana' premises at Ragama for manufacturing artificial orthopaedic equipment for Disabled War Heroes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The Prosthetics and Orthotics Unit at the 'Ranawiru Sevana' Ragama, is engaged in constructing artificial orthopaedic equipment for the disabled war heroes.  Presently, over 3,000 disabled war heroes are registered there, with the expectation of full filling their rehabilitative needs.  The facilities currently available at the Prosthetics and Orthotics Unit are inadequate, As a solution to the above, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to construct a two-storeyed building with the essential basic facilities for this Unit, at an estimated cost of Rs.81.43 Million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Independent Centralized Procurement Institution for procuring items generally used in State Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-11-01
decision_details_body: - The need to establish an Independent Centralized Procurement Institution has been identified, in order to minimize undue delays and wastage  in the procurement process, reap the benefits in large scale procurement, ensure the quality of goods and the value in terms of prices etc. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, for the establishment of an Independent Centralized Procurement Institution, comprising of 05 members with expertise in various fields pertaining to procurement procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a Credit of Special Drawing Rights being the equivalent of United States Dollars 75 million from the International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank for the Social Safety Nets Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body:
- The Government of Sri Lanka has planned to implement the 'Social Safety Nets Project 2017-2022' for improving equity, efficiency and transparency of its social safety network programmes for the benefit to the poor and the vulnerable. 

	The International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank has given its consent to provide the Government of Sri Lanka with the required credit facilities for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance to enter into a financing agreement with the IDA of the World Bank to borrow a credit  of Special Drawing Rights equivalent of US$ 75 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 3,000 Rain Water Harvesting Tanks in the Jaffna District by the Government of India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - There is a grave problem in the entire Jaffna Peninsular with regard to the quality of drinking water and as a remedial measure, a project proposal by the Office for National Unity and Reconciliation (ONUR) aimed at providing the population with a sustainable and safe drinking water has been submitted to the Indian High Commission. Having considered the proposal, the Indian High Commission has expressed its willingness to assist in constructing 3,000 Rain Water Harvesting Tanks within the financial provision of LKR 300 million in the District of Jaffna.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena in his capacity as the Minister of National Integration and Reconciliation to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of India for the implementation of the Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Incentivizing the Consumption of Good Quality Food under the National Programme of Food Production - (2016-2018)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body:
- Surveys have revealed that people are mostly afflicted with non-communicable diseases due to the consumption of food cultivated by utilizing chemical substances and as such, making them accustomed to a pattern of consumption of good quality food is an essential factor.  Therefore, attention is focused in promoting the consumption of toxin-free good quality food as a major item of the National Programme of Food Production which is prioritized by the Government. In this connection, a major problem posed is the inadequacy of seeds available for the cultivation of qualitative food crops.   

	With the objective of increasing the availability of quality seed paddy for farming, it is proposed to provide the farmers with a certain quantity of quality seed paddy of traditional varieties free of charge for the Maha Season 2016/2017.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to purchase 400,000 kg of seed paddy with the assistance of the Department of Agriculture and the Department of Agrarian Services from the farm lands where traditional varieties have been cultivated and distribute them among the selected farmers with the support of the relevant authorities and also to give them the technology required, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agro-based Industries and Marketing Infrastructure Facilities Development   Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The  Multi-Sectoral Development Programme implemented under the Presidential Programme of 'Rajarata Navodaya' and ‘Pibidemu Polonnaruwa’, has accorded high priority for the establishment of Agro Marketing Chains and the construction of an Agricultural Economic Marketing Centre. In view of same, it has been proposed to implement an Agro-based Industries and Marketing Infrastructure Facilities Development Project and the People's Republic of China has agreed to provide the required financial assistance in this regard.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to award the contract for the implementation of the Project, in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee (CANC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Vocational Training Centre at Ahangama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - With the objective of expanding the Vocational Training Network to cater to the demand existing in the technical sector of the country, the Cabinet of Ministers has granted approval for the construction of a new Vocational Training Centre at Ahangama under the 'Skills Sector Development Programme (2014-2020)'.   Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to award the contract for the construction of the said Vocational Training Centre, in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Warehouse Complex at Embilipitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance,  to award the contract in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), for the construction of a warehouse complex at Embilipitiya with a floor area of 28,500 sq.ft. consisting of an office building, a laboratory, a building with accommodation facilities, a water tank, and a transformer room etc.,  with the objective of providing the farmers of the Ratnapura District, with quality storage facilities to store their agricultural produce, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Pannala-Makandura-Kuliyapitiya Integrated Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The proposed Pannala-Makandura-Kuliyapitiya Integrated Water Supply Project designed to cover the Pannala area, a part of Makandura area, Kuliyapitiya (East and West) and a part of Udubeddawa Divisional Secretary's Division in the Kurunegala District is expected to provide a safe drinking water supply to cover a population of about 112,000. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to award the contract for implementing the project in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the High Frequency Transmitting Station, at Attidiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for installing 03 Aeronautical High Frequency Transmitters with Antennas required for the High Frequency Transmitting Station, at Attidiya, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Erection of the Electric-fence 800 km in length around the villages where Wild Elephant threats exist
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - Human lives of 60 to 80 numbers and over 200 lives of elephants are lost annually due to the conflict between the wild elephants and humans.  The issue could be kept under control to a certain extent by restricting the  straying of wild elephants into agricultural farm lands in search of food and water.  It has been revealed that the most effective methodology to be adopted in this regard, is the erection of the electric fence.  The length of the electric fence erected which has already been erected around forest reserves and the villages and the farm lands where the elephant conflicts exist, is about 3,300 km.  Towards the erection of about 275 km of the electric fence required to be completed for the year 2016 under the National Plan for the Management of Human-Elephant Conflict is now underway.  Under this programme, it has been planned to erect an electric fence of 800 km in length in the year 2017, in 07 Wildlife Zones where majority of the conflicts between human and elephants are reported.  The proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to purchase the materials required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Installation of a new CCTV Network in place of the existing network in the Parliament Chamber
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approval has been granted to install new Networks replacing the existing Sound Congress System, CCTV System, the Main Clock System and the Telephone Exchange in the Parliament.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to award the contract for installing a Digital TV Network in place of  the existing CCTV network in the Parliament, in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Projects implemented during the period of 2016-2018 for the Improvement of the Information Technology Literacy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, for the two projects namely; the 'e-Grama Niladhari Project' and the 'Awareness of Internet of Things (IoT)' to educate school children, the younger generation and youth entrepreneurs and the usage of IoT devices and the creation of innovations for the Improvement of the Information Technology Literacy, introduced by the Ministry of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure in collaboration with the Ministry of Home Affairs, at an estimated cost of Rs.662 million and Rs.133 million, respectively, to be implemented during the period from 2016-2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the balance work of the building at the Kollupitiya Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The development activities of the Kolluptiya Police Station was initiated in the year 2007 and subsequently, due to various reasons, the activities of the project was suspended temporarily. With the objective of rendering a friendly, effective and productive police service to the public, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Rathnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, for the implementation of the project to initiate the construction of the balance work of the building at the Kollupitiya Police Station during the period from 2017-2019, at an estimated cost of Rs.153.3 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Organizing an International Sports Workshop, an Exhibition and a Festival
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Sports has planned to conduct a Sports Workshop, Exhibition and a Festival in collaboration with the local and sports related International Institutions in the 1st quarter of the year 2017 at the Galle Face, Colombo, with an anticipated participation of around 8,000 local and foreign athletes, with a view to promoting 07 selected sports in Sri Lanka, with the guidance of foreign coaches and for the purpose of enhancing the skills and aptitudes of Sri Lankan athletes by organizing competitions where the Sri Lankan athletes could compete with International  athletes. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to appoint a Steering Committee with the Chairmanship of the Secretary, Ministry of Sports for holding the above workshop, exhibition and festival and also to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding with a Company of Malaysia and to get the sponsorship and cooperation of the public and private sectors, to make the programme a success, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regularization and expedition of the receipt of court fines and stamp duties levied on transfer of lands to the Local Authorities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to amend section 19 of the Provincial Council Act, No.42 of 1987, with a view to making the existing method of transferring the revenue received from the receipt of court fines and stamp duties levied on transfer of lands pertaining to the Local Authorities, more effectively to the respective Local Authorities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Pilot Project for Printing Text books on durable  Synthetic Paper
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The Government incurs an expenditure of around Rs.3,500 million annually, to provide text books free of charge.  Although, programmes for increasing the re-use of text books was implemented by the Educational Publications Department, it is found that a text book cannot be used for more than 03 years.  As such, 70% of the text books have to be reprinted  for distribution and an exorbitant expenditure has to be incurred for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to implement a pilot project in the year 2017, for printing a different-types of the text books using  synthetic paper with a high quality finish, which could be used by the students with ease and which do not get damaged due to natural disasters and where the pen and pencil marks could be removed easily, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Action Plan for Children of Sri Lanka - 2016 - 2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, to implement the 'National Action Plan for Children of Sri Lanka (2016-2020)', drafted in collaboration with the subject Ministries and Institutions pertaining to Education, Health, Justice, Labour, Mass Media and Water Supply which are directly involved with the subject matter for the purpose of ensuring the comprehensive development of all children, while providing them with an opportunity to improve their unique talents and skills, with a view to protecting the rights of all children and also creating a safe, supportive and conducive environment for their growth and development, and to establish a National Steering Committee with the representation of all stake-holders, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Committee to consider Reforms to the Muslim Marriage and Divorce Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that a revision is essential in respect of the provisions regarding the minimum age of marriage and certain other matters covered under the Muslim Law which are not in conformity with the norms specified in certain International Conventions to which Sri Lanka is also a party. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to appoint a Cabinet Sub‑Committee to study and propose appropriate amendments to the Muslim Marriage and Divorce Act, to the Cabinet, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for Nationally Appropriate Mitigation Actions on Minimizing Green House Gas Emissions in Energy Generation and Usage
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The Global Leaders, through the Paris Agreement entered into in the year 2015, have agreed to keep the global temperature increase restricted at   20 C during the next century.  When compared with the major countries which emit green house gasses like China (20.08%), the United States of America (17.89%) and Russia/India/Japan/Canada (combined 17.34%), the Green House Gas Emissions by Sri Lanka, amounts to about 0.05%.  However, Sri Lanka is committed to reducing the amount of Green House Gas released in 2010 up to 20% by the year 2030. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to implement a project for formulation of a framework for monitoring and reporting the contribution made by Sri Lanka with the Private Sector, the Global Environment Facility (GEF), the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), for the reduction of the Green House Gas Emission, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the By-pass Road from Battaramulla - Polduwa Junction upto Udumulla Junction through ‘Suhurupaya’
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The policy of the Government is to locate all public institutions found in the Colombo city, at Battaramulla in the Administrative Capital of Sri Jayewardenepura Kotte. Therefore, most of the public institutions have already been located at Battaramulla.  To coincide with this development, it is essential to provide the infrastructure facilities like road network and transport systems to the neighbouring areas expeditiously.  Accordingly, it is proposed to lay a by-pass road, 4km in length, from Polduwa Junction up to Koswatta Junction with a view to providing easy access to the public institutions. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to extend the by-pass road section from Polduwa Junction up to ‘Suhurupaya’, which has been designed as Stage-I of the project, with the objective of easing the huge traffic congestion now found in the Battaramulla junction and to complete the project, at an estimated cost of Rs.250 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Repayment of Security Deposit Holders of the Golden Key Credit Card Company Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - In terms of the Cabinet decision and on the methodology approved by the Supreme Court, the General Treasury has released Rs.544.3 million, for the first tranche and Rs.3,945.6 million for the second tranche, in respect of the Golden Key Company Ltd. The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to release a sum of Rs.4,055.1 million in stages to the Central Bank of Sri Lanka as the third and the final payment and to take expeditious measures to liquidate the Golden Key Credit Card Company Ltd. and the Group of Companies affiliated to it, and to reimburse the amount so derived to the General Treasury, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Buildings in Medirigiriya Ayurveda Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - Around 90 patients receive treatment daily, from the Central Ayurveda Dispensary, Medirigiriya. It has been found that successful results could be obtained from long term continuous Ayurveda treatment for the Chronic Kidney Disease and other non communicable diseases prevalent in the area.  The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to construct the buildings necessary for the improvement of the Medirigiriya Ayurveda Central Dispensary to be converted into a Ayurveda Hospital at an estimated cost of Rs.37 million, to enable the people of the Divisional Secretaries Divisions of Medirigiriya, Hingurakgoda, Lankapura and Thamankaduwa, to have facilities for residential  Ayurveda treatment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of Work at the Third Floor of the Provincial Ayurveda Hospital, Anuradhapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - Anuradhapura Provincial Ayurveda Hospital is the largest Ayurveda Hospital in the North Central Province.  The work in two floors of the building where there are paying wards have already been completed.  Presently, great interest is shown, by the people for receiving Ayurveda treatment and therefore, an increasing demand has been generated for the 08 paying rooms available in addition to the non paying wards at the hospital, among both the local and foreign patients.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to complete the construction work of the third floor paying ward complex of the Anuradhapura Ayurveda Hospital which has been designed to house 10 rooms, at an estimated cost of Rs.30 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Setting up of a New Laboratory Building for Sri Lanka Standards Institution (SLSI) at Malabe
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - It is vital to expand the laboratory services in order to improve the efficiency and the productivity of the services provided for by the Sri Lanka Standards Institution (SLSI).  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to purchase 03 Acres of land at the Information Technology Park at Malabe, at a cost of Rs.168 million for the establishment of its Laboratory Services Division and for a budget allocation of Rs.550 million for the construction work involved, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Assessment of damages to the houses and property due to sudden disasters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - Granting of disaster relief has been delayed due to the lack of an appropriate number of trained field officers to assess the damages caused to the houses and property, immediately, after a disaster situation.  As a solution to the problem, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, to obtain the services of 30 retired trained Technical Officers at the Divisional Secretariat level for a period of 03 months, and make use of their services to assess the damages caused due to the explosion that occurred at the Salawa Army Camp, the landslides that occurred due to the heavy rains that fell in the Kegalle District and the floods that occurred in May 2016, and for the payment of compensation expeditiously to the people whose houses and properties were damaged, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Relief to construct new houses for those completely damaged due to the landslides that occurred in Hali-Ela and Badulla Divisional Secretariat Divisions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - In the year 2014, 24 houses have been completely damaged, due to the landslides that occurred in Rilpola including other areas in the Divisional Secretary's Divisions of Hali Ela and Badulla.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, for granting a payment of Rs.1,250,000/- for each family, for reconstructing their house and to release provision amounting to Rs.30 million for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relief provided to consumers affected by the drought
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The National Water Supply & Drainage Board has encountered difficulties in supplying drinking water to 54 water supply schemes due to the depletion of ground water levels in the water resources as a result of the drought which prevailed for the last two months. The information provided to the Cabinet by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to the effect, that due to this reason, 70 water bowsers have been used to supply water to the consumers who do not get sufficient water supply through their pipe lines, that a special team has been deployed for each regional sub‑office to provide a 24 hour water supply service to the areas which are affected by the drought and that the public has been made aware to use water sparingly through the news media, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Capital Market Strategy 2016-2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - Capital market strategy plays a major role in facilitating the rapid expansion and the sustained growth of emerging economies around the world.  However, the potential of Sri Lanka's capital market remains unrealised.  Hence, it is essential to develop a strong, efficient and vibrant capital market in Sri Lanka by creating an environment conducive to instilling trust and confidence among share issuers, investors, market institutions and market intermediaries. As such, with a view to laying the ground work for the purpose, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to adopt the regulatory and development measures proposed in the 'Capital Market Strategy 2016-2020', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Governments of the Member States of the Indian Ocean Rim Association  (IORA) for the Coordination and Cooperation of Search and Rescue Services in the Indian Ocean Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Governments of the Member States of the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) to establish a framework for the Coordination and Cooperation of Search and Rescue Services in the Indian Ocean Region, and to promote consultation and cooperation among the Governments concerned to face the situations which the States of the Indian Ocean Region have to encounter, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development (Special Provisions) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-25
decision_details_body: - The Government has given priority to accelerate the economic development of Sri Lanka and it is the understanding that new legislation is needed towards speeding up the process of economic development.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister and Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to publish the Development (Special Provisions) Bill prepared, to facilitate the formulation of a national policy, on all subjects connected with the rapid economic development of Sri Lanka and to make provisions for the economic development, establishment of development agencies, preparation of policies relating to rural modernization and regional development etc. in the Government Gazette and thereafter, present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lanka Government Network - Implementation of Project 2
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The reduction in the speed of data transmission under the Lanka Government Network (LGN), introduced by the Information Communication Technology Agency (ICTA) during the period of 2007-2012, for the purpose of maintaining interconnections through digital means between government institutions and the public and among government institutions themselves, has become a major obstacle to attaining the goal of digitizing the economy as envisaged by the Government. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to implement project 2 of the LGN aimed at providing secure, high speed internet connections and free Wi-Fi services required for e-Government activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: ‘Rajarata Navodaya’ - Presidential Programme - ‘Let’s Awaken Polonnaruwa’ - District Development Projects - 2016-2020
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to entrust the structural engineering design works and the construction works pertaining to four special projects, namely, the construction of the proposed Government Officers' Quarters Complex and the Administrative Building Complex within the New Town of Polonnaruwa, the reconstruction of the Railway Quarters for the development of the Kaduruwela Town and the construction of the Thamankaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha Building within the Polonnaruwa New Town,  implemented on a concept of H.E. the President and identified under the District Development Programme, to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) and the Central Engineering Services (Pvt) Ltd., (CESL) for an estimated cost of Rs.4,120 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 20 Container Carrier Wagons and 30 Fuel Tank Wagons for the Department of Sri Lanka Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the supply of 20 Container Carrier Wagons and 30 Fuel Tank Wagons for the Department of Sri Lanka Railways under the Indian Line of Credit, in accordance with the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee (CANC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 163 Ashok Leyland New Engine Kits for the Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, for the procurement of 163 Ashok Leyland New Engine Kits for the Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB), under the Indian Line of Credit, on repeat order basis, as per the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee (CANC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Radial & Solid Tyre Plant in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to provide necessary facilities through the Board of Investment, to an investor who has come forward to establish a Radial & Solid Tyre Manufacturing Plant in Horana area deploying a capital investment of US$ 75 million within 4 years, aiming 60% of the total production at export market and generating more than 1,000 local job opportunities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Sugathadasa National Sports Complex Authority Act, No. 17 of 1999
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The administrative and maintenance activities of the Sugathadasa Indoor Stadium, Sugathadasa Outdoor Stadium, Sugathadasa Swimming Pool Complex, Bogambara Outdoor Stadium in Kandy, Nuwara Eliya Race Course and the Beliatta Swimming Pool Complex are carried out by the Sugathadasa National Sports Complex Authority. The Authority provides sports facilities at extremely concessionary rates and as such, the revenue so derived is not adequate for the proper maintenance of the relevant stadiums. Therefore, with a view to generating a sufficient income to maintain the relevant stadiums and provide sports facilities, the proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekera, Minister of Sports, to amend the Sugathadasa National Sports Complex Authority Act, No.17 of 1999, incorporating amendments to suit the present, in order to provide an opportunity for the relvant stadiums to be used for  arts activities, seminars, examinations and suchlike possible income generating activities, on occasions when they are not in use for sports events, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No. 28 of 1961
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The importance of bringing the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation under the regulatory purview of the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka, has  been identified by the Government. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Chandima Weerakkody, the Minister of Petroleum Resources Development, to amend the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No. 28 of 1961, without causing any hindrance to the sales activities presently carried out by the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Plan for Women Headed Households
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - When empowering women who form 52% of the total population of Sri Lanka, it is imperative to pay foremost attention to the 24.3% of families out of the total number of families in the country, which are headed by women. With a view to ensuring women's contribution and performance in the development process, a combined approach is being planned to be implemented island wide, for “women headed households” and the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, to implement the cluster of proposals for a national initiative made thereunder in respect of a number of fields such as, Health and Psycho-Social Support, Livelihood Development, Support Services System, Protection, Social Security and National Level Policy Foundation and Raising Community Awareness, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accelerated Programme for Middle Income Housing & Infrastructure Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - It is expected to construct 500,000 housing units within a period of five (05) years, under the 'Accelerated Middle Income Housing & Infrastructure Development Programme', implemented with a view to providing housing facilities  for the middle income  employees in the public and private sectors,  at an affordable price. Accordingly, as per the recommendations of the National Steering Committee established for this programme, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to implement the construction work  of the Iskagarawatta, Kundasale Housing Scheme consisting of 332 housing units and Mount Clifford Estate, Homagama Housing Scheme consisting of 860 housing units, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commencing a Value Added Processing Zone in Elpitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to commence a Value Added Processing Zone, centering  Elpitiya area in the Galle District, to coincide with the state policy of establishing 23 Agricultural Mega Zones throughout the country. Through this  initiative, the products of the area will receive a high export income and  employment opportunities will also be created for the youth of the area. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries; Hon. Gayantha Karunathilake, the Minister of Parliamentary Reforms and Mass Media; and Hon. Daya Gamage, the Minister of Primary Industries, to allocate 200 acres from the Igalakanda and Ketapolawatta areas, situated in close proximity to the Southern Expressway,  belonging to the Elpitiya Plantation Company, for the establishment of the proposed Elpitiya Agri Processing Zone, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a Land for the Construction of the District Sports Complex and  Indoor Stadium in Moneragala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Public Enterprise Development, to allocate a land in extent of 10 acres from the Kumarawatta  Estate, Moneragala belonging to the Land Reform Commission (LRC) and presently possessed by the Janatha Estate Development Board (JEDB), for the construction of the proposed District Sports Complex and Indoor Stadium in Moneragala,  to provide  a fine arena to promote the health of people in Moneragala District and to bestow the country with the sports skills of future generations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancement of Productivity of the Livestock Sector in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - With a view to assisting the task of developing the livestock production sector in Sri Lanka, while conquering the foreign markets and fulfilling the local demand, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to obtain a Treasury provision of Rs.1,402 million, to establish a new food technology laboratory in the Veterinary Research Institute of the Department of Animal Production and Health, to modernize the Veterinary Vaccine Production Centre of the said Department, to establish Multi-sectoral Units at district level to  control  Rabies and to prepare a national programme for the protection from diseases spread  through various animals, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Physical and Spiritual Development Programme implemented under the ‘Punyagrama’ Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The ‘Punyagrama Programme' implemented under the Ministry of Buddhasasana, is expected to promote moral values as well as develop the physical facilities related therewith while strengthening the relationship between the village and the temple. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to implement a project of  installing water filter (Reverse Osmosis) machines to provide  safe  drinking water, centering  the temples which are being maintained amidst various difficulties, situated in the areas  in the Northern, North Central and Eastern Provinces, where the  Chronic Kidney Disease (CKDu) is prevalent and in the other Provinces where water borne diseases are prevalent, utilizing the provision of Rs.24 million allocated for this project, in the year 2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Developing an IT Backbone  for the Tea Industry - Sri Lanka Tea Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - Although Sri Lanka Tea fetches a high price in the world market due to its its unparalleled characteristics, the profitability in the tea industry is gradually declining as a result of rising production costs and depressed prices of goods at global level. Under these circumstances, it is essential to apply high quality standards to ensure the future of Tea exports of Sri Lanka. To this end, the Sri Lanka Tea Board  monitors each and every stage of the process from plucking of tea leaves to the manufacturing, transporting, auctioning, quality controlling, blending and packing up to exportation.  Therefore, with a view to making these activities, which are presently based on documents, more efficient, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to develop an IT Backbone, at an estimated cost of Rs.220 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of Oluvil Fishery Harbour to the Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The Oluvil Fishery Harbour is the largest fishery harbour constructed for the fisheries industry in the Eastern Province, with a harbour base of 3.5 meters in depth, berthing facilities for large number of multi-day trawlers and other harbour infrastructure facilities. There is a high potential to develop the export fishery industry and the fish processing industry centering this fishery harbour which also possesses the required  basic facilities to initiate fish processing factories.  With a view to extensively developing the fisheries industry in the Eastern Province and making this harbour a profitable commercial venture, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to vest the Oluvil Fisheries harbour presently administered by  the Sri Lanka Ports Authority (SLPA), with the Ceylon Fisheries Harbour Corporation (CFHC) functioning under the Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the ‘Acland House’ as a Boutique Hotel with high standard facilities and services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The 'Acland House' ('Visumpaya') Building, which is a two storeied building, built as an Officers' Mess of the Ceylon Rifle Regiment during the colonial era, is gradually getting dilapidated and carrying out rehabilitation and renovation  activities in a manner that would preserve its historical value, has become necessary. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to develop and manage the said building as a 'Boutique Hotel' with a unique identity which provides high quality services including accommodation facilities, aimed at high-end tourists and  special guests, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting a Feasibility Study for Five Light Rail Transit (LRT) Lines, proposed to be constructed in the Western Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval for the introduction of 07 Light Rail Transit (LRT) Lines, as a successful long term solution to cope with the future transport demand that will be created as a result of development activities that take place in the Western Region and other related areas. The Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) has expressed its consent to provide support for the construction of two of these rail lines.  Accordingly, with a view to inviting the private sector to invest in the construction of the balance 05 LRT lines, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to conduct  a formal feasibility study  for the  said purpose,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Industrial and Techno Development Super Zone at Raigama, Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The establishment of industrial estates with the objective of extending the industrial development limited to the urban areas, to the rural level; creating industries that produce value added goods from rural resources and  increasing the availability of higher salaried employment opportunities in rural areas, is the concept of the Government. Under this, it has been planned to establish 11 Industrial and Techno Development Zones throughout the country, with infrastructure facilities and support services on par with the infrastructure facilities and support services available in the development zones established in the the East Asian countries and Rs.500 million has been set apart from the Budgetary provisions of 2016 for the establishment of 04 Super Zones, out of these, in Hambantota, Raigama, Mahaoya and Trincomalee.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to establish a Techno Development Super Zone dedicated  for consumer and innovative technological products, in Raigama area of the Kalutara District, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Intellectual Property Act, No. 36 of 2003 to ensure the protection given for the Geographical Indications of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - A sign or an indication which gives an item a unique identity, owing to the specific qualities and characteristics that could be attributed to the country or region in which it has originated, is known as a 'Geographical Indication' (GI) and such an item is an asset to the country of its origin. 'Ceylon Tea' and 'Ceylon Cinnamon', products which render an immense contribution to the economy of Sri Lanka,  have been identified as GIs  through the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003, as goods that originate in Sri Lanka. However, since a legal framework relating to the registration  of GIs in Sri Lanka is not in operation, the producers and exporters are faced with problems. Therefore, as per the recommendation of the Officials' Committee which had examined this matter,  the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to publish the  Bill  prepared to amend the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003,  vesting the authority with the Minister in charge of the subject to issue orders to safeguard, register and certify any product that originated in Sri Lanka, in the Government Gazette and thereafter to present the same in the Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulating a Mechanism to sell  processed paddy   (rice)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - With the objective of stable maintenance of rice prices within the country and the uninterrupted operation of the rice processing centres at Pannegamuwa and Hingurakgoda belonging to the Co-operative Wholesale Establishment (CWE), the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to formulate a mechanism for paddy to be given to the CWE by the Paddy Marketing Board, turned into rice by the said two rice processing centers and the private rice processing centers and then distributed to consumers through Lanka Sathosa and Cooperative and Wholesale dealers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enactment of Anti-Dumping, Countervailing and Safeguard Legislation in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The joint proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce and Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to publish the "Anti-Dumping and Countervailing Duties Bill' containing provisions for the imposition and investigation of "Anti-Dumping Taxes" against the introduction of imported goods to the local market at a lower price than their actual value and "Countervailing Taxes" against the entry into local market of imported goods at unusually low prices due to the various concessions granted by foreign governments, in order to deal with the unfair trade practices carried out by certain countries and protect the local industries and manufacturers from the goods imported to Sri Lanka without control and the "Safeguard Measures Bill' that provides for the conduct of investigations and the application of safeguard measures on products imported into Sri Lanka, in the Government Gazette, subject to obtaining clearance for same from the Attorney General and thereafter  present the same in the Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Act to amend the Divineguma Act, No. 1 of 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval to amend the Divineguma Act, No.1 of 2013, in order to substitute the name 'Divineguma' with the name of 'Samurdhi', taking into consideration the requests made by small groups organized for the upliftment of living conditions of low income communities; societies; associations and village level officers who implement related programmes. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, the Minister of Social Empowerment and Welfare, to publish the  Amendment  Bill prepared for the said purpose by the Legal Draftsman, in the Government Gazette and present it, thereafter, in the Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improving  the  living conditions of the  people living around Wildlife Zones
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval to relocate the families living in the elephant migratory pathways, under  three (03) stages.  Accordingly,  as the first phase, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to entrust the task of conducting  relevant preliminary surveys and community awareness programmes in the three Zones of North-Western, Uva and the Southern, which have been identified by the Department of Wildlife Conservation as the areas in which elephant migratory pathways exist and where human-elephant conflicts are rampant, to the Wildlife Trust, which is an experienced institution in the relevant field and also to get the relevant urgent and priority field activities attended to by the said Trust,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new three storeyed building for the Negombo Regional Engineering Office of the Department of Coast Conservation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The preparation and implementation of plans for coast conservation engineering work within the coastal area of about 250 sq.km., in the Gampaha, Puttalam and Mannar Districts and regulation and control of development activities in the coastal areas are being carried out through the Regional Engineering Office of the Department of Coast Conservation built in Negombo area in the year 1987.  The building, in which this office is presently housed, is about 30 years old and the facilities found there are inadequate for the present day requirements.
