Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to construct a new three storied building for the Negombo Regional Engineering Office of the Department of Coast Conservation, at an estimated cost of Rs.60 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project on the Preparation of Sri Lanka’s Third National Communication (TNC) Report on Climate Change
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-18
decision_details_body: - The United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) was ratified by Sri Lanka in the year 1993. In terms of Article 12 of the said Convention, each Party is required to prepare and submit a National Communication  Report containing the information on climate change  and accordingly, Sri Lanka has submitted the relevant First and Second  Communication Reports to the UNFCCC Secretariat, in the years 2000 and 2012,  respectively. In order to successfully strengthen Sri Lanka's institutional and technical capacities to respond effectively to climate change challenges and meet its obligations  under the UNFCCC, as a Member State, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement the Project on the Preparation of the Third National Communication Report on Climate Change,  utilizing the grant assistance to be provided under the Global Environment Facility (GEF)  by  the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and to submit the Report so prepared to the UNFCCC Secretariat, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Budget 2017 - the Second Reading Debate and the Committee Stage Debate
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - The information submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, that the First Reading related to the 2017 Budget (the Budget Speech) is scheduled to be held on 2016-10-11, and the dates proposed for the Second Reading Debate and the Committee Stage Debate are scheduled for 26 days during the months of November and December, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Warehouse Complex at Kilinochchi
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - With a view to providing high quality storage facilities for the farmers of the Kilinochchi district to store their agricultural produce, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to award the contract for the construction of a Warehouse Complex of 32,000 sq ft, in the district, consisting of an office building with a research laboratory, a building with accommodation facilities, a water sump and a transformer cabin etc., in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of Contracts for Buildings to be Constructed at the Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - With a view to developing infrastructure facilities required by the student population studying in the Universities of Kelaniya, Eastern, Ruhuna and the Bhiksu University, to obtain a more quality education, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contracts for the buildings to be constructed at the above Universities, in accordance with the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Expeditious Project for Construction of Hostels for the University Students
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - The number of students presently receiving education within the State University system is about 94,000 and the development of buildings and other facilities required to provide  adequate hostel facilities to 52,800 out of this number, have been completed.  Since the Government has planned to increase the annual intake of students to State Universities by 10%, action has to be taken to provide more hostel facilities.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to construct 24 new hostels to provide hostel facilities for a further number of about 9,600 university students, at a cost of Rs.1,430 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Secretariat and an Advisory Committee for the Colombo Process and the Abu Dhabi Dialogue during the period of Sri Lankan chair
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - The Colombo Process was established in the year 2003 as a regional consultative process on contractual labour for Asian countries. Similarly, in 2008, the Abu Dhabi Dialogue was founded by stakeholders engaged in the process of recruiting labour with the objective of accepting the joint responsibility of the members states to enforce compliance with international law and regulations relating to the employing of temporary contractual labour. Recognizing Sri Lanka's commitment towards promoting the safety of emigrant workers, Sri Lanka has been unanimously selected for the next Chair of the Abu Dhabi Dialogue for a period of two years. Accordingly, with a view to providing facilities for the functions of the above International Forums, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Foreign Employment, for the establishment of a Secretariat and an Advisory Committee for the Colombo Process and the Abu Dhabi Dialogue for the period that Sri Lanka holds the Chair of the Abu Dhabi Dialogue, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation and Construction of Access Roads and Internal Roads of the 	Dedicated Economic Centers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to get the construction work of the internal roads, access roads, vehicle parks and the network of drains of the Dedicated Economic Centers of Meegoda, Nuwara Eliya, Keppetipola and Veyangoda, carried out by the relevant Provincial Road Development Authority, at an estimated cost of Rs.25.2 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Facilitating the observing of the International Vesak commemoration of the United Nations - 2017 and its convention in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval for the United Nations Vesak Day Celebrations and Conference to be held in the year 2017, to be held in Sri Lanka, with the participation of the United Nations. Representatives of more than 100 countries, including a number of Heads of State, are due to participate in the conference. Furthermore, this occasion would immensely contribute to create an interest in the country of Buddhist philosophy and also to ensure the international respect and recognition that Sri Lanka should receive as the centre of Theravada Buddhism. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to get the necessary funds reserved to organize the United Nations Vesak Day Celebrations and Conference - 2017,  to be held in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Beira Lake Rehabilitation and Redevelopment Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - The Beira lake, extending over an area of approximately 120 ha. in the middle of Colombo city, adds considerable beauty to the city while supporting the drainage of rain water, recreational activities and biodiversity. Due to wastewater discharged through various activities in surrounding environs of the Beira Lake, sewers illegally directed into it and the solid waste, this water source is being subjected to pollution. Similarly, due to the irregular development activities carried out in the adjacent lands, access to the lake bund is also obstructed from many places. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement the Beira Lake Redevelopment Project, in order to develop the Beira lake and the surrounding area as a place with pleasant environmental conditions and recreational facilities in the city of Colombo, at an estimated cost of Rs.12,550 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement to be entered into between Sri Lanka and the Philippines on the Waiver of Visa Requirements for Holders of Diplomatic and Official Passports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - With a view to improving the bilateral relations between Sri Lanka and the Philippines, while facilitating the travel of parties' nationals who are on official mission for their respective Governments, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs, to sign the Agreement to be entered into between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Republic of the Philippines, to exempt the nationals of either Party who are holders of valid diplomatic and official passports, from the obligation to obtain visas for entry, stay and travel across the territory of the other party, for a period that does not exceed 30 days,    was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of District General Hospital ,Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - The District General Hospital, Kalutara, being the largest hospital in the Kalutara District, provides healthcare services also  for patients coming from the  adjacent districts such as Ratnapura and Galle. During the past several years, the number of patients visiting this hospital has increased and therefore, the facilities of the hospital have to be improved in order to provide a quality healthcare service. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to construct a medical ward complex,  administrative building, staff quarters and the drugs store, at an estimated cost of Rs.4,121 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement between Sri Lanka and the Republic of Cuba, on Cooperation in Science, Technology and Innovation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to sign the  'Agreement on the Cooperation in Science, Technology and Innovation', to be entered into between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Cuba, with a view to encouraging the cooperation between Sri Lanka and Cuba, in the fields of Science, Technology and Research and providing assistance for the said purpose,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Scientific and Technological Cooperation in High Energy Physics
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to sign an Expression of Interest (EoI) with the   European Organization for Nuclear Research (CERN), for the Scientific and Technological Cooperation in High Energy Physics, expressing agreement to support research projects implemented with CERN by the Universities and other Research Institutes of Sri Lanka, and also providing an opportunity to Sri Lankan Scientists, Engineers and Technicians to work in the said organization as its Associate Members, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing further relief to the victims of the explosion that occurred on 2016-06-05 in the ammunition dump of the Army Camp at Salawa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - A sum exceeding Rs.359 million has already been released to the District Secretariat, Colombo, for the payments in respect of the houses which were damaged due to the explosion that occurred in the ammunition dump of the Army Camp at Salawa, belonging to the Seethawaka Divisional Secretary's Division in the Colombo District. The proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, to provide compensation for the equipment that had been in the houses and business places affected by this disaster and to construct a temporary common business place, through the Urban Development Authority (UDA), for those who had conducted their businesses in places obtained on rental basis, until such business places are renovated, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting a Workshop on ‘Water Re-use/Alternative Water Supply’ in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to hold a Workshop on "Water Re-use and  Alternative Water Supply", in Colombo, from 1st to 3rd November, 2016, organized in collaboration with the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA), with a view to provinding an overview on both theoretical and practical aspects of water re-use and desalination, membrane technology, advanced oxidation processes and natural treatment systems, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Control of flood and environmental pollution in the Sainthamarthu Divisional Secretary's Division in Kalmunai
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - The people living in the Sainthamarthu Divisional Secretary's Division, which is situated in the coastal belt of the Ampara District, are affected by the floods annually caused due to the overflow of the lagoon situated in the vicinity of the area. This situation has arisen due to lack of a proper draining network, the natuaral flow of water being obstructed due to various aquatic plants which are posing a threat to the natural ecosystem of the lagoon and the disposal of garbage in the lagoon by the people. Therefore, with a view to improving the natural beauty of the lagoon, developing the same and securing its sides from dumped garbage and protecting more than 10,000 people belonging to 2,700 families living in the vicinity of the lagoon from floods and erosion, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to construct a retaining wall around the lagoon, at an estimated cost of Rs.162 million,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ratification of the Conventions of the International Labour Organization (ILO) pertaining to the Maritime Field
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - With a view to enhancing the employment opportunities for Sri Lankans  pertaining to the maritime field, uplifting their working conditions and obtaining other benefits associated with the Shipping Industry, the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, the Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, to ratify the ILO Maritime Labour Convention of 2006 and the Seafarers' Identity Documents Convention No.185 of 2003, and to provide necessary legislative provisions for the implementation of the said Conventions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Open Government Partnership - National Action Plan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - The 'Open Government Partnership' (OGP), formally established at international level in the year 2011 as a multilateral initiative that encourages governments to promote transparency, empower citizens, fight corruption, harness new technologies to strengthen governments, learn from each other's experiences and work in harmony with civil society, has at present, a membership of about 70 countries. As per the invitation issued to Sri Lanka to join the said Partnership, in appreciation of the good governance initiative being carried out by the present government, Sri Lanka too, participated at its summit held in October, 2015 in Mexico. All participating member countries of OGP are required to develop a two year National Action Plan pertaining to the areas such as good governance, accountability, transparency, public participation and anti-corruption in accordance with the founding principles of the said Partnership. Accordingly, as proposed by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, the Cabinet decided to accept the Open Government National Action Plan prepared by Sri Lanka with the assistance of the relevant parties, and to establish a National Steering Committee headed by H.E. the President and the Hon. Prime Minister and comprising of the relevant Ministers and the Parties concerned, to monitor its operation and progress.

description: Implementation of a country level Intellectual Property Project on Tourism and Culture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - The joint proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs and Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs, to enter into a Cooperation Agreement between the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority (SLTDA) and the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), for the implementation of a proposed Project on 'Intellectual Property in Tourism and Culture” of WIPO, in Sri Lanka,  with a view to promoting tourism industry and cultural heritage as well as raising awareness and developing capacities on the use of Intellectual Property (IP) to support the attaining of development goals associated with the tourism industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Draft Concept Paper and Framework pertaining to the establishment of “Grama Rajya” Units
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - A proposal to establish 2,500 “Grama Rajya” units throughout the Island, in order to ensure the active participation of the general public in the development process, was included in the “Five Point Plan” policy statement presented in the General Election 2015.  Accordingly, the draft concept paper and framework prepared by the Committee comprising of public officers, university scholars, retired public officers and representatives from non-Government sectors, appointed to prepare a draft concept paper for the establishment of “Grama Rajaya” units, and submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, was referred to the Parliamentary Sectoral Oversight Committee on Internal Administration and Public Management for further discussion, as decided by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of Powers (Divisional Secretaries) (Special Provisions) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that District Secretaries warrant the grant of more power,  to supervise the development activities implemented at District and Divisional level. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, and the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to publish the Transfer of Powers (Divisional Secretaries) (Special Provisions) Bill, which has been drafted in order to make provisions for a more meaningful, effective and transparent implementation of the Transfer of Powers (Divisional Secretaries) Act No.58 of 1992, within the District and Divisional Administration, in the Government Gazette and present it thereafter in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Policy and Legal Framework relating to the Proposed Counter Terrorism Act of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-11
decision_details_body: - A Committee headed by the Hon. Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, has been appointed to draft the Policy and Legal Framework to introduce a new Counter Terrorism Law, instead of the Prevention of Terrorism Act presently in force, that would adequately provide for the suppression of terrorism and related activities and ensure compliance with the obligations to be fulfilled by Sri Lanka in relation to  Human Rights. Accordingly, the Cabinet decided to refer the Policy and Legal Framework drafted by the said Committee and submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to the Parliamentary Sectoral Oversight Committee on National Security, in order to enable further discussion on the matter.

description: Sustainable Model Village Programme for Poverty Elimination
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already declared the Year 2017 as the “Year of Gaining Freedom From Poverty”. While the poverty of a person or a family will not be reflected merely through the minimum income they receive, the 'house' they reside in could be considered as a primary indicator to society of their poverty.  According to the data and information published by the Department of Census and Statistics and the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, 165,000 of people identified as the 'extremely poor community', are living in either huts, shanties or line rooms.  Similarly, 63% of the poor population resides  in houses  which are less than 400 sq.ft. in extent and another 10% lives with no toilet facilities while a majority lives without having access even to electricity. Considering this state of affairs, the Ministry of Housing and Construction has proposed to implement a 'Sustainable Model Village Programme for Poverty Elimination', to coincide with the Poverty Alleviation Year which falls on Year 2017.  Accordingly, the joint proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena and Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to  implement a programme to construct a total of 12,500 housing units, inclusive of 20 model villages for each district, comprising of 25 housing units of 550 sq.ft each, covering the areas where most indigent people exist, stricken by extreme poverty, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appropriation Bill for the Financial Year 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to present the  Appropriation Bill for the Financial Year 2017, in Parliament, for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of an Integrated Rural Development Programme through  the officers deployed  at Divisional Secretariat  and Grama Niladhari’s Division Levels
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - Presently, 14,022 Grama Niladhari Divisions have been established within 332 Divisional Secretariat Divisions, covering all the villages across the country. Each Grama Niladhari Division has been allocated with five (05) field officers, namely, Grama Niladhari, Economic Development Officer, Divinaguma Development Officer, Agricultural Research and Production Assistant and  Family Health Services Officer, while  approximately 50 field officers have been deployed at  Divisional Secretariat  Level, representing various Ministries and Departments. Therefore, the proposal made by H.E the President Maithripala Sirisena, to appoint a Cabinet Sub‑Committee, to submit proposals and recommendations on implementing an Integrated Rural Development Programme, with a view to harnessing the contributions of those officers to the national development, in a fruitful and a creative manner, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Beach Nourishment Project  at Marawila through off-shore Sand Mining - Phase II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - Approval has already been granted by the Cabinet of Ministers for the implementation of a Beach Nourishment Project through off-shore sand mining, to control coastal erosion and stabilize the coastal belt at Marawila area, where the most severe coastal erosion situation in Sri Lanka is presently reported.   Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to award the contract relevant to the said project, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Coordination of Inter Provincial Subjects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - When implementing development proposals, the existence of a proper coordination between the Line Ministries and the Provincial Councils will prevent the duplication of tasks and enable the utilization of resources at its optimum level. Therefore, in order to maintain a proper coordination between the Line Ministries and the Provincial Councils, instead of each Ministry conducting its affairs separately with each Provincial Council, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to hold a Conference of the Provincial Chief Secretaries and Secretaries of Line Ministries, in Colombo, once in every two months and to coordinate and implement the said Conference through the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of necessary Drugs to continue with the Child Immunization Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the tender for the procurement of  100,000 Vials of Adsorbed Diptheria, Tetanus, Pertussis, Hepatitis B and Haemophilus Influenza Type B Conjugate Liquid Vaccine (Pentavalent), 10 Dose Vial, which are essential for the continuation of the Child Immunization Programme, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Antibiotics necessary for the Government Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the tenders for the purchase of 2,400,000 vials of Co-Amoxiclav Injection 1000/200 mg, which is widely  used as an antibiotic drug, and 500,000 Vials of Meropenem Injection 1gm, which is used as an antibiotic for infections, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Infrastructure Facilities of the State Universities and the Higher Educational Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - The Government has accorded a high priority to fulfilling the requirements of students who are presently engaged in studies, and students who are to be enrolled for the Technology Degree and other Degree Courses, by enhancing the existing space and facilities at State Universities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to implement development projects for improving infrastructure facilities in the Universities of Colombo, Sri Jayawardenepura, Ruhuna, Sabaragamuwa, Peradeniya, Wayamba, Buddhist and  Pali and the Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening of the public transport service in the hilly and rural areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - With a view to providing a better transport service for the people living in hilly and rural areas, through daily deploying a higher number of buses along the hilly and curvy routes of the Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva Provinces as well as on the narrow roads in the rural areas of other Provinces, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to procure 250 Nos. of 32-35 seater new small buses for the Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB),  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a National College of Education for the Students who follow the Technology Subject Stream
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - The Technology Stream is already being taught in the school system. However, a College of Education for Technology, at national level, has not yet been established to train teachers for the said stream. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to establish the National College of Education for Technology, in Kuliyapitiya, utilizing the financial aid of Rs.1,911 million to be provided by the Korean International Cooperation Agency (KOICA), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recommendations of the Ministerial Sub-Committee appointed to look into the matters pertaining to  female  migrant workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the recommendations of the Ministerial Sub-Committee appointed to look into the matters pertaining to  female  migrant workers, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Foreign Employment, to widen the scope of the existing Family Background Report (FBR) and use the same as a document that decides the eligibility of female migrant workers for pre-departure orientation and recruitment and to entrust the  task of evaluating the family background and the suitability to migrate for employment, to the Committees under the Chairmanship of the relevant Divisional Secretary and comprised of the officers such as the Child Rights Promotion Officer, Early Childhood Development Officer, Women' Development Officer, Child Protection Officer, Medical Officer of Health (MOH) and the Development Officer (Ministry of Foreign Employment) and also to continue with the existing minimum ages for female domestic workers,  without any change, as 25 years of age for Saudi Arabia,  23 years of age for other Middle East countries and  21 years of age for non-Middle East countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revocation of Irrevocable Deeds of Gift on the Ground of Gross Ingratitude Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to present the 'Revocation of Irrevocable Deeds of Gift on the Grounds of Gross Ingratitude Bill', prepared to provide for the revocation of irrevocable deeds of gift, only on the order of a competent court, on the grounds of gross ingratitude to the donor by the donee, in Parliament, for approval, after publishing same in the Government Gazette, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Seethawaka River Hydropower Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - It is anticipated that 50 GW hours could be added to the National Grid annually through the proposed Seethawaka River Hydropower Project of 20 MW, which has been identified under the Electricity Generation Plan of Sri Lanka. This  project is proposed to be established in the Hinguralakanda village of the Dehiowita Divisional Secretariat Division in the Kegalle District. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to obtain the expertise required for the implementation of the project, from the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: To refer Unemployed Graduates, equipped with Skills and Managerial Capacity, to the Plantation Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - A large number of young graduates, who pass out annually from the Universities in Sri Lanka, remaining in an unemployed or under-employed condition for a considerable period of time, has become a social, economic as well as a political issue.  Nevertheless, it is also observed that vacancies exist in posts, in certain fields of the private sector, for which the Degree is considered as a basic qualification. Therefore, with the hope of  referring unemployed graduates to the plantation sector, which is one area where such vacancies exist, the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to commence a Residential Training Course under the National Institute of Plantation Management (NIPM), as a pilot project, to train unemployed graduates for the managerial posts that are vacant in the Regional Plantation Companies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed  Colombo Fort Development Project (Construction of Pedestrian Web and Relocation of Shops)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - Due to irregular development and unauthorized constructions, the area of Colombo Fort and Pettah has become a highly congested area. It has been planned to utilize the blocks of land which had not undergone development due to such irregular constructions and thereby left idling in the middle of the city without being put to any public use, for authorized development works. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to construct two pedestrian paths in the area along the Lake House premises and Beira Lake from D.R. Wijewardene Mawatha to Olcott Mawatha and along the pathway that runs from Olcott Mawatha to Sea Street, at an estimated cost of Rs.44 million and to relocate the shops removed with the objective of regularizing the pavement at Olcott Mawatha, at an estimated cost of Rs.22 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Industrial Park for Leather Industry in the Batticaloa District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - The leather industry, a sector where plenty of scope exists for accessing the export market, has been identified as an industry that should be developed by according high priority. Through the said industry, a substantial amount of foreign exchange could be earned and more than 10,000 direct and indirect employment opportunities would be created. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to establish an eco-friendly Industrial Estate in the Wahanery area of the Batticaloa District, coinciding with the Government's poverty alleviation programme implemented in the said district, in order to provide raw materials required for the footwear and leather goods industry, to facilitate cottage industries in that sector and to develop human resources, and to provide common amenities and marketing facilities,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Cooperation Agreement to be entered into between Sri Lanka and Switzerland  on Migration Matters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs, to sign the Cooperation Agreement to be entered into between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, and the Swiss Federal Council, on migration matters, in order to  prevent irregular migration and related criminal activities, enhance cooperation between the two countries, effectively protect the rights of migrants and enable persons who illegally remain in the other State to return to their own country in a secure and dignified manner, and take necessary steps for the implementation of the said Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Agreement between Sri Lanka and Finland for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion of Taxes on Income
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to sign at State Level, the Agreement to be entered into between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Finland, for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion of taxes on income with a view to improving economic relations and enhancing cooperation between Sri Lanka and Finland, and to move a resolution in Parliament to that effect, in terms of Section 97 (1) (a) of the Inland Revenue Act, No.10 of 2006, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of relief to persons affected by recent disasters - Progress as at 2016-08-31
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body:
- The Cabinet noted the following information submitted by Hon. Anura Priyadharashan Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, relating to the progress  achieved by the end of August  2016, on the provision of relief to  persons affected by the explosion that occurred on 2016-06-05 at the Salawa Army Camp located in Seethawaka Divisional Secretariat Division of the Colombo District, provision of relief to persons affected by the landslides which occurred as a result of heavy rains in the Kegalle District between 10th  to 17th of May 2016 and the provision of relief for those who were affected due to floods and landslides that occurred in  May 2016:   
 *   Provision of Rs.422.85 million has already been issued to District Secretariat, Colombo, for the provision of relief  to people affected by the explosion that occurred at the Army Camp located at Salawa, and the said provisions have been spent to provide monthly allowances for  persons with damaged houses until they  return  to their houses, to grant allowances to those affected who were self-employed and  for the payment of compensation  for the damaged houses.  
*      Provisions have been given to the District Secretariat Kegalle, at various instances, to provide relief to 34,653 people of 9,588 families in the said district, who were affected due to landslides which occurred as a result of heavy rains in the Kegalle District between 10th to 17th of May 2016 and action is being taken to construct 145 houses, for the families recommended to be resettled due to high-risk, with the contribution of the private sector.  
*    	Measures have been taken to provide Rs. 586.79 million  under the National Insurance Programme for natural disasters, Rs.149.02 million  under  the National Insurance Programme and Rs. 111.21 million  under the treasury provisions for the  provision of relief to  586,731 persons of 142,942 families affected due to disasters of floods and landslides that occurred in  May 2016.

description: Bilateral Air Services Consultations between Sri Lanka and Finland
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to formally sign the Air Services Agreement between Sri Lanka and Finland, agreed on 2013-12-12 in Durban, South Africa in order to  exercise the freedom traffic rights for both passenger and cargo flights of the two countries without any restrictions and to accept the designated airlines of the two countries, and thereafter to take appropriate measures for its entry into force, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Air Services Consultations between Sri Lanka and the Kingdom of Norway/ Sweden/Denmark (The Parties)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to formally sign the Air Services Agreement agreed on 2015-10-21 by the Aeronautical Authorities of the states concerned, during the International Civil Aviation Negotiations Conference (ICAN) held in Antalya, Turkey, for the purpose of conducting both passenger and freighter operations between Sri Lanka and the Kingdom of Norway/Sweden/Denmark and to take appropriate measures for its entry into force, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme - Tranche 2
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to obtain funds from the Asian Development Bank (ADB), for the implementation of Tranche 2 of the Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme, comprising of the components of electricity transmission infrastructure enhancement, efficiency improvement of the medium-voltage network and expansion of demand-based power management for energy efficiency through development of a smart grid and metering pilot sub-project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening the  Farmers of the Dry Zone to face up to the impacts of climate change
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-10-04
decision_details_body: - In the recent past, Sri Lanka had to face calamities such as rising temperatures,  erratic rainfall patterns as well as ensuing severe droughts and floods due to climate change and the people who farm in the Dry Zone using rain water and rural irrigation systems, are the ones most affected by these disasters.  Similarly, the Chronic Kidney Disease (CKDu), which has severely affected the Dry Zone, shows a high incidence in 81 Divisional Secretariat Divisions of 11 districts in the  said Zone. Accordingly,  with a view to  promoting integrated development in the watershed areas of Malwathu Oya, Yan Oya and Mee Oya river basins where  rural irrigation systems are more prevalent and the  Kidney Disease and Poverty are widespread, implementing drinking water supply schemes in the districts of Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa, Mannar, Vavuniya, Trincomalee, Kurunegala and Puttalam, which are connected to the above river basins and strengthening the institutional and organizational structures of the relevant areas with community participation to face up to disasters, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment,to implement a Climate Resilience Project through integrated water management, within 07 years from the year 2017,  utilizing the grant of US$ 38.087 million to be provided by the Green Climate Fund (GCF), established under the  United Nations Framework Convention on  Climate Change (UNFCCC),  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Redevelopment of the Bogambara Prison Precinct
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to entrust the redevelopment of the precincts of the Bogambara Prison of about 5ha in Kandy city, which has become vacant due to the said Prison being relocated in Pallekele area, as a tourist centre, in a manner that safeguards its historic value, to an internationally reputed institution which possesses expertise in designing such work, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of taxes imposed on Cigarettes and Tobacco Products
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - It has been revealed through surveys that 15% of persons between the ages of 18 to 69  in Sri Lanka are smokers and it is estimated that the annual deaths which occur due to tobacco related diseases amount to approximately 30,000. It has been calculated that the Government has to spend annually, a sum of about Rs.72 billion to treat the ailments caused through the use of tobacco.  'Imposing of taxes' has been identified as a successful methodology in  controlling  the use of tobacco and the consumption of cigarettes, by the World Health Organization (WHO).   Accordingly, as per the recommendation made by the Ministerial Committee appointed to consider the joint proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena and Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to revise the tax imposed on cigarettes and tobacco products, the Cabinet decided to re-impose the 15% Value Added Tax (VAT) on cigarettes; to increase the production tax on a cigarette of any size by Rs.5/-; to increase the cess tax on import of beedi leaves from Rs.2,000/- to Rs.3,000/- per kilogram; and in addition, to take action to reduce the use of tobacco in the country, through the adoption of other measures as well.

description: Review of the Government Paddy Purchasing Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - The Government Paddy Purchasing Programme, under this government, has been implemented up to now throughout the three consecutive harvesting Seasons of Maha 2014/15, Yala 2015 and Maha 2015/16. The Cabinet approved the implementation of the proposals made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of  Finance, to dispose the remaining paddy stock of the paddy purchased in the year 2015, following the government approved procurement procedure, prior to the  commencement of the reaping of harvest of Yala 2016; to dispose  the paddy  stocks purchased in the year 2016 and stored in warehouses of the Paddy Marketing Board, during the months of October and November, where the higher  price is reported; and to settle the outstanding balances to the General Treasury; and to settle the dues to the State Banks pertaining to  paddy purchasing through utilizing  the money derived from paddy disposal, with a view to implementing the said programme successfully in the future too, as per the recommendations made by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management (CCEM).

description: Restructuring of the Department of Labour and the Drafting of a Service Minute for Labour Officers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - The private sector renders an immense contribution to the economic growth of the country and a huge task is being carried out by the Department of Labour to  maintain  industrial peace, which is required to  obtain the services of the private sector efficiently and qualitatively. The Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations has appointed an Officials' Committee to study the problems that arise in providing the services of the Department efficiently and with high quality and to make recommendations to restructure the Department to suit the present day needs and the recommendation process of the said Committee is at its final phase.  Simultaneous with the said process, an Officials' Committee comprising of the officials of the relevant ministries and the departments, has also been appointed  to draft a Service Minute for the Labour Officers' Service, for the improvement of the service conditions of the Labour Officers in the Department of Labour. Accordingly, the Cabinet noted the information submitted by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, the Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, to the effect that the Reports of the above two (02) Officials' Committees will be submitted to the Cabinet in near future.

description: Awarding  the Contract for the Construction of  Anchorage Facilities at Peraliya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to award the contract for the construction of  the proposed anchorage facilities to be established at Peraliya, Galle district, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of Medical Equipment for the Epilepsy Unit of the National Hospital of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the procurement/tender for the supply and installation of the Monitoring Medical Equipment essential for providing an advanced healthcare service through the newly constructed Epilepsy Unit of the National Hospital of Sri Lanka, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion the Construction Work of the Cancer Treatment Centre at  Teaching Hospital, Kandy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - The Teaching Hospital, Kandy, which is the second largest tertiary healthcare institute in Sri Lanka, caters to about 4,000 cancer patients every year. With a view to increasing the number of beds in the hospital by 340 and providing a more qualitative healthcare service to the cancer patients, the construction of a 11 storied Cancer Treatment Centre for the Teaching Hospital, Kandy was commenced in the year 2013 and the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contract for the completion of the balance work (Phase III) of the Centre, to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of the Main Road, that runs towards Nedunkerni Town  from Gajabapura area of Welioya, Mullaitivu District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - The main road of 11.1 km long running from Gajabapura, Welioya to the Nedunkerni Town, is the shortest route  available for the people living in Welioya, Mullaitivu District, to access the Mullaitivu Town, which is the main town of the  district. The development of this road, which is highly dilapidated at present, would ease the daily life of the people living in the Welioya area. As such, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to improve this road, at an estimated cost of Rs.466.3 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Projects with the objective of dispersing the benefits of the digital technology to every citizen of the country
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - With the objective of dispersing the benefits of  digital technology to every citizen in the country, a number of development projects that should be implemented within the three year period from 2016 to 2018, have been identified by the Information and CommunicationTechnology Agency (ICTA) of Sri Lanka.    Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, for the implementation of 40 projects under the programmes of 'National Digitization' and 'Upgrading Nenasala', utilizing the budgetary provisions approved for the year 2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 13. National Anti-Corruption Summit scheduled to be held in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval to conduct a National Anti-Corruption Summit in Sri Lanka, with the objectives of educating politicians, senior officials in public and private sectors, other relevant parties and the general public for the establishment of a corruption free society and creating a dialogue in society on the eradication of bribery and corruption. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to hold a 'National Summit on Anti-Corruption' in Colombo, on the 09th of December, 2016, with the participation of about 700 local and foreign  representatives, to coincide with the International Anti-Corruption Day, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prevention of the difficulties caused to the general public due to stray dogs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, for the implementation of the Action Plan containing the recommendations focusing on the areas of controlling the dog population, efficient conducting of dog vaccination programmes, establishing  dog care centres and creating proper coordination in this regard between the Local Government Authorities and other institutions, submitted by the Officials' Committee appointed by the Cabinet to formulate a suitable mechanism to prevent the difficulties caused to the general public due to the stray dogs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improving the nutritional levels of the Children of Early Childhood Development Centres/Pre-Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - The programme to provide a glass of fresh milk for the children learning in  Childhood Development Centres and Pre-Schools is being implemented since the year 2006, with the objectives of improving the nutritional levels of the children of low income families who suffer from nutritional deficiencies and strengthening the domestic dairy farmer. When reviewing the said programme, experts have pointed out that the nutritional requirements of  a pre-school child could not be fulfilled  through merely providing a glass of milk. With a view to minimizing the nutrition deficiencies of children in their early childhood,  the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, to select the Divisions of Medical Officers of Health (MOH), where a higher percentage of underweight children of 2-5 years of age reside and to implement a programme of providing a balanced breakfast to the children of the Early Childhood Development Centres in such divisions, during the five (05) days of the week, from the year 2017, in place of the programme of providing a fresh glass of milk, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquisition of Land for the Construction of the Proposed Economic Centre in Vavuniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - A sum of Rs.200 million has been allocated through the Budget Proposals - 2016, for the construction of a Dedicated Economic Centre in the vicinity of  Vavuniya Town.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to acquire for the said Ministry, a block of land in extent of 2.5 Acres situated in the Madauwythakulam village in the Munrumurippu Grama Niladhari Division, selected with the consent of the Co-Chairmen of the District Coordinating Committee of Vavuniya, for the construction of the said Dedicated Economic Centre,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Incorporation of the Institute of Food Science and Technology of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - The Institute of Food Science and Technology of Sri Lanka functions with the objectives of providing modern technological knowledge required for food production and processing industry in Sri Lanka, improving the quality and  safety of foods on a scientific basis in keeping with international standards and bringing the country's food industry up to an internationally competitive level.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to incorporate the Institute of Food Science and Technology of Sri Lanka, through an Act of Parliament, in order to strengthen the operations of the said Institute, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of Soya Bean for the Production of Thriposha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - The annual requirement of Soya Bean in Sri Lanka is around 220,000 MT and the average annual production of Soya Bean in the country is around 22,500 MT.  Therefore, high priority has been given by the Government to enhance the production of Soya Beans.  As such, during the Yala Season of 2016, Soya Bean has been cultivated in about 4,000 ha, giving priority to the Mahaweli Zones and the Anuradhapura District and the anticipated harvest from that is about 8,000 MT.  With a view to protecting the local farmers and promoting supplementary food crop production, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to purchase about 5,000 MT. of the said anticipated harvest from farmers and issue to the Thriposha Production Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transferring the freshwater hatchery at Panapitiya, Kalutara, to the National Aquatic Resources Research and Development Agency, permanently
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - The ornamental fisheries industry is a high-potential area that can make a considerable contribution towards employment generation, and researches related to the said industry are being successfully conducted by the National Aquatic Resources Research and Development Agency (NARA). Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development to permanently transfer the freshwater hatchery at Panapitiya, Kalutara, which is presently, a property of the National Aquaculture Development Authority of Sri Lanka (NAQDA), to the National Aquatic Resources Research and Development Agency, to enable the the fulfilment of research requirements related to the ornamental fisheries industry, while enhancing its infrastructure facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Water Supply Facilities for the Villages where the affected families in the Kegalle District are resettled
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - About 2,000 families in Kegalle District have been temporarily settled in 65 locations, due to the destruction of their houses or the removal from their homes as a result of landslides and high-risk  warnings. It has been planned to resettle the said displaced people in 11 Divisional Secretariats of the Kegalle District.  Water supply facilities have to be provided expeditiously to the 45 places so identified as suitable for resettlement. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to provide the necessary water supply facilities, at an estimated cost of Rs.455 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ensuring safety at unguarded railway crossings
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - There are about 676 unguarded railway gates within Sri Lanka and even though there should be 2028 gate keepers, consisting of 03 persons per gate, only 1953 gate keepers are currently employed to assure the safety of pedestrians, passengers and  vehicles. An honorary service is rendered by them for a monthly allowance of only Rs.7,500/-, which consists of Rs.250 per day, without any right to salaries, wages and other privileges to which  government servants are entitled. Considering the requests made by the said gate keepers to the effect that this allowance is  inadequate,  the proposals made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, as per  the recommendations of the Officials' Committee appointed to submit  recommendations to resolve this problem, that the allowance of Rs.22,500/- presently  allocated per a month for 03 gate keepers, should be granted not as an allowance made for a person but as an allowance made per a gate, and that a suitable internal arrangement should be formulated to distribute that allowance  among the railway gate keepers involved per gate and to install railway gates with 'Bell and Light' systems  in relevant places, as a long-term solution, giving priority to places where most accidents occur and unsafe locations with bends, were approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enforcement of the Memorandum of Understanding relevant to Youth development due to be signed between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval to sign the Memorandum of Understanding pertaining to Youth development between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. As such, the proposal made by the Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, for the revised Memorandum of Understanding, incorporating the subsequent amendments made by the Government of Pakistan, to be signed between the Ministry of National Policies and Economic Affairs of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Inter Provincial Coordination of Pakistan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Filling of the Existing Teacher Vacancies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body:
- An adequate number of teachers should be available in schools to ensure equal access to a qualitative education in  schools  throughout the island.  However, there is a dearth of about 22,500 teachers as a whole, in  schools across  the island. Neither Teachers nor resources have been adequately provided for, especially, to the schools in rural areas to teach the subjects of Science, Maths and English. With a view to providing a sustainable solution to this problem, in addition to the recruitment of graduates from state universities and diploma holders, it has been planned to implement a programme to recruit youth who have passed A/Ls and qualified for university entrance,  to the teaching service, after completion of a B.Ed (Science) or a B.Ed. (Arts) Degree awarded by a  private university approved by the Ministry of Higher Education and Highways, and also to provide a sum of Rs.275,000/- annually by a state bank to those who have been admitted to such Degree programme and after completing the Degree, to have them serve in a teacher vacancy in a school in a district of their choice for 10 years. In case they serve for a period of 10 years in the relevant district, action will be taken not to recover the loan granted to them for the Degree programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to recruit 5,000 students, who have passed the G.C.E. (A.L) Examination, as teachers of Science and Maths under this programme during the 1st Phase, was approved by the Cabinet. 
 
	It was also decided to vest authority on the Ministry of Education, to recruit graduates expeditiously to address the dearth of Science teachers existing in the government schools.

description: Construction and maintenance of Government and Semi-government buildings widely as eco-friendly green buildings
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - Although our ancestors had constructed their dwelling places using very simple plans and maintaining very high standards to suit the tropical climatic conditions; in the recent years, due to imitating foreign architectural designs without paying attention to the climatic conditions in Sri Lanka, most of the present day buildings are deprived of sufficient sunlight and natural ventilation and have become dependent on artificial lighting and air conditioning and as a result, a plethora of environmental, economic and technological issues have arisen. Buildings which are constructed with eco-friendly materials and methods and optimal and efficient utilization of other resources including energy, are commonly known as 'green buildings' and when moving towards sustainable development, the adoption of the Guidelines on  Green Buildings is of utmost importance.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement the Guidelines on Green Buildings, prepared with the concurrence of the relevant Ministries, by the Officials' Committee appointed to submit recommendations on bringing all government buildings to up to a sustainable and eco-friendly level and maintaining such buildings in a safe and user-friendly manner, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Quay at Naval Dockyard - Trincomalee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-27
decision_details_body: - Due to the terrorist activities which prevailed in the past, the Trincomalee harbour which is one of the deepest natural harbours in the world and the second deepest in Asia, could not be properly developed. The largest base of the Sri Lanka Navy is located in this harbour and the naval dockyard situated there is the home to the Eastern Naval Command and the Maritime Academy of Sri Lanka. Although the construction work of a quay at the naval dockyard had been commenced in the year 1990 to provide berthing facilities for larger vessels, the said construction work has been subsequently suspended due to various reasons.  Since action is being  taken by the Sri Lanka Navy to  acquire four (04) larger vessels during the period of 2017-2019 to expand the patrolling of the Sri Lankan territorial waters, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to recommence the construction work of the proposed quay, with a length of 220m and a width of 20m, and an access bridge, in order to provide berthing facilities for such larger vessels at the naval dockyard in Trincomalee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extending the service period of Experienced Clinical Consultants up to 63 Years of Age
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13
decision_details_body: - There are 1,164 vacancies in the posts of Medical Consultants in the curative sectors of Hospitals in the Island. Since a considerable period of time will be needed to fill the said vacancies under the prevailing system and taking into consideration their ability to serve beyond the existing  compulsory age of retirement, with the skills and experiences acquired during their service period, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to extend the age of compulsory retirement of experienced Medical Consultants serving in the curative sectors up to age of 63 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting the Cremation Ceremony of Late Most Venerable Nauyane Ariyadhamma Thero, the Venerable Sub-Chief Incumbent of the Ramanna Chapter, under State Sponsorship
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13
decision_details_body: - Appreciating the great service rendered to Sri Lanka nationally and religiously by the Late Most Venerable Nauyane Ariyadhamma Thero,  Maha Kammattanacharya, Mahopadya, Thripitakacharya, Venerable Sub-Chief Incumbent of the Ramanna, Chapter and  Chief Advisor to Kalyani Yogashrama Sansthawa, the proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, to hold the Cremation Ceremony of Ven. Thero, under state sponsorship, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Organizing the 69th  Independence Day falling on 04th  February 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, to appoint a Committee under the Chairmanship of Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to organize and monitor the programmes pertaining to the 69th Independence Day Celebration falling on 04th of February 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Act on Value Added Tax
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13

description: Construction of a Three Storied New Building for the Divisional Secretariat, Panadura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13
decision_details_body: - The Divisional Secretariat, Panadura belonging to the Kalutara District, consists of 72 Grama Niladhari Divisions with a population of about 205,969. Since there is insufficient space in the buildings where the Divisional Secretariat is housed, the people who daily visit the office to  receive services and also the staff of the office have to undergo many difficulties. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, to construct a new building for the Divisional Secretariat, Panadura, with the necessary facilities, at an estimated cost of Rs.172.8 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Projects implemented by the Ministry of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure  for the improvement of the Information  Technology Literacy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to implement the two (02) projects namely the 'School Computer Labs Project' carried out with a view to improving the Information Technology (IT) infrastructure and literacy in the identified schools across the country coming under the purview of the Provincial Councils and the 'District IT Resources Centres Project' carried out with the main objective of coordinating with the district administration on issues related to IT resources management in each district, utilizing the budgetary provision of Rs.250 million and Rs.42 million set apart from the Budget 2016, respectively, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquisition of Soranawatta land in Horana, to the Department of Prisons, to relocate the Welikada Prison and its supportive units
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement and Hindu Religious Affairs, to vest the Soranawatta land in extent of 28 acres situated in Horana, presently possessed by the UDA, with the Department of Prisons, for the relocation of Welikada Prison, Prison Hospital, Women's Ward and Prison Quarters and the other Units of the prison and to handover the land in extent of 38.5 acres in extent belonging to the Department of Prisons where the Welikada Prison is presently situated, to the UDA for town development activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the Fields of Radio, Television and Film between Sri Lanka and   Bangladesh
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13
decision_details_body: - With a view to exchanging current news and television programmes,  success stories and technology in the Media field between the two countries, the proposal made by Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Parliamentary Reforms and Mass Media, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Ministry of Parliamentary Reforms and Mass Media of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Information of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mihintale Town Centre Re-development Project at Mihintale
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13
decision_details_body: - The Urban Development Authority (UDA) has prepared a plan to develop the Mihintale Town with facilities required for around 8,000 people that daily visit the town for various requirements as well as for the devotees and tourists who visit the town in the festive season.  Under this plan it has been proposed to construct commercial buildings, a public market, a surface drain system, children's parks, public places,  car parks  and street seating places.  Accordingly,  the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement the Mihintale Town Centre Re-development Project, during the period from 2016 to 2019, at an estimated cost of Rs.200 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of Lands required for the Development of the Angunakolapelassa Town
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13
decision_details_body: - The Urban Development Authority (UDA) has designed to develop the Angunukolapelassa Town which is located in a place that links towns in the Hambantota District with each other, under a formal development plan. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development,  to vest a block of land in extent of 9A-2R-10P belonging to the Mahaweli Development Authority, situated in the Angunukolapelassa town, with the UDA, required for the development projects such as the construction of proposed circuit bungalows, bank buildings, commercial complex, buildings for government institutions, public car park and the  development of the town centre and the bus stand, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Building for the National Design Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13
decision_details_body: - The building which currently accommodates the National Design Centre established for the betterment of local handicraft artists is in a very  dilapidated condition and cannot withstand renovation or alteration to suit  the present day requirements.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to demolish the said building and construct a new building with the required facilities including a workshop, design unit, library, craft demonstration area and administration block etc., for each handicraft sector, at an estimated cost of Rs.80 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of Contributory Pension Scheme for Artists
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13
decision_details_body: - Through the Budget proposals for 2016, funds have been allocated for the creation of a Contributory Pension Scheme for Artists, engaged in various fields of Arts, with a view to ensure their professional recognition and social security.  Accordingly, the proposal  made by Hon. S.B. Nawinne, the Minister of Internal Affairs, Wayamba Development and Cultural Affairs, to implement a Contributory Pension Scheme for the Artists selected by the Department of Cultural Affairs, adopting a method of awarding marks based on age, through the Social Security Board,  effective from this year onwards, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Sri Lanka Disaster Management Act, No.13 of 2005
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13
decision_details_body: - 'The National Council for Disaster Management' and 'the Disaster Management Centre' were established in the year 2005, under the provisions of the Sri Lanka Disaster Management Act, No.13 of 2005, as institutional structures which function to manage the disaster situations  that occur due to natural and human activities and a separate Ministry was established in the year 2010 for the subject of Disaster Management.  The likelihood of the occurrence of disasters has rapidly increased in the recent past and taking into consideration the practical difficulties encountered by the Disaster Management Centre and the Ministry of Disaster Management in carrying out the responsibilities and functions entrusted under the above Act, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadarshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, to amend the Sri Lanka Disaster Management Act, to enable the performance of the functions mentioned in the said Act with proper coordination and collaboration, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Occupational Safety Week 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13
decision_details_body: - The arrangements have been made to conduct the 'National Occupational Safety Week' organized annually by the National Institute of Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH), from 7th to 14th of October 2016, with the main objective of making an outstanding contribution towards boosting the national production through creating a healthy labour force, by minimizing all forms of work related hazards.  It is scheduled to hold an International Conference and a National Seminar on Occupational Safety and Health concurrent with this year's 'National Occupational Safety and Health Week'; and the 'National Occupational Safety and Health - Awards of Excellence Ceremony' will be held, with a view to appreciating the selected business entities which are committed to creating a safe working environment for the employees.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, the Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations, to implement this year's National Occupational Safety Week' in collaboration with the relevant public and private institutions, treating it as a National Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing the compensation paid for damages to human lives and property caused by wild elephants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-09-13
decision_details_body: - The compensation paid for damages to human lives and property caused by wild elephants has been revised lastly in the year 2004.  Accordingly, the total sum of compensation paid annually is around Rs.25million to Rs.35 million. The proposal made by Hon.
