*	Under  the Original Agreement, the SLPA would execute a master lease to the Project Company.

*	Under  the  new Agreement, all reclaimed land will be gazetted under the Lands Ordinance by H.E the President and then allocated to the UDA at which point the UDA will declare such lands as a Development Area under the UDA Act.  This will happen before land is leased on 99 year basis to the Project Company as mentioned above.
Fisherman's Income support programme 

*	Under the Original Agreement, the responsibility of funding the income support programme for  fishermen was a responsibility of the SLPA.  No such programme was implemented by the previous administration of the SLPA .

*	Under the new Agreement, the Project Company will allocate Rs. 500 million towards the fishermen's income support program to the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development to implement the programme in consultation with the Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development. 
Utilities and Transport Infrastructure 

*	Under the Original Agreement, all investments in roads and utilities within the reclaimed area was the responsibility of the Project Company while providing all utilities and road infrastructure up to the periphery of the site was the responsibility of the Government of Sri Lanka (GoSL).

*	Under the new Agreement, the possibility of undertaking public-private partnerships through the Project Company will be evaluated as a long term solution to ease the GoSL's responsibility of undertaking provision of road infrastructure and utilities up to the periphery of the site.
Management and Maintenance of the Reclaimed area 

*	Under the Original Agreement, an Estate Management Company (EMC), 100% owned by the GoSL would manage, maintain and repair the common areas of the Port City by collecting management charges from investors.  However, until such time the EMC is self-sustainable, GoSL or SLPA would have had to inject funds for the operation of the EMC.

*	In order to ease the GoSL's obligation to fund such a venture, under the new agreement, the Project company has agreed to consider establishing and operating the EMC in partnership with GoSL.
Limits imposed on developing lands of the GoSL

*	The Original Agreement limits the developments GoSL could undertake on its land during three years from the completion of reclamation, to educational and cultural activities only.

*	Under the new agreement the above has been expanded in favour of GoSL to include healthcare and hospitals and exhibition and convention centres and the new Colombo International Financial Centre (CIFC).  Also, no restriction will be placed on developing the North and West Ports of the Colombo Harbour.  In addition, the Project Company has agreed to the setting up of the CIFC building in the land area reclaimed first, including making a new investment in the CIFC building no sooner than it is technically feasible to build on reclaimed land and upon mutually acceptable terms being agreed with the GoSL after a feasibility study.
Compensation Claims

*	In view of the goodwill created by the visits of H.E. the President and the Hon. Prime Minister, to China, the Project Company has agreed to withdraw all compensation claims for losses incurred due to the suspension of the project caused by the failure of the previous Administration of the SLPA to obtain the required environmental permits.

*	In their original Master Plan there was provision for night racing.  They had fully abandoned that plan at present. In view of this, a large extent of marketable land becomes available.  Out of this, 2 hectares may be allocated to them.  This will be a good gesture to reciprocate their goodwill in completely waiving off all compensation claims.

*	The above proposal was acceptable to the GoSL since the Project Company has agreed in the new Master Plan approved by the UDA this year to increase public lands (parks, roads, walkways etc. to be used by the general public)  by 28 hectares more than originally planned to make Port City more attractive to the public.  For example, when completed Port City will have 45 hectares of parks and 13 hectares of artificial beaches (compared to 5.7 hectares available to the public at Galle Face Green).
Environmental Approvals

*	Under the original Agreement, the responsibility for undertaking to obtain and financing all environmental approvals for the Project was a responsibility of the SLPA.  There were short-comings in the environmental approvals obtained by the former administration of the SLPA.

*	A comprehensive new Supplementary Environmental Impact Assessment (SEIA) was carried out by the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development in 2015 to address such shortcomings, with the cooperation and funding extended by the Project Company.
New environmental conditions

*	Under the original EIA study carried out in 2011, 42 conditions were imposed by the Department of Coast Conservation (CCD) in its Development Permit.

*	Under the new SEIA carried out by the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development for 269 hectares of reclaimed land and made available for public comments in December 2015, the new Development Permit issued by the CCD includes 70 conditions to mitigate the impact on the environment.
Change of status

*	The previous administration considered this as a Land Reclamation Project to be utilized for real estate, sports, education and cultural development including night racing tracks etc.  Therefore, the bulk of the land was not available for real estate development by the Government.

*	Now it has been agreed with the Government that this land would be used to build a Financial City to fill the vacuum between Singapore and Dubai.  This will enable offshore operations.  For this purpose, the Government will propose new laws for governing offshore activities, like in Dubai.  The Financial City will act as a major income earner and an employment provider for Sri Lanka.

description: Proposals on the measures to be taken to identify the damages caused to people due to landslides occurred because of the extensive rainfall experienced in the Kegalle District during the period of 10th to 17th May 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - Huge damages were caused each and every Divisional Secretariat Divisions located in the Kegalle District including the Aranayake Divisional Secretariat Division due to extensive rainfall experienced in the said District during the period of 10th to 17th May, 2016.  As a result of these landslides, 151 human lives were lost and a total number of 34,833 people of 9,620 families were adversely affected.  At the Special District Coordinating Committee Meeting held on 2016‑06‑01 at the Kegalle Town Hall, chaired by H.E. the President, instructions were given by His Excellency to take immediate action to bring back to normal, the daily life of the people of the district.   Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, for the National Insurance Trust Fund to reimburse the losses caused to the partially damaged 1,845 houses, due to above disaster situation; to construct 1,682 new houses for the 1,682 households recommended for  resettlement by the National Building Research Organization (NBRO), including the totally damaged 230 houses, at an estimated cost of Rs.2,018.4 million; to provide a sum of Rs.200 million to 500 beneficiaries, Rs.400,000 each, who are willing to  build houses in their own lands; to declare the landslide affected areas and the areas identified as high-risk areas as areas restricted for settlement; and to entrust the responsibility of providing the necessary instructions on safety measures in respect of the construction of houses, with the NBRO, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Request for a Treasury loan to the State Engineering Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - Since the Government institutions have awarded a large number of contracts to the State Engineering Corporation, the proposal made to  issue a Treasury Guarantee to obtain loan facilities to meet the working capital required by the Corporation to carry out such activities, as per the recommendation of the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Bilateral Political Consultation between the Ministries of Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka and Georgia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - With a view to enhancing the bilateral relations including economic, trade, scientific, technical, tourism promotion, cultural as well as political cooperation, between the two countries, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to sign the Memorandum of Understanding on Bilateral Political Consultation, during the consultations at the level of Deputy Ministers of Foreign Affairs scheduled to be held in Colombo from 3rd to 4th August 2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Four Storied Building for the Divisional Secretariat, Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - The Divisional Secretariat, Kalutara which is situated centering the Kalutara Town, is comprised of 87 Grama Niladhari Divisions, with a total population of about 159,225. Presently, the Divisional Secretariat, Kalutara is established in the second floor of the District Secretariat and it causes various difficulties for the officers serving there as well as the public who come for services, due to the minimal space available. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, to construct a separate building for the Divisional Secretariat, Kalutara at a total estimated cost of Rs.180 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Building for the District Secretariat, Kalutara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - Kalutara District in the Western Province is comprised of 14 Divisional Secretary's Divisions and 762 Grama Niladhari Divisions, with a total population of about 1,217,374.  The District Secretariat of Kalutara where about 1,100 employees are working, is accommodated in a building of about 45 years old and the limited space therein is inadequate for the office staff and the public.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, to construct a new building for the District Secretariat, Kalutara, with necessary modifications that should be done to the current building, adjacent and connected to the existing building, at an estimated cost of Rs.110.3 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to be signed between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Canada in respect of the National Languages Equality Advancement Project (NLEAP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - The  'National Languages Equality Advancement Project' (NLEAP) is scheduled to be implemented from the year 2017, as a five year programme, with a view to promoting national co-existence, dialogue and official languages among the communities living in Sri Lanka and  improving economic and social equality of Sinhala and Tamil speaking communities living in the country.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mano Ganeshan, the Minister of National Co‑existence, Dialogue and Official Languages, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Canada, for the implementation of the project, utilizing the Canadian Dollars (CAD) 11.2 million grant given by the Government of Canada, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: New Villages Development Authority for Plantation Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Palani Digambaram, the Minister of Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation for the establishment of New Villages Development Authority for Plantation Region, to develop social, economic, cultural and infrastructure facilities and to ensure more active participation of the people living in the plantation areas in the national stream, through establishing new villages in plantation areas, and with the objective of empowering plantation community, as recommended by the Task Force appointed by the Cabinet to work on the establishment of new villages development authority for plantation regions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The International Year of Shelter for the Homeless (IYSH) 1987
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - With a view to finding solutions for the homeless people around the world, on a proposal made by Hon. Ranasinghe Premadasa, the then Prime Minister and the Minister of Housing of Sri Lanka, at the 35th Session of the United Nations General Assembly, the year 1987 was declared as the 'International Year of Shelter for the Homeless'.   Concurrently, Sri Lanka carried out a number of various human settlement projects, in collaboration with several other developing countries. The 30th  Anniversary of the International Year of Shelter for the Homeless falls on the year 2017 and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to commence the development of a series of 'Model Villages' and 'Re‑awakened Villages' in several selected district in the island, on 1st of January 2017, to complete and open several selected human settlement projects and to organize several commemorative programmes in commemoration of the IYSH, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Provisions for the Payment of Salaries before Restructuring the Janatha Estate Development Board, the Sri Lanka State Plantations Corporation and the Elkaduwa Plantations Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Public Enterprise Development, to obtain provisions from the General Treasury, for the payment of salaries for the employees of the Janatha Estate Development Board, the Sri Lanka State Plantations Corporation and the Elkaduwa Plantations Limited, which are being planned to be restructured, since they have become a burden to the Government due to loss-making, for the forthcoming period of this year, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Holding of the Asian Food and Agri Business Conference of the Asian Productivity Organization  in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - The Asian Productivity Organization (APO) was established as a Japan based  International Organization in 1961 and its objective is to enhance the productivity in the industrial and agricultural fields of the member countries.  20 countries in the Asian Pacific Region have obtained the membership of the said organization and Sri Lanka is also a member.  This Organization has decided to hold a Conference on Asian Food and Agri Business, in Sri Lanka from 2nd to 5th August, 2016, under the theme of 'Innovation for enhancing the Productivity and Sustainability of Enterprises in Agri Business and Food Industry'. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to make arrangements to host the said Conference, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of proposed Commercial Complex and By-Pass Road at Gampola
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - The Gampola Town situated in the Kandy District spreads over an area of 5.18 Sq.km and the Urban Development Authority (UDA) has planned to formally develop the Gampola Town,  in order to provide  necessary facilities for  the people within the city limits quantitatively and qualitatively and to minimize the traffic congestion prevalent in the town. As the first stage of this project, it is expected to construct an alternative road to minimize the existing traffic congestion and to establish a Commercial Complex adjacent to the said road.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to vest a block of land belonging to the Railway Department, with the UDA, for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Incubator and Technology Transfer Centre at Makandura (West) Industrial Estate
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - An Incubator and a Technology Transfer Centre is scheduled to be established at Makandura (West) Industrial Estate, as a joint project of the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka and the National Enterprise Development Authority.  This would provide the necessary basic facilities and business ideas for new inventors to create productions.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to establish an Incubator and a Technology Transfer Centre at Makandura (West) Industrial Estate, at an estimated cost of Rs.46.5 million, and to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Wayamba University of Sri  Lanka and the National Enterprise Development Authority, for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of English Language Training at the Sri Lanka German Training Institute (SLGTI), Kilinochchi and Satellite Centres in the Northern and the Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - With the objective of improving demand oriented vocational training in the Northern and Eastern Provinces, 'Vocational Training in the North and the East of Sri Lanka' Project is being implemented under a grant aid assistance of the Government of Germany. The Sri Lanka - German Training Institute (SLGTI) established in Kilinochchi under this project was declared open recently by H.E. the President and the training courses for NVQ Levels 4, 5 and 6 are scheduled to be commenced there.  Further, 15 Satellite Centers will be established in the Northern and Eastern Provinces, providing access to the training courses in NVQ Levels 1 to 3.  The Johannes Gutenberg - University of Mainz and the German International Cooperation (GTZ) Institute have come forward to provide assistance for the development of English Language proficiency of the students studying in the said Satellite Centers of the SLGTI.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, the Minister of Skills Development and Vocational Training, to enter into the Memorandum of Understanding for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Approval for the Memorandum of Understanding for the Development of  the National Eye Bank of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - According to the information of the World Health Organization (WHO), Corneal Blindness is the fourth leading cause of blindness in the World.  This can be cured by restoring the sight through Corneal transplant.  Presently, the number of persons afflicted with Corneal Blindness exceeds 10 million and the lack of supply of Corneas to meet the demand has been a constraint against the elimination of Corneal Blindness. The National Eye Bank of Sri Lanka plays an important role in the elimination of Corneal Blindness in Sri Lanka.  The Sri Lanka National Eye Bank is the only Eye Bank in Sri Lanka that operates with quality certificates according to internationally accepted medical standards and observes without fail the ethics that are to be followed in the transplanting of eye tissues. The 'Asian Corneal Blindness Foundation' and the SightLife, which is a non-profit global health organization have come forward to provide technical assistance and training opportunities required for the National Eye Bank of Sri Lanka and with the objective of developing the National Eye Bank of Sri Lanka, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to enter into the Memoranda of Understanding with those institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Two-storied Paediatric Ward Complex at the Provincial General Hospital, Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - The Provincial General Hospital, Ratnapura is the largest tertiary health care hospital in the Sabaragamuwa Province and it provides health services to a large number of patients from the adjacent Provinces.  However, presently, there is only one ward with 68 beds for paediatric patients. Due to direct admission of patients as well as the patients transferred to the hospital from other hospitals, the Paediatric Ward is constantly overcrowded. Considering the necessity of increasing the quality of patient care services and also the increase in the number of children admitted to the hospital, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to construct a two storied building for the Paediatric Ward of the Provincial General Hospital, Ratnapura, utilizing the donations made by the donors, enabling the addition of 116 additional beds to the said ward, at an estimated cost of Rs.70 million and for the Government to provide the other facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project to Upgrade and Popularize Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) Education in Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - About 65% of the employment in the future world is expected to  consist of  jobs related to Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM).  However, it is only 30% of students that follow the STEM education stream in Sri Lanka. Since this percentage is very low in comparison with the world employment market related to the educational field, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to popularize among children, the studies in the fields of science, technology, engineering and mathematics, to improve the learning processes related to science and technology subject and to implement a project to increase the STEM education in schools, in collaboration with the relevant other Ministries including the Ministry Education and to disseminate the knowledge on innovation to the school children, in an effective manner, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Funds for the Construction of a Building Complex for the National Institute of Social Development, in Seeduwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - The National Institute of Social Development functioning under the Ministry of Social Empowerment and Welfare, is the only state educational institution in Sri Lanka that provides education on social work.  This Institute conducts study courses that possess a high level  of quality which include practical sessions as well.  Presently, approximately 1,500 students who follow the 17 full time courses conducted by this institution, engage in their studies amidst various difficulties, within a space of 70,000 sq.ft. obtained on lease basis and it has been identified that the space available is inadequate for the functions such as conduct of study courses, office work and also for the provision of welfare facilities  to the academic staff and the students. Therefore, as per the recommendation made by the Officials' Committee appointed to investigate into the matter, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, the Minister of Social Empowerment and Welfare, to construct a building of about 100,000 sq.ft. as the first phase of the project on constructing a building complex for the National Institute of Social Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Independent Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIBSL)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of the Convention on International Civil Aviation, to which Sri Lanka is also a party, each Member State is required to establish an independent organization for the conduct of investigations into aircraft accidents and incidents that fall within the jurisdiction of the State. The objective of this requirement is to identify the causal factors that led to an accident or incident and make recommendations for  improvements of the aviation system with the aim of preventing future accidents and incidents.  In terms of the Civil Aviation Act, No.14 of 2010, the responsibility of conducting investigations into aircraft accidents and incidents, is vested with the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri  Lanka.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to draft necessary legislation for the establishment of 'Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau of Sri Lanka', as an independent organization for the conduct of investigations into aircraft accidents and incidents, in terms of the obligations under the Convention on International Civil Aviation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Wildlife Control Units
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - Although, plans have been drawn up to initiate a number of long term and medium term measures to minimize the elephant-human conflict, it would take a considerable period of time to implement such plans and obtain results.  As such, an arrangement is required to minimize the harm that may occur from wild elephants during this period. Similarly, an arrangement is also required to avoid the attacks on humans by creatures such as leopards and crocodiles, as well as to minimize the harm that may be caused to such creatures by humans.  As a short term measure for the above purpose, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to establish 'Wildlife Control Units' covering wildlife zones where the conflicts between wildlife and humans are mostly reported,  to visit such places immediately and take necessary action expeditiously, if any such incident is reported, has already been approved by the Cabinet.  The proposal made by Hon. Mrs. Sumedha G. Jayasena, the Acting Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to establish 05 Wildlife Control Units expeditiously, as a pilot project and to proceed with the establishment of the remaining Units, after reviewing the progress of the established Units by 06 months, as per the recommendations made by the Officials' Committee appointed to study the matter and submit recommendations in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: A Dollar Credit Line of US$ 318 million from the Government of India for the Development of Sri Lanka Railway Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - The Government of India has already provided a credit facility amounting  to US$ 966 million, for the development of the railway  sector in Sri Lanka and that credit facility has been utilized to improve the  Southern and Northern railway lines and for the procurement of rolling stock for the Sri Lanka Railways.  During the official visit made to Sri Lanka in the year 2015, the Prime Minister  of India, has expressed his consent to provide a further Line of Credit amounting to US$ 318 million for the improvement of the railway service in the country. This loan facility is intended to be utilized to rehabilitate the railway tracks from Maho to Anuradhapura and from Anuradhapura to Omanthai, also improving the signalling system; to procure 06 Diesel Multiple Units with air conditioned passenger compartments, 10 locomotives, 30 oil tank wagons, 20 container carrier wagons and 160 passenger coaches, with a view to encouraging economic activities, while ensuring efficient transportation of goods and passengers between Northern and Southern areas of the country.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs,  to enter into an Agreement with the EXIM Bank of India to borrow the said loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting tax relief for commercial lands alienated on lease basis in terms of the State Land Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - When lands are leased out on long term lease for a period of 30 years under the State Land Ordinance, the annual lease amount is calculated  based on the market value determined by the Chief Valuer and once in every five years, the said lease amount will be increased by 50%. As such, taking into consideration the difficulties encountered  by the small and medium scale entrepreneurs, especially in the Mahaweli areas, due to the exorbitant lease amounts charged in leasing out state lands for commercial purposes, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to formulate a policy on charging a relevant lease amount based on a concessionary methodology, when leasing out state lands for commercial purposes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Use of Public Funds for  Foreign Travel in a Productive Manner
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-26
decision_details_body: - 	Use of Public Funds with frugality and care, is the responsibility of all peoples' representatives and public officers. Accordingly, circular  instructions have been issued,  to all public institutions, for that purpose.  However, it has been observed that sometimes, acting contrary to such instructions,  the peoples' representatives of the Provincial Councils and Local Government Authorities in particular,  and also public officers, engage in foreign travel as groups, utilizing government funds and the funds received through the foreign projects. As such, taking into consideration the necessity of using government funds, especially the foreign grants and loans, effectively; the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to formulate a suitable methodology pertaining to foreign travel by peoples' representatives and public officers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka and the Surbana Jurong, Singapore to establish a Consultancy Company
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - Rightly assessing the investment potentials of Sri Lanka, the Government has recognized the acute need of attracting top tier investors to  make Sri Lanka an attractive destination. It has been identified that it is appropriate to establish a Government owned Consultancy Firm to leverage the maximum benefits to the Government of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade,  to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka and the Surbana Jurong of Singapore which is a world renowned urban redevelopment consultancy firm that provides widespread area of services such as Urban Planning & Design,  Development Management, Architecture, Cost & Contracts Management, Project Management, Facilities Management etc., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Price Control of essential food Items
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - Although it is usual for significant changes in prices of essential consumer commodities to vary from district to district based on transport costs and the number of middlemen  involved, an opinion has now been created among the consumers that this state of affairs has arisen due to the recent increase of  Value Added Tax (VAT).  Although the VAT is applicable  to certain commodities, it is not applicable to pharmaceuticals and essential food items such as rice, sugar, dhal, big onions, potatoes, red onions, milk powder, wheat flour, dried chilies, green grams, chick peas, canned fish, chicken and sprats. It has also been observed that the retail traders are selling these essential food items at exorbitantly high prices than that of the food items sold through the Sathosa sales outlets. As a remedial measure, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to identify 15 essential food items and to gazette the same in terms of the provisions of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, to determine the maximum retail price of such food items by the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Cost of Living and to obtain the services of 200 Graduate Trainees and officers of the armed forces,  where necessary, to the Consumer Affairs Authority, to regulate the implementation of the said price control,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual bus fare revision - 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - The Expert Committee appointed for reviewing the policies and criteria on  revising the bus fare prepared in the year 2002, also incorporating new criteria, if any, that should be used for the revision of annual bus fare, has submitted its recommendations, having also obtained the views and the suggestions of the representatives of the bus associations as well as the bus commuter associations. The Committee has recommended a revised bus fare increase of 6%, with a view to  maintaining a proper public transport service  and since it has to be formally implemented  through the National Transport Commission (NTC), the Cabinet granted approval to effect the said increase of  bus fare from 01st August 2016.

description: Obtaining Financial Assistance for Implementation of Kelani Right Bank Water Supply Project Phase-II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - The approval of the Cabinet has already been granted for the implementation of the project on procuring infrastructure facilities including the construction of a new water treatment plant of 180,000 m3 to increase the capacity of the water treatment plant of the Kalani Right Bank, laying of treated water main pumping lines and a long water transmission line of 25 km, construction of the Wee Oya Reservoir and the supply and installation of inflatable rubber balloons as a salinity barrier. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to issue a treasury guarantee to obtain a credit facility  amounting to the  Rupee equivalent of Euro 13 million plus  Rs.10 billion from a local bank, for the implementation of this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mid-Year Fiscal Position Report - 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12

description: Construction of a New Five Storied Building for the District Secretariat, Matale
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, to award the Contract for the construction of a new 05 storied Building Complex for the District Secretariat, Matale, to the lowest substantially responsive bidder, as per the recommendation made by the  Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of District Secretariat Building Complex, Batticaloa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs,  to award the Contract for the construction of a new 03 storied Building Complex for the District Secretariat, Batticaloa, to the lowest substantially responsive bidder, as per the recommendation made by the  Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Four Storied Building for the District Secretariat, Polonnaruwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, to award the Contract on the first phase of the construction of a new four storied building complex for the District Secretariat, Polonnaruwa, to the lowest substantially responsive bidder, as per the recommendation made by  the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Scholarship Fund for the Technology Stream
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has provided a grant of Rs.100 million for the scholarship programme implemented for the students of low income families who follow the newly introduced Technology Stream of the G.C.E. (Advanced Level) and the said programme is implemented through the Department of Public Trustee.  However, since a considerable amount of the grant has to be spent on administrative matters, a situation has arisen where the anticipated objectives of the scholarship programme are not achieved. Therefore,  in order to make use of the relevant funds for the anticipated objectives, enabling a greater number of students to have the benefits, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to get the funds transferred to the Ministry of Education, which are currently credited to the Department of Public Trustee and thereafter to continuously implement this scholarship programme through an annual allocation from the Budget, under a relevant Expenditure Head of the General Treasury,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Funds for the Development of Rural Infrastructure Facilities and Livelihood Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - A budgetary provision of Rs.13.3 billion has been allocated for the programme on Development of Rural Infrastructure Facilities through the Budget - 2016 and the project is being implemented at present. As such, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to implement a pilot project on development of rural infrastructure facilities and rural livelihood in the districts of Anuradhapura, Batticaloa and Polonnaruwa, targeting the communities which are not covered by the small scale infrastructure  development programmes implemented by various institutions, at national and provincial levels, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relocation of the Welikada Prison
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - Most of the Prisons in Sri Lanka are located in the middle of the relevant cities on lands which possess higher economic importance. Under the programme for relocation of Prisons situated island-wide, it is proposed to establish the Welikada prison and its sub units in a different location.  The Welikada Prison Complex is comprised of 04 sections segregated from each other and the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to acquire the land owned by the BCC Lanka Limited, situated in close proximity to the Supreme Courts Complex,  for the establishment of the Remand Prison where the suspects who have to be produced in Courts frequently are detained,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National Payment Platform for Digital Commerce and easing of Digital Transactions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - Presently, the most convenient way adopted in the payment for goods and services by the public is the use of international credit cards such as VISA  Master Card, and American Express.  However, the adoption of such cards in Sri Lanka is still at a relatively low ebb due to various reasons including the  charges levied in such transactions.  When the value of a transaction is high, the charges levied by the relevant card scheme also rise, and the government institutions including Sri Lanka Customs, Department of Inland Revenue, Excise Department as well as the other businessmen are reluctant to use such cards.  As proposed by the Committee comprising of veteran senior officials in the relevant fields who studied the recommendations made by the Ministry of Finance and the Central Bank of Sri Lanka in this regard, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, for the establishment of  a National Payment Platform as a methodology for the facilitation of digital commerce and online transactions for the Government Institutions of Sri Lanka, enterprises and citizens, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a Technical Cooperation Grant of Euro 13 million from the  Federal Republic of Germany
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to enter into an agreement for a Technical Cooperation Grant of Euro 14 million   agreed to be provided by the Federal Republic of Germany, during the visit of H.E. the President of Sri Lanka to Germany in February 2016, for the implementation of the 04 projects, namely the National Park and Buffer Zone Management Project in Wilpattu, the Vocational Training Project in the North and East, the Small and Medium sized Enterprises (SME) Sector Development Project and the Facilitating Initiatives for Social Cohesion and Transformation (FLICT) Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Tranche - 3 of the Greater Colombo Water and Wastewater Management Improvement Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to sign a Credit Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the European Investment Bank, to implement the Tranche - 3 of the Greater Colombo Water and Wastewater Management Improvement Programme, at a cost of Euro156 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Infrastructure Facilities of the Universities of Sri Jayawardenapura, Sabaragamuwa, Jaffna, Kelaniya, Colombo, Peradeniya, Uva Wellassa and the South Eastern
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - 	It has been planned to increase the number of students admitting to the Universities to follow Degree Courses under various subject streams annually by 5%.  As such, in order to provide facilities for the increasing number of students, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to commence the activities pertaining to the development of common infrastructure facilities in the Universities of Sri Jayawardenapura, Sabaragamuwa, Jaffna, Kelaniya, Colombo, Peradeniya and activities pertaining to the development of required infrastructure facilities to establish Information Technology (IT) Faculties in the Universities of Uva Wellassa, Sabaragamuwa and South Eastern, utilizing the financial provision of Rs.1,369 million allocated for the purpose in the year 2016, and to get the financial provisions required for the purpose in the years 2017 and 2018 from the General Treasury, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of the Vocational Training Centre located at Nilaveli in the  Eastern Province with the Department of Divineguma Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - 	With the objective of providing Vocational Training, the Divineguma Development Department implements various training programmes and practical workshops and such training programme and workshops are conducted at the training centres belonging to the said Department and at the Rural Development Training and Research Institute located at Borella.  However, the training workshops and lectures conducted by the Department for the beneficiaries who reside in the Northern and Eastern provinces, have to be conducted in Colombo and they encounter various practical difficulties in taking part in such workshops and lectures and the Department also faces various problems in providing them with accommodation facilities.  Therefore, in order to establish a Training Centre to conduct training programme to Divinaguma beneficiaries living in the Northern and Eastern Provinces, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, the Minister of Social Empowerment and Welfare, to vest the Vocational Training Centre Building situated in Gopalapuram, Nilaveli in the Trincomalee District, with the Department of Divineguma Development at a Government valuation of a sum of Rs.125 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a  Concessionary Period and a method of Concessionary Charges for the Applicants who delayed in applying for Registration of Transfer of Vehicles on the change of possession of motor vehicles
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - 	Due to usage of vehicles under the name of the first owner without the registration of the transfer where the ownership has changed for over a long period and circulation of vehicles among various persons on open transfer papers, the Government is deprived of a large amount of income including registration charges and this situation has caused many difficulties for the law enforcement institutions as well.  Although a method of delayed charges was introduced through the Motor Traffic (Fees) Regulations published in the year 2011, in a bid to minimize this trend, it is observed that the anticipated objectives have not been achieved.  As such,  the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to provide a concessionary period of three months for the vehicle owners who have not applied for registration of transfers within the specified time period, although the ownership has been changed, to register such transfers and in order to persuade such registration of transfers, to grant a concession on the additional fee levied in such instances, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka Sustainable Development Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to publish the  Sri Lanka Sustainable Development Bill prepared for the implementation and  promotion of the National Policy and strategy on sustainable development in Sri Lanka, the establishment of a Sustainable Development Council and to provide for matters connected  therewith, in the Government Gazette and to present the same in Parliament for approval, after fulling the relevant other requirements thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formation of an Institution for Nation Development with Civil-Military Coordination
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-12
decision_details_body: - The knowledge and resources possessed by the Tri Forces of Sri Lanka can be utilized easily for nation building and they are prepared to bear the responsibilities in respect of the nation building mechanism using their knowledge on various fields.  As such, in order to make use of the resources, strength and training possessed by the Tri Forces for the overall national development and for the process of establishing peace, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to establish an Institution with Civil-Military coordination which functions on a mutual understanding with the civilian officers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Maintaining a Pool of Elephants consisting of about 35 Tuskers / Male Elephants / Female Elephants under the Zoological Department to make them to participate in cultural activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - The Perahera culture in Sri Lanka has inherited a proud history and especially the splendid peraheras such as  Dalada Perahera  have  drawn the attention of the whole world. It has been observed that, participation of Tuskers and Elephants is essential to maintain the beauty, magnificence and sacredness of a procession. The obtaining of elephants for peraheras has become a problem when Dalada Perahera and other famous peraheras are held during the same period of time. It has been found difficult to have all the existing elephants participate in pageant occasions due to the ageing and musth of elephants.  Accordingly, with the objective of training elephants to take part in pageant activities, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to establish a pool of  tamed Elephants from Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and Udawalawa 'Eth Athuru Sewana' if necessary, to a maximum of  35 Tuskers / Male Elephants/Female Elephants and maintain it as a unit of the Department of Zoology, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kaduruwela Town Expansion Project - Phase I
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - With the end of the conflict situation, the economic activities in the area of Kaduruwela increased tremendously, and it has resulted in issues such as traffic congestion and parking issues; and due to the haphazard development, a number of environmental and social issues have emerged as well. The Urban Development Authority (UDA), having considered the said issues, has designed the Kaduruwela Town Expansion Project and a number of projects are to be implemented under the said programme. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to award the designing activities of phase 1 of the project, land development activities, construction of drainage system and land filling, to Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Leasing of the Old Chancery Building of the Embassy of Sri  Lanka in Washington D.C.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Government owned building in Washington D.C., in which the office works of the Embassy of Sri Lanka in the United States of America were conducted until recently, is now vacant and therefore, it has been observed that, it would be better to utilize the said building in an economically productive manner beneficial to the Government of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to appoint a Technical Evaluation Committee, under the Chairmanship of the Sri Lankan Ambassador to the United States of America, to negotiate the terms and conditions pertaining to the leasing/renting of the said building and to proceed with the activities related thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Creating a Special Head in Annual Budget Estimates for the effective implementation of the Official Language Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - Sinhala and Tamil languages have been recognized as official languages by the Constitution of Sri Lanka and the right of the citizens of Sri Lanka to satisfy their service needs from any public institution in an official language of their preference has also been safeguarded.  Accordingly, all the public institutions in Sri Lanka, are bound to deliver their services in Sinhala and Tamil Languages in terms of the Official Languages Policy. Therefore, with the objective of facilitating the citizens to satisfy their service needs in an official language of their preference by the year 2020, the proposal made by Hon. Mano Ganeshan, the Minister of National Co-existence, Dialogue and Official Languages,  to allocate provisions by creating a separate object code in the Budget Estimates of the Ministries and Government Departments, from the year 2017, for the implementation of  the Official Languages policy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development Projects on Rehabilitation & Resettlement 2016 : Development Projects implemented for the Resettled Families and Returnee Refugees in the Northern, Eastern Provinces and former threatened Villages
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - A special budgetary provision of Rs.14 Billion was allocated though the budget proposals 2016, for the implementation of Resettlement and Rehabilitation projects in the year 2016, for the conflict affected  areas in the Northern and Eastern Provinces and former threatened villages. Accordingly, the Cabinet noted the information submitted by Hon. D.M Swaminathan, the Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement and Hindu Religious Affairs, to the effect that the Ministry has implemented a number of development projects for the betterment of IDPs and returnee Refugees, including the construction of new houses, repair of partly damaged houses,  provision of sanitation facilities, supply of safe drinking water, relocation of families, provision of livelihood assistance for IDP resettled families and returnee refugees, renovation of roads and development of infrastructural facilities in the relevant areas, under the budget proposals - 2016.

description: Resettlement of Protracted Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) in the Northern Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - Internal displacement due to conflict situation became a phenomena in Sri Lanka from the decade of 1980s and due to the said situation many  Sinhalese and Muslim families, in addition to the Tamil people, who lived in the Northern Province were internally displaced. Although the protracted IDPs commenced returning to their places of origin after conflicts were over, they could not be resettled productively, due to the lack of basic facilities. It has been identified that, for the housing requirement of the protracted returnees, 16,120 houses and 5,543 houses are required for Muslim families and Sinhalese families respectively. Due to the displacement their political rights, including the right to vote, have been adversely affected and they have to face difficulties in registering births and deaths, admitting children to schools and accessing the facilities offered by the Divisional Secretariat and other Government Institutions.  Accordingly, in order to facilitate the resettlement activities of the protracted displaced families in the Northern Province and to provide solutions for the issues  encountered by them in the said process, the approval of the Cabinet was granted to appoint a Task Force comprising of the Provincial Heads and Senior officials, under the Co‑chairmanship of the Ministers of Industry and Commerce; Provincial Councils and Local Government; and Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement and Hindu Religious Affairs to pursue action as per the recommendations of the said Task Force.

description: Enforcement of new Regulations in terms of the Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - As per the “Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea” (SOLAS), issued by the International Maritime Organization (IMO), in the year 1974, common and specific laws and regulations for the safety of life at sea, to be followed in the international merchant shipping affairs have been introduced. All the member states have agreed upon  to follow all these rules and regulations imposed with regard to the field of merchant shipping.  Accordingly, a Certificate detailing as to the gross mass of all the containers shipped, should be submitted, with a view to enhancing the security of the container ships, maintaining the stability/balance of the ships, storing the containers in a due manner and minimizing the environmental effects. However, no steps have been taken to issue a formal Certificate in this regard, though records of the gross weight of the export containers are kept at present.  Therefore, in order to provide for the said purpose, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to draft the Regulations prepared by the Merchant Shipping Secretariat, for the issuance of Certificates to container weight verifiers and container transporters, after having discussions with all the relevant stakeholders relating to the maritime affairs, through the Legal Draftsman and to publish the said regulations  in the Government Gazette and to submit the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act, No. 04 of 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - The Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act, No.04 of 2015 was brought into operation on 16th May 2016. There have been requests to permit the giving of evidence under the said Act, from a remote location outside Sri Lanka, too.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to draft amending legislation to the Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act, No.04 of 2015, to provide for the victims and witnesses of a crime to record an evidence or a statement through audio-visual linkage, from anywhere outside Sri Lanka, without his personal attendance in Court, and to give such evidence through  Sri Lankan diplomatic Mission abroad, while ensuring the freedom and lack of any duress on the witness, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Consolidation of Core Legislation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - It has become a complicated and difficult task to understand the laws/statutes enacted long ago, due to the frequent amendments made to such legislation.  In order to redress this situation, the Ministry of Justice, with the support of the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) works on to re-draft five (05) core pieces of legislation in three languages of Sinhala, Tamil and English and to consolidate the same. In considering the statutes of Evidence Ordinance, Criminal Procedure Code and Penal Code which fall under the purview of the five (05) core statutes to be consolidated under this programme, it has been apparent that there may be a potential of misunderstanding of certain words and expressions, by the public who refer such legislation, since certain words and expressions contained in such statutes are totally outdated in the present context. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to substitute or revise such words and expressions contained in the said statutes, so as to reflect and suit the contemporary language usage, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No. 15 of 1979 	(Rights of Detainees - Access to Legal Counsel)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to publish the Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Bill prepared to provide for the acceptance of the right to retain and consult an Attorney-at-law of his choice at his own expenses by any person who has been arrested and detained in police custody, after recording his statements and prior to being produced before a Magistrate and provision of services of an Attorney-at-law of the Legal Aid Commission, to such person, in an instance where such person states that he is unable to retain and consult an Attorney-at-law at his own expense, in the Government Gazette and thereafter to submit the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Holding the United NationsVesak Day Celebrations in Sri Lanka in	the year 2017
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - It was proposed by Prof. Gunapala Malalasekara at the World Buddhist Congress held in Sri Lanka, in the year 1950, to the effect that the Vesak Day should be celebrated internationally and on a proposal subsequently made by Hon. Lakshman Kadirgamar, former Minister of Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka, at the United Nations General Assembly in the year 1999, the tradition of celebrating the Vesak Day internationally was adopted. The United Nations Vesak Day Celebrations were held in Thailand, in the year 2016. Therefore, the joint proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe and Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to hold the United Nations Vesak Day Celebrations and the Conference of the year 2017, on 12th and 13th May 2017, in Sri Lanka and to appoint a Committee to arrange the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the 'Engineering Council' to regulate the	professional practice of Engineering in Sri Lanka by registering	Engineering Practitioners
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - The Engineering professionals who qualify from different educational establishments in Sri Lanka and abroad, possess different levels of academic and professional competencies depending on the standard and level of the educational programmes they followed, practice Engineering at different levels. However, an accepted formal methodology for registering or granting licenses followed in respect of the professionals in the fields of Medicine and Law, who qualify similarly from different establishments, is  not pursued in respect of the Engineering professionals.  Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power & Renewable Energy and Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to publish 'the Engineering Council, Sri Lanka Bill' drafted for the purposes of establishing the 'Engineering Council, Sri Lanka', which shall be responsible for the maintenance of professional standard and conduct of engineering practitioners, registration of different categories of engineering practitioners and to provide for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto, in the Government Gazette and thereafter to submit same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restructuring of Tea Shakthi Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to restructure the Tea Shakthi Fund, as recommended by the Officials' Committee appointed to submit the recommendations on the restructuring of the Tea Shakthi Fund and to improve the management of the twelve (12) factories belonging to the Tea Shakthi Fund, under the direct supervision of the Ministry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Stormwater Drainage Improvements within Western Megapolis Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - Even though the Western Province accounts for only 5.7% of the total land extent of the country, it contributes more than 50% to the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and is an immensely important industrial, commercial and administrative centre in Sri Lanka. Five (05) major river basins of Sri Lanka, including Kalu and Kelani Rivers are located in the Western Province and hence, it will be vitally important to improve the existing infrastructure facilities to minimize the risk of frequent floods, in transforming the Western Region into a Megapolis on par with the international standards. As per now, around 30% of the activities of the Weras Ganga Stormwater Drainage and Environment Improvement Project have been completed. Accordingly, with a view to exploring long term solutions for the flood issues in the flood prone areas of the Western Province, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement 08 projects expeditiously, including the construction of two (02) small tunnels to enhance the capacity of disposal of stormwater to the sea and the construction of two (02) pumping stations to pump  stormwater to the sea,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Traditional Indigenous Medical Research Hospital and Herbal Garden
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - At present, a conspicuous tendency in Sri Lankans to move towards  the Ayurvedic and Indigenous medical treatments can be seen / witnessed. Since the traditional indigenous medical system is a precious medical system to be transferred to the present as well as future generations,  measures are being taken by the Government to take necessary action for its conservation and development. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to construct a traditional indigenous medical research hospital and a herbal garden, in associated with the 'Wedagama' model village in the Dompe Divisional Secretariat Division, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposals on the measures to be taken with regard to the damages caused to the houses of the residents of the area and business places due to the explosion of ammunition dump in Salawa Army Camp
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body:
- Even though any loss of civilian lives was not reported due to the explosion that occurred in the ammunition dump in Army Camp at Salawa, Kosgama on 2016‑06‑05, movable and immovable properties in 12 Grama Niladhari Divisions around the area have been damaged. Cabinet decided to provide necessary relief, as per the recommendations of the Ministerial Committee appointed under the Chairmanship of Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to examine on the payment of compensation for such damaged houses and business places. Accordingly, Rs.50,000/- per month is being paid to the families, whose houses and business places are damaged, until their resettlement in the said premises and up to now  of around 400 families have been paid Rs.50,000/- each. Since it may take several months to restore normalcy in Salawa and the surrounding area, the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharashana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management,  to  provide a  monthly allowance of Rs.50,000/- each, to the rest of the families, whose houses were completely and partially damaged and are unable to resettle in their houses and to provide compensation in respect of the damages to the movable property expeditiously, as per the recommendations of the Assessing Committees appointed for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.  
It was also decided by the Cabinet, to instruct the relevant authorities to expedite the activities of providing relief to the residents of the Western Province, including Kolonnawa, who were affected due to the flood disaster that occurred recently.

description: 'E-Motoring Project' - Department of Motor Traffic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-07-05
decision_details_body: - The above project is expected to be implemented under three (03) components, namely the  preparation of an Electronic Documentation Management System for the Department of Motor Traffic, development  of the existing Vehicle Registration System and its database and the improvement of communication network.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to implement this 'E-Motoring Project' as a Build, Operate and Transfer (BOT) Project, as per the recommendation of the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Clearance of the debris of houses and garbage accumulated at Salawa area in Kosgama due to the emergency disaster situation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-06-21
decision_details_body: - The disposal of garbage accumulated in certain areas of  the Western Province due to the sudden disaster of floods that occurred in May 2016, has been implemented successfully and the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to employ around 20 tippers for a period of one (01) week, as per the request made by the Sri Lanka Army, utilizing the balance amount of funds allocated for the disposal of garbage accumulated due to floods, to clear the debris of the damaged houses and garbage, accumulated due to the sudden disaster which occurred  at  Salawa  area in Kosgama recently, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a Credit of Special Drawing Rights (SDR) from the International  Development  Association (IDA) of the World Bank for the Competitiveness, Transparency and Fiscal Sustainability Development Policy Financing (DPF) Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-06-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies	 and Economic Affairs, to enter into a Financial Agreement to obtain a credit facility being equivalent of US$ 100 million from the International Development Association (IDA), for the proposed programme of Economic Development in Sri Lanka, through the implementation of the identified reforms under three (03) sectors for the purposes of removing the existing impediments for the competition in the Private Sector, improving transparency and management in the Public Sector and developing government's fiscal sustainability, was approved by the	Cabinet.

description: Financial assistance for disaster relief and recovery
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-06-21
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet was informed by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to the effect that three (03) Bank accounts for the remittance of the financial donations received from local donors and five (05) accounts to deposit the donations received from foreign donors in different foreign currencies to provide relief to the people affected by the heavy floods and landslides which occurred in several districts of the island due to adverse weather conditions that prevailed in May 2016, have been opened and the funds accumulated into these accounts are credited daily, to the account opened in the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, in the name of the Deputy Secretary to the Treasury, to enable to be used for the relevant relief providing measures.

description: Central Expressway Project – obtaining consultancy services for	the construction of Section 2  from Meerigama to Kurunegala	(39.91km) with a link from Meerigama to Ambepussa (9.3 km)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-06-21
decision_details_body: - A four lane Expressway with a length of 39.91 km from Meerigama to Kurunegala via Pothuhera will be constructed under Section 2 of the Central Expressway Project and a link road with 2 lanes in a length of 9.3 km from the Meerigama Interchange to Ambepussa will also be constructed. Therefore, the  proposal made  by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to initiate the procurement work required for selecting an appropriate Consultancy Company to provide the consultancy services for the supervision of these construction, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of 2016 Budget Proposals - Construction of Cold 	Stores
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-06-21
decision_details_body: - The price fluctuation of fruits and vegetables, at different times of the year, including B onions	and Potatoes, has caused adverse effects to the farmer as well as to the consumer.  Since the cultivation of crops in Sri Lanka	 occurs in terms of seasonal patterns, funds have been allocated through the 2016 Budget proposals for the provision of cold stores facilities, to ensure the continuous supply of harvest throughout the year.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to construct cold stores, as a pilot project, closer to the Dambulla Special Economic Centre for some selected vegetables and fruits, including B Onions and closer to the Keppetipola Special Economic Centre for some selected vegetables and fruits, including Potatoes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of Medical Equipment and Services for the Epilepsy Unit	at the National Hospital of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-06-21
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the contracts for the supply of ward medical equipment and services to the Epilepsy Unit at the National Hospital of Sri Lanka, as per the recommendations made by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Domestic Airport in Badulla District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-06-21
decision_details_body: - Domestic airports are located in all the other provinces of Sri Lanka, except in the Uva and Sabaragamuwa Provinces. It takes more than	06 hours at least, to travel from Colombo to Badulla by a vehicle and	that time can be restricted to 25 minutes by way of flights and the establishment of an airport in the Badulla district will serve immensely for the promotion of tourism in the area and the development of  cultivation of economic crops for export purposes. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to establish a domestic	airport at Bandarawela in the Badulla district, was approved in principle by the	Cabinet.

description: Meeting of Heads of National Law Enforcement Agencies (HONLEA), Asia and Pacific Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-06-21
decision_details_body: - The United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) functions as the main and premier body in investigating into the global illicit drug racket and the supervision of the implementation of the international treaties on drug control is carried out by the Commission on Narcotic Drugs (CND). The Meeting of Heads of National Law Enforcement Agencies (HONLEA),  Asia and Pacific Region, which functions as a subsidiary body of the Commission, deals with the new trends and matters pertaining to drugs within Asia and Pacific Region and it also provides the opportunity of exchanging views and knowledge on law enforcement against illicit drug rackets. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Sagala Rathnayake, the Minister of Law and Order and Southern Development, to provide relevant facilities to hold/conduct the above Conference in Colombo, from 22nd to 28th October 2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relocation of City-centered Prisons to Interior Areas with more Space
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-06-21
decision_details_body: - The Government has recognized the necessity of undertaking urgent reforms in the prisons with a view to converting prisons into correction centers.  Under this programme, the priority has been given to relocate  the city-centered prisons in the less populated areas. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. D.M Swaminathan, the Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement and Hindu Religious Affairs, to entrust preparation of design and consultancy activities pertaining to the relocation of Colombo, Galle, Matara, Badulla, Trincomalee and Batticaloa Prisons, to Government owned Construction Agencies,  as recommended by the Committee appointed to expedite the prison relocation activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Utilization  of the provisions required for conducting the National Pirivena Day Festival
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-06-21
decision_details_body: - The contribution rendered by the Pirivena Education, for the Buddhist Education and Culture in Sri Lanka is immense. At present, 64,606 of lay and clergy students receive education from 750 pirivenas which have been organized as Mulika Pirivenas, Maha Pirivenas and Vidyathana Pirivenas, 6,495 lay and clergy teachers are engaged in teaching in such institutions. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to conduct the Pirivena Day Festival which is held annually to appreciate the service rendered by pirivena institutions and their teachers as well as the creativity skills of  pirivena students, this time at the Getambe Stadium, Kandy on 16th, 17th and 18th July 2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Developing Jetty Facilities in the Jaffna Peninsula and Suburban 	Islands to transport Passengers and Cargo safely
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-06-21
decision_details_body: - People living in islands suburban to Jaffna peninsula including Delft and Nagadeepa use boat transport services for their day to day necessities. In addition to that, the tourists who visit religious places also use boats as their mode of transportation.  However, due to problems such as lack of sufficient and secure boat services, available facilities in the jetties being at a minimum level and the existing light house being in a condition which deserves renovation, have caused obstacles/impediments to the coastal passenger transportation.
