decision_details_body: - The Government, according to the Budget proposals of 2016, considers the provision of hostel facilities to all university students as its responsibility and as such, it is anticipated to complete this task by the year 2018. The second phase of the project for construction of 60 hostels being implemented at present is expected to be completed by mid 2016.  With the completion of this project, it will be possible to provide hostel facilities approximately for 62% of the students of the National Universities and the Sri Lanka Institute of Advanced Technology (SLIAT) who should be provided with hostel facilities. Accordingly, with a view to providing an expeditious solution to the hostel issue, which is the most acute problem prevailing in universities in general, along with the problem of providing hostel facilities for the future intake of students in the Technological Stream as well, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to construct 16 hostels for the students of the National  Universities and SLIAT, utilizing the Budgetary provisions of 2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal to increase the penalties for obstruction of duties of Authorized Officers in the process of implementing the provisions of the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-26
decision_details_body: - As a measure to avoid the shortcomings that led to the European Union ban on the export of fish products from Sri Lanka, the penalties for the illegal, unregulated and unreported fishing have been increased in compliance with international standards and proportionate to the gravity of the infringements. Due to stringent nature of the penalties, the authorized officers who engaged in the  implementation of the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, including the officers of the Navy and the Police who engaged in raids and arrests under the Act, have to face many obstructions and threats. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to amend the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act to increase the present fine of Rs.25,000/- up to a minimum of Rs.50,000/- and enabling the increase of such fine, based on the length of the fishing vessel, for the obstructions made to the authorized officers when they implement the powers vested on them under the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act and to recognize the officers of the Coast Guard also as authorized officers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting of the 69th Session of the World Health Organization (WHO) Regional Committee for South-East Asia from 5th to 9th September, 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-26
decision_details_body: - The South-East Asia Region of the World Health Organization (WHO-SEARO) was established in 1948 and it provides leadership and technical assistance for the prevailing health issues and relevant policy alternatives in the South-East Asia Region, which is home to a 1/4 of the world population. Sri Lanka works closely with this Committee and the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to host its 69th Session to be held in Sri Lanka from 5th to 9th September, 2016, depicting the progress achieved by Sri Lanka in the health sector, to the world, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Thambuttegama Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to proceed with the implementation of the Thambuttegama Water Supply Project which is funded by the China Development Bank and the local banks, as recommended by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Katana Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, to proceed with the implementation of the Katana Water Supply Project which is funded by the China Development Bank and the local banks, as recommended by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Resident Diplomatic Mission in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-26
decision_details_body: - At present, Sri Lanka maintains diplomatic relations with 38 States out of the 54 Sovereign States found in the African Region and of that, Resident Diplomatic Missions operate in only four (04) African Countries. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to establish an Embassy in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia where the headquarters of the African Union is situated, with a view to extending trade and economic relations with Ethiopia which has the largest economy in terms of GDP in East Africa and Central Africa and establishing a close relationship with the countries of the African Union, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Election of Hon. Gamini Jayawickrama Perera as Chair and Hon. S.B. Dissanayake as a Vice Chair of the Asia-Pacific Forum on Sustainable Development for the year 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-26
decision_details_body: - 	The Asia-Pacific Forum on Sustainable Development (APFSD 2016) organized by the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (ESCAP) was held in Bangkok from 3rd to 5th April 2016. A preliminary agreement has been reached, at this Forum, on a Regional Road Map for implementing the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and the establishment and  functioning of the Asia-Pacific Forum on Sustainable Development including the follow up and review process of the Forum. The Cabinet noted with appreciation that Hon. Gamini Jayawickrama Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife has been elected as the Chair and Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, the Minister of Social Empowerment and Welfare as a Vice Chair of the  Asia - Pacific Forum on Sustainable Development, for the year 2016.

description: Signing of the Memorandum of Understanding between Expo 2012 YEOSU Korea Foundation and Marine Environmental Protection Authority of Sri Lanka for Capacity Building to Manage Marine Debris in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-26
decision_details_body: - The marine environment can be considered as a vital resource base which affects a country's socio-economic upliftment as well as the development in the fields of fishery, harbour and tourism. Due to waste and debris released to the environment through human activities in and around marine and coastal areas, the marine and coastal environment has to be restored incurring a huge cost.  Sometimes the damage caused to the marine environment is irreparable. It has been identified that 60 - 80% of marine debris is composed of plastics and Sri Lanka is in the 5th place in the world pertaining to the release of marine debris. The 'Expo 2012 YEOSU Korea Foundation' established in the year 2012 on the financial assistance granted by the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries of South Korea, functions with the objective of contributing towards the sustainable development of the world marine environment. The above Foundation has agreed to provide assistance to commence a research project on capacity building to manage marine debris in Sri Lanka and the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the above Foundation and the Marine Environment Protection Authority of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Guidelines to be followed by the electronic or the print media during a time of a Referendum or Elections
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-26
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister, Ranil Wickremasinghe, to present the Gazette (Extraordinary) Notification, No.1955/19 dated 2016-02-26 containing the  guidelines to be followed/observed by the electronic and the print media and activists during a time of a referendum or elections, issued  by the Elections Commission, as per Article 104 B.(5) of the Constitution, as amended by the Nineteenth Amendment, in order to ensure the conduct of a free and fair referendum or an election, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National  Agribusiness Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-26
decision_details_body: - This programme is a five year programme financed by the Government of Sri Lanka and the International Fund for Agriculture Development (IFAD) affiliated to the United Nations Organization.  The main objective of this programme is to increase the income of the rural small farm owners and particularly the youth who do not own lands, by 20 - 30% through provision of better farm prices, upliftment of farm productivity and the value addition for the farm products. Under this programme, 6 projects of value addition for agro products have been initiated in collaboration with the private sector and these projects have contributed directly to increase the income of 5,648 rural agro producers. At the same time, opportunities have been provided for 2,710 rural entrepreneurs to improve their products through the grant of small scale credit facilities. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, to improve the farm products so as to further enhance the benefits under this programme and to provide entrepreneurship training to the youth of the low income families along with easy small scale loan facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Facilitation of a meeting of the relevant Cabinet  Ministers for the Members of Parliament to discuss the issues that they confront in their areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet concurred with the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Prime Minister that the Cabinet Ministers should be available from 2.00 pm onwards in their offices within the Parliamentary complex, on Tuesdays of the second sitting week of Parliament of every month, to enable the Members of Parliament to meet the Ministers to resolve the issues prevailing in their electorates.

description: Implementation of the Rural Infrastructure Development Programme - 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed through the Budget - 2016 to provide Rs.10 lakhs per Grama Niladhari Division in order to develop rural infrastructure facilities determined by the people of those areas as necessary to implement expeditiously for the upliftment of  the living conditions and the livelihood of the rural communities. The Ministry of National Policies and Economic Affairs has already provided the instructions necessary to all the District Secretaries  to implement the relevant projects in accordance with the said proposal. According to the proposal, a Committee comprising of the leaders of rural community organizations should identify 2-5 rural infrastructure development programmes for each Grama Niladhari Division, where priority should be given for the construction and improvement of the community based water supply projects, provision of drinking water, small scale power generating projects, rural roads, bridges, culverts, foot bridges, etc. and the projects which uplift the livelihood of the rural community and the activities related to the construction and renovation of  canals, anicuts, ponds and agro wells under the minor irrigation projects for agricultural  activities. This programme is expected to be completed by 31st of October, 2016. Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs submitted the information on the implementation of this project, to the Cabinet.

description: Revision of Salaries of the Employees of the Government Corporations, Statutory Boards and Fully Government Owned Companies - 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - The Public Administration Circular No.03/2016 of 2016-02-25 was  issued in accordance with the decision taken by the  Government to add the special allowances  and the interim allowance of Rs 10,000/- granted for the public servants in addition to their basic salaries, to their basic salaries, in stages and accordingly, the salaries of the public sector employees have already been revised. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to issue circular instructions, to revise the basic salaries of the employees of Government Corporations, Statutory Boards and Fully Government Owned Companies, in accordance with the recommendations of the National Salaries and Cadre Commission, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conversion of the building at No.51  Katukurunda Training School of the Special Task Force into a 03 storey building
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka Police Special Task Force Training School at Katukurunda, conducts training courses of Basic Paramilitary Training, Training on VIP security, Training on Riots and Commotions control, Training on bomb disposal and skill enhancement as well as training of security personnel of local and foreign groups. Therefore, the Cabinet of Ministers, according to a proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, decided to remove the old residential  buildings in  the Training School which are about 75 years old and to construct a  three storey building which could provide residential facilities for 300 personnel, at a time, at an estimated cost of Rs.88.2  million and to allocate the provisions required for the purpose in the medium term budgetary framework of 2017-2019.

description: Construction of a new 03 storey building to enhance the administration, accommodation and vehicle parking facilities at the Special Task Force (STF) Headquarters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - A considerable number of officers of the Headquarters of the Sri Lanka Police Special Task Force are engaged in routine security operations for protection of law and order, inclusive of ensuring the security of Very Important Personnel (VIP), controlling unlawful activities like riots and underworld activities. Therefore, the Cabinet of Ministers, according to a proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, decided to construct a new 03 storey building to enhance the administration, accommodation and vehicle parking facilities at the Special Task Force (STF) Headquarters, at a cost of Rs.58.6 million and to allocate the provisions required for the purpose in the medium term budgetary framework of 2017-2019.

description: Construction of a building with accommodation facilities for Commissioned Officers at the Special Task Force (STF) Camp in Mahaoya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers, according to a proposal made by Hon. Sagala Ratnayake, the Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, decided to construct a new building, instead of the old building which is 40 years old, to provide accommodation facilities for the Commissioned Officers and the Special Task Force officers who attend  the Police Special Task Force Camp at Mahaoya in the Ampara District for duties and as well as service matters, at an estimated cost of Rs.24.6 million and to provide the provisions required for the purpose in the medium term budgetary framework of 2017-2019.

description: Construction activities of the proposed Building Complex with 17 Floors for the Faculty of Medicine in the University of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - Although the Cabinet approval had been given in the year 2000 for the construction of this building, the construction activites have been delayed due to various reasons.  The pile foundation works required for the construction of the building have been commenced in the year 2014.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to construct this building at an estimated cost of Rs.5,688.5 million, was approved by the Cabinet in principle.

description: Southern Transport Development Project - Implementation of three (03) new projects utilizing the balance provision of the contract for the construction of the Southern Section of the Southern Expressway from Pinnaduwa to Godagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to make use of the balance provision of the contract for the construction of the Southern Section of the Southern Expressway from Pinnaduwa to Godagama, amounting to Rs.1.93 billion, for the rehabilitation of 11 local roads, for the procurement of 04 Motor Vehicles for the Police and to renovate the slope failure at 114 km of the Southern Expressway, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of a Land and Construction of a Building Complex for the proposed Faculty of Medicine in the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - The Wayamba University of Sri Lanka which was established as a national university in the year 1999 is comprised of four (04) faculties of studies, at present. It has been decided to establish a Medical Faculty in the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka with the objective of enhancing medical education, liaising with the General Hospital,  Kurunegala, which has gained a tremendous development in recent past. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to purchase a land for the purpose, to provide infrastructure facilities and to construct the buildings required, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of New Tyre Kits to Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala De Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contract for the procurement of New Tyre Kits required for the Sri Lanka Transport Board, as per the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.  This will cost nearly Rs.1,108 million.

description: Hosting the 16th World Export Development Forum by Sri Lanka - 12th & 13th October, 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - The World Export Development Forum is the annual flagship event of the International Trade Centre (ITC) which is a joint agency of the World Trade Organization (WTO) and the United Nations. It is held with the participation of all worldwide stakeholders related to International Trade. The 16th World Export Development Forum is proposed to be organized jointly by the Sri Lanka Export Development Board and the International Trade Centre on 12th and 13th October, 2016 in Colombo under the theme, 'Trade for Success: Connect, Compete, Change'. This Forum will contribute to highlight the country's openness towards International Trade and the prevailing friendly business environment. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the International Trade Centre and the Export Development Board of Sri Lanka to host the World Export Development Forum - 2016 by Sri Lanka, also with the financial contribution of  the International Trade Centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of Rabies Ordinance and the Dog Registration Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body:
- In accordance with the decision already taken by the Cabinet, to amend the above ordinances to suit the present day needs and to prepare those as a consolidated Act, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to proceed with the activities relating to drafting a new Bill amalgamating the two ordinances and also incorporating the proposed amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.  

	The attention of the Cabinet was also drawn to the difficulties and health hazards encountered by the general public due to stray dogs and it was decided to convey to the Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government, the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine and the Ministry of Rural Economy, to submit their proposals in this regard.

description: Regularization of the functions of the Local Government Authorities whose Term of Office has been extended
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - The Term of Office of a number of Local Government Authorities whose term of office has expired, has been extended by the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government under the powers vested in him. Since the Minister in charge of the subject of Local Government has been receiving complaints to the effect that irregularities occur  in the officials duties of certain Local Government Authorities of which such term of office has been extended a Committee comprising of the Deputy Secretary to the Treasury, Secretary, Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government and the Chief Secretary of the Western  Provincial Council has been appointed to examine such complaints and make recommendations. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to take necessary action as per the recommendations of the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reverting the Land 'Thennankuriyawa Watta' at Anamaduwa to the Land Reform Commission to be distributed among the landless residents of the area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to revert the land 'Thennankuriyawa Watta' at Anamaduwa, in extent of 9.6 hectares, to the Land Reform Commission, to be  distributed among the landless residents of the area, selected after conducting a Land Kachcheri under the supervision of the Divisional Secretary, Anamaduwa, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of State of the Art Ward Complex in the Cancer Institute of Maharagama (Rasavi Project)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - The construction of a Ward Complex at the Cancer Institute of Maharagama has been commenced with the financial contribution of the Ahamed Tea Company of the United Kingdom and the Government of Sri Lanka and the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to complete the construction work of the Ward Complex expeditiously through further enhancing the contribution for the purpose by the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a Land in extent of 100 acres from the Embilipitiya area to be used as a Cattle Sanctuary
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-19
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to lease a land in extent of 100 acres out of the 200 acres  reserved for a grassland at present, situated in Kowulara village in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Sevanagala, Monaragala District, to the Sri Bodhiraja Trust of Sri Bodhiraja Dharmayathanaya, Embilipitiya incorporated by the Sri Bodhiraja Trust Act, No.30 of 1993, for 30 years, on a nominal lease, for the purpose of conducting a Cattle Sanctuary, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of the Paris Agreement on Climate Change
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-06
decision_details_body: - The signing ceremony of the Paris Agreement on Climate Change is due to be held in the United Nations Head Quarters in New York on 22nd April 2016. In addition to it, the United Nations General Assembly on the World Drug Problem and the High Level Thematic Debate on achieving the Sustainable Development Goals would also be conducted on or about the same dates. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, H.E. the President,  in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to authorize Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research to represent Sri Lanka and sign the Paris Agreement on Climate Change and to take part in the other programmes, conducted simultaneously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Criteria for Consideration for Appointment of Chairmen and Board of Directors of State Owned Enterprises (SOEs)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-06
decision_details_body: - The lack of a clear-cut policy directive,  weaknesses in decision making at senior management level, making decisions in absence of consideration in market competitiveness, the interference of politicians in making appointments, trying to fulfill the ambitions of political parties and the lack of formal guidelines for appointment of persons to managerial level, have been the reasons for the decline in the performance of  public enterprises. As such, the adoption of a formal and transparent methodology, when the appointment of Chairmen and members of the Director Boards of Public Enterprises are made, to regularize the operations, is a timely need. Accordingly, H.E. the President has appointed a Special Committee to examine the suitability of the nominations made for the posts of Chairmen / Members of the Director Boards, and Chief Executive Officers of Public Enterprises and make recommendations; and the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs to make those recommendations made applicable to consider such criteria as Managerial and Professional experience, the Maximum Age Limit, the Tenure of Office and the limits on such Tenures of Service, provisions for the prevention of Conflict of Interest and illegibility conditions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and the China Development Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-06
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs to sign the Memorandum of Understanding between the Central Bank of Sri Lanka and a Commercial Bank of the People's Republic of China called the Development Bank of China, during his official visit to China, for making an effort to work on a basis of significant corporation with the Republic of China, with the objective of stable maintenance of the financial network of the country, ensuring the domestic monetary stability and the safety of the international stability of the Sri Lanka Rupee as well as the promotion of agriculture and the infrastructure facilities of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Programme under Implementation in 2016 in relation to the National Food Production Programme (2016-2018)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-06
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, H.E. the President to provide the seeds and planting materials during the Yala Season, free of charge, to attain the proposed self-sufficiency in the year 2016 by accelerating the National Food Production Programme (2016-2018) in an effort to further encourage cultivators for 'toxin' free cultivations and to provide them with facilities to sell the harvest and to direct, supervise and monitor the implementation of the programme as a whole and undertake follow up activities and progress review at Provincial, District and Divisional levels, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Buddhist Revival Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-06
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has about 12,150 Buddhist Temples and out of which about 750 temples maintain Pirivenas. Similarly, there are about 150 Forest Hermitages around the island. These Temples render an invaluable service to safeguard the cultural heritage related to Buddhist religious traditions and to promote the knowledge of  priests as well as laymen through the Pirivena education. Due to the problems associated with Temples and Pirivenas, the Bhikkhus have to face various difficulties in carrying out their social responsibilities and a state of affairs has now arisen, in most instances, where the incumbent priests of the Temples find it difficult to incur the present day expenditure required for these tasks. Although, the Ministry of Buddhasasana, the Department of Buddhist Affairs and the Ministry of Education make a significant contribution to fulfill the management of physical resources pertaining to the Temples and the Pirivenas, it is done only within the provisions of the Annual Budgetary Estimates. Privileges like donations by philanthropists are also rare for most of these temples in the remote areas.  As a solution to the above problems, the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, H.E. the President to create a fund called 'Buddhist Revival Fund',  with the use of various forms of revenue and donations as proposed by the Buddhist Bikkhus to select the places of Buddhist religious worship and provide facilities and provisions to them, on a common policy adopted therein, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The payment of compensation for those who are affected due to Land Acquisitions made for the Development Activities Implemented by the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project under the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-06
decision_details_body: - Based on the objectives of the flood control in Colombo Metropolitan area and suburbs, infrastructure furtherance and institutional development, many constructions and renovations have to be done in the main cities and in the densely populated areas falling within the 56 sub-projects implemented under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project and therefore, it has been planned to acquire private lands, too, for the proposed activities. As such, to implement this project without any delay and with the idea of granting maximum justice to the affected parties during acquisition and payment of compensation, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance and Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to make relevant the Land Acquisition (payment of compensation) regulations imposed by Gazette (Extraordinary) Notification No.1864/54 of 2014-05-30 containing  the mechanism of paying compensation in the case of parties affected by the acquisition of lands for special projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Commerce of the People’s Republic of China and the Ministry of Development Strategies & International Trade of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on Comprehensive Implementation of Investment, Economic and Technological Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-06
decision_details_body: - The Government is engaged in an attempt to encourage Chinese entrepreneurs to enhance the investment co-operation in the major economic sectors through non-traditional financial instruments, bringing a new approach towards the co-operation between the two countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to sign the Memorandum of Understanding between the two countries for the implementation of the investment, economic and technological agreement during the Official Visit to China by the Hon. Prime Minister, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Research and Training Complex at the Faculty of Agriculture, University of Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-06
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan has expressed agreement to provide a grant of Japanese Yen 1,667,000,000 (equivalent to approximately Rs.2,100 million) for the construction of a Research and Training Complex at the Faculty of Agriculture, University of Jaffna. The main objectives of this project are to implement research programmes and education promotional activities on dry zone agriculture in the Northern Province in an efficient manner and it has also been designed to meet the future demands of the main agricultural sectors such as Animal Husbandry, Crop Science, Agricultural Chemistry, Agricultural Biology, Agricultural Engineering and Agricultural Economics through the development of specialized fields under the Faculty of Agriculture. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs to enter into an agreement in regard to a grant assistance with the Japan International Corporation Agency (JICA) for the implementation of this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of Roads under the China Development Bank funded Priority Roads Project 3 - Phase II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-06
decision_details_body: - The  proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to renovate 20 roads at a total length of 128.85 km, located in the Central and Sabaragamuwa Provinces, under the China Development Bank funded Priority Roads Project 3 - Phase II, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Science Technology & Research Educational Training Programme with facilities for Prototype Manufacturing  of Solar Panels
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-06
decision_details_body: - The policy of the Government is to envisage 20% of the entire power generation from the non-conservative renewable energy resources, by the year 2020.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science Technology and Research, to enter into the Memoranda of Understanding to have expert advice and guidance of the University of Illinois of the United States of America and the Sivanandan Laboratories Company to get an advanced practical training, on manufacturing solar panels and installation and research and development of solar panels and the service maintenance of solar power generation systems, for a group of about 2,000 including undergraduates, students of the vocational training centres, former military veterans and GCE A/L qualified high school leavers and to install the relevant research and training facilities in the Universities of Peradeniya, Jaffna, Ruhuna and Kelaniya, for the purpose of supporting the rapidly growing solar energy related industries, was approved by the Cabinet as a matter of principle.

description: Declaration of a National Inventors' Day
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-06
decision_details_body: - When a country marches forward from the middle income status to the higher income status, it is the responsibility of that country to provide all required facilities and the necessary encouragement for the new inventors to help them in the creation of their inventions and innovations. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science Technology and Research, to declare the 26th of October, which falls on the birthday of  Deshabandhu Dr. A.N.S. Kulasinghe, an eminent civil engineer, inventor and the first Commissioner of the Sri Lanka Inventors' Commission, produced by Sri Lanka, as the 'National  Inventors' Day', with a view to awarding due recognition to the new inventors of Sri Lanka, providing encouragement for them and bringing them together, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Sri Lanka and China on Cooperation in the field of Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-04-06
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. John Amaratunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Sri Lanka and the People's Republic of China in the field of Tourism Cooperation, during the forthcoming official visit to China by the Hon. Prime Minister, as proposed at its 7th meeting of the China - Sri Lanka Joint Committee on Economic Cooperation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recent Power Blackout and Supply of Electricity without interruption
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body:
- After a comprehensive discussion regarding the recent power blackout and the measures to be taken for the provision of Electricity without interruption in future, the Cabinet reached the following decisions: 

(i)	to implement recommendations in the Reports submitted by  the Committees appointed to examine the simultaneous Power Blackout in the country and make recommendations by H.E. the President with the Chairmanship of the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy and by the Hon. Prime Minister with the Chairmanship of Mr. C. Maliyadde.

(ii)	to take necessary action to purchase the electricity power, only absolutely necessary, from the private sector in order to face the power generation limits that could be arisen, if there is no adequate rain in the coming days.

description: Ratification of the Agreement on concurrence for obtaining the  membership of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) by Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka became a party to the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) on 29th January 2015, by placing her signature to the Articles of Agreement of the said Bank. The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance to publish the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank Agreement (Ratification) Bill prepared to ratify the said Agreement and enforce the same within Sri Lanka, in the Government Gazette and present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing money to Farmers for Purchasing of Fertilizer  as per the Budget Proposals - 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of  Agriculture, for payment of money, in cash, according to the budget proposal 2016, instead of the fertilizer subsidy programme which was effective previously, to enable the farmers to buy the required fertilizer from the open market as per their necessity, for around one million farmers scattered around the Island, being Rs.25,000 per hectare up to a maximum of two hectares for the Yala season in 2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement Plan of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation for Crude Oil & Petroleum Products - 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The  Procurement Plan of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation to purchase  Crude Oil and Petroleum Products for the year 2016 submitted by Hon. Chandima Weerakkody, the Minister of Petroleum Resources Development, was approved by the Cabinet, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC).

description: Rehabilitation of B 157 (East) Road from the Southern Expressway to Madurugoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka has received a loan of US$ 75 million from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) as the cost of Southern Road Connectivity Project for improving the capacity of National Highways linking the Southern Expressway. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to award the contract for the improvement and rehabilitation of the road section of 10 km in length on B 157 (East) Road from Southern Expressway to Madurugoda including the five (05) years performance based maintenance, to the bidder recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Rebuilding and Pre-curing services for the tyres of Sri Lanka Transport Board buses
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala De Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to obtain the Pre-curing  and  Rebuilding services for tyres of Sri Lanka Transport Board buses, from the bidders recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Oil and Lubricant for Sri Lanka Transport Bord
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala De Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to award the contracts for procurement of Oil and Lubricant for Sri Lanka Transport Board buses, to the bidders recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Task Force to Establish a Hill Country New Villages Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The Ministry of Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development is vested with the major task of establishing new villages and towns by enhancing the infrastructure facilities and housing development, in order to upgrade the social and cultural needs of the plantation community. A National Plan for the Social Development of the Plantation Community (2016-2020), has been launched by the Ministry and a proposal has been made to establish an Authority to implement the duties and responsibilities assigned to the Ministry both effectively and productively and to achieve the objectives and targets of the project within the anticipated  time frame. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. U. Palani Digambaram, the Minister of  Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development, to set up a task force to draft a bill to establish the Hill Country New Villages Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Bill to amend the Trust Ordinance, No.9 of 1917
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The Proposal made by Hon. (Dr) Wijayadasa Rajapaksha, the Minister of Justice, to amend  the Trust Ordinance, so as to widen its scope to meet the international standards in order to minimize the risk of money laundering and raising money for Terrorism, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of National Programme on Energy Demand Management, Efficient Energy Use and Energy Conservation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - It is envisaged that an average of about 1000 GWh power can be saved within the next five (05) years and avoid the need for the construction of 500 MW power stations by educating the public on the frugal use of electricity, the use of electrical equipment and technology and the change of various economic and social patterns. Therefore, a programme has been prepared with the collaboration of the Ceylon Electricity Board, the Lanka Electricity (Pvt) Company and the Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority for the promotion of efficient use of electricity and its conservation. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to appoint a Presidential Task Force  and a National Operational Committee to implement the said programme with a wide participation of the domestic, commercial and industry sector as well as the Public Sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the National Science Foundation of Sri Lanka and the National Natural Science Foundation of China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to sign the Memorandum of Understanding between the National Science Foundation of Sri Lanka and the National Natural Science Foundation of China with a view to enhancing co-operation in the field of Science and Technology, during the Prime Minister's visit to China, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Research Council as a Statutory Entity
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to publish the Bill drafted for the establishment of the National Research Council as a statutory entity to provide for a Science and Technology research culture in Sri Lanka with a view to creating an interest in same among the General Public, in the Government Gazette and present it to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Science Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has already granted approval to establish a National Science Centre. Therefore, having considered the submission made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science,Technology and Research, the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers was granted to establish the proposed National Science Centre, in a plot of land located at Mahena area, Homagama, belonging to the Urban Development Authority.

description: Appointing of a Committee of Experts for Continental Shelf Submission of Sri Lanka to the Commission on the Limits of the Continental Shelf (CLCS) under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka presented her Continental Shelf Submission to the Commission on the Limits of the  Continental Shelf (CLCS) during the year 2009, regarding the matters related to the establishment of the outer edge of the continental margins of the countries, in the southern part of the Bay of Bengal. There is a possibility of taking Sri Lanka's submission for consideration by the Commission regarding the Limits of the  Continental Shelf (CLCS) during the period  of 2017-2022. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, to appoint a Committee comprising of world renowned experts to uphold  the submissions made on behalf of Sri Lanka and to face successfully, the counter views  likely to be raised by the other countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Concessionary Railway fares for Handicapped War Heroes holding 'Virusara' Privilege Cards
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - 'Virusara' Privilege Card, which has been introduced as a part of the Government programme of providing special concessions to the handicapped war heroes,  provides them and also the members of their families, with the opportunity of having such privileges when obtaining the services from the Government and private institutions using the 'Virusara'  Privilege Card. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to provide  facilities to handicapped war heroes, holding the 'Virusara' privilege card for train travel,  at a concessionary rate of not more than 50% of the normal fare, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Use of 'Digital Marketing' Strategy for the Promotion of Sri Lanka Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The Tourism industry has become the most rapidly improving sector in Sri Lanka after 2009. According to the recent research conducted by  'Google', it has been revealed that more than 50% of the tourists of the world travel without having any idea whatsoever of their next travelling destination or where to lodge next. At present, more than 40% of the World population use the internet; and the Tactical Digital and Social Media Marketing which adopts internet as the medium, takes a significant place in paving the background for tourists to determine their traveling destinations and popularizing such destinations. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to implement a Tactical Digital Marketing Campaign, targeting the markets identified for promotion of tourism industry of Sri Lanka in 2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National Agricultural Loan Protection   Scheme through the National Insurance Trust Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The Proposal made by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic affairs, to launch a National Agricultural Loan Protection Scheme, to provide a safe cover to the farmers and for the banks and financial institutions which are engaged in  the provision of agricultural loans, in situations where the farmers run the risk of failing to settle loans they had obtained in the event of a crop failure, due to floods, droughts and other natural disasters and also to extend facilities to  enable them to obtain loans, without any problem, for the next season as well, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of Agrahara Benefits received to Government Servants    and their families through National Insurance Trust Fund (NITF)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - Considering the daily increasing expenditure for medical treatments, the Proposal made by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic affairs, to implement the 'Agrahara Insurance Scheme', also to be inclusive of the retired Government servants, so as to receive more flexible and higher benefits, according to the recommendations  of  the Cabinet appointed Officials' Committee made regarding the extension of the health security benefits, offered to the Government Servants and their families through Agrahara Insurance Scheme,  governed by the National Insurance Trust Fund, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Invasive Alien Species (IAS) Policy of Sri Lanka and Strategies and Action Plan for Control and Management of Invasive Alien Species
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The introduction of certain alien and invasive species of plants and beings  and their speedy expansion have made a great impact on the agro-ecosystems in Sri Lanka, as well as the economic activities associated with them. Although, there are legal instruments available in Sri Lanka to prevent this state of affairs, when considering the environmental, economic and social harm caused, the importance of a well prepared National Policy for control and management of invasive plants/trees and the prevention of alien species, is a felt need. Therefore, to control the extension of invasive plants/trees and to minimize the harm caused to the bio-diversity, environmental systems and the economy and society, the  proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment to implement the National Invasive Alien Species Policy, Strategies and Action Plan related thereto, formulated in collaboration with the all stakeholders and the experts relating to the field, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Training Opportunities of the Defence Service Command and Staff College for Foreign Officers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The Defence Services Command and Staff College established in the year 2007 is the highest Military Training Institution in the Island. Since 2009,  opportunities for these training courses have been provided to other countries as well, as a mark of cordiality. Considering the goodwill,  foreign exchange and the exchange of knowledge and experiences Sri Lanka will gain, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena in his capacity as the Minister of Defence, to provide 10 training opportunities on payment basis and 22 training opportunities on Gratis Basis to foreign officers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mobilization of Human Resources of the Tri Forces of National Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - A large number of experienced officers of various ranks in the Tri Forces, with both technical and professional qualifications/experience, have to retire annually from military service on completion of 22 years of service or on expiration of the maximum length of time they are obliged to serve in the same rank. Out of them, a considerable number of persons are those who have acquired both technical skills as well as professional qualifications in the fields such as engineering, surveying, medicine, nursing, paramedical, technical and sports and when they go on retirement they are generally aged about 42 and 45 years and both mentally and physically fit enough to perform their duties further. The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena to build up and operate a resource pool by the Ministry of Defence,  comprising of the retired officers and those of other ranks who are professionally and suitably qualified in their fields with a view to harnessing their services more productively and as a solution to the dearth of technically and professionally competent officers to provide the opportunity to get the services of those retired and registered officers to the public institutions, on contract basis, at instances where necessary, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Database of Resource Persons with Bilingual/Trilingual Competency at District Level by the Office for National Unity and Reconciliation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-30
decision_details_body: - The Constitution has guaranteed the right of every citizen to  communicate with the Government in one's own mother tongue.  Although, the Government has taken various steps to enforce this right from time to time, there still exists a considerable dearth of officers in the public institutions who have the ability to work in the two official languages namely Sinhala and Tamil (bilingual) and the three languages namely Sinhala, English and Tamil (trilingual). The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena for the  establishment of a database of resource persons with bilingual/trilingual competency, at district level, as an interim measure and to make such information in the database open to all public institutions, non-governmental institutions and the general public and to get their services to public institutions, at instances where necessary,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Loan scheme for Small and Medium Size Enterprises of Sri Lanka implemented under the Financial Assistance from the Asian Development Bank (ADB)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - A loan agreement was signed between the Ministry of Finance and the Asian Development Bank to obtain a loan of US$ 100 million, with the objective of strengthening the entrepreneurs of  the local small and medium-sized Enterprise Sector, by assisting them financially. Under this scheme, loans will be offered to commence a business or to expand the existing business, subject to a maximum Rs.50 million and a 10 year recovery period. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to implement the loan scheme and to enter into loan agreements with the Participatory Financial Institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of the road section of A3 Road from Ja-ela to Chilaw Under the Transport Connectivity and Asset Management Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by  the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct loan negotiations and to enter into agreement with the International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank, to borrow a credit of Rs.90.5 million, Special Drawing Rights (US$ million 126.7 approximately) from the IDA of the World Bank for the renovation activities of the road section of A3 Road from Ja-Ela to Chilaw, under the Transport Connectivity and Asset Management Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Entering into Four (04) Long Term Contracts for the purchase of Refined Petroleum Products for the period of Eight (08) Months  from 01st March 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Chandima Weerakkody, the Minister of Petroleum Resources Development to award 04 long term contracts, for the purchase of refined petroleum products, as per the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding the contract for the supply and distribution of Ariel Bundle Conductors
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contract for the supply and distribution of Ariel Bundle Conductors Alu-ABC, for the distribution region 1, as per the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act of the United States of America - entering into an Inter-Governmental Agreement with the Internal Revenue Services of the United States of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the minister of National Policies and Economic affairs, to enter into an Inter-Governmental Agreement, between the Institute for Internal Revenue Services of the United States of America and the Department of Inland Revenue of Sri Lanka, for tax-information exchange on reciprocal basis, between the  United States of America and Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Re-launching of the Village Reawakening (Gam Udawa) Program
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - The programme 'Gam Udawa', which was launched successfully in the 1980s as an innovative strategy to reach the poor and under privileged people, in every nook and cranny of the country for the upliftment of their living standards, was implemented on the basis that shelter is fundamental to  physical, psychological, social and spiritual well-being of the people.  However, the implementation of 'Gam Udawa' was abandoned during the middle of 1990s. The proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to restore this integrated development effort, which had evolved around the development of human settlements and followed with the 'Gam Udawa' Exhibition, covering a few electorates at regional level, effective from this year, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Accelerated Program for the development of Middle Income Housing & Infrastructure
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - A five year programme for providing houses for the middle income wage earners in urban and sub-urban areas, in all districts, has been launched with the assistance of the private sector, and it would be implemented within the next five years. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to establish a Programme Coordination Unit for the efficient implementation of the programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing a Land for the Ministry of Parliamentary Reforms and Mass Media
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, the Minister of Parliamentary Reforms and Mass Media, to purchase a plot of land of 40 perches, located at the new Parliament Road, Battaramulla at a cost of Rs.31.5 million, from the Urban Development Authority, since it is beneficial to construct a Government owned building, to house the Ministry of Parliamentary Reforms and Mass Media, which is presently functioning in a private building at Pelawatta, Battaramulla on a monthly rental of Rs.630,000/-, as per the recommendations of the Cabinet Committee on Economic Management, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bill to amend the Mediation Boards Act, No.72 of 1988
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers has already granted approval, to increase the limit of monetary value in respect of disputes to be referred to compulsory mediation, from Rs.250,000/- to Rs.500,000/-. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon.(Dr) Wijayadasa Rajapaksha, the Minister of Justice, to  publish the draft bill in the Government Gazette and present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of annual contribution to the Centre for Alleviation of Poverty through Sustainable Agriculture (CAPSA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - The centre for Alleviation of Poverty through Sustainable Agriculture (CAPSA) is a sub-institution governed by the United Nations' Economic and Social Commission and the main objective of the institution is to provide policy inducement for member countries for the upliftment of the living standard of the rural people living on secondary crops and carrying out development activities on agriculture and research to alleviate poverty.  Sri Lanka as a member of this centre has obtained the services pertaining to agricultural development and gained various other benefits. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture to continue to pay the annual membership fee as a member of this centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Social Welfare Centre at Mattakkuliya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to construct a Social Welfare Centre at Mattakkuliya with a view to creating a good day-to-day life for the under privileged and the low income groups living in the Colombo North Urban Area. The building which is proposed to be constructed by the Urban Development Authority in collaboration with the Colombo Municipal Council will have child and maternity clinics, healthcare centres, e-channeling, a library, a gym, carom, chess etc; and common office facilities. The construction of the building will be completed within one year and after completion the ownership of the building and its management will be vested with the Colombo Municipal Council.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development to implement the project for the construction of the proposed Welfare Centre at Mattakkuliya at a cost of Rs.250 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Horana Town Centre Improvement Programme - Implementation of the Horana Bus Stand Development Project - Stage II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - The Development Plan prepared by the Urban Development Authority for Horana Town has identified the issues regarding the inadequacy of infrastructure, traffic congestion and improper land use pattern in the Central Business Area and the basic requirements for the development of the city. To upgrade the Central Business Area, it is absolutely necessary to develop the existing bus stand with adequate parking space for the large number of buses operating to and fro to provide the necessary facilities for the people who come to the city. Stage I of this bus stand has already been completed and therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development to proceed with Stage II of the bus stand development project which includes small scale shop spaces, sanitary facilities, bus shelter access facilities  and access road improvement facilities at a cost of Rs.182 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Companies Act, No. 07 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - The Companies Act, No.07 of 2007 provides for the Incorporation of  Companies, Administration and Management, Amalgamation, Liquidation and Settlement of Company Disputes etc; and it has now been in operation for a period of nearly 10 years.  Based on the Auditor General's Report, all three versions of the Act were reviewed  by the Advisory Commission appointed to advise the Minister regarding the implementation of Company Law and certain provisions were identified for expeditious amendment. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce to amend the Companies Act, No.07 of 2007 incorporating the proposed amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of Compensations and gratuity - The Department of Divineguma Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - The joint proposal made by Hon. S.B Dissanayake, the Minister of Social Empowerment and Welfare and Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, for obtaining funds required for payment of Compensation and gratuity, in stages, for the officers who served in the institutions that were amalgamated to form the Department of Divineguma Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a rail track from Kurunegala to Habarana via Dambulla to be implemented under ‘Let’s Awaken Polonnaruwa’ District Development Programme (2016 - 2020)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - Under the 5 year plan of ‘Let’s Awaken Polonnaruwa’ District Development Programme (2016-2020) which includes development projects for the enhancement of the living standards of the people living in Polonnaruwa and other adjoining districts, the project for the construction of a rail track from Kurunegala to Habarana via Dambulla, 80 km in length has been identified as a priority. This project envisages to provide a safe, fast and a cheap mode of transport to the people of the Eastern and North Central Provinces and also the linking of the Dambulla Economic Centre to the Railway Network which will greatly facilitate the achievement of district development targets and objectives.  The Peoples' Republic of China has agreed to contribute to the implementation of this project and therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation to appoint a project staff for speedy action to complete the project and to acquire the lands required for the identified trace of the  rail track, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financing of Polgahawela, Pothuhera and Alawwa Integrated Water Supply Project, Kundasale - Haragama Water Supply Project and Aluthgama, Mathugama and Agalawatta  Integrated Water Supply Project through the Local Banks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - The cabinet of Ministers has already granted approval, to implement the Water Supply Project of Kundasale-Haragama and the Integrated Water Supply Projects of the Polgahawela, Pothuhera and Alawwa; and Aluthgama, Mathugama and Agalawatta. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic affairs, to authorize the National Water Supply and Drainage Board to obtain the funds through the local banks to implement the Projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of a Waste Management Project in the Matara   Municipal Council and the areas under the purview of the Matara Pradeshiya Sabha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-23
decision_details_body: - A project for establishing a centre for disposing waste in a proper manner and a plant for generating electricity power using bio-gas produced from waste, in Matara, Kotawila area, had been planned  concurrent to the Deyata Kirula 2015, the National Development Exhibition. With the suspension of the Deyata Kirula, the National Development Exhibition, the project activities too came to a standstill. Therefore, the proposal made by H.E the president Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement the suspended Waste Management Project, expeditiously, for the purpose of solving the irregular waste disposal problem of Matara Municipal Council and the areas under the purview of the Matara Pradeshiya Sabha,with the assistance of the private sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Eco-systems Conservation and Management Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, for the implementation of the Eco-systems Conservation and Management Project during the period of 2016 to 2021, with a view to improving the management of Eco-systems in identified areas, to formulate mechanisms to create co-existence between the elephants and humans and to provide benefits to the people through the sustainable use and protection of natural resources, by developing the capacity of the government institutions as well as of the people has already been approved by the Cabinet.  The International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank has shown its interest to provide funds for the said project and the World Bank has agreed to provide a loan facility equivalent to US$ 45 million. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to conduct loan negotiations with the IDA for the implementation of this project and to enter into a relevant Financing Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Greater Colombo Wastewater Management Project - Stage-II -  Design Supervision and Management Consultancy Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - The Greater Colombo Drinking Water and Wastewater Management Project and the Development Investment Programme are being implemented with the objective of streamlining the Wastewater disposal process and improving the public health of the residents of the Greater Colombo area. The Asian Development Bank has provided financial facilities to the Government of Sri Lanka for Stage-II of the Programme and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faiszer Musthapha, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Local Government, to award the Contract for Design Supervision and Management Consultancy Service, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultant Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Stator Replacement - Victoria Power Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - Three Generators are being operated at the Victoria Power Station and such  machines have been in use for over 30 years.  The technical experts in the field have recommended that the said machines have to be repaired without delay, if further efficient service is to be obtained from these machines. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the Tender for the replacement of the Stator of Unit 3 Machine of Victoria Power Station, to the bidder recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the District Secretariat Building, Mullaitivu - Stage - II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - Mullaitivu belonging to the Northern Province is a district where the lives of the people have been worst affected by the Tsunami and the protracted conflict. Although, a large number of development activities are in progress under the supervision of the District Secretary, to uplift the living conditions of the people of the district, the limited space available in the District Secretariat has become an obstruction to carry out such development activities efficiently and effectively. Accordingly, with a view to providing the services of the District Secretariat under one roof, in order to provide a better service to the people of the district, the proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, to carry out the construction work of  the Stage II of the District Secretariat, Mullaitivu at an estimated cost of Rs.328 million,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Building for the Divisional Secretariat, Homagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - Divisional Secretariat, Homagama is the one which comprises the most number of Grama Niladhari Divisions and covers the largest area out of the thirteen (13) Divisional Secretariat Divisions in the Colombo District. The extent of this Divisional Secretariat Division is 11,815.5 hectares and the number of families residing there is around 60,425.  The pensioners residing in the area are around 10,000 and the total population there is around 250,000. Adequate facilities are not available in the building where the Divisional Secretariat is housed presently and therefore, with a view to providing a more efficient and an effective service to the general public, the proposal made by Hon. Vajira Abeywardena, the Minister of Home Affairs, to construct a three (03) storied building for the above Secretariat , at a cost of Rs.286.66 million,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for Supply, Installation & After - Sales Services of 01 No. MRI Scanner for the National Hospital of Sri Lanka (NHSL)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - The MRI Scanner presently installed at the National Hospital is about 15 years old and as such, it is essential to procure a new MRI Scanner for the National Hospital.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Faizal Casim, the Acting Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the Tender for Supply, Installation and After Sales Services of 01 No. MRI Scanner for the NHSL, to the lowest responsive bidder, as per the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an Administrative Building for the Ministry of Higher Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - Since the building facilities found in the Ministry of Higher Education  which is presently situated in a state land in Ward Place, Colombo 07, are inadequate for the present day service requirements, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to demolish a building more than 25 years old and to make use of the premises for the construction of a new Administrative Building consisting with eight (08) floors and  a floor area of 64,255 sq.ft., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of infrastructure facilities of the Universities of Kelaniya, Visual and Performing Arts, Moratuwa, Rajarata, Sri Jayawardenapura, Colombo and the University of Colombo School of Computing
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - Development of infrastructure facilities of Universities and Higher Education Institutions is essential to produce professionally competent graduates who par  with the existing development needs of the economy of the country and cater to the needs of the international job market. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.
