Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to implement the proposed 09 projects of developing the infrastructure facilities of the Universities of Kelaniya, Visual and Performing Arts, Moratuwa, Sri Jayawardenapura, Rajarata, Colombo and the University of Colombo School of Computing, at an investment of Rs.1,706.9 million, during the period of 2016-2019, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Contract for Consultancy Service for Reviewing of Design and Construction Supervision of Headworks of Moragahakanda Reservoir
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - The projects of Moragahakanda and Kalu Ganga have been identified as projects that provide strong contribution towards the provision of water for the agricultural activities, supply of electricity and  the development of the livelihood of the people of the area and by now, a considerable quantity of work has been completed. Presently 60% of the head work of Moragahakanda project has been completed and it has been planned to complete the construction  work by March 2017. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to award the Contract for Consultancy Services for reviewing of design and construction supervision of the head work of this project, to the Mahaweli Consultancy Bureau, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The programme of  Providing Rs.20,000/- to obtain nutritional foods for expectant mothers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - In order to give birth to a physically and mentally healthy child and for the elimination of low birth-weigh child births from Sri Lanka, a programme of providing nutritional food in a value of Rs.20,000/- to expectant mothers for a period of 10 months, including the final 06 months of pregnancy period and the first 04 months of the lactation period, is being implemented by the Government since March 2015. It has been recommended  to introduce a new methodology, to enable the expectant mothers to select food of their preference and choice and to further simplify the present methodology. It would provide expectant mothers with the opportunity of getting nutritional food, for a period of 10 months from any of the easily accessible business institutions, subject to a maximum of Rs. 20,000/- per month, which have been registered in the Divisional Secretariat. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, to implement the proposed new methodology, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a block of land developed for a Tsunami Housing Scheme at Kalmunai Town to the National Housing Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - Kalmunai Town can be described as one of the most affected towns from the Tsunami disaster that occurred in the year 2004. The families displaced from the said disaster have been resettled in a three storied housing complex comprising of 174 housing units, which was constructed utilizing a sum of money given by a private donor, in a plot of land purchased by the Urban Development Authority, for the resettlement of displaced families. The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to allocate the relevant land as a free grant to the National Housing Development Authority (NHDA) by the Urban Development Authority, enabling the NHDA to legally allocate the said housing units to the residents of such housing units through issuing deeds to them and also to take necessary measures to manage common amenities of the said housing scheme, providing solutions  to the issues encountered by the residents due to absence of a proper mechanism for the maintenance of this housing scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strategic Cities Development Project - Development of Jaffna City
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - The main objective of the Strategic Cities Development Project is  to develop a system of environmentally sustainable and well-linked cities. The development of  the cities of Kandy and Galle as strategic cities, with relevant facilities has already been commenced under this project, on loan facilities, obtained from the World Bank. Jaffna city too has been identified as an appropriate city to be developed under this programme and  therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restructuring of Lanka Sathosa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - In August 2014, Lanka Sathosa  imported 257,853 metric tons of rice, on a bank loan of Rs.14,078 million and due to the failure in selling the stock of rice as expected, it has become impossible to settle the loan obtained. By now a sum of Rs.5,742 million has been settled and further Rs.8,754 million together with the outstanding interest is to be settled. A sum of Rs.17,000 million has been spent for the importation of this stock of rice including port charges, demurrages, transportation and warehouse costs. It has been identified that 3,048 Metric tons of rice from the presently remaining stock is unfit for human consumption. It seems that the anticipated income from selling the remaining stock of rice, will not be sufficient to settle the outstanding loan amount and to have the working capital required to continue the daily operational activities of Lanka Sathosa. Accordingly, in order to avoid this situation, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, Hon. P. Harison, the Minister of Rural Economy, Hon. Malik Samarawickrama, the Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, to provide the  funds required to meet the urgent working Capital requirement and to pay the outstanding loan due to the state banks by Lanka Sathosa, from the General Treasury, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: World Expo 2017 - Astana, Kazakhstan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - The 'World Expo' exhibition is  held biennially in major cities of the world, under different themes and this year's exhibition is scheduled to be held in Astana, Kazakhastan from the 10th of June to 10th of September, 2017, under the theme of 'Future Energy'. The Republic of Kazakhstan has invited Sri Lanka to take part in the said exhibition. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to appoint a Commissioner General to organize the Sri Lanka's participation at this exhibition and to provide the opportunity for the small and medium sector producers of horticulture and related products in Sri Lanka, to be involved in the Exposition through an accepted methodology, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Report of the Cabinet Sub-Committee appointed to submit the recommendations on relocation of families living in high risk areas prone to landslide
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - A Cabinet Sub-Committee under the Chairmanship of Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, the Minister of Disaster Management, was appointed by the Cabinet of Ministers, to study and report issues pertaining to the relocation of families living in high risk areas prone to landslides and expediting of the construction of houses for the persons who have been affected due to landslides. Accordingly, the implementation of the recommendations submitted, giving attention to  matters such as identification of the number of families settled at landslide risk prone areas, resettling them in other places, provision of facilities to convert the disaster affected persons back to normalcy,  re-establishment of  public places such as schools situated in high risk prone areas, in stages, on priority basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Wildlife Management Units
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka looses more than 50 human lives and 200 wild elephants  annually, due to the elephant-human conflict and a trend is developing where in addition to elephants, other  animals such as leopards,  crocodiles and monkeys have conflicts with humans. As such, in order to control this situation, plans are being launched by the Department of Wildlife Conservation, and therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife, to establish Wildlife Management Units covering the wildlife areas where wildlife-human conflicts are mostly reported, to take prompt measures by visiting relevant places immediately, when a such incident is reported, was approved by the Cabinet in principle.

description: Agreement on Global Climate Change and National Strategic	Accord (National Contribution towards minimizing Global	Temperature)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-16
decision_details_body: - Excessive burning of fossil fuels, industrialization, urbanization, deforestation and environmental pollution have paved the way to the increase of global temperature and it has been predicted that the global temperature is likely to rise by 4 degrees Celcius (4°C) by the end of this Century. The climate changes that occur due to the increase of global temperature will cause adverse effects to the sustenance of mankind. As per the Paris Agreement entered into at the 21st Session of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCC), which was held in Paris,  France from 30th November to 11th December 2015, it has been agreed not to exceed the global temperature by another 2 degrees Celcius (2°C)  from the present temperature level by 2100 and to maintain the same below 1.5 degrees Celcius (1.5°C).  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of  Mahaweli Development and Environment, for Sri Lanka to sign the Paris Agreement in concurrence with the above to formulate the policies and plans relevant to implement the set of proposals for the reduction of Green House Gas emissions  as designed for the contribution of Sri Lanka as per the said Agreement, to draft legislation for the establishment of the 'Climate Change Commission of Sri Lanka' and to implement the ''Blue Green Beautiful Lanka' Programme, in 10,000 villages, during the period of 2016-2020, in collaboration with the community organizations, with a view to creating eco-friendly 'Green Smart Villages', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the Agreement on Colombo Port City Development Project with the Government of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-09
decision_details_body: - Due to the environmental issues that have arisen, the activities of the  Colombo Port City Development Project has been suspended since February 2015 and a comprehensive and formal Environmental Impact Assessment Report on the Project was called for. The Cabinet Committee on Economic Management has recommended to allow the re-commencement of the activities of the Colombo Port City Development Project, subject to certain matters to be resolved in future and within the fixed limits and conditions indicated in the said Report. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Prime Minister, to extend the Agreement entered into with the relevant Project Company by the Government of Sri Lanka, for a further period of six (06) months from 15th March 2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the New Courts Complex, Matara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-09
decision_details_body: - The Courts Complex, Matara is housed in buildings of over 100 years old, within the premises of Fort of Matara. It has become necessary to house all the Court buildings, comprising of a Civil Appellate High Court, a Provincial High Court, three District Courts, two Magistrate's Courts and a Labour Tribunal under one roof and for this purpose, a portion of land from the land called Kotawilawatta, situated in Matara has been identified.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to construct the Courts Complex, Matara, at a cost of Rs.1,119.5 million, with a Juvenile Magistrate's Court, a Commercial High Court, a Bank, a Post Office, Rest Rooms and Library for Lawyers, a Community Correction Office, a Legal Aid Office and Family Counselling Office, in addition to the above Courts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ratification of United Nations Convention on the Use of Electronic Communications in International Contracts: Amendments to Electronic Transactions Act, No. 19 of 2006
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-09
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka signed the United Nations Electronic Communications Convention (UN-ECC) on 07th July, 2015 and thus Sri Lanka is the second country in Asia and the first country in South Asia to ratify this Convention. The purpose of this Convention is to offer practical solutions for the issues related to the use of electronic means of communication in connection with international contracts. The proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to amend the Electronic Transactions Act, No.19 of 2006, for the implementation of this Convention in Sri Lanka, which provides necessary facilities to promote Sri Lanka as a hub for e-commerce, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of at least 25% of the provisions for women, from  the Projects implemented for Rural Economic Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-09
decision_details_body: - As per the recommendation of the Cabinet Sub-Committee appointed to study the proposal submitted previously for the use of at least 25% of the provisions earned by the projects implemented for the development of the rural economy, for women, the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) K.D.M. Chandrani Bandara, the Minister of Women and Child Affairs, to use at least a minimum of 25% of investments made for the identified rural development projects implemented by the various Ministries, in the interest of women, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Allocations for the Payment of Compensation for the lands acquired for the Second Stage of the Hambantota Port Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-09
decision_details_body: - The construction work of the Phase II of this project is nearing completion by now and therefore, the joint proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Ports and Shipping and Hon. Sagala Rathnayake, Minister of Law & Order and Southern Development, to obtain the provisions required for the payment of compensation, in respect of the lands acquired for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obscene Publications Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-09
decision_details_body: - It is of paramount importance to safeguard children from the adverse effects which could result from their exposure to obscene publications. The provisions contained in the Penal Code and the Obscene Publications Ordinance of 1927 are  inadequate to deal with that regard, especially in the present social context. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to bring in a new Act on obscene publications, in place of the existing legal provisions, in order to provide for the prohibition of obscene publications using children, prevention of keeping child pornography through use of computer systems and for the avoidance of exposure of children to visuals on sexual activities using computer as a medium, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Land at Kalutara to the Kalutara Bodhi Trust for a Public Car Park
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-09
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to legally transfer the block of land known as 'Diyambathalawa' of 33.75 perches in extent, situated in between the two bridges across the Kalu Ganga, in the Kalutara city, in Galle Road to which the Kalutara Bodhi Trust  has already paid  compensation and the interest related thereto in respect of the transfer of the said land and the possession had been transferred to the said Trust, to the Kalutara Bodhi Trust, by the Urban Development Authority, for the enhancement of the parking facilities of the pilgrims who daily arrive at the Kalutara Bodhi, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Small and Micro Industries Leader and Entrepreneur  Promotion  Project - SMILE III - Revolving Fund Loan Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-09
decision_details_body: - Granting loans to small and medium size entrepreneurs including those who engaged in the production of import substitutes, value added goods and goods produced using modern technology for the export market, with a view to uplifting high yielding industries within macro-economic framework of the Government and to all those  small and medium size industrialists who are not covered by other loan schemes, is undertaken by the above Loan Scheme. As per the requests made by the small and medium industrial entrepreneurs, who are the recipient beneficiaries of this loan scheme and the participating loan institutions who implement this loan scheme, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to increase the maximum subsidiary loan limit up to Rs.25 million, provided under the present General Loan Scheme and to increase the re-financing ratio for the subsidiary Loans provided  to the participating credit institutions, by the Government, up to 100%, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial Assistance for the implementation of Anuradhapura Integrated Urban Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-09
decision_details_body: - Anuradhapura, which belongs to the 'Cultural Triangle' of Sri Lanka holds a special significance due to its archaeological specialty and the number of sacred places of Buddhist worship found therein. At the same time, it is the economic and administrative hub of the North Central Province and is a destination which has gained the  attraction of the local and foreign tourists. Presently, a population of more than 51,000 reside in the city limits of Anuradhapura, where a high growth is anticipated in time to come. Therefore, it is proposed to create a balanced growth and co-development between the sacred city and the new town areas of Anuradhapura, under the Strategic Cities Development Project implemented by the Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development, while preserving its cultural and natural heritage.  The improvement of the city water drainage system, provision of public transport facilities, traffic management and the enhancement of public space are anticipated to be carried out through this project. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement the Anuradhapura Integrated Urban Development Project, under the Strategic Cities Development Project being implemented and the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to enter into a loan agreement with the Agence Francaise De Developpment (AFD), to obtain a credit facility of Euro 52 million, were approved by the Cabinet.

description: Investment in the 'Commonwealth Small States Trade Financing Facility'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-09
decision_details_body: - During the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) which was held in Malta in November, 2015, the Commonwealth along with Sri Lanka, India, Mauritius and Malta had announced the setting up of a new Fund as 'Commonwealth Small States Trade Financing Facility', to promote trade and investment flows, particularly for small and developing countries of the Commonwealth. The objective of this Fund is to promote trade flows to and from the small States of the Commonwealth.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to invest a sum of US$ 1.5 million, as an 'Anchor investor', in the said Fund, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Expressway Authority Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-09
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to publish the National Expressway Authority Bill drafted to provide for the establishment of National Expressway Authority for the construction, management, development and maintenance of expressways in Sri Lanka, to   ensure a safe, efficient and an environmental friendly movement of vehicles on the expressways, and to entrust the powers and functions connected thereto, in the Gazette and thereafter to present same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of  Pre-paid Card System for Public Transport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-09
decision_details_body: - The use of Information Technology Solutions for the qualitative development of the Public transport service has become popular in many countries today. Among these solutions, the use of an electronic charging system has become very popular and the ability to charge the relevant fee accurately from the passengers, receipt of due income by the bus owner, avoidance of issues such as settling balances (due to not possessing coins) are among the advantages of this system. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to introduce a system of electronic charging for the passenger service buses, via pre-paid cards, in collaboration with the Sri Lanka Information and Communication Technology Agency, Sri Lanka Transport Board, National Transport Commission, Private Bus Owners, State Banks and IT Companies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of  Passenger Permits for the Expressway
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-09
decision_details_body: - A Tender procedure to select bus operators, for the issuance of passenger permits in the expressway was introduced and under that procedure the permits were issued to the persons who have submitted the highest bid and therefore the ordinary bus owners were deprived of the opportunity of providing transport services in the expressway. Accordingly, an Officials' Committee was appointed by the Cabinet, to submit an alternative methodology for the purpose. On the recommendations of the said Committee, also with the approval of the Cabinet, the criterion to be followed in issuing passenger permits for the expressway and the marking scheme related thereto were implemented. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to implement the recommendations of the Cabinet Sub-Committee, appointed to submit recommendations for the introduction of a more transparent methodology, avoiding the shortcomings evident in the previous procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ecosystems Conservation and Management  Project (ESCAMP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-09
decision_details_body: - Although Sri Lanka has been ranked as a global bio-diversity hot spot, the ecosystem and the bio-diversity of the country have been confronted with serious threats. The prime objective of the Government is to direct Sri Lanka towards a sustainable development that ensures the conservation and management, while empowering environmental safety. The objective of this project is to strengthen the capacity of the Government Institutions and the General Public, for the improvement of the sensitive ecosystems in selected areas, demonstrating models on human-elephant co-existence and the sustainable consumption and conservation of natural resources. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment, to implement this project during the period of 2016-2021, utilizing a loan facility of US$ 40 million to be obtained from the World Bank and Rs.473 million to be provided by the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining vehicles for Government Agencies under the Operating 	Leasing Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The Government spends a considerable amount of money for the purchase of vehicles for public institutions as well as for the maintenance of such vehicles due to the high repair costs and administrative delays. It has been proposed through the Budget - 2016 to introduce an 'Operating Leasing Scheme' to obtain vehicles for the vehicle pools of the Government institutions and the officers of the Government institutions and public enterprises entitled to have official vehicles, in order to avoid the weaknesses in the existing system, to reduce the amount of money spent by all public institutions for the maintenance of a large number of vehicles and to increase the efficiency of the Leasing industry in the country while promoting the same. Under this system, a portion of the vehicles required for the Government will be obtained on the option of 'Use and Return' on a 60 month fixed rental basis from the eligible suppliers who provide vehicle rental services, selected through the Government Procurement procedure, and the lessor will bear the expenses of Insurance covers, revenue licenses, all repair  costs and the other relevant expenses, and the Government will bear only the expenses for the drivers and fuel. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to implement the above methodology of obtaining vehicles under the proposed Operating Leasing Scheme, incurring an optimal costs saving to the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Paddy Purchasing Programme during the Maha Season 2015/16
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - Reaping the harvest in the Maha Season 2015/2016 has already commenced and the Paddy Marketing Board has made arrangements to purchase paddy in 19 Districts during this Season, in accordance with the Government's Policy on purchase of paddy. Accordingly, the proposals made by Hon. P. Harrison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to purchase paddy directly from the farmers by the Paddy Marketing Board, under the Paddy purchasing programme of the Government in the Maha Season 2015/2016, to implement the programme in the relevant Districts with the  assistance of the District Secretaries/Government Agents, to pay Rs.50/- per kg for 'Keeri samba', Rs. 41/- per kg for 'Samba' and Rs.38/- per kg for 'Nadu' purchased by the Board and purchase paddy from the farmers engaged in the paddy cultivation during the Season, subject to a maximum	quantity of 2,000 kg from each, were approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Joint Action Programme between Sri Lanka and Thailand for the implementation of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Cooperation in the field of Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka and Thailand entered into a MoU on Cooperation in the field of tourism in the year 2013. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, to sign a Joint Action Programme for the implementation of the above MoU, between the Ministry of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs of the Democratic, Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Tourism and Sports of the Kingdom of Thailand, during the forthcoming visit of the Hon. Deputy Prime Minister of Thailand to Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing the SAARC Youth Charter
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The SAARC Youth Charter principally anticipates the promotion of health,well being, rights and potentials of the youth. In achieving the said objectives, it is also anticipated to expedite the national development through acquisition of knowledge of the youth in the South Asian region and to provide employment opportunities to all through the effective utilization of skills and opportunities while yielding benefits for the youth.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister Hon. Ranil  Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to sign and	ratify	the SAARC Youth Charter to be signed at the 36th Session of the SAARC Council of Ministers which will be held on 17th March, 2016 in Kathmandu, Nepal, by Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the purchase of 80,000 bottles of Human Albumin	Solution BP (PH EUR) 20% in 50ml bottle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the Tender for the purchase of the above medicine which is used for the treatment of kidney patients, to the bidder recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the purchase of 300,000 Vials of Rabies Vaccine (Human Use (1ml/0.5)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the Tender for the purchase of the above vaccine which is used to prevent rabies, to the bidder recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the purchase of 580,000 Vials of Enoxaparin Sodium Injection 6,000 IU in 60mg/0.6ml Prefilled Syringe
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the Tender for the purchase of the above vaccine, which is used for the treatment of heart patients, to the bidder recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the purchase of 120,000,000 Tablets of Clopidogrel 75mg
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the Tender for the purchase of the above essential medicine used to inhibit blood clots in heart patients, to the bidder recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the purchase of 1,200,000 Doses of Adsorbed Diptheria Tetanus, Pertussis, Hepatitis B and Haemophilus Influenza Type b Conjugate Liquid Vaccine BP, USP or EP (Pentavalent)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the Tender for the purchase of the above vaccine essential for the continuation of the child immunization programme, to the bidder recommended by the Standing  Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The elevated Highway from the New Kelani Bridge to Rajagiriya with the connection to Battaramulla, Malabe, Athurugiriya and Outer Circular Highway
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to construct an elevated highway network in Colombo, in order to improve the connectivity between the Colombo city, suburbs and expressways, and to reduce the prevailing traffic congestion. Under this network, it is proposed to construct an elevated highway of 6.9 km in length with four lanes, commencing from the proposed New Kelani Bridge and ending at Rajagiriya. This section will be extended towards the Southern direction enabling it to connect with the Outer Circular Highway at Athurugiriya. And also, the Northern end of this section of the proposed elevated highway will  be linked with the Katunayake Expressway at the New Kelani Bridge. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to implement this project and to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the infrastructure facilities of the Advanced Technological Institutes at Galle, Gampaha, Kandy, Kurunegala & Sammanthurai
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to establish an Advanced Technological Institute (ATI) in each district, in order to accomplish the tasks entrusted with the Sri Lanka Institute of Advanced Technological Education (SLIATE), which is functioning under the purview of the Ministry of Higher Education and Highways. Eleven (11) Advanced Technological Institutes and six (06) Advanced Technological Institute Sections are presently being operated under the SLIATE and there is a very high recognition for the Higher National Diplomas awarded by the Institute. Only about 35% of the students was enrolled out of more than 20,000 students who have applied for the courses in 2015, due to insufficient space available.  Hence, the opportunity has been limited for the students to have  advanced technological education on the fields such as Engineering, Quantity Surveying, English Language and Information Technology which possess a higher demand in the current job market.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to implement the projects for the development of buildings, equipment, staff and the student capacity of the Advanced Technological Institutes situated in Kegalle, Dehiwala, Jaffna, Galle, Gampaha, Kandy, Kurunegala and Sammanthurai, at an estimated cost of Rs. 2,368.5 million, as a solution to this situation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The project for issuing Vehicle Emission Test Certificates
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The contract period of the two companies which entered into contracts  with the Department of Motor Traffic, to operate the authorized Vehicle Emission Test Centres islandwide for the purpose of issuing vehicle emission certificates, to effect the vehicle emission standards, is due to  expire on 2016-07-01.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala De Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to commence the procurement activities to select few suitable private sector companies as contractors for the implementation of vehicle emission  standards by establishing Vehicle Emission Test Centres for the period of next five (05) years and to establish Test Centres of the Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB) in the nine (09) Provinces to bring in line the vehicles owned by the SLTB with this programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Advance Passenger Information Processing (APIP) and Passenger Name Record (PNR) System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Harin Fernando, the Minister of  Telecommunication and Digital Infrastructure, to establish an Advance Passenger Information Processing (APIP) and Passenger Name Record (PNR) System at the Department of Immigration and Emigration, in association with the Information and Communication Technology Agency of Sri Lanka (ICTA) and Socie'te' Internationale de Te'le' communications Ae'ronautiques (SITA) as stakeholders, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-development of the Bambalapitiya Flats
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - Although the above housing scheme has been extended to a premises of 10 acres and 15.55 perches, only 259 condominium residential units and 10 condominium commercial units are situated in the said scheme. Moreover, these half a century aged buildings have become dilapidated and insecure since they are located close to the sea. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to take necessary action to implement the project for the Redevelopment of the 'Bambalapitiya Flats', in the above premises which has a vast development potential, with the foreign investor recommended by the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of 150 sets of fishing equipment to the fishermen in the Mullaitivu District under the Indian Grant Assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The fishing community in Mullaitivu area had undergone several hardships by losing their fishing equipment and having suffered damages to such equipment, due to the war atmosphere which prevailed for 30 years. As per the request made by the Ministry of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, in order to  provide relief to those fishermen, the Government of India has agreed to provide outboard engines and 150 sets of fishing equipment as a grant. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda  Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding to obtain those equipment worth of about Rs.100 million, as a grant of the Government of India, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of UDA land at Perahera Mawatha, Colombo 03 to the Colombo Plan Secretariat
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The Colombo Plan Secretariat, an international bureau located in Sri Lanka, which is currently housed in a rented building has been proposed to be established in a more spacious premises. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to provide a plot of land at Perahera Mawatha, Colombo 03, identified as suitable for the establishment of the Secretariat, to the said Secretariat, on a lease term of 50 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of land blocks from Regional Industrial Estates to set up industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The Regional Industrial Estates Development Programme is implemented by the Ministry of Industry and Commerce with the objective of  promoting industries at regional level. The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to allocate plots of land from the respective Industrial Estates, to the appropriate investors/companies who possessed the required qualifications, under this programme, as per the recommendation of the Ministerial Project Evaluation Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transport connectivity and Asset Management Project to be funded by the World Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to implement the rehabilitation of Peliyagoda - Puttlam Road, under the Output and Performance Based Contract  (OPBC) which is presently being implemented for the rehabilitation and maintenance of roads in many countries of the World, by the Wold Bank, the Asian Development Bank and other international funding agencies, as a pilot project and to conduct negotiations with the World Bank to obtain the funds required for the above project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Port Access Elevated Highway Project - obtaining approval to seek financial assistance from the Asian Development Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to construct an elevated highway of 5.8 km in length from the New Kelani Bridge, Peliyagoda to Colombo Fort, to connect the Colombo Fort area with the expressway network,  at an estimated cost of Rs.36 billion, in order to provide easy access to cargo and container traffic from Colombo and suburban areas to reach Colombo Fort and to ease the prevailing traffic congestion in the Colombo City area. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to implement the above project and to secure the funds required for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accession to the Ottawa Convention/Anti-Personnel Mine Ban Convention by Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - Due to the conflict situation that prevailed in Sri Lanka, the Northern and Eastern provinces of the country have been adversely affected by the landmines and explosive remnants of war. Mine clearance operations are vital for the safe resettlement of internally displaced persons (IDP), and the threats caused by the landmines and the explosive remnants of war need to be prevented for the better living conditions of the people residing in those areas and infrastructure development activities. Therefore, the joint proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Hon. D.M.	Swaminathan, the Minister of Prison Reforms, Rehabilitation, Resettlement and Hindu Religious Affairs, to accede to the Anti-Personnel Mine Ban Convention which is also known as Ottawa Convention, by the Government of Sri Lanka, which arranges the required background for	the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Air Services Consultations between Sri Lanka and Austria
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - Consultations on executing a new bilateral Air Services Agreement between Sri	Lanka and Austria  were held in the month of November, 2015 in Vienna, Austria, with the participation of the aeronautical authorities	of both countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal	 Siripala De Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to sign the new bilateral Air Services Agreement between Sri Lanka and Austria by an accredited representative of Sri Lanka, as agreed upon at the above consultations and to take appropriate measures thereafter for the effective implementation of the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Celebration of the Golden Jubilee of Sri Lanka Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The functioning of the Tourism Industry in Sri Lanka with a targeted approach commenced with the establishment of the Ceylon Tourist Board in the year 1966, subsequent to the enactment of the Tourist Board Act, No.10 of 1966. Since then, the Tourism Industry in the country has been able to earn a lucrative income during the past fifty years and nearly 03 Lakhs of direct and indirect employment opportunities have been generated through the said Industry. Tourist arrivals to the country which was around 19,079 in the year 1966 increased up to 1,798,380 by the year 2015. Both the Government Economic Policy presented in Parliament by the Hon. Prime Minister last year and the Budget proposals - 2016 have emphasized the importance of development and promotion of the Tourism Industry in Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, the Cabinet noted the information submitted by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Tourism Development and Christian Religious Affairs, as to the effect  that a celebration programme is scheduled to be held during  this year, to celebrate the Golden Jubilee of Sri Lanka Tourism, with a view to contributing towards the future progress of the Tourism Industry.

description: Expansion of the role of the Cabinet Committee on Economic 	Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-03-02
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet Committee on Economic Management, chaired by the Hon. Prime Minister, has been established to make recommendations to the Cabinet, on the matters pertaining to economic affairs, monetary and fiscal policy, National Investment Programme, facilitation of private sector investment and implementation of various legislation which are directly applicable to the investment and economic development of the country, etc. The proposal made by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, to introduce an appropriate mechanism, for the efficient implementation of the recommendations made to the Cabinet by the said Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presentation of the Regulations made by the Minister of Sports under Section 34 (1) of the Convention against Doping in Sports Act, No.33 of 2013, in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to present the Regulations published in the Gazette (Extraordinary) Notification No.1950/1 dated 2016-01-18, made under Section 34(1) of the Convention against Doping in Sports Act, No.33 of 2013, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of salaries of the Public Service – 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-23
decision_details_body: - The Budget 2016, proposed to revise the salaries of the Public Service by adding special allowances given in addition to the basic salary, presently entitled by the Public Servants and the interim monthly allowance of Rs.10,000 given as per the Election Manifesto of H.E. the President, to the basic salary, in phases. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Public Administration and Management, to implement the new Salary structure, prepared as per the recommendation of the National Pay Commission and in concurrence with the Ministry of Finance, to be effective from 2016-01-01 and to issue the relevant Circular instructions accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Partnership Arrangement for the Sri Lankan Dairy Excellence Training Initiative
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-23
decision_details_body: - The above Agreement prepared with a view to upgrading the quality and capacity of the dairy extension services provided to the farmers by the Department of Animal Production and Health, to increase the  manufacturing productivity of local dairy farms, is to be signed between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of the Government of New Zealand and the Ministries of Finance and Rural Economy of Sri Lanka. The activities under this Arrangement are proposed to be implemented within a period of three years with a financial grant of New Zealand  dollars 2.5 million. Accordingly, the  proposal made by Hon. P. Harrison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to sign the above Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Salaries and Cadre Commission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-23
decision_details_body: - As per the pledge given in the Election Manifesto submitted by himself for the Presidential Election - 2015, to increase the efficiency and effectiveness in the entire Public Service and to uplift the living conditions and service satisfaction of the Public Servants, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to appoint a New Salaries and Cadre Commission comprising of learned and experienced experts so as to represent all sectors of the Public Service and the Private Sector, to establish a more effective and satisfied Public Service, after broadly and formally reviewing the existing salary structure and cadre, taking into consideration the future development process to be launched by the Government, and to formulate a New Salary Policy giving due consideration to the manpower requirement of the Private Sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Greater Colombo Transmission and Distribution Loss Reduction Project, Package No-1 (Lot-1): Construction of Grid Substations and Package - No-2: Construction & Distribution Cables
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-23
decision_details_body: - The basic objective of this project is to enhance the transmission and distribution network in the Greater Colombo area, in order to strengthen the transmission and distribution system and increase the reliability of power supply and reduce transmission losses, thereby contributing to economic development in the said area. A loan of 15.9 Billion of Japanese Yen will be provided by the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) for the project planned to be implemented under 03 procurement packages.  Accordingly, the proposals made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to award the contracts for the construction of the Grid Substations and distribution cables, to the suitable bidders, as per the recommendations made by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, were approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Shelter for All' National Housing Programme to construct 1000     	houses in each electorate
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-23
decision_details_body: - The basic objective of the 'Shelter for All' National Housing Programme proposed to be implemented in the year 2016, is to construct new houses, upgrade the existing houses and to grant ownership of the houses and lands to the residents. This programme is expected to be implemented, so as to cover the entire country and all the sectors. Accordingly, 1,000 houses with a floor area of 500 square feet per house are scheduled to be constructed in each electorate, and the maximum contribution by the Government for a house will be Rs.300,000/-. A sum of Rs.5,800 million has already been allocated to the Ministry of Housing and Construction through the Budget Estimates - 2016, for the implementation of this housing programme and therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Construction, to obtain the balance provision further required for the implementation of this  programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Asia-Pacific Association of Agricultural Research Institutions (APAARI): Upgrading the membership fee of the Sri Lanka Council for Agricultural Research Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-23
decision_details_body: - The objective of the Asia-Pacific Association of Agricultural Research Institutions (APAARI) is to foster the development of agricultural research in the Asia-Pacific Region. The Sri Lanka Council for Agricultural Research Policy holds the membership of this association since the year 1988 and according to the membership categorization of that Association, Sri Lanka belongs to the category 'C'. Since this Association offers many of its training programmes and expert consultations without any additional expenses, other than the annual subscription fee, in order to receive more benefits, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to upgrade the membership of the Sri Lanka Council for Agricultural Research Policy in the said Association, from category 'C' to category 'B', was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Membership Update of the Asia-Pacific Plant Protection Commission (APPPC) functioning under the United Nations' Food and Agriculture Organization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-23
decision_details_body: - The above Regional Co-operation Organization, established in the Asia-Pacific Region, pertaining to the activities and responsibilities on plant phytosanitary, is one of the organizations established under the International Plant Protection Commission (IPPC). This organization paves the way to study and discuss the problems encountered by each country on plant phytosanitary. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to update the membership of the Commission and to pay the annual contribution by the Government of Sri Lanka as a Member State of the Organization, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for establishment of the BIMSTEC Grid Inter - Connection
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-23
decision_details_body: - A programme on Energy Co-operation was adopted at the Ministerial Conference of the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi Sectoral Technical and Economic Co-operation (BIMSTEC) held in October, 2015 in New Delhi with the participation of the Ministers of the BIMSTEC Member States, namely Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka and Thailand. As an initial step of this programme, a MoU has been drafted for electricity transmission through Grid Interconnections with the co-operation of Member States. Its vision is to generate electricity and promote optimal power transmission within all Member States. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, the Minister of Power and Renewable Energy, to sign the above MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Graduate Trainee Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-23
decision_details_body: - Graduates had been recruited directly to the Public Service of Sri Lanka initially, and almost all the graduates have been provided with  Government employment opportunities about the year 1964. The Graduate Trainee Scheme for the unemployed graduates commenced in the year 1971 and the various Governments which came into power from time to time, have recruited graduates into the Public Service under Graduate Trainee Schemes.  In the year 2005 the total actual cadre of the Public Service was 900,642 and by the year 2014  it depicted a rapid increased up to 1,302,258 and during this period 88,609 graduates were recruited to the Public Service as 'Development Officers'.  However,  the recruitment of graduates into the Public Service in this manner as a remedy for unemployment has created a situation where the expected service from them could not be obtained.  Accordingly, taking into consideration, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, the Cabinet approved to employ more productively, the Development Officers already recruited, after reviewing the cadre requirement of the Public Service, and to recruit in future into the Public Service, the graduates equipped with necessary subject knowledge and skills to uphold the Public Service, on par with the modern challenges, only for the vacancies identified as per the service requirement and depending only on results of the competitive examinations.

description: Amendment of Section 40(e) of the National Transport	Commission Act, No.37 of 1991
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-23
decision_details_body: - As per the provisions of the above Act, the National Transport Commission issues passenger service permits for deploying buses in the inter-provincial routes, by calling applications under competitive bids after publishing advertisements in the national newspapers. However, it has been reported that a large number of buses are driven in inter provincial routes, without the possession of valid passenger service permits and this situation is detrimental to the passenger transport bus service as well as the passengers. Therefore, with a view to establishing a qualitative bus service by freeing the passengers out of this adverse situation, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, to amend the Section 40(e) of the National Transport Commission Act,  No.37 of 1991 to increase the existing maximum fine of Rs.10,000/- which could be imposed by a Magistrate's Court, against the persons who drive buses without having any passenger service permits, up to Rs.200,000/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of Customs import duty on imported rice
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-10
decision_details_body: - Having considered the local paddy production anticipated in the up coming Maha Season 2015/2016, in order to protect the local farmer,  steps have been taken to increase the import duty on imported rice from Rs.35/- per kg to Rs.50/- per kg, with effect from 2016-02-01.  Accordingly, the proposal made by  Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to submit the Gazette Notification (Extraordinary) No.1952/10 dated 2016-02-01, issued under the Revenue Protection Act, for the purpose, to the Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing  of  a  Memorandum  of  Understanding   between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Germany for the Development of Sports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Dayasiri Jayasekara, the Minister of Sports, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Germany, on the co-operation in the field of Sports, by providing the framework for bilateral cooperation in the fields of Sports, Sports Administration, Sports Research, Sports Development and the excellence in Sports, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memoranda of Understanding between the Government of Sri 	Lanka and the South Asia Institute affiliated to the Heidelberg 	University of the Federal Republic of Germany and German 	Academic Exchange Service (DAAD)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-10
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to establish a 'Sri Lankan studies' Section in the South Asian Institute of the University of  Heidelberg and to appoint  Sri lankan academics to the Section so established. Further, it is proposed to exchange the university lecturers between the Governments of Sri Lanka and Germany, for study and research activities.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Higher Education and Highways, to enter into two (02) Memoranda of Understanding between the Ministry of Higher Education and Highways of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the South Asia Institute affiliated to the Heidelberg University of the Federal Republic of Germany and German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) respectively, during the forthcoming visit of H.E. the President to Germany, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Memorandum of Understanding  between the Ministry of Industry and Commerce of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the German Association for Small and Medium-sized Enterprises of the Federal Republic of Germany for the Co-operation in the field of Small and Medium Enterprise Sector Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-10
decision_details_body: - Small and Medium Enterprise  sector has been identified as an important sector to be developed by the Government of Sri Lanka, taking into consideration the contribution it provides for the economic growth, employment generation and poverty reduction in Sri Lanka.  Having considered its importance to be a driving force for the development, the policy of the government is to facilitate the Small and Medium Enterprise  sector enabling it to access the export market. Accordingly, the Government has got an opportunity to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding for the promotion of the business opportunities and co-operation between the Small and Medium entrepreneurs of the Sri Lanka and Germany. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to sign the proposed  Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Industry and Commerce of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the German Association for Small and Medium-sized Enterprises of the Federal Republic of Germany, during the forthcoming visit of H.E. the President to Germany, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Gampaha, Attanagalla and Minuwangoda Integrated Water 	Supply Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-10
decision_details_body: -*The objective of this project is to provide safe and reliable drinking water to the areas of Gampaha, Attanagalla and Minuwangoda Divisional Secretariat Divisions and a part of the Mirigama Divisional Secretariat  Division. This project would provide drinking water facilities for a population of about 300,000 and enhance the service level of the drinking water facilities already provided for a population of 100,000. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to obtain funds from the China Development Bank for the implementation of this project, covering 85% of its total cost and enter into the relevant agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Colombo Port Expansion Project- Development and 	Operational options to the East Container Terminal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-10
decision_details_body: - The East Container Terminal is the second deep-water terminal of  the Colombo Port Expansion Project. It has been decided to launch the operational activities of this terminal,  as a joint venture with a shipping line or a private terminal operator with 51% of equity owned by Sri Lanka Ports Authority since the plans have been drawn to conduct the operational activities of the terminal with the ownership of Sri Lanka Ports Authority. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Ports and Shipping,  to appoint the Asian Development Bank as the transaction advisor of this project and to call for expressions of interest and business proposals from the parties interested, in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of a portion of land from the Siringapatha Farm 	belonging to the National Livestock Development Board, to the 	MILCO (Pvt) Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-10
decision_details_body: - MILCO (Pvt) Ltd. is the only milk-based food production factory, which holds shares totally owned by the General Treasury. A project is being implemented to establish a milk processing factory equipped with modern facilities at Badalgama area in place of the old factory of that company situated at Narahenpita. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harrison, the Minister of Rural Economy,  to vest a block of land from the Siringapatha farm which belongs to the National Livestock Development Board, in extent of 35 acres, required for the purpose, with the MILCO (Pvt) Ltd.,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of Stores Complex of Marandagahamula to the Paddy 		Marketing Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-10
decision_details_body: - As per a Cabinet decision taken in the year 2014, the stores complex of around 61,000 Square feet, constructed by the Sri Lanka Engineering Corporation, at a cost of Rs.372 million, situated  in the Marandagahamula village of the Divulapitiya Divisional Secretariat Division, and 110 stalls which are being constructed,  have not yet been transferred formally to a specific management authority and those are being presently maintained without a proper management. With a view to facilitating the paddy purchasing programme of the Government, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harrison, the Minister of Rural Economy, to vest the said stores complex constructed by the Government, with the Paddy Marketing Board, to maintain and use the same properly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The State Wesak Festival - 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksha, the Minister of Buddhasasana, to hold the State Wesak festival – 2016, at the premises of Naigala Rajamaha Viharaya, which has a historical and archaeological importance, in the Weeraketiya Divisional Secretariat Division of the District of Hambantota of the Southern Province, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a Mode of Transportation along the Colombo Canal Network as a Tourism Promotional Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-10
decision_details_body: - The Colombo Canal Network of 43 km in length, is presently maintained by the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation. This canal network, which has not been used for a productive purpose for many years, has been identified as suitable, for the transportation of goods and passengers, in order to ease the traffic congestion and also to promote the Tourism industry. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Megapolis and Western Development, to implement  a project for the purpose which includes the introduction of a mode of transportation along the Colombo canals, water related recreational activities along the canals using boats and commercial activities such as Floating Markets along the canals through the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the e-Education Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-10
decision_details_body: - As per the present global trends, computer literacy is an essential factor for the progress of a country and accordingly, Sri Lanka has also introduced various programmes, paying more attention to computer literacy. Further, computer literacy will become a compulsory qualification in entering into the Job Market. The UNIS, which is affiliated to the Tsinghua University of China has submitted a proposal for the implementation of an e-Education project in Sri Lanka, and  it is proposed to provide benefits through this project to those who couldn't enter the universities, the unemployed youth and the employed youth  devoid of computer literacy. Under this programme, e-Education Centres will be established in all nine (09) provinces including the main centre to be established in Colombo. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, the Minister of Science, Technology and Research, to implement this project in collaboration with the relevant Ministries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Regulations on Payment made to the 	Arbitrators and the members of the Industrial Court 	appointed under the 	Industrial 	Dispute Act, for conducting 	Inquiries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-10
decision_details_body: - Having considered the necessity of revising the rates paid to the Arbitrators and the members of the Industrial Court for conducting inquiries, to suit their  professional competency,  the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Senevirathne, the Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations,  to amend the Regulations published in the Gazette Notification (Extraordinary) No. 1542/35 dated 2008-03-28, which are presently in operation in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting the 53rd Conference of the Directors General of Civil 	Aviation of the Asia - Pacific Region in Sri Lanka in August 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-10
decision_details_body: - The Directors General of Civil Aviation who  head the national civil aviation regulatory authorities  of the countries in the Asia – Pacific Region conducts an annual Conference since 1960, with a view to working together on a common platform in respect of the international rules and standards pertaining to the civil aviation service, in order to ensure safety, security, regularity and efficiency of air transportation within their respective states and across borders. This Conference is the most important meeting in the annual Asia – Pacific regional aviation programme of the International Civil Aviation Organization. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala De Silva, the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation,  to hold the 53rd Conference of the Directors General of Civil  Aviation of the Asia - Pacific Region, from the 01st to 05th August, 2016, in Sri Lanka, under the theme of “Fostering safe, secure and efficient aviation system in an eco - friendly environment with no country left behind”, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining loan facilities from the Export Import (EXIM) Bank of India for the implementation of 03 Water Supply Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-03
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance,  to authorize the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, to enter into financial agreements with the EXIM Bank of India, to obtain loan facilities required for the implementation of the following water supply projects, was approved by the Cabinet, taking into consideration the positive socio-economic benefits received by the people living in such areas: 
	
	
*	Aluthgama, Mathugama and Agalawatta Integrated Water Supply Project (US$  164.9 million)

*	Kundasale - Haragama Water Supply Project (US$ 146.31 million)

*	Polgahawela, Pothuhera and Alawwa Integrated Water Supply Project (US$  91.8 million)

description: Construction of Surgical Unit at the Teaching Hospital, Batticaloa and Supply of Medical Equipment to the same
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-03
decision_details_body: - The Teaching Hospital, Batticaloa serves more than two million people living in the Eastern Province as well as the people in the adjoining Districts. 95,959 patients have been admitted to this hospital as indoor patients in the year 2015 and of which 36,463 were surgical patients and  that number amounts to 40% of the patients admitted. The surgeries  performed in this hospital during that year amount to 18,378. However,  the infrastructure facilities available at this hospital for the performance of surgeries have to be improved with modern technological equipment facilities.  As such, with the objective of providing the public a more qualitative health service, the proposal made by Hon. Faizal Cassim, the Acting Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine, to implement the project for constructing a surgical unit consisting of 360 patient beds, 10 surgical intensive care beds and 03 operation theaters at  the Teaching Hospital, Batticaloa and to provide medical equipment to the same, at an estimated cost of Rs. 275 million, under the assistance of Government of India and to sign the related Memorandum of Understanding, between the Governments of Sri Lanka and India, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Tender for the Supply of 700,000 Vials of Biphasic Isophane Insulin Injection BP, 30% / 70% 1000IU / 10ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the Tender for the purchase of the above medicine which is essential for the treatment of diabetic patients, to the Bidder recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, at a price of US$ 1,505,000.00, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Tender for the Supply of 475,000 Vials of Desferrioxamine 	Mesylate for Injection BP, 500 mg
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-03
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine, to award the Tender for the purchase of the above medicine which is essential for the treatment of thalaseemia, to the Bidder recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, at a price of US$ 1,413,125.00, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Framework Arrangement between the Government of  the	Republic of Korea and the Government of the Democratic Socialist	Republic of Sri Lanka, concerning loans from the Economic	Development Cooperation Fund of the EXIM Bank of Korea from	2016-2018
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-03
decision_details_body: - In order to further strengthen the friendship and the economic cooperation between the two countries, the Government of Korea has agreed to grant an aggregate commitment amount in Korean Won not exceeding the equivalent of US$ 300 million to Sri Lanka, from 2016 to 2018, through the Economic Development Cooperation Fund (EDCF) of the Export Import (EXIM) Bank of Korea, to finance the mutually agreed projects by the two Governments.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of  National Policies and Economic Affairs, to enter into a Framework Arrangement  with  the Government of Korea, to obtain the said loan amount, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: UNITERRA Volunteer Co-operation Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-03
decision_details_body: - UNITERRA is a volunteer co-operation and international development programme which is jointly implemented by the World University Service of Canada (WUSE) and the Centre for International Studies and Co-operation (CECI) in Canada. It has been planned to implement this programme in Sri Lanka, during the period of 2016-2020, and the proposed programme will be implemented in relation to the sectors of  Tourism & Hospitality and Apparels. The Government of Canada will spend an amount of Canadian dollars 2.7 million for this programme to be implemented covering about 80,000 beneficiaries, during the period of 2016-2020. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, in his capacity as the Minister of National Policies and Economic Affairs, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of Canada, for the implementation of the above programme in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 4,000 Houses for the Plantation Community in the Uva and Central Provinces, under the Indian Government Grant Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-03
decision_details_body: - As per a Memorandum of Understanding signed by the Governments of Sri Lanka and India in the year 2012, the arrangements have been made to construct 4,000 houses for the plantation community in the Uva and Central Provinces, within the next three years from 2016-2019.  As the first phase of this endeavour, the preliminary activities related to the construction of 1,134 houses have been completed and activities pertaining to the construction of the rest of the 2,866 houses also have been commenced.  Each house is to be constructed in a land area of 7 perches with a floor area of 550 square feet and the total cost to be incurred for a house would be Rs.1,120,000.00.  In selecting beneficiaries  for this purpose, the priority is given to the families who live in landslide affected and landslide prone areas and the families living in the fire affected line-rooms.  Accordingly, in order to proceed with this project, the proposal made by Hon. U. Palani Digambaram, the Minister of Hill Country New Villages, Infrastructure and Community Development, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding which clearly outlines the  responsibilities and the functions of the respective parties, between the Governments of India and Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for Issuing of Internationally recognized 'Continuous  Discharge Certificate' and  'Certificate of Competency' for Sri Lankan Seafarers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-03
decision_details_body: - There is a high demand for Sri Lankan Seafarers, from the  International Shipping Companies, because of their knowledge, skills and positive attitudes.  Sri Lankan Naval Captains, Officers, Marine Engineers and other Technical officers are presently employed in mega ships of  several companies and Sri Lanka derives a considerable amount of foreign exchange on their earnings. It is a legal requirement for the Sri Lankan Seafarers to obtain the 'Continuous Discharge Certificate(CDC)' and 'Certificate of Competency(COC)' issued by the Director General of Merchant Shipping, to engage in their occupations.  In comparison with the certificates issued to their Seafarers by the developed countries, the quality of the certificates issued to the Sri Lankan Seafarers should be further upgraded to be complied with the International Standards. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to implement a project to issue a 'Continuous Discharge Certificate' and a 'Certificate of Competency' which possess recognition at international level, incorporating bio metric information, to the Sri Lankan Seafarers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Strategic Plan to Monitor and Combat Human Trafficking - 2015 - 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2016-02-03
decision_details_body: - 'Human Trafficking' which is often described as 'modern - day slavery' is a heinous crime condemned by the civilized world.
