Considering the importance of the improvement to the railway road section between Mahawa and Vavuniya, with the railway tracks constructed newly beyond Vavuniya under the Northern Railway track development activities carried out recently, the Sri Lanka Railways Department has planned to rehabilitate the said track of 120.7 km (inclusive of the 5 km loop line).  Accordingly, the Mahawa - Vavuniya Railway Track will be developed and the section between the Anuradhapura - Vavuniya (49.4 km) is to be rehabilitated as its First Phase and the section between Mahawa - Anuradhapura (66.4 km) is to be rehabilitated as its Second Phase.  The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Internal Transport, to carry out the rehabilitation activities through procuring track materials including concrete sleepers required for the purpose and the necessary equipments locally, as wherever possible and utilizing the manpower  of the Department, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Diagnostic Medical Imaging Equipment for Epilepsy Unit at the National Hospital of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-08-05
decision_details_body: - As another measure of providing an effective health service to the public, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, to award the relevant contracts, to purchase a MRI Scanner, a SPECT Scanner, a PET-CT Scanner each for the Epilepsy Unit and to install a Digital Subtraction Angiography (DSA) System at the National Hospital and to select relevant companies to maintain the said equipments in  future, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of Intensive Care Unit of Renal Dialysis & Transplant Unit at Maligawatta
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-08-05
decision_details_body: - Renal Dialysis & Transplant Unit at Maligawatta provides an invaluable patient care service to the patients coming from all over the country. The Intensive Care Unit and the Isolation Unit of this hospital are also housed in the residential patients' ward.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, to renovate the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) expeditiously, with a view to minimize the vulnerability of patients, for infections, through the retention of such patients in the ICU after the surgeries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Investigation on Corruptions, Mal-administration and Irregularities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-08-05
decision_details_body:
The proposal made by the Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Internal Transport to consult the Attorney General's Department, to institute legal actions against the responsible institutions and persons, in accordance with the Report pertaining to the following matters submitted by the Special Investigation Committee appointed by the Secretary to the Ministry, on a directive made by the Minister of Internal Transport, to make investigations into corruption, maladministration and irregularities said to have been taken place during the past five year period in the Ministry and its affiliated institutions and to avoid occurrence of such situations in future, was approved by the Cabinet:  

*	Non-recovery of a sum of Rs.142 million for the buses hired by the Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB), for the presidential election-2015.  

*	Non-receipt of the discount offered in procuring 2,200 new buses for the SLTB. 

*	Loosing the anticipated quality and the import duty concessions to the SLTB when purchasing spare parts. 

*	Operation of private buses under SLTB logo. 

*	Operation of 20 luxury buses imported for the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting, by the Road Development Authority. 

*	Issues with regard to enormous cost and the estimates in the construction of the Northern Railway Line. 

*	Submission of estimates with an enormous cost in the construction of the Matara - Kataragama Railway Line. 

*	Vesting and leasing out lands owned by the Railway Department, to the external institutions and persons,  deviating from the formal procedure. 

*	Operation of rail carriages/special trains with private sector participation and loses incurred in the operation of the Vice Roy special train. 

*	Sale of scrap iron deviating from the accepted procedure.

description: ‘Sri Lanka Expo 2016’ to be held from 15th - 17th September, 2016 at the BMICH, Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-08-05
decision_details_body: - Organizing of International Expositions to showcase the country's export capabilities while facilitating Sri Lankan producers, exporters and service providers to meet the prospective international buyers, partners and potential investors is one of the strategic promotional tools. In the back-drop of the special political and economic developments taken place recently in the country, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen,  the Minister of Industry and Commerce to hold the 'Sri Lanka Expo - 2016' from 15th - 17th September 2016 at BMICH, Colombo, enabling concerned parties to obtain valuable business experience with a combination of events such as  expositions, seminars, meetings, programmes conducted simultaneously and visits to factories, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Incorporating the Divi Neguma Social Security Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-08-05
decision_details_body: - The Samurdhi Social Security Fund established under the Samurdhi Programme which commenced with a view to alleviating poverty of the low income earners is implemented with effect from 1st January 1997 and its  objective is to extend financial assistance to Samurdhi beneficiaries beset with unexpected problems during their journey towards economic development. As of now, 1,478,288 families receive monthly Samurdhi subsidy and a contribution of Rs.45/- out of it is debited to this Fund.  Having taken into consideration the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, the Minister of Housing and Samurdhi, to incorporate the said Fund, the approval of the Cabinet was granted to operate the said Fund as a Trust under the Trust Ordinance until it is formally incorporated.

description: Protocol of Phytosanitary Requirements for the Export of Banana from Sri Lanka to China between the General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine of China and the Ministry of Agriculture of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-08-05
decision_details_body: - Banana is being cultivated successfully in Sri Lanka as if suits with the climatic and environmental conditions prevail in the Country and it is a crop which could be used to meet the local food requirements and to generate export income. There is a healthy potential for the exportation of banana to China through developing trade relations with China, a friendly country of Sri Lanka. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to enter into an Agreement with the General Administration on Quality Supervision, Inspection and Plant Quarantine of China, enabling Sri Lanka to export banana to China complying with laws and regulations on phytosanitary requirements and to provide information on banana cultivation lands and localise packing houses, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Plasma from the National Blood Transfusion Service in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-08-05
decision_details_body: - No substitute has yet been found for blood and the blood necessary for transfusion is obtained from the donors.  Although, blood used to be transfused as “whole blood” up to recent times, the situation has now changed. If one unit of blood could be separated accurately as recommended, there is a possibility of deriving up to four components out of it.  As such, a patient can be given only the portion of blood he needs and the balance components can be given to other patients who need them.  The National Blood Transfusion Service (NBTS) collects 100,000 litres of Plasma, annually, from the donors and after the separation of components the NBTS utilizes only around 60,000 units out of them for the clinical use.  Since the facilities are not available with the NBTS to separate a large number of components there is the possibility of providing the balance quantity of 40,000 litres which is currently discarded,  to the companies which possess the technology of producing Plasma Protein.  Although, the situation is such, the Plasma Protein requirement of Sri Lanka is imported from the foreign companies / institutions which produce Plasma Protein incurring a heavy expenditure.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, to give the excess quantity of Plasma for Plasma Protein production, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development Project of National Hospital Health Square – Providing Houses for the unauthorized settlers in Bosevanawatte
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-08-05
decision_details_body: - Cardiology Unit of the Sri Lanka National Hospital provides an invaluable patient care service to the heart patients of the country.  However, the building complex where the Cardiology Unit is housed is very old and the space available in the building is not at all sufficient, in considering the services currently provided by the Unit.  As such, the health staff as well as the patients under go excessive difficulties.  As a remedy, the Cardiology Unit should be extended,  but the prevailing land is inadequate for the purpose.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, to utilize the adjacent land called 'Bosevanawatte' to improve the required facilities of the Cardiology Unit, by providing the unauthorized settlers reside in the said land with the alternative houses from a Multi-storeyed Housing Project is being constructed at another place under the Urban Regeneration Project of  Urban Development Authority, in lieu of the 63 housing units of the said unauthorized settlers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement on Exemption from Visa Requirements for Holders of Diplomatic and Official / Service Passports between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Kazakhstan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-08-05
decision_details_body: - The purpose of entering into this Agreement is to further strengthen the friendly relations between two countries and to simplify the relevant procedures to facilitate the movement of citizens of Sri Lanka and Kazakhstan between the two countries. The permission is granted for the Nationals of States of one Party, holders of valid diplomatic or service/official passports to enter, leave and transit through the territory of the  State of the other Party without obtaining visas for a period of thirty (30) days, through this Agreement. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Public Order and Christian Affairs, to enter into the above Agreement between Sri Lanka and Kazakhstan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Archaeological Heritage Management in the Rajagala Archaeological Reserve
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-08-05
decision_details_body:
- Rajagalatenna Ancient Ariyakara Viharaya situated in the Uhana Divisional Secretariat Division of the Ampara District of the Eastern Province is considered to be established by the King Lajjitissa.  The ruins of this monastery which is believed to be a combination of a Pabbatha Vihara and a forest monastery type are scattered in an area of 1,025 acres.  The ashes of the great Arahath Mahinda is said to be interred in a Stupa found in the premises. The Rajagala Archaeological Project is being carried out as a joint project of the Department of Archaeology and the University of Sri Jayawardenapura since 2012, to arrest the deterioration process of the archeological remains in this monastery and to conserve them in order to secure them sustainably in the future and for the developemnt of the Heritage Tourism Programme. 

	The total estimated cost of this project is Rs.323.8 million and the sum spent on the project  up to the end of 2014 amounts to Rs.55.5 million including the funds provided for by the American Embassy Fund and the University of Sri Jayawardenapura. The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister and the Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs, to obtain a sum of Rs. 268.3 million required for the completion of these project, from the Government Consolidated Fund,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishement of a Wastewater Management System for the Negombo town area
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-08-05
decision_details_body:
- As far as Sri Lanka wastewater management sector is concerned, only 2.4% of the Sri Lankan population is connected to a collective wastewater management system and the vast majority of the population uses individual sanitation systems.  In reality, most of the existing collective systems are out dated and poorly maintained.  This has decreased their efficient functioning. Therefore, under treated wastewater is discharged into drainage channels and this has brought adverse consequences for both the public health and the environment. Considering the prevailing situation, the 'Sanitation and  Hygiene Initiative for Towns' (SHIFT) Project has been initiated to establish three collective wastewater management systems for Negombo, Galle and Kelaniya - Peliyagoda areas.  

	Under first phase of this project, it is expected to establish a wastewater management system for the Negombo Urban Area at a cost of Euro 107 million and the Agence Francaise De Development (AFD) has agreed to provide a financial facility of Euro 76 million for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs, to enter into an agreement with AFD of France, for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resettlement of Families affected due to acquiring of lands for Moragahakanda - Kaluganga Agricultural Development Project - the increase of families due to the delay of the project - Revision of benefits including approval of alternative proposals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-08-05
decision_details_body:
Moragahakanda - Kaluganga Agricultural Development Project was commenced in 2008 and it has been identified that the 1,747 families of 12 Grama Niladari Divisions in Naula Divisional Secretary's Division and 907 families of 11 Grama Niladari Divisions in Laggala Pallegama Divisional Secretary's Division will be affected in the implementation of the said project. However, the following issues have arisen due to the delay in the implementation of the project by 8 years:   

*	Since the new marriages have taken place within the families to be affected, another 224 families have been added to the earlier number, as families to be affected. 

*	reluctance of the newly added families, to leave the area 	and settle down in Medirigiriya. 

*	the expression of unwillingness by 345 families which consented to settle down in Medirigiriya in the year 2007 to go and live in the said area.  

*	the alternative lands have to be provided with the newly added families who have expressed their unwillingness to settle down in Medirigiriya area. 

The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripla Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment,  to acquire the lands identified to be given to the famiies to be added under above project belonging to the Government Owned Plantation Companies situated in the relevant area and suburbs, to pay compensation for the lands owned by such families and to provide assistance for building houses in alternative lands, as a remedy to solve the above issues, was approved by the Cabinet.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29

description: Printing of School Textbooks required for the year 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - The main task of the Department of Educational Publications is to print  and duly distribute the textbooks required by all the school students and the student monks in Pirivenas, through out the Island, free of charge. Accordingly, the Cabinet has already been granted the approval to get it printed 13,210,600 copies of 80 types out of 410 books from the State Printing Corporation, Department of Government Printing and Associated Newspapers of Ceylon Limited, and the relevant printing orders have already been referred to the said Institutions. A further 30,862,500 copies of textbooks from 330 categories have to be printed during this year through the Private Printing Institutions. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to get 30,862,500 copies of textbooks from 330 categories printed from 19 printing institutions of private sector, to enable the textbooks prescribed for the year 2016 to be distributed in schools before 2015?12?03, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Laggala and Wilgamuwa Water Supply Projects with funding secured from Local Banks with a Treasury Guarantee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - Laggala and Wilgamuwa Water Supply Projects implemented by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, under the supervision of the Ministry of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, are expected to be completed by the year 2017. The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs, to authorize the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, to secure the funds required for the implementation of the said two projects from the local banks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Apparel and Allied Industries in Welioya and Musali Divisional Secretariat Divisions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body:
- Cabinet approval has already been granted to establish Apparel and Allied Industries to elevate the income level and the living conditions of the unemployed and resettled people living in the Welioya and Musali Divisional Secretarys' Divisions. Although, the construction of  factories should be carried out through utilizing the funds of the investors, as per the said approval, it has not been able to achieve the task successfully as the investors are  reluctant to invest on such buildings, since these areas are situated in the remote districts such as Mullativu and Mannar.  
According to a survey conducted, it has been revealed that over 2,500 workers in these two divisions are willing to employ in apparel industry, out of them 500 are skilled workers with experience in the field. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to construct three factories each on the lands identified in the Welioya and Musali Divisional Secretary Divisions, by the Government and to recover the expenditure incurred on factories from the investors as long term lease rental, based on the Government valuation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new building to the Attorney General’s Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: -Due to the inadequate space available in the present building, where the Attorney General's Department is housed, the construction work has been commenced to construct a seven storeyed new building for the Department, in the premises of the Superior Court Complex. The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to award the contract for the pilling work of the building, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of  Clinical Waste Management Systems for the hospitals in Sri Lanka, under the Australian Assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - Lack of a proper management methodology for the disposal of clinical waste with infectious materials, without causing adverse effects to public health  is a serious problem faced by the hospitals in Sri Lanka. As such, the previous Cabinet has granted its approval for a proposal made voluntarily, to establish a formal clinical waste management system for the Government hospitals, under the Australian loan assistance. As per the recommendations made by the Committee appointed to review and report the project proposal, and by the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Economic Affairs, and taking into consideration the importance of such a project, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, to implement the above project, subject to making changes to the scope of the project as appropriate,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the remaining work of the New Baby Unit of the De Soyza Hospital for Women
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - De Soyza Hospital for Women situated in Kinsey Road, Colombo functions under the Ministry of Health provides an invaluable service to the pregnant mothers afflicted with complications, who come from various parts of the country. The buildings in which the hospital is housed are very old and inadequate space is a constraint to provide a quality service. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, to entrust the work relating to the completion of the construction of the new Baby Unit which includes the Premature Baby Care Unit expeditiously, with the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, on the design and build basis, at a cost of Rs.325.4 million, where the construction work has now been stopped owing to the negligence of the contractor who had started the construction work ten years ago, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 13. Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Programme has been implemented under the loan assistance of the Asian Development Bank obtained in the year 2014 and the medium voltage network efficiency improvement is being carried out under package 3 of this project. The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawake, the Minister of Power and Energy, to award the contract for the procurement of necessary machinery for the purpose, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation  of   Local  Banks  funded  Water  Supply  Projects  -    Galagedara  and  Mawathagama  Water  Supply  Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - The contractor had agreed to offer a lump sum discount of Rs.21 million, at the negotiation conducted between the relevant contractor and the Review Committee appointed by the Ministry, to review the contract sum of the above project that has been already awarded. The approval of the Cabinet Sub?Committee on Economic Affairs has also been received for this project  and as such, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to proceed with the activities of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Holding of the 34th Session of the Asia-Pacific Fishery Commission (APFIC) and the 06th APFIC Regional Consultative Forum in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - Asia-Pacific Fisheries Commission (APFIC) is a regional fisheries body established under the Food and Agricultural Organization (FAO) of the United Nations, to promote the comprehensive and proper utilization of aquatic resources in the Asia-Pacific region through the development and management strategies and by improving fishing related processing and marketing activities in conformity with the objectives of its member countries. The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to hold the 6th Regional Consultative Forum of the above Commission from 8th to 11th February 2016 and its 34th Session from 12th to 14th February 2016 in Sri Lanka and to provide host facilities by the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of ILO Protocol to the Conventions and Recommendations to the Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is a member country of the International Labour Organization (ILO). Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinna, the Minister of Labour, to present the Protocol to  Convention 29, that is the ILO Protocol to the Convention on Forced Labour, and the Recommendation 203, that is the recommendation on supplementary measures for the effective suppression of forced labour, which was adopted in the 103rd Secession of the International Labour Conference held in 2014, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Domestic Power Supply for resettled families in the North and East, free of charge
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - The necessary actions have been taken by the Government continuously to resettle all the families in the Northern and Eastern Provinces displaced due to conflict situation. At present, 232,828 families have been resettled and the number of members belonging to such families are 796,342. Providing those families with electricity, water and sanitary facilities is a responsibility of the Government. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Power and Energy and Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Resettlement, Reconstruction and Hindu Religious Affairs, to obtain an additional allocation of Rs.105 million to provide domestic power supply connections with the 5,000 families resettled in the year 2015, and for providing of electricity supply for 20,000 families resettled in the Northern Province, free of charge, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining approval for additional allocations during the year 2015, in order to settle payments under 24 Road Projects which are being financed by the National Savings Bank under which Rs. 28.0 billion out of the loan proceeds has been used by the Road Development Authority for the payment of activities outside the scope of loans
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - The Road Development Authority (RDA) has been implementing a programme to rehabilitate 28 identified road projects in various parts of the country through local contractors making use of the loan facility of Rs.54.70 billion provided by the National Savings Bank. A sum of Rs.28 billion  obtained under the said programme has been used for the purposes outside the activities of the relevant road rehabilitation projects and as such the RDA has been conducting  an internal investigation into the matter, and it has also made a complaint to the Financial Crimes Investigation Division. Since the funds obtained for the intended purpose from the National Savings Bank has been used for other activities, the relevant road rehabilitation projects have come to a standstill and therefore, the joint proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunayake, the Minister of Finance and Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways and Investment Promotion, to obtain necessary funds from the General Treasury to settle the outstanding bills related to the said projects and to resume the work of the said projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Standardization for Fertilizers imported outside the Fertilizer Recommendations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - The Department of Agriculture has declared the recommended quantity of fertilizer for each food crop taking into consideration the factors such as  type of crop, soil condition and climatic zones. However, the farmers engaged in commercial farming tend to apply chemical fertilizer in excessive quantities with a view to achieving higher economic gains. Due to reasons such as the usage of chemical fertilizer exceeding the recommended quantity / dosage and applying substandard fertilizer, the healthiness of the agricultural products is under threat and thereby causing adverse affects to the health of the consumers. Although the unmixed fertilizer has to be applied on crops after mixing it with the recommended proportions, the farmers are used to apply fertilizer excessive of the recommended dosages on the crops, for their convenience and also depending on the commercials. Over 100 types of diverse chemical fertilizers manufactured in various countries and with different qualities are now available in the local market and as such the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to take necessary action to declare a standard for such fertilizer with the consent of the fertilizer importers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Broadlands Hydro Power Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - The Broadlands Hydro Power Plant is being built in Kitulgala area situated in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Ambagamuwa Korale and Yatiyantota, and the expected capacity from the plant is 35 MW. This Hydro Power Plant is a significant milestone in the generation of renewable energy in Sri Lanka and it is one of the few medium scale Hydro Power Plants built in the Country. The financial facilities required for the constructions of this Plant has been secured from the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) and the insurance cover for that facility has been provided by the China Export and Credit Insurance Corporation (SINOSURE). The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Power and Energy, to accept the said insurance institution as a combined lender of this loan facility, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Greater Polonnaruwa Town Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - The Polonnaruwa town and its urban centres, namely, Polonnaruwa, Kaduruwela and the New Town are being developed rapidly as the Heritage City, the Commercial City and the Administrative City respectively. It has been observed that this town is catering for over 80,000 people daily and this number is increasing rapidly. The Urban Development Authority has proposed to implement a number of town development projects in line with the Town Development Plan prepared to develop Polonnaruwa Town as a Metro city, overcoming the issues such as traffic congestion, vehicle parking issue and environmental hazards.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to implement the Greater Polonnaruwa Town Development Project on a priority basis, which comprises of number of projects related to fields such as Commercial Development, Heritage Conservation, Tourism Promotion, Environmental Development and  Landscaping, at an estimated cost of Rs.16,650 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Local  Banks  Funded   Water  Supply  Projects for Towns  East  of  Colombo  –  Package II and  III
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to proceed with the implementation of the Packages II and III of the Towns East of Colombo Water Supply Project utilizing the funds secured from local banks, under the implementation of priority water supply projects funded by local banks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Holding of the Commonwealth Heads of Valuation Agencies Conference in Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - Commonwealth Heads of Valuation Agencies Conference (CHOVA) is held annually with the objective of providing opportunities to share a wide range of knowledge and views on utilization, rights, development and valuation of the properties among the member countries. The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to make necessary arrangements to hold the said Conference this time in Colombo in the month of October this year, with the participation of around 100 delegates from Commonwealth countries, was approved by the Cabinet.
