description: Renovation of Places of Worship damaged due to the earthquake occurred in Nepal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-29
decision_details_body: - In terms of the approval granted by the Cabinet, the Ananda Kuti Buddhist Temple in Swayabunath and the Rathomachindranath Hindu Kovil in Lalitpur which were damaged by the disastrous earthquake which occurred in Nepal recently, have been selected for renovation. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Karu Jayasuriya, the Minister of Buddha Sasana, to send a group comprising of relevant officers and technicians to Nepal for the designing of the said renovations, to assign the construction work to the Sri Lanka Army and to allocate a sum of Rs.345 million to the Ministry of Buddha Sasana for the said renovation work, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Installation of a Container Scanning System for Sri Lanka Customs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-22
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka Customs releases about 1,100 import containers per day and  only about 10% to 15% of such containers, randomly selected, are subjected to X-ray scanning by the department owned scanners. These scanners are about 08 years old and undergo frequent repairs. When the Interim Budget-2015, was presented by the Hon. Minister of Finance, it was proposed to establish a Container Scanning System with modern technology, with the view to enhancing the efficiency and productivity of the Sri Lanka Customs. Accordingly, having taken into consideration the  human resources required for the purpose, the cost involved for the equipment and their maintenance, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to establish a modern Container Scanning System for the Sri Lanka Customs, with the participation of public and private sectors,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer for the Year 2015 (August / Mid-September Delivery)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-22
decision_details_body: - The supply of fertilizer to farmers at concessionary prices through the fertilizer subsidy programme is carried out by the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited (Lak Pohora) and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Limited (Commercial Fertilizer), under the purview of the Ministry of Agriculture. Also taking into consideration that no appeals have been received with regard to the award of the tender, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture,  to award the contract for the supply of fertilizer for distribution in August/mid-September 2015, as recommended by the Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SSCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquiring of Land for the Construction of the Proposed Hospital Complex for Kidney patients at Polonnaruwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-22
decision_details_body:
- The North Central Province of Sri Lanka is one of areas where the Chronic Kidney Disease (CKDu) is highly prevalent. According to recent statistics, nearly 2,500 kidney patients are registered in the renal clinic of the General Hospital in Polonnaruwa district, alone. In terms of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed in 2015 between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the People's Republic of China, the Government  of China has agreed to construct a fully equipped hospital complex at the Polonnaruwa General Hospital, to treat kidney diseases, at a cost of of RMB 600 million (approximately Rs.12,840 million).   

	However, since the land space available at the District General Hospital, Polonnaruwa is inadequate for this purpose, the joint proposal submitted by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine and Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to acquire a land adjoining the District Hospital, in extent of 7.27 hectares, presently occupied by the Polonnaruwa Fresh Water Fish Breeding Centre and the District Aquaculture Extension Office, for the purpose of establishing the proposed Nephrology complex and to relocate the Fish Breeding Centre at another suitable place, without decreasing its current facilities and capacity, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Central Expressway
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-22
decision_details_body: - The road from Kadawatha to Meerigama is scheduled to be constructed as the first section of the Central Expressway. The section from Kossinna to Meerigama, of approximately 5km in length, will be constructed from the funds saved after discussions held with contractor of the third section of the outer circular road, and the relevant contractor has already commenced the preliminary work. As per the decision made by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Matters, on the recommendation of the Negotiation Committees appointed by the Ministry of Finance, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to award the contract for the construction of section from Kossinna to Meerigama, of 32.55km in length, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Emergency and Accident Centre at the Teaching Hospital, Batticaloa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-22
decision_details_body: - This project, implemented under the funds provided by the Government of Sri Lanka and the 'Foundation Supporting a National Trauma Service in Sri Lanka', in the State of Victoria, Australia will establish a three storeyed Emergency and Accident Trauma Complex with with 100 bed facilities, 06 Operating Theaters and Intensive Care Units in the premises of Batticaloa Hospital to address the increasing demand of emergency accident services in Eastern Province, and thereby it is expected to enhance the quality and capacity of the said Teaching Hospital. Considering the urgent need to implement this project, the proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, to award the construction contract of the same to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), at an estimated cost of Rs.807 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Local Bank funded Water Supply Projects - Medirigiriya Water Supply Project - Phase - II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-22
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted approval for the implementation of the above project and accordingly, the National Water Supply and Drainage Board has entered into agreements with the relevant contractor. The project envisages providing 15,000 new water connections which will contribute to achieving the Government's target of providing 400,000 new water connections in the near future. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to obtain the funds required for the implementation of the Medirigiriya Water Supply Project-Phase II, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Two-Storeyed Hostel for the National Institute of Language Education and Training (NILET)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-22
decision_details_body: - The National Institute of Language Education and Training (NILET), established by the Act No.26 of 2007,  is located at Agalawatta in the Kalutara District, with the mandate of enhancing bilingual and trilingual skills of public officers, teachers and persons who are interested in learning languages, in order to implement the Official Languages Policy efficiently. It conducts training programmes to produce teachers skilled in teaching Sinhala, Tamil and English languages, to train translators and interpreters, to provide language training to public officers, and for government approved language training courses. Although requests have been made to conduct the Residential Training Programme for Proficiency in the Second Official Language implemented at present for medical officers who have completed their internship, for the officers of the other All Island Services,   nursing officers and officers from the defence forces as well, the limited availability of residential facilities poses a constraint to the increase of residential training opportunities. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Karu Jayasuriya, the Minister of Public Administration, Local Government and Democratic Governance, to construct a hostel which would provide residential facilities for 90 persons more, in addition to the available hostel facilities, at the premises of the NILET at Agalawatta, at a cost of Rs.98.8 million,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expenditure incurred by the institutions under the Ministry of 	Internal Transport during the last Presidential Election period, on 	unofficial external matters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-22

description: Construction of a Dockyard at Hambantota Port
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-22
decision_details_body: - The information submitted by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, with regard to the steps taken to explore the possibility of constructing a Dockyard at the Port of Hambantota and prepare relevant comprehensive plans and feasibility reports for the purpose, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: New Prison Administration Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-22
decision_details_body: - The Prison Ordinance in force at present is a legislation that had been enacted in the year 1877 and the necessity of revising the provisions pertaining to prison administration therein, so as to suit the present day requirements, has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to prepare a new Prison Administration Draft Bill, as per the recommendations made by an Experts Committee under the Chairmanship of the former Judge of the Supreme Court, Justice Hector Yapa, appointed to study the best practices prevailing under  international standards in this regard and submit recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Outer Circular Highway Project – Obtaining Consultancy Services for the Construction Supervision of Civil Works of the Section ii of the Northern Section from Kerawalapitiya to Kadawatha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-22
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways and Investment Promotion, to issue a Treasury Guarantee to the Bank of Ceylon, on behalf of the Road Development Authority, in respect of financing the cost of consultancy services contract for the supervision of the construction of Segment II of Northern Section of the Outer Circular Highway from Kerawalapitiya to Kadawatha, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy and Strategy on the Health of Young Persons
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-22
decision_details_body: - During the past few decades, various measures have been taken to improve the health conditions of the youth of Sri Lanka and through certain International Conventions and locally enacted legislation,  the necessity of promoting the health conditions of children and youth has been emphasized. At present, nearly 25% of the population is represented by the youth and due to the physical and mental changes that take palace during this age period, some times they tend to get themselves involved in risky tasks. This creates a great impact on the country's economic and health sectors and providing the youth with health services such as adequate counseling services, nutrition programmes and awareness on reproductive health would prevent that by generating a healthy young and adult population in the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, for the implementation of the National Policy and Strategies on the Health of Young Persons, which is directly related to the Maternal and Child Policy, the National Nutrition Policy, the Population and Reproductive Health Policy, National HIV/AIDS Prevention Policy and the Prevention of Non‑Communicable Diseases Policy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a plot of land from the Government owned Gm/ Katana/ Kaludiyawalawatta for the Department of Immigration and Emigration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-22
decision_details_body: - Recently, there is a significant increase in the arrival of foreigners to Sri Lanka. There is a tendency that some of such foreigners continue to stay in the country even after the expiry of their visa. Through the networking of administrative work in outstations, currently implemented by the Department of Immigration and Emigration, it has become possible to identify the said overstaying foreigners within a short period of time, and the Department is vested with the responsibility of providing the necessary facilities to detain such persons, until necessary action is taken to deport them from the country. Since it would be more productive to  utilize a location close to the Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake, where the activities pertaining to immigration and emigration of foreigners mainly take place, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Public Order and Christian Affairs, to transfer an extent of 100 perches of land from the Kaludiyawalawatta land, Katana, Gampaha which has been vested with the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority for the establishment of a Tourism Centre, to the Department of Immigration and Emigration, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer for the Year 2015 - (September Delivery)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - Supply of fertilizer to farmers at a subsidized price under the fertilizer subsidy programme is handled by the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited and the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Limited,  under the purview of the Ministry of Agriculture.  The proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Minister of Agriculture, to award the  contract for the supply of fertilizer for distribution during the month of September 2015, as per the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Special  Procurement Committee and of the Procurement Appeal Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restructuring of Lanka Sathosa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - Lanka Sathosa has been underperforming over a period of time.  The operational lapses and the shortcomings in the financial management are the main causes adduced for this difficult situation.  Lanka Sathosa incurred a loss of around Rs.5.1 billion during the latter part of the year 2014, due to import of rice in large scale at high cost and selling them at a low price, and due to provision of essential food items at a low price. The government's prime attention has been focused towards the restructuring of Sathosa, taking into consideration the unhealthy financial difficulties currently encountered by Sathosa on one hand and on the other side the task performed by Sathosa, to control the price escalations of essential commodities, while competing with the private sector. The joint proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance and Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and  Commerce, to settle the loan balance of Rs. 9.9 billion due to state banks, which was obtained to import rice, through selling surplus stocks of rice found in Sathosa stores at the current market price, following the open tender procedure and to implement the proposals on restructuring of Sathosa through issuing a Letter of Comfort to a state bank, by the Treasury, to obtain a loan of Rs.4.0 billion, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: To launch the National Policy on Drug Prevention and Action Plan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - It has been revealed through the surveys conducted, that the 1/3 of the income of the low income families of Sri Lanka is being spent for tobacco and alcohol, and over 22% of the expenditure by the Government on free health service is incurred in respect of the ailing persons due to the consumption of tobacco and alcohol. With a view to improving the health and well being of the Sri Lankans, a programme to gradually reduce the use of tobacco, alcohol and illicit drugs is being implemented by the Presidential Task Force on Drug Prevention, and as such the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to declare 9th July to 8th August, 2015 as the 'National Drug Prevention Month', to draw the public attention to this programme, and to launch the National Policy on Drug Prevention and the Action Plan, and to implement this programme with the cooperation of all Ministries, Departments  and the Semi?Government Institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Central Expressway
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08

description: Charter of Two Harbour Tugs for the Sri Lanka Ports Authority  for the operations at the Port of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - With the development of the shipping field, large container vessels arrive at the Port of Colombo and therefore it is necessary to provide an efficient tug service to such vessels, by the Sri Lanka Ports Authority (SLPA).  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to call for proposals to charter two harbour tugs to the SLPA on rental basis, and to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee to appraise successful proposals and make recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Call for Expressions of Interest for a Joint Venture Ro-Ro Operation of the phase-I of the Multipurpose Terminal at Hambantota Port
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - Ships can reach East African Countries and the Western Australia directly from Hambantota Port which lies almost in the middle of the maritime course between the Singapore and Dubai, the two main vehicle transhipment hubs presently function close to Sri Lanka.  Therefore, taking into consideration the potentiality of improving Hambantota Port as a centre for reshipment, if the operations and management activities carried out after arranging the identified anchors in an appropriate manner, as to attract the vehicle manufacturers who tranship their vehicles, as such, the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to call for 'Expressions of Interest' and business proposals from the parties interested in carrying out operations of the Phase-I of the Multipurpose Terminal at Hambantota Port as a joint venture with a Ro-Ro vessel / terminal operator, and to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee to determine successful proposals and make recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the East Container Terminal and Operational Options
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Ports Authority (SLPA) has planned to enhance the container handling volume of the Colombo Port through the implementation of Colombo Ports Expansion Project and thereby to sustain a competitive advantage over the ports in the region. The civil constructions of  the quay wall which is of 450 meters in length and the required yard facilities are nearing completion.  The proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to call 'Expressions of Interest' and business proposals (RFP) from the parties interested in carrying out operations as a joint venture with a private terminal operator or with a Shipping Company which the SLPA holds 51% of its ownership, after conducting a proper feasibility study and to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee to determine successful proposals and make recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Development and Production of the Natural Gas Deposits  presently discovered in the Mannar Basin
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Power and Energy, to select a suitable investor, for the commercial level development and production of the presently found natural gas deposits in the exploration block SL 2007-01-001 in the Mannar basin, following international competitive bidding, and to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiation Committee to assist in this task, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the Construction work of the National Measurement Laboratory and the Installation of High Precision Air Conditioning System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - In order to maintain the National Measurement System accurately and to have the international recognition for the same, a Laboratory was designed in compliance with the international criteria and the construction works of that Laboratory have commenced in 2009 and the constructions are being carried out in Pitipana area in Homagama. The said constructions are to be completed soon. Taking into consideration the escalation of prices, the proposal made by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Food Security, to revise the total cost of this project from Rs.1,950 million to Rs. 2,433 million and to award the contract for the installation of High Precision Air Conditioning System in the Laboratory, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Incorporation of Sri Lanka Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Association
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - The existence of a focal organization in the country to collect all the important research and development information and data related to the fisheries and aquatic resources sector and to utilise these for the development of the country has been a long felt need, and as a solution to this, action is being taken to establish the Sri Lanka Fisheries and the Aquatic Resources Association comprising of academics from universities and higher education institutions and the researchers of the government and non?governmental institutions interested in the fisheries sector.  In order to form a more constructive base for the development of the fisheries sector in the country, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to incorporate the Sri Lanka Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Association, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The marking of the National Safety Day - 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - The National Safety Day falls on 26th December  every year.  The proposal made by Hon. A.H.M. Fowzie, the Minister of Disaster Management, to conduct the national programme to mark the National Safety Day of this year, in Polonnaruwa district, under the main theme of 'A safe Sri Lanka' and the sub-theme of 'let us unite to eliminate disasters', and  to implement a series of  island?wide programmes simultaneously in collaboration with the other Ministries and Departments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Electrification of the Urban Railway Network
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - The joint proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of  Internal Transport and Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Power and Energy, to grant policy priority for the electrification of Colombo Urban Railway Service, with a medium term objective of establishing an efficient railway service which suits the contemporary global standards, to conduct a comprehensive feasibility study pertaining to the electrification of railway system between Panadura and Veyangoda based on the preliminary feasibility study conducted jointly by the Sri Lanka Institute of Engineers, Ceylon Electricity Board and the Department of Sri Lanka Railways, to determine the Railway electrification strategies and projects within the recommended policy framework based on the said study reports and also to implement the said proposals with a maximum capital productivity and avoiding corruption and waste, following a transparent and competitive methodology, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting the land of the National Library and Documentation Services Board with the same institution as a free grant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - The prime objectives of the National Library and Documentation Services Board are to safeguard the intellectual legacies of the nation by establishing the National Library of Sri Lanka, to encourage the use of information and communication technology, to encourage the book publications and promotion of reading, in order to create an informed society.  Currently, the Board functions at the premises of No.14, Independence Avenue, Colombo 07 and the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to vest the land in extend of 01 hectare situated at the above address in which this building is located, with the National Library and Documentation Services Board, free of charge, in lieu of the lease arrangement that existed to date, to carry out its non-profitable activities more successfully, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Loans obtained for the Development Projects of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet noted that the total credit due by the Sri Lanka Ports Authority (SLPA) to date amounts to Rs.215 billion, on the information submitted by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, as per the  instructions he had received to submit particulars of the loans obtained by the SLPA for its development projects.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Iraq for the Cooperation in the field of Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - With a view to strengthening and enhancing the cooperation in the field of tourism between the two countries and having recognized the tourism field as an important field for strengthening mutual understanding, developing goodwill and generating relationships between the people of the two countries,	the proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Tourism and Sports, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Iraq,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a State of the Art Cancer Hospital at the National Cancer Institute, Maharagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - The National Cancer Institute at Maharagama is the main centre that provides cancer treatment services in Sri Lanka. A project to convert the National Cancer Institute in Maharagama into 'a state of the art cancer hospital', in order to cater to the increasing demand of the cancer care services of that Institute is already in progress, with an initial contribution of Rs.850 million and a subsequent contribution of Rs.380 million received from the Ahamed Tea Company in London, and in the meantime it is proposed to construct a Bone Marrow Testing Unit with a Theatre, to generate additional facilities in the Chemotherapy Unit and to provide the essential equipment including Bone Marrow transplanting facilities. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr) Rajitha Senaratne, Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, to bear the balance amount of Rs.233 million required for the purpose, by the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing the General Hospital, Kalutara with the Specialized Maternal and Childcare Facilities under Netherlands Assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration that the enhanced health service facilities can be provided to the people of Matugama, Agalawatta, Dodangoda, Ingiriya, Bulathsinhala, Horana, Beruwala and Balapitiya who possess less health facilities and obtain the services from General Hospital, Kalutara, through improving that hospital, as a specialized maternal and child healthcare hospital, as such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, to construct a specialized Maternal and Child Healthcare Centre in the General Hospital, Kalutara, under the Netherlands assistance amounts to Euro28,782,948.30, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Greater Colombo Water and Waste Water Management Improvement Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has already granted its approval for the implementation of Segments I and II of the Greater Colombo Water and Waste Water Management Improvement Investment Programme.  The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to obtain additional funds amount to US$ 35 million from the Asian Development Bank (ADB), required for the implementation of the next stage of this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Implementation of 22 Water Supply Projects for the expansion of the pipe-born water supply service coverage by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) on a priority basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approval has already been granted for the implementation of  22 water supply projects for the expansion of  pipe-born water supply service on a priority basis, with the funds secured from the local banks.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to issue a Treasury Guarantee in respect of obtaining a loan facility of a sum of Rs.3,499 million from the Bank of Ceylon, by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB), for the implementation of said 22 water supply projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kalutara Town Centre Improvement Project and Development of the Kalido Beach
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - The joint proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage and Hon. Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Tourism and Sports, to vest a plot of land in extent of 20 hectares with the Urban Development Authority and with the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority, for the development of the urban, tourist and recreational facilities in the Kalutara Town and Kalido Beach, and also to improve the facilities of the pilgrims, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing the Ceiling of the Revolving Credit Facilities provided by the State Banks for Payment of the Gratuity of Retiring Public Employees
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - Approximately 25,000 employees retire from Public Service annually and the payment of pension gratuity through state banks was introduced to pay their gratuity as soon as possible. Currently, the said process works efficiently and productively. As such, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to grant authority to the General Treasury to increase the ceiling of the revolving credit facilities given to the Director General of Pensions,  by the Bank of Ceylon, Peoples' Bank and the National Savings Bank, whenever necessary, based on the necessity of providing services, with a view to continuing the said activity uninterruptedly in future too, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Drafting of a new Bill amalgamating the Rabies Ordinance and the Dog Registration Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the proposals made with regard to the revision of the Rabies Ordinance and the Dog Registration Ordinance, under the programme of updating the legislation related to the Local Government sector, to suit with the present needs of the country, the Cabinet appointed an Officials' Committee to explore the possibility of consolidation of the said two (02) Ordinances.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Karu Jayasuriya, the Minister of Public Administration, Local Government and Democratic Governance, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Bill consolidating the Rabies Ordinance No.07 of 1893 and   the Dog Registration Ordinance No.25 of 1901, as recommended by the above Committee, to enable the successful implementation of the functions entrusted in two Ordinances under one single Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of the Total Estimated Cost of the Construction of the Police Stations of Jaffna and Point Pedro
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-07-08
decision_details_body: - One of the steps taken to further strengthen the civil administration established after the end of the conflict situation is enhancement of the Police Stations and the Government Institutions in the Northern Province.  Accordingly, the approval of the Cabinet, for the construction of the Police Stations in Jaffna and Point Pedro has already been granted and as such, it has become necessary to increase the total estimated cost related to the construction of these  police stations.  Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Public Order and Christian Affairs, to revise the total estimated cost related to the construction of the Police Station in Jaffna from Rs.294.8 million to Rs.484.1 million and the total cost estimate related to the construction of the Police Station in Point Pedro from Rs.119 million to Rs.176 million, and to complete the balance work of said projects expeditiously, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the Gazette Notification issued for banning of  Import and Use of Glyphosate Herbicide, in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - As per the decision taken at the Cabinet Meeting held on 2015?05?27, the Import and Export Control Department has issued  the Gazette (Extraordinary) Notification, No.1918/22 of 2015?06?11, to ban the import of Glyphosate Herbicide. The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to present the said  Gazette Notification in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Report of the Ministry of Finance - 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to present the Report that should be issued to the Parliament and to the public, evaluating the final Budget Situation Report,  updated information on the Government's fiscal position pertaining to the financial year - 2014 and the execution of the fiscal strategy of the Government, in terms of the provisions of Section 13 of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act No.3 of 2003, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Greater Matale Water Supply Project and Kandy North Pathadumbara Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to arrange required funds after conducting negotiations with the relevant banks, to proceed with the implementation of the above two projects, with a view to improving the drinking water supply coverage in Matale and Kandy towns and the suburban areas, to install new water treatment plants and also to improve the other infrastructure facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Design and Build Contract for the development of Right Bank of the Kelani River - Stage II (KRB II)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - It is expected to supply pipe borne water to the areas not yet covered  in Kelaniya, Kadawatha, Wattala, Peliyagoda, Mahara, Ragama, Biyagama, Welisara, Kandana, Ja-Ela and Ekala areas, and to improve the existing water supply facilities through the above proposed Water Treatment Plant with a capacity of 180,000 cubic meters per day. The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to award the contract for the implementation of the proposed project, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Kattankudy Wastewater Disposal Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to arrange funds from local and foreign sources, to proceed with the implementation of the above project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Houses for the resettlement of the families  displaced due to the landslide disaster in Koslanda, Meeriyabedda area on 29?10?2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - Due to above disaster, 34 individuals of the Meeriyabedda Village in Koslanda have died and 330 individuals of 57 families were victimized. Hon. A.H.M. Fowzie, the Minister of Disaster Management informed the Cabinet that the action has been taken to complete the construction activities of the houses by the 15th of October 2015, in accordance with the instructions given by H.E. the President, to accelerate the construction of houses for those displaced.

description: Implementation of a Health Insurance Scheme for the Judges
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to grant a health insurance cover of Rs.500,000.00 to all Judges of the Courts, subject to outdoor treatments of Rs.35,000.00, and to bear 75% of its subscription by the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The renovation of the seven storeyed building of the District General Hospital,  Negombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - District General Hospital, Negombo falls under the administration of the Provincial Ministry of Health, Western Province. Annually, it caters to around 360,000 outdoor patients and around 100,000 indoor patients of the Western and the North Western Provinces. The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, to carry out the renovation activities of the seven storeyed building of this hospital as recommended by the University of Moratuwa and the Atomic Energy Authority, to provide facilities to continue the services of the hospital in other suitable nearby buildings found in Negombo and the temporary buildings found at the hospital premises, till the completion of the renovation activities, and to assign the relevant renovation activities to the State Development and Construction Corporation, at a sum of Rs.500 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) and the Research Center for Eco?Environment Sciences (RCEES)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to sign the above MoU for investigating into the root causes of the unidentified Chronic Kidney Disease (CKDu) and to identify sustainable Water Treatment Technologies for the CKDu affected areas in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transferring the Ownership of Houses in the Housing Complex situated at Mahawela Lane, Dematagoda, to the Occupants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to execute the deeds of transfer in favour of 21 occupants reside at the above housing complex, who have completed the payment of the prescribed value of their housing units, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of Compensation for the Lands acquired for the projects implemented under the Strategic Cities Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - The main cities of Kandy, Galle, Trincomalee and Anuradhapura have been identified for the development under the Strategic Towns Development Programme.  The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to adopt the procedures of Land Acquisition and Resettlement Committees (LARC) and Land Acquisition and Resettlement Special Committees (SUPER LARC) in paying compensation to those who are affected due to land acquisitions for the projects implemented under this programme, which are more advantageous to them, was approved by the Cabinet. This would discourage the initiation of court actions against the land acquisitions.

description: Vesting of the State Land owned by the Government for Moragahahena Town Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - The Urban Development Authority (UDA) has initiated a programme to develop the small and medium township in the country, in line with the future urban development activities, and it is expected to develop the Moragahahena area situated in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Horana as a vibrant commercial sub?centre, under the said programme.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to work in collaboration with other public institutes for the expeditious development of the Bus Stand, Market, Commercial Complex, Sathi Pola (weekly fare) and Public Play Ground, on a well designed plan and to vest a block of land in extent of 1.354 hectares owned by the government, required for the purpose, with the UDA, as a free grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ease of Doing Business Forum -2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - The objective of holding this Forum is to provide the facilities required to maintain a healthy relationship between the public and private sectors while bridging the gap existing between the Sri Lankan business community and the public sector. This provides the space for the business community to discuss their issues face to face  with the top management of the major institutions of the public sector and to resolve those matters.  The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to hold this Forum at least once a month as appropriate, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Working Capital Loan Scheme for Tea Factories
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - Since the tea factory owners are in a financially constraint situation due to the decline in prices of tea, as a result of the problematic situation prevails in the world market, it has been planned to implement a Loan Scheme to meet the working capital required to maintain tea factories. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to implement this Loan Scheme for all tea factory owners, through the state and commercial banks, and to provide an interest subsidy of 2% per annum on the loans provided under the said loan scheme, to the relevant financial institution by the General Treasury, for a period of 02 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a new methodology for the Implementation of the Guaranteed Price Scheme for the Natural Raw Rubber produced by Rubber Smallholders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - Taking into consideration the shortcomings and the delays identified in the implementation of this programme, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to implement the guaranteed price mechanism through the registered rubber dealers, enabling the Rubber Smallholders to receive the guaranteed price at the time of selling their rubber, and to obtain a sum of Rs.2,063 million, required for the implementation of this programme till the end of September this year, from the General Treasury, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Limiting the Summoning of District Secretaries / Government Agents to Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - Performing their duties in the districts by the District Secretaries/ Government Agents has been obstructed due to the frequent summoning of them to Colombo by various Ministries, for conferences and discussions.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. Joseph Michael Perera, the Minister of Home Affairs, to hold a two day conference in Colombo every month, with a view to limiting the summoning of District Secretaries/Government Agents to Colombo, through providing time/opportunity to all ministries, to discuss matters relevant to their ministries with the District Secretaries/Government Agents during the said conference, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Emergency Ambulance Medical Care Servic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-24
decision_details_body: - The medical care received within the first 30 minutes is very important to preserve life, to prevent further injuries and to have a quick recovery, of persons who meet with any accident, disaster or a state of emergency. At present, such an Emergency Ambulance Medical Care Service is being implemented in India, successfully.  The Prime Minister of India, during his recent visit to Sri Lanka, agreed to assist Sri Lanka in the implementation of such an ambulance service equivalent to that prevailing in India, in Sri Lanka as well, with a view to further strengthening the friendship between India and Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, it has been proposed to implement such a non?profit motivated emergency ambulance service, in 04 stages, with the deployment of 297 ambulances and a trained staff of 2,000 members, covering the rural areas of Sri Lanka, further increasing the quality of the free health service.  The proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs, to implement its first phase through deploying 88 ambulances in the Western and Southern Provinces and to obtain a sum of US$ 08 million to be spent for the purpose, from the Government of India as a grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Repayment Mechanism for the Security Deposit Holders of the Golden Key Credit (GKC) Card Company Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to grant relief to the depositors of Non-Bank Inactive Financial Institutions by the Supplementary Budget - 2015 and the Minister of Finance has had several meetings in this regard with the relevant stakeholders.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, the Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs to repay the depositors who have maintained security deposits up to Rs.2 million in the GKC Card Company Ltd. within a month and thereafter, to liquidate the assets  of the GKC Company Ltd. for repayment of the further amounts to be paid and to make provision in collaboration with the General Treasury for the repayment of deposits based on the proposal submitted by the Minister of Finance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Utilization of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Funds by State Agencies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister Ranil Wickramasinghe, to appoint a Committee under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Ministry of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs, comprising of a representative each from the Presidential Secretariat and the Ministry of Finance to draft guidelines for Public Institutions, Ministries, Departments, Statutory Boards and Corporations on how the expenditure of the above funds should be incurred and also to decide on the requests made for obtaining such funds from the CSR, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Colombo Port City Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Prime Minister Ranil Wickremasinghe, to vest the activities of the project with the Urban Development Authority, to instruct the Central Environment Authority to commence a comprehensive Environmental Impact Assessment in association with other relevant institutions and to consider the re-commencement of the activities of the project, after completing the said assessment, as recommended by the Cabinet Sub?Committee on Economic Affairs considering the recommendations of the Senior Officials' Committee comprising of Secretaries to the Ministries appointed by the Cabinet, to report on the issues arisen, pertaining to the implementation of the above project and the progress achieved in the project activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement on the Articles of Association on setting up of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The Agreement on the Articles of Association on establishment of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank is scheduled to be signed on the 29th June 2015 in Beijing, China and the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, seeking approval to sign the Agreement on behalf of Sri Lanka at that event, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Gazette Notifications for the Revision of Import Taxes to the Parliament for Approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to present 06 Gazette Notifications issued for the Revision of Import Taxes, in Parliament for approval in terms of the provision of relevant Acts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme for introducing a Special Privilege Card for the War Heroes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - It has been decided to introduce a “Special Ranaviru Card” and a “Badge” for the purpose of identification of the war heroes of the Three Armed Forces, the Police and the Department of Civil Security who sacrificed their lives for achieving peace in Sri Lanka, who were missing in action and disabled, and their dependants, with a view to providing them with various benefits.  The war heroes and the members of their families will be afforded with an opportunity of receiving various services with ease  from around 50 Public and Private Sector institutions, through this programme. When obtaining services under this programme, they will be entitled to special benefits such as recognition, priority, discounts, concessionary methods of payment, interest free loan facilities, insurance facilities, transport services, health services, recreational needs and scholarships. The Cabinet noted the above information furnished to the Cabinet by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence.

description: Augmenting the Rolling Stock Capacity of the Sri Lanka Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Internal Transport, to procure 18 sets of Diesel Multiple Units, 160 Passenger Coaches and 30 Oil Tank Wagons for augmenting the Rolling Stock capacity of the Sri Lanka Railways as identified in the 2015-2020 National Railways Development Strategic Framework, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Container Handling Cranes for East Container Terminal of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority (SLPA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Ports Authority (SLPA) has invested US$80 million for the construction of the first 400 meters of the 1200 meters long  East Container Terminal Berth and by now its construction work is nearing completion. The proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to procure 04 Container Handling Cranes and 12 Gantry Cranes required for this Terminal, according to International Competitive Bidding method,  following the Government approved procurement process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: China Development  Bank funded Priority Roads Project 3 - Phase II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The China Development Bank provides US$100 million for this project and accordingly the development of the Tangalle – Weeraketiya Road and the Weeraketiya – Middeniya Road is already in progress. The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways and Investment Promotion, to identify the roads that need greater priority instead of the 08 roads that had been identified earlier for development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of consultancy services for the reconstruction of 25 Bridges funded by the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development (KFAED)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development (KFAED) provides funds for the reconstruction of 25 bridges.  The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways and Investment Promotion, to award the contract for the provision of consultancy services for the supervision of constructions under this Project, as recommended by the Consultants Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Stage II of the Horana Bus Stand Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - Horana Town is a major service centre in the Kalutara District and it is linked with the major towns of Colombo and Ratnapura Districts through the Regional Road Network.  The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to award the contract for the construction of Stage II of the Horana Bus Stand Development Project to the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Pavilion in the George Rajapaksa Stadium  Weeraketiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The Weeraketiya Town has been identified for development under the Small and Medium Scale Town Development Project, in the year 2014 by the Urban Development Authority.  The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to award the contract for the construction of the pavilion of the stadium to the State Engineering Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Building for the Office of the Finance Commission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The Finance Commission which has been empowered as an Independent Commission through the 19th Amendment to the Constitution, co-ordinates the National Policy and the Provincial Development Activities and also deals with the supervision and monitoring of the entire provincial council network.  The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to construct a new building for the Finance Commission, in a block of land of 60 perches, at No.03, Sarana Mawatha, Rajagiriya, owned by the Finance Commission and to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a Code of Conduct for the Members of Local Government Authorities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - There are 335 Local Government Authorities functioning in the country comprising of 23 Municipal Councils, 41 Urban Councils and 271 Pradeshiya Sabhas and 4,486 representatives are elected for these councils from the votes of the people.  According to the recently made inquires, actions are being taken  to conduct investigations or to issue charge sheets or to commence legal actions against 104 members of these councils on various malpractices and corruption charges.  The joint proposal made by Hon. Karu Jayasuriya, the Minister of Public Administration, Local Government and Democratic Governance, and Hon. Janaka Bandara Tennakoon, the Minister of Provincial Councils and Regional Development, to introduce a Code of Conduct for the people’s representatives who have been elected and would be elected to these Local Government Authorities and to implement the said code of conduct after obtaining the views of the Provincial Councils, with a view to making a set of exemplary people's representatives devoid of wrongdoings and corruption, who would put into practice the principles of Good Governance dedicating themselves to serve the people, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memoranda of Understanding on Scientist Exchange Programme and Co-establishing China – Sri Lanka Joint Laboratory on Biotechnology
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The objective of the above Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Scientist Exchange Programme is to expand channels for promote communication between Scientists and Researchers of the two countries and develop mutual understanding and friendship among them. The objective of the MoU on Co-establishing China – Sri Lanka Joint Laboratory on Biotechnology is to conduct high level joint researches, encourage technology transfers and strengthen the scientific and technological capacity. The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Higher Education and Research  to sign the above Memoranda of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of an Allowance of Rs. 2000.00 to Senior Citizens over 70 years of Age
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. P. Harisan, the Minister of Social Services, Welfare and Livestock Development, to make provision for an allocation for the payment of Rs.2,000.00 each to a number of 386,080 Senior Citizens over 70 years of Age, who are adversely affected due to various reasons, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing the Purchasing Price of a Litre of Liquid Milk from Rs. 60.00 to Rs.70.00
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - It was  proposed to increase the purchasing price of a litre of Liquid Milk from Rs. 60.00 to Rs.70.00 through the Interim Budget 2015.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. P. Harisan, the Minister of Social Services, Welfare and Livestock Development, to implement the proposed price formula based on the factors such as the percentage of fat in the liquid milk, non-fat solid available in the milk and the total solid content in the liquid milk, prepared after obtaining the views and the consent of the relevant stakeholders, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing relief to the employees of the Werahera Engineering Services Company Limited (WESCO) and Kahagolla Engineering Services Company Limited (KESCO) who have lost their employment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - A section of the employees who lost their employment due to the closure of the above institutions in 2001, have been recruited for employment, on casual basis, in the Sri Lanka Transport Board.  Out of these employees, only a section of employees has been confirmed in their service while others remain unconfirmed.  The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Madduma Bandara, the Minister of Internal Transport, to confirm the remaining employees in their service and to provide them with other rights entitled to them, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Adoption of the Protocol amending the WTO Agreement on Trade related Intellectual Property Rights
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The World Trade Organization has adopted a Protocol to amend the Agreement on Trade Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS) agreed by its member countries, in order to relax existing certain restrictions with regard to the production and use of medical drugs.  As a country, which has only a limited manufacturing capacity in the pharmaceutical sector, Sri Lanka stands to benefit from the above flexibilities that would allow it to source generic versions of expensive patented medicines from any competitive supplier around the world in times of any medical emergencies such as epidemics or natural disasters.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to ratify the relevant Protocol, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Sports Festival - 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The National Sports Festival is held annually with the objective of identifying the talents prevail in the fields of Sports in the country and to develop such talents.  Arrangements are afoot, for the National Sports Festival  which is to be held for the 41st time and the final events of the Festival will be held in Badulla Town at the latter half of 2015.  The proposal made by Hon.Navin Dissanayake, the Minister of Tourism and Sports, to hold the National Sports Festival - 2016 in the Districts of Jaffna and Kilinochchi of the Northern Province ensuring the participation of all Sri Lankans with a view to integrate the rural community to the main stream of the society and to appoint a Steering Committee comprising of Senior Officials to organize the event, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Programme on National Energy Conservation and Efficient Use - Energy Conservation Methods to be adopted by the Government Institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has to incur approximately 30% of its National Export Income, to import fuel required for generation of electricity, every year.  Similarly, it has been revealed through the studies that 25% of the electricity provided to the people goes waste due to inefficient   usage.  Therefore, the  conservation and efficient utilization of energy is very important. Accordingly, the Programme on National Energy Conservation and Efficient Use was introduced.  The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Power and Energy, to issue instructions to all Government Institutions to promote conservation and efficient utilization of energy getting involving the employees of those institutions with the objective of reducing the energy usage in the Government Institutions by 10%, as an initial step of this programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Oil Pipeline Project from Colombo Harbour to Kolonnawa Oil Terminal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Power and Energy, to direct the Ceylon Petroleum Storage Terminals Company Limited to conduct a full scale study regarding the construction of the pipeline that carries oil / fuel from Colombo Harbour to Kolonnawa Oil Terminal, which is 40 to 70 years old and is in a highly dilapidated status and of the infrastructure facilities required for the purpose, and also to construct the oil pipeline accordingly and to call for open international bids to select a  suitable contractor for the relevant construction work, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Alternative housing plots provided for the displaced families, due to acquisition of lands for the Urban Development Projects, to be sold to those who reside on them
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The Urban Development Authority during the period between 1980-1990 while acquiring lands for the implementation of various development projects has provided the low and medium scale income families which were residing in such lands and lost their shelters with alternative residences and as well as plots of land for construction of houses on monthly rentals or on the basis of monthly land rentals.  The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to vest the ownership of lands with the residents of the relevant plots of land in the Housing Schemes at Ratnapura, Peliyagoda, Battaramulla, Ratmalana and Madiwela, on the basis of commercial value that prevailed at the time of providing lands to them, upon the request made by the occupants of these lands, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Government Paddy Purchasing Programme 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, the Minister of Food Security, and Hon.Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, submitted the progress of the programme implemented by the Government to purchase paddy during the Maha Season - 2014/2015, to the Cabinet.  Accordingly, 160,301.8 MT of paddy have been purchased and it is the largest stock of paddy purchased through the Government intervention within a single Season.  The Cabinet granted approval to sell the stock of paddy now stored in the warehouses following the open tender procedure, to enable the paddy purchase programme to be implemented in the forthcoming Maha season as well and to have a more streamlined methodology implemented to purchase the Maha Season paddy  harvest.

description: Information on Government Borrowing status for the first four months of the year 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body:

description: Establishment of the Inter-Ministerial Committee under the Information and Communication Technology Act. No.27 of 2003
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The Information and Communication Technology sector in Sri Lanka has developed rapidly during the recent times. According to the Global Information Technology Report for the year 2015, published by the  World Economic Forum, the Sri Lanka has been placed in the 65th place among 143 countries in the Networked Readiness Index, securing the 1st place in the South Asian Region.  The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, the Minister of Foreign Affairs,  to further expand the existing Inter-Ministerial Committee, appointed in terms of the Section 3 of the above Act, with the representation of relevant Ministers and other concerned stakeholders in the field, to further develop the existing position, to ensure that the strategies  in the Information and Communication Technology field are being implemented  appropriately, in order to create a more conducive environment for investors and to have a greater coordination among Government Institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of the Marriage Registration Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The revision of the marriage registration fees from Rs.5,000/- to Rs.1,000/- as proposed in the Budget is implemented with effect from 2015?03?16. The proposal made by Hon. Joseph Michael Perera, the Minister of Home Affairs, to amend the Marriage Registration Ordinance for the said purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recommendations of the Finance Commission for the Financial year 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-17
decision_details_body: - The Finance Commission is entrusted with the task of making recommendations to the President, on the policies to be adopted in the distribution of funds to the Provinces, by the Government to meet their needs.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to implement the recommendations made by the Finance Commission, for the year 2015 and to present them in Parliament notifying that the said recommendations will be made effective, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The project for construction of the new Maternity Hospital in Galle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-10
decision_details_body: - After the Tsunami disaster in the year 2004, the Helmut Kohl Foundation of Germany initiated the construction of a new Maternity Hospital in the vicinity of Galle but discontinued from the year 2008 due to various constraints.  Considering the necessity of the services of this hospital to the people living in the area who were affected by the Tsunami calamity, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne to award the contact relevant to the completion of the balance work of the project,  to the substantially responsive lowest bidder according to the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of National Housing Day of Sri Lanka that symbolizes participatory Housing Development in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Housing and Samurdhi, Sajith Premadasa, to make the state policy to provide the ownership of a house to every citizen of Sri Lanka, a success, in the launching of the National Housing Development Programme more productively, mustering a wide people's participation, to declare the 23rd day of June, 2015 being the first day which initiated the participatory Housing Day programme and to declare the Week starting from the National Housing Day as the 'Housing Week' with the implementation of the programme of housing construction within that week, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Empowering Widows and Women Household Heads
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-10
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka women population represents over 51% of the total population and out of them a considerable number had become widows owing to the conflict situation prevailed during the past and also household heads as a result.  The proposal made by the Minister of Women's Affairs, K.D.M. Chandrani Bandara, to implement an expeditious programme for empowering widows and women household heads economically and socially, in Jaffna, Kilinochchi, Mannar, Vauniya, Mulativu, Ampara, Trincomallee, Batticaloa, Anuradhapura and Polonnaruwa where such women are more prevalent, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Four Storied Building for the District Secretariat, Polonnaruwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-10
decision_details_body: - The Polonnaruwa District of the North Central Province covers an area of 3337.9 Sq kms in extent and constitutes 07 Divisional Secretary's Divisions and 295 Grama Niladhari Divisions.  The building where the District Secretariat is housed is 53 years old and over 25 public institutions of other departments and ministries are also located.  The proposal made by the Minister of Home Affairs Joseph Michael Perera  to construct a District Secretariat Complex with modern facilities to ensure a more efficient and productive service to the public, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Proposed Mechanism for the Services provided by the Postal Department of Sri Lanka in Collaboration with the Government/ Semi Government/Private Institutes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-10
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Postal Department which is more than 200 years old by now, is implementing programmes of efficient and quality services using the newest technologies and new marketing concepts that suit the changing customer requirements.  At the same time, it lends the services of the Department as well as agency services to various government, semi-government and the private sector institutions.  The Department has a strong post office net work consisting of around 4063 Post Offices spread island-wide and out of which 653 Post Offices have been successfully provided with the new technology through the network. The proposal made by the Minister of Muslim Religious Affairs and Posts, M.H.A.Haleem to implement the business  services expeditiously and transparently without the Department having to incur additional financial expenditure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Self-employment Loan for Socially Re-integrated Trainees
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-10
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval in 2012 to implement self-employment loan scheme for socially re-integrated trainees who had been involved in terrorist activities.  This Loan Scheme has provided a wide opportunity to the socially re-integrated youth to conduct their livelihood activities successfully while also providing a strong base to create the necessary economic atmosphere for them to live as good citizens in the society.  The amount of loans so granted by State Banks up to 31?12?2014 exceed Rs. 302 million. The number of applications submitted in anticipation to obtain loans in the future are more than 5,750.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Resettlement, Reconstruction and Hindu Religious Affairs, D.M.Swaminathan, to implement Stage II of this Loan Scheme with the revisions required, through the Bank of Ceylon, Peoples' Bank, Lanka Puthra Bank and the Savings Bank of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of Sri Lanka Maritime Week from 21st  to 27th September 2015, in line with the World Maritime Day that falls on the 25th  of September, 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-10
decision_details_body: - The International Maritime Organization with the auspices of the United Nations had declared 25th day of September 2015 as the World Maritime Day aimed at promoting the Maritime Activities and the Global Economic Development.  The theme for 2015 World Maritime Day is 'Maritime Education and Training'.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping, Arjuna Ranathunga, to declare September 21- 27 of 2015 as the Sri Lanka Maritime Week and to implement the proposed programmes during the period, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Polgahawela, Pothuhera, Alawwa Integrated WS Project - Kundasale - Haragama WS Project - Mathugama, Dodangoda, Agalawatta and Neboda Integrated WS Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-10
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage Rauff Hakeem, to proceed with the implementation and the activities of the above water supply projects and to make a request to the Department of External Resources to hold negotiations with  the relevant institutions to secure funds required for the above projects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: MoU between the Coconut Research Institute of the Ministry of Plantation Industries of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Chinese Academy of Tropical Agricultural Sciences of the Coconut Research Institute of the People’s Republic of China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-10
decision_details_body: - The objective of the above MOU is to strengthen the co-operation in the field of coconut research and development between the two countries and to develop integrated coconut research and development programmes relating to scientific, technological and skill development prevalent in the sphere.  Therefore, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation Industries, Lakshman Kiriella, to obtain covering approval for the MOU entered into during H.E. President's visit to China in March this year and to implement the matters covered in the agreement within the next three (03) years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ratification of the United Nations Convention on the use of Electronic Communications in International Contracts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-10
decision_details_body: - The above convention was prepared by the United Nations Commission on International Trade Law (UNCITRAL) and adopted by the United Nations General Assembly in the year 2005.  The objective of the Convention is to offer practical solutions for issues related to the use of electronic means of communication in connection with International contracts.
