Sri Lanka has signed the Convention in the year 2006 and in the preparation of Sri Lankan Electronic Transactions Act No.19 of 2006, the features and underlying principles of the Convention have been included in the Act.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Mangala Samaraweera, to authorize the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to ratify the Convention, to empower  the Information and Communication Technology Agency (ICTA) to undertake a review of the Electronic Transactions Act No.19 of 2006 and make recommendations for such revisions as may be required to meet the obligations under the above Convention, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The National Flower of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-06-10
decision_details_body: - The flower 'Manel' was declared as the National Flower of Sri Lanka in 1986 on the proposals made by the public and based on the recommendations of a Committee of Scholars and Officials. Considering the discrepancies that had taken place during recent times as the right image of the National Flower of Sri Lanka has not been displayed every time the National Flower is mentioned, and as such the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahawali Development and Environment to refer to the National Flower of Sri Lanka as 'Manel' in Sinhala, 'Neelothpalam' in Tamil and 'Blue Water Lily' in English and to use the correct image of the flower and the correct scientific name, 'Nymphaea Nouchali Burm.f', every time the National Flower is referred to and also to provide adequate publicity to popularize the correct name and the image of the flower and to educate the public institutions in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Committee of Secretaries to Monitor and Report on Colombo Port City Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - The construction work of the Colombo Port City Project has been suspended based on the recommendations of the Committee appointed to review this project. The proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister Ranil Wickramasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs, to appoint an Apex Committee chaired by the Secretary to the Prime Minister, to explore the possibility of authorizing the continuation of the project, after rectifying identified shortcomings and procedures, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Glass of Milk to the School Children - 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - The distribution of milk packets to school children was implemented in collaboration with the Milco (Pvt) Ltd., with the objective of promoting liquid milk consumption, encouraging dairy farmers and familiarizing local food consumption patterns.  Having taken into consideration, that the purchase price of per liter of milk has increased up to  Rs.70/- as per the new proposals of the 2015 Budget, the proposal made by Hon. Akila Viraj Kariyawasam, the Minister of Education, to purchase per packet of 150ml of milk at a revised rate of Rs.20/-, in accordance with the trilateral agreement existing among the Ministry of Education, the  Ministry of Social Services, Welfare and Livestock Development and the  Milco (Pvt) Ltd., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 12th Steering Committee Meeting and Symposium of International Network on Water and Eco-system in Paddy Filed
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - The "International Network for Water and Eco-system in Paddy Fields" is an international co-operation forum established in the year 2004, with the objective of sustaining a proper water management, while focusing on the sustainability of eco-system in the paddy cultivation lands. The proposal made by Hon. Gamini Vijith Vijayamuni Soyza, the Minister of Irrigation, to host the 12th Steering Committee Meeting and the Symposium of this International Network, with the participation of 17 member countries, in November  2015, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Additional Allocation required for the provision of facilities to the IDPs recently resettled
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - The policy of the government is to resettle all the internally displaced persons  (IDPs) in their places of origin. The proposal made by Hon.D.M. Swaminathan, the Minister of Resettlement, Reconstruction and Hindu Religious Affairs, to obtain Rs.160 million, to provide facilities for the resettlement of  approximately 2,175 internally displaced families in the districts such as Jaffna and Trincomalee, to achieve this goal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Batticaloa Courts Complex – Second Phase
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - The re-construction work of the Batticaloa Court Complex which was in a state of dilapidation and danger has now been completed. The proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, the Minister of Justice, to implement  the second phase of the project, to provide further facilities required to maintain the functions of this Courts Complex, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointing of a  “Highways Anti-corruption Investigation Unit”
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - The Government has made huge investments in the Highways Sector during the period from 01?01?2011 to 08?01?2015. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, the Minister of Highways and Investment Promotion, to appoint a Highways  Anti?corruption Investigation Unit functions under the Ministry of Highways and Investment Promotion, to conduct investigations to determine whether there were lapses in the administration, technical, financial and other procedures which could have led to significant losses to the Government and if so, to find out the persons responsible for such losses and to provide appropriate recommendations to alter the relevant procedures to avoid such occurrences in future,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restricting Import and Use of Glyphosate Pesticide
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - The scientists who conduct researches on the affliction of the Chronic Kidney Disease have pointed out that the use of chemical fertilizer, pesticides and weedicides could be a contributory factor for the said disease. Accordingly, the government has already banned totally the import of identified four (04) chemical fertilizer and weedicides.  In addition, the implementation of the decision taken by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to totally ban the import and use of Glyphosate weedicide, as it is, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy on Healthcare Quality and Patient Safety
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - The quality of the patient care services provided by the healthcare institutions of different levels in Sri Lanka differs.  Bypassing of the healthcare institutions close to them by the patients can be avoided through ensuring safety of patients and providing access for an equal and high quality healthcare service to all strata of the community.  This will reduce the rush in the major hospitals, while increasing the utilization of services in the primary level healthcare institutions. Accordingly, the 'National Policy on Healthcare Quality and Patient Safety', presented by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, to ensure the quality of healthcare and safety of patients who attend the government hospitals in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Dry Zone Urban Water and Sanitation Project - Providing alternative lands for the people affected due to the construction of Peru Aru Reservoir in Vavuniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - The above project is implemented by the Ministry of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to improve the water supply and sanitation in the dry zone towns of Vauniya, Mannar, Chilaw, and Puttalam.  The joint proposal made by Hon. M.K.A.D.S. Gunawardana, the Minister of Lands and Hon. Rauff Hakeem, the Ministers of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to provide alternative lands as outright grants to 88 persons who were deprived of their lands due to the construction of the Peru-Aru Reservoir in Vavuniya under this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Participation of Hon. Minister of Finance at the International Monetary Fund (IMF)/ World Bank  (WB) Spring Meetings held in Washington DC From 15th to 18th April 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - A delegation led by the Minister of Finance had participated in the above meeting representing Sri Lanka and during the said visit, the Minister of Finance had also participated in several official as well as some bilateral meetings. The attention of the Summit has been focused on overcoming the challenges of world economy. Even though the reduction of oil prices in the World Market has made a positive effect on the world economy, it has been pointed out in the Summit, that the world economy is still at a risk.  Simultaneous to the participation of the above meeting, the Minister of Finance had met and held discussions with the officials of the State Department of the United States, the Hon. Finance Ministers of Malaysia, Japan, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and India and also with the high level officials of the World Bank and IMF.  The Cabinet also noted that the Minister has also briefed the current political situation, the economic development and the development of the business environment in Sri Lanka, before the Chamber of Commerce of the United States.

description: The 'Pura Neguma' Project for the development of Local Government Services of the Northern and Eastern Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - The divisional services and infrastructure facilities will be improved under the 'Pura Neguma' Project which is being implemented during the five year period from 2010-2015, under a grant of US$50 million provided by the World Bank, covering 80 Local Government Institutes in Northern and Eastern Provinces. The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake,  the Minister of Finance, to conduct negotiations to seek additional funds for the project, and to enter into an agreement to obtain a loan of US$ 20 million from the International Development Association of the World Bank, for the component of the project which is being carried out through utilizing the Sri Lankan funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a Loan for the Early Childhood Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - The development strategies of the government have identified well the importance of investing funds more for the welfare of the children in early childhood and accordingly, the objective of the government is to ensure safe and appropriate environment for the children between the age range of years 0?5 through improving the quality of services rendered, and provided them with proper nutrition, protection and access for the early childhood development activities. The  'Early Childhood Development Project 2015-2020' has been proposed with a view to achieving the said goals. The International Development Association of the World Bank has agreed to provide the necessary financial contribution towards this and accordingly the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to conduct negotiations with the said institution and to enter into a financial agreement with the said institute, to borrow a credit of Special Drawing Rights equivalent to US$ 50 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Thattuthurai Bridge and Access Ways of Samawachathivu - Munichchenai Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - Through this proposed project, it will be easy for the residents of Samawachathivu, to access and connect with the facilities such as highways, health and education.  Accordingly, the living conditions and the livelihood of the people of Nedunatheevu, Chullimurichchantheevu, Pulichchankerny, Samawachathevu and Aalimtheevu will be improved. Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, informed the Cabinet that the action will be taken to utilize the unutilized sum of US$601,581 of the Trincomalee - Batticaloa Road Development Project, for the purpose, with the concurrence of the Saudi Fund for Development.

description: Rehabilitation of A-5 Road Corridor from Badulla to Chenkaladi
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - The Peradeniya - Badulla - Chenkaladi Road has been identified as a major road that links the Eastern and the Central Provinces of the country. Accordingly, the road section from Peradeniya to Badulla has been rehabilitated and the balance road section of 151.3km from Badulla to Chenkaladi is to be rehabilitated through this project.  The necessary action is being already taken to obtain a loan of US$60.0 million from the OPEC Fund for International Development, for the purpose. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, the Minister of Finance, to conduct negotiations with the Saudi Fund for Development, to obtain another loan of US$60.0 million for this project and to enter into a loan agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bandaranaike International Airport Development Project - Phase 2 (II)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - It is expected to develop the infrastructure facilities essential for the enhancement of the Bandaranaike International Airport, enabling the increase of the present annual passenger handling capacity of the Airport from 7.4 million to 15 million by 2020, through this Project. The Government of Japan has agreed to provide a sum of Japanese Yen 45,428 million (approximately LKR 48,969 million) to the Government of Sri Lanka, through the Japan International Co?operation Agency (JICA), for the purpose.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs, to enter into an agreement with the Government of Japan, to obtain such funds and to proceed with the activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the National Kidney Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-27
decision_details_body: - At present, a Monitoring Committee has been appointed to deal with the Chronic Kidney Disease which is spreading rapidly and relevant Sub?Committees have also been established under the said Committee. The entire process relating to this effort is being coordinated through the Kidney Disease Prevention Co?ordination Unit established under the Presidential Secretariat. Various parties including National and International Civil Organizations and individuals interested in activities pertaining to the prevention of the disease and its spreading have expressed their willingness to contribute towards the proposed Fund and a contribution of Rs. 7 million has already been received towards the Fund. The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena, to establish the National Kidney Fund proposed by the budget proposals 2015 of the new Government, under the Presidential Secretariat, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Further activities relating to the Bill for Registration of Theravada Bikkhu Kathikawatha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Buddha Sasana, Hon. Karu Jayasuriya, to get the recommendations of the Attorney General in regard to the above Draft Bill, to publish it in the Government Gazette and thereafter to present it in the Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance No.19 of 1931
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet of Ministers at its meeting held on 2015?04?22 decided to allow   the interested parties to make further observations to amend certain provisions in the Buddhist Temporalities (Amendment) Ordinance.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddha Sasana, Hon. Karu Jayasuriya to get the recommendations of the Attorney General for the final draft prepared incorporating the amendments proposed by the Minister of Justice and the Reverend Bikkhus represented the sects of the Siyam Chapter, to publish it in the Government Gazette and thereafter to present it in the Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Asian Development Bank funded Southern Road Connectivity Project - Award of Contract for Consultancy Services for Project Implementation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka has received a loan amounting to US$70 million from the Asian Development Bank to meet the cost of the Southern Road Connectivity Project.  Approximately 33 km of the national highways which provide connectivity to the Southern Expressway will be improved under this loan. The proposal made by the Minister of Highways and Investment Promotion, Hon. Kabir Hashim, to award the contract as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 500MT of Full Cream Milk Powder for the Thriposha Production 2015/2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - Thriposha is a nutritious food supplement, distributed free of charge to the children with malnutrition, pregnant mothers with nutrition problems and lactating mothers through ‘National Thriposha Program’.  The annual requirement of the full cream milk powder for manufacturing of Thriposha is 500 MT.  The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine Dr. Rajitha Senaratne to procure the 500 MT full cream milk powder from Milco (Pvt.) Limited for the production of Thriposha for the year 2015/2016  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for strengthening the Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources for Accelerated Revocation of the European Union Ban on Fish Export
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - Due to the ban imposed by the European Union on the importation of fish products of Sri Lanka in November 2014, Sri Lanka has lost a market of around US $100 million.  The adaptation of the necessary preliminary legal framework, strengthening of the legal enforcement capacities, training of stakeholders and educating them, establishment of  a vessel monitoring system etc. for the revocation of the above ban have already been commenced.  The proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera to take necessary measures to strengthen the Department of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Provincial Councils Elections Act, No.02 of 1988
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - The present government in its program for a 'Maithri Administration' proposed to increase women representation by a minimum of 25% in the political decision making process.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Provincial Councils and Regional Development Hon. Janaka Bandara Tennakoon to draft legislation to amend the Provincial Councils Elections Act, No.02 of 1988 including provision to comprise not less than a 30% of women representation of the total number of candidates in each nomination paper submitted by the political parties or groups at a Provincial Council Election, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an Exploratorium at the Sri Lanka Planetarium
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - Around 200,000 persons including school children, teachers and Navy officers visit the Sri Lanka Planetarium established in 1965, every year.  The Exploratorium is an exciting place which offers creative and thought provoking environment having exhibits, tools and projects for promoting curiosities.  The proposal made by the Minister of Higher Education and Research, Dr. Sarath Amunugama to develop an Exploratorium at the Sri Lanka Planetarium and to explore the possibility of receiving grant aid from international sources, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Land Blocks from Regional Industrial Estates to set up Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - The Regional Industrial Estates Development Program implemented by the Ministry of Industry and Commerce is a major program launched with the objective of promoting industries at regional level.  The proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Commerce, Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, to allocate blocks of land from relevant Industrial Estates for the 14 project proposals recommended by the Project Evaluation Committee of the Ministry on a 35 years lease basis, out of the 34 project proposals received in response to the public notices published in the recent past for the selection of suitable investors for the vacant land plots in the industrial estates, based on their financial feasibility, income tax payments, payment of Employees Provident Fund, progress made on the repayment of bank loans, employment generation and environment friendliness etc. and to vest the land plots back with the Government in case of failure to start industries within the specified time frame as agreed upon by the investors, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of the construction work of the Kothmale Mahaweli Maha Seya - 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Sports, Hon. Navin Dissanayake to obtain additional provisions from the General Treasury to complete the construction work of the Kothmale Mahaweli Maha Seya, which commenced in 1983, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Russian Federation and the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on Co-operation in the field of Mass Communication
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - The Proposal made by the Minister of Mass Media, Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Russian Federation with a view of enhancing co?operation in the field of Mass Communication, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Collective Agreement between Ceylon Electricity Board and the Trade Unions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy, Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka for the approval of the Collective Agreement made between the Ceylon Electricity Board and the relevant Trade Unions on 2014?12?01 to enhance the performance of the Electricity Board and to have an Administrative Agreement between the Employees and the Management, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taking action to avoid misuse of the National Flag of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and to establish due respect to the National Flag
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that the National Flag of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka is used against the Regulations stipulated in the Code for the use of the National Flag approved by the Cabinet of Ministers in 1986 in a manner dwindling the respect of the flag and also that national flags inconsistent with the specifications of the Standards of Sri Lanka Standards Institution are offered for sale in the market and as such, the proposal made by the Minister of Home Affairs, Hon. Joseph Michael Perera to instruct the Legal Draftsman to convert the Code to a law of the country in order to prevent the disrespect caused and misuse of the flag and also to appoint a Committee to design a officially recognized ceremonial flag to be used in ceremonial occasions by the Government as well as the general public, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: http://www.cabinetoffice.gov.lk/cab/index.php?option=com_fabrik&c=form&view=form&Itemid=65&fabrik=11&rowid=6084&tableid=11⟨=en
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. John Amaratunga, the Minister of Public Order and Christian Affairs to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Romanian Government on releasing Diplomatic Passport holders from the obligation to obtain visa, with a view to further strengthening friendly relations between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Romania, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of Projects commenced under 'Deyata Kirula' National Development Programme - 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs to complete the remaining work of projects already commenced and identified as essential for the benefit of the communities covered under 'Deyata Kirula' National Development Program in the Districts of Galle, Matara, Hambantota and Rathnapura,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancing Educational Opportunities for Afghanistan Officer Cadets at General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-20
decision_details_body: - Sir John Kotelawala Defence University which was established with a mission for producing academically and professionally qualified personnel to the Armed Forces fulfills the higher educational aspirations of Officer Cadets / Civilian Students providing Degree Programs in numerous fields.  The University has offered two (02) placements each for the students of the countries of the African and Asian regions as well as to pursue their studies on a gratis basis, in order to extend goodwill among these countries.   Having taken into consideration of a request made by the former President of Afghanistan H.E. Hamid Karzai on his official visit to Sri Lanka during 2014, the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to offer two (02) additional placements to Afghanistan was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reconstruction of Theravada Buddhist Temples heavily destroyed by the Earth quake in Nepal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body: The devastating earth quake which occurred in Nepal during the recent past caused extensive damage to the people of Nepal and the Government of Sri Lanka intervened to send aid groups along with essential food items to provide them with relief.  It has been reported by the Embassy of Sri Lanka that a large number of Theravada Buddihist places of worship have been severely affected and the proposal made by the Minister of Buddha Sasana, Hon. Karu Jayasuriya for the Government of Sri Lanka to make a contribution to renovate one Buddhist shrine and one Hindu shrine out of those damaged, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Participation of Hon. Minister of Finance at the 48th Annual Meeting of the Asian Development Bank held from 2015?05?02 to 05 in Baku, Azerbaijan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet noted that the Minister of Finance, Hon. Ravi Karunanayake and several officials of the Ministry have represented Sri Lanka at the 48th Annual Conference of the Asian Development Bank which was held in Baku, Azerbaijan.  The Cabinet further noted that the Minister of Finance had participated in the informal meeting of Finance Ministers of the SAARC region and also had other meetings with the President and the Vice President of the Asian Development Bank during this visit.

description: Western Province Road Development Project and Rehabilitation of A 5 Road Corridor from Badulla to Chenkaladi Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body: - The Minister of Finance Hon. Ravi Karunanayake brought to the notice of the Cabinet the agreements to be entered into with the OPEC fund for International Development at the request of the Government of Sri Lanka, which would provide the funds necessary for rehabilitation of 27 kilo meters of selected roads under the Western Province Road Development Project and rehabilitation of A 5 road corridor from Badulla to Chenkaladi.

description: Water Supply and Sanitation Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet approval has already been granted for the Water Supply and Sanitation Improvement Project 2015-2020 to be implemented to enhance the pipe born water services and the sanitation facilities focusing 540 Gramasevaka Niladhari Divisions in the Districts of Mullativu, Kilinochchi, Nuwara-eliya, Badulla, Kegalle, Monaragala and Ratnapura.  The proposal made by the Minister of Finance Hon. Ravi Karunanayake to conduct loan negotiations and enter into a financial agreement with the International Development Agency of the World Bank to borrow a credit of US$ 165 million, equivalent amount in Special Drawing Rights, for the implementation of the above project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Celebrating the Republic Day
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body: - With the adoption of the first Republican Constitution on 1972?05?22, Sri Lanka became a sovereign and independent state accountable to the people. Circular instructions are issued to celebrate the Republic Day falls due on the 22nd of May every year to commemorate the event and the proposal made by the Minister of Home Affairs, Hon. Joseph Michael Perera to issue a similar circular this year too, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the Term of Office of the Local Authorities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body:
- Out of the 335 local authorities, the term of office of the 234 local authorities, functional at present is due to end on 2015?05?15, the term of office of 65 local authorities is due to end on 2015?07?31, the term of office of 21 local authorities is due to end on 2015?10?16 and         
	the term of office of 02 local authorities is due to end on 2015?10?31. There is the possibility of either to extend or shorten the term of office of these institutions governed by the Municipal Councils Ordinance, Urban Councils Ordinance and the Pradeshiya Sabas Act under the provisions therein. However, the Minister of Public Administration, Local Government and Democratic Governance, Hon. Karu Jayasuriya brought to the attention of the Cabinet that, since there is a possibility of electing the members to local bodies through an election under the mixed electoral system based on electoral divisions in future, the term of office of the local bodies will be allowed to lapse without being extended.

description: Construction of a Multi-model Center at Makumbura under the Township Development Component of the Greater Colombo Urban Transport Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body: - The Makumbura new Township Development has been identified by the Urban Development Authority and the Ministry of Transport specially as a Transport Hub connecting both Bus and Rail, to cater to the needs of the commuter population.  Under this programme it is anticipated to construct a Bus Terminal, Railway Station, Bus/Car/Taxi Park and the related road networks. The proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, Hon. Rauff Hakeem to award the contract of the construction of the Multi-model Center at Makumbura with the Loan Assistance from the Japan International Cooperation Agency, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the Year 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Prime Minister Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe as the  Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs to present the Annual Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka - 2014 in Parliament, in accordance with the provisions of the Monetary Law Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Dissolution of the Secretariat of Strategic Affairs functioning under the Ministry of Defence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body: - The objectives of establishing the above Secretariat have, by now, been enlarged into a great extent and as such identifying the new approaches for the socialization of war heroes back into the civil society, promoting the reconciliation among the communities etc; have become a priority.  In order to achieve these objectives, a Research and Development Division with a competent and trained staff has already been established within the Ministry of Defence and as such maintaining a separate Secretariat for Strategic Affairs, which is only an additional financial burden to the Government, is no longer required. Therefore, the proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripla Sirisena in his capacity as the Minister of Defence for the dissolution of the above office was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Greater Colombo Waste Water Management Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body: - The Asian Development Bank has granted a loan amount of US$ 100 million to create a healthy environment more suited for the life of the urban population in Colombo by rehabilitating the Greater Colombo Waste Water Management Project.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Local Government and Democratic Governance, Hon. Karu Jayasuriya to award the contract for designing, construction, installation and rehabilitation of the waste water pumping stations within the Colombo Municipal limits, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Air Services Consultations between Sri Lanka and Kazakhstan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body: - Discussions relating to the development of an Air Service Link between Sri Lanka and Kazakhstan have been held between the delegates of the two countries in Astana, Kazakhstan.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Aviation, Reginold Cooray to sign the already initiated Air Services Agreement at official level by an accredited representative and take appropriate action thereafter for its entry into force, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Memorandum of Understanding on Recruitment of Domestic Workers / Employment of Workers between the Ministry of Human Resources of the Government of Malaysia and the Ministry of Foreign Employment of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Employment Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala to enter into two (02) Memoranda of Understanding between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of Malaysia on Employment of Domestic Workers and Other Personnel so as to ensure  safeguarding their rights and welfare facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regularizing of the Registration of Domestic Elephants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body: - The Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance requires that all tamed and domesticated elephants of Sri Lanka be registered with the Department of Wildlife Conservation and a license obtained. Under these provisions, in addition to elephants owned by the Department of National Zoological Gardens, a total number of 161 elephants in the custody of private owners have been registered with the Department of Wildlife Conservation.  During the recent past, complaints regarding irregularities and offenses in the method of registration and capturing of wild baby elephants have been received over which investigations have already begun. Representations have also been made in this connection by the members of the Maha Sanga and the Association of Tamed Elephants including various other interested parties.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Sports Hon. Navin Dissanayake to appoint a Committee to streamline the welfare of tamed elephants in captivity in Sri Lanka and to take appropriate measures in accordance with the recommendations of the Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bio Park and Small Mammal Breeding Centre at Pinnawala Zoo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body: - The Pinnawala Zoo which was opened recently is becoming immensely popular among the local tourists day by day. This zoo located in close proximity to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage has been designed as an open range zoo. It is also the maiden experience of its kind for Sri Lankan visitors.  The proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Sports Hon. Navin Dissanayake to establish a small Mammal Breeding Centre and a Bio Park at the Pinnawala Zoo for conserving the local animal species, was approved by the Cabinet, as a matter of policy.

description: Provision of Training Courses of the Defence Services Command and Staff College to Foreign Officers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-05-13
decision_details_body: - The Defence Services Command and Staff College is the highest Military Training Institution in the island and it provides training to the Middle Level Officers of the three (03) Armed Forces and the Police.  The institution also provides to selected officers the knowledge, skills and advance command vital to hold high level posts of the three (03) Armed Forces whilst grooming them for managerial activities. The proposal made by H.E. the President Maithripala Sirisena in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to provide training opportunities for 27 foreign military officers as an opportunity afforded to the officers of the three (03) Armed Forces of Sri Lanka to be trained jointly with the foreign military officers, as a mark of friendship and a way of sharing the knowledge and experience of the foreign military officers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Constitutional Amendment to amend the present Electoral System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-29
decision_details_body: - Having obtained the views of the relevant parties as decided by the Cabinet at its meeting held on 2015?04?22, H.E. the President, presented a draft legislation on new Electoral System for the attention of  the Cabinet and requested the Hon. Ministers to submit their further views in that regard at the next Cabinet Meeting.

description: Implementation of Water Supply and Sanitation Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-29
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, Hon. Rauff Hakeem to implement the above project and to proceed with the activities, with a view to strengthening the capacity of the Department of National Community Water Supply and to solve the drinking water issues and to improve the sanitary conditions of the people living in the districts of Mullaitivu, Kilinochchi, Nuwara-Eliya, Badulla, Moneragala, Kegalle and Ratnapura, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'World Exposition - 2015'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-29
decision_details_body: - The World Exposition is held in major cities of selected countries on a bi?annual basis on different themes and its next exhibition will be held during a span of six (6) months period from 01?05?2015 to 31?10?2015 in the city of Milan, Italy. On the information submitted by the Minister of Industry and Commerce, Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Cabinet noted that the Sri Lanka is scheduled to participate at the above exhibition and the objectives of Sri Lanka's participation are to exhibit the Sri Lankan dignity, to improve the relations with the Western Countries and to improve the brand image of Sri Lanka.

description: Increase of Wages of the Private Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-29
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by the Minister of Labour, Hon. S.B. Navinne to draft legislation for the above purpose taken into consideration the necessity of introducing a law similar to the  methodology adopted in the Budgetary Relief Allowance Act, No.36 of 2005, in principle, with the objective of providing an expeditious solution to the wage increase issue relating to the Private Sector Employees, was approved by the Cabinet. It has been proposed to incorporate the following provisions in the draft Bill to be implemented: 

*	The minimum monthly wage of all employees of the Private Sector will be Rs.10,000/- and accordingly, the minimum daily wage will be Rs. 400/- 

*	The above will be implemented as the basic wage with effect from 01st May 2015. 

*	As the first step of increasing the wages of Private Sector Employees by Rs.2,500/-, their present wage will be increased by Rs.1,500/- with effect from 01?05?2015 and accordingly, the wage of the daily paid employees will also be increased by Rs.60/-. 
*	The second step will be implemented with effect from 01?01?2016 and the wage paid as at 31?12?2015 will be increased by another Rs.1,000/- and accordingly, the wage of the daily paid employees will also be increased by Rs.40/-.

description: Right to Information Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-29
decision_details_body: - Various agencies and persons have proposed amendments to the Right to Information Bill approved by the Cabinet at its previous  meeting, and as such, instead of submitting the amendments at the Committee Stage, a finalized draft amalgamating these amendments submitted to the Cabinet by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe for consideration of the Cabinet, was approved by the Cabinet.  Also, the proposal made by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, not to present the Right to Information Bill and the National Audit Bill as urgent Bills, but to present them to the Parliament following the normal procedure applicable to the passing of Bills, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the North Central Province Canal Project (NCPCP) Phase 1
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-29
decision_details_body: - The Mahaweli Development Programme commenced in 1970 and the Government has given high priority for the completion of the outstanding water conveyance investments under this programme.  Water conveyance to North, North Central and Eastern Provinces is the main component outstanding.  The Cabinet has already granted approval for the implementation of the Northern Province Canal Project and the proposal made by H.E. the President, Maithripala Sirisena, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment to enter into an agreement with the Asian Development Bank to implement the Phase I of the North Central Province Canal Project and pursue action accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Merchant Shipping Act, No.52 of 1971 in order to bring it in line with the International Maritime Organization (IMO) International Conventions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-29
decision_details_body: - The member States should act in accordance with the 'Mandatory Conventions' of the IMO which is the International Organization mandated by the United Nations to deal with shipping activities.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Shipping, Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga to draft amendments to amend the Merchant Shipping Act, No.52 of 1971 for the enactment of laws necessary for the successful implementation of the conventions of the IMO, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Declaration of Jungle Corridors, Nature Reserves, Sanctuaries and National Parks in the Northern Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-29
decision_details_body: - With the dawn of peace at the end of a war which prevailed over a period of more than 30 years, an Integrated Strategic Environmental Assessment was carried out in the Northern Province to identify the areas that can be utilized for development work as well as for environmental conservation with the participation of more than 25 public institutions.  The Central Environmental Authority and the Disaster Management Centre pioneered this programme and the necessary financial and technical facilities were provided by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).  Under this assessment, areas to be declared as wildlife protected areas, with the prime objectives of mitigating the human?elephant conflict,  conservation of wetlands, protection of bird migratory flyways and conservation of bio?diversity, and the few existing reserves to be updated were identified.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Tourism and Sports, Hon. Navin Dissanayake to declare the Jungle Corridors, the new Nature Reserves and the National Parks so identified and to upgrade the sanctuaries and to prepare new boundary schedules revising the existing boundaries of sanctuaries and to publish in the Government Gazette, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Agreement between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Russian Federation on Mutual Legal assistance in Criminal Matters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-29
decision_details_body: - International Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters is of paramount importance to combat transnational crimes.  The Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act, No.25 of 2002 provides for the provision of assistance by Sri Lanka to foreign countries in respect of criminal matters in those countries and also for obtaining of similar assistance from such countries by Sri Lanka.  The proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Hon. Wijayadasa Rajapaksa to enter into the above Agreement on Mutual Legal Assistance between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Russian Federation with the view to effectively enforce the laws of two countries on investigation, prosecution and confiscation of criminal proceeds and to ratify the same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Traditional Local Paddy Harvest
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-29
decision_details_body: - A tendency of spreading of non-communicable deceases prevails in the country and a most number of deaths that occur annually in the country due to the affliction of non?communicable deceases.  Both local and foreign scientific researches have proved that resorting to modern farming which depends on the excessive use of agrochemicals neglecting the traditional cultivation methods and deviation from the  traditional food crops and food consumption pattern have contributed to spreading of the non-communicable deceases. On the information furnished by the Minister of Agriculture, Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, the Cabinet noted that the measures have been taken to purchase 2.5 million kilograms from the traditional local paddy harvest at a rate of Rs.80/- per kilo and a part of which is to be sold as seed paddy among the farmers giving priority to the kidney decease prevalent areas, subject to a maximum of 25 kilograms per individual at a rate of Rs.90/- per kilogram and that the balance to be converted to rice and will be sold in the open market, as a remedial measure for this state of affairs and with the view to familiarizing the people once again with the traditional food consumption pattern.

description: Appointment of an Advisory Board to the Department of Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-29
decision_details_body: - The Department of Agriculture which comes under the purview of the Ministry of Agriculture is the main institute responsible for  agricultural activities of the country and its prime objective is to enhance the income and the living standards of farmers by increasing production and productivity and also providing the consumer with quality agricultural products at a reasonable price.  The proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Hon. Duminda Dissanayake,  for the appointment of a Committee named 'The Advisory Committee to the Department of Agriculture' comprising of the Agriculture related Institutions and of the officials and personnel represent the Agriculture Sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Paddy Purchase during the Maha Season
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-29
decision_details_body: - The Minister of Food Security, Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera brought to the notice of the Cabinet that the Ministry of Food Security during the period from 19th February 2015 to date, has purchased 148,973 MT of paddy directly from the farmers and as well as from the farmer organizations through the Paddy Marketing Board and Co?operative Societies, that the General Treasury had provided Rs.7,200 million for the purpose and that it is the largest stock of paddy the Government has so far intervened to purchase since the year 2007.

description: The Proposed Constitutional Amendment to amend the existing Electoral System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - In view of the public opinion expressed at the last Presidential election and the common request made by the political parties, His Excellency the President presented to the Cabinet a Draft Proposal containing the necessary provisions to introduce a Mixed Electoral System which enables the election of Members of Parliament for each and every constituency and electorate directly and also in proportionate to the votes gain by respective political parties, discarding the existing preferential voting system from the Electoral System of Sri Lanka.  The Cabinet decided to present the constitutional amendments for a new Electoral System after obtaining the views of the all parties concerned, based on the above draft proposal.

description: Outer Circular Highway (OCH) Project  (Phase III) - Commencement of work in Phase III of the Outer Circular Highway from Kerawalapitiya to Kadawatha (9.32 km)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - Outer Circular Highway (OCH) Phase III starts from Kerawalapitiya and ends at Kadawatha, has a length of 9.32 km. The civil works contract approved under this Phase amounts to Rs.66,689 million and 95% of the above contract  will be financed by the EXIM Bank of China. The land acquisition work in this regard is nearing completion by now and the total outstanding payment as compensation for land acquisition is Rs.1,100 million.  The proposal made by the Minister of Highways and Investment Promotion, Hon. Kabir Hashim, to commence the work of the above project under the revised work programme as recommended by the Review Committee appointed to evaluate the technical and financial aspect of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Mahaweli Water Security Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - The main objective of this programme is to maximize the productivity of Mahaweli waters by transferring the available water to the North Western, North Central and Northern Provinces for irrigation, drinking and commercial purposes. The Construction of a new and improved water conveyance and storage of infrastructure under this programme will increase the productivity of the agricultural lands and also provide safe drinking water for people living in the above provinces mitigating the risks of the chronic kidney disease prevalent in these areas. Three investment projects, namely the Upper Elahera Canal Project, the North Western Province Canal Project and the Minipe Left Bank Canal Rehabilitation Project, will be implemented under the above investment programme.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs, to enter into loan agreements with the Asian Development Bank for obtaining the necessary funds to implement the 1st Phase of this programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Transmission and Distribution Network Development and Efficiency Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - The requirement of electricity in Sri Lanka is growing at an average rate of 5% to 7% annually during the last decade and this trend persists with the economic development of the country. Therefore, while taking measures to increase the electricity generation, it is also necessary to strengthen electricity transmission and distribution network for mitigating the system losses in order to obtain quality and uninterrupted electricity supply for all people in the country. Accordingly, the above project is expected to be implemented and the Government of Japan has agreed to provide a loan for this purpose, amounting to Japanese Yen 24,930 million (approximately Rs.26,873 million) through the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA). The proposal made by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs, to sign the Exchange of Notes with the Government of Japan and to enter into a loan agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and  JICA for this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the USAID Agreements
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - Since 1956, US supported Programmes have been implemented in Sri Lanka on  the sectors of health, education and technical training and agricultural and livelihood development, environment and natural resource management, local governance and humanitarian assistance. The United States Agency for International Development (USAID) continues to work with Sri Lanka to address the key development priorities towards achieving good governance, economic growth and humanitarian assistance.  The proposal made by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, in his capacity as the Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs to extend the period of the agreements related to the programmes in progress, with a view to gaining the potential benefits, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Planning The Greater Colombo Area and the Western Region Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - The Western Region including the City of Colombo is emerging as one of the fast growing regions in South Asia and the region is of paramount importance in the economic growth of the country.  The existence of a sound city development strategy is essential for sustainable development. Therefore, it has been proposed to upgrade the status of the Colombo city in the near future to convert it into a regional finance and business hub and a prominent township in South Asia.  It is the responsibility of the Government to guide the development of the Western Region and the Colombo City through a comprehensive, inclusive and dynamic planning process to realize these goals.   Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe in his capacity as the Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs, to adjust the Western Region Megapolis Plan prepared in 2004 to suit the present conditions and to proceed with the related activities, with a view to expediting the planning process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Audit Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body:
- It has been pledged that a National Audit Bill will be presented in Parliament under the 100 Days Programme of the Government.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister, Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe to present the above  Bill in Parliament as an urgent Bill as provided for in the Article 122 of the Constitution with a view to ensuring the effective implementation of the powers vested in Parliament over Public Finance Management through the Constitution, was approved by the Cabinet. The salient features of the above Bill are as follows: 

*	the Bill provides for any member of the public the right to bring to the notice of the Auditor General any matter and the Auditor General may inquire into such matters and submit a report thereon to the Parliament.  

*	when there are no auditing standards specified in Sri Lanka for performance audits, technical audits etc.,  the International Standards shall apply.

*	the Bill casts a duty on an Audit Officer not to disclose any information received by him in the course of performing his duties. 
*	the Auditor General shall submit a report annually to the Parliament on the results of the audits carried out by him during the year.  

*	the Auditor General shall submit to the Parliament the Technical Reports once in every three years.  

*	An Audit Service Commission, the members of which are appointed by the President, will be established. 

*	with effect from the date the proposed Bill comes into operation, the Auditor Generals' Department will cease to function and its functions will be vested in the Audit Service Commission. The staff attached to the Department will be absorbed into the new Commission.

description: Right to Information Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body:
- It has been pledged that the draft Bill on Right to Information will be presented in Parliament under the 100 Days Programme of the Government.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe to present the above Bill in Parliament as an urgent Bill as provided for in the Article 122 of the Constitution, was approved by the Cabinet.  The salient features of the above Bill are as follows: 

*	That the Right to Information is afforded to every citizen of Sri Lanka.

*	The right of access to information is the right to obtain such information from the possession, custody or control of a public authority.  Nevertheless, the access to information may be refused in the following instances where:

(i)	the information relates to personal information, the disclosure of which has no relationship to public activity or interest or which would cause invasion of the privacy of the individual.

(ii)	the information, the disclosure of which would seriously affect the defence of the State or its territorial integrity or national security or is likely to be seriously prejudicial to Sri Lanka's international relations or its obligation under the  International Law.  

(iii)	the information, the disclosure of which would cause  serious prejudice to the economy of Sri Lanka.

(iv)	the information, the disclosure of which would  reveal any trade secrets or cause harm to commercial interests of any person.

(v)	the information, the disclosure of which would  reveal the medical reports relating to any person. 

(vi)	the information, the disclosure of which is not permitted under Section 126 of the Evidence Ordinance. 

(vii)	the information, which is required to be treated as confidential due to the existence of a fiduciary relationship. 


(viii)	the information relates to prevention or detection  of any crime or the  apprehension  or prosecution of offenders or  the disclosure of which would cause obstruction to such activities.  

(ix)	the information, which is held in confidence by the relevant public authority. 

(x)	the information, the disclosure of which would result in contempt of Court or impinge the privileges of Parliament. 

(xi)	the information, which relates to an examination conducted by the Department of Examinations or Higher Educational Institution which is required to be kept confidential.  

*	The Right to Information Commission will be established to facilitate the implementation of the right of access to information.  This Commission will intervene to determine the information required to be  maintained in confidence.     

*	The effective implementation of the provisions of this Bill is entrusted with the Minister in-charge of the subject of Public Administration.

description: The project for the supply of equipment of high quality Radiotherapy with High Energy Radiation including the infrastructure for Cancer Patients in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - The Government, having taken into consideration the fact that the number of Cancer Patients in the country is increasing rapidly, has identified the establishment of high quality Radiotherapy equipment with high energy radiation in the main cancer centres as a matter of high priority.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, Hon. Rajitha Senaratne to procure the Linear Accelerators, Brachy Therapy Units and CT Simulators for the National Cancer Institute, Maharagama and also for  the Cancer Centres at General Hospital-Kandy, Teaching Hospital-Jaffna, Teaching Hospital-Karapitiya and the Teaching Hospital-Batticaloa, under the Phase I of the above Project, during the period from 2015 to 2017, utilizing   the aids of the World Bank and funds of the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Uniform Material to distribute among Dhamma School Teachers - 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - The Government, since the year 2004, implements the programme of distributing uniforms to the teachers who serve voluntarily in Dhamma Schools throughout the country. The proposal made by the Minister of Buddha Sasana, Hon. Karu Jayasuriya to procure 30,000 local handloom sarees with jacket pieces (uniforms) at the rate of Rs.1,400/- each, worth of Rs.42 million from the Department of Textile Industries which is a state entity, under this programme, for the year 2015, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement for the transfer of Sentenced Persons between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Russian Federation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - The Transfer of Offenders Act No.5 of 1995 of Sri Lanka provides for a citizen of another country convicted and sentenced to imprisonment by a Court of Sri Lanka to serve his sentence in the country of which he claims to be a citizen.  Likewise, the Act also provides for a Sri Lankan citizen imprisoned in another country to be transferred back to Sri Lanka to serve the balance period of his sentence.  The provisions of this Act apply only when an agreement in this regard has been entered into between Sri Lanka and another country.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Hon. Wijayadasa Rajapaksa to enter into the above agreement for the transfer of sentenced persons between Government of Sri Lanka and the Russian Federation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Registering a Government owned Company to operate International Arbitration Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - Considering the potentials and  the professional standards of the legal sector prevalent in the country, the attention has been focused to develop Sri Lanka as a regional hub allied to legal services.  As a step towards achieving this goal,  an International Centre for Arbitration was established in Sri Lanka with the  objective of meeting the demands of the International Business Community, for an impartial, efficient and reliable dispute resolution mechanism in Asia.  The activities of this centre is expected to be commenced  from the month of May this year and the proposal made by the Minister of Justice, Hon. Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, to establish a company owned by the Government to curry out its administrative functions  successfully, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Accident and Emergency Care Policy in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has achieved remarkable health status indicators those can be  compared equally with the health status indicators of the developed countries. However, Accident and Emergency Care Services need further development and in the recent past since there has been an increased incidence of accidents and emergencies, the urgent need for an emergency care services has been intensified.  The policy proposes to introduce a well coordinated, stratified and cost?effective accident and emergency care service by establishing new units or upgrading the existing Accident and Emergency Units with a health system approach for timely access to integrated care in all emergencies to prevent death and disability with a view to providing prompt and quality patient care services with safety, dignity and compassion. 'The Accident and Emergency Care Policy in Sri Lanka' presented by the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, Hon. Rajitha Senaratne, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bibile Sugar Development Project proposed to be implemented in the Districts of Badulla and Ampara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - A project titled the 'Bibile Sugar Development Project' is expected to be implemented within the Divisional Secretary's Divisions of Ridimaliyadda in the Badulla District and Padiyathalawa and Mahaoya Divisional Secretary's Divisions of Ampara District to cultivate sugar canes mainly for the manufacture of sugar and cultivation of mixed crops, rearing milch cows, cultivation of Gliricidia and to generate renewable energy with the use of discarded  parts of Gliricidia stems involving the participation of farmers of the respective areas.  In this endevour, a block of land of 2.5 hectares is given to each farmer living in the area to generate a sustainable income and the income so anticipated for each family will be around Rs.60,000 to Rs.80,000 per month.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation  Industries, Hon. Lakshman Kiriella to implement the above project and to proceed with its activities was approved by the Cabinet in principle.

description: Amendments to Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance No.19 of 1931
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - The Government in its 100 Day Programme has pledged that it will endevour to make the amendments proposed to Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance on the advice, the instructions, the guidance and the approval of the chief prelates. The Bill to amend the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance so prepared was presented to the Cabinet by the Minister of Buddha Sasana, Hon. Karu Jayasuriya.  After discussion, it was deferred for the views of the Ministers concerned.

description: 'Gaalu Samaya - 2015'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - The 'Gaalu Samaya' festival and the carnival comprising of agricultural, trade and industrial exhibitions aimed at tourist attraction was held in high glamour in the year 2008 and 2009 in the Galle City to expose the world the beauty, the dignity and the splendour of the Southern Sri Lanka, especially of the Galle District. The Minister of Public Administration, Local Government and Democratic Governance, Hon. Karu Jayasuriya brought to the notice of the Cabinet that the necessary arrangements have been made to hold the 'Gaalu Samaya - 2015' festival and carnival on 27th, 28th, 29th, 30th and 31st of  December this year in the Galle City, with the cooperation of both the Southern Provincial Council and the Galle Municipal Council.

description: Initiation of Bilateral Political Consultations by Sri Lanka with the Republic of the Philippines and the Kingdom of Cambodia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-22
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka maintains longstanding bilateral relations with the Republic of  Philippines and the Kingdom of Cambodia and there is a potential to expand these relations into new sectors of cooperation for mutual benefit.  As such, the Philippines and the Kingdom of Cambodia continue to cooperate with Sri Lanka in regional and multilateral forums.   Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka to enter into the Memoranda of Understanding on Political Consultations with the Department of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Philippines and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of the Kingdom of Cambodia, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Office for National Unity
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, for the  establishment of an Office for National Unity, with a view to building an inclusive and peaceful society in Sri Lanka, where diversity will be respected and celebrated, and in which all communities will co?exist in harmony and unity, with a vision to  guarantee every citizen equal opportunities in the economic, social, cultural and political spheres, whilst safeguarding the Sri Lankan identity, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Cremation Ceremony of the Late Most Venerable Keerthi Sri Dhammadassi Rathnapala Buddharakkithabhidhana Thero, the Mahanayake of the Shiyamopali Maha Nikaya (Asgiriya Maha Vihara Chapter)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Karu Jayasuriya, the Minister of Buddha Sasana,  for the cremation ceremony of the Late Most Venerable Keerthi Sri Dhammadassi Rathnapala Buddharakkithabhidhana Thero, the Mahanayake of the Shiyamopali Maha Nikaya-Asgiriya Maha Vihara Chapter, the great Reverend Prelate who had rendered a noble societal mission,  a yeoman service to Buddhism and the Buddhist Order, nationally and internationally as well, to be held under full State Patronage and to declare that Sunday, the 12th of April 2015 as a National Day of Mourning, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Container Handling Cranes for East Container Terminal of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority (SLPA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Ports Authority has commenced activities to construct its own container terminal within the Colombo South Harbour, namely, 'the East Container Terminal'.  The proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, the Minister of Ports and Shipping,  to proceed with the necessary activities for procurement of container handling cranes, to commence the operational activities with the completion of the civil construction work, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increase of Mahapola Scholarship Payment and Bursary Payment of Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - The Budget - 2015 proposed to increase the Mahapola Scholarship payment up to Rs.5,000/- per month with effect from 2015?07?01.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, the Minister of Higher Education and Research, to implement that above proposal with effect from 2015-05-01 and to increase the Bursary payment from Rs.2,000/- to Rs.2,500/- effective from this date, with a view to create an environment conducive for studies, to the university student population, devoid of problems, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Bilateral Consultation between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Royal Government of Bhutan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - Establishment of a mechanism for regular bilateral consultation between Colombo and Thimpu at the level of Foreign Secretaries is envisaged by the above Memorandum of Understanding, which will open up interactions  with regard to important bilateral matters, regional and international issues of mutual interest including the views on political, economic, cultural and educational cooperation. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ajith P Perera, the Acting Minister of Foreign Affairs, to enter into the above Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Royal Government of Bhutan, during the forthcoming visit of Hon. Tshering Tobgay, Prime Minister of Bhutan, to Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Driver Training Track and the Vehicle Parking Area to be constructed at Werahera Office Premises of the Department of Motor Traffic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - Practical tests related to driving licenses issued by the Department of Motor Traffic are conducted on district basis and the practical tests pertinent to Colombo district are conducted at its office premises at Werahera.  Werahera Office receives about 10,000 applications per month for the above practical tests and presently, such practical tests are being done on the main road.  Conducting these practical tests on the main road is a difficult task and other countries of the world practise different developed methods for this purpose.  As such, the construction of a driver training track is identified as a prioritized matter to be implemented expeditiously. The proposal made in this regard by Hon. R.M.Ranjith Maddumabandara, the Minister of Internal Transport, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Consultancy Services for Broadlands Hydropower Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, the Minister of Power and Energy, to award the Contract for consultancy services of Broadlands Hydropower Project, to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau, as per the recommendation of the Project Committee appointed for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Intellectual Property Act, No. 36 of 2003 to enhance the protection given for Geographical Indications of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, the Minister of Industry and Commerce, to make necessary regulations under the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003 and to draft pertinent amending legislations to prevent the detriment caused to the country due to the fraudulent use of the Trade Names and to safeguard the interests of the producers and exporters of Ceylon Tea, Pure Ceylon Tea, Sri Lanka Tea, Pure Sri Lanka Tea, Ceylon Cinnamon, Pure Ceylon Cinnamon, Sri Lanka Cinnamon, Pure Sri Lanka Cinnamon etc. accepted as attributed to Sri Lanka alone, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Transfer of Lands for the Second Phase of the Hambanthota Port
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - Under the Second Phase of the Hambanthota Port Project, 491.5 hectares of lands have been identified for acquisition and these lands are to be utilized for the Port development activities and as well as for the creation of industries related to the Port.  There are about 400 families presently residing in these lands which are to be acquired  and the proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga,  the Minister of Ports and Shipping, to provide them with alternative lands and compensation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting of the 37th Asian Conference on Remote Sensing in Sri Lanka during October - November, 2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - The Asian Conference on Remote Sensing held annually to explore the possibilities of using the latest technology on surveying and mapping and it is a prestigious annual event organized by the Asian Association on Remote Sensing and its host country.  It is held in rotation in the countries within the Asia Pacific Region to promote Remote Sensing Technology and its applications.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. M.K.A.D.S.
