Gunawardana, the Minister of Lands, to host the 37th Asian Conference on Remote Sensing in Sri Lanka, during the months of October and November,2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Special Cardiac Surgery Programme for underprivileged Children at Lady Ridgeway Children Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - The structural problems of the heart prevail at the birth are known as “Congenital Heart Defects” and it is estimated by now that approximately 2,500 to 3,000 children are born with congenital heart defects in Sri Lanka annually, and out of which around 2,000 children have to undergo corrective surgeries.  Currently about 900 children undergo similar surgeries at the Lady Ridgeway Hospital for Children every year and only a small number of surgeries are performed at Teaching Hospital, Karapitiya and Sri Jayawardenapura General Hospital.  At present, there are thousands of children waiting in the lists till their opportunity comes for the surgery, but most of them succumb to their illness or develop irreversible complications while waiting for surgery.  As such, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, to implement a programme for “after working hours cardiac surgery” at the Lady Ridgeway Hospital for Children as the best possible measure can be taken to perform above surgeries without further delay with the financial sponsorship of the “Gift of Life International”, an organization relates to Rotary Club, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka National Policy on Alcohol Control
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - Alcohol consumption is identified as a significant contributor to the global burden of diseases and it is also listed as the prime risk factor that leads to premature deaths and disabilities reported in low and lower middle income countries.  As reported, the Cirrhosis mortality rate among male in Sri Lanka is 33.4 per 100,000, which is the highest in the world.  Alcohol is strongly related with large number of suicides and deliberate self-harm prevail in the country. It is also a cause for domestic violence that prevails within the families. As such, a complex relationship subsists between alcohol consumption and poverty in Sri Lanka.  The necessity of having an effective national policy on alcohol control has been identified  by all other stakeholders inclusive of the Ministry of Health and Indigenous Medicine and the National Mental Health Committee. Accordingly, the Sri Lanka National Policy on Alcohol Control presented by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy on Cancer Prevention and Control
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - Cancer is identified as one of the major diseases reported in Sri Lanka in recent times.  The cancer incidence rate which was 37.6 per 100,000 persons in the year 1985 has been increased to 74.2 per 100,000 persons by the year 2005.  This shows an increasing trend in cancer frequency in Sri Lanka. The  10 most common cancer types in Sri Lanka are the cancers of breast, oral cavity, esophagus, cervix, lungs, thyroid, colon & rectum, lymphoma, ovary and leukemia.  The National Health Policy of Sri Lanka and the Health Master Plan  2007-2016 have recognized the prevention and control of cancer as part of  a broader concept of the Non-Communicable Disease prevention.  Accordingly, the National Policy and  Strategic Framework encompassing all actions to minimize the difficulties faced by the public due to cancer, presented by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of 100 Day Programme to provide land ownership and proper housing to Plantation Workers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - It is declared in the 100 Day Programme that the action will be taken to provide land ownership and proper housing to plantation workers instead of their current confinement in line rooms. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.Lakshman Kiriella, the Minister of Plantation Industries, to implement the measures identified to be followed for the said purpose with the concurrence of all relevant stakeholders, to provide the estate workers each with a plot of land in extent of 07 perches, to provide them with a bankable document for those lands and to take back the houses constructed under different schemes and given to the beneficiaries, but subsequently transferred to third parties illegally and vest the said houses with the Estate Worker Housing Co-operative Societies without providing compensation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recognition of INTERPOL Travel Document in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-08
decision_details_body: - The International Criminal Police Organization (ICPO) of which Sri Lanka is also a member, has introduced a special travel document to enable the officers of the INTERPOL and the law enforcement officers who travel abroad to conduct transnational investigations pertaining to the official duties of INTERPOL, to obtain visas expeditiously.   At present, 72 member countries of the ICPO, including several Asian countries such as Malaysia, Maldives, Pakistan, Nepal, Afghanistan, Laos, Philippines and Singapore have recognized this special travel document. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, the Minister of Public Order and Christian Affairs, to enter into an Agreement for the recognition of said Special Travel Document, as per the request made by ICPO and to authorize the Inspector General of Police to sign the said Agreement on behalf of the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recruitment of a Team of Retired Police Officers to assist the activities of Anti-Corruption Committee Secretariat
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to recruit a team of retired police officers to the Anti-Corruption Committee Secretariat for a period of 03 months on temporary basis in order to assist the carrying out of the activities of the Anti-corruption Committee Secretariat expeditiously and efficiently, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Guaranteed Price Scheme for Natural Raw Rubber Produced by Rubber Smallholders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-01
decision_details_body: - Considering the substantial decrease in prices of raw rubber in the local market, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe the Prime Minister, to pay the difference between the local market price and the guaranteed price by the Rubber Development Department directly to the Rubber Smallholders, based on the prices of the local market, instead of the method approved earlier by the Cabinet which was based on the prices of the international market and accordingly to adopt the aforesaid new method with effect from 1st April 2015, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Unsolicited Project Proposals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-01
decision_details_body:
- During the last few years there appeared a tendency to submit unsolicited project proposals by the project proposers for the approval of the Cabinet and the matter was subject to criticisms.  As the cost of unsolicited project proposals is not decided upon, on a competitive basis, the country had to bear an exorbitant expenditure unbearable to the national economy. Having taken stock of this situation, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister,  as the Minister of Policy  Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs to adopt the following measures, was approved by the Cabinet: 

* 	not to accept unsolicited proposals in future as a matter of policy.

*  	to take action with regard to all such proposals in compliance with the Government Procurement Guidelines, in the future.

to review the proposals under implementation at various stages, and submit each proposal found to have exceptional economic value for the country, for the approval of the Cabinet.

description: On-going negotiations relating to establishment of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-01
decision_details_body: - On a request made by the People's Republic of China in December 2013, Sri Lanka participated in multilateral consultation meetings as a founder member of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank planned to be established by the end of the year 2015.  Along with the 21 nations who expressed their willingness to join the bank as founder members, Sri Lanka signed the relevant Memorandum of Understanding on 24th October 2014.  Accordingly,  Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, as the Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs informed the Cabinet that Sri Lanka too has become eligible to participate in the negotiation process for the establishment of the bank.

description: The Academic Co-operation Agreement (ACA) between Lakshman Kadirgamar Institute of International Relations & Strategic Studies (LKIIRSS) of Sri Lanka and National Defence University (NDU) of Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Mangala Samaraweera, Minister of Foreign Affairs, to sign the above Academic Co-operation Agreement during the proposed state visit to Pakistan by H.E. the President  between the Lakshman Kadirgamar Institute of International Relations & Strategic Studies (LKIIRSS) of Sri Lanka and the National Defence University (NDU) of Pakistan with a view to enhancing cooperation in sharing of knowledge, experiences and information in areas of mutual interest, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Gazette Notifications Published for the approval of the Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-01

description: Rs.550 million (Japanese Yen 500 million) grant for the provision of Japanese local products under Japanese Non Project Grant Aid - 2014/2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-01
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan under its annual Non-Project Grant Aid to Sri Lanka, has agreed to provide a grant aid amounting to Japanese Yen 500 million (Approximately Rs.550 million) for the provision of Japanese equipment to promote transport facilities and agricultural activities of the citizens of Sri Lanka, with a view to strengthening the longstanding friendly  relations between the two countries.  The equipment is to be distributed to the Department of Sri Lanka Railways and the Government Agricultural Institutions under the Ministry of Agriculture. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Prime Minister Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe as the Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs to sign the Exchange of  Notes between the Governments of Japan and Sri Lanka in regard to the above grant, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Mutual Cooperation between  the  Ceylon  Shipping  Corporation  Ltd.  (CSC) and the Pakistan  National Shipping Corporation (PNSC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-01
decision_details_body: - Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding between the National Flag Carriers with the sanction of the two Governments will pave the way for the two National Flag Carriers to further strengthen cooperation between them. The proposal made by Hon.Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Ports and Shipping to sign the Memorandum of Understanding during the State Visit of H.E. the President of Sri Lanka to Pakistan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Penal Code
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-01
decision_details_body: - The Lessons Learnt and Reconciliation Commission (LLRC) was appointed with the mandate to have a flashback of the armed conflict that Sri Lanka experienced and to ensure the dawn of an era where reconciliation is built and issues involved are resolved on the experiences so gained.  The Commission has observed  the instances where “Hate Speech” and statements relating to ethnicity and religion have aggravated ethnic and religious tensions in the past four or five decades. The Commission has recommended that tough laws be enacted to deal with such practices and these laws should strictly be enforced. The proposal made by Dr. Wijayadasa Rajapakshe, Minister of Justice, to publish the draft Bill in the Government Gazette as amended by the Legal Draftsman incorporating provisions in the Penal Code to prohibit and punish those who advocate religious and racial hatred and present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka Energy Sector Development Plan for a Knowledge Based Economy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-01
decision_details_body: - The Energy Sector Development Plan has been developed with a view to making available the maximum contribution of the energy sector for the strength required for development drive which strides along competing at international levels, making Sri Lanka as knowledge based middle income economy.  The prime objective of this Plan is to  provide an affordable, high quality and reliable energy supply for all citizens irrespective of their being rich of poor, while preserving the environment and giving priority to the indigenous sources of energy and minimizing regional disparities.  The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy, to implement the development plan (2015-2025), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme to Control Weligama Coconut Leaf Wilt and Rot Disease - 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-01
decision_details_body: - The Weligama Coconut Leaf Wilt and Rot Disease caused by a vector called “Phytoplasma” is a disease which brings destruction to  the coconut plantation.  This was first reported from the Weligama area in Matara district in the year 2006.  No decisive cure for the disease has yet been found in the world.  The disease is prevalent in 12 Divisional Secretary Divisions in the Matara District, 02 Divisional Secretary Divisions in the Hambantota District and 02 Divisional Secretary Divisions in the Galle District and the authorities have taken all necessary precautions to prevent the spread of the disease to other areas.  The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, Minister of Plantation Industries, to continue the implementation of the project to control the spread of the disease, for a further period of 03 years from 2015 to 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Maintaining a Guaranteed Price of Rs.80/- per kilogramme of Raw Tea Leaf
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-01
decision_details_body: - To maintain a guaranteed price of Rs.80/- per  kilo gram of raw tea leaf produced by Tea Smallholders is one of the proposals incorporated in the 100 days programme of the Government and the proposal has also been included in the interim budget presented to the Parliament on 29th January 2015 by the Minister of Finance.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, Minister of Plantation Industries, to ensure a guaranteed price of Rs. 80/- per kilo gram of raw tea leaf produced by Tea Smallholders under the 100 days programme of the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: State Wesak Festival  - 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-01
decision_details_body: - It has been decided to hold State Wesak Festival this year at the Maiyangana sacred area in the Badulla District and it is anticipated to seek the patronage / sponsorship of the private sector for selected programmes that will be held in parallel with the Wesak Festival. The proposal made by Minister of Buddha Sasana Hon.Karu Jayasuriya to obtain necessary financial allocation to carry out the activities envisaged under the State Wesak Festival, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Registration of Persons Act, No.32 of 1968 to make provisions to establish a persons’ data base containing biometric information and for the issuance of Electronic National Identity Card
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-04-01
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, Minister of Public Order and Christian Affairs, to publish the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman to amend the  Registration of Persons' Act, No.32 of 1968 incorporating provisions to issue an Electronic National Identity Card and to establish a persons’ data base containing biometric information (finger prints) in the Government Gazette and to present the draft Bill in Parliament thereafter for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Identifying the root cause of the Chronic Kidney Decease (CKD) and carrying out water treatment in the affected areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-23
decision_details_body: - The Chronic Kidney Decease, the root cause of which has not yet been identified precisely, continues to spread in the North Central, North Western, Uva, Central, Eastern and Nothern Provinces of Sri Lanka and views have been expressed that the Hydro - Geological constituents in the drinking water to be the cause of the decease.  The proposal made by Mr, Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the Research Centre for Science in China and the Ministry of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage for conducting further research in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Future Course of Action relating to the Head Works of Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project (UOMDP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-23
decision_details_body: - The Agreement signed with M/s FARAB Co. of Iran for the construction work of the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project (UOMDP) is in force and the physical progress achieved in the project up to now is 47%.  However, with the ingress of water into the Head Race Tunnel at the end of 2014, some socio-economic issues like drying up of wells, developing cracks in houses and crop damage etc. have surfaced in 6 Grama Niladari Divisions around Bandarawela and Ella Divisional Secretary's Divisions.  As such, until the receipt of the recommendations of the Central Environment Authority and the Panel of Experts appointed specially for the purpose, the construction of the head works had been temporarily suspended with effect from 2015?02?16 except for those essential work on sealing the water ingress into the Head Race Tunnel and the other work of protective nature.  The reports of the Panel of Experts as well as the Central Environment Authority have now been received.  Accordingly, most of the remedial measures recommended by those committees have to be implemented by the Contractual Construction Co. and a monitoring mechanism is required to be adopted to prevent the occurrence of circumstances of above nature in future.  The proposal made by H.E. Maithripala Sirisena, the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Mahaweli Development and Environment to construct above 600 houses damaged due to ingress of water into the Tunnel, to provide uninterrupted supply of pipe borne water by the Water Supply and Drainage Board for the affected families and to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee comprising the Minister in-charge of the Subject and other Ministers representing the respective area to make recommendations, as to how the future activities of the project should be handled, taking also into consideration the recommendations of the  Central Environment Authority and the  Panel of Experts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on mutual co?operation and  exchange of news between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the State of Qatar
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Mr. Gayantha Karunathilaka, Minister of Mass Media and Parliamentary Affairs, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and the Government of State of Qatar with a view to developing bilateral corporation in the field of news exchange	between the two countries, in parallel with the official visit of Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, the Emir of the State of Qatar scheduled on 24th March 2015, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Maternity Benefits Ordinance and Shop and Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-23
decision_details_body: - The government sector women employees are entitled to 84 working days of leave irrespective of the number of confinements.  However, the two Acts i.e. the Maternity Benefits Ordinance and Shop and Office Employees Act which are applicable to woman employees in the private sector, grant 84 days of maternity leave in respect of only 02 child births and only 42 days of maternity leave for the 3rd child birth or subsequent child births and also the maternity benefits accorded to them vary accordingly.  Furthermore, under the Maternity Benefits Act, woman worker in the estate sector gets only three fourths of the maternity benefits whereas the woman workers in other sectors receive the full benefits.  Accordingly, taking into account the facts highlighted by various social organizations such as trade unions, various worker groups, International Labour Organization (ILO) and human rights activists with regard to the apparent anomalies in granting maternity leave and maternity benefits to the woman workers in the government, private and plantation sectors, the proposal made by Dr. Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, Minister of Justice, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation to the  Maternity Benefits Ordinance and to the Shop and Office Employees (Regulation of Employment and Remuneration) Act for the purpose of granting entitlement of 84 days of maternity leave to woman workers in both the private and the plantation sectors when a child birth occurs irrespective of the number of previous confinements they have had, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rural Road Re-awakening Programme - 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-23
decision_details_body: - The Minister of Highways, Higher Education and Investment Promotion has prepared a project proposal for the rehabilitation and improvement of rural roads covering all the 160 electorates in Sri Lanka. The objective of this project is to improve rural roads which will have a greater impact on the day to day lives of the people living in the villages. It will also provide an opportunity for the people of the area to participate in the development activities through the implementation of road development projects  identified by the community based organizations in the area concerned.  It is also intended herein to generate employment opportunities at village level, by way of supplying raw material and manufacturing concrete blocks.  The proposal made by Mr. Kabir Hashim, Minister of Highways, Higher Education and Investment Promotion, to implement the above project, was  approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development work of the Base Hospital, Teldeniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-23
decision_details_body: - The Japan International Corporation Agency (JICA) project to develop basic social services targeting emerging regions has selected Teldeniya Base Hospital in the district of Kandy to improve its secondary level health care facilities.  The proposal made by Dr. Rajitha Senaratne, Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, to obtain an additional estimated financial provision of Rs.200 Mn. to install a mechanical and electrical system in the hospital to be in line with its undergoing development activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Augmentation of Killinochchi Grid Substation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-23
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Mr. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy, to award the contract for the Augmentation of Killinochchi Grid Substation utilizing the balance funds available under the Japan International Corporation Agency (JICA) loan scheme, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Greater Kandy Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-23
decision_details_body: - The Greater Kandy Water Supply Project Phase 1 Stage II is funded by the Japan International Corporation Agency (JICA) and it is implemented to meet the high demand for pipe borne water in the Greater Kandy Area.  Phase I Stage II of this project includes the construction of a service tank, pumping station, official residences, transmission and distribution lines and road rehabilitation.  Since the newly introduced scope of work of the project has increased the estimated cost thereof, the proposal made by  Mr. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage to revise the total cost estimate on the recommendations of the Cost Estimate Examination Committee and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and also to extend the duration of the project up to 2015?06?20, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Northern Province International Relations Centre Building Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-23
decision_details_body: - Northern Province International Relations Centre which is under construction at Kankasanthurai in Jaffna, on a decision taken by the Cabinet of Ministers in January 2014, is equipped with several facilities such as water, electricity, telephone and internet and has a floor area of 113,000 sq. ft. In addition, this complex, consists of an internal road network, a garden, two swimming pools, generators, elevators and water treatment plants.  At present, nearly 70% of the work on the construction has been completed. The approved estimated cost of this construction is Rs.1587.8 Mn. and the expenditure incurred for the work carried out so far amounts to Rs. 966.3 Mn. The proposal made by H.E. Maithripala Sirisena, the President, to complete only the essential balance work in line with the engineering plan and to vest the building complex in a government, semi-government or any other suitable institution for public use, was approved by the Cabinet.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18

description: Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and the State of Qatar for the Development of Sports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18
decision_details_body:
- The proposal made by Hon. Navin Dissanayake, Minister of Tourism and Sports, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of Qatar for the development of Sports was approved by the Cabinet.  In this regard the parties will work for the development of Sports and Cooperation inclusive of the following areas: 

*	sports for persons with special needs 
*	control of prohibited stimulants 
*	management and maintenance of sports facilities 
*	training camps 
*	cooperation in all fields related to sports movement and its 	development 
*	any other sports cooperation agreed upon

description: Special Presidential Task Force on Recovery of State Assets
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, the President to establish a Special Presidential Task Force to investigate, identify, trace, seize and transfer to Sri Lanka, State assets and revenue due to the Government of Sri Lanka which have been illegally or unlawfully acquired or procured by Sri Lankan Nationals and other persons acting on behalf of Sri Lankan nationals or otherwise, and are being concealed or kept outside the territory of Sri Lanka  by such persons and others acting on their behalf, and take effective steps to cause their seizure and transfer or return to Sri Lanka to be confiscated and vested in the General Treasury, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Second Phase of the renovation of the Superior Courts Complex Building
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18
decision_details_body:
The Superior Courts Complex Building  where the Supreme Court, Appeals Court and the Ministry of Justice of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka are housed, was constructed by the Chinese Government in the decade of 1980 and on a request made by the Government of Sri Lanka to the Government of the Republic of China, the 1st phase of its renovations was  successfully completed in the years 2013 and 2014 as a free gift from the Chinese Government.  The proposal made by Hon. Wijayadasa Rajapaksha, Minister of Justice and Labour Relations, to enter into a preliminary Agreement with the Republic of China to bring a  specialized Chinese Team of Designers to the country to attend to initial designing of the following renovations as the second phase of the said renovations to be carried out as a gift from the  Chinese Government, was approved by the Cabinet: 

*	structural changes to the layout of the building 
*	repairs to the entire electrical system 
*	repairs to the drainage system 
*	repairs to the telephone system 
*	repairs to the fire guard system and 
*	repairs to the air conditioning system

description: Contract on Bandaranaike International Airport, Runaway Widening, Overlay and Associated Work
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Arjuna Ranatunga, Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation, to cancel the award of the above contract, as it has been established that the award of the above contract had not been made in a transparent manner following  the competitive tender procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for Construction of Defence Headquarters Complex at Akuregoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, Minister of Finance to appoint a Committee under the Chairmanship of the Secretary, Ministry of Defence and comprising of Senior Officials of the Ministries of Finance; Urban Development; and Water Supply and Drainage, Department of Buildings and the Auditor General's Department to submit a Report on the  entire project which had been estimated at an exorbitant cost including its scope, total cost,  operational time?frames and awarding of consultancy contracts and to pursue action in pursuant to the said Report, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Asian Development Bank funded Integrated Road Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18
decision_details_body: The proposal made by Hon. Kabir Hashim, Minister of Highways, Higher Education and Investment Promotion to award 09 contract packages in the Southern Province under the Asian Development Bank Funded Integrated Road Investment Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer for the Year 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18
decision_details_body: The programme to provide fertilizer to the farmers at low prices under the Government's fertilizer subsidy scheme is handled by the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited and  the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Limited which function under the Ministry of Irrigation and Agriculture.  The proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, Minister of Irrigation and Agriculture to procure fertilizer on the recommendations made by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of Sanitary facilities among resettled communities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. D.M. Swaminathan, Minister of Resettlement, Reconstruction and Hindu Religious Affairs, to construct a Sanitary Unit each at a maximum cost of Rs.50,000/- per family with a view to improving sanitary facilities among the resettled communities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Houses for Plantation Communities affected by landslides or living in high risk landslide prone areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18
decision_details_body: - In accordance with the studies and assessments made by the National Building Research Organization, the Plantation Community affected by landslides and living in high risk landslides prone areas should expeditiously be resettled in safer locations. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Palani Digambaram, Minister of Plantation Infrastructure Development, to construct houses at government expense under the 100 days programme to resettle the plantation workers who were affected by landslides and arson or relocated elsewhere due to risks of landslides, was approved by the Cabinet.  It was also noted that 300 houses will be constructed during the year 2015 under this programme.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between Pakistan and Sri Lanka for the Development of Sports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18

description: Implementation of the special program for uplifting villages throughout the island parallel to the 100 days Special Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18
decision_details_body: - This programme envisages uplifting of 36,822 villages in 14,023 Grama Niladhari Divisions covering the entire Island with the community participation. In this context, identifying projects, planning, implementing, supervising, reviewing, managing and maintaining projects, and the decision making process will have direct community participation. Under this programme Rs. one million will be provided to each village  and a village will have a project worth of Rs.1.25 million with a contribution of 25% by the community. The above proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, Minister of Housing and Samurdhi, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Guaranteed Price Scheme for Natural Raw Rubber produced by Rubber Smallholders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18
decision_details_body: - One of the proposals included in the 100 days programme of the new government is the implementation of a guaranteed price of Rs.350/- for natural raw rubber produced by the Rubber Small Holders. This proposal is also included in the Budget proposals presented in Parliament on 2015?01?29 by the Minister of Finance. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, Minister of Plantation Industries to implement the guaranteed price with effect from 2015?03?15 for the natural raw rubber produced by the Rubber Small Holders with the agreement of all the stakeholder parties who represent the rubber sector, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Immigration and Emigration Act in order to Introduce Biometrics to the Sri Lankan Passport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, Minister of Public Order, Disaster Management and Christian Affairs, to present in Parliament the Bill drafted by the Legal Draftsman to amend the Immigration and Emigration Act, No.20 of 1948 to enable the Department of Immigration and Emigration, which is the authority to issue and renew passports, to take finger prints of the applicant for inclusion in the passports, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between  Sri Lanka and Pakistan on Disaster Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18

description: Signing the Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan and the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka  against Illicit Trafficking in Narcotic Drugs, Psychotropic Substances and their Chemical Precursors
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-18
decision_details_body: - Discussions regarding bi-lateral corporation between Sri Lanka and Pakistan have commenced recently and further strengthening the bi?lateral corporation between the two countries against Illicit Trafficking in Narcotic Drugs, Psychotropic Substances and their Chemical Precursors is an area to which attention is greatly focused. As such, the proposal made by Hon. John Amarathunga, Minister of Public Order, Disaster Management and Christian Affairs to make aware of the seriousness of crimes relating to Narcotic Drugs, Psychotropic Substances and their Chemical Precursors, with a view to minimizing the imminent danger caused thereby to the society, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Vessel Monitoring System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-12
decision_details_body: - The incumbent Government has decided to take prompt actions to regain the European market for fisheries products  of Sri Lanka and the foreign exchange back to the country giving due consideration to the observations of the Indian Ocean Tuna Commission and the European Union, while giving preference to the views of the fisher community regarding the issues in the fisheries sector including the lifting of the ban already imposed on fish exports to the countries in the European Union. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon.Joseph Michael Perera, Minister of Home Affairs and Fisheries, to purchase 1,500 transponders and distribute them among the fishermen free of charge and to complete the process in that regard by August 2015, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Administrative Procedure for granting Dual Citizenship
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-12

description: Draft Bill on Right to Information
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-12
decision_details_body: - Government indents to draft and submit a Bill on Right to Information which enshrines provisions to ensure the right of the public to official information of the Government and to appoint a Commission for the purpose, with the intention to give effect to better implementation of democracy and good governance in the country and thereby to create an ethical society free of corruption in Sri Lanka.  	Accordingly, action has been taken to prepare a preliminary draft for the Bill by a Committee appointed for the purpose in association with the Ministries of Mass Media and Parliamentary Affairs; Public Administration, Provincial Councils, Local Government and Democratic Governance; and Justice and Labour and also  taking into consideration of the views of journalists, veterans in the legal field, representatives of the Non Governmental Organizations and Public Officers.  The proposal made by Hon.Gayantha Karunathilaka, Minister of Mass Media and Parliamentary Affairs, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation based on the above preliminary draft, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Youth Development to be signed between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and Republic of India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-12
decision_details_body: - The objectives of the Memorandum of Understanding to be signed between the State Ministry of Youth Affairs of the Government of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports of the Government of India are to share the knowledge, experience, and  resources between the parties and to develop long term cooperation between the two countries in respect of youth development. In this respect, the cooperation includes Youth Leadership and Personality Development Programmes, Youth Exchange Programmes, Youth Cultural Exchange Programmes, Exposure Programmes for the Young Entrepreneurs, etc. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, Minister of Policy Planning, Economic Affairs, Child, Youth and Cultural Affairs to enter into above Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer - Yala Season, 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-12
decision_details_body: - The programme to provide fertilizer to the farmers at subsidized prices is handled by both the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited and  the Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Limited which function under the Ministry of Irrigation and Agriculture.  The proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, Minister of Irrigation and Agriculture to procure fertilizer on the recommendations made by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Welfare Measures for Migrant Workers under the 100 Days Programme of the Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-12

description: Port City Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-04
decision_details_body: - In the Interim Report submitted by the Committee appointed to review the project and make recommendations to the Cabinet Sub?Committee on Economic Affairs, revealed that the activities of the project is being implemented without the proper regulatory clearances from all related institutions.  Taking into consideration the recommendations made in the Interim Report, the proposal made Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister, to temporarily suspend the operations of the project with immediate effect and to inform the company carrying out the project to produce valid permits/approvals if they have, in order to implement the project, within two weeks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Pension Scheme for Migrant Workers to be introduced under the accelerated 100 days programme of the Government
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-04
decision_details_body:
- The 100 days programme of the Government envisages to establish a Social Security Fund for the migrant workers with the contributions made by the employers, migrant workers and the Government of Sri Lanka and to provide relief there under to all migrant workers including house maids and unskilled workers who engage in services under tiring conditions. 

	The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, Minister of Foreign Employment, to appoint a Committee comprising of relevant stakeholders including Public Officers, representatives of Foreign Employment Agencies and Rataviruwo Organization to design the proposed Pension Scheme and to make proposals thereon, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Small Development Project Grant Assistance by the Government of India for the establishment of a state of the art Theater and Auditorium at the University of Ruhuna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-04
decision_details_body: - The Government of India has agreed to provide Rs.300 million on a grant assistance out of the cost of Rs.336 million estimated for the construction of a state of the art Theater and Auditorium with a seating capacity for 1500, at the University of Ruhuna, where approximately 7,320 students pursue higher studies in 46 Departments, and the proposal made by Hon. Kabeer Hasheem, Minister of Highways, Higher Education and Investment Promotion to sign the Memorandum of Understanding in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extending the term of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Government of India pertaining to the Project for the provision of sales facilities to Women Entrepreneurs and for the maintenance  of the Community Education Centre in the Batticaloa  District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Chandrani Bandara, Minister of Women's Affairs, to extend the duration up to 30th June 2016 of the project which was initiated in the year 2010 on a Memorandum of Understanding signed with the Government of India to economically and socially strengthen the war affected women in the Batticoloa District through the implementation of various Entrepreneur Development Training Courses,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rs.20,000/- Nutritional Food Package for Pregnant Mothers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-04

description: Implementation of Warehouse Receipts Financing System for Storage of Farm Produce by Farmers in the Dry Zone Districts of the Country
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-04
decision_details_body:
- The construction of warehouses in the districts of  Anuradhapura, Moneragala and Mannar, has been commenced under Phase I of the Warehouse Receipts Financing Mechanism introduced by the Government of Sri Lanka with a grant assistance from the World Bank, innovated a mechanism with a view to providing cultivators in the dry zone with high quality storage facilities to secure a higher income and profit for them by selling their produce in the off season rather than in the harvesting season and to providing them with financial assistance for the purpose. 

	The construction of the first warehouse under this programme inaugurated in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Galenbindunuwewa in the Anuradhapura district, has by now been completed and the proposal made by Hon. Ravi Karunanayake, Minister of Finance, to enter into a Management Service Agreement with the Divisional Development Bank and appoint the  District Secretary Anuradhapura, as the authorized operator thereof, was approved by the Cabinet

description: Distribution of subsidized fertilizer for paddy cultivation during Yala Season 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-04
decision_details_body: -The fertilizer subsidy provided for the paddy cultivation has resulted in high yields. Accordingly, the total extent of land envisaged for cultivation in the Yala season of 2015 is 540,000 hectares and the total  fertilizer requirement is estimated at 162,733 MT. Taking these facts into consideration, the proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, Minister of Irrigation and Agriculture, to implement the fertilizer subsidy scheme in the Yala Season 2015 and also to take necessary activities to purchase the required quantity of fertilizer ensuring its quality, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of vegetable seedlings at concessionary prices and  vegetable seeds on a 50% subsidy for small scale farm lands for off-season vegetable cultivation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-04
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, Minister of Irrigation and Agriculture, to present a pot of plant suitably prepared for easy cultivation to the people at a concessionary price amounting to Rs.25/-, instead of distributing vegetable seeds and to provide relief for seeds requirement to encourage farmers engaged in vegetable cultivation on commercial basis in selected lands in extent up to ½ acre, with a view to popularizing home garden concept, arresting the escalation in vegetable prices and to maintaining a fair price throughout the year, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: "Ceylon Tea Expo 2015" in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-03-04
decision_details_body: - The year 2017 marks the 150th year since the first commercial tea venture was  introduced in Sri Lanka and as such it is proposed to organize the Tea Expo Exhibition in 2017 instead in 2015 to be  parallel to the commemoration of the 150th Anniversary with the participation of stakeholders of the entire tea industry including the local producers and exporters. The proposal made by the Hon. Lakshman Kiriella, Minister of Plantation Industries, to make it an opportunity to create a promotional avenue for Sri  Lanka tea in the World Market with a view to popularizing and fetching a high price for Sri Lanka tea, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Printing of School Text Books - 2015 - State Printing Corporation, Associated Newspapers of Ceylon Ltd. and Department of Government Printing
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Gayantha Karunathilaka, Minister of Mass Media and Parliamentary Affairs, to award the printing of school text books also to the State Printing Corporation, Associated Newspapers of Ceylon Ltd. and Department of Government Printing, taking into consideration the printing capacity of these state institutions and performance of previous years was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Plan to convert the Ayurvedic Hospital of Borella into a Teaching Hospital -Second Phase
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senarathna, Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, to revise the contract cost from Rs.728 million to Rs.1,113 million as recommended by the Cost Estimate Examination Committee to develop the Ayurvedic Hospital, Borella as a Teaching Hospital, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: ADB assisted Greater Colombo Water & Waste Water Management Improvement Investment Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage to award the contract as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) for the proposed project to be implemented under two stages to rehabilitate the present water supply system and reduce the non-revenue generating water within the Area Engineer's boundaries in the City of Colombo, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prevention of further spreading of the Kidney Disease and provision of the welfare of the patients affected and their families
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-25

description: Increase of Samurdhi Relief Assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-25
decision_details_body: - The Government has pledged to increase the Samurdhi Relief Assistance by 200% under the instant relief programme to be implemented by the Government within 100 Days and the Minister of Finance has proposed to implement it from April 2015, through the Interim Budget - 2015.    Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Sajith Premadasa, Minister of Housing and Samurdhi, to take necessary action in that regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Re-development and Mixed use Development Project at Slave Island, Colombo 02 - One Colombo (Pvt.) Ltd
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Kabeer Hasheem, Minister of Highways, Higher Education and Investment Promotion,  to review the entire project status of the above project launched to provide a more conducive living standard to the residents living there, with the implementation of a re-development and mixed use development project in a 8 acre land situated at Slave Island, Colombo 02, and to re-commence the process from the beginning in terms of the provisions of the Strategic Development Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of an accelerated programme to restore damages caused to Irrigation Systems due to heavy rain and flood in the latter part of the Year 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-25
decision_details_body: - Estimates have,  by now, been prepared on the damages caused to the minor and major irrigation systems due to excessive rains and floods during the latter part of 2014. Accordingly, the damages caused in 1348 places in the major irrigation systems in 13 districts and the 2132 damaged places in the minor irrigation systems in 15 districts  have been identified. The proposal made by Hon. Duminda Dissanayake, Minister of Irrigation and Agriculture, to repair the damages caused in the irrigation systems before the commencement of the Yala Season 2015, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Special Committee  to Inquire into Election Complaints
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-25
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Karu Jayasuriya, Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils, Local Government and Democratic Governance to establish a Special Committee to inquire into Election complaints,  comprising of experts in disciplines of Law, Administration, Election, Fiscal, and Investigation to initiate a proper, efficient and transparent mechanism to investigate the complaints made before and after the Presidential Election - 2015, on misuse of State Media, improper use of public property for election purposes, misappropriation of Government funds, use of public officers for political activities, violation of provisions of Act, No. 15 of  1981 relating to the Election of the President etc. and take necessary legal and disciplinary action expeditiously and to present its Report within sixty (60) days, in order to ensure confidence of the citizen on a free and fair election process before holding another National  Election,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: State visit to India by H.E. the President
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-18
decision_details_body: - H.E. the President informed the Cabinet that his visit to India from 15th to 18th of this month, the first state visit after his appointment as the Head of State, on an invitation extended to him by the Government of India was highly successful and it paved the way to further strengthen the historical relationship and the bilateral cooperation between the two countries.  His Excellency further stated that during his visit he has had successful bilateral discussions with His Excellency the President, the Hon. Prime Minister, the former Prime Minister and other leaders of India and had concluded four (04) Memoranda of Understanding.  The Cabinet also noted that the anticipated state visit of Hon. Prime Minister of India will take place in March this year, which is the first visit by a Head of State in India since 1987.

description: Visit to Washington DC and New York
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-18
decision_details_body: - the Minister of Foreign Affairs informed the Cabinet that he had an official visit to the United States of America on 11th and 12th of this month and during his state visit he had successful bilateral discussions with Mr. John F Kerry, the United States Secretary of State, Ms. Samantha Power, US Permanent Representative to the United Nations and many other high ranking State Officials. The Minister stated that in his discussion, specially with the Secretary of State, Mr. Kerry expressed the view that he appreciated the expeditious measures adopted   by the new Government of Sri Lanka and  that he is really interested in the 100 Day Programme of the Government. The Minister further stated that he had the opportunity of meeting the Secretary General of the United Nations, Mr. Ban Ki-moon and that while holding discussions with him  he also focused his attention over the cordial relationship Sri Lanka had with the United Nations for the last sixty years. The Minister further informed the Cabinet that in consideration of the written request made by him to the United Nations High Commission for Human Rights to postpone the presentation of the Report concerning Sri Lanka scheduled for March this year, he was able to postpone it by a further six months.

description: Meeting of the Cost of Living and Food Security Committee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-18
decision_details_body: - having taking into consideration that the consumers do not get the benefit of the price reduction of commodities announced in the interim budget, the joint proposal submitted by Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, Minister of Food Security; and Hon. Karu Jayasuriya, Public Administration, Provincial Councils, Local Government and Democratic Governance to direct the Consumer Affairs Authority to publish a notification in the Government Gazette indicating the prices of items reduced, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Cabinet Sub?Committees
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-18
decision_details_body:
- the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister for the establishment of five Cabinet Sub?Committees to make an in-depth study of the issues relating to the respective subject fields and make appropriate recommendations in order to facilitate the decision making process of the Cabinet, was approved by the Cabinet. 

	(a)	Cabinet Sub?Committee on National Policy
	(b)	Cabinet Sub?Committee on Economic Affairs
	(c)	Cabinet Sub?Committee on Establishment Matters
	(d)	Cabinet Sub?Committee on Legislation
	(e)	Cabinet Sub?Committee on Procurement Matters

	The Cabinet is vested with the responsibility of appointing Heads of Departments in terms of Article 55(2) of the Constitution. Therefore, to facilitate the appointment of more suitable persons to such posts, the responsibility of making recommendations for same is vested in the Cabinet Sub?Committee on Establishment Matters. The Cabinet also decided that the Secretary to the Cabinet should report to the Cabinet Sub?Committee on Establishment Matters in consultation with the Public Service Commission and the relevant administrative authority, in this connection.

description: Allocation of Provision Required for the Payment of Salaries of the Employees and Incurring other Expenses of Kantale Sugar Company Ltd
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-18
decision_details_body: - presently a staff of 39 has been employed for the protection / maintenance of the assets belonging to the Kantale Sugar Company Limited and its other essential functions. The proposal made by Hon. M.K.A.D.S. Gunawardana, Minister of Lands, to obtain provision to pay their salaries and other allowances, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Committee to Investigate the Allegations of Political Victimization in the Three Armed Forces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-18
decision_details_body: - the Government in its 100 Day Programme has pledged to restore the ranks and rights of those who were subject to political revenge and punishment.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Ranil Wickremasinghe, the Prime Minister to give a directive to the Secretary, Ministry of Defence, to appoint a Committee to investigate the allegations of political victimization in the Three Armed Forces, since 2010 and make recommendations to provide relief, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: ADB Loan No.2518 SRI : Clean Energy and Access Improvement Project - Part 2 - Transmission System Strengthening - Transmission Lines - ICB No.CEB/AGM/TR/2009/ICB/003 - Extra Contractual Payment for Price Escalation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-18
decision_details_body: - the above contractual price had been determined based on the quantities included in the (Bills of Quantities) BOQ of the tender prepared at the time of bidding.  As per the conditions of the contract, payments have been made having measured the actual quantity of work done at the time of construction.  The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy, to pay the contractor the contract price increased, due to changes in tower types, tower quantities and foundation erection work as a result of additional activities carried out in the course of the implementation of the project,  on the approval of the price variations, based on the recommendations made by the Cost Estimate Examination Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Children (Judicial Protection) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-18
decision_details_body: - the Children and Young Persons Ordinance last amended in 1945, has not been subject to change for nearly 70 years and therefore, it has been difficult to ensure effective, speedy and expeditious disposal of cases.  At the same time,  a need has arisen to amend the existing laws in keeping with the many changes that have occurred in our legal system and as well as in the international sphere, with regard to Judicial Procedure. Further, with the ratification by Sri Lanka of the UN Convention on the Rights of the Children, amending the existing laws to address the shortcomings in both immediate and long term response to the care and protection of the children and the juvenile justice system has become necessary. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Wijayadasa Rajapaksa, Minister of Justice and Labour Relations, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft the proposed Childrens' (Judicial Protection) Bill, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lands of the Land Reform Commission on which housing schemes have been constructed by the National Housing Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-18
decision_details_body: - although the possession of 34 lands in extent of 271 Acres, 02 Roods and 38.4 Perches owned by the Land Reform Commission has been taken over by the National Housing Development Authority, the ownership had not been transferred over to the National Housing Development Authority and therefore, the residents of the 748 houses constructed by the National Housing Authority on these lands, have not gained the legal ownership of the houses. Therefore, Hon. Sajith Premadasa, Minister of Housing and Samurdhi had submitted a proposal to vest the said lands with the National Housing Development Authority with a view to granting legal ownership to the residents of the houses situated in 34 lands under the 100 Day Programme implemented by the Ministry of Housing and Samurdhi. Since the lands belonging to the Land Reform Commission cannot be vested on a free grant,  in terms of the Land Reforms Law, approval was granted by the Cabinet to vest the lands with the National Housing Development Authority at a most concessionary value after  conducting negotiations with the Land Reform Commission.

description: Demographic Health Survey of Sri Lanka 2014/2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-18
decision_details_body: - collection of current data is necessary in taking policy decisions for the advancement of the health sector, and for the purpose it has been planned to conduct the Demographic Health Survey of Sri Lanka - 2014/2015 in this year.  A survey of this nature, for the last time, had been conducted during the year 2006 and 2007 and the activities pertaining to the survey to be conducted this year will be carried out jointly by the Ministry of Health and Indigenous and the Department of Census and Statistics. The estimated cost for the survey is  Two Hundred and One Million rupees. The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine to conduct the above survey, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Food Security Operation Room
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-18
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet noted that 'food security along with sustainable agriculture' is a priority sector identified in the Election Manifesto of His Excellency the President Maithripala Sirisena, and that Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera, Minister of Food Security, has taken action to establish a “Food Security Operation Room” with the view to collecting, compiling and analyzing food production and imports related activities to regulate the market of the main food items through suitable policy initiatives.  The Cabinet further noted that it is expected that this will be the focal point for dissemination of information related to strategies adopted for the food security of the country.

description: Release of Land and  Property in the High Security Zone
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body:
- a large extent of land out of the 11,639 acres which was under the control of the the Security Forces during the period of conflict has been released by now and a land in extent of 6,152 acres continue to be under the control of the Sri Lanka Army and the Sri Lanka Air Force to ensure the security of the Palali area. The proposal made by His Excellency the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence to release a further 1000 acres from this High Security Zone in stages and to release 220 acres situated in the Grama Niladhari Division of Valalai - J/284 in the Walikamam East Divisional Secretary's Division and to establish a model village to resettle 1022 families displaced due to the conflict was approved by the Cabinet.  Under this programme it is also proposed to provide a block of land in extent of 20 perches each and housing assistance and the model village so established to be provided with a school, preschool, hospital, places of religious observance, community centres and other infrastructure facilities.   Action will be pursued to release the remaining 780 acres expected to be released also for the future resettlement of the persons displaced due to the conflict. 

	It was also decided to release the land under the control of the Sri Lanka Air Force situated in Panama in the Eastern Province, except for the 25 acres where some buildings are being constructed, to enable it to be distributed among the landless persons of the area. 

	It was further decided to release the buildings in the High Security Zone in close proximity to the President's House in Colombo and also those around Temple Trees, presently under the control of the Security Forces.

description: Proposed Agreement between the Government of the Republic of India and the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on Co?operation and Mutual Assistance in customs matters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body: - by the above agreement it is expected to strengthen, promote and develop the co-operation and mutual assistance on matters pertaining to customs and also to reinforce the mutual understanding and communication between the two countries.  It is also expected to enhance the  trade facilities and exchange of information and intelligence in customs matters.  The proposal made by the Minister of Finance, Hon. Ravi Karunayake to sign the proposed agreement during the forthcoming visit to India by His Excellency the President was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of Paddy utilizing Government Funds during Maha Season of 2014/15 by the Paddy Marketing Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body: - the joint proposal made by the Minister of Food Security, Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera; and the Minister of Finance Hon. Ravi Karunayake for the Treasury to provide the necessary provision for the Ministry of Food Security to purchase 200,000 MT of paddy by the Paddy Marketing Board during the Maha season of 2014/2015 from registered farmer organizations, through the District Secretaries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Houses to improve the living conditions of the Plantation Workers with Grant funding Assistance of the Government of India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation Infrastructure Development, Hon. Palani Digambaram to obtain a grant of around US $260 million from the Government of India to construct 20,000 individual houses for the plantation workers, so as to cover the Nuwara Eliya District including Hatton, Badulla, Ratnapura, Kegalle, Kandy, Matale and Galle Districts and to re?roof and improve the existing 30,000 line rooms for better conditions of living as an interim measure for the families which cannot be provided with individual houses in the first stage itself, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing the Work Plan for the year 2014 and 2015 under the Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and India on Cooperation in the field of Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body: - as agreed upon in the Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the field of Agriculture between Sri  Lanka and India, a bi-annual action plan has to be signed and made effective with the consensus of the two parties. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Irrigation and Agriculture, Hon. (Mrs.) Anoma Gamage to sign the said action plan during his Excellency the President's proposed state visit to India, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Approval to sign the Memoranda of Understanding in respect of subjects which come under the purview of the Ministry of Highways, Higher Education and Investment Promotion during His Excellency the President's state visit to India in Mid February 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by the Minister of Highways, Higher Education and Investment Promotion, Hon. Kabeer Hasheem to discuss the subject matters coming under the purview of the Ministry of Highways, Higher Education and Investment Promotion and reach an agreement with the relevant Agencies in India during His Excellency the President's state visit to India in mid February 2015 for bi-lateral cooperation and to take necessary action to enter into the Memoranda of Understanding in respect of  the above subject matters during the state visit of Hon. Prime Minister of India to Sri Lanka scheduled to take place March 2015, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Republic of India on Establishment of Nalanda University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body: - the proposed Memorandum of Understanding recognizes the importance of establishing the Nalanda University and also as a means of furtherance of ties between the student communities of the two countries.  The proposal made by the Minister of Highways, Higher Education and Investment Promotion, Hon. Kabeer Hasheem to sign the above Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Highways, Higher Education and Investment Promotion of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Education of the Republic of India with a view to strengthening the mutual cooperation between Sri Lanka and India in the field of education, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement between Sri Lanka and India on Exemption from Visa Requirements for the Holders of Diplomatic and Official Passports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by the Minister of Public Order, Disaster Management and Christian Affairs, Hon. John Amarathunga to enter into the above agreement to exempt the holders of valid diplomatic and official passports between Sri Lanka and India from the visa requirements,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Progress Report of 100 Days Work Programme as at 2015?02?10
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body: - the Progress Report submitted by the Monitoring Committee appointed by the Cabinet to monitor the implementation of the 100 Day Programme was considered by the Cabinet.  The Cabinet observed that several relief measures included in the 100 Day Programme have been made effective by the proposals made in the new Budget Speech of the Finance Minister.  The Cabinet noted that action has been initiated to draft legislation with regard to the proposals that have to be implemented through amending Acts or enactment of new laws and also that the respective Ministries have been instructed to identify the measures to be adopted for implementation of proposals which require special mechanisms and take action to complete same within the stipulated time frame.

description: Tender for the Supply of 1,200,000 Doses of Adsorbed Diptheria Tetanus, Pertussis, Hepatitis B and Haemophilus Influenza Type b Conjugate Liquid Vaccine BP, USP or EP, IP or WHO IP
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine, Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne to purchase a required quantity of above as a repeat order as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee to ensure adequate stock position of the above essential medicine, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of Spare Parts for 12,000Rhr Major Overhauls of Engine No.01 and Engine No.04 at Sapugaskanda Power Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy, Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka to award the above tender as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prevention of further spreading of the chronic kidney disease and the welfare of the patients now affected by the disease and their family members
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by the Minister of Social Services, Welfare and Livestock Development, Hon. P. Harrison to appoint a Ministerial Sub?Committee chaired by H.E. the President with the participation of the Hon. Prime Minister to expeditiously implement the recommendations made by the Committee of Experts appointed in this regard earlier by the respective Ministries with a view to preventing the further spreading of the chronic kidney disease which has become a national calamity and provide for the welfare of the patients now affected by the disease and their family members and also to appoint an Officials' Committee chaired by the Secretary to the President comprising of Senior Officials to assist the above Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Committee for Reviewing Relocation and Evictions by the Urban Development Authority in the City of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body:
-  based on a survey carried out by the former Ministry of Defence and Urban Development at that time in 2010 as a part of its Urban Regeneration Project and other activities in the Colombo City, the Urban Development Authority initiated action to evict and relocate around 68,000 families who lived in the undeserved settlements.   A large number of complaints have been received in this regard by the Ministry of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, in the course of the last two weeks from the families affected in the process and the concerned citizens.  As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Water Supply and Drainage, Hon. Rahuff Hakeem to set up a Committee comprising of representatives from the relevant Government Institutions to review all aspects pertaining to eviction and location of families and provide relief expeditiously to those who deserve and to make recommendations for far reaching solutions for the problems involved, was approved by the Cabinet. 

	It was further decided that the activities of this Officials' Committee should be carried out under the supervision of the  Committee comprising of  the following three Ministers in order to ensure that the grievances of the parties aggrieved  are properly addressed during the above process. 


		*	Minister Hon. Ravi Karunanayake
		*	State Minister Hon. (Mrs.) Rose Senanayake
		*	Deputy Minister Hon. Eran Wickramaratne

description: Appointment of a Committee to investigate and report on the alleged malpractices, corrupt activities or misuse of power at institutions functioning under the Ministry of Food Security
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body:
- the proposal made by the Minister of Food Security, Hon. Gamini Jayawickrema Perera to appoint a Committee to investigate into the alleged malpractices, corrupt activities and misuse of power said to have been carried out by certain elements in the Institutions gazetted under the Ministry of Food Security and initiate legal action against the persons concerned and to report on the measures to be adopted to prevent such occurrences again, was approved by the Cabinet.  
		
	Since several voluntary organizations engaged in anti-corruption activities have expressed their willingness to voluntarily assist in the investigations  on corruption and malpractices taken place in various Government Institutions, it was also decided to explore the possibility of appointing professionals from such organizations to the Committee.

description: Ranaviru Upahara - Commemorative Ceremony
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
