decision_details_body: - the proposal made by His Excellency the President, Maithripala Sirisena,  to hold the victory parade held annually on or about the 18th of May, since 2009, in appreciation of the contribution made by the members of the three Armed Forces, the Police and the Civil Security Force to mark the military  defeat of the LTTE terrorism and commemorate the heroes who sacrificed their lives for the sake of the country during the war that prevailed for over 30 years, as a hero honour bestowing event this year, in the Galle Town, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Secretariat for the Anti Corruption Committee and Recruitment of a suitable staff
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-02-11
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by the Prime Minister Hon. Ranil Wickramasinghe to establish a Secretariat for the Anti Corruption Committee to investigate into large scale corruption and fraudulent  activities that prevailed during the previous Government and initiate legal action againsts those responsible for same and recommend measures to be adopted to prevent such occurrences in future, was approved by the Cabinet. In addition, approval was also granted to establish a Financial Crimes Investigation Division under the supervision of the Inspector General of Police to investigate into large scale illegal financial transactions including money laundering.  The notification in this regard will be published in the Government Gazette by the Inspector General of Police under Section 55 of the Police Ordinance.

description: Payments made to the Mass Media Institutions by the State Banks during the period of the Presidential Election
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-28
decision_details_body: - the Cabinet decided that the payments made by State Banks to various Mass Media Institutions during the period of the Presidential Election should be probed.

description: Payments made outside the normal expenditure incurred by the Ministries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-28
decision_details_body: - it was decided that the respective Ministers should examine any deviations from the normal modes of expenditure incurred by their Ministries from the date of declaration of the Presidential Election up to the date of conclusion and submit a Report at the next meeting and also direct the Secretaries to the Ministries to suspend all payments that appear to be unjustifiable. In this regard, it was also decided to make an investigation into the large scale payments made to media institutions and also the expenditure incurred for obtaining vehicles on rental basis.

description: Celebration of Vesak Festival 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-28

description: Broadcasting and Telecasting Rights of International Cricket Matches played in Sri Lanka and Abroad
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-28
decision_details_body: - the Cabinet having observed the loss incurred by the two State Television Channels due to the decision made in the year 2011 to award the Broadcasting and Telecasting rights also to private television or radio channels exclusively dedicated for sports changing the earlier decision to award same to the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation and the Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation and also having noted that an injustice has been caused as the CSN which had received the license had not made an Islandwide coverage the broadcasting and telecasting in the Sinhala and Tamil languages had not reached the listeners and viewers in remote areas, the Cabinet decided to appoint a Committee to make recommendations to rectify this situation.

description: Amending Section 34 of the National Authority on Tobacco and Alcohol Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-28
decision_details_body: - the draft Bill submitted by the Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne to amend Section 34 of the National Authority on Tobacco and Alcohol Act to enable the display of health warnings describing the harmful effects of tobacco use on packages of tobacco products to cover 80% of their surface, to be presented in Parliament as an urgent Bill in the national interest in terms of Article 122 of the Constitution, was approved by the Cabinet.  In addition  to the above amendment the fine of Rs.2,000/- and the imprisonment of one (01) year imposed in the original Act are to be amended to a fine of Rs.50,000/- and an imprisonment of one (01) year and provisions are also to be included to change the pictorial warnings recommended by the Authority established for this purpose every six (06) months.

description: Amendments to the Appropriation Act No. 41 of 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-28
decision_details_body: - the functions of the 60 Cabinet Ministries which existed when allocating funds for the year 2015 under the Appropriation Act No. 41 of 2014 are now categorized under the 31 Cabinet Ministries and 10 State Ministries and the provisions set apart for the previous 60 Ministries should be reallocated to the new Ministries based on their scope and as such the draft Bill submitted by the Minister of Finance Hon. Ravi Karunanayake to amend to the Appropriation Act No. 41 of 2014 to provide provisions to implement the 100 Day Instant Relief Programme and to present it in Parliament as an urgent Bill in the national interest, in terms of Article 122 of the Constitution, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Proposal made for the declaration of Peace to be read over at the Independence Day Ceremony
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-28
decision_details_body: -  the joint proposal made by the Minister of Home Affairs and Fisheries Hon. Joseph Michael Perera and the Acting Minister of Foreign Affairs Hon. Ajith P. Perera for a declaration of peace to be read over at the National Independence Day ceremony to be held on the 4th February 2015 to express solidarity and empathy with all victims of the tragic conflict which prevailed in the country over a length of time and pledge collective commitment to ensure non-repetition, taking into consideration the recommendations made by the Lessons Learnt and Reconciliation Commission (LLRC), in paragraph 9.284 and 9.285 of its Report, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Cultural Show to be held concurrent to the Commemoration of the 67th Independence Day
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-28
decision_details_body: - the Cabinet noted that the Mayor of Colombo has made arrangements to hold a Cultural Show on various cultural aspects on the theme of "National Unity" on the evening of 4th February opposite the Town Hall with the participation of Artists representing all communities to coincide with the commemoration of the 67th Independence Day.

description: Assignment of Subjects and Functions to the State Ministers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-28
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister to make an administrative arrangement to assign subjects and functions to the State Ministers and to  gazette the subjects so assigned, under Article 45(4) of the Constitution, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a Media Spokesman to the Cabinet
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-21
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet decided to appoint Hon. Rajitha Senaratne, Minister of Health and Indigenous Medicine as the Cabinet Media Spokesman.

description: Implementation of the 100 Day Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-21
decision_details_body: - A request was made to all Hon. Ministers to direct their respective Secretaries to the Ministries render the highest priority for the implementation of the 100 Day Programme. It was also decided to appoint a Committee comprising of five (05) Secretaries to the Ministries with two other experts presided by a Senior Advisor to the Hon. Prime Minister to monitor this programme.

description: Release of information to the Mass Media by Public Officers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-21
decision_details_body: - It was decided to request the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils, Local Government and Democratic Governance to advise the Secretary to the Ministry to issue circular instructions so that the provisions of the Establishments Code are strictly adhered to when public officers release information to the Mas Media.

description: Stocks of imported rice lying in the Government stores complexes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-21
decision_details_body:
- The Hon. Minister of Food Security was requested to take action to release the stocks of rice imported by the previous government and lying in storage, to the market before the Maha Season harvest of 2014/2015 enters the market, after having examined whether such stocks of rice are suitable for human consumption. 

	It was also decided to request the Hon. Minister of Finance to take action to increase the prevailing tax of Rs. 1% per kg for the imported rice appropriately, with a view to enabling the domestic farmers to receive a reasonable price by the time the harvest in the Maha Season enters the market.

description: Conducting the presidential election in a just and fair manner
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-21
decision_details_body: It was decided to convey the appreciation  of the Cabinet to the Commissioner  of Elections, and all the officers including District Secretaries involved in the election duties, and all the officers in the Police Department including the Inspector General of Police and officers of the Police Special Task Force who provided security in vulnerable areas paving the way for holding of a just and fair election.

description: Re-assessment in regard to the implementation of some of the large scale projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-21

description: The official visit of the Hon. Minister of Foreign Affairs to India on the 17th and 18th of January 2015 on the invitation extended by the Hon. Minister of Foreign Affairs of India.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-21

description: Use of Official Vehicles
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-21
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet decided that no new vehicles should be purchased for the use of His Excellency the President, the Hon. Prime Minister, all Hon. Ministers and Deputy Ministers but to utilize the official vehicles existing in the respective Ministries.

description: Revision of Fuel Prices
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-21
decision_details_body: -The Hon. Minister of Power and Energy was requested to take expeditious action to reduce the prices of fuel in order to provide relief to the consumers.

description: Appointment of Special Commissions to investigate the large scale corruption which had prevailed during the past
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2015-01-21

description: Moratuwa, Lunawa Urban Housing Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the contract for the construction of above low income housing scheme consisting of 356 housing units at Lunawa situated in the coastal belt of Moratuwa has been awarded to the State Engineering Corporation.   The proposal made  by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities,  to increase the cost estimate of the project due to additional items of work included, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Moratuwa, Angulana Multi-storey Housing Scheme - First Phase and Second Phase
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - construction work of 135 housing units under the First Phase  and 153 housing units under the Second Phase of the above Multi-storied Housing Project has been completed by the Urban Settlement Development Authority to resettle the families displaced due to sea erosion and low income urban community residing within the limits of the Moratuwa Municipal Council Area.  Construction work of the First and Second Phases of the Project has been awarded to the State Engineering Corporation.  The proposals made by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities,  to increase the two cost estimates of the two projects due to additional items of work included, were approved by the Cabinet.

description: Threat of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - Hon. Arumugan Thondaman, Minister of Livestock and Rural Community Development, brought to the notice of the Cabinet the prevalence of Avian Influenza (Bird Flu) in the villages of Chennithala, Aalapuzha and Kerala in South India, as reported to him.  The proposal made by the Minister to take preventive measures for its entry into Sri Lanka, specially with the importation of poultry products during this festive season, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme to strengthen Small and Medium Scale Millers and Stockists
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23

description: Increase of the Monthly Allowance paid to Trainees of Traditional Handicrafts Sector under the National Crafts Council
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the National Crafts Council has undertaken many craft training programmes to strengthen the skills and capacity of the craftsmen and provides training in the 20 craft clusters of handicrafts industry at rural level through the Master Craftsman Training Programme since 1985 and in addition, through the Handicraft Training Centres since 2009.  Handicrafts which is a traditional national heritage, provides a formidable platform to showcase the culture of our country to the world.  The proposal made by Hon. Douglas Devananda, Minister of Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development, to increase the monthly allowance of Rs.500/- paid to trainees undergoing training in the handicrafts field under the National Crafts Council, to Rs.1,000/- was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the proposed Sri Lanka State Audit Service as a Special Service independent of other Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the functions of the Auditor General are specified in terms of Article 154 of the Constitution wherein he is required to carry out annual audit of financial statements relating to the Ministries, Departments, State Corporations, Provincial Councils, Local Authorities and Foreign funded Projects and report the position to Parliament.  The Sri Lanka Audit Service and Audit Examiners' Service assist the Auditor General in the performance and discharge of the statutory duties and functions entrusted to him.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, to proceed with the activities relating to the establishment of the proposed Sri Lanka State Audit Service as a special service, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of SAARC Cultural Centre in Navimana, Matara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. T.B. Ekanayake, Minister of Culture and the Arts, to proceed with the activities relating to the above construction work, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Head Office Building for the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka intends to construct a new building in a block of land in close proximity to the Bandaranaike International Airport for its Head Office. The proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation, to award the above tender as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Clean Energy & Network Efficiency Improvement Project - Package 1 - Lot B : Mannar Transmission Infrastructure - Lot - B : Construction of New Anuradhapura to Vavuniya 55 km, Double Circuit, 2xZebra, 132kV Transmission Line and Vavuniya to Mannar 70 km, Double Circuit, Single Zebra, 132 kV Transmission Line (Designed for 220kV operation)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Power and Energy, to award the contract for package 1 as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Augmentation of 132/33kV Grid Substation at Kiribathkumbura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Power and Energy, to award the above contract as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kandy City Waste Water Management Project - Award of Contract for Design & Construction of Waste Water Treatment Plant, Main Pump House, Treated Effluent Disposal System and Supply of Operation & Maintenance Equipment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the objective of this project is to prevent pollution of the Kandy City water sources, Mahaweli River and the Kandy Lake by collecting and treating domestic and industrial waste water with treatment facility.  This project is to be implemented under four contract packages and this is contract package (1).   The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to award the above contract as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Flyover Across the Railway Crossing at Maho Junction
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - Nikaweratiya - Moragollagama - Siyambalangamuwa Road (B 326) crosses the Main Railway Line leading to Northern, North Central and Eastern Provinces at Maho town. Long delays to the movement of traffic on the above road are experienced due to frequent gate closures and congestion in the Maho town area. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to award the contract for the purpose as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board (PAB), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Building for the Attorney General’s Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, to have the construction of the new building of the Attorney General's Department carried out in two stages, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Tea Promotion Unit in the Embassy of Sri Lanka in Beijing, China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the domestic consumption of black tea is increasing in China and the current import of black tea is around 15 million kg and it is estimated that it will reach 100 million kg by the year 2020.  Sri Lanka is the largest supplier of black tea to China and shares 27% of the market.  The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, Minister of Plantation Industries, to set up a Tea Promotion Unit at the Embassy of Sri Lanka in Beijing, China and to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Holding the event of ‘CEYLON TEA EXPO 2015’ in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the Ministry of Plantation Industries in association with the Sri Lanka Tea Board is planning to organize the first ever 'Ceylon Tea Expo 2015' exhibition and a conference from 6th to 8th November 2015 at the BMICH, Colombo. This event envisages to attract international buyers, Super Market Chains, Wholesalers, Value Chain Developers, Institutions, Associations, etc. This event will also generate revenue to the country while giving adequate publicity for Ceylon Tea  throughout the World. The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, Minister of Plantation Industries, to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increase of the Monthly Allowance for Food and Service Facilities of  Student Teachers in  National Colleges of Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education to increase the monthly allowance paid to a scholar during the academic training period by Rs.1,000/- making it Rs.3,500/- per month and during the in-service training period by Rs.1,000/-, making it Rs.4,000/- per month, in keeping with the Budget proposals for the year 2015, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: SAARC Framework Agreement for Energy Cooperation (Electricity)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Power and Energy, to ratify the above Agreement which has already been signed at the 18th SAARC Summit held in Kathmandu, Nepal, with the minor amendments proposed by the Government of Pakistan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Dairy Processing Plant at Badalgama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - Milco Private Limited (Milco) which is a public enterprise engaged in milk processing industry has four main processing factories at Narahenpita, Digana, Ambewela and Polonnaruwa.  Milco factory at Narahenpita which is located in a highly urbanized area has been proposed to be relocated at Badalgama in the Gampaha District. It is proposed to establish a dairy processing plant together with all necessary infrastructure and amenities, to produce pasteurized milk, yoghurt, ice cream, butter, cheese etc. in the new factory at Badalgama.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to funding arrangements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting of Dual Citizenship
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-23
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to adopt the proposed new Administrative Procedure for granting of dual citizenship, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of houses to resettle the affected families due to the Landslide Disaster which occurred at Meeriyabedda, Koslanda on 29.10.2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - an extent of approximately 02 acres of land in Malvern Division of Ampitikanda / Koslanda Estate owned by the Maskeliya Plantation Company has been allocated to construct houses for the 75 families affected due to the Landslide which occurred at Meeriyabedda, Koslanda on 29.10.2014 and the National Building Research Organization (NBRO) has recommended that the said land is suitable for the construction of houses.  The construction work will be carried out by the Urban Development Authority and the foundation laying ceremony initiating construction work is scheduled to be held on 2014?12?18.  The above information was provided to the Cabinet jointly by Hon. Arumugan Thodaman, Minister of Livestock and Rural Community Development and Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, Minister of Plantation Industries.

description: Construction of a Permanent Building and an Access Roadway for the Office of the Public Service Commission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, to award the contract for the construction of a permanent building for the office of the Public Service Commission, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Training Centre to be constructed at Kotawilawatta, Matara in parallel to the 'Deyata Kirula' National Exhibition
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Chandrasiri Gajadeera, Minister of Rehabilitation and Prison Reforms, to construct the above training centre to be utilized as the training school for the officers of the Department of Prisons, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Fertilizer Procurement - Maha Season 2014/15
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: -  supply of fertilizer under the subsidy scheme is handled by the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited (CFC) and Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Limited (CCF) which fall under the purview of the Ministry of Agriculture. The proposals made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to award the contracts for the procurement of fertilizer for the Maha Season 2014/15 as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) at its meeting held on 2014?09?24, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Lakshman Kadirgamar Institute for International  Relations and Strategic Studies (LKIIRSS), Colombo and the China Institute for Contemporary International Relations (CICIR), Beijing
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the Lakshman Kadirgamar Institute for International  Relations and Strategic Studies is a multi - disciplinary research forum dedicated to analyzing Sri Lanka's strategic interests in the realm of international relations, within the contemporary domestic and global contexts.  This institute functions as a forum for the generation of research and analysis, with a view to providing inputs to national policy formulation. The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to enter into the above Memorandum of Understanding between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Clean Energy & Network Efficiency Improvement Project - Package 3 - 220 kv Transmission Infrastructure Project - Lot-A: Construction of New Grid Substations at Polpitiya and Padukka and Augmentation of Existing 220/132/33 kv Grid Substation at Pannipitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Power and Energy, to award the above contract as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the term of office of the National Delimitation Committee on Demarcation of Wards for Local Authorities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. A.L.M. Athaullah, Minister of Local Government and Provincial Councils, to extend the term of office of the National Delimitation Committee on Demarcation of Wards  of Local Authorities from 2014?12?31 to 2015?03?10, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Awarding Contract for Remedial works of Victoria Dam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the Government has received a loan from the International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank towards the cost of Dam Safety and Water Resources Planning Project. The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala De Silva, Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to apply a part of the funds for remedial works of the Victoria Dam and to award the above contract as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Major Bridges Construction Project of the National Road Network funded by Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the Government of Sri Lanka has received a loan of JY 12,381 million from the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) towards the cost of the Major Bridges Construction Project of the National Road Network.  Thirty seven (37) bridges which are narrow or in weak condition on the National Highway Network in the Western, Southern, North Western, Northern and Sabaragamuwa Provinces have been identified for this project. The Contract Package 01 includes 10 bridges. The proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to award the contract for the Contract Package 01 as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Priority Water Supply Projects with funding secured from Local Banks - Award of contract for Uragasmanhandiya,  Gonapinuwala, Dikkumbura and Weligama Water Supply Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted to the proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to award the above contract as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC). The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to the funding arrangements for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hatton - Nuwara Eliya Road Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the objectives of this  project are the rehabilitation of the road section between Hatton and Nuwara Eliya to improve the accessibility to the people living in the area,  eliminate traffic congestion and enhance road safety.  The project includes widening and improvement of 35.6 km long Hatton-Nuwara Eliya Road with 2 lane facility. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to the funding arrangements for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Outer Circular Highway Project Phase III
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the Outer Circular Highway with a total length of 29.22 km  starts from Kottawa and traverses through Kaduwela, Kadawatha and ends up at Kerawalapitiya. It will radiate from the city of Colombo and link Southern Expressway, Colombo -  Katunayake Expressway, Northern Expressway and other major National Highways. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to the funding arrangements for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Medirigiriya Water Supply Project with Funding Secured from Local Banks with a Treasury Guarantee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to the funding arrangements for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.  This project is scheduled to be completed in 2016.

description: Implementation of 22 Water Supply Projects with funding secured from Local Banks for the Enhancement of Pipe Borne Water Supply Service coverage by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) on Priority Basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the Ministry of Water Supply and Drainage has drawn up an accelerated programme for the implementation of 22 water supply projects with local bank financing, covering all Provinces of the country and it is expected to provide safe drinking water to a population of 150,000 by March 2015. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to the funding arrangements for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Head Office Building for the Excise Department of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the  Minister of Finance and Planning, to award the contract for the construction of the Head Office Building for the Excise Department of Sri Lanka at Rajagiriya, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Gazette Notification issued under the Import and Export Control Act, No.1 of 1969 to Parliament to meet the Legal Requirement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the  Minister of Finance and Planning, to submit the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.1889/15 dated 2014?11?18 relating to rescinding of the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.1883/16 dated 2014?10?10 on suspension of the importation of potatoes, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Building for Mullaithivu Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Law and Order, to construct a new building for the Mullaithivu Police Station at a cost of Rs.209 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a two storied building for Dining Hall and a Multi Purpose Student Centre under the Relocation of the Buddhasravaka Bhikhu University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to construct a two storied building to be used as a Dining Hall at a cost of Rs.171.6 million and a Multi Purpose Student Centre at a cost of Rs.76.4 million and to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply and Installation of 10 Nos. Solar Universal Pumps and Drinking Water Treatment Plants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, for the Supply and Installation of 10 Nos. Solar Universal Pumps and Drinking Water Treatment Plants, with the view to providing safe drinking water to the people living in areas where  the chronic kidney disease prevails, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Five Storied Office Building at the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWS&DB) Head Office Premises, Ratmalana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to construct a Five Storied Office Building at Ratmalana for the National Water Supply and Drainage Board and to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reduction of Landslide Risk of Vulnerable Communities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the Government has already allocated necessary financial provision in the 2015 Budget for the construction of 50,000 houses for the community living in estate related areas including the families facing landslide risks.  Under this programme, action is being taken jointly by the Urban Development Authority and the Ministry of Livestock and Rural Community Development, on priority basis, through the Plantation Human Development Trust, for the construction of houses for the estates identified as high risk zones by the National Building Research Organization (NBRO), including the estate which was subjected to the recent landslide disaster.  The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, Minister of Disaster Management, to proceed with the activities relating to the identification of areas which are vulnerable to landslide disasters through suitable technical methodologies and taking measures to minimize landslide risks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Meeriyabedda Landslide - Financial assistance for funeral expenses to the  Next?of?Kin of deceased persons and, to meet medical expenses of those who were injured
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body:
- the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, Minister of Disaster Management, to provide relief to the victims of the above disaster as follows, was approved by the Cabinet: 

*	payment of Rs.100,000/- each on behalf of the 12 persons who had died and 20 persons who had disappeared due to the above disaster, after proper identification of the eligible recipients;



*	payment upto a maximum of Rs.50,000/- each to the five persons who were injured, taking into consideration the nature of their injuries and Rs.10,000/- to be paid as an initial installment; and

*	payment of Rs.25,000/- each to the widow / widower or the next-of-kin of the deceased persons as funeral expenses.

description: Awarding the Bachelor of Education Degree to prospective Teachers of National Colleges of Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - there are 19 Colleges of Education functioning at present and the annual intake for training in these colleges is around 3000 students. The proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to extend the period of study of the students in a College of Education by one more year, making the total period as four years commencing from the 2014 student intake and grant them the Bachelor of Education Degree after successful completion of the course of study, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to Employees’ Provident Fund Act, No.15 of 1958 - Introduction of Provisions on Payment of Dividend to Members and Enhancement of Employers’ Contribution
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the Central Bank of Sri Lanka manages the Employees’ Provident Fund which has an asset base of Rs.1 trillion and the bank in recent years has invested about 10% of its assets in income earning commercial assets which has gained capital appreciation of around Rs.10 billion this year.  It is intended to distribute dividends to members of the Provident Fund who have active accounts of over ten years,  and also to increase the employer contribution  to the fund by 2% making it 14% by the employer so that each employee will have 22% saving from their salaries, in keeping with the Budget proposals for the year 2015. The proposal made by Hon. Gamini Lokuge, Minister of Labour and Labour Relations,  to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation to the Employees’ Provident Fund Act, No.15 of 1958 accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Post Office Security Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Jeewan Kumaranathunga, Minister of Postal Services, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation to amend the Post Office Security Fund Ordinance to meet the present day needs, was  approved by the Cabinet.

description: Fertilizer Procurement - Maha Season 2014/15
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-04
decision_details_body: -  supply of fertilizer under the subsidy scheme is handled by the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Limited (CFC) and Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Limited (CCF) which fall under the purview of the Ministry of Agriculture. The proposals made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to award the contracts for the procurement of fertilizer for the Maha Season 2014/15 as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) at its meetings held on 2014?08?29 and 2014?09?03, were approved by the Cabinet.

description: Infrastructure Development of Sri Lanka Institute of Advanced Technological Education

description: Implementation of Priority Water Supply Projects with funding secured from Local Banks - Award of Contract for the Towns East of Colombo District WSP Package II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-04
decision_details_body: - this project includes the construction of 18,000 m3 capacity Ground Reservoir, supply and laying of 08 km length of transmission pipeline and 10 km length of distribution pipeline from Iridapola junction to Pitumpe along Waga Road. decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-04
decision_details_body: - The Road Development Authority (RDA) has identified the need to construct flyovers at Rajagiriya, Polgahawela and Ganemulla. A flyover at Rajagiriya is required to be constructed urgently to ease traffic congestion, minimize accidents and to reduce high vehicle operating costs.  Flyovers at Ganemulla and Polgahawela are especially required to avoid long delays that are being experienced  by road users due to frequent closure of railway gates at the level crossings. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to award the contract for the construction of the three flyovers referred to above, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the Reconstruction of 25 Bridges funded by Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development (KFAED) - Award of Civil Works Contract for Contract Package 01
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-04

The project has been divided into 03 Contract Packages and the Contract Package 01 includes 08 bridges. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to award the contract for the Contract Package 01 as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Northern Expressway Project - Award of Contracts for Consultancy Services for Construction Supervision of Contract Packages No.02 to 08
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-04
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to award the contracts for providing consultancy services for construction supervision for Contract Packages 02 to 08, for the construction of the portion of the Northern Expressway from Veyangoda to Galewela and the portion of the Link Expressway from Pothuhera to Galagedara, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

Redevelopment of this area will comprise mainly of designing tourism related premises such as Museums, Exhibition Halls, Information Centres, Rest Houses etc.  and the identified archeological monuments will be rehabilitated and preserved.  The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Investment Promotion, to provide ten blocks of identified land for the purpose and to proceed with the activities relating to the allocation of blocks of land, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Prevention of Crimes Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-04
decision_details_body: - Since the enactment of this Ordinance, many new laws have been introduced by Parliament, providing for the regularizing and control of certain criminal activities which also resulted in the introduction of new offences in order to combat the commission of such crimes. A need therefore has now arisen to enable those accused of committing some of the offences introduced by these laws, also to be fingerprinted. The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Dutugemunu Pilgrims Rest established at Lumbini City, Nepal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-04
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. D.M. Jayaratne, Minister of Buddha Sasana and Religious Affairs for the allocation of financial provisions of Rs.20.72 million by the General Treasury for the purchase of furniture and equipment to the Dutugemunu Pilgrims Rest at Lumbini City, Nepal for the use of visiting pilgrims, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and Republic of Korea on Recognition of Certificates issued to Seafarers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-04
decision_details_body: - The International Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watch-keeping (STWC) 1978 has made it mandatory for a seafarer holding maritime certificates issued to him by the maritime administration of his country to obtain a similar Certificate of Recognition from the country concerned to serve on ships flying its flag. The Merchant Shipping Act, No.52 of 1971 also highlights the compliance with this requirement.  Sri Lanka has already entered into Agreements with 28 countries whereby a large number of Sri Lankan seafarers are provided with opportunities to serve on foreign vessels.  The Republic of Korea has expressed its willingness to enter into a Bilateral Agreement regarding the issuance of the said certificates which will enable Sri Lankan seafarers to serve on ships flying the Korean flag and Korean seafarers to serve on ships registered under the Sri Lankan flag.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping to sign the above Memorandum of Understanding between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the Southern Expressway Section 1 (Matara to Beliatta) Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-11-19
decision_details_body: - the Southern Expressway which has a total length of 227 km traverses from Kottawa to Hambantota through Galle and Matara.  It will link major economic centres such as Hambantota Sea Port and Mattala Mahinda Rajapaksa International Airport in the Southern Province with the Colombo city and the Northern part of the country through the Outer Circular Highway, Colombo - Katunayake Expressway and the proposed Northern Expressway. The Southern Expressway Extension from Matara to Hambantota with a total length of 96 km consists of four main sections namely, Section 1 (from Matara to Beliatta - 30 km), Section 2 (from Beliatta to Wetiya - 26 km), Section 3 (from Wetiya to Andarawewa - 15 km) and Section 4 (from Mattala to Hambantota via Andarawewa - 25 km).  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to the loan arrangement for the construction of Section 1 from Matara to Beliatta - 30 km, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a South Asian Centre for Judicial Capacity Building in Environmental Rule of Law
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-11-19
decision_details_body:
- the Chief Justices and Senior Judges of the South Asian countries (Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan and Sri Lanka) have gratefully accepted the offer made by H.E. the President at the inaugural session of the South Asian Chief Justices Roundtable on Environmental Justice and Sustainable Green Development, held in Colombo from 7th to 9th August 2014, to provide  start-up funds and institutional support for the creation of a small but efficient Unit within the office of the Hon. Chief Justice of Sri Lanka, to initiate and coordinate appropriate activities for strengthening judicial capacity in the South Asian countries in the area of environmental  rule of law and sustainable green development. 

	The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) and the Asian Development Bank  (ADB) have both indicated their support for this initiative. This programme will make Sri Lanka the Centre of Excellence in the Judicial Capacity Building in legal matters relating to Environment and Sustainable Development and the Centre will work closely with UNEP, ADB, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), the World Bank and other organizations to collectively develop and implement judicial training programmes in the region.  

	The proposal made by H.E. the President, to proceed with the activities relating to the establishment of a South Asian Centre for Judicial Capacity Building in Environmental Rule of Law, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the Construction of a New Bridge Over Kelani River - Procurement of Consulting Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-11-19
decision_details_body: - the Government of Sri Lanka has received a loan of JP Y35,020 mn. from the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) towards the cost of the above project.  The objective of the above project is to improve the traffic situation around the existing new Kelani Bridge.  The project includes the construction of another new Bridge over the Kelani River, Port Access Road and Interchanges at Orugodawatte, Ingurukade and Kelanitissa Junctions including improvements to roads at Orugodawatte and Kelanitissa. Chandrasiri Gajadeera, Minister of Rehabilitation and Prison Reforms, to construct necessary buildings for the establishment of a separate centre for the rehabilitation of drug addicted persons to be useful citizens through counseling, religious and aesthetic activities, educational activities, vocational training and sports, and to entrust the project to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Police Ordinance No.16 of 1865
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-11-19
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka Police Force had been established in keeping with the provisions of the Police Ordinance No. 16 of 1865 and the population of Sri Lanka at that time had been 2.5 million.  The population of Sri Lanka now is nearly 21 million and the strength of the Police Force is nearly 84,000.  It has been found necessary to amend the Police Ordinance in keeping with the present day needs of the country.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Law and Order, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, Minister of Environment and Renewable Energy, to proceed with the activities relating to the construction of 04 District Forest Offices in these two Provinces, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Visit of His Excellency the President to New York, USA, for the UN Climate Summit and the 69th Session of the United Nations General Assembly - September 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-11-19
decision_details_body: - H.E. the President, led the Sri Lanka delegation to the UN Climate Summit 2014 and the High?Level Segment of the 69th Session of the United Nations General Assembly which were held in New York from 22nd to 27th September 2014.  The aim of the Summit which was attended by a number of world leaders including 100 Heads of State and Government and over 800 leaders from business, finance and civil society, was to raise political momentum for a meaningful universal climate agreement in Paris in 2015 and to galvanize transformative action in all countries to reduce emissions and built resilience to the adverse impacts of climate change.  Addressing the Climate Summit, H.E. the President had elaborated on the steps taken by the Government to address Climate Change and emphasized that although Sri Lanka was able to triple its per capita income within the last eight years, its per capita carbon emission is still less than 1 metric ton.  H.E. the President has had several discussions with the participants of other countries, during these meetings, and has highlighted the continuing progress made by Sri Lanka in addressing post conflict issues, emerging opportunities for trade and investment in the present economic resurgence, Sri Lanka's continuous engagement with the UN system and matters relating to Human Rights Council.  Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, who accompanied H.E. the President and provided the above information to the Cabinet, also has had fruitful discussions with the Foreign Ministers of other countries who participated at these meetings.

description: Construction of Kokilai Bridge and Approaches across Kokilai Lagoon on Mullaitivu - Kokilai - Pulmudai Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-11-12
decision_details_body: - development of the road network which is currently underway connecting 38,000 villages will enable better access to nearly 80% of the population living in rural areas. The Mullaitivu - Kokilai - Pulmudai Road has been identified as a priority road for development with the view to providing continuous land connectivity on the coastal belt between the Eastern Province and the Northern Province. It is proposed to construct a bridge across the Kokilai Lagoon which will greatly reduce the distance between Mullaitivu and Pulmudai by about 100 km. description: Participation at the International Monetary Fund/World Bank Annual Meetings - 2014,  held in Washington DC from 7th  to 12th  October 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-11-12

(Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, Minister (Senior) for International Monetary Co-operation and Deputy Minister of Finance and Planning, including a team of Senior Officials from the General Treasury and the Central Bank of Sri Lanka had represented Sri Lanka at the above Annual Meetings. decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-11-12

It is proposed to rehabilitate the railway track, 62 km in length between Anuradhapura and Omantai with the balance funds available under the above Line of Credit. The proposal made by Hon. description: Implementation of the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi?Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation Free Trade Area (BIMSTEC FTA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-11-12
decision_details_body: - BIMSTEC comprises of Bangladesh, India, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Myanmar, Nepal and Bhutan and the main objective of this regional grouping is to foster socio?economic progress of the member countries by promoting co-operation in eight priority sectors, namely, Trade and Investment, Technology, Transportation and Communication, Tourism, Fisheries, Energy, Agriculture and Human Resources Development. It provides a unique link between South Asia and Southeast Asia. The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce, to confirm the Negative List of Sri Lanka under BIMSTEC FTA, which has been prepared in consultation with the relevant state sector authorities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rural Development Initiatives of the Ministry of Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-11-12
decision_details_body:
- the proposal made by Hon. Douglas Devananda, Minister of Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development, to proceed with the activities pertaining to the following, was approved by the Cabinet:

*	Rehabilitation and reactivation of the Elephant Pass Saltern - in 2014 the Ministry of Economic Development has provided Rs.100 mn. under the "Uthuru Wasanthaya" Programme to rehabilitate and reactivate 330 acres of Saltern as Phase I to achieve an estimated salt production of 20,000 MT per annum and development work to rehabilitate infrastructure such as sea water reservoir, evaporation pans, crystallization pans and salt platforms are currently being undertaken.  In 2015 it has been planned to  rehabilitate and reactivate an additional 447 acres as Phase II to produce a further 25,000 to 30,000 MT of salt per annum.  The estimated cost of Phase II to be initiated in 2015 is Rs.125 mn.; and 

*	Strengthening the Fishnet Factories in Weerawila and Lunuwila to support and strengthen fish production - currently the Weerawila Fishnet Factory has a production capacity of 120 MT per annum and Lunuwila Factory has a capacity of 180 MT per annum.  It is proposed to modernize these two factories at a cost of Rs.99.5 mn. in 2015.

description: Strategic Cities Development Project - Consultancy Services for Design and Supervision of Augmentation and Rehabilitation of Kandy Municipal Water Supply Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-30
decision_details_body: - one of the key development initiatives that has been identified in the Kandy City is the augmentation and rehabilitation of the Kandy Municipal Water Supply Scheme. The proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to award the consultancy services contract for design and construction supervision of the above, to the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Technical Assistance of Euro 06 million from the Government of Federal Republic of Germany
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-30
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted to obtain grant assistance of Euro 04 mn. and Euro 5.5 mn. under the development assistance of the Government of Federal Republic of Germany for the completion of 2 development projects namely, Establishment of a Vocational Training Centre in the Northern Province and SME Sector Development Project in Sri Lanka.  The German Government has agreed to provide further technical assistance of Euro 06 mn. for the completion of the present activities and for financing of additional activities of these projects.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to sign the Exchange of Notes for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Projects of 'Construction of Four Grid Substations and Related Transmission Line' and 'Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Program'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-30
decision_details_body:
-  it has been observed that power sector capacity has to be enhanced to cater to demand of the emerging economic activities.  Accordingly, the Ceylon Electricity Board intends to implement the following 2 projects: 

*	Project of 'Construction of Four Grid Substations and Related Transmission Line' - it is expected to add 4 new sub-stations under this project in the central region at Nawalapitiya, Ragala, Wewalwatte and Maliboda at an estimated cost of Euro 38 mn.  These 4 sub-stations will add 220 MW of additional capacity to the National grid; and

*	Project of 'Green Power Development and Energy Efficiency Improvement Investment Program' - this programme will be implemented by the Government with financial assistance from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and an Agency from France.  A loan of Euro 22 mn. is to be provided to construct and rehabilitate 3 sub-stations at Kesbawa, Kalutara and Old Anuradhapura.

The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to loan arrangements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Integrated Road Investment Program - Tranche 2
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-30
decision_details_body: - the Government has planned to implement an investment programme to ensure rural road connectivity with rural hubs and the Asian Development Bank (ADB) has agreed to provide US $800 mn. in 6 tranches for the purpose and the Government investment for the total programme will be  US $106 mn.  This programme will connect rural hub Grama Niladhari Divisions to the adjacent socio-economic centres in the Southern, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North Central and North Western Provinces and Kalutara District of the Western Province through 5 projects.  The projects cover 2548 km of rural access road including local authority and provincial roads and 118 km of national roads.   The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to loan arrangements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ruwanpura Expressway Project - award of contract for providing Consultancy Services for carrying out feasibility studies, environmental impact assessment etc.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-30
decision_details_body: - the proposed Ruwanpura Expressway commences from the Kahatuduwa Interchange of the Southern Expressway and ends at Pelmadulla (on the third kilometer of Pelmadulla - Embilipitiya - Nonagama Road) and the total length of this Expressway is around 71 km.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to award the above contract as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee (CACPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rs. 240 million (Japanese Yen 200 million) Grant for Provision of Japanese SME’s Products under Japanese Non Project Grant Aid
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-30
decision_details_body: - the Government of Japan has agreed to provide grant assistance under non-project grant aid amounting to Japanese Yen 200 million (approximately Rs.240 Million) in the fiscal year 2014/2015 for provision of Japanese SME's products to uplift the health standards and sanitary conditions of the Sri Lankan citizens.  Equipment to be procured under this scheme for the Ministry of Health will be distributed to the National Hospital, Teaching Hospitals, Province Hospitals, District Hospitals, Base Hospitals, and Primary Medical Care Units under the Ministry and the equipment to be procured for the Ministry of Water Supply and Drainage will be distributed to rural institutes under the Ministry, to develop ground water resources in drought affected areas. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to sign the Exchange of Notes for the purpose with the Government of Japan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Towns East of Colombo District Water Supply Project - Package III with Funding Secured from Local Banks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-30

description: Establishment of  Vessel Monitoring System (VMS)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-30
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that new technology has to be incorporated for the sustainable management of the fisheries industry of this country and the implementation of the global concept of the Vessel Monitoring System (VMS) has become mandatory.  The scope of the proposed VMS Project is to supply 3000 VMS transceivers to the Fishing Boats and equipment for the Fisheries Monitoring Centre to monitor the position of the Fishing Boats via Satellite and provide maintenance and support of the equipment, elements and software for a period of ten (10) years.  The proposal made by Hon. Rajitha Senaratne, Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resource Development, to proceed with the related activities for the establishment of the Vessel Monitoring System as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Model National Secondary School of the Sabaragamuwa Province in Ratnapura Town
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-30
decision_details_body: - it has been proposed to establish a new National School within the Sabaragamuwa Province in a block of land closed to the Ratnapura Town. The construction work is to be commenced in the third quarter of the year 2014 and completed within three years. The school will consist of ten parallel classes from Grade 6 to Grade 13. The proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to purchase the block of land situated at Kuliyapitiya, adjoining the University, for future development activities needed to the University, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-Development of Public Fair at Anuradhapura

description: Kurunegala Town Beautification Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-30
decision_details_body: - Kurunegala Town is being developed as the Main Urban Centre in the North Western Province. The Urban Development Authority (UDA) has already undertaken the beautification of  the surrounding areas of the Kurunegala lake as one of the priority projects with a view to enhancing the aesthetic landscape of the town while providing recreational and leisure facilities for the public. description: Renovation of the Bandaranayake Building at Sri Lanka National Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-16
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka National Hospital which provides high level patient care services to the Sri Lankan population, celebrates its 150th Anniversary in 2014.  Among the buildings in the National Hospital, Bandaranayake Building is a main building complex and it accommodates a number of units such as the Intensive Care Units, Surgical Theatres, Neuro Surgery Unit, Radiology Unit, ENT and Plastic Surgery Units etc.   The proposal made by Hon. Basheer Segudawood, Minister of Productivity Promotion.

description: Search and Rescue Services for Aircraft in Distress - Search and Rescue Arrangements between Sri Lanka and neighbouring countries such as Australia,  India, Indonesia and Maldives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-16
decision_details_body: - it is obligatory on the part of Sri Lanka, being a party to the Convention on International Civil Aviation (Chicago Convention - 1944), to make arrangements for the effective implementation of the International Standards and Recommended Practices contained in the said Convention.  It is a requirement that every State enters into arrangements with neighbouring States to strengthen her ability to provide  Search and Rescue Services in mutual cooperation and coordination with each other when the need for search and rescue arises.  According to an international survey conducted relating to air safety measures adopted by countries (USOAP-2013), Sri Lanka has attained the 19th place out of 191 countries in the world and the 4th place out of 34 countries in the Asia Pacific Region.  The proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation, to make certain adjustments to the original text of the Arrangements as requested by the Maldivian Authorities, which do not change the objective of the Arrangements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Wide Body Fleet Replacement of Sri Lankan Airlines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-16

- Hon.Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation, informed the Cabinet that Sri Lankan Airlines has finalized the Wide Body Fleet Replacement Plan, including the financing of the first 9 aircraft, the details of which are as follows:

description: Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) for the Identification and Protection of Trafficking Victims
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-16
decision_details_body: - the National Anti-Human Trafficking Task Force chaired by the Secretary, Ministry of Justice has developed a set of Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) for the identification and protection of trafficking victims. The objective of the SOP is to enhance the effectiveness of Sri Lanka's anti-human trafficking efforts. The SOP is a National strategy developed in conformity  with International Conventions to sensitize Government stakeholders on their  roles and  responsibilities in protecting victims and ensuring successful conviction of offenders with the view to protecting human rights of victims. The SOP prepared for the identification of protection of trafficking victims submitted by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, was approved by the Cabinet.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-16

description: 3rd International Conference on  ‘Community Water Service’ held in Kandy from 22nd  - 24th  August, 2014

About 750 participants which included local representatives from 475 Community Based Water Organizations had attended this Conference. description: National Immunization Policy of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-16
decision_details_body: - the main objective of the immunization policy is to have a country free of vaccine preventable diseases of public health importance by ensuring the use of safe and quality vaccines relevant to the health care needs of the people in a sustainable and equitable manner. The Ministry of Health has developed this immunization policy in close collaboration with all stakeholders, including relevant professional bodies and Government Institutions. description: Memorandum of Understanding on setting up the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-16
decision_details_body: -  the President  of the People's Republic of China has proposed to establish the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) to ensure regional cooperation for sustainable economic and social development in Asia as well as to strengthen regional resilence against potential financial crises and Sri Lanka has been officially invited to join the said bank as a founder member. Sri Lanka is a founder member of two largest multilateral development financing institutions, i.e., the World Bank and the Asian Development Bank. Establishment of the AIIB will help to mobilize the much needed additional resources from inside and outside Asia, remove the financing bottlenecks faced by the individual economies in Asia and complement the existing multilateral development banks to promote sustained and stable growth in Asia. 22 countries across the region have indicated their willingness to join the said bank as founder members. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the related activities pertaining to the signing of the Memorandum of Understanding on the establishment of the AIIB, was approved by the Cabinet.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-16

Financial institutions include licensed banks, licensed finance companies and leasing companies, money brokers,  primary dealers, insurance companies, insurance brokers, insurance agents, loss adjusters, institutional agents, stock exchanges and stock brokers/dealers. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enact legislation for the purpose through an Act of Parliament and to instruct the Legal  Draftsman to draft legislation for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

On the Link Expressway interchanges will be constructed at Rambukkana and Galagedara.  System Interchange provides connectivity only among expressway.  The feasibility studies and preliminary designs have been already completed and the proposed expressway corridors for the above mentioned sections have been already identified. description: Construction of a Building Complex for the establishment of an International Relations Centre in the Eastern Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-09
decision_details_body: - the Government has observed the need to implement various administrative and social relations programmes to consolidate social integration and reconciliation of the community in the Eastern Province.  It is proposed to establish an active operational centre named “International Relations Centre in the Eastern Province”, in Panama, Lahugala, aimed at creating a conducive administrative and social background centred around the Eastern Province for the people in the region, similar to the operational centre presently functioning in the Northern Province. decision_details_body: - over the last ten years local professionals, Engineers in particular, have gained immense experience and in depth knowledge in design and construction supervision pertaining to the construction works of roads, water supply schemes, power supply etc., by involving in mega infrastructure development projects launched by the Government.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to establish a Government owned Consultancy Company under the Companies Act and to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting 49th Session of the UN affiliated International Sugar Organization to be held in Colombo in mid - 2016

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-09
decision_details_body: - subsequent to the visit of H.E. the President and the Minister of Education Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, to South Korea, the Minister of Education of the Republic of Korea has consented to provide a fully equipped modern ICT Classroom to the Mahinda Rajapaksa College, Pitipana, Homagama, as a donation from the Republic of Korea.  The proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mount Clifford Housing Scheme, Homagama and Werallawatta Housing Scheme, Yakkala (Ceylon State Hardware Corporation Land) proposed to be constructed under the Jana Sevana National Housing and Settlement Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-09
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, to award the contract for the investment, design and construction of Mount Clifford Housing Scheme, Homagama consisting of 924 housing units and Werallawatta Housing Scheme, Yakkala consisting of 591 housing units for a contract sum of Rs.2659.2 million and Rs.1775.2 million respectively and to carry out all marketing activities of the said projects by the National Housing Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.
