decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-09
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the work relating to loan arrangements with domestic banks for the implementation of the above Water Supply Projects by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board and completed in 2016, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial Regulations - 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-09
decision_details_body: - as announced in the Budget Speech 2013, the General Treasury undertook to proceed with the activities relating to further revising the Financial Regulations in an endeavour to make such Regulations simpler to follow and more relevant to the present day needs of the Country. These Regulations set out principles, the broad framework and the basic rules associated with Public Financial Management connected to areas including planning, budgeting, execution, monitoring, accounting, auditing and reporting, to promote best practices and accountability in Public Financial Management. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to conduct an extensive awareness programme on the provisions contained therein through 'Miloda' Academy of Financial Studies, the training arm of the Ministry of Finance and Planning, on the basis that it will become operative in 2015 from a date to be approved by the Cabinet of Ministers, and to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Southern Campus of the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-09
decision_details_body: - with the intention of providing educational opportunities for the civil students in the Southern, Central and Eastern Provinces and for foreign students, it is proposed to establish the Southern Campus of the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University at Sooriyawewa by further extending the services of this University.  The Southern Campus of the University is planned to be constructed in three stages within a period of five years from 2014.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of Land for Naula Town Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-09
decision_details_body: - with the increasing demand for agriculture, transportation, tourism, commercial and other urban development activities in the Matale District, the Urban Development Authority has identified Naula Town in the said District to be developed as a planned city under the Regional Township Development Project.   The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to vest the identified land in extent of 6.7884 hectares for the Naula Town Development Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-09
decision_details_body: - the residential population within the Anuradhapura Municipal Council Area is about 51,000 and with the increase in pilgrim arrivals to Anuradhapura due to the peaceful environment in the country, the day time population is around 100,000.  The Urban Development Authority is closely regulating the development activities while improving the pubic facilities in the sacred area to maintain a planned development in the town area based on a development plan prepared by the Authority.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to vest the state land in extent of 228.9 perches situated at 1st Lane, Maithripala Senanayake Mawatha, Anuradhapura, with the UDA, for redevelopment activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Special Bureau for Reconciliation to facilitate the Implementation of Recommendations of the Commission of Inquiry on Lessons Learnt & Reconciliation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-09
decision_details_body: - a Committee headed by the Secretary to the President is engaged in monitoring the implementation of 144 recommendations of the Lessons Learnt and Reconciliation Commission (LLRC) contained in the National Plan of Action, out of which, 45 are deemed to be completed, 89 are ongoing and 10 are in the early stage of implementation.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, to establish a Special Bureau for Reconciliation to function under the Secretary to the President and to carry out tasks entrusted to it for the purpose of facilitating the Committee's work in monitoring the implementation of the LLRC recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Lotus Mall and Recreational Complex along with the Colombo Lotus Tower
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-10-09
decision_details_body: - the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka (TRCSL) is constructing the Colombo Lotus Tower (CLT) which is a 350 m high multifunctional tower and an entertainment centre at D.R. Wijewardena Mawatha, Colombo 10.  It is also expected to develop the land adjoining CLT as a suitable pleasure garden by constructing necessary infrastructure facilities including a parking complex.  The structural work of the Tower is expected to be completed by June 2015.  On the proposal made by H.E. the President, the Cabinet approval was granted to acquire an additional extent of land from the adjoining land for the above purpose and to proceed with the related activities.

description: Signing of Minamata Convention on Mercury
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that adverse effects have been caused globally to man's health and ecosystem by the release of mercury to the environment for a long time.  The main objective of the above Convention is to protect human health and the global environment against adverse effects of mercury by minimizing the release of mercury to air, water and land.  The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, Minister of Environment and Renewable Energy, to sign the above convention, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancement of Research Innovation and Development Capabilities in the Rubber Research Institute
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - the Rubber Research Institute was set up in 1909 to cater to the research and development aspects of the Rubber Industry and was the first ever such Institute in the world and its valuable contribution to the advancement of global rubber industry is recognized world over. With the view to enhancing the capabilities of the Institute it is proposed to set up a modern laboratory complex.  The proposed laboratory complex is expected to provide facilities to all the stakeholders in the rubber sector including smallholder community, large scale rubber product manufacturers, rubber based trading  companies, university students and academia. The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, Minister of Plantation Industries, to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Middeniya-Angunakolapelessa, Weeraketiya, Barawakumbuka - Rote, Deniyaya, Urubokka and Morawaka Water Supply Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - the above projects envisage to rehabilitate the existing water supply scheme in Middeniya-Angunakolapelessa, Barawakumbuka - Rote and Weeraketiya (Muruthawela Water Supply Scheme) in the  Hambantota  District and augmentation of Deniyaya, Urubokka Water Supply Schemes and construction of a new Water Supply Scheme at Morawaka replacing the existing Pradeshiya Sabha Scheme in Matara District. description: Access to Learning Award 2014 - Sri Lankan  e-Library Nenasala Project won the International Award titled “Access to Learning” together with LKR million  286 (US 2.2 million)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation presented its Access to Learning Award together with 1 million US dollars and Microsoft software worth 1.2 million US dollars  to the Sri Lanka Nenasala e?Library Project implemented  under the Information and Communication Technology Agency of Sri Lanka (ICTA), in recognition  of its work of providing increased and affordable access to computers and the Internet, specially to the people living in rural and remote areas of the country.  Sri Lanka's Nenasala Project was selected for this prestigious award out of 200 applications received worldwide. This information was provided to the Cabinet by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, Minister of Telecommunication and Information Technology.

description: Sri Lanka's position in the United Nations e-Government Development Index in 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has risen to the 74th position in 2014 out of 192 countries in the United Nations e-Government Development Index and is among the leading countries in the world engaged in implementing an e-Government Agenda.  This index was derived from a survey conducted by the United Nations to assess the status of the  e-Government of its member countries.  According to the 2014 Report, Sri Lanka has gained first place in South Asia and India is 44 places behind Sri Lanka.  This information was provided to the Cabinet by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, Minister of Telecommunication and Information Technology.

description: Making Regulations on Registration and keeping of Tamed Elephants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - legal provisions to ensure protection of elephants in Sri Lanka in their natural habitats and outside under domestic conditions have been included in Part II of the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance and the legal protection of tamed elephants have been further strengthened by Regulations published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.662/4 dated 1991?05?14.  The proposal made by Hon. Gamini Vijith Vijayamuni Soysa, Minister of Wildlife Resources Conservation, to update the existing Regulations to ensure the welfare of tamed elephants and conservation of the elephant population in Sri Lanka and to proceed with the activities related thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - the National Safety Day is commemorated on the 26th of December every year with the participation of the public with a view to raising awareness of the public on how they should face natural disasters and how they should get involved in disaster mitigation. The Ministry of Disaster Management intends to conduct a series of programmes to commemorate this day at the Mahinda Rajapaksa International Conference Hall at Hambantota under the main theme “Safer Sri Lanka” and the sub theme “Let us unite to mitigate the impact of disasters”.  The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, Minister of Disaster Management, to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Atomic Energy Authority of  Sri Lanka and the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission of Pakistan on Cooperation in the Field of Atomic Energy

decision_details_body:
- the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Technology and Research, to publish the Sri Lanka Atomic Energy Bill in the Government Gazette and present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet. The Bill provides for the establishment of the following entities:

*	The Sri Lanka Atomic Energy Board - for the promotion and encouragement of the use of Nuclear Science and Technology for national development purposes; and

*	The Sri Lanka Atomic Energy Regulatory Council - for the regulation of practices involving ionizing radiation and safety and security of sources.

description: Proposal to Establish a Consulate General of Sri Lanka in Milan, Italy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - the city of Milan is the main industrial, commercial and financial centre of Italy. The Italian Stock Exchange and the headquarters of major national banks and multinational companies are located in this region. More than 75% of Sri Lanka's trade with Italy is handled by the Italian companies based in Milan. The Sri Lankan community is the sixth largest immigrant community in Milan.  The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to establish a Consulate General of Sri Lanka in Milan, Italy once the concurrence of the Italian authorities is received, and to proceed with the related activities, was approved by  the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Centre of Excellence on Ocean Sciences and Environment
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) currently comprises of 20 Member States and it aims to provide maximum opportunities to develop shared interests and reap mutual benefits and exchange information on trade and investment and also provide opportunities to expand intra-regional trade among countries in the group. The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to establish the IORA Centre of Excellence on Ocean Sciences and Environment in Sri Lanka in consultation and collaboration with local stakeholders, the IORA Secretariat and IORA Member States and to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Agreement between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Belarus
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - the Treaty on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters has already been signed by the Ministers of External Affairs of both countries. The Treaty provides for parties of both countries to grant each other mutual legal assistance in criminal matters, including investigations, prosecutions, trials and resulting proceedings. Accordingly, an Order has been made by the Minister of Justice bringing into operation, the provisions of the Agreement.  The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, to submit the Order to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003 to enhance the protection given for Geographical Indications of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation for the Intellectual Property Act, No.36 of 2003, to make regulations to safeguard the interests of the producers and exporters of Tea and Cinnamon, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of 22 Water Supply Projects with funding secured from Local Banks for the Enhancement of Pipe Borne Water Supply Service coverage by the National Water Supply & Drainage Board (NWSDB) on Priority Basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - the Ministry of Water Supply and Drainage has drawn up an accelerated programme for the implementation of 22 water supply projects with local bank financing, covering all Provinces of the country and it is expected to provide safe drinking water to a population of 150,000 by March 2015. The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Suspension of Regulation No.22 under the Animals Act No.29 of 1958
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - this Regulation stipulates a levy of Rs.20/- per animal for registering cattle by the Government Veterinary Surgeon, fixing an ear tag with an identification number on each head of cattle. The cattle identification system is fundamental for tracing of animal either for disease control or for breeding. The Department concerned find it difficult to carry out the cattle identification programme as planned due to the small farmers as well as large herd owners not extending their cooperation in this regard, which seriously affects the dairy development programmes of the Government. The proposal made by Hon. Arumugan Thondaman, Minister of Livestock and Rural Community Development, to carry out the cattle identification programme free of charge for a period of 02 years by suspending the enforcement of Regulation No.22, to overcome the present difficulty, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commemorating the 150th Birth Anniversary of Srimath Anagarika Dharmapala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - 150th Birth Anniversary of Srimath Anagarika Dharmapala falls on 17th September 2014 and His Excellency the President has already declared that  day as the 'Dharmapala Day' and the year commencing from 17th September 2014 as the 'Dharmapala Year'. The proposal made by Hon. D.M. Jayaratne, Minister of Buddha Sasana and Religious Affairs, to conduct a series of programmes through out the year commencing from 17th September 2014 in association with the relevant Ministries, Departments and other Government Institutions to commemorate this event, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Consolidations in the Banking Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted to convert the DFCC Bank as a Company  incorporated under the Companies Act, No.07 of 2007 to facilitate the proposed merger of DFCC Bank, DFCC Vardhana Bank and NDB Bank as announced in the Budget proposals for 2014. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning,  to publish the draft Bill prepared for the purpose in keeping with the recommendations of the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Legislation, in the Government Gazette and thereafter, submit it to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an Additional Building for the Office of the Leader of the Opposition in the same premises that presently houses his office
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted for the construction of an additional building for the Office of the Leader of the Opposition in the premises of No.30, Sir Marcus Fernando Mawatha, Colombo 07, presently used as his Colombo Office. The proposal made by Hon. D.M. Jayaratna, the Prime Minister, to increase the total cost estimate of the project from Rs.28,400,000.00 to Rs.56,280,036.49 due to price escalations etc., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Creation of a mechanism for regulation of Programmes implemented with the objective of ensuring mutual friendship and trust among communities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-30
decision_details_body:
- in the recommendations made by the Lessons Learnt and Reconciliation Commission (LLRC) special emphasis has been made on promoting coexistence among communities. Various Government Institutions are implementing programmes and projects based on the recommendations of this Commission from national level to regional level.  The following proposals made by H.E. the President in this regard were approved by the Cabinet:

*	to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee on Social Reconciliation and Coexistence among Communities presided over by H.E. the President and comprising of Hon. Ministers to monitor and facilitate the implementation of the LLRC recommendations aimed at strengthening of coexistence among communities; and

*	to appoint a Committee of Officers comprising of Ministry Secretaries and presided over by the Secretary to the President who functions as the Chairman of the Committee which supervises the implementation of the recommendations of LLRC to assist this Cabinet Sub?Committee.

description: Implementation of Construction of Headworks of Thalpitigala Reservoir Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: -  Thalpitigala Reservoir Project envisages the construction of a 45.7 m. high dam across Uma Oya at Thalpitigala and the reservoir will have a capacity of 15.6 million cu.m.   It will provide improved irrigation water for 810 hectares in the Bathmedilla Scheme currently served by water from Vela Oya and supplemented by diversion from Uma Oya.  This will ensure meeting drinking water supply requirements and irrigation requirements at Menipe and Bathmedilla Anicuts among downstream water users in the area.   The project also envisages the construction of a hydro?power station with a capacity of 2 x 7.5 MW that will generate 51 GWh of hydro?power annually to feed the National Grid.  The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to award the above construction works as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appropriation Bill for the Financial Year 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body:
-  the General Treasury has conducted Budget discussions with Ministries, Provincial Councils and other stakeholders and accordingly budgetary provisions have been made taking into consideration of the total resources available in the medium term 2015?2017, giving priority for timely completion of on going development activities and new development projects identified for implementation during the medium term, based on the priorities identified during the above discussions.  Within the medium term 2015?2017, the total estimated revenue of the Government for 2015 is Rs.1,713 billion and total Government expenditure for 2015 is estimated to be Rs.3,053 billion.  The expected fiscal targets to be achieved in 2015 under the medium term 2015?2017 are as follows:

						                      2014     2015	   2016	      2017	
	*	Public Investment (% of GDP)                  6.0	   6.5	     6.5	       6.5
	*	Budget Deficit (% of GDP)	             5.2	   4.4        3.6        3.0
	*	Total Public Debt (% of GDP)	           75.0     71.0      68.0      65.0
	*	Economic Growth Rate                              7.8       8.2        8.3        8.4
	*	Inflation					  6.0	   5.5	     5.0         5.0

	The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Agreement between Sri Lanka and the People’s Republic of  China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - the Treaty on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters between  Sri Lanka and the People’s Republic of  China provides for the Parties to grant each other  mutual legal assistance in criminal matters, including investigations, prosecutions, trials and resulting proceedings. The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, to sign and ratify the above Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Towns East of Colombo District Water Supply Project Package 1 and Bentota Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body:
- Cabinet approval has already been granted for the implementation of 34 Water Supply Projects at a cost of Rs. 10.095 billion with financial assistance from Local Banks. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity of the Minister of Finance and Planning, to authorize the Water Supply and Drainage Board, to proceed with the activities relating to the loan arrangements for the implementation of the following Water Supply Projects, was approved by the Cabinet. 

*	Towns East of Colombo District Water Supply Project -  Package 1; and

		*	Bentota Water Supply Project.

description: Provision of Infrastructure Facilities for the Universities to facilitate the additional intake of students for 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to award the contract for the construction of a five storied new building for Lecture Halls, Reading Rooms and Multipurpose Auditorium for the University of Colombo School of Computing, to the lowest evaluated responsive bidder as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for Relocation and Development of the Institute of Technology - University of Moratuwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - the objectives of this project are to resolve the issues between the University students and the students of the Institute of Technology, established within the University of Moratuwa, and to develop the National Diploma Technology Programme which enjoys higher national and international demand and to expand it enabling an increase in the student intake. It is also proposed to accommodate the students from the technology stream expected to enter universities from 2015, by implementing this project. The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of  Higher Education on the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of Medical Equipment to the Medical Faculties of Rajarata and Eastern Universities and the Faculty of Allied Health Sciences of the University of Peradeniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - the Faculty of Medicine and Allied Health Sciences of the University of Rajarata, the Faculty of Healthcare Sciences of the Eastern University and the Faculty of Allied Health Sciences of the University of  Peradeniya are newly established faculties and it is proposed to uplift their standards in keeping with the other National Universities of the country by the provision of the required equipment and accessories for teaching and learning activities.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education on the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), to proceed with the related activities,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Nagamu Purawara 2014 - Third Phase Renovation of Multi-storeyed Housing Schemes and installing Infrastructure Facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18

description: Greater Colombo Waste Water Management Project (GCWMP) funded by Asian Development Bank - Additional Work under Design, Supervision and Management Consultancy (DSC) Contract for Design and Supervision Consultant
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - the Government of Sri Lanka has received a loan of US$ 116.63 Million from the Asian Development Bank for the Greater Colombo Waste Water Management Project to improve the urban environment by rehabilitating the sewerage system and thereby enhance the public health facilities of the residents of the Greater Colombo area. The proposal made by Hon. A.L.M. Athaullah, Minister of Local Government and Provincial Councils, to award the additional consultancy work of the above as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee (CACPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Kiriibbanwewa Water Supply Project and Badalkumbura - Alupotha  Water  Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to invite technical and financial proposals for the implementation of the Kiriibbanwewa Water Supply Project and Badalkumbura - Alupotha  Water  Supply Project, to appoint the Project Committee to evaluate such proposals to be received and to submit the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) to the Cabinet for consideration, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Thambuttegama Water Supply Scheme - Plant & Design-build Contract for the Civil and M&E Works
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - this project is to enhance the pipe borne water supply coverage for safe drinking water to 42 Grama Niladhari Divisions in Thalawa, Thambuttegama and Galnewa Divisional Secretaries' Divisions.  The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to implement the above water supply project and to award the contract as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the Supply of 10,000,000 Tablets of Co-Amoxiclav Tablets BP 625mg or Amoxicillin and Clavulanate Potassium Tablet USP 625mg
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the supply of 25% of the above contract initially to the sole responsive bidder  at a cost of US$ 236,250.00 and thereafter to award the balance 75% quantity at a total cost of US$ 708,750.00 depending on the satisfactory performance of the supply of the initial quantity, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of Nursing Schools in Kandana, Matara & Hambantota
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the contract for the modernization and renovation of the Nursing School in Kandana, Hambantota and Matara, to the Mahaweli Consultancy Bureau was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing a Memorandum of Understanding between Seychelles and Sri Lanka for the Development of Sports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval was granted for signing of  above Memorandum of Understanding between the two countries for the development of sports as proposed by Hon. Mahindananda Aluthgamage, Minister of Sports.

description: Transfer of land owned by Janatha Estate Development Board in Pallai, Jaffna to the Coconut Cultivation Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. A.P. Jagath Pushpakumara, Minister of Coconut Development and Janatha Estate Development, to vest the land of about 600 acres in extent, adjoining the Tharmakerni Model Coconut Park, Pallai, Jaffna, belonging to the Janatha Estate Development Board, with the Coconut Cultivation Board, to establish a Model Coconut Park and for related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Air Service Consultations between Sri Lanka and Azerbaijan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratna, Minister of Civil Aviation, to sign the above Air Services Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Republic of Azerbaijan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Cost variations of the Contracts for the Reconstruction of Railway Lines in the Northern Province of Sri Lanka under the Indian Line of Credit Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - reconstruction work of the Omanthai - Pallai and Madawachchiya - Madhu Road railway line has been completed and the train services have been restored. Presently, Madhu Road - Talaimannar railway track and the Signal and Telecommunication services are under construction. The proposal made by Hon. Kumara Welgama, Minister of Transport, to revise the original cost estimates of the above, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Divineguma National Development Programme - Phase VI - 2014 - Supply of Vegetable Seeds and Fruit Plants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to procure vegetable seed pouches, fruit plants and other agricultural crop plants for the Divineguma National Development Programme, from nurseries of the Department of Agriculture and private owned nurseries registered with the Department of Agriculture at rates approved by the Department, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Seed Paddy to Farmers who suffered cultivation losses due to Drought
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - due to the prolonged drought conditions prevailing from the beginning of this year, crop cultivation in many parts of the country has been affected and it has been observed that farmers experience difficulties in procuring seed paddy in sufficient quantities to commence cultivation for the next Maha Season. The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to purchase seed paddy by the Department of Agriculture, from seed paddy producing farmers as well as from private sector seed paddy producers to meet the shortfall of the supply and distribute same among the drought affected farmers  on cost recovery basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the National Institute of Plantation Management Act, No.45 of 1979
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, Minister of Plantation Industries, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation  to amend the National Institute of Plantation Management Act, No. 45 of 1979, in keeping with the present day needs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Nomination of the National Designated Entity (NDE) for Climate Technology Centre and Network (CTCN) under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - Climate Change has been identified as a major environmental issue threatening the global sustainable development and poverty eradication.  The CTCN provides services to developing countries by responding to requests for technical assistance to identify the technology needs and facilitate the preparation and implementation of technology projects and strategies to face the climate change impacts. The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, Minister of Environment and Renewable Energy, to nominate the Ministry of Environment and Renewable Energy as the National Designated Entity (NDE) for the Climate Technology Centre and Network, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme to Commemorate World Habitat Day - 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - every year since 1986, the “World Habitat Day” is celebrated on the first Monday in the month of October by the United Nations with the aim of drawing the attention of the global community to key issues related to development of urban housing and human settlements. The United Nations has declared “Voices from Slums” as the theme of this year's World Habitat Day which falls on Monday the 06th October 2014. The theme is intended to reflect on development activities implemented while listening to the voices of the people living in slums. The Government has accorded the highest priority to the provision of housing and settlement facilities to low income earners in the City of Colombo and other urban zones throughout the country. The Ministry of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, intends to conduct several programmes under the above theme to mark the World Habitat Day. The proposal made by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Power and Energy of  Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Environment and Energy of the Republic of Seychelles to Promote Technical and Investment Cooperation in the Power Sector Development in General and the Implementation of Renewable Energy Projects in Seychelles
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval was granted for signing of the above Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Seychelles as proposed by Hon. (Mrs.) Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Power and Energy.

description: Agreement on Establishment of Inter-Governmental Commission on Trade, Economic, Scientific and Technical Cooperation between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Russian Federation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - the two way trade between Sri Lanka and Russia has been increasing 	over 	the	years.  Sri Lanka's exports to Russia have increased from US $11.6 million in 2001 to US $279.91 million in 2013 while Sri Lanka's imports from Russia have increased from US $3.7 million to US $145.85 million during the same period.  The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Ministry of Industry and Commerce, to enter into an Agreement on establishment of the Inter-governmental Commission on Trade, Economic, Scientific and Technical Cooperation, to enhance cooperation between the two countries in the said fields, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Human Heart Valve Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - it is estimated that approximately 2500 to 3000 children are born with congenital heart defects in Sri Lanka annually and around 2000 of them need corrective surgery. The current practice in Sri Lanka is to use imported bovine grafts (Tissue valves)  which cost about Rs. 300,000/- per graft which is borne by the Government. With the rapid  advancement in healthcare offered to children with heart diseases  in Sri Lanka, the establishment of a Human Heart Valve Bank to provide cardiac valves and tissues necessary for valve replacement and repair of some of the congenital and acquired heart diseases has become a priority. The process of establishing a Human Heart Valve Bank had been initiated through the Children's Heart Project of Sri Lanka and the Oxford Tissue Bank has already agreed to provide the necessary technical support and advice for the  purpose. The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to establish a Human Heart Valve Bank at the Lady Ridgeway Hospital in Colombo at a cost of about Rs. 30 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement between the Republic of Belarus and Sri Lanka on Cultural Cooperation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-04
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. T.B. Ekanayake, Minister of Culture and the Arts, to sign an Agreement between the two countries to develop and promote bilateral cooperation in the field of  Culture and the Arts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: China Development Bank (CDB) Financing for the Water Supply Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-04
decision_details_body:
- the China Development Bank (CDB) has agreed to provide a loan of US $400 million to the National Water Supply and Drainage Board for the implementation of the following water supply projects: 

		*	Katana Water Supply Project;
		*	Thambuttegama Water Supply Project; and
		*	Kandy North Water Supply Project.

	The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to proceed with the relevant activities pertaining to the loan arrangements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Priority Water Supply Projects with funding secured from Local Banks - Award of Contract for three Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-04
decision_details_body:
- the proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to award the contracts for the following three projects, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet:
*	Towns East of Colombo District Water Supply Project - Package III - Supplying and Laying of Pipes for Distribution Network in Homagama, Padukka and Seethawaka Divisional Secretaries' Divisions;
*	Avissawella and Kosgama Integrated Water Supply Scheme; and

*	Galagedera and Mawathagama Water Supply Scheme

description: Implementation of Anamaduwa Integrated Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-04
decision_details_body: - the proposed Anamaduwa Integrated Water Supply Project will provide safe drinking water to a population of about 81,700 in the Puttalam District. The project  includes the construction of a new intake at Inginimitiya Reservoir, a fully equipped water treatment plant inclusive of water towers, laying of 62 km long water transmission mains and  328 km long distribution system and other related works. The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to proceed with the activities relating to the award of the contract, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Gazette Notification issued under the Import and Export Control Act, No.1 of 1969 to the Parliament to meet the Legal Requirement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-04
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to submit the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No.1872/5 dated 2014?07?21, containing Import and Export (Control) Regulations No.04 of 2014, which are to be effective from 2014?08?01,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Loan Facility of US $100 million from China Development Bank Corporation to Finance the Improvement and Rehabilitation of Priority Roads Project 3 (Phase II)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-04
decision_details_body: -  the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to loan arrangements to finance the Improvement and Rehabilitation of Priority Roads Project 3 (Phase II),  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Extension of Southern Expressway Section 4 - from Mattala to Hambantota via Andarawewa Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-04
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to loan arrangements to finance the Construction of Extension of Southern Expressway Section 4 from Mattala to Hambantota via Andarawewa, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Roads and Flyovers in Hambantota International Hub Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-04
decision_details_body: - the Southern Expressway Extension Project with a total length of 96 km consists of four main sections, namely, Section 1 (from Matara to Beliatta - 30 km), Section 2 (from Beliatta to Wetiya - 26 km), Section 3 (from Wetiya to Mattala - 15 km) and Section 4 (from Mattala to Hambantota via Andarawewa - 25 km). The construction of roads and flyovers in Hambantota International Hub Development Project contains Section 3 of the Southern Expressway Extension with Sooriyawewa - Galwela Junction - Moraketiya - Embilipitya Road (18.28 km) and Ranna - Wetiya Road (16.15 km).  The proposal made  by  H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to loan arrangements for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Outer Circular Highway - Northern Section II (from Kadawatha to Kerawalapitiya) Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-04
decision_details_body: - the Outer Circular Highway with a total length of 29.22 km starts from Kottawa and traverses through Kaduwela, Kadawatha and ends up at Kerawalapitiya. It will radiate from the city of Colombo and link Southern Expressway, Colombo - Katunayake Expressway, Northern Expressway and other major National Highways. The Project consists of three main sections namely, Kottawa to Kaduwela (11.0 km), Kaduwela to Kadawatha (8.9 km) and Kadawatha to Kerawalapitiya (9.32 km).  The proposal made by  H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to loan arrangements for the Construction of Outer Circular Highway - Northern Section II (from Kadawatha to Kerawalapitiya) Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extradition Treaty between Sri Lanka and the Russian Federation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-04
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that entering into such a Treaty with the Russian Federation would be beneficial for Sri Lanka as it would enable Sri Lanka to request for the extradition of persons of concern who have engaged in illegal acts in the country and sought refuge in Russia, for criminal prosecution or execution of sentences.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to sign the above Treaty between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of the Procurement Appeal Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-04
decision_details_body:
- the Procurement Appeal Board (PAB) has been established since 2005 under the provisions of the Procurement Guidelines in order to streamline and ensure transparency of the Government procurement process.  The PAB is required to look into the appeals made by those unsuccessful bidders who are dissatisfied with the recommendations of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committees and Negotiating Committees and to submit their recommendations to the Cabinet for consideration.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, to appoint the following persons to the Procurement Appeal Board with effect from 2014?08?16, was approved by the Cabinet:

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-08-14
decision_details_body: - the Credit Information Bureau of Sri Lanka was set up in 1990 under the Credit Information Bureau Act, No.18 of 1990 as amended, to collect and collate credit information and to furnish such information to its member lending institutions.  As the economic growth has improved due to peaceful conditions prevailing in the country and due to improvements in the macroeconomic environment, the credit demand has increased with greater demand for credit information by member financial institutions.  The proposed Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Infrastructure of the CRIB would enable all financial institutions to send and receive credit information online, at a faster pace and improve the data quality and accuracy of credit information. description: Municipal Solid Waste Disposal System for Metro Colombo Region -  Transfer and Disposal of Municipal Solid Waste at Aruakkalu, Puttalam - Metro Colombo Solid Waste Management Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-08-14
decision_details_body: - the Government has been looking for an environmentally acceptable and economically feasible solution for the disposal of Municipal Solid Waste in the Metro Colombo Region.  The current collection of Solid Waste in the city of Colombo is about 700 MT per day and with the other urbanized local authorities in the Metro Colombo Region, the collection is about 1200 MT per day.  It is proposed to construct a Sanitary Land Fill in Aruakkalu in the Puttalam District and to transport  Solid Waste by train from a Transfer Station at Meethotamulla.  The proposed Sanitary Land Fill will be constructed in keeping with international standards.  The Railway Department has already completed the design work of rail transportation system and the preparation of specifications for locomotives and rolling stocks. The total cost of the Project is US $107 million (SLR 14017 million).  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2015 - 2017 and Preparation of Budget 2015
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-08-07
decision_details_body: - The second five year development policy framework of the Government is being implemented since 2011 with the aim of transforming Sri Lanka  into a poverty free country by 2016 and raising per?capita income continuously. The Government focuses on the Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2015 - 2017 mainly to ensure development by creating more livelihood and employment opportunities, food security, energy security and environmental safety  with particular emphasis on low income and poor families. It is proposed to prepare the Budget 2015 within the Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2015- 2017 giving priority to increase access to basic infrastructure facilities such as health, education, roads and safe drinking water in districts which are below the national average in social development, basic infrastructure facilities and economic indices.  The proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: New Sri Lanka Atomic Energy Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-08-07
decision_details_body: - the current law which provides for  the establishment of the Atomic Energy Authority and its powers and functions is the Atomic Energy Authority Act No.16 of 1969. The rules dealing with the use of Atomic Energy has changed considerably since 1969 and it has been observed that there is a need to incorporate several new provisions into the Law.  The Bill provides for all matters that are necessary to be done for the beneficial and peaceful applications of nuclear science and technology in health, industry, environment and agriculture for national development including the protection of individuals, society and the environment from the harmful effects of ionizing radiation and radiation sources and also specifically states that, in Sri Lanka, all nuclear activities shall be carried out exclusively for peaceful purposes and prohibits the manufacture or acquisition of nuclear weapons or other explosive nuclear devices.  The Bill also provides for the establishment of two new bodies, namely, the Sri Lanka Atomic Energy Board and the Sri Lanka Atomic Energy Regulatory Council. Cabinet approval was granted for the above Bill presented to the Cabinet by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Technology and Research, to be referred to the Cabinet Sub?Committee on Legislation for its recommendations, in the first instance.

description: Visit of H.E the President to the G77 Summit in Santa Cruz, and Official Visit to Bolivia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-17
decision_details_body: -  a delegation led by H.E. the President paid the State Visit to Bolivia for the 50th Anniversary Commemorative Summit of the G77 which is the largest inter-governmental organization of developing countries in the United Nations, consisting of 133 member countries.  Addressing the Summit, H.E. the President had stated that the G77's founding vision of unity, solidarity and development remains relevant and that it is in this context that Sri Lanka has been closely associated with the work of the group and is currently the Chair of its Vienna Chapter.  His Excellency had also stated that many developing countries would have succeeded in emerging from poverty to a more acceptable level of development if the commitments made by developed countries to transfer 0.7% of their GNI to developing countries have been met.   H.E. the President had also held bilateral discussions with the Presidents of Cuba, Uruguay, Equatorial Guinea and the Prime Minister of Gabon.  The Legislative Assembly of Bolivia had conferred upon H.E. the President of Sri Lanka the 'Parliamentary Order to the Democratic Merit - Deputy Marcelo Quiroga Santa Cruz' which is the highest honour awarded by Bolivia and this had been first time it was ever awarded to a foreign Head of State, which was in recognition of H.E. the Presidents' commitment to the advancement of peace and democracy.

description: A Plot of Land for the Colombo Plan Secretariat
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-17
decision_details_body: - the Colombo Plan was established in 1951 as an international mechanism to provide both capital and technical assistance for the economic and social advancement of the people of South and South East Asian with the participation of seven members countries which included India, Pakistan, New Zealand, Canada, Australia, United Kingdom and Sri Lanka.   Currently the organization consists of 27 countries.  It is the only international organization located in Sri Lanka.  Colombo Plan annually provides around 50 foreign training opportunities to the Government of Sri Lanka to develop knowledge and skills of the Public Sector and it envisages a gradual expansion to include new countries from Central Asia, Africa and Middle East, in the near future.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to provide a block of State Land in the Colombo area for the Colombo Plan Secretariat, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project on Respect Yourself Respect Others (RYRO)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-10
decision_details_body: - RYRO is a massive social impact project to be initiated by the National School of Business Management Ltd. (NSBM) functioning under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Skills Development.  It uses a scientifically designed innovative mechanism to change both aggressive and passive types of mindsets, especially of the youth, which are harmful to social development, to personalities who respect themselves and respect others.  The project will reach all the stakeholders in the society including Schools, Universities, Higher Educational Institutes, Government and Semi?Government Institutions, Private Sector Organizations etc.  The proposal made by Hon.  Dullas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of compensation for land acquisitions made for Matara?Hambantota Extension of Southern Expressway and the Construction of the Northern Expressway
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-10
decision_details_body: -  the  proposal  made  by Hon. Janaka Bandara Thennakoon, Minister of Lands and Land Development, to adopt the provisions stipulated in the Land Acquisitions (Payment of Compensation) Regulations - 2013 published in the Government Gazette No.1864/54 dated 2014?05?30, for the payment of compensation to the parties affected due to land acquisitions for Matara?Hambantota Extension of Southern Expressway and the Construction of the Northern Expressway, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of a Land for the Establishment of Ratnapura Model Secondary School
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-10
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to transfer a block of land 5.1670 hectares in extent, located in the Ratnapura Divisional Secretary's Division and owned by the Urban Development Authority, for the construction of a new National School in Ratnapura consisting of 10 parallel classes from Grade 6 to Grade 13, with the view to providing enhanced education facilities to the students of the Sabaragamuwa Province, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of a Land owned by Tangalle Depot of the Sri Lanka Transport Board to Ha/Tangalle Balika Maha Vidyalaya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-10
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to transfer a block of land in an extent of 04 Acres and 18.7 Perches situated in the Tangalle Divisional Secretary's Division of the Hambantota District, belonging to the Sri Lanka Transport Board, to the Ministry of Education, for the relocation of Ha/Tangalle Balika Maha Vidyalaya, with the view to providing enhanced facilities to the school children in the area, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Executive Council Meeting of Asia Pacific Postal Union  (APPU) in Sri Lanka from September 15-19
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-10
decision_details_body: - the above Meeting is to be held from 15th to 19th of September  2014 in Colombo, where about 150 representatives from 32 Member countries will participate.  The inaugural ceremony is to be held on 15th of September under  the patronage of H.E. the President.  The above information was furnished to the Cabinet by Hon. Jeevan Kumaranathunga, Minister of Postal Services.

description: Social Integration Week - July 14 - July 20, 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-10
decision_details_body: - the Ministry of National Languages and Social Integration had carried out activities Island?wide successfully with the assistance of the Government Institutions and other stakeholders under theme “Education for Social Integration” during the Social Integration Week in the year 2013. This year's Social Integration Week will be held from 14th to 20th July 2014 for the 3rd consecutive year, under theme 'National Unity through Social Integration' and several activities / programmes such as Kite Festival, Launching of Trilingual Magazine, Inter-School Speech Competitions etc., will be held during this week.  The above information was furnished to the Cabinet by Hon. Vasudeva Nanayakkara, Minister of National Languages and Social Integration.

description: Cooperation Agreement on the Establishment of "Water Supply and Waste Water Management Master Plan" for Matara and Hambantota Districts in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-10
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, for signing of a Cooperation Agreement on the establishment of a Water Supply and Waste Water Management Master Plan for Matara and Hambantota Districts, between the National Water Supply and Drainage Board of Sri Lanka and Korea Environmental Industry and Technology Institute of Korea, was approved by the Cabinet.  The possibility of covering the entire Southern Province will also be considered.

description: 3rd International Conference on Community and Water Services - August 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-10
decision_details_body: - the above Conference is to be held in Kandy from 22nd to 24th August 2014 under chairmanship of Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage and a number of countries within the region such as India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Nepal, Bhutan, Afghanistan and Maldives are expected to attend to this Conference.  This Conference is aimed at providing a platform for sharing knowledge, strategies and best practices and to promote dialogue, mutual understanding and cooperation among communities, managing their water schemes.  About 500 delegates from different Community Based Organizations, Policy Makers, Researchers, Academia, UN Agencies and International Development Agencies are expected to participate at this Conference.  The above information was furnished to the Cabinet by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage.

description: Providing priority for the Local Pharmaceutical Manufacturers when drugs are purchased for the State Healthcare Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-10
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to procure the balance quantity of drugs which cannot be supplied by the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation to meet the total requirement of the Government Hospitals, and the other western drugs needed for Government Hospitals but not manufactured by the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation, from Local Western Drug Manufacturers, at prices negotiated by a Committee of Officials, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resettlement Program for the Occupants of Underserved Settlements and Temporary Shelters in the City of Colombo and its Environs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-10
decision_details_body: - the Government has initiated a programme to accelerate the Underserved Resettlements in the city of Colombo to be implemented by the Urban Development Authority and the objective of this programme is to provide houses with modern facilities to upgrade the living standards of the underserved occupants.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to construct a 15 storied housing complex for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Dengue Control Programme - 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-03
decision_details_body: - Cabinet noted the successful implementation of the first stage of the Dengue Prevention Programme conducted by the Emergency Presidential Task Force deploying personnel of the Security Forces in addition to the employees of the Ministry of Health in Colombo, Kalutara and Gampaha Districts from 20th to 22nd June 2014, where 1,05,879 premises had been cleared, 6,347 potential breading sites detected, 3,796 notices issued and legal action initiated against 1,787 premises.  The second stage of this programme is scheduled to be implemented from 03rd to 10th July 2014 in the same Districts and since this is a national issue where maximum public cooperation has to be given for the total eradication of the dreadful dengue disease, Cabinet of Ministers appealed to the public to extend their utmost cooperation when the relevant dengue prevention teams of officials visit their places of residence for inspection purposes.

description: Implementation of Integrated Road Investment Program
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-03
decision_details_body:
- the Government has already taken initiatives to connect all major townships, airports and ports by developing the country's road network and is planning to connect all the villages to the road network by implementing the investment plan for rural road connectivity.  About 1,000 villages will be selected under this programme as rural hubs based on the population and development potential.  The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has agreed to support this programme by providing financial assistance in a sum of US $800 million to implement the programme in five Provinces through five projects as given below and the Government contribution for the entire programme is US $106 million:

		*	Project 1	-	Southern Province
*	Project 2  	-	Sabaragamuwa Province and the Kalutara District of Western Province
		*	Project 3	-	Central Province
		*	Project 4	-	North Central Province
		*	Project 5	-	North Western Province
	The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to the loan arrangements to be made with the ADB, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of Contract for the Construction of Migrant Resource Centre of Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment at Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Dilan Perara, Minister of Foreign Employment Promotion and Welfare, to award the above contract as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet

description: Enhancement of Scope of Work of the Projects Implemented under ADB and JICA Loans by Utilizing the Balance Funds of Loans
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Power and Energy, to enhance the Scope of Work of the Projects Implemented under Asian Development Bank (ADB) and Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) loans, in view of the savings generated by awarding the contracts at lessor prices than the cost estimates, due to competition, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sale of Fly ash Produced from Unit 2 and Unit 3 of Lakvijaya Power Station Norochcholai
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-03
decision_details_body: - Puttalam Coal Power Project Phase II - Unit 2 commenced its operations in April 2014 and expects its Unit 3 to be operational in September 2014.  Fly ash generated continuously while operating these plants has to be disposed of and it can be used for the cement manufacturing process and other industrial activities in the industrial sector.   Fly ash production per unit annually is 75,000 tons and a total of 150,000 tons per year will be produced from these two units.  The recommendation made by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee to sell fly ash to five qualified companies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of New Dialysis Unit and Kidney Transplant Unit in Teaching Hospital, Karapitiya, Galle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-03
decision_details_body: - the Dialysis Unit and Kidney Transplant Unit at the Teaching Hospital, Karapitiya, Galle provide services to patients in the Southern Province as well as to those in the adjacent Districts of Moneragala and Ratnapura.  It is proposed to construct a new five storied building complex at this hospital which would include, two Wards, Theatres for Kidney Transplant, Intensive Care Unit and a Research Unit for Kidney Diseases.  The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the above contract to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) for a total cost of Rs.884.89 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Electrification of Radial Gates with Centrally Controlled Operation System - Deduru Oya Reservoir Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-03
decision_details_body: - Deduru Oya Reservoir Project is being implemented by the Ministry of Irrigation and Water Resources Management to supply irrigation water to 30,000 acres of paddy lands and to provide drinking water to about 50,000 families in the Kurunegala and Puttalam Districts.  The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to install a centrally controlled electrical gate operation system for the Deduru Oya Spillway adopting new technologies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Proper Marketing Facilities within the Local Market for Products of Coconut and Coconut related Producers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-03
decision_details_body: - presently, about 150 coconut and coconut related finished products are produced in Sri Lanka, out of which around 50 selected items are exported, bringing in foreign exchange amounting to around Rs.50 billion annually.  On the proposal made by Hon. Jagath Pushpakumara, Minister of Coconut Development and Janatha Estate Development, to make arrangements to supply a percentage of the total requirement of Items such as coir mattresses, brooms, carpets, brushes etc. produced by manufacturers, to State Institutions through the Coconut Development Authority, with the view to enhancing the domestic market, the Cabinet decided to render 10% priority for the local entrepreneurs who engage in this industry and submit their bids through the Coconut Development Authority, in the Bid Evaluation.

description: Visit of His Excellency the President to Shanghai, China for participation at the 4th Summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence Building Measures in Asia (CICA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-03
decision_details_body: - a delegation led by H.E. the President, participated at the above Conference.  Addressing the Conference H.E. the President drew the attention to Asia being a vibrant and dynamic region with increased international focus, and bringing a multitude opportunities and challenges from both within the region as well as from external sources.  His Excellency had also stated that external forces under the guise of democracy, have sought to interfere in the domestic affairs of sovereign countries, resulting in de-stabilizing these nations and regions.  At the meeting with the UN Secretary General, the latter had congratulated Sri Lanka on the successful conclusion of the World Youth Conference and had observed that Sri Lanka has made much progress to economically and socially develop the country.  The above information was provided by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs.

description: Cost of Survey Regulations made under the Partition Law
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, to amend the existing regulations revising the rates chargeable for surveys carried out in relation to Partition Actions, to publish the amending regulations in the Government Gazette and to present them thereafter in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The 3rd Istanbul International Water Forum from 27th to 29th May, 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-07-03
decision_details_body: -  a delegation led by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage attended the above Conference. The Conference had focused on subjects of water security and legal aspects of water and was attended by Water Professionals, Academia, Scientists, International Organizations etc.  The delegates had agreed to common approaches to water and sanitation issues and Millennium Development Goal Targets in the Asian Region.  The above information was furnished to the Cabinet by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage.

description: Protracted Relief and Recovery Operation (PRRO) in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-06-19
decision_details_body: - the objective of the  PRRO Programme is to strengthen national capacities to address acute malnutrition among children aged from 06 to 59 months and pregnant, lactating women while improving their food security.  The World Food Programme has agreed to extend the food aid assistance under the Protracted Relief and Recovery Operation (PRRO) for the purpose.  The total cost of the PRRO Programme is US $34,799,036, out of which US $23,482,866 will be direct grant assistance and US $19,547,890 will be the food contribution.  This Programme is to be implemented in Mannar, Vavuniya, Mullaitivu, Kilinochchi and Jaffna Districts in the Northern Province and the estimated number of beneficiaries is 435,000.   The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to sign the Letter of Understanding with the World Food Programme for the above purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Articles of Agreement and Subscription to the Sri Lanka Shares under 2010 Selective Capital Increase of the International Finance Corporation (IFC) of World Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-06-19
decision_details_body: - the International Finance Corporation (IFC) is the Development Finance Institution of the World Bank Group which offers investment and advisory services to encourage private sector development and related employment opportunities in developing countries.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities relating to the above Amendment to the Articles of Agreement and Subscription to the Sri Lanka Shares, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Building Complex for the District Secretariat, Batticaloa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-06-19
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, to construct a New Building Complex for the District Secretariat, Batticaloa in the Thiraimadu area, in keeping with the town development plan of Batticaloa, at a total cost of Rs.804 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
