Kumara Welgama, Minister of Transport, to award the contract for the supply of 2200 new buses, made up of 800 two door 42 seater buses at the unit price of US $31,100 and 1400 semi luxury 54 seater buses at the unit price of US $34,100, to Ashok Leyland Ltd. India, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee (CANC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Polgahawela-Pothuhera-Alawwa Integrated Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-03-20
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to award the design and build contract for the Polgahawela-Pothuhera-Alawwa Integrated Water Supply Project, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Hatton - Nuwara Eliya Road Improvement Project Funded by the Economic Development Cooperation Fund (EDCF) of Korea - Variation to the Civil Works Contract
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-03-20
decision_details_body: - the Government of Sri Lanka has received a loan of US Dollars 40 million from Economic Development Cooperation Fund (EDCF) of Korea towards the cost of improvements to Hatton - Nuwara Eliya section (46.75 km) of the Avissawella - Hatton - Nuwara Eliya Road (A7).  Among the changes to be made to the original project proposal, is the inclusion of the construction of an underpass at Nanu Oya Railway crossing and a tunnel at Kotagala.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to revise the original contract sum and to extend the date of completion of works from 2014?06?01 to 2015?03?02, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Outer Circular Highway Project - Selection of a Consultancy Firm for Providing Consultancy Services for Construction Supervision of Civil Works for the Northern Section II from Kerawalapitiya to Kadawatha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-03-20
decision_details_body: - the Outer Circular  Highway starts from Kottawa and traverses through Kaduwela, Kadawatha and ends up at Kerawalapitiya. It links with the Southern Expressway, Colombo - Katunayake Expressway, the proposed Northern Expressway and other major National Highways.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to award the above contract as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee (CACPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Building Complex for Faculty of Graduate Studies for General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University (KDU)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-03-20
decision_details_body: - the project consists of construction of a six-storeyed building which includes an Auditorium, a Library, Lecture Rooms and an Administrative area.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to award the above contract to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Building for Attorney General’s Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-03-20
decision_details_body: - the Attorney General's Department is presently housed in a building which is about 80 years old and it is intended to construct a new building for the Department with the view to providing more accommodation and better facilities.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, to construct a new building for the Department at a cost of Rs.1182 million, for the project to be completed within a period of two years and to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Supplementary Food Crop Production Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-03-20
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that Sri Lanka has achieved self-sufficiency in rice under the local food production drive 'Api Wawamu - Rata Nagamu' and the annual paddy production is expected to exceed 04 million metric tons which is higher than the country's annual rice requirement. With the view to achieving self-sufficiency in supplementary food crops and saving foreign exchange spent on imports, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to utilize 35% of paddy land during the 2014 Yala Season, for the cultivation of supplementary food crops such as big onions, red onions, potatoes, chillies, maize, green gram, soya bean, cowpea etc. and to encourage farmers in that regard by the provision of infrastructure facilities such as fertilizer subsidy, loans at concessional interest rates and introduction of high yielding  varieties etc., was approved by the Cabinet.

description: State Visit by His Excellency the President Mahinda Rajapaksa to the State of Palestine, 6th to 7th January, 2014 - Conclusion of Agreement
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-03-20
decision_details_body: - at the invitation of His Excellency the President of the State of Palestine, His Excellency the President of Sri Lanka undertook a two day State Visit to the State of Palestine from 06th to 07th January, 2014.  Reflecting Sri Lanka's commitment to support capacity building of Palestinian youth, H.E. the President of Sri Lanka announced the establishing of a Vocational Training Centre in Ramallah City, which will contribute to skills development through training in tourism, nursing and other vocations. The two leaders acknowledged the necessity to establish a solid framework to facilitate seamless engagement between the two governments and accordingly, an Agreement was signed between the two countries, for the establishment of the Sri Lanka - Palestine Joint Commission.  The proposal made by Hon. Neomal Perera, Acting Minister of External Affairs, seeking covering approval for the concluded Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Kithulaka Varuna' Exhibition and Trade Fair : Declaration of the Week commencing from 1st to 6th April 2014 as Kithul Promotion and Consumption Week
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-03-20
decision_details_body: - 'Kithulaka Varuna' Exhibition and Trade Fair is held every year before the Sinhala and Tamil New Year to popularize and promote Kithul products.  The National Kithul Development Programme is a major development initiative undertaken by the Ministry of Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development to strengthen, support, upgrade and harness the foreign exchange earning potential of the Kithul Sector.  The activities under this programme have helped to increase kithul treacle and jaggery exports earnings from Rs.26 million in 2011 to Rs.58 million in 2012 and to Rs.68 million in 2013.  The proposal made by Hon. Douglas Devananda, Minister of Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development, to declare the first week from 1st to 6th April 2014 as the Kithul Promotion and Consumption Week and to implement the relevant programmes drawn up for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Investigations into Complaints received from the General Public in Discharging Duties of the Ministry of Health
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-03-20
decision_details_body: - with the view to providing an efficient and effective health care service to the public and to take action on complaints made by the public in instances where they are inconvenienced and dissatisfied with the services provided by the Ministry of Health and the institutions under its purview, the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to establish a pool of officers consisting of serving or retired Specialist Medical Officers, Senior Medical Administrative Officers and Senior Officers of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, so that Investigating Committees could be appointed in such instances from the said pool of officers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rs.625 million (Japanese Yen 500 million) Grant for the Provision of Japanese Advanced Products (Medical Equipment and Welfare Apparatus) under Japanese Non-Project Grant Aid
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - the Government of Japan has agreed to provide grant assistance under Non-Project Grant Aid amounting to Japanese Yen 500 million (approximately Rs. 625 million) for the provision of Japanese Advanced Products (Medical Equipment and Welfare Apparatus) to uplift the health standards of Sri Lankan citizens.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to sign the Exchange of Notes for the purpose with the Government of Japan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: A Credit of United States Dollars 147 million from the International Development Association (IDA) of World Bank for the Strategic Cities Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - the Economic Policy Framework of the Government envisages a well planned and connected network of cities and townships throughout the country by 2020.  The Government has identified Colombo, Hambantota, Trincomalee and Jaffna as Large Cities to be developed under this programme.  Nine other cities covering the entire country will also be developed as Urban Growth Centres.  The IDA of the World Bank has agreed to provide  a credit of US $147 million for the above project.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity of the Minister of Finance and Planning, to conduct loan negotiations and enter into a Financial Agreement with the IDA, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: A Credit of United States Dollars 102 million from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) of the World Bank for emergency climatic disasters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka had faced an increased occurrence of natural disasters such as floods, landslides, cyclones etc. during the last two decades, particularly due to climatic changes.  The International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) of the World Bank through its system of financing gives immediate access to funds after a natural disaster.  IBRD has agreed to provide a credit of US Dollars 102 million for the purpose and funds will be made available for disbursement after the occurrence of a national disaster.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to conduct negotiations and to enter into a Financing Arrangement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Health Week - 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health to declare the period from 10th to 16th March 2014 as the “National Health Week - 2014” and to conduct related programmes in association with other relevant Ministries and institutions under their purview, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for Supply of 300,000 Vials of Rabies Vaccine (Human Use) (1ml/0.5ml)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the above tender to the lowest responsive bidder as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply and Installation of 03 Nos. CT Scanners
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the above Contract at a cost of US Dollars 816,000.00 plus LKR 2,040,000.00, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Japan International Cooperation Agency Funded Landslide Disaster Protection Project of the National Road Network - award of contract for the consultancy services for investigation, detail design and construction supervision
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - the Government of Sri Lanka has received a loan of Japanese Yen 7619 million from the Government of Japan through its lending arm, Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), towards the cost of the Landslide Disaster Protection Project of the National Road Network.  The main objective of this project is to mitigate landslide disasters, targeting 'A' Class National Roads as basic infrastructure by implementing appropriate counter measures in highland areas.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to award the above Contract as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Disaster Recovery Center Building at Technology Park in Sooriyawewa, Hambantota
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted for the collecting of data of all Sri Lankans, digitizing them for developing a persons' database and issuing an electronic National Identity Card, with the view to minimizing the issues and inconveniences related to manual paper based registering system and issuing of identity cards with hand written information. It has been found necessary to establish a Disaster Recovery Centre in order to provide uninterrupted service and secure the main data centre from natural disasters such as storms, floods or earthquakes and technological problems such as network failure etc. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to establish a Disaster Recovery Centre at the Technology Park in Sooriyawewa, Hambantota, where the required infrastructure facilities are available, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Maldives for the Development of Sports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - covering approval of the Cabinet was granted for the MoU signed between the National Sports Institute of the Republic of Maldives and the Institute of National Sports Science in Sri Lanka, during the visit of the President of Maldives to Sri Lanka, for the development of sports in the two countries. This MoU will provide opportunities to share expertise and knowledge in the field of sports, training opportunities, sports equipment, infrastructure facilities and sports technology, for the development of sports in the two countries.

description: Introduction of the new Technological Subject Stream for the G.C.E. (Advance Level) Students
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - this new subject stream has been introduced in 200 Mahindodaya Technological Schools for the academic year 2013 and at present, 13,100 students are following the said subject stream.  It has been proposed to increase the number of schools up to 250 due to the increased demand of students and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to recruit 150 teachers who possess the necessary qualifications to teach the relevant subjects, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancing Health Care Education in Sri Lanka, collaboration with the Singapore International Foundation (SIF)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - enhancing Health Care Education in Sri Lanka is a three year project which is to be implemented  with  the collaboration of Singapore  International Foundation, the Ministry of Health and the University of Colombo.  The project intends to enhance the quality of health care education in Sri Lanka, reaching out to both national and institutional levels.  The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to implement this project with the collaboration of the above institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Collaboration Agreement on Strengthening Human Resources for Mental Health in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - this Collaboration Agreement is made between the University of Melbourne through its Centre for International Mental Health of Melbourne School of Population and Global Health, Australia and the Directorate of Mental Health and National Institute of Mental Health of the Ministry of Health, Sri Lanka to strengthen the capacity of human resources for mental health in Sri Lanka.  Commonwealth of Australia represented by the Australian Agency for International Development (AusAID) is providing a Grant of Australian Dollars 199,000 to undertake this activity.  The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to accept this Collaboration Agreement on Strengthening of Human Resources for Mental Health in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance, No.19 of 1931
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. D.M. Jayaratne, Minister of Buddha Sasana and Religious Affairs, to refer the proposed amendments to the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance, No.19 of 1931, to the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Legislation, for its recommendations in the first instance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision and Consolidation of Legislative Enactments
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - Legislative Enactments officially edited up to the year 1956 consist of 12 volumes of principle enactments and 07 volumes of subsidiary legislation. Legislation subsequently enacted from 1956 to 1980 are incorporated in the last revised edition of legislative enactments of Sri Lanka.  It has become necessary to revise and consolidate the laws that were promulgated since 1956 and to have such editions in Sinhala, Tamil and English languages.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Bridge over the Kelani River
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - since the volume of traffic in the city of Colombo has increased significantly during the past few years, it is proposed to construct an elevated road network to divert the Colombo traffic to the expressway network in order to minimize the traffic congestion. In the meantime, the Government plans to build a new bridge across the Kelani River, linking Colombo city and Colombo - Katunayake Expressway to mitigate and disperse the increased traffic congestion in the city areas.  The new bridge is expected to be constructed parallel to the existing new Kelani bridge using advanced Japanese technology and the project has been designed by considering the estimated future traffic volume around the Kelani bridge from 2022 to 2035.  The Government of Japan has agreed to provide a loan amounting to Japanese Yen 35,020 million (approximately Rs.45,526 million) through the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) for the construction of the second new Kelani bridge.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Grant of Euro 2.5 million from the Federal Republic of Germany to implement the new phase of Facilitating Initiatives for Social Cohesion and Transformation Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - several phases of the above programme have been implemented under Grant Assistance from the Federal Republic of Germany and the last phase of the project focused on developing the capacity of Local Government Authorities and to enhance citizen participation in development activities.  The Government of Germany has agreed to extend  further technical cooperation worth of Euro 2.5 million for activities in relation to the development of a National Master Plan for Social Integration and to carry forward the recommendations of the National Policy Framework for Social Integration.  The above information was provided to the Cabinet by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning.

description: Agreement between Sri Lanka and Afghanistan on the Employment of Sri Lankan Manpower in Afghanistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - with the view to creating more employment opportunities for Sri Lankans and increasing foreign exchange earnings to the country, the proposal made by Hon. Dilan Perera, Minister of Foreign Employment Promotion and Welfare, to enter into the above Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Accreditation of Sri Lanka within the African Union (AU)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - the African Union was established in 1999 to promote unity and solidarity among African States, to safeguard the sovereignty and territorial integrity of Member States and to promote international cooperation within the framework of the United Nations.  Presently, the AU consists of 54 African States.  Currently, over 72 Non-African States are accredited to the African Union.  Among the Asian countries, Japan, China, Republic of Korea, India and Pakistan have already obtained Accreditation Status.  The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to seek accreditation within the African Union, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Association (MoA) on the Establishment of the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - this is a regional inter-governmental grouping which was established in 1997 and it currently comprises of 07 Member States from South Asia and South-East Asia namely Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka and Thailand.  It has been decided to establish the Permanent Secretariat of BIMSTEC in Dhaka, Bangladesh.  The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to sign the MoA on the establishment of the Secretariat, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Rural Bridges in Sri Lanka - Phase II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - the rural bridges programme was initiated in 2011 and work has already commenced for the construction of 210 rural bridges.  These bridges will replace foot bridges and ferries in selected villages. Nearly 120,000 families will benefit from this programme and 537 rural bridges are to be constructed under Phase II. The Government of the United Kingdom together with the Deutsche Bank, UK will be supporting the project with 100% financing. The proposal made by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development, to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Sri Lankan Police Force and Maldivian Police Service on Combating Transnational Crime and Developing Police Cooperation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - the main purpose of this MoU is to address and prioritize transnational criminal issues such as, Terrorism, Illicit Drugs, Smuggling, Human Trafficking, Money Laundering etc.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Law and Order to sign the MoU as proposed, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishing the Seethawaka Wet Zone Botanical Garden at Illukowita, in  Avissawella
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Jayaratne Herath, Minister of Botanical Gardens and Public Recreation, to establish the Seethawaka Wet Zone Botanical Garden at Illukowita, in  Avissawella in a land with an extent of 32 hectares, adjacent to the Indikada Mukalana Forest Reserve in Avissawella, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prevention of Match-Fixing
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - taking into consideration the recent developments in the world of sports by certain sportsmen / sportswomen of several countries in the field of sports such as cricket, football, rugby etc. engaged in match-fixing, which is found to be detrimental to the relevant country as well as to the sportsmen /sportswomen, the proposal made by Hon. Mahindananda Aluthgamage, Minister of Sports, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation for the prevention of match-fixing, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Simulation of Tourism Development through a comprehensive Global Mega Promotional Campaign
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - the number of foreign tourist arrival to the country has increased from 447,939 in 2009 to 1.274 million in 2013 and earnings in that regard from US $340 million in 2009 to US $1500 million in 2013 which illustrates an annual average growth of 20-26% during the past five years.  Considering the importance of the tourism industry for the economic development of the country and the direct earnings of US $1.5 billion from foreign tourist arrivals and the recorded domestic activities by 5.2 million domestic tourists in 2013, the proposal made by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development, to implement a comprehensive mega promotional campaign pertaining to tourism, for a period of two years from 2014 and to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Land belonging to Ministry of Health at IDH Hospital - Construction of Ground Reservoir at Gothatuwa - Colombo Water Supply Service Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - the Ministry of Water Supply and Drainage together with the National Water Supply and Drainage Board have launched a major project to bring down the Non?Revenue Water (water losses) in the city of Colombo associated with the water distribution and transmission networks.  With the implementation of this project, particularly the residents in the Rajagiriya, Nawala and Kolonnawa areas will be benefited.  The water transmission  and distribution network system will be fully overhauled and expanded to ensure an uninterrupted 24 hour drinking water supply coverage to the city of Colombo.  The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to request the Ministry of Health to release the block of land identified for the purpose, situated at Gothatuwa, to construct the ground reservoir, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Taking over of an INGO (International Non-Governmental Organization) supported Prosthetic and Orthotic Clinic of Lady Ridgeway Hospital for Children and Physical Rehabilitation Centre of Teaching Hospital Batticaloa, by the Ministry of Health
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - 'Handicap International', an international non-governmental organization has been working in Sri Lanka providing rehabilitation services for persons with disabilities since 2004 by manufacturing Prosthetic and Orthotic devices to cater to the needs of persons with disabilities. Their services have been extended to the Teaching Hospital, Batticoloa in 2008 and to the Lady Ridgeway Hospital for Children in 2009, through a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed with the Ministry of Health.  The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to take over the Physical Rehabilitation Centres at the Teaching Hospital, Batticaloa and the Lady Ridgeway Hospital in Colombo presently maintained by the said Organization, by the Ministry of Health through a MoU to be signed for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Deduru Oya Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - the Economic Development Corporation Fund of the Export - Import Bank of Korea has agreed to provide a loan in Korea Won not exceeding the equivalent of US $58,155,000 to finance the Dedura Oya Water Supply Project, which will provide safe drinking water to the residents in Mahawa and Polpitigama Divisional Secretaries' Divisions.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ruwanwella Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - the Economic Development Corporation Fund of the Export - Import Bank of Korea has agreed to provide a loan in Korea Won not exceeding the equivalent of US $20,530,000 to finance the Ruwanwella Water Supply Project, which will provide safe drinking water to the residents in the Ruwanwella area and thereby improve the living conditions of the people in the area.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting of CGR land with UDA for construction of new Bus Stand at Bandarawela
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - Bandarawela Town functions as the main service centre, providing facilities for other regional towns such as Welimada, Atampitiya, Wellawaya, Koslanda, Haputale, Diyatalawa, Ella, Demodara etc.  The Urban Development Authority has designed a new Bus Terminal Building in a block of land to be released to the UDA by the Railway Department.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strategic Cities Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-20
decision_details_body: - a project is being formulated by the Ministry of Finance and Planning to develop major cities in the country, including Galle and Kandy, to achieve the planned development in those cities.  Preparation of Strategic Development Plans for Galle and Kandy cities, together with a Transport Improvement Plan to overcome traffic issues in Kandy city were identified as priority needs under this project.   The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to obtain the consultancy services for the preparation of Strategic Development Plans and for conducting Environmental Assessments for the purpose from the University of Moratuwa and for Social Assessments from the University of Peradeniya, and to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Impact on Water Supply due to the current drought situation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, brought to the notice of the Cabinet the current position of Major Water Treatment Plants in the country due to the prevailing drought situation, and stated that water levels at the intakes at rivers and reservoirs are receding due to which water supply will have to be curtailed in the near future if the drought prevails.

description: A Credit of United States Dollars 110 million from the International Development Association (IDA) of World Bank for the Comprehensive Programme for  Improving Climate Resilience
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is a country with great exposure to risks of multi hazards and as such the Government has taken significant steps towards strengthening the legislative and institutional arrangements for disaster risk management while investing to a great extent on emergency preparedness and response capacity, as priority is given for climate change in the country’s development agenda.  The International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank has agreed to provide a credit of US $110 million for improving the Climate Resilience Programme.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Guaranteed Price for Potatoes, Big Onions and Dried Chillies as proposed in the Budget 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body:
- the Government aims to expand domestic agriculture production, ensuring a reasonable price for agricultural produce and creating an uninterrupted access to competitive markets both in Sri Lanka and abroad for value added agricultural products.  To meet the above targets, it is proposed to expand the extent under cultivation, use high yielding seeds, utilize improved water management systems, introduce efficient farm management techniques, reduce wastage in transport and provide modern storage facilities.  It is proposed to create 50% self sufficiency in potatoes, big onions and dried chillies by 2015 and to export the surplus production by 2020.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to introduce a guaranteed price for these food items as indicated below and to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet:

		*	guaranteed producer price of 1kg of potatoes	        - Rs.80/-

		*	guaranteed producer price of 1kg of big onions	        -  Rs.60/-

		*	guaranteed producer price of 1kg of dried chillies     -  Rs.350/-

		*	guaranteed producer price of 1kg of seed potatoes    -  Rs.160/-

		*	guaranteed producer price of 1kg of big onion seeds -  Rs.12,000/-

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the National University of Singapore, Institute of South Asian Studies and the Lakshman Kadirgamar Institute for International Relations and Strategic Studies (LKIIRSS), Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - the objective of this Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) is to promote joint research and development activities of mutual interest.  The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, for the Lakshman Kadirgamar Institute for International Relations and Strategic Studies of Sri Lanka to enter into a MoU with the National University of Singapore, Institute of South Asian Studies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bandaranaike International Airport Development Project - Phase II - Stage 2 - Design & Post Design Supervision Consultancy Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that with the dawn of peace in the country in 2009, passenger movements through the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) has increased at a rate of 15% and in the year 2013 over 7 million passengers were handled at the BIA.  It is expected to increase the total capacity of the BIA to 15 million  passengers per annum with the completion of Stage 2 of Phase II  Development Project of the BIA.  The proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation, to proceed with the relevant activities relating to the above, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of proposed buildings for Faculty of Engineering at Ariviyal Nagar Killinochchi - University of Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to award the above contract to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder at a cost of Rs.1,504 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of three storied building for the establishment of Professorial Units at the Teaching Hospital, Batticaloa for the Faculty of Health Care Sciences of the Eastern University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - the  proposal  made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to award the above contract to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder at a cost of Rs.185 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of  a Faculty of Health Sciences - Eastern University, Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to award the above contract to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder at a cost of Rs.277 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Nine Storied building Complex (Phase IV) for the Faculty of Medical Sciences, University of Sri Jayewardenepura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayaka, Minister of Higher Education, to award the above contract as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Contract for the Construction of the Courts Complex at Homagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, to award the above contract at a cost of Rs.513 million, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC) was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Northern Road Connectivity Project - Award of Contract for the Rehabilitation/Improvement of Mannar End approach of 'Sangupity' Bridge (4.5 km) on Navatkuli - Keraitivu - Mannar Road (A32)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to award the above contract to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder at a cost of Rs.1,119 million, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Agreement on Domestic Worker Recruitment between the Ministry of Labour of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the Ministry of Foreign Employment Promotion and Welfare of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13

description: Regulation Made under paragraph (c) of Sub?Section (2) of Section 37 of the National Aquaculture Development Authority of Sri Lank Act, No.53 of 1998 on Live Rock Culture for Export Regulations No.1 of 2011
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - many countries in the world have used specific areas with high biodiversity in the coastal belt and inland waters for live rock culture.   Live rock can be used for beautification of marine and fresh water ornamental fish tanks.  The proposal made by Hon. Rajitha Senaratne, Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development,  to  submit  the  relevant  Gazette Extraordinary Notification Nos.1734/12 dated 2011?11?30 and 1786/26 dated 2012?11?30 containing the regulations for the purpose, to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: South - East Asia Sub-Regional Parliamentarian’s Meeting on Trafficking and Prevention of Violence Against Women, held in Manila, Philippines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - on an invitation extended by the Executive Director of the Asian Forum of Parliamentarians on Population and Development (AFPPD), Hon. Tissa Karalliyedda, Minister of Child Development and Women’s Affairs attended the above Conference.  The main objective of the Conference was to provide an opportunity for Parliamentarians from the Asia Pacific Region to meet and discuss human trafficking issues in South East Asia and to share each other's experience on the subject.  The delegates who attended the above Conference appreciated the achievements made by Sri Lanka in combating human trafficking in the country and also the positive steps taken to eliminate gender?based violence.  The above information was provided to the Cabinet by Hon. Tissa Karalliyedda, Minister of Child Development and Women’s Affairs.

description: Development of the Faculty of Agriculture and the Faculty of Engineering at Kilinochchi, University of Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - the Government of India has allocated Rs.300 million each for the Faculty of Agriculture and the Faculty of Engineering through Small Development Project (SDP) Grant Assistance.  With the Rs.300 million allocated to the Faculty of Agriculture, it is proposed to set up a Centre for Skills Development which will provide facilities for an Auditorium, a Computer Unit, a Library and an Indoor Games Complex.  With the Rs.300 million allocated for the Engineering Faculty, it is proposed to set up a building which would house the Civil and Mechanical Engineering Departments with the necessary equipment and furniture.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayaka, Minister of Higher Education, to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial Assistance from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) for Implementation of the Skills Sector Enhancement Program (SSEP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-13
decision_details_body: - the Skills Sector Development Programme aims to establish an efficient skills education system to meet the local and foreign labour market demand by 2020.  The programme will develop skills, abilities and competencies of the youth to meet the demand of the global economy and support the country's transition to a knowledge?based economy.  The Asian Development Bank has agreed to contribute US $200 million for the purpose.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of National Expressway Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-30
decision_details_body:
- the functions related to Expressways are being handled by the Road Development Authority at present.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to establish a National Expressway Authority (NEA), in order to administer and manage the operation and maintenance of the already commissioned Expressways and to plan and construct the proposed new projects, which are as follows, as early as possible, and to proceed with the related activities, was approved by the Cabinet:

*	the Southern Expressway from Kottawa to Pinnaduwa and the Colombo - Katunayake Expressway have already been commissioned and are in operation;

*	the Section of the Outer Circular Highway from Kottawa to Kaduwela and the Section of the Southern Expressway from Pinnaduwa to Matara are expected to be commissioned in March 2014; and

*	action has been initiated relating to the projects for the Northern Expressway from Enderamulla to Dambulla and Kandy; Extension of the Southern Expressway from Matara to Hambantota; and an Expressway from Ingiriya to Ratnapura.

description: Relocation of the Tangalle Prison and a Section of the Welikada Prison in Colombo at Eraminiyaya, Angunakolapelessa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-30
decision_details_body: - Tangalle Prison and a Section of the Welikada Prison in Colombo are to be re?located at Eraminiyaya, Angunakolapelessa. The proposal made by Hon. Chandrasiri Gajadeera, Minister of Rehabilitation and Prison Reforms, to award the above contract as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Fertilizer Procurement - Yala Season 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-30
decision_details_body: - supply of fertilizer under the subsidy scheme is handled by Ceylon Fertilizer Company Ltd. (CFC) and Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Ltd.` under the purview of the Ministry of Agriculture.  The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to procure the required quantities of fertilizer for the Yala Season - 2014, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conservation of Dutch Fort in Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-30
decision_details_body: - the Dutch Fort in Jaffna was built by the Dutch in 1690 and the Department of Archeology commenced conservation work of same in 2009 with financial assistance from the Government of Netherlands and the Government of Sri Lanka.  The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Jagath Balasooriya, Minister of National Heritage, to complete the balance conservation activities in the Dutch Fort in Jaffna with an estimated cost of Rs.200 million within the next 4 years commencing from 2014, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Aquaculture Management Regulations made under paragraph (c) of sub Section (2) of Section 37 of the National Aquaculture Development Authority of  Sri Lanka Act, No.53 of 1998
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-30
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Rajitha Senaratne, Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to submit the above regulations to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.  Through these regulations, aquaculture farming without obtaining a license for same is prohibited and an inspection fee too has been included in the regulations.

description: Multi-storied Housing Scheme proposed to be constructed for Legal Officers of the Attorney General’s Department on the Andersonwatta Land, Chitra Lane, Narahenpita under Jana Sevana National Housing and Settlement Development Drive
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-30
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted for the construction of a Housing Scheme with 55 Housing Units in a multi?storied building at Chitra Lane, Narahenpita, for the Legal Officers of the Attorney General’s Department. The proposal made by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, to increase the number of Housing Units to 80 and the number of stories from 12 to 20, to provide more accommodation to the  Legal Officers of the Attorney General’s Department, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Initiating the "Sujatha Diyani Scholarship Fund" for Female Students of Low Income Families Following the New Technology Subject Stream
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-30
decision_details_body: - steps are being taken by the Ministry of Education to set up the above scholarship fund from the donation of US $100,000 made by Mrs. Lee Young?ae, the main actress of the popular Tele Drama “Sujatha Diyani” telecast in this country.  It is intended to provide financial assistance through this Fund, in a sum of Rs.500/- per student per month for selected female students from low income families with the highest qualifications following the G.C.E. Advanced Level Technology subject stream from each District, as the first stage.  The above proposal was made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education and it was decided to implement the proposal through the Public Trustee.

description: Setting-up of National Equipment Identity Register (NEIR) at Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka (TRCSL)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-30
decision_details_body: - at present, there are nearly 2.2 million mobile phone users in the country and the TRCSL has decided to set up a National Equipment Identity Register for use of all Mobile Operators with the aim of curtailing the counterfeit mobile phone market and to discourage mobile phone theft so as to protect the consumers.  This NEIR acts as a central system for all network operators to ensure that black listed mobile terminals in one network will not work on other networks even if the Subscriber Identity Module (SIM) Card in the device is changed.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: State Visit by H.E. the President of Sri Lanka to the Republic of Kenya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-23
decision_details_body: - H.E. the President of Sri Lanka visited Kenya on the invitation of H.E. the President of  Kenya.  The bilateral talks between the two leaders covered a wide range of issues of mutual interest.  The two leaders agreed that this visit was an exceptional opportunity to consolidate the longstanding partnership between the two countries and forge even closer ties heading into a new and promising future of shared destiny and mutual prosperity.  The significance of signing of the Agreement on establishing the Kenya - Sri Lanka Joint Commission for Co-operation, as a primary point of contact for advancing, monitoring and evaluating bilateral ties between the two countries, was highlighted.  The above information was furnished to the Cabinet by Hon.(Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs.

description: Project for the Construction of 1000 Rural Bridges
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-23
decision_details_body: - it is proposed to construct 1000 bridges in rural areas to establish connectivity for transportation and through this initiative, a large number of remote villages will be benefited  and in turn will provide easy access to market, education and healthcare facilities to villagers.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into loan agreements with the relevant foreign Banks for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

- Cabinet approval has already been granted for the rehabilitation and improvements to the following sections of roads with financial assistance from local Banks. decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-23
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the above tender as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Stage II of Cancer Ward Complex in Teaching Hospital - Batticoloa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-23
decision_details_body: - Teaching Hospital, Batticoloa is the main hospital in the Eastern Province.  Construction of Stage I of the Cancer Ward Complex of this hospital was awarded to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) which is a Government concern and the work is now in progress.  The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the contract for the construction work of Stage II of the Project also to the CECB, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for Supply of Locally Manufactured Unsterilized Latex Examination Gloves On Long Term Agreement for the Year 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-23
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to extend the contract of the present supplier for the supply of the above items, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Tropical Bio-diversity Fruit Gardens in Horana, Kundasale and Diyagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-23
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that there is an increasing demand for fruits in the local as well as the overseas market. With the objective of introducing new varieties, producing quality seeds and planting material and promoting the interest and ambition of people towards the cultivation of fruits  and provision of basic propagation materials of recommended varieties, the initial phase of establishing tropical fruit gardens in Horana, Kundasale and Diyagama, has already been finalized. The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Title Registration Act, No.21 of 1998
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-23
decision_details_body: - one of the major programmes implemented by the Ministry of Lands and Land Development is the Title Registration (Bimsaviya) Programme which is being implemented under the provisions of the above Act. The proposal made by Hon. Janaka Bandara Thennakoon, Minister of Lands and Land Development, to make certain amendments to the above Act on the recommendations made by a Special Committee appointed by H.E. the President, to identify the problems arisen in the implementation of the provisions of the above Act, and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare amending legislation accordingly, for the benefit of the public, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Sri Lanka Resident Diplomatic Mission in Berne, Switzerland
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-23
decision_details_body: - there are 54,932 expatriate Sri Lankans in Switzerland as at 2012. Switzerland has for many decades extended bilateral assistance to Sri Lanka for development programmes.  The value of total trade between the two countries was US $325.76 million in 2012.  It is observed that there is considerable potential to increase exports to Switzerland which is a major industrialized nation and a gateway to the European markets.  The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, for the establishment of a Sri Lanka Diplomatic Mission in Berne, the capital of  Switzerland, with effect from 01st February, 2014, and to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing Milk Production through Availability of Dairy Feed at Affordable Prices
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-23
decision_details_body: - the intention of the government is to reach self sufficiency in all livestock produce and the dairy industry has been identified as a key area to be developed as a local industry.  Sri Lanka has reached 40% self sufficiency by producing 299 million litres of milk in 2012 which is a 16% increase when compared to that of 2011.  40% of the cost of production of a litre of milk is borne by concentrated feed which is mainly a mixture of Maize, Rice Bran, Coconut Poonac and Wheat Bran together with minerals and vitamins. The proposal made by Hon. Arumugan Thondaman, Minister of Livestock and Rural Community Development, to take measures to restrict the export of Coconut Poonac and Rice Bran, so that these could be made available for dairy feed at affordable prices, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Programme to build a society free from indulgence in intoxicants - 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-23
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that, protecting particularly the youth and the future generations of our country from indulgence in intoxicants such as being addicted to heroine, alcohol, tobacco etc., is a national priority. Cabinet of Ministers considered a proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health to implement a National Programme in collaboration with all State and Private Sector Organizations with community participation, to build a society free from indulgence in intoxicants.  After discussion, Cabinet decided to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee under the Chairmanship of H.E. the President and consisting of the Hon. Minister of Health and other relevant Ministers, to be assisted by an Officials' Committee comprising of Senior Officials, for this purpose.

description: Granting relief to persons affected by the acquisition of lands for the Morana Reservoir Project in Badulla District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-23
decision_details_body: - the Morana Reservoir is a new irrigation project in the Rideemaliyadda Divisional Secretary's Division of the Badulla District, to overcome the shortage of water in the Nagadeepa Scheme.  With the implementation of this project it will be possible to supply water in both Yala and Maha seasons for about 1500 acres of paddy lands under the Nagadeepa Scheme, and also drinking water for the people in the area.  It is necessary to acquire 250 ha. of land for this reservoir and arrangements have been made to provide relief and relocate those to be affected, in the villages of Lihiniyaya and Aldeniya.  A proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management to award compensation for properties of persons affected and granting of relief in respect of relocation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Dry Zone Urban Water and Sanitation Projects

decision_details_body:

*	Construction of Water Treatment Plants and Storage Structures with Supply and Installation of Pumps, Automation System and M & E Equipment in Chilaw and Puttalam.

description: New Value Added Tax Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - since the Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002 has been amended on several occasions from time to time due to amendments introduced to the relevant Act from 2003 to 2013, the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to introduce a new Bill for the purpose incorporating all amendments, to facilitate easy reference to tax payers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of Sri Lanka Standards for Imported Items
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to submit to Parliament, the Gazette Extraordinary No.1844/49 dated 2014?01?08, which amends the Import (Standardization and Quality Control) Regulations No.01 of 2006 and introduces new Sri Lanka Standards for 23 imported items, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of the balance 2500 heads of cows under Phase II of the earlier project and a further 20,000 heads of cows
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - the government has given high priority to increase the local milk production to cater to the demand in the country.  Out of the 4500 heads of cows proposed to be imported under Phase I, 2000 have already been imported from Australia. It has been planned to import the balance 2500 from Australia and develop the infrastructure facilities of the Ridiyagama Farm in Hambantota under Phase II of the project in 2014.  Negotiations have already been concluded to obtain credit facilities from a Bank in Netherlands for the importation of the balance 2500 cows referred to above, and an additional 20,000 high quality cows in keeping with the Budget Proposals for 2014.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into loan agreements for the purpose with the relevant Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Rehabilitation of Priority Roads with Financial Assistance from Local Banks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13

- Cabinet approval has already been granted to award the contracts for the rehabilitation and improvements to the following priority roads with financial assistance from local Banks:

The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning to enter into loan agreements for the purpose with the relevant local Banks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting of the Executive Committee Meeting of the Asia Pacific Postal   Union in Sri Lanka in 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - the Asia Pacific Postal Union is an Organization with a membership of 32 countries in the Region and its objective is to promote better relations between its member countries in providing postal services.  The proposal made by Hon. Jeevan Kumaranathunga, Minister of Postal Services, to host the 50th Executive Committee Meeting of Asia Pacific and to organize the International Stamp Exhibition and to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Building for the Jaffna Municipal Council
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. A.L.M. Athaullah, Minister of Local Government and Provincial Councils, for the construction of a three storeyed building complex for the Jaffna Municipal Council to provide a better service for the people living in the area and to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provincial Component of Additional Financing of Northern Road Connectivity Project Funded by Asian Development Bank - Awarding of Project Implementation Consultancy Contract for Supervision of Civil Works Contracts in Northern and North Central Provinces
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - the Asian Development Bank has allocated funds for rehabilitation and upgrading of National and Provincial Roads in the Northern Province and the North Central Province.  The objective of the consultancy services contract referred to above is to professionally supervise the construction of Provincial Road contracts in the 02 Provinces to ensure that the works are completed as stipulated in the contracts. The proposal made by Hon. A.L.M. Athaullah, Minister of Local Government and Provincial Councils, to award the above contract as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Consultancy Procurement Committee (SCACPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of District Hospital, Beliatta also as a Specialized Maternal & Children’s Hospital under the Netherlands Assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health to award the above contract as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Colombo Port City Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - based on the concept of Colombo Port City Development Project, a land of 233 hectares is planned to be reclaimed adjoining the Breakwater of the Colombo Port Expansion Project towards Galle Face Green.  This project leads to the creation of a new city which uplifts the image of the Port of Colombo as a leading hub city.  The proposed Port City will consist of luxury hotels and apartment complexes, shopping malls, space for modern offices for the corporate sector, leisure and recreational activities etc.  The proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Model Police Buildings under the Special Project for Construction of New Buildings - 2014/2016
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - 39 buildings  consisting of 26 Police Stations, 07 DIG Offices, 04 Barracks etc., falling under the purview of the Department of Police are to be constructed during the next three (03) years at a total cost of Rs.6,367 million under this project.  The above proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Law and Order, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: International Conference on Natural Fibers in Collaboration with Food & Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - this Conference was held in Sri Lanka in November 2013 with the participation of 47 delegates from Member Countries. As the host country, Sri Lanka was offered Chairmanship of the Inter-Governmental Group on Natural Fibres for the next 02 years. Sri Lanka being the World's Second Largest Exporter of coir products is presently going for more value added production in the fibre sector.  The above information provided by Hon. Jagath Pushpakumara, Minister of Coconut Development and Janatha Estate Development, was noted by the Cabinet.

description: The High Level Expert Consultation on Development of the Coconut Sector in the Asia Pacific Region
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - Hon. Jagath Pushpakumara, Minister of Coconut Development and Janatha Estate Development informed the Cabinet that a delegation from Sri Lanka led by him had attended this Conference, on the invitation of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) of the United Nations' Regional Office in Bangkok.  Representatives from member countries such as China, Fiji, India, Indonesia, Maldives, Philippines, Samoa, Solomon Islands, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Tonga, Vietnam and Vanuatu had participated at this Conference.  The objective of this Conference was to take stock of the current status of the Coconut Industry in each of the 18 Asia Pacific Coconut Community (APCC) countries, to identify the major constraints and propose solutions for future development. Several recommendations for both production and processing sectors had been made at this Conference for followup action to be taken by the individual countries, the FAO and APCC.

description: Regulations made under the Section 61 of the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No.2 of 1996
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Rajitha Senaratne, Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development to submit the Gazette Extraordinary Notification numbers 1780/31 dated 2012?10?19 and 1788/41 dated 2012?12?14, containing regulations made under Section 61 of the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No.2 of 1996 to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Equipment for Mahindodaya Technological Laboratories under the Programme of Redesigning of 1000 Secondary Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - a proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to award the contract for the supply of Computers with all other accessories,  with networking for 200 schools in which construction work has been completed and electricity facilities provided, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to award the construction works relating to the renovation activities of the above schools, to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) which is fully owned by the Government, and to complete the work in 2014 utilizing Rs.148 million allocated for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Dry Ports in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - the Sri Lanka Ports Authority is planning to set up 2 Dry Ports at Peliyagoda and Thelangapatha and has identified 100 acres  for the Dry Port Zone of which 30 acres will be developed initially.  An inland port has a level of integration with the maritime terminal and supports a more efficient access to the inland market both for inbound and outbound traffic.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to authorize the Permanent Country Representative to the UN in New York to sign the Agreement on Dry Ports on behalf of the Government of Sri Lanka and become a party to the Inter-Governmental Agreement on Dry Ports, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial Assistance for Implementation of Moneragala - Buttala Water Supply Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-13
decision_details_body: - the Moneragala - Buttala Water Supply Scheme will cover a distribution network in 43 Grama Niladhari Divisions to provide pipe borne water to 50,000 families.  KBC Bank of Belgium has agreed to provide a loan of Euro 12,996,578.95 to cover a major portion of the project.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into a loan agreement with the Hatton National Bank to finance the remaining portion of the contract and to on lend the proceeds of the loan to the National Water Supply and Drainage Board for implementation of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Grade 5 Scholarship Examination
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03
decision_details_body: - attention of the Cabinet was drawn to various news items appearing both in the print and electronic media to the effect that the Government intends to do away with the Grade 5 Scholarship Examination.  It was noted that such decision has not been taken by the Cabinet.  However, the Government contemplates to simplify the examination in view of the severe pressure caused to the students by the present system.  Any decision to change the method of conducting the examination will be taken, based on the recommendations of the National Education Commission and in consultation with all other interested parties.

description: Loans from Domestic Banks for the Rehabilitation and Improvements to the Sections of the following Roads  on priority basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03
decision_details_body:
- the proposals made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to authorize the Road Development Authority to enter into loan agreements with a State Bank to obtain loans for the rehabilitation and improvements to the following road sections, were approved by the Cabinet:

* Thaldoowa - Meewitigammana Road (B408) - from 0 km to 17.30 km; and 

* Kurunegala - Narammala - Madampe Road - from 40.87 km to 64.77 km.

description: Establishment of a Training Centre for the Palestinian Youth in Ramallah City in the State of Palestine
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03
decision_details_body: - it is proposed to establish a Centre in the Ramallah City in the State of Palestine to train the Palestinian youth in the areas such as tourism / hospitality, middle level healthcare (nursing) and similar vocations initially for a period of five years.  The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to establish and administer the training centre for an initial period of five years from January 2014, was approved by the Cabinet.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03

description: The National Disaster Management Plan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03
decision_details_body: - this Plan has been prepared for the period of 5 years from 2013 to 2017 conforming to the Disaster Management Act, No.13 of 2005 and the Sri Lanka National Disaster Management Policy.  The objective of the Plan is to establish and strengthen the Disaster Risk Management Framework outlined in the Act and to implement related programmes involving multi-stakeholder participation covering all phases of the Disaster Management Cycle.  The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, Minister of Disaster Management, to implement the National Disaster Management Plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03

Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to transfer a block of land owned by the Department of Railways, to the Ministry of Education to provide more space to develop the sports activities of Devi Balika Vidyalaya, Colombo, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Asia - Pacific Regional Conference for the Principles on the Childhood Protection and Education - Seoul - Korea
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03
decision_details_body:
- the above Conference was held in Seoul, South Korea towards the latter part of 2013 and a delegation from Sri Lanka headed by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education attended this Conference and the Hon. Minister informed the Cabinet that discussions have been concluded in particular relating inter alia, to the following:
