description: Establishment of a Private Company to Manage, Operate and Maintain Entities Established by the Atomic Energy Authority and Its Successor
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Technology and Research to establish a private limited liability company to be owned by the Atomic Energy Authority, to manage, operate and maintain the government owned Gamma Irradiation Facility and the National Centre for Non-Destructive Testing and all such other entities that may be established by the Atomic Energy Authority for commercial operations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new two storied building for the Divisional Secretariat, Kandawalai
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03
decision_details_body: - this Divisional Secretary's Division situated in the Kilinochchi District of the Northern Province consists of 16 Grama Niladhari Divisions and the total population is around 24,235. The proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, to construct a two storeyed building for this Divisional Secretariat at a cost of Rs.67.72 million to provide a  better service to the public, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Official Quarters Complex for the District Secretariat, Badulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03
decision_details_body: -  Badulla District consists of 15 Divisional Secretary's Divisions and the total population is around 811,758.  The proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, to construct official quarters for the District Secretariat, Badulla at a total cost estimate of Rs.57.4 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing a Block of Land for the Development of the Infrastructure Facilities of the University of Moratuwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03
decision_details_body: - the University of Moratuwa comprises of three Faculties in the disciplines of Engineering, Information Technology and Architecture and the number of students admitted for the Academic Year 2011/2012 was 1747.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to purchase the block of land at Katubedda, Moratuwa, to provide more accommodation to the students and the staff of the University, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: International Conference on Language and Development held in Cape Town, South Africa from 15th  to 17th  October 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03
decision_details_body: - a delegation from Sri Lanka led by Hon. Vasudeva Nanayakkara, Minister of National Languages and Social Integration, attended this Conference and the Minister apprised the Members of the Cabinet on the events that took place at the Conference and the representations made by the delegation.  Cabinet observed that in South Africa, Primary Education is provided free of charge, but not Secondary Education which is provided free of charge only for children from families of low income groups.  The Minister also stated that the delegates at the Conference were impressed about our system of education that facilitates a child to receive education from the lowest level to the highest in all three languages and that, too, free of charge.

description: Urban Forest Resort Project, Sri Jayewardenepura Kotte
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development, to develop the land at Battaramulla with an extent of about 11 acres owned by the Urban Development Authority, which was used for the exhibition of "Reflection of Sri Lanka" as an Urban Forest Resort without any adverse impact upon the landscape of the area, to cater to the tourists both local and foreign, and to proceed with the activities, was approved by the the Cabinet.

description: Transferring the Water Supply System in Ratnapura Provincial General Hospital to the National Water Supply and Drainage Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to transfer the Water Supply System in Ratnapura Provincial General Hospital from the Buildings Department to the National Water Supply and Drainage Board to provide a better service to the hospital, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Avian / Pandemic Influenza Surveillance Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03
decision_details_body: -  the Centres for Disease Control and Prevention - USA is to provide funds to the Epidemiology Unit of the Ministry of Health for a period of five years for implementation of  a  National Avian / Pandemic Influenza Programme.   Sri Lanka is considered to be in high risk category for H5N1 Avian influenza due to its geographical location, existence of a considerable poultry industry and its popularity as a destination for migratory birds.  A sum of money equivalent to US $852,050 will be received over the next five years (2014-2018) in yearly installments to conduct the programme.  The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to proceed with the activities relating to the above programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Scanning and e-documenting of applications and the relevant associated documents submitted to the Department of Immigration and Emigration for obtaining Citizenship and Visas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-01-03
decision_details_body: - since a large number of applications along with supporting documents for obtaining dual citizenship, registering births of children born overseas and obtaining visas, are being received by the Department of Immigration and Emigration, it has been proposed to commence a project to convert such applications and documents relating to citizenship and visas, into an electronic document archive.  This will facilitate to strengthen the visa and citizenship issuance process and upgrade the record management system. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Integrated Timetables
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB|) and the private operators daily operate around 4,314 and 17,129 buses respectively to cater to six million passengers island-wide.  Non-operation of these buses on integrated timetable has caused immense difficulties to passengers. The proposal made by Hon. A.H.M. Fawzie, Minister (Senior) for Urban Affairs and the Chairman of the Cabinet Sub-Committee appointed for the purpose, to implement integrated timetables with a ratio of 60% - 40% between Private and SLTB buses respectively, in order to avoid unhealthy competition between SLTB and the private operators and to provide a better transport service to the public, with effect from 2014?01?15, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Equipment for Mahindodaya Technological Laboratories under the Programme of Redesigning of 1000 Secondary Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to purchase 6,600 computers with all accessories, 400 printers, 100 scanners and 85 laptop computers for 100 Mahindodaya Technological Laboratories, as per the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) and the Technical Evaluation Committee (TEC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: China Aided Superior Court Complex Maintenance Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - the Chinese Government has agreed to undertake a project to repair and refurbish the Superior Court Complex under Chinese Aid.  The proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, to exempt the items needed for the project from the relevant taxes and levy, after the project is approved as a special project under relevant Acts, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of 92 RON Gasoline in place of 90 RON Gasoline to the Local Market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - pursuance to an analysis conducted with regard to specifications of the appropriate gasoline grade to be marketed in Sri Lanka, the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) has recommended the 92 RON gasoline which has many advantages compared to 90 RON gasoline presently used.  The proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, Minister of Petroleum Industries, to introduce 92 RON gasoline to the local market with effect from 2014?01?01, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Closing of Mahaweli Tunnel at Polgolla and New Laxapana Power Tunnel for Safety Checking
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - Polgolla tunnel and intake, one of the key trans-basin conveyances of Mahaweli System was commissioned in 1976 to divert Mahaweli water to the North Central Province.  This tunnel has been last inspected in 1986 and has been in operation for more than 20 years without any inspection.  Similarly, new Laxapana Power Tunnel has not been inspected since its commission in 1975.  Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, informed the Cabinet that his Ministry has taken action to close Polgolla and New Laxapana Tunnel temporarily for two weeks during the month of January 2014 to inspect the tunnels in order to avoid any disastrous situation that may arise due to any delay in attending to structural damages, if any, of these tunnels, and also taken steps to mitigate economic and social impact of the closure.

description: Rs.520 million (Japanese Yen 400 million) Grant for Provision of Industrial Equipment under Japanese Non Project Grant Aid
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - the Government of Japan, in addition to the Annual Yen Loan Package, provides grant assistance annually under various Grant Schemes one of which is the Non-project Grant Aid Scheme, with a view to strengthening friendship and cooperation between the two countries.  The Government of Japan has agreed to grant assistance in a sum of Japanese Yen 400 million  under this Non-project Grant Aid Scheme for the financial year 2013/2014 which is to be utilized for provision of medical equipment to Teaching Hospitals, Secondary Hospitals and Medical Research Institutes of the Ministry of Health to improve the healthcare facilities for the upliftment of health standards of Sri Lankan citizens.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to sign Exchange of Notes with the Government of Japan for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Additional Grant Assistance for Financing the Cost of Extended Consultancy Services Contract of Waste Water Disposal Project for Ratmalana / Moratuwa and Ja-Ela / Ekala Areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - Waste Water Disposal Project for Ratmalana / Moratuwa and Ja-Ela / Ekala Areas is implemented with the financial assistance from the Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (SIDA) and the proposal made by the H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to sign an amendment to the Agreement with SIDA to finance the additional fund requirement for consultancy services of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Additions and Alterations to the Existing Training Centre of the Sri Lanka Bureau of the Foreign Employment at Dambulla and to upgrade it as a Fully Equipped Migrant Resource Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - the Migrant Resource Centre of Matale District is to be developed with additions and alterations to the existing Trainig Centre and provision of hostel facilities to 180 trainees and training facilitate to 350 trainees.  The proposal made by Hon. Dilan Perera, Minister of Foreign Employment Promotion and Welfare, to proceed with the relevant renovation activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Migrant Resource Centre of Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment at Hali Ela, Badulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - the above proposal made by Hon. Dilan Perera, Minister of Foreign Employment Promotion and Welfare, to provide better services to migrant workers, utilizing funds generated by the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Fertilizer for the Maha Season 2013/2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - the two proposals made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, for the award of the relevant contract for the procurement of fertilizer for the Maha Season 2013/2014 as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committees (SCAPCs) subject to the stipulations made by the General Treasury, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Enhancement of Scope of Work of the Projects Implemented under ADB and JICA Loans by Utilizing the Balance Funds of Loans
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Power and Energy, to utilize the balance funds of 03 loans provided by the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and 01 loan provided by the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), for related activities of Grid Substations of Chunnakam, Polonnaruwa, Moneragala, Valachchenai, Maho, Naula, Puttalam, Kilinochchi, Vavuniya, Kelaniya and Kiribathkumbura, with the consent of the donor agencies and to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Surface Water Development in Chilaw and Puttalam - ADB Assisted Dry Zone Urban Water & Sanitation Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - this Project is to be implemented with the assistance of the Asian Development Bank.  The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to award the above contract to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Japan International Cooperation Agency Funded Major Bridges Construction Project of the National Road Network - Procurement of Consulting Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - the Government of Sri Lanka has received a loan of Japanese Yen 12,381 million from the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) towards the cost of Major Bridges Construction Project of the National Road Network and 37 major bridges are to be constructed under this project.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to award the contract for providing consultancy services for the above project as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of 02 Ships for the Ceylon Shipping Corporation Limited under  Phase - 1 of the Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to purchase two (02)  Bulk Carriers for the Ceylon Shipping Corporation, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee (CANC) and to instruct the Director General of the Department of External Resources to finalize formalities of loan arrangements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Approval to lease out two Blocks of Land in the rest areas on Southern Expressway for the Establishment of Fuel Filling Stations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Highways, Ports and Shipping, to lease out two (02) plots of land identified near to the Rest Area on the Southern Expressway, for the establishment of Fuel Filling Stations to a subsidiary company of Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Limited, on the valuation given by the Chief Government Valuer, for a period of 30 years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commemoration of the National Safety Day - 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - 26th of December each year has been declared as the "National Safety Day" which has been commemorated for seven years continuously since 2006, centering around Galle, Ratnapura, Kandy, Kurunegala, Jaffna, Batticaloa and Badulla Districts respectively.  The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, Minister of Disaster Management, to implement the programmes scheduled for the purpose for the National Safety Day 2013 in the Kalutara District, with the active participation of the relevant Ministries and Provincial Council and other stakeholders, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal for a New Draft Bill for Soil Conservation and Preventing Land Degradation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to enact new Legislation in place of the existing Legislation, to deal with matters relating to soil conservation and land degradation more effectively in keeping with the accelerated development activities of the Government was referred to the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Legislation for recommendations.

description: Procurement of Plant Materials for Phase V of the "Divi Neguma" National Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - it has been planned to distribute vegetable seeds and plants under Phase V of the Divi Neguma National Development Programme now being implemented with the objective of developing home gardens as productive economic units ensuring food and nutrition security of the people and to make the country self sufficient to a great extent in vegetables and fruits, thereby minimizing food and fruits imports.  The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to procure plants required for the above programme from the nurseries of the Department of Agriculture and those registered with the Department and to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sales Promotion of the Products of the Disabled and the Elders Community
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: -  on the proposal made by Hon. Felix Perera, Minister of Social Services, the Cabinet granted approval for the Ministry of Social Services to formulate a combined Action Plan for the promotion and sale of the products of the disabled and the elders in association with the Ministries of Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development; Economic Development; and Botanical Gardens and Public Recreation and all other stake holders including public and private trade agencies.

description: Implementation of the National Action Plan for Disability
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - the National Policy on Disability promotes and protects the rights of differently able people in the spirit of social justice. They will have opportunities for enjoying a full and satisfying life and for contributing to national development, their knowledge, experience and particular skills and capabilities as equal citizens of Sri Lanka. The National Action Plan has been designed for implementation of 7 Thematic areas namely, Empowerment, Health and Rehabilitation, Education, Work and Employment, Mainstreaming and Enabling Environments, Data and Research and Social Institutional Cohesion.  Nearly Rs.65 billion has been allocated by the Government in the Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2014 - 2016 for the implementation of the Government Policy Framework on empowering the differently able community and mobilizing them as an equally useful segment of the society. The proposal made by Hon. Felix Perera, Minister of Social Services, to proceed with the activities relating to the implementation of the said Action Plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the term of Office of the National Delimitation Committee for the Demarcation of Wards under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) for a further period of two months
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. A.L.M. Athaulla, Minister of Local Government and Provincial Councils, to extend the term of office of the above Committee for a further period of three months with effect from 2013?12?07 for the completion of the work entrusted to the Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Completion of bridge work related to Nepal Lumbini Sri Lanka Vihara and renovation of Dutugamunu Pilgrims' Rest
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - on the above proposal made by Hon. D.M. Jayaratna, the Prime Minister in his capacity as the Minister of Buddha Sasana and Religious Affairs, Cabinet approval was granted for completion of the above works during the year 2014.

description: Allocation of Land at Hulftsdorp to the Attorney General's Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-12-16
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to allocate a vacant plot of land around 80 perches in extent situated at Hulftsdorp, Colombo 12, owned by the Urban Development Authority, to the Attorney General's Department, as the existing space in the buildings is inadequate to meet the present requirements of the Department, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Fifth South Asian Conference on Sanitation (SACOSAN)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, informed the Cabinet with regard to the representations made by the delegation from the Sri Lanka led by him at the above Conference which was held in Kathmandu, Nepal recently.  SACOSAN is a Government led biennial Convention held on rotation basis in each SAARC country providing a platform for interaction on sanitation.

description: The Convention on National Unity in Diversity to be held at the BMICH on 04th March 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - having overcome the conflicts that constrained the development of Sri Lankan nationality based on the unity in diversity, numerous programes are being implemented by Government institutions towards strengthening the feeling of belongingness as one nation. Hon. Vasudeva Nanayakkara, Minister of National Languages and Social Integration informed the Cabinet of Ministers that his Ministry intends to convene a Convention in National Unity in Diversity at the BMICH  on March 04, 2014 with the participation of experts in various segments of the society.

description: Subsidiary Loan Agreement with National Water Supply and Drainage Board for Austrian Funded Mahiyangana Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - a loan agreement has already been signed between the Government of Sri Lanka and Unicredit Bank Austria AG to finance the Mahiyangana Water Supply Project. The proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into a subsidiary loan agreement with the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWS&DB) to on-lend the proceeds of the loan to NWS&DB, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Loan facility of US$ 300 million from China Development Bank Corporation to Finance the Improvement and Rehabilitation of Priority Road Project 3 (Phase I)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body:
- the above project aims to rehabilitate about 270 km of priority road sections and the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to include the under mentioned 04 road sections too under this project and to enter into a loan agreement to obtain a loan of US$ 300 million for the above project, was approved by the Cabinet:

* Narandeniya - Hakmana Road 	-   0.00 -11.95 km
* Ayagama - Egaloya Road		-   0.00 - 23 km
* Mawanella Hemmathagama Road -  0.00 - 26 km
* Hatton Maskeliya Dalhousie Road -  0.00 - 31.89 km

description: Interest Free Loan of RMB Yuan 200 million from the People’s Republic of China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - with the view to further strengthening friendly relations and economic and technical co-operation between the two countries, the Government of the People's Republic of China has agreed to provide an interest free loan of Yuan 200 million to the Government of Sri Lanka. The loan will be utilized to implement priority projects to be agreed upon through consultations between the two Governments. The proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the  Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter  into an Agreement for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Governments of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and People’s Republic of China in the Field of Labour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - the objective of this Memorandum of Understanding is to strengthen the mutual relationship between the two countries and to promote bilateral exchange and co-operation in the field of labour policy.  The proposal made by Hon. Gamini Lokuge, Minister of Labour and Labour Relations, to sign the above Memorandum of Understanding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Fertilizer Procurement - Maha Season 2013/2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - supply of fertilizer under the subsidy scheme is being handled by the Ceylon Fertilizer Company Ltd. and Colombo Commercial Fertilizer Ltd. functioning under the purview of the Ministry of Agriculture. The procurement process to procure the fertilizer requirement for Maha Season - 2013/2014 has already commenced through pre-qualified list of registered fertilizer suppliers for the year 2013.  The proposal of  Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture  to award the contracts for the supply of fertilizer to the successful bidders as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for Supply of 60,000 Bottles of Human Albumin Solution BP or Ph EUR 	20% in 50ML Bottles
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon.  Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of 	Health, to award the above contract to the lowest responsive bidder as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the 	Cabinet.

description: The Project funded by the Saudi Fund for Development - award of contract for the Rehabilitation and Improvements to the road section from Palapathwela to Naula  (from 32.54 km to 54.18 km ) on Kandy - Jaffna Road (A9)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - the Government of Sri Lanka has received a loan of Saudi Riyal 225,000,000	(approximately US$ 60 million) from the Saudi Fund for Development for the rehabilitation and improvement of about 144 km of the National Road Network of Sri Lanka.  The project will also support to develop rural areas by providing connectivity through links with other parts of the existing roads enabling to enhance easy access for industries and agricultural activities. The proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Highways,Ports and Shipping to utilize a part of this loan for the rehabilitation and improvement of the road section from Palapathwela to Naula  (from 32.54 km to 54.18 km) on Kandy - Jaffna Road (A9) as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme funded by the Local Banks for the Rehabilitation of National Highways through Domestic Contractors - award of six (06) contracts under Stage 2
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29

description: Re-engineering of the National Institute of Sports Science for the Development of Sports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Mahindananda Aluthgamage, Minister of Sports, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Bill for the purpose, in keeping with the present day and future needs of the country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of a Land for the Hostel of Mahinda Rajapaksa Model National School, Pitipana, Homagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - this is  the first Model National School constructed under the Programme of Developing 1000 Secondary Schools and at present, the student population of the school is 2447 and the majority of the students travel to school from distant places.  It has been observed that it is essential to provide residential facilities to students as well as teachers who travel to the school from distant places.  The proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to transfer the identified block of land owned by Lanka Salusala Ltd., to the Ministry of Education to be utilized for the fulfillment of the proposed residential requirement of the school, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Sri Lanka Resident Diplomatic Mission in Kabul, Afghanistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka and Afghanistan have maintained close bilateral relations for several decades.  These historical relations between the two countries have been further enhanced with Afghanistan's entry into the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) in 2007.  The proposal made by Hon. (Prof) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to proceed with the work relating to the establishment of a Sri Lanka Diplomatic Mission in Kabul, Afghanistan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Release of confiscated sand and timber to religious places of worship
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, to release sand and timber confiscated by relevant authorities at a concessionary rate to places of religious worship subject to a maximum limit of 10 cubes of sand and 100 cubic feet of timber per place of religious worship, for renovation work, on requests made by them, and the balance quantities of sand and timber to the Government construction institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding among Member-States, Observers and Dialog Partners of Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO), on Creation of an Energy Club
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) is a permanent inter-governmental International Organization proclaimed in June 2001 in Shanghai (China), by the Republic of Kazakhastan, the People's Republic of China, the Kyrgyz Republic, the Russian Federation, the Republic of Tajikistan and the Republic of Uzbekistan. The main purposes of the SCO are strengthening mutual trust and friendship among Member States and developing their effective cooperation in the fields of economy and trade, science and technology, culture, education, energy, transportation, environmental protection and other fields etc.. The purposes of the Energy Club are to exchange views on strategy, planning, policy and investment issues in energy area, develop co-operation and train professional personnel with a specialization in energies.  The proposal made by Hon. Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Power and Energy, to sign the above MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Cooperation Agreement between the Sri Lanka Export Development Board of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the National Centre for Marketing & Price Study of the Republic of Belarus
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - with the objective of further enhancing the existing trade and economic relations between the two countries, covering approval  of the Cabinet of Ministers was granted to the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce for signing of the above Agreement.

description: Release of land for Sewer Treatment Plant for Kandy City Waste-water Management Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - a Waste-water Treatment System has been planned to serve the Kandy City Centre, Kandy Lake Round, Peradeniya - Kandy Road, William Gopallawa Mawatha and Mahaiyawa covering an area of 733 hectares. The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to release the identified block of land to the National Water Supply and Drainage Board to construct the proposed Sewer Treatment Plant for the Kandy City Waste-water Management Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Dambulla Sacred Area Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - the Urban Development Authority (UDA) has prepared the Greater Dambulla Development Plan, to facilitate the fast growing economic activities in the Dambulla Town Centre and its surrounding areas.  Considering importance and urgency, the UDA has taken action to take over the balance development work of the Sacred Area Development Plan on a priority basis.  The proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to proceed with the relevant activities was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Pola Development Projects at Padukka, Delkanda and Embilipitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to develop the existing Padukka Pola and the Embilipitiya Pola and to relocate the existing Delkanda Pola which is currently functioning either side of the High Level Road, at Delkanda area for the benefit of the public and the vendors, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Handing over of Beira Lake Area to Sri Lanka Land Reclamation & Development Corporation for Maintenance Purposes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - action is being taken by the Government to develop Colombo and its suburbs as environmental friendly cities in keeping with international standards. Since the maintenance of the main canal systems in Colombo and development of new links are being carried out by the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation, the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to hand over the Beira Lake Area with the consent of the Sri Lanka Ports Authority, to the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation for maintenance works, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of 01 Acre Land at Wedamulla, Kelaniya to Police Department
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29

description: Establishment of a Vocational Training Centre in the Northern Province with Grant Assistance from the Government of the Federal Republic of Germany
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-11
decision_details_body: - a Vocational Training Centre with necessary facilities is to be established at Kilinochchi with grant assistance from the Government of the Federal Republic of Germany and the work is to be completed by 2015.   The proposed Vocational Training Centre will have the capacity to cater to 200 trainees and will offer short-term and long-term training programmes.  The Government of Germany has agreed to enhance its financial contribution for this project with an additional grant of Euro 4.4 million, to establish 8 Satellite Centres at this Vocational Training Centre at Kilinochchi and these Satellite Centres will be established in Mullaitivu, Jaffna, Kilinochchi, Vavuniya and Mannar Districts.  The project will be implemented by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Skills Development in close collaboration with the relevant line Ministries and Agencies.  The above proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal for Drafting a New Bill for Seeds and Planting Material Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-11
decision_details_body: – the Government has observed that it has become a timely need to draft a new Bill to deal with all aspects in the field of seeds and planting material in keeping with the new trends of scientific agricultural development in the country.  The use of low quality seeds has led to various issues including low productivity and farmer disputes.  The provisions presently available under the Seed Act, No. 22 of 2003 are insufficient to address such issues and to ensure the rights of farmers.  Accordingly, it was decided to refer the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Legislation for its recommendations.

description: Investment Projects offered for CHOGM Business Forum in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-10-31
decision_details_body:
- in conjunction with the Commonwealth Heads of Governments' Meeting scheduled to be held in Sri Lanka from 15th to 17th November, 2013, the Commonwealth Business Council (CBC) in collaboration with the Government of Sri Lanka, has organized the Commonwealth Business Forum (CBF).  The CBF is to be held between 12th and 14th November, 2013 at the Hotel Cinnamon Grand, Colombo.  The key objective of the CBF is to attract foreign direct investments to Sri Lanka through potential investors from Commonwealth countries by making them aware of the vast investment opportunities available in Sri Lanka in various sectors.  The CBC jointly with the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka has identified investment opportunities which could be offered to potential foreign investors during the forthcoming CBF.  Some of the sectors of such projects are as follows:

* 	Tourism and Leisure 
* 	Higher Education and Training
* 	Agriculture and Fisheries
* 	Health
* 	Information Technology
* 	Manufacturing and Agro-processing
* 	Infrastructure including Aviation.

The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Investment Promotion to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Difficulties faced by Teachers at the Zonal Education Offices

description: Multi-Sector Action Plan for Nutrition
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-10-31
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that the country has entered a phase of rapid growth and development and that the workforce has to be transformed into a productive human resource which is physically and mentally fit to meet the challenges.  The improvement of nutrition of all age groups and segments of the population up to the required level needs intervention not only from the health sector but also from stakeholders from other sectors such as education, agriculture, livestock etc.  Nutrition is thus identified as requiring a multi-sectoral approach.  The Multi-Sector Action Plan for nutrition comprises activities formulated by a panel of experts under the guidance of the National Nutrition Council (NNC) in keeping with globally accepted standards for nutrition.  The proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Chairman, National Nutrition Council, to proceed with the activities relating to the above, was approved by the Cabinet.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-10-17
decision_details_body: - white cane is used by the visually impaired community for mobility, to ensure protection and to display their identity.  At present, nearly 200,000 visually impaired persons in the country use white canes but there is no specific provision in the Protection of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act No.28 of 1996 for the purpose.  Having considered the proposal submitted by Hon. Felix Perera, Minister of Social Services pertaining to this issue, the Cabinet of Ministers decided that laws should enacted to provide legal protection to all physically handicapped persons.

description: Comprehensive Mastitis Control Programme for increased milk production

It is proposed to implement a comprehensive National Mastitis Control Programme in the country by enhancing the production capacity of locally manufactured udder infusions by the Veterinary Research Institute (VRI).  This project is to be implemented over a period of 05 years commencing from 2014.

description: Visit of His Excellency the President to New York, USA for the 68th Session of the United Nations General Assembly - September 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-10-10
decision_details_body: - Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, presented the Report to the Cabinet on the above visit of His Excellency the President.  In his address to the General Assembly, His Excellency stressed inter alia, the need to protect and abide by the principle of equal treatment of countries as the bedrock of all international interactions.  H.E. the President explained the salutary accomplishments of Sri Lanka in the socio economic sphere, made despite the 2004 Tsunami, global financial meltdown and a protracted conflict.  He also called upon the United Nations to declare an International Skills Day.  He stated that the Northern Provincial Council Election was held after the lapse of almost a quarter of century and emphasized its importance in the context of political empowerment and reconciliation and stressed that it is clearly the responsibility of the international communities to assist with these efforts and ensure their success for the benefit of all the people in the country.  H.E. the President in conclusion, referred to the disproportionate emphasis on Sri Lanka and the unequal treatment through the multilateral framework while questioning the basis for this relentless pursuit despite the country's consistent engagement with the UN mechanisms and the visible progress made.  H.E. the President also took this opportunity to conduct bilateral meetings with several Heads of Governments and the Secretaries General of the United Nations and the Commonwealth.
