description: Revision of 2:5  of Chapter VI, 1:5 of Chapter XII  and 6:4 of Chapter XXVIII of the Establishments Code
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-10-10
decision_details_body: - the telegram service which was used by Public Officers as one of the modes to inform the respective Heads of Departments when they are unable to report for duty owing to an urgent matter, specially without obtaining prior approval, has been terminated with effect from 2013?10?01.  Under the circumstances, the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, to make necessary arrangements to recognize the Tele-mail service which has been introduced by the Department of Posts as an alternative to the Telegram service, as a legal document for the purpose of obtaining leave for Public Officers; and to make necessary amendments to the provisions of the Establishments Code accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Resurfacing and Improvements to Baseline Road from Kelanitissa Roundabout to Kanatta Roundabout (0.00 km - 4.80 km)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-19
decision_details_body: the Section of the Baseline Road from Kelanitissa Roundabout to Kanatta Roundabout (0.00 km - 4.80 km) has a dual carriageway with six traffic lanes.  This section of the road requires resurfacing urgently in order to provide a better service.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to proceed with the work relating to the above, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Two Storied Building for the Divisional Secretariat, Galewela
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-19
decision_details_body: - Galewela Divisional Secretary's Division consists of 59 Grama Niladhari Divisions and the total population is about 75,000.   The proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, to construct a two storied building at a cost of Rs.50 million, to provide better services to the people living in the area, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of an Underground Vehicle Park at Senanayake Ground of Badulla Town
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-19
decision_details_body: - it has been proposed to construct an underground vehicle park and a green garden in Badulla Town for the convenience of the public.  Preliminary works of the project are to be commenced utilizing an allocation of Rs.15 million provided to the District Secretary, Badulla in the Budget Estimate for 2013.  The proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Dry Zone Urban Water and Sanitation Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-19
decision_details_body: - Tender for Construction of Water Storage Structures in Mannar - the above project is being implemented by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board with Government of Sri Lanka contribution and loan funds provided by the Asian Development Bank.  There are 15 major contract packages to be awarded to implement the various components of the project in the four towns of Puttalam, Chillaw, Vavuniya and Mannar and the above is one such contract.  This contract includes two (02) ground reservoirs, an elevated tower and Chlorination System.  The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to award the above tender to the lowest evaluated responsive bidder as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Workshop on Heritage Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-19
decision_details_body: - the Indian Ocean Rim Association for Regional Co-operation (IOR-ARC) was set up in 1995 and formally launched in March 1997 in Mauritius with its main focus for Regional Co-operation.  It currently comprises of 20 Member States.  The above is a two day workshop expected to be held in May 2014 and will be jointly organized by the Ministry of National Heritage and the Ministry of External Affairs.  The main objective of this workshop is to create awareness among IOR-ARC Member States regarding diversity of culture and heritage of Member States.  The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Jagath Balasooriya, Minister of National Heritage, to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Cocoa Development Project - Uva Wellassa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-19
decision_details_body: - Cocoa was introduced to Sri Lanka by the British in 1834.  Cocoa cultivation was established in Matale of the Central Hills and Uva Wellassa areas in Sri Lanka as a mixed crop with rubber and coconut.  A new rubber cultivation programme in 5000 ha. is underway in the Uva Province and this programme has created a favourable environment to commence growing cocoa as a mixed crop.   The objective of the above project is to ensure the maximum utilization of existing lands while maintaining ecological balance in the respective zone thereby increasing the extent of cocoa cultivation up to 3000 ha., and the cocoa harvest up to 5550 mt. by 2020.  On the proposal made by Hon. Reginald Cooray, Minister of Minor Export Crop Promotion, Cabinet approval was granted to proceed with the programme in close collaboration with the Ministry of Plantation Industries and the Rubber Development Department.

description: Tenth Commonwealth Women’s Affairs Ministers Conference held in Dhaka, Bangladesh
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-19

description: Establishment of a Resident Diplomatic Mission of Sri Lanka in Victoria, the Republic of Seychelles
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-19
decision_details_body: - The Republic of Seychelles is one of the internationally active countries in the African Region.  Diplomatic relations between Seychelles and Sri Lanka were established at Ambassadorial level in 1988 and at present the High Commissioner of Sri Lanka in Pretoria is concurrently accredited to Seychelles.  H.E. the President of Sri Lanka undertook a State visit to Seychelles in late June this year and during the visit the two leaders expressed their strong desire to broaden and deepen economic, diplomatic  ties between the two countries.  Some of the outcomes of the visit are -*    Sri Lankan Air Lines and Mihin Lanka to commence direct air traffic between the two countries;*    Bank of Ceylon, with the concurrence of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, to establish a Bank of Ceylon Branch in Seychelles;*    The Insurance Corporation of Sri Lanka to establish a Branch Office in Seychelles; and*    Nawaloka Group of Sri Lanka is considering the establishment of a Hospital in Seychelles.The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to establish a Resident Diplomatic Mission of Sri Lanka in Victoria, Seychelles and to proceed with the connected activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Second New Kelani Bridge - Shifting of High Voltage Transmission Lines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-12
decision_details_body: - a preparatory survey on traffic improvement project around new Kelani Bridge is being carried out by the Road Development Authority (RDA), in line with the proposed construction of the second new Kelani Bridge in collaboration with Japan International Co-operation Agency (JICA) and it has been revealed that the 2 overhead high tension transmission lines should be converted to underground cables to provide the required clearance to the proposed new Bridge and associated highway network.  The proposal made by Hon. Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Power and Energy to proceed with the activities relating to the shifting of the  High Voltage Transmission Lines, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for supply of 100,000 Vials of Dried Factor VIII Fraction BP (Dried Human Antihaemophilic Fraction) or Human Coagulation Factor VIII Ph Eur (250IU-300IU)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-12
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to purchase 50% of the above from the previous supplier, and to call for fresh world-wide tenders to purchase one year requirement of  the above item, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), to meet the present needs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal to set up and operate an Integrated Resort at D.R. Wijewardene Mawatha, Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-12
decision_details_body: - this would include a hotel with a minimum of 400 rooms, convention facilities, restaurants and other associated facilities with a total investment of US $350 million.  The project will generate direct employment for 2600 local employees and will also create indirect employment opportunities.  The proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Investment Promotion, to proceed with the activities relating to the award of the project and matters connected thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Integrated Tourism Related Project to be set up at Glennie Street and Justice Akbar Mawatha, Colombo 02
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-12
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Lakahman Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Investment Promotion, to implement a project to set up a luxury multi / mixed use Integrated Resort consisting of the convention centre, entertainment facilities, international standard shopping mall, luxury condominiums and office space with a total investment of US $650 million, which will create direct employment opportunities for 3000-4000 persons during the construction period and in addition, 3000 direct and indirect employment on commencement of business operations, and to grant concessions under the Strategic Development Project Act, No.14 of 2008 (as amended), for the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lankan Delegation to the 9th Regional Women Ministers’ and Parliamentarian’s Conference on Gender Equity and the Post 2015 Development Agenda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-12
decision_details_body: - Sri Lankan delegation headed by Hon. Tissa Karalliyadda, Minister of Child Development and Women’s Affairs and consisting of  three Deputy Ministers had attended the above Conference held in Seoul, South Korea on 15th and 16th of May 2013 which was hosted by the Asian Forum of Parliamentarians on Population and Development (AFPPD) in partnership with the Korean Parliamentary League on Children, Population and Development and Plan Population Federation of Korea with assistance from the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) and Japan Trust Fund.  The Conference was attended by 45 delegates representing more than 15 countries in the Asian Pacific Region.  Hon. Tissa Karalliyadda, in his speech, had highlighted the action taken by the Ministry of Child Development and Women’s Affairs and the Government of Sri Lanka and structural arrangements in place to eliminate all forms of violence against women and children, and towards maintaining gender equality in Sri Lanka, and also to provide education, health and employment facilities by the State to all its citizens without any discrimination based on gender, ethnicity, cast or creed.  The participants had appreciated the development goals reached by Sri Lanka, particularly the very high literacy rate and attendance of women in tertiary education, low maternity and infantile death rates, high rate of girls' attendance in primary and secondary education and the high rate of women employed in professional jobs etc. Cabinet of Ministers noted with appreciation, the above information provided by Hon. Tissa Karalliyadda, Minister of Child Development and Women’s Affairs.

description: A). Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Co-operation (BIMSTEC) Convention on Cooperation in Combating International Terrorism, Transnational Organized Crime and Illicit Drug Trafficking
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-12
decision_details_body: - the salient features of this Convention are -*    co-operation in sharing experiences in areas of mutual concern while enhancing co-operation between law enforcement Agencies of the Member Countries;*    sharing and exchanging of information on financing of terrorism, transnational organized crime and illicit drug trafficking; and*    co-ordinating ways and means to facilitate mutual legal assistance in criminal matters, arrest, extradition and prosecution of individuals, their associates engaged in crimes covered within the scope of the Convention. B). Memorandum of Association (MOA) among the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Co-operation (BIMSTEC) Member Countries for Establishment of BIMSTEC Energy Centre - the main objectives of this MOA are -*    to create, manage  and evaluate energy related data-base relevant to the Region;   *    to prepare and operate a framework for networking among the national level institutions in the Region; and *    to enhance co-operation for capacity building and sharing of experiences on best practices. The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to proceed with the activities relating to the above, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing of a Land for Development activities of the University of Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-12
decision_details_body: - the present student population at the University of Jaffna is around 5700.  The Faculties of Science, Arts (including the Division of Law), Management Studies & Commerce, and Medicine (including the Division of Allied Health Science) of the University and the Institutes of Siddha Medicine and Ramanathan Academy of Fine Arts are established in Jaffna.   It has been identified as a crucial development project to uplift the standard of the University of Jaffna and also accommodate the  increasing student population. Therefore, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to purchase an identified block of land with the view to expanding the activities of the University, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Continuance of the National Online Distance Education Service (NODES) as a Division of the Ministry of Higher Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-12
decision_details_body: - NODES has facilitated local as well as foreign students to follow 35 educational courses at 26 Access Centres throughout the country, through the Distance Education System being implemented based on a computer network.  In 2012, about 8000 students of the Open University have utilized the facilities at Access Centres of the NODES.  Further, in 2012, under a partnership programme the government has formed with the private institutes, it has been possible to provide learning facilities for about 6,500 employees in the government and the private sector, using technological facilities possessed by the  NODES and it is expected to increase this number up to 9000 by the end of 2013.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to proceed with the proposed activities relating to NODES, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of International Irrigation and Water Management Training Institute of Kotmale, Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-12
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to recruit trainees to the above Institute which was established in 2012, to be trained as Engineering Assistants and Technical Assistants to meet the existing shortage of Engineering Staff in the Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka and the Department of Irrigation and other Government Institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Deyata Kirula National Development Programme 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-05
decision_details_body: - Village Level Public Meetings and Mobile Services - Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minster of Economic Development, informed the Members of the Cabinet that, parallel to the Deyata Kirula Exhibition 2014, community welfare services and mobile services are being implemented, covering all Grama Niladhari Divisions of the three Districts of Kurunegala, Kegalle and Puttalam.  The main objectives of this programme are:*    to identify individual and family based problems, including land, housing etc., and to provide solutions for same;*    to identify common amenities to be developed within the Grame Niladhari Divisions;*    to provide various services by Government Institutions at village level; and*    to provide mobile health clinics at village level for the benefit of the public.

description: State Visit of H.E. the President of Sri Lanka to the Republic of Belarus - 25th to 27th August 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-05
decision_details_body: - H.E. the President paid a State Visit to the Republic of Belarus from 25-27 August 2013, at the invitation of the President of the Republic of Belarus and this was the first State Visit to Belarus by a Head of State of Sri Lanka.  Bilateral discussions between the leaders of the two countries had been conducted in an atmosphere of openness, friendship and mutual understanding and the constructive exchange of views were promising for further development and strengthening of bilateral relations as well as issues of mutual interests on the international agenda. Some of the salient outcomes of the above visit are as follows:*    establishment of a Joint Commission on Trade and Economic Cooperation for the development of economic ties between the two countries;*    a delegation from Belarus to visit Sri Lanka with the view to establishing a tractor and agricultural machinery assembling plant for which a partner from Sri Lanka will be identified for a Joint Venture;*    flexible conditions on prices for the import of fertilizer to be worked out;*    cooperation in the fields of dairy production and cattle breeding; *    education particularly in the Science and Medical fields;  *   agreement of cooperation in higher education between the Universities of the two countries; and*    enhanced exports from Belarus to Sri Lanka, for supply to South and South East Asia, taking advantage of the free port system and Free Trade Agreements of Sri Lanka.Memoranda of Understanding/Agreements on the following were signed during    the visit, to further enhance the bilateral relations:    *    Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters;*    Trade and Economic Cooperation;*    Avoidance of Double Taxation and Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income; and*    Cooperation in the Field of Tourism.

description: The Second Global Young Parliamentarians' Consultation on International Conference on Population and Development and Post 2015 UN Development Agenda - 3rd and 4th October 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-05
decision_details_body: - the above International Conference sponsored by the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) New York Office and organized by the Asian Forum of Parliamentarians' on Population and Development (AFPPD) is scheduled to be held in Colombo on 3rd and 4th October 2013.  Hon. D.M. Jayaratne, the Prime Minister and Hon. Chamal Rajapakse, the Speaker of Parliament, have been invited to grace the occasion and address the delegates.  The main objective of this meeting is to review the global progress made on International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD) Programme of Action from the perspective of young Parliamentarians. The outcome expected of this meeting will be that the Young Members of Parliament are adequately briefed and prepared to make positive contributions for the ICPD beyond 2014.  All expenses towards conducting of this meeting in Sri Lanka will be met by the UNFPA New York Office.  The proposal made by Hon. Tissa Karalliyadda, Minister of Child Development and Women's Affairs, to organize and conduct this meeting in Colombo, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a permanent building and an access roadway for the Office of the Public Service Commission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-05
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, for the construction of a permanent building for the Office of the Public Service Commission, in a block of land adjoining the premises of the Ministry of Lands and Land Development with funds to be provided under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework and to proceed with the matters connected thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Special Education Resource and Information Centres
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-05
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that the teaching process that has to be adopted for the children with visual and hearing impairments, Autism etc. is more complex than that of normal students and it is essential to provide special equipment and facilities and specially trained teachers for their education. The proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to establish Resource and Information Centres for students with special needs with financial allocations to be provided under the Medium Term Expenditure Framework 2013 - 2015 and for the implementation of special education programmes with a proper co-ordination with the Ministries of Education, Health, Social Services, Vocational Training and Media, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reconstruction of the Wekanda National Housing Scheme at Stuart Street, Colombo 02.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-05
decision_details_body: -  At present these housing units pose a great danger as they are in a dilapidated condition. The residents in the above Housing Scheme consisting of 114 housing units in 4, four storyed buildings constructed long ago are to be relocated as early as possible.   On the above proposal made by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, for the relocation of the residents of the above Housing Scheme, Cabinet approval was granted to allocate 114 housing units from an Urban Housing Project in Colombo being implemented by the Urban Development Authority (UDA).

description: Livelihood Development of Palmyrah Dependent 70,000 Families in the Northern Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-05
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that there are about 10 million Palmyrah trees in the Northern Province alone which has contributed to the Northern economy as a source of food and beverages, craft sector development, provision of timber and leaves for housing and shelter, projection of heritage and culture and in generating income earning opportunities for the people living in the relevant areas.  There are over 70,000 families depending on the Palmyrah Sector, directly and indirectly in the Northern Province. The Palmyrah sector contributes to the livelihood development through variety of palmyrah based value added products such as - *    Sap based products (jaggery, treacle, sweet toddy etc.); *    Fruit based products (soft drinks, panadu, jam etc.);  *    Leaf based products (handicraft, dustbins, bags, table mats etc.); *    Fibre based products (broomsticks, brushes etc.); *    Tuber based products (odial, palm posha, odial flour etc.); and *    Wood based products (timber, furniture etc.)Palmyrah based handicraft training is to be expanded in the Northern and Eastern Provinces, including Puttalam and Hambantota Districts.  The proposal made by Hon. Douglas Devananda, Minister of Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development, to implement the identified projects that need State intervention on a priority basis under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework through the Palmyrah Development Board in the Northern Province, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation Project for Gin Ganga Flood Regulation Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-05
decision_details_body: - this Scheme implemented with Chinese Government aid in the late 70's had commenced its operation in 1982 and is located in the Galle District, covering Badalgama, Bope - Poddala, Welivita, Divitura and Hikkaduwa Divisional Secretary's Division.  The main objectives of the Scheme are, to protect cultivation of 5000 ha of paddy lands in lower valley of Gin Ganga from damages caused by frequent flooding and to protect around 20,000 families living in the area from flood hazards.  Having observed that, rehabilitation of Gin Ganga Flood Regulation Scheme is a long felt need, Cabinet approval was granted to the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to implement the said rehabilitation project at a total cost of Rs.700 million, over a period of 3 years from 2014 to 2016.

description: 'Smart - Sri Lanka' - An ICT Development Strategy for Sri Lanka (e-Sri Lanka Development Initiative - Phase 2)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-09-05
decision_details_body: - the primary objective of this initiative is to achieve national economic development by bringing the dividends of ICT   within the reach of every village and citizen of the country.  The ICT literacy rate which was less than 8% in 2005 had surpassed 35% by 2012, primarily due to the expansion of the 'Nenasala' Network in remote areas.  The above project is to be implemented over a period of 5 to 6 years, commencing in the first quarter of 2014.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, to proceed with the project, subject to stipulations laid down by the General Treasury, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recent reports of milk powder contamination with Dicyandiamide (DCD) and Whey Protein Concentrate Contamination with Clostridium Botulinum Bacteria
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-29
decision_details_body: - Cabinet at its meeting held on 2013-08-15 appointed a Cabinet Sub-Committee headed by Hon. D.E.W. Gunasekara, Minister (Senior) for Human Resources and consisting of six other Ministers to examine this issue and submit a Report to the Cabinet.  Accordingly, the Report of the Committee was submitted by Hon. D.E.W. Gunasekara, Minister (Senior) for Human Resources and the following recommendations contained in the Report were approved by the Cabinet for implementation:(a)    to improve the capacity of local laboratories to meet the emerging demands including those at the Medical Research Institute and Industrial Technical Institute; (b)    to inspect the Complex and Advanced Food Manufacturing Plants in Sri Lanka by the experts under the Chief Food Authority to ensure good manufacturing practices;(c)    to launch an Island-wide programme to promote breast feeding and consumption of locally produced liquid milk by the Ministry of Health in collaboration with other relevant stakeholders;(d)    to take action to strengthen the capacity of the Food Authority in terms of staff and other facilities and to amend the Food Act to address the existing and emerging food safety issues effectually;(e)    to direct the Ministry of Health to publish a detailed news paper advertisement indicating in simple language:(i)    background of the issue; and(ii)    a system of labelling to identify the products free of DCD and Clostridium bacteria, which are safe to consume.(f)    to ensure the introduction of the new labelling system prior to publishing the above public communication;(g)    to purchase a Liquid Chromatograph Mass Spectrometer (LC/MS/MS) for the ITI;(h)    to direct the Chief Food Authority and the Consumer Affairs Authority to withdraw from the market  imported milk products suspected to be contaminated with  DCD as decided by that Authority; and(i)    to ensure close collaboration with the Ministry of Health, the Consumer Affairs Authority and the Industrial Technology Institute when addressing the issues of this nature. Action will also be taken to introduce a methodology to carry out Food Safety Hazards Tests prior to clearance of goods by the Customs, jointly by the Sri Lanka Customs, the Medical Research Institute and the Industrial Technical Institute in keeping with international standards.

description: Rehabilitation of 2x37.5 MW Samanala Power Station - Polpitiya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-29
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Power and Energy, to authorize the Ceylon Electricity Board to proceed with the International Competitive Bidding process to select a contractor for the rehabilitation of Samanala Power Station and with matters connected thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Defence Services College in Kurunegala for the Children of Three Forces and Police Personnel
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-29
decision_details_body: - the Defence Services College has been commenced in Colombo to provide educational facilities to the Children of the three Forces and the Police.  Cabinet approval has already been granted to expand such facilities to other areas of the country.  The joint proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development and Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to develop Wewagedara Junior School in Kurunegala as the 'Kurunegala Defence Services College' and to proceed with the activities thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Membership of the International Tropical Fruits Network (TFNet) by Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-29
decision_details_body: - International Tropical Fruits Network is a Regional Development Organization established under the auspices of the World Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and is acting as a network to promote the production, productivity, processing, marketing, quality, consumption and international trade of tropical fruits.  The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeyewardena, Minister of Agriculture, to obtain Membership of this Organization, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding for Agricultural Co-operation to be signed between the Republic of Turkey and the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-29
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to sign the above Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) during the visit to Sri Lanka of the Minister of Food, Agriculture and Livestock of the Republic of Turkey in October 2013, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Setting up a Formal National Program for the Common use and sharing of Spatial Data and Information
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-29
decision_details_body: - spatial data means geo-spatial data or information which could exactly indicate the geographic location of a natural or constructed feature on earth such as a road, river, building, and allotment of land or a boundary of land.  The proposal made by Hon. Janaka Bandara Thennakoon, Minister of Lands and Land Development, to implement the above programme through a separate unit to be established in the Survey Department under the directives of the Ministry of Lands and Land Development, and for the appointment of a Monitoring Committee consisting of representatives of the relevant Ministries and Departments, to monitor this programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 66th Independence Day falling on 04th February 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-29
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee headed by Hon. D.M. Jayaratne, the Prime Minister and Minister of Buddha Sasana and Religious Affairs and consisting of 07 other Ministers including the Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs and the Chief Minister, Sabaragamuwa Province and a Deputy Minister, to prepare the programme and to organize and monitor the necessary matters relevant to the 66th Independence Day Celebrations falling on 04th February 2014, and for the Secretary, Ministry of Public Administration and Home Affairs to function as the Secretary to this Cabinet Sub-Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Provincial Offices to provide services of the Ministry of National Languages and Social Integration at Provincial Level
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-29
decision_details_body: - on the proposal made by Hon. Vasudeva Nanayakkara, Minister of National Languages and Social Integration, to establish Provincial Offices to provide services to the Public relating to National Languages and Social Integration at Provincial Level, Cabinet approval was granted for the submission of a detailed Project Report covering all Provinces, to the Department of National Planning of the Ministry of Finance and Planning for appraisal and for the provision of funds for the purpose under the Medium Term Expenditure Framework 2014-2016. Some of the activities to be carried out by this office are -monitoring of all language classes in the Province and providing facilities to conduct classes;*    effective assistance for co-ordination and implementation of social integration activities;*    provision of translation and interpretation facilities;*    identification of challenges faced by Public Institutions in implementing the Official Languages Policy of the Government;*    matters relating to the implementation of the Official Languages Policy of the Government; *    language training and co-ordination by the National Institute for Language Education and Training.

description: Amendment to Section 431 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-29
decision_details_body: - with a view to avoid unnecessary delays in disposing Court productions accumulated in Court premises, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, to amend Section 431 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979, for the period of time given to a person from the date of the notification published in the Court Notice Board and two other public places, to establish a person's claim in respect of a property, the possession of which is unknown, be reduced to 02 months from 06 months, the value of such property to be increased from Rs.2500/- to Rs.25,000/-, and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 147 Housing Units located at No.210-260, Sirimavo Bandaranaike Mawatha, (former Prince of Wales Street), Colombo 14.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-29
decision_details_body: - there are about 1000 residents residing in the above Housing Scheme consisting of 147 housing units in six buildings constructed long ago.  At present these housing units pose a great danger as they are in a dilapidated condition.  Since these buildings are to undergo major repairs, action is to be taken to relocate the residents in a Housing Scheme around Sirimavo Bandaranaike Mawatha, being constructed by the Urban Development Authority.  The old buildings are to be demolished and it has been proposed to implement a suitable housing project in the said premises, after taking over of the land either by the National Housing Development Authority or by the Condominium Management Authority.   The above proposal made by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Land Blocks from Regional Industrial Estates to set up Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-29
decision_details_body: - Regional Industrial Estates Development Programme is being implemented by the Ministry of Industry and Commerce, with the objective of promoting industries at Regional Level.  The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce, to allocate blocks of land from Industrial Estates on lease basis to prospective investors, subject to stipulations,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of National Eye Bank of Sri Lanka as a Trust
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-29
decision_details_body: - major causes of blindness worldwide, with the highest prevalence in Asia, are diseases affecting the Cornea.  Asia Cornea Society (ACS) has been formed by leading corneal specialists in Asian countries, contributing significantly towards developing clinical, educational and research programmes aiming at alleviating Asian and global corneal blindness. National Eye Bank of Sri Lanka is a non-profitable organization with a mission to procure and provide donated human eye tissues for sight restoring transplantation procedures as well as providing tissues for research and education.  The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to convert the existing National Eye Bank of Sri Lanka to a Public Trust by an Act of Parliament and to proceed with matters connected thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of Biometrics (Fingerprints) to the Passport Issuance Process
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-29
decision_details_body: - this project is to intended to enhance the security features of Passports by streamlining the Automated Fingerprint Identification System. The Total Estimated Cost of the Project is Rs.679.7 million of which Rs.629.7 million is to be provided as a grant by the Australian Government, through the International Organization for Migration which will be responsible for the project management and procurement process, in association with the Department of Immigration and Emigration.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strategic Cities Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-29
decision_details_body: - the proposed Project is to be implemented in Galle and Kandy as the initial phase of the project.  The assistance of the World Bank will be received for this urban development programme of the Government, to plan, design and develop selected cities and its surrounding areas to facilitate a guided economic transformation of such cities into one of the major regional economic centres for growth and employment generation.  The project is to be commenced in 2013 and completed within a period of three (03) years at a cost of US $200 million.  Some of the salient features of the project are as follows:*    improved urban infrastructure and services at the city centre and peripheral local authority areas of Greater Kandy and Galle cities.*    improved traffic and transport arrangements in both cities.*    improved urban road network to ease the traffic flow in both cities.*    benefits to the urban community by improving drainage facilities and solid waste management systems. Cabinet granted approval to proceed with the project submitted by H.E. the President,  in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development.

description: Bilateral Agreement and Treaty between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Republic of Belarus
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-22
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, to sign the above Agreement and the Treaty on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal matters between Sri Lanka and Belarus during the forthcoming visit of H.E. the President of Sri Lanka to Belarus, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The 5th South Asian Conference on Sanitation (SACOSAN-V) from 21st to 24th  October, 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-22
decision_details_body: - this Conference is scheduled to be held from 21st to 24th  October, 2013 in Nepal and will be attended by the Ministers of Water Supply and Drainage; Health; and Education and Government Officials.  The representatives from the Civil Society, Private Sector Institutions,  Academia and School Children from the South Asian Region viz. Pakistan, India, Nepal, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Maldives, Afghanistan, including Sri Lanka are expected to participate in this International Conference.   Cabinet noted the above information provided by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of  Water Supply and Drainage in this regard.

description: Medium Term Expenditure Framework 2014-2016 and Preparation of Budget 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-22
decision_details_body: - H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, informed the Cabinet of Ministers that the Ministry has already commenced the initial activities relating to the preparation of the Budget 2014.  His Excellency stated that, as a country with a higher economic growth and encouraging development by expanding the infrastructure facilities and strengthening the financial management, the principle target of the strategy is to raise per-capita income over US $4,000.  A large number of projects is being implemented at rural, regional and urban levels covering social, economic and environmental sectors to achieve these targets. 2014 Budget will also give priority for timely completion of such projects to ensure that expected benefits of those projects will reach the general public at the earliest.

description: Construction of Proposed University Complex of National School of Business Management Limited (NSBM) at Homagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-22
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted for the construction of the proposed University Complex at Homagama to be funded through a loan from the China Development Bank.  The proposal made by Hon. Dullas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to award the construction contract of the above to the lowest bid received, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Modernization of the Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation (SLBC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-22
decision_details_body: - according to a concept of H.E. the President it has been proposed to modernize the SLBC under a leading project of the Government.  The objective of this project is to upgrade, while preserving the historic value of the Lanka Broadcasting Corporation, which has commenced its services as the oldest broadcasting service in South Asia in 1924.  The proposal made by Hon. Keheliya Rambukwella, Minister of Mass Media and Information, to obtain architectural consultancy services from the UDA and required funds from the Government Treasury, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Buildings for the Faculty of Management and Finance, University of Ruhuna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-22
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to award the above contract to the next lowest evaluated responsive bidder, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of  Galle Road  and  R. A. De Mel Mawatha  Contract Package ‘A’ (from Galadari Roundabout to Kollupitiya Junction)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-22
decision_details_body: - Metro Colombo Urban Development Project (MCUDP) has been established under the Ministry of Defence and Urban Development as a World Bank Project funded by the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD).  As a part of this project, it has been decided to rehabilitate the above section of the Galle  Road.  The proposal made by H. E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development to award the above contract to the lowest evaluated responsive bidder, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Air Services Agreement between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and Australia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-22
decision_details_body: - covering approval of the Cabinet was granted for the Amended Text of the Air Services Agreement which has already been signed between the two countries and to take necessary steps for the effective implementation of the said Agreement, as proposed by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation.

description: Establishment of Rehabilitation Centers for Drug Addicts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-22
decision_details_body: - drug addiction has become a huge calamity to the society at present. In addition to destroying the state wealth, that has turned into a mechanism of converting energetic youth generation with capabilities into patients.  In 2011, the numbers of imprisonments due to drug addiction were 10,568. 6,165 persons had been imprisoned due to the same offence for the second time and 2,073 for more than two occasions. When considering as a percentage, it amounts to 78%. Bureau of Commissioner General of Rehabilitation which possesses an experienced staff of rehabilitating and reintegrating LTTE ex-combatants will have the competency of rehabilitating drug addicts jointly with the National Dangerous Drugs Control Board.  A proposal made by Hon. Chandrasiri Gajadeera, Minister of Rehabilitation and Prison Reforms for the establishment of Rehabilitation Centers under the Bureau of Commissioner General of Rehabilitation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Republic of Maldives on Co-operation in the Field of Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-22
decision_details_body: -  the proposed Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) recognizes the importance of Education and Training in National Development as well as a means to further cultivate ties between their people.  The above proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to sign the above MoU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Celebration of World Habitat Day 2013 - 07th of October 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-22
decision_details_body: - the 'World Habitat Day' for this year falls on 07th of October.  A Habitat Week from 30th of September to 06th of October has been declared on account of the World Habitat Day.  The proposal made by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, to implement the Programme of events drawn up for the purpose, including development of the village at Laksirigama in the Moratuwa Divisional Secretary's Division, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Agreement between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Republic of Belarus on Trade and Economic Co-operation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-22
decision_details_body: - the objective of this Agreement is to further enhance the existing trade and economic relations between the two countries.  The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce, to sign the above Agreement during the forthcoming visit of H.E. the President of Sri Lanka to Belarus, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Environment Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-22
decision_details_body: this project has been formulated by the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation (SLLR&DC) based on a hydrological study carried out by JICA together with SLLR&DC for the preparation of a Master Plan to control flooding in Nugegoda, Rattanapitiya, Borelasgamuwa, Maha Ela and Ratmalana areas.  Implementation of this project will mitigate frequent flooding in Weras Ganga Basin and also promote sustainable development activities and enhance environment improvement which will promote tourism industry in the relevant areas.  The total cost of the project is estimated to be Rs.14,227 million and is scheduled to be completed within 04 years.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to proceed with the activities relating to loan arrangements for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Contamination of Milk Powder with Dicyandiamide and Whey Protein Concentrate
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - based on various reports received pertaining to this matter, immediate action has been taken by the Ministry of Health to stop the release of imported milk with Whey Protein Concentrate to the market.  This action has led to many implications.  Therefore, to ensure the availability of adequate amount of milk powder including infant milk formule, increased local milk production, processing and marketing and also nutrition of the society, Cabinet approval was granted for the appointment of a Cabinet Sub-Committee comprising of relevant senior Ministers and Ministers to examine this issue and submit a report to the next meeting of the Cabinet, for consideration.

description: State Visit by H.E. President of Sri Lanka to Seychelles
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: -  Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs  furnished information pertaining to the recent visit of H.E. the President to  Seychelles and covering approval was granted for the Agreements / MoUs concluded between the two countries during the visit.   the leaders of the two countries welcomed the signing of MoUs / Agreements on Bilateral Air Services, Vocational Training and Youth Development.  They also welcomed the enhanced collaboration between the two countries in a broad range of areas such as education, fisheries, trade and investment, judiciary and health.

description: Visit to Tanzania and Participation at the Global 2013 Smart Partnership Dialogue in Dar es Salaam by H.E. the President
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - in keeping with the Government policy of strengthening the relations with African countries, H.E. the President visited Tanzania and participated at the Global 2013 Smart Partnership Dialogue in Dar es Salaam.  Sri Lanka's economic partnership with African countries has developed beyond trade and investments, reaching areas like knowledge sharing, skills development and technology transfer etc.  Leaders of the two countries expressed their great interest in establishing resident Diplomatic Missions in the respective capitals.  Both leaders witnessed the conclusion of Memoranda of Understanding in the field of tourism cooperation, economic and technical cooperation, and cultural cooperation.  Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs submitted the above information and covering approval was granted by the Cabinet for the concluded Agreements / MoUs.

description: Submission of Gazette Notification issued under the Import and Export Control Act, No.01 of 1969 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to submit the above Gazette Notification, imposing regulations to control exportation and importation of all types of Halogenated Chlorofluorocarbon (HCFC) substances  on a quota system issued by the Ozone Division of the Ministry of Environment, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Amendment of the People’s Bank Act No. 29 of 1961, to increase its Share Capital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - over the years, the People's Bank has expanded its branch network throughout the country with the objective of strengthening its business operations in the region.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation to increase the Share Capital of the Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Amendments to the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No.43 of 2000
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation pertaining to the above Act, was approved by the Cabinet.  The salient feature of the proposed amendment is that, insurers who are engaged in carrying on both long term insurance business and general insurance business, under the valid license issued by the Insurance Board of Sri Lanka (IBSL), are required to segregate the two businesses within four years from the date of coming into operation of the Act, into two companies, one to carry on life insurance and the other to carry on general insurance.

description: Financial Assistance from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) for the Implementation of Greater Colombo Water Supply and Waste Water Management Improvement Programme - Tranche 2
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - ADB has agreed to provide financial assistance in a sum of US $300 for this programme which consists of 04 Tranches.  The purpose of this programme is to improve the water service efficiency in the Greater Colombo area.  Two stages of this project are expected to be implemented and completed over the period from 2012 to 2018.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Republic of Belarus for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes of Income
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President,  in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to sign the above Agreement at Government level and to present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of Sahaspura Housing Scheme, Baseline Road, Borella and Sinhapura Flats Housing Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, to proceed with the activities of the above at a cost of Rs. 75.96 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Renovation of Multi Storeyed Housing Schemes - Nagamu Puravara 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - Rupees 1000 million has been allocated by the General Treasury to the National Housing Development Authority (NHDA) for the renovation of apartment housing complexes under the “Nagamu Puravara Programmes - 2013” and it is expected to renovate 25 housing schemes under this Programme.  Work on housing schemes up to the value of Rs.300 million has already commenced.  The proposal made by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, to award the renovation activities of 17 housing schemes located within the Colombo Municipal area to the State Engineering Corporation, utilizing the funds already allocated, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hambantota Port Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - the Sri Lanka Ports Authority has prepared a Business Plan to identify business ventures that could be undertaken in the Hambantota Port Development Project.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the following business ventures to the respective bidders as recommended by the  Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee (CANC), and subject to stipulations, was approved by the Cabinet:*    Advance Surfactants India Ltd. - lease of land to establish a Plant for the manufacture of Petroleum, Petrochemicals and Chemicals;*    Laugfs Gas PLC - lease of land to establish a LPG Storage and Distribution Plant;*    Laugfs Holdings Ltd. - lease of land to establish a Lubricants Blending Plant with a capacity of 50,000 MT per annum;*    Energy World International Ltd. -  lease of land to establish an "elengee" LNG Hub Terminal; and*    Rank Container Terminal Ltd. -  lease of land to establish a Petro-chemical Storage and Transshipment Facility.

description: Awarding of Six Contracts under the Programme funded by the Local Banks for the Rehabilitation of National Highways through Domestic Contractors - Stage 2
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the following contracts for rehabilitation/widening/improvements to National Highways as recommended by the  Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet:*    Hasalaka - Handungamuwa - Hettipola Road (B 484) from 0.00 km to 20.00 km;*    Kelanimulla - Mulleriyawa - Koswatta Road - Phase I - construction of a viaduct and approach from 0.00 km to 0.60 km;*    Kurunegala -Narammala - Madampe Road from 22.26 km to 40.87 km;*    Seeduwa - Katunayake Road from 0.00 km to 3.90 km and Seeduwa to Udugampola from 0.00 km to 11.70 km;*    Jaffna - Ponnalai - Point Pedro Road 1.5 km between 28.5 km to 31.5 km;*    Road Network associated with development of Defence Headquarters Project at Akuregoda.

description: Declaration of the National Day for Technical, Vocational Education and Training
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that the enthusiasm in State and Private Sector Training Institutions as well as in the Industrial Sector for the competent work course has resulted in the socio-economic development of the country and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Dullas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to declare July 15th as the National Day for Technical, Vocational Education and Training, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Tertiary and Vocational Education Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Dullas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to instruct the Legal Draftsman, to draft amending legislation to the Tertiary and Vocational Education Act, No.20 of 1990, as proposed in the Memorandum, subject to incorporating the amendments recommended by the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Legislation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commencing  a Government School within the Prison Premises for Young Inmates
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - on the joint proposal made by Hon. Chandrasiri Gajadheera, Minister of Rehabilitation and Prison Reforms and Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to provide education to young inmates of Prisons who have been sentenced for long periods, to enable them to be good citizens when leaving Prisons, Cabinet approval was granted to set up a school in Watareka Prison jointly by the Ministries of Rehabilitation and Prison Reforms; and Education, with a view to developing the literacy rate and vocational skills of prison inmates.

description: Implementation of the Second Health Sector Development Project funded by the World Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-15
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, for the implementation of the Second Health Sector Development Project at National and Provincial levels, utilizing US $200 million to be received from the International Development Association (IDA) for a five (05) year period from 2013 to 2017, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Gazette Notification issued under the Import and Export Control Act No.1 of 1969 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-01
decision_details_body: - according to available statistics there has been a paddy surplus of 1,467,545 MT in 2012 and in addition, production of crops such as maize, green gram, cowpea, soya bean has increased and measures have been taken by the authorities concerned for the timely supply of fertilizer, seeds, water, loan facilities, new technological equipment, stores facilities etc.  Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to submit the Gazette Extraordinary No.1819/32 dated 2013-07-18, to repeal the Regulations laid down in the Gazette Extraordinary No.1764/9 dated  2012-06-27 to restrict exportation of rice under the Import and Export Control Act No.1 of 1969, to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the Ministry of Textiles of India and the Ministry of Industry and Commerce of Sri Lanka on Cooperation in the Development of SMEs in Handloom, Powerloom and Textiles
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-01
decision_details_body: - the objective of this MoU is to expand the business and cooperation in the development of Small and Medium Enterprises in handloom, powerloom and textiles.  The MoU has been jointly prepared by both parties and will remain in force for five years from the date of signing and could be renewed every five years.  The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce, to sign the above MoU and to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Refurbishment of Parliamentary Complex and Construction of a Residential Housing  Complex  for  Members  of  Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-01
decision_details_body: -  the  proposal  made  by Hon. D.M. Jayaratne, the Prime Minister, to appoint a Technical Evaluation Committee and a Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee, to evaluate proposals and negotiate costs to refurbish the Parliament Building and construct a new Housing Complex at Thalapathpitiya  with the required amenities, for Members of Parliament, and to obtain the services of  M/s. Sumitomo Mitsui Construction Co. Ltd. which constructed the Parliament Building in 1982, as approved by the Staff Advisory Committee of  Parliament,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Second Asian Productivity Organization (APO) Workshop - 2013 to be held in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-01
decision_details_body: - Asian Productivity Organization is a Japan based International Organization which is assisting its member countries to enhance productivity in the fields of Industry and Agriculture.   At present 20 countries in the Asia Pacific Region including Sri Lanka, have obtained its membership.  Of the two workshops scheduled to be held in Sri Lanka for 2013, the first was held from 03rd to 07th June 2013.  The second workshop on Developing Farming System for Mitigating Climate Change is to be held in Sri Lanka from 26th to 30th August 2013.  The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to proceed with the activities relating to the second workshop, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Roof Cover for the Maligavila Buddha Statue
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-01
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Jagath Balasuriya, Minister of National Heritage, to construct a permanent roof cover for the Maligavila Buddha Statue, located 15 km away from Buttala town, utilizing Rs.15 million provided by the Central Cultural Fund to the Ministry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Southern Transport Development Project - Construction of South Section from Pinnaduwa to Godagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-01
decision_details_body: - Rehabilitation of National Highways Leading to Southern Expressway -  the Government has obtained a loan from China Exim Bank towards the cost for the construction of Southern Section of the Southern Expressway from Pinnaduwa to Matara.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to utilize the savings of the above loan to rehabilitate the undermentioned National Highways which lead to the Southern Expressway, was approved by the Cabinet.*    B465    -    Weligama - Kananke Road    -    9.6 km*    B466    -    Weligama - Thelijjawila Road    -    7.7 km*    B578    -    Dorape - Hiyare            -    8.7 km

description: Proposed Investment Promotion Zone (IPZ) at Suriyawewa, Hambantota set up by Board of Investment of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-01
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Investment Promotion, to lease out blocks of land to investors for Mixed Development Projects including Residential Apartment Complexes within the Master Plan of the Suriyawewa Investment Promotion Zone, subject to the laid down stipulations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Deyata Kirula National Exhibition 2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-01
decision_details_body: - Construction of E-laboratories in Kurunegala and Puttalam Districts - the Ministry of Telecommunication and Information Technology has decided to establish 75 E-laboratories in the Kurunegala District and 50 in the Puttalam District, parallel to the Deyata Kirula National Development Programme and Exhibition 2014.  Of these E-laboratories, 25 in the Kurunegala District and 15 in the Puttalam District will be constructed in 2013 and the remaining 85 in 2014. The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, Minister of Telecommunication and Information Technology, to proceed with the above activities at a cost of Rs.168 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Suitable Land for the Establishment of the University College, Matara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-01
decision_details_body: - the objective of establishing University Colleges is to expand the intake capacity for the Diploma level programmes of National Vocational Qualifications (NVQ) and produce middle level technicians to meet the industry demands of the country. The proposed University Colleges are scheduled to be commenced from January 2014. One such University College is intended to be setup in Matara in a land located at Maddewatta, Matara which belongs to the Food Department under the Ministry of Co-operatives and Internal Trade. The proposal made by Hon. Dullas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to pursue action on this matter, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hosting the International Conference on  ‘Better Air Quality (BAQ) – 2014’  and 8th Regional Environmentally Sustainable Transport (EST) Forum in Asia, in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-01
decision_details_body: - this Conference provides a platform for the largest gathering of air quality management expertise in Asia to discuss on sustainable transport, energy, industry, clean fuels and efficient vehicles, air quality and climate change with special emphasis on Government policies and measures.  In addition to the above, the Organizers of the Regional Environmentally Sustainable Transport (EST) Forum in Asia has officially announced that the 8th EST Forum in Asia will also be held in Sri Lanka from 29th September to 03rd October 2014 in parallel with the above Conference.  The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, Minister of Environment and Renewable Energy, to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Release of Land from Palmyrah Model Farm at Weerawila for Export Production Village
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-01
decision_details_body: - the Palmyrah Development Board has established a Palmyrah Model Farm in a land of approximately 23 acres in the Hambantota District.  The proposal made by Hon. Douglas Devananda, Minister of Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development, to make available half of the extent of the land for the Export Production Village functioning under the Hambantota Development Foundation, for the cultivation of vegetables and fruits, where a large number of females from adjoining areas have been provided employment,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing Training Opportunities for the Foreign Officers at the Defence Services Command and Staff College
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-01
decision_details_body: - this College was inaugurated in 2007 and provides training facilities to Middle Level Officers of the three Armed Forces and the Police.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to provide opportunities to personnel of similar status in countries such as India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Maldives, Nepal, China, Malaysia, Indonesia, Rwanda, Senagal and Sudan for  training at this college, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Galawatta Land' Development Project at Panadura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-01
decision_details_body: - Panadura town is one of the main commercial and service centres in the Kalutara District.  The Galawatta Land is located at the entrance to the Panadura Town Centre and it is proposed to develop it as a public square.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to relocate the families and 35 commercial units to be displaced, commence the project with Rs.25 million made available in 2013 and complete the project in 2014 with the balance funds amounting to Rs.40 million to be provided, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Policy and Regulatory Framework for Next Generation Networks in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-08-01
decision_details_body: - Next Generation Networks (NGNs) carry all types of services, including voice, video and e-mail, on a common platform.  This 'network convergence' allows operators to save money by having to maintain only one network platform and to provide new services that combine different types of data.  NGNs are more versatile than traditional networks because they do not have to be physically upgraded to support new types of services.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, to adopt the Policy and Regulatory Framework for Next Generation Networks in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: H.E. the President's State Visit to the People's Republic of China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-25
decision_details_body:
- H.E. the President paid a State Visit to the People's Republic of China recently.  From a bilateral point of view, the visit was highly successful due to the following:   *  the leaders of the two countries agreed to strengthen co-operation in maritime security, combating piracy, search and rescue and navigation safety.  *  in the economic sphere, a major breakthrough was achieved when both leaders endorsed a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) between the two countries, which would help Sri Lanka to advance its market access to the second largest luxury market in the world with a population of more than 1.3 billion. This would also bring more benefits to Sri Lanka in the investment sector and also pave the way to enhance Chinese tourist arrivals in Sri Lanka. 

*  China extended further grant assistance in a sum of RMB Yuan 200 million which will be utilized for building an International Convention Centre in Kandy and an Arts Theatre in Anuradhapura.

*  the construction of the National School of Business Management at Homagama will also commence with the assistance of China.  

*  the leaders also agreed to promote people to people contacts, strengthen exchanges and co-operation in education, culture, religion, press, radio, television and other areas, and intensify contacts between women, civil groups and academic institutions.

*  China assured assistance for agricultural development and offered small machineries to Sri Lanka, as a means of further capacity building co-operation. 

*  the leaders also agreed to further strengthen exchanges and co-operation in the areas of aerospace co-operation, telecommunication and broadcasting, disaster management, tsunami monitoring, environmental protection and other areas to serve economic growth and social progress in both countries.

description: International Conference on Water Co-operation for Community Development - August 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-25
decision_details_body: this Conference is to be held from 16th to 18th August 2013 in Anuradhapura under the Chairmanship of Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage. The Conference is convened to mark this years' UN declared theme 'International Year of Water Co-operation'.  The objective of this Conference is to provide a platform for sharing knowledge, strategies and best practices and to promote dialogue, mutual understanding and co-operation among communities managing their water schemes.  Sri Lanka has over 15 years of experience in promoting community organizations to provide their own water supply for drinking and sanitation facilities through community water supply and sanitation projects. Over 3500 community based organizations that were formed to implement the projects are now empowered to manage, operate and maintain these systems with the support of the National Community Water Trust (NCWT) and the National Water Supply and Drainage Board.  About 500 delegates from India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Nepal, Bhutan, Afghanistan and Maldives are expected to participate at the Conference.   The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Indiscriminate usage of Chemical Fertilizer and Agro Chemicals; and the prevailing Kidney related diseases in the North Central Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-25
decision_details_body: - the use of Chemical Fertilizer and Agro Chemicals was introduced to the country with the objective of increasing crop productivity and ensuring food security and although near self sufficiency has been achieved due to the usage of same, it has been observed that the country is experiencing some adverse effects of same such as damage to bio-diversity, contamination of water and soil due to chemical substances etc., leading to various health problems, particularly such as Kidney related diseases in the North Central Province.  Recommendations on measures to be adopted in this regard were submitted by the Cabinet Sub-Committee chaired by  Hon. Athauda Seneviratne, Minister (Senior) for Rural Affairs and attended by 13 Ministers.  Secretaries to the relevant Ministries and 58 Scientists were also involved in the deliberations.  Proposals submitted in this regard by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture were also taken into consideration.  There are 19 long term measures and 10 short terms measures recommended in the relevant report. The recommendations were approved by the Cabinet for implementation, giving due consideration to the observations made in this regard by the Minister of Finance and Planning; and the Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities.  A Cabinet Sub-Committee and an Officials' Committee were appointed to monitor the implementation of the recommendations.

A sum of Rs.899 million has been released as advances to the District Secretaries of the relevant Districts for the purchase of paddy and the stock of paddy purchased as at 30th June, 2013 stands at 22,705 MT.  Harvesting of paddy of the Yala Season 2013 commences towards the end of July, 2013.
