The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the relevant activities, and to authorize the Secretary to the Treasury to allocate Rs.1500 million for the purchase of paddy of Yala 2013 from the Revolving Fund of the General Treasury, since the anticipated paddy production of Yala 2013 is greater than that of 2012 in the Districts affected by the drought in Yala 2012, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulatory and Supervisory Framework for Microfinance Institutions (MFIs) in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-18
decision_details_body: - the proposed Regulatory and Supervisory Framework will be applicable to Microfinance Institutions  which accepts deposits from the Public and will consist of a three tier system as follows:*    Tier I - Large MFIs to come under the direct supervision and examination by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL);*    Tier II - Small MFIs to come under the supervision and examination by CBSL approved Audit Firms;*    Tier III - Institutions falling under the Commissioner of Cooperative Development and Registrar of Cooperative Societies, Divineguma Department and Board of Management of Divineguma Community Based Bank and Banking Societies and the Commissioner General of Agrarian Development will be exempted from the CBSL regulation and will come under the regulation and supervision of the Authorities already empowered under the relevant Statutes.Some of the salient features are -*    no person other than a licensed MFI and an exempted entity can carry on microfinance business after the enactment of the proposed Act;*    provisions of the proposed Act will not apply to Banks licensed under the Banking Act, No. 30 of 1988, Finance Companies licensed under the Finance Business Act, No. 42 of 2011 and Community Based Organizations established with social objectives and engaged in microfinance business, as determined by the CBSL; and*    Registered Cooperative Societies , entities formed in terms of the Agrarian Development Act, No. 46 of 2000 and Organizations established under the Divineguma Act, No.1 of 2013 are exempted from the application of the provisions of the proposed Act.The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to present the relevant Bill in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

Rajitha Senaratne, Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to submit the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (Amendment) Bill to Parliament, after incorporating the amendments recommended by the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Legislation, and obtaining the clearance of the Attorney General for same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of 04 New National Schools in Kilinochchi and Mullaitivu Districts
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-11
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to grant the status of National Schools to Kilinochchi M.M.V. and Mulangavil M.M.V. in the Kilinochchi District and Vidiyananda College and M/Mallavi M.M.V. in the Mullaitivu District and to develop them through absorbing into the 1000 Secondary Schools Development Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Existing Regulations on Standards of Training, Certification and Watch Keeping for Seafarers (STCW) with Manila Amendment - 2010
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-11
decision_details_body: the Training  Certification and Watch Keeping for Seafarers (STCW) is being carried out in accordance with the International Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watch Keeping for Seafarers.  These Regulations have since been amended and the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to publish the new Regulations under the Merchant Shipping Act No.52 of 1971, in the Government Gazette and enforce such Regulations with effect from 2013-07-01, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a Land at Hyde Park Corner, Colombo 02 to the People’s Property Development Company Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-11
decision_details_body: A Subsidiary Company of People’s Bank for Office Complex and Staff Training Centre - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to lease out the block of land referred to above belonging to the Urban Development Authority, to the People’s Property Development Company Ltd., to construct a multi-storeyed building complex to house their Staff Training Centre and for the Office of People's Leasing Company, subject to stipulations made by the General Treasury, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recommendations of the Finance Commission for the Financial Year 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-11
decision_details_body: the proposal made by H.E. the President, to give effect to the recommendations of the Finance Commission on the apportionment of funds to Provinces allocated by the Annual Budget and setting out other administrative measures that need to be adopted; and to present the said recommendations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Export of excess paddy stocks of the Paddy Marketing Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-04
decision_details_body: the Paddy Marketing Board expects to purchase around 75,000 to 100,000 MT. of paddy from the total harvest of Yala Season towards end of July, 2013.  With the view to make available the storage facilities required for the purpose, the proposal made by Hon. Johnston Fernando, Minister of Co-operatives and Internal Trade, to convert 50,000 MT. of paddy available in stores, to rice and sell them to foreign countries, after retaining a buffer stock of 50,000 MT. of paddy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Mid Year Fiscal Position Report - 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-04
decision_details_body: the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning to submit the Mid Year Fiscal Position Report 2013 to Parliament, in terms of the provisions of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No.3 of 2003, was approved by the Cabinet.  This Report includes information on government revenue, expenditure, cash flow activities and borrowings within the first four (04) months of 2013 and also contains data on macro economic performance, foreign financing, government debt and external sector performance.

description: The Annual Performance Report, 2012 of the Ministry of Economic Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-04
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development, to present the above Annual Performance Report to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.  Some of the salient features are as follows:*    'Divi Neguma' National Programme - this programme was implemented under the Agriculture, Livestock, Fisheries and Enterprise Development Sectors and a sum of Rs.2912.98 million had been spent in 2012 for the entire programme.*    Agricultural Sector - a sum of Rs.1559.81 million had been spent in 2012 for the supply of inputs such as, seeds and plants etc. for this sector.*    Livestock Sector - a sum of Rs.365 million had been spent in 2012 for this sector.*    Social Security - Samurdhi Programme - a sum of Rs.10,553 million had been distributed among 1,549,107 families in 2012 for the upliftment of living standards of low income groups.*    Programmes have also been implemented under the 'Gama Neguma' and 'Pura Neguma' Projects in 2012.*    Development and renovation works in the Northern and Easter Provinces - a sum of Rs.3310.93 million had been invested for the development of roads in the Northern Province, and Rs.1,149.83 million for such works in the Eastern Province.  Rs.717.24 million was spent for the supply of electricity in the Districts of Jaffna, Kilinochchi and Mullaitivu.

description: Local Authorities Filling of Vacancies (Special Provisions) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-04
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. A.L.M. Athaullah, Minister of Local Government and Provincial Councils, to submit the above Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.  This amendment is for the purpose of filling of vacancies in the Office of Mayor, Deputy Mayor or a Member, elected to any Local Authority under the provisions of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262).

description: Construction of a Four Storied Resource Center and an Auditorium for the Ministry of Public Administration and Home Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-04
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, to proceed with the construction of the above project at an estimated cost of Rs.271.7 million with funds to be made available under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2014 - 2016 and to select a contractor for the purpose through limited competitive bidding process, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Kirama - Katuwana Integrated Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-04
decision_details_body: this project area is situated in the Hambantota District and it covers 34 Grama Niladhari Divisions of the Katuwana and Walasmulla Divisional Secretaries' Divisions.  The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to award the above contract for a sum of Euro11,139,931.64 as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Review Committee (SCARC) and to request the General Treasury to allocate funds to meet the local funding requirement,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Project for completion of the new Maternity Hospital Galle with the financial assistance of Euro 28 Million from the KfW Bank (Kreditanstalt fur Weideraufbau) of Germany - The Helmut Kohl
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-04
decision_details_body: Galle Maternity Hospital Foundation initiated for the construction of a new Maternity Hospital in the city of Galle in the South-West Coast of Sri Lanka, after the Tsunami which occurred in December, 2004.  The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health to proceed with the above project with financial assistance in a sum of Euro 28 million to be provided by  KfW Bank of  Germany, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Shopping Complex at Badulla - Phase II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-04
decision_details_body: Phase I of the Project consisting of 103 Vegetable Stalls, 05 Fish Stalls, 03 Meat Stalls and Public Parking facilities  is nearing completion.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to award the contract of Phase II of the Project, on Design and Build basis, to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), subject to the rates of the estimate being approved by the Standing Technical Committee of the Ministry of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Air Services Agreement (ASA) between Sri Lanka and Seychelles
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-04
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation, to sign and ratify an Air Services Agreement between Sri Lanka and Seychelles, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Second Phase of providing of loan facilities for self-employment in respect of persons rehabilitated and re-integrated into the society
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-04
decision_details_body: the number of persons rehabilitated and re-integrated into the society after the conflict situation which prevailed in the Northern and Eastern Provinces, stands at 11573.  Steps were initiated to provide a sum of Rs.300 million in the form of loans  to 1549 beneficiaries from the Northern and Eastern Provinces, through State Banks for self-employment purposes.  The proposal made by Hon. Chandrasiri Gajadeera, Minister of Rehabilitation and Prison Reforms, to provide a sum of Rs.525 million to provide loans to a further 4724 rehabilitated persons, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation, Upgrading  and Modernization of Small and Medium Industrial Estates
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-04
decision_details_body: there are 265 small and medium industrial firms engaged in manufacturing in the 18 Industrial Estates and these establishments provide direct employment to over 6,900 persons.  The project components include the renovation of internal road networks, peripheral security fencing, water supply and sewerage improvements, internal street lighting, fire protection systems and worker welfare facilities.  The proposal made by Hon. Douglas Devananda, Minister of Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development, to proceed with the project at a total cost of Rs.305.5 million, with funds to be provided from 2013 to 2015, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Migration Health Policy of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-04
decision_details_body: the Sri Lanka National Migration Health Policy aims to engage all relevant sectors and agencies that are responsible to ensure the health of migrants throughout the migration process.  Sri Lanka has recognized that outbound, internal and inbound migrants and the families left behind by outbound migrants are the key groups considered in this policy.  The above proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, was approved by the Cabinet.  Salient features of this Policy are - Outbound migrants and families left behind *    ensure the health and social well being of all migrants by guaranteeing their access to decent and productive employment in conditions of freedom, equity, security and human dignity;*    ensure health protection for Sri Lankan migrant workers by entering into Bilateral Agreements and Memoranda of Understanding with countries that employ Sri Lankan migrant workers; and*    develop and implement a coordinated plan to address the welfare needs of single parent families where the single parent migrates for employment. Internal migrants*    develop a National Programme that addresses specific nutritional issues of vulnerable internal migrant population; and*    ensure access to primary health care for internal migrant population, in partnership with private sector health care providers.Inbound migrants*    ensure that the migration process does not endanger the health of the migrant or the host population;*    identify and address conditions of public health concern in order to mitigate the impact of the migrants; disease burden on national health or social services; and*    promote Sri Lanka as a country with high health standards.

description: Recommendations of the Commission of Inquiry on Lessons Learnt and Reconciliation (LLRC) not incorporated in the National Plan of Action
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-07-04
decision_details_body: the proposal made by H.E. the President, to integrate the additional 53 recommendations that were not included in the National Plan of Action at the initial stage, majority of which overlap with other recommendations or form part of the recommendations contained in the National Human Rights Action Plan, in order to fully represent the recommendations stated in the Report of the LLRC, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Extension of the time period of the National Delimitation Committee and District Delimitation Committees established for the Demarcation of Wards under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: Cabinet approval has already been granted for the appointment of the above Delimitation Committees, in order to demarcate of wards for the election of Members of Local Authorities under the ward system.  The proposal made by Hon. A.L.M. Athaullah, Minister Local Government and Provincial Councils, to extend the period of time granted to the above Committees by a further six (06) months from 2013 06 07, so that the final Report on this matter could be prepared and submitted, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transfer of Lands to Foreigners
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body:
the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation to impose restrictions on transfer of lands to Foreigners, was approved by the Cabinet.  The salient features are -
(i)	transfer of State or Private land by way of a sale, donation, gift or by any other disposition will be prohibited, to a person who is not a Citizen of Sri Lanka, or to a Company incorporated in Sri Lanka, where any foreign shareholding in such Company is 50% or above to a Foreign Company, unless exemption is granted in terms of the proposed Act; (ii)	State or Private lands could be leased out to persons referred to at (i) above, for a maximum period of 99 years, instead of outright sale, subject to stipulations.

description: Construction of a new three storied building for the District Secretariat, Rathnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, to commence initial works of the project utilizing funds allocated for 2013 and carry out the remaining works with funds to be provided under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2014 - 2016 and to award the contract on competitive bidding basis,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction Building Blocks - A, D & E for the Faculty of Management Studies and Commerce of the University of Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: the 2 proposals made by Hon.S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education,  to award the 2 contracts of the University of Jaffna to the State Engineering Corporation, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), were approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Priority Water Supply Projects with funding secured from Local Banks engaging local contractors
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: at present pipe borne water supply coverage in the island is 44% and it is expected to increase it to 60% by the year 2020.  The Government intends to engage local contractors with local Bank financing for capital investment in the sector and to significantly reduce the capital cost involved. The local contractors over the past few years have gained considerable experience in water supply projects, either working as Joint Venture Partners or Sub Contractors with Foreign Contractors.  The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to proceed with the programme by implementing 30 water supply projects at an estimated cost of Rs.29 billion, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improving Efficiency of Supplying Drugs to Government Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: discussions have been held to purchase essential drugs for Government Hospitals from Bangladesh, where a well established pharmaceutical industry exists which is one of the largest in the South Asian Region. The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to proceed with the activities to purchase essential drugs from Bangladesh through a Government to Government mechanism; and to appoint the State Pharmaceuticals Corporation as the local agent for these procurements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 01 No. 1.5 Tesla MRI System for Military Hospital at Narahenpita
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to purchase the above MRI system and other related accessories for the 10 storied hospital building of the Sri Lanka Army at Narahenpita, for an approximate total cost of Rs.192,821,590.00, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), to provide better facilities for personnel in the Army Forces, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Report of the Officials’ Committee appointed by the Cabinet of Ministers to conduct a study and make recommendations pertaining to the acquisition of Official Languages Proficiency by Public Officers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: an Officials' Committee headed by the Secretary to the Cabinet and consisting of senior officials which looked into the difficulties encountered by Public Officers in achieving bilingual proficiency (i.e. in Sinhala or Tamil as applicable), in keeping with the Official Languages Policy of the Government, has proposed a number of short term, medium term and long term measures, in consultation with a group of leading academics engaged in language education and other relevant authorities.  After deliberations, Cabinet approved the recommendations specified in the Report. Some of the salient proposals are as follows: (i)	the syllabi which were more of an academic nature have now been reformulated in a practical manner to suit the needs of the Public Officers; (ii)	preparation of self study packs for new courses; (iii)	instead of an ordinary pass in the native language (as a core subject), at G.C.E. (O/L)  which is presently considered as an alternative qualification to evaluate the  second language proficiency of certain higher grade officers, it has now been proposed to accept an ordinary pass in the second  language at G.C.E. (O/L); (iv)	it has been made mandatory to provide a basic knowledge in the second language at the induction training programme when new recruitments are made to the Public Service;  (v)	a transfer policy to be formulated to enable public officers to achieve a working knowledge of the second language;  (vi)	officers who have already obtained second language proficiency in keeping with the stipulations in Service Minute are to be exempted from the requirement of obtaining the second language proficiency; (vii)	opportunities have been provided for the new recruits to professions like Medicine, Engineering, Veterinary Science etc. as well as certain technical grades, to follow an Official Language Training Course of 150 hours during their induction trainings to complete the official languages proficiency requirement; (viii)	restructuring of the Translators' Service; (ix)	graduate trainees who possess a basic knowledge in Sinhala/Tamil, to be selected to undergo a special training in languages; (x)	students entering Universities to be provided with a basic knowledge of Sinhala and Tamil languages during induction training programmes; (xi)	to make the requirement of obtaining official languages proficiency  applicable to new recruits to State Corporations, Statutory Boards, State Banks and fully Government Owned Companies  (to be achieved within 05 years from the date of joining); (xii)	to make it mandatory to possess proficiency in both Sinhala and Tamil languages when recruitments are made to the Public Service from 2019 onwards.

description: Signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the National Zoological Gardens of Sri Lanka and the Pretoria Zoological Gardens in the Republic of South Africa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: the intention of this MoU is to lay a foundation for collaboration, exchange of ideas and support in the fields of animal husbandry, public presentation of zoological species, related research, veterinary and keeper  training. The proposal made by Hon. Jayaratne Herath, Minister of Botanical Gardens and Public Recreation, to enter into the above Memorandum of Understanding between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal to set up a Mixed Development Project with Luxury Hotel with a Foreign direct investment of US$170 million by EoN Resorts Group Pvt Limited of the Republic of Maldives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20

description: SAARC Agreement on Rapid Response to Natural Disasters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: this Agreement will strengthen the unilateral and bilateral relationships between Regional countries and will assist in restoring normalcy in disaster stricken countries within a minimum period.  Covering approval of the Cabinet was granted for the above Agreement submitted by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, Minister of Disaster Management, which has been signed at the 17th SAARC Summit held in Maldives in 2011.

description: Regulating of International Schools and Private Schools
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: a number of International Schools are presently functioning in the country and they have been registered as business ventures under the Board of Investment or Companies Act. It has been found necessary to bring in amendments to existing rules and regulations for the effective functioning of the International Schools and Private Schools  in keeping with the needs of the country.  The proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to proceed with the proposed arrangements for the formulation of a legal framework and a mechanism  to regularize these schools to be in line with the national educational policies,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: G.C.E. (O/L) Examination - 2012 - Analysis of Examination Results
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20

description: Construction of a new three storied building for the Divisional Secretariat, Bulathsinhala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: this Divisional Secretary's Division consists of 54 Grama Niladhari Divisions and the total population is 69,902. The proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, for the construction of a three storied building at a total cost of Rs.79.9 million, with funds to be provided under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2014 - 2016, to provide sufficient facilities for the people in the area and the staff, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening the Small and Medium Industrial Estates
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: the Ministry of  Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development has facilitated the Small and Medium Scale Enterprises/Industries spread out across the country through the establishment, operation and servicing of 18 Industrial Estates which are managed by the Industrial Development Board.  The proposal made by Hon. Douglas Devananda, Minister of Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development to adapt and adopt the lease rental policy recommendations to the Small and Medium Industrial Estates operated by the Industrial Development Board, to provide relief to all small and medium industrialists  with effect from 2011 06 01, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Amendment to the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act No. 43 of 2000
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: provisions of the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act require insurers registered with the Insurance Board of Sri Lanka (IBSL) prior to 2011 02 11 to list themselves on a licensed Stock Exchange within a period of 5 years from the date of enforcement of the Amendment Act and such Insurance Companies are required to comply with this requirement on or before 2016 02 11.  Those insurers registered on or after 2011 02 11 are required to be listed on a licensed Stock Exchange within a period of 03 years.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation, to exempt the Insurance Companies registered under the Insurance Board of Sri Lanka prior to 2011 02 11 from the requirement of registering under a licensed Stock Exchange, subject to stipulations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of land at Kamburupitiya to the National Housing Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development to allocate the block of land at the Kamburupitiya 'Gam Udawa' site utilized for the relocation of families displaced due to the Gam Udawa -1991, to the National Housing Development Authority (NHDA) by the Urban Development Authority (UDA), to execute the individual deeds of transfer to the displaced occupants, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage and Environmental Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: preliminary works of the above Project have commenced  and the implementation of the Project will improve the environmental system of Colombo and its suburbs, particularly flood control in the relevant areas.  The Project is to be implemented under 02 phases. Phase I will consist of, improvement of Nugegoda - Raththanapitiya watercourse, improvement of canals within the North and South Sub-Zone of Boralesgamuwa, development of Maha Ela, and Weras Ganga by dredging, conservation of marshy lands and improvement of drainage system in Bolgoda area and its surroundings. The estimated cost of the Project is Rs.13,000 million.  Measures will be taken to provide relief to the families to be displaced due to the implementation of the above Project.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to grant relief to those to be affected, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lease of land situated bordering D.R. Wijewardena Mawatha and Sir Chiththampalam A. Gardiner Mawatha, Colombo 02 to M/s Lake Leisure Holdings (Pvt) Ltd for a Mixed Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-20
decision_details_body: the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to lease out the above land to implement a mixed development project in keeping with the ongoing tourism related development plan of the Urban Development Authority (UDA) for Beira Lake surrounding areas, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Review Committee (SCARC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Relief to the Fishermen who were affected by the cyclone on 2013-06-08
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-13
decision_details_body: Cabinet of Ministers having considered the severe damages caused to life and property of the fishing community in the affected areas due to the cyclone which occurred on 2013-06-08, decided to grant relief to them in the following manner: (i) payment of Rs.100,000/- to the next-of-kin of each deceased /disappeared  fisherman;(ii) to procure and supply Fishing Craft and equipment in lieu of those fully damaged and not having insurance cover; and(iii) to grant a relief payment of 50% of the cost incurred to attend to the repairs of partially damaged Fishing Craft and equipment.

description: Export of Cinnamon
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-13
decision_details_body: Sri Lanka exports about 13,000 MT of cinnamon per year.  With the view to preventing the export of low quality cinnamon and enhancing the production of cinnamon in the country and sustaining the livelihood of more than 350,000 families engaged in this industry, the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama, Minister (Senior) for International Monetary Co-operation, to make it mandatory to adhere to the specifications for Sri Lanka standard for exporting of   cinnamon and to submit the Gazette Extraordinary No.1813/15 dated 2013-06-05 to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Encouraging the Domestic Industries within the government Policy Framework
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-13
decision_details_body: the need for identification of priority areas for which foreign direct investment should be mobilized while protecting the interest of the local investors was considered by the Cabinet.  It was decided that processing and value addition of spices, animal husbandry and poultry farming are the sectors for which foreign investments need to be limited, with the intention of import substitution. Foreign investment on assembling of vehicles, refining of petroleum products, manufacturing of boats for export market should be encouraged.  In order to protect the local investors, it was decided that foreign investment should not be encouraged in small scale agricultural industries, retail trade, manufacturing of steel and cement and beauty care related products.  A Ministerial Committee under the Chairmanship of Hon. Minister (Senior) for International Monetary Co-operation and consisting of other Ministers, was appointed to revise the current regulations and to make proposals to the Cabinet.

description: The Proposed Teaching Hospital for General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-13
decision_details_body: with the intention of addressing the shortage of trained Medical Officers in Military Hospitals, this University has commenced a Degree Programme in Medical Science, and the construction works of the proposed Teaching Hospital has to be expedited to provide facilities for the Medical Students who are supposed to obtain Clinical Appointments by August 2013. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to obtain a loan of US $201,629,000 (approximately Rs.26 billion) from a State Bank for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Cultural Co-operation between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-13
decision_details_body: approval of the Cabinet was granted to the proposal made by Hon. T.B. Ekanayake, Minister of Culture and the Arts, to enter into the above Memorandum of Understanding between the two countries.  This MoU will further promote the friendly relations existing between the two countries and re-affirm the   need for cultivating and developing closer and stronger cultural relations between the two countries.

description: Commonwealth Youth Forum
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-13
decision_details_body: arrangements have been made to conduct the Commonwealth Youth Forum from 10th-14th November at the Hambantota International Conference Hall to coincide with the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) scheduled to be held in Colombo from 15th to 17th November, 2013.   54 Commonwealth Member Countries are scheduled to participate in this Forum and around 1500 local and foreign representatives will also participate in the inaugural ceremony.  The proposal made by Hon. Dallas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to proceed with the programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Introduction of a new Subject Stream of Technology scheduled for the G.C.E. (A/L) Examination in 200 selected Secondary Schools equipped with Mahindodaya Technological Laboratories
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-13
decision_details_body: arrangements are underway to introduce a new subject stream of Technology for the G.C.E. (A/L) in 200 selected Secondary Schools equipped with Mahindodaya Technological Laboratories, with the consent of the relevant Institutions such as the National Education Commission, the Ministry of Higher Education, the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Skills Development and the University Grants Commission. The schools have been selected so as to have at least one such school for each electorate.  The joint proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education and Hon. Dallas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to proceed with the relevant activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to Regulations made under the Employees' Provident Fund Act, No.15 of 1958
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-13
decision_details_body: consequent to the amendments introduced to the Employees' Provident Fund Scheme recently by the Government by Act, No.2 of 2012, introduction of new amendments to the relevant Regulations are to be made to grant benefits to the workers.  The Commissioner General of Labour is to introduce the National Identity Card Number in lieu of the existing employer centric number and every employee under the new regulations is required to register his or her finger print marks of the left thumb and the right thumb in the form of electronic record with the Department of Labour. The proposal made by Hon. Gamini Lokuge, Minister of Labour and Labour Relations, to submit the Gazette Notification No.1810/20 dated 2013-05-13 to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Scientific and Technological Co-operation between the Ministry of Technology, Research  and Atomic Energy, Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Science and Technology, Thailand
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-13
decision_details_body: this MoU recognizes the importance of science and technology in the development of the respective national economies and the value of cooperation between the two countries to serve common interests in contributing to the enhancement of science and technology. Approval of the Cabinet was granted to the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Technology, Research and Atomic Energy for signing of the above MoU between the two countries.

description: Hosting of the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting in Sri Lanka in 2013 (CHOGM)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-13
decision_details_body: this would be the largest international event to be hosted by Sri Lanka since 1976 when Sri Lanka hosted the 5th Non-Aligned Movement Summit. Extensive preparatory arrangements are underway to host this event and the proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris for the appointment of the following Committees for policy decision making at Ministerial level, was approved by the Cabinet:*    Committee on the Commonwealth Business Forum, under the Chairmanship of Hon.  Basil Rajapakse, Minister of Economic Development.*    Committee on the Commonwealth Youth Forum, under the Chairmanship of Hon. Dallas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development.*    Committee on Media and Public Relations, under the Chairmanship of Hon. Keheliya Rambukwella, Minister of Mass Media and Information.

description: Social Integration Week -  July 15 - July 21, 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-13
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Vasudeva Nanayakkara, Minister of National Languages and Social Integration, to declare 15th to 21st July 2013 as the “Social Integration Week”, was approved by the Cabinet. Many activities and programmes have been identified for the purpose, to be carried out to promote social integration in the country.

description: Allocation of Land at D.M. Colombage Mawatha, Kirulapone to the persons displaced due to the Baseline Road Widening Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-13
decision_details_body: the Road Development Authority (RDA) has utilized a land in an extent of about 3 acres belonging to the Urban Development Authority (UDA), to re-locate the families who were displaced due to the Baseline Road Widening Project. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to allocate the said land to the RDA, to enable it to execute the transfer of deeds in favour of the allottees who were displaced due to the Baseline Road Widening Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Land at Vauxhall Street, Colombo 02 to Lanka Mahila Samithi as Provision of Alternative Accommodation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-06-13
decision_details_body: the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development to allocate a land at Vauxhall Street, Colombo 02, to the Lanka Mahila Samithi on 30 year lease basis, for the construction of its Office and Sales Outlet, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Japanese Human Resources Development Scholarship Programme - 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: The Government of Japan has agreed to provide grant assistance in a sum of Japanese Yen 192 million (Approximately Rs.245 million) to Sri Lanka for the above programme to be implemented in 2013.  The objective of this programme is to support human resources development by providing opportunities to government officials to follow higher educational programmes in reputed Japanese Universities, to enable them to contribute to the social and economic development of the country in a productive manner.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into a Grant Agreement for the purpose with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between China Development Bank Corporation and the Government of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: China Development Bank Corporation is to extend financial assistance in a sum of US $580 million in 2013 for development projects of Sri Lanka.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to sign the above Memorandum of Understanding between China Development Bank Corporation and the Ministry of Finance and Planning of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commemoration of the World Environment Day 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: all State parties including Sri Lanka which signed the environmental conventions in 1992 at the World Earth Summit in Brazil are required to commemorate the World Environment Day on 05th June.  Accordingly, arrangements have been made to implement a programme covering the whole Island on the World Environment Day that falls on 05th June 2013, under the patronage of H.E. the President, and in association with all Local Authorities and Government Institutions at District level.  5000 school children will also participate in this programme.  The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, Minister of Environment and Renewable Energy, to proceed with the above programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement between the Republic of Poland and the Government of Sri Lanka on Cooperation in the Field of Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development, to sign and ratify the above Agreement on cooperation in the field of tourism between the Government of the Republic of Poland and the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Two Storied Building for Divisional Secretariat, Udubaddawa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: this Divisional Secretary's Division  consists of 43 Grama Niladhari Divisions and the total population is 13,859.  The proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, to proceed with the above project at a cost of Rs.23.37 million with funds to be provided under the Medium Term Expenditure Frame Work - 2014, to provide better facilities for the people living in the area, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a New Two Storied Official Quarters for District Secretary, Hambanthota
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: Hambanthota District consists of 12 Divisional Secretary's Divisions and 576 Grama Niladhari Divisions.  The total population is 596,617.  The Cabinet granted approval to the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, to proceed with the above project, if part of the cost can be met from the budgetary provisions made available for the year 2013, failing which, the provisions have to be met in the Budget for 2014.

description: Construction of Proposed Building for Computer Unit of the Department of Computer Science, University of Ruhuna  (Phase II )
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to revise the total cost of the above project from Rs.263 million to Rs.291 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation and improvement of Hulandawa Left - Kahambana Road (UVMMC803) Uva Province - Provincial Roads Project funded by the World Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: the World Bank has allocated US $105 million for the rehabilitation and upgrading of Provincial roads in Uva, Eastern and Northern Provinces and the proposal made by Hon. A.L.M. Athaullah, Minister of Local Government and Provincial Councils, to award the above contract as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), utilizing a part of the proceeds of the above loan for the rehabilitation and improvement of Hulandawa Left - Kahambana Road, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Road Sector Assistance Project funded by the World Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21

description: The Proposed Teaching Hospital of General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University has commenced a new Degree programme in Medicine for Military Medical Cadets who could fulfill the requirement of the military medical services of the country and functioning of the proposed Teaching Hospital of the above University, as early as possible, is essential for the training of Military Medical Cadets who are to commence their professorial clinical appointments by August 2013.  The hospital will also cater to foreign patients and also provide ultra modern facilities for medical check-ups for which Sri Lankan patients opt to go abroad spending large amount of foreign exchange.  It will also cater to advanced rehabilitation and physiotherapy for disabled soldiers. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to proceed with the project at a cost of US $201.6 million (approximately Rs.26 billion), with funds to be provided by a State Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Contribution of Sri Lanka towards the construction works of Sri Parvatharama (Buddhavanam) Buddhist Theme Park in Andra Pradesh, India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: the prime objective of this enormous project which has been initiated by the Ministry of Tourism, Media and Culture in Andra Pradesh is to establish a Cultural Centre of international level depicting historical events that took place in different countries and masterpieces of religious creations belonging to those countries. The proposal made by Hon. T.B. Ekanayaka, Minister of Culture and the Arts, to proceed with the project at a cost of Rs.7.9 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Youth Park in Matara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Dullas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to construct a Youth Park in Eliyakanda, Matara at a cost of Rs. 80 million, utilizing the financial allocations provided to the National Youth Services Council for the year 2013, with the view to developing infrastructure facilities for Sri Lankan Youth to spend their leisure time productively in a more eco-friendly environment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Functions of the Sub-committee on Media and Publicity of the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body:
following functions of the Sub-Committee on Media and Publicity of the task force, appointed to organize the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting scheduled to be held in Sri Lanka in November 2013, devolve on the Ministry of Mass Media and Information:
 

launching of the official logo of the Conference and designing and maintaining the official website of the Conference; 
designing and maintaining the Official Media Centre of this Conference to facilitate 1200 local and foreign journalists; and
raising public awareness while uplifting the image of Sri Lanka, nationally and internationally.

The proposal made by Hon. Keheliya Rambukwella, Minister of Mass Media and Information to proceed with the programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion of Vocational Training Centre at Thelambuyaya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body:
there are 05 Vocational Training Centres in the country providing vocational training for the disabled and Thelambuyaya Training Centre in the Hambantota District is one such Institution which provides two year training courses in Agriculture, Tailoring, Bakery Products, Electronics and Carpentry.  The proposal made by Hon. Felix Perera, Minister of Social Services, to award the above contract, which includes the following,  to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) at an estimated cost of Rs.174,820,800.00, subject to approval of rates in the estimate by the Technical Committee of the Ministry of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities and completion of work within the stipulated time frame, was approved by the Cabinet:
 

construction of a boys hostel for 100 trainees;
construction of a girls hostel for 100 trainees; and
construction of a kitchen and dining hall for 300 trainees.

description: Report on the Local Manufactures of School Uniform Material
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: the quantity of clothing material required for distribution annually as school uniforms is 11.7 million meters.  The short term recommendation made by Hon. Ratnasiri Wickramanayake, Minister (Senior) for Good Governance and Infrastructure, and the Chairman of the Ministerial Committee appointed for the purpose, to accord the opportunity to supply 80% of the school uniform material requirements for 2014 to local manufacturers and the balance 20% to be imported as Grey cloth to be finished locally by local Grey fabric processors, failing which only, to import the said quantity of 20%, was approved by the Cabinet.  Action is to be taken by the Authorities concerned to ensure that the total requirement of school uniform materials will be procured from local manufacturers, from 2015 onwards.

description: Project to Formulate a Chemical Accidents Prevention and Preparedness Programme for Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: according to an industrial census conducted, there are nearly 1000 large, medium and small scale chemical industries in the country. It has been found that preparedness measures have to be formulated to prevent or mitigate accidents caused by these chemical industries and activities.  The Secretariat for the Strategic Approach to International Chemicals Management (SAICM) under United Nations Environmental Programme has offered to provide a sum of US $224,834.00 as a grant to Sri Lanka, for  such a programme to be implemented. The proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, Minister of Environment and Renewable Energy, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendments to the Sri Lanka Inventors Incentives Act, No.53 of 1979
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Technology, Research and Atomic Energy, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare necessary amending legislation for the above Act in keeping with the present needs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Production of High Quality Heifers for Dairy Industry
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: the above project was prepared to be implemented from 2008 to 2015 at a total cost of Rs.1,442.00 million and  a sum of Rs.93.0 million was allocated for the purpose in 2008 and Rs.1,349.0 million for the rest of the 7 year period from 2009 to 2015, with Cabinet approval. The objective of this project is to produce high quality heifer calves which are born from the artificial breeding programme implemented by the Department of Animal Production and Health. The proposal made by Hon. Arumugan Thondaman, Minister of Livestock and Rural Community Development, to provide incentives to dairy farmers in the form of cash subject to the relevant terms, instead of supplying cattle feed within the rest of the project period from 2013 to 2015 utilizing a sum of Rs.300 million in the first instance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recognition by the Sri Lanka Medical Council - Degree of Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery of the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: the First Batch of Officer Cadets of the Faculty of Medicine of the  General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University will be conferred with the Degree of Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) in 2014.  The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to make provisions under the Medical Ordinance for the purpose, to enable the Sri Lanka Medical Council to register them under the said Ordinance to practice Medicine and Surgery in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Free Grant of UDA land at Ratnapura New Town to the University Grants Commission to handover the same to the University of Sabaragamuwa, Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-21
decision_details_body: the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to allocate a land at Ratnapura New Town near the General Hospital, in extent of about 20 Acres, to the University Grants Commission to handover same to the University of Sabaragamuwa, Sri Lanka, to establish the Faculty of Health Sciences of the said University, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Registration of Electors (Special Provisions) Bill
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation to enable persons who have been internally displaced from the Northern Province and who are now temporarily residing in other parts of Sri Lanka, to get themselves registered as electors, on submission of satisfactory proof thereof as stipulated, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Resident Diplomatic Mission of Sri Lanka in Kampala, Uganda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: in accordance with the Government's policy on enhancing relations with Africa, there is a need to have a Resident Diplomatic Mission of Sri Lanka in Uganda and accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to establish the said Diplomatic Mission of Sri Lanka in Kampala, Uganda with immediate effect, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Consultations between the Ministry of External Affairs of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Belarus
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: the objectives of this Memorandum of Understanding is to further strengthen and consolidate the close and friendly relations between Sri Lanka and Belarus.  The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to sign the above MoU between the Ministry of External Affairs of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Belarus, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of pre-cast two storied lecture halls for the Vavuniya Campus at Pampaimadu - University of Jaffna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to construct pre-cast two storied lecture hall buildings at a total cost of Rs.59.37 million, to commence the project in 2013 and complete the construction work within six (06) months, to meet the additional accommodation facilities required for the increased student intake, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Gampaha, Attanagalla and Minuwangoda Integrated Water Supply Scheme with Preferential Buyers Credit from China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardene, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to award the above contract for a total price of US $229.5 million as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Review Committee (SCARC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Monaragala-Buttala Water Supply Project through Belgium Funding
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: this Water Supply Project will provide pipe borne water to about 50,000 consumers including commercial and industrial sectors in Monaragala and Buttala towns and suburban areas. The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to award the above contract and to request the Department of External Resources to seek foreign and local funding for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender  for  the  Supply  of  250,000  Vials of Rabies Vaccine (Human Use) 1 ml. x 0.5 ml.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the above tender to the lowest responsive bidder for a total C&F price of US $1,250,000.00 (LKR162,670,625.00), as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the Supply of X-Ray Developer for Automatic Processing, X-Ray Fixer for Automatic Processing, Film X-Ray Dental Standard Size 3x4cm, Film X-Ray Dental Occlusal Size 5x7cm, X-Ray Film, Blue Base Automatic Processing Size - 24x30 cm, 35.6x35.6cm, 18x24cm, 35.6x43.2cm, 30x40cm
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to proceed with the procurement of the above items as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Clinical Waste Management Systems in the Needy Hospitals in Sri Lanka under Australian Assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: considering the need for the implementation of a long felt need of safe practice of healthcare waste management in hospitals and since this project has been identified as a priority requirement of the Ministry of Health which will provide a total solution for the proper management of clinical waste in the country, the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to proceed with the project as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Southern Transport Development Project - leasing out Lot No.1 and Lot No.9 in the Rest Areas for the establishment of Fuel Filling Stations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to lease out the above blocks of land  in the Rest Areas at the 44th Km. on the Southern Expressway to two separate parties selected on competitive basis, for a lease period of 30 years, for the establishment of Fuel Filling Stations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation and upgrading of Muttetugala - Hiripitiya Road  (B300) from 0 to 18.50 km
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity  as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to include this Section of the Muttetugala - Hiripitiya Road in the Programme for the Rehabilitation of National Highways through domestic contractors and to award the above contract as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) and to seek funding for the purpose from local banks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: International Conference on Natural Fibre, proposed to be held in Sri Lanka in collaboration with the World Food and Agriculture Organization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: Hon. Jagath Pushpakumara, Minister of Coconut Development and Janatha Estate Development  informed the Cabinet of Ministers through a Note submitted by him, that a request has been received from the World Food and Agriculture Organization to hold the above Conference in Sri Lanka during the 1st week of November, 2013 and that the said Conference will be held as scheduled.  The cost of air travel and hotel accommodation will be borne by the international participants themselves.

description: Search and Rescue Services for Aircraft in Distress - Search & Rescue arrangements between Sri Lanka and neighbouring countries such as Australia,  India, Indonesia and Maldives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: it is obligatory on the part of Sri Lanka, being a party to the Convention on International Civil Aviation (Chicago Convention – 1944), to make arrangements for the effective implementation of the International Standards and Recommended Practices contained in the said Convention.  It is a requirement that every State enters into arrangements with neighbouring States to strengthen her ability to provide  Search and Rescue Services in mutual cooperation and coordination with each other when the need for search and rescue arises.  The proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratna, Minister of Civil Aviation, for the Government of Sri Lanka, to enter into such arrangements with the relevant authorities of Australia,  India, Indonesia and Maldives for the above purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the 11th Regulation under Press Council (General) Regulations of the  Sri Lanka Press Council Law, No.05 of 1973
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Keheliya Rambukwella, Minister of Mass Media and Information, to submit the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.1797/21 dated 2013?02?15 pertaining to the above amendment, in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Printing of School Text Books distributed free-of-charge for  the year  2014
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to entrust the printing of 8,546,100 copies of 81 categories of books at a cost of Rs.758,385,350.00 to the State Printing Corporation, and 1,030,000 copies of 05 categories of books at a cost of Rs.63,980,520.00 to the Government Printing Department, pertaining to the School Text Books to be distributed in the year 2014, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a National College of Education for Entrepreneurship and Management Studies which offers the Course in teaching the subject of Entrepreneurship Studies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to upgrade the Teachers' College at Maharagama to a National College of Education for Entrepreneurship and Management Studies in a manner that the Course in teaching Commerce can be conducted to provide training in teaching the subject of Entrepreneurship Studies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Government of Sri Lanka Presidential Scholarship Programme for Foreign Students
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body: Cabinet approval has already been granted to implement the scheme of granting 100 scholarships by the Ministry of Higher Education for Foreign Students in 48 identified countries from the year 2011.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to increase the facilities offered for foreign students and also to include 10 new countries namely, Oman, Uganda, Ethiopia, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Iceland, Swaziland, Seychelles and Burkina Faso, to be eligible for the above scholarships, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Manufacture of Chemical Fertilizer
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body:
considering the joint proposal made by Hon. Piyasena Gamage, Minister 
 
(Senior) for National Resources and Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of 
 
Industry and Commerce, Cabinet approval was granted to conduct a 
 
pre-feasibility study by the Ministry of Industry and Commerce in 
 
association with the Ministry of State Resources and Enterprise 
 
Development, in the first instance.

description: Implementation of Small and Micro Industries Leader and Entrepreneur Promotion Project (SMILE III) - Revolving Fund Loan Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body:
in terms of the provisions of the Loan Agreement between Japan Bank for 
International Cooperation (JBIC) and the Government of Sri Lanka, the proceeds 
of the Small and Micro Industries Leader and Entrepreneur Promotion Project 
(SMILE III) should be used as a Revolving Fund to grant loans to Small and 
Medium Scale Entrepreneurs.  The General Treasury has allocated Rs. 300 
million for this year to implement SMILE III with funds available for the 
purpose in the Revolving Fund Account at the Central Bank.  The proposal made 
by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce, to implement 
the SMILE III Revolving Fund Loan Scheme and to provide loans to 
Participatory Credit Institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Inter-sectoral Participation in Eradicating Mosquito Breeding Places for the Control of Dengue Disease
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-05-09
decision_details_body:
the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, for the need to strengthen the 
actions taken by the Ministries mainly on the following for the prevention of the spread of Dengue 
disease, was approved by the Cabinet. 
 Ministry of Defence and Urban Development
 
*	regular participation of Officials of the Police Department in inter-sectoral meetings at District and Divisional levels.
 
*	assisting health and other authorities in cleaning up campaigns in high risk Grama Niladhari Divisions.
 

 
Ministry of Health
 
*	coordinating and facilitating of other sectors;
 
*	early diagnosis and management of epidemics; 
 
*	formation of village committees together with other relevant sectors.
 

 
 Ministry of Environment and Renewable Energy
 
*	introduction of waste recycling system in all Local Authority areas.
 

 
Ministry of Local Government and Provincial Councils (through Local Authorities)
 
*  	proper disposal of waste; and
 
*  	conduct of Dengue Review Meetings at Local Authority level.
 

 
Ministry of Public Administration and Home Affairs (through District and Divisional Secretaries) 
*	formation of mosquito prevention committees in every Grama Niladhari Division; and
 
*	conduct of regular inter-sectoral meetings at District and Divisional levels.
 

 Ministry of Education
 
*	regular cleaning up of school premises.

description: Submission of the Annual Report of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year 2012 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-04-24

description: Tender for the Supply of 2,400,000 Doses of Japanese Encephalitis Live Vaccine for Human Use
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-04-24
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to call for fresh tenders for the above and to enhance the previous year tender by 50% (300,000 doses) from the same supplier at the same price, to avoid any shortages of this vaccine in hospitals to continue the immunization programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for Supply of 1,000,000 Doses of Measles, Mumps and Rubella Vaccine Live BP or Measles, Mumps and Rubella Virus Vaccine USP
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-04-24
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the above contract, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) for a total price of US $1,125,000.00 (LKR146,403,562.50), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining Membership of the International Treaty on Plant Gene Resources for Food and Agriculture
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-04-24
decision_details_body: ? the International Treaty on Gene Resources for Food and Agriculture was established in 2002 and 128 countries have become signatories to this Treaty.  It has become a timely need for Sri Lanka to obtain Membership of International Organizations of this nature which provide valuable opportunities for conservating plant genetic resources and their sustainable usage.  The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, for Sri Lanka to sign the above Treaty,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of Essential/Life Saving Drugs for Government Hospitals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-04-24
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, for the purchase of Essential/Life Saving Drugs for Government Hospitals up to a maximum of Rs.159,000,000.00, on the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee (TEC) and the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Judicial Corporation between the Ministry of Justice of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Justice of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-04-18

description: 'Divi Neguma'/Agrarian Development New Year Fair - 05th to 12th April, 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-04-18
decision_details_body: - Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development, informed the Cabinet of Ministers through a Note submitted by him, that 364 Divi Neguma New Year Fairs sponsored by the Ministry of Economic Development in association with several government institutions, were conducted throughout the country during the festive season to provide essential consumer items to the general public at affordable prices.  Over 800,000 consumers have attended these fairs resulting in an income of Rs.131.0 million. Cabinet also observed that market prices of vegetables and certain other items had gone down by about 30% during this festive season when compared with the prices which prevailed during normal times.  In addition, a relief pack containing essential food items was also distributed by the Ministry of Co-operatives and Internal Trade to consumers at a very reasonable price.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-04-18

Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to obtain membership of the above Organization, was approved by the Cabinet.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-04-04
decision_details_body: - at present the annual import of soya products in the form of soya punnac, soya oil, soya flour is around 175,000 tons which require foreign exchange in a sum of Rs.14,000 million. description: Construction and Upgrading of Peripheral Blood Banks coming under the National Blood Transfusion Services of Ministry of Health
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-03-21

Accordingly, 06 regional and 13 cluster level blood banks are to be developed with necessary infrastructure and 66 blood banks will be upgraded with necessary equipment to cater to the demand. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to hold the Joint International Dental Conference from 27th June to 01st July 2013 at the BMICH where  Dental Professionals from American, Asian, European and Pacific Regions are expected to participate, was approved by the Cabinet.  A Dental Trade Exhibition will also be held parallel to the above and Dental Manufactures and Traders from Japan, China, India, Pakistan, Singapore and several other regional countries are expected to participate in this exhibition.

description: Increasing the number of Scholarships offered by the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-03-21
decision_details_body: - the above University has been engaged in offering  Degrees to foreign students of the SAARC Region and approval has already been granted for the intake of foreign cadets (02 from each country for each intake) from India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal and Maldives.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to extend this facility as a gesture of goodwill to Myanmar, Bhutan, Afghanistan and Vietnam, was approved by the Cabinet. description: Kandy City Development Plan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-03-21

*   	improvements to the road network from Peradeniya to Katugastota by providing a 4 - lane facility with overhead bridges and tunnels where necessary;

- the Government of Sri Lanka has received a loan of US$ 40 million from the OPEC Fund for International Development for the rehabilitation and improvements to roads in the National Road Network. - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to utilize a part of the loan of approximately US $60 million from the Saudi Fund for Development, for the rehabilitation and improvements to the following sections of roads, was approved by the Cabinet:

*	road section from Dehiowita to Deraniyagala (From 0 to 14.0 km) on Dehiowita - Deraniyagala - Noori Road (B093) at a cost of Rs.1,092,571,553.13; and

A part of the loan will be utilized for the above project.
