description: Rehabilitation and Improvements to the Road Sections from Katugastota to Alawathugoda and  from Alawathugoda to Palapathwela
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-03-07
decision_details_body:
- the government of Sri Lanka has received a loan of  Saudi Riyal 225,000,000 (approximately US $60 million) from the Saudi Fund for Development, for the rehabilitation and improvement of about 144 km of the National Road network of Sri Lanka.  A part of the above loan will be utilized for the following:

*	rehabilitation and improvements to the road section from Katugastota to Alawathugoda (from 4.6 km to 15.57 km) on Kandy - Jaffna Road (A9) at a cost of Rs.767,037,382.82; and 

*	rehabilitation and improvements to the road section from Alawathugoda to Palapathwela (from 15.57 km to 32.54 km) on Kandy - Jaffna Road (A9) at a cost of Rs.949,155,320.32.

The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the above 2 contracts as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of Raw Material (Waste Paper) for productions and sale of produced items for Valachchenai Paper Mill of the National Paper Company Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-03-07
decision_details_body: - this is the largest government owned factory situated in the Eastern Province and the Ministry of State Resources and Enterprise Development is in the process of developing this factory into a profit making institution.  The proposal made by Hon. Dayasritha Thisera, Minister of State Resources and Enterprise Development, to inform all state institutions, to send all discarded paper to the National Paper Company Ltd. for re-cycling purposes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provisions  for the maintenance of the Residential Care Home for the children profoundly disabled by Autism and Autism related disorders
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-03-07
decision_details_body: - the ?Udapadi Trust? has been initiated in 2003 by a group of parents to meet the needs of the children profoundly disabled by Autism and Autism related disorders at least to a certain extent. On the proposal made by Hon. Felix Perera, Minister of Social Services, to provide funds for the purpose, Cabinet observed that funds have already been provided through the Budget Estimate for the year 2013.  Cabinet also decided that the Ministry of Social Welfare should formulate a proper mechanism for the welfare of such disabled children and prepare an Action Plan  for the purpose.

description: Beliatta Town Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-03-07
decision_details_body: - the Ministry of Local Government and Provincial Councils has initiated a programme to develop rapidly urbanizing small and medium scale towns in Sri Lanka where infrastructure facilities are not adequately developed for delivery of services to the Public.  Beliatta town in the Hambantota District has been selected to be developed under this programme.  Beliatta town  is a Regional Centre which has access to a large number of main towns in the Hambantota District and it serves as a centre for collecting and marketing agricultural products.  The proposal made by Hon. A.L.M. Athaullah, Minister of Local Government and Provincial Councils, to proceed with the project at a total cost of Rs.638 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka Water Convention - 2013 - from 20th to 22nd March 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-03-07
decision_details_body: - pursuant to a decision taken by the United Nations to declare the year 2013 as the 'International Year of Water Co-operation' and also to commemorate the World Water Day scheduled for 22nd March, the Ministry of Water Supply and Drainage together with the National Water Supply and Drainage Board  intends to organize a Water Convention at the BMICH from 20th to 22nd March 2013.  The proposed Convention expects to bring together all possible stakeholders to create awareness and share experiences on Water Cooperation.  An exhibition will also be held to coincide with the Convention.  The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to proceed with the programme was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Weeraketiya Town Centre Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-03-07
decision_details_body: - the Urban Development Authority (UDA) intends to develop the Weeraketiya Town Centre under the Small Township Development Programme and the area identified to be developed is about 1.2 km in length. The project includes the development of walkways, construction of boundary walls, re-location of shops / houses, construction of Public Vehicle Park etc.  The above proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to implement the above project at a total cost of 71.0 million, with funds to be provided under the Medium Term Budgetary Frame Work, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Acquisition, Processing and Analyzing of Offshore Petroleum  Data on a Multi-Client Basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-03-07
decision_details_body: - with the view to attracting investors of the highest quality subsequent to the discoveries made by the Cairn Company presently engaged in  the drilling, the Petroleum Resources Development Committee intends to enhance the petroleum data catalogue of the Government of Sri Lanka by the addition of new information. The proposal made by H.E. the President, for acquisition, processing and analyzing of petroleum data in offshore Sri Lanka on Multi-Client Agreements, where the resource owner does not spend any money on acquisition, but selects a company to acquire the data at its own risk and cost, and then licenses it to sell the data on behalf of the resource owner and share the revenue, was approved by the Cabinet.  The proposed agreement for the purpose will be prepared in consultation with the Attorney General's Department and submitted to the Cabinet for consideration.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Sri Lanka and  the Government of India for Technical Assistance in support of the 10 year (2012-2022) National Plan for a Trilingual Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-03-07
decision_details_body: - the Presidential Initiative for Trilingual Sri Lanka aims to make every Sri Lankan citizen knowledgeable in Sinhala, Tamil and English.  The 10 year National Plan for a Trilingual Sri Lanka drawn up for the purpose sets the foundation for a national initiative to encourage the acquisition of trilingual skills and competencies by all citizens of the country.  Technical assistance for the purpose is to be obtained from the government of India and the proposal by H.E. the President to sign the relevant agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of India, after incorporating the amendments discussed at the Cabinet Meeting, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tourism Promotion Campaign in China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-28
decision_details_body: -  the Tourism Development Strategy  2011 - 2016 envisages to increase tourist arrivals to 2.5 million, foreign direct investments in tourism sector to US$ 3 billion tourism related employment to 500,000 and foreign exchange earnings from tourism up to US$ 3 billion by 2016.  It has been planned to invite over 100 travel agents from China to visit Sri Lanka during 2013 to familiarize them on our tourism related activities.  The proposal made by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development, to proceed with the related activities of the campaign, was approved by the Cabinet.

The Sri Lanka Ports Authority has prepared a Business Plan to identify the Business Ventures that could be undertaken under Phase I of the Project.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the contract for the operation of Polyethylene Terephthalate (PET) Manufacturing Plant for a period of 25 years and to lease out 05 hectares of land, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee (CANC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase and sale of  paddy during the Maha season 2012/2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-28
decision_details_body:
? the government has decided to vest the responsibility of the implementation of  the Paddy Purchase Programme of the Government, with the District Secretaries / Government Agents, to ensure food security, a stable price for paddy for the farmers and for the sale of paddy to consumers at a concessionary rate.  For this purpose, the state banks will provide pledge loans amounting to Rs.1798.11 million made up as follows for the purchase of paddy during the Maha season 2012/13:

*   	Bank of Ceylon 			- 391.59 million
*   	People's Bank			- 816.29 million
*   	Regional Development Bank	- 205.54 million
*   	National Savings Bank		- 384.69 million

Funds to meet any shortfalls for the purchase of paddy will also be provided up to an amount of Rs.700 million from the Revolving Fund for the Purchase of Paddy maintained under the General Treasury.  The above proposals submitted by Hon. Johnston Fernando, Minister of Cooperatives and Internal Trade, were approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the Sri Lanka Ocean University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-28
decision_details_body:
? on the proposal made by Hon. Dullas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, for the Establishment of the Sri Lanka Ocean University in place of the National Institute of Fisheries and Nautical Engineering, Cabinet approval was granted to refer the relevant Bill to the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Legislation for recommendations.  Some of the main objectives of the establishment of the said University are as follows:

*	develop the knowledge and skills of persons who are engaged in fisheries and its related fields and do not qualify to enter Universities.


*    	conduct relevant courses for the middle level persons in professional, scientific, technological and management fields to obtain recognized qualifications.

*    	conduct courses of study for those who possess the National Vocational Qualification (NVQ) so as to upgrade their efficiency and acquire higher educational qualifications.

description: Amendments to the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act No. 2 of 1996
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-28
decision_details_body: - on the  Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (Amendment) Bill which incorporates necessary Legislation to accede to international obligations to regulate fishing in high seas and exports of fishery products to foreign countries, submitted by Hon. Rajitha Senaratne, Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, Cabinet approval was granted to refer the said Bill to the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Legislation for recommendations.

description: Building a healthy nation and encouraging the students skilled in sports activities to develop such skills to be talented sportsmen
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-28
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that only about 5% of the students following primary education in the country are engaged in sports activities which could be due to devoting much time for education purposes.  The joint proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardana, Minister of Education and Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, and Hon. Mahindananda Aluthgamage, Minister of Sports, to implement physical education and sports programmes within the school system and universities, so that students with special skills and abilities in sports activities could be identified and assistance provided to achieve national and international levels in the field of sports, was approved by the Cabinet.  It was also decided to encourage students to participate in cadeting and scouting as well, to develop their skills in extra curricula activities.

description: Sale of items by vendors at Bus Stands  and Railway Stations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-21
decision_details_body:
- the  recommendations made by the Officials' Committee appointed by the Committee of Ministers, to formulate a methodology for the above purpose, were approved by the Cabinet for implementation.  Some of them are as follows:

*  	data pertaining to those engaged in self employment for the sale of items at bus stands and railway stations will be collected and action will be taken to register such persons.

*  	a uniform and an identity card will also be issued to such persons.

*  	combining those engaged in self employment as above with the Divineguma Enterprise Development Programme shall be considered. 

*  	those engaged in the trade will be supervised by the authorities concerned.

description: Implementation of Budget Proposals - 2013 - Prohibition of outright transfer of property to foreigners
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-21
decision_details_body:
- taking into consideration the increasing demand for foreign investments with the expansion of development activities of the Government, Cabinet approval was granted to make regulations under State Land Ordinance and to introduce amendments to the Notaries Ordinance and Registration of Document Ordinance, for the implementation of the following pertaining to State / Private lands in Sri Lanka:

*  	introduction of provisions to prohibit foreigners from purchasing absolute ownership of State / Private lands in Sri Lanka.

*  	to lease out such lands on long term lease basis without affecting the economic development activities of the country.

*  	the prohibition shall not be applicable for purchasing of lands for foreign Embassies / High Commissions in Sri Lanka.

		The above proposals were submitted by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratna, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs  and Hon. Janaka Bandara Tennakoon, Minister of Lands and Land Development.

The project consists of 2 Phases of Feasibility Study and Phase 1 has already been completed.  The proposal made by Hon. decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-21

description: Recommendation of the Supreme Court to allow a 4th attempt to sit the G.C.E. (A/L) Examination for the affected students due to Z-Score issue in 2011 (A/L) Examination
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-21
decision_details_body:
- the following joint proposals submitted by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education and Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, in keeping with the Supreme Court determination, were approved by the Cabinet.

(1)  	to allow students who sat for the G.C.E. (A/L) Examination for the 3rd and final time in the year 2011, to sit as the 4th and final attempt for the G.C.E. (A/L) Examination in 2013 under the syllabus for which the students wish to sit (New Syllabus or Old Syllabus) for the purpose of University admission, only for the academic year  2013/2014;  

(2)  	to allow students who could have sat for the G.C.E. (A/L) Examination for the 3rd and final time, but who did not get the opportunity to sit for the said examination in 2012, to sit as the final attempt for the G.C.E. (A/L) Examination 2013 under the Syllabus for which the students wish to sit (New Syllabus or Old Syllabus) for the purpose of University admission; and

(3)  	to allow students who sat for the G.C.E. (A/L) Examination for the 3rd and  final time in the year 2012, to sit as the 4th and final attempt for the G.C.E. (A/L) Examination in 2013 under the syllabus for which the students wish to sit (New Syllabus or Old Syllabus) for the purpose of University admission, only for the academic year 2013/2014).

description: Repeal of Sir John Kotelawala Defence Academy Act, No.68 of 1981, as amended by Acts, No. 27 of 1988 and No.50 of 2007 and introduction of a new Act titled General Sir John Kotelawala National Defence University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-21
decision_details_body: - this is the only Defence University in the South East Asian Region and with the gradual expansion of this University, Faculties such as Defence, Medical, Engineering, Law and Management, Humanities and Social Services have been established.  In addition to the regular Undergraduate Degree Programmes, several Post Graduate Degree Programmes, and Diploma and Certificate Courses have been introduced to meet the growing demand for such qualifications in the three Armed Forces and the Police.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation to repeal the existing Act and for the establishment of the General Sir John Kotelawala National Defence University, was approved by the Cabinet.  Provisions will also be included in the Bill for the establishment of new Faculties, Departments, local and foreign affiliated institutions under the General Sir John Kotelawala National Defence University, so as to enhance opportunities for higher education for local as well as foreign students.

description: Purchase of the Building for the Sri Lanka Embassy in Oman
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that nearly 75,000 Sri Lankan migrant workers are employed in Oman at present. The proposal made by Hon. Dilan Perera, Minister of Foreign Employment Promotion and Welfare, to purchase the building occupied by the Sri Lanka Embassy in Oman, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for Construction and Rehabilitation of 25 Bridges of the National Road Network
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body: - the Kuwait Fund for Arabic Economic Development has agreed to provide loan assistance in a sum of Kuwait Dinars 10 million (approximately US $36 million) for implementation of the construction and rehabilitation of 25 bridges on the National Road Network.  This includes, 09 bridges in the Western Province, 03 bridges in the Southern Province, 05 bridges in the North Western Province, 04 bridges in the Sabaragamuwa Province, 03 bridges in the Northern Province and 01 bridge in the Eastern Province.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the loan arrangements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reinforcement of the planning and operational sectors for efficient development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to reinforce the existing organizational structure and human resources in order to plan and direct the proposed National, District, Divisional and Rural Development Programmes, with the view to completing same within the estimated costs and scheduled time frames; and to reinforce the planning and operational sector of Ministries and District Secretariats for effective and efficient planning, operation and monitoring of development activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: A Credit of United States Dollars 200 million from the International Development Association  (IDA) of World Bank for the Second Health Sector Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body:
- the Ministry of Health, in consultation with the Provincial Health Authorities and other stakeholders, has formulated a National Health Development Plan for period from 2013 to 2017 in line with the Development Policy Framework of the Government and the Health Sector Master Plan.  The International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank has agreed to provide financial assistance of US $200 million equivalent of Special Drawing Rights (SDR) for the is programme which covers the following: 
*   malnutrition 
*   	prevention and control of non-communicable diseases
*   	maternal and child health and prevention and control of communicable diseases<>
*   	health system improveme 
the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the loan arrangements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Proposed Building (Stage II) for the Department of Computer Science and Computer Unit of Faculty of Science, University of Ruhuna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body: - Stage I of the project has already been completed for a total cost of Rs.63 million.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to award the above construction work of Stage II of the project to the lowest evaluated bidder for a sum of Rs.179,463,752.94 as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Proposed Six Storied Building Complex for the Lecture Halls and Examination Halls (Stage II), University of Kelaniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body: - Stage I of the above project has been completed at a cost of Rs.40 million.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to award the tender for the construction of Stage II of the project to the lowest evaluated bidder for a sum of Rs.246,005,998.18, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Eight Storied Building for the 'Medical Education Resource Centre (MERC)' of the Postgraduate Institute of Medicine (PGIM), University of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, for the construction of the above building to provide more accommodation, so as to increase the student intake by 30% for the Postgraduate Academic Programmes, with the view to overcome the shortage of specialists in various subject areas such as Microbiology, Pathology, Radiology and Psychiatry etc. and to commence the construction work in 2013 and complete the project within 2 years at a total cost of Rs.169 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Buildings for the Faculty of Management and Finance, University of Ruhuna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to award the above contract to the lowest evaluated bidder for a total cost of Rs.231,706,515.46, as recommended by Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for supply of 44.5 Million of Locally Manufactured Unsterile Latex Examination Gloves on Long Term Agreement (for year 2013-2014)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the above tender to the only responsive domestic bidder, for a total cost of LKR 199,293,873.00, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presentation of regulation made by the Minister of Sports under Section 41 of the Sports Law, No.25 of 1973
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Mahindananda Aluthgamage, Minister of Sports, to submit the Gazette Extraordinary No.1793/3 dated 2013?01?15 containing regulations made by him under the  Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973,  to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of Legislation to Amend the Resettlement Authority Act, No. 09 of 2007
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Gunarathna Weerakoon, Minister of Resettlement, to submit the draft Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman to extend the validity period of the Resettlement Authority Act, No.09 of 2007 for a further of three (03) years beyond April 10, 2013 to Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Agreement between the European Community and the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on certain aspects of Air Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body: - Cabinet of Ministers having observed that the European Union has informed that they have obtained the approval of their relevant authorities to ratify the above Agreement and for the entry into force of the provisions of the Agreement, decided to grant approval to ratify the said Agreement.

description: Sri Lanka's Participation at the World Expo Exposition 2015, Milan, Italy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body: -  the next World Expo Exposition is scheduled to be held in Milan, Italy from 01st May to 31st October, 2015. The primary objective of this Exposition is to highlight the economic, cultural and scientific achievements of a country and to share the knowledge and technology in all spheres gained by the country with the rest of the world.  The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce, to proceed with the preliminary work relating to Sri Lanka's participation at this Exposition, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of a block Land at Bibile Town Centre to the Bibile Pradeshiya Sabha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-14
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to allocate a block of land at the Center of Bibile Town belonging to the Urban Development Authority, to the Bibile Pradesiya Sabha, for the purpose of the development of the said land in keeping with the Bibile Town Development Plan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Repeal of the Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration Act, No.9 of 	1982 and drafting of a new Bill for the purpose
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon.	W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, to	instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation to repeal the Sri Lanka Institute of 	Development Administration Act, No.9 of 1982 and to draft a new Bill	incorporating all necessary amendments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of contract for rehabilitation of Hamilton Canal, Negombo to the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-07
decision_details_body: - rehabilitation of 8.7 km of the Hamilton Canal from Ma-Oya to Negombo Lagoon has been successfully carried out by the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation and the work is nearing completion.  The Department of Town and Country Planning of the University of Moratuwa has prepared a development plan pertaining to the balance 14 km section of the Hamilton Canal from Negombo Lagoon to Kelani Ganga Estuary (Hekiththa) with the objective of improving the livelihood of the people living in the area and also for tourism promotion.  The proposal made by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development, to entrust the work to the Land Reclamation and Development Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply and Delivery of Materials for Sustainable Power Sector Support Project (Expansion of Rural Electrification & Distribution System Improvement Ampara and Uva ) - Package - 4 - LOT 6A - I  - Switches, Drop Down Lift Off (DDLO) - 11kV/33kV and Solid Copper Link for 33kV DDLO  -  Package 4 - Lot No.6A - II  - Diverter Surge 11kV and 33kV Supply & Delivery of Materials
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by the Minister of Power and Energy to award the contracts for the above two packages to the lowest responsive bidders as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Strengthening the Primary Health Care Services System in Hambantota District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to construct 50 Primary Healthcare Service Centres in the Hambantota District and as the first stage of the project, to construct 05 Centres at Beliatta, Tissamaharama, Walasmulla, Sooriyawewa and Hambantota Divisional Secretariat Divisions at a cost of Rs.76 million, and thereafter to extend this programme to cover all parts of the country, was approved.

description: Tender for the Supply of 25,000 Vials of Normal Immunoglobulin for Intravenous Use BP 5g-6g Vial
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the tender for the supply of 25,000 Vials of the above to the lowest responsive bidder for a sum of US $3,941,000.00 (LKR 521,803,767.50) was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Refurbishment of Elections Secretariat Building at Rajagiriya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President to effect structural additions to the Elections Secretariat at a total cost of Rs.42.54 million, to provide better facilities, and to entrust the work to the Department of Buildings, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Regulations on Control and Monitoring of Refuse Tea, Reclaimed Tea, Absolute Refuse, Grade Broken Mixed Fanning (BMF) and Tea Waste and Regulations on Control and Monitoring of Handling and Dealing of Bin Teas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-07
decision_details_body: - refuse tea is a by-product resulted in the process of converting green leaf into made tea. On the above proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, Minister of Plantation Industries, to draft regulations for the above purpose to prevent malpractices, Cabinet approval was granted to refer the matter to the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Legislation chaired by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, Minister of Environment and Renewable Energy, for its recommendations.

description: Establishment of three Maga Neguma Companies under the Road Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-07
decision_details_body:
- the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways,  for the establishment of three Companies under the Road Development Authority (RDA) as follows, was approved by the Cabinet:
*  	Maga Neguma Construction Equipment Company (Pvt) Limited:
   -  	to provide construction equipment and machinery to those engaged in the Road Sector Development, on recovery of hire charges; and 
   -  	to undertake and complete road construction works not exceeding Rs.100 million awarded by the RDA.
*  	Maga Neguma Emulsion Production Company (Pvt) Limited:
   -  	to undertake manufacture of Emulsion, Pre-mix etc. and to supply same for road sector development works.
*  	Maga Neguma Consultancy and Management Company (Pvt) Limited:
  -  	to provide consultancy services for the preparation of Bills of Quantities, project proposals etc.

description: Lease of UDA land at Ratnapura New Town to M/s Ratnapura District Co-operative Rural Banks Union Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to lease out a block of land in the Ratnapura New Town to M/s. Ratnapura District Co-operative Rural Banks Union Ltd. for a period of 30 years for the construction of an Auditorium,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lease of UDA land at Ratnapura New Town to Geological Survey and Mines Bureau
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to lease out a block of land in the Ratnapura New Town to the Geological Survey and Mines Bureau for a period of 30 years for the construction of its Regional Office, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Integrated Urban Development Project for Trincomalee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-02-07
decision_details_body: - the overall objective of the Integrated Urban Development Project is to improve planning and for the delivery of priority infrastructure and local services in the Trincomalee  Urban Development area.  The project will also encourage private sector investment and operation through promotion programmes.  Asian Development Bank (ADB) has agreed to fund this Integrated Urban Development Project for Trincomalee and the total project cost is expected to be US$ 85 million.   On the above proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development,  Cabinet approval was granted for the Ministry of Defence and Urban Development to conduct a feasibility study on this matter and submit a detailed project report.

description: Outer Circular Highway (OCH) Project - Award of contract for the construction of 9.32 km long section from Kadawatha to Kerawalapitiya ( Northern Section II )
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-31
decision_details_body: - the Outer Circular Highway starts from Kottawa and traverses  through Kaduwela, Kadawatha and ends up at Kerawalapitiya.  It will link Southern Expressway, Colombo-Katunayake Expressway, the proposed Northern Expressway and other major National Highways from the city of Colombo.  The total length of the Outer Circular Highway is 29.22 km.   The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the above contract, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expansion of National Measurement Laboratory of the Department of Measurement Units, Standards and Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-31
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Johnston Fernando, Minister of Co-operatives and Internal Trade, to award the above tender to the lowest responsive bidder for a cost of Rs.1,328,457, 615.43, as recommended by the  Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Housing project proposed to be constructed for the Legal Officers of the Attorney General's Department in the Anderson Watta Land at Chitra Lane, Narahenpita under Janasevana National Housing and Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-31
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, for the National Housing Development Authority to construct a storied building consisting of 55 Housing Units, at Chitra Lane, Narahenpita, belonging to the National Housing Development Authority, on a request made by the members of the Legal Officers' Association of the Attorney General's Department, with funds to be provided by the said Association and to engage the service of the State Engineering Corporation for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the Supply of 120,000 Vials of Dried Factor VIII Fraction BP 250 - 300 IU
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-31
decision_details_body: -  the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health for the purchase of six (06) month's  requirement of the above item (20,000 vials) for a total cost of US$ 1,217,400.00 (LKR 161,188,506,00) and to call for quotations for the balance quantity, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Tertiary and Vocational Education Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-31
decision_details_body: - since many changes have taken place in the field of Tertiary and Vocational Education during the last two decades, the proposal made by Hon. Dullas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to make necessary amendments to the Tertiary and Vocational Education Act, No.20 of 1990, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Model Secondary School - Matara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-31
decision_details_body: - on the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to develop the new school buildings with 36 class rooms constructed in an extent of 2 acres of land adjoining the University of Ruhuna, Cabinet approval was granted to develop it as a Model Secondary School under the 1000 Secondary Schools Development Project.

description: Extending the period of the Post Office Networking Project by two years
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-31
decision_details_body: - work pertaining to the amalgamation of the network of Post Offices throughout the Island is now being carried out.  The proposal made by Hon. Jeewan Kumaranatunga, Minister of Postal Services, to extend the project period by two more years up to 2014?12?31, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project Phase 1
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-31
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to construct a Water Supply Scheme to provide safe drinking water for the people living in Anuradhapura North area, with loan facilities amounting to Japanese Yen 5,166 million (approximately Rs.7,458 million) to be provided by the Government of Japan, was approved by the Cabinet.  It is intended to cover Medawachchiya and Rambewa Divisional Secretariat divisions in the Anuradhapura District under the Mahakandarawa Water Supply Scheme in the first instance, and to implement the design stage of the Wahalkada Water Supply Scheme in the ensuing year.

description: Housing Support & Reintegration  Programme for Migrant Workers (Ratawiruwo)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-24

description: Loan Facility Agreements with Hungarian Export - Import Bank Private Limited Company to Finance the Rehabilitation of Labugama and Kalatuwawa Water Treatment Plants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-24
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into two loan facility agreements with the  Hungarian Export-Import Bank Private Limited Company, in amounts not exceeding Euro 16,714,045 and Euro 17,383,906 for the rehabilitation of the Water Treatment Plants at Labugama and Kalatuwawa respectively, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Policy on sending Female Domestic Workers for employment abroad
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-24
decision_details_body:
- the proposal made by Hon. Dilan Perera, Minister of Foreign Employment Promotion and Welfare for the following conditions to be imposed for female domestic workers seeking employment abroad in future, were approved by the Cabinet:
	Saudi Arabia
*      	Minimum Age -  25 years
*      	should have completed 21 days residential training and obtained Nation Vocational Qualification (NVQ) level 3 Certificate for "Domestic Housekeeping Assistant".
Other 7 Middle East Countries
*      	Minimum Age - 23 years
*      	should have completed 21 days residential training and obtained National Vocational Qualification (NVQ) level 3 Certificate for "Domestic Housekeeping Assistant".
Singapore, Hongkong, Malaysia, Cyprus and other countries
*      Minimum Age - 21 years
*      	should have completed 30 days residential training and obtained National Vocational Qualification (NVQ) level 3 Certificate for "Domestic Housekeeping Assistant".

description: Construction of a roof for the Thiwanka Statue in Polonnaruwa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-24
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Jagath Balasooriya, Minister of National Heritage to construct a permanent metal cover (roof) for the protection of the historical Thiwanka Statue at Polonnaruwa at a cost of Rs.54 million and to entrust the work to State Engineering Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme to Develop thousand secondary schools with five thousand primary schools network - Construction of Mahindodaya Technical Laboratories
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-24
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to award the construction of Mahindodaya Technical Laboratories to 400 schools among the remaining schools where the said laboratories are expected to be constructed under Phase II of the thousand secondary schools programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Four Storied Building for the Library under Relocation of the Buddhasravaka Bhikku University, Anuradhapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-24
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to construct a Four Storied Building for the Library of the Buddhasravaka Bhikku University, Anuradhapura, at a total cost of Rs.363 million, to entrust the work after calling for limited quotations from reputed contractors and complete the construction work within 30 months, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction   of   a  Fly-over   across   Maho  level  crossing
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-24
decision_details_body: - Nikaweratiya  -Moragollagama-Siyambalangamuwa Road crosses the Main Railway Line leading to Northern, North Central and Eastern Provinces, in Maho town and long delays to the movement of traffic on the above road are experienced due to frequent gate closures.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to proceed with the initial activities relating to the above project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of 25 University Colleges attached to University of Vocational Technology within the Provisions of University of Vocational Technology Act, No. 31 of  2008
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-24
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Dullas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to set up 20 University Colleges affiliated to the University of Vocational Technology (UNIVOTEC) by upgrading the existing Training Centres falling under the purview of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, utilizing Rs.1600 million allocated for the purpose in the 2013 Budget, and to establish a further number of 05 University Colleges in collaboration with the private sector, was approved by the Cabinet.  The proposed University Colleges will be able to create alternate learning pathways up to the Degree level for school leavers, and thereby provide more employment opportunities.

description: Proposal to Host the International Conference on "Better Air Quality (BAQ) - 2014" in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-24
decision_details_body: - the above conference provides a platform for the meeting of a large number of air quality management experts in Asia to discuss on sustainable transport, energy, industry, clean fuels and vehicles, air quality, climate change etc. It is expected to attract more than 500 dignitaries, resource persons, observers and participants for this event.  The proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadarshana Yapa, Minister of Environment, to proceed with the work pertaining to the above conference, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Defence Services Command and Staff College Act, No. 5 of 2008
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-24
decision_details_body: ? the Army Command and Staff College which functioned as a college belonging to the Sri Lanka Army, under the Ministry of Defence, has now been established as the Defence Services Command and Staff College.  The college conducts a one year residential course and those who pass out are awarded certificates.  This Institution is to be brought under the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University and will confer the Masters Degree in Defence Studies in consultation with that University, for those who complete the relevant courses of study.  The above proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Petroleum Resources Act, No. 26 of 2003
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-24
decision_details_body: -  with the view to meeting the required standards of global expectations of the petroleum industry as well as to introduce the principles of good governance into Sri Lanka's Oil and Gas Industry, the proposal made by H.E. the President, to bring in amendments to the Petroleum Resources Act, No.26 of 2003 and widen the scope of the Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement between the United Arab Emirates and Sri Lanka for the Establishment of a Joint Commission
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-17
decision_details_body: ? the proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to sign the above agreement between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of the United Arab Emirates for the establishment of a Joint Commission between the two countries for the purpose of promoting co-operation in various fields and strengthening existing bilateral relations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Colombo National Highways Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-17
decision_details_body: - the OPEC Fund for International Development has agreed to provide loan assistance in a sum of US$ 50 million for implementation of the Colombo National Highways Project.  The Project is expected to widen and improve 13 road sections covering 65 Km and to meet the expenditure involved in the reconstruction of the Nawala Bridge on the Nawala - Nugegoda road.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Landslide Disaster Protection Project  of the National Road Network
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-17
decision_details_body: - the government of Japan has agreed to provide loan facilities amounting to Japanese Yen 7,619 million approximately Rs.11,423 million through Japan International Corporation Agency (JICA) for the above project.  This project will cover the identified risk areas in the Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva Provinces.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Major Bridges Construction Project of the National Road Network
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to construct 37 major bridges connecting to the National Road Network with loan facilities to be provided by the Government of Japan amounting to Japanese Yen 12,381 million (approximately Rs.18,572 million) through Japan International Corporation Agency (JICA), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Greater Colombo Transmission and Distribution Loss Reduction Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-17
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that the electricity demand in the Greater Colombo area has increased rapidly due to the development and investment promotion activities initiated by the government.  The government of Japan has agreed to provide a loan amounting to Japanese Yen 15,941 million (approximately Rs.23,912 million) through Japan International Corporation Agency (JICA) for the above project.  The objective of the project is to construct a transmission and distribution network in the Greater Colombo area to strengthen the transmission and distribution capacity, increase reliability of power and reduce transmission losses.  The  proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning to enter into a loan agreement for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 200 Nos. small Buses for rural areas
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Kumara Welgama, Minister of Transport for the purchase of 200 numbers 33 seater buses at a unit price of Rs.3,520,760.00, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), to cater to the rural areas of the country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Two Hostels for 100 Female students and 100 Male students 	of the Vavuniya Campus at Pampeimadu, Administered by the Jaffna University - Stage II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education to construct a two storyed building at the above campus to accommodate 100 male students and 100 female students, at a total estimated cost of Rs.229 million, in keeping with the increased intake of students to universities, with funds allocated under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework, was approved by the Cabinet.  The project is intended to be completed in 2014.

description: Bilateral Agreement between Ukraine and Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by 	Hon. Mahindananda Aluthgamage, Minister of Sports,  to sign an Agreement on 	Bilateral Co-operation in the Field of  Sports  between Ukraine and Sri Lanka, was 	approved by the Cabinet.

description: Domestic School Uniform Manufacturers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-17
decision_details_body: - the two reports on the manufacture of School Uniform Materials by Domestic Manufactures submitted separately by Hon. Rishard Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce and Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, were considered by the Cabinet and it was observed that 50% of the total requirement of School Uniform Materials required for distribution among school children throughout the country for the year 2013, has been supplied by the Domestic Manufactures and also that the manufactures have assured that they have already taken steps to enhance their production capacity by installing new machinery in their factories and will be able to supply the total requirement of school uniform material domestically in 2014 as well.  After discussion, it was decided to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee under the chairmanship of Hon. Ratnasiri Wickremanayaka, Minister (Senior) for Good Governance and Infrastructure, to revisit the issue and make recommendations to develop the local textile industry to ensure that the textile requirement of the government sector, including school uniform materials, can be procured from local manufactures.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-17

description: Conversion of Single and Double Cabs and Land Rover Defender Motor vehicles to five door Luxury Station Wagons and conversion  of Single Cabs to Double Cabs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-01-03
decision_details_body:
- it has been observed that Land Rover Defender Motor vehicles auctioned by the government institutions are being converted to 5 door luxury station wagons and imported single cabs already registered as single cabs, to double cabs by changing the body structure of such vehicles.  The proposal made by Hon. Kumara Welgama, Minister of Transport, to implement the following, with the view to controlling these activities, was approved by the Cabinet:

*     	the relevant registration should be in accordance with provisions of the Motor Traffic (Amendment) Act, No.08 of 2009; 

*     	the Commissioner General of Motor Traffic should be satisfied that the relevant and parts have been lawfully imported to the Country; and 

*     	the difference between the tax payable for a new/used imported vehicle similar to that of the converted vehicle on the date of registration of the converted vehicle and the tax already paid on the converted vehicle at the time of its importation, should be paid as a surcharge to the Government.

The registration of such converted vehicles under the above conditions should be completed by 2013?03?31 and registration of such vehicles after the above date should not be permitted under any circumstances.

description: Presidential Task Force for Resettlement, Development and Security - Northern Province - Report of the Presidential Task Force - 2009-2012 - "From Conflict to Stability?
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-12-12
decision_details_body:
- contents in the above Report submitted to the Cabinet by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of  Economic Development, were noted.  Cabinet observed that an Action Programme has been formulated through a consultative process enlisting the cooperation from line Ministries, Provincial Councils, the Armed Forces, UN Agencies and INGOs.  Many Police Stations have now been re-opened and civil security is looked after by the Police.  Elections to local authorities in the Northern Province were held in July 2011 and 378 Members to 32 Pradeshiya Sabhas in all 5 Districts of the Northern Province were elected.  Provincial Council elections to the Eastern Province were also held.  Already 142,230 families have been resettled in all the Districts of the Northern Province. Some of the projects undertaken in the Northern Province are as follows:
*  	Restoration of Health Services	- major hospitals in all the Districts have been renovated.  At present, 161 preventive care institutions and 102 curative care institutions are functioning.  Total expenditure for healthcare services from 2009 to 2011 amounts to Rs.2135 million and an investment of Rs.9254 million has been allocated for ongoing and future projects.
*  	Revival of the Education Sector - out of the 1020 schools in the twelve educational zones in the Northern Province, 990 schools have been renovated and are functioning.  
 *  	Housing - for successful implementation of resettlement programme 78,144 permanent houses are scheduled to be constructed, out of which 27,983 houses have already been completed.
*  	Rehabilitation of Roads and Railway -  all major highways are being rehabilitated with a total investment of Rs.75,071 million.  In addition, rehabilitation of the Northern Railway Network is underway with assistance in a sum of US $650 million from the Government of India.
*  	Water Supply and Sanitation -  this work has been given high priority and already Rs.29.9 billion has been invested to improve water supply and sanitation in this Province.  A major water supply and sanitation project to relieve the water problems in Jaffna is underway at a cost of Rs.25 billion.
*  	Restoration of Electricity -  rehabilitation of the electricity network is underway, covering Vavuniya, Kilinochchi, Chunnakam etc.
*  	Revival of Agriculture - 90% of the 180,000 acres of  abandoned paddy lands have been brought under cultivation.  Seeds paddy and subsidized fertilizer have been provided.  A production of 212,722 MT of paddy was recorded during this period.
*  	Rehabilitation of Irrigation Network -  a total commitment of Rs.6333.9 million has been made by the Government for the rehabilitation of the entire irrigation network in the Province.
*  	Fisheries Sector - the total fishing fleet has now been increased to 11,225 and the fish production in the Northern Province has risen from 15,250 MT in 2007, up to 48,520 MT in 2011.
*  	Banking Sector - 20 State and Private Banks are operating in the Northern Region.  Loans amounting to about Rs.4,614 million have been granted to 36,000 beneficiaries under different credit lines by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka up to the end of 2011.
*  	Private Sector Investment - private sector has already begun to move to the regions in the Northern Province.   There are 23 projects approved by the BOI for a total investment of Rs.68,268 million.  In addition, 9 hotel projects consisting of 328 rooms have been approved for construction at an investment of  Rs.2217 million.

description:
Cabinet Paper No.12/1534/558/041-I (2012-11-14) 
Appeals made against the Disciplinary Orders issued by the Cabinet of Ministers on behalf of the Public Service Commission during the period between 2009?04?09 and 2011?05?12 when the Commission was non-functional
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-11-14
decision_details_body:
- (Cabinet decision dated 2012?10?18 - Item 41 refers) Cabinet of Ministers having considered the facts enumerated in the above Report, decided that action should be taken in the following manner in order to ensure administrative fairness: 
 
(a)	to grant approval as a matter of policy in terms of Sub-Article 55(1) of the Constitution, to deem it appropriate for the Public Service Commission (PSC) to consider petitions submitted to the Commission by officers aggrieved by the decisions taken by the Cabinet of Ministers in respect of the disciplinary matters that would have otherwise come within the purview of the PSC if not for it being non-functional from 2009?04?09 to 2011?05?12, under the special circumstances set out below:

(i)	petitions, requesting the consideration of a fact or facts that should have been considered during the formal disciplinary inquiry or during the deliberations of the Cabinet of Ministers, but had not been so considered;


(ii)	petitions, regarding any procedural impropriety which has occurred from the time of the commencement of the formal disciplinary inquiry to the issuance of the formal disciplinary order that has resulted in prejudice to the accused;

(iii)	petitions indicating that the punishment stipulated by the Cabinet of Ministers in the course of carrying out the functions of the disciplinary authority was excessively severe having regard to the comparable precedents.


(b)	For the PSC to receive petitions under the aforesaid grounds during a period specified by it. The PSC shall decide and convey its decisions to the administrative authority and the petitioner within a time frame determined by it.

	The Cabinet of Ministers also observed that the rationale of the above arrangement is to enable Public Officers who had been aggrieved by the disciplinary orders issued by the Cabinet of Ministers during the period in which the PSC was non-functional, to petition the PSC as would otherwise have been the case, and if aggrieved by the decision of the PSC to make available therefrom an appeal to the Administrative Appeals Tribunal within four (04) weeks of the receipt of the order or decision by the PSC.

decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to construct the ground floor and the first floor of the proposed 3 storeyed building for the above school, utilizing Rs.15 million to be provided by the School Development Society and to entrust the construction and related activities to a State Institution engaged in construction work on limited competitive bidding basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of National Highways with Concrete Surfacing through Domestic Contractors with funds to be provided by local Banks - Improvements to the section of Road from 33.50 to 44.00 km and the section of Road from 57.00 to 59.00 km on Naula - Elahera - Laggala - Pallegama - Hettipola Road (B312) and the section of Road from 20.00 to 45.00 km on Hasalaka - Handungamuwa Road (B484)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-31
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the contract for the rehabilitation of the above sections of roads, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of National Highways with Concrete Surfacing through Domestic Contractors with funds to be provided by local Banks - Rehabilitation and upgrading of  Ampara-Uhana-Mahaoya Road (A027) from 13.00 to 30.00 km
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-31
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted for the rehabilitation of additional roads having a total length of 328.77 km under the above programme and the section of road from 13.00 - 30.00 km on the Ampara - Uhana - Mahaoya Road is one such project. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the contact of this project, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Investment Promotion Zone (IPZ) at Suriyawewa, Hambantota set up by Board of Investment of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-31
decision_details_body: - a Master Plan has been prepared for the development of the Suriyawewa area as an Investment Promotion Zone (IPZ) covering approximately 230 ha., which will consist of a Multi Sports Complex, Cycling Stadium, Hockey Stadium, an International Aquatic Centre, a Media Centre, Information and Technology Park, Convention Centre, Educational Park, Hotels and Residencies etc.  The proposal made by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minsiter of Economic Development, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Alienation of land at Uchchimunai Island in Kalpitiya Tourism Zone to be developed as an integrated Luxury Hotel Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-31
decision_details_body: - Kalpitiya Tourism Zone has been planned to be developed as a special tourism destination in Sri Lanka.  Under this project, Uchchimunai Island (Northern Part) in Kalpitiya is to be given on a 99 year lease to an investor recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Review Committee.  Hotels, Resorts, Water Villas, Spas, Golf Courses etc. are to be constructed and other leisure and recreation facilities provided to meet the present day needs of tourists.  The proposal made by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Land Blocks from Regional Industrial Estates to set up Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-31
decision_details_body: - the objective of this programme is to promote industrial development at regional level.  There are 26 Industrial Estates established in the Districts.  The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce, to allocate blocks of land to 24 prospective investors, as recommended by Regional Industry Service Committees, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of Canal Layout of Moragahakanda-Kaluganga Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-31
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Development, for the revision of the canal layout of Moragahakanda - Kaluganga Project with the construction of the Upper Elehera Canal in place of the Second Bowathenna Tunnel and upgrading of the existing Huruluwewa Feeder Canal, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Policy on Antenna Structures
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-31
decision_details_body: - the modern telecommunication infrastructure is an essential requirement for rapid economic and social development of the country and at present 9 Public Switched Telecommunication Net-work Operators are providing telecommunication services in Sri Lanka and more than 2900 antenna structures have been installed to facilitate the provision of such services.  Considering the environmental and health related public concerns for human safety issues that arise when engaged in the construction of antenna structures and installation of net-works in public places, the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka has established a Technical Advisory Committee to assist the regulatory process on construction of antenna structures.  The proposal made by H.E. the President to implement the National Policy on Antenna Structures prepared by the said Committee and to issue guidelines in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Usage of Chemical Fertilizer and Agro Chemicals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-18
decision_details_body: - Cabinet of Ministers decided to appoint a Ministerial Committee comprising of relevant Ministers, to be assisted by an Officials' Committee, to examine the issues arising from the  utilization of these chemicals and make recommendations to the Cabinet on measures to be taken to mitigate adverse effects of these to the environment and to the people.

description: Regulations made under the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No.43 of 2000
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-18
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by  H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to submit the Gazette Extraordinary No.1746/4 dated 2012?02?21 pertaining to the above in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of nine storied Building Complex (Phase IV) for the Faculty of Medical Sciences, University of Sri Jayewardenepura -
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-18
decision_details_body: - the objective of the proposed construction project is to provide adequate space for the increasing number of student intake to the Faculty of Medical Sciences, as well as for the improvement of facilities and infrastructure for teaching and research activities.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, for the construction of the above with approved funds under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework, to commence the project in 2012 and complete it in 2018, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Dry Zone Urban Water and Sanitation Project - Sri Lanka - ADB Loan No:L2477SRI (SF) - Tender for Supply and Laying of HDPE, DI & PVC Pipes, Specials, Fittings and Valves for Transmission main and Distribution System in Chilaw WSS - Stage II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-18
decision_details_body: - this project is being implemented by the National Water Supply and  Drainage Board with funds provided by the Asian Development Bank and the Government of Sri Lanka.  The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to award the above contract, on the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC) to the lowest responsive offer for  a total bid price of US $2,310,021.00 plus LKR 289,261,568.65, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement of 02 Nos. Top Heavy Lift Trucks (40 Ton) for Sri Lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-18
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, for the procurement of the above on the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, at a total cost of Rs.168,167,649.59,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Repealing the National Museum Ordinance No.31 of 1942 and formulating a new Act in keeping with the present and future needs of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-18
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Jagath Balasuriya, Minister of National Heritage, to present the National Museums Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman, incorporating  the amendments recommended by the the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Legislation, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conversion of Sri Lanka Driving Licenses issued Prior to 2009 to New  Smart Card Driving Licenses
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-18
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Kumara Welgama, Minister of Transport,  to convert the remaining number of Old Driving Licenses of approximately 1.2 million, issued prior to 2009, to the New Smart Card Driving License System and to complete the task within a period of two years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Deyata Sevana' National Tree Planting Programme - 15th November 2012
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-18
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharashana Yapa, Minister of Environment, to conduct this year's National Ceremony of the Deyata Sevana National Tree Planting Programme on 15th November 2012, with the participation of all Ministries, Departments, Corporations, Statutory Boards, Provincial Councils, District and Divisional Administration, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prevention of Mosquito Breeding - Amendments to the relevant Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-18
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to bring in  amendments to the existing Act, No.11 of 2007, as recommended by the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Legislation, to enhance the powers of the relevant Authorities in the prevention of mosquito breeding, so as to curb the spreading of the dangerous dengue disease which has reached epidemic proportions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Slave Island Area Redevelopment Project, Colombo 02
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-18
decision_details_body: - the Urban Development Authority is presently engaged in the implementation of several projects in the city of Colombo to create more opportunities for urban investments and the housing development programme to resettle 65,000 low income families living in under-served settlements in the city of Colombo, is one such project to liberate prime lands for urban development.  The occupants in the relevant lands will be provided with decent houses with all facilities within a period of two years in lieu of their individual properties and the relevant families have agreed to renounce their rights to claim compensation for the respective land plots.  The total cost for providing alternate housing/commercial units including rental payments for temporary accommodation of the families is estimated to be about SLR 5874 million.  The proposal made by H.E. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Special Flood Mitigation Projects implemented by the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation (SLLR&DC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-18
decision_details_body: - Colombo Metropolitan Region is highly vulnerable to the effects of  floods and on the direction of the Ministry of Defence and Urban Development, the Sri Lanaka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation has initiated several urgent short term measures such as, cleaning of existing canal system, dredging of flood retention areas, creating water retention lakes and controlling haphazard filling of low lying lands etc.  Medium Term flood mitigatory measures have also been identified and implementation of these measures will be carried out under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project and the Weras Ganga Flood Control Project.  The proposal made by H. E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to proceed with the special flood control work programme initiated by the SLLR&DC for the year 2012, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of  Kandy Lake -
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-18
decision_details_body: work on the development of the city of Kandy is now underway and the proposal by H.E. the President, to entrust the development of the Kandy Lake and the wall surrounding it as well as the pavement, to the Ministry of Defence and Urban Development, with the view to preserve its historical value and to promote the scenic beauty of the city of Kandy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial Assistance from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) for the Completion of the Original Scope of the Dry Zone Urban Water and Sanitation Project -
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-10
decision_details_body: this project will cover the construction of three new water treatment plants in Chillaw, Puttalam and Vavuniya and improvement of sanitation facilities in Chillaw, Puttalam, Vavuniya and Mannar.  This project, on completion, will provide safe drinking water to more than 453,000 people  living in the relevant areas.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of  Finance and Planning,  to negotiate with the Asian Development Bank to obtain  Special Drawing Rights (SDR) equivalent to US$ 40 million as additional financing for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment  of a Sri Lanka Consulate General in Melbourne, Australia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-10
decision_details_body: - Melbourne has the largest Sri Lankan community concentration in Australia with a presence of nearly 80,000 to 100,000 Sri Lankans engaged in multiple fields including employment, education, trade, investment etc. The proposal made by Hon.(Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, for the establishment of a Consulate General in Melbourne which would cover the States of Victoria, South Australia and Tasmania, for which the concurrence of the Australian government has been received, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Revision to Convention on the Suppression of Terrorist Financing Act No.25 of 2005
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-10
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to amend the Convention on the Suppression of Terrorist Financing Act No.25 of 2005 and to submit the relevant amending Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: World Habitat Day - 2012 - Housing and Settlement Development Program in Colombo and other Urban areas -
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-10

description: Supply, Delivery,  Installation  and Maintenance of 02 Nos. of 3 Tesla MRI Scanner Machines for Kandy and Karapitiya Teaching Hospitals -
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-10
decision_details_body: with the view to providing better health care services to the people living in the relevant areas, the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health to award the above tender to the lowest responsive bidder, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, at a cost of US $4,054,495.00, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reconstruction of Janakala premises at Battaramulla to promote Tourism
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-10
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Jagath Balasooriya, Minister of National Heritage to utilize about two acres of Janakala Premises at Battaramulla to be developed as a model traditional village for the benefit of foreign as well as local tourists, was approved in principle by the Cabinet.
