description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Philippines and the Government of Sri Lanka for Co-operation on Agriculture and Related fields
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-10
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to sign the above Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of Philippines and the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed Joint Task Force for Promotion of Commercial Relations between Sri Lanka and India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-10
decision_details_body: - the annual value of two way trade between Sri Lanka and India has now reached nearly US$ 5.0 billion.  Sri Lanka's exports to India stands over US $500 million, while its imports from India have been closer to US $4.5 billion in 2011. With the view to promoting mutual trade between the two countries and also to promote Indian investments in several key sectors including pharmaceuticals, textiles and auto accessories etc. it is intended to establish a Joint Task Force representing different line authorities and private sector agencies.  The above information was furnished  by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce, for the information of the Cabinet of Ministers.

description: United States Agency for International Development (USAID) - First Amendments to Assistance Agreements on Strengthening of Social Integration Programme and the Programme for Equitable Economic Growth in Developing Regions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03
decision_details_body: - two assistance agreements have already been signed by the Government with USAID for the above and a USAID has agreed to enhance its contribution in a sum of US $1,400,000 and US $3,700,000 respectively, for above two programmes.

description: Tax Week - from November 01st to 08th 2012
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03

description: Establishment of Wild Elephant Holding Grounds to Minimize Damages Caused by Wild Elephants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal to establish two Wild Elephant Holding Grounds at Horowpathana and Lunugamwehera, in the first instance, with funds to be provided under the Medium Term Budgetary Frame Work 2013 - 2015, to minimize human  elephant conflict, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Priority Projects 2012 - Bandaranaike International Airport and Hambantota  International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03
decision_details_body:

Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation,  to call for sealed bids for the above projects from the reputed contractors as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Review Committee (SCARC), was approved by the Cabinet.  The following are to be implemented under these projects:

description: Construction of three storied three (03) Building units for the Expansion of Students Hostel at Sarasaviuyana, University of Peradeniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03
decision_details_body: - with the view to enhancing the accommodation facilities at the University of Peradeniya to cater to the increasing number of students entering the University, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education to construct three (03) storied building units at the Peradeniya University at a total cost of Rs.89.53 million and to commence this project in 2012 and complete it within three years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bunkering facility and Tank Farm Project Hambantota - Increase of Estimated Total Contract Price
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, for the Sri Lanka Ports Authority to enter into a loan agreement with the Bank of Ceylon for a sum of US $20,879,037.00, to meet the additional cost involved due to the addition of the second oil jetty to the scope of the work and also for the provision of other related facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of National Highways with concrete surfacing through  domestic contractors - rehabilitation and improvement of Haputale - Boralanda - Keppettipola Road (B353) from  0 to 27 Km and Meepe - Ingiriya Road (B285) from 0 to 18.13 Km
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03
decision_details_body: ? Cabinet approval has already been granted to rehabilitate 662.04 km of roads with concrete surfacing through domestic contractors to be financed by local banks.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Posts and Highways, to include the above two roads also in the above programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the construction of the proposed Ten Storeyed Building for the Army Hospital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to construct a 10 storeyed building with modern facilities for the Army Hospital at a total cost of Rs.4105 million with financial provision to be provided between 2013 - 2015, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Expeditious solution for prevention of occurrence of Forest Fires
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03

description: Multi Faceted Mixed Use Development Project in Colombo - ITC Ltd., India (Welcome Hotels Lanka Pvt. Ltd.)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03
decision_details_body: - ITC Limited, India intends to set up a multi faceted mixed use development project with an investment of US $140 million on a section of the property of former Army Headquarters premises in Colombo 03.  ITC Limited, India is the second largest hotel chain in India with over 100 hotels.  The above project includes luxury hotels, high quality residencies and shopping malls.  The proposal made by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development, to recognize this project as a Strategic Development Project under Act No.14 of 2008, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promotion Day for Grass Growing in respect of Milk Production
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03
decision_details_body: - presently the country producers nearly 40% of its milk requirement and the Government has adopted several measures to increase the production of milk.  There are about 2000 farmer - managed - dairy societies in the country with a membership of nearly 70,000 dairy farmers.  The proposal made by Hon. Arumugan Thondaman, Minister of Livestock and Rural Community Development, to declare October 30th as a Promotion Day for grass growing, so as to create awareness among the farmers, of the value of natural resources for increased milk production, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply of uniforms and other clothing materials for the Army, Air Force, Police, Special Task Force, Department of Civil Security and National Cadet Crops - 2012
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, for the purchase of uniform material required for the above services for the year 2012, from domestic manufactures, on the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee, at a total cost of Rs.2,034,031,720/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of Financial Provisions to supply necessary facilities for the commencement of Immigration and Emigration duties at the Mattala International Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H. E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to purchase the necessary equipments and make other arrangements to provide an effective and efficient service in accordance with international standards to passengers passing through Mattala Airport once it is commissioned, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Lease of Land at Warakapola Town Center to M/s Cargills Ceylon PLC for a Shopping Mall or Super Market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to lease out a block of land owned by the Urban Development Authority, for a Shopping Mall / Super Market under the Warakapola Town Development Project, to M/s. Cargills Ceylon PLC, which has quoted the highest bid value during selection, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Vesting / Acquisition of Lands for resettlement of families living in  Under-served Settlements in the City of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-03
decision_details_body: -  the Urban Development Authority has planned to construct 65,000 Housing Units for resettlement of shanty dwellers living in under-served settlements in the City of Colombo.  It is expected to construct high rise apartments with all common amenities to resettle the families and to free those sites for commercial and mixed development projects, in keeping with the City of Colombo Development Plan.  The Urban Development Authority has already awarded contracts to build 9,781 Housing Units under 11 projects within the City of Colombo, where the work is in progress and is intended to complete construction within the next 2 years.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development to vest the identified blocks of state land to be utilized for the purpose, as Free Grants with the Urban Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Export Processing Zone (EPZ) at Mirijjavila
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body: - the proposed Export Processing Zone will consist 228 hectares of government land released by Government Agencies in the Hambantota District.  The projected expenditure for the development the EPZ is estimated at Rs.2.2 billion and the BOI will recover the cost as lease rental of individual blocks to be allocated to investors and for providing other services such as water, electricity etc.  The proposal made by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial Assistance for the Reconstruction of 6 Railway Bridges under Belgium Assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body: - 6 bridges at Wellawatta, Polgahawela, Narahenpita, Navatkuli, Dehiwela and Angulana have been identified to be reconstructed under the above project.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, to enter into a loan agreement with Belgium to borrow Euro 4,438,681.70 for implementation of the above project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Loan Agreements with Export Import Bank of the United States and Hatton National Bank to obtain Financial Assistance for the implementation of Badulla, Haliela and Ella Integrated Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body: - the project is designed to meet the present and future demand of pipe borne water in Badulla, Haliela,  Ella and Demodara areas by augmenting the existing water resources and water for the purpose will be supplied from Demodara and Moretota reservoirs.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into loan agreements with the Export Import Bank of the United States and the Hatton National Bank of Sri Lanka for a sum of US $64.9 million and US $9.26 million respectively, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial Assistance for the Implementation of Greater Ratnapura Water Supply Scheme - Phase I
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body: - around 160,000 people living in Ratnapura, Kuruvita and Pelmadulla DS Divisions will be benefited by implementation of this project.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into a loan agreement with a Bank in Spain to obtain a Buyer's Credit in a sum of Euro 21,930,000 to finance 85% of the project cost and to obtain domestic funds equivalent to Euro 3,870,000 from a local Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the Supply of Normal Immunoglobulin for Intravenous use - BP - 5G - 6G 9000 vials
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Serisena, Minister of Health, to award the above tender, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, at a cost of US $990,000.00, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appropriation Bill for the Financial Year 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval was granted for the Appropriation Bill for the Financial Year 2013 submitted by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to be submitted to Parliament, after publishing it in the Government Gazette.  In the preparation of this Bill, H.E. the President and the General Treasury had consulted each line Ministry and other Stakeholders, with the view to formulating a realistic budget.  Emphasis has been given for the priorities identified under the Medium Term Expenditure Framework 2013-2015 and for the completion of development activities which have already commenced and are ongoing.  The estimated  Government  expenditure of Rs. 2520 billion for 2013 represents a 15% increase over the approved estimates for the current year.

description: Improvement of physical facilities at the Technical College, Matale
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Dallas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to construct a two storied building consisting of six class rooms, a computer room, and a room for plan drawing and other ancillary buildings etc. and for the provision of other necessary equipment at a cost of Rs.135 million, with funds to be provided through the Tertiary and Vocational Education Development Programme to be financed by the Asian Development Bank during 2013-2016 and to obtain the services of the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau for the preparation of the relevant plans and consultations with regard to the construction work, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of physical facilities at Hardy Technical College, Ampara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body: the proposal made by Hon. Dallas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to construct a three storied building consisting of class rooms, an auditorium etc. and for the provision of other necessary equipment at a cost of Rs.192 million, and to obtain the services of the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau for the preparation of the relevant plans and consultations with regard to the construction work, was approved by the Cabinet.  Action will also be taken to upgrade this Technical College to a University of Technology with funds to be provided under the Medium Term Expenditure Framework 2013-2015, through the Tertiary and Vocational Education Development Programme to be financed by the Asian Development Bank.

description: Construction of four storied Pre-Cast Building Complex for the Faculty of Humanities  - University of Kelaniya (Second Stage of Building K20)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body: - the University of Kelaniya intends to improve the teaching and learning environment of the Faculty of Humanities through the construction of a building containing Lecture Rooms, Auditorium, Laboratories, Libraries etc.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayaka, Minister of Higher Education, to award the construction of the above at a total cost of Rs.25 million, to the State Engineering Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upper Kotmale Hydropower Project (UKHP) - JICA Loan No.SL - P74 and SL - P100 - Variation No.2 to the Consultancy Services Contract
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy, for the time extension to the consultancy contract of the above project up to the end of December 2014 and for the costs variation as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: China Development Bank Funded Priority Road Project - Phase II - Consultancy Services for Construction Supervision
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body: - the China Development Bank has agreed to provide US $500 million for phase II of the project.  The civil works of the project intends to rehabilitate 504.9 km. of roads in the Western, Southern, Central, Uva, Sabaragamuwa, North Western and North Central Provinces and 85.0 km. of Provincial roads in the Nuwara-Eliya District.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the contract for consultancy services for the Southern Region and the Northern Region for a contract sum of Rs.337,616,000.00 and Rs.401,404,000.00 respectively, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the Construction of Manmunai Bridge
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body: -  the Government of Japan through the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) has extended a grant of Japanese Yen 1206 million towards the cost of the above project.  The relevant area is separated by the lagoon and accessibility is difficult between the eastern and western sections of the area.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to implement the above project with the above Japanese grant and with the contribution of Rs.397 million by the Government of Sri Lanka, for the development of the area and for the benefit of the public, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Road Sector Assistance Project - Second Additional Financing - Phase II - Funded by the International Development Association - Consultancy Services for Design Review, Construction Supervision and Contract Administration
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body:
- the under mentioned road sections are to be rehabilitated under this project:

*	Road Section from Maliban Junction to Cross Junction along Colombo - Galle Road from 13.35 km to 18.30 km.;

*	Road Section from Cross Junction to Panadura Bridge (from 0 to 7 km.) and Road Section from Panadura Bridge to Nalluruwa Junction  (from 25.50 km. to 30.00 km.) on Galle Road; and

*	Road Section from Peliyagoda to Mahabage (from 0.60 km. to 9.00 km.) and from Mahabage to Ja-Ela (from 9.00 km. to 17.50 km.) on Peliyagoda - Puttalam Road.

	The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the above contract for a sum of US $1,076,704.44 + LKR 252,256,292.78, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee (CACPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new building for Audio Video Centre of the Department of Agriculture to upgrade IT services and the establishment of a National Agriculture  Information Network
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body: - the Cabinet of Ministers has already granted approval to construct an Audio Video Centre for the Department of Agriculture at a cost of Rs.100 million.  The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to expand the scope of the Centre by empowering it with information technology facilities so as to cater to the media needs of the Ministries and other Government Agencies involved in agriculture related activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 65th Independence Day Celebrations - 04th February 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body:
the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, to appoint a Ministerial Committee consisting of the following to make necessary arrangements for the 65th Independence Day Celebrations, was approved by the Cabinet:
Ministerial Committee 

		*	Hon. D.M. Jayaratne, 
			Prime Minister and Minister of Buddha Sasana 
			and Religious Affairs - (Chairman);

		*	Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne,
			Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs;

		*	Hon. Bandula Gunawardena,
			Minister of Education;

		*	Hon. Keheliya Rambukwella,
			Minister of Mass Media and Information;

		*	Hon. T.B. Ekanayaka,
			Minister of Culture and the Arts;

		*	Hon. Najeeb Abdul Majeed,
			Chief Minister,
			Eastern Province;

		*	Hon. M.K.A.D.S. Gunawardena,
			Deputy Minister of Buddha Sasana and Religious Affairs; and

		*	Hon. Wijaya Dahanayaka,
			Deputy Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs.

	Secretary, Ministry of Public Administration and Home Affairs will function as the Secretary to this Committee.

description: Shilpa 2012 Craft and Small  Medium Industry Exhibition and Trade Fair
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-26
decision_details_body: - this Exhibition and Trade Fair will be held for 4 days from 27th December 2012 at the BMICH.  This event plays a pivotal role in supporting handicraftsmen and small and medium scale entrepreneurs to strengthen and develop their craft skills and marketing channels.  The National Crafts Council, the National Design Centre, Industrial Development Board and Palmyrah Development Board will be associated in making necessary arrangements for this Exhibition and Trade Fair.  The proposal made by Hon. Douglas Devananda, Minister of Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development, to proceed with the programme was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Award of contract for the construction of Roads and Flyovers in Hambantota Hub Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body:
- the following Roads and Flyovers have been included for construction in a separate contract package in the above project:

		*	Mirijjewila - Sooriyawewa Road - 23.34 km.
		*	Sooriyawewa-Moraketiya-Embilipitiya Road - 18.28 km.
		*	Outer Circular Road 6.64 km.
		*	Ranna-Wetiya Road - 16.15 km.
		*	Wetiya-Sooriyawewa-Andarawewa Road - 18.53 km.
		*	Flyovers at Wetiya-Namadagaswewa 

	85% of the total cost will be funded by the EXIM Bank of China and the balance 15% by the Government of Sri Lanka.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the above contract on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, to the China State Construction Engineering Corporation Limited, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: International Day of  the Girl Child 2012
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - on the proposal made at the 55th Meeting of the United Nations Commission on the status of women, the United Nations Organization has decided, with the consensus  of all member countries of the Organization, to name 11th of October each year as the International Day of  the Girl Child, with the view to ensuring social security, parental care and also to provide suitable solutions to the impediments faced by the child in the day to day life in the fields of education, health, sports etc.  The proposal made by Hon. Tissa Karalliyadda, Minister of Child Development and Women's Affairs, to declare 11th of October each year  as the International Day of  the Girl Child, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a 350 meter High Multifunctional TV and Telecommunication Tower with a Leisure Park in Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - the Export Import (EXIM) Bank of China has agreed to provide a loan of US $88,655,000 to finance 85% of the cost of the above project.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the activities pertaining to the above loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Loan from the Exim Bank of China to Finance Hambantota Port Development Project - Phase II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: ? Cabinet approval has already been granted to obtain a loan of US $600 million under preferential buyers credit and a Chinese Government concessional loan of Renminbi Yuan 1 billion from the Export Import (EXIM) Bank of China to finance the above project.  In addition, the EXIM Bank of China has agreed to provide a credit facility of US $51 million to finance the balance funds required to cover the total cost of US $808.14 million of the above project.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into the relevant loan agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Improvement of Padeniya - Anuradapura Road Project (Supplementary Loan)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: ? a loan agreement has already been signed between the Economic Development Cooperation Fund (EDCF) of the Export Import Bank (EXIM Bank) of Korea and the Government of Sri Lanka for the provision of a loan in Korean Won equivalent to US$ 55 million for the above project.  The project includes widening and improvement of 80.8 km of Padeniya - Anuradhapura Road.  The EDCF has agreed to provide a supplementary loan in Korean Won equivalent to US$ 11,132,000 to finance the additional work of the project.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into a loan agreement for the supplementary loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of 03 New Youth Corps Centres
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: ? presently, there are 37 Youth Corps Centres throughout the country which provide 06 months training in personality development and leadership qualities and about 15,000 male and female youth undergo training at these centres annually.  On completion of their training, they are referred to the Public Sector as well as the Private Sector for prefessional training according to their preference for employment.  The proposal made by Hon. Dallas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to establish 03 more Youth Corps Training Centres at Pannala, Senkadagala and Bibile at a total cost of Rs.250 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Matara-Beliatta Section of Matara-Kataragama Railway Extension Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: -  Cabinet approval has already been granted for the above project and a contract agreement has been signed between the General Manager of Railways and a company in China for the construction of the above.  The proposal made by Hon. Kumara Welgama, Minister of Transport, to authorize the General Manager of Railways to sign a supplementary agreement pertaining to the above project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Broadlands Hydropower Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: ? Cabinet approval has already been granted to award the above contract to M/s. China National Electric Equipment Corporation of China (CNEEC) who submitted the lowest evaluated and technically responsive bid.  85% of the total cost, being US $ 69,723,605.35, is to be borne by a bank in China and the balance 15% by a domestic bank in Sri Lanka.  The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy, to obtain 15% of the contract sum of US $ 12,304,166 from the Hatton National Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of Kilinochchi Water  Supply Scheme under Japanese Grant - Aid
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: -  the Government of Japan has agreed to provide a grant of Japanese Yen 677 million to be utilized for the above project.  The existing water treatment plant will also be rehabilitated under this project.  This project is to provide an adequate supply of safe drinking water to nearly 4500 houses and more than 20,000 people   living in 14 Grama Niladhari Divisions in the Kilinochchi District, will be benefited.  The project is scheduled to commence in January 2013 and completed by February 2014.

description: Establishment of "Saki" Knowledge and Technology Park in Hambantota
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - the proposed Park will cover around 500 acres of land and will be implemented in three stages during the period from 2013 to 2016.  After completion of the project, about 100 investors will engage in the IT Industry with a total investment of about US $5000 million.  This will also create around 50,000 new job opportunities and will generate a total income of about US $700 million per annum.  The proposal made by Hon. Ranjith Siyambalapitiya, Minister of Telecommunication and Information Technology, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Packeting and Supply of 40 Lakhs (4.0 Mn.) of Vegetable Seed Packets for Home Gardening under Phase IV of "DIVI NEGUMA" National Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, for the procurement of 40 lakhs of seed packets from six institutions, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), for distribution among farmers, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Asian Development Bank Funded National Highways Sector Project - Approval to Award Contract for the Rehabilitation and Improvements of Road Section from Pamankada to Kesbewa (North Section) on Colombo - Horana Road (B084) and Construction of Piliyandala by Pass
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - The Government of Sri Lanka has received a loan of US $85 million from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) for the above project.  Under this project, the existing road from Pamankada to Kohuwala will be improved to have a four lane carriage way and the road from Kohuwala to the starting point of the Piliyandala by pass will be improved to have a four lane carriage way.  The Piliyandala by pass will be constructed with a four lane carriage way and cycle lane on either side.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the above contract, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), for a contract sum of Rs.3,322,596,100.00, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Southern Transport Development Project - Extension of Consultancy Services for the Section from Kottawa to Kurundugahahetekma
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - the construction of 66 Km. long section of the Southern Expressway from Kottawa to Kurundugahahetekma is being financed by the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA).  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to extend the period of the ongoing contract for the consultancy services for construction supervision of the above project up to 2013?08?31, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Housing Development Programme for under-served Settlements by the Urban Development Authority - Award of the Construction of 816 (G+11) Housing Units, 500 (G+4) Housing Units and 17 Nos. Quarters for Angoda Hospital Staff to the State Engineering Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body:
? the following Housing Units are to be constructed under this programme:

*	816 Housing Units (storied buildings) at Kalinga Mawatha, Colombo 05;

*	500 Housing Units (storied buildings) at Angoda Hospital premises; and

*	17 Housing Units as hospital quarters at Mandawela Road, Angoda hospital land.

	The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to entrust the construction work to the State Engineering Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the proposed Maritime Museum at the Old Dutch Naval Commissioner?s House in Trincomalee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Jagath Balasuriya, Minister of National Heritage, to establish the above Museum in Trincomalee, was approved by the Cabinet.  Preliminary work relating to the above is being carried out by the Ministry and its remaining work is to be completed in line with the "Deyata Kirula" National Development Programme scheduled to be conducted in the Eastern Province in 2013.

description: Bilateral Air Services Negotiations between Sri Lanka and Indonesia
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation, to amend the existing Air Services Agreement signed in December 1993, to meet the present day needs, was approved by the Cabinet.  Under this Agreement, Sri Lanka and Indonesia will be entitled to operate up to a total of 14 Weekly Services with any type of Air Craft.

description: Enhancing the Quality of Fossil Fuels for Managing Air Quality in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that the use of low quality fossil fuel in vehicles, machinery and equipment etc. causes damage to engines and other systems of vehicles, machinery etc. as well as increase the pollution in the atmosphere. The Air Resources Management Centre of the Ministry of Environment has focused on this matter and has intervened to reduce its effects on air pollution by improving the quality of petrol through the introduction of lead free petrol.  The proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, Minister of Environment, for the appointment of a Cabinet Sub-Committee to examine this matter and make necessary recommendations, and also to appoint a Technical Committee consisting of Officials of the relevant Institutions to assist the Cabinet Sub-Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Regional Development Initiatives on Fast Track Basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - on the initiative of Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development, preparation of Detailed Plans and Bills of Quantities etc. of development activities in the respective regions, including Provincial Road Development Projects, Weekly Fair Development Projects and Maternity and Childcare Clinics Improvement Projects, have been entrusted to the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB), the State Engineering Corporation (SEC) and the Western Province Road Development Authority, which are state organizations. The proposals made by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development, to arrange for participation of Chambers of Construction Industry, organizations of contractors and accepted private sector construction entities recommended by the District Secretaries, in addition to the above state organizations, when similar projects are expected to be implemented and also to handover the projects of Weekly Fairs and Maternity and Childcare Clinics, on completion of the construction work, to the Local Authorities and other relevant organizations, for their maintenance, were approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Agreement between Russian Federation and the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - the Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters Act No.25 of 2002 provides for the provision of assistance by Sri Lanka to foreign countries relating to criminal matters and for obtaining of similar assistance from such countries by Sri Lanka. The objective of this agreement is to improve the effectiveness of  law enforcement of both parties relating to the investigation, prosecution and prevention of crime and confiscation of criminal proceeds. The above proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Shifting of CEB Transmission line to facilitate the constructions and operations of Outer Circular  Highway North Section - 1, Kaduwela to Kadawatha
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - the construction of Phase II of the above project is underway and it is necessary to permanently relocate the high voltage electricity transmission lines of the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) to facilitate the ongoing construction works of this project.  The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy, to proceed with the work pertaining to the shifting of the said electricity transmission lines and to entrust the work to M/s. LTL Holdings which is a subsidiary of the Ceylon Electricity Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sri Lanka Membership at Bureau of International Expositions (BIE)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: ? the primary objective of World Exposition is to share all branches of knowledge and technology with the rest of the world.  The present membership of the Bureau of International Expositions is 160 member countries.  The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce to  renew Sri Lanka's membership of the BIE, so as to promote and sustain closer relationship with other member countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Bentota Distribution System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - this project intends to meet the drinking water demand of the people in the coastal belt of the Galle District and it covers 22 Grama Niladhari Divisions within the Bentota Pradeshiya Sabha.  The successful completion of the project will improve the living standards of the people in the area and enhance social and economic development in the said area.  The water supply scheme will be based on an extension of the existing Baddegama Group Water Supply Scheme.  The project is estimated the cost Rs.790 million.  The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Modernization of Sapugaskanda Oil Refinery
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, Minister of Petroleum Industries, for action to be taken to modernize the Sapugaskanda Oil Refinery at a cost of US $500 million and to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee to make recommendations to the Cabinet and also to appoint a Committee consisting of relevant experts in the field, to examine the feasibility of expansion of the Sapugaskanda Refinery and make recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the National Human Resources and Employment Policy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12

description: Amending the Coast Guard Department Act No.41 of 2009
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation to the above Act, so as to bring in amendments to meet the present day requirements of the country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of land at Rajagiriya to the  Excise Department of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-09-12
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to allocate a block of land 30.26 perches in extent at Rajagiriya Town, owned by the Urban Development Authority, to the Excise Department, through the Commissioner General of Lands, for the construction of its Head Office building, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Matters pertaining to Education and Higher Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body:
42.  -  Cabinet of Ministers endorsed the views expressed in the joint Memorandum by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development and Hon. S.B. Dissanayaka, Minister of Higher Education, that the Academia of the Universities be treated as a special category, so that those with excellent academic career can be retained in the Universities and also intelligentia serving overseas can be induced to return to the country.  Cabinet also decided to appoint a High Powered Committee to monitor the implementation of the proposals agreed between the University academic staff and the authorities concerned.  

	Since, the intention of the Government is to develop Sri Lanka as a knowledge hub,  the proposal made in the Memorandum to set up a Presidential Commission to make recommendations on reforms that should be introduced to the entire education system and on measures that should be adopted to retain the autonomy of Universities, was also endorsed.  It was also agreed that there should be an effective dialogue with the University Academia and acknowledged the need for making University Academia active players of the  development strategy of the government.

description: Suspension of recovery of loan installments from farmers in drought affected areas of the country
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body: - H.E. the President informed the Cabinet of Ministers that, on representations made to him by farmer communities during his recent visit to the drought affected areas, instant action has been taken to direct the authorities concerned to suspend with immediate effect, the recovery of installments on cultivation loans and loans on pawned items obtained by farmers in the drought affected regions of the country  due to the hardships experienced by them, until the harvesting of the Maha Season 2013, which facility will be in addition to the package of relief already provided to this category of farmers.  His Excellency further stated that instructions in this regard has already been issued by the Secretary, Ministry of Finance and Planning to the Bank of Ceylon, Peoples' Bank, National Savings Bank, Regional Development Bank and the Rural Co-operative Development Bank.

description: Construction of an overlay for the Runway at Ampara Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to construct an overlay for the Runway at Ampara Airport, under the "Deyata Kirula 2013 Programme" and to invite competitive bids from domestic contractors registered with the Institute for Construction Training and Development (ICTAD) for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial Assistance from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) for the implementation of Greater Colombo Water Supply and Wastewater Management Improvement Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body: - the Asian Development Bank (ADB) is to provide financial assistance in a sum of US $300 million for the implementation of the above programme.  The total cost of this programme is US $400 million, of which the contribution by the Government will be US $100 million.  This programme consists of two main components, which are, enhancing the water supply the Greater Colombo Region and improving the wastewater management system.  The National Water Supply and Drainage Board  under the supervision of the Ministry of Water Supply and Drainage and the Colombo Municipal Council under the supervision of the Ministry of Local Government and Provincial Council, will be the implementing agencies of this programme.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into two loan agreements with the ADB, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of Priority Roads with the Utilization of Financial Assistance from the Local Banks - Financial Assistance from Commercial Bank of  Ceylon PLC for the rehabilitation of 19.05 kilometers of Galagedara -Horana Road Section
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to authorize the Road Development Authority to enter into a loan agreement with the Commercial Bank of Ceylon to borrow a loan of Rs.1,393,613,193, to be utilized for the rehabilitation of 19.05 km. of Galagedara - Horana Road Section, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement of Economic and Technical Co-operation between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of  the People?s Republic of China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body: - the Chinese Government has agreed to provide a grant of  Renminbi Yuan 100 million to Sri Lanka, to further enhancing friendly relation and bilateral economic and technical co-operation between the two countries.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into the relevant agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of the Green Garden  (Biodiversity Park ) next to the Diyawanna Oya Reservoir
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body: ? the main purpose of constructing this park is create a one-stop centre for visiting and obtaining knowledge and understanding for local and foreign parties and school children, with regard to conservation of biodiversity.  Rare species of plants currently threatened with extinction as well as bushes and plants which can attract butterflies and birds etc. are intended to be planted in this park, as proposed by the Hon. Anura Priyadarshana Yapa, Minister of Environment, was approved by the Cabinet.  It was decided that the project should be implemented by the Urban Development Authority, in association with the Environmental Authorities.

description: Establishment of International Arbitration Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, to establish the International Arbitration Centre, as envisaged in the budget speech 2012 by H.E. the President, with the state of the art facilities , in a location in the city of Colombo to be identified in consultation with the Urban Development Authority, and to locate the centre for the time-being at the sixth floor of the World Trade Centre, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Forty Six (46) Bridges on National Highways with Financial Assistance from the Government of France
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body: -  Cabinet approval has already been granted for the construction of 46 bridges on National Highways with a loan of Euro 22,021,702.00 from the Government of France.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, to include side walks on both sides of the bridges for the benefit of the public, at a cost of Rs.79.5 million to be provided with domestic funds, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Antiquities Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Jagath Balasooriya, Minister of National Heritage, to bring in amendments to the above Ordinance to suit the present day requirements of the country and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Sri Lanka Mission in Bahrain
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body: -  	the joint proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, and Hon. Dilan Perera, Minister of Foreign Employment Promotion, to establish a Sri Lanka Mission in Bahrain, to deal with matters on welfare of migrant workers and promotion of employment opportunities, trade and investment along with other consular and diplomatic matters, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Countering Dengue Vector Mosquitoes by Completing the Policy and Legal Requirements Necessary for the Elimination of the Environmental Factors Conducive to Mosquito Breeding
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body: -  it has been observed that breeding grounds for mosquitoes are increasing due to the rapid increase of packing materials, scraps, and polythene bags etc. that are being added to the urban solid waste and also due to the inadequacy of proper methods of waste disposal and that a multi-sectoral an integrated national level programme has to be implemented expeditiously for substituting the packaging materials with environmental friendly materials, minimizing the amount of waste generated and proper disposing of waste materials etc.  The above proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadarshana Yapa, Minister of Environment, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement between the Government of the Russian Federation and the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on Visa Free Travel for Holders of Diplomatic and Official/Service Passports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body: ? the objective of the proposed agreement is to enable persons who are in possession of Diplomatic, Official/Service Passports, to enter into, depart from, transit through or stay in Russia or Sri Lanka, as the case may be, without having obtained a prior visa for the duration of an official mission.  The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Pieris, Minister of External Affairs, to sign the above agreement between Sri Lanka and the Russian Federation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Reorienting Sri Lanka?s Diplomatic Presence in India
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body: -  the proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Pieris, Minister of External Affairs, to expand Sri Lanka's Diplomatic and Consular Representations in India, through expansion of the existing Missions in India to suit the present day needs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Centre for Dengue Research at the University of Sri Jayawardenepura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-29
decision_details_body: - on the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to establish a Centre for Dengue Research at the Department of Microbiology in the Faculty of Medical Sciences, at the University of Sri Jayawardenepura, at a cost of Rs.92,632,040/-, Cabinet approval was granted to implement the project within a period of two years.

description: Increasing the Monthly Allowance of the Teacher Assistants appointed to various Provincial Schools in the Island
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - Cabinet having observed that the decision taken on 2010?06?16 to increase the allowance paid to Teacher Assistants from Rs.3,000/- to Rs.6,000/- has not given effect to, decided to grant approval to the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to increase the monthly allowance of these Teacher Assistants, numbering approximately 4700, to Rs.6,000/- per month, so that they could continue their academic activities as well, to obtain the Teacher Training Certificate or a Degree from a recognized University, which is a compulsory requirement to be confirmed in the post.

description: Loans from the Exim Bank of China to finance Hambantota Port Development Project ? Phase II
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - Phase I of the above project was implemented with financial assistance from the Exim Bank of China.  The main components completed under Phase I were, breakwater, approaching channel, harbour basin, stocking yard, roads and administration building.  The Exim Bank of China has agreed to provide a loan of US $600 million and a Chinese Government Concessional Loan Renminbi Yuan 1 billion to finance Phase II of the project.  The objective of Phase II of the project is to build a strong supplementary Port to Colombo Port as an International Hub  and support Sri Lanka to consolidate the status as a container transshipment hub in the Southern Asian Region.  The proposal made by  H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into the relevant loan agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Loans from the Exim Bank of China to finance Matara-Beliatta Section of the Matara - Kataragama Railway Line Extension Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - the Exim Bank of China has agreed to provide a loan of US $200 million and a Chinese Government Concessional Loan of Renminbi Yuan 508 million to cover the total cost of US $278.2 million of the above project.  The objective of this project is to improve the transport system in the Southern Region.  The project is planned to be implemented in three stages.  Stage I of the project includes the construction of the railway line from Matara to Beliatta, Stage II from Beliatta to Weerawila and Stage III from Weerawila to Kataragama.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into the relevant loan agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial Assistance for the supply, installation, commissioning, testing and training of 2 Nos. Cardiac Catheterization Systems and 2 Nos. Echo Cardiography Machines to Cardiology Department of the National Hospital of Sri Lanka (NHSL)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - negotiations have been concluded with the Uni Credit Bank Austria AG to obtain a soft loan facility of Euro 2,382,000 to finance the above project.  The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to enter into a loan agreement with the said Bank for the above purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the Establishment of Colombo Vocational Training Center and Gampaha College of Technology
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - the Economic Development Co-operation Fund (EDCF) of the Export-Import Bank (Exim Bank) of Korea has agreed to provide a loan in Korean Won not exceeding the equivalent of US $26,046,000 to finance the above project .  The objective of the project is to establish two Vocational Training Centres with modern technological facilities in Colombo and Gampaha. This project is to provide facilities to the youth to gain the knowledge and skills necessary to meet the domestic as well as international demands, which in turn would increase job opportunities, contributing to the growth of the economy in the country.  The proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into the relevant loan agreement with the EDCF of the Exim Bank of Korea, for the above purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Paddy Purchasing Programme of the Government in Order to Stabilize the Paddy Price of 2012 Yala Harvest and Maintaining the Price Stability of Rice from September 2012 to March 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - the paddy harvest of the Yala Season 2012 is expected to enter the market from Mid August up to the first week of October 2012 and the estimated paddy production for this Yala Season is about 1.13 million MT.  H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, informed the Cabinet of Ministers that loan facilities amounting to Rs.4950 million have been provided by State Banks to the Paddy Marketing Board up to June 2012, for the purchase of paddy.  The General Treasury has provided a further sum of Rs.2000 million to the Paddy Marketing Board for the said purpose.  Rs.1,588 million will be made available to the Paddy Marketing Board through pledge loans from the Banks to purchase paddy in Yala Season 2012, in addition to the proceeds of sale of paddy stocks purchased in previous seasons by the District Secretaries/Government Agents of paddy producing Districts, utilizing around Rs.1,300 million released to them by the General Treasury.  His Excellency also stated that action has been taken under the guidance of the Ministry of Agriculture, to develop four zones to produce rice for export purposes, in keeping with the budget proposals for 2012 and that the Ministry of Agriculture will coordinate the activities for the sale of this special variety of paddy produced by farmers in the said regions, to the export market.

description: Vesting/Acquisition of Lands earmarked for the Proposed Telecommunication Tower Project (Lotus Tower) at  D.R. Wijewardena Mawatha, Colombo 10.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - the Urban Development Authority (UDA) has planned to develop the land area along D.R. Wijewardena Mawatha, Colombo 10., for tourism related activities, in line with the ongoing Colombo City Development Programme.  Under this development programme, the UDA has already earmarked 7.5 acres of land in the above area, to construct a 350 metre high Multifunctional T.V. and Communication Tower (Lotus Tower) with a revolving restaurant and many other entertainment activities, by the Telecommunication Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to vest all State Lands in the area, with the UDA, for the above development activities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Independence Square, Colombo 07 - Vesting of State Lands with the UDA
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - Urban Development Authority is to undertake the project to refurbish old buildings in the Independence Square Area while preserving the original architectural features.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to release the Race Course Ground including the Grand Stand and the Mini Stand buildings, a play ground and certain premises in the area occupied by Government Departments, to the Urban Development Authority for overall development in the area, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the Supply of 200,000 of Merepenem Injection 1g. Vials
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to purchase 30,000 vials from the local market at the lowest price, as recommended by the Procurement Appeal Board (PAB) and to call for fresh worldwide tenders for the balance amount of 170,000 vials, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supply and Delivery of Materials for Sustainable Power Sector Support Project (Expansion of Rural Electrification & Distribution System Improvement   Ampara and Uva) - (Package - 5) (NCB) - Lot No. 9 - Reinforced Concrete Poles
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy to award the above contract for an amount of  LKR 123,298,576.00, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the government.

description: Maintaining a Buffer Stock of Water Pipes Laying of Water Transmission and Distribution Pipes together with Road Development Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - the government has already undertaken the implementation of a large number of road development / expansion projects and more projects are scheduled to commence in the near future in most parts of the Island.  On the proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, for pipes to be made available to the road contractors well in time for replacing and re-laying of water pipes to coincide with the execution of the road contracts, Cabinet approval was granted to entrust the work relating to replacing and re-laying of water pipes also to the road construction contractors, to be done under the supervision of the Water Supply and Drainage Board.

description: Supply and Installation of Hydro - Meteorology Information System Dam Safety and Water Resources Planning Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body:
- this project is being implemented with the objective of establishing long term sustainable arrangement for operation and maintenance of large dams and improving water resources planning and is funded by the World Bank.  The project includes the following:

*	Component 1: Improvement of Dam Safety and Operational Efficiency; under this component, 32 major dams will be rehabilitated and basic safety facilities will be provided to an additional 48 major dams.

*	Component 2: Upgrading and Modernization of Hydro-Meteorological Information System, and

*	Component 3:  Multi-sector Water Resources Planning which will produce a National Water Use Master Plan and detailed River Basin Management plans for Mahaweli and Mundeni Aru River Basins.

The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to award the above contract for a sum of Rs.352,289,472.00 plus Euro 2,274,565.74, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.  It was also observed that World Bank concurrence has been received for the award of this contract.

description: Controlling the  Import  Export  and Production of Hydrochlorofluorocarbon (HCFCs) under the Montreal Protocol on Ozone Depleting Substances
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - the Ozone layer is situated 20-50 Km. above the earth's surface and acts as a protective shield and filters the harmful ultra-violet radiation coming from the sun.  When Ozone Depleting Substances are released to the atmosphere they destroy the Ozone layer, which would lead to, increasing the risk of having skin cancers, eye cataracts etc.  as well as global climate change.  In keeping with the Montreal Protocol, Sri Lanka is obliged to completely phase out chlorofluorocarbon which is widely used in refrigeration and air conditioning. The proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharashana Yapa, Minister of Environment, to implement the recommendations made by the Officials' Committee to start the control of the import/export and production of Hydrochlorofluorocarbon with effect from 01st January 2013, and stop such activities by January 2030 on phased out basis and to direct the Controller of Imports and Exports to introduce appropriate regulations for the purpose under the provisions of the relevant Act, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision to the Convention on the Suppression of Terrorist Financing Act No. 25 of 2005
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft necessary amendments to the Convention on Suppression of Terrorist Financing Act No. 25 of 2005, in keeping with the recommendations of the Financial Action Task Force of the G 7 countries, to eliminate the remaining deficiencies in the law, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Bilateral Consultations between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Sultanate of Oman and the Ministry of External Affairs of  the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs for signing of the above Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Oman and the Ministry of External Affairs of Sri Lanka, as a further step to enhance the existing bilateral relations between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: A regulatory and supervisory mechanism for Micro Finance Institutions in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-22
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to introduce legislation to regulate and supervise Micro Finance Institutions in the country to ensure the financial stability in that sector and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft legislation for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Modernization of Processing Factories of MILCO (Pvt) Ltd.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-15
decision_details_body: - the government has observed the importance of increasing the domestic milk production by facilitating to increase the capacity of the existing milk processing factories located at Digana, Polonnaruwa and Ambewela and to encourage the private sector participation in this regard.  MILCO has planned to increase its liquid milk production to 165 million liters from the existing level of 30 million liters.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to modernize the above factories to meet the increasing demand for domestic milk and to obtain credit facilities for same from Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Ltd. and for the project to be implemented by MILCO (Pvt) Ltd., under the supervision of the Ministry of Livestock and Rural Community Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining services of Australian volunteers for development programmes
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-15
decision_details_body: - the objective of the above programme is to provide an opportunity to Australian volunteers to share their skills and knowledge with local counterparts on short term (6 months) and long term (up to 3 years) basis and foster links between organizations and communities in Australia and Sri Lanka.  These volunteers are to be deployed for development programmes in coordination with Aus-Aid's Development Cooperation Programme in Sri Lanka and all relevant expenses of this programme will be borne by the Government of Australia. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding for the purpose, was approved by the  Cabinet.

description: Institutionalizing the Academy of Financial Studies (AFS) as the Training Arm of the Ministry of Finance and Planning
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-15
decision_details_body: ? action has been taken by the Ministry of Finance and Planning to renovate and refurbish the Times Building situated at Colombo Fort, after Sri Lanka Customs moved into their newly built premises, as a modern and high-tech training facility, which could be occupied by the end of August, 2012.  This would provide training and skills development on specialized fields / specific subjects for the benefit of officers of the Ministry together with the staff of the 14 Departments of the General Treasury and other government institutions.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the above programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

decision_details_body: - the Asian Development Bank (ADB) has provided funds to the Government of Sri Lanka for the above project.  The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy to award the above contract  to Nippon Koei Co. Ltd. of Japan, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC), was approved by the government.

description: Rehabilitation of National Highways with Concrete Surfacing through Domestic Contractors - Improvements to Galagedara - Horana Road (B123) from 0 to 19.05 km
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-15
decision_details_body: - this is one of the roads approved for rehabilitation under the above programme. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the above contract, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, for a negotiated sum of Rs.1,393,613,193.42 with funds to be provided by a local Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 40th International Pepper Conference - 30th October to 02nd November 2012 - Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-15
decision_details_body: - the International Pepper Conference has been established under the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for the Asia Pacific.  Brazil, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Sri Lanka and Vietnam which are the major Pepper producers comprise the permanent membership of this conference at present.  Hon. Reginald Cooray, Minister of  Minor Export Crop Promotion, informed the Cabinet of Ministers that arrangements have been made to organize the above Conference, in collaboration with Indonesia.

description: Entering into a Memorandum of Understanding between the two Ministries of Education of the Seychelles Republic and Sri Lanka, in respect of Education and Training
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-15
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to enter into the above Memorandum of Understanding between the two Ministries of Education of the Seychelles Republic and Sri Lanka , with the view to further strengthening the relationship between the two countries , was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulating the National Green Procurement Policy and  Guidelines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-15
decision_details_body: ? Green Procurement Process is identified as the process for the  selection of bidders who adhere to environmental conservation standards when contracts are awarded for purchasing of goods and services in general.  In this process, the  environmental impact of the goods or services is also taken into consideration  as a criterion, in addition to its quality, price, maximum economic benefits  etc.  Attention will also be paid to include provisions in the above Procurement Policy and Guidelines, to encourage local producers to produce eco-friendly goods and services and to give priority for locally made goods in making purchases for local consumption. The above proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadarshana Yapa, Minister of Environment, to formulate a National Green Procurement Policy for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Environmental Rehabilitation of Areas Affected by the Implementation of Infrastructure Projects
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-15
decision_details_body: - currently, a methodology is in operation by way of environmental impact assessment process, to minimize the damage that can be caused  by implementation of a project.  It has been observed that, in projects such as highway constructions and township development, the environmental damage that would cause, affects tourism, which has a high potential for using the environment in a sustainable way. On the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadarshana Yapa, Minister of Environment relating to the above, Cabinet approval was granted to implement an Environmental Management Plan in association with the project investors and stakeholders of the State and the Private Sector, after conducting a study on the impact that could be caused to the environment by the projects.

description: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations with Countries of Latin America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-15
decision_details_body:
- Latin American countries which were under the British, French and other European Colonial rule are today marching towards sustainable growth and development as emerging States, and promotion of Sri Lanka's diplomatic relations in a wide scale in this region will be another step forward in Sri Lanka's foreign policy.
