decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-15
decision_details_body: ? the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy, to obtain the services of the University of Moratuwa for the above purpose, with the view to providing better services to the consumers living in the relevant areas and to save the cost of rental being paid at present to private parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposed 400 mm DI Transmission Main from Kantale to Thampalakamam and relocation of existing Distribution System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-15
decision_details_body: - the National Water Supply and Drainage Board is currently implementing a project for augmenting the Greater Trincomalee Area with financial assistance from France.  The project includes enhancing the Kantale Water Treatment Plant from its present capacity and constructing a supplementary transmission main from Kantale to Thampalakamam.  Since the Road Development Authority is developing the A06 Main Road from Kantale to Trincomalee through 4 separate contracts, the proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardene, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to entrust the pipe laying work pertaining to the above, to the respective road development contractors under the supervision of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, at a total cost of Rs.1397.8 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Pension benefits for the Members of the Home Guards Force and the Civil Security Force
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-15
decision_details_body: ? Cabinet of Ministers confirmed its decision taken at its meeting on 2012?08?08 on the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban development, to grant pension benefits for the  Members of the Home Guards Force and the Civil Security Force, in terms of the provisions of the Minute on Pensions and to formulate suitable Schemes of Recruitment and Salary Scales for the said Services, in consultation with the General Treasury and other relevant authorities.

description: Food Aid Assistance from the World Food Programme (WFP) to Sri Lanka for 2012
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-08
decision_details_body: - the  World Food Programme (WFP) is to extend the duration of the existing food aid assistance under the Protracted Relief and Recovery Operation (PRRO) programme until 2012. The objective of this programme is to assist the Government in its efforts to restore the livelihood and assets of the displaced persons in the Northern and Eastern Provinces, in their re-settlement activities.  The total cost of the programme is US $27,960,762. The programme will be implemented in Mannar, Mulativu, Vavuniya, Kilinochchi and Jaffna Districts in the Northern Province and selected areas in the Eastern Province and the estimated number of beneficiaries of this programme would be about 176,000 persons.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to sign the Letters of Understanding for the purpose with the World Food Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 2013 Deyata Kirula National Exhibition and Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-08
decision_details_body:
- the above programme is to be implemented covering the four (04) Districts of Polonnaruwa, Trincomalee, Ampara and Batticaloa.  All development projects that are being implemented and those proposed to be implemented in the above 04 Districts by all Ministries, Departments and other Institutions, are to be integrated  under the above programme for implementation expeditiously. Financial provisions in the following manner will be made available for the development activities to be carried out in line with Deyata Kirula National Exhibition in the said four Districts:

	The above proposals made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Medium Term Expenditure Framework 2013-2015 and Preparation of Budget 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-08
decision_details_body: - H.E. the President, in his capacity of the Minister of Finance and Planning, informed the Cabinet of  Ministers that the Ministry has already commenced the initial activities relating to the preparation of the Budget 2013, based on the Medium Term Expenditure Framework 2013 - 2015.  The Budget 2013 is to be prepared in line with the policies and strategies implemented under the "Mahinda Chintana - Vision for the Future - The Development Policy Framework of the Government", to achieve a higher economic growth, ensuring the distribution of benefits to all segments of communities and also maintaining a balanced development in all sectors.

description: Implementation of the Urgent Development Programme to uplift the living standards of the people affected by the drought
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-08
decision_details_body:
- Cabinet of Ministers at its Meeting held on 2012?07?11 has already directed the relevant authorities to formulate an urgent  programme to provide relief to the people affected by the drought.  Accordingly, H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, briefed the Cabinet of Ministers on the following progress  achieved in this regard: 

*	Project for the Payment in Cash for the work done - under this project, members of affected families between the ages of 18 and 60 have been engaged in the renovation work pertaining to minor irrigation systems, canals and rural access roads, in their  respective areas and the works are in progress.  Arrangements have been made by the General Treasury to release funds for the purpose to the District Secretaries of Polonnaruwa, Anuradhapura and Puttalam, depending on the needs.

*	provision of Drinking Water - financial provision has been provided to the relevant District Secretaries of 14 Districts by the Ministry of Disaster Management, for the purchase of water tanks and to obtain water bowsers on rental basis to provide drinking water facilities to 66,131 affected families.  
 
*	renovation of Agricultural Wells - work pertaining to dredging and renovation of selected agricultural wells at regional level in the drought affected areas, is in progress.

*	dredging of major irrigation reservoirs so as to increase there water retention capacities - under this programme, dredging of Kalawewa and 126 reservoirs / tanks etc. in the vicinity, in the Anuradhapura District is in progress. In the Polonnaruwa District, dredging of  Girithale Tank and 03 reservoirs in the vicinity, is in progress. Dredging of Magalla reservoir in the Kurunegala District commenced on 2012?07?27. Work pertaining to the other reservoirs in the vicinity have also commenced. The work is being attended to by the Department of Irrigation, Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka and the Department of  Agrarian Development.



*	provision of relief for cultivation purposes for the Maha season 2012 / 2013 - the requirement of seed paddy for distribution in the drought affected areas for the 2012 / 2013 Maha season is about 180,000 bushels and it is intended to allocate financial provision in a sum of Rs. 216 million for the purpose.  

This programme is being monitored by a Presidential Task Force comprising of Secretaries to the relevant Ministries and other relevant authorities, and is headed by the Secretary, Ministry of Finance Planning and a progress review on the entire programme is being conducted once in 10 days.

description: Allocation of land from Kandapola Forest Reserve, Seetha Eliya for High Frequency Receiving Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-08
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is responsible for the provision of Air Navigation Services and Communication Services for the Aircraft operating within the region assigned to Sri Lanka under the Regional Air Navigational Plan of the International Civil Aviation Organization.  The Joint proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation and Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, Minister of Environment, to proceed with the allocation of the above land for the purpose, subject to stipulations made, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Registration of News casting Websites - Amendment to the Sri Lanka Press Council Act No 05 of 1973
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-08

description: Amending the Mines and Minerals Act No.33 of 1992 amended by Act No.66 of 2009
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-08
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, Minister of Environment, to formulate a systematic and easy methodology to control the transporting of minerals, such as sand, needed by the public for construction purposes, so that such method could be amended from time to time by orders published in the government gazette based on the needs of the country, and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare amending legislation for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Aviation fuel hydrant system at the proposed new Airport Apron (apron-E) and upgrading of aviation fuel terminal facilities at the BIA in parallel with the Phase -II, Stage-II of BIA Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-08
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, Minister of Petroleum Industries, to award the contract for the preparation of detailed designs of the above project on negotiating basis, enabling the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation to ensure the completion of the Apron Area Installation Works by August 2013 and to call for international competitive bids for its construction, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Remedial measures for unfavourable situations caused by Dry Climatic Conditions

Jayaratne, the Prime Minister, for the appointment of a Ministerial Committee to be assisted by an Officials' Committee, to carry out a feasibility study on the small scale water resources available for the implementation of a project to generate power and to use for cultivation purposes and domestic consumption; and to provide an opportunity with the required facilities, for interested parties to implement this project with the necessary approvals of the relevant authorities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Air Services Negotiations between  Sri Lanka and South Africa

Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation, to enter into an Air Services Agreement between Sri Lanka and the Republic of South Africa as a means of creating and preserving friendship, understanding and cooperation between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Air Services Agreement  (ASA) between Sri Lanka and Vietnam

decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation, to enter into an Air Services Agreement between Sri Lanka and Vietnam, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations with the Soloman Islands and Tuvalu
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-08
decision_details_body: - both  the Soloman Islands and Tuvalu, two Pacific Island Nations, through the Sri Lanka Mission in New York, have conveyed their interests in establishing Diplomatic Relations with Sri Lanka. Both these countries share common membership in several international fora with Sri Lanka that include the United Nations, the Commonwealth, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) etc.  The proposal made by Hon. description: Deyata Kirula National Development Programme - 2013 - Allocations for National Development Programmes

description: Commencement of a Housing Project at Ampara area for the Government Servants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-08-08
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, to launch a programme for the construction of 100 houses for the government servants of the District of Ampara, in a block of land about 10 acres in extent, at Nawagampura, situated close to the Ampara town, under the Deyata Kirula Development Programme 2013, was approved by the Cabinet. description: Financial Assistance from the  Asian Development Bank (ADB) for the implementation of Clean Energy and Network Efficiency Improvement Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-25
decision_details_body: - this project aims to achieve future requirements of Sri Lanka in an environment friendly manner while increasing the clean energy sources to the national grid, thereby improving the efficiency and reliability of the supply of electricity in the country.  The proposed project involves construction of transmission lines from Anuradhapura to Vavuniya (55 Km) and Vavuniya to Mannar (70 Km), to strengthen the transmission infrastructure in the said districts and improving the transmission and distribution network efficiency in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-Western Provinces. description: Exportation of Rice and Paddy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-25
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to impose a minimum price on the exportation of Paddy and Rice, until the production of Maha Season 2012 / 2013 is harvested, so that an adequate stock of rice in the country at affordable prices could be ensured until the paddy production of Maha Season is yielded and supplied to the market and to submit the relevant Gazette Notification pertaining to the regulations imposed in terms of the provisions of the Import and Export Control Act No.01 of 1969, was approved by the Cabinet.  At present the Government is processing a paddy stock of approximately 240,260 MT. purchased by the Paddy Marketing Board and another stock of 59,786 MT. purchased by the District Secretariats and the total investment by the Government for this stock of paddy is Rs.4,115 million.  The Government has also granted Rs.4,750 million to the State Banks as a facility for the purchase of paddy.  The rice varieties produced exclusively for the purpose of exporting to the foreign market will not be affected by implementation of the above proposal.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-18

The Agreement on Re-admission of persons residing without authorization signed with the European Community is one such Agreement. The International Organization for Migration (IOM) is supporting the Government of Sri Lanka for the effective implementation of the Re-admission Agreement under the EU Funded Project titled "Support to the Governments of Pakistan and Sri Lanka for the implementation of Re-admission Agreements with the European Community". The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, for the formal establishment of the National Coordinating Committee on Re-admission (NCCR), to guide and negotiate future Re-admission Agreements with other countries and to attend to matters connected thereto, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Legislation for the protection of the rights of the Breeders of new plant varieties and of the Farmers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-18

Since the provisions of the Intellectual Property Act No.36 of 2003 do not cover the protection of the rights of the breeders of new plant varieties and of the farmers, the joint proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce and Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to refer it to the Cabinet Sub-Committee on legislation for its recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Carrying out Feasibility Studies, Environmental Impact Assessment and Preparation of Documents to Invite Expression of Interest and Requests for Proposals for Phase 1 of the Proposed Northern Expressway
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-18
decision_details_body:
this is one of the six expressways identified for implementation in the National Road Master Plan 2007-2017. The tentative corridor for phase 1 of the expressway has been identified and is proposed to be implemented in three stages as follows:     

*	Stage I - total length of Stage I is 42.5 Km. and interchanges are proposed to be constructed at Enderamulla, Gampaha, Veyangoda and Mirigama.  	

*	Stage II -	total length of Stage II is 35 Km. and interchanges are proposed to be constructed at Pothupitiya, Dampalassa and Pellandeniya.

*	Stage III -  total length of Stage III is 44 km. and interchanges are proposed to be constructed at Pothupitiya, Polgahawela, Rambukkana and Hedeniya.  

	Cabinet of Ministers granted approval for implementation of the above proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways.

description: Implementation of the Urgent Development Programme to uplift the living standards of the people affected by the drought
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-11
decision_details_body:
- Cabinet of Ministers at its Meeting held on 2012?07?04 directed the relevant authorities to formulate an urgent  programme to provide relief to the people affected by the drought.   Accordingly, the following proposals submitted to the Cabinet by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, for the Meeting of 2012?07?11, were approved for implementation:

*	dredging of major irrigation reservoirs so as to increase there water retention capacities - under this programme, dredging of 1278 reservoirs / tanks will be undertaken at a cost of Rs.3577 million and the increase in capacity of these reservoirs / tanks after dredging will be 7378 acre feet.   The work will be attended to by the Department of Irrigation, Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka and the Department of Agrarian Development.

*	provision of Drinking Water - drinking water facilities are to be provided to 52,430 families in 12 Districts at a cost of Rs.30 million.  

*	Renovation of Agricultural Wells - dredging and renovation of 4,000 selected agricultural wells will be undertaken at a cost of Rs.40 million.

*	Project for the Payment in Cash for the work done - under this project, members of affected families between the ages of 18 and 60 are to be engaged in the renovation work pertaining to minor irrigation systems, canals and rural access roads, for a period of 8 - 12 days per month, subject to a maximum payment of Rs.6,000/- each, in their  respective areas. 

This programme will be monitored by a Presidential Task Force comprising of Secretaries to the relevant Ministries.

description: Financial Assistance from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) for the Implementation of Northern Road Connectivity Project (Additional Financing)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-11
decision_details_body: - the main objective of the above project, which was started in 2010 with ADB Loan funding, is to improve the road connectivity between the Northern Province and the other parts of the country.  About 170 Km. of National roads in the Northern and North Central Provinces and about 140 Km. of Provincial roads and selected bridges in the North Central Province are now being rehabilitated under this project.  The total estimated cost of the ongoing projects is US $173 million, of which US $154 million has been provided by the ADB while the government contribution is US $18.6 million.   An additional 80 Km. of national roads and 120 Km. of provincial roads have subsequently been identified for rehabilitation under this project.  Loan negotiations will be held with the Asian Development Bank to obtain additional financing of US $98 million (approximately Rs.11 billion) to meet the cost of the additional 200 Km. of the project.  The government contribution would be US $14.8 million.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to proceed with the work on arrangements of the ADB loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Setting up Migrant Resource Centres of Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment (SLBFE) on a District Basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-11
decision_details_body: - presently the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment has 07 regional centres and 25 district and other training centres.  These centres provide various services to persons to go abroad for employment purposes. With the view to providing better training facilities to migrant workers, it has been proposed to construct well designed Migrant Resource Centres with all necessary facilities, including residential training, particularly in District Capitals. A resource centre is presently under construction at Tangalle, with funds generated by the Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment, and is due to be completed by the end of July 2012. Another Resource Centre with hostel facilities for 200 females is to be constructed at Ratnapura at a total cost of Rs.274 million. The Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment will make arrangements to utilize vacant Government buildings to provide these training facilities to migrant workers in other District Capitals, in association with the Vocational Training Institutes of the Government.  The above proposal made by Hon. Dilan Perera, Minister of Foreign Employment Promotion and Welfare, was approved by the Cabinet.
