The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, to award the contract at the negotiated contract price of Rs.3,915,946,330.81 was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of National Highways with Concrete Surfacing through Domestic Contractors - Rehabilitation and Upgrading of sections from 0 to 8.40 km and 19.00 to 33.50 km on Naula-Elahera-Laggala-Pallegama-Hettipola Road (B312)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-04
decision_details_body: - the above road is one of the roads approved for rehabilitation under the above programme. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, to award the contract at the negotiated contract price of Rs.2,053,529,400.33, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Building to House the Faculty of Engineering of General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-04
decision_details_body: - the faculty of Engineering of this University comprises of six (06) Departments. With the conflict situation in the country being over, this University has now opened it doors to civilian students as well. In 2012 the Faculty of Engineering enrolled its first batch of fee levying civilian students. The Faculty has also engaged in offering degrees to foreign students of the SAARC Region, and is now open for all friendly countries, on a fee levying basis. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to construct a six storied building complex for this Faculty, at an estimated cost of Rs.500 million and to commence project in the year 2013 to be completed in 2015 with funds provided under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework, was approved by the Cabinet. It was noted that the anticipated income of the Faculty per year will be Rs.137 million from 2015 onwards.

description: Construction of a Telecommunications Media Centre by the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka at Hambantota IT Park
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-04
decision_details_body: - the site earmarked for this project is within the proposed IT Park at Meegahajandura, Sooriyawewa which is owned by the Forest Department. The site possesses high potential for development as it is located adjacent to the Sooriyawewa International Sports City and is close to the Mattala International Airport. The proposal made by H.E. the President to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Constituting the Sri Lanka Television Training Institute as a State - Owned  Limited Liability Company
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-04
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that this institution could be utilized to produce professional journalists with knowledge, experience and practical skills, not only in the field of television, but also in the field of Mass Media in general. The present television training is to be further expanded so as to develop the institution as a Media Training Institute which covers the entire mass media. The proposal made by Hon. Keheliya Rambukwella, Minister of Mass Media and Information, to establish this institution as a State Owned Limited Liability Company under the name ?Sri Lanka Media Training Institute?, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project on Ambient Air Quality Monitoring in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-04
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that with the increasing vehicle fleet and industrial and commercial activities in the country, pollutant emissions to the ambient atmosphere is increasing. As the main regulating agency responsible for environmental protection and management, the Central Environment Authority is responsible for monitoring data on ambient air quality throughout the country. The above project includes the identification of monitoring locations suitable for monitoring network, purchasing four ambient air quality monitoring stations, installation of monitoring instruments in identified locations etc. The proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, Minister of Environment, to implement the above project at a cost of Rs.120 million, with funds already provided through the Budget 2012, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations with Fifteen (15) African Countries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-04
decision_details_body:
- the proposal made by Hon.(Prof.) G. L. Peiris, Minister of  External Affairs, for the establishment of Diplomatic Relations with the following 15 African countries, was approved by the Cabinet:

*     Islamic Republic of Mauritania
*     Republic of Malawi
*	Burkina Faso 
*     Republic of Chad 
*	Republic of Djibouti
*     Central African Republic
*	Gabonese Republic
*     Republic of Cameroon
*	Republic of Cote d'lvoire
*     Republic of Equatorial Guinea
*	Republic of Gambia
*     Republic of Cape Verde
*	Republic of Sierra Leone
*     Togolese Republic
*	Republic of Niger

description: Allocation of the land in extent of 05 acres owned by the Coconut Research Institute to the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-04
decision_details_body: ? the joint proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education and Hon. A.P. Jagath Pushpakumara, Minister of Coconut Development and Janatha Estate Development, to allocate 05 acres of land from the Makandura Research Centre, belonging to the Coconut Research Institute, to the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka, for the purpose of constructing the required buildings needed for the expansion of the University, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Dengue Surveillance Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-04
decision_details_body: - Cabinet of Ministers took note of the situation report submitted by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, according to which, Colombo, Gampaha, Kalutara, Kandy, Kurunegala, Batticaloa, Matara, Kegalle, Puttalam and Ratnapura Districts are considered as high risk Districts. A total number of 11,227 cases has been reported with a total of 30 deaths and over 50% of the patients has been from the Western Province.

description: Management  of  Funds for Purchasing of Paddy of the Maha Season 2011/2012
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-04
decision_details_body: - H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, informed the Members of the Cabinet that due to the increase in the production of paddy, particularly in the Districts of Vavuniya, Polonnaruwa, and Mullaitivu, more funds had to be provided to the District Secretaries for the purchase of paddy. Paddy production in the Maha Season 2011/2012 has increased by 33% and the approved amount of advance allocated to the District Secretaries, which was Rs.1015 million in the previous year, has now increased up to Rs.1340 million. Cabinet approval was granted for the increased amounts released to the District Secretaries.

description: Allocation of land at Ratnapura New Town, to the Lions Vision for Sight Hospital Trust, Ratnapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-04
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to lease out a block of land to the ?Lions Vision for Sight Hospital Trust?, Ratnapura, was approved by the Cabinet.  Funds for the construction of the hospital building are to be provided by the International Lions Club of  Finland and on completion, it will be a fully equipped Eye Hospital with 50 beds.

description: Allocation of a block of land at Madiwela to the Parliament of Sri Lanka for the construction of an Administrative Office Complex
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-04
decision_details_body: ? the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to allocate a block of land at Madiwela belonging to the Urban Development Authority (UDA) to the Sri Lanka Parliament, for the construction of an administrative office complex to house the offices which are not directly connected to its legislative and related matters, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of land at Hikkaduwa to the Samurdhi Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-04
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to lease out a block of land at Hikkaduwa, belonging to the Urban Development Authority (UDA),  to the Hikkaduwa Samurdhi Bank on a  30 year lease, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Recommendations of the Finance Commission for the Financial Year 2012
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-07-04
decision_details_body: - H.E. the President submitted to the Cabinet, recommendations of the Finance Commission, on the apportionment of funds to Provinces allocated by the Annual Budget.  Cabinet approval was granted to give effect to the said recommendations and to present them in Parliament for approval.

description: Construction of an Extension to the Building of the Ministry of Higher	Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-27
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher	Education, to construct an extension to the existing  building of the Ministry of	Higher Education, on the recommendation of the Department of National Planning, 	with the view to providing more accommodation to the Ministry office as well as	the University Grants Commission, was approved by the Cabinet. Initial	construction	work of the project is to be commenced in 2012, utilizing funds	allocated to the Ministry for the year 2012.

description: Building complex for the Faculty of Management Studies, Rajarata University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-27
decision_details_body: -  the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to award the contract for the construction of the above, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee,at a cost of Rs.156,805,633.50, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of five storied building stage II for the Post Graduate Institute of Management (PIM), University of Sri Jayawardenapura
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-27
decision_details_body: - this is one of the leading institutes for Management Education in the University System of Sri Lanka which provides study courses and training in Management.  With the view to meet the emerging needs of the nation, it has been found necessary to expand the facilities available in this Institute.  Stage I of the project has already been completed.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to construct the five storied building as Stage II of the project at a total cost of Rs.171 million, with funds generated by the Institute, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Economic Development Co-operation Fund - Improvements to Padeniya - Anuradhapura Road (80.75 Km) - variations to civil works contract and the Consultancy Services Contract
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-27
decision_details_body: - the government has obtained a loan of US$55.0 million from the Export - Import Bank of Korea towards the cost of improvements to the above road. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to revise the contract prices of civil works and consultancy services, on the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, due to the changes in the scope of work, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of National Highways with Concrete Surfacing through Domestic Contractors - Rehabilitation  of an Additional List of 328.77 Km Roads
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-27
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President,in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, for the rehabilitation of additional roads with a total length of 328.77Km., under the above programme, through local contractors, by obtaining the necessary funds from the local Banks, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Hambantota Port Development Project - Commencement of Business Ventures
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-27
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the contract for Warehousing Facilities to three bidders, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee, and to lease out the relevant land lots for operation of Warehouses, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Nomination of ancient places of worship, Buddhist Temples, Hindu Kovils and Ports and Forts in the Northern and Eastern Provinces of Sri Lanka as a cluster of World Heritage Sites
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-27
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Jagath Balasooriya, Minister of National Heritage, to forward a proposal to the World Heritage Centre of UNESCO, was considered by the Cabinet and it was decided that an Officials' Committee consisting of representatives of the relevant Institutions should be appointed to go into this matter and make recommendations to the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the combined development work-plan to improve the housing programme in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Weli-Oya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-27
decision_details_body: - people living in the Grama Niladhari Divisions in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Weli-Oya were badly affected due to terrorist activities which prevailed in the region during the last three decades. The joint proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management; Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, and Hon. M.H. Gunaratne Weerakoon, Minister of Resettlement, to provide housing facilities to 500 families in the region with the assistance of the above three Ministries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Holding the International Conference titled "Environment Revolution" as a new Asian approach for the current environmental crisis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-27
decision_details_body: - it is envisaged that this conference will help to raise the image of Sri Lanka in the international arena and also assist in enhancing activities relating to tourism. It is expected that a total of 400 persons from other countries would participate in this Conference, as Representatives, Resource Persons and Observers.  The cost of the Conference is approximately Rs.25 million, of which Rs.10 million will be borne by international participants. The proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, Minister of Environment, to proceed with matters in connection with the holding of this Conference in Sri Lanka in 2012, for this year, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Learning and Training Campus for the Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration (SLIDA), in an outstation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-27
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs for the construction of a new building for this institute which provides intensive training facilities to Public Officers was approved in principle. A detailed feasibility study will be made on this proposal, after which, funds will be provided to proceed with the project.

description: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations with the Republic of San Marino
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-27
decision_details_body: -  San Marino is an Independent State near Central Italy and is one of the wealthiest countries in Europe. It is a leading banking and financial centre and a popular tourist destination. There is potential for Sri Lanka to promote tourism and to export  apparel and ceramic ware to San Marino.  The Government of the Republic of San Marino has expressed its wish to establish Diplomatic Relations with Sri Lanka in order to enhance the friendship and cooperation between the two countries. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Neomal Perera, Acting Minister of External Affairs, to establish Diplomatic Relations between Sri Lanka and San Marino, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulation of a  Programme to Achieve Energy Security
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-27
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is highly dependent on imported petroleum products to meet its energy requirements.  As a result of  rising oil prices in the world market as well as the local demand for petroleum product, Sri Lanka's oil bill  during the recent years shows a substantial increase.  To address this issue and to assess the country's energy situation and also to formulate a programme to achieve immediate, medium and long term energy security, Cabinet of Ministers granted approval to the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, Minister of Petroleum Industries, to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee, to be assisted by an Inter-ministerial Senior Officials' Committee consisting of representatives of the relevant Institutions to make early recommendations to the Cabinet in this regard.

description: Supplying of Locally produced Maize for Thriposha Programme - 2012
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-27
decision_details_body:
- a quantity of 15,000 MT of locally produced Maize is required annually for the manufacture of Thriposha. On the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, for the purchase maize for the manufacture of Thriposha, Cabinet of Ministers granted approval for the purchase of the annual requirement of maize from the identified Farmer Organizations and the suppliers who have been recommended by the Regional Development Bank, at the rate of Rs.42/- to Rs.45/- per kg. 

	Cabinet also decided that an Action Plan should be formulated jointly by the Ministry of Finance and Planning, Ministry of Economic Development, Ministry of Health, Ministry of Industry and Commerce, Ministry of Agriculture and the Thriposha Institute, to enhance the production capacity of the Thriposha Institute and increase the domestic production of the basic raw materials such as soya beans and maize so that excess quantities of Thriposha could be supplied to the export market.

description: Providing relief to the families affected by the acquisition of property for the Construction of the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project (UMODP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-27
decision_details_body: - this project is being implemented with funds provided by the Islamic Republic of Iran. Four new reservoirs are to be constructed under this project and the capacity of Handapanagala Tank will also be increased. In addition, the existing irrigation systems and the infrastructure will be improved, including installation of 120 MW Hydro Power Plant with a 23 Km. long tunnel and an Underground Power Station. Water released after the generation of power is to be utilized for agriculture and other needs of the people of Wellassa and Ruhuna. The proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, to appoint Valuation and Appeal Committees to determine the amount of compensation payable for the land acquired for the project, and to provide extents of land from nearby areas for the people who are affected due to the implementation of the above project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: "Memorandum Of Understanding (MOU) between Lakshman Kadirgamar Institute for International Relations & Strategic Studies (LKIIRSS) of Sri Lanka and Raul Roa Garcia Institute of International Relations (ISRI) of Cuba"
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-13
decision_details_body: - the objective of the MOU is to develop academic cooperation through joint research and exchange of information between the above two institutions in Sri Lanka and Cuba, respectively. The proposal made by Hon. D.E.W. Gunasekara, Acting Minister of External Affairs, to sign the above MOU during the visit of H.E. the President of Sri Lanka to Cuba shortly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Consultations and Co-operation between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Hungary and the Ministry of External Affairs of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-13
decision_details_body: - the objective of the proposed Memorandum of Understanding is to further strengthened the close relations between Sri Lanka and Hungary, by reviewing at an annual meeting, the political, economic, trade, financial, agricultural, consular, cultural, technological and scientific co-oporation and issues of mutual interests in the regional and international Arena.  The proposal made by Hon. Neomal Perera, Acting Minister of External Affairs, to sign the above MOU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of six storied Examination & Multipurpose Building Complex - University of Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-13
decision_details_body:
- the Proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to construct the above six storied building complex for the University of Colombo in two stages, as follows, was approved by the Cabinet:

*	Stage I  -  	Construction of the 1st two floors at a total cost of Rs.150 million, utilizing funds generated by the University and to complete the construction work within one year.

* 	Stage II  - 	Construction of the remaining floors at a total cost of Rs. 245 million, with funds obtained as a loan from the People's Bank and to complete  the  construction work within two years.

description: Proposed Memorandum of Understanding in the field of Labour and Training between the Government of the Sultanate of Oman and the Government of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-13
decision_details_body: - about 25,000 Sri Lankans are employed in the Sultanate of Oman at present, of which 55% are female workers. The proposed Memorandum of Understanding will be of immense benefit to Sri Lanka to protect the rights and ensure welfare of Sri Lankan migrant workers employed in Oman. The proposal made by Hon. Dilan Perera, Minister of Foreign Employment Promotion and Welfare, to sign the above Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of Oman, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading the Chest Hospital, Welisara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-13
decision_details_body: - This is the only Chest Hospital in Sri Lanka which caters to the patients throughout the country.  Due to the increase in respiratory diseases prevailing in the country and to provide better facilities to patients, the proposal made by  Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to  upgrade the Chest Hospital, Welisara, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Exposition of Sacred Kapilawasthu Relics
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-13
decision_details_body:
-  His Excellency the Prime Minister of India has agreed to a request made by His Excellency the President of Sri Lanka to send the Most Sacred Kapilawasthu Relics to Sri Lanka to provide an opportunity for Sri Lankan Buddhist devotees to pay homage during the period of commemoration of the Sambuddhathwa Jayanthi 2600.  Accordingly, the Ministry of Buddha Sasana and Religious Affairs together with the Presidential Secretariat, the Ministry of External Affairs and the High Commission of India have made arrangements for the exposition of the Sacred Relics from 20th August to 5th September 2012.  The exposition will be conducted at the following venues:

	*	Manelwattha Viharaya, Kelaniya		-  August  	20th - 22nd
	*	Sri Sumangala Pirivena, Wariyapola	-  August 	23rd,  24th
	*	Sri Sambuddhathwa Jayanthi Viharaya, 
			Anuradhapura.				- August 	25th,  26th
	*	Agrabodhi Viharaya, Kantale		- August 	27th,  28th
	*	Sambuddhathwa Jayanthi Viharaya, 
			Gampola					- August 	29th,  30th
	*	Rajamaha Viharaya, Pelmadulla		- August 	31st,  Sep. 01st
	*	Kotikagoda Rajamaha Viharaya, Matara	-  September	02nd - 04th

description: Seminar of Asian Productivity Organization in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-01
decision_details_body: - this Organization based in Japan gives assistance to its member countries to enhance the productivity in industrial and agricultural fields.  20 countries in the Asia -Pacific Region are members of this Organization and Sri Lanka too has signed the relevant Convention.  The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardane, Minister of Agriculture, to hold the above seminar on "Training Course on Organic Product Certification and Auditing" in Sri Lanka from 18th - 23rd June 2012, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of External Affairs of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Thailand on Bilateral Political Consultations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-01
decision_details_body: - this Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) will cover bilateral relations and cooperation of mutual interest between the two countries and will also provide a frame work for co-operation in the field of political, economic, trade, investment, cultural, technological and scientific co-operation between the two countries. The above proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Prison Relocation Programme -  Pallekelle
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-01
decision_details_body: - Bogambara Prison situated in the heart of Kandy town occupies an extent of 5.8 hectares of land.  With the view to releasing lands with commercial value for development activities of Kandy town and minimizing the congestion in the Prison, the Bogambara Prison is to be relocated at Pallekelle.  Stage I of the project has been completed at a cost of Rs.418 million. The proposal made by Hon. Chandrasiri Gajadeera, Minister of Rehabilitation and Prison Reforms, to proceed with the work relating to Stage II of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relocation of the Tangalle Prison to Eraminiyaya Angunakolapelessa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-01
decision_details_body: - the Tangalle Prison, too is to be relocated under the proposed programme for the relocation of Prisons which are situated in towns.  A block of land 58 acres in extent, situated in the Angunakolapelassa area, has been acquired for the purpose.  Plans have been prepared by the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) for the construction of the Prison at the said location in two stages and Stage I of the  project is estimated to cost Rs.357.84 million. The proposal made by Hon. Chandrasiri  Gajadeera, Minister of  Rehabilitation and Prison Reforms, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: ADB Loan No.2733-SRI: Sustainable Power Sector Support Project II Transmission System Strengthening
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-01
decision_details_body:
- Asian Development Bank (ADB) has agreed to provide funding assistance to implement six (06) Power Sector Project for the Power and Energy Sector. Eastern (North and East) Transmission Development Project is one of the six projects consisting of the  following:  
 
*	Construction of 132/33 KV Grid Substations at Polonnaruwa,
	Vavunativu and Monaragala; and,
*	Construction of Rantabe - Mahiyangana - Vavunativu 132 KV Transmission Line and second circuit stringing of Kotmale - New Anuradhapura 220 KV Transmission Line.    

	The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy, to award the above tender as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for Piling Work for Proposed Eight Storied Epilepsy Unit at National Hospital Sri Lanka under Saudi Fund
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-01
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the above tender, financed under the Saudi Fund, to the  lowest responsive bidder as recommended by the Standing  Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee for a total cost of Rs.91,373,499.12, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Forty Six (46) Bridges on National Highways with Financial Assistance from the Government of France
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-01
decision_details_body: - the Government of France is to provide a loan of Euro 22,021,702.00 for the construction of 46 bridges on the national highways. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways,on the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), to award the above contract to a company in France, for a sum of Euro 22,021,702.00, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Bilateral Air Services Consultations between Sri Lanka and Japan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-01
decision_details_body: - consultations between the Aeronautical Authorities of Japan and Sri Lanka  have been held in Tokyo and it has been agreed to allow daily flights between Narita Airport and Sri Lanka with immediate effect and in addition, from Summer of 2013, designated Airlines of Sri Lanka will be able to operate unlimited flights to Narita Airport. The proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation, to implement the new route schedule through exchange of Diplomatic Notes, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Multi-purpose  HD  Cinema   and   TV   Studio  for  the Mahinda Rajapaksa National Tele Cinema Park, Ranminitenna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-01
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Lakshman Yapa Abeywardhena,  Acting Minister of Mass Media and Information, to commence the initial work of the Multi-purpose HD Studio at Mahinda Rajapaksa National Tele Cinema Park, Ranminitenna, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between Sri Lanka and Seychelles for Co-operation in Fisheries Activities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-01
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to sign a fresh Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Seychelles, during the proposed visit by H.E. the President of Seychelles to Sri Lanka, in order to  intensify the economic, scientific and technical co-operation in the field of fisheries between the two countries,was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a subsidiary company fully owned by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board named ?Lanka Water Services (Pvt) Ltd.?, to provide bottled drinking water
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-01
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that non-availability of safe drinking water in certain areas of the country such as the North Central Province, has resulted in the spread of Chronic Kidney Disease. A pilot project to provide water only for drinking and cooking purposes in the form of bulk bottled water to a few selected villages in the affected areas of Anuradhapura has already commenced and is found to be successful. The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage to establish a subsidiary company fully owned by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board to carry out the production and distribution of bottled/containerized safe drinking water targeting the affected areas, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Project for improvement of Basic Social Services in Developing Regions (JICA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-01
decision_details_body:
- the objective of this project is to enhance non-communicable diseases management through improvement of facilities in secondary level hospitals and drug security.  The project consists of three components which are as follows:

			* 	Strengthening of State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing  				Corporation.
*		Strengthening of Secondary Hospitals - four Base Hospitals, namely, Teldeniya in the Central Province, Galgamuwa in the North Western Province, Kalawanchikudy in the Eastern Province; and Warakapola in the Sabaragamuwa Province have been selected for the purpose.     
*		Provision of Ambulances - 124 Ambulances are to be provided for the 7 developing regions, other than the Southern and Western Provinces.

		The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to implement this project with financial assistance from Japan International Co-operation Agency (JICA) at a total cost of Japanese Yen 4760 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial provisions for construction work at Rajopavanarama temple, Getambe in conjunction with the 68th Upasampada Ceremony of the Sri Lanka Ramanna Nikaya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-01
decision_details_body: - arrangements have been made to conduct the 68th Upasampada Ceremony of the Sri Lanka Ramanna Nikaya from 2012?07?23 to 2012?08?01 at Rajopavanarama temple, Getambe. The proposal made by Hon. M.K.A.D.S. Gunawardena, Acting Minister of Buddha Sasana and Religious Affairs, to complete the remaining construction work of the temple before the commencement of the above ceremony of the Sri Lanka  Ramanna Nikaya, with funds available with the Ministry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Obtaining a loan facility for the construction of a building for the Institute of Post Graduate Studies of the Sir John Kotelawala Defence University
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-06-01
decision_details_body: - M.Sc. and B.Sc. degree programmes and many Diploma and Certificate Courses are being conducted by the Institute of Postgraduate Studies of the General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University, facilitating serving officers of the Armed Forces and the Police and Non-Commissioned officers of the Forces, to obtain higher educational qualifications. With the view to meeting the present demand and future requirements, the government has acquired a block of land in the vicinity of this University to construct a six storied building complex with all facilities, which includes lecture halls, tutorial rooms, a library, and auditorium and office rooms. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, was approved by the  Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of Dutugamunu Pilgrims Rest at Lumbini in Nepal
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-23
decision_details_body: - this Pilgrims Rest has been established for the benefit of the Sri Lankan Pilgrims visiting Nepal. The proposal made by the Acting Minister of Buddha Sasana and Religious Affairs, to attend to the renovation work of this building at a total cost of Rs.65 million and the work to be commenced with an initial allocation of Rs.20 million, so that the pilgrims from Sri Lanka visiting Lumbini could be provided accommodation facilities, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Widening and Reconstruction of Matara-Hakmana Road from 0 to 24.14 Km.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-23
decision_details_body: - the Section of the road 0 to 2.0 Km. will be constructed to have a duel carriage way having four traffic lanes and the section from 2.0 km. 24.14 km. will have two lane carriageway. The work will be carried out by domestic contractors under total  cost of the project amounting to Rs.1,977,376,618.75 will be provided by local Banks.

description: Improvement and Rehabilitation of Maha Oya - Aralaganwila Road (24 Km.)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-23
decision_details_body: - this road having a length of 24 Km., connects Ampara and Polonnaruwa Districts and provides access to the Maduru Oya Reservoir. The distance of travel from Ampara to Polonnaruwa along this road is around 60 Km. shorter than the other route which runs through Mahiyangana.  Improvement and rehabilitation of this road will help to improve Agriculture, Fisheries and Tourism Industries in this region. The work is to be done through domestic contractors with funds to be provided from local Banks. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to proceed with the initial work of the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Official Language Policy - Public Service
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-23
decision_details_body: - having observed the difficulties experienced by employees in the Public Service in obtaining the required proficiency in the second language,  Cabinet approval was granted to offer a final concessionary period of another two (02) years for officers recruited to the Public Service during the period from 01?07?2007 to 30?06?2010, to obtain the prescribed level of language proficiency and to amend the relevant Section of the Public Administration Circular No.07/2007 accordingly.  Cabinet also decided to appoint an Officials' Committee under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Cabinet of Ministers, to examine the matter of conducting an examination in the second language, to suit the duties and responsibilities of the Minor, Subordinate and Executive Grades in the Public Service and formulate a scheme/modality for same.

description: Procurement of a Full Dome Projector System for Sri Lanka Planetarium
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-23
decision_details_body: -  with the view to increasing the facilities at the Planetarium for the viewers, majority of whom are school children, the proposal made by Hon. Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Technology and Research, to award the contract for the supply and installation of a Full Dome Project System, on the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, at a cost of US$ 1,187,317 and LKR 19,559,883, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: ADB Loan No.2733-SRI : Sustainable Power Sector Support Project II Transmission System Strengthening Tender for the Construction of New Galle 3X31.5MVA 132kV / 33kV Grid Substation (Lot A1 - New Galle Power Transmission Development Project)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-23
decision_details_body:
- this is a project funded by the Asian Development Bank (ADB). Part I of the Project is Transmission System Strengthening and it consists of the following two projects:

		(a)	New Galle Power Transmission Development Project; and,
		(b)	North East Power Transmission Development Project.   


	the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy, to authorize the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) to award the tender for the construction of New Galle 3x31.5 MVA 132 kV/33 kV Grid Substation under the New Galle Power Transmission Development Project, to ABB Ltd., India, on the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulation of Regulations to watch Marine mammals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-23
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that the tourism industry is developing rapidly due to the peaceful environment established in the country at present and watching Marine mammals including whales is also increasing.  It has therefore become highly essential to formulate regulations to handle mammal watching activities in a regular manner with proper management.  The regulations to be framed are intended to ensure the peaceful and natural existence of all sea mammals whose natural habitat is within the territorial waters of Sri Lanka; and assist the regulation and control of vessels used by visitors for the purpose of observing such sea mammals. The proposal made by Hon. S.M. Chandrasena, Minister of Agrarian Services and Wildlife, to publish the regulations prepared by the Legal Draftsman, in the Government Gazette and to present those thereafter in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of the South Asian Centre for Teacher Development (SACTAD) in Sri Lanka as a Category - 2 Centre under the auspices of UNESCO
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-23

description: Amendment of the Notaries Ordinance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-23
decision_details_body: ? the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs,  to amend the Notaries Ordinance pertaining to regulations on attesting of documents by Notaries and fines to be imposed for offenses committed by Notaries and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare amending legislation for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading the existing Waste Water Treatment Plant at National Cancer Institute Maharagama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-23
decision_details_body: - this institute provides treatment for around 10,000 new patients and follow up treatment to above 30,000 patients annually. It has been observed that the waste disposal system in the hospital has to be improved for the benefit of patients, hospital employees as well as the people living in close proximity to the hospital. The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the contract to upgrade the existing waste water treatment plant at the Cancer Hospital, Maharagama, at an estimated cost of Rs.236,868,438.00, to the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Upgrading the National Blood Transfusion Services (NBTS) of Sri Lanka with state of the Art Technology giving special emphasis to Northern and Eastern Provinces under the Netherlands Assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-23
decision_details_body:
- the National Blood Transfusion Service (NBTS) of Sri Lanka is the sole supplier of blood to all Government Hospitals and the majority of private sector hospitals in the country. Among the major benefits of the above will be -

	*	introduction of ultra high sensitive test methods to minimize the threat of transmission of blood born infections; and,
  
 *	frozen red cell facility to enable the preservation of rare blood types up to 10 years. With the existing facilities the maximum life for red blood cells is 42 days. The proposed frozen red cell facility would preserve the red cells up to a period of 10 years. 

The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, on the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), to accept the project proposal submitted by a company in Netherlands to upgrade the blood transfusion services at a cost of US $ 32,634,979.58, to provide domestic funds in 2013 for local taxes etc. and to enter into relevant agreements, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transportation of Sand and issues relating thereto
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-16
decision_details_body: - it was brought to the notice of the Cabinet that transporting sand cause heavy traffic  congestion on main roads, particularly during peak hours as transportation of sand has been restricted for day time only.  Therefore, it was decided that such sand transportation need not be restricted to day time only, as permits for such transport are not needed at present.

description: Special Flood Mitigation Projects implemented by the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation (SLLR&DC)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-16
decision_details_body: - Several places in the Colombo Metropolitan Region are subjected to floods during heavy rains.  On the direction of the Ministry of Defence and Urban Development, the  SLLR&DC has initiated several urgent short term flood control measures to reduce the level of inundation in the region.  These include cleaning of existing canal system, dredging of flood retention areas, creating water retention lakes and controlling haphazard filling of low lying lands etc. The SLLR&DC has prepared a special flood control project programme for the year 2012 and the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to implement it utilizing the budgetary allocation of Rs.800 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Report and Accounts of Sri Lankan Airlines for the year 2011
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-16
decision_details_body:
- the Government has purchased 94.68% of the shareholding of Sri Lankan Airlines which was earlier held by Emirates Airline and the remaining 5.32% is held by the employees of Sri Lankan Airlines.  Some of the activities carried out by the Airline during the year and the review were -

*	expansion of our global route network to 51 destinations in 32 countries; 
 
*	re-launching of our domestic service, Sri Lankan Air Taxi; and

*	addition of one A 320 aircraft, one A340 wide body aircraft and one Twin Otter Floatplane.

	The Sri Lankan Airlines will shortly commission an Airbus A320 Full Flight Simulator Centre at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) in partnership with a company in Netherlands and the project is expected to make BIA a regional hub for pilot training.  The above Annual Report submitted by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratna, Minister of Civil Aviation, was approved for presentation in Parliament.

description: Construction of three storied building for the establishment of Professorial Units at the Teaching Hospital, Batticaloa for the Faculty of Health Care Sciences of Eastern University of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-16
decision_details_body: - the Eastern University of Sri Lanka functions as a National University for students of all communities in the Island and consists of five (05) Faculties established for Agriculture, Science, Arts and Culture, Commerce and Management and Health Care Sciences, including the Campus at Trincomalee and Swami Vipulananda Institute of Aesthetic Studies, Batticaloa. The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to construct a three storied building for the establishment of  professorial units at the Teaching Hospital, Batticaloa, for the Faculty of Healthcare Sciences of the Eastern University at a total cost of Rs.299 million, which includes costs for medical equipment and furniture as well, and to implement the project concurrently with the 'Dayata Kirula' National Development Programme, 2013, was approved by the Cabinet of Ministers.

description: Amendment of the Citizenship Act No.18 of 1948 and the Immigration and Emigration Act No.20 of 1948 with a view to formalizing the grant of Dual Citizenship and the Establishment of the "Overseas Sri Lankans" Scheme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-16
decision_details_body:
- the Government has decided to amend the above Act so as to make room for pre-examination to satisfy that a person applying for dual citizenship in Sri Lanka has fulfilled the requirements to make him eligible for such dual citizenship.  The main amendments to be made will touch on the following:

	*	to establish a new scheme called "Overseas Sri Lankans" with a view to affording facilities to persons who have terminated citizenship in Sri Lanka, and their under aged children to enter Sri Lanka and to stay in Sri Lanka; and

	*	to afford the opportunity of applying for dual citizenship to those who have registered under the above scheme, only after being subjected to a pre-examination after being placed in a state of probation for a period of 05 years.

The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to make necessary amendments to the above Act and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare amending legislation accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Term Contract between Ceylon Petroleum Corporation and Oman Trading International (OTI), Dubai for the purchase of Oman Export Blend Crude Oil for the period of one year from August 2012 to August 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by the Hon. Susil Premajayantha, Minister of Petroleum Industries to purchase a stock of Oman Export Blend Crude Oil from Oman, on the recommendations made by Special Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SSCAPC), for a period from August 2012 to August 2013, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Clean Energy & Access Improvement Project Part (I) - System Control Centre Modernization Project - Package A - National System Control Center and SCADA & Communication System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: - this project is funded by the Asian Development Bank (ADB). Part I of the project is System Control Centre Modernization. Package 'A' of the project is estimated to cost US $17.1 million (Rs.1,892,457,000.00). The proposal made by Hon Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy to adopt the Two Stage Bidding Procedure for this procurement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Japanese Human Resources Development Scholarship Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: - The Government of Japan has agreed to provide grant assistance in a sum of Japanese Yen 211 million (approximately Rs.340 million) to Sri Lanka for the above programme  to be implemented in 2012. The objective of this programme is to provide opportunities to Government Officials to follow post graduate studies in Japanese Universities in the fields of Public Policy and Public Finance, Public Administration, Regional Development etc. The candidates for this programme will be selected on a competitive selection process. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into a Grant Agreement with the Japan International Co-operation Agency (JICA) to obtain the above grant assistance, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a Building for the Library of Faculty of Engineering - University of  Ruhuna
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to construct a three storied building for the Library of the Faculty of Engineering of the University of  Ruhuna at a total cost of Rs.128.6 million, to commence this project in 2012 and complete construction work within three years, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Aircraft Refueling Facility at New Southern Airport at Mattala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Susil Premajayantha, Minister of Petroleum Industries, to authorize the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation, to award the contract for the construction of a Fuel Hydrant System outside the Apron Area and the Aviation Fuel Storage Tank Farm for a lump sum price of US $31,251,584.02, on the recommendations made by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the Supply of Sterile Surgical Gloves Latex, Confirming to BS (4005) 1996 for single use, size 7 - 9,300,000 pairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the above tender to the lowest responsive bidder, on the recommendations made by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), at a total cost of US $1,785,600.00 (LKR 196,365,287.10), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment  of a National Centre for Lighting Safety and appointment of an Interim Committee
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: - location of Sri Lanka is such that it is exposed to severe thunderstorms and intense lightning than many other countries in the world.  With the rapid development of the country, the use of delicate electrical and electronic equipment too has increased and these are vulnerable to both direct and indirect effects of lightning.  Many developed countries have taken steps to mitigate this vulnerability which has resulted in minimizing the damage caused to lives and properties. The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, Minister of Disaster Management to establish a National Centre for Lighting Safety, under the Department of Meteorology with an Interim Committee of Officials headed by the Director General of Meteorology to manage the Centre, until such time proper legislation is framed for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing agricultural equipments received under 2KR Japanese Grant 2010 to farmers at concessionary rates to promote local food production
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: - the Government of Japan has made available to the Ministry of Agriculture, a consignment of agricultural equipment worth JY 360 million in 2012 which includes 50 Nos. 04 Wheel Tractors and 896 Nos. 02 Wheel Tractors.  On a  proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, the Cabinet decided to provide such agricultural equipment on concessionary terms to the farmer organizations; and farmers who excel in the field of agriculture, selected through a transparent procedure where the use of organic fertilizer and the achievements made under the Divineguma Programme are measured.

description: Providing Uniform material to school children for the academic year 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to import 50% of the total quantity of School Uniform material for the year 2013 through the Sri Lanka State Trading (Miscellaneous) Corporation, following the competitive bidding procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Printing of School Textbooks for free distribution for 2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: -  the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to entrust the printing of School Textbooks to the State Printing Corporation and the Department of Government Printing and the balance, if any, through open competitive bidding, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 23. Memorandum of Understanding between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan and the Ministry of External Affairs of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: - the objective of the proposed Memorandum of Understanding is to further strengthen and consolidate the close relationship between Sri Lanka and Kazakhstan by reviewing at an annual meeting, the political, economic, trade, scientific and cultural cooperation as well as issues of mutual interests in the international arena. The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to sign the above Memorandum of Understanding during his proposed visit to the Republic of Kazakhstan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 19. Allocation of Blocks of Land from Regional Industrial Estates to set up Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: - there are 25 Industrial Estates established on District basis in the country and selection of industrialists for investment is being done following transparent procedure. The proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce for the allocation of 38 blocks of land to the selected industrialists, on the recommendations of the relevant authorities and on conditions stipulated, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 4th  Session of the Bangladesh - Sri Lanka Joint Commission on Economic Cooperation -7th to 8th March, 2012 in Dhaka, Bangladesh
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: ? Cabinet noted that several important decisions in the fields of trade, commerce and industry, agriculture, aquaculture, shipping industry, tourism, information and communication technology, education and fisheries sector, had been taken at this meeting to strengthen the cooperation between the two countries. The Sri Lanka delegation for the meeting had been led by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce.

description: Annual Blood Donation Programme - 2012
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: - the National Blood Donation Service makes a significant contribution to the Health Services in the country in the  provision of blood to needy patients in hospitals throughout the country. There are 82 branches of the Blood Bank located throughout the country with its main Centre at Narahenpita. The calendar drawn up to facilitate blood donation programmes to be carried out effectively from the year 2012 onwards, for Ministries, Departments and other State Institutions, submitted by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Action Plan for implementation of National Policy on Maternal and Child Health
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to implement the National Policy on Maternal and Child Health, prepared in consultation with the relevant stakeholders, to enable policy guidelines and directions to be given to the Provincial Authorities for effective implementation of the programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amending the Defence Services Command and Staff College Act No. 5 of 2008
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-09
decision_details_body: - this college is the only educational institution which provides training facilities to the Middle Level Officers of the three Armed Forces. With the view to providing better and enhanced educational facilities to the trainees, this institution has been affiliated to the General Sir John Kotalawala Defence University from the year 2012. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to make necessary arrangements in the above Act and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft amending legislation for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Report and Accounts of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka for the year  2011
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-03
decision_details_body: - according to the above Annual Report, the Gross Domestic Production of Sri Lanka has reported a growth of 8.3%. The per capita income of the year 2010 which was US $2400 has increased up to US $2836 during the year. The above Report submitted by H.E. the President, in his capacity of the Minister of Finance and Planning, was approved to be presented in Parliament.

description: Hambantota Port Development Project (Phase II)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-03
decision_details_body: - construction work of Phase I of the project is nearing completion.  Under Phase I, two multipurpose berths and 1 oil berth were constructed along with basic port infrastructures.  Industrial operations, general cargo handling and bunkering operations can be undertaken with these facilities.  Phase II of the project includes construction of four container berths, one oil berth, two multipurpose berths, naval berths and other infrastructures.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee and a Project Committee to evaluate detailed implementation arrangements of the project and submit them to the Cabinet for consideration, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Proposal to amend the High Court of the Provinces Act No. 10 of 1996
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, to increase the  monetary value of actions that will be heard by the Commercial High Court  from its present value of Rs. 3 million which was introduced nearly 16 years ago, to Rs.5 million and to make such increase to be effective from 31st May 2012, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Transmission System Strengthening - New Galle Transmission Development Project Lot B - Construction of 40 km 132 kv Double Circuit Transmission Line from Ambalangoda Grid Substation to New Galle Grid Substation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy, to award the above tender, on the recommendation of the Cabinet appointed Procurement Committee, for a total cost of US$ 5,218,790.65 and LKR 607,226,805.00, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Collection and sale of Liquid Milk
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-03
decision_details_body: - issues pertaining to the matter due to the increase in the production of liquid milk were brought to the notice of the Cabinet and after discussion it was agreed that liquid milk collected by farmer organizations from dairy farmers in various parts of the country, will be purchased by MILCO Limited to be sent to its factories for the manufacture of powered milk and milk products. With the view to safeguarding the interests of dairy farmers, Cabinet of Ministers also decided to increase the import duty on imported milk powder, other than infant milk,  with immediate effect.

description: Construction of the Hostel Building at the Kaathankudi Central College, Batticaloa
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-03
decision_details_body: - this Central College is a National School with a student population of about 2500.  Students from both Batticaloa and Ampara Districts use the school hostel.  The proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to call for open competitive bidding from construction contractors in the Eastern Province, treating it as a project under the 2013 Deyata Kirula Programme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Selection of "Financial Service Provider" for the "Rural Household Connection" Project, under the ADB Loan: L2519-SRI - Clean Energy Access Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-03
decision_details_body:
- this project is to facilitate electricity access to poor households, initially in three Districts, namely, Hambantota, Ratnapura and Ampara.  The proposed Rural Household Connection Project with a project funding of US $3.5 million from the Asian Development Bank, intends to operate on the following objectives:

	*	improve operational and financial efficiency in rural electrification in the country;

	*	expand coverage of rural electrification; and

	*	establish a loan - funded credit support programme to provide electricity to poor households, including those living in areas affected by the conflict.

The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy, to authorize the CEB, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, to accept the Bid of SANASA Development Bank to operate as the Financial Service Provider for this project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Tender for the Supply of 5,000,000 Vials of Cefuroxime Sodium for Injection BP 750mg
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the above tender for a total cost of US $1,285,000.00 (LKR 140,825,000.00), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of National Highways with Concrete Surfacing through Domestic Contractors - rehabilitation of Bibile - Pitakumbura - Namaloya - Inginiyagala Road from 0 to 60.310 km.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to increase the length of the road to be rehabilitated by 20.31 km. in order to accommodate the road section from Namaloya to Inginiyagala and to rehabilitate the road with asphalt concrete surfacing instead of cement concrete surfacing and to award the contract, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, for a contract sum of Rs.4,605,000,000.00, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of National Highways with Concrete Surfacing through Domestic Contractors - rehabilitation of the section of road from 5.00 to 16.28 km on Pannala - Kuliyapitiya road (B356) and Kuliyapitiya - Hettipola Road (B243) from 0 to 15.69 km.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-03
decision_details_body: - the above two roads are to be rehabilitated under the above programme.  the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the above contract, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee for a contract sum of Rs.1,995,000,000.00, on a loan to be provided by Bank of Ceylon, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of National Highways with Concrete Surfacing through Domestic Contractors - rehabilitation and improvement to Bangadeniya - Andigama - Anamaduwa Road from 0 to 38 km.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-03
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the above contract, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, for a contract sum of Rs.2,570,953,030.79, on a loan to be provided by Bank of Ceylon, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Old Kachcheri Building Located in Galle Fort
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-03
decision_details_body: - On a proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Jagath Balasooriya, Minister of National Heritage, to develop the Old Kachcheri Building which is over 300 years old, Cabinet of Ministers decided to conserve this building and to develop it in an appropriate manner for the preservation of its archaeological, cultural and architectural value and for the promotion of the tourism industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Trainees who are undergoing theoretical training on electrical work in Institutions under the purview of Ministry of Youth Affairs and Skills Development to be sent for apprentice training at the Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-05-03
decision_details_body: - considering the difficulties experienced by the Ceylon Electricity Board in recruiting trained electricians required for the CEB, a Committee of Officials from the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Skills Development and the Ministry of Power and Energy has examined this matter and made recommendations.  According to the recommendations, it is proposed to commence a course in electricity at selected Centres of the Vocational Training Institutions under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, as a pilot project.   G.C.E. (O./L.) qualified youth are to be taken in for this course which will be conducted in Sinhala and Tamil Medium.  Candidates who successfully complete the theoretical and practical training are to be recruited to the Ceylon Electricity Board.  The joint proposal made by Hon. description: Hosting of Global Symposium for Regulators  (GSR-12) & Global Industry Leaders Forum (GILF) of the International Telecommunication Union  - from 03rd to 05th October 2012

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-04-04

Air Carriers will also be able to achieve substantive operational savings through the use of electronically produced and simplified documents of carriage, especially in the cargo field. description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding for the Proposed Aviation Security Audit in Sri Lanka conducted by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-04-04
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka has become a Signatory State to the Convention on International Civil Aviation in 1948 and thereby it undertakes to implement in the country, the applicable international standards in respect of Civil Aviation Safety and Security. Through the implementation of such standards in the respective States, all 190 Signatory States to the Convention are expected to maintain uniformity in conducting global air transportation activities. Sri Lanka was audited by ICAO in November 2010 and it was found that the level of effective implementation of International Safety Standards in Sri Lanka has achieved a high percentage of 86.5% whereas the global average was 59.8%, thereby Sri Lanka was able to take the topmost position amongst the South Asian States and 4th position amongst 34 States in the Asia and Pacific Regions. The proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation, to sign a MOU between the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka and the ICAO to conduct this Aviation Security Audit in Sri Lanka in May 2012, with the concurrence of the Hon. Attorney General and the Ministry of External Affairs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Controlling the   Import   Export  and Production of Hydrochlorofluorocarbon (HCFCs) under the Montreal Protocol on Ozone Depleting Substances
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-28
decision_details_body: - the Ozone layer is situated 20-50 Km. above the earth's surface and acts as a protective shield and filters the harmful ultra-violet radiation coming from the sun.  When Ozone Depleting Substances are released to atmosphere they destroy the Ozone layer, which would lead to, increasing the risk of having skin cancers, eye cataracts etc.  as well as global climate change.  In keeping with the Montreal Protocol, Sri Lanka is obliged to completely phased out chlorofluorocarbon which is widely used in refrigeration and air conditioning. The proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharashana Yapa, Minister of Environment, to appoint an Officials' Committee to examine and submit recommendations to control the import/export and production of Hydrochlorofluorocarbon with effect from 01st January 2013, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Report of the Sri Lanka Samurdhi Authority for the year                               2008/2009
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-21
decision_details_body:
- Low income earners are the basic target group of the Samurdhi Programme and to provide opportunities for them to have a sustainable source of income and to make them stakeholders in the national production, a large number of  Agricultural Development Programmes have been implemented. Some of the main programmes are as follows:

  *	Local Food Promotion Project -  cultivation projects such as fruits,vegetables, yams, leafy vegetables, field crops an cereals were implemented. 

*	National Project for the enrichment of small scale plantation crop growers - attention was paid to the cultivation of cinnamon, in addition to tea, coconut and rubber. 

*	Project for the tilling of fallow paddy lands - this was inaugurated to encourage re-tilling of cultivable paddy lands. 

*	Supply of Solar Powered sprinkler water supply kits -  this was implemented in collaboration with the Department of Agriculture thorough a  concessionary line of credit granted by the Government of Australia to the Government of Sri Lanka. 

*	Home Garden Development Programme for Nutrition  Enhancement - this was implemented to make available the basic nutritional requirements of low income earners from their home gardens, enabling them to earn an extra income through the sale of surplus production. Under this programme, a sum of Rs.90 million had been spent for 72,073 home gardens. 

*	Post Harvesting Technology Project -  this was implemented mainly in the districts of Matale, Anuradhapura, Polonnaruwa and Vavuniya to enable Samurdhi Beneficiaries to obtain a higher price by storing the harvest of onions and releasing it to the market when the prices were on the rise. 

	  
	The above Annual Report submitted by Hon. Basil Rajapakse, Minister of Economic Development, was approved by the Cabinet to be presented in Parliament.
