description: Road Sector Assistance Project Funded by the World Bank - Rehabilitation and Improvements to the Ingiriya - Ratnapura Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-21
decision_details_body:
- the Government has received two separate loans for a total amount of US $198.1 million from the International Development Association (IDA) towards the cost of technical assistance and investment  in the Road Sector.  It has been found necessary to effect the following changes to the scope of work during the implementation of the contract:


*	increase the width of the carriage way from 5.0 m to 6.5 m.; and,

*	rehabilitation of additional 1.6 Km. of road in Ratnapura town. 

	The proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways to increase the contract price and also to use funds from the Consolidated Fund to pay the additional amount required over and above the amount approved by the World Bank to settle the increase in the contract price, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding reached between Sri Lanka and Qatar
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-21
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation, to exchange Diplomatic Notes between Sri Lanka and Qatar in order to confirm the Memorandum of Understanding agreed upon, related to Air Services between Qatar and Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Memorandum of Understanding signed between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-21
decision_details_body: - covering approval of the Cabinet of Ministers was granted for the above Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) which was signed on 11th February 2012 between Pakistan and Sri Lanka and submitted by  Hon. Dullas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development.  This MOU has been prepared with the aim of developing the long term cooperation between the two countries through the provision of competency standards, course curricula, teaching and assessment material, which were developed under the National Vocational Qualification Framework of Sri Lanka.

description: Touching Your Future' Competition on Skills & Innovations and Educational Exhibition - 2012
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-21
decision_details_body:
- the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Skills Development intends to hold a competition on skills and innovations and an Educational Exhibition under the above at the BMICH, Colombo, during the period from 6th to 8th November 2012, in collaboration with the Ministry of Technology and Research.  Three major activities have been identified under this programme:

*	skills competition - this is open for the students of both public and private sector vocational training providers which will be held at District and National levels in selected subject areas;

*	competition on selection of the best innovation in the Technical, Vocational Education and Training (TVET) sector in identified trade areas at National level; and

*	educational exhibition in the TVET sector.

The proposal made by Hon. Dullas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of National School of Business Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-21
decision_details_body: - the National School of Business Management has been incorporated to conduct Degree Courses under the supervision of the National Institute of Business Management.  A land with an extent of 25 acres has been allocated by the Urban Development Authority at a location in Udahena, Pitipana, Homagama for the construction of the proposed National School of Business Management.  The proposal made by Hon. Dullas Alahappperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Islamic Republic of Pakistan and Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on Mass Media
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-21
decision_details_body: - covering approval was granted for the above Memorandum of Understanding signed between Pakistan and Sri Lanka during the recent visit of H.E. the President of Sri Lanka, to Pakistan.

description: Import of chili and vegetable seeds by the government to increase chili production, control vegetable seed prices and to increase the quality of production
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-21
decision_details_body: - at present the country imports 80% of her requirement of 42,000 Mt. of dried chilies mainly from India at a cost of around Rs.5000 million.  It has been proposed to cultivate 7000 ha. of chilies in the coming Yala Season under the "Api Wawamu - Rata Nagamu" and "Divi Neguma" programmes.  The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to import 500 kg. of hybrid chili seeds and around 10% of selected varieties of vegetable seeds at a cost of Rs.50 million each for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: National Programme of Divi Naguma - 2012 Packeting and Supply of Seed Requirement for Home Gardening
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-21
decision_details_body: - the Ministry of Agriculture has been entrusted with the task of providing two million five hundred thousand packets of seeds to the Department of Agrarian Development, each containing ten varieties of vegetable seeds and the inaugural ceremony of this national programme is to be held Island wide on 2012?04?05. The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to proceed with the programme at a cost of Rs.178,255,000, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Re-laying of identified sections of Galle Distribution System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-21
decision_details_body: - the Galle Water Supply Scheme covers 50 Grama Niladhari Divisions within the Galle Municipal Council area through 18,235 domestic consumer connections and 2049 non-domestic consumer connections and the beneficiary population stands at 101,420 people.  It has been observed that the people living within the Galle Municipal Council area do not have alternative source to cover their daily water needs, except the pipe borne water supplied by the National Water Supply and Drainage Board.  Major consumers of pipe borne water in this area include Galle Harbour, Galle Teaching Hospital, the Navy Camp, the Army Camp etc.  The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to proceed with the above project with domestic funds at a total cost of Rs.341 million to be provided in 2013 and 2014, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Southern Transport Development Project (STDP) - Approval to assign development, operation and maintenance of rest areas to the Sri Lanka Insurance Resorts & SPAS Private Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-21
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to sign a Lease Agreement for the development, operation and maintenance of rest areas on the Southern Expressway which are located at Welipenna on the 44th Km. from Kottawa,  for a period of 99 years, with Sri Lanka Insurance Resorts & SPAS Private Limited which is a fully owned subsidiary of Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Limited, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Nano Science Park
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-21
decision_details_body: - NANCO (Pvt) Limited (now SLINTEC Pvt Limited) has been established with 77% government shares and the balance 23% by five industry partners under Public Private Partnership with the objective of engaging in activities relating to Nano Science Research and Promotion by establishing the Nano Science Park.  The Park is to be constructed on a 50 acre property at Mahenawatte, Pitipana, Homagama.  The construction of the Park will be in 3 stages and phase 1a is to cost Rs.695 million to be met with Government funds. The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Technology and Research, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishing a Wild Elephant Confinement Centre in order to Minimize damages caused by Wild Elephants
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-14
decision_details_body: - the joint proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, Minister of Environment; and Hon. S.M. Chandrasena, Minister of Agrarian Services and Wildlife, to utilize a land area of 1582 hectares in extent belonging to the Department of Forest Conservation in Horowupothana, covering the Northern and 	North Western Region for this purpose, so as to minimize human-elephant conflict, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Report and Final Accounts of the Sri Lanka Institute of Textile & Apparel for the year 2010
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-14
decision_details_body: - during the year under review textile and garment exports amounted to US$3504 million, accounting for nearly 42 percent of the country's export proceeds.  Sri Lanka apparel industry employees both directly and indirectly, nearly a half a million work force.  The industry has been able to make a significant impact in alleviating poverty in the country in general and rural areas in particular.  The above Annual Report and Final Accounts submitted by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce, was approved by the Cabinet to be presented in Parliament.

description: Annual Report and Accounts of the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Limited for the year  2010
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-14
decision_details_body: - the Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation had reported a 24.6 percent growth in life insurance premium during the year under review, increasing from Rs.4819 million in 2009 to Rs.6009 million in 2010.  The company had achieved a profit of Rs.15,130 million before tax and Rs.13,270 million after tax, during the year under review.  The Company has made a major investment in November, when it purchased the 100 percent shareholding of Shell Gas Terminal Lanka (Pvt) Ltd. and 51 percent shares of Shell Gas Lanka Ltd. to acquire the controlling interest and now operate as Litro Gas Terminal Lanka (Pvt) Ltd. and Litro Gas Lanka Ltd. respectively, engaged in importation, storage, filling and distribution of LP gas in Sri Lanka and enjoys a 72 percent market share.  The above Annual Report and Accounts submitted by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, was approved by the Cabinet to be presented in Parliament.

description: Construction of a new Conference Hall for District Secretariat Kandy
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-14
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home 	Affairs, to construct a new Conference Hall with modern facilities at the premises of the District Secretariat, Kandy, at a total cost of Rs.200 million was approved by the Cabinet.  Initial work of the project is to be commenced with the financial provision provided to the Ministry for the year 2012.

description: ADB Loan for 2011 - Sustainable Power Sector Support Project II - Part (i) Transmission System Strengthening - North East Power Transmission Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-14
decision_details_body: - Asian Development Bank has agreed to provide funding assistance to implement six power sector projects and Eastern (North & East) Transmission Development Project is one of the six projects.  The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champaka Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy to award the above contract, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee at a total cost of US $14,976,710.00 and LKR 711,236,759.00, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agence Francaise De Developpment (AFD) Funded Trincomalee Integrated Infrastructure Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-14
decision_details_body:
- the Government of Sri Lanka has received 2 credit facilities from AFD towards the cost of Trincomalee Integrated Infrastructure Project.  The scope of work under the above project includes the following :
*	National Highways
	 	Batticaloa -Tirikkondiadimadu - Trincomalee Road (A15) - 99 	km.
	   	Allai - Kantale Road (B10) - 41 km.
*	Provincial Roads
                                		 	Mavadichchenai - Kaddaiparichchan Road (12km.)
*      Major Bridges
			 	Ralkuli Bridge
			 	Upparu Bridge
			  	Gangei Bridge
		             	Kayenkerni Bridge
			  	Verugal Bridge


the proposal made by H.E. The President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, for the revision of the cost of the contract up to Rs.11,217,000,000.00, as recommended by the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, due to variations in the scope of the work, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of National Highways with concrete surfacing through domestic contractors -  Rehabilitation of Tennekumbura - Kandehandiya Road (20.4 km) and Kandehandiya - Randenigala Road (13.6 km)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-14
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted for the rehabilitation of 692.09 Km of Roads through domestic contractors by obtaining the required funds amounting to around US $500 million from Local Banks. The road section from Tennekumbura to Kandehandiya having a length of 20.40 Km. and  Kandehandiya - Randenigala Road (13.60 km) are two of the roads approved for rehabilitation under the above programme. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways to award the above contract, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, at the negotiated contract sum of Rs.2,647,635,497.07, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Handing over of the Vaishakya Girls? College, Wellawatte to St. Pauls Girls? College, Milagiriya for development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-14
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Bandula Gunawardena, Minister of Education, to hand over the Vaishakya Girls' College, Wellawatta which has been handed over by the Western Provincial Council to the Ministry of Education, to St. Pauls Girls' College, Milagiriya, for development of the school, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Increasing the Profitability of the Lunuwila and the Weerawila Fishnet Factories
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-14
decision_details_body: - the three Fishnet factories at Jaffna, Lunuwila and Weerawila of Northsea Ltd. produce 600 MT. of fishnet per annum and can meet the demand of 12,000 fishermen throughout the country.  The proposal made by Hon. Douglas Devananda, Minister of Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development, to increase the production capacity of Northsea Ltd. to 80% with funds amounting Rs.15 million to be obtained through a Bank loan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of Small and Medium Scale Poultry Farming System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-03-14

description: Memorandum of understanding between the Ministry of External Affairs of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia on Diplomatic Education and Training
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-29
decision_details_body: - Cabinet of Ministers granted approval for the above Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed between the Republic of Indonesia and Sri Lanka, developing and strengthening friendly relations and cooperation between the two countries.  The above MoU submitted by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs.

description: IT Literacy Development Project implemented by special funds of the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka (TRCSL) under the Special Programme for upliftment of the Rural Primary School System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-29
decision_details_body: - a programme has already been launched to upgrade 1000 selected Secondary Schools and 5000 Primary Schools, to uplift the school system in the country, under the "Mahinda Chinthana" .  In parallel to this programme, it is proposed to launch a three year special project aimed at providing IT educational facilities, Internet facilities as well as Educational Software and Teacher training to 5000 Primary Schools, including 1590 Small Rural Schools.  It has been observed that the IT literacy rate in the country which was 4% in 2004, has now improved to 38% over the past 06 years and it is intended to increase this percentage up to 75% by 2016.  The programme is to be launched targeting 01 Administrative District each month and in the first two months it will be launched in Badulla and Jaffna and thereafter, throughout the Island within the next 24 months.  The proposed activities include provision of Computers, Computer Accessories and Furniture to selected schools in each District, filtered Internet facilities through School Net, renovation of a suitable class room by the respective Provincial Councils etc.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchase of Prefabricated Buildings for Government Agencies from People's Republic of China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-29
decision_details_body: - construction of prefabricated buildings has been found effective in achieving time targets of development activities of the government, in that these could be constructed within a very short period of time.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, Minister of Irrigation and Water Resources Management, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, to authorize the Central Engineering Consultancy Bureau (CECB) to purchase prefabricated buildings for distribution among government agencies as needed by them, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of National Highways with Concrete Surfacing through Domestic Contractors - Rehabilitation of Kesbewa-Kindelpitiya - Bandaragama Road   (B216) from 0 to 11.78 Km and Waskaduwa - Bandaragama Road  (B458) from 0 to 12.07 Km
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-29
decision_details_body:
- the above sections of roads have been identified for rehabilitation by obtaining the required funds from local Banks and the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the contracts for the rehabilitation of the following roads, on the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet:

*	Kesbewa-Kindelpitiya-Bandaragama Road having a length of 11.78 km at the negotiated contract sum of Rs.1,029,906,963.14; and

*	Waskaduwa-Bandaragama Road having a length of 12.07 km at the negotiated contract sum of Rs.1,073,816,085.52.

description: Asian Development Bank Funded National Highways Sector Project - Approval for variation to the contract for the rehabilitation and upgrading of the Road Section from Puttalam to Nochchiyagama on Puttalam - Traincomalee Road (A12)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-29
decision_details_body:
- the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to include the following road sections having a total length of 13.5 Km, to the ongoing above contract and to revise the contract price accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet:

*	2.6 km in Puttalam Town on Puttalam - Trincomalee Road
*	6.5 km up to the Clock Tower in Anuradhapura Town on Puttalam - Trincomalee Road
*	1 km from Lion Pillar Junction up to Market Junction in Anuradhapura Town on Puttalam - Trincomalee Road
*	Section of road from 79.6 km to 83.0 km with a length of 3.40 km on Puttalam - Trincomalee Road

description: Purchase of paddy of Maha Season 2011/2012 and proposals for the export of excess paddy stocks
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-29

description: Bandaranaike International Airport Development Project - Phase 2 - Japan International Co-operation Agency (JICA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-29
decision_details_body: -  the Government of Japan has agreed to provide a loan of Japanese Yen 28,969 million (approximately Rs.40,557 million) through the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) for implementation of the above project.  The objective of this project is to improve and modernize the facilities of the Bandaranaike International Airport, so as to contribute towards the promotion of tourism as well as to the economic development of the country.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into a loan agreement for the purpose with JICA, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Habarana - Veyangoda Transmission Line Project - Japan International Co-operation Agency (JICA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-29
decision_details_body: - the Government of Japan has agreed to provide a loan of Japanese Yen 9573 million (approximately Rs.13,402 million) through the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) for the construction of the 220 KV Transmission Line from Habarana to Veyangoda.  The objective of the project is to improve the stability and reliability of the transmission system and to cater to the growing demand of electricity in the country.  The proposal made by H. E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into a loan agreement for the purpose with JICA, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Ohiya Water Supply Scheme -  Revision of the Cost Estimate (TCE)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-29
decision_details_body: - the project will provide drinking water to the people living in the Boralanda and Welimada townships and surrounding areas. The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to revise the total cost estimate of the project to Rs.264.73 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Augmentation of Mahiyangana Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-29
decision_details_body: - this Water Supply Scheme is fed with water from the Mahaveli river.  The Scheme at present provides water to the Mahiyangana town areas, the temple, hospital and surrounding areas. The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, to award the above contract to a company in Austria for a sum of Euro 10,404,953 to be provided in the form of a loan through a Bank in Austria with provision of Rs.1036 million from the General Treasury and to be implemented during 2012 - 2014, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Promotion of Organic Fertilizer Production & Application
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-29
decision_details_body: - in keeping with the Budget Proposals for 2012, the National Fertilizer Secretariat of  the Ministry of Agrarian Services and Wildlife has prepared a programme to establish village level organic fertilizer production units in Agrarian Services areas to produce and distribute organic fertilizer among farmers at comparatively low cost.  The joint proposal made by Hon. S.M. Chandrasena, Minister of Agrarian Services and Wildlife and Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardhana, Minister of Agriculture, to proceed with the project, which would, among other matters, establish 6000 village level organic fertilizer production units throughout the country and provide about 30,000 self-employment opportunities and also reduce the expenditure on chemical fertilizer, was approved by the Cabinet.   It was also observed that there are 221 registered organic fertilizer manufacturers and the annual production is around 57000 MT.

description: FAO - TEC Project - Development of Capacities for Early Diagnosis, Surveillance, Spread Prevention and Integrated Management of Weligama Coconut Leaf Wilt Disease
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-29
decision_details_body: - the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) has provided US $307,000 for the prevention of Coconut Leaf Wilt Disease prevailing in the Southern Province. The FAO has granted this assistance to review the entire management programme, to develop strategies for quick diagnosis of the disease, to device an integrated management programme for the purpose, create farmers' awareness through demonstrations in the affected Districts of Galle,  Matara and Hambantota and to initiate a resistance breeding programme. The proposal made by Hon. Jagath Pushpakumara, Minister of Coconut Development and Janatha Estate Development, to implement the project  through the Coconut Research Institute, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provision of Credit Facilities for Self Employment to the Trainees who have entered the Society on completion of the Rehabilitation Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-29
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Chandrasiri Gajadeera, Minister of Rehabilitation and Prison Reforms, to implement a loan scheme through a State Bank to provide a loan up to a maximum of Rs.250,000/- with a repayment period of ten years for self employment purposes, to 10,375 persons from the North and East who have successfully completed the rehabilitation programme conducted by the Commissioner General of Rehabilitation,, was approved by the Cabinet.  Credit facilities to persons of this category who wish to pursue vocational education will also be provided.

description: 36. Project for Rehabilitation of Kilinochchi Water Supply Scheme - Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-22
decision_details_body: 36. - the Government of Japan has agreed to provide grant assistance in a sum of Japanese Yen 677,000,000 million (Approximately Rs.982 million) through JICA for rehabilitation activities of the Kilinochchi Water Supply Scheme.  The main objective of the project is to reduce waterborne deceases and uplift the health standards of the people in the Kilinochchi District, by improving water purification facilities in the area and restoring operational activities of the existing water supply scheme in the District which was damaged during the conflict period.  Under this project, it is expected to construct a new water intake, a raw water transmission line from the intake, a water treatment plant and two water towers at Kilinochchi and Paranthan.  In addition, a distribution pipeline covering approximately 42 km. will be constructed to distribute water to Paranthan and Iranamadu, benefiting over 20,000 people living in 14 Grama Niladhari Divisions in the Kilinochchi District.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into a grant agreement with JICA, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: apan Grant Aid for Provision of Industrial Products - Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-22
decision_details_body:
- the Government of Japan has agreed to provide grant assistance in a sum of Japanese Yen 300 million (Approximately Rs.420 million) through JICA to procure Industrial Equipment produced in Japan, to promote economy and social development in Sri Lanka.  The grant assistance will be utilized for the procurement of the following:

	*	Medical Equipment - will be provided to Teaching Hospitals, Secondary Hospitals and Medical Research Institutes, to improve existing facilities.

	*	Water Purification Equipment - will  be used to provide safe drinking water to the people living in areas where there is a scarcity for water and areas affected by disasters.

*	Excavators - will be provided for provincial and rural road development activities.

		The above proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into a grant agreement with JICA, for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for Improvement of Japanese Language Learning Equipment of the University of Kelaniya and Sabaragamuwa University - Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-22
decision_details_body: - the Government of Japan has agreed to provide grant assistance in a sum of Japanese Yen 48,400,000 (Approximately Rs.70,180,000) through JICA, for the above purpose.  The main objective of the project is to develop essential infrastructure facilities at these Universities so as to produce professionally competent  graduates to cope with the emerging needs of the country.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into a grant agreement with JICA, for the above purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the Improvement of Basic Social Services in Developing Regions - Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-22
decision_details_body:
- the Japanese Government has agreed to provide a loan of Japanese Yen 3935 million (approximate Rs.5509 million) through JICA for the above purpose.  The following are to be implemented under this project:

	*	Expansion of the production capacity of the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation - four new manufacturing machines along with other processing machinery are to be installed to enhance the production of tablets up to 4000 million per annum to meet the requirement of the government.

	*	Strengthening of Secondary Hospitals and providing modern and quality care services -  selected secondary hospitals in the Central, Sabaragamuwa, North Western and North Central Province are to be upgraded with the required facilities to function as core hospitals in the region.  In addition, 124 Ambulances are to be provided to hospitals in the Central, Sabaragamuwa, North Western, North Central, Uva, Eastern and Northern Provinces.

		The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into a loan agreement for the purpose with JICA, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Financial Assistance for the Construction of Veyangoda Railway Crossing Flyover
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-22
decision_details_body: - Veyangoda is a major town in the Gampaha District and it provides access to the Katunayake International Airport and the Free Trade Zone.  The main railway lines to the upcountry as well as to the Northern and Eastern Provinces pass through Veyangoda.  Cabinet approval has already been granted for the construction of a flyover at Veyangoda, to overcome the traffic congestion due to the closing of rail gates at frequent intervals.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into loan agreements with a Bank in Spain for financial assistance for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction and Upgrading of Peripheral Blood Banks under Netherlands Assistance
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-22
decision_details_body: - the National Blood Transfusion Service provides blood to all government hospitals and the majority of private sector hospitals in the country.  It has 15 clusters and 60 hospital based blood banks. The proposed project aims to develop infrastructure facilities and provide urgently needed equipment for 19 peripheral centres and essential equipment for the blood banks in the country.  The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, on the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee, to award the above contract to a company in Netherlands at a cost of Euro 21,237,254.00, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Company under the Ministry of Livestock and Rural Community Development for the development of Poultry Sector
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-22
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Arumugan Thondaman, Minister of Livestock and Rural Community Development,  for the National Livestock Development Board (NLDB) to purchase 49% of the shares of  LANLIB which is a Joint Venture between a company in Libya and the NLDB, for the formation of a fully government owned company under the Ministry, named as Sri Lanka Poultry Development Company (Pvt.) Ltd., for the sole purpose of supporting the poultry industry in the country, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Recommendations of the Cabinet Sub-Committee and the Standing Procurement Planning Committee for Pharmaceuticals
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-22
decision_details_body:
- a Cabinet Sub-Committee consisting of the following Ministers have already been appointed by the Cabinet to make recommendations on the procurement and supply process relating to pharmaceuticals, so as to ensure a smooth supply of pharmaceuticals in adequate quantities to Government hospitals:  
			
				The Cabinet Sub-Committee
 
			*	Hon.(Prof.) Tissa Vitharana, 
				Minister (Senior) for Scientific Affairs;
			*	Hon. (Dr.) Sarath Amunugama,
				Minister (Senior) for International Monetary Co-operation;
			*	Hon. Maithripala Sirisena,
				Minister of Health; 
			*	Hon. Susil Premajayantha,
				Minister of Petroleum Industries; and,
			*	Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka,
				Minister of Power and Energy.

A Procurement Planning Committee consisting of 05 officials has also been appointed to assist this Sub-Committee. Cabinet of Ministers granted approval in principle to the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to implement the recommendations made by this Cabinet Sub-Committee. Arrangements are to be made for the distribution of drugs required by hospitals, through the network of 27 sales outlets in the country, belonging to the State Pharmaceuticals Corporation.

description: Annual Report of the National Council for Elders for the Year 2010
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-15
decision_details_body:
- the National Secretariat for Elders functioning under the Ministry of Social Services, has initiated the following programmes:

*	Elder Protection Voluntary Workers Programme - this is a programme  to train and employ persons for providing protection and nursing services needed for elders.  Under this programme, a systematic training is given to persons, on looking after and providing health services for elders.  After training, the services of these persons could be obtained for an 8 hour shift during the day time for a fee of Rs.600/-.  A proper certificate and an identity card are issued for those who have completed the training successfully.  This service is presently centred around the Western Province and is expected to be extended to other Provinces.

*	"Wedihiti Awarana Kepakaru" (Sponsorship) Scheme - under this Scheme any person can make financial contributions which will be paid to needy elders selected from AGA's Divisions and each elder is paid Rs.250/- per month, through the Divisional Secretariat.  An officer attached to the Divisional Secretariat by the National Secretariat for Elders will coordinate the activity of this programme.


*	Senior Citizens Pension Scheme -  the National Secretariat for Elders jointly with the Sri Lanka Social Security Board has launched this programme with effect from 2008.  Needy elders who are above 70 years of age and not getting any financial assistance from the government are selected at Divisional Secretariat level for this Scheme and priority is given to elders with disabilities and non-communicable deceases.



*	Maintenance Board for Elders -  the function of this Board is to assist needy elders over 60 years of age who wish to claim maintenance from their own children who have neglected them. Applications for same have been made available in Divisional Secretariat or Grama Niladhari Offices, by the National Secretariat for Elders.


The above Annual Report of  the National Council for Elders for the year 2010, submitted by Hon. Felix Perera, Minister of Social Services, was approved to be presented in Parliament.

description: Annual Report of the Sri Lanka Institute of Development Administration (SLIDA) for the Year 2010
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-15
decision_details_body: - during the year under review, apart from the normal training programmes conducted by SLIDA, a novel programme has been initiated with the view to develop capacities of officers of Class III of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service (SLAS).  The objective of the new programme was to enhance the knowledge, skills and attitudes of the young officers to render better service to the public, while taking the development initiatives of the government to the periphery.   Further, in collaboration with the Commonwealth Secretariat and with the assistance of the Singapore Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Administrative Staff College of India, a special leadership development programme for senior officers in the Public Service was also conducted by SLIDA.  The above Annual Report submitted by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, was approved  to be presented in Parliament.

description: Ambagasdowa Water Supply Scheme - Revision of the Cost Estimate (TCE)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-15
decision_details_body: - this project intends to provide safe drinking water to the people living in the Uva Paranagama Township and surrounding areas in the Badulla District.  The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to revise the total cost of the project up to Rs.382 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: MoU Entered into between the Ministry of Health and Samanala Valley Foundation and the Issuance of Free VISA
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-15
decision_details_body: - Samanala Valley Foundation is a duly incorporated INGO which works in collaboration with Vision 2020 which is the global initiative for the prevention of blindness, initiated by the World Health Organization and the International Agency for Prevention of Blindness. Sri Lanka is a signatory to this programme since the year 2000. The objective of Vision 2020 is to eliminate avoidable blindness from Sri Lanka by the year 2020. The project hospital is situated in a Tea Estate, where the estate community can get free medical expertise and free medicine from visiting teams of foreign and local doctors. The Ministry of Health has already entered into a MOU with Samanala Valley foundation to proceed with the activities of the project and the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health to obtain resident Visa facilities for the members of the Samanala Valley Foundation free of charge  and to gazette the MOU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Human Rights Action Plan of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-09
decision_details_body:
? this Action Plan  has already been approved by the Cabinet of Ministers for implementation, at its meeting held on 2011?09?07.  Cabinet of Ministers  having observed that most of the proposals embodies in the Action Plan have already been or are in the process of being implemented,   decided to appoint a Cabinet Sub-Committee consisting of the following to monitor the process of speedy implementation of the proposals in the Action Plan by the relevant Ministries and  authorized agencies:

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-09

description: US$ 200 million from the Government of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-09
decision_details_body: ? the Government of Pakistan has agreed to extend an Export Credit Facility of US$ 200 million through the State Bank of Pakistan. An amount of US$ 150 million is to be utilized for the construction of Housing Units for Shanty Dwellers in Colombo and suburbs and the balance US$ 50 million for the importation of livestock, plant and machinery from Pakistan. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into a loan agreement for the purpose with the Government of Pakistan, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of 792 Housing Units (02 Nos. 12 storied building blocks) at 	Salamulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-09
decision_details_body: - this is a Low Income Housing Project to be implemented by the Sri Lanka 	Land Reclamation and Development Corporation, at Vijaya Road, Salamulla, 	Kolonnawa, for the people living in shanties in the area. The housing complex consists 	of 3 blocks and the piling work of  block 'A' for the construction of 216 Housing Units, 	has already been completed. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as 	the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, on the recommendation of the 	Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, to award the contract for piling  	for the construction of 792 Housing Units in blocks 'B' and 'C' at a total cost of 	Rs.270,636,190.00, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Provisions of Relief Assistance to the affected Fishermen due to the Storm on 25th November 2011
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-09
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon.(Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to provide 5000 life saving jackets to selected needy fishermen in the coastal areas, in Galle and Matara Districts in particular, affected by the disaster, utilizing the Rs.40 million allocated for 2012, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of National Green Reporting System in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-09
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, Minister of Environment for the establishment of the National Green Reporting System in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet. The objective of its establishment is to facilitate the manufacturing and service sectors, to periodically measure and report their sustainability performance with regard to economic, environmental and social aspects, in order to continually improve their production processes and services, relationship with stakeholders and enhance their image, while contributing towards the sustainable development of the country.

description: Financial Assistance for Implementation of Metro Colombo Urban Development Project from the International Bank for Reconstruction & Development (IBRD) of World Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-01
decision_details_body: - loan negotiations are scheduled to be held in Mid February 2012, with the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRB) of the World Bank to obtain financial assistance in a sum of US $213 million for the implementation of the above project.  The objective of the project is to reduce adverse physical and socio-economic impact of flooding in the Colombo Metropolitan Area and to improve the overall capacity of land use and economic activities in the said area.  It is expected to commence project activities in April 2012 and to be completed within three (03) years.  The proposal made by Hon. H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to conduct negotiations with IBRB of the World Bank and to enter into a financial agreement with the said Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Special Competitive Examination for filling Grade III Vacancies of the Sri Lanka	Accountants? Service in Northern and Eastern Provinces - 2012

decision_details_body: - the proposal	made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to	conduct a special competitive examination to recruit officers for 63 vacancies of Grade	III posts in the Sri Lanka Accountants' Service in the Northern and Eastern Provinces,	as per provisions of the Service Minute of the said service and to select a batch of	officers with language proficiency to meet the expectations of the general public living	in the said areas, was approved by the Cabinet. Those selected for appointment will	serve a minimum compulsory period of ten (10) years in the Northern and Eastern	Provinces.

description: Amendment of the Penalty pertaining to violation of Seat Belt Regulations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-01
decision_details_body: - in keeping with the provisions of the Motor Traffic Act, regulations pertaining to violation of seat belt regulations have already been gazetted by the Minister in-charge of the subject of Transport.  These regulations provide for the imposition of a fine not less than Rs.1000/- and not exceeding Rs.2000/- on the first occasion, to a fine not less Rs.2000/- and not exceeding Rs.3000/- on the second occasion, and to a fine not exceeding Rs.3,500/- and cancellation of the driving license on the third occasion, on conviction after a summary trial in a Court of Law.  Since it has been observed that the general public is inconvenienced, in that they are compelled to appear in Courts for such offenses, the proposal made by Hon. Kumara Welgama, Minister of Transport, to amend Section 157A(4) of the Motor Traffic Act, to enable spot fines to be imposed in similar manner, against drivers and passengers traveling in the front seat of vehicles who contravene such regulations, instead of convicting them after a summary trial in a Court of Law, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting in Sri Lanka in 2013 -CHOGM	2013
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-01
decision_details_body: - as decided by the Commonwealth Heads of Government, the meeting in 2013	will be held in Sri Lanka and this will be the largest international event at the level of	Heads of State to be held in Sri Lanka since 1976 when Sri Lanka hosted the 5th	Summit of the Non Aligned Movement. description: Matara Accelerated Urban Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-02-01
decision_details_body:
- Matara Municipal Council area has been declared as an Urban Development Area under the Urban Development Authority. Accordingly, the following projects are to be implemented under this programme:

		*	Development of Nilwala Riverside Park; and,

description: Memorandum of Understanding on Cultural Cooperation Between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Indonesia

description: Bilateral Agreement with the State of the United Arab Emirates on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-25
decision_details_body: - the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act No.25 of 2002 provides for the provision of assistance by Sri Lanka to foreign countries in respect of criminal matters in those countries and for obtaining similar assistance from such countries by Sri Lanka.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, for the Government of Sri Lanka to sign a Bilateral Agreement on Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters with the United Arab Emirates and ratify same, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Italian Republic Concerning the Recognition of Training and Certification of Seafarers
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-25
decision_details_body: -  A Sri Lankan seafarer holding a Certificate of Competency issued by the Government of Sri Lanka, but employed in a vessel registered in a foreign country should hold an equivalent Certificate of Competency issued by the Maritime Administration of that country.  The Italian Maritime Administration has agreed to facilitate Sri Lankan seafarers to be employed on Italian Flag Vessels and accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding for the purpose between the Governments of Sri Lanka and Italy, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Allocation of land at Ratnapura New Town to the Ministry of Higher Education to be allocated to the Sri Lanka Institute of Advanced Technological Education
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-25
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, to release a block of land one (01) acre in extent, situated at Hidellana in the Ratnapura New Town, held by the Urban Development Authority, to the Ministry of Higher Education, through the Land Commissioner General, for the Ministry to allocate the block of land to the Sri Lanka Institute of Advanced Technological Education (SLIATE), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Coal Based power Plant of 2x250MW capacity at Sampoor situated in the Administrative District of Trincomalee in the Eastern Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-18
decision_details_body: - due to the increased demand for electricity in the Eastern Province, it has been decided to establish a Coal Based Power Plant of 2x250MW capacity at Sampoor in the Trincomalee District, at a total investment of around US$500 million.  The joint venture partners for this project are the Ceylon Electricity Board and the National Thermal Power Corporation Ltd. of India.  It is to be identified as a project of national importance that is likely to bring substantial economic benefits to the country.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Basil Rajapaksa, Minister of Economic Development to recognize this project as a Strategic Development Project in terms of the Act No.14 of 2008, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Lecture Theatre Complex of Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka

The work will be prioritized and funds allocated to the University Grants Commission for the year 2012 will be utilized for the purpose.

description: Renovation and rehabilitation of the Elphinston Theatre, Maradana, constructed in 1925 and governed by the Tower Hall Theatre Foundation, to meet modern requirements
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-18
decision_details_body: ? the proposal made by Hon. T.B. Ekanayake, Minister of Culture and the Arts for the renovation and rehabilitation of the Elphinston Theatre, Maradana and to provide improved facilities to the public, at an estimated cost of Rs.286 million and to entrust the work to the Buildings Department, was approved by the Cabinet.  The Project will be implemented in stages and preliminary work will be commenced with Rs.80 million provided in the Budget Estimates of 2012.  The balance financial provision for the purpose is to be provided under the Medium Term Budgetary Frame Work 2013-2014.

description: The National Climate Change Policy of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-18
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka being a developing island nation subject to tropical climate patterns, is highly vulnerable to climate change impacts. Extreme weather events such as high intensity rainfall, flash floods and landslides and extended dry periods resulting in water scarcity are now becoming common occurrences in Sri Lanka.  As such, urgent measures are necessary to face the adverse impacts of climate change. The National Climate Change Policy of Sri Lanka developed through a series of consultations with the main stakeholders and on public comments received, will provide guidance and directions for all stakeholders  to address this situation efficiently and effectively. The proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, Minister of Environment, for the implementation of the proposed National Climate Change Policy of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Cabinet Memorandum for implementation of the Dengue Surveillance Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-18
decision_details_body: ? due to the increasing spread of Dengue in the world, the European Commission has decided to provide funding support to set up a multi-country project supporting healthcare system capacity building, and to develop an early warning system for Dengue in developing countries. The Epidemiology Unit of the Ministry of Health in Sri Lanka has been chosen to conduct the main surveillance component of this project. The project will be implemented in Sri Lanka for the next 4 years. A sum equivalent to Euro 1.1 million will be received over the next 4 years to conduct this project. The proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to implement the proposed project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for co-operation in Education, Higher Education and Scientific Research between the Government of State of Qatar and the Government of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-11
decision_details_body: - this MoU intends to consolidate friendship ties and promote co-operation in the fields of Education, Higher Education and Scientific Research between the two Governments with goals and objectives of common interests within the framework of laws and regulations of both countries.  The proposal made by Hon. description: Proposed Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement between the Government of  Sri Lanka and the State of Qatar
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-11
decision_details_body: - the proposed Agreement would intensify economic co-operation to the mutual benefit of both States, while creating and maintaining more favourable conditions for investments by investors of both countries.  The above proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Government of India and the Government of Sri Lanka for obtaining Indian Grant Assistance for Reconstruction/Repair of 49,000 houses in Northern, Eastern, Central and Uva Provinces of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-11
decision_details_body: - the Government of India has agreed to provide grant assistance in a sum of Indian Rupees 13.19 billion (Approximately US $260 million) for the above purpose.  The project is to be implemented in three modes.  Under mode 1, about 38,000 houses in the Northern and Eastern Provinces will be reconstructed, with a total payment of  SLR 550,000 per house.  Payment will be made in four installments directly to the beneficiaries based on the progress of work.  Under mode 2, about 5000 houses in the Northern and Eastern will be repaired and payment will be made directly to the beneficiaries in three installments.  Under mode 3 about 6000 are to be reconstructed and of these, 4000 houses will be  reconstructed for Estates workers in the Central and Uva Provinces.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to sign a Memorandum of Understanding between the two Governments, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Building Complex for the District Secretariat Badulla
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-11

Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs, to revise the total estimate up to Rs.332.9 million and to carryout further activities of the project using the Rs.25 million allocated under the Vote of the District Secretary, Badulla for 2012, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Supplying of Drugs Manufactured by the State Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Corporation Directly to the Medical Supplies Division
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-11

description: Rehabilitation of National Highways with Concrete Surfacing through	Domestic	Contractors - Rehabilitation of Anamaduwa-Uswewa-	Galgamuwa Road (39.1	km)

description: Pilgrims Facility Center at Sellakatharagama Development of Sellakatharagama Sacred Area and its Surrounding Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-11

description: Construction of Two, Two Storeyed Buildings Each in the Watareka and the Mahara Prisons to keep the Detainees Currently Held in the Welikada Prison
