description: Delimitation of the Outer Edge of the Continental Margin of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-11
decision_details_body: - theUnited Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea required State Parties to submit geological and scientific data and other material to the Commission on the Limits of the Continental Shelf (CLCS) to establish the outer limits of the Continental Shelf beyond 200 nautical miles and Sri Lanka has already presented its submission to the CLCS.  Sri Lanka is scheduled to make an oral presentation to the CLCS during the second half of 2012. The proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs to proceed with the matter, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Consultancy Services to undertake a feasibility study and outline design of elevated Highways from Kirulapone to Kadawatha, from Colombo Fort to Kottawa and from Colombo Fort to Peliyagoda
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-11
decision_details_body:
- vehicular traffic in the Colombo Metropolitan Area has steadily increased during the recent years due to the accelerated economic and social development in the country. Since it is extremely difficult to widen the existing roads due to massive roadside development that has already taken place, it has been proposed to construct elevated highways on the undermentioned road sections, in order to ease traffic congestion in the Colombo Metropolitan Area and to provide access to Southern Expressway, Outer Circular Highway and Colombo - Katunayake Expressway:     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
*	From Kirulapone to Kadawata (approximately 19Km) which will connect Outer Circular Highway at Kadawata and Colombo - Katunayake Expressway at Peliyagoda;

*	From Colombo Fort to Kottawa (approximately 21Km) which will connect Southern Expressway and Outer Circular Highway at Kottawa; and,

*	From Colombo Fort to Peliyagoda interchange on Colombo-Katunayake Expressway (approximately 5 km).
		
	The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to procure consultancy services for the above feasibility study and to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and a Technical Evaluation Committee for the purpose, was considered and it was decided that the Engineering Faculties of Local Universities should be requested to undertake the  task of providing consultancy services for the purpose, in the first instance.

description: Exemption from charging processing fees of foreign children under 12 years of age visiting Sri Lanka, and of transit foreign passengers for a period of two days (48 hours) who travel through Sri Lanka on visas obtained through the internet
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-11
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted for foreigners visiting Sri Lanka to obtain visas through the internet.   Exemption of children under 12 years of age from charging processing fees would make this system attractive while boosting visits of foreigners with their families.  It would also be very favourable for Sri Lanka, if transit passengers are given exemption from processing fees up to two (02) days (48 hours), as on numerous occasions they conclude their visits within that period of time.  The above proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Sri Lanka Mission in Ukraine
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-05
decision_details_body: - Ukraine gained independence in 1991 and following the establishment of diplomatic relations there has been closer co-operation between Sri Lanka and Ukariane at bilateral and multilateral levels.  Currently a range of agreements are in the process of being negotiated covering the fields of Education, Defence, Science and Technology, Ports and Shipping, Air Services, Trade etc.  Direct flights have also commenced between the two countries.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs to establish a Resident Diplomatic Mission in Ukraine, was approved by the Cabinet. The Government of Ukraine will, on a reciprocal basis, establish a Resident Mission in Colombo.

description: Water Supply to Mahiyanganaya - Ridimaliyadda DS Areas - Project Proposal Submitted By Maschin-Uniwelptechnik-Transportanlagen Ges.m.b.H. Austria
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-05
decision_details_body: - the Ministry of Water Supply and Drainage has received a proposal from Austria to finance the above water supply project under a soft loan sponsored by the Austrian Government.  The initial project proposal covers the construction of Intakes Structures on Mahaweli River,  Treatment Plant, Water Tower, Transmission and Distribution System in Mahiyanganaya and Ridimaliyadda Divisional Secretary Areas.  About 30,300 people living in the areas would be benefited by this project.  Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage informed the Cabinet that the project could be commenced in 2012 on receipt of the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee.

description: A Dollar Credit Line of US $382.37 Million from the Government of India for the Restoration of Northern Railway Services
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-05
decision_details_body: - the Government of India has agreed to provide a loan of US $382.37 million for the above. Of the proceeds of the loan, US $149.3 million will be utilized for the reconstruction of the Railway line from Pallai to Kankasanthurai, US $86.52 million for setting up of signaling and telecommunication systems for the Northern Railway Line and US $146.51 million for other contracts that may be mutually agreed upon by the two Governments.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as a Minister of Finance and Planning to enter into a credit agreement with the Export-Import Bank of India to obtain the above credit facility, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Road Network Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-05
decision_details_body: - The Development Policy Framework of the Government has identified the necessity of rehabilitation and improvement of National Road Network of the Country on priority basis. Accordingly, on a request made by the Government, the Saudi Fund for Development has agreed to provide Saudi Riyals 225,000,000 (approximately US $60 million) for rehabilitation and improvement of about 144 Km. of the National Road Network of the country.  The loan will have a 20 year repayment period including a grace period of 5 years. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to conduct loan negotiations with the Saudi Fund for development to obtain financial assistance and to enter into a loan agreement for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) & Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka (TRCSL)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-05
decision_details_body: - this MOU provides a framework for technical and institutional co-operation in the field of telecommunication between India and Sri Lanka.  The proposal made by H.E. the President to enter into the above MOU, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Issuance of Passports to the Sri Lanka Refugees who have sought refuge in the areas of Tamil Nadu in India, without levying charges when they return to Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-05
decision_details_body: - on the initiative of H.E. the president in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, steps are being taken  to re-settle in their own villages about 90,000 Sri Lankan Tamils living in refugee camps and residencies privately sought by them in Tamil Nadu due to LTTE terrorist activities which prevailed during the last 3 decades.  In terms of the provisions of the Immigration and Emigration Act, they should have a valid passport to land in Sri Lanka.  The proposal made by H.E. the President to authorize the Deputy High Commissioner of Sri Lanka in Chennai to issue passports without levying a fee of Rs.4,400/- to these refugees who are to return to Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: The Draft Agreement between the Government  of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the State of Palestine for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-05
decision_details_body: ? this Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement was negotiated and concluded, with the view to enhance economic relations between Sri Lanka and Palestine. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning to sign the draft Agreement at Government level and to present it in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project for the supply, installation, testing and commissioning of 02 Nos. Cardiac Catheterization systems and 02 Nos. Echo Cardiography Machines to the Cardiology Department of the National Hospital of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-05
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health to award the above contract to a company in Austria, on the recommendations of the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Protocol on Political Consultations between the Ministry of External Affairs of    Sri Lanka and the Ministry of foreign Affairs of the State of Palestine
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-05
decision_details_body: - this agreement would enhance friendly relations between Sri Lanka and the State of Palestine and would contribute to international and regional  peace, security and prosperity. The proposal made by Hon. (Prof) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to sign the above agreement during the visit of the Hon. Minister of Foreign affairs of Palestine to Sri Lanka in January 2012, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the Civil Procedure Code to introduce Judicial Mediation and Pre-trial  Procedure
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-05
decision_details_body: -  The Government has observed the economic difficulties that are being faced by the people due to law's delays and pending legal cases. With the view to overcome this situation, a system of judicial mediation is to be introduced as a first step in Court proceedings and pre-trial procedures are to be adopted thereafter. Judicial mediation will endeavor to bring about an amicable settlement on the issues concerned  between the relevant parties. The proposal made by Hon Rauff Hakeem, Minister of Justice, was referred to the Cabinet Sub-Committee on Legislation for its recommendations.

description: Design and construction of new buildings to include facilities for persons whose walking is hampered  due to disabilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-01-05
decision_details_body: - The Government has observed the difficulties experienced by persons with disabilities in entering public and private sector institutions for their needs. Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health to enlighten public and private sector institutions to include access and other facilities for such disabled persons when designing and constructing new buildings, in keeping with the regulations published in the Gazette Extraordinary dated 2006?10?17, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Programme for Strengthening the Samurdhi / Divineguma families in the Anuradhapura District concurrently with the 'Deyata Kirula' Exhibition
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body: - housing facilities of Samurdhi / Divineguma low income families are to be improved during the above period  and 31,931 household units have been identified for development under this programme.   The total quantity of tiles required for the District has been estimated to be 27,821,836.  The above proposal made by Hon. Basil Rajapakse, Minister of Economic Development, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: ADB Loan for 2011 - Lot C - Second Circuit Stringing of Kotmale - New Anuradhapura 220KV, 163 Km Long Transmission Line
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body: ? Asian Development Bank has agreed to provide funding assistance to implement six power sector projects and one such project is the Eastern (North and East) Transmission Development Project. Lot C above is estimated to cost US $8.8 million (equivalent to LKR 1008.04 million). The proposal made by Hon. Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy, to proceed with the above project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Investment Opportunities under the Second International Airport at Mattala
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation, to call for request for proposals for various investment opportunities relating to aviation services, to be associated with the Mattala Airport, in addition to passenger handling and cargo operations, was approved by the Cabinet. Blocks of land are to be leased out for the investors selected to launch their projects.

description: Iranamadu Irrigation Development Project - Kilinochchi District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body:
- on the initiative of H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning,  Loan Negotiations have been concluded with the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) to obtain a loan of Special Drawing Rights (SDR) 14,350,000 (approximately US$ 22,231,000) to finance the above project.  The project will cover 8455 hectares and will benefit the farmers living around the tank area.  The project includes the following:

*	Infrastructure Development - it is proposed to rehabilitate down-stream canal system of this tank which provides irrigation water to 8455 hectares.  This includes rehabilitation of 30km of 2 main canals, 135km of branch and distribution canals, 123km of field canals and 95km of drainage canals.  Farm roads will also be improved. The project will support around 2000 families experiencing water shortages.

*	Production and Marketing - the project will support and strengthen water management activities for women groups and youth to engage in non-paddy crop cultivation and off-farm income generation activities, agricultural processing and organic fertilizer production.  

The loan will have a 40 year re-payment period including a grace period of 10 years. The proposal made by H.E. the President to enter into a loan agreement with the IFAD for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Payment of Bonus to the Employees of  Government Corporations and Fully Owned Government companies for the Year 2011
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, for the payment of bonus to the employees of  Government Corporations and Fully Owned Government companies for the Year 2011, as was paid in the year 2010, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Submission of the Annual Report and Accounts for the year 2009 of Paddy  Marketing Board to the Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body: - during the year under review the Paddy Marketing Board had purchased 57,469 MT of paddy from farmers throughout the Island and was able to generate Rs.150 million as profit from this operation.  The Board was also able to maintain a buffer stock of 180,000 MT of paddy.  The above Annual Report submitted by Hon. Johnston Fernando, Minister of Cooperatives and Internal Trade, was approved for presentation in Parliament.

description: Construction of the SAARC Cultural Centre at Naawimana in Matara
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body:
- the proposal made by Hon. T.B. Ekanayaka, Minister of Culture and the Arts, for the construction of the SAARC Cultural Centre at a cost of Rs.500 million and for the work to be completed within the first quarter of 2013, was approved by the Cabinet.  The objectives of the Centre are:

*	Strengthening regional cultural relations through the Cultural Centre.

*	Protecting and promoting regional heritage and traditional diversities.

* Providing opportunities for traditional teachings, studies, explorations and research in the region.

description: Procurement of 25 Nos. Super Luxury Buses on Easy Credit Basis to Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Kumara Welgama, Minister of Transport, to procure 25 super luxury buses to the Sri Lanka Transport Board, in order to minimize the traffic congestion on approach roads to Colombo city, such as Galle Road, Kandy Road, High Level Road, Negombo Road, Kaduwela Road, Horana Road  and to provide better facilities to commuters, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Repairing the Building complex with class rooms and the old Boarding House at the Visakha National School, Colombo 04
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body: - the proposal by Hon. Bandula Gunawardane, Minister of Education, to award the contract for repair and modernization, planning and supervision of the three storied building complex and the Boarding House building on a competitive bidding basis, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of four storied Administration Building for Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute, University of Kelaniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body: - this Institute offers Bachelor of Ayurveda Medicine and Surgery Degree (BAMS) and has over 400 students and it has increased the annual intake of students for this Degree programme from 80 to 120 per year.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to construct a four storied building at a total cost of Rs.134 million, was approved by the Cabinet.  The initial work of the project will be commenced utilizing the financial provision allocated for construction work in 2012 and the balance will be completed with funds to be provided under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2013 - 2015.

description: Commemoration of the National Safety Day - 2011
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body: - 26th of December each year has been declared as the National Safety Day. The objective of this declaration is to create awareness among the people on natural and other disasters and particularly to enhance proper disaster response capacity to encounter situations such as the Tsunami which occurred on 26th December 2004. The National Safety Day has been held annually since 2006 and it has been decided to commemorate this event in 2011 in Kattankudy Town, Batticaloa. The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Amaraweera, Minister of Disaster Management to implement a series of programmes for the purpose with the active participation of the relevant Government institutions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Approval for implementation of Project Facilitating Initiatives for Social cohesion and Transformation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body: - this project stems from the bilateral agreement between the Government of the Federal Republic of Germany and the Government of Sri Lanka. This programme contributes to initiatives towards a socially integrated, harmonious and peaceful Sri Lanka that promotes equality and diversity. The project would help to build institutional capabilities of Community Based Organizations to take up local responsibilities. The proposal made by Hon. Wasudewa Nanayakkara, Minister of National Languages and Social Integration to implement all programmes pertaining to social cohesion and transformation in the five Districts of Ampara, Puttalam, Mullaitivu, Badulla and Galle at a total cost of Euro 3 million (Rs.474 million), was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of Dikkumbura Water Supply System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body: - Dikkumbura is located in the Galle District about 6 Km. away from Ahangama. This area lies within the  administrative area of the Imaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha. The objective of the proposal is to supply safe drinking water facilities to the people living in the area. The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage to implement this project at a total cost of Rs.317 million with funds to be provided during 2013 and 2014 , was approved by the Cabinet.

description: A Credit of United States Dollars 11 million (approximately Special Drawing Rights 7 million ) from the International Development Association of the World Bank as an Additional Financing for E- Sri Lanka Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted to enter into a Loan Agreement with the International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank to borrow US$ 53 million for the implementation of the above project. The World Bank has agreed to provide a further amount of US$ 11 million as additional financing for the development of this project and the proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to conduct loan negotiations with IDA of the World Bank and enter into a Financing Arrangement for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Sand 	feeding in the Marawila Coastal Region for protection against coastal erosion
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21
decision_details_body: - it has been identified that one of the main reasons for coastal erosion in the Negombo-Chilaw Coastal Zone is excessive sand mining and the most appropriate solution to arrest this situation in the Marawila coastal region is sand feeding by means of sand mined from deep sea and construction of a few off shore break waters. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Defence and Urban Development, for the appointment of a Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and a Technical Evaluation Committee to proceed with the work, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-development Programme of Colombo City and its? Surroundings
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-21

description: Agreement on Economic and Technical Cooperation between the Government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the People?s Republic of China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body: - the Government of the Peoples Republic of China has agreed to provide a grant in a sum of Renminbi Yuan 100 million to Sri Lanka and the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, to enter into an Economic and Technical Cooperation Agreement between the two countries in December 2011, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Grant Assistance of Euro 11,500,000 from the Government of Federal Republic of Germany
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body:
- the Government of the Federal Republic of Germany has agreed to provide grant assistance in a sum of Euro 11,500,000 for the implementation of  the following development projects in the Northern and Eastern Provinces of Sri Lanka:

*	Vocational Training Centre in the Northern Province  - it is proposed to establish a complete Vocational Training Centre at Kilinochchi.  This Centre will have a capacity of about 400 students and both short term and long term training programmes will be conducted in the fields of Metal Technology, Electronics, Automotive Sector, IT Sector, Agriculture and Food Security.  In addition to the above grant, a loan of 3 million Euro from KfW of Germany, will also be obtained for the construction of building.

*	Small and Medium Sector Development Project - this programme will include Textile, Agribusiness, Food and Beverages, Tourism related industry, Livestock etc.

*	Performance Improvement Project for Development Actors in the Northern and Eastern Provinces - this project is focused on human resource development in the Northern and Eastern Provincial Councils and capacity development for local government institutions.

description: Institute of Construction Training & Development (ICTAD) - Annual Report for the Year 2010
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body: - the main objective of ICTAD is to promote the contribution of the construction industry in meeting national demand in development objectives.  Currently nearly 2500 construction contractors are registered with ICTAD and this information is now available on the Web site.   The Operator Training Unit provides training on construction equipment such as crawler tractors, loaders, excavators etc.  The training programmes consist of institutional training and on-the-job training.  During the year under review, ICTAD has conducted vocational training courses for early school leavers to help to solve the unemployment problem of the youth.  This three year Basic Mechanical Training Programme is conducted in collaboration with the National Apprenticeship & Industrial Training Authority (NAITA).   The above Annual Report submitted by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, was approved for presentation in Parliament.

description: Tender for the purchase of New Buses to Sri Lanka Transport Board
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Kumara Welgama, Minister of Transport, to award the tender, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, for the procurement of 54 seater buses at a unit price of Rs.4,740,940.00, to Lanka Ashok Layland PLC., utilizing Rs.500 million allocated for the year 2011, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Conducting an Airborne Magnetic and Gamma Ray Spectrometer Survey Covering Entire Sri Lanka including the Fringe of the Continental Shelf
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body: - this survey is vital to gather essential geo-information required for systematic mineral exploration of the country and hence, would be a key factor in attracting investors for mineral sector development. This would assist to identify areas for detailed ground surveys in the mineral sector.  It was not possible to conduct a survey of this nature covering the entire Island for the last three decades due to the conflict situation which prevailed in the North and the East. The proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, Minister of Environment, to award the above contract, on the recommendations of the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee and the Project Committee,  for a total cost of  US $16.4 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new building for the Institute of Fundamental Studies
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body: - the principal mandate of this Institute is to initiate, promote and conduct research and investigations in fundamental studies in general with particular emphasis on mathematics, physical and chemical sciences, life sciences and philosophy.  The proposal made by Hon. Pavithra Wanniarachchi, Minister of Technology and Research, for the construction of a new building for this Institute and to purchase necessary equipment at a total cost of Rs.2,00,000,000.00, was approved by the Cabinet.  The initial work of the project will be commenced utilizing the financial provision allocated for construction work in 2012 and the balance will be completed with funds to be provided under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2013.

description: Construction of New Building for the Department of Management Studies - Faculty of Arts, University of Peradeniya - Revision of Total Cost Estimate
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted for the construction of a new building for the above, to commence Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) programme with an intake of 100 students per year, the proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to revise the Total Cost Estimate of the construction of the two storied building from Rs.42.11 million to Rs.78.5 million, due to increase in construction costs, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of stage I of the seven storied building for the Faculty of Graduate Studies, University of Colombo using Generated funds
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted for the construction of  a seven storied building for the above Faculty of the University of Colombo at a total cost of 405 million.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to construct first two floors of the above under Stage I of the project with an amount of Rs.152 million from the generated funds of the Faculty of Graduate Studies, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of four storied Administration Building for Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute, University of Kelaniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body: - this Institute offers Bachelor of Ayurveda Medicine and Surgery Degree (BAMS) and has over 400 students and it has increased the annual intake of students for this Degree programme from 80 to 120 per year.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education, to construct a four storied building at a total cost of Rs.79 million, was approved by the Cabinet.  The initial work of the project will be commenced utilizing the financial provision allocated for construction work in 2012 and the balance will be completed with funds to be provided under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2013 - 2014.

description: Supply & Delivery of Materials for Sustainable Power Sector Support Project (Expansion of Rural Electrification & Distribution System Improvement Ampara and Uva)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body: - the Government has received a loan from the Asian Development Bank towards the cost of Sustainable Power Sector Support Project and it intends to apply part of the proceeds of the loan for expansion of Rural Electrification and Distribution System Improvement in Ampara and Uva.  The proposal made by Hon. Patali Chanpika Ranawaka, Minister of Power and Energy, to award four relevant contracts, on the recommendations of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of Electricity Supply - Jaffna Region Transmission Project Kilinochchi - Chunnakam Transmission Line - Lot C-B : Earth Wire replacement with OPGW
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14

description: Regional Bridge Project Phase - 2 with Financial assistance from United Kingdom
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body: - there are over 4500 bridges on the National Highway Network in Sri Lanka and about 160 bridges have been identified for replacement with new bridges on a priority basis.  Mabey Bridge Limited, UK is presently involved in the Regional Bridge Project implemented by the Road Development Authority with UK funding.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the contract for the construction of single and two lane steel bridges throughout Sri Lanka, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, to Mabey Bridge Limited, UK, at a cost of GBP 45 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of National Highways with concrete surfacing through domestic contractors - Approval to Implement the proposal submitted by M/S Nawaloka Construction Company(Pvt) Ltd. for the rehabilitation of Galigamuwa - Ruwanwella - Karawanella Road from 0 to 29.21 km
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted to rehabilitate 662.04 km. of roads by the Road Development Authority through domestic contractors by obtaining the required funds amounting to around US $500 million from local Banks.  The above is one such road approved for rehabilitation under this programme.  The proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the contract of the above at the negotiated sum of Rs.2,472,357,070.33 was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Project to construct a 350 meter high Multifunctional TV and Telecommunication Tower along with a Leisure Park in Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body: - with the present rate of growth in the TV and Telecommunication Sectors in the country, Cabinet approval has already been granted to construct a multifunctional TV and Telecommunication Tower approximately 350 meters in height  which could be used by 50 telecasting services, 10 telecommunication services and 50 radio broadcasting services.  The proposal made by H.E. the President, to rename the project as "Colombo Lotus Tower Project" and to explore the possibility of shifting the project to a central tourist zone in Colombo with the view to proceed with the project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the National Human Rights Action Plan (NHRAP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body: - this action plan for the protection and promotion of human rights was approved by the Cabinet at its meeting held on 07th September 2011. The Government considers it important to implement the above Action Plan to enable our successful engagement with several international human rights organizations, especially the United Nations Human Rights Council (UNHCR). The proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, Minister of Plantation Industries, to undertake initial work for Sri Lanka's participation in the second cycle of the Universal Periodic Review in October 2012, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Policy on the Establishment of a Health Assessment for Resident Visa Applicants to Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-14
decision_details_body: - with the increased development activities taking place in the country after the conflict situation which prevailed some time  back, it has been observed that quite a large number of foreigners obtain resident visas to Sri Lanka to participate in these activities.  It has been found necessary to protect the public health needs of the Sri Lankan community and also the physical, mental and social needs of migrants.  Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, for the implementation of a policy to conduct a health assessment for the resident visa applicants, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Agreement on Economic, Commercial and Technical Cooperation between the Government of the State of Qatar and the Government  of the Democratic  Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-07
decision_details_body: -  the proposal made by Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce, to sign the above Agreement between the State of Qatar and the Government of Sri Lanka to enhance economic relations between the  two countries and to promote and facilitate export and import of industrial and agricultural raw material and value added products, was approved by the Cabinet.  The proposed Agreement will promote and develop cooperation between the two countries in economic, commercial and technical fields.

description: Financial Assistance of Euro 22 million from the Government of France for Widening and Reconstruction of Bridges on National Road Network
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-07
decision_details_body: - the Government of France has agreed to provide Euro 22 million for the reconstruction of 46 bridges on the National Road Network.  These bridges have been selected from Western, Southern, Uva, Sabaragamuwa, Central and North Western Provinces on priority basis.  The bridges located close to towns will be given high priority to eliminate traffic congestion.  The project will be implemented by the Road Development Authority under the supervision of the Ministry of Ports and Highways.  The proposal made by H.E. the President to enter into a Loan Agreement for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on the Establishment of a High Joint Committee between the Government of the State of Qatar and the Government  of the Democratic  Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-07
decision_details_body: -  the proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to sign the above Agreement between the State of Qatar and the Government of Sri Lanka, to strengthen bi-lateral relations in the economic, commercial, cultural, scientific, technical, education and information sectors and to develop trade, investment and tourism between the two countries, was approved by the Cabinet. description: Signing of the Agreement of Co-operation in the field of Culture between the government of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Government of the State of Qatar
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. T.B. Ekanyake, Minister of Culture and the Arts, to enter into the above Agreement with the view to  enhancing the cultural cooperation between the State of Qatar and the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.   This will promote and develop co-operation between the two countries in the fields of culture, publications and similar areas.

description: Construction of 50m, 8 lane Swimming Pool with diving facilities at Piliyandala Central Collage
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Mahindananda Aluthgama, Minister of Sports to construct a swimming pool at the Piliyandala Central College at a total revised contract sum of Rs.43,882,660.00 was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Rehabilitation of National Highways with concrete surfacing through domestic contractors - Rehabilitation and Improvement of the Polonnaruwa - Tambala - Sungawila - Somawathiya Road (33.0 km)

decision_details_body: - Cabinet has granted approval for the rehabilitation of 662.04 Km. of roads through domestic contractors by obtaining the required funds amounting to around US $ 500 million from local Banks. The above road  having a length of 33.0 Km. is one of the roads approved for rehabilitation under this programme. The proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to award the above contract on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee and the Technical Evaluation Committee, for a sum of Rs. 2,750, 000,000.00, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Youth Corps Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Dullas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development, to repeal the Youth Corps Act No. 21 of 2002 and to establish a new statutory institution named Youth Corps Authority and to draft legislation for the purpose, was approved by the Cabinet. The proposed Bill will focus on youth development, leadership training, conducting job oriented vocational courses etc.

description: Amendments to the National Film Corporation Act No.47 of 1971 as amended by Act No.45 of 1980
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Keheliya Rambukwella, Minister of Mass Media and Information, to introduce necessary amendments to the above Act  in keeping with the recommendations of the Cabinet Sub-Committee  on Legislation and to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare amending legislation for the purpose,  was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Vessel Monitoring System (VMS)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-07
decision_details_body: - at present about 3000 multi-day fishing vessels owned by Sri Lankan fishermen are being operated in the deep sea and in international waters in the Indian Ocean.  Sri Lanka, as a member and a contracting party of the Indian Ocean Tuna Commission is required to establish and operate a Vessel Monitoring System (VMS) for the vessels operating in the high seas.  This will immensely benefit the country to combat illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing practices in the region.  The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Rajitha Senaratne, Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development, to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee and a Technical Evaluation Committee to evaluate the proposal received in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Apartment Housing Ownership Act No.11 of 1973 and the Condominium Management Authority Act No.10 of 1973"
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, for the appointment of a Committee of Experts consisting of representatives of the relevant institutions, to examine  the amendments necessary for the above two Acts and make recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Road Project Preparatory Facility funded by Asian Development Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-07
decision_details_body: - under the Asian Development Bank funded Road Development Preparatory Facility, a consultancy contract to undertake a feasibility study  and detailed engineering design of 400 Km. of Provincial Roads in Kilinochchi and Mullaitivu Districts, has already been awarded to a company in France by the Ministry of Local Government and Provincial Councils. The proposal made by Hon. A.L.M. Athaullah, Minister of Local Government and Provincial Councils, on the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Consultant Procurement Committee, to assign the responsibility of completing the preparatory works of additional roads of the National Highways too to the same company of France, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Restoration and Development of Defunct Elephant Pass Saltern
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal by Hon. Douglas Devananda, Minister of Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development, for action to be taken by the Ministry to recommence operation of the Elephant Pass Saltern which is in a defunct state due to the conflict situation which prevailed in the Northern Province for nearly three decades, was approved by the Cabinet. This will generate employment opportunities in the Northern Province and will also help the Government to save foreign exchange spent on import of salt and salt base products. A suitable local investor is to be selected for the purpose through formal procedure and the relevant land and other assets will be leased out to the investor.

description: Allocation of land at Pannipitiya to the Ministry of Education of the Western Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-12-07
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President,  in his  capacity  as  Minister of Defence and Urban Development to allocate a block of land over one acre in extent, situated at Depanama, Pannipitiya to the Ministry of Education of the Western Province, to be used for expansion of school premises of the Depanama Dharmapala Junior School, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Flagship Investment in the City of Colombo by M/S International TC Limited (ITCL) of India Franchisee of  Sheraton Group of USA
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-30
decision_details_body: - Colombo is to be developed as a Middle Income City in terms of the long term development framework of the Government.   This includes housing for shanty dwellers presently living within the city, so as to ensure better living conditions and to provide them opportunities for urban employment and livelihood activities.  The new plan will also protect the green belt areas, waterway reservations etc. M/s. ITC Limited of India, 'Franchisee of SHERATON GROUP of USA' has expressed its interest to invest in a sum of US $300 million, in a luxury hotel and mixed development in Colombo.   Accordingly, the proposal made by Hon. Basil Rajapakse, Minister of Economic Development, to provide a block of land on lease in Colombo, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Review Committee (SCARC), was approved by the Cabinet. The proposal was also supported by the Indian High Commission in Colombo and Indian Senior Government Officials, as a reputed investments that would be beneficial for Sri Lanka's tourism industry.

description: Construction of a Building Complex for the Faculty of Agriculture of the University of Rajarata
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-30
decision_details_body: - the Rajarata University which was established in 2001 at Puliyankulama, has 5 Faculties including the Faculty of Agriculture. The student population of the Faculty of Agriculture is over 400 and it is expected to increase the intake with the expansion of infrastructure facilities.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Dissanayake, Minister of Higher Education to construct a three storied building complex for this Faculty at a total cost of Rs.143 million and to award the consultancy services to the State Engineering Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.  The initial work of the project will be commenced with funds provided in 2011 and the balance construction work  with funds provided from 2012 to 2014.

description: Procurement of 2 Nos. Top Heavy Lift Trucks (40 Ton) for Sri Lanka Ports Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-30
decision_details_body: - the volume of domestic cargo handled in the Port of Colombo continues to increase with the steady economic growth in the country and it has been found necessary to commence procurement activities for the purchase of the above mentioned cargo handling equipment. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways to award the contract for Consultancy Services of the above project for a sum of US $723,000 and LKR 178,009,500/-, was approved by the Cabinet.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-23

The Board was also successful in earning its highest income during the year. Special training programmes were held during the year for the officers of the Board in the Northern and Eastern Provinces, where the Board's Insurance Schemes had remained inactive for a long time due to the conflict situation, but have now been revived.  The above Annual Report submitted by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, was approved for presentation in Parliament.

decision_details_body: - the University has been relocated and the construction of the administration building has been completed.  The proposal made by Hon. S.B. description: 2012-2021 Ten Year Plan for a Trilingual Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-23
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that one of the far-seeing initiatives that needs to be taken to prevent the resurgence of terrorism which ravaged the country for over three decades is to encourage the people of Sri Lanka to communicate effectively in all three languages. In recognition of this need, a Ten Year Plan formulated as the basis for a National Programme to motivate the people to acquire trilingual skills, presented to the Cabinet by H.E. the President, was approved for implementation. A Co-ordinating Unit for the purpose will be established at the Presidential Secretariat.  According to this Plan, the Year 2012 is to be declared as the Year for a Trilingual Sri Lanka.

description: Awarding the Contract for the Construction of the Proposed Building for the Department of Census and Statistics - Phase 2
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-16
decision_details_body: - the Department of Census and Statistics is housed in 06 locations in Colombo at present and it has been decided to construct a new building for this Department to house all the divisions in one building.  Stage I of the Project was implemented with funds from the World Bank and the Government of Sri Lanka. The proposal made by H.E. the President, on the recommendation of the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee, to award the contract for Phase II of the Project  for a total contract  sum of Rs.727,529,015.16 with funds to be provided by the Government, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 17th SAARC Summit held in Addu City, Maldives
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-16
decision_details_body:
- the 17th SAARC Summit was held in Maldives from 10 - 11 November 2011 and was attended by Heads of States of  Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan and Sri Lanka.  H.E. the President in his address stated that the Region of  South Asia consists of a large, creative and talented pool of young human resource base reflecting an increasingly promising future for the Region of SAARC and that the Region should take necessary courses of action to realize the potential of such unprecedented human resource base.  He also stated that the other challenges the Region confronts are food and energy security, environmental degradation, upgrading of infrastructure and protection of our societies from terrorism.  During the Summit, the following four (04) crucial Agreements were signed:

*	Agreement of Multilateral Arrangement for Recognition of Conformity Assessment,

*	Agreement on Implementation of Regional Standards,

*	Agreement on Establishing SAARC Seed Bank,

*	Agreement on Rapid Response to Natural Disaster.

	H.E. the President also held discussions with other Heads of States and dignitaries.  At his meeting with the Prime Minister of  India, the President appreciated the contribution made by India for the reconstruction and development of the Northern Province and elaborated on the measures the government is taking on re-settlement, rehabilitation and re-integration, including that of former LTTE combatants.

description: Credit Facility of US$ 33 million from the EXIM Bank of China to finance Lighting Sri Lanka Eastern Province Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-16
decision_details_body: - the Government of China has agreed to provide a credit facility through the Export Import Bank of China for the above project, the total cost of which is US $ 33,335,280 and LKR 544,184,780. Accordingly, 85% of the cost will be financed by the EXIM Bank of China and the  balance 15% will be provided by the government of Sri Lanka. The objective of the project is to electrify 268 villages in the Trincomalee and Batticaloa Districts.  The project is expected to serve the increasing needs of the people in rural areas in the Province and will enhance the economic potential in the area by increasing productivity, creating new employment opportunities and improving the living standards of the community.  The above proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Report and Statement of Accounts of the Palmyrah Development Board for the year 2009 in Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-16
decision_details_body: - this is the only state institution engaged in  the Palmyrah Industry and during the year under review 2,268,120 seeds have been planted in the Districts of Jaffna, Mannar, Vavuniya, Kilinochchi, Mullaithevu, Batticaloa, Trincomalee, Ampara, Puttlam, Hambantota and Moneragala with the view to increase Palmyrah vegetation in the country.  The Palmyrah Development Board is also involved in conducting vocational training programmes in Handicraft, Fibre production and Jaggery  production.  Handicraft Training Programme is for a period of six months and the other two for a period of three months each. The above Annual Report  submitted by Hon. Douglas Devananda, Minister of Traditional Industries and Small Enterprise Development, was approved for presentation in Parliament.

description: Rehabilitation and Improvement of the Section of Road from Narammala to Giriulla (16.03 km) on the Narammala - Dankotuwa Road (B308)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-16
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval has already been granted to rehabilitate 662.04 km. of roads with concrete surfacing through domestic contractors by obtaining the required funds amounting to around US$500 million from local Banks.  The Section of Road from Narammala to Giriulla, which is 16.03 km. in length is one of the roads included in the above project. description: National Sports Policy of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-16
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Mahindananda Aluthgamage, Minister of Sports for a National Sports Policy of Sri Lanka, for the creation of a healthy younger generation to ensure national unity, peace and development  through proper development of sports in Sri Lanka and proper scientific and technical training for the younger generation and for the formulation of National Sports Policy in association with the relevant Line Ministries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relocation of Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-16
decision_details_body: - in keeping with the government policy to ensure a dignified resettlement to all IDPs, the Ministry of Resettlement has already resettled almost 97% of the IDPs who were displaced soon after the humanitarian operation, in their native villages by October 2011. The proposal made by  Hon. Gunaratne Weerakoon, Minister of Resettlement, for the relocation of 1687 families in the Mullaitivu District, 1272 families in Muttur in the Trincomalee District and 166 families in the Mannar District, with the assistance of the Security Forces in the North and East, was approved in principle by the Cabinet.

description: Cabinet Memorandum for Agreement on Establishment of the SAARC Seed Bank in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-16
decision_details_body:
- the objectives of setting up of the Seed Bank, as agreed upon by SAARC countries, are -

*	to provide regional support to National Seed Security efforts; address regional seed shortages through collective actions and foster inter-country partnership;

*	to promote increase of Seed Replacement Rate with appropriate varieties at a faster rate as far as possible so that the use of quality seeds for crop production can be ensured; and,

		*	to act as a Regional Seed Security reserve for the Member States. 

	The proposal made Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to sign the above Agreement, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Preparation of a National Policy Framework and Action Plan on Consumer Welfare
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-16
decision_details_body: - it has been observed that the country needs a more comprehensive and coordinated effort to have a National Policy Framework and Action Plan on Consumer Welfare in which all government Ministries will work under one umbrella to facilitate and coordinate the process of building a developed society where consumer welfare is part and parcel of the society. The proposal made by Hon. S.B. Navinna, Minister (Senior) for Consumer Welfare,  to conduct discussions with stakeholders etc. and to prepare  a National Policy and Programme for the purpose, in association with the Ministry of Co-operatives and Internal Trade, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Importation of Bitumen by the Road Development Authority for the Implementation of Road Construction and Maintenance Works
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-16
decision_details_body: - road works that are being handled by the Road Development Authority has increased by many folds over the recent years and the government has observed that the present demand for bitumen is very high. At present the entire requirement of bitumen for road construction and maintenance works is supplied by the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation which appears to be inadequate to meet the increased demand. This has caused delays in the implementation of Road Development Works. Accordingly, the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways,  for the Road Development Authority to import bitumen on the recommendation of the Ministry of Petroleum Industries, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Report and Accounts of the Sri Lanka Social Security Board for the year 2010
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-09
decision_details_body: - By the end of the year 2010 the number enrolled for Pension and Social Security Benefit Scheme stood at 400,047. Those in self employment, employees of the private sector, business enterprises, foreign employment and Ayurvedic Medical Practitioners and Physicians and Arts and Craftsmen could enter this scheme. Membership  could be obtained through Grama Niladhari officers, Samurdhi Development Officers, Divisional Secretariats, District Secretariats and the Sri Lanka Social Security Board Head office. Members are entitled to a monthly pension, partial and complete incapacitation benefits as well as death donations. Those between the age of 18-59 are entitled to obtain membership of these pension schemes. The above Annual Report presented by H.E. the President, in his capacity as Minister of Finance and Planning, was approved for presentation in Parliament.

description: Annual Report of the Sri Lanka Foundation for the year 2009 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-09
decision_details_body: - during the year under review, the Sri Lanka Foundation Institute has concentrated mainly on capacity building of public sector organizations, community leaders, law enforcement officers and other public and cooperate sector employees. During 2009 the institute has conducted 123 programmes earning a sum of  Rs.7,345,457.25 as income from fee-levying courses and externally funded education training programme.  Under the Language Training Programme, it has  conducted a certificate course in spoken Tamil, for the participants to gain ability to speak in simple Tamil, to develop day to day communication skills in Tamil etc. and a certificate course in Spoken English.  The above Annual Report presented by H.E. the President, was approved for presentation in Parliament.

description: Construction of a Building for the Rubber Research Institute of Sri Lanka, Agalawatta
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-09
decision_details_body: - Rubber growers and related personnel in the rubber industries as well as students of Universities, Technical Institutions and schools visit this institute located at Agalawatte regularly to acquire research and technical know-how pertaining to rubber cultivation and manufacturing of rubber finished products. Due to inadequate accommodation facilities available at the present building of this institute, the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, Minister of Plantation Industries, to construct a new building at Agalawatta at a total cost of Rs.34 million with funds to be provided in 2011 and 2012, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of a new Bridge Replacing the Existing Bridge No.6/2 near Polduwa Junction on Kollupitiya - Sri Jayawardenepura Road
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-09
decision_details_body: - on a proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Ports and Highways, to invite Bids and to appoint a Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (CAPC) and a Technical Evaluation Committee (TEC) for the construction of a new bridge replacing the existing bridge, to provide adequate vertical clearance under the bridge for navigation purposes, which would help promote tourism etc., was approved by the Cabinet. decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-09

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-09

description: Community Water Supply & Sanitation Project (CWSSP)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-09
decision_details_body: - these projects are implemented in stages with community participation.  In addition to sharing a part of the cost of these projects, the communities carry out physical construction of facilities through Community Based Organizations formed within the community under the direction and support of the Ministry of Water Supply and Drainage.   There are about 3500 Community Based Organizations covering approximately 600,000 families formed under this Scheme. description: H.E. the President?s visit to Perth, Australia for the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) 2011 - Report to the Cabinet of Ministers by the Minister of External Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-02
decision_details_body: - the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) was held in Perth, Australia from 28 - 30 October 2011. During the meeting, Sri Lanka led by H.E. the President was able to secure its position as the CHOGM venue for the year of 2013, amidst the campaigns against it. During the final executive session of the meeting , H.E. the President invited the Heads of State and their delegations for CHOGM 2013 to Sri Lanka, which was followed by visual presentation of the conference facilities and the variety of facets of the country. H.E. the President also participated in the Business Forum and delivered the keynote address at the session on "Indian Ocean and the Pacific Rim: Fast Growing Markets", in which he highlighted the economic growth prospects in Sri Lanka. Having 'pull-aside' meetings with the counterparts of Australia, Singapore, Mauritius, Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Uganda, Zambia, Kenya, Nigeria , Malaysia and Ghana, H.E. the President was able to effectively exchange views regarding Sri Lanka's progress on post conflict reconstruction,  rehabilitation, reconciliation and economic development. Meanwhile, Hon. G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs has briefed the international media about the success achieved in post conflict developments in Sri Lanka. Cabinet of Ministers noted the details enumerated in the Note and congratulated H.E. the President, Hon. Minister of External Affairs and the other Members of the delegation on the achievements made in improving international relations.

description: Report on Sri Lanka?s Participation at the United Nations Human Rights Council (UNHRC) 18th Session - 12th to 30th September 2011
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-02
decision_details_body: - The 18th Session of the United Nations Human Rights Council (UNHRC) was held from 12th to 30th September 2011 in Geneva. Cabinet noted that the Sri Lankan delegation led by Hon. Mahinda Samarasinghe, Minister of Plantation Industries has been successful in precluding an  attempt by certain western countries to prejudge the national reconciliation process pursuant to the hearings and forthcoming conclusions of the Lessons Learnt and Reconciliation Commission (LLRC), at the next UN Human Rights Council (HRC) in March 2012. Cabinet further noted that the delegation has enlightened the representatives of Council Member States of the progress made in postwar reconstruction and initiatives to bring about reconciliations in the country.   Cabinet also noted that the position of Sri Lanka had been strengthened by the interactions of H.E. the President at the UN General Assembly in New York with several Heads of States and Government at which the current situation in the country was extensively discussed.

description: National Institute of Business Management - Annual Report - 2009
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-02
decision_details_body: - the National Institute of Business Management is presently functioning under the purview of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Skills Development as a statutory institution. It offers degrees approved by the University Grants Commission. In 2009, it followed methodologies such as opening on weekends and Government holidays in order to cater to the needs of the present labour market. In the same year, the productivity and management development sector earned Rs.132 million whereas it was Rs.96 million in the previous year. Besides the expansion of library facilities, the NIBM administration also took steps to establish two new Centres in Kurunegala and Kandy as Regional Centres.  The proposal made by Hon. Dallas Alahapperuma, Minister of Youth Affairs and Skills Development to present the Annual Report of the National Institute of Business Management for the year 2009 in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Report and Accounts of the Sri Lanka Insurance Board  - 2010
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-02
decision_details_body: - the total fund of the share holders of the Insurance Companies as at 31st December 2010 was Rs.42,326.9 million. It was a growth of 45.6% compared to the previous year. Also the total assets of all the Insurance Companies by the end of 2010 was Rs.222,242 million. It shows a growth of 22.7% compared to Rs.181,044 in the previous year. The Sri Lanka Insurance Board has also been able to acquire an accumulated premium income of Rs.68,493 million from Insurance activities within the year 2010.   The proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning to present the Annual Report and Accounts of Sri Lanka Insurance Board for the year 2010 in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Annual Report and Accounts of the Development Lotteries Board - 2010
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-02
decision_details_body: -  during the year under review the Development Lotteries Board has earned an income of Rs.5.67 billion.  Compared to its income in 2009 which stood at Rs.5.22 billion, this is a growth of 8.62%.  Also, Rs.3406 million has been given out as awards and a surplus income of Rs.937.9 million has been earned in the year 2010. It shows a growth of 70% compared to Rs.551.7 million earned as a surplus income in the year 2009. In addition, the Development Lotteries Board has also paid Rs.799.5 million to the President's Fund in 2010.  The proposal made by H.E. the President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning to present the Annual Report and Accounts of the Development Lotteries Board for the year 2010 in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Construction of Hambantota Heritage Museum
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-02

By the proposed museum, it is envisaged to present Ruhunu cultural heritage to the local and foreign travelers visiting the south via new Hambantota port and the proposed International Airport. The museum will also be a tourist  destination while providing a highly valuable educational opportunity to the local students.  The proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Jagath Balasuriya, Minister of National Heritage, to establish the above museum in the old Kachcheri building complex at Hambantota, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Relocation of the Ministry of External Affairs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-11-02
decision_details_body: - due to the expansion of the functions and responsibilities of the Ministry of External Affairs, the number of operational divisions and staff has increased fourfold over the past two decades. The Consular Affairs Division alone caters to over 1000 members of the public on daily basis. Despite the rented additional space, the Ministry continues to lack adequate space and facilities for the members of the staff, to carry out their functions effectively.  The Republic Building where the Ministry of External Affairs is located requires extensive repairs and maintenance which would not be cost effective in the long run.  Thus, the proposal made by Hon. G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, to relocate the Ministry of External Affairs at Battaramulla and to proceed with the formalities for the new building complex for the Ministry of External Affairs, was approved by the Cabinet.

decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-10-19
decision_details_body: - the annual consumption of Pharmaceutical Products by the Government is around Rs.15 billion and it represents well over 35% of the domestic consumption.  The Government intends to introduce a system to procure government pharmaceutical requirements from local manufacturers by the Ministry of Health to promote the local pharmaceutical industry.  Steps have been taken by the Ministry of Industry and Commerce to provide laboratory facilities in collaboration with the University of Colombo to facilitate testing of products and also to assist the industry to obtain required short term technical training overseas.  On a proposal made Hon. Rishad Bathiudeen, Minister of Industry and Commerce, a Dedicated Industrial Zone for life sciences is to be established to promote local production.  At the moment over 10 reputed pharmaceutical manufacturers have expressed their willingness to invest in this industry.  The above proposal made by the Minister, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appropriation Bill for the Financial Year 2012
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-10-06
decision_details_body: - the Appropriation Bill for the Financial Year 2012 submitted by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance and Planning, was approved for presentation in Parliament, after publishing it in the Government Gazette.  In the preparation of this Bill, H.E. the President and the General Treasury had consulted each line Ministry and other stakeholders, mainly with a view to formulating a realistic budget to divert resources for priority areas identified in the "Mahinda Chinthana"  and phased out in the  Medium Term Expenditure Frame Work 2012 - 2014.  In this process, priority has been given for the completion of ongoing development activities, before allocating resources for new projects.   Budget Estimates for 2012 are to be prepared with the aim of containing the budget deficit at 6.2 percent of the Gross Domestic Product in order to ensure that economic development is maintained at 8 percent and the rate of annual inflation at 6 to 7 percent.  The total estimated expenditure for 2012 is to be Rs.2220 billion, necessitating an increase in Recurrent Expenditure from Rs.1029 billion in 2011 to Rs.1109 billion in 2012, and the Capital Expenditure from Rs.938 billion to Rs.1111 billion.  Public Investment has increased from Rs.453 billion in 2011 to Rs.541 billion in 2012 in order to maintain the momentum in the growth rate of 8 percent.

description: Approval for 10 year Development plan for the Implementation of Medium/Large Scale Irrigation Projects by the Ministry of Irrigation & Water Resources Management
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-28
decision_details_body:
- Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, Minister of Irrigation & Water Resources Management, presented an Investment Plan for the development of this sector in the ensuing ten years.  In the preparation of this Plan due consideration has been given to meet all the water requirements by optimum utilization of the water resources in the country.  The following are included in this Plan:

*	Diversion of Siyambalangamuwa Oya to augment Maha Galgamuwa Wewa - this is an ancient tank located in Ehetuwewa Divisional Secretary's Division in the Kurunegala District.  Augmentation of this tank will enable to ensure irrigation water to 1200 acres of existing land and 200 acres of new land. It is proposed to cultivate paddy, chillies, red onion and maize in both Yala and Maha seasons.





*	Construction of Lower Malwathu Oya Reservoir - it is planned to provide irrigation water for 809 hectares of new land immediately down stream of the proposed reservoir and to cultivate mainly fruits crops, such as mango, guava and grapes etc.

*	Ridemaliyadde Integrated Development Project - this project is expected to upgrade available irrigation infrastructure, provide 100 agro wells for highland cultivation and 100 drinking water wells, introduce commercial crop cultivation  in 1100 hectares, livestock related income opportunities for 1000 families and provide sanitary facilities, roads etc.

*	Weli Oya (Mahaweli System L) Integrated Development - this project will provide facilities for irrigating 1700 hectares of new land and 700 hectares of existing lands for cultivation of paddy and other field crops in Maha and Yala seasons.  2400 farmer families in System L area will be benefited by this Scheme.  The tentative cost of this project is Rs.6000 million. 

*	Extension of Kaudulla L.B. Main Canal upto Damsopura Wewa -  the proposed project is expected to provide irrigation facilities to 1850 acres of paddy land including 870 acres new land.
	
*	Rambaken Oya Integrated Development Project - the project will enhance the benefits of the Rambukkan  Oya Reservoir Project and improve the living standards of the community living in Maha Oya and Padiyathalawa D.S. Divisions which are considered as under developed areas.

*	System B - Maduru Oya Right Bank Development Project - the proposed project consists of construction of 76.9 Km. length of canal network and to provide irrigation facilities for 14,000 hectares. The project will enhance the living standards of 12630 settlers in zones 7 and 8. 

	Cabinet approval was granted for the implementation of the above projects.
