description: Commencing a Third Cultivation Season Under State Patronage
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-21
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Mahinda Yapa Abeywardena, Minister of Agriculture, to commence a Third Cultivation Season between Yala and Maha Seasons for the cultivation of short term leguminous food crops such as, green gram, cowpea, black gram, with the objective of increasing food production and reducing food imports and also to provide opportunities for farmers to generate additional income, was approved by the Cabinet. The Government intends to encourage farmers to cultivate leguminous crops utilizing organic fertilizer for these food crops which would in turn reduce the use of imported chemical fertilizers and also increase the fertility of the soil.  The new cultivation season will be from August to October and the introduction of this new season would enhance the extent of land utilize for agricultural purposes.  Suitable areas identified for cultivation of these short term crops are Hambantota, Moneragala, Anuradhapura, Ampara, Polonnaruwa, Kurunegala and Hasalaka as well as Mahaweli Systems of Galnewa and Girandurukotte.

description: Annual Report and Accounts of the National Lotteries Board - 2010
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-14
decision_details_body: - the National Lotteries Board continued to make a steady progress and achieved a turnover of Rs.8,862.8 million in 2010, compared to Rs.8580.5 million in 2009, which is an increase of 282.3 million. The contribution to the Consolidated Fund in 2010 was Rs.1336.1 million as against Rs.1136.2 million in 2009. The Board has projected a sale figure of Rs.10.0 billion in 2011, which is an increase of around 13% over the previous year. The above Report submitted by H.E. the President as the Minister of Finance and Planning, was approved for presentation in Parliament.

description: Provincial Roads Project Funded By the World Bank Awarding of Supervision Consultancy Contract for Civil Work Contracts - Jaffna District - Northern Province
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-14
decision_details_body: - the World Bank has allocated US$ 105 million for rehabilitation and upgrading provincial roads in Uva, Eastern and Northern Provinces.  The proposal made by Hon. A.L.M. Athaullah, Minister of Local Government and Provincial Councils, to spend US$ 736,805.20 of the proceeds of this loan and a sum of Rs.213,191,748.20 local funds for the supervision of construction of civil contracts in the Jaffna District, Northern Province, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Secondary Towns and Rural Community based Water Supply & Sanitation Project - Sri Lanka -ADB Loan Nos.1993 SRI (SF), 2275 SRI, 2276 SRI (SF) - Construction and Completion of head works, Raw Water Transmission Main, Treatment Plant and Treated Water Pumping main (Plant & Design Build)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-14

description: Construction of 500 Housing Units at Dematagoda under Relocation of Underserved Settlement Project (Resettlement Programme - Phase II) Award of the Contract for Super Structure Work
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-14
decision_details_body: -  construction of 320 Housing Units under Phase I of 1000 Housing Units Programme at Dematagoda was completed and these Housing Units have been allocated to the occupants of underserved settlements in Slave Island area. Under Phase II of the Programme, it is proposed to construct 500 Housing Units in  two, ten storied buildings at Dematagoda.  Piling work in 1 block is fully completed and 60% of work in the other block has also been completed. The proposal made by H.E. the President, on the recommendation of the Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee,  to award the contract for the superstructure works of Phase II for a sum of Rs.952.62 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Heritage Information and Activity Centre
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-14
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. (Dr.) Jagath Balasuriya, Minister of National Heritage, for the establishment of a Heritage Information and Activity Centre to provide information about all heritage sites in Sri Lanka on Provincial and District Basis through a well designed Web Site, leaflets and brochures at a cost of Rs.106 million, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a District Aquaculture Extension Office for Kilinochchi District
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-14
decision_details_body:
- 
Inland Fisheries and Aquaculture has been identified as a source of livelihood for the people in the Northern Province. These programmes are implemented in the North under the National Aquaculture Development Authority. At present about 4000 people are engaged in Inland Fisheries in the Northern Province. The proposal made by Hon. Rajitha Senaratne, Minister of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Development to establish a District Aquaculture Extension Office in the Kilinochchi District, at Kilinochchi, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: "Deyata Sevana" National Tree Planting Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-14
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Anura Priyadharshana Yapa, Minister of Environment, to inaugurate this year's "Deyata Sevana" National Tree Planting Programme on 15th November 2011 at the premises of the Ranaviru Upahara "Sandahiruseya" in Anuradhapura and to implement this programme islandwide, in collaboration with all Ministries, Departments, Corporations,  Statutory Boards, Provincial Councils, Local Authorities and District and Divisional Secretariats, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Post Office Networking Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-14
decision_details_body: - the project initiated with Cabinet approval, with a view to providing an efficient and reliable postal service through amalgamating its network of 648 Post Offices throughout the Island is being successfully implemented. The General Treasury initially provided Rs.300 million for the project. On a proposal made by Hon. Jeevan Kumaratunga, Minister of Postal Services, approval was granted to provide an additional allocation of Rs.348.8 million for the successful completion of the project.

description: Construction of a new three storied building for the Divisional Secretariat, Mathugama
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-14
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Public Administration and Home Affairs to construct a new three storied building, at a total cost of Rs.97.5 million, for the Divisional Secretariat, Mathugama, to provide better facilities for the residents in Mathugama, covering 57 Grama Niladhari Divisions with a population of 81,350, was approved by the Cabinet. Preliminary work is to commence in 2011 and the balance work will be completed in 2012.

description: Commemoration of World Habitat Day, 2011 - 03rd October 2011
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-14
decision_details_body: - since 1986, the first Monday in October has been declared as the World Habitat Day.  The main objective in commemorating  this day is to invite attention of all stakeholders in the settlement sectors with regard to problems existing in respect of housing and settlements and to find alternative solutions for same.  The proposal made by Hon. Wimal Weerawansa, Minister of Construction, Engineering Services, Housing and Common Amenities, to declare the Settlement Week from 29th September to 03rd October 2011 and to implement s series of programmes in this regard, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revision of total Cost Estimate of Kelani Right Bank Water Treatment Plant Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-14
decision_details_body: - the proposed project will improve the water supply to Colombo city and towns out of Colombo.   This project will develop the Water Treatment Plant in the Gampaha District and will serve a population of 350,000 with existing connections presently experiencing inadequate water supply and an additional population of 100,000 will be connected to the system.  The project is financed under the Danida Mixed Credit Programme.  The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to increase the foreign component of the project to Rs.8390 million and the local component to Rs.1760 million, was approved by the Cabinet. Funds for the purpose will be provided under the Medium Term Budgetary Framework 2012-2014.

description: The World Bank Grant Funded Project for Increasing Household Sewerage Connections and Off-Network Sanitary Solutions in Greater Colombo
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-09-14
decision_details_body: -  the objective of this project is to increase the number of sewerage connections to low income households in Dehiwala, Ratmalana, Moratuwa, Kolonnawa, Ja-Ela and Ekala areas.  The World Bank has agreed to increase their financial contribution for this project.  The project will benefit 15407 poor households who currently rely on unsanitary pit latrines, non-functioning septic tanks or have no sanitary facilities.  The total cost of the project will be US $9.96 million (approximately Rs.1096 million) consisting of World Bank Grant of 5.08 million and the balance from Domestic Funds.  The proposal made by Hon. Dinesh Gunawardena, Minister of Water Supply and Drainage, to proceed with the project and to include it in the Public Investment Programme 2011 - 2015, was approved by the Cabinet.
